english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”
translation_verse: Suakpole ye mɔɔ zua ɛke ala la bikye mɔɔ menriandi mekɔ zolɛ a ɔle kpalɛ a, yɛɛ eza ɔle ekyi. Bɛmaa menriandi mengɔ ɛkɛ ne na mebanyia ngoane.”

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.
translation_verse: Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Menwu wɔ anwunvɔne ɛhye noko, menrɛzɛkye sua zɔhane mɔɔ wɔha ye edwɛkɛ la.

english_verse: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there.” The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small. Sodom and Gomorrah Are Destroyed
translation_verse: Ka ɛ nwo nriandi kɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔboalekɛ saa ɛtɛdwule ɛkɛ ne a menrɛyɛ ɛhwee.” Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛle sua zɔhane Zowaa Sodɔm nee Gomɔla ɛzɛkyelɛ

english_verse: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Lɔɔto dwule Zowaa la, ɛnee sɛnzɛne ne ɛdudu.

english_verse: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle sɔlefe nee senle vi anwuma dɔle kɛ ezule guale Sodɔm nee Gomɔla azo.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: Na ɔzɛkyele azuamgbole zɔhane mɔ, bɔnza ne anu amuala, nee menli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la amuala, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ fifile azɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Na Lɔɔto aye ne mɔɔ ɛnee li ɔ nzi la dole ɔ nye ɔ nzi, na ɔhakyile ngyenle mpila.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔhɔgyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la.

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Ɔdole ɔ nye Sodɔm nee Gomɔla na ɔnleanle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la bɔnza ne anu la amuala azo, na ɔnwunle kɛ maanle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛyela la esike ne ɛdwazo bolonwonwo kɛ tɔlɔra senle.

english_verse: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction. Moab and Ammon
translation_verse: Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile zɛkyele azuamgbole zɔhane mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anu la ɛne. Noko ɔhakyele Ebileham, yemɔti ɔyele Lɔɔto ɔvile nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔsɛkye azuamgbole mɔɔ Lɔɔto dɛnlanle zolɛ la. Mowabema nee Amɔnoma abo

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Lɔɔto sulo kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla Zowaa, yemɔti ɔ nee ɔ mra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne dule vile Zowaa na bɛhɔdɛnlanle bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ awoka ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Na ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne zele ekyi ne kɛ, “Yɛ ze ɛyɛ kpanyinli, yɛɛ nrenya biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ye azo mɔɔ nee yɛ kɛla, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye ewiade amuala la.

english_verse: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.”
translation_verse: Bɛla, maa yɛnloa egya nwanye yɛmaa ɔbo, na yɛ nee ye ɛla, amaa yɛ nee ye anyia mralɛ yɛazie yɛ gyakɛ anu.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kenle ko ne nɔe ne bɛmanle bɛ ze nwanye bɛmanle ɔbole na ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne nee ye hɔlale. Ɔbole kpole somaa, yemɔti yeannwu kɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ne zile ralale na yeayɛ ye ɛdwazolɛ nu.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la, ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne zele ekyi ne kɛ, “Nea, nɔe me nee egya lale. Maa yɛmaa ɔnlo nwanye ɔbo bieko ɛnɛ nɔe na ɛ nee ye ɛhɔla, na ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛanyia mralɛ.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kenle ko ne nɔe ne bɛmanle bɛ ze nlonle nwanye bole, na ralɛ raalɛ ekyi ne doale ye nee ye hɔlale. Noko bɛ ze annwu ye, ɔluakɛ ɔbole somaa.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ Lɔɔto amra mraalɛ nwiɔ ne nee bɛ ze nrenzɛle a.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Ralɛ raalɛ kpanyinli ne wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Mowabe. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Mowabema mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Ekyi ne noko wole ralɛ nrenya na ɔdonle ye Bɛnamae. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Amɔnoma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Na Ebileham zele kɛ, “Sɛla le me diema raalɛ.” Yemɔti Gilaa Belemgbunli Abemɛlɛke zoanle manle bɛhɔvale Sɛla bɛrale ye sua nu.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle rahanle Abemɛlɛke ɛlalɛ kɛ, “Nea, raalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhɔva ye la ati, wɔwu wɔwie; ɔluakɛ ɔle awie aye.”

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Ɔdaye nrenya ne yɛɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele me kɛ ɔ diema raalɛ a, yɛɛ ɔdaye raalɛ ne ɔdole zolɛ kɛ ɔ diema nrenya ɔ. Me ti anu wienyi, yɛɛ metɛfale me sa metɛkanle ye.”

english_verse: Then God continued: I know you are innocent. That's why I kept you from sleeping with Sarah and doing anything wrong.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle buale ye kɛ, “Meze kɛ ɛ ti anu wienyi, yɛɛ medame yɛɛ menzɔle wɔ mɔɔ wɔannyia adenle wɔanyɛ ɛtane wɔantia me a, yemɔti a meammaa wɔanva ɛ sa wɔanga ye a.

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Yemɔti fa nrenya ne aye ne kɔmaa ye. Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, ɔbazɛlɛ yeamaa wɔ, na wɔanyia ngoane. Na saa wɔanva raalɛ ne wɔangɔ a, ɛnee nwu ye kɛ ɛdawɔ nee wɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti bawu.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Abemɛlɛke dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔvɛlɛle ye sonvolɛma ne amuala na ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne amuala ɔhilele bɛ. Na ɛzulolɛ hanle menli ne mɔ.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Akee Abemɛlɛke vɛlɛle Ebileham na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔva wɔyɛ yɛ la? Duzu ɛtane yɛɛ meyɛ metia wɔ, mɔɔ wɔva munzule kpole ɛhye wɔra me nee me maanlema anwo zo a? Wɔyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la wɔmaa me.

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Duzu a ɛnee ɛlɛdwenle nwolɛ mɔɔ yemɔti ɛyɛle deɛ ɛhye a?”

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Ebileham buale kɛ, “Menyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɛke amra ɛnzulo Nyamenle fee, na me ye ati bɛkɛhu me.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Yeanga ye zɔhane, nɔhalɛ, eza ɔle me diema. Ɔle me ze ara raalɛ, na me nee ye ɛnvi ɛkolɛ ko anu, yɛɛ ɔrayɛle me ye a.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle maanle mendule egya sua nu kɛ menlɔ nu la, menganle mengilele ye kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye ɛmaa me; ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkɛhɔ la, ka kɛ ɛ diema nrenya a le me.’ ”

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Akee Abemɛlɛke vale mboane, nlankɛ, yɛɛ ahanra mrenya nee mraalɛ manle Ebileham, na ɔvale ɔ ye Sɛla ɔmanle ye.

english_verse: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.
translation_verse: Abemɛlɛke zele Ebileham kɛ, “Nea, me azɛlɛ ne a ɛ nye dua ye la; tɛnla ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la.”

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma rakpɔlale Sɛla, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ala la, na ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la ɔmanle ye.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Na Sɛla nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya ɔmanle Ebileham wɔ ye mrelera nu, wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle nee ye dendɛle nwolɛ la.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: Ayezeke lile kenle mɔtwɛ la, Ebileham yɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye la.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Na Sɛla hanle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa ɛzelekɛ ɛdɔ me nwo. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛde me nganeɛ la nee me bazele.”

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ. “Nwane ala bɔbɔ yɛɛ anrɛɛ kɛhola kɛze Ebileham kɛ Sɛla banloa ngakula nyɛfonlɛ a? Noko akee mɔɔ yeyɛ ɛrelera la mewo ralɛ nrenya memaa ye.”

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Kakula ne nyinli, na kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɔpɛle nyɛfonlɛ la, ɔ ze Ebileham dole nwolɛ ɛkponle kpole bie. Bɛvoa Heega nee Yehyemeeyɛle

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔzele Ebileham kɛ, “To raalɛ akɛlɛ ne nee ɔ ra nrenya ne adenle zo, ɔluakɛ akɛlɛ ɛhye ara nrenya ne nee me ra Ayezeke ɛnrɛbɔ nu ɛnrɛli agya ko.”

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele Ebileham kɛ, “Mmadwenle ɛ ra nrenya ne nee wɔ akɛlɛ raalɛ ne anwo. Di edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Sɛla ɛha ɛhile wɔ la azo, ɔluakɛ ɛ bo zo amra vi Ayezeke anu a bara a.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ akɛlɛ raalɛ ne ɛwo ye la noko ada ayɛ maanle, ɔboalekɛ ɔle ɛ ra.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔvale aleɛ nee nzule nwoma kodoku ko ɔmanle Heega vale dole ɔ kɔme zo, na ɔdole ye nee ɔ ra ne adenle zo. Heega hɔle na ɔhɔluoluale Biyɛhyiba fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Ye nzule ne wiele la, ɔgyakyile ɔ ra ne ɔdole aziakɛ bie abo.

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Nyamenle dele kakula ne ane, na Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma vɛlɛle Heega na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Heega, duzu a ɛlɛgyegye wɔ a? Mmasulo, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛde kakula ne ane wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Dwazo, kɔmaa kakula ne zo na nea ye boɛ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ mebamaa yeayɛ maanle kpole.”

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle bukele ɔ nye, na Heega nwunle bula bie mɔɔ nzule wɔ nu la, na ɔhɔle nwolɛ ɔhɔzale bie ɔguale ye nwoma kodoku ne anu ɔmanle ɔyile na ɔnloanle ɔ ra ne bie.

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati fa Nyamenle ka ndane kile me kɛ, ɛnrɛbɛlɛbɛla me, anzɛɛ me mra, anzɛɛ me bo zo amra mɔɔ bara la amuala, na kɛmɔ meli nɔhalɛ memaa wɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛbayɛ wɔamaa me nee azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ wɔra zolɛ la azo amra a.”

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Na Ebileham zele kɛ, “Mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ zɔhane.”

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Ebileham hanle nzule bula bie mɔɔ Abemɛlɛke sonvolɛma ne liele vile ɔ sa nu la anwo edwɛkɛ hilele ye.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Na Abemɛlɛke zele kɛ, “Menze ahenle mɔɔ yɛle zɔhane debie la. Wɔanga wɔangile me, yɛɛ metɛtele ye ɛlɛ kɛ ɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Akee Ebileham vale mboane nee nlankɛ manle Abemɛlɛke, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛhyele ɔ bo.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Ebileham yele mboane mbelɛ nsuu vile ye mboane ne anu ziele ahane.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Ebileham buale kɛ, “Die me sa nu mboane nsuu ɛhye fa di daselɛ, kɛ medame yɛɛ membɔle bula ɛhye a.”

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛvɛlɛle ɛleka ne Biyɛhyiba, ɔboalekɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlile amonle a.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛyɛle ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye wɔ Biyɛhyiba, na Abemɛlɛke nee Faekɔlo, ye safohyenlema kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema anwo zo la ziale hɔle Filisitia.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Ebileham luale “Tamaleseke” baka wɔ Biyɛhyiba ɛkɛ, na ɔzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na Ebileham dɛnlanle Filisitia maanle nu hyɛle kpalɛ.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ anzi Nyamenle zɔle Ebileham nleanle na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ebileham!” Na Ebileham liele zolɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fa ɛ ra nrenya ne, ɛ ra kokye Ayezeke, mɔɔ la wɔ ahonle nwo la, na kɔ Molaya azɛlɛ zo kɔyela ye bɔ azu wɔ awoka ne mɔ ko mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo maa me.”

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ebileham dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala na ɔzieziele ye asoaso ne, ɔvale ye sonvolɛma nwiɔ yɛɛ ɔ ra Ayezeke; akee ɔpepɛle ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeayela azubɔdeɛ ne la, na ɔhɔle ɛleka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha kɛ ɔhɔ la.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Bɛzile nu na ye kenle nsa ne azo, Ebileham nwunle ɛleka ne kɛ ɔwɔ moa moa nehane.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Ebileham zele ye sonvolɛma nwiɔ ne kɛ, “Bɛ nee asoaso ne ɛhendɛ ɛke, na me nee kpavolɛ ye yɛkɔ nehane yeahɔzonle na yɛara.”

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Akee Ebileham vale ɛyɛne ne zoale ɔ ra Ayezeke na ɔdaye ɔvale senle ne nee dadeɛ ne. Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛzile nu kɛ bɛkɔ.

english_verse: Isaac said, “Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?” “My son,” Abraham answered, “God will provide the lamb.” The two of them walked on, and
translation_verse: Ebileham buale kɛ, “Me ra nrenya, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbava boane ralɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ yɛbayela yɛabɔ azu ne la yeamaa yɛ.” Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛluale nwolɛ bɛhɔle.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛhɔdwule ɛleka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ hilele Ebileham la, Ebileham zile azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔvale ɛyɛne ne ɔguale zolɛ, na ɔkyekyele ɔ ra Ayezeke ɔdole azukponle ne azo, wɔ ɛyɛne ne azo.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Akee Ebileham dole ɔ sa vale dadeɛ ne kɛ ɔku ɔ ra ne.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ vɛlɛle ye vile anwuma, ɔse, “Ebileham, Ebileham!” Ebileham liele zolɛ, “Mewɔ ɛke!”

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka kakula ne anzɛɛ mmayɛ ye debie. Ɔluakɛ kɛkala, menwu kɛ ɛsulo Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ wɔanva ɛ ra kokye ne wɔanyɛ me abokɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Na Ebileham manle ɔ nye zo na ɔnwunle kɛ, ɔ nzi ɛkɛ ne ala, boane nyinli kpole ko mɔɔ ye mɛne ne mɔ ɛmaa yetosa aziakɛ bie anu la gyi ɛkɛ. Ebileham hɔyele boane nyinli ne, ɔgyakyile ɔ ra ne na ɔvale boane ne ɔyelale ye, ɔbɔle azu ne.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ebileham vɛlɛle ɛleka ne, “Ɛdɛnkɛma bahile.” Na kɛkala bɔbɔ menli ka kɛ, “Wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne azo, ɔdaye ɔbahile.”

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne eza vɛlɛle Ebileham vi anwuma bieko,

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Meka medame mumua ne me nwo kɛ, ɛhye mɔɔ wɔyɛ, na wɔanva ɛ ra nrenya kokye ne wɔanyɛ me abokɛ la,

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: mebayila wɔ na meamaa ɛ bo zo amra ayɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra nee ɛnweazo anwea. Ɛ bo zo amra bali bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo konim na bɛazie bɛ,

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: na ɛ bo zo amra anwo zo yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la balua anyia nyilalɛ a, ɔboalekɛ wɔdie me ne.’ ”

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ebileham ziale rale ye mgbavolɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛ muala bɛziale bɛhɔle Biyɛhyiba. Na Ebileham dɛnlanle Biyɛhyiba. Neehɔ abo zo amra

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Ye mgbɔnla Wulumaa ɔdaye noko ɔwole Tiba, Geeham, Teehahye, yɛɛ Meeyaka.

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: “Mele ɛyɛvolɛ a mede bɛ avinli ɛke a; bɛmaa me azɛlɛ mendɔ menyɛ me azie menzie me funli wɔ zolɛ.”

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Yɛmenle, tie mɔɔ yɛka la. Ɛle belemgbunli kpole a ɛwɔ yɛ avinli a. Ɛdawɔ neɛnlea yɛ nla ne mɔ na sie wɔ funli ne wɔ nla biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la anu. Yɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛva ye nla ɛnrɛyɛ wɔ abokɛ, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛgyegye wɔ wɔ funli ne ɛzielɛ nu.”

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛkulo kɛ mesie me funli ne a, ɛnee mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛzɛlɛ Zohaa ara Yifolɔn

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: bɛmaa ɔva ye bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Makepilaa la ɔmaa me. Ɔwɔ ye azɛlɛ ne abo lɔ. Metɔ meadua ye kakɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nyunlu ɛke, na meava meayɛ azie.”

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Ɛnee Yifolɔn de Hɛtema ne avinli, na ɔbuale Ebileham ɔmanle Hɛtema mɔɔ yiale ɛkɛ ne la kɔsɔɔti dele. Ɔse,

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Me menle, kyɛkyɛ, tie mɔɔ meka la. Mefa azɛlɛ ne memaa wɔ, yɛɛ bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Mefa memaa wɔ, wɔ me menli ye mɔɔ ɛyia ɛke la amuala anyunlu. Fa sie wɔ funli ne.”

english_verse: Once again, Abraham bowed down
translation_verse: Na Ebileham dwazole bɔle ɔ ti aze wɔ Hɛtema anyunlu,

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: na ɔhanle ɔhilele Yifolɔn, ɔmanle Hɛtema mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛkɛ ne la amuala dele bie kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, tie medame noko. Metua azɛlɛ ne kakɛ. Die, na maa menzie me funli ne wɔ zolɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham accepted Ephron's offer and paid him the
translation_verse: rayɛle Ebileham ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɔdaye ye agyadeɛ ɔ, wɔ Hɛtema mɔɔ rayiale la kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi akee Ebileham hɔziele ɔ ye Sɛla wɔ bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Makepilaa mɔɔ wɔ Mameli aduduleɛ la anu, wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Akee Ebileham yɛle kpanyinli kpalɛ, ɔyɛle ɛrelera nwosonwoso. Ɛdɛnkɛma noko ɛyila ye wɔ debie biala anu.

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Mekulo kɛ ɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la ɛka ndane kɛ, ɛnrɛgya Keenama mɔɔ mede bɛ avinli la amra mraalɛ ne mɔ bie ɛnrɛmaa me ra nrenya ne,

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: na ɛkɛhɔ me maanle nu wɔ me nwo amra anu, na ɛkɛhɔgya raalɛ ɛkɛmaa me ra Ayezeke.”

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ ne bizale ye kɛ, “Na saa ngyengyene nu bie ala raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔnrɛra ɛke a, ɛnee memanva ɛ ra nrenya ye mengɔ maanle ne mɔɔ ɛvi nu ɛrale la anu ɔ?”

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Ebileham buale ye kɛ, “Nea boɛ na wɔanva me ra nrenya ne wɔanzia wɔangɔ maanle zɔhane anu.

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma, mɔɔ yele me vile egya sua nu nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ me kotoa nyɛma la zolɛ la azo, na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele me, ɔbɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra yɛɛ mebava azɛlɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ’ la, bamaa ye soanvolɛ alumua ɛ nyunlu, na wɔagya raalɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne wɔarɛlɛ me ra ye.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Na saa raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔ nee wɔ ɛnrɛra a, ɛndo ndane ne mɔɔ melɛmaa wɔaha la; noko mmafa me ra nrenya ne ɛsia ɛkɔ lɔ.”

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Yemɔti sonvolɛ ne vale ɔ sa vulale ɔ menle Ebileham ɛzɔlɛ nu na ɔhanle ndane ɔhilele Ebileham wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Akee sonvolɛ ne vale ɔ menle afunlumu ne mɔ anu bulu na ɔzile nu ɔhɔle. Ɔvale ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔ menle ne ɛnlea ɛkpa nu ɛyeye la, na ɔhɔle Mɛsɔpɔteemea maanzinli nu suakpole ne mɔɔ Neehɔ dɛnlanle zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔdwule sua ne kandiba la, ɔmanle afunlumu ne mɔ hotohotole suakpole ne bane ne anzi wɔ bula ne azo. Ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛmua nwolɛ na yedwu mekɛ mɔɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ sesa nzule a.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Na sonvolɛ ne zele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle, maa menli konim ɛnɛ kenle ye. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kile ɛhulolɛ kpundii mɔɔ ɛlɛ wɔ me menle Ebileham anwo la.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: Megyi bula ye azo ɛke, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ɛhye azo la amra mraalɛ ɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛba bɛarasesa nzule.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: Maa kakula raalɛ ne mɔɔ menwɔze ye kɛ, ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, ka wɔ dwora ne aze maa meno wɔ nzule ne bie,’ na ɔkɛbua me kɛ, ‘No bie, na maa memaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ bie bɛnlo’ la, ɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye wɔmaa Ayezeke la. Ɛhye bamaa meanwu kɛ wɔhulo me menle ne kpole kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ ne nriandile hɔyiale ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa meno nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ dwora ne anu la bie.”

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛra ne buale kɛ, “Me menle, no bie.” Na ɔhanle ye dwora ne aze, ɔlɛle ye ɔ sa nu ɔmanle ɔnlonle nzule ne bie.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔwolale mɔɔ ɔzo la ɔguale kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛgua afunlumu ne mɔ nzule nu la anu. Ɔnriandile ɔhɔle nzubula ne anloa ɔhɔzale nzule ne bie ɔrɛlɛle afunlumu ne mɔ amuala ɔmanle bɛnlonle.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Nrenya ne nleanle Relɛbɛka koonwu na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnea saa Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi ɔ nzi wɔ ye adendulɛ ne anu a.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ afunlumu ne mɔ wiele nzule no la, sonvolɛ ne vale ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba mɔɔ ye bolɛ yɛ se la zɔle bɛlɛra ne abonyi na ɔvale nwiɔ noko ɔguale ɔ sa.

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛ ze a le nwane? Ka kile me. Asoo ɛ ze lɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛkola yɛbasokoɛ nu a?”

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Relɛbɛka buale kɛ, “Neehɔ nee ɔ ye Melekaa bɛ ra nrenya Bɛtuwɛle ara raalɛ a le me.”

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Yɛlɛ ndile nee nya nya mɔɔ nane di a, yɛɛ eza yɛlɛ sua mɔɔ bɛbala nu a.”

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ ne bɔle ɔ ti aze zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Akee Relɛbɛka nriandile hɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele ɔ nli awuke nu amra.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Leeban nwunle bɛ bonyi nee bɛ sa ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ nrenya ne ɛva ɛziezie Relɛbɛka na ɔdele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔ diema raalɛ ne hanle ye wɔ nwolɛ amuala la, ɔhɔle sonvolɛ ne anwo lɔ na ɔhɔdole ye kɛ ɔgyi ye afunlumu ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ, wɔ nzubula ne anloa.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ a, bɛla. Mmagyinla ahane nehane. Ɔluakɛ meziezie ɛleka memaa wɔ nee wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Yemɔti nrenya ne rale sua nu; Leeban zianyinle ye afunlumu ne mɔ na ɔmanle bɛ ndile nee nya nya. Ɔmanle nrenya ne nee ye menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la nzule bɛnrinzinle bɛ gyakɛ anwo.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Akee bɛmanle bɛ debie kɛ bɛli. Na nrenya ne zele kɛ, “Saa metɛbɔle me amaneɛ ne a, menrɛli debie.” Leeban zele kɛ, “Bɔ wɔ amaneɛ ne.”

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Nrenya ne zele kɛ, “Mele Ebileham sonvolɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila me menle kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ yeyɛ sonlakpole. Yemaa yenyia mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo; yenyia ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule dɔɔnwo. Ɔlɛ ye sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ, yɛɛ afunlumu nee asoaso.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Me menle aye Sɛla yɛle kpanyinli kpalɛ la, ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Na ralɛ nrenya zɔhane yɛɛ me menle ne ɛva debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛmaa ye a.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Me menle ɛmaa meha ndane, ɔse, ‘Mmagya Keenama mɔɔ mede bɛ avinli la mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bie ɛmaa me ra nrenya ne.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Kɔ me maanle nu, me ze sua nu, medame me nwo amra anu, na kɔgya raalɛ maa me ra nrenya ne.’

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: Membizale ye kɛ, ‘Na saa raalɛ ne se kɛ ɔnrɛra ɛ?’

english_verse: My master answered, “I have always obeyed the Lord, and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.
translation_verse: Na ɔbuale me kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mesonle ye la bamaa ye soanvolɛ nee wɔ ahɔ na yeamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ moavolɛ, na wɔagya raalɛ wɔ me nwo amra avinli, wɔ egya sua nu, wɔamaa me ra nrenya ne.

english_verse: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.”
translation_verse: Saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛanva raalɛ ne bɛammaa wɔ a, yemɔ ɛnee ɛndo ndane ne mɔɔ wɔha la.’

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: “Ɛnɛ ala a membandwule nzubula ne anwo a, na menganle kɛ, ‘O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle, saa amgba ala me adendulɛ ye kɛyɛ saleɛ a,

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: ɛnee kɛkala mɔɔ megyi nzubula ye anloa la, maa kakula raalɛ mɔɔ kɛra kɛ ɔbaza nzule, na menwɔze ye kɛ: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa me wɔ nzule ne ekyi meno,’

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: na ɔkɛze me kɛ, ‘Banlo bie, na maa menza bie memaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ la ɛyɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔye ye kɛ mengya ye memaa me menle ara nrenya ne la.’

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Me nloa ampe bɔbɔ, yɛɛ Relɛbɛka ravindele ɛkɛ ne a, ɔzo ye dwora ɔ kɔme zo kɛ ɔbaza nzule. Ɔzale nzule ne la, menzele ye kɛ, ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa meno bie.’

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔhanle ye dwora ne aze na ɔzele kɛ, ‘No bie, na eza mebaza bie meamaa wɔ afunlumu ne mɔ noko anlo.’

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: Akee membizale ye kɛ, ‘Nwane ara raalɛ a le wɔ?’ Ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Mele Neehɔ nee ɔ ye Melekaa bɛ ra nrenya Bɛtuwɛle ara raalɛ.’ Yemɔti menvale ngɛba menzɔle ɔ bonyi na menvale bie menguale ɔ sa.

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: Akee membɔle me ti aze na menzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na menyele Ɛdɛnkɛma, me menle Ebileham Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, kɛ yeva me yelua adenle kpalɛ zo yemaa menyia raalɛ wɔ me menle anwo amra anu memaa ɔ ra nrenya ne a.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, saa bɛkɛkponle na bɛkɛli nɔhalɛ bɛkɛmaa me menle ne ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛha. Saa bɛnrɛkponle noko a, eza bɛha, amaa meanwu me bɛne nee me fema.”

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Leeban nee Bɛtuwɛle buale kɛ, “Deɛ mumua ne vi Ɛdɛnkɛma; yɛngola yɛnga nwolɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: Relɛbɛka a lua ɛkɛ ne la, fa ye ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ na maa ɔhɔyɛ ɛ menle ara nrenya ne aye, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ala la.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant bowed down and thanked the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ebileham sonvolɛ ne dele bɛ edwɛkɛ ne la, ɔdule ɔdɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɔyeyɛle ye.

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale anwoneɛ mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛ yɛɛ anwoneɛ mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la ɔmanle Relɛbɛka. Eza ɔmanle ye adɛladeɛ. Ɔvale ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la noko ɔmanle Leeban nee ɔ nli.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Na sonvolɛ ne nee menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua la akee lile na bɛnlonle, na bɛlale. Bɛdwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, sonvolɛ ne zele kɛ, “Bɛmaa me adenle mengɔ me menle anwo lɔ.”

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
translation_verse: Relɛbɛka adiema nrenya ne nee ɔ nli zele ye kɛ, “Maa kakula raalɛ ne nee yɛ ɛdɛnla kenle kɛyɛ bulu na ɛ nee ye ahɔ.”

english_verse: But he said, “Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.”
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ ne buale kɛ, “Bɛmmasi me aze. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa me adendule ne ɛyɛ kɛnlɛma, bɛmaa me adenle mengɔ me menle anwo lɔ.”

english_verse: They answered, “Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛvɛlɛ kakula raalɛ ne yɛbiza ye.”

english_verse: They called her and asked, “Are you willing to leave with this man at once?” “Yes,” she answered.
translation_verse: Na bɛvɛlɛle Relɛbɛka bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛ nee nrenya ye kɛhɔ ɔ?” Na ɔbuale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, me nee ye kɔ.”

english_verse: So they agreed to let Rebekah and an old family servant woman leave immediately with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmanle Relɛbɛka nee ye raalɛ ne mɔɔ sonle ye la, nee Ebileham sonvolɛ ne nee ye menli ne mɔ adenle.

english_verse: They gave Rebekah their blessing and said, “We pray that God will give you many children and grandchildren and that he will help them defeat their enemies.”
translation_verse: Na bɛyileyilale Relɛbɛka bɛzele kɛ, “Adiema raalɛ, yɛ menli mgbe mgbe bɛ nli! Ɛ bo zo amra ɛli bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.”

english_verse: Afterwards, Rebekah and the young women who were to travel with her prepared to leave. Then they got on camels and left with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Na Relɛbɛka nee ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ vole bɛ afunlumu zo na bɛ nee Ebileham sonvolɛ ne zile nu hɔle.

english_verse: At that time Isaac was living in the southern part of Canaan near a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Ayezeke vi Biyɛleehaelɔe fienemgbole ne anu ɛra, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔde Keena nyiakɛ.

english_verse: One evening he was walking out in the fields, when suddenly he saw a group of people approaching on camels. So he started toward them. Rebekah saw him coming; she got down from her camel, and asked, “Who is that man?” “He is my master Isaac,” the servant answered. Then Rebekah covered her face with her veil.
translation_verse: na ɔbizale Ebileham sonvolɛ ne kɛ, “Nwane nrenya a lua ɛya nu lɔ ɛlɛba arayia yɛ la?” Sonvolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Me menle ne ɔ.” Yemɔti Relɛbɛka vale ɛdanlɛ hedale ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: The servant told Isaac everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ ne hanle debie biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la amuala hilele Ayezeke.

english_verse: Isaac took Rebekah into the tent where his mother had lived before she died, and Rebekah became his wife. He loved her and was comforted over the loss of his mother.
translation_verse: Ayezeke akee vale Relɛbɛka hɔle ɔ nli Sɛla ndanlɛ sua ne anu na Relɛbɛka yɛle ɔ ye; Ayezeke hulole ye somaa, yemɔti akee ɔ rɛle kyekyele na ɔ rɛle vile ɔ nli ewule ne.

english_verse: and they had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee ye wole Zemelan, Dwɔkohyan, Midan, Medean, Yehyebake yɛɛ Hyua.

english_verse: Later, Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan, and when Dedan grew up, he had three sons: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
translation_verse: Dwɔkohyan wole Hyiba nee Didan. Didan amra a le Ahyulem, Lɛtuhyem, yɛɛ Lɛɛmem.

english_verse: Midian also had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
translation_verse: Medean amra mrenya a le Yifaa, Yifɛ, Heenɔko, Abaeda, yɛɛ Ɛledeeya. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Kɛtula abo zo amra.

english_verse: While Abraham was still alive, he gave gifts to the sons of Hagar and Keturah. He also sent their sons to live in the east far from his son Isaac, and when Abraham died, he left everything to Isaac. The Death of Abraham
translation_verse: Na ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ amra ɛdeɛ, ɔmanle bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔtɛwule la, ɔmanle ngakula zɔhane mɔ hwenle bɛ nwo vile Ayezeke anwo, hɔle aduduleɛ maanle bie anu. Ebileham ewule nee ye ɛzielɛ

english_verse: Abraham died at the ripe old age of
translation_verse: Ebileham yɛle kpanyinli kpalɛ, ɔyɛle ɛrelera nwosonwoso na yeawu. Ɔlile ɛvolɛ ɛya ko abulasuu nee nnu.

english_verse: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him east of Hebron in Machpelah Cave that was part of the field Abraham had bought from Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite. Abraham was buried there beside his wife Sarah.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ɛhye a Ebileham dɔle vile Hɛtema ɛkɛ ne la. Ɛkɛ ne a bɛziele Ebileham nee ɔ ye Sɛla a.

english_verse: God blessed Isaac after this, and Isaac moved to a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.” Ishmael's Descendants
translation_verse: Ebileham ewule ne anzi, Nyamenle yilale Ayezeke. Na Ayezeke dɛnlanle bula ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Teasenli ne mɔɔ nwu me la Bula” ne anwo. Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo amra (

english_verse: Ishmael was the son of Abraham and Hagar, the slave woman of Sarah.
translation_verse: Ebileham ara Yehyemeeyɛle, mɔɔ ɔ nee Sɛla Yigyibitinli sonvolɛ raalɛ Heega wole la,

english_verse: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
translation_verse: Mehyema, Dumaa, Masa,

english_verse: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
translation_verse: Heedade, Tima, Gyitɛ, Neefehye, yɛɛ Kidɛmaa.

english_verse: Each of Ishmael's sons was a tribal chief, and a village was named after each of them.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ yɛle mbusua ekpunli ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ mgbanyinli yɛɛ bɛvale bɛ aluma bɛtotonle bɛ namunamu nee bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Ishmael had settled in the land east of his brothers, and his sons settled everywhere from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt on the way to Asshur. Ishmael was
translation_verse: Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo amra ne dɛnlanle Havelaa nee Hyulu mɔɔ saa ɛlɛkɔ Aselea a ɛnee ɔwɔ Yigyibiti aduduleɛ la. Bɛ nee Ebileham abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la andɛnla. Yisɔ nee Gyekɔbo awolɛ ne

english_verse: Isaac was the son of Abraham,
translation_verse: Ebileham ara nrenya Ayezeke abo zo amra ɛne: Ebileham wole Ayezeke.

english_verse: Rebekah still had no children. So Isaac asked the Lord to let her have a child, and the Lord answered his prayer.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛnee Relɛbɛka ɛnwo la ati, Ayezeke zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma maanle ye; Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ na ɔ ye Relɛbɛka nrenzɛle.

english_verse: Before Rebekah gave birth, she knew she was going to have twins, because she could feel them inside her, fighting each other. She thought, “Why is this happening to me?” Finally, she asked the Lord why her twins were fighting,
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɔlɛnrenzɛ ndalɛ, na ngakula ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛko bɛ nli akunlu. Relɛbɛka zele kɛ, “Na duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛra me nwo zo a?” Yemɔti ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkabiza nwolɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.

english_verse: and he told her: “Your two sons will become two separate nations. The younger of the two will be stronger, and the older son will be his servant.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Maanle nwiɔ a gua ɛ kunlu a; Ɛbawo ndalɛ, na bɛ nloa ɛnrɛzɛ. Ko anwo bayɛ se adɛla ko; Kpanyinli ne bazonle ekyi ne.”

english_verse: the first baby was covered with red hair, so he was named Esau.
translation_verse: Kpanyinli ne le kɔkɔlɛ, ɔ nwo amuala le enrinli dɔɔnwo, na bɛdonle ye Yisɔ.

english_verse: As Jacob and Esau grew older, Esau liked the outdoors and became a good hunter, while Jacob lived the quiet life of a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ngakula ne mɔ nyinle la Yisɔ nyianle ɛbɔlɛ di yɛɛ ɔze ɛbɔlɛlilɛ nye zo. Gyekɔbo noko yɛle sonla bɛtɛɛ, na dahuu ɔwɔ sua nu.

english_verse: Esau would take the meat of wild animals to his father Isaac, so Isaac loved him more, but Jacob was his mother's favorite son.
translation_verse: Ayezeke hulole Yisɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔmaa ɔnyia ɛbɔ nu nane ɔdi; na Relɛbɛka noko hulole Gyekɔbo.

english_verse: One day, when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came home hungry
translation_verse: Kenle ko mɔɔ ɛnee Gyekɔbo ɛlɛto ye aluba tolo la Yisɔ vi ɛbɔ nu rale, na ɛnee ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye kpalɛ.

english_verse: and said, “I'm starving to death! Here and now give me some of that red stew!” That's how Esau got the name “Edom.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele Gyekɔbo kɛ, “Maa me aluba kɔkɔlɛ tolo ye bie meno na me nye zo ɛlɛbulu!” .

english_verse: Jacob replied, “Sell me your rights as the first-born son.”
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee dumua tɔne wɔ awolɛ kpanyinli gyinlabelɛ ne maa me.”

english_verse: “I'm about to die,” Esau answered. “What good will those rights do me?”
translation_verse: Yisɔ buale kɛ, “Melɛwu, awolɛ kpanyinli noko ɔdaye ɔkile duzu?”

english_verse: Jacob then gave Esau some bread and some of the bean stew, and when Esau had finished eating and drinking, he just got up and left, showing how little he thought of his rights as the first-born.
translation_verse: Akee Gyekɔbo manle Yisɔ kpanwo nee aluba kɔkɔlɛ tolo ne bie. Yisɔ lile kpanwo ne, ɔnlonle tolo ne, ɔnlonle nzule ɔguale zolɛ na ɔdwazole ɔhɔle. Ɛnee kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ Yisɔ kpole ye awolɛ nu gyinlabelɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Once during Abraham's lifetime, the fields had not produced enough grain, and now the same thing happened. So Isaac went to King Abimelech of the Philistines in the land of Gerar,
translation_verse: Saa ɛye ɛhɔne ne mɔɔ Ebileham mekɛ zo rale la a, ɛhɔne bieko rale azɛlɛ ne azo. Na Ayezeke hɔle Filisitiama Belemgbunli Abemɛlɛke anwo lɔ wɔ Gilaa.

english_verse: because the Lord had appeared to Isaac and said: Isaac, stay away from Egypt! I will show you where I want you to go.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mmakɔ Yigyibiti. Tɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menwɔze wɔ kɛ ɛdɛnla zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: You will live there as a foreigner, but I will be with you and bless you. I will keep my promise to your father Abraham by giving this land to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Duolua azɛlɛ ɛhye azo ala na me nee wɔ balua. Mebayila wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ bo zo amra yɛɛ mebava azɛlɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ a, na mebali me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle ɛ ze Ebileham la azo.

english_verse: I will give you as many descendants as there are stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all of this land. They will be a blessing to every nation on earth,
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛ bo zo amra ayɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra. Mebava azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala meamaa ɛ bo zo amra, na ɛ bo zo amra anwo zo yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la balua anyia nyilalɛ a.

english_verse: because Abraham did everything I told him to do.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ Ebileham diele me ne na ɔvale me folɛdulɛ, ɔlile me mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.”

english_verse: Isaac moved to Gerar
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ayezeke dɛnlanle Gilaa.

english_verse: with his beautiful wife Rebekah. He was afraid that someone might kill him to get her, and so he told everyone that Rebekah was his sister.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la bizale ye ɔ ye anwo edwɛkɛ la, ɔzele kɛ, “Ɔle me diema raalɛ”, ɔluakɛ ɔsulo kɛ ɔkɛha kɛ, “Me ye ɔ”, anrɛɛ ɔlua Relɛbɛka ati menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la kɛhu ye, ɔboalekɛ Relɛbɛka anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: After Isaac had been there a long time, King Abimelech looked out a window and saw Isaac hugging and kissing Rebekah.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne ɔhyɛle kpalɛ la, kenle ko Filisitia Belemgbunli Abemɛlɛke gyi ye nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu la, ɔnwunle kɛ Ayezeke nee ɔ ye Relɛbɛka ɛlɛdi anyezo.

english_verse: Abimelech called him in and said, “Rebekah must be your wife! Why did you say she is your sister?” “Because I thought someone would kill me,” Isaac answered.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Abemɛlɛke vɛlɛle Ayezeke na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Nea, raalɛ ne le ɛ ye, na duzu ati yɛɛ ɛse ɔle ɛ diema ɛ?” Ayezeke buale kɛ, “Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɔlua yemɔ ɔ ti bɛkɛhu me.”

english_verse: “Don't you know what you've done?” Abimelech exclaimed. “If someone had slept with her, you would have made our whole nation guilty!”
translation_verse: Abemɛlɛke bizale ye kɛ, “Na ɛhye mɔɔ wɔva wɔli yɛ la abo a le duzu? Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ye anu la bie kola nee ye da, na anrɛɛ wɔhwe munzule kpole wɔmaa yɛ.”

english_verse: Then Abimelech warned his people that anyone who even touched Isaac or Rebekah would be put to death.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Abemɛlɛke bɔle ye menli ne mɔ kɔkɔ kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva ɛ sa ɛkɛha nrenya ɛhye anzɛɛ ɔ ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku wɔ.”

english_verse: Isaac planted grain and had a good harvest that same year. The Lord blessed him,
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ zɔhane Ayezeke yɛle egyinli wɔ ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne azo, na ɛbuhenle ne dwule la ye bɛyɔba ne bɔle nwolɛ ɛya. Ɛdɛnkɛma yilale ye, na ɔnyianle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: and Isaac was so successful that he became very rich.
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔnyianle ninyɛne, ɔkpazile toonwo akee ɔyɛle sukoavolɛ kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the Philistines were jealous of the large number of sheep, goats, and slaves that Isaac owned,
translation_verse: Ɔnyianle mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo; ye awuke yɛle kpole na nuhua yɛle gbudugbudu, yemɔti Filisitiama anye bolole ye.

english_verse: and they stopped up the wells that Abraham's servants had dug before his death.
translation_verse: Filisitiama vulale ndɛtɛlɛ duoduale bula ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ ze Ebileham maanle ye sonvolɛma bɔle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la amuala.

english_verse: Finally, Abimelech said, “Isaac, I want you to leave our country. You have become too powerful to stay here.”
translation_verse: Na Abemɛlɛke zele Ayezeke kɛ, “Ɛvi yɛ maanle ye anu tu, na ɛ nwo bɔbɔ akee ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛdɛla yɛ.”

english_verse: where he cleaned out those wells that the Philistines had stopped up. Isaac also gave each of the wells the same name that Abraham had given to them.
translation_verse: Na Ayezeke eza bɔle bula ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze Ebileham de aze la bieko, ɔluakɛ ɔ ze Ebileham wule la, Filisitiama duoduale bula ne mɔ. Na Ayezeke vale aluma mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ ze ɛva ɛtoto bula ne mɔ la vɛlɛle bɛ.

english_verse: While his servants were digging in the valley, they found a spring-fed well.
translation_verse: Ayezeke sonvolɛma ne hɔle bɔnza ne anu lɔ na bɛhɔbɔle bula bie na bɛnyianle nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ nu la,

english_verse: But the shepherds of Gerar Valley quarreled with Isaac's shepherds and claimed the water belonged to them. So this well was named “Quarrel,” because they had quarreled with Isaac.
translation_verse: Gilaa menli mɔɔ ka nyɛmoa la radoale Ayezeke sonvolɛma ne mɔ bɛ nee bɛ zule nwolɛ kpolera bɛzele kɛ, “Nzule ne le yɛ ɛdeɛ.” Yemɔti ɔdonle bula ne Yisɛke, ɔboalekɛ bɛ nee ye zule ɔ bo zo kpolera.

english_verse: Isaac's servants dug another well, and the shepherds also quarreled about it. So that well was named “Jealous.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔbɔle bula bieko, na eza bɛlile ɔ bo zo butule, yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle ye Setena.

english_verse: Finally, they dug one more well. There was no quarreling this time, and the well was named “Lots of Room,” because the Lord had given them room and would make them very successful.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii na ɔhɔbɔle bula bieko, na yemɔ butule amba nwolɛ. Yemɔti ɔdonle ye Rilihɔbo, ɔzele kɛ, “Kɛkala akee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa yɛ ɛleka, na yɛbakpazi wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.”

english_verse: Isaac went on to Beersheba,
translation_verse: Ayezeke vi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhɔle Biyɛhyiba.

english_verse: where the Lord appeared to him that night and told him, “Don't be afraid! I am the God who was worshiped by your father Abraham, my servant. I will be with you and bless you, and because of Abraham I will give you many descendants.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye wɔ kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɔdwule ɛkɛ ne la nɔe ne, ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mame a mele ɛ ze Ebileham Nyamenle ne a; mmasulo, ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ a lua a. Mebayila wɔ na meamaa ɛ bo zo amra azo ayɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ me sonvolɛ Ebileham ati.”

english_verse: Isaac built an altar there and worshiped the Lord. Then he set up camp, and his servants started digging a well.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔzile azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne na ɔzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔzile ye ndanlɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ. Ayezeke sonvolɛma ne bɔle bula wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Ayezeke nee Abemɛlɛke ngyehyɛlɛ ne

english_verse: Meanwhile, Abimelech had left Gerar and was taking his advisor Ahuzzath and his army commander Phicol to see Isaac.
translation_verse: Akee Abemɛlɛke vi Gilaa hɔle Ayezeke anwo ɛkɛ. Ɔ nee Ahɛzate mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la yɛɛ ye Safohyenlema Kpanyinli Faekɔlo a hɔle a.

english_verse: When they arrived, Isaac asked, “Why are you here? Didn't you send me away because you hated me?”
translation_verse: Ayezeke bizale ye kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛkyi me, bɛdu me, na duzu ati a akee bɛra me nwo ɛke a?”

english_verse: They answered, “We now know for certain that the Lord is with you, and we have decided there needs to be a peace treaty between you and us. So let's make a solemn agreement
