english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: “Saa ehyianvolɛ nyia edwɛkɛ a, bɛmmakyea nɔhalɛ ne anye.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Bɛmmato awie ɛzonle, bɛmmaku sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie na ɔdi pɛlepɛle la, ɔluakɛ menrɛgyakyi amumuyɛnli ne dwɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadie ndoloboa, ɔluakɛ ndoloboa si mgbanyima mɔɔ di edwɛkɛ la anye na ɔsɛkye menli mɔɔ di benle la edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Bɛmmasisi ɛyɛvolɛ; bɛze kɛ ɛyɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ si yɛ nyane la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo. Ɛvolɛ nsuu ne nee kenle nsuu ne

english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ nsia anu bɛbalua bɛ ɛya ne mɔ bɛabu,

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: na ɛvolɛ nsuu ne azo bɛmaa azɛlɛ ne ɛla ɛkɛ ne mgbane, amaa ehyianvolɛma ali mɔɔ kɛfifi zolɛ la, na mɔɔ kɛha la nanemgbole noko ali. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ vanye nee ɔlivi avule ne mɔ a.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: “Bɛva kenle nsia bɛyɛ gyima, na kenle nsuu ne azo, bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle, amaa bɛ nlankɛ nyinli nee bɛ asoaso ne mɔ alie bɛ ɛnwomenle na bɛ ahanra nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ yɛ gyima maa bɛ la alie bɛ ɛnwomenle.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la, bɛdie ye boɛ. Bɛmmabɔ nyamenle gyɛne biala duma, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bie duma finde bɛ nloa. Ɛvoyia mgbole nsa ne (Ade

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛku ayɛmoa bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa me a, bɛmmafa kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la bɛboka nwolɛ. Bɛmmamaa nyɛmoa mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ azu bɛkɛmaa me la ɛnlome ne ka ɛkɛ ne toonwo aleɛ kye zolɛ.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Bɛ maanle ne anu raalɛ biala ako ɛnrɛkpɔne yɛɛ bie ɛnrɛyɛ mota. Mebamaa bɛ ngoane tendenle.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Bɛli Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛte bɛ ma mɔɔ lumua la, na bɛli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne wɔ ɛbuhenle ne awieleɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛwie bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la twe ba sua nu la.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ biala, wɔ ɛvoyia fane nsa ɛhye mɔ ɛlilɛ nu, ɔwɔ kɛ nrenya biala ba medame Awulae bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ ko biala bɛli ɛvoyia mgbole nsa bɛwula me anyunlunyia.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: “Bɛli Angye Ɛvoyia ne wɔ siane Ebebe ne anu, kɛmɔ menzele bɛ la. Bɛbali kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la kenle nsuu, ɔluakɛ siane ɛhye anu a bɛvile Yigyibiti a. Biala mmafa ɔ sa mgbane ba me nyunlu.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Bɛyɔba mɔɔ kɛlumua kɛvinde bɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ anu la, bɛva bɛrɛla medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne sua nu. “Bɛmmato boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ wɔ ɔ nli nyɛfonzule nu bɛdi. Ɛwɔkɛ nee ngilehilelɛ

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, mebazoa Nyamenle soanvolɛ meamaa yeali bɛ nyunlu, yeazinza bɛ wɔ bɛ adendulɛ nu ɔ nee bɛ ahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ meziezie memaa bɛ la.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Bɛdie ye na bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa ye. Bɛmmate ɔ nwo atua, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛva bɛ mɛladonlɛ biala ɔnrɛhyɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔgyi me gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: If you faithfully obey him, I will be a fierce enemy of your enemies.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtie ɔ ne na bɛyɛ mɔɔ menwɔha la a, mebayɛ kpɔvolɛ meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma na meaho meatia menli mɔɔ ko tia bɛ la.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Saa me soanvolɛ ne di bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ kɔ Amɔlema, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Keenama, Haevaema, nee Gyibɛsema maanle nu na mebɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ a,

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ yɛɛ bɛmmasonle bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔ bie. Bɛzɛkye bɛ na bɛbubu bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ mpila ne mɔ dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: Bɛzonle me ngomekye, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na mebayila bɛ aleɛ nee bɛ nzule zo; eza mebaye anwondolɛ meavi bɛ avinli.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: “Mebaha menli mɔɔ ko tia bɛ la ɛzulolɛ meamaa bɛ nye zo ada bɛ, na meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma agua ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ngɛkɛba mɔɔ le kɛ nrɛlabɔlɛ la alumua bɛ nyunlu ahɔvoa Haevaema, Keenama, yɛɛ Hɛtema.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Menrɛva ɛvolɛ ko ala menrɛdu bɛ, anrɛɛ azɛlɛ ne kɛla ɛkɛ ne mgbane kɛmaa nanemgbole kɛzo zolɛ kɛgyegye bɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Mebadu bɛ ngyikyi ngyikyi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo kɛzo na bɛkɛva azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti la.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Mebagya bɛ ɛweɛne ne meavi Akaba Ebolo ne anu meahɔ Azule Yufileti ne anloa, na meava ye fienemgbole ne anu toonwo meahɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Mebamaa bɛali menli ne anwo zo konim na bɛavoa bɛ bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee bɛ anzɛɛ bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mmayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ biala.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa menli ne mɔ tɛnla bɛ maanle ne anu, anrɛɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane bɛkɛtia me, ɔluakɛ saa bɛsonle bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ a, ɔbayɛ ɛhane yeamaa bɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ɛ nee Aalɔn, Needabe, yɛɛ Abaehu, nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima abulasuu ɛrɛla me nwo ɛke wɔ boka ye azo. Bɛgyinla moa ekyii na bɛzonle me.

english_verse: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.”
translation_verse: Mosisi angomekye a babikye Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo ɛkɛ a; menli mɔɔ ɛha la ɛnrɛbikye ye, yɛɛ menli ne noko ɛnrɛhɔ boka ne azo bie.”

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Mosisi rahanle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la amuala nee nwolɛ mɛla ne amuala hilele menli ne. Menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɔle nu hanle kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la, yɛbali zolɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi hɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne amuala. Ɔdwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ɔzile azukponle nee mpila bulu nee nwiɔ, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne de la wɔ boka ne abo.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔzoanle Yizilayɛ mgbavolɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu na bɛvale nlankɛ nyinli bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi wolale mogya ne foa ko guale ahyɛnze nu, na ɔvale foa ko ne ɔguale azukponle ne anwo.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ngyekyeleɛ buluku ne, na ɔgengale ɔhilele menli ne; na bɛhanle kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la yɛbayɛ, yɛɛ yɛbayɛ tieyɛ yeamaa ye.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Mosisi vale mogya ne dole guale menli ne anwo, na ɔhanle kɛ, “Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne se la, mogya ye sɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ ɛkyekye la anloa.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi nee Aalɔn, Needabe, Abaehu, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima abulasuu hɔle boka ne azo,

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: na bɛnwunle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛnwunle debie mɔɔ zɔho ezukoa bolɛ buluwu mɔɔ sonle bolɛ na nuhua te kɛ anwomanyunlu la wɔ ɔ gyakɛ abo.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma angu Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ɛhye mɔ. Bɛnwunle Nyamenle, bɛlile na bɛnlonle. Mosisi wɔ Boka Saenae azo

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Bɛla me nwo ɛke wɔ boka ye azo na kendɛ ɛkɛ. Mebava awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ mehɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbahilehile bɛ la zolɛ la meamaa wɔ.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi nee ye sonvolɛ Dwɔhyua dwazole, na Mosisi hɔle Nyamenle boka ne azo.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔhilele mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛhendɛ yɛ ɛke kɔkpula kɛ yɛkɛzia yɛkɛra la. Aalɔn nee Hule nee bɛ wɔ ɛke, awie mɔɔ kɛnyia edwɛkɛ la, ɔhɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi hɔle boka ne azo na amungu hedale boka ne azo.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me. Die awie biala asa anu azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ vi ye ahonle nu la.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛbalie wɔavi bɛ ɛkɛ ne la ɛne: ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ kɔbele;

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: mboane nyinli nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ kɔkɔlɛ, abɔnkye nwoma, akasea baka,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: kɛnlaneɛ nwole, ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ,

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Maa menli ne ɛziezie ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ɛmaa me, amaa meadɛnla bɛ avinli.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Kolo ezukoa nvutuke tagyee gua nwolɛ amuala nee ɔ kunlu na fa bie to ɔ nloa bɛnra yia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Fa ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nna mɔɔ bɛsosɔ nu bɛdwu la sosɔ ɔ gyakɛ nna ne, nwiɔ wɔ ye foa ko yɛɛ nwiɔ wɔ ye foa ko noko.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Se akasea mbaka nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la, na fa nvutuke fɔle nwolɛ,

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: na fa wulowula ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu ngɛba nwiɔ ne anu.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛyeye mbaka ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboa ɛlɛka ne ngɛba ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: siezie ɔ ti nee ɔ ti. Fa bɛ boka tile ne yɛ maa bɛyɛ kpundii mɔɔ ɛkpɔkye bɛ a bɛmkpɔkye a.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Akee ɛbava awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa wɔ la wɔagua ɛlɛka ne anu na wɔava ɔ ti ne wɔadua zolɛ.

translation_verse: Na me nee wɔ bayia ɛkɛ, na ɛlɛka ne azo, abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne andɛba ne mɔ avinli yɛɛ mebadendɛ meava me mɛla ne mɔ amuala meamaa wɔ na wɔava wɔamaa Yizilayɛma a. Kpanwo nee mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la ɛkponle ne (Ade

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Yɛ ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nna sosɔ ye muleɛ nna ne, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ ne mɔ wɔ la.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Fa akasea mbaka yɛ mbaka zɔhane mɔ na fa ezukoa nvutuke fɔle nwolɛ na bɛava bɛazoa ɛkponle ne.

english_verse: The table is to be kept in the holy place, and the sacred loaves of bread must always be on it. All bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings are to be made of pure gold and set on this table. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛva ɛkponle ne bɛzie me Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛva kpanwo mɔɔ dahuu bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ azu bɛkɛmaa me la bɛgua zolɛ. Kɛnlaneɛ baka ne (Ade

english_verse: Make a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered gold
translation_verse: “Bɛva ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛyɛ kɛnlaneɛ baka. Bɛva hamenle bɛbolo ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛyɛ ɔ bo tɛtɛlɛ ne nee baka mumua ne. Ye ndotolo ne mɔ, ye ahɔpo ne mɔ, nee ɔ sa ɔ sa ne mɔ, bɛva bɛ bɛbɔ nu bɛyɛ ye debie munli ko.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Ndotolo ne mɔ, ngane ne mɔ, yɛɛ kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke tagyee mɔɔ bɛva hamenle bɛbolo la bɛyɛ ye debie ko.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ dabekɛ nee bɛ bo ahyɛnze ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ ɛyɛ ezukoa nvutuke tagyee.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Nea maa bɛyɛ bɛ kɛmɔ melɛfa meahile wɔ wɔ boka ye azo la.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Kpomgba lenen mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ anye te, nee ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛva mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwo, na bɛnwo nuhua la kenda Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Maa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ mgbole ɛzɛ, ko tendenle ɛyɛ mita bulu nee nsa na ye tɛtɛlɛ ɛyɛ mita nwiɔ.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Fa mgbɛnu ndanlɛ azinli bulu mɔɔ bɛva lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, nee mboane enrinli buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee mboane enrinli kɔkɔlɛ nyɛma bɛnwo, na bɛnwo abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bɛgua nu la si Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.
translation_verse: Fa nuhua nnu bɔ nwolɛ, na bɔ nnu ne noko nwolɛ.

english_verse: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold
translation_verse: Maa kɛyɛ mita foa ko ɛhendɛhenda Ndanlɛ Sua ne tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Fa nnu bɔ nwolɛ, na fa nsia ne noko bɔ nwolɛ, maa bɛyɛ mumua nwiɔ. Bu mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia ne la anu na maa ɔgua Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: “Akee kpomgba mboane nyinli nwoma maa bɛwula ye ayile kɔkɔlɛ, na fa mbɔnkye nwoma kɛnlɛma noko kpomgba ko na fa keda Ndanlɛ Sua ne findezo ne azo.

english_verse: more along the north.
translation_verse: Gyinlegyinla felɛmo abulanwiɔ noko sɔlɔ,

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Fa Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne ati ne tua zolɛ wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Fa akasea mbaka nvonvɔɔnwo bobɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne felɛmo ne mɔ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: na fa siezie adiabo abulanla azo, felɛmo ko biala ɛdeɛ nwiɔ.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Gyinlegyinla felɛmo nsia wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anzi adɔleɛ,

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Mgbɛnezo felɛmo ne mɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ye bɛ bo bɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ, bɛkyekye toonwo ɔkɔdwu bɛ anwuma. Mgbɛnezo felɛmo nwiɔ ne, kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Yemɔti felɛmo ne mɔ bayɛ mɔtwɛ yɛɛ bɛ bo dwɛtɛ fufule adiabo bulu nee nsia, ko biala ɛdeɛ nwiɔ.

english_verse: Make five crossbars for each of the wooden frames,
translation_verse: tɛbanu bieko ɛdeɛ nnu, yɛɛ ɔ nzi mɔɔ di kɔ adɔleɛ la ɛdeɛ nnu.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Fa ezukoa nvutuke fɔle felɛmo ne mɔ anwo na fa ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba sosɔ bɛ maa bɛsosɔ meɛbeanu mbaka ne mɔ anu. Fa ezukoa nvutuke fɔle meɛbeanu mbaka ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Si Ndanlɛ Sua ne kɛ mɔɔ bɛhile wɔ wɔ boka ne azo la.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Akee fa ɛkponle ne sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne sɔlɔ na fa kɛnlaneɛ baka ne sie nyiakɛ maa ɔ nee ɛkponle ne bɛ nye ɛbɔ zo wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Fa nzosɔnu ne mɔ sosɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ dedɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne ati zo ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anu la, na fa Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne gua nuhua la sie mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anzi. english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Se akasea mbaka nnu, fa ezukoa nvutuke fɔle nwo, fa ezukoa nvutuke nzosɔnu sosɔ ɛdanlɛ ne; yɛ kɔbele adiabo na fa mbaka ne mɔ siezie zolɛ.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: na fa wulowula azukponle ne tɛbanu nwiɔ ne ngɛba ne mɔ anu na mekɛ biala bɛava bɛazoa.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Yɛ nwolɛ mbuakɛ na bɛava nzonle bɛagua nu. Eza yɛ azofi nee ahyɛnze nee faka nee senlevalɛ ahyɛnze; fa kɔbele a yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti a.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Fa ndaboa bobɔ azukponle ne na gyakyi ɔ kunlu ne tokule, kɛmɔ meva mehile wɔ wɔ boka ne azo la.

translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ mbaka ne mɔ yɛ abulanwiɔ, bɛ adiabo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva kɔbele bɛyɛ la yɛ abulanwiɔ, na fa dwɛtɛ fufule yɛ nzosɔnu nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Anlenkɛ mumua ne anloa, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ndanlɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le mita ngɔnla, na bɛva lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwo, na bɛva agbuyia bɛnwo nuhua la bɛyɛ mgbɛnu bɛhenda nuhua wɔ mbaka nna mɔɔ gyigyi adiabo nna zo la azo.

translation_verse: Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu ahyɛnze, nwolɛ adakola nee alie ne anwo takola biala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa kɔbele a bɛyɛ a. Kɛnlaneɛ ne boɛ ɛnleanlɛ (Sɛlɛ

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ memaa bɛ adwenle mɔɔ anu pi na bɛbɔ mɔdenle la kɛ bɛbu Aalɔn adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, amaa bɛadu ye bɛazie ahane bɛamaa me kɛ ɔle me sɛlɛvolɛ.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛbabu la ɛne: akɛnrazo aguzo, ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye yifɔdo la, tɛladeɛ woladapi, anwuma tɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ɔ nloa, abɔtile, yɛɛ tabule mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkye bɛ avinli la. english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ menli mɔɔ kpomgba la fa lenen ɛdanlɛ, mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ ɛdanlɛ, nee nyɛma anye akɔlɛnlome a kpomgba adɛladeɛ ne mɔ a.

translation_verse: Akee bɛva awolɛ nwiɔ ne bɛsosɔ ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne abati nwiɔ ne bɛmaa bɛyɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne ngakyedeɛ. Wɔ adenle ɛhye anu, dahuu Aalɔn bazoa bɛ aluma ɔ bati nwiɔ ne, amaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meava meahakye me menli ne.

translation_verse: Awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ, ko biala bɛhɛlɛ Gyekɔbo amra mrenya ne mɔ ko duma zolɛ bɛmaa bɛgyinla ɛkɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Bɛsolo awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la ɛhonlone nna wɔ zolɛ. Ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛva awolɛ wulubi, topaze, yɛɛ ganɛte;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛva ɛmelade, safaya, yɛɛ daemɔn;

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛva tɛkɔese, agate, yɛɛ ameteze;

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, bɛva bɛlele, kanɛlea, yɛɛ gyasepa. Bɛwula ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ ezukoa nvutuke boa nu.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Bɛva nyɛma ne mɔ ati nwiɔ ne bɛsosɔ ezukoa nvutuke boa nwiɔ ne na bɛva bɛsosɔ ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ bati nee ɔ bati la.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Bɛva nyɛma buluwu bɛbɔ akɛnrazo aguzo ngɛba ne mɔ nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ngɛba ne mɔ kpɔkɛ, amaa akɛnrazo aguzo ne amkpɔne na yeazinze akyeso ne azo fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛpɛ ɔ kɔme mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ ti bɛwula nu la. Ɔ kɔme ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwo debie bɛsɛ nu, amaa bɛwula a yeande.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Ɔ bo aze ne mɔɔ bɛbu la, bɛva mboane enrinli nyɛma buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛnwo debie mɔɔ zɔho akutue la bɛhendɛhenda ɔ nloa toonwo bɛbɛnra bɛyia, na bɛva ezukoa nvutuke dɔne bɛdidi bɛ avinli.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Saa Aalɔn ɛlɛdi ye sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwula tɛladeɛ ɛhye, amaa saa ɔlɛba me nyunlu wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, anzɛɛ ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔlɛfinde a, dɔne ne mɔ awozo na yeanwu.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Fa ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bolo yɛ ye ɛdɛbaa na kɛlɛ zolɛ, ‘Bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.’

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Fa ɛdanlɛ buluwu ɛdenraa kyekye ye wɔ abɔtile ne anyunlu.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Aalɔn bɔ abɔtile ne a ɛnee ɔwɔ ɔ nwoma azo, amaa saa Yizilayɛma fa azubɔdeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne arɛlɛ me na bɛfo a yeali nwolɛ ɛzonle. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbɔ abɔtile ne dahuu, amaa azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ azɔ me nye na mealie.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Bɛkpomgba anwuma adɛladeɛ, akyeso, yɛɛ ahyɛlɛ bɛmaa Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ, amaa bɛ nwo ayɛ fɛ na bɛ nyunlu ara anyia.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Fa adɛladeɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wulowula ɛ diema Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ. Akee kpokpa bɛ nwole, wula bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ, tu bɛ maa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma maa bɛzonle me kɛ me sɛlɛvolɛma.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Fa lenen ɛdanlɛ bu aze adɛladeɛ maa bɛ, maa ɔvi bɛ bo ɔdwu bɛ ɛzɔlɛ nwo, amaa bɛ nwo anye angua zo.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Kenle biala mɔɔ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ɛlɛba me nyunlu wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu anzɛɛ bɛlɛkɔ azukponle ne anwo wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛahɔyɛ bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwula zɔhane adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, anrɛɛ bɛkɛli ɛzonle na bɛkɛwu. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu maa Aalɔn nee ɔ bo zo amra a.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Kenle ko biala ku ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko bɔ ɛtane azu, amaa bɛava bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Eza bɔ ɛtane azu maa azukponle ne, kpokpa ye nwole fa nua ye mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛkɛmaa azukponle ne la.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu, keeki mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfete la, yɛɛ belɛde mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛva nwole bɛvɔ ɔ nyunlu la. Ɛbava esamo kpalɛ a wɔayɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala a.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Ɛbagua bɛ kɛndɛne nu na wɔava bɛ wɔ kɛndɛne ne anu wɔaboka ɛnlankɛ ne nee mboane ne mɔ anwo wɔara.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Ɛbava Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ wɔara Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne na wɔava nzule wɔabia bɛ.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Akee ɛbava adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na wɔava anwuma tɛladeɛ ne, ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnwo ye woladapi, ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne, akɛnrazo aguzo ne wɔawula Aalɔn na wɔava yifɔdo akyeso tabule ne wɔahye zolɛ.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Akee ɛbava ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne wɔawola wɔagua ɔ ti zo wɔakpokpa ye.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Akee ɛbava ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne wɔara me nyunlu wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu na wɔamaa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ava bɛ sa agua ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Akee ku ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne wɔ me nyunlu ɛke wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka bɔ mogya ne anu na fa ka azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo na wola mogya ne mɔɔ kɛha la gua azukponle ne abo.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Na yela ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne nane ne, ye nwoma ne, nee ye anyalɛ ne mɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne anzi lɔ. Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Akee ɛbava mboane nyinli ne mɔ ko na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ava bɛ sa agua ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ku ye na to ye mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo yia.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Ɛbapepɛ boane ne nane ne anu azinli, wɔawowo ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo na wɔava wɔagua ɔ ti ne nee nane azinli ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Yela boane ne mumua wɔ azukponle ne azo bɔ azu maa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma. Azubɔlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la sɔ me nye.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Akee ɛbava boane nyinli ɛhendeɛ ne na wɔamaa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ava bɛ sa agua ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi ku ye na fa ɛ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka fa ye mogya ne bie keha Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ anzo fema ne mɔ ati, fa bie keha bɛ sa fema ahohotile ne mɔ azo nee bɛ gyakɛ fema ahohotile ne mɔ azo, na to mogya ne mɔɔ ɛha la gua azukponle ne anwo yia.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Akee ɛbava mogya ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la nee ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne bie wɔakponde Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ anwo nee bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu. Ɔdaye, ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, nee bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anwo kɛde.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Eza ɛbayeye boane nyinli ne akunlu ɛnlome ne, dualɛ dɔlera ne, ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo, ye ezizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne, nee ye ɛbolɛ ne anwo ninyɛne ne amuala, yɛɛ ye ɛzɔlɛ fema ne .

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: na fa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala wula Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ asa anu maa bɛdo bɛ ehono, kɛ bɛle ehono azubɔdeɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Akee dielie ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛ sa nu na yela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo boka ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne kɛ bɛle azubɔlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: “Ɛbaye boane nyinli ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛdule Aalɔn bɛmanle me la akɛnrazo ne na wɔado ye ehono kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ. Nane kpɔkɛ ɛhye bayɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Aalɔn ara nrenya ne mɔɔ kɛli ye agya, kɛ ɔdi sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne la, saa ɔlɛba me nyunlu wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne kɛ ɔbazonle a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwula adɛladeɛ ɛhye mɔ toonwo kenle nsuu.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Bɛbava bɛaboka kpanwo ne mɔ mɔɔ hale kɛndɛne ne anu la na bɛali wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Bɛbali ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne wɔ bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ɛwulalɛ ne anu la. Awie mɔɔ ɛnle sɛlɛvolɛ la ɛnle kɛ di aleɛ ne bie, ɔboalekɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛbu Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ amaamuo ne kenle nsuu pɛpɛ, kɛmɔ mehile wɔ la.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ɛbayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne na wɔanlua azukponle ne kenle ko biala toonwo kenle nsuu. Akee azukponle ne anwo bade, ayɛ nwuanzanwuanza bɔkɔɔ, na ye nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne bamaa awie anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ kɛzɔ nu la anwo ade ayɛ nwuanzanwuanza. Dahuu azubɔlɛ ninyɛne (Ɛdi

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Fa ko bɔ azu nwonlomɔ na fa ko noko bɔ azu nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Ku boane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la nɔsolɛ nu, na fa ma azubɔdeɛ nee nwolɛ ɛdɛneyelɛ nwanye, kɛmɔ nwonlomɔ ɛdeɛ ne de ala la boka nwolɛ na fa bɔ azu. Ɛhye le azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ bɛmaa medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a, na ɔsɔ me nye.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Mebade Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne anwo na meadu Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya meazie ahane kɛ bɛle me sɛlɛvolɛma.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Mebadɛnla Yizilayɛma avinli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale kɛ mebadɛnla bɛ avinli la. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛbava wɔayɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛhye la, bɛmmafa bie bɛyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne bie bɛdabɛ bɛfa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ ɔle debie nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ahane bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: “Fa akasea ndaboa bobɔ azukponle na woayela ɛyɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Yɛ ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba nwiɔ sosɔ ezukoa nvutuke kɛba ne mɔɔ la ɔ nloa la abo wɔ ye tɛbanu nwiɔ ne. Nuhua yɛɛ saa bɛsoa azukponle ne a bɛbava mbaka ne mɔ bɛawulowula a.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ɛbava akasea ndaboa a wɔaze mbaka ne mɔ a na wɔaholo ezukoa nvutuke wɔagua nwolɛ.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Sie azukponle ɛhye wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ wa anwunvɔnezelɛ ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la akunlu. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebayia wɔ a.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Mmayela ɛyɛlɛ biala mɔɔ ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza la wɔ azukponle ɛhye azo, mmafa nane azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ɛbɔ azu na ɛye ɛdɛne wɔ azukponle ɛhye azo.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn fa nane ne mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ ɛtane nwo azu ne la mogya ne bie gua azukponle ne mɛne ne azo ɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti yɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ ɔmaa medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma.” Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo adwule

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛtia Yizilayɛma a, ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala tua ɔ nwo ɛkpɔnenlɛ adwule maa me, amaa munzule biala ando ye.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bava awowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Die mgbɔdalɛ ezukoa ɛhye wɔ Yizilayɛma lɔ na fa bu Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo amaamuo, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ahakye bɛ dahuu wɔ bɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne ati.” Kɔbele kyɛnze ne

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ye ko ne ala bie kɛyɛ ɔ nwo la, bɛye ye bɛvi ye menli ne avinli.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtu bɛ ɛsie ahane ɛmaa me, amaa bɛayɛ nwuanzanwuanza. Debie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha bɛ la bayɛ nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Fa kpokpa Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne, Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: ɛkponle ne nee nwolɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ, kɛnlaneɛ baka ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ, ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Kpokpa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nwole na tu bɛ sie ɛkɛ maa me maa bɛzonle me kɛ bɛle me sɛlɛvolɛma.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee ɛbaha wɔahile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Ɛhye bayɛ me ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nwuanzanwuanza wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bara la.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa bɛkpokpa awie gyɛne biala, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle nwole ɛhye la, bɛmmafa bɛyɛ nwole gyɛne biala. Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa ɔsonle bolɛ kɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ye ko ne ala bie, anzɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛva bie kɛkpokpa awie gyɛne biala la, bɛye ye bɛvi ye menli ne avinli.’ ” Ɛyɛlɛ ne

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: na fa bɛ bɔ nu, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ nwole evuanlɛ la yɛ ɛyɛlɛ. Fa ngyenle gua nu maa ɔ nye ɛde na ɔyɛ nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Ti bie motomoto na fa bie sie Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ gyi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la anyunlu, ɛleka mɔɔ mebayia wɔ la. Nwu ye kɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛhye le nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Nea, meye Yulae ara nrenya Bɛzalii, mɔɔ ɔ nlenya a le Huuli mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la,

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Eza meye Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe noko mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la kɛ ɔ nee ye ɛyɛ gyima. Eza memaa dwinvolɛma gyɛne gyɛne adwenle kpole, amaa bɛahola debie biala mɔɔ meze wɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la yɛ.

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Bɛzie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, ɔboalekɛ ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmaa bɛ nee medame wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bara la amuala kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mede bɛ nwo meyɛ bɛ me menli a.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Kenle nsia yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima a, na kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu ne la le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa me. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima kenle ko ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma nee medame yɛ avinli a, ɔboalekɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, menvale kenle nsia membɔle anwuma nee aze, ye kenle nsuu ne azo, mengyakyile gyima menliele me ɛnwomenle.”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle wiele tendɛ kile Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka ne azo la, ɔvale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle mumua ne ɛva ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɛhɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ zolɛ la ɔmanle Mosisi.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Menwu kɛ menli ne le dapele,

english_verse: The people got up early the next morning and killed some animals to be used for sacrifices and others to be eaten. Then everyone ate and drank so much that they began to carry on like wild people.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la bɛbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu na bɛvale anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛrale. Akee menli ne dɛnlanle aze lile nlonle na bɛzile agole.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Na Mosisi hanle kɛ, “Ɛnɛ, awie biala ɛva ɔ ra nrenya nee ɔ diema mogya ɛnlua ɔ nwo ɛwula ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma awola ye nyilalɛ agua bɛ nwo zo.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne nwunle kɛ Mosisi akee ɛhyɛ somaa wɔ boka ne azo na ɔmba la, bɛ muala bɛhɔle Aalɔn anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛndɛ maa yɛ nyamenle maa ɔli yɛ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ Mosisi ɛhye, mɔɔ yemɔ a le sonla mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yɛnze mɔɔ kɛkala ɛzi ɔ nwo zo a.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Na Aalɔn zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛyeye ezukoa nvutuke asomadeɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mra mrenya, nee bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ anzo nu la bɛrɛlɛ me.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Ɔliele nvutuke asomadeɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ sa nu na ɔholole ɔguale ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ɔmanle bɛ. Menli ne hanle kɛ, “O Yizilayɛ, yɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti la, yemɔ ɛne!”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Aalɔn nwunle ɛhye la, ɔzile azukponle wɔ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ, na ɔbɔle ye nolo ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhyema yɛbali ɛvoyia kpole yeawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛndɛ tolo kɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔ menli ne mɔɔ ɛyele bɛ ɛvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la ɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛkpo me.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Adenle ne mɔɔ mengilele bɛ kɛ bɛlua nu la, bɛanlua nuhua; bɛgua ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze na bɛzonle ye, bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa ye na bɛha kɛ, ‘O Yizilayɛ, yɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yemɔ ɛne!’

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: yemɔti gyakyi me maa menkpokpo me ɛya ne mengua bɛ nwo zo, membɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Na wɔmɔ, mebayɛ wɔ maanle kpole.”

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Kakye wɔ sonvolɛma, Ebileham, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo mɔɔ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛhanle ndane ɛbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ‘Mebamaa bɛ bo zo amra azo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra, azɛlɛ ɛhye amuala mɔɔ meva mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ la, mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra, na ɔbayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ’ la.”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle. Yeammaa munzule ne mɔɔ ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ la amba menli ne anwo zo.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mumua ne a zele awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ a, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔhɛlɛle mɛla ne mɔ wɔ zolɛ a.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwɔhyua dele menli ne mɔ ane kɛ bɛlɛteɛdea nuhua la, ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ, “Mete konle nganeɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ lɔ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Na Mosisi hanle kɛ, “Ɛdeanlɛ ne ɛnle ɛdeanlɛ mɔɔ kile konimlilɛ yɛɛ ɔngile kɛ bɛli bɛ nwo zo konim. Mete edwɛndolɛ ala.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi bikyele azokoɛleɛ ne na ɔnwunle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ne nee nwolɛ agolezilɛ ne la, ye ahonle futule kpole kpalɛ. Ye ɛya ne bole ɔ nwo zo manle ɔvuandinle awolɛ ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ zolɛ la ɔguale boka ne abo aze ɔbubule bɛ.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɛnlankɛ ananze ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, ɔvale senle ɔholole, ɔdinle ɔmanle ɔyɛle motomoto kɛ munlutu, na ɔvale ɔguale nzule ne mɔɔ bɛno la anu ɔmanle Yizilayɛma nlonle.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Mosisi bizale Aalɔn kɛ, “Na duzu ɛweɛleɛ a menli ne vale yɛle wɔ mɔɔ yemɔti wɔmaa bɛyɛ ɛtane kpole ɛhye a?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Na Aalɔn zele ye kɛ, “Me menle, mmafa me nwo ɛya. Ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ ɛtane ala a wɔ menli ne adwenle nu a.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Bɛhanle bɛhilele me kɛ, ‘Maa yɛ nyamenle maa ɔli yɛ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ Mosisi ne mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, yɛnze mɔɔ ɛzi ɔ nwo zo a.’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Na menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, ‘Awie biala ɛva ye nvutuke anwoneɛ biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɔmaa me.’ Yemɔti bɛvale bɛmanle me; menvuandinle menguale senle nu na ɛnlankɛ ɛhye a vindele nu a.”

english_verse: Moses knew that the people were out of control and that it was Aaron's fault. And now they had made fools of themselves in front of their enemies.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi nwunle kɛ menli ne ɛbɔ atondo, ɔluakɛ Aalɔn ɛmaa bɛbɔ atondo na nyiane akee ɛlɛku bɛ wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔgyinlanle azokoɛleɛ ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa na ɔdeanle nu ɔhanle kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma afoa la ɛrɛla.” Na Livaema ne kɔsɔɔti pianle bɛ nwo hɔle ye afoa.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, ‘Awie biala ɛva ye dadeɛ ne ɛhɔ azokoɛleɛ ye ɛleka biala, ɔvi anuhɔlɛ ɔhɔ anuhɔlɛ na ɔhu awie biala, ɔ diema, ɔ gɔnwo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ zua la.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Livaema ne yɛle mɔɔ Mosisi hanle la, na bɛhunle menli kɛyɛ apenle nsa kenle ko ne.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Mosisi zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛyɛ ɛtane kpole. Yemɔti mesia meahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo lɔ wɔ boka ne azo. Wɔannea a mebahola meali bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbɔdalɛ.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi ziale hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, menli ne ɛyɛ ɛtane kpole kpalɛ. Bɛdabɛ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ bɛ nyamenle bɛzonle ye.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Mebodo wɔ, fa bɛ ɛtane ne kyɛ bɛ. Saa ɛfa ɛkyɛ bɛ na ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee pɛ me duma nu wɔ buluku ne mɔɔ ɛhɛlɛle ye nu la anu.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia me la, yemɔ yɛɛ mebaye ye duma meavi buluku ne anu a.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, sia kɔva menli ne kɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ mehile wɔ la. Me soanvolɛ bali ɛ nyunlu. Noko akee kenle mɔɔ mebara la, mebadea menli ne mɔ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne ati.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ewule nzane deanle menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛhyele Aalɔn mialera nu bɛmanle ɔyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze ne.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Fa menli ne mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo ɛra la fi ɛke kɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menganle ndane menvale membɔle Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra la azo.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo; na mame, me nee bɛ ɛnrɛhɔ, anrɛɛ menwɔbɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ adenle nu, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ anzo yɛ se a.”

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile Mosisi kɛ, “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛle menli anzosesebɛma mɔɔ saa me nee bɛ tudu agyakɛ ekyii bɔbɔ a, mebabɔ bɛ bo zo a. Yemɔti bɛyeye bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛziezie bɛ nwo la, amaa meanwu kɛ mesi meayɛ bɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne vile Saenae Boka la bɛyeyele bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Saa Yizilayɛma yɛ azokoɛleɛ biala a Mosisi sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne maa ɔ nee azokoɛleɛ ne avinli twe; na ɔvɛlɛle ye Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua. Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma debie la kɔ Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba la anu.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Mosisi kɛze kɛ ɔkɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la, menli ne kɔsɔɔti dwazo gyinlegyinla bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa nea ye toonwo ɔkɔwolo nu.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma luale adenle zɛhae anu dendɛle hilele Mosisi, kɛmɔ sonla si tendɛ kile ɔ gɔnwo ala la. Saa Mosisi sia ba azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne bieko a, ye sonvolɛ kpavolɛ ne, Nɛn ara nrenya Dwɔhyua ɛnvi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu fee. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye menli ne balua

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle hilele Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, wɔze me kɛ, ‘Di menli ɛhye ati fa bɛ kɔ azɛlɛ zɔhane azo’ noko ahenle mɔɔ baboka me la, ɛtɛkanle. Wɔze me kɛ ɛze me kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ eza mezɔ ɛ nye.

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa mezɔ ɛ nye ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee kile me wɔ ndenle ne mɔ, amaa meazonle wɔ na meazɔ ɛ nye dahuu. Eza kakye kɛ maanle ɛhye le wɔ menli.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Me nee wɔ bahɔ, yɛɛ mebamaa ɛ nzo nu adwo wɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Mosisi buale ye kɛ, “Saa ɛ nee yɛ ɛnrɛhɔ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee mmamaa yɛfi ɛke.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛanwu kɛ medame nee wɔ menli ne yɛsɔ ɛ nye ɛ? Wɔ ɛlualɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ lua la yɛɛ maa menli nwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nee menli gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la avinli a.”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko ɛhye mɔɔ wɔha la ati, me nee bɛ bahɔ, ɔluakɛ meze wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ wɔzɔ me nye.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Mosisi bodole ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kile me wɔ anyunlunyia ne.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Mebamaa me wienyi kpole ne ada ɛ nwo zo, na meado me duma ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma’ ne kpaanu meahile wɔ. Mebayɛ menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ bɛ boɛ la boɛ, na meaze menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mese bɛ anwunvɔne la anwunvɔne.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Noko akee ɛnrɛnwu me nyunlu, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnrɛnwu me nyunlu na ɔnrɛdɛnla ngoane nu.

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Nea, bodane bie wɔ me foa ko ɛke mɔɔ ɛbagyinla zolɛ a.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ me anyunlunyia ne kɛze kɛ ɔpɛ nu la, mebava wɔ meawula bodane ne kuma bie anu, meava me sa meaheda zolɛ kɔkpula kɛ menwɔpɛ nu menwɔze la.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Akee mebaye me sa, ɛbanwu me kɔme anzi, na me nyunlu ɛdeɛ, ɛnrɛnwu ye.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Nea, me nee Yizilayɛma kyekye ngyekyeleɛ. Mebayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bie wɔ aleɛabo anzɛɛ maanle biala anu ɛlɛ la, wɔ wɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu. Na menli ne mɔɔ ɛwɔ bɛ avinli la amuala banwu nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ la, ɔluakɛ debie mɔɔ mebamaa wɔayɛ la yɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Boɔboa ɛ nwo na ɛhyema nwonlomɔ maa menwu ɛ nyunlu wɔ Saenae Boka ye azo.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Ɛ nee awie biala mmaba. Ɔnle kɛ bɛnwu awie biala wɔ boka ye anwo ɛleka biala, yɛɛ mboane nee nlankɛ mmakɔ adidi wɔ boka ne abo.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi zele awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ kɛ alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ala la. Na kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la, ɔdwazole nwonlomɔ ne na ɔvale awolɛ ne mɔ ɔhɔle Saenae Boka ne azo.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma akee zenle ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mele anwunvɔnezelɛ nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma Nyamenle, menva ɛya mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi me tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi bɔle ɔ ti aze ndɛndɛ na ɔzonlenle.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔhanle kɛ, “O Awulae, mebodo wɔ, Awulae, menli ne le dapele bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mesɛlɛ wɔ, saa me nyunlu ɛra anyia wɔ ɛ nyunlu a, ɛnee ɛ nee yɛ ɛhɔ, fa yɛ munzule nee yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ, na fa yɛ yɛ wɔ menli.” Bɛkyekye Ngyekyeleɛ ne bieko (Ade

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ biala bɛ mrenya ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛrazonle medame Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne fane nsa.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ ɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne biala, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ me duma a le Nungule la, mele Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule a.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: “Belamunli ralɛ nrenya biala, yɛɛ ɛnlankɛ nee boane biala ara nyinli mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo ye la le me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmagua awozonle ananze biala bɛmaa bɛ nwo na bɛsonle bɛ.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: “Di mɔɔ meka meahile wɔ ɛnɛ la azo. Mebavoa Amɔlema, Keenama, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, nee Gyibɛsema wɔ ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Nea boɛ na maanle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nu la, ɛ nee menli ne anyɛ ngyekyeleɛ biala, anrɛɛ ɛkɛzua ɛ nwo ɛhane.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Bubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, tudu bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ mpila ne mɔ, na pepɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ gua.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Bɛzie Angye Ɛvoyia ne na bɛli, kɛmɔ meha mehile bɛ la. Bɛli Ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu wɔ siane Ebebe ne anu, ɔboalekɛ siane zɔhane anu a bɛvile Yigyibiti a.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Noko akee ɛkola ɛfa boane ralɛ nyinli ɛsie asoaso ralɛ nyinli abo zo. Saa ɛnrɛzie ɔ bo zo a, ɛnee bu ɔ kɔme. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpɔne bɛ belamunli mralɛ mrenya kɔsɔɔti. “Biala mmafa ɔ sa mgbane finde me nyunlu.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ gyima kenle nsia, na kenle nsuu ne azo, saa ɛyazonlɛ anzɛɛ ɛbuhenle o, bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛte hwiiti a, bɛli Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ saa ɛvolɛ awieleɛ ma nloa ɛboɔboalɛ ne wie a, bɛli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mebadu menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu la na meamaa bɛ maanle ne adɛlɛ. Saa ɛvolɛ biala bɛsonle medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne fane nsa ne a, bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛvi bɛ sa ɛlɛ.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmafa nane mɔɔ bɛku ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa me la bɛboka kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la bɛbɔ azu ne bɛmaa me. Saa bɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne azubɔdeɛ ne a, bɛmmamaa bie ka aleɛ kye zolɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ biala ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde la, bɛva bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. “Bɛmmato boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ biala wɔ ɔ nli nyɛfonzule nu bɛdi.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Kɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo a mebalua me nee wɔ nee Yizilayɛma akyekye ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye a.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi vale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Mɛla Bulu ne wɔ zolɛ la vi Saenae Boka ne azo dwule aze la, ɛnee ɔ nyunlu ɛlɛta nwohyee, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔ nee Nyamenle ɛdendɛ, noko ɛnee Mosisi ɛnze kɛ ɔ nyunlu ɛlɛta.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Aalɔn nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti nwunle kɛ Mosisi anyunlu ɛlɛta la, bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛbikye ye.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Mosisi vɛlɛle bɛ, Aalɔn nee mgbanyima ne mɔ ziale rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na Mosisi nee bɛ dendɛle.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Nzinlii Yizilayɛma amuala hwenle bikyele ye. Na Mosisi vale mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle ye wɔ Saenae Boka ne azo la manle bɛ.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi nee bɛ wiele tendɛ la, ɔvale ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Mosisi kɛhɔ Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kadendɛ la, ɔye ɛdanlɛ ne ɔ nyunlu kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛvinde la. Saa ɔfinde na ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la a,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma nwu kɛ Mosisi anyunlu ɛlɛta. Mosisi eza fa ɛdanlɛ ne keda ɔ nyunlu kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu bieko kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kadendɛ la.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛva kenle nsia bɛyɛ bɛ gyima, na kenle nsuu ne le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. Ɔle kenle nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ gyima kenle ko ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Senle bɔbɔ, bɛmmawuda bie bɛ azua nu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne.” Ndanlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne azubɔdeɛ ninyɛne (Ade

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ mɔɔ ze ninyɛne nwo la yɛle ɛdanlɛnwolɛ nyɛma buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ lenen nyɛma rale.

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Yemaa bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛfa bɛdi adwinli biala, anwoneɛ nee awolɛ zo ɛhɛlɛlɛ, ninyɛne nu ɛnwolɛ, nee mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ lenen nyɛma ngɛnlɛma ndanlɛ ɛnwonlɛ. Yemɔti bɛkola bɛyɛ gyima ngakyile biala.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ ze adwinli di wɔ bɛ nu la ɛrayɛ debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la.

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons. Gifts for the Lord
translation_verse: yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bawula azonle wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la.” Menli ne fa bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ara

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛyɛ la ɛne:

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛbɔ azu ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Awie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la ɛva azubɔdeɛ ɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma: azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ kɔbele;

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ; lenen ɛdanlɛ nyɛma, ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva mbɔnkye enrinli bɛnwo;

english_verse: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: mboane nyinli nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile kɔkɔlɛ, nee mbɔnkye nwoma; akasea mbaka;

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: kɛnlaneɛ nwole; ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ;

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nee ye mbaka ne mɔ, ye nduazo ne nee mgbɛnu ndanlɛ ne;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: ɛkponle ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ; kpanwo mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle;

english_verse: the lamp with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ahɛnlaneɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ nwole;

english_verse: the incense altar with its carrying poles and sweet-smelling incense; the ordination oil; the curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent;
translation_verse: ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne nee ye mbaka ne mɔ, ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne; ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne; Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛdanlɛ ne;

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛyela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ zolɛ, nee ye kɔbele kɛlakɛlɛ ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ nee nwolɛ ninyɛne; kyɛnze kuloonwu ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nu la nee ɔ bo ne;

english_verse: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;
translation_verse: alie ne anwo ɛwowalɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ, ye mbaka sika ne mɔ nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ; alie ne anwo anuhɔlɛ ɛdanlɛ ne,

english_verse: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;
translation_verse: Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee alie ne anwo bane ne adakola ne mɔ nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ,

english_verse: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti vile Mosisi anwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then those who wanted to bring gifts to the Lord, brought them to be used for the sacred tent, the worship services, and the priestly clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ sunsum manle bɛ anwosesebɛ la, yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ rɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛva bɛzi Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne. Bɛvale debie biala mɔɔ hyia wɔ ye ɛzonlenlɛ nu nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛnwo sɛlɛvolɛma adɛladeɛ ne mɔ la bɛrale.

english_verse: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.
translation_verse: Awie biala, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ kulo la vale anwoneɛ, bɛ bonyi nu ngɛba, asomadeɛ, mgbɔdelera nee ngɛba, bɛ kɔme nu ndweabane, nee ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ ngakyile radole ehono bɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ lɛ mboane enrinli buluwu anzɛɛ buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla anzɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ, lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma, mbɔnkye enrinli, yɛɛ mboane anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile la vale rale.

english_verse: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ noko mɔɔ kola la vale mbɔnkye enrinli nwonle nyɛma.

translation_verse: eza bɛvale ninyɛne evuanlɛ, nwole mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ kɛnlaneɛ, nee mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛkpokpalɛ nwole la, yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛrale.

translation_verse: Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ lɛ ɛhulolɛ la yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale bɛ azubɔdeɛ rɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛvale bɛyɛle gyima ne mɔɔ ɔzele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne dwinvolɛma (Ade

english_verse: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye Yulae ara nrenya Bɛzalii, Huuli anlɔnra ne mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la,
