translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye anwosesebɛ kɛ ɔhile ɔdaye nee Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la.

english_verse: and he gave them the gifts that the people of Israel had donated for building the place of worship. In fact, so much was being given each morning,
translation_verse: Mosisi vale azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛva ɛra kɛ bɛva bɛzi Ndanlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne la kɔsɔɔti manle bɛ. Menli ne hɔle zolɛ vale azubɔdeɛ ninyɛne rɛlɛle Mosisi nwonlomɔ biala.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, there is already more than we need for what the Lord has assigned us to do.”
translation_verse: hɔbɔle Mosisi amaneɛ kɛ, “Ninyɛne mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛfa ara la akee bo gyima mumua ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile kɛ yɛyɛ la azo.”

english_verse: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done. The Curtains and Coverings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nee bɛ ɛra la bo gyima ne azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ (Ade

translation_verse: Bɛvale nnu bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale ye mumua ko, yɛɛ eza bɛvale nnu ne noko bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale.

english_verse: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.
translation_verse: Bɛvale azinli nnu bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale, yɛɛ bɛvale nsia ne noko bɛbɔle nwolɛ bɛkpomgbale.

english_verse: Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel,
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle ndanlɛ azinli ahotosalɛ abulanlu bɛsosɔle alumua ɛdeɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ bɛvale abulanlu noko bɛsosɔle amozi ɛdeɛ ne noko anloa.

english_verse: and the two panels were fastened at the loops with
translation_verse: Bɛvale kɔbele bɛyɛle nzosɔnu abulanlu bɛsosɔle ndanlɛ nwiɔ ne bɛyɛle ye debie mumua ko.

english_verse: Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Akee bɛvale mboane nee mbɔnkye nwoma mɔɔ bɛwula ye ayile la bɛhedale sua ne azo.

english_verse: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti felɛmo ne mɔ le mɔtwɛ yɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule adiabo bulu nee nsia, felɛmo ko biala gyi adiabo nwiɔ azo.

english_verse: more along the north.
translation_verse: Bɛvale akasea mbaka felɛmo bɛgyinlanle Ndanlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side
translation_verse: Adɔleɛ afoa nu, bɛyɛle nlenkɛ felɛmo nsia,

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Mgbɛnezo felɛmo nwiɔ ne, bɛbɔle bɛ nwo anwuma toonwo ɔdwule aze. Bɛyɛle felɛmo nwiɔ zɛhae wɔ sua ne mgbɛnezo nwiɔ ne azo.

english_verse: Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Baka ne mɔɔ bea Ndanlɛ Sua ne bane ne mɔ avinli la vi bane nwo kɔkpula bane nwo, yɛɛ ɔbea felɛmo ne mɔ avinli.

english_verse: The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through. The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele felɛmo ne mɔ anwo, na bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ngɛba bɛasosɔ bɛ, amaa bɛava mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ beɛbea avinli mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke fɔle nwolɛ la bɛawulowula nu.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛva mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ lenen nyɛma kpalɛ bɛnwo na bɛnwo nuhua la bɛkpomgbale ɛdanlɛ bɛhendanle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: Bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma bɛnwonle ngbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne na bɛnwonle abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bɛguale nu.

english_verse: They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
translation_verse: Bɛzele akasea mbaka nna, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele nwolɛ, bɛvale bie nzosɔnu bɛsosɔle bɛ na bɛvale mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne bɛhendanle bɛ. Akee bɛyɛle dwɛtɛ fufule adiabo nna na bɛvale mbaka ne mɔ bɛzieziele zolɛ.

english_verse: They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_verse: Ɛdanlɛ ɛhye, bɛzele mbaka nnu bɛvale nzosɔnu bɛsosɔle bɛ, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔlele bɛ ti nee mbaka mumua ne mɔ anwo na bɛyɛle kɔbele adiabo nnu bɛvale ye mbaka ne mɔ bɛzieziele zolɛ.

english_verse: He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔfɔlele ɔ kunlu nee nwolɛ na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔdole ɔ nloa kɛba ɔyiale.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔyɛle ngɛba nna mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka bɛawulowula nu bɛazoa la ɔsosɔle ye mgbɛnezo nna ne, nwiɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu yɛɛ nwiɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu.

english_verse: Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold,
translation_verse: Ɔvale akasea mbaka ɔzele mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele nwolɛ

english_verse: The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle ɛlɛka ne ati. Ye tendenle le mita ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita foa ko nee ekyi.

english_verse: On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la anye bɔ zo, na bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ nu la keda tile ne azo. Ɛkponle ne mɔɔ bɛfa kpanwo azubɔdeɛ bɛgua zo bɛmaa Nyamenle la Ɛbobɔlɛ (Ade

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Ɔdole ɔ nloa kɛba mɔɔ ye tɛtɛlɛ kɛyɛ ɛsalɛ ɛrɛlɛsɛka nsa na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele nwo.

english_verse: He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ngɛba mɔɔ bɛfa mbaka bɛwulowula nu na bɛazoa la nna ɔsosɔle ɔ bati nna ne, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ ne mɔ wɔ la.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings
translation_verse: Ɔvale ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka ne bɛawulowula nu bɛazoa la ɔsosɔle ɔ nloa kɛba ne.

english_verse: Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle ɛkponle ne ahyɛnze ne mɔ, agbɛlɛte, ahanrɛlɛ, dwora ne mɔ, nee ahyɛnze kuloonwu mɔɔ bɛfa nwanye azubɔdeɛ bɛgua nu bɛye ɛdɛne, nee mɔɔ bɛfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛgua nu la. Kɛnlaneɛ baka ne ɛyɛlɛ (Ade

english_verse: Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold,
translation_verse: Ɔvale hamenle ɔbolole ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɔyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne abo ne nee ye baka mumua ne; ɔvale bie ɔyɛle ndotolo nee ye nya ne mɔ, na ɔvale bɛ muala ɔbɔle nu ɔyɛle bɛ debie ko.

english_verse: with three branches on each of its two sides.
translation_verse: Kɛnlaneɛ baka ne lɛ ngane nsia, nsa wɔ ye foa ko yɛɛ nsa noko wɔ ye foa ko.

english_verse: There was also a blossom where each pair of branches came out from the stem.
translation_verse: Nya ɛdɛkɛ ko wɔ ngane nwiɔ biala abo.

translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kilo abulasa nee nnu a ɔyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti a. Ɛyɛlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne ɛbobɔlɛ (Ade

english_verse: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔyɛle ngɛba mɔɔ bɛbava mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la bɛawulowula nu la ɔsosɔle ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔdole ɔ nloa la abo wɔ ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu.

english_verse: These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold. The Oil for Dedication and the Incense (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔvale akasea ndaboa a ɔzele mbaka ne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛazoa la na yeava nvutuke yeafɔle nwolɛ. Ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne nee ɛyɛlɛ ne ɛyɛlɛ (Ade

english_verse: Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛkpokpalɛ nwole nwuanzanwuanza ne nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne kɛnlɛma kpalɛ kɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ la kɛyɛ ala la.

english_verse: Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔvale mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyianu Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa la neanleɛ ne mɔ ɔyɛle kɔbele kyɛnze nee ɔ bo ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo bane ɛlielɛ (Ade

english_verse: Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle mbaka mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsoa la anwo ngɛba nna ɔsosɔle ye mgbɛnezo nna ne.

english_verse: put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: na ɔvale ɔwulowulale azukponle ne anwo ngɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu la anu kɛ bɛbava bɛazoa. Bɛvale ndaboa a bɛbobɔle azukponle ne a, yɛɛ ɔ kunlu le tokule. Kɔbele kyɛnze ne ɛyɛlɛ (Ade

translation_verse: Bɛzalii vale ɛhye yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne mbaka ne mɔ adiabo ne mɔ, kɔbele azukponle ne nee zolɛ kɛlakɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ azukponle ne anwo debie biala.

english_verse: For the entrance to the courtyard, Bezalel made a curtain nine meters long, which he hung on four bronze posts that were set on bronze stands. This curtain was
translation_verse: Bɛ mbaka ne mɔ le nna; bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle bɛ adiabo nna ne a. Bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛle bɛ nzosɔnu ne mɔ, yɛɛ eza bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule bɛfɔlele mbaka ne mɔ ati zo; ye mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ noko le dwɛtɛ fufule.

english_verse: for the west. Then he hung a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. He placed three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hung a curtain
translation_verse: Bɛ mbaka ne mɔ le abulanwiɔ, yɛɛ bɛ adiabo ne mɔ noko le abulanwiɔ. Bɛvale kɔbele a bɛyɛle adiabo ne mɔ a. Bɛ nzosɔnu ne nee mɛkaleɛ ne mɔ, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a.

english_verse: Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done. Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ye boavolɛ Ahesamake ara nrenya Oholeabe mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la le dwinvolɛ mɔɔ kola kɛlɛhɛlɛ anwoneɛ zo, ɔdolɔdolɔ ninyɛne ɔmaa bɛnea zolɛ bɛyɛ anzɛɛ bɛnwo, ɔfa mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ ɔnwo ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma.

english_verse: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.
translation_verse: Kɔbele mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma la to tone nu kilo apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nna abulanwiɔ nee nnu.

english_verse: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bie ɔyɛle mbaka mɔɔ bɛvale bɛliele sua ne alie ne anwo la adiabo nee nlenkɛ ne adiabo ne mɔ, Ndanlɛ Sua ne adakola ne mɔ, yɛɛ alie ne anwo adakola ne mɔ.

english_verse: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛvale mboane enrinli buluwu, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla, nee kɔkɔlɛ nyɛma bɛnwonle adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ wula fa sonle wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele Mosisi la bɛmanle Aalɔn.

english_verse: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne, ko biala bɛhɛlɛle Gyekɔbo amra mrenya ne mɔ ko duma zo, yɛɛ bɛgyi ɛkɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne.

english_verse: The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest.
translation_verse: Bɛvale hamenle bɛbolole ezukoa nvutuke na bɛpepɛle bɛ ndenrɛndenra bɛvale bɛbokale lenen nyɛma kɛnlɛma ne, mboane enrinli buluwu ne, buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla ne, yɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ ne bɛnwonle ɛdanlɛ ne.

english_verse: It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ninyɛne ko ne ala bie bɛnwonle akyeso bɛzɔle yifɔdo ne bɛmanle ɔ nee ye yɛle debie ko, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi ala la.

english_verse: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.
translation_verse: Bɛzele kanɛlea awolɛ ne mɔ na bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛtotole bɛ nloa. Bɛdɔle alagye bɛhɛlɛle Gyekɔbo amra bulu nee nwiɔ ne aluma wɔ zo.

english_verse: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛbobɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ ne abati nee ɔ bati ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ ne azo. Ɛhye mɔ gyigyi ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile Mosisi la. Akɛnrazo aguzo ne ɛnwonlɛ (Ade

translation_verse: Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛbolole ye ɛdɛbaa na bɛhɛlɛle zolɛ, “Bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma”, na bɛvale bɛbɔle belemgbunli abɔtile nwuanzanwuanza ne azo.

english_verse: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;
translation_verse: ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛvale ɛmelade, safaya, yɛɛ daemɔn;

english_verse: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;
translation_verse: ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛvale tɛkɔese, agate, yɛɛ ameteze;

english_verse: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting,
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, bɛvale bɛlele, kanɛlea, yɛɛ gyasepa. Bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke bɛtotole ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anloa.

english_verse: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: bɛvale ɔ ti nwiɔ ne bɛsosɔle ndolebɛnloa nwiɔ ne na bɛvale bɛsosɔle ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ yifɔdo ne ndanlɛ ndenrɛndenra nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ bati nee ɔ bati la.

english_verse: and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash.

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Akee bɛwiele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne si bɔkɔɔ. Yizilayɛma ne yɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Mosisi ala la.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Bɛvale Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee nwolɛ debie biala bɛrɛlɛle Mosisi, ye nzosɔnu ne mɔ, ye felɛmo ne mɔ, meɛbeanu ne mɔ, ye mbaka azika ne mɔ, nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ;

english_verse: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;
translation_verse: zolɛ ɛhedalɛ mboane nyinli nee mbɔnkye nwoma ne mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ ayile, nee mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne;

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
translation_verse: ɛkponle ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, nee kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la;

english_verse: the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil;
translation_verse: ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ye ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, nee ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ nwole ne,

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne, ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne, ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne, Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne;

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: kɔbele azukponle ne nee kɔbele kɛlakɛlɛ ne, ye mbaka ne mɔ, nee nwolɛ debie biala, kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nuhua la nee ɔ bo ne;

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: alie ne anwo banelielɛ ndanlɛ, bɛ mbaka azika nee bɛ adiabo ne mɔ, bane ne mɔɔ bɛliele la anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne nee nwolɛ nyɛma, Ndanlɛ Sua ne adakola ne mɔ;

english_verse: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.
translation_verse: yɛɛ adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma, Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bawula wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Alumua siane ne, ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, kyehyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Fa Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne sie nu, na fa mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne wa ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Fa ɛkponle ne sie nu na fa nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti gua zolɛ. Eza fa kɛnlaneɛ baka ne sie nu na fa ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ siezie zolɛ.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Fa ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbakpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ la sie Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu na fa Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne kenda ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Fa azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne,

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: na fa kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛbawowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo nuhua la sie Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne avinli na gua nzule nu.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Fa alie ne anwo bane ne anwo ndanlɛ ne mɔ wowa nwo, na fa ɛdanlɛ wa ye anlenkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment
translation_verse: Bieko, fa nwole kpokpa azukponle ne nee nwolɛ debie biala, tu bɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛkɛyɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Akee fa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bɛla Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa na fa nzule bia bɛ.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Fa sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ wulowula Aalɔn, kpokpa ye nwole na tu ye sie ahane maa me, amaa yeazonle me kɛ ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ.

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Mosisi yɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la.

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvile Yigyibiti la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne anu, ye siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, bɛhyehyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne ɔguale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anu. Ɔvale Ɛlɛka ne mbaka ne mɔ ɔwulowulale ye ngɛba ne mɔ anu na ɔvale ɔ ti ne ɔduale zolɛ.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale Ɛlɛka ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔvale mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne ɔwale ɔ nyunlu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɛkponle ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu sɔlɔ afoa nu wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu,

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɛkɛ ne, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ɔsosɔle ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: na ɔyelale ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ zolɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɔvale Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu ɛdanlɛ ne ɔhendanle ɛkɛ,

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: na ɔvale azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyela azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne anloa. Ɔvale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ ɔbɔle azu wɔ zolɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye ala la.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ɔvale kyɛnze ne mɔɔ bɛwowo bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo wɔ nuhua la ɔziele Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne avinli na ɔguale nzule nu.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Mosisi, Aalɔn, yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ wowole bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ anwo ɛkɛ

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu anzɛɛ bɛlɛsia bɛara azukponle ne anwo la, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi ala la.

english_verse: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance. The Glory of the Lord
translation_verse: Mosisi wowale Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne anwo na ɔvale ɛdanlɛ ɔhendanle ye anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anu. Na Mosisi wiele gyima ne yɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo amungu ne (Ɛdi

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee amungu hedale Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne yile sua ne tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: Saa amungu ne ɛtɛyele ɔ nwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, bɛtɛnla azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, bɛndu bɛ bo.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne anu bɛnwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma amungu ne keda Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, na aledwolɛ nu noko a, ɛnee ɔle senle.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo, na bɛkɛlie bɛkɛdo nu kɛ ɔle ahenle ne ati mgbɔdalɛ.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee ahenle ne ɛhu ɛnlankɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ na Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛva mogya ne ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛdo bɛgua azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa la anwo amuala.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Akee ahenle mɔɔ lɛ azubɔdeɛ ne la ɛye nane ne nwoma na ɔbia ye.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛwuda senle wɔ azukponle ne azo na bɛziezie ɛyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ senle ne anu la.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Akee ahenle ne ɛva nzule ɛnrinzi nane ne akunlu ninyɛne ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela ɔ muala wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ. Azubɔlɛ zɛhae mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ la evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Saa sonla ne ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne le ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ vi ɔdaye ye mboane anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔku ye wɔ azukponle ne sɔlɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne to ye mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo amuala yia.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Akee ɔva nzule ɔnrinzi nane ne akunlu ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛva bɛ muala na ɔyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɛhye le ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “Saa ahenle ne azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la le nloma ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ye azubɔdeɛ ne yɛ abubule anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma mralɛ.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ara azukponle ne anwo, ahwi ɔ ti anu mogya ne, na yeayela anloma ne wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔmaa ye mogya ne twi gua azukponle ne foa ko.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne fa anloma ne toku ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne amuala, na ɔto ɔgua azukponle ne foa ko wɔ ye aduduleɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgua nzonle ne la.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “Saa awie fa ma ara kɛ ɔfa yearabɔ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔpe ɔyɛ ye esamo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgua ɔlivi nwole zolɛ na ɔgua ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ nu,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: na ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne. Akee ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne fula esamo ne mɔɔ nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne bie wɔ nu la ɔ sa ko, kɛ ɔle ahenle ne afoa nu ɛdeɛ, na ɔyela yemɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Esamo ne mɔɔ kɛha la le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na nwolɛ te kpole kpalɛ a.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “Saa awie fa ma azubɔdeɛ ara na ɔle debie mɔɔ bɛdo ye wɔ fonlomo nu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ angye belɛde mɔɔ bɛva esamo nee nwole a bɛyɛ a, anzɛɛ kpanwo ndɛbandɛba ngukulungukulu mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛgua nwole zolɛ la.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: “Saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛloa ye kɛ tata wɔ kyɛnze nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ esamo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la.

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbubu nu na bɛgua nwole zolɛ; ɔle ma azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: “Saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛdo ye wɔ kyɛnze nu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ debie mɔɔ bɛva esamo mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bɛyɛ la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Saa bɛ nee bɛ ba a bɛva bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ava ahɔ azukponle ne anwo.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava bie ahile kɛ bɛva bɛra kɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva senle bɛbɔ la, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Aleɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ kɛha la le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle ma ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, na nwolɛ te kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula ma azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛarɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛyela mgbɔvonle anzɛɛ wolɛ biala kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛnyia ye la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔ, noko ɔnle kɛ bɛfa bɛkɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ngyenle bɛgua bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ amuala anu. Ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa ngyenle mɔɔ kile bɛ nee bɛ Nyamenle ne ngyekyeleɛ ne la kpa bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ nu.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa ma mɔɔ bɛlumua bɛde la azubɔdeɛ bɛarɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne yɛ ma amolɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛbu anzɛɛ bɛde la; bɛhyehye ye ekyii na bɛgelegele nu.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua nwole zolɛ na bɛfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛgua zolɛ. Ɔle ma azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “Saa awie fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli anzɛɛ belɛ azubɔdeɛ arabɔ anzonudwolɛ azu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la a ɔfinde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto nane ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia.

english_verse: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides,
translation_verse: Akee ɔyeye nane ne akunlu ne anwo ɛnlome kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nze nu yɛɛ ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔvi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ bayela bɛ wɔ ɛyɛne ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la azo. Ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle a bɛbɔ a, na ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Saa awie fa boane nyinli anzɛɛ belɛ azubɔdeɛ arabɔ anzonudwolɛ azu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Saa ɔfa boane ralɛ a yeabɔ azu ne a, ɛnee ɔva ye ɔrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: ɔva ɔ sa ɔdo nane ne ati zo, ɔhu ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ aleɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “Saa ahenle ne azubɔdeɛ ne le abɔnkye a, ɔva ɔhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: na ɔva ɔ sa ɔdo abɔnkye ne ati zo, na ɔhu ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bado ye mogya ne agua azukponle ne anwo amuala ayia.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛyela bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ aleɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɔ evuanlɛ la. Nane ne ɛnlome ne amuala le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛhye yɛ mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu, wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛde la; ɔnle kɛ bɛdi nane ɛnlome anzɛɛ mogya.”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ mogya ne anu na yeakponde ye Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nwuanzanwuanza ɛleka ne la anyunlu fane nsuu.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Akee ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto abɔnkye ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ava mogya ne bie apepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, saa awie anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane, ɔyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie,

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: na saa ahenle le sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛkpokpa ye nwole la yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛva evinli ɛha menli ne a, bɛmaa ɔva ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔyɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛnlankɛ ne ɔba Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛnlankɛ ne ati zo, na ɔku ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne bie ahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mogya ne bie aha ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne la abo ne anwo.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava ɛnlankɛ mumua ne: ye nwoma, ye nane ne, ɔ ti, ye ndwɛlɛ, ɔ kunlu ninyɛne nee ye ebinli ne yeavinde yeahɔ ɛleka bɔkɔbɔkɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgua nzonle ne la yeahɔgua bɛ ɛyɛne zo yeayela bɛ.

english_verse: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.
translation_verse: “Saa Yizilayɛ maanlema kɔsɔɔti andwenle nwolɛ na bɛannwu ye la ati bɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛdi fɔlɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie,

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: na saa bɛmaa bɛnwu bɛ ɛtane ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la a, bɛ muala bɛbabɔ nu bɛava ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na bɛava bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ ezuavolɛ ne avinli la bava bɛ sa agua ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne ati zo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ, na akee bɛahu ɛnlankɛ ne.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Akee Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne bie ahɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na sɛlɛvolɛ ne ava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka abɔ mogya ne anu akponde ye wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu fane nsuu.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mogya ne bie aha azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne la abo ne anwo.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: na saa bɛmaa ɔnwu ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abɔnkye nyinli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔba kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛva ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɛva ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie na ɔva ɔpepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na ɔwola mogya ne mɔɔ kɛha la ɔgua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abo ne anwo.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɔbayela nane ne anu ɛnlome ne amuala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛmɔ bɛfa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛabɔ azu a bɛyɛ ye la Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ye ɛtane ne anwo mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye, na bɛkɛva ye ɛtane ne bɛkɛhyɛ ye.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “Saa koahweabane bie andwenle nwolɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane, na ɔdi fɔlɛ kɛ yeyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ bɛmmayɛ la bie,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: na saa bɛmaa ɔnwu ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abɔnkye belɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la ɔbabɔ azu wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo na ɔku ye wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛleka ne.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Ɔbayeye azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ la, na akee yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali ye ɛtane ne anwo mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Saa ahenle fa boane ralɛ ara kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa belɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɔto azubɔdeɛ ne ati zo na ɔku ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ava azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie na yeava yeapepe ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na yeawola mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɔbayeye azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne amuala, kɛmɔ bɛyeye boane ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔlɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo yeaboka azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyela bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo. Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ali mgbɔdalɛ amaa ahenle ne wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛkɛva bɛkɛhyɛ ye.

english_verse: You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ saa awie annwu ye na ɔ nwo ka debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa nane bie funli o, saa ɛnlankɛ funli o, saa ngɛkɛba mɔɔ tu la bie funli o, na saa nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi fɔlɛ; evinli ɛha ye.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ saa ɔ nwo ka awie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa duzu debie yɛɛ manle evinli hanle ahenle ne bɔbɔ a, saa ɔnze na nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi fɔlɛ.

english_verse: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ saa awie buke ɔ nloa di amonle kɛ ɔdi ɛtane anzɛɛ ɔyɛ boɛ a, amonle ɛtane biala mɔɔ ahenle ne kɛli la, saa ɔnze bɔbɔ na nzinlii ɔnwu ye a, ɔdi ko biala anwo fɔlɛ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: “Saa awie di fɔlɛ wɔ ɛhye mɔ biala anwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔka ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la wɔ bagua nu,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na ɔfa fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane ralɛ belɛ anzɛɛ abɔnkye belɛ ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ di ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ wɔ ye ɛtane ne anwo.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne na sɛlɛvolɛ ne alumua ava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne abɔ azu; ɔbahyiba anloma ne ati yeabu ɔ kɔme noko ɔnrɛde ye ɔnrɛvi zolɛ.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie yeakponde azukponle ne foa ko, na yeahwi mogya ne mɔɔ kɛha la yeagua azukponle ne abo ne anwo. Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: “Na saa ahenle ne angola abubule nwiɔ ne anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ne fa a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa esamo kilo nwiɔ ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. Ɔnle kɛ ɔfa nwole ɔgua nu anzɛɛ ɔfa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ biala ɔgua zolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne avula ɔ sa ko, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo yeaboka ɛyelalɛ. azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ la anwo. Ɔle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bazɛlɛ ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ amaa ye wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na bɛbava bɛahyɛ ye. Esamo ne mɔɔ kɛha la le sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ ma azubɔdeɛ de la.” Abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ

translation_verse: “Azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ fa bɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ kenle mɔɔ bɛkɛkpokpa ye nwole kɛ ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ la ɛne. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa esamo kilo ko ɔyɛ ma azubɔdeɛ dahuu biala. Ɔbava foa ko nwonlomɔ na yeava foa ko ne nɔsolɛ.

translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ: Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nwo la ɛne. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne da azukponle ne azo anyevinle ne nɔe ne toonwo alehyenlɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ azukponle ne azo senle ne sɔ bɔ ye.

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: “Mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ma azubɔdeɛ nwo noko la ɛne. Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bava azubɔdeɛ ne amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ azukponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua ko bavula ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdi bɛyɛ ye esamo na nwole nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ nu la ɔ sa ko, na yeayela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo. Ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aalɔn abo zo amra mrenya biala kola di bie. Meyɛ ɛhye mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ awolɛndoazo biala anu na ɔfane ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo. Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha bie la anwo kɛde saanwu.”

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nrenya biala mɔɔ wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne anu la kola di bie Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la. Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Saa ahenle fa ba kɛ ɔfa yeayɛ mo a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa kpanwo ngyikyi mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la, kpanwo ngyikyi ndɛbandɛba ngukulungukulu mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu na nwole wɔ nwolɛ la, yɛɛ belɛde mɔɔ bɛva esamo kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛyɛ mo la amuala kenle ko ne. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyakyi bie bɛsie ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: “Na saa azubɔdeɛ ne le ɛwɔkɛyelɛ azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ahenle ɛyeye ɔ kunlu ɛva ɛra la a, yemɔ bɛli azubɔdeɛ ne kenle ko ne ala, na saa bie ka ɛdeɛ a, bɛkola bɛdi wɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Saa azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne bie ka, ɔdi kenle nsa na bɛdi a, ɔnle kɛ bɛdie ahenle mɔɔ nee azubɔdeɛ ne rale la bɛto nu, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ye kɛ ɔvale debie bɔbɔ ɔrale. Ɔle munzule debie, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛli bie la, ɛtane ne zo ɔdaye.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, saa sonla o, nane o, anzɛɛ kyibadeɛ biala, na ɔkɛli anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la aleɛ ne bie la a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye sonla zɔhane bɛfi ye menli ne avinli.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi nane ɛnlome, saa ɛnlankɛ o, boane o anzɛɛ abɔnkye o.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli nane mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛnlome la, bɛye ye bɛvi ye menli ne avinli.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛdi mogya biala fee. Saa ɔle anloma anzɛɛ nane mɔɔ wɔ wɔ sua nu bɔbɔ la a, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ye mogya

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli mogya la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi ye menli ne avinli.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔfa nuhua ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɔ sa nu ɔbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nane ne ɛnlome ne nee ɔ kɛnra azo ne a ba a, amaa bɛado ɔ kɛnra azo ne ehono bɛabɔ ehono azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayela ɛnlome ne wɔ azukponle ne azo, na ɔ kɛnra azo ne le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Ɛzɔlɛ ɛhye le sɛlɛvolɛ ne nee Aalɔn amra ne mɔ mɔɔ to anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya ne gua azukponle ne anwo la ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nane ne akɛnra azo ne nee ɛzɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkɛdu la, melie mevi Yizilayɛma ɛkɛ, mevi bɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ anu, na meva memaa Sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ na meyɛ ye kɛ dahuu biala ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hyehyɛle manle Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔzele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛva bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛwɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi vale azubɔdeɛ ne akɛnra azo ne dole ye ehono kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; Mosisi afoa nu ɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ azubɔlɛ boane ne anu la a le ɛhye, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Fa Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ, adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nee ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu sonla bɛmaa Nyamenle la, ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, mboane nyinli nwiɔ ne, yɛɛ akee kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la kɛndɛne ko ne.

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Boɔboa menli ne kɔsɔɔti anloa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la, na menli ne amuala rayiale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Na Mosisi hanle hilele menli ne kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze me kɛ menyɛ la ɛne.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ rale, na ɔvale nzule ɔbiale bɛ.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Ɔvale Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli tɛladeɛ ɔwulale Aalɔn, na ɔvale tabule ne ɔhyele zo, ɔvale tɛladeɛ aguzo ne ɔkpolole ye, ɔvale yifɔdo ne ɔwulale ye na ɔvale ye akyeso ne mɔɔ bɛnwo ye kɛnlɛma bie la ɔhyele zolɛ.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale akɛnrazo aguzo ne ɔwulale ye na ɔvale “Yulem” ne nee “Tɛmem” ne ɔguale nu.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ɛdanlɛ abɔtile ne ɔbɔle ye na ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔbɔle abɔtile ne anyunlu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, ɔle belemgbunli kyɛlɛ mɔɔ anwo te a.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale ɛkpokpalɛ nwole ne na ɔvale bie ɔguale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo, nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anu la azo, ɔdule bɛ muala ɔmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle azukponle ne anwo fane nsuu, ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle ahyɛnze nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima wɔ azukponle ne azo la anwo ɔdule bɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔwolale bie ɔguale Aalɔn ati zo, na ɔdule ye ɔmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mosisi vale Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ rale, ɔwulale bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ, ɔvale ndabule ne mɔ ɔhyehyele zo na ɔzoale bɛ ahyɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ɛnlankɛ nyinli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ɔrale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɛnlankɛ ne ati zo.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mosisi hunle ye na ɔvale mogya ne, ɔvale ɔ sa. ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔle nu na ɔvale ɔpepenle azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi zolɛ la azo ɔyiale, ɔvale ɔnluanle azukponle ne, na akee ɔwolale mogya ne mɔɔ hale la ɔguale azukponle ne abo ne anwo, ɔdule ɔmanle Nyamenle ɔyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmanle ye.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi yeyele azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee ye ɛbolɛ ne nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala, na ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na ɛnlankɛ ne nane ne, ye nwoma ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala, Mosisi yelale bɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale boane nyinli ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne rale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mosisi hunle boane ne na ɔdole ye mogya ne ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Akee bɛvale nzule bɛnrinzinle nane ne ndwɛlɛ ne nee ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo na Mosisi yelale boane mumua ne amuala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. Ɔbɔ evuanlɛ, na ɔle azu mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale boane nyinli ko ne, mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ boane ne rale, na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale boane nyinli ne ati zo.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mosisi hunle boane ne na ɔvale ye mogya ne bie ɔhanle Aalɔn anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee bɛvale Aalɔn amra ne mɔ bɛrale, na Mosisi vale mogya ne bie hanle bɛ nzo fema ne mɔ ati, bɛ sa nee bɛ gyakɛ fema ahohotile ne mɔ azo na akee ɔdole mogya ne ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale nane ɛnlome ne, ɔ dua dɔlera ne, ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo la, ye ɛbolɛ nwo ninyɛne, ye ɛzizira nwiɔ ne nee nwolɛ ɛnlome ne, yɛɛ nane ne ɛzɔlɛ fema ne.

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi yele angye kpanwo tɛtɛlɛ ko, angye belɛde mɔɔ nwole wɔ nu la ko, yɛɛ kpanwo ɛdɛbaa kulukulu ko, wɔ angye kpanwo kɛndɛne ko ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ la anu na ɔvale ɔguale nane ɛnlome ne nee ɛzɔlɛ fema ne azo,

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔvale ɔwulale Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ asa anu, na ɔdole ninyɛne ne mɔ ehono, kɛ ɔle ehono azubɔdeɛ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi liele ninyɛne ne bɛ sa nu na ɔvale ɔbokale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɔyelale bɛ muala wɔ azukponle ne azo, kɛ sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa senle bɛbɔ ye azu evuanlɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vale nwole ne na ɔvale mogya ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la bie ɔkpotole nuhua na ɔvale ɔkpondenle Aalɔn anwo nee ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu. Ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle ɔ mra ne mɔ anwo na ɔvale bie ɔkpondenle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu. Yemɔti ɔbɔle Aalɔn nee ye adɛladeɛ yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nu ɔdule bɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛdo nane ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ lɔ, na bɛli bɛboka kpanwo ne mɔɔ wɔ kɛndɛne ne mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛwulalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ nu la, kɛmɔ menzele bɛ la kɛ, ‘Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ a bali a.’

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɔ bɛtɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ ne dedee kenle nsuu, kɔkpula mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛadu bɛ bɛamaa Nyamenle la kɛwie la, ɔluakɛ bɛfa kenle nsuu a bɛadu bɛ bɛamaa Nyamenle a.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛyɛ ye ɛnɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ kɛ bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Bɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kenle nsuu, bɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ la, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, ɔluakɛ zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze me a.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Na Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ yɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo zele bɛ la kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, Mosisi vɛlɛle Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima;

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: na ɔzele Aalɔn kɛ, “Fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko yɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na fa boane nyinli ko yɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔnle kɛ nane nwiɔ ne biala anwo nyia dɛne.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Na ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛva abɔnkye nyinli bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ; bɛva boane edonraa nee ɛnlankɛ edonraa mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, na bɛli ɛvolɛ ngoko la bɛyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ,

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: yɛɛ akee boane nyinli ko nee ɛnlankɛ nyinli kpole ko bɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ, na bɛva ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la bɛboka nwo bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma baye ɔ nwo ahile bɛ.’ ”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ Mosisi zele bɛ kɛ bɛsesa la bɛrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi zele kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɛne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma baye ye anyunlunyia ne ahile bɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mosisi zele Aalɔn kɛ, “Kɔ azukponle ne anwo, fa wɔ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne nee wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ kɔ, na bɔ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ azu maa ɛ nwo nee menli ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze wɔ la. Na fa menli ne mɔ azubɔdeɛ ne bɔ mgbɔdalɛ azu maa bɛ.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Aalɔn hɔle azukponle ne anwo na ɔhunle ɔdaye ye ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ɛnlankɛ ne.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne rɛlɛle ye, na ɔvale ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔle nu na ɔvale ɔpepenle azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, na ɔwolale mogya ne mɔɔ hale la ɔguale azukponle ne abo ne anwo.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ɔyelale nane ɛnlome ne, ye ɛzizira ne mɔ, ye ɛbolɛ nee nwolɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Azubɔdeɛ ne nane ne nee ye nwoma ne, ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Akee Aalɔn hunle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne; ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne hɔmanle ye, na ɔdole ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne azinli azinli ne mɔɔ bɛpepɛ la nee ɔ ti ne bɛrɛlɛle ye, na ɔyelale bɛ wɔ azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Akee ɔnrinzinle ɔ kunlu ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo na ɔyelale bɛ ɔbokale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anwo wɔ azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Akee Aalɔn vale menli ne azubɔdeɛ ne, ɔhunle abɔnkye ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne, na ɔvale ɔbɔle azu wɔ menli ne ɛtane ti, kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle alumua ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Eza ɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ azu ne, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne kile la.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle ma azubɔdeɛ azu ne na ɔyelale ye wɔ azukponle ne azo ɔbokale nwonlomɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne nee boane nyinli ne ɔbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu ne ɔmanle menli ne. Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ vale mogya ne rɛlɛle ye, na ɔdole ɔguale azukponle ne anwo amuala ɔyiale.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Na nane ne mɔ akɛnra azo ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛzɔlɛ fema ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdudule la, Aalɔn dole bɛ ehono na ɔvale ɔbɔle ehono azu ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Mosisi zele la.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Akee Aalɔn manle ɔ sa zo wɔ menli ne anwo zo na ɔyilale bɛ, na ɔvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvale ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔbɔle azu la ɔdwule aze.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi nee Aalɔn hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, na bɛvindele bɛrayilale menli ne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle menli ne kɔsɔɔti nwunle ye anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Na senle vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne rayelale ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne nee nane ɛnlome ne mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo la. Menli ne amuala nwunle ye la, bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua na bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Na Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ nwiɔ, Needabe nee Abaehu vale bɛ dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ la na bɛguale senle nu, bɛvulale ɛyɛlɛ bɛguale nu, na bɛvale senle mɔɔ ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza la bɛvindele Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛanze bɛ zɔhane la.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: Na senle vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne rayelale bɛ, na bɛwule ɛkɛ ne ala wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Mekile meamaa menli mɔɔ bikye me la anwu kɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza, na meamaa menli ne amuala anwu me anyunlunyia ne.’ ” Na Aalɔn andɛ ɔ nloa anu.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Mosisi vɛlɛle Aalɔn awuvuanyi Ɛzeɛle amra Maehyeeyɛle nee Ɛlezeefan na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛraye bɛ mediema ne mɔ bɛvi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ye bɛhɔ azokoɛleɛ ne anzi lɔ.”

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛrale na bɛravale bɛ wɔ bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu bɛvindele azokoɛleɛ ne anzi lɔ, kɛmɔ Mosisi ɛha la.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa bɛ ti enrinli kendɛhenda nwolɛ yɛɛ bɛmmasuosua bɛ adɛladeɛ nu bɛkile kɛ bɛlɛdi nyane, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, na bɛkɛmaa bɛkɛva menli mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛke la amuala anwo ɛya. Noko bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma amuala kola su bɛ wɔ senle ɛhye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛyela bɛ la ati.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Eza bɛmmabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ye anuhɔlɛ ne bɛtɛla, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwole ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔkpokpale bɛ la wɔ bɛ nwo.” Na bɛyɛle, kɛmɔ Mosisi hanle la. Sɛlɛvolɛma mɛla

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Mmano nza nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ. Ɛdawɔ o, anzɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ o, bɛmmano nza kolaa na bɛahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu. Ɛhye bayɛ mɛla ala ɛkɛ dahuu amaa wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la na bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo te la na bɛnwu mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile Yizilayɛma mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua Mosisi anwo zo ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la amuala.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Mosisi zele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛha la, Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa kɛ, “Bɛva ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyelale bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la abo ne mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛmmafa mgbɔvonle bɛwula nu, na bɛli wɔ azukponle ne anwo ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ, mɔɔ vi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu. Ɔluakɛ zɔhane yɛɛ bɛze me a.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Nane ɛzɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu ne nee nane ne akɛnra azo ne mɔɔ bɛdo ye ehono la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛboka ɛnlome ne mɔɔ bɛyela la anwo bɛto ye ehono, kɛ ehono azubɔdeɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na akee yeayɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mra ne mɔ ɛdeɛ dahuu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele la.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi bizebizale abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la anwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ, na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛyelale ye. Ɔvale Aalɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la, Ɛlieza nee Yetamaa anwo ɛya na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Duzu ati a bɛanli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛ? Ɔboalekɛ ɔle debie nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ, amaa bɛazoa menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ na bɛahɔyɛ nwolɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛanva ye mogya ne bɛamba ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne akunlu. Yemɔti anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ menzele la.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aalɔn buale Mosisi kɛ, “Nea, ɛnɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ nee bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛra Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la, nea mɔɔ ɛzi me nwo zo la. Saa menlile ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne ɛnɛ a, anrɛɛ ɛnee ɛnea a, ɔkɛzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye ɔ?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi dele ɛhye la, ɔ kunlu dwole.

english_verse: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkpakye ye ndwɛlɛ taboa ne anu nwiɔ na ɔkpu ɔkposa la, bɛli.
