english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Bɛha bɛhile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Ninyɛne mɔɔ lɛ ngoane kɛ nane nane, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi la, bɛmɛ ɛne:

english_verse: You may eat anything that lives in water and has fins and scales. But it would be disgusting for you to eat anything else that lives in water, and you must not even touch their dead bodies.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azule nu mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne anzɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ abonle la le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ.

english_verse: Eagles, vultures, buzzards, crows, ostriches, hawks, sea gulls, owls, pelicans, storks, herons, hoopoes, and bats are also disgusting, and you are forbidden to eat any of them.
translation_verse: “Nloma ɛhye mɔ noko le kyibadeɛ maa bɛ. Bɛmmadi bie: kɔleɛ, ɛkpɔtɛ, bɔngɔ, sanzia, kyɛnyema nee ye ɛsaso, kɔkɔsɛlɛ biala nee ye ɛsaso, soholo, kpadule, akoso, azuazuanloma, ahweanga, yɛɛ akpanlɛ.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Na ngɛkɛba mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ nee egyakɛ nna la kɔsɔɔti le kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha nane ɛhye mɔ bie funli la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu: nane biala mɔɔ lɛ ndwɛlɛ ndaboa mɔɔ bɛamkpakye nu noko ɔkpu ɔkposa, yɛɛ nane biala mɔɔ lɛ ɛweɛlɛ na ye ndwɛlɛ nna la, ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛzɔ bie funli nu la kpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, noko evinli ne mɔɔ ɛha ye la bawoa ɛkɛ ne toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha bie funli la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: If something made of wood, cloth, or leather touches one of their dead bodies, it must be washed, but it is still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Saa bie wu, na debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɔ zolɛ la, saa baka o, ɛdanlɛ o, nwoma o, kodoku o, debie biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ debie a ɔyɛ boɛ la, ɛnee deɛ zɔhane, evinli ɛha ye; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwula ye nzule nu, na nwolɛ ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ na nwolɛ ade.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Saa bie funli tɔ ɛyɛba anzɛɛ dwora nu a, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyɛba ne anzɛɛ dwora ne.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Aleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdi a ɔyɛ boɛ, na bɛkɛwola ɛyɛba ne anzɛɛ dwora ne anu nzule bɛkɛgua zolɛ la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Nzule bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ dwora anzɛɛ ɛyɛba ne anu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛno la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bie funli ɛleka bie bɔbɔ kɛdɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye; saa fonlomo o, anzɛɛ mokyea o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbubu ye. Bɛ nwo ɛnde, yemɔti bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Noko akee nzubula anzɛɛ nzule mɔɔ se la, bɛmɛ, evinli ɛnga bɛ. Na debie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha bɛ avunli la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Saa bie funli tɔ ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la azo a, evinli ɛnga ye.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛgua nzule ma ne azo na bie funli foa ko bie tɔ zolɛ a, nwolɛ ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Saa nane biala mɔɔ bɛdi la bie wu na ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛkɛva ɛ sa ɛkɛha ye la, evinli baha wɔ toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kɛli nane funli ne bie la, evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu; yɛɛ eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anzi, bɛdi bie na bɛyɛ kyibadeɛ. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛtoa bɛ bɛmaa evinli ka bɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. Bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔluakɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza. Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa debie biala mɔɔ kola fo anwuma na eza ɔtwenle ɔ nwo aze wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo a, amaa meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. Yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔluakɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza.”

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Mɛla ne kile ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, nee debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi nee mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛdi la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, saa raalɛ fa ɛkolɛ na ɔwo ralɛ nrenya a, evinli baha ye kenle nsuu, kɛ asɛɛ ɔhɔle amozi la.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo bɛbayɛ kakula ne mrenyanu nzonlɛ.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: “Saa raalɛ wo raalɛ a, evinli baha ye dapɛne nwiɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la, na yeahyi evinli ne kenle abulasia nee nsia na yeawie ye ɛdane fi.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Saa raalɛ wo na ɔwie ɛdane ne mɔ fi a, saa ɔwole nrenya o, ɔwole raalɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa boane edonraa mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko la ɔyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ekyi ko anzɛɛ abubule ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ye azubɔdeɛ ne abɔ azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na yeayɛ ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Ɔyɛ ɛhye ɔwie a, ɛnee akee ɔ nwo ɛde ɛvi mogya ne mɔɔ dule ye la anwo. Awie mɔɔ kɛwo ralɛ nrenya anzɛɛ ralɛ raalɛ la mɛla a le ɛhye.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Saa ɔnrɛhola boane fa a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ngyikyi nwiɔ; bɛfa ko bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa ye na bɛfa ko ne noko bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ye, na ɔ nwo ade.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Saa debie nwu awie, anzɛɛ hanlɛ tu ye anzɛɛ saa nyila bie nwu ye na ɔkakyi kokobɛ wɔ ahenle anwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ye bɛkɔ Aalɔn anzɛɛ ɔ mra sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ bie ɛkɛ,

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne nea ewule ne mɔɔ ɛha ahenle ne la Saa ɔba ye kɛ enrinli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ la ɛyɛ fufule, na ye hanlɛ ne anyunlu ɛyɛ kuma a, ɛnee kokobɛ ɔ; sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye wie a, ɔto duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na saa ɛleka mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ la le fufule na hanlɛ ne ɛnle kuma, eza enrinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛtɛyɛle fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula sonla ne mɔɔ ewule ne ɛha ye la sua nu kenle nsuu.

english_verse: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne anwo bieko; saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne nea na ewule ne anloa ɛha aze na ɔtɛtɛlɛle a, eza ɔbamaa bɛawula ahenle ne sua nu kenle nsuu bieko.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ɛhye noko dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea wuleravolɛ ne anwo bieko; saa deɛ ne mɔɔ yɛle ahenle la anyunlu ɛbulubulu na ɔtɛtɛlɛle a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te na debie ala a nwunle ye a. Ahenle ne bakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ɔ nwo bieko na saa deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ ye la ɛdɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Kokobɛ tila awie a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ahenle ne bɛkɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛkɛ.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle anwo kpalɛ, na saa debie fufule bie ɛnwu ahenle anwo, ɛmaa ye enrinli ne ɛyɛ fufule, na hanlɛ ne kpolo nzule a,

english_verse: he will say, “This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.”
translation_verse: ɛnee ɔle kokobɛ kokolabi wɔ ahenle anwo. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde. Ɔngyia kɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛwula ahenle sua nu, ɔluakɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde.

english_verse: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea nu kpalɛ. Saa ɔba ye kɛ ewule ne ɛva ɔ nwo amuala a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo te wɔ ewule ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔ muala ɛyɛ fufule; ɔ nwo te.

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banlea hanlɛ ne mɔɔ kpolo nzule la na yeado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde. Hanlɛ mɔɔ kpolo nzule la ɛnle debie kpalɛ, ɔle kokobɛ.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne anwo, na saa ewule ne anyunlu ɛyɛ fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te; ɔ nwo te bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: na saa debie fufule nwu ɔ bo zo ne anzɛɛ hanlɛ anyunlu kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule tu ɔ bo zo ne a, bɛva bɛhɔhile sɛlɛvolɛ ne.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ahenle ne hanlɛ ne kpalɛ, na saa hanlɛ ne ɛyɛ kuma na enrinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛyɛ fufule a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye na yevinde hanlɛ ne anu.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye na ɔnwu kɛ enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la ɛnle fufule yɛɛ hanlɛ ne ɛnle kuma, na eza ɔ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Saa hanlɛ ne tɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde; ewule ɛha ye.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Na saa hanlɛ ne andɛlɛ a, ɛnee deɛ ne mɔɔ nwunle ye la abo zo hanlɛ ɔ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ɔ nwo te.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: “Saa awie yelɛyela na ye ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛtwi nzule la anyunlu yɛ fufule anzɛɛ kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule a,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛnleɛnlea ye. Saa enrinli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nganlɛ ne anu la ɛyɛ fufule na hanlɛ ne anyunlu le kuma a, ɛnee kokobɛ ɔ; ɛyelalɛ hanlɛ ne a ɛhakyi a. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde; ɔle ewule kokobɛ.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ye na ɔnwu kɛ enrinli ne mɔ ɛtɛyɛle fufule, nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma na bɛ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne eza banleɛnlea ye bieko. Saa nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛtɛlɛdɛlɛ a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde; kokobɛ ɛdila ye.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Na saa nganlɛ ne mɔ andɛlɛdɛlɛ na bɛ nyunlu ɛbulubulu a, ɛnee ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛnwunwu a. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo te, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛyelalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ahapenle ɔ.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ nyia ewule wɔ ɔ ti zo anzɛɛ ɔ kɛsa anu a,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ewule ne, na saa ye nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu le kuma na enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la le akɔlɛnlome, na bɛle ndenrɛndenra a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado duma kɛ ahenle anwo ɛnde. Azenra ɛdila ye, na ɔle ewule kokobɛ mɔɔ ɛdila ɔ ti anzɛɛ ɔ kɛsa a.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ewule ne na nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma na enrinli bile ɛngyigyi nu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛawula ahenle mɔɔ azenra ne ɛdila ye la sua nu kenle nsuu.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne azo sɛlɛvolɛ ne eza banleɛnlea ewule ne na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle, na enrinli mɔɔ gyigyi nu la ɛtɛyɛle akɔlɛnlome, na azenra ne mɔ anyunlu ɛnle kuma a,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa ahenle akpa ɔ ti na bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu bieko; ɛleka mɔɔ azenra ne mɔ bie wɔ la, bɛnrɛkpa ɛkɛ ne enrinli ne.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread and seems no more than skin deep, he will say, “You are clean; now you must wash your clothes.”
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne dwu a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea azenra ne mɔ, na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle na bɛ nyunlu ɛnle kuma a, ɔbado duma kɛ ahenle ne anwo te. Ɔbakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ ala, ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ye, na saa azenra ne mɔ ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ a, ɛnee ɔngyia kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛkpondɛ kɛnwu kɛ enrinli akɔlɛnlome gyi nu; ahenle anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Saa debie fufule pepe raalɛ anzɛɛ nrenya nwo a,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea deɛ zɔhane na saa deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛpepe ahenle anwo la ɛnle fufule nwohyee kpalɛ a, ɛnee ahenle anwo yɛɛ ɛnyia dɛne a, na ɔ nwo te.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Saa ɔ nwoma azo enrinli ne tudu kɔ a, ɛnee ɔ nwoma azo a ɛdu a na ɔ nwo te.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea, na saa ewule ne mɔɔ ɛvinde ɔ ti zo ɛleka mɔɔ ɛdu anzɛɛ ɔ nwoma azo ɛleka mɔɔ ɛdu la le kɔkɔlɛ nee fufule kɛ asɛɛ kokobɛ ɛlɛfinde ɔ nwo la a,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Awie mɔɔ kokobɛ kɛdila ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwula adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛtete la na ɔgyakyi ɔ ti enrinli ne ɔgua zolɛ, mɔɔ ɔntoli nu a. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkeda ɔ nloa sɔlɔ ne azo na ɔlua a, ɔtea nuhua kɛ, ‘Me nwo ɛnde o, me nwo ɛnde!’

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne banleɛnlea ewule ne, na yeamaa bɛawula deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la sua nu kenle nsuu.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the mildew hasn't spread,
translation_verse: “Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne neɛnlea ewule ne na ɔtɛtɛlɛdɛlɛle ɛdanlɛ anzɛɛ nwoma ne anu a,

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛakpo deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la na bɛawula ye sua nu kenle nsuu bieko.

english_verse: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.
translation_verse: Saa ewule ne finde ɛleka fofolɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɔlɛtɛlɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ne wɔ nu la senle nu bɛyela ye.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Tɛladeɛ, ndanlɛ nyɛma, anzɛɛ nwoma mɔɔ kɛbɔ adubue na bɛkɛkpo na adubue ne anzia amba bieko la, bɛkpo ye bieko, ɛnee deɛ ne anwo ɛde.”

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛabɔ ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛnua ye la ati bɛava nloma mɔɔ anwo te la nwiɔ anyewɔzo, sida baka, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli, yɛɛ nyinlanyinla.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛahu nloma ne mɔ ko wɔ siase mɔɔ nzule amolɛ wɔ nu la anu.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava anloma ko ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la, sida baka ne, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli ne nee nyinlanyinla ne yeabɔ bɛ anloma ne mɔɔ bɛhu ye la mogya ne anu,

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: na yeakponde ye ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anwo fane nsuu, na akee yeado duma kɛ ɔ nwo ɛde, na yeadwula anloma anyewɔzo ne yeamaa yeahɔ.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Akee ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la bakpo ye adɛladeɛ, yeakpa ɔ nwo enrinli kɔsɔɔti na yeabia; ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛde. Ɛhye anzi ɔbara sua zo, noko ɔnrɛhɔ ye ndanlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔbala alie nwo toonwo kenle nsuu.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne azo ɔbakpa ɔ ti bieko, yeakpa ɔ kɛsa, ɔ nye anzi nee ɔ nwo enrinli biala. Ɔbakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na yeabia, ɛnee akee ɔ nwo ɛde.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la nee ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava mboane nyinli ne mɔ ko nee ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko ne ayɛ fɔlɛlilɛ anzɛɛ abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ, abɔ ehono azu amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbahu boane ne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la, wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne. Ɔluakɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne le kɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne la, na ɔle sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ; ɔle debie mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ a.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne bie aha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile ne azo, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne azo.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bawola ɔlivi nwole toba foa ko ne bie agua ɔdaye sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɔ sa bɛne ne anu,

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na yeava ɔ sa fema ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la anu yeava yeakponde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Nwole ne mɔɔ kɛha sɛlɛvolɛ ne asa anu la, ɔbava bie yeaha ahenle mɔɔ ɔlɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile ne azo, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne azo wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvale fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mogya ne ɔpepenle la.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne babɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ azu ne mɔ wɔ azukponle ne azo. Zɛhae debie yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ yeava yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ahenle ne na ahenle anwo ade saanwu a.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ, nuhua biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhola ye fa la; bɛbava ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na bɛava ko bɛayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo yɛɛ ɔbava bɛ yearɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne na bɛanlua ye a. Ɔbava yearagyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne;

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbahu fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ boane ne, na yeava ye mogya ne bie yeaha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati nee ɔ sa fema kokotile nee ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bawola nwole ne bie ɔdaye ɔ sa bɛne ne anu

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na yeava ɔ sa fema ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeava nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la bie yeakponde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava nwole ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ sa bɛne ne anu la bie aha ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la anzo fema ne ati, ɔ sa fema kokotile nee ɔ gyakɛ fema kokotile ne mɔ azo, wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvale fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya ne bɛpepenle la.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko ne yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ yeaboka ma azubɔdeɛ ne anwo. Na sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu amaa ahenle mɔɔ bɛnua ye la.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Ɛnee sonla mɔɔ kokobɛ ɛdila ye na ɔ nwo ɛza, na ɔnrɛhola azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ sesa la mɛla ɛdeɛ ne ɛne.” Sua nu nzenzemile

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo, na memaa ewule kokobɛ tɔ awuke bie anu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo a,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ lɛ sua ne la baka kile sɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me kɛ ewule bie ɛdɔ me sua nu ɛkɛ.’

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Ɔbanleɛnlea ewule ne, na saa ewule holɛ ko ne wɔ sua ne bane ne mɔ bie anwo, na ɔ nye le asuomenle nee kɔkɔlɛ, na ɔ bo le kuma a,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne bavinde ara sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, na yeado sua ne anu dedee kenle nsuu.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bara bieko wɔ kenle nsuu ne azo na yearanlea. Saa ewule ne ɛdɛlɛ sua ne bane ne mɔ anwo a,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne bamaa bɛakpokpo sua ne anu bane ne mɔ anwo bɛayia na bɛahɔdo bɛagua fovolɛ zo wɔ suakpole ne kandiba,

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: na bɛava awolɛ fofolɛ bɛawulowula bane ne mɔ anu, bɛatanlitanli sua ne bane ne na akee bɛada sua ne bieko.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne bahɔ ahɔnlea sua ne bieko, na saa ewule ne ɛdɛlɛ a, ɛnee ɔle ewule kokobɛ nzane mɔɔ ɛha sua ne a; sua ne anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ɔbamaa bɛabubu sua ne, na bɛavulovula nuhua awolɛ, mbaka nee ndɛtɛlɛ ne mɔ amuala bɛahɔgua fovolɛ zo wɔ suakpole ne kandiba.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ɔba ye zɛhae a awie biala mɔɔ kɛwolo sua ne anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdo nu la, evinli baha ye na ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: “Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne baneɛnlea sua ne anu na ewule ne ɛtɛtɛlɛle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛda sua ne akunlu fofolɛ la a, ɔbaha yeado gua kɛ sua ne anwo te, ɔluakɛ ewule ne ɛhɔ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Sua zɛhae ɛnluanlɛ nu, ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ lɛ sua ne la sesa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ: nloma ngyikyi nwiɔ, sida baka nee boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli, yɛɛ nyinlanyinla.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Akee ɔbahu nloma ne mɔ ko wɔ ɛyɛba mɔɔ nzule amolɛ wɔ nu la anu,

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Zɛhae yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ na ɔfa anloma ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la, boane kɔkɔlɛ enrinli ne nee nyinlanyinla ne ɔnua sua ne a.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbadwula anloma ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la yeamaa yeahɔ; na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa sua ne; ɛnee sua ne anwo ɛde bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a bahile kɛ ahenle anzɛɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ ewule ɛhye mɔ bie ɛha ye la anwo te anzɛɛ anwo ɛnde a. Ewule kokobɛ nwo mɛla ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Saa nide vi awie mrenyanu finde a, ɛnee ahenle anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: Anything that he rests on or sits on is also unclean,
translation_verse: Ɛkpa biala mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la kɛla zolɛ anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔwɔ evinli nu toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Saa awie mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la to nyɛlɛ awie mɔɔ anwo te la anwo a, ahenle mɔɔ bɛdole nyɛlɛ ne ɔ nwo la anwo ɛnde. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Yemɔti awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha debie biala mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle zolɛ la evinli baha ye toonwo nɔsolɛ; yɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛzoa debie zɛhae bie la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ sonla mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la anrinzi ɔ sa anwo na ɔ nwo kɛha ye la, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Dwora biala mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la kɛva ɔ sa kɛha ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ye. Saa dwora ne le baka dwora a, yemɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpuda nu kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: “ ‘Saa awie mɔɔ ye mrenyanu twi nide la te kpɔkɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtia kenle nsuu, na akee ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia azudenle nu anzɛɛ ɔfa nzule amolɛ ɔbia na ɔ nwo ade.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, na ɔfa ɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava abɔ azu; ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko ne yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ ye mrenyanu ewule ne anwo.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “ ‘Saa nrenya nwo ba a, ɛnee evinli ɛha ye. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Debie biala, tɛladeɛ, nwoma anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ biala mɔɔ nlanzule ne bie kɛpe nuhua la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpo, yɛɛ nwolɛ ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya nee raalɛ da na ɔ nwo ba a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbia, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “ ‘Saa raalɛ kɔ ɛwazɛne nu a, evinli baha ye toonwo kenle nsuu. Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ye la anwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ye ɛkpa anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya fa raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la a, ɛnee raalɛ ne anwo evinli ne bie ɛha ye. Evinli ne baha ye toonwo kenle nsuu, yɛɛ ɛkpa biala mɔɔ ɔkɛla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “ ‘Saa raalɛ tudu mogya kenle dɔɔnwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnle ɛwazɛne nu, anzɛɛ saa ɔka ɛwazɛne nu a, mekɛ dodo mɔɔ mogya ne tɛtu ye anzɛɛ ɔtɛbɔ ɛwazɛne nu la, ɔ nwo ɛnde. Evinli ɛha ye, kɛmɔ saa ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu a ɛnee ɔwɔ evinli nu la.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Ɛkpa biala mɔɔ ɔkɛla zolɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mogya ne tɛtu ye la le kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu la, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdɛnla zolɛ la anwo ɛnde; ɔle kɛ ɔwɔ ɛwazɛne nu la.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ anwo kɛha ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ biala la anwo ɛnde. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔ nwo pɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtia kenle nsuu kolaa na ɔ nwo ade.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava abɔ azu; ɔbava ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ evinli ne mɔɔ ɛha ye la anwo.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: “ ‘Zɛhae yɛɛ ɛbayɛ wɔava wɔade Yizilayɛma anwo wɔ evinli mɔɔ kɛha bɛ la anwo a, amaa bɛanva evinli bɛanga me Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ gyi bɛ avinli la na bɛawu.’ ”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ka kile ɛ diema nrenya Aalɔn kɛ ɔmmaba Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ wɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la anwo dahuu. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɔbawu, ɔluakɛ mebaye me nwo meahile wɔ amungu ne mɔɔ wɔ Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne azo la anu.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn si ba Nwuanzanwuanza Ɛleka ne la ɛne: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɔba la, ɔva ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko ɔyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ boane nyinli ko ɔyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔrabɔ azu.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbia, na ɔwula ye sɛlɛvolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ: Lenen tɛladeɛ bubu nwuanzanwuanza ne, lenen akyeso ne, yɛɛ lenen abɔtile ne.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: “Akee Yizilayɛ maanlema ne bava mbɔnkye nyinli nwiɔ bɛamaa yeava yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ yɛɛ boane nyinli ko bɛamaa yeava yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Aalɔn bava ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne abɔ ɔdaye ye ɛtane nwo azu, na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava mbɔnkye nwiɔ ne yeahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Ɔbagua mbɔnkye nwiɔ ne ati nzeleba, yeaye ko yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na ko ne noko ahɔ Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Aalɔn bava abɔnkye ne mɔɔ hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne la amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeava yeabɔ ɛtane azu.

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ko ne mɔɔ hɔle Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne la, bɛbava ye anyewɔzo bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeagua zolɛ, amaa bɛava bɛahɔ fienemgbole ne anu bɛahɔgyakyi ye bɛamaa Azazɛle.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Saa Aalɔn fa ɛnlankɛ nyinli ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne bɔ azu maa ɔ nwo, na ɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra ɔwie a, ɔbahu ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne yeabɔ ɛtane azu yeamaa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava kyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ la yeavula samɛnlankɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo, na eza yeavula ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnlu ye ekyii la ɔ sa nwiɔ yeara mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne, ɔbava ɛyɛlɛ ne yeagua senle ne anu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, amaa ɛyɛlɛ ne esike ne aheda Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la azo, amaa yeannwu ye na yeawu.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbava ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka yeabɔ ɛnlankɛ ne mogya ne anu yeakponde Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne fane nsuu.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “Akee Aalɔn bahu ɛtane azubɔdeɛ abɔnkye ne yeabɔ azu wɔ Yizilayɛma ati, na yeava ye mogya ne yeahɔ mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne akunlu na yeakponde ye wɔ Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne azo nee ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ne mogya ne la.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Zɛhae yɛɛ ɔbayɛ yeayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeade Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne nee Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo a, kɛmɔ ɔgyi Yizilayɛma avinli na bɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ nee bɛ mɛladonlɛ bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli bɛha ye la.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Ɔwie a, akee ɔbavinde yeahɔ azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la anwo, yeahɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa azukponle ne, na yeava ɛnlankɛ ne nee abɔnkye ne mogya ne mɔ bie yeapepe ɔ bati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo yeayia.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ɔbɔ mogya ne anu ɔkponde azukponle ne fane nsuu ɔnua ye, na ɔte nwolɛ ɔfi Yizilayɛma evinli ne anwo. Abɔnkye ne

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Saa Aalɔn wie Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne, Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne mɔ ati mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ a, akee ɔbava abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛtɛkunle ye la yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Ɔbava ɔ sa nwiɔ yeagua abɔnkye ne ati zo, na yeaha Yizilayɛma amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛ mɛladonlɛ nee ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala yeagua abɔnkye ne ati zo, na yeagyakyi ye yeamaa awie mɔɔ bɛboa bɛye ye la ava ye ahɔ fienemgbole ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Abɔnkye ne bazoa bɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ahɔ ɛleka solokoko wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ awie biala ɛnle la.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: na yeava nzule yeabia wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ te la, yeava ɔdaye ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ yeawula, yeavinde na yearabɔ ye ɛyelalɛ azu ɛdeɛ ne. Ɔwie a eza ɔbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ menli ne ati na akee ɔyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo, na ɔyɛ bie ɔmaa menli ne amuala.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ɔyela ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne akunlu ɛnlome ne wɔ azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Ahenle mɔɔ hɔgyakyile abɔnkye ne manle ɔhɔle Azazɛle ɛkɛ ne la bakpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na yeabia kolaa na yeara azokoɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbazoa ɛnlankɛ ne nee abɔnkye ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ bɛ mogya a bɛvale bɛhɔle Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne bɛhɔyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne la bɛahɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba, na bɛayela bɛ nane, nwoma nee bɛ kunlu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ahenle mɔɔ kɛyela bɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia kolaa na yeara azokoɛleɛ ne. Mgbɔdalɛ Nzɛlɛlɛ Kenle ne ɛzielɛ

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Akee ɔbayɛ mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu ɔmaa bɛ a; siane nsuu ne kenle bulu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ o, nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ nee bɛ de la o, biala ɛnyɛ gyima a.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kenle ɛhye anu yɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, bɛanlua bɛ, bɛade bɛ nwo bɛavi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo, na bɛ nwo ayɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ hyia maa bɛ a, na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne kenle zɔhane. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu a.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛkɛwula ye, bɛkɛdu ye bɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔkɛgyinla ɔ ze agyakɛ anu la a bayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne a. Ɔbawula lenen adɛladeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ a yeayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne a.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yeamaa Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔbayɛ bie yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee azukponle ne, na yeayɛ bie yeamaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee menli ne amuala.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bayɛ mɛla mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ la amaa bɛ, amaa bɛava kenle ko wɔ ɛvolɛ biala anu bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛamaa Yizilayɛma amuala, wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.” Na Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye la amuala.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ: Ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: na yeanva yeamba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, yeambɔ azu yeammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu a, ɛnee yedo mɛla kɛ yeha mogya yegua. Sonla zɔhane, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi Nyamenle menli ne avinli.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bado ye mogya ne agua Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne anwo ayia wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, na yeayela ye ɛnlome ne yeabɔ azu evuanlɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: “Eza ka kile bɛ kɛ: Yizilayɛnli biala, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu anzɛɛ kɛbɔ azu ngakyile biala,

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: na yeanva yeamba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne, yeambambɔ azu ne yeammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la, sonla zɔhane, bɛbaye ye bɛavi Nyamenle menli ne avinli.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: “Saa Yizilayɛnli biala, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la di mogya a, mebahyi sonla zɔhane mɔɔ di mogya la, na meaye ye meavi ɔdaye ye menli avinli.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nwonane ne ngoane wɔ mogya ne anu, yɛɛ meva memaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne azo bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ mogya ne a maa mgbɔdalɛ ne di munli a, ɔboalekɛ ngoane wɔ nu.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: “Eza ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛnli biala anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ di ɛbɔlɛ ku nane nee nloma mɔɔ bɛdi la, twi mogya ne gua na ɔfe ɛnwea ɔkeda zolɛ.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ abɔdeɛ biala ngoane wɔ ye mogya ne anu. Yemɔti meka meahile Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Awie biala mmadi abɔdeɛ biala mogya. Ɔluakɛ nane biala ngoane a le ye mogya ne. Mɔɔ kɛli bie la bɛbaye ye bɛavi menli ne avinli.’

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛli nane mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome yewu anzɛɛ nanemgbole bie ɛtete ye la, saa ɔle Yizilayɛnli o, ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔbia, yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛnrɛde toonwo nɔsolɛ, ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛde a.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Na saa yeamkpo ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ, yeambia ɔ nwo a, ɔdaye ye ɛtane zo ye.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ Yigyibitima mɔɔ ɛnee bɛde bɛ avinli la yɛ la bie. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Keenama mɔɔ melɛfa bɛ meara bɛ avinli la yɛ la bie. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi menli zɔhane amaamuo zo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛsie me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, bɛdi zolɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze aye biala. Ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, wɔgua ɛ ze anyunlu aze.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye bɛ ze nee bɛ nli ko, anzɛɛ asolo ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli la.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ nli adiema raalɛ; ɔle ɛ nli anwo sonla mɔɔ bikye ye a.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ze adiema nrenya aye. Ɔle ɛ nli.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa raalɛ na eza ɛfa ɔ ra raalɛ; mmafa ɔ ra nrenya ara raalɛ anzɛɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ara raalɛ. Ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee wɔgua raalɛ ne anyunlu aze. Bɛ muala bɛle mraalɛ mɔɔ bikye wɔ a, ɛ nwo amra ɔ. Nyɛleɛ zɛhae le amumuyɛ ɛbɛla.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Eza ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ ye adiema raalɛ ɛyɛ ɛ ye ahola wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ ye de ngoane nu la.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Eza ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛ gɔnwo aye na ɛgua ɛ nwo evinli.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ mra ne mɔ anu biala bɛsie ahane bɛmaa kɛ bɛyela ye bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bozonle Molɛke. Bɛyɛ ɛhye a, ɛnee bɛbɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne anyiemgba. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo nrenya; ɔle munzule debie.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: “Bɛmmayɛ ɛhye mɔ anu biala bie na bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli, ɔluakɛ zɔhane ninyɛne yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ melɛtu bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo meava meamaa bɛ la yɛle vale zɛkyele bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle zɔhane bɛvale bɛzɛkyele azɛlɛ ne, amaa ɔlua zo mendeanle azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛlɛtu menli mɔɔ de zolɛ la a.

english_verse: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ zɛhae munzule ninyɛne yɛɛ menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la yɛle vale zɛkyele azɛlɛ ne a.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ bie a azɛlɛ ne bakpo bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔkpole maanle maanle mɔɔ lumuale dɛnlanle zolɛ la.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛli me edwɛkɛ zo, na bɛmmayɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bie, na bɛbu munzule amaamuo ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ lumuale azɛlɛ ne azo la bule la bie. Bɛmmayɛ ye zɔhane bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te, ɔluakɛ Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mele nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmagyakyi me bɛkɔsonle awozonle na bɛyɛ ananze mmonle biala bɛmaa bɛ nwo. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛfa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bɛmaa ɔvi bɛ ahonle nu, amaa mealie bɛ meado nu.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi azubɔdeɛ ne amuala kenle ko ne ala, anzɛɛ bɛwie ye di wɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu. Mɔɔ kɛha na ɔkɛli kenle nsa la, bɛgua ye senle nu bɛyela ye.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Saa ɔdi kenle nsa na bie tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛdi a, ɔle munzule; menrɛlie menrɛdo nu.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ahenle noko mɔɔ lile la, ye munzule zo ye, ɔboalekɛ yegua debie nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ la anwo evinli. Sonla zɔhane, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi Nyamenle menli ne anu.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbu bɛ ɛya nu bɛyɔba ne a, bɛmmabu toonwo bɛkɔ ɛya ne anloa kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛbu a, ɔ bo zo ɔ bo zo ne mɔ, bɛmmasia bɛ nzi bɛkɔsesa.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Bɛtete bɛ vanye ma a, bɛmmatete dedee bɛmaa ɔka mbaka mgbane ne ala, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛtete kɛgua la, bɛmmasesa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi bie zolɛ bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma nee nyɛvolɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmawua, bɛmmadi ndunlumi, yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo ngoko.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Eza bɛmmafa me duma bɛka adalɛ ndane bɛgua bɛ Nyamenle ne duma ne anwo evinli. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmasisi bɛ gɔnwo mɔ yɛɛ bɛmmawua bɛ. Bɛbɔ awie ɛkpa a ɔnle kɛ ye ɛkpabɔdeɛ ne anzɛɛ ye ahatualɛ ne ka bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne toonwo aleɛ kye zolɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛwa mɔɔ anzo ɛdi la amonle, anzɛɛ bɛfa koti bɛto mɔɔ anye ɛzi la adenle nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo bɛ Nyamenle ne; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛbua mgbɔvodɛne. Ɔnle kɛ bɛbua bɛtia ehyianli na bɛbua bɛmaa sonlakpole. Bɛbua bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ndɛne wɔ adenle kpalɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛduolua bɛ gɔnwo mɔ akɔme nu bɛkeha awie mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ la, yɛɛ bɛmmadi daselɛ adalɛ bɛtia bɛ gɔnwo bɛmaa ɔminli ye ngoane. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmafa bɛ gɔnwo anwo edwɛkɛ bɛsie bɛ kunlu; bɛ nee ye ɛha, anrɛɛ bɛkɛli ɔ nwo ɛzonle.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadi nzenralɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛdabɛ bɛ menli ne mɔ amra mrenya anwo edwɛkɛ bɛsie bɛ kunlu. Bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nwo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo. Ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa nyɛmoa gyɛne fola bɛ nyɛmoa. Ɔnle kɛ bɛdua ma ngakyile nwiɔ wɔ ɛya ko ne ala anu, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ninyɛne ngakyile nwiɔ bɛnwo tɛladeɛ bɛwula.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya nee kanranli raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛyia ye na bɛtɛkpɔnenle ye anzɛɛ bɛtɛmanle ye fanwodi la da a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu menli bɛmaa bɛneɛnlea nu kpalɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛku bɛ, ɔboalekɛ raalɛ ne ɛnli ɔ ti anwo.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: na sɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ maa ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo; na bɛkɛva ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la bɛkɛhyɛ ye.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ zo, na bɛdua bɛ mbakama ngakyile ne mɔ na ɔso a, bɛbu nzoleɛ ne kɛ ɔle kyibadeɛ, bɛmmadi zolɛ aleɛ toonwo ɛvolɛ nsa.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ nna ne azo, mbaka ne mɔ azo ma ne amuala anwo bade saanwu; bɛva bɛbɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Na ye ɛvolɛ nnu ne azo bɛkola bɛdi nzoleɛ ne bie. Ɛhye bamaa mbaka ne mɔ azo dɔɔnwo amaa bɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmadi nane biala mɔɔ mogya ne gyi nu la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛye ngonyia anzɛɛ bɛbɔ ayɛne ɛbɛla biala.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛbodɛboda bɛ nwo bɛkile bɛ nyanelilɛ wɔ awie mɔɔ ɛwu la ati anzɛɛ bɛbobɔ ngonlɛ biala; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mraalɛ bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze, anrɛɛ tuutuulilɛ kɛva azɛlɛ ne na amumuyɛ kɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ na bɛdi me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne eni; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmabiza bɛ nwo wɔ menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo la anzɛɛ nyɛnema ɛkɛ. Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ bo zo bɔbɔ na evinli aha bɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “Bɛnwu kpanyinli a bɛli ye eni, bɛdwazo enililɛ nu bɛmaa mɔɔ ati zo ɛdu la na bɛzulo bɛ Nyamenle ne; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛyɛvolɛ bie batɛnla bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo a, bɛmmayɛ ye ɛtane.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye a lua la bɛyɛ ye kɛmɔ bɛkɛyɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nuhua bie ala la. Eza bɛhulo ye kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ nwo la. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ tone ne mɔ ɛgyinla sɛsɛ. Bɛmmawua debie ɛzuzulɛ nu; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Yizilayɛnli biala anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ de Yizilayɛma avinli, mɔɔ kɛva ɔ ra kɛbɔ azu kɛmaa bozonle Molɛke la, bɛhu ye. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ maanle ne anu la ɛzi ye awolɛ ɛhu ye.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Medame mumua ne mebava me nye meawula sonla zɔhane anyunlu, na meaye ye meavi ɔdaye ye menli avinli. Mebayɛ ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ yeva ɔ ra yebɔ azu yemaa bozonle Molɛke, yegua me Ɛzonlenlɛ Ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli na yezɛkye me duma.

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: mebava me nye meazie ahenle nee ye mbusuafoɔ anyunlu, na meaye bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdoale ye bɛhɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla mgbane ne wɔ bozonle Molɛke abo la amuala meavi bɛ menli avinli.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “Saa awie kɔbiza ɔ nwo wɔ sonla mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo la ɛkɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɔ bayivolɛ bie ɛkɛ ɔkɔbiza ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ kɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla a, mebava me nye meazie ɔ nyunlu na meaye ye meavi ye menli ne avinli.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde saanwu, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Bɛli me mɛla ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ memaa bɛ nwo te a.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛwa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli amonle la, bɛhu ye. Yewa ɔ ze nee ɔ nli amonle, yemɔti ye mogya gua ɔdaye ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo aye a, bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ nee ɔ ze aye kɛla la ɛbɔ ɔ ze anyiemgba; bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ. Bɛ mogya gua bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Saa awie fa ɔ ra nrenya aye a, bɛhu nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne. Bɛbɔ munzule, bɛ mogya ne gua bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya fa ɔ gɔnwo nrenya a, bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbɔ munzule; bɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ bɛ mogya gua bɛdabɛ bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya gya raalɛ na eza ɔfa ɔ ye ɔ nli a, ɔle amumuyɛ ɛbɛla. Bɛgua bɛ senle nu bɛyela bɛ, amaa zɛhae amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne azi aze wɔ bɛ avinli.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Saa raalɛ twe bikye nane bie na ɔmaa ɔfa ye a, bɛhu raalɛ ne nee nane ne; bɛ mogya ne gua bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya fa ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ le ɔ ze ara anzɛɛ ɔ nli ara a, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze. Ɔle anyiemgba debie, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye bɛ bɛfi bɛ mediema ne mɔ anu. Nrenya ne ɛbɔ ɔ diema raalɛ ne anyiemgba, yemɔti ye amumuyɛ ne zo ye.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya nee raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛwazɛne nu la da, ɔfa ye a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛfi menli ne avinli, ɔboalekɛ bɛgua bɛ nwo evinli.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ nrenya fa ɔ nli adiema raalɛ anzɛɛ ɔ ze adiema raalɛ. Ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee yeva ɔ nwo sonla; bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ munzule doa bɛ.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya nee ɔ wuvuanyi aye da a, ɛnee yebɔ ɔ wuvuanyi ne anyiemgba. Ɔ nee raalɛ ne bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ ɛtane zo bɛ; bɛnrɛwo ralɛ ɛlɛ na bɛawu.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Saa awie fa ɔ diema nrenya aye a, ɔle evinli yɛɛ eza yegua ɔ diema nrenya ne anyunlu aze; bɛnrɛwo ɛlɛ na bɛawu.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛli me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo na bɛyɛ, amaa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la anye bɛ.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Eza bɛmmadi menli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti melɛtu bɛ la maamɛla ne mɔ azo; ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle ɛhye mɔ amuala, yemɔti a mengyile bɛ a.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, meha mehile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛbava azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ mebava meamaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ a.’ Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ mevi menli kɔsɔɔti anu a.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te maa me, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ meye bɛ mevi menli kɔsɔɔti avinli mezie ahane, kɛ bɛle me ɛdeɛ mekɛ biala.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “Nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ biala mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo anzɛɛ le bayivolɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye. Bɛzi bɛ awolɛ bɛhu bɛ, na bɛ mogya gua bɛdabɛ bɛ ti zo.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Tendɛ kile Aalɔn amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne na ka kile bɛ kɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛ biala gua ɔ nwo evinli. Saa awie wu a, ɔnle kɛ bɛ biala kɔ funli ne anwo,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: anzɛɛ ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛkɔle agyalɛ na ɔnze nrenya la, yemɔ, ɔkola ɔkɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Saa ɔle kunli bɔbɔ a ɔnle kɛ ɔgua ɔ nwo evinli wɔ ye menli ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛkpa bɛ ti anzɛɛ bɛ kɛsa, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛbobɔ ngonlɛ biala.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te maa bɛ Nyamenle; ɔnle kɛ bɛgua bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo evinli. Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na eza bɛbɔ aleɛ azu bɛmaa bɛ Nyamenle ne a. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛgya raalɛ tuutuunli anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛva ye ɛlɛ la. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole la, ɔluakɛ sɛlɛvolɛ biala anwo te maa ye Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtu ye ɛsie ahane ɛmaa Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye a ɔfa aleɛ ɔbɔ azu ɔmaa wɔ Nyamenle ne a; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ nwo te maa wɔ, ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ mete ɛ nwo la, mele nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ara raalɛ biala mɔɔ kɛzɛkye ɔ nwo kɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla biala la ɛgua ɔ ze anyunlu aze. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛto ye senle nu bɛyela ye.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya raalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya la.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Saa ɔkagya raalɛ a ɔnle kɛ ɔgya raalɛ mɔɔ le kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole, anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛva ye ɛlɛ, anzɛɛ tuutuunli. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya ɔdaye ye abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne mɔ bie mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya fee la.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Saa yeanyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔ mra mɔɔ ɔbawo bɛ la, biala anwo ɛnrɛde, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mete ɔ nwo a.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la, ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye me; anyenzinliravolɛ anzɛɛ abubura, anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ anahɛlɛ ɛtete ye, anzɛɛ ye agbɔkɛ ne mɔ bie wale bo zolɛ,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: anzɛɛ nrenya mɔɔ agyakɛ anzɛɛ asa ɛbu,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: awie mɔɔ le afu, anzɛɛ ɔle adwola kɛ motia, anzɛɛ awie mɔɔ anye ɛyɛ na ɔnnwu aze kpalɛ, anzɛɛ mɔɔ senra, nzɔlɔsɔlɔ anzɛɛ fonvoamgbɔde ɛgua ye anzɛɛ bɛza ye,

english_verse: They may eat the food offerings presented to me,
translation_verse: Ɔkola ɔdi ye Nyamenle ne aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza nee aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ ne bie,

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: noko ɔnle kɛ ɔbikye mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anzɛɛ azukponle ne, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nwo lɛ dɛne. Ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee yeva evinli yeha ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ memaa bɛ nwo te a.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi dendɛle hilele Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma amuala.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɛ bɛnlea ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛdu ɛzie ahane ɛmaa me la boɛ, amaa bɛanzɛkye me duma; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: “Aalɔn abo zo sonla biala mɔɔ le kokobɛvolɛ anzɛɛ anwo twihwi nzule la ɛnlɛ adenle ɛnli aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ bie, kyesɛ ɔ nwo ɛza na ɔ nwo ɛde. Eza awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha funli anzɛɛ awie mɔɔ anla boɛ la, evinli ɛha ye.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Saa sɛnzɛne ne tɔ a ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛde a; nzinlii akee ɔkola ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, ɔboalekɛ aleɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi la ala ɛne.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛwu anzɛɛ nanemgbole bie kɛtete ye la, saa bɛfa bɛ sa bɛka ye a, ɛnee evinli ɛha bɛ Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛli me mɛla zo na anrɛɛ bɛkɛli ɛzonle na bɛkɛwu kɛ bɛvonle me mɛla ne a; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ maa bɛ nwo te a.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
