translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛmboka sɛlɛvolɛma abusua ekpunli ne anwo la di aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie. Sɛlɛvolɛ biala ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye de anzɛɛ ye sonvolɛ mɔɔ yebɔ ye ɛkpa la, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne bie.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Saa bɛgya sɛlɛvolɛ bie ara raalɛ bɛkɔ abusua ekpunli gyɛne nu a, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu la bie.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Na saa sɛlɛvolɛ ne ara raalɛ ne le kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔ hu ɛbɔ ye ewole, na ɔnlɛ ralɛ, na yezia yera ɔ ze sua nu a, ɔle kɛ mɔɔ ye ngakula nu ɔde la; ɔkola ɔdi ɔ ze aleɛ ne bie Noko awie gyɛne ɛdeɛ, ɔngola ɔnli bie.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa debie biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la, ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛdo nu.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne maa evinli ka ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛva ɛra, ɛmaa bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea ninyɛne ne mɔ boɛ, amaa bɛanli ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ bie, bɛandwe munzule nee fɔlɛlilɛ bɛammaa bɛ nwo; ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mete bɛ nwo a.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa Yizilayɛnli bie anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la bie fa ye ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ara Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a, saa ɛwɔkɛyelɛ anzɛɛ ahunlunyele azubɔdeɛ, na ɔkulo kɛ ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ a,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Saa awie babɔ anzonudwolɛ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ ɔfa yeaye ye ɛwɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɔfa yeabɔ ahonle fufule nu azu, na ɔlɛ nane mɔɔ vi ye nlankɛ anzɛɛ ye nyɛmoa ne mɔ anu a, ɔwɔ kɛ nane ne di munli, mɔɔ ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala, amaa bɛalie ye bɛado nu.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane mɔɔ ye foa ko ɛleka bie wale bo zolɛ anzɛɛ le ezinraa bo zolɛ la, bɛkola bɛfa bɛyɛ ahonle fufule nu ahyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ, na saa bɛfa bɛaye ɛwɔkɛ a, yemɔ bɛnlie.

english_verse: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa nane biala mɔɔ bɛza ye anzɛɛ bɛbɔ ɔ ndɔma anzɛɛ bɛde ɔ ndɔma la bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka biala.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Nane biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye bɛkɛvi ɛyɛvolɛ ɛkɛ ne la, bɛmmafa bɛyɛ aleɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ me. Kɛmɔ bɛpepɛle bɛ na bɛahu bɛ la, bɛ nwo lɛ dɛne; bɛfa bɛba a menrɛlie.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛnlankɛ, boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye wo fofolɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔboa ɔ nli anwo ɛkɛ kenle nsuu. Ɔvi kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo mɔɔ kɔ la, saa bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔkɛlie.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Saa nane ralɛ ne ɔ nli le ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane a, ɔnle kɛ bɛku ralɛ ne nee ɔ nli kenle ko ne ala.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Saa ɔba ye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛalie bɛ bɛado nu.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi azubɔdeɛ ne kenle ko ne ala. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyakyi bie bɛmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ, mɔɔ le medame me ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la a le ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ gyima kenle nsia; kenle nsuu ne le Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle a Ɔle kenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nwuanzanwuanza Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala wɔ nu. Ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala kenle ko ne, ɔluakɛ ɔle mgbɔdalɛlilɛ kenle mɔɔ bɛyɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu a.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua ɛvolɛ ne anu la, ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna la nɔsolɛ nu, le Ɛdɛnkɛma Akpabɛnwo.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Bɛbava azubɔdeɛ bɛara bɛamaa bɛayela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma toonwo kenle nsuu. Kenle nsuu ne azo bɛbayia nu bɛazonle; bɛnrɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ kenle ko ne.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Saa bɛba azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo na bɛbu bɛ abɛlɛ a, bɛva mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛbu la bɛhɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ ne.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ boka nwo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ esamo kilo nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye. Nza azubɔdeɛ ne noko ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nwanye litili ko.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɔnle kɛ bɛdi kpanwo anzɛɛ ma ngyehye, ma amolɛ anzɛɛ ma ndondo, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛkɛrɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la. Ɛhye le mɛla maa bɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la. Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne (Ɛdi

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala kenle ko ne; ɔle mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ bɛ awolɛndoazo muala anu.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: “Akee bɛdia dapɛne nsuu; bɛdia bɛvi Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ alumua bɛyɔba ne bɛbɔle ehono azu ne la alehyenlɛ nu.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛva kpanwo ahunguma nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛva esamo kilo nwiɔ a bɛyɛ la bɛvi sua nu bɛrɛla bɛrabɔ ehono azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa mgbɔvonle bɛwula esamo ne anu na bɛado, na bɛva bɛyɛ ma mɔɔ lumua la azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Akee bɛva mboane nsuu mɔɔ ko biala ɛli ɛvolɛ ko na bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, ɛnlankɛ egyegyebaa ko, yɛɛ mboane nwiɔ bɛrɛla. Bɛbava bɛayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛaboka ma nee nwanye azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛayela bɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ye evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Eza bɛbava abɔnkye nyinli ko bɛayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, yɛɛ mboane nyinli nwiɔ bɛayɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava bɛ muala aboka kpanwo ne mɔɔ le bɛyɔba mɔɔ lumua la nee mboane nyinli nwiɔ ne anwo yeado bɛ ehono yeabɔ azu yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ maa sɛlɛvolɛma ne yɛɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Kenle ko zɔhane ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ nolo, bɛyia bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ; ɔnle kɛ awie biala yɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu, wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ la.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbu bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo bɛyɔba ne a, ɔnle kɛ bɛbu toonwo bɛkɔkpula ɔ nloa, yɛɛ ngoko mɔɔ kɛha nu la, ɔnle kɛ bɛsia bɛkɔbu. Bɛgyakyi bɛ bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma nee nyɛvolɛ; medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.” Ɛvolɛ Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne (Ɛdi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Siane nsuu ɛhye ala kenle bulu ne le mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ kenle. Ɔle mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nuhua bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne na bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ bɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle mɔɔ hyia a, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne. Siane ne kenle ngɔnla ne azo nɔsolɛ nu, toonwo kɔkpula ye alehyenlɛ nu nɔsolɛ yɛɛ bɛbabɔ ɛhɔnehyelɛ ne abo a, yɛɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne bɔ ɔ bo toonwo kɔkpula alehyenlɛ ne nɔsolɛ nu.” Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne (Ɛdi

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Siane nsuu ne kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye kenle nsuu.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, bɛbava bɛayɛ ɛzonlenlɛ; ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne anu, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa azubɔdeɛ bɛba bɛmaa bɛyela bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔle ɛzonlenlɛ nyianu kpole, ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.”

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: (Ɛhye mɔ a le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nolo kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyia nu bɛsonle, na bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, ma azubɔdeɛ, azubɔlɛ ngakyile, yɛɛ nza azubɔdeɛ, ko biala nee ye kenle, bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ɛhye mɔ

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: bɛboka Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ anwo, na bɛfa bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ, bɛ ɛwɔkɛyelɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle fufule nu azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.)

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “Siane nsuu ne kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbu bɛ bɛyɔba ne la, bɛbali Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛvoyia ɛhye kenle nsuu. Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la bɛbava bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle bɛayia nu bɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, yɛɛ kenle mɔtwɛ ne ɔdaye bɛbava bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle bɛayia nu bɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Bɛli ɛvoyia ɛhye kenle nsuu wɔ ɛvolɛ ne anu bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia. Ɔle mɛla mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu maa awolɛndoazo muala a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ɛhye wɔ siane nsuu ne anu.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti bɛbadɛnla kpɔda bo dedee kenle nsuu,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: amaa bɛ bo zo amra anwu kɛ memanle Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle kpɔda bo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi yele Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvoyia ne mɔ dole Yizilayɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kɛhu ayɛmoa la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie ɔ bo zo, yɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Maa Yizilayɛma ɛva nwole anye bɔkɔbɔkɔ mɔɔ bɛhwihwi bɛvi ɔlivi ma nu la bɛrɛla bɛmaa ɛva ɛgua ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ anu, amaa bɛagyinla zolɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aalɔn banlea ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi ezukoa nvutuke tagyee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne azo la boɛ, na yeamaa bɛazɔ bɛagyinla zolɛ dahuu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne. Kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: “Fa esamo kilo bulu nee nwiɔ fɔtɔ to kpanwo ahunguma bulu nee nwiɔ.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Gua bɛ ɛhonlone nwiɔ, nsia nsia, wɔ ezukoa nvutuke tagyee ɛkponle ne azo.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Fa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ gua ɛhonlone ko biala anwo fa kile kɛ ɔle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala, Aalɔn banlea ava kpanwo agyinla Yizilayɛma agyakɛ anu asolo bɛ ɛhonlone nwiɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Ɛhye le ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ kyekye Yizilayɛma dahuu a.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Kpanwo zɔhane mɔ le Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la anu bie Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ na dahuu ɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɛdeɛ.” Ndeanlɛ mɔɔ fɛta la anwo ndonwo

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli, ɔ ze le Yigyibitinli, yɛɛ ɔ nli le Yizilayɛnli. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Hyɛlomete. Hyɛlomete ɔ ze a le Debelae, mɔɔ vi Dan abusua ekpunli ne anu la. Ɔrale kɛ kenle ko nrenya ne nee Yizilayɛnli bie nyianle butule; nrenya ne bɔle Nyamenle sasa, na bɛhyele ye bɛhɔmanle Mosisi.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ye bɛziele kɛ bɛkendɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma baha wɔ nwolɛ la.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Bɛva ahenle ne mɔɔ bɔle sasa ne la bɛvinde azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba lɔ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele ye sasabɔlɛ ne la, biala ɛva ɔ sa ɛdo nrenya ne anwoma azo ɛli daselɛ, na akee ɛlɔne ne amuala ɛzi ye awolɛ ɛhu ye.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kɛbɔ Nyamenle sasa la, bɛbahu ye. Menli ne amuala bazi ye awolɛ ahu ye. Saa ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ o, ɔle Yizilayɛnli o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye kɛ yebɔ Nyamenle sasa a.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye,

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu awie ayɛmoa la, ɔbazie ɔ bo zo. Ngyehyɛlɛ ne a le kɛ, bɛfa ngoane bɛsie ngoane bo zo.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: “Saa awie boda ɔ gɔnwo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboda ye bie, kɛ ɔzile ɔbodale ye ala la.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mɛla ko ala a wɔ ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛnli nee ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de Yizilayɛma avinli la a, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi hanle mɛla ne amuala hilele Yizilayɛma amuala. Bɛvale nrenya ne mɔɔ bɔle sasa ne la bɛhɔle azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba ne na bɛzile ye awolɛ. Yizilayɛma yɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo hanle hilele bɛ la.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Saa ɛya yɛɛ bɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛzuzu nwolɛ bɛnlea kɛ toonwo mɔɔ ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne anloa la, nzoleɛ nyɛ yɛɛ bavinde nu a, yɛɛ ɛvolɛ biala nzoleɛ ne anloa bado ɛzɛ kolaa na bɛadɔne anzɛɛ bɛadɔ ɛya ne.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi wɔ Saenae Boka kɛ,

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Ɔle ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ɔmaa bɛ. Saa ɔdwu zo a, bɛnlua, bɛmbu yɛɛ bɛntete ma mɔɔ wɔ bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo la.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa bɛ la azo a, azɛlɛ ne banyia ye ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ, bɛava bɛali Ɛdɛnkɛma eni.

english_verse: You may raise grain and grapes for six years,
translation_verse: Bɛbava ɛvolɛ nsia bɛazo bɛ ɛya, bɛaziezie bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ na bɛade zolɛ ma.

english_verse: but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la le azɛlɛ ne ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ; ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnwomenlelielɛ mekɛ. Ɔnle kɛ bɛso ɛya yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛsiezie bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛbu bɛyɔba biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛvinde bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛtete bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo ma ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ne die ye ɛnwomenle bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: Eza bɛbanyia aleɛ bɛamaa bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ nyɛmoa, yɛɛ nane ngakyile noko mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la banyia bie ali. Abozozielɛ ɛvolɛ ne

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: Ɔ wuvuanyi, ɔ nli anzɛɛ ɔ ze adiema ara, anzɛɛ ɔ nwo sonla biala mɔɔ wɔ ye abusua ne anu la kola kpɔne ye; anzɛɛ saa nzinlii ɔdaye ɔnyia ezukoa a, ɔkola ɔkpɔne ɔ nwo.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na soa maa bɛhɔbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne wɔ ɛvolɛ zɔhane siane nsuu ne kenle bulu ne azo, wɔ maanle ne anu amuala; kenle ne le mgbɔdalɛ kenle.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Ɔle ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa bɛ. Yemɔti bɛbali debie biala mɔɔ kpɔkɛ ne kɛye kɛmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Wɔ ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ɛlilɛ ɛhye anu, awie biala mɔɔ ye agyadeɛ wɔ awoba la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ sa ka ye.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Saa ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛha kolaa na ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne adwu la zonle a, ɔwɔ kɛ deɛ ne bolɛ kɔ ɔ nyunlu, saa mɔɔ ɛha noko la anzo a, ɔwɔ kɛ deɛ ne bolɛ ka aze, ɔluakɛ ma dodo mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la yɛɛ ahenle ne ɛlɛtɔne amaa wɔ a.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne bamaa bɛ nzoleɛ dɔɔnwo, bɛbali bɛ ko ayi, na bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: “Wɔannea a bɛ bie babiza kɛ, ‘Na ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la anu, yɛnrɛlua yɛɛ yɛnrɛbu la, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛali debie ɛ?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa me nyilalɛ ara bɛ nwo zo wɔ ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia ne la anu, amaa bɛanyia aleɛ mɔɔ sa bɛ di la dedee ɛvolɛ nsa.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ ne azo bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛlɛso bɛ ɛya ne mɔ la, bɛbanyia aleɛ bɛali toonwo yeahɔdwu ɛvolɛ ngɔnla ne anu; yemɔ anu bɔbɔ, bɛbanyia aleɛ dɛba bɛali. Agyadeɛ abozozielɛ

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne azɛlɛ biala bɔkɔɔ, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ; yɛɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ nee adendulɛma mɔɔ nee me de a.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: “Kanza ɛtɔ azɛlɛ ne amuala bɔbɔ a, ɔwɔ kɛ adenle da ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ maa azɛlɛ menlema kola tɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ die bɛ debie la.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Saa ɛ diema bie kyia na ɔ nwo kyele ye maa ɔtɔne ye agyadeɛ ne foa ko ɔmaa wɔ a, ɔ nwo sonla kola bakpɔne deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ diema ne ɛdɔne ye la.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Saa ahenle ɛnlɛ awie mɔɔ kola kpɔne ye agyadeɛ ne maa ye, na nzinlii ɔ nwo yɛ boɛ, na ɔnea na ɔkɛhola ye deɛ ne kpɔne a,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: ɛ nee ye bɛsese bɛnwu ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ deɛ ne ralile ɛ sa nu la, na maa ɔdua kakɛ mɔɔ ɛha ɔ nzi la, na ɔlie ye debie.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Na saa ahenle ɛnlɛ ezukoa mɔɔ ɔkola ɔdie ye debie a, yemɔ ɛnee ahenle mɔɔ deɛ ne li ɔ sa nu la ɛmaa ɔli ɔ sa nu toonwo ɔhɔdwu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne. Ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ nu yɛɛ ɔ sa baha ye agyadeɛ ne na yeahɔ zolɛ a.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: “Saa awie tɔne ye sua mɔɔ wɔ suakpole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la azo a, eza ɔkola ɔkpɔne ye debie wɔ ɛvolɛ ko ne ala anu. Saa ɔnyia ɛvolɛ a, ɔkola ɔkpɔne ye debie.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Saa ɛvolɛ mumua ko dwu na yeamkpɔne ye sua ne a, yemɔ ɛnee sua ne, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ suakpole mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ la azo la ati, ɔyɛ ahenle mɔɔ dɔle la nee ɔ bo zo amra ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu. Ɛvolɛ abulanlu dwu a, bɛnrɛziane ye bɛnrɛmaa ɔ menle.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na azua mɔɔ wɔ namunamu mɔɔ bɛtɛkyele nwolɛ la azo la, saa awie tɔ bie a, ahenle kola kpɔne ye mekɛ biala, yɛɛ saa ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsiane ye bɛmaa ɔ menle.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Noko wɔ Livaema azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, Livaema ne kola kpɔne bɛ azua ne mɔ mekɛ biala.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na saa Livaenli bie le ehyianli somaa la ati yeangola ye sua ne kpɔne a, ɛnee saa ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsiane ye debie bɛmaa ye. Ɔluakɛ Livaema azua ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛ, wɔ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la a le bɛ agyadeɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ, wɔ bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma avinli a.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Adidileka mɔɔ la Livaema azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo, mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛdidi zolɛ la, yemɔ ɔnle kɛ awie tɔne bie, ɔluakɛ ɔle bɛ agyadeɛ dahuu. Ehyianvolɛ bosea ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛ diema yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔngola ɔ nwo nea a, nea ye. Bu ye kɛ ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ adendulɛnli yɛɛ ɔ nee wɔ de a.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Mmabɔ ye bosea na ɛdie nwolɛ nzinwo anzɛɛ mmatɔne aleɛ mɔɔ ɛfa wɔamaa ye la ɛdie nvasoɛ.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale kɛ mebava Keena azɛlɛ ne meamaa bɛ na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle la a. Ahanra ɛgyakyilɛ

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛ diema bie mɔɔ bikye wɔ la yɛ anwunvɔne, na ɔtɔne ɔ nwo ɔmaa wɔ a, mmamaa ɔsonle wɔ kɛ kanranli.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Maa ɔ nee wɔ ɛdɛnla kɛ wɔ ɛkpanli anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ Ɔbazonle wɔ toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne adwu,

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛle me sonvolɛma mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale a. Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne bɛ ahanra.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɛfa atisesebɛ ɛsie ye; ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsulo Nyamenle.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Eza bɛkola bɛtɔ bɛfi nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ adendulɛma mɔɔ nee bɛ de la anu anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mbusua mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo bie la anu, na bɛfa bɛ bɛyɛ bɛ agyadeɛ.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Bɛkola bɛfa bɛyɛ agyadeɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya kɛ bɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛkola bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ ahanra bɔkɔɔ; na bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛmmafa atisesebɛ bɛsie bɛ.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: “Saa ɛyɛvolɛ bie anzɛɛ adendulɛnli bie mɔɔ nee bɛ de la nyia ɔ nwo, na bɛ diema bie mɔɔ bikye ye la yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔtɔne ɔ nwo ɔmaa ye, anzɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ ne busuanli bie a,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: mɔɔ yedɔne ɔ nwo yewie la bɛkola bɛkpɔne ye; ɔ mediema ne mɔ ko ɛhɔkpɔne ye.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye de la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ ɛkpanli mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye ɛkpa ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛgyinla bɛnea ye bɛmaa ɔyɛ ye amumuyɛ.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Saa bɛangola ye kpɔne wɔ adenle ɛhye mɔ biala azo a, yemɔ ɛnee ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdaye nee ɔ mra ne mɔ amuala nyia bɛ ti.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mame, Yizilayɛma amuala le sonvolɛma. Bɛle me sonvolɛma mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale a: medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛzie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ, na bɛli ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛsonle me la eni. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: yemɔ ɛlobɔ ne dwu a, mebamaa ezule adɔ na azɛlɛ ne aye aleɛ dɔɔnwo amaa bɛ, na kpɔkɛ nu mbaka amaa bɛ nzoleɛ.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: “Mebamaa bɛ nzo nu adwo bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ. Mebaye nane mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la amuala wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ konle ɛnrɛzi maanle ne anu.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Bɛbavoa bɛ kpɔvolɛma na bɛahu bɛ muala.

english_verse: Your barns will overflow with grain each year.
translation_verse: “Bɛbali bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziele dɛba la, bɛbaye dɛba ne bɛavinde na bɛava fofolɛ bɛazie.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Mebanlea bɛ nwo zo kpalɛ na meamaa bɛawo mralɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛ nwo azo, na meamoa me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la azo.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ badɛnla yɛɛ menrɛkpo bɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ balua, meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo a, amaa bɛanyɛ Yigyibitima ahanra. Meye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo ne memaa bɛnyia bɛ ti. Anzosesebɛ nwo ndeanlɛ (Mɛla

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: mɔɔ mebava meayɛ bɛ la ɛne: Mebamaa ɛzulolɛ kpole bie araheda bɛ nwo zo, meamaa ewule mɔɔ maa nwonane wie la, nee ebunlu fufule aha bɛ, azi bɛ nye na yeahu bɛ. Bɛbalua ma na bɛnrɛnyia bie, ɔluakɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma barali.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Mebava me nye meawula bɛ nyunlu, meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ali bɛ nwo zo konim. Menli ne mɔɔ kyi bɛ la bazie bɛ, na bɛbanriandi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ awie ɛndoa bɛ la.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: “Na saa ɛhye mɔ anzi na eza bɛnrɛdie me ne a, akee mebahwi bɛ ɛza fane nsuu wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ adubɛnwo anwosesebɛ biala; ezule ɛnrɛdɔ, na bɛ azɛlɛ ne bahwie ayɛ ketekete kɛ bolɛ.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Bɛbavɛ mgbane, ɔluakɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ɛnrɛhye aleɛ yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu mbaka ɛnrɛzo.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkɔ zolɛ na bɛandie me ne, na bɛkpo me a, mebamaa ewulenzane mɔɔ anu yɛ se tɛla bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ fane nsuu la adɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Mebatulu nanemgbole anwo ɛzulolɛ wɔ bɛ avinli, meamaa bɛahu bɛ mra, bɛazɛkye bɛ nlankɛ, amaa bɛ nwo ayɛ ekyi na bɛ ndenle ne mɔ azo adɔ mgbane.

english_verse: If you remain my enemies after this,
translation_verse: “Eza saa ndeanlɛ ɛhye anzi bɛangakyi bɛanzia bɛamba me nwo, na bɛkpo me a,

english_verse: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.
translation_verse: medame noko mebakpo bɛ, na medame mumua ne meadea bɛ fane nsuu wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛlɔnema ara bɛ nwo zo na bɛahu bɛ bɛadua me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛtulu ye la abo zo. Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea bɛ azuamgbole zo a, mebava ewule meado bɛ nwo, meamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa aha bɛ.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Saa metua, mɔɔ bɛnnyia aleɛ la a, mraalɛ bulu babɔ nu ado kpanwo fonlomo ko anu, na bɛazuzu bɛava bɛarɛlɛ bɛ; bɛbali, na bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: akee mebava ɛya kpole kpalɛ meakpo bɛ, na medame mumua ne meadea bɛ ndeanlɛ fane nsuu wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛali bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ nwonane.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Eza mebazɛkye bɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkɔsonle la, na meabubu bɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na meavuandi bɛdabɛ bɛ avunli meagua bɛ mmonle avunli ne mɔ azo, na meahyi bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole ayɛ azuadu, na meazɛkye bɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle la, yɛɛ menrɛlie bɛ azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye azɛlɛ ne, na ɔbazi bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ de zolɛ la anwo.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛlɔne ava bɛ aze, na meazande bɛ wɔ maanle maanle zo. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane, na bɛ azuamgbole ayɛ azuadu.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Mekɛ tendenle ala mɔɔ awie ɛnle zolɛ la, ɔbalie ye ɛnwomenle ne mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ zolɛ la bɛamaa yeannyia ye la.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Bɛbadu bɛagua bɛ ngome bɛ nwo zo kɛ asɛɛ bɛdoa bɛ wɔ konle nu la, noko awie ɛndoa bɛ; bɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Bɛbawu bɛazie bɛ wɔ nlɔnu, wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma maanle nu.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛbaha la ɛnrɛkpazi wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma maanle ne anu, wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ nee bɛ ze mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: mɔɔ yemɔti medame memkpole bɛ na menvale bɛ mengɔle bɛ kpɔvolɛma maanle nu la bɛto gua, na saa akee bɛbɛlɛ bɛ ahonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛsolo la aze, na bɛsia bɛ nzi bɛfi bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ anwo a,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: mebahakye me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee Gyekɔbo, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Ebileham kyekyele la, na meahakye azɛlɛ ne noko.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Noko bɛbagyakyi azɛlɛ ne bɛamaa yealie ye ɛnwomenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛnde zolɛ la; eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsia bɛ nzi bɛfi bɛ amumuyɛ nwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛbulule me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Noko akee ɛhye mɔ ati, saa bɛwɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma maanle nu a, menrɛbu me nye menrɛgua bɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ menrɛhyi bɛ menrɛmaa bɛnrɛzɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ, eza menrɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la. Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti mebahakye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele la. Menvale bɛ ze mɔ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo, menluale maanle maanle avinli membale, amaa meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo vale manle Yizilayɛma wɔ Saenae Boka la a le ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa awie fa sonla bɔ ɛwɔkɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɔkola ɔtua ezukoa ɔkpɔne sonla zɔhane,

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “Azɛlɛ ne azo ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne mɔ amuala, saa ma o, saa baka nzoleɛ o, biala le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ. Ɔle debie mɔɔ anwo te na ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ a.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: “Saa ahenle le ehyianli mɔɔ ɛngola ɛndua mɔɔ maamɛla ne se la a, ɛnee bɛva sonla ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la bɛrɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne bɛmaa ɔnlea ahenle ne mɔɔ bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la gyinlabelɛ nwo ɔpɛ bolɛ ɔmaa ɔdua.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛwɔkɛ ne fane ayɛmoa nwo, na ayɛmoa ne le mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ahenle vale manle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anwo te.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Na saa ɛwɔkɛ ne kɔyɛ ayɛmoa mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔnyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee ahenle ɛva ayɛmoa ne ɛrɛla sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛkɛ;

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “Saa awie tu ye azɛlɛ mɔɔ le ye agyadeɛ la foa ko maa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ye bolɛ bayɛ kɛ ma dodo mɔɔ sa ye dua la bolɛ Bɛbasese ye kakɛ ne ma kilo abulanwiɔ biala dwɛtɛ fufule bulu.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Saa ɔdule ɛya ne ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne anloa a, ye bolɛ ne gyi kɛmɔ ɔgyi ye ala la.

english_verse: But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Saa ɔdule ɔmanle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia mekɛ ne ɛhɔ dɔɔnwo la a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne basese bolɛ ne ahɔdwu mekɛ dodo mɔɔ yeha na bɛali ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne la, na akee bɛade zolɛ.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Saa ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɛnee ɛya ne anwo te na ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ, kɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛdu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: If you promise me a field that you have bought,
translation_verse: “Saa awie tu azɛlɛ mɔɔ yedɔ la maa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔmboka ye agyadeɛ nwo a,

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: sɛlɛvolɛ ne basese ye bolɛ ne ahɔdwu ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne anloa, na mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ la ahenle adua. Ezukoa zɛhae anwo te na ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ abulanlu ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsiane azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa ɔ menle ne mɔɔ dɔnenle ye na azɛlɛ ne le ye agyadeɛ la.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Bolɛ biala mɔɔ bɛsese la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsese ye wɔ nwuanzanwuanza ɛleka ne ezukoa nu: gilaa abulanwiɔ le hyikɛle ko anzɛɛ ɛkpanli kenle nna ahatualɛ.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “Noko akee, kɛmɔ ayɛmoa biala ara mɔɔ ɔkɛlumua ɔkɛwo ye la le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ la ati, awie biala ɛnlɛ adenle kɛ ɔkɛdu ɔkɛmaa; saa ɔle ɛnlankɛ o, anzɛɛ boane o, ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “Debie biala mɔɔ awie lɛ na yedu yemaa Nyamenle la, saa sonla o, ayɛmoa o, anzɛɛ ye agyadeɛ azɛlɛ ne bie o, ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne ye anzɛɛ ɔ menle eza kpɔne ye debie. Debie biala mɔɔ bɛdu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔkɔɔ la anwo te na ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ezukoa bɛkpɔne sonla mɔɔ bɛdu ye bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛzɛkye ye la. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Saa awie kpondɛ kɛ eza ɔtɔ ye ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa deɛ ne ati bolɛ ne ngyɛnu nnu ɛkpɔ ko ɔboka deɛ ne ati bolɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Nlankɛ nee nyɛmoa ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko a le kɛ, saa mboaneneavolɛ ne tia bɛ a, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu biala la anwo te na ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ awie biala biza nwolɛ edwɛkɛ kɛ ɔle kpalɛ anzɛɛ ɔnle kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛkakyi bie; saa ɔkakyi bie a, mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhakyile nee alumua ayɛmoa ne amu nwiɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ. Ɔnle kɛ ɔ menle kpɔne ye.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ a le mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo vale manle Yizilayɛma wɔ Saenae Boka a.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne anu, ye siane nwiɔ ne kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Mosisi wɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Ɛ nee Aalɔn bɛdia menli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ, mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ, mɔɔ kola konle kɔ la ekpunli ekpunli.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Ɔlua menli bulu nee nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ moalɛ zo, Mosisi nee Aalɔn

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: vɛlɛle menli ne kɔsɔɔti wɔ siane nwiɔ ne anu, ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo na bɛhɛlɛle bɛ aluma, kɛmɔ bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli nee bɛ mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ de la. Bɛhɛlɛle menli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ la aluma na bɛdianle bɛ,

english_verse: just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi wɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu la.

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma yɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na Livaema ne bayɛ azokoɛleɛ abɔ ayia Ndanlɛ Sua ne na bɛazinza, amaa awie ambikye ye na yeaha me ɛya yeamaa meava me ɛya ne meagua Yizilayɛma anwo zo.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Bɛangɛlɛ Livaema aluma bɛamboka mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛtia menli ne a anrɛɛ mmatia Livae abusua ekpunli ne ɛboka Yizilayɛma anwo.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛvi azokoɛleɛ ko bɛlɛkɔ azokoɛleɛ fofolɛ la, Livaema ne badudu Ndanlɛ Sua ne ahɔ azokoɛleɛ fofolɛ ne na bɛakpɔnla ye bieko. Awie gyɛne biala mɔɔ kɛbikye Ndanlɛ Sua ne la, bɛhu ye.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma badɛnla ye ekpunli ekpunli, awie biala wɔ ɔdaye ye azokoɛleɛ, wɔ ye fɛlɛnra bo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi nee Aalɔn kɛ,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma bayɛ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli fɛlɛnra ne mɔ abo wɔ bɛ ze mɔ mbusua ekpulike ekpulike sɛkɛlɛneɛ bo. Bɛbasisi bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ bɛabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne bɛayia, ko biala anye kɔne Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anwo.

english_verse: troops will march into battle last.
translation_verse: Yesakaa Zuwaa ara nrenya Nɛtanili

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: “Akee Livaema ne bazoa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne ali ekpunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lumua nee ekpunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ li amozi la avinli. Ekpunli biala bahɔ ye kɛmɔ bɛzile bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle bɛ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne la, biala bali ɔ bo zo ne wɔ ye abusua ekpunli fɛlɛnra ne abo.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛdianle bɛ ekpunli ekpunli nee awuke awuke la, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle apenle ngoko ɛya nsia nee nsa, menli ɛya nnu abulanlu.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, bɛandia Livaema ne bɛamboka Yizilayɛma anwo.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma yɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la. Biala dɛnlanle ɔdaye ye ekpunli sɛkɛlɛneɛ bo, yɛɛ ko biala nee ɔdaye ye abusua ekpulike ne luale.

english_verse: were the ones to be ordained as priests.
