translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava raalɛ ne ahɔgyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbawola nzule nwuanzanwuanza yeagua dwora nu, yeade ndɛtɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la bie yeagua nzule ne anu.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: “Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛhɛlɛ amonle ne debie zo na ɔwowo ɔgua kanrɛlɛ ne mɔɔ nzule ɛnwonle ne wɔ nu la anu.

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa raalɛ ne ɛnlo nzule ɛnwonle ne, mɔɔ wɔannea ye boɛ a ɔbamaa yeade nyane kpole wɔ ɔ kunlu la.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛlie ma azubɔdeɛ ne wɔ raalɛ ne asa anu, ɔdo ye ehono wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na ɔva ɔzie azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvula ma azubɔdeɛ ne ɔ sa tukuu ko ɔyɛ ngakyedeɛ ɔyela ye wɔ azukponle ne azo, na ɔmaa raalɛ ne ɛnlo nzule ne.

english_verse: If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya gyɛne ɛva ye yɛɛ yeanli nɔhalɛ yeammaa ɔ hu a, amonle ne bamaa yeade nyane kpole, yeamaa yeawulowula, ye awodeɛ anwoso, na bɛahyi ye wɔ ye menli ne avinli.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane biala a, amonle ne ɛndo ye, yɛɛ ɔnyia ɛkolɛ ɔbɔ ɛdane.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya twe nungule, ye adwenle ɛngya ɔ ye anwo a, ɛnee mɛla mɔɔ wɔ nwolɛ la ɛne. Bɛmaa raalɛ ne gyinla azukponle ne anyunlu na sɛlɛvolɛ ne noa ye amonle ne.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Kunli ne ɛnli ɛhye anwo fɔlɛ. Na saa raalɛ ne di fɔlɛ ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee ɔdaye ye ɛtane zo ye.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: ɔva ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ ɔmaa Yizilayɛma. “Saa nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔtu ɔ nwo yeazie ɛkɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: ɔnle kɛ ɔno nwanye nee nza ɛsesebɛ biala. Ɔnle kɛ ɔno nzanvinli anzɛɛ nza biala mɔɔ bo la, anzɛɛ debie mɔɔ bɛva vanye ma nzule bɛyɛ la, yɛɛ ɔmmadi vanye ma amolɛ anzɛɛ welera.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ yedu ɔ nwo yezie ɛkɛ yemaa Nyamenle la, ɔ nwo te maa Awulae.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: “Saa arɛlevilɛ nu awie wu ɔ sa nu na evinli ka ɔ ti enrinli nwuanzanwuanza ne a, ɔhendɛ toonwo kenle nsuu ne mɔɔ ɔnua ɔ nwo la na ɔkpa ɔ ti nee ɔ kɛsa na ɔ nwo ade.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo, ɔva abubule nwiɔ anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma nwiɔ ɔrɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ko ayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na yeava ko yeayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ yeanlua ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nwo ɛha funli. Kenle ko ne ala, eza ɔbadu ye enrinli ne yeamaa Nyamenle

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: na eza yeadu ɔ nwo yeazie ɛkɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔkɔɔ. Mekɛ dɛba ne mɔɔ ɔdule ɔ nwo ɔziele ɛkɛ ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la, bɛndia bɛmboka nwo, ɔboalekɛ evinli hanle ye enrinli nwuanzanwuanza ne. Ɔbava boane ralɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko la yeayɛ fɔlɛlilɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: “Na saa mekɛ dodo mɔɔ ɔkɛdu ɔ nwo ɔkɛzie ɛkɛ ɔkɛmaa Nyamenle la wie a, ɛnee mɛla mɔɔ wɔ nwolɛ la ɛne. Ɔkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa,

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: ɔfa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma: boane ralɛ nyinli ko mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko, mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la bɛyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, boane ralɛ belɛ mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, na bɛava boane nyinli kpole ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la bɛayɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Eza ɔfa kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu, keeki mɔɔ bɛva esamo kɛnlɛma mɔɔ bɛva ɔlivi nwole bɛfɔtɔ la kɛndɛne ko, kpanwo ndɛbandɛba ngukulungukulu mɔɔ bɛva nwole kɛkpokpa zolɛ, yɛɛ nwolɛ ma nee nwanye azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ ne tu ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti maa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeabɔ ɛtane nee ɛyelalɛ azu ne mɔ.

english_verse: Then he will sacrifice the ram and offer the wine, grain, and bread.
translation_verse: Ɔfa boane nyinli ne ɔboka kpanwo kɛndɛne ko ne anwo ɔyɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ. Eza ɔfa ma nee nwanye azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la kpa ɔ ti wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa na ɔfa ɔgua senle ne mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne gyi zolɛ la anu.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: “Saa sonla mɔɔ ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa Nyamenle la kpa ɔ ti nee ɔ kɛsa wie na ɔfa ye azubɔdeɛ ne ɔba a, sɛlɛvolɛ ne ye boane ne abɛsa ne na ɔye kpanwo ɛzamo ko nee ndɛbandɛba ne mɔ ko wɔ kɛndɛne ne anu ɔmaa sonla ne mɔɔ dule ɔ nwo ziele ɛkɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ ne to bɛ ehono maa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ehono azubɔdeɛ. Bɛle azubɔdeɛ nwuanzanwuanza mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ na bɛfa bɛboka boane nyinli ne akɛnrazo ne nee ye ndwɛlɛ ne mɔɔ le maamɛla kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛdeɛ ɔ la anwo. Ɛhye wie a, sonla ne mɔɔ dule ɔ nwo ziele ɛkɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma la kola no nza.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɛ bɛva edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ ɛhye mɔ bɛyila Yizilayɛma:

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ na ɔva bɛ ɔzie gyɛlɛɛnye;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma ɛmaa bɛ na ɔlo bɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpogya ɔ nye zo ɛnlea bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Saa bɛbɔ me duma bɛyila Yizilayɛma a, mebayila bɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne mɔɔ Mosisi wiele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne si la, ɔkpokpale ye nwole na ɔdule Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔkpokpale azukponle ne na ɔdule ye nee nwolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima, mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ ati, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyigyi bɛ ze mɔ awuke ne mɔ ati, na bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a bɛnleanle bɛmanle bɛdianle Yizilayɛma ne la

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: vale bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne rɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma: ehwili mɔɔ soa ninyɛne na bɛdu zolɛ la nsia yɛɛ nlankɛ mɔɔ twe ehwili la bulu nee nwiɔ, mgbanyima nwiɔ biala ehwili ko yɛɛ kpanyinli ko biala ɛnlankɛ ko. Bɛvale ninyɛne ne bɛrɛlɛle Mosisi wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi vale ehwili ne mɔ nee nlankɛ ne mɔ manle Livaema.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: yɛɛ kɛmɔ bɛ gyima ne si de la, ɔvale ehwili nna nee nlankɛ mɔtwɛ ɔmanle Mɛlɛlae asa azo ne mɔɔ Sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn ara nrenya Yetamaa a nea bɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Na Kohate asa azo ne, Mosisi ammaa bɛ bie, ɔboalekɛ bɛmɛ, bɛ gyima ɛdeɛ ne ala a le ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsoa bɛ bɛ kɔme zo na bɛnea bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye la.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ bɛkpokpale azukponle ne nwole la, mgbanyima ne mɔ vale azubɔlɛ ninyɛne raguale azukponle ne anyunlu kɛ bɛva bɛdu azukponle ne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, kenle ko biala abusua kpanyinli ko bava ye azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ɛdeɛ ara yeamaa bɛava bɛadu azukponle ne bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

english_verse: So each leader brought the following gifts: a silver bowl that weighed one and a half kilograms and a silver sprinkling bowl weighing almost a kilogram, both of them filled with flour and olive oil as grain sacrifices and weighed according to the official standards; a small gold dish filled with incense; a young bull, a full-grown ram, and a year-old ram as sacrifices to please the Lord; a goat as a sacrifice for sin; and two bulls, five full-grown rams, five goats, and five rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing. The tribal leaders brought their gifts and offerings in the following order: On the first day Nahshon from Judah, on the second day Nethanel from Issachar, on the third day Eliab from Zebulun, on the fourth day Elizur from Reuben, on the fifth day Shelumiel from Simeon, on the sixth day Eliasaph from Gad, on the seventh day Elishama from Ephraim, on the eighth day Gamaliel from Manasseh, on the ninth day Abidan from Benjamin, on the tenth day Ahiezer from Dan, on the eleventh day Pagiel from Asher, on the twelfth day Ahira from Naphtali.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛzile bɛvale bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛrale la ɛne: Kenle Abusua Ekpunli Abusua Kpanyinli Ko ne Dwuda Amenadabe ara nrenya Naahyɔn Nwiɔ ne Yesakaa Zuwaa ara nrenya Nɛtanili Nsa ne Zɛbulɛn Hɛlɔn ara nrenya Yilayabe Nna ne Wulubɛn Hyɛdiyɛ ara nrenya Ɛlaezɛ Nnu ne Semɛyɔn Zulehyadae ara nrenya Hyɛlɛmeɛle Nsia ne Gaade Duwɛle ara nrenya Yilayasafe Nsuu ne Yifelaem Amehɛde ara nrenya Yilaehyama Mɔtwɛ ne Manasɛ Pɛdaazɛ ara nrenya Gameeleɛle Ngɔnla ne Bɛngyaman Gedɛyonae ara nrenya Abaedan Bulu ne Dan Amehyadae ara nrenya Ehayizɛ Bulu nee ko ne Ahya Ɔkelan ara nrenya Peegeɛle Bulu nee nwiɔ ne Nafetalae Yinan ara nrenya Ahaela Azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ menli ne mɔ vale rale la amuala le ngakyile ko: dwɛtɛ fufule bonkuma ko, ɔto tone nu kilo ko nee foa yɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule kyɛnze kuloonwu ko, ɔto tone nu gelamo ɛya mɔtwɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nzuzudeɛ ne si to la. Bɛwulale bɛ mu nwiɔ esamo mɔɔ bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la tetɛkɛɛ bɛvale bɛyɛle ma azubɔdeɛ; ezukoa nvutuke kyɛnze ɛdɛbaa mɔɔ ɛyɛlɛ ɛyi ye la, ɔto tone nu gelamo ɛya ko nee bulu; ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko, boane nyinli ko, yɛɛ boane edonraa mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne la; abɔnkye nyinli ko mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛtane azu ne la; yɛɛ nlankɛ nyinli nwiɔ, mboane nyinli nnu, mbɔnkye nyinli nnu, yɛɛ mboane nyinli ndonrandonra mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ngoko la nnu mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ anzonudwolɛ azu ne la.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi hɔle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kadendɛ la, ɔdele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛtendɛ ahile ye wɔ abɔdeɛ nwiɔ ne mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ, mɔɔ gyigyi Anwunvɔnezelɛ Ebia ne mɔɔ dua Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la avinli anwuma.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Ka kile Aalɔn kɛ, saa ɔsosɔ ahɛnlaneɛ nsuu ne mɔ a anrɛɛ ɔva ɔziezie kɛnlaneɛ baka ne azo ɔmaa bɛ nye ɛhɔ kɛnlaneɛ baka ne anyunlu.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Na kɛ bɛzile bɛyɛle kɛnlaneɛ baka ne la ɛne: ɔvi ɔ bo ne toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu ye anwuma ndotolo ne mɔ, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bɛva hamenle bɛbolo la a bɛyɛle a. Bɛyɛle ye kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele Mosisi ala la. Livaema ɛnluanlɛ nee bɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu ɛduwulalɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɛbazi wɔanlua bɛ la ɛne: Fa ɛnluanlɛ nzule ne kponde bɛ nwo, maa bɛkpa bɛ nwo enrinli biala, na bɛkpo bɛ nwo ninyɛne, na bɛ nwo kɛde.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Akee maa bɛva ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko nee ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ bɛhakyi ye esamo na bɛva nwole bɛfɔtɔ la na bɛva ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko noko bɛyɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Akee maa Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛyia na maa Livaema ne ɛgyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: Saa ɛfa Livaema ne ɛba Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a, Yizilayɛma bava bɛ sa agugua Livaema ne ati zo,

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: na Aalɔn adu bɛ amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ Yizilayɛma ehono azubɔdeɛ, amaa bɛayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima ne.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Akee Livaema bava bɛ sa agugua nlankɛ nyinli ne mɔ ati zo na wɔava ko wɔayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ na wɔava ko noko wɔayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ wɔamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔava wɔayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Livaema ne ati.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: “Fa Livaema ne yɛ ehono azubɔdeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma na maa bɛzonle Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Adenle ɛhye anu yɛɛ ɛbalua wɔaye Livaema ne wɔavi Yizilayɛma anu a, amaa bɛayɛ me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Saa ɛnua Livaema ne ɛwie na ɛfa bɛ ɛbɔ ehono azu ne a, akee bɛbahɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu bɛahɔyɛ gyima.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ mengunle Yigyibitima belamunli mralɛ mrenya muala la, mendule Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli biala anu belamunli ralɛ nrenya biala nee ayɛmoa biala ara mɔɔ ɔlumuale ɔwole ye la menziele ɛkɛ memanle me nwo.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Kɛkala, meva Livaema mezie Yizilayɛma belamunli mralɛ mrenya agyakɛ anu.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Meye Livaema mevi Yizilayɛma anu meva bɛ mehyɛ Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya kɛ bɛyɛ gyima bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ne wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, amaa saa ngyengyene nu bie menli ne bikye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne a, bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛakpa ewulenzane mɔɔ anrɛɛ kɛra bɛ nwo zo la bɛagua.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi, Aalɔn, nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti dule Livaema ne manle Nyamenle, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Livaema ne nluanle bɛ nwo na bɛkpole bɛ ninyɛne, na Aalɔn dule bɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ehono azubɔdeɛ. Eza ɔyɛle bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na ɔvale ɔdele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nzinlii, Livaema ne nee Aalɔn nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu hɔyɛle bɛ gyima ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: noko bɛbahola bɛaboa bɛ mediema Livaema ne wɔ bɛ gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa bɛ gyima kɛ bɛyɛ. Ɛnee kɛ ɛbazi wɔahyehyɛ Livaema gyima ne la ɛne.”

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne anu na siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Mosisi wɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu. Ɔse,

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Saa mekɛ ne dwu a maa Yizilayɛma ɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Siane ɛhye, ye kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna ne la, ye nɔsolɛ nu, bɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ nwolɛ mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ se la.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Yemɔti siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna ne la nɔsolɛ nu, Yizilayɛma lile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne wɔ Saenae fienemgbole ne anu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi ala la.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na menli bie wɔ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɛnee evinli ɛha bɛ a, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale bɛ sa bɛhanle funli, amaa ɔlua zolɛ kenle ko ne bɛangola bɛanli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bie. Na bɛhɔle Mosisi nee Aalɔn anwo ɛkɛ

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: bɛhɔhanle kɛ, “Evinli ɛha yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛva yɛ sa yɛha funli, na duzu ati a ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa yɛ adenle bɛmaa yɛboka Yizilayɛma anwo na yɛfa yɛ azubɔdeɛ yɛkɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛ?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Mosisi buale kɛ, “Bɛhendɛ toonwo kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnyia mualɛ menwɔvi Ɛdɛnkɛma lɔ la.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: ɔha ɔhile Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Saa evinli ɛha bɛ nuhua bie anzɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra bie, ɔluakɛ yeva ɔ sa yeha funli anzɛɛ yedu adenle yehɔ maanle zo na ɔkulo kɛ ɔdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne a, ɔlɛ adenle kɛ nzinlii ɔdi ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi ye siane nwiɔ ne anu ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna la nɔsolɛ nu. Bɛva kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu nee nya nya ɛnwonle bɛli Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Bɛmmagyakyi aleɛ ne bie bɛmaa aleɛ kye zolɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ nane ne bowule biala anu. Bɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ se la.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ evinli ɛtɛkanle ye, yɛɛ ɔtɛtule adenle na yeanli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛfi ye menli ne avinli, ɔboalekɛ mekɛ ne dwule la, yeanva Ɛdɛnkɛma azubɔdeɛ ne yeamaa ye. Sonla zɔhane ɛtane zo ye.

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: “Saa ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la kulo kɛ ɔdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bie a, ɔli ye kɛmɔ nwolɛ mɛla nee nwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ se la. Mɛla ɛhye wɔ ɛkɛ maa awie biala, ɛyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ ekulomeni.” Senle amungu ne (Ade

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛzile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne la, amungu rahedale zolɛ. Nɔɔzo ɛnee amungu ne ɛdɔlɔ kɛ senle la, ɔsɔ toonwo aleɛ kye, na alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee amungu ne ala a heda zolɛ a.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Saa kenle nwiɔ o, siane ko o, ɛvolɛ ko anzɛɛ ɔbo o, sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ amungu ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo anwuma la, bɛndu bɛ bo; na kɛ ɔye ɔ nwo zolɛ la, ɛnee bɛdu bɛ bo.

english_verse: They obeyed the Lord's commands and went wherever he directed Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛlile azokoɛleɛ kyekyetu. Bɛyɛle ɛhye bɛvale bɛyɛle tieyɛ bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mɔɔ ɔluale Mosisi anwo zo ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Fa dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ bɛva hamenle bɛbolo la yɛ aweɛne ndendenle nwiɔ na wɔava wɔavɛlɛ menli ne wɔamaa bɛarayia, na eza wɔava wɔamaa bɛadudu zo bɛavi azokoɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Saa bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne amu nwiɔ anu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ menli ne kɔsɔɔti bayia ɛ nwo ɛkɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛwu aweɛne tendenle kokye anu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ala a bayia ɛ nwo ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Saa bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu nzinrenzinra mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu la tudu zo. Yemɔti bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu nzinrenzinra bɛva bɛmaa menli ne ɛdudu zo.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛfɛlɛ menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛamaa bɛarayia a, bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu bɛmaa ɔhyɛ.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ Aalɔn amra mrenya sɛlɛvolɛma ne a wu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu a. “Melɛ tendenle mɔɔ bara la kɔsɔɔti, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye azo.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo la kaho a, bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu nzinrenzinra bɛhile kɛ konle ɛzi. Na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mebaboa bɛ na mealie bɛ meavi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Wɔ fɛlɛkolilɛ nu noko, Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ nee ɛvoyia ngakyile ne mɔ ɛlilɛ nu, bɛwu aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu bɛgua ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ azo, nee bɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ azo, na mebaboa bɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.” Yizilayɛma fi azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne anu, siane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la kenle abulanwiɔ ne azo, amungu ne mɔɔ zinze Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne azo la hwenle ɔ nwo vile zolɛ,

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: na Yizilayɛma vi Saenae Fienemgbole nu dule bɛ bo zɔle bɛ adendulɛ ne azo, bɛkpɔsale toonwo ɔhɔdwule kɛ amungu ne hɔdole sɛkɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ wɔ Pɛlan la anu.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a le mekɛ mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo manle Yizilayɛma dule bɛ bo a.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛtu bɛ bo la, bɛkɔ ye kɛmɔ bɛhyehyɛle ye dɛba ne ala la. Bɛkɔ ye ekpunli ekpunli. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la a dumua a. Amenadabe ara nrenya Nahyɔn a li bɛ ti a.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Zuwaa ara nrenya Nɛtanili a li Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne ati a,

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Hilɔn ara nrenya Yilayabe a li Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne ati a.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtudu Ndanlɛ Sua ne bɛwie a, Gɛhyɔn nee Mɛlɛlae mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ mɔɔ soa la akee tɔ adenle zo.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtoa bɛ la a le Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra. Hyɛdiyɛ ara nrenya Ɛlaezɛ a li bɛ ti a.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Zulehyadae ara nrenya Hyɛlɛmeɛle a li Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne ati a,

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Duwɛle ara nrenya Yilayasafe a li Gaade abusua ekpunli ne ati a.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Akee Kohate abusua ekpulike ne mɔɔ soa ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ la toa bɛ. Saa bɛdwu azokoɛleɛ fofolɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkyehyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne bɛwie kolaa na Livaema mɔɔ zo ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ la adwu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne anu la toa zolɛ. Amehɛde ara nrenya Yilaehyama a li bɛ ti a.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Pɛdaazɛ ara nrenya Gameeleɛle a li Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne ati a,

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Gedɛyonae ara nrenya Abaedan a li Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne ati a.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Ahya abusua ekpunli ne mɔɔ Ɔkelan ara nrenya Peegeɛle li bɛ ti, yɛɛ

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne mɔɔ Yinam ara nrenya Ahaela li bɛ ti la a li bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nzi a.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vi azokoɛleɛ ko kɛdu bɛ bo kɛ bɛkɔ la, kɛ bɛzile bɛdoɔdoale zolɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle hilele ɔ ye adiema nrenya Hobabe, mɔɔ le Medeanenli Gyɛtelo ara nrenya ne kɛ, “Yɛlɛkɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle kɛ ɔbava yeamaa yɛ la; maa yɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbamaa Yizilayɛma akpazi wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Hobabe buale ye kɛ “Kyɛkyɛ, menrɛhɔ, mesia meahɔ me maanle nu, meahɔ me mbusua avinli.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, mmagyakyi yɛ adevinli, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkyekye azokoɛleɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu a, na wɔayɛ yɛ nye.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Saa ɛmaa yɛkɔ a, boɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛyɛ kɛmaa yɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛbayɛ yɛamaa wɔ a.” Menli ne gua adenle zo

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne vile boka nwuanzanwuanza Saenae la, bɛdiale kenle nsa adenle. Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne lumuale bɛ nyunlu kenle nsa kɛ ɔkakpondɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbadɛnla la yeamaa bɛ.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne kɛdu ɔ bo la, Mosisi ka kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo bɔ wɔ kpɔvolɛma asande, na maa menli mɔɔ kyi wɔ la ɛgua ɛbɔ nu.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala noko mɔɔ amungu ne kɛgyinla la, ɔka kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sia bɛla Yizilayɛma mgbe mgbe ne mɔ avinli.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Menli ne dendɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ nzo abo wɔ nyane mɔɔ ɔlɛkile bɛ la anwo. Ɛdɛnkɛma dele na ɔvale ɛya kpole ɔmanle senle radɔle bɛ avinli yelale azokoɛleɛ ne foa ko.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Menli ne zunle vɛlɛle Mosisi; Mosisi zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma na senle ne guale aze.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle ɛleka zɔhane Tabɛla, ɔboalekɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma senle ne zɔle bɛ avinli a. Mosisi ye mgbanyima abulasuu

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.

translation_verse: Na Mosisi bizale ye kɛ, “Ɛtwe me ti nungule ɔ? Me kunlu a anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye Sunsum ne ɛwula ye menli ne nu yemaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛyɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma!”

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!

translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, kile yɛ wɔ tumi ne na di wɔ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔle kɛ,

translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔlua wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɛngakyi ɛlɛ la ati, mesɛlɛ wɔ, fa menli ɛhye mɔ ɛtane ne kyɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ sumunli kɛ bɛvile Yigyibiti la, wɔva wɔhyɛ bɛ toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ la.”

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Bɛbawu, bɛ avunli akponde fienemgbole ye anu. Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ bɛtendɛ bɛtia me la, bɛ nuhua ko biala mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ la agyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ kɛ bɛdɛnla zolɛ la azo,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. translation_verse: na bɛfa ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane kɛ bɛyela ye bɛabɔ azu, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛaye ɛwɔkɛ, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛayɛ ahunlunyele azubɔdeɛ, anzɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, amaa yeazɔ ɔ nye la,

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ fa azubɔdeɛ ne arɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la fa esamo kilo ko mɔɔ bɛva ɔlivi nwole litili ko bɛfete la boka nane ne anwo kɛ ɔle ma azubɔdeɛ, na ɔfa nwanye litili ko ɔboka nwolɛ ɔbɔ azu ne ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa ɛnlankɛ nyinli azubɔdeɛ bɛba kɛ ɛyelalɛ anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛaye ɛwɔkɛ anzɛɛ anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ a,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa esamo kpalɛ kilo nsa mɔɔ bɛva ɔlivi nwole litili nwiɔ bɛfete la bɛyɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na bɛfa nwanye azubɔdeɛ litili nwiɔ bɛboka nwo. Azubɔlɛ ɛhye sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ekulomeni biala fa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ara a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ ɛhye; ye ɛyelalɛ ne evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Mɛla ko yɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ko ala a wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ nee bɛ de la a.”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: na bɛdi aleɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la bie a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bie bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Saa bɛbu abɛlɛ na ɛdɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛva bɛkɛyɛ la, bɛloa bie bɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔvi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne.

translation_verse: yɛɛ saa bɛanli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua Mosisi anwo zo ɛha ɛhile bɛ la amuala azo, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale mɛla ne manle la azo toonwo wɔ awolɛndoazo ne mɔ anu a,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ɛnee kɛmɔ bɛnze la ati, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ɛnlankɛ nyinli bɛyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ye ɛyelalɛ ne evuanlɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, nwolɛ ma azubɔdeɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ nwanye azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛhakye na bɛli me mɛla ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo, na bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛzie ahane bɛmaa me.

translation_verse: Yezaa ara nrenya Kɔla mɔɔ vi Livaenli Kohate abusua ekpulike ne anu la dwazole Mosisi anwo zo. translation_verse: Na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Akee bɛyɛ bɛmaa yebo zolɛ! Ɛlɔne ne kɔsɔɔti le Ɛdɛnkɛma menli, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee yɛ muala lua. Duzu ati a bɛvo bɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne akɔme zo zɛhae a?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi dele ɛhye la, ɔbutule mutule nu,

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: ɔhanle ɔhilele Kɔla nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ kɛ, “Ɛhyema nwonlomɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bahile yɛ sonla holɛ ko mɔɔ le ye ɛdeɛ, na ɔle nwuanzanwuanza, na ɔkɛmaa ye adenle kɛ ɔbikye ye la; mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkɛye ye la babikye ye.

translation_verse: Ɛ kunlu ɛtɛdwole ɔ, kɛ wɔva yɛ wɔvi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo, wɔragua yɛ fienemgbole nwenle ye azo kɛ ɛku yɛ? Eza ɛkulo kɛ ɛfo ɛtɛnla yɛ kɔme zo ɔ?
