english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle toonwo bɛhɔdwule Ɛhyekɔlo Bɔnza na bɛnleanle azɛlɛ ne, na mɔɔ bɛziale bɛrale la, bɛrazɛkyele Yizilayɛma adwenle kɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ gyakɛ ba tia azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi hanle hilele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛkɛyɛ ɛhye, bɛkɛva konle ninyɛne bɛkɛhɔho konle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya na ɔmanle bɛlile ahyimango wɔ fienemgbole ne anu toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanla, hɔkpulale kɛ awolɛndoazo zɔhane mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la wiele wu la.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi vale Geleade manle Manasɛ ara Meekɛ abusua ekpulike ne na bɛdɛnlanle zo.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Na bɛnlea, bɛva bɛ ze mɔ agyakɛ, ɛtanevolɛma akpolane, kɛ bɛlɛka Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole bɛamaa yeava Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya a!

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Saa bɛandoa ɔ bo zo na bɛkakyi bɛ nzi bɛsi ye a, eza ɔbakpo bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ye anu, na ɛnee bɛbamaa menli ne amuala adɔ gyebilisanza.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Akee bɛbikyele ye na bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ, “Yɛbazi mboane tunli wɔ ɛkɛ yeamaa yɛ mboane ne mɔ, na yeakyekye azuamgbole yeamaa yɛ mra ngyikyi ne mɔ.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Yɛnrɛzia yɛnrɛra yɛ sua zo, kyesɛ yɛnwu kɛ Yizilayɛma asa ɛha bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛhyɛ agyadeɛ wɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi nehane, ɔboalekɛ yɛmɛ, yɛnyia yɛ agyadeɛ ɛdeɛ wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ ɛke.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: saa ɛlɔnenli biala kɛpɛ Dwɔdan ye kɛhɔho Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu toonwo kɔkpula kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛbɛlɛ ye kpɔvolɛma ne aze

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛ ɛtane ne baye bɛ amaa.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Bɛkyekye azuamgbole bɛmaa bɛ mra, bɛsisi tunli bɛmaa bɛ mboane, na bɛli ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛbɔ la azo.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Na Gaadema nee Wulubɛnema ne mɔ hanle hilele Mosisi kɛ, “Wɔ sonvolɛma bayɛ ye kɛmɔ yɛ menle ɛha la.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Yɛ mra, yɛ mraalɛ, yɛ mboane, yɛɛ yɛ nlankɛ bawoa Geleade azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Na wɔ sonvolɛma ne mɔ, awie ko biala ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo wɔ konle nu kɛ ɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma kɔ konle ne.”

english_verse: Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi vale mɛla ɛhye mɔ manle Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza, Dwɔhyua, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli mgbanyinli ne mɔ kɛ,

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: “Saa Gaade nee Wulubɛn menli ne mɔ boɔboa bɛ nwo nee bɛ pɛ Dwɔdan ne, kɔko fa azɛlɛ ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la a, ɛnee bɛva Geleade azɛlɛ ne bɛdɛnla zolɛ.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Na saa bɛ nee bɛ ampɛ Dwɔdan ne, bɛ nee bɛ angɔngo ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee yemɔ, bɛbanyia bɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne wɔ Keena kɛ bɛdabɛ la.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Na Gaadema nee Wulubɛnema buale kɛ, “Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile ye sonvolɛma la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ yɛbayɛ a.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Yɛbapɛ yɛahɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo yeahɔho, amaa Dwɔdan ye anzi aduduleɛ ɛke afoa nu azɛlɛ ne ayɛ yɛ agyadeɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi vale Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn nee Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ, bɛ azuamgbole nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti manle Gaade nee Wulubɛn mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ nee Dwosefi ara Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne foa ko.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gaade abusua ekpunli ne kyekyele azuamgbole Daebɔn, Atalo, Alowɛ,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: Atelo Hyofan, Gyeezɛ, Dwɔgebɛhaa,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Bɛte Nemela, yɛɛ Bɛte Hɛlan bieko. Bɛle azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane a. Eza bɛyɛle tunli bɛmanle bɛ mboane ne mɔ.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne kyekyele azuamgbole Hɛhyebɔn, Ɛlɛyeli, Keleateeyem,

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: Nibo, Beeyale Miyɔn , yɛɛ Sebema. Bɛtotonle azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛkyekyele bɛ bieko la aluma fofolɛ.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manasɛ ara Meekɛ abusua ekpulike ne honle vale Geleade, bɛdule Amɔlema mɔɔ de ɛkɛ la, na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Na Manasɛ ara Gyeeyɛ hɔtetale namunamu bie, ɔvale bɛ na ɔdonle bɛ “Gyeeyɛ Namunamu.”

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Noba ɔdaye ɔtetale bɛ na ɔvale Kinate nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, na ɔvale sua ne ɔdonle ɔdaye Noba ɔ nwo.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Azokoɛleɛ dodo mɔɔ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛnee Mosisi nee Aalɔn li bɛ ti la yɛle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛdule bɛ bo la ɛne:

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Mosisi hɛlɛle ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ azokoɛleɛ la duma.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yigyibitima anye ɛbolo bɛlɛsie bɛ belamunli mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhu bɛ la avunli ne mɔ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle ɛhye hilele kɛ ɔlɛ tumi ɔtɛla Yigyibiti awozonle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma dule bɛ bo wɔ Relamɛsize na bɛrayɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Sɛko.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Bɛvi Sɛko la, bɛrayɛle azokoɛleɛ bieko wɔ Yitam, wɔ fienemgbole ne anloa.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Bɛvi Yitam bɛziale bɛ nzi bɛhɔle Pae Hahaelo, wɔ Beeyale Zifɔn aduduleɛ afoa nu, na bɛyɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɔka ekyii bɛdwu Megedɔ la.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Bɛvile Pae Hahaelo na bɛpɛle Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne, bɛdiale kenle nsa adenle bɛhɔle Hyɔɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na bɛyɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Mɛɛla.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Bɛvile Yilem na bɛhɔyɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Suwɛze, wɔ Ndɔ Nyevile ne anloa.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne la, bɛhɔzokoɛle Sen fienemgbole nu.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛvi Ɛlɛhye la, bɛhɔyɛle azokoɛleɛ wɔ Relɛfedem, ɛke ɛnee bɛnnyia nzule fee mɔɔ bɛno a.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Keenanli Belemgbunli Ɛlade mɔɔ de maanle ne nyiakɛ la dele kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛba.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Wɔ Mowabe ɛsɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa, mɔɔ zua Gyɛleko la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ saa bɛpɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛkɔdwu Keena azɛlɛ zo a,

english_verse: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.
translation_verse: bɛvoa menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la. Bɛzɛkye bɛ awolɛ nee mbulalɛ mmonle ne mɔ nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsɔ bɛ la kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Bɛva azɛlɛ ne bɛdɛnla zolɛ, ɔboalekɛ melɛfa meamaa bɛ.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Bɛgua nzeleba bɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne nee mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ. Bɛmaa abusua ekpulike mɔɔ anwo zonle la azɛlɛ kpole, yɛɛ ekpulike mɔɔ le ekyi la azɛlɛ ekyi.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Saa bɛandu menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la a, ekyi bɔbɔ mɔɔ kɛha la bawowɔ bɛ nye mbaka na bɛayɛ kɛ mbowule mɔɔ ɛlɛwowɔ bɛ nvenle la, na bɛagyegye bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: “Na anrɛɛ mɔɔ mevua kɛ mebava meayɛ menli zɔhane la, mebava meayɛ bɛmɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Saa bɛdwu Keena azɛlɛ ne azo, azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ la azo a, bɛgyigya ɛweɛne ne mɔ zɛhae:

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ye Zen fienemgbole nu, ɔlua Yidɔm afoa nu. Ɔbɔ ɔ bo wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu wɔ Nyevile Wulera ne nyiakɛ.

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: Na ɛweɛne ne abele ɔ nwo wɔ Akelabem Ademgbolezo nyiakɛ, yeapɛ nu wɔ Zen na yeahɔdwu Keedɛhye Baanɛya nyiakɛ. Akee ɔtenrɛ ɔ nwo ɔkɔ Heeza Adaa na ɔkɔ Azemɔn.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ɔdwu ɛkɛ a ɔkakyi ɔ nwo ɔkɔ bɔnza ne mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo la anu, na yeahɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: “Adɔleɛ afoa nu ɛweɛne ne a le Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: “Sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne vi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa kɔdwu Hɔɔ Boka,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: na ɔvi ɛkɛ ne yeahɔ Heemate Ademgbolezo. Ɔbadoa zo yeahɔ Zidade,

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: na eza yeahɔ Zefɔlɔn, na yeahɔgua ye Heeza Yinan.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: “Aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne vi Heeza Yinan kɔdwu Hyifam.

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: Akee ɔbawɔne ɔ ti nyiakɛ yeahɔ Habɛle wɔ Eyen aduduleɛ, na yeahɔ Galeli Tandane ne aduduleɛ ɛvoleɛ.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Ɔdwu ɛkɛ a ɔbawɔne ɔ ti aze yeava nyiakɛ, yealua Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa yeahɔgua ye Nyevile Wulera ne anloa. “Bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne nna ne, bɛmɛ ɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa mbusua ekpunli ngɔnla nee foa ne, mɔɔ bɛbagua nwolɛ nzeleba bɛahyɛ bɛava la ɛne.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne foa ko asa ɛha bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ afoa nu mɔɔ bikye Gyɛleko la.” Mgbanyima mɔɔ nea bɛamaa bɛahyɛ azɛlɛ ne la

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza nee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua a bahyɛ azɛlɛ ne amaa menli ne a.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Bɛye mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ mgbanyima ngoko bɛmaa bɛboa bɛ bɛmaa bɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne.”

english_verse: and here is the list of their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from Judah, Shemuel son of Ammihud from Simeon, Elidad son of Chislon from Benjamin, Bukki son of Jogli from Dan, Hanniel son of Ephod from Manasseh, Kemuel son of Shiphtan from Ephraim, Elizaphan son of Parnach from Zebulun, Paltiel son of Azzan from Issachar, Ahihud son of Shelomi from Asher, and Pedahel son of Ammihud from Naphtali.”
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ a Ɛdɛnkɛma yele bɛ a: Abusua Ekpunli Abusua Kpanyinli Dwuda Gyɛfɛni ara nrenya Kalɛbe Semɛyɔn Amehɛde ara nrenya Hyɛlumeɛle Bɛngyaman Keleselɔn ara nrenya Yilaedade Dan Dwɔgelae ara nrenya Bɛkae Manasɛ Yifɔdo ara nrenya Haneɛle Yifelaem Hyefetan ara nrenya Kɛmuwɛle Zɛbulɛn Panake ara nrenya Yilaezeefan Yesakaa Azan ara nrenya Paleteɛle Ahya Hyɛlomae ara nrenya Ahaehɛde Nafetalae Amehɛde ara nrenya Pɛdaahɛle

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ a Ɛdɛnkɛma yele bɛ manle bɛhyɛle Keena azɛlɛ ne bɛmanle Yizilayɛma a.

english_verse: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, bɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo azuamgbole ne mɔ bie bɛmaa Livaema bɛmaa bɛdɛnla zolɛ. Eza bɛmaa bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ne mɔ bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ nyɛmoa ne mɔ badidi azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Ye afoa nu ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti sɛ, yemɔti azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ yia suakpole ne la le mita ɛya ngɔnla, yɛɛ suakpole ne wɔ avinli.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Livaema la le nsia mɔɔ bayɛ ɛvealeka mɔɔ bɛbamaa awie mɔɔ anye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔkɛhu sonla la adenle bɛamaa yeahɔvea a. Eza bɛva azuamgbole abulanla nee nwiɔ bɛboka bɛ nwo.

english_verse: so they will have a total of

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ bɛ ti, Ɛdɛnkɛma vale medame noko me nwo ɛya na ɔzele kɛ,

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: ‘Ɛdawɔ noko ɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛ. Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua mɔɔ boa wɔ la, yemɔ a ɔbahɔ azɛlɛ ne azo a. Si ye ahonle, ɔluakɛ ɔbamaa Yizilayɛma ahɔva azɛlɛ ne.’

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Akee bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛkɛhye bɛ bɛkɛhu bɛ, nee bɛ mra ngyikyi ne mɔ mɔɔ kɛkala bɛnze ɛtane a bɛnze kpalɛ la, bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛbahɔ azɛlɛ ne azo a. Na mebava azɛlɛ ne meamaa bɛ na bɛadɛnla zolɛ bɛava bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: “Na bɛbuale kɛ, ‘Mosisi, yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yɛkɔ yɛahɔho, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne zele yɛ la.’ Na bɛ nuhua ko biala vale ye konle ninyɛne na bɛdwenlenle kɛ bɛkɔ bɛahɔva menli mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo la adufudeɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: “Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Ka kile bɛ kɛ bɛmmakɔ anzɛɛ bɛmmakɔko, ɔluakɛ memboka bɛ nwo. Bɛkɔ a bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne bali bɛ nwo zo konim.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle mengilele bɛ, noko bɛandie. Bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne na adubɛnwo nu ala bɛhɔle awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Na Amɔlema mɔɔ ɛnee de ɛkɛ ne maanle ne anu la vindele rayiale bɛ na bɛvoanle bɛ kɛ wolɛ foa menli la, bɛbole bɛ toonwo bɛradwule Hɔɔma, na bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim wɔ Yidɔm awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛdɛnlanle Keedɛhye bɛhyɛle dɔɔnwo. Nzinlii mɔɔ ɛnee bɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne bɛhyɛ kpalɛ la,

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: “Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘Bɛkpɔsa maanle ye anu awoka ne mɔ avinli bɛhyɛ bie ala. Bɛhakyi bɛ nye bɛbɔ bɛ ti ɛbɔ nu afoa nu.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Na se menli ne kɛ bɛlɛdua bɛ mediema Yisɔ abo zo amra ne mɔɔ de Yidɔm la maanle nu. Menli ne bazulo bɛ, yemɔti bɛnlea boɛ.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa konle biala bɛtoa bɛ, ɔluakɛ menrɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne bie menrɛmaa bɛ. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne ekyi mɔɔ le kɛ egyakɛ ko abo zo bɔbɔ la, bɛnrɛnyia ye, ɔboalekɛ meva Yidɔm maanle ne memaa Yisɔ nee ɔ bo zo amra kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtɔ aleɛ bɛfi bɛ ɛkɛ na bɛali, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtɔ nzule na bɛanlo.’

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti yɛhɔle yɛ nyunlu na yɛbule yɛhoanenle yɛ mediema Yisɔ abo zo amra ne mɔ mɔɔ de Yidɔm la. Yɛanva adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ Yilate, Yizeɔngibɛ nee Nyevile Wulera ne anloa la, na yɛbɔle yɛ ti ɛbɔ nu wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu kɛ yɛkɔ Mowabe fienemgbole nu.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Bɛmmagyegye Mowabema yɛɛ bɛmmafa konle bɛtoa bɛ. Ɔluakɛ menrɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne bie menrɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛdɛnla zolɛ, ɔboalekɛ meva suakpole Aale memaa Lɔɔto abo zo amra kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Ɛnee menli kakanyinlima bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Yimemma la a de Aale a. Bɛwowale, bɛ nwo zonle kɛ Anakema la.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Eza bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Rilipeeyemma, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔyɛ a bɛfɛlɛ Anakema la. Noko Mowabema fɛlɛ bɛ Yimemma.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ menli mɔɔ vi Hɔɔ la de Yidɔm maanle nu, na Yisɔ abo zo amra ne dule bɛ, bɛhunle bɛ, na bɛdɛnlanle azɛlɛ ne azo. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle na bɛvale azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale manle bɛ la a.)

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: “Na kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele yɛ ala la, yɛpɛle yɛhɔle Azudenle Zilɛde ne anzi lɔ.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛwiele wu bɔkɔɔ la,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Ɛnɛ kenle ye, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua Aale na bɛpɛ nu wɔ Mowabe azɛlɛ zo,

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: na saa bɛdwu Amɔnoma ɛweɛne zo a anrɛɛ bɛmmafa konle bɛtoa bɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmagyegye bɛ, ɔluakɛ menrɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne bie menrɛmaa bɛ, ɔboalekɛ meva ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne memaa Lɔɔto abo zo amra kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Maanle ɛhye noko eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Rilipeeyemma maanle. Menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ne azo la duma a le Rilipeeyem, noko ɛnee Amɔnoma fɛlɛ bɛ Zamezɛmemma.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔyɛle ɔmanle Yisɔ abo zo amra ne mɔɔ de Yidɔm la a, ɔbɔle menli mɔɔ ɛnee de Hɔɔ la abo zo, na bɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ vi Kiliti la rabɔle Avemma mɔɔ ɛnee de Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa la abo zo na bɛdabɛ noko bɛvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne toonwo bɛhɔdwule azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ nehane, wɔ Gaza, na bɛdɛnlanle zolɛ.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: “Akee mɔɔ yɛpɛle nu Mowabe azɛlɛ zo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Bɛdwazo bɛzɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne azo na bɛhɔva bɔnza ne anu bɛpɛ Azule Anɔn ne. Meva Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ de Hɛhyebɔn la nee ye azɛlɛ ne amuala memaa bɛ. Bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛfa azɛlɛ ne, na bɛva konle bɛdoa ye.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛnɛ kenle ye mebabɔ ɔ bo kɛ memaa bɛ nwo ayɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la ɛzulolɛ. Biala mɔɔ kɛde bɛ nganeɛ la anwo bawozo ye na ɔ rɛle abɔ.’ Yizilayɛma di Belemgbunli Saehɔn anwo zo konim (Ɛdi

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: “Yemɔti menzoanle menli wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛwɔ Kidɛmo fienemgbole ne anu lɔ la memanle bɛvale anzonudwolɛ nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Saehɔn, wɔ Hɛhyebɔn kɛ,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘Maa me nee me menli ne yɛrapɛ nu wɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Yɛbava adenle ne azo ala yɛahɔ. Yɛnrɛmakyi bɛne zo anzɛɛ fema zo.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: kɛmɔ Yisɔ abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm nee Mowabema mɔɔ wɔ Aale la yɛle manle yɛ la. Mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la a le kɛ yɛkɛpɛ nu yɛkɛhɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa yɛ la azo.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: “Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Meye Belemgbunli Saehɔn nee ye azɛlɛ ne memaa bɛ. Bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛfa azɛlɛ ne bɛadɛnla zolɛ.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Saehɔn vale ye ɛlɔnema rale kɛ bɛbazi yɛ aze, na bɛ nee ye bɔle ye zo wɔ Gyeehaze.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne yele ye manle yɛ. Yɛlile ɔ nwo zo konim, yɛlile ɔ mra nee ye menli ne amuala anwo zo konim.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Ɔvi Alowɛ mɔɔ wɔ Azule Anɔn ne bɔnza ne anloa, nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la azo toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Geleade la, suakpole biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ holale yɛ nyunlu gyinla a. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne yele bɛ muala manle yɛ.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Noko akee yɛangɔ Amɔnoma azɛlɛ ne azo. Eza yɛangɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ la Azule Gyeebɔko ne anloa la nee azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo nee ɛleka biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele yɛ kɛ yɛmmakɔ la.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Mmasulo ye, ɔluakɛ meva ye nee ye menli ne amuala memaa wɔ. Yɛ ye kɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛle Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ ɛnee de Hɛhyebɔn la.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Na yɛzɛkyele bɛ kɔsɔɔti, yɛzɛkyele suakpole biala, yɛhunle mrenya nee mraalɛ nee ngakula kɔsɔɔti, yɛyɛle bɛ kɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛle Hɛhyebɔn Belemgbunli Saehɔn la.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Na yɛvale nlankɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛnyianle bɛ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati mekɛ ne anu yɛliele azɛlɛ ne yɛvile Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan aduduleɛ la asa anu. Azɛlɛ ne kpole vi Azule Anɔn bɔnza ne anu kɔdwu Hɛmɔn Boka.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Yɛvale Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo maanle ne anu azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne azo la nee Geleade nee Beehyan toonwo yɛhɔdwule Salɛka nee Ɛdelɛyae.”

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa bɛ mediema ne mɔ amuala kɛnyia ɛleka kɛdɛnla, kɛmɔ yeyɛ yemaa bɛ la, na bɛkɛnyia azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ la. Na bɛwie a, akee awie biala azia ahɔva ye azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ meva memaa ye la.’

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu menzɛlɛle kɛ,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘O Awulae Nyamenle, bɔ zo mɔɔ wɔbɔ ɔ bo ɛlɛkile wɔ sonvolɛ wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ nee wɔ tumi a. Ɔluakɛ nyamenle biala ɛnle anwuma anzɛɛ aze mɔɔ kola yɛ ninyɛne mgbole nee nwanwane gyima kɛ wɔmɔ ala.

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa mempɛ azule ye mengɔ ɔ nzi lɔ na mengɔnwu azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ la Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ awoka ne mɔ azo la nee Lɛbanɔn.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: “Na kɛmɔ ɛnee bɛmɛ bɛ ti Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva me nwo ɛya la, yeandie me nzɛlɛlɛ ne, na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Yeyɛ boɛ; mmaka ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ bieko ɛkile me.

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Kɔ Boka Pesega azo na to ɛ nye adɔleɛ, ɛbɔ nu, nyevile nu, nee aduduleɛ na nea ye kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Fa ɛlɔne ne wula Dwɔhyua asa anu; si ye ahonle na maa ye anwosesebɛ. Ɔluakɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbali menli ne ati bɛahɔpɛ azule ne bɛahɔ ɔ nzi lɔ na yeahɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛ nye banwu ye la yeamaa bɛ a.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti yɛdɛnlanle bɔnza ne ɛleka mɔɔ nee sua Bɛtepiyɔ anye bɔ zolɛ la anu.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Na Mosisi zele menli ne kɛ, “Yizilayɛma, kɛkala, akee bɛdie mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ melɛkilehile bɛ la na bɛli zolɛ, amaa bɛanyi bɛahyɛ na bɛahɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ bɛboka mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ la anwo, yɛɛ bɛmmaye bie bɛfi nu, amaa bɛahola bɛali Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛhɔle zo bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne nɔhalɛ nu la tɛte aze kɛkala.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu, amaa bɛ rɛle anvi ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnwu ye bɛ nye zo la. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi ye ɛlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la. Bɛhilehile bɛ mra nee bɛ nlɔnra

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: ninyɛne mɔɔ sisile mekɛ ne anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛgyi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu wɔ Saenae Boka la. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Boɔboa menli ne anloa ɛ nee bɛ ɛvinde me nyunlu, amaa bɛade me nloa anu edwɛkɛ, na bɛabɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛsulo me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ewiade ye anu la na eza bɛahilehile bɛ mra noko.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: “Bɛrale na bɛradwule boka ne abo la, bɛnwunle kɛ boka ne ɛlɛsɔ kɛ senle na yedwazo bolonwonwo yehɔ Nyamenle ne ako abo lɔ, na awozinli, amungu, nee esike ɛva ɛleka ne amuala.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma luale senle ne anu dendɛle hilele bɛ. Bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne, noko bɛannwu ɛhwee. Ɛnelɛ ne ala a bɛdele a.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne amuala nee mɛla mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi zolɛ la ɔhilele bɛ. Ɔhɛlɛle mɛla ne mɔ wɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ azo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔhanle la a le Mɛla Bulu ne.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ mengilehile bɛ ye mɛla ne nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, amaa bɛali zolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la azo. Awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma tendɛ ahile bɛ wɔ Saenae Boka la, bɛannwu debie biala wɔ senle ne anu. Zɔhane ati bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: na bɛanyɛ ananze bɛammaa yeanzɔho debie biala, amaa bɛanyɛ ɛtane. Bɛmmayɛ debie mɔɔ le kɛ raalɛ anzɛɛ nrenya.

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Eza bɛnlea boɛ, amaa saa bɛmaa bɛ nye zo anwuma na bɛnwu sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, nee nwɔlɔra ne mɔ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu la a, bɛangakyi bɛangɔnzonle bɛ. Bɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛziezie ɛkɛ ne wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la ati.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva bɛ na yeye bɛ yevi Yigyibiti bulalɛ fonlomo gɔhyee ne anu kɛ bɛrayɛ ɔdaye ye menli, kɛmɔ bɛde ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Akee bɛmɛ bɛ ti Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva me nwo ɛya na yeha ndane kɛ me gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ na yeayɛ azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ mepɛ mekɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ mewu azɛlɛ ɛhye azo, na bɛmɛ, bɛbapɛ na bɛahɔva azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛ rɛle anvi ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne nee bɛ yɛle la. Bɛmmayɛ debie biala ananze, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdua bɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne le sendɔlɔra. Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bakponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli. Maanle biala noko mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhɔgua bɛ nu la, bɛ nwo ɛnrɛzo, bɛbaha ekyi,

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: na bɛazonle mbaka nee awolɛ, mɔɔ le menli asa anloa gyima mɔɔ bɛnnwu debie, bɛnde edwɛkɛ, bɛnli aleɛ, yɛɛ bɛnde nvoanle la kɛ bɛ nyamenle.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Saa ngyegyelɛ kpole bie ba bɛ nwo zo, na ɛhye mɔ sisi bɛ nwo zo a, bɛzia bɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na bɛdie ɔ ne,

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne le Nyamenle mɔɔ se anwunvɔne a. Ɔnrɛye bɛ anrinli ɔnrɛdo bɛ sa nu, ɔnrɛzɛkye bɛ, yɛɛ ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ ze mɔ yɛle na ɔhanle ndane ɔdole zolɛ la.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ saa nyamenle bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ ɔdaye yezi ɔ kɛnra na yeyɛ kɛ ɔkava maanle bie wɔ maanle bie avinli yeayɛ ye ɔdaye ye maanle, na yeva ngyegyelɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ, nwanwane nyɛleɛ, konle nee tumi kpole nee ɛzulolɛ yeyɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle yɛle wɔ Yigyibiti manle bɛdabɛ bɛnwunle ye la a.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛte ɔ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ, amaa yeadu bɛ folɛ, yɛɛ bɛte ɔ ne wɔ aze ɛke, amaa bɛanwu ye senle kpole ne na bɛade ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vi senle ne anu ba la.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔhulole bɛ ze mɔ na ɔkpale nu ɔyele bɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra la ati, ɔyele ɔ nyunlu ɔvale tumi kpole ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔvoanle maanle maanle mɔɔ le mgbole, bɛ nwo yɛ se tɛla bɛ la ɔvile bɛ nye zo na ɔ nee bɛ ɛra kɛ ɔbava bɛ azɛlɛ ne yeamaa bɛava bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔde la.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛnwu ye ɛnɛ na bɛva bɛzie bɛ ti anu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a le Nyamenle wɔ anwuma nee azɛlɛ ti anu a; nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo, amaa yeayɛ kpalɛ yeamaa bɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra mɔɔ bara la. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, bɛbanyi bɛahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ bɔkɔɔ la azo.” Azuamgbole mɔɔ le ɛvealeka wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ la

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ne mɔ a lɛ Bizɛ mɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu azɛlɛ sɛsɛ ne azo la; ɛke a Wulubɛnema bie mɔɔ ɛnzuzu na ɔkɛhu sonla la nriandi kɔfea a. Gaadema suakpole ɛvealeka a le Releemo mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la, yɛɛ Manasɛma suakpole ɛvealeka a le Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la. Mosisi buke Nyamenle Mɛla ne mɔ anye

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ Mosisi vale manle Yizilayɛma la ɛne. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvile Yigyibiti na bɛwɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne aduduleɛ bɔnza ne anu, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nee Bɛtepiyɔ sua zo anye bɔ zolɛ la yɛɛ ɔvale mɛla ɛhye mɔ ɔmanle bɛ a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛwɔ Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ ɛnee sie Hɛhyebɔn la maanle nu. Mosisi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne lile ɔ nwo zo konim wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛrale la.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Na bɛvale azɛlɛ ne nee Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo azɛlɛ ne amuala. Bɛle Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ a.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ tɛlɛ vi Alowɛ mɔɔ wɔ Azule Anɔn bɔnza ne anloa la toonwo ɔkɔdwu Sayɔn Boka .

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Azule Dwɔdan ne aduduleɛ afoa nu toonwo mɔɔ kɔ ye ɛbɔ nu kɔdwu Nyevile Wulera ne anloa nee Pesega Boka ne abo aduduleɛ afoa nu la amuala boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mosisi manle Yizilayɛma amuala rayiale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Yizilayɛma, bɛdie mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye la. Bɛzukoa na bɛli bɛ muala azo boɛ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmmaku sonla.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne nee yɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ wɔ Saenae Boka.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye, tɛ yɛ ze mɔ yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ kyekyele a. Yɛdayɛ mɔɔ kɛkala yɛtɛte aze la, yɛmɛ yɛɛ ɔ nee yɛ kyekyele a.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu mengyinlanle bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma avinli kɛ meka Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ ne meahile bɛ. Ɔluakɛ senle ne ati ɛnee bɛsulo, yemɔti bɛangola boka ne azo lɔ kɔ. “Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: ‘Mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmmanyia nyamenle biala kɛ medame me ngome ala.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmmayɛ ananze biala bɛmaa bɛ nwo. Bɛmmayɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ti anu anzɛɛ mɔɔ wɔ nzule mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye abo la anu ananze.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ anzɛɛ bɛsonle bɛ, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mele Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule a, na mefa selɛma mɔɔ kyi me la amumuyɛ nwo ndeanlɛ metea bɛ mra kɔdwu awolɛndoazo nsa nee nna ne azo,

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: na mekile me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ apenle apenle mɔɔ kulo me na bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo la anwo zo.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmmabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne duma mgbane mgbane, ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, menrɛmaa mɔɔ bɔ me duma mgbane mgbane la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza, kɛmɔ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle meha mehile bɛ la.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Bɛva kenle nsia bɛyɛ gyima, na bɛyɛ bɛ gyima biala.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la le ɛnwomenlelielɛ maa medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle. Bɛmmayɛ gyima biala wɔ kenle ne anu; ɛdawɔ o, ɛ ra nrenya o, ɛ ra raalɛ o, wɔ sonvolɛ nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ o, wɔ ɛkpɔnwɔ o, asoaso o, anzɛɛ wɔ nlankɛ ne mɔ anu biala, yɛɛ wɔ ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛrazokoɛ wɔ la, amaa wɔ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ noko nee wɔ alie bɛ ɛnwomenle.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ ɛnee bɛle ahanra wɔ Yigyibiti, yɛɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle menvale tumi kpole menyele bɛ menvile ɛkɛ a. Zɔhane ati medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle mehyehyɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛli bɛ ze nee bɛ nli eni, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle zele bɛ la, amaa bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbali la awa na yeayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle mebava meamaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmmawua.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: “Mɛla mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle bɛ muala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛyiale boka ne azo, wɔ senle, amungu, nee awozinli kabii ne anu la ɛne. Ɔvale ɛnelɛ kpole a ɔdendɛle a; yeanva debie biala yeamboka nwolɛ. Ɔhɛlɛle bɛ muala wɔ awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ azo na ɔvale ɔmanle me. Menli ne ɛzulolɛ ne (Ade

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee boka ne azo amuala ɛlɛsɔ na bɛdele ɛnelɛ ne wɔ awozinli ne anu la, bɛ muala, bɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mgbanyinli nee bɛ mgbanyima bikyele me,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: na bɛzele kɛ, ‘Nea, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛhile ye anyunlunyia nee ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne yɛɛ yɛde ɔ ne wɔ senle ne anu. Ɛnɛ kenle ye yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle nee sonla ɛdendɛ na sonla tɛte ngoane nu.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Saa ye zɔhane a ɛnee duzu ati yɛɛ yɛkɛhwe ewule yɛkɛmaa yɛ nwo a? Saa yɛtɛnla ɛke kɛ yɛtie Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ane bieko a, senle kpole ɛhye barava yɛ ahu yɛ.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ dasanli boni yɛɛ ɛde Nyamenle ane kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeavi senle nu na ɔtɛte ngoane nu kɛ yɛdayɛ a?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Bikye ye na tie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne kɛha kɛhile wɔ la na baha kile yɛ, na yɛkɛdie na yɛkɛyɛ.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma dele bɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele me la na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Mede menli ɛhye mɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha bɛhile wɔ la. Bɛha nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ wɔ mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la anwo.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ bɛanyia adwenle mɔɔ le zɛhae la dahuu, kɛ bɛkɛzulo me na bɛkɛli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, amaa yeayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ nee bɛ mra dahuu.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Kɔ na kɔze bɛ kɛ bɛzia bɛhɔ bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, gyinla me nwo ɛke na mebaha mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛbava wɔahilehile bɛ la meahile wɔ, amaa bɛali zolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Bɛlua adenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛze bɛ la azo, amaa bɛanyia ngoane, na yeayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ, na bɛanyi bɛahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbahɔva bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Akee mɛla ne mɔ nee ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle me kɛ mengilehile bɛ, na bɛli zolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛpɛ azule ne bɛahɔva bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo la ɛne,

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: amaa bɛazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na bɛ mra nee bɛ mra amra ali zolɛ. Bɛli mɛla ne mɔ azo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la amuala na bɛ mekɛ awa.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Yizilayɛma, bɛnlea boɛ na bɛli mɛla ne mɔ azo, amaa yeayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo, na bɛ nwo azo dɔɔnwo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne vale bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma, bɛdie, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne le Ɛdɛnkɛma kokye ala.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ ahonle muala, bɛ ɛkɛla muala, nee bɛ anwosesebɛ muala bɛhulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: na bɛva bɛhilehile bɛ mra kpalɛ kpalɛ. Bɛwɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ anu a, bɛdwenledwenle nwolɛ, yɛɛ saa bɛlua adenle zo o, bɛla o, bɛdwazo o, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ye debie zo bɛbobɔ bɛ sa, bɛva bɛhendɛhenda bɛ ndo avinli,

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: na bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ nlenkɛ nee nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo. Anzosesebɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ, Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ la, ɔ nee bɛ badwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ azuamgbole ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛkyekyele la wɔ zo la azo.

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: Awuke mgbole mɔɔ nuhua le ninyɛne kpalɛ ngome mɔɔ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛvale bɛzieziele nuhua, bula mɔɔ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛbɔle, nee vanye tola nee ɔlivi mbaka egyinli mɔɔ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛluale la wɔ ɛkɛ. Na saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne azo na bɛnyia ye bɛdi, bɛ ko yi a,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ rɛle anvi Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu rale la.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛzonle ye, na bɛva ye duma bɛha ndane.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Bɛmmakɔdi awozonle nzi na bɛsonle menli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la nyamenle ne mɔ,

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la le Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule a. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava bɛ nwo ɛya na yeazɛkye bɛ, yeaminli bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmasɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛnea, kɛmɔ bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle wɔ Masa la.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Bɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ yeva yemaa bɛ la azo kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: na bɛavoa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ amuala bɛagua ɛbɔ nu, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle la se la.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: “Saa kenle bie bɛ mra biza bɛ kɛ, ‘Mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne vale manle bɛ la abo a le duzu?’ a,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: bɛha bɛhile bɛ mra ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Anrɛɛ yɛle Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ahanra, na Ɛdɛnkɛma vale tumi kpole rayele yɛ vile Yigyibiti.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ mgbole mɔɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ la tiale Yigyibiti maanle ne nee ye belemgbunli ne nee ye sua nu amra mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nye nwunle bɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ɔyele yɛ ɔvile ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔ nee yɛ ba na yeava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle yɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la yeamaa yɛ.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Na saa yɛnea boɛ na yɛdi ye mɛla ne azo nɔhalɛ nu, kɛmɔ ɔdaye Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne yeze yɛ la a, yɛbazɔ ɔ nye.’

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛnlea boɛ na bɛli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo. Tieyɛ nwo nyilalɛ (Mɛla

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkye menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛye bɛ kɛmaa bɛ la amuala. Ɔnle kɛ bɛse bɛ anwunvɔne fee, yɛɛ bɛmmasonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ zɔhane ninyɛne ne mɔ bayɛ ngane amaa bɛ.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ye menli ɛhye mɔ maa bɛ na bɛdi bɛ nwo zo konim a, anrɛɛ bɛzɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛ nee bɛ mmayɛ ngyekyeleɛ biala, yɛɛ bɛmmase bɛ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a bɛbahakyi bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ, bɛnrɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma anzi bieko, na bɛbahɔzonle awozonle. Ɔba ye zɛhae a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava bɛ nwo ɛya na yeazɛkye bɛ muala ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ la ɛne: bɛbubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ bɛgua, na bɛbubu bɛ mpila sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ, bɛpepɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ mbaka ne mɔ bɛgua, na bɛyela ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbubu bɛgua la.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛle menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛde bɛ nwo a. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ ɛvi menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala anu, kɛ ye menli a le bɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlɛdi ye ndane ne mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ ze mɔ la azo, na yemɔti yɛɛ yeva tumi kpole yeye bɛ yevi akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu wɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne asa anu a.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne le Nyamenle, nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ sie ye ngyekyeleɛ, na ɔkulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye na bɛdi ye mɛla zo la, kɔdwu awolɛndoazo apenle nwo zo,

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: na ɔtea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi ye la, ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Awie biala mɔɔ kyi ye la ɔnrɛva ɔnrɛhyɛ ye, ɔbadea ye kpalɛ.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Bɛbanyia nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo bɛadɛla maanle biala anu amra. Bɛ nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ anzɛɛ ɛnlankɛ ɛnrɛyɛ mota.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa debie biala mɔɔ le kyibadeɛ la bɛba bɛ azua nu. Bɛhyi bɛ na bɛkpo bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle munzule ninyɛne.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Ɔbahulo bɛ, yeayila bɛ, na yeamaa bɛ nwo azo. Eza ɔbayila bɛ kunlu mralɛ na yeayila bɛ azɛlɛ ne, amaa bɛanyia abɛlɛ, nwanye, nee nwole dɔɔnwo; bɛ nlankɛ nwo bazo na bɛanyia mboane mralɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛtie mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ, bɛfa bɛsie na bɛdi zolɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bali ye ngyekyeleɛ ne azo na yeahulo bɛ kpalɛ, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ la.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma baye bɛ nwo ewule kɔsɔɔti ahɔ, Yigyibiti ewule ɛzulolɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛze la, ɔnrɛmaa bie ɛnrɛha bɛ, noko ɔbamaa bie aha menli mɔɔ kpɔ bɛ la.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Bɛmmaka bɛkile bɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Maanle ɛhye mɔ le mgbole tɛla yɛ, na kɛ yɛkɛzi yɛkɛye bɛ ɛkɛ ne ɛ?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo bɛ. Bɛhakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale yɛle Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nee ye maanlema amuala la.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Ɔgyegyele bɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnwunle ye a. Nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ mgbole, yɛɛ tumi kpole yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale yele bɛ a. Na zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava ayɛ menli mɔɔ bɛsulo bɛ la a.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bamaa ewulenzane adɔ menli zɔhane avinli, kɔkpula kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha na bɛkɛvoa bɛ la kɛwie wu bɔkɔɔ la.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛsulo bɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ bɛ avinli. Ɔle Nyamenle kpole mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ a.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bavoa menli ɛhye mɔ ngyikyi ngyikyi. Bɛnrɛwie bɛ muala sɛkye ɛkɛ ne ala. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, nanemgbole anwo kɛzo kɛbo bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ɔbaye bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ yeamaa bɛ na bɛamaa bɛ aluma aminli ewiade ye anu. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ nyunlu gyinla, kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛzɛkye menli zɔhane mɔ kɔsɔɔti la.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Bɛyela bɛ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua la kɔsɔɔti wɔ senle nu. Bɛmmamaa bɛ nye bolo ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛholo bɛgua nwolɛ la na anrɛɛ bɛkɛzua bɛ nwo ɛhane, ɔluakɛ bɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Bɛli mɛla mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ ɛnɛ demua ye la azo kpalɛ, amaa bɛanyia ngoane na bɛ nwo azo, na bɛahɔ bɛahɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle ɛhɔne hunle bɛ na ɔbɛlɛle bɛ aze, akee ɔmanle bɛ anwuma aleɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye mana la ɔmanle bɛlile. Ɛnee bɛnze aleɛ ɛhye deɛ holɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ bɔbɔ ɛnze ye. Ɔyɛle ɛhye ɔmanle bɛnwunle kɛ tɛ kpanwo angome a bɛdi a bɛnyia ngoane a, na sonla ngoane a le edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa anu kɛvinde la.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ye kɛ, kɛ sonla si kilehile ɔ ra nrenya na eza ɔtea ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne yɛ ye a.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛlua ye adenle ne anu na bɛli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ zo. Azudenle, nzufeanvea, yɛɛ nzubula wɔ ye mbɔnza ne mɔ anu nee awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛhyia aleɛ nwo wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ bɛnrɛhyia ɛhwee nwo. Bulalɛ wɔ awolɛ mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la anu, yɛɛ bɛbadu kɔbele wɔ ye awoka ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Bɛbali bɛ ko ayi, na bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ wɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa bɛ la ati. Bɛ rɛle mɔɔ kɛvi Awulae la anwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ rɛle anvi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛmmabulu ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Saa bɛnyia ye bɛdi na bɛ ko yi na bɛsisi azua ngɛnlɛma bɛdeda nu,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
