translation_verse: na bɛanyi bɛahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔfa yeamaa bɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra la azo.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la ɛnle kɛ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvi zolɛ bɛra la, mɔɔ bɛdua ninyɛne a ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgugua zolɛ nzule kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ ndɔlɔra tola bie la.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Na azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la le awoka nee mbɔnza, yɛɛ ezule tɔ a ɔmeme.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Ɔle azɛlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anye wɔ zo a. Dahuu biala ɔ nye wɔ zo, ɔvi ɛvolɛ ne mɔlebɛbo ɔkɔdwu ye awieleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdi mɛla mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ la azo, bɛkulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛsonle ye a,

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: Ɔbamaa bɛ ndile mɔɔ bɛ nlankɛ bali a, na bɛanyia aleɛ bɛali bɛ ko ayi.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ noko na bɛambɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo, bɛandwe bɛ nwo bɛanvi Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo bɛangɔnzonle bɛanyeyɛ awozonle.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava bɛ nwo ɛya, ɔnrɛmaa ezule ɛnrɛdɔ na bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anyia nzule ayɛ kpalɛ. Ɛhye bamaa bɛ muala bɛawu ndɛndɛ wɔ azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛva me edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ bɛzie bɛ ti anu kpalɛ na bɛhɛlɛ bɛ debie zo bɛkyekye bɛ sa, bɛva bie bɛhendɛhenda bɛ ndo avinli.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Bɛhilehile bɛ mra na bɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ bɛhile bɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdɛnla aze wɔ bɛ azua nu, anzɛɛ bɛlua adenle zo, anzɛɛ bɛkɛhɔ nla nu, anzɛɛ bɛkɛdwazo la.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ bɛ azua nu nlenkɛ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo nee bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anwo,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: amaa bɛdabɛ nee bɛ mra bɛanyi bɛahyɛ na bɛ nwo azo wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava yeamaa bɛ la azo wɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ewiade ne ɛtɛsɛkyele la.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ saa bɛnea boɛ, bɛdi mɛla ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ la azo, bɛkulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛdua ye adenle ne anu, na bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛmaa ye bɔkɔɔ a,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bavoa maanle maanle mɔɔ kɛkala wɔ zolɛ la, na bɛaho bɛava maanle maanle mɔɔ le mgbole, bɛ nwo yɛ se tɛla bɛ la.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛ gyakɛ kɛtia la bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɛtɛlɛ bɔ ye ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa ɔkɔ Lɛbanɔn, na ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa ɔkɔgua adɔleɛ nyevile ne anloa.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ nyunlu gyinla. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bamaa bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ adɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala anwo zo, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea o, na kɛkala meva nyilalɛ nee munzule mezie bɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo a, ɔbayɛ nyilalɛ.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛanli Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo na bɛkakyi bɛ nzi bɛsi mɔɔ melɛka meahile bɛ ɛnɛ la, bɛsonle awozonle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ la a, ɔbayɛ munzule.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne fa bɛ dwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la azo a, bɛva nyilalɛ ne bɛzie Gɛlaezem Boka na bɛva munzule ne bɛzie Yibale Boka.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛapɛ Dwɔdan ne bɛahɔ kɛ bɛkava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo. Na saa bɛ sa ka ye bɛtɛnla zolɛ a,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛnlea na bɛli mɛla ne mɔ nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Mɛla ne mɔ nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbali zolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ewiade la ɛne:

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkye ɛleka biala mɔɔ menli ne sonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ la, wɔ awoka ndendenle nee awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, nee mbaka bubuzuu ne mɔ abo.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Bɛbubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ bɛgua, bɛbubu bɛ mpila sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ, na bɛyela bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ. Bɛbubu bɛ awozonle ne mɔ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua bɛziezie ɛkɛ ne la, na bɛminli bɛ aluma ne mɔ abo zo bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ bɛnzonle bɛ bieko ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmasonle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, kɛmɔ menli ɛhye mɔ sonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Saa ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛva ye duma kɛdo zolɛ kɛ bɛzonle ye la nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛde la wale somaa a, ɛnee bɛhu bɛ mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la bie bɛli, kɛmɔ meha la. Bɛli dodo biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛsi bɛdi kutu nee kɛtɛboɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛli bɛ mboane a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo te nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnde la, bɛkola bɛdi bie.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadi ye fee, amaa saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la a bɛ nee bɛ mra mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la anwo adɔ bɛ.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛyela nane mumua nee ye mogya ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne azo a. Bɛwola azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbali la anu mogya ne bɛgua Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne azo na akee bɛdo nane ne bɛli.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛli mɔɔ meha la amuala azo, amaa saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anye la a, yeayɛ kpalɛ yeamaa bɛ nee bɛ mra mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Awozonlezonlenlɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bali maanlema mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la anwo zo konim na bɛahɔva azɛlɛ ne bɛadɛnla zolɛ.

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛkye maanle zɔhane mɔ wie a, bɛnlea boɛ na debie andwe bɛ ammaa bɛanva menli zɔhane agyakɛ. Bɛmmabiza bɛ awozonle ne mɔ bɔbɔ abo zo na bɛanwu kɛ bɛzile bɛzonlenle bɛ la, na bɛdabɛ bɛayɛ bie.

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasonle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, kɛmɔ menli zɔhane mɔ si sonle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ la. Ɔluakɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi la angome a bɛyɛ bɛmaa bɛ awozonle ne mɔ a. Bɛyela bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ bɔbɔ bɛmaa bɛ awozonle ne mɔ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: “Bɛli mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la azo kpalɛ. Bɛmmafa bie bɛboka nwolɛ yɛɛ bɛmmaye bie bɛfi nuhua.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: na saa ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ sisi na ɔse bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛhɔzonle awozonle bie mɔ,’ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ bɛtɛyɛle bie ɛlɛ la a,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: bɛmmatie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane anzɛɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ hanle ɛlalɛ ne la edwɛkɛ biala. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne lɛ ye ɛlɛsɔ bɛ anlea saa bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛkulo ye a.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Bɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne abo zo na bɛzulo ye, bɛli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, bɛdie ɔ ne, bɛzonle ye na bɛva bɛ nwo amuala bɛmaa ye.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛhu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane anzɛɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ hanle ɛlalɛ ne la, ɔboalekɛ yehilehile bɛ kɛ bɛde Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti rale la anwo atua, amaa bɛavi adenle ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛlua nu la anu. Zɔhane yɛɛ bɛbayɛ na bɛaye musuofoɔ ne bɛavi bɛ avinli a.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti bade, bɛbazulo, na bɛanyɛ amumuyɛ debie mɔɔ le zɛhae la bieko wɔ bɛ avinli.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛwɔ bɛ azua mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo,

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: na bɛte kɛ kpamgbanvolɛma bie ɛdwazo sua bie azo amra anwo zo, bɛze bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛhɔzonle awozonle,’ mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ anzonle bie ɛlɛ la a,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: bɛbiza nu kpalɛ, bɛvedevede nuhua gyɛlɛɛnye na saa amgba edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ kɛ debie zɛhae ɛzi a,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: bɛhu menli mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la amuala, bɛbɔ sua ne tɔɔ, bɛzɛkye debie biala nee nlankɛ mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne menli mɔɔ anwo te a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la avinli kɛ ɔdaye ye menli a le bɛ. Nane mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la (Sɛlɛ

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: “Bɛli anloma biala mɔɔ anwo te la.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛdi debie biala mɔɔ le kyibadeɛ la.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: nane biala mɔɔ bɛkpakye ɔ gyakɛ taboa ne anu nwiɔ na ɔkpu ɔkposa aleɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛli la.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Noko nane mɔɔ bɛamkpakye ɔ gyakɛ taboa ne anu nwiɔ noko ɔkpu ɔkposa la anu ɛhye mɔ, bɛmmadi: afunlumu, asoasoa anzɛɛ abotokila, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpu bɛkposa bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛamkpakye bɛ gyakɛ adaboa ne mɔ anu. Yemɔti bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Akee kpolike noko, bɛkpakye ɔ gyakɛ taboa ne anu ɛdeɛ na ɔmkpu ɔmkposa, yemɔti ɔ nwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ. Bɛmmadi ye nane yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka ye funli bɔbɔ.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: “Nzule nu fɛlɛ noko, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi la ɛne: fɛlɛ biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ abonle na ɔlɛ ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne la bɛkola bɛdi.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ abonle nee ɔ nzi ngyɛnengyɛne la, bɛmmadi, ɔluakɛ bɛ nwo ɛnde ɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: But don't eat the meat of any of the following birds: eagles, vultures, falcons, kites, ravens, ostriches, owls, sea gulls, hawks, pelicans, ospreys, cormorants, storks, herons, and hoopoes. You must not eat bats.
translation_verse: Nloma mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛdi la a le ɛhye mɔ: kɔleɛ, ɛkpɔtɛ, bɔngɔ, sanzia, kyɛnyema, akoso, kpadule, akpanlɛ, kɔkɔsɛlɛ, soholo, ahweanga, azuazuanloma nee nloma mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la biala.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: “Kɛkɛba biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la anwo ɛnde ɛmmaa bɛ; bɛmmadi bie fee.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ na ɔ nwo te la bɛkola bɛdi.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: “Debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛwu la, bɛmmadi. Bɛkola bɛfa bɛmaa bɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la kɛ bɛli anzɛɛ bɛkola bɛtɔne ye bɛmaa ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnle Yizilayɛnli la, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛle menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdu bɛ ɛzie ahane ɛmaa ɔ nwo a. “Bɛmmato boane anzɛɛ abɔnkye ralɛ wɔ ɔ nli nyɛfonzule nu bɛdi. Ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne anwo mɛla

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ biala aleɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkyɛ nu bulu bɛtu ɛkpɔ ngoko bɛsie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Akee bɛva bɛ aleɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔ bɛhɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ye duma ɛdo zolɛ kɛ bɛzonle ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne la na bɛali. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ ma, nwanye, ɔlivi nwole mɔɔ lumua nee bɛ nlankɛ nee mboane ne mɔ amra mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo bɛ la a. Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛva bɛzukoa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne enililɛ dahuu.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Na saa ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ bie mɔ de la nee ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne se bɛzonle ye la anu twe, na bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛva ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛkɛma ɛlo bɛ ɛmaa bɛnyia ye ɛvolɛ ne anu la ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔ bɛnrɛhɔ a,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Akee bɛva ezukoa ne bɛdɔ ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane anzɛɛ nwanye anzɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ biala, anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛ tiakunlu wɔ zolɛ la na bɛli wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu na bɛ nee bɛ sua nu amra ɛlie bɛ nye.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: “Anrɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi Livaema mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la, ɔboalekɛ bɛampɛ bɛ gya yɛɛ bɛnlɛ agyadeɛ biala wɔ bɛ avinli.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ nsa biala awieleɛ bɛva bɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ngoko ne mɔ bɛrɛla sua zo bɛrazie.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Aleɛ zɛhae le Livaema ne mɔ ɛdeɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛmɛ, bɛampɛ bɛ gya yɛɛ bɛnlɛ agyadeɛ. Eza ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔmaa nyɛvolɛ, nrisa, nee ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛba na bɛbadie aleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhyia nwolɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ. Bɛyɛ ɛhye na Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bayila bɛ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛ diema bie yɛ ehyianli wɔ sua bie azo, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo a, anrɛɛ bɛmmayɛ ye atisesebɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmafoa adiema ne bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Na kɛ bɛbazi bɛava bɛahyɛ bɛ la ɛne: ɔwɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ awie tua ye kakɛ la fa kakɛ ne kyɛ ɔ gɔnwo ne anzɛɛ ɔ diema ne mɔɔ tua ye kakɛ ne la, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛpɛ kakɛ biala anu.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Saa ahenle mɔɔ tua kakɛ ne la le ɛyɛvolɛ a, yemɔ bɛkola bɛdie, na saa ahenle mɔɔ tua kakɛ ne la le bɛdabɛ menli ko ye ala bie a, bɛmmabɔ zo mgbane bɔbɔ.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bayila bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la. Bɛbabɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bosea, na bɛmɛ, bɛnrɛbiza awie bosea ɛlɛ. Bɛbazie maanle maanle dɔɔnwo, noko maanle biala ɛnrɛzie bɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛannyia adwenle ɛtane, bɛanga kɛ ɛvolɛ nsuu ne mɔɔ bɛfa awie biala kakɛ bɛkyɛ ye la ɛbikye, na bɛyɛ bɛ diema mɔɔ tua bɛ kakɛ la kpɔdekpɔde anzɛɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ ɛra babiza bosea la atisesebɛ kɛ bɛnrɛmaa ye ɛhwee. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbazu yeavɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne yeamaa nyɛleɛ ne ayɛ ɛtane atia bɛ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Bɛbuke bɛ munli nu bɛbɔ bɛ bosea ne, yɛɛ bɛmmatendɛ bɛ kolaa na bɛava bɛamaa bɛ, na Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayila bɛ wɔ gyima biala mɔɔ bɛkɛzɔ nu la anu.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na saa ayɛmoa zɔhane anwo lɛ dɛne, saa ye ndwɛlɛ ɛbubu anzɛɛ saa ɔ nye ɛzi a, bɛmmafa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Saa bɛgyakyi ye bɛamaa yeahɔ a, bɛmmamaa ɔdɛ ɔ sa mgbane ɔkɔ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea bɛ mboane ne mɔ anu, bɛ ma ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne nee bɛ nwanye sua ne anu, na bɛmaa ye ninyɛne ala mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne zile lole wɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ ɛmaa ɔdaye noko a.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: “Na saa kanranli ne ka kile wɔ kɛ ɔkulo wɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra, na eza ɔwɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne a ɔ nwo tɔ ye la ati, ɔvi ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɔnrɛhɔ a,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: ɛnee fa ye kɔ wɔ anlenkɛ ne anwo, na fa ketera fiti ɔ nzo maa ɔwɔ anlenkɛ ne anu kile kɛ ɔle wɔ kanranli dahuu. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ wɔ kanranli raalɛ a.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: “Bɛ mboane nyinli anzɛɛ nlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo bɛ la, bɛva bɛ bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛmmafa nlankɛ nyinli zɔhane mɔ bɛyɛ gyima biala yɛɛ bɛmmapepɛ mboane nyinli zɔhane mɔ anwo enrinli.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ biala bɛva nlankɛ nee mboane zɛhae mɔ bɛhɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la, na bɛ nee bɛ awuke nu amra ɛli wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Bɛdo bɛli wɔ bɛ azua zo. Bɛmaa mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la biala ɛli bie, kɛmɔ bɛdi kutu anzɛɛ kɛtɛboɛ la.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Noko bɛmmadi ye mogya ne; bɛhwi bɛgua aze kɛ asɛɛ nzule la.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Bɛzie siane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ebebe la na bɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne wɔ nuhua bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia. Ɔluakɛ siane Ebebe ne anu kenle ko nɔɔzo yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne rayele bɛ vile Yigyibiti a.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Pɛlepɛle ala a bɛli ɔ nzi a, amaa bɛanyi bɛahyɛ na bɛava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava amaa bɛ la.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat of the Passover sacrifice that same night. But don't serve bread made with yeast at the Passover meal. Serve the same kind of thin bread that you ate when you were slaves suffering in Egypt and when you had to leave Egypt quickly. As long as you live, this thin bread will remind you of the day you left Egypt. For seven days following Passover, don't make any bread with yeast. In fact, there should be no yeast anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɔnle kɛ bɛnwu mgbɔvonle biala wɔ awie biala sua nu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde zo la amuala azo dedee kenle nsuu. Eza nane ne mɔɔ bɛkɛhu ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la nɔsolɛ nu la, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi bɛmaa bie ka aleɛ kye zolɛ.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛdɔkɛ mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu la kenle nsia, na kenle nsuu ne azo bɛayia bɛazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Kenle ko ne ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ gyima biala. Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne (Ade

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ mboane anzɛɛ nlankɛ ne mɔ ko bɛbɔ Akpabɛnwo azu ne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ ɔkɛhile kɛ ɛkɛ ne a bɛzonle ye la.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmabɔ Akpabɛnwo azu ne wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava amaa bɛadɛnlɛdɛnla zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ye wɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la, wɔ nɔsolɛ nu, mekɛ mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkɔ ahɔdɔ la, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfi Yigyibiti la.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛto na bɛdi ye wɔ ɛleka ko ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile la, na aleɛ kye a akee bɛahɔ bɛ azua nu.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: Eza bɛmmakpɔnla mpila biala kɛ bɛfa bɛazonle awozonle, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kyi.

english_verse: After you have finished the grain harvest and the grape harvest, take your sons and daughters and all your servants to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. The Lord will give you big harvests and make you successful in everything you do. You will be completely happy, so celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord your God. Three Festivals at the Place of Worship (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛli ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu wɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile la bɛva bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bayila bɛ, amaa bɛanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛakpazi wɔ gyima biala mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛ sa bɛkɛha ye la anu, amaa bɛ muala bɛ nye alie.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmakpɔnla baka biala bɛfa bɛyɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛboka Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbazi la anwo.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest,
translation_verse: “Bɛbɔ ɔ bo kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ abɛlɛ ɛbulɛ bo la, bɛdia toonwo dapɛne nsuu,

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ, bɛ sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ, Livaema nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo, nrisa nee ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la ɛbɔ nu ɛli ɛvoyia ne anyelielɛ nu, wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ ɛleka ko ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua ko biala bava debie mɔɔ ɔkɛhola ye fa la, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛva ɛmaa ye la si de la. Pɛlepɛlelilɛ

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ mrenya mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala yia nuhua fane nsa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu, wɔ ɛleka ne mɔɔ ɔkɛhile la. Ayia fane nsa ne a le Angye Ɛvoyia ne, Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne. Bɛlɛba biala a ɔnle kɛ bɛdɛ bɛ sa mgbane bɛba.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ɛnlankɛ nyinli biala nee boane biala mɔɔ anwo lɛ dɛne la anzɛɛ yebubu la bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, ɔluakɛ ɔle kyibadeɛ kpole ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: bɛnleɛnlea nu kpalɛ. Na saa bɛnwu kɛ amgba yeyɛ munzule debie ɛhye wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu a,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛli daselɛ ne la, bɛmɛ a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdumua bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ bɛku ye kolaa na akee menli mɔɔ ɛha la arazɔ nu bɛahu ye a. Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa na bɛye munzule ne bɛfi bɛ avinli a.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, menli kɔsɔɔti bade na bɛazulo na bɛanli bɛ ti anwo bieko. Belemgbunli nwo folɛdulɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava amaa bɛ la azo, na bɛfa azɛlɛ ne bɛtɛnla zo, na bɛnyia adwenle kɛ akee bɛkpondɛ belemgbunli azie bɛ, kɛmɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la de la a,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: bɛkola bɛsie ahenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛye ye kɛmaa bɛ la belemgbunli bɛmaa ɔsie bɛ. Bɛdabɛ bɛ nuhua ko yɛɛ bɛva ye bɛzie bɛ belemgbunli a; bɛmmafa ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ ɔnle bɛ diema la bɛsie belemgbunli.

english_verse: The king should not have many horses, especially those from Egypt. The Lord has said never to go back there again.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne, ɔnle kɛ ɔnyia mgbɔnwɔ dɔɔnwo. Ɔnle kɛ ɔfa adenle bie anu kɛ ɔmaa menli ne azia ahɔ Yigyibiti amaa bɛanyia mgbɔnwɔ dɔɔnwo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze kɛ, ‘Bɛmmasia bɛ nzi bɛfa zɔhane adenle ne azo ɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɔ ɛkɛ.’

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɔgya mraalɛ dɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ ɛhye bamaa ɔ rɛle avi Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ eza ɔnle kɛ ɔ nye bolo dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke dɔɔnwo ɛnyianlɛ.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ahenle mɔɔ bɛkɛzie ye belemgbunli la nyia Nyamenle Mɛla Buluku ne ko. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔkɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ne ɔfi Mɛla Buluku ne mɔɔ Livae sɛlɛvolɛma ne lɛ la anu.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔsie kpalɛ na ɔkenga ye dahuu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la, amaa yeazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne na yeali ye mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ azo.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bazi ye adenle amaa yeammemaa ɔ nwo zo yeangile ɔ mediema ne mɔ. Eza ɔnrɛmaa ɔnrɛvi mɛla ne nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo ɔnrɛhɔ fema zo anzɛɛ bɛne zo, na ɔdaye nee ɔ mra bɛali belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ bɛahyɛ.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebamaa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ avinde bɛdabɛ bɛ avinli. Mebava me edwɛkɛ meadua ɔ nloa na yeaha mɔɔ menwɔze ye la yeahile bɛ.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛze kɛ ɔyɛ ye gyima ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia debie biala mɔɔ bɛ nee ye kɛra la bie, kɛmɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la nyia ye ala la. Debie biala mɔɔ ye sua nu amra kɛva kɛnwa ye la ɔkola ɔfa ɔsie. Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la nyɛleɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma la nyia Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne bie. Bɛmɛ, ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛrabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie yɛɛ bɛbado bɛali a, yɛɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ngakyile ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti le bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ kɛrabɔ azu la, saa ɛnlankɛ o, boane o, bɛku ye a ɔ kɔme zo ne, ye awudwɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔ kunlu ninyɛne ne le sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Akee bɛ ma mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde, bɛ nwanye nee nwole mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛyɛ, yɛɛ bɛ mboane ne mɔ amra mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo bɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛnlea nu ɛye bɛmɛ wɔ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu kɛ bɛ nee bɛ mra bɛyɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛma bɛzonle ye dahuu.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: “Saa Livaenli bie wɔ Yizilayɛ sua bie azo na ɔyɛ ye adwenle kɛ ɔba ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛzonle ye la a, ɔkola ɔba.

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: Ɔba a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsonle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne duma nu, kɛmɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ Livaema ne yɛ ye la.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava amaa bɛ la azo a, bɛmmasukoa bɛyɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ yɛ la bie.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la bɔ munzule wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Na ɔlua bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ ati yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfoa menli zɔhane mɔ avi bɛ nye zo a.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbazoa ye la anwo ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi zele bɛ kɛ, “Maanlema ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛbahɔ bɛahɔdu bɛ la tie ngonyiama nee menli mɔɔ biza bɔ awie munzule la edwɛkɛ, na bɛmɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛmkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye bie.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bamaa ye kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ le kɛ medame la avinde bɛ avinli. Ɔbaye ye yeavi bɛdabɛ bɛ mediema ne mɔ avinli, na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie ye a.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛyiale nu wɔ Saenae Boka la, bɛzɛlɛle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mmatendɛ maa bɛte ɔ ne bieko anzɛɛ bɛnwu ye senle hulenyihulenyi ne bieko, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛsulo kɛ bɛkɛwu.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Mɔɔ bɛha la le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ andie edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkɛlua me duma nu ɔkɛha la, medame me nee ye bali.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ ɔ ti anu kɛva me duma kɛha edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ tɛ medame a menzele ye anzɛɛ kɛdendɛ nyamenle gyɛne bie mɔ anloa azo la bawu a.’

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: “Bɛ adwenle nu bayɛ bɛ kesee kɛ, ‘Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanwu kɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne ɛ?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala fa Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ka edwɛkɛ na edwɛkɛ ne anyɛ zɔhane anzɛɛ anyɛ nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee ɔnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛha a, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɔdaye a yebɔ ɔ ti anu yeha a. Bɛmmasulo kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: “Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɔ maanlema mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeamaa bɛ la abo zo, na bɛfa bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ na bɛtɛnla bɛ azua ne mɔ anu a,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a le kɛ, saa awie nee ɔ gɔnwo kɔ ɛbɔ nu kɛ bɛkapɛ baka, na baka ne ɛpɛlɛ nu ye akuma ne ati tu kɔbɔ ɔ gɔnwo ne maa ɔwu a, ɔkola ɔnriandi ɔkɔfea azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ ko azo na ɔdie ye ngoane.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Saa tɛ ye zɔ a, anrɛɛ kɛmɔ adenle ne wale la, sonla ne mɔɔ di nzenralɛ ne la bahola avoa ahenle mɔɔ hunle ye la toonwo yeahɔhye ye adenle nu, yeava ɛya yeahu ye yeazie ɔ bo zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ hunle ye la ɛnli fɔlɛ la. Ɔnle kɛ bɛku ye bɛsie ɔ bo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔ nee ye ɛnlɛ bie dɛba yɛɛ yeanzuzu.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati mese bɛ kɛ bɛva azuamgbole nsa bɛzie ahane bɛyɛ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛanga mogya mɔɔ ɛnli fɔlɛ la bɛangua mgbane wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo, na eza bɛanli fɔlɛ kɛ bɛha mogya mɔɔ ɛnli fɔlɛ la bɛgua a.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: “Na saa awie kpɔ ɔ gɔnwo na ɔsia ye adenle nu, ɔboda ye kpole bie ɔmaa ɔwu, na ahenle mɔɔ hunle ye la nriandi kɔ ɛvealeka azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ biala azo a,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ɔwɔ kɛ ye sua ne azo mgbanyima soa maa bɛkɔfa ye bɛfi ɛvealeka ne bɛba na bɛye ye bɛwula ahenle mɔɔ di nzenralɛ ne la asa anu, na ɔku ye ɔsie ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛse ye anwunvɔne. Bɛye kɔdiawu ɛhye bɛvi Yizilayɛ, amaa kpalɛ adoa kpalɛ. Tete ɛweɛne ne mɔ

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ɛweɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ mɔmoane amra ne gyigyale wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo la, anrɛɛ bɛmmakakyihakyi bɛ. Bɛmaa bɛdeda bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ avinli zɔhane ala. Mɔɔ fane daselɛlilɛ nwo la

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Saa awie di awie anwo dasewia kɛ ahenle ne ɛyɛ ɛtane bie a,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛmmase awie biala anwunvɔne. Awie mɔɔ kɛhu sonla la, bɛhu ye, ɔtu ɛnyelɛ a, bɛdu ɔ nye, ɔtu egyele a, bɛdu ɔ gye, ɔpɛ ɛsalɛ a, bɛpɛ ɔ sa, yɛɛ ɔbu egyakɛ a, bɛbu ɔ gyakɛ.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkɔ konle nloa kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma kaho, na bɛnwu kɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛlɔnema ne anwo zonle tɛla bɛ na bɛlɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee konle ehwili dɔɔnwo a, bɛmmasulo bɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti rale la nee bɛ a lua a.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Saa bɛdwu konle ne anloa a, bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛpɛ ɛli bɛ nyunlu na bɛ nee ɛlɔnema ne ɛdendɛ na bɛze bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: ‘Yizilayɛma, bɛdie! Ɛnɛ kenle ye bɛra kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma baho. Bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu, bɛmmasulo anzɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ nwo wozo bɛ bɛmaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ kɔ ɔ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne ahɔho na yeamaa bɛali konim a.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: “Akee mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ nu la noko badendɛ ahile ɛlɔnema ne kɛ, ‘Nwane a ɛzi sua fofolɛ mɔɔ ɔtɛbukele a? Ɔzia ɔhɔ sua nu na wɔannea a ɔkɛwu konle ye anu na awie gyɛne ava ye sua ne abuke ala nu.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛlua ye vanye egyinli na ɔtɛdile nuhua ma ne bie a? Ɔzia ɔhɔ sua nu na wɔannea a ɔkɛwu konle ye anu na awie gyɛne ali ye vanye egyinli ne anu ma ne.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Yɛɛ nrenya boni a wɔ ɛke mɔɔ ɛyia raalɛ na ɔ nee ye ɛtɛkɔle sua nu a? Ɔzia ɔhɔ na ɔhɔva ɔ ye ne ɔhɔ ye sua nu na wɔannea a ɔkɛwu konle ye anu na awie gyɛne ava ɔ ye ne.’

english_verse: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.
translation_verse: “Akee mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛze menli ne mɔ bieko kɛ, ‘Nwane a sulo na ye ahonle ɛdu a? Ɔzia ɔhɔ sua nu na anrɛɛ ɔkɛmaa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ ahonle kɛdu kɛ ye ɛdeɛ ne la.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Saa mgbanyima ne mɔ tendɛ kile ɛlɔnema ne na bɛwie a, akee bɛyeye safohyenlema bɛmaa bɛli menli ne ati.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: “Na azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo la, saa bɛko bɛfa bie a, bɛhu debie biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkye debie biala: bɛbɔ Hɛtema, Amɔlema, Keenama, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema amuala abo zo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛze bɛ la.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛhu bɛ muala, amaa menli zɔhane mɔ angilehile bɛ bɛammaa bɛanyɛ bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu la bie, na bɛayɛ ɛtane bɛatia Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbɛnra bɛyia suakpole bie kɛ bɛ nee zolɛ amra kaho bɛava suakpole ne na bɛhye nwolɛ a, bɛmmafa akuma bɛka mbaka mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la bɛsɛkye bɛ. Bɛli zolɛ aleɛ ne bie na bɛmmabubu bɛ bɛgua, ɔluakɛ mbaka ne mɔ ɛnle menli na bɛava bɛ konle bɛadoa bɛ.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Saa bɛsɛkye mbaka a, bɛzɛkye mbaka mɔɔ ɛnzo ma mɔɔ bɛdi la na bɛva bɛ mbaka azinli ne mɔ bɛdua suakpole ne azo amra adenle mɔɔ bɛnvinde a, kɔkpula kɛ suakpole ne azo amra kɛmaa bɛ sa zo la.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛnwu kɛ bɛhu awie bɛdo kpɔkɛ bie anu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo na bɛngola bɛnnwu ahenle mɔɔ hunle ye la a,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: bɛ mgbanyima ne nee bɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma ne mɔ ɛhɔ na bɛhɔzuzu, ɔvi ahenle mɔɔ ɛwu la anwo ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɔ azuamgbole mɔɔ zuozua ɛkɛ ne la,

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: na bɛnwu suakpole mɔɔ bikye ye la. Saa bɛnwu ye a, mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ suakpole zɔhane azo la ɛva ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛfale bɛtɛyɛle gyima ɛlɛ la,

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne, mɔɔ le Livae abo zo amra ne kɔ bie, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye bɛ kɛ bɛzonle ye na bɛva ye duma bɛyila menli ne a. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ kpolera la anwo anzɛɛ ndɛne biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbua wɔ konle biala anwo la ɛnee ɔdaye ne ala ɛne.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow

translation_verse: Nzinlii saa akee ɛ nye ɛnlie ɔ nwo ko a, gyakyi ye maa ɔhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la. Ɔnle kɛ ɛtɔne ye ɛdie ezukoa, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛyɛ ye kɛ asɛɛ ɔle kanranli, ɔboalekɛ ɛ nee ye bɛyɛ nrenya nee raalɛ. Ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli agyalilɛ

translation_verse: “Saa awie to mɛla bie mɔɔ ɔfɛta ɛhunlɛ la na bɛkenda ye bɛku ye a,

translation_verse: ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa ye funli ne kenda baka ne azo aledwolɛ ne amuala. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye bɛsie ye kenle ko ne ala. english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛnwu kɛ ɛ diema bie ɛnlankɛ anzɛɛ boane ɛde ɛlɛkɔ a, mmayɛ kɛ asɛɛ ɔnvane ɛ nwo la. Fa ɛnlankɛ ne anzɛɛ boane ne sia kɔmaa ɔ menle.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Saa ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi yera la wale, anzɛɛ ɛnze ɔ menle a, fa ye sie wɔ tunli ne anu, wɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne maa ɔwoa ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwu kɛ ɔ menle kɛra ye ɛkpondɛlɛ la na fa ye debie maa ye.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ fa yɛ ɛ gɔnwo asoaso, ye tɛladeɛ nee ye debie biala mɔɔ kɛminli la a. Ɔnle kɛ ɛtɛnla ɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ kɛ wɔannwu ye na ɛmaa deɛ ne minli.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ raalɛ wula nrenya tɛladeɛ, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ nrenya keda raalɛ ɛdanlɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kyi menli mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Saa ɛsi wɔ sua a, bɔ mɔdenle die bane wɔ ɔ ti zo, amaa saa awie vi zolɛ tɔ aze na ɔwu a, wɔanli fɔlɛ kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛhunle ye a.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ ɛdua ma ngakyile bieko wɔ wɔ vanye egyinli nu. Saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, bɛbasisi ɛ nwo zo, na egyinli ne nee nuhua ma ne amuala bayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: “Mmawula tɛladeɛ anzɛɛ mmakeda ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛva boane enrinli nee bolɔfodɔ mɔleɛ bɛnwo la.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Wɔ ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛfa ɛgua ɛ nwo la, nwo nyɛma sosɔkpɔɔ ɔ ti nna ne amuala. Raalɛ nee nrenya nla kpalɛ nwo mɛla

translation_verse: Saa bɛkɔ a, selɛ ne ɛze mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Menvale me ra raalɛ ye memanle nrenya ɛhye gyale ye, na kɛkala, ɔse akee ɔngulo ye.

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛba la, bɛammaa bɛ aleɛ a bɛammaa bɛ nzule. Eza bɛbɔle Biyɔ ara nrenya Beelam, mɔɔ vi suakpole Pitɔ mɔɔ wɔ Mɛsɔpɔteemea la ɛkpa kɛ ɔwa bɛ amonle.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.

translation_verse: “Bɛmmakpo Yidɔmenli, ɔluakɛ ɔle bɛ diema; bɛmmakpo Yigyibitinli, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛle nyɛvolɛ wɔ ye maanle nu.

translation_verse: Ɔvi awolɛndoazo nsa ne azo mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛmaa bɛ bo zo amra adenle bɛmaa bɛwolo Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne avinli. Ɛlɔnema azokoɛleɛ ne bɔkɔbɔkɔyɛlɛ

translation_verse: Saa bɛ nuhua bie anla boɛ aledwolɛ ne anu la ati ɔ nwo ɛnde a, ɔhɔ azokoɛleɛ ne kandiba, ɔmmaba azokoɛleɛ ne.

translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia amgbɔma ko bɛboka bɛ konle ninyɛne ne anwo, amaa saa bɛfinde kɛ bɛkazɔho bɛ gyakɛ a bɛava bɛawɔ, bɛwie a bɛahakyi bɛ nwo bɛadua ye.

translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne luolua bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne kɛ ɔbalie bɛ na yeaye bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne yeamaa bɛ. Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne te, amaa yeannwu debie ɛtane biala wɔ ɛkɛ ne na yeahakyi ɔ nwo yeahɔ. Mɛla ngakyile ngakyile

translation_verse: “Saa kanranli bie nriandi batane bɛ a, bɛmmaye ye bɛmaa ɔ menle.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Ezukoa biala noko mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ tuutuulilɛ nu la, bɛmmafa bɛbatua ɛwɔkɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛbɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmabɔ bɛ mediema ne mɔ bosea na bɛdie nwolɛ nzinwo, meka ezukoa, aleɛ, anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛfa ɛfɛne awie na ɛdie nwolɛ nzinwo a ɔyɛ boɛ la.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Saa ahenle le ɛyɛvolɛ a, yemɔ bɛkola bɛdie. Na bɛ mediema ne mɔ ɛdeɛ bɛmmadie, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayila bɛ wɔ debie biala anu wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛwɔkɛ a, bɛmmatwenlehwenle bɛ bo aze wɔ ye ɛdualɛ nu, ɔluakɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne balie avi bɛ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ eza ɔle ɛtane bɔbɔ ɔmaa bɛ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Na saa wɔambɔ ɛwɔkɛ fee a ɔnle ɛtane ɔmmaa wɔ.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea boɛ na bɛyɛ debie biala mɔɔ vi bɛ nloa anu kɛvinde la. Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ kunlu fufule yɛɛ bɛbɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛwɔkɛ ne a. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi zolɛ.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛkɔ ɛ diema bie vanye egyinli nu a, ɛkola ɛdi ma ne bie kpalɛ ɛmaa ɛ ko yi, dodo biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la, ɛkola ɛdi. Noko mmafa bie ɛto wɔ bondo nu ɛkɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔ ɛ gɔnwo bie awule ɛya nu a, ɛkola ɛfa ɛ sa ɛte bie, na ɔnle kɛ ɛfa ɛdedadeɛ ɛka ye awule ne.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya gya raalɛ na nzinlii ɔnwu kɛ raalɛ ne ɛnli ɔ nwo eni a, ɔhɛlɛ ewolebɔlɛ kɛlata ɔwula ɔ sa nu na ɔye ye ali wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Saa ɔkɔ na nrenya fofolɛ gya ye,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ɔnle kɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ lumuale gyale ye la sia fa ye yɛ ɔ ye bieko, ɔboalekɛ ye nyɛleɛ ɛgua ɔ nwo evinli. Ɛhye le kyibadeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa evinli biala bɛka azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la. Mɛla ngakyile ngakyile

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Saa nrenya gya raalɛ ɛkɛ ne ala a, ɔnle kɛ bɛmaa ɔkɔ ɛlɔne nloa kɛ ɔkaho anzɛɛ bɛfa gyima dɔɔnwo bɛgua ɔ nwo zo. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa ye adenle bɛmaa ɔda sua nu ɛvolɛ ko ɔ nee ɔ ye ne mɔɔ yegya ye la dielie bɛ nye.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ awie biala fa awie mɔɔ yebɔ ye bosea la ɛdibolɛ di agyinla nu. Saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɔlɛye ahenle ne mɔɔ bizale ye bosea ne la nee ye sua nu amra anloa anu aleɛ.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Saa awie kye ɔ diema Yizilayɛnli bie nuokɛ tɔne ye anzɛɛ maa ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ ɔmaa ye kɛ kanranli la a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku sonla zɔhane ne, amaa bɛakpa munzule debie zɔhane bɛavi bɛ avinli.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: “Saa ewule kokobɛ gua bɛ bie a, ɔnlea boɛ na ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ Livaema, mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma la kɛha kɛhile ye la. Mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la, bɛnlea bɛli zolɛ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛhakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne vale yɛle Meleam wɔ adevinli ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvile Yigyibiti bɛdule bɛ bo kɛ bɛba la.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛbɔ ɛ diema bie bosea a, mmakɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɛkalie deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeali agyinlanu la.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Gyinla alie nwo nehane maa ahenle ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ ye bosea ne la ɔdaye ɔva deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa yeali agyinlanu la ɔrɛla.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Saa ahenle mɔɔ ɛbɔle ye bosea la le ehyianli a, mmafa deɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔlile agyinlanu ne la ɛsie ɛmaa aleɛ kye.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Fa ye deɛ ne sia kɔmaa ye nɔsolɛ biala mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkɔ ahɔdɔ la, amaa saa ɛdanlɛ a, yeava yeagua ɔ nwo nɔe ne na yeayileyila wɔ kosoɛ kosoɛ. Ɛhye a sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anye a.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛbɔ awie ɛkpa na ahenle le ehyianli a anrɛɛ bɛmmasisi ye. Saa ɔle bɛ mediema ne mɔ anu ko o, saa ɔle ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo azua ne mɔ ko azo o, bɛmmasisi ye.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛdua ye ɛkpabɔlɛ ahatualɛ ne bɛmaa ye kenle ko biala na sɛnzɛne ne adɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔle ehyianli yɛɛ ɔ ti nee ɔ bo ne amuala ala ɛne. Saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɔbazu yeavɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yeatia bɛ wɔ nwolɛ, na ɛhye le ɛtane mɔɔ batia bɛ a.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye a. Ɔnle kɛ bɛku awovolɛma wɔ mralɛ ɛtane ti anzɛɛ bɛku mralɛ wɔ awovolɛma ɛtane ti.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ bɛnea ɛyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ arisa nyunlu bɛbua ye mgbɔvodɛne. Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛdie kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ɛdanlɛ bɛsie awoba.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛle ahanra wɔ Yigyibiti yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne rayele bɛ vile ɛkɛ a. Yemɔti mese bɛ kɛ, bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ meha la.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛbu wɔ ɛya nu bɛyɔba ne, na wɔ sua zo ɛralɛ nu, ɛ rɛle fi ekyi bie mɔɔ wɔkyekye kɛ ɛfa wɔara sua zo la ɛbɔ ne anu na ɛba sua zo a, mmasia ɛ nzi kɛ ɛkɔ wɔahɔva. Maa ɔyɛ nyɛvolɛ, mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze anzɛɛ nrisa nee ahunlanvolɛ bie ɛdeɛ, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ayila wɔ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɛyɛ la anu.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Saa ɛte wɔ ɔlivi ma ne ɛwie a, ngoko ne mɔɔ kɛha zolɛ la, mmakɔ kɛ ɛkatete. Gyakyi maa nyɛvolɛ, nrisa, nee ahunlanvolɛ.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa ɛtete wɔ vanye ma ne ɛwie a, ngoko ne mɔɔ kɛha zolɛ la, mmasia ɛkɔtete a. Gyakyi maa nyɛvolɛ, nrisa, nee ahunlanvolɛ.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ ɛnee bɛle ahanra wɔ Yigyibiti. Yemɔti mese bɛ kɛ bɛli mɔɔ meha la azo.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Saa ɔba ye kɛ mɔɔ lile fɔlɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbo ye a, ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ɛmaa bɛbutu ye na bɛbila ye empele dodo biala mɔɔ fɛta ye ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la wɔ ɔdaye ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Saa ɔkyele zolɛ a bɛbila ye empele abulanla, ɔnle kɛ ɔbo. Saa ɔbo a ɛnee bɛbɔ adiema ne anyiemgba wɔ bagua nu.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Saa ɛlɛfa ɛnlankɛ wɔawozo ma a mmakyekye ɔ nloa. Gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛmaa adiema nrenya mɔɔ kɛwu la

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛwo ye la, yemɔ a ɔdi ɔ ze ne mɔɔ ɛwu la agya a, amaa mɔɔ ɛwu la duma amminli Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Na saa nrenya ne ɛngulo kɛ ɔfa ɔ diema ne mɔɔ ɛwu la aye ne a, ɛnee kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne ɛhɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ, wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa na ɔze bɛ kɛ, ‘Me hu adiema nrenya ne ɛkpo kɛ ɔnrɛmaa ɔ diema nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛwu la duma ɛnrɛha Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu. Amaamuo mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbu ɔmaa me kɛ ɔ diema nrenya a le me hu ne mɔɔ ɛwu la, ɔmbu.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Ɔba ye zɔhane a suakpole ne azo mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛvɛlɛ nrenya ne na bɛbiza ye, na saa eza ɔsi zolɛ bieko kɛ, ‘Menrɛyɛ a’,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: ɛnee bɛmaa kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ne ɛhɔye nrenya ne agyakɛ ko mgbɔlaboa, ɔdo nyɛlɛ ɔ nwo wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔha kɛ, ‘Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ sonla ne mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ ɔ diema duma ka Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo la ɛne.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma amuala bavɛlɛ ye awuke ne, ‘Nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyele ɔ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa la awuke nu ɛne.’ Mɛla gyɛne gyɛne bie mɔ

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: “Saa mrenya nwiɔ ɛlɛko, na ko aye ba kɛ ɔbalie ɔ hu yeavi mɔɔ ɛlɛbo ye la asa anu, na ɔsɔ ko ne mrenyanu a,

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmanyia ɛzuzudeɛ nwiɔ nwiɔ mɔɔ ko le kpole tɛla ko la wɔ bɛ azua nu anzɛɛ bɛ ahodoku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Bɛsuzu debie a bɛzuzu ye pɛpɛ. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛanyi bɛahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi menli mɔɔ le nzisi la. Amalɛkema ɛhunlɛ nwo mɛla

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: “Bɛhakye mɔɔ Amalɛkema vale yɛle bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛlɛba la.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: Bɛanzulo Nyamenle, bɛratetale yɛ adenle nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛwie fɛ na yɛ nwo ɛbɛlɛ yɛ la, na bɛhunle menli mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ manle bɛhale amozi la kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne maa bɛ nwo tɔ bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo, mɔɔ kpɔvolɛ biala ɛngyegye bɛ bieko la a, bɛhu Amalɛkema amuala; bɛmmagyakyi ko bɔbɔ na awie ava abɔ bɛ duma bieko wɔ ewiade ye anu. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi ɛhye fee.

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkɔtɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava amaa bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la azo,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: na bɛso ɛya a, bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛbalumua bɛanyia ye wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, bɛwula ye kɛndɛne nu bɛva bɛhɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ sɛlɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne wɔ ɔ sa nu la ɛkɛ ne na bɛha bɛhile ye kɛ, ‘Meka meado gua ɛnɛ kenle ye meahile Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne kɛ, akee medwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle yɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa yɛ la azo.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ ne balie kɛndɛne ne mɔɔ aleɛ ne wɔ nuhua la na yeava yeazie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Akee wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne, bɛbaha edwɛkɛ ɛhye: ‘Ɛnee egya le Arelamenli adendulɛnli, na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Yigyibiti. Bɛkɔ la ɛnee bɛ nwo anzo; na wɔ Yigyibiti ɛkɛ ne, akee bɛyɛle maanle mumua na bɛ nwo yɛle ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Na Yigyibitima sisile yɛ na bɛyɛle yɛ kpɔdekpɔde, na bɛmanle yɛyɛle akɛlɛ gyima.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Na yɛzunle yɛvɛlɛle yɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma dele yɛ ne na ɔnwunle yɛ ɛvɛlɛ, yɛ nyane, nee ɛsisilɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi yɛ la.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale tumi kpole nee nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ nwunlonwunlanle Yigyibitima,

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: na ɔyele yɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti ɔrale azɛlɛ ɛhye azo.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati meva me aleɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔva wɔmaa me la anu mɔɔ lumua la melɛbɛlɛ wɔ.’ “Akee ɛbazokoɛ wɔazie Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ na wɔazonle ye,

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: na ɛdawɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra, nee Livaema nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la bɛali fɛlɛko na bɛ nye alie wɔ ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ati.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ nsa biala bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye la, bɛbu nuhua bulu, bɛdu ɛkpɔ ko bɛmaa bɛva bɛmaa Livaema, nyɛvolɛ, nrisa, yɛɛ ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la, amaa bɛdabɛ bɛanyia bie bɛali bɛ ko ayi.

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbaha wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ, ‘Meye ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko nwuanzanwuanza ne mevi me awuke ye anu, na meva memaa Livaema ne, nyɛvolɛ, nrisa, nee ahunlanvolɛ, kɛmɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ la se la. Metɛbulule wɔ mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ la azo, yɛɛ me rɛle ɛtɛfile bɛ.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Nyane dole me la, meanli ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne bie. Evinli hanle me wɔ me nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu la, meangɔ nwolɛ meangɔnye bie, yɛɛ meanva bie meambɔ azu meammaa mɔwuamra. Medie Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne ane na meyɛ mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛle ɛmanle me la amuala.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ anwuma lɔ, wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne a, to ɛ nye aze ɛke na yila wɔ menli Yizilayɛma nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa yɛ la, kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛbɔle yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ azɛlɛ ne kye aleɛ la.’ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye menli

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Ɛnɛ kenle ye, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛmaa bɛ mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛli zolɛ. Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛva bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛli zolɛ.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ bɛha bɛdo gua kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a le bɛ Nyamenle a, na bɛbalua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu na bɛali ye mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, bɛadie ɔ ne.
