english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma noko ɛva ɛdo gua ɛnɛ kenle ye kɛ bɛle ɔdaye ye menli, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ɔbakpogya bɛ zo yeayɛ bɛ maanle kpole mɔɔ bo maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo a, na bɛali bɛ eni bɛaye bɛ ayɛlɛ. Bɛbayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɔdaye ye menli mɔɔ anwo te a, kɛmɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Bɛli mɛla ne mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ ɛnɛ la amuala azo.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Akee bɛzi azukponle wɔ ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛva awolɛ a bɛzi azukponle ne a; bɛmmafa bulalɛ biala bɛwula nu.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛva awolɛ mɔɔ bɛanva bulalɛ bɛanga ye la a bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne a, na bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ zolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Eza bɛbɔ anzonudwolɛ azu ne mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ na bɛli debie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛli fɛlɛko na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi nee Livaema mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma la zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Yizilayɛma, bɛyɛ ngungoonwu na bɛdie. Ɛnɛ kenle ye, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɔdaye ye menli a le bɛ.

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne ala, eza Mosisi hanle ɛhye hilele menli ne mɔ, ɔzele kɛ,

english_verse: Today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. Always obey them, and the Lord will make Israel the most famous and important nation on earth, and he will bless you in many ways.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a, nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na bɛanyia ye molozo.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ, yeayila bɛ azua mɔɔ bɛdede zolɛ nee bɛ egyinli mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ la.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ yeamaa bɛanyia mralɛ dɔɔnwo, bɛyɔba dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu, bɛ nyɛmoa bada, bɛ nlankɛ bazo, na bɛanyia mboane mralɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ, yeamaa bɛ ahɛndɛne ayiyi tetɛkɛɛ, na aleɛ ɛnrɛkpa bɛ azua nu ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ, wɔ bɛ ɛhɔlɛ nee bɛ ɛralɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛali kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ kɛdwazo bɛ nwo zo la anwo zo konim. Bɛ kpɔvolɛma bava bɛ nyunlu ara na bɛava bɛ nzi bɛahɔ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ sa anloa gyima zo na yeamaa bɛ kpɔda zo ayiyi, na yeamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ twetwe wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛfa amaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla zo na bɛdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava bɛ ayɛ ye menli mɔɔ anwo te a, kɛmɔ yeva yebɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la banwu kɛ bɛfa ye duma a bɛfɛlɛ bɛ a, na bɛazulo bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila bɛ yeamaa bɛakpazi, bɛawo mralɛ, bɛ nlankɛ ada, na bɛ egyinli nu ninyɛne ara dɔɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava yeamaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma babuke anwuma, yeamaa bɛ ezule wɔ ye ɛlobɔ nloa na yeayila bɛ sa anloa gyima yeamaa bɛanyia bie bɛabɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bosea, noko bɛmɛ, bɛnrɛbiza bosea ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo nɔhalɛ nu, bɛnea boɛ, bɛyɛ bɛ muala a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛali maanle maanle ti dahuu, bɛnrɛha amozi ɛlɛ, na dahuu bɛ nyunlu akpogya yɛɛ bɛnrɛkpo aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Bɛ avunli bayɛ anwomanyunlu nloma aleɛ na ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole ali bɛ nwonane, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛvoa bɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ munzule sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee azibɛnwo debie yeala bɛ nwo zo nee bɛ bo zo amra anwo zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: “Na saa bɛandie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane anzɛɛ bɛanli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo nɔhalɛ nu a, yemɔ munzule ɛhye mɔ amuala bava bɛ aze yeabulu bɛ nwo zo:

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Munzule bayiyi bɛ ahɛndɛne ne mɔ na ɛhɔne ara bɛ azua nu.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: “Munzule baha bɛ mɔɔ ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛnyia mralɛ dɔɔnwo, bɛ egyinli ɛnrɛhye, yɛɛ bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ mboane ɛnrɛda.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Munzule bali bɛ nzi wɔ bɛ ɛhɔlɛ nee bɛ ɛralɛ nu.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa munzule ado bɛ, bɛ nye zo ada bɛ, bɛ agbɔkɛ nu atuto wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, kɔdwu kɛ bɛkɛzɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ na bɛ bo zo kɛminli ndɛndɛ, wɔ bɛ munzule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa munlutu adɔ kɛ ezule toonwo kɔkpula kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛwie wu la.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ali bɛ nwo zo konim. Bɛbava bɛ nyunlu bɛahɔ na bɛava bɛ nzi bɛara. Na ɔbayɛ ewiade amra amuala nwanwane kɛ ɛhye ɛzi bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa nyila ne mɔ mɔɔ nwunwunle Yigyibitima la bie anwunwu bɛ. Bɛ nwo bayɛ nganlɛ, na bɛ nwo agua asa ayɛ nzabenle, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhola bɛ nwo ayile yɛ ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛ adwenle aha abɔ nu, bɛ nye azi, na bɛabɔ ɛlane.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Bɛbali nvuovua ewia henlema kɛ anyenzinliravolɛ fuovua awozinli nu la, yɛɛ bɛnrɛkpazi ɛlɛ. Awie mɔ ala a basisi bɛ awua bɛ dahuu a, noko bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛboa bɛ.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: “Bɛbayia raalɛ, na awie gyɛne a nee ye bala a; bɛbazi sua, na bɛnrɛla nuhua ɛlɛ; bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli, na bɛnrɛli ye ma ne bie.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Bɛbahu bɛ nlankɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, na bɛnrɛnyia bie bɛnrɛli. Bɛbaza bɛ bɛalie bɛ asoaso ne mɔ wɔ bɛ sa nu, bɛnrɛva bie bɛnrɛzie bɛ bo zo. Bɛbava bɛ mboane bɛamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma, awie ɛnrɛboa bɛ.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ nye zo, bɛbadɔne bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛamaa awie mɔ gyɛne, noko bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛlie bɛ. Bɛ nwo balɔ bɛ, na bɛ nye aha adenle zo, na bɛnrɛnwu bɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Maanle bie mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ye nganeɛ ɛlɛ la anu amra barali bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu aleɛ, na bɛbasisi bɛ bɛayɛ bɛ amumuyɛ dahuu,

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: mɔɔ bɛannea bɔbɔ a mɔɔ bɛbanwu ye la bamaa bɛabɔ ɛlane a.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa nyila anwunwu bɛ gyakɛ agbɔkɛ nee bɛ gyakɛ agbɔma ne mɔ anwo, ɔvi bɛ gyakɛ akunlu toonwo yeahɔdwu bɛ ti zo, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhola bɛ ayile yɛ ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛava bɛ nee bɛ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛbazie la bɛahɔ maanle bie mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ bɔbɔ ɛnze nu na yeayɛ bɛdabɛ la anu, na bɛazonle awozonle mɔɔ bɛva mbaka nee awolɛ bɛze la.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Na ɔbayɛ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ bahɔ nu la anu amra azibɛnwo, na yeayɛ ɛrɛlɛ nee ɛfenle wɔ menli nloa.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: “Bɛbalua ma dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛ ɛya nu, noko bɛ bɛyɔba bayɛ ekyi bie, ɔluakɛ mbɛbɛ bali bɛ muala.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli, noko bɛnrɛnyia zolɛ ma ne bie na yeayɛ nuhua nwanye, ɔluakɛ nvuba bali bɛ muala.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Bɛbanyia ɔlivi mbaka wɔ bɛ maanle ne kɔsɔɔti anu yeayia, noko bɛnrɛnyia nuhua nwole bɛnrɛkpokpa, ɔluakɛ bɛ ɔlivi ma ne bakpolo agua.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Bɛbawo mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ, noko bɛnrɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye bɛ nuokɛ.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Mbɛbɛ bali bɛ mbaka nee bɛ egyinli nu aleɛ muala.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: “Ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ maanle ne anu la bavo adɛnla bɛ kɔme zo na bɛmɛ bɛ tumi ne abɔ aze bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti bara bɛ nwo zo, adu bɛ mgbaliko na bɛabu bɛava bɛ nwo zo, kɔkpula kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛwie wu la, ɔboalekɛ bɛanli Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ yeva yemaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: Yemɔti, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛmaa ninyɛne ɛbu bɛ nwo zo la, saa bɛanva fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ bɛanzonle ye a,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: ɔbamaa bɛazonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛaraho ava bɛ la. Ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne bahu bɛ; bɛbalɛ bɛ nwo zɔ na bɛahyia ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti anwo. Ɛdɛnkɛma bava kpomgbolo kpole akpolo bɛ, kɔkpula kɛ bɛ bo zo kɛbɔ la.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa maanle vi moa moa adwazo bɛ nwo zo. Maanle zɔhane anu amra anwo yɛ ndɛ kɛ kɔleɛ. Bɛvi ewiade awieleɛ lɔ, yɛɛ bɛnde bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Bɛle maanle mɔɔ bɛ ti yɛ se, bɛmbu kpanyinli yɛɛ bɛnze kakula anwunvɔne.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Bɛbava konle bɛadoa bɛ wɔ bɛ azua mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la azo, na bɛ bane ndendenle nee aranemgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ ti zua bɛ la bagologolo agua.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma kɛva bɛ ɛlɔnema kɛrabɛnra kɛyia bɛ la, ɛhɔne bamaa bɛ nye zo ada bɛ na bɛado bɛ kunlu mralɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la bɛali.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nyane nee abodelɛ bamaa yeahu ɔ ra mɔɔ yewo ye fofolɛ la, na yeado ye nee ye anziama ne amuala yeali wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlɔnema kɛrabɛnra kɛyia bɛ sua ne la.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: “Saa bɛannea boɛ bɛanli edwɛkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ɛhye mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la azo nɔhalɛ nu, bɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne duma nwuanzanwuanza kpole ne a,

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Eza ɔbamaa ewule ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛangɛlɛ bɛ wɔ mɛla buluku ɛhye anu la aha bɛ, kɔkpula kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛwie wu, bɛ bo zo kɛbɔ la.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, bɛ nwo zonle kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra, noko saa bɛandie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane a, bɛ nwo baha ekyi.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Na kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zile liele bɛ nwo mɔɔ yemaa bɛ nwo ɛzo zɛhae la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbayɛ yeava munzule yeara bɛ nwo zo, na yeazɛkye bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo a.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma babɔ bɛ asande na bɛakponde bɛahɔ maanle ti nee maanle bo bɛahɔzonle awolɛ nee mbaka awozonle mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ nlenya mɔ bɛtɛsonlenle bie ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Ɔdwu nwonlomɔ a bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Me kunlu a anrɛɛ aleɛ ɛdwo,’ yɛɛ ɔdwu nɔsolɛ a bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Me kunlu a anrɛɛ aleɛ ɛhye.’ Bɛ ahonle badu wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛbanwu ye la anwo.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bawula bɛ meli nu ɔ nee bɛ ahɔ Yigyibiti bieko, na bɛadu adenle ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛnrɛdu ye bieko ɛlɛ la. Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛbadɔne bɛ nwo kɛ ahanra mraalɛ nee mrenya bɛamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma, noko bɔbɔ, awie ɛnrɛdɔ bɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Mosisi nee Yizilayɛma yɛle la anu la ɛne: Bɛyɛle ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye wɔ Mowabe azɛlɛ zo, yɛɛ asolo mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ yɛle wɔ Saenae Boka la.

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Bɛnwunle amaneɛ mgbole dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale bɛ nwo zo nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɔyɛle la amuala.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛradwule ɛke la, Hɛhyebɔn Belemgbunli Saehɔn nee Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo rale kɛ bɛ nee yɛ baho, na yɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Yɛvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne, na yɛhyɛle yɛmanle Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne, Gaade abusua ekpunli ne, nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne anu amra.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛnlea edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anu la boɛ na bɛli zolɛ, amaa bɛakpazi wɔ debie biala anu.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛ ayahanlɛ la, bɛ awolɛ nee mbaka awozonle ne mɔ, nee bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke awozonle ne mɔ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie, raalɛ o, nrenya o, mbusua ekpulike anzɛɛ abusua ekpunli, andwe ɔ nwo anvi Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anwo angɔnzonle maanle zɔhane mɔ awozonle ne mɔ. Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie anyɛ ɔ nwo ndinli ɛtane mɔɔ fifi so ma ɛnwonle mɔɔ ku sonla la.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea na bɛ bie anva andu ɔ nwo kɛ, kɛmɔ yede ngyekyeleɛ ne anu edwɛkɛ la ati saa ɔyɛ anzosesebɛ a, ɔbava ɔ nwo dwɔɔ. Ɛhye ka awie biala, kpalɛ o, anzɛɛ ɛtane o.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma baye ɔ ngomekye yeavi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ avinli kɛ yebɔ munzule, kɛmɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne anu munzule ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ mɛla buluku ne anu la de la.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: “Mekɛ bie bara, na bɛ bo zo amra mɔɔ bara amozi la, nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ vi maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa la anu la bara aranwu munzule nee ewule mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale dole azɛlɛ ye azo la.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Bɛbanwu kɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛhwie, ɛhwee ɛnfifi zolɛ, bɛnlua debie zolɛ, ndile ɛnfifi zolɛ, zolɛ le sɔlefe nee ngyenle ngome, na yeyɛ kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla, Ademaa nee Zɛbɔyem mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya zɛkyele bɛ la.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Akee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti babiza kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ azɛlɛ ye zɛhae ɛ? Ɛya kpole ɛhye abo a le duzu?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Na menli baye ɔ nloa kɛ, ‘Ɔboalekɛ menli ne kpole Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yɛle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti radwule ɛke la,

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: na bɛhɔzonlenle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle awozonle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ, yɛɛ yeanze bɛ kɛ bɛzonle bɛ la.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma eza vale ɛya dule bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo na ɔmanle bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔle maanle gyɛne nu, kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔde la.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: “Ninyɛne mɔɔ vea la le Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdeɛ; na mɔɔ bɛye bɛhile la le yɛ nee yɛ mra ɛdeɛ dahuu, amaa yɛayɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne kpondɛ la amuala.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Kɛkala, meva ninyɛne nwiɔ a mezie bɛ nyunlu a, nyilalɛ yɛɛ munzule. Saa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ sisi bɛ nwo zo na Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne maa bɛkponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ azo a, bɛhakye mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la.

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: Bɛzia bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, bɛdabɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra amuala, na bɛva bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛdie ɔ ne, kɛmɔ meze bɛ ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee bɛ menli ne mɔɔ bɛmbu bɛ bie la wɔ moa bɔbɔ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne baboɔboa bɛ nloa na ɔ nee bɛ vi lɔ ara.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne nee bɛ bara azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ dɛnlanle zolɛ la azo, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛadɛnla zolɛ na yeamaa bɛakpazi, bɛ nwo azo dɔɔnwo adɛla bɛ ze mɔ.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bade bɛ ahonle nu, na yeade bɛ bo zo amra ahonle nu, amaa bɛava bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛahulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na bɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bava munzule ne ahɔgua bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔɔ yɛle bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la anwo zo.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Bɛbadie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane bieko na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ ɛnɛ la azo.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bamaa bɛakpazi wɔ gyima biala anu, bɛawo mralɛ dɔɔnwo, bɛ nlankɛ azo na bɛ egyinli ahye. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye balie bɛ nwo bieko kɛ bɛkɛkpazi, kɛmɔ ɔ nye liele bɛ ze mɔ anwo la.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Noko ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane, na bɛdi ye mɛla nee ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Mɛla Buluku ɛhye anu la, na bɛfa bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛsia bɛba Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: “Mɛla ɛhye mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa bɛ ɛnɛ la ɛnyɛ se, yɛɛ ɔmbo bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ɔnle anwuma yɛɛ bɛkava a na bɛaha kɛ, ‘Nwane a fo ahɔ ahɔva ara, amaa yeadie bie na yeali zolɛ a?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ ɔnle nyevile nzi na bɛaha kɛ, ‘Nwane a pɛ nyevile ye ahɔ ɔ nzi lɔ ahɔva ara, amaa yɛadie bie na yɛali zolɛ a?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, edwɛkɛ ne nee bɛ a wɔ ɛke a. Ɔwɔ bɛ ahonle nu yɛɛ ɔdua bɛ nloa. Yemɔti bɛkola bɛdi zolɛ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, ɛnɛ meva ngoane nee saleɛ, yɛɛ munzule nee ewule mezie bɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Mefɛlɛ anwuma nee aze kɛ bɛrali me nee bɛ daselɛ kɛ ɛnɛ demua ye, meva ngoane nee ewule, yɛɛ saleɛ nee munzule mezie bɛ nyunlu. Zɔhane ati bɛva ngoane, amaa bɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra bɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Bɛhulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛdie ɔ ne na bɛdudu bɛhisa ye, ɔluakɛ saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔle ngoane ɔmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛbanyi bɛahyɛ, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle bɛ ze mɔ, Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava yeamaa bɛ la azo.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Mosisi hɔle zolɛ dendɛle hilele Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Bɛgyinla kpundii na bɛmia bɛ nwo. Bɛmmasulo yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ nwo mɔra tu. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ a. Ɔnrɛgyakyi bɛ yɛɛ ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛye bɛ ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vɛlɛle Dwɔhyua na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele ye wɔ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anyunlu kɛ, “Mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ. Mia ɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛ nee menli ɛhye mɔ bahɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛbɔ bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo na bɛahɔva a.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a bali ɛ nyunlu nee wɔ ahɔ a. Ɔ nee wɔ balua. Ɔnrɛgyakyi wɔ yɛɛ ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ. Mmasulo yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ.” Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkenga mɛla ne ɛvolɛ nsuu biala

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi hɛlɛle mɛla ɛhye na ɔvale ɔmanle Livae abo zo amra ne mɔ mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma, mɔɔ zoale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la, nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛ mra mɔɔ ɛnze la ade na bɛazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, wɔ mekɛ tendenle biala mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛpɛ Dwɔdan ne bɛahɔva la azo la.” Ɛdɛnkɛma folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Mosisi la

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Mekɛ asɛɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɔ wɔ ɛkɛla nzi a. Fɛlɛ Dwɔhyua na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na menva ye gyima menwula ɔ sa nu.” Na Mosisi nee Dwɔhyua hɔle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma rale Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔyɛle amungu mpila ɔgyinlanle anlenkɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ, “Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na wɔahɔ wɔ ɛkɛla nzi. Na menli ɛhye mɔ babɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, bɛakpo me na bɛazonle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkadɛnla zolɛ la azo awozonle ne mɔ. Bɛ rɛle bavi me na bɛatulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛyɛ la.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu, mebava bɛ nwo ɛya na meamaa bɛazɛkye bɛ. Munzule dɔɔnwo basisi bɛ nwo zo na bɛanwu amaneɛ. Na ɔdwu zo a akee bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛzi yɛ nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛnle yɛ avinli.’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Amgba noko, bɛ ninyɛndane ti, ɔvi kenle zɔhane mebaye me nye meado ɛbɔ nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛgyakyi me bɛlɛsonle awozonle.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, kɛlɛ edwɛne ɛhye na kile Yizilayɛma. Maa bɛdo ye dahuu bɛmaa ɔkokoa bɛ nloa anu, amaa yeayɛ daselɛ wɔ me nee bɛ yɛ avinli.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa mefa bɛ medwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ mɔɔ menvale membɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo, na bɛdi bɛ ko yi, bɛyɛ mbelane a, bɛbahakyi bɛabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛamaa awozonle na bɛazonle bɛ. Bɛbakpo me na bɛatulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Na saa edwɛkɛ to bɛ na munzule si bɛ nwo zo a, edwɛne ɛhye bara bɛ ti anu yeamaa bɛ ti anu aze bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ bo zo amra bɔbɔ arɛle ɛnrɛvi edwɛne ɛhye. Bɛbahakye ye dahuu. Bɛtɛdwule azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ meva mebɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la azo bɔbɔ, noko meze mɔɔ kɛkala angome bɛlɛdwenle debie mɔɔ bɛdwu a bɛbayɛ la anwo.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Mosisi hɛlɛle edwɛne ne na ɔhilele Yizilayɛma amuala.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua gyima ne wulale ɔ sa nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Mia ɛ nwo na gyinla kpundii, ɔluakɛ ɛbava Yizilayɛma wɔadwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ la azo. Me nee wɔ balua.”

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Mosisi hɛlɛle Nyamenle Mɛla ne amuala wulale buluku nu; ɔdɔle ɔ rɛle aze ɔhɛlɛle, amaa bie anga nuhua.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi zele Livaema ne mɔɔ soa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la kɛ,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Bɛlie mɛla buluku ɛhye bɛdo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anu foa ko, amaa yeala ɛkɛ ne yeali daselɛ yeatia bɛ.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ bɛngyɛ na bɛade atua. Mɔɔ medame mumua ne mede aze la, medame me nye zo, bɛdele Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo atua, na akee mɔɔ menwɔwu la!

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Bɛboɔboa mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mgbanyinli ne mɔ, nee bɛ mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli ne mɔ anloa bɛmaa bɛrɛla bɛmaa menga edwɛkɛ mengile bɛ, na menvɛlɛ anwuma nee aze memaa bɛli yɛ daselɛ.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ mewu a bɛbade atua na bɛahwe bɛ nwo bɛavi adenle ne mɔɔ mese bɛlua zolɛ la azo. Mekɛ zɔhane anu, kɛmɔ bɛbayɛ ɛtane bɛatia Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛava bɛ sa anloa gyima bɛaha ye ɛya la ati, munzule bazi bɛ nwo zo.” Mosisi edwɛne ne

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: “Anwuma amra, bɛdie na metendɛ, Aze amra, bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Me ngilehilelɛ badɔ kɛ ezule, me ɛdendɛlɛ bavie kɛ ɛbɔlɛ. Me ɛdendɛlɛ bayɛ kɛ nyenyensuo mɔɔ gugua ndile zo, ɔbayɛ kɛ kyɛngyɛne mɔɔ gua doɔloa ɛbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mebabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne nolo, meahile yɛ Nyamenle ne ye bedevinli ne!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: “Bodane ne, ye gyima di munli, ɔluakɛ ɔdi pɛlepɛle. Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ, ɔnle amumuyɛ, ɔdi pɛlepɛle, ye edwɛkɛ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa ye, bɛnle ɔ mra ko, ɔboalekɛ bɛ nwo lɛ dɛne; bɛle awolɛndoazo ɛtane, anzosesebɛma.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ menli ahɔnwɔne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle a, asoo bɛ mo mɔɔ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛne. Asoo tɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔle bɛ ze, mɔɔ bɔle bɛ, na ɔyɛle bɛ maanle la?

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: “Bɛhakye dɛba, bɛdwenle mɔmoane mɔmoane; bɛbiza bɛ ze mɔ, na bɛkɛha bɛkɛhile bɛ; bɛbiza bɛ mgbanyinli, na bɛkɛze bɛ.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Anwuma Anwumanli ne manle maanle biala agyadeɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkpakyekpakyele menli avinli la, ɔnleanle Yizilayɛma ne dodo na ɔgyigyale menli ne ɛweɛne.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔ ɛdeɛ a le ye menli ne, Gyekɔbo a le ye afoa nu agyadeɛ a.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: “Ɔnwunle ye wɔ ɛsɛlɛ zo, wɔ fienemgbole nu anwoma nu. Ɔbɔle ɔ nwo bane, ɔlile ye adane, na ɔdule ɔ nye ko ɔdole ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Kɛ kɔleɛ si kpusu ɔ nwo wɔ ye sane nu wozowozo ɔ ndɛba anu ɔ mra nwo zo, kɛ ɔkile ɔ mra ɛdulɛ, ɔsɔ bɛ wɔ ɔ ndɛba ne mɔ azo la,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma angome a hilele ye adenle a, nyamenle gyɛne biala amboka ɔ nwo.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: “Ɔmanle ɔluoluale azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka mgbole mgbole, na ɔlile kpɔkɛ nu aleɛ; ɔmanle ɔnlonle bodane nu wolɛ, na ɔnlonle ɛtwɛlɛboɔ nu nwole.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ɔlile kyiisi na ɔnlonle nlankɛ nyɛfonzule, ɔlile Beehyan nlankɛ, mboane, nee mbɔnkye mɔɔ ɛlɔ, ɔlile hwiiti kpalɛ na ɔnlonle nwanye kpalɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: “Nyamenle menli ne hyenle yɛle kpukpotoloo, bɛyɛle mgbole mbelane tutoboo, bɛkpole bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle bɛ la, na bɛkpole bɛ Ngoanelielɛ Bodane ne.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Bɛvale awozonlezonlenlɛ bɛhanle ye ɛya; bɛyɛle bɛkyi ninyɛne bɛmanle ɔvale ɛya.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle mmonle mɔɔ ɛnle nyamenle, awozonle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ, nyamenle fofolɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ ɛvinde, mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ ɛnze bɛ.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Bɛandwenle Bodane ne mɔɔ bɔle bɛ la anwo, bɛ rɛle vile Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wole bɛ la.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle ye na ɔkpole bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ hanle ye ɛya.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele kɛ, ‘Meye me nye meado ɛbɔ nu, na meanlea kɛ bɛ awieleɛ kɛzi kɛwie bɛ la. Ɔluakɛ bɛle awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛzɛkye a, menli mɔɔ nɔhalɛ ɛnle bɛ nu.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Bɛva debie mɔɔ ɛnle nyamenle la bɛha me ɛya, bɛva bɛ mmonle bɛfutu me ahonle. Yemɔti medame mebava menli mɔɔ ɛndo ɛhwee la meaha bɛ ɛya; mebava maanle kɔnwɔne bie meaha bɛ ɛya.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me ɛya sɔ kɛ senle, ɔsɔ toonwo ɔdwu ɛbolɔ. Ɔyela azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ debie biala, na ɔmaa awoka ne mɔ adiabo yela.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mebamaa munzule mgbole ado bɛ; mebatoto me nyane ɛda ne meawowɔ bɛ.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne bazɛkye bɛ muala, ewia samɛnlakɛ nee ewulenzane bayela bɛ wee. Mebamaa nanemgbole ahye bɛ ali, na nwɔlɛ akeka bɛ ahu bɛ.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Bɛbadɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ konle nu, bɛbanwu ɛzulolɛ bɛ sua kunlu. Bɛbahu mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, yɛɛ ngakula mɔɔ no nyɛfonlɛ nee mrelera.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ menwɔha kɛ: Mebabɔ bɛ asande, meagua bɛ moa, na meamaa menli arɛle avi bɛ.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Noko mesulo ɔ nzi kɛ kpɔvolɛ ne kɛha me ɛya, anrɛɛ mɔɔ kyi bɛ la ɛnrɛde ɔ bo, na bɛkɛha kɛ yɛli konim, na tɛ mame Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ meyɛ a.’

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma le menli mɔɔ ɛnde folɛ, bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo fee.

english_verse: If you did, you could see where you are headed.
translation_verse: Saa bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a anrɛɛ bɛkɛde ɛhye abo, anrɛɛ bɛbanwu mɔɔ nzinlii bazi bɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na baholɛ avoa apenle, na menli nwiɔ aha apenle bulu agua ɛbɔ nu ɛ? Kyesɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Bodane ne ɛdɔne bɛ ɛmaa, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye bɛ ɛmaa.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ bodane ne ɛnle kɛ yɛ Bodane ne, yɛ kpɔvolɛma bɔbɔ ze ɛhye sie.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ vanye ne vi Sodɔm, yɛɛ Gomɔla vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu, Bɛ ma ne mɔ le pɔezen, bɛ vanye aziakɛ yɛ ɛnwonle.

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwanye ku kɛ nwɔlɛ bɔlɔ, ɔ nloa yɛ se kɛ bɔna bɔlɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: “Meva ɛhye mɔ amuala mezie, meheda zo wɔ me gya ne mɔ anu, na me rɛle ɛnrɛvi ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ gyakɛ kɛhoati la, medame a mebali nzenralɛ na meadua kakɛ a. Bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ ɛdwu, na bɛ awieleɛ ɛbikye.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma balie ye menli ne ati, na yeanwu ye ngɛkɛlɛ anwunvɔne, saa ɔnwu kɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie, na alehelɛ nee ahanra muala ɛlɛminli a.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Akee ɔbaha kɛ: Na bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ, bodane ne mɔɔ bɛhɔveale ɔ bo,

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: mɔɔ lile bɛ azubɔdeɛ mgbole ne mɔ, nlonle bɛ nwanye azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ la wɔ ni? Bɛmaa bɛdwazo bɛboa bɛ ɛ! Bɛmaa bɛlie bɛ ti ɛ!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: “Kɛkala, bɛnwu ye kɛ medame ala a mele Nyamenle a, nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ me ngome. Medame a meku, memaa ngoane a, meboda eza meyɛ ayile a. Awie ɛngola ɛnlie debie wɔ me sa nu.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛmɔ mele Tease Nyamenle la, memaa me sa zo anwuma meka ndane kɛ,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: saa mesi me konle dadeɛ memeamemea ne, na mese kɛ mebua ndɛne a, mebali me kpɔvolɛma ne nzenralɛ, na meadua menli mɔɔ kpɔ me la kakɛ.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Me ɛda mbaka babia mogya, na me dadeɛ ali nwonane, menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ, menrɛvavi bie, mebahu me kpɔvolɛma ne amuala.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: “Maanle maanle, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne ayɛlɛ; ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di ye sonvolɛma ati, ɔsenra ye kpɔvolɛma amuala, na ɔkpɔda ɔ nwo wɔ ye menli ne ati.”

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi wiele edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ka kile Yizilayɛma la,

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva mɛla mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ ɛnɛ la amuala bɛzie bɛ ahonle nu na bɛli zolɛ, amaa bɛaha bɛahile bɛ mra, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛali zolɛ.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Ɔnle nwɔwe edwɛkɛ; ɔle bɛ ngoane. Bɛdi zolɛ a bɛbanyi bɛahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ la azo.”

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Kɔ Abalem awoka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Mowabe azɛlɛ zo la azo, na fo Nibo Boka ne mɔɔ nee Gyɛleko bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ la na to ɛ nye nea Keena azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛva la.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Wu boka ne mɔɔ ɛbavo zolɛ la azo, na kɔ wɔ ɛkɛla nzi, kɛmɔ ɛ diema Aalɔn wule Hɔɔ Boka ne azo na ɔhɔle ye ɛkɛla nzi la.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me wɔ Yizilayɛma anyunlu wɔ Mɛleba, mɔɔ zua Keedɛhye nzule ne mɔ anloa wɔ Zen fienemgbole ne anu la. Ɔboalekɛ bɛanli me eni bɛanzonle me kɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza bɛangile Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Ɛbanwu azɛlɛ ne kɛ ɔla ɛ nyunlu lɔ, na ɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa Yizilayɛma la azo.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle sonla Mosisi zɛlɛle manle Yizilayɛma kolaa na yeawu la ɛne:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vi Saenae Boka rale, ɔdudule yɛ nwo zo wɔ Yidɔm kɛ sɛnzɛne. Ɔdale ɔvi Pɛlan Boka ɔguale yɛ nwo zo, ɔ nee nwuanzanwuanzama apenle bulu a lua a, ɔlɛ senle hulenyihulenyi ɔ sa fema nu.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, ɔhulole ye menli ne, ɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa ye la anwo bane. Ɛhye ati bɛdoale ɛ bo zo, bɛtie bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛze bɛ la.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Mosisi manle yɛ mɛla kɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra agyadeɛ.

english_verse: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli, nee mbusua mgbanyinli yiale nu la.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle wɔ Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne anwo kɛ, “Maa Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne ɛnyi, ɔmmabɔ, na maa nuhua menli ne anwo ɛzo.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anwo la ɛne: “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie Dwudama ane, na maa bɛ nee mbusua ekpunli mɔɔ ɛha la ɛli ahua. Ɛdawɔ die bɛ konle ko maa bɛ, na boa bɛ wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu.”

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ Livae abusua ekpunli ne anwo la ɛne: “Ɛdɛnkɛma, dua Livaema ye anwo zo maa bɛva Yulem nee Tɛmem bɛye wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ bɛhile. Ɛzɔle bɛ ɛnleanle wɔ Masa na ɛnwunle bɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ wɔ Mɛleba nzule nloa.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Bɛkpole bɛ ze mɔ nee bɛ nli mɔ, bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛnze bɛ; bɛkpole mediema nee mralɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛlile wɔ mɛla zo, na bɛlile wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne azo.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Bɛbahilehile Gyekɔbo abo zo amra wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ; bɛahilehile Yizilayɛma wɔ mɛla ne mɔ; bɛbakpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛamaa wɔ, bɛayela nane mumua bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa wɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yila bɛ abusua ekpunli ne; na maa bɛ gyima ɛzɔ ɛ nye. Sɛkye bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ kyi bɛ la, sɛkye bɛ mɔɔ bɛndwazo ko ɛlɛ a.”

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye wɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anwo; “Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo abusua ekpunli ɛhye anu amra, ɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane, ɔsinza bɛ alehyenlɛ biala, na ɔde bɛ avinli.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Wɔ Dwosefi abusua ekpunli ne anwo, ɔzele kɛ: “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdɔ ɛbɔlɛ kpalɛ ɛgua bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, na ɔmaa azɛlɛ ɛkpu nzule ɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ewia ɛvi ɛbolo bɛ bɛyɔba, ɔmaa bɛ nzoleɛ kpalɛ wɔ ɛbuhenle nloa.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛ tete awoka ne mɔ ɛhye aleɛ, na aleɛ ɛbu awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye aleɛ, na ɔzɔ mɔɔ dendɛle kpɔkɛ ne anu senle ne anu la anye. Nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛyɛ Dwosefi abusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a ɔlile ɔ mediema ne mɔ ati a.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Dwosefi anwosesebɛ le kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli, ye mɛne ɛsesebɛ le kɛ ɛnlankɛ kokonyinli. Ye mɛne le Manasɛ ɛdeɛ apenle, ɔle Yifelaem ɛdeɛ apenle bulu. Ɔfa ɔpia maanle maanle ne mɔ, ɔpia bɛ toonwo ɔkɔ ewiade ati nee ɔ bo.”

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Bɛbavɛlɛ menli wɔ bɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛabɔ azu mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la. Ɔluakɛ bɛnyia bɛ anwonyia wɔ nyevile nu, bɛnyia bɛ mgbɔba wɔ anwea nu.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ Gaade abusua ekpunli ne anwo la ɛne: “Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ ɔmanle bɛ azɛlɛ ne dɛlɛle a, Gaade kɔ nzia kɛ awenade, ɔto a ɔtu ɛsalɛ, ɔkpuke amelɛ.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Bɛnleanle nu bɛvale azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ɔle safohyenle kyɛfoa; ɔrale abusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma lile Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ azo.”

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Wɔ Dan abusua ekpunli ne anwo, ɔhanle kɛ, “Dan le awenade ralɛ, mɔɔ vi Beehyan wulu ba a.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Wɔ Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne anwo, ɔhanle kɛ, “O Nafetalae, wɔzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ dɔɔnwo. Fa azɛlɛ ne fi Galeli Tandane ne anloa, kɔdwu nyiakɛ nehane.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Ahya abusua ekpunli ne anwo noko, ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛyila Ahya abusua ekpunli ne bɛdɛla abusua ekpunli biala. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛhulo ye, na nwole ɛbu ye azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Bɛbava mbulalɛ nee kɔbele bɛagua bɛ azuamgbole nlenkɛ nzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛnyi bɛhyɛ na bɛde kpɔkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, nyamenle bie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ dua ye belemgbunlililɛ nu vi anwuma baboa ye menli a.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne anwo ɛkɛ a le bɛ tɛnlabelɛ a; bɛvea ɔ sa abo a, bɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo, ɔka bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɔgua ɔmaa bɛ, na yeaze bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhu bɛ.”

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle anzonudwolɛ nu, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ye angome, dɛnlanle azɛlɛ mɔɔ abɛlɛ nee nza ɛbu zolɛ la azo; ɛbɔlɛ ɛmkpa azɛlɛ ne azo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛ! Nwane mɔ bɔbɔ a le kɛ bɛdabɛ a? Bɛmɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie bɛ, yebɔ bɛ nwo bane, na ɔle bɛ dadeɛ bɛfa bɛdi konim a. Bɛ kpɔvolɛma badu agua bɛ nyunlu, na bɛatietia bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Akee Mosisi vi Mowabe ɛsɛlɛ ne anu hɔle Nibo Boka, ɔhɔvole ɔhɔle Pesega boka ne mɔɔ nee Gyɛleko anye bɔ zolɛ la azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele ye azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti, ɔvi Geleade mɔɔ kɔdwu Dan la, Nafetalae amuala,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Yifelaem nee Manasɛ azɛlɛ ne, Dwuda azɛlɛ ne amuala toonwo mɔɔ kɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Dwuda nyiakɛ, yɛɛ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ vi Zowaa kɔdwu Gyɛleko, mrɛlɛ suakpole ne azo la amuala.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebava meamaa bɛ bo zo amra la ɛne. Memaa ɛ nye nwiɔ anwu ye, noko ɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia zolɛ.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi wule Mowabe azɛlɛ zo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ziele ye wɔ bɔnza ne mɔɔ wɔ Mowabe azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ nee Bɛtepiyɔ anye bɔ zolɛ la anu. Na toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la, awie biala ɛtɛnwunle ye nla ne.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma zunle ye wɔ Mowabe fienemgbole ne anu kenle abulasa.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Akee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua nrɛlɛbɛ ne yɛle kpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Mosisi ɛva ɔ sa ɛgua ɔ ti zo. Yemɔti Yizilayɛma diele ye na bɛlile mɛla mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Mosisi la azo.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Na sumunli kɛ de la Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛtɛfindele Yizilayɛ mɔɔ le kɛ Mosisi, mɔɔ ɛnwu Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: Bie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa ye ɛmaa yeyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, kɛmɔ Mosisi yɛle wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo hilele Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne, ye azɛlɛ, nee ye menli ne la.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛtɛfindele mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa yeyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ mgbole ɛhile Yizilayɛma ɛdɛla mɔɔ Mosisi yɛle la a.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi wule la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua mɔɔ le Mosisi boavolɛ la kɛ,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Me sonvolɛ Mosisi ɛwu. Zɔhane ati boɔboa ɛ nwo na ɛ nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔpɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛhɔ ɔ nzi lɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa bɛ la azo.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menganle mengilele Mosisi la, meva azɛlɛ biala mɔɔ ɛ gyakɛ kɛtia zolɛ la memaa wɔ.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa lɔ bakpula Lɛbanɔn ɛke, toonwo mɔɔ kɔ azule kpole Yufileti ne anloa, ɔlua Hɛtema maanle ne anu kɔkpula Nyevile Kpole ne anloa wɔ sɛnzɛne adɔleɛ lɔ la, meva memaa wɔ.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛli ɛ nwo zo konim wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛde aze la. Me nee wɔ balua, kɛmɔ me nee Mosisi luale la. Menrɛye ɛ rɛle menrɛdo ɛ sa nu yɛɛ menrɛkpo wɔ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Maa ɔyɛ wɔ gyima kɛ ɛkɛgenga Mɛla buluku ne dahuu wɔ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ mekɛ biala anu. Dwenledwenle Mɛla ne anwo nɔɔzo nee ewiazo, na di mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye nuhua la amuala azo. Ɛhye bamaa wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne adenrɛ.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Kakye kɛ meze wɔ kɛ ɛgyinla kpundii. Mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ nwo bubu wɔ, ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne, me nee wɔ lua ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɔ la.” Dwɔhyua maa menli ne ahɔ

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua zele ye mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Bɛhɔ menli ne mɔ anu na bɛze bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛkpondɛ aleɛ na bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnɛ anwo zo kenle nsa bɛbahɔpɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɛahɔ ɔ nzi lɔ na bɛahɔva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Na Dwɔhyua zele Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli ne anu foa ko ne anu amra kɛ,

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mra yɛɛ bɛ nlankɛ ne mɔ baha ɛke wɔ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ Mosisi ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la azo, na bɛ ɛlɔnema ne mɔ mɔɔ kola ko la apɛ azule ne ahɔboa bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma wɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ,

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛva Dwɔdan adɔleɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la, na akee bɛazia bɛaradɛnla bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi vale manle bɛ wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ ɛke la azo.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Menli ne buale Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛbayɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔha wɔhile yɛ la, yɛɛ yɛbahɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɛze yɛ kɛ yɛhɔ la.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdu ɛ nloa kɛdo na ɔkɛhakyi ɔ nzi ɔkɛzi wɔ, na yeanli mɔɔ ɛkɛha la azo la, yɛbahu ye. Wɔmɔ gyinla kpundii na si pi.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Akee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua zoanle menli nwiɔ awozinli nu, vi Akasea azokoɛleɛ ne kɛ, “Bɛhɔli busia bɛnleɛnlea kɛ Keena maanle ne anu si de la, bɔbɔ suakpole Gyɛleko.” Menli ne mɔ dwule suakpole ne azo la, bɛhɔlale raalɛ tuutuunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Releehabe la sua nu.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Na awie mɔ hɔhanle hilele Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Yizilayɛma bie ɛra ɛke nɔsolɛ ye ala kɛ bɛbanleɛnlea maanle ye anu.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Nɔe ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ne kagua adile aze la, Releehabe vole doale bɛ

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva azɛlɛ ye ɛmaa bɛ. Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ yɛ maanle ye anu la sulo bɛ, yɛɛ menli te bɛ nganeɛ a ɛnee ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Yɛde kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zile manle Nyevile kɔkɔlɛ ne sesanle bɔkɔɔ manle bɛpɛle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛlɛba la. Eza yɛde kɛ bɛzile bɛhunle Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne, Saehɔn nee Ɔɔgo, wɔ Dwɔdan aduduleɛ lɔ la.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Yɛdele la yɛzulole kpole, na ɔlua bɛmɛ bɛ ti, anwosesebɛ biala mɔɔ yɛlɛ la ɛwie. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a le Nyamenle wɔ anwuma lɔ nee azɛlɛ ye azo a.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ boɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa bɛ la, bɛkɛmaa me nee egya sua nu amra yɛ nwo kɛdɔ yɛ, na bɛhile me sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ bamaa mealie bɛ meali la.

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛlie egya nee ɔmɔ, me mediema mrenya nee mraalɛ, nee bɛ nwo amra amuala ngoane na bɛnrɛhu bɛ.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ne zele ye kɛ, “Mɔɔ kɛhu wɔ la ɛhu yɛ! Mɔɔ yɛrayɛ la, saa wɔanga wɔangile awie biala a, yɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, saa Ɛdɛnkɛma fa azɛlɛ ye maa yɛ a, yɛkɛyɛ wɔ boɛ.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Releehabe de sua bie mɔɔ bɛzi ye wɔ suakpole ne bane ne anu la anu, yemɔti ɔvale samgbe nyɛma ɔzɔle bɛ na ɔvale bɛ ɔluale sua ne nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu ɔdwulale bɛ aze wɔ suakpole ne bane ne anzi lɔ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: “Bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ na belemgbunli ne soanvolɛma ne nee bɛ anyia adenle nu. Bɛvea ɛkɛ ne kenle nsa bɛmaa sonvolɛma ne ɛzia ɛrɛla sua zo. Kenle nsa ne anzi, bɛkola bɛkɔ bɛ ɛleka bie.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Releehabe zele kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛha la ɛyɛ zɔhane”, na ɔmanle bɛhɔle. Mɔɔ bɛhɔle la, ɔvale nyɛma kɔkɔlɛ ne ɔhendanle nvɛnzɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ne hɔle awoka ne mɔ azo hɔveale lɔ kenle nsa. Belemgbunli ne menli mɔɔ ɔzoanle bɛ la wolowolole ahodoka mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala la anu dedee kenle nsa, na bɛannwu Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ne. Yemɔti bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛleko.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Menli nwiɔ ne akee vi awoka ne mɔ azo ziale rapɛle Azule Dwɔdan ne na bɛziale bɛhɔle Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua anwo lɔ. Bɛhanle mɔɔ zile la amuala bɛhilele ye,

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: na bɛzele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛdie yɛdi bɔkɔɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva maanle ne amuala ɛmaa yɛ; menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala ɛzulo yɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma amuala dwazole nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala; bɛvi Akasea azokoɛleɛ ne bɛdule bɛ bo bɛrazokoɛle Dwɔdan ne anloa bɛrahendɛle bɛ nwo kolaa na bɛapɛ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Ye kenle nsa ne azo, mgbanyima ne mɔ kpɔsale menli ne anwo zo

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛ biala ɛtɛbale ɛke ɛlɛ la, sɛlɛvolɛma ye ala yɛɛ bahile adenle ne a. Noko anrɛɛ bɛmmabikye Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne somasoma. Bɛmaa adenle kɛyɛ kilomita ko ɛla bɛ nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne avinli.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ ɛhyema Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ahile bɛ.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele sɛlɛvolɛma ne kɛ, “Bɛva Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛze bɛlumua menli ne anyunlu.” Na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ye mebayɛ wɔ sonlakpole meamaa Yizilayɛma amuala abɔ ɔ bo ali wɔ eni na bɛanwu ye wienyi kɛ me nee wɔ lua, kɛmɔ me nee Mosisi luale la.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Se sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zo Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la kɛ, ‘Saa bɛdwu Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa a, bɛwudwu bɛhɔ ye pemgbɛne ne azo na bɛgyinla.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua zele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Bɛrɛla ɛke bɛradie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛka la!

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Saa sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zo ewiade amuala Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la wula bɛ gyakɛ Dwɔdan ne anu a, ɔbagyakyi ɛzenlɛ, na nzule ne mɔɔ vi ye sɔlɔ ba la bagyinla ayɛ bonrabonra wɔ ɛleka ko.”

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne le ɛbuhenle, na azule ne ɛyi ɛbu aze. Na menli ne mɔ vi bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne dule bɛ bo kɛ bɛkɔ bɛahɔpɛ Dwɔdan ne. Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zo Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la li bɛ ti. Mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zo Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la agyakɛ hanle nzule ne mɔɔ wɔ azule ne pemgbɛne ne anloa ala la yɛɛ

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔɔ zo Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la gyinlanle azɛlɛ resee zo wɔ azule ne avinli, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛlɛpɛ azule ne la. Sɛlɛvolɛma ne gyinlanle bɛ gyakɛ anu ɛkɛ ne toonwo Yizilayɛma amuala wiele pɛ kɔ sunvoa.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma amuala wiele Azule Dwɔdan ne pɛ la, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: na se bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛhɔsesa awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne avinli lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ gyi la.’ Se bɛ kɛ bɛva awolɛ zɔhane mɔ bɛhɔ bɛhɔgua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbazokoɛ ɛnɛ nɔe la.”

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anu na bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛlɛka ne anwo ɛkɛ, bɛ nuhua ko biala ɛva bolɛ ko ɛdo ɔ kɔme zo ɛrɛla, bolɛ ko biala gyi ɛkɛ ne maa Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ko.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: bɛze bɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne pɛ Azule Dwɔdan ne la, azule ne tikale na ɔgyakyile ɛzenlɛ. Awolɛ ɛhye mɔ bayɛ ngakyelɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ amaa Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti wɔ mɔɔ zile la anwo.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Menli ne lile mɔɔ Dwɔhyua hanle hilele bɛ la azo. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Dwɔhyua la, bɛsesale awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne avinli lɔ na bɛzoale bɛraguale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua noko huohuanle awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ anloa wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne avinli, ɛleka mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔɔ zo Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la gyinlanle la.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la kenle bulu ne azo yɛɛ menli ne pɛle azule Dwɔdan ne a, na bɛyɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Gelegale, wɔ Gyɛleko aduduleɛ.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Ɛke yɛɛ Dwɔhyua huohuanle awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛsesale bɛ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anu la anloa a.
