english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Saa kenle bie bɛ bo zo amra biza bɛ ze mɔ kɛ, ‘Awolɛ ɛhye mɔ abo a le duzu’ a,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛhile bɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne manle azule ne sesanle dole azɛlɛ resee ne hɔkpulale kɛ bɛ muala bɛpɛle nu la, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle Ndɔ Nyevile ne ɔmanle yɛpɛle la.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati awie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la banwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ tumi kpole, na bɛazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Amɔle arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan adɔleɛ nee Keena arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa lɔ la dele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa Azule Dwɔdan ne ɛsesa na yeye azɛlɛ resee yemaa Yizilayɛma ɛpɛ la, bɛ ahonle dule. Yizilayɛma ati, bɛ nwo mɔra dule bɔkɔɔ. Bɛyɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ wɔ Gelegale

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Fa ɛtwɛlɛboɔ yɛ dadeɛ ngyikyi dɔɔnwo na fa yɛ Yizilayɛma mrenyanu nzonlɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua yɛle ɛtwɛlɛboɔ dadeɛ ngyikyi dɔɔnwo na ɔmanle bɛyɛle Yizilayɛma mrenyanu nzonlɛ wɔ boka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Mrenyanu Nzonlɛyɛlɛ Boka” la azo.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ amra mrenya a bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la, na awolɛndoazo fofolɛ ɛhye yɛɛ Dwɔhyua manle bɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ a.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ ne wiele la, Yizilayɛma amuala dɛnlanle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne toonwo bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ amuala hɔle.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ye, nyiane ne mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle ngɛkɛlɛ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, meye mevi ɛkɛ.” Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle ɛkɛ ne Gelegale, duma ne tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛkala.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbɔ Gelegale azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma lile “Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia” ne wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ bikye Gyɛleko la anu. Bɛlile ɛvoyia ne wɔ siane ne anu kenle bulu nee nna ne azo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Mana ne andɔ bieko, yemɔti Yizilayɛma ne annyia bieko. Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane bɛlile aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlua ye wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo la bie. Dwɔhyua nee nrenya ne mɔɔ lɛ konle dadeɛ ne la

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwɔhyua bikyele Gyɛleko la, arɛlevilɛ nu ala ɔnwunle nrenya ko kɛ ɔlɛ konle dadeɛ ɔ sa nu ɔgyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne. Dwɔhyua hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛboka yɛ nwo anzɛɛ ɛle kpɔvolɛ?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Nrenya ne buale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, menle kpɔvolɛ. Mera kɛ mele Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɔnema ne Safohyenle Kpanyinli.” Dwɔhyua dule dɔle ɔ nyunlu zonlenle ye na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mele wɔ akɛlɛ, duzu a ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ a?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɔnema Safohyenle Kpanyinli ne zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yeye wɔ mgbɔlaboa ne; azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛgyi zolɛ la le nwuanzanwuanza.” Na Dwɔhyua yɛle mɔɔ ɔzele ye la.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ati, Gyɛleko amra totole bɛ sua bɔdenle ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ anu. Awie vi sua ne azo ɛnvinde yɛɛ bie ɛmba sua ne azo.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ɛbamaa sɛlɛvolɛma nsuu ava mboane mɛne nsuu ayɛ aweɛne na bɛali Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu. Kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la, ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema ne bɛdia kilikili bɛbɔ sua bɔdenle ne mgbɔlɔka fane nsuu. Mekɛ ɛhye amuala ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛlɛwu bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbabɔ bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ tendenle ko. Saa bɛte ɛhye ala a, awie biala ɛdea nu kpole kpalɛ ko, na suakpole ne bane ne mɔ bade agua aze gɔɔ; na ɛlɔnema ne ko biala ɛva ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo ɛhɔ sua ne azo.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma ne na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne na bɛ nuhua nsuu ɛva mɛne aweɛne ne mɔ na bɛhɔli Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔmanle menli ne mɔ vale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɔle suakpole ne anwo mgbɔlɔka yiale na bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne bɛhɔlale.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne azo bɛdwazole aleɛbahye ne na bɛhɔbɔle suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, fane nsuu. Kenle ko ɛhye ala yɛɛ bɛdiale kilikili bɛbɔle suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka fane nsuu a.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Fane nsuu ne azo, mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne wule aweɛne ne mɔ anu la, Dwɔhyua zele menli ne kɛ, “Bɛdea nu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva suakpole ye ɛmaa bɛ!

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkye suakpole ne nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bɔkɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Tuutuunli Releehabe nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ala a bɛgyakyi bɛ a, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale yɛ menli ne mɔɔ yɛzoanle bɛ la ɔveale.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele anzɛɛ bulalɛ bɛyɛ la, bɛva bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛva zɔhane ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛhɔgua Ɛdɛnkɛma gya ne anu.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati sɛlɛvolɛma ne bɔle bɛ aweɛne ne mɔ anu. Menli ne dele ala la, bɛdeanle nu kpole ko, ɛnee bane ne mɔɔ bɛhye ye suakpole ne anwo la ɛde ɛgua aze, gɔɔ. Na Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne nyianle adenle hɔle suakpole ne azo na bɛhonle bɛvale.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Dwɔhyua bɔle kɔkɔ mɔɔ anu yɛ se la kɛ, “Awie ko biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔkyekye suakpole Gyɛleko bieko la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua ye kakɛ. english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Dwɔhyua luale, na ye nganeɛ hɔle maanle ne anu ɛleka biala.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔlile ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɛ awie biala mmafa ɔ sa ka debie biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye ye wɔ Gyɛleko la, bɛanli zolɛ. Nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ekan la donle mɛla ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ tetele bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bɛvale bɛhilele nyane mɔɔ ɛha bɛ la, na bɛdule bɛguale mutule nu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu, na bɛguale ɛkɛ ne toonwo nɔsolɛ nu; eza bɛvulale ɛnwea bɛguale bɛ ti zo bɛhilele kɛ bɛlɛdi nyane.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔhyua hanle kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔva yɛ wɔra azule Dwɔdan ye anzi ɛke, na wɔye yɛ wɔmaa Amɔlema kɛ bɛhu yɛ ɛ? Duzu ati yɛɛ yɛandɛnla Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ a?

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: O, Awulae, kɛkala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛnriandi ɛvi bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu la, duzu edwɛkɛ yɛɛ menga a?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Dwazo! Duzu ati a ɛla ye mutule nu zɛhae ɛ?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ ɛtane. Bɛdo me mɛla ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la. Bɛva ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ la bie. Bɛwuale, bɛbɔle nwolɛ adalɛ na bɛva bɛvea bɛ ninyɛne nu.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛangola bɛangyinla bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu a. Bɛnriandile, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ! Me nee bɛ ɛnrɛlua bieko kyesɛ bɛsɛkye ninyɛne ne mɔɔ bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛmmafa na bɛandie bɛvale la.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. translation_verse: Zɔhane ati se bɛ kɛ, nwonlomɔ bɛbara ye abusua ekpunli ekpunli. Abusua ekpunli ko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye mrɛladane nu. Ɛrɛladane ko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye awuke awuke; awuke ko noko mɔɔ menwɔye ye la anu amra bara ye ngoko.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛhye ye kɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bie wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la, bɛbayela ye nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la. Ɔluakɛ yemaa anyiemgba ɛha Yizilayɛma, yɛɛ eza yedo me mɛla ne.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, Dwɔhyua vale Yizilayɛma ne rale, ɔvale bɛ abusua ekpunli ekpunli ɔvindele Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu na bɛyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmanle abusua ekpunli ne anu amra rale ye mrɛladane nu, na ɔbɔle Zila asa azo ne. Dwɔhyua manle Zila asa azo ne ragyinlanle ye awuke awuke nu, na ɔbɔle Zabedae awuke nu amra.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Zabedae vale ye awuke nu amra ne rale ngoko ngoko, na ɔbɔle Ekan, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Kaamae na ɔ nlenya a le Zabedae la. Kaamae le Zila alɔnra yɛɛ ɔvi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu.

translation_verse: Na Dwɔhyua zele ye kɛ, “Me ra nrenya, ka nɔhalɛ ne na fa anyunlunyia maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, na ye ye ayɛlɛ; to mɔɔ wɔyɛ la kpaa nu. Ka mɔɔ wɔyɛ la kile me. Mmafa ɛfea me.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ekan buale kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, meyɛ ɛtane metia Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne. Mɔɔ menyɛle la ɛne:

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛrale Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma anyunlu, na bɛguale bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma zɔle Zila angabɛnzo Ekan nu, bɛvale dwɛtɛ fufule ne, tɛladeɛ ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne; akee bɛvale Ekan amra mrenya nee mraalɛ, ye nlankɛ, mboane, asoaso, yɛɛ ndanlɛ sua ne nee debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la bɛhɔle Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua bizale Ekan kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔva ngyegyelɛ ɛhye wɔdo yɛ nwo ɛ? Ɛdɛnkɛma bava bie ado ɛ nwo ɛnɛ.” Na Yizilayɛma zile Ekan awolɛ manle ɔwule. Eza bɛzile ye sua nu amra amuala awolɛ bɛhunle bɛ na bɛyelale bɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: Bɛhuohuanle awolɛ edukue kpole kpalɛ ɔ nwo zo; ɔtɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala. Yemɔti bɛfɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma akunlu dwole fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't be afraid, and don't be discouraged by what happened at the town of Ai. Take the army and attack again. But first, order part of the army to set up an ambush on the other side of the town. I will help you defeat the king of Ai and his army, and you will capture the town and the land around it. translation_verse: Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔvea suakpole ne anzi lɔ; bɛmmakɔ moa biala, na bɛva bɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛfa suakpole ne.

english_verse: So he called out every man in Ai to go after Joshua's troops. They all rushed out to chase the Israelite army, and they left the town gates wide open. Not one man was left in Ai or in Bethel. Joshua let the men of Ai chase him and his army farther and farther away from Ai.

translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Tende wɔ atwɛ ne wɔ Eyae; mebaye sua ne meamaa wɔ.” Na Dwɔhyua dendenle atwɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye ɔ sa nu la wɔ Eyae.

translation_verse: nee mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhilele Amɔle arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔdan ne anzi mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la. Arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ a le Saehɔn, mɔɔ le Hɛhyebɔn belemgbunli ne nee Ɔɔgo mɔɔ le Beehyan belemgbunli ne mɔɔ dɛnlanle Ahyetalo la.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: Yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ nee maanle ne anu amra amuala ɛzoa yɛ kɛ yɛva aleɛ yɛzia yɛ nwo na yɛrayia bɛ, na yɛha yɛhile bɛ kɛ yɛle bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ, na ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ.

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Nea yɛ kpanwo ne mɔ; yɛtu yɛ bo wɔ yɛ maanle nu la ɛnee bɛle wuluwulu. Noko nea kɛ bɛzi bɛyɛ reresee bie a; bɛbɔ adubue!

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛgua nwanye ne wɔ nwoma ahodoku ɛhye mɔ anu la, ɛnee bɛle fofolɛ, noko nea kɛ bɛzi bɛkpukekpuke bɛmaa yɛteta nu bie a! Adenle ne mɔɔ wale la ati yɛ adɛladeɛ nee yɛ mgbɔlaboa ɛwie yɛ nwo tete.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ne liele nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ aleɛ ne bie lile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛambiza Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛandie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ la.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua nee Gebɛyɔnoma ne yɛle anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bamaa bɛadɛnla ngoane nu a. Yizilayɛma mgbanyinli ne mɔ hanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛli ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma zile nu kɛ bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ la na ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛdwule azua ne mɔ mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ vi zolɛ rale la azo. Azua ne mɔ a le Gebɛyɔn, Kɛfaela, Biyɛlo, yɛɛ Keleate Gyialem.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Noko Yizilayɛma angu bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛva Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha ndane ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati Yizilayɛma amuala dendɛle bɛ nzo abo tiale bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua manle bɛvɛlɛle Gebɛyɔnoma na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛmɔti yɛɛ bɛbɛlɛbɛla yɛ kɛ bɛvi moa a bɛrale a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛzua yɛ nwo ɛke ala la ɛ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, Nyamenle ɛbua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ ɛwie. Bɛ menli ne mɔ bayɛ ahanra dahuu azoa ɛyɛne nee nzule ahɔ me Nyamenle ne sua nu.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ yɛnwunle kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne zele ye sonvolɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔva azɛlɛ ne amuala ɔmaa bɛ na bɛhu menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Zɔhane ati ɛnee ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ ɛha yɛ; yɛsulo kɛ bɛkɛhu yɛ bɛkɛbɔ yɛ bo zo.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Kɛkala, yɛwɔ bɛ sa nu; mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, bɛva bɛyɛ yɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua bɔle bɛ nwo bane na yeammaa Yizilayɛma adenle yeammaa bɛangu bɛ.

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛle bɛ ahanra ɔmanle bɛzoale ɛyɛne nee nzule bɛmanle Yizilayɛma na bɛvale bie bɛhɔle ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne wɔ la. Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛtɛdi zɔhane gyima ne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhile kɛ bɛzonle ye la.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm Belemgbunli Adonaezidɛke dele kɛ Dwɔhyua ɛho ɛva Eyae, yebɔ sua ne bɔkɔɔ na yehu ye belemgbunli ne, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko nee ye belemgbunli ne la. Eza ɔdele kɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na ɔlua zolɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee bɛ a de a.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Ɛhye manle Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne zulole kpole, ɔboalekɛ Gebɛyɔn le suakpole mɔɔ zolɛ belemgbunli ne di munli a; ɔle kpole ɔtɛla Eyae yɛɛ eza ye menli ne mɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Adonaezidɛke vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle Hibulɔn Belemgbunli Hoham, Gyaamutu Belemgbunli Paelam, Leekehye Belemgbunli Gyafaya, yɛɛ Ɛgelɔn Belemgbunli Dibɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Gebɛyɔnoma nee Dwɔhyua yɛɛ Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛraboa me bɛmaa me nee Gebɛyɔnoma ɛhɔho.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Gebɛyɔnoma zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Dwɔhyua wɔ Gelegale azokoɛleɛ ne kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mmaye yɛ ɛmaa! Bɛla ndɛndɛ baboa yɛ na die yɛ ngoane. Amɔle arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la ɛbɔ nu ɛra nee yɛ baho.”

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Mmasulo bɛ na meva konimlilɛ memaa wɔ dɛbadɛba. Bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛ nyunlu gyinla.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne zile nu nɔe ne; bɛvi Gelegale bɛgyi zolɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Gebɛyɔn na bɛhɔlile Amɔlema nvunu.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Amɔlema nwunle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ na bɛ nye zo danle bɛ. Yizilayɛma hunle bɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Gebɛyɔn ɛkɛ ne na bɛdoale bɛ ndinlizo, bɛlua Bɛte Hɔlɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu adenle zo toonwo bɛrale Azika nee Makidaa.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Amɔlema nriandi Yizilayɛma wɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu la, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ezuawolɛ mgbole dɔle guale bɛ nwo zo toonwo bɛdwule Azika. Ezuawolɛ mgbole zɔhane mɔɔ dɔle la hunle Amɔlema dɔɔnwo dɛlale mɔɔ Yizilayɛma mumua ne hunle bɛ la.

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɔnrɛzi ɛlɛ, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle tieyɛ manle dasanli. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔhonle ɔmanle Yizilayɛma a.

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale hɔle bɛ azokoɛleɛ ne wɔ Gelegale. Dwɔhyua kye Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne nriandile la, bɛhɔveale bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Makidaa.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Awie mɔ nwunle bɛ na bɛhɔhanle bɛhilele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Yɛnwu kɛ Amɔle arelemgbunli nnu ne vea bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Makidaa.”

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔhyua zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhundo awolɛ mgbole bɛnyi bɔne ne. Bɛmaa menli ɛzinza ɛkɛ ne

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: na bɛmɛ, bɛmmatɛnla ɛkɛ. Bɛdoa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne na bɛbu bɛ nzi bɛ nee bɛ ɛho; bɛmmamaa bɛkɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛye bɛ ɛmaa kɛ bɛli bɛ nwo zo konim.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne hunle Amɔlema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ a. Menli mɔɔ bɛ sa anga bɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛziale bɛhɔveale suakpole ne azo la.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua menli ne mɔ ziale rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Makidaa azokoɛleɛ ne. Awie biala ɛnle maanle ne anu mɔɔ dendɛle tiale Yizilayɛma a.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua zele kɛ, “Bɛdukue bɔne ne na bɛva arelemgbunli nnu ne bɛrɛla ɛke.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛdukuele bɔne ne na bɛvale Gyɛlusalɛm, Hibulɔn, Gyaamutu, Leekehye, yɛɛ Ɛgelɔn arelemgbunli ne mɔ bɛvindele.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ bɛrɛlɛle Dwɔhyua. Dwɔhyua vɛlɛle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne amuala na ɔzele bɛ safohyenlema ne mɔɔ nee bɛ a hɔle la kɛ bɛva bɛ gyakɛ bɛtietia arelemgbunli ne mɔ akɔme zo. Na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua zele safohyenlema ne kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ nwo bubu bɛ. Bɛgyinla ye mrenya zo na bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se, ɔluakɛ ɛhye yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ayɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ baho la a.”

english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Nzinlii akee Dwɔhyua hunle arelemgbunli ne mɔ na ɔhendɛhendanle bɛ wɔ mbaka nnu azo; bɛhendanle zolɛ toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛkɔ ahɔdɔ la, Dwɔhyua manle bɛyeyele avunli ne mɔ na bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale bɔne ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛvea nu la anu. Bɛhundole awolɛ mgbole bɛduale bɔne ne, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔtɛbɔ ɛkɛ. Dwɔhyua ko ava Amɔle maanle ne dɔɔnwo

english_verse: Later that day, Joshua captured Makkedah and killed its king and everyone else in the town, just as he had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne Dwɔhyua honle vale Makidaa na ɔhyele ye belemgbunli ne ɔhunle ye nee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la; ko bɔbɔ anga. Ɔyɛle Makidaa belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne la.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vi Makidaa hɔle Lebena na ɔ nee Lebenama hɔhonle.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma lile konim na bɛvale suakpole ne na bɛhyele belemgbunli ne noko. Bɛangyakyi sonla ko bɔbɔ; bɛhunle bɛ muala. Na Dwɔhyua yɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Gyɛleko belemgbunli ne la.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Lebena hɔle Leekehye. Bɛbɔle bɛyiale suakpole ne na bɛtetale ye bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la honle.

english_verse: and the next day the Lord let them capture the town. They killed everyone, as they had done at Libnah.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nwiɔ ne azo Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma lile Leekehyema anwo zo konim. Kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Lebena la, bɛangyakyi sonla ko bɔbɔ. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɔlam mɔɔ vi Gizɛ la rale kɛ ɔbaboa Leekehyema, na Dwɔhyua bɛlɛle ye nee ye ɛlɔnema ne aze na ɔhunle bɛ muala; ko bɔbɔ anga.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Bieko, Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Leekehye hɔle Ɛgelɔn; bɛbɔle bɛyiale ye na bɛtetale ɔdaye noko.

english_verse: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.
translation_verse: Bɛhonle bɛvale ye wɔ kenle ko ne ala na bɛhunle awie biala kɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Leekehye la.

english_verse: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.
translation_verse: na bɛvale. Bɛhunle belemgbunli ne nee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la; bɛzɛkyele azua mɔɔ bikye suakpole ne la. Dwɔhyua zɛkyele suakpole ne bɔkɔɔ kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Ɛgelɔn la. Sonla ko bɔbɔ anga.

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale bɛ nzi hɔtetale Dibɛ ɔ nee sua ne azo amra honle.

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: Ɔvale sua ne na ɔhyele ye belemgbunli ne. Eza ɔvale azua mɔɔ zuozua suakpole ne la. Bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la. Dwɔhyua yɛle Dibɛ nee ye belemgbunli ne kɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle Hibulɔn yɛɛ Lebena nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ la.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua honle vale maanle ne amuala. Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ne mɔ azo, nee mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ ndololeɛ ne mɔ anu, nee mɔɔ wɔ adɔleɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nyiakɛ maanle ne mɔ anu la amuala; yeanvavi sonla ko bɔbɔ; ɔhunle awie biala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele kɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua honle vale maanle maanle ne mɔ; ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔvile Keedɛhye Baanɛya wɔ nyiakɛ nehane ɔhɔkpulale Gaza mɔɔ bikye nyevile ne anloa la, nee Gohyɛn azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ, ɔhɔkpulale Gebɛyɔn.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyeeben mɔɔ vi Heezɔ la dele Yizilayɛma konimlilɛ ne mɔ la, ɔdule ɛbɔfoɔ ɔmanle ɔhɔle Belemgbunli Dwobabe mɔɔ wɔ Meedɔn la ɛkɛ. Ɛbɔfoɔ eza hɔle Hyemelɔn belemgbunli ne nee Akehyafe belemgbunli ne mɔ ɛkɛ;

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: ɛbɔfoɔ ne bie mɔ hɔle arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne sɔlɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu wɔ Galeli Tandane ne nyiakɛ, awoka ne mɔ abo nee ɛnweanloa toonwo asɛɛ Dɔɔ la amuala ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɔ ne bie mɔ noko hɔle Keenama mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ la, Amɔlema, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema mɔɔ de Hɛmɔn Boka ne ndololeɛ nu wɔ Mezepa azɛlɛ zo la ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Mmasulo bɛ. Ɛhyema bekezɛ ɛnee memaa Yizilayɛma ɛhu bɛ muala. Ɛbabubu mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ndwɛlɛ na wɔayela bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Dwɔhyua nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hɔle bɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu wɔ Milɔm Azule na bɛ nee bɛ honle.

english_verse: and everyone else, then they set the town on fire.
translation_verse: Bɛhunle awie biala; ko bɔbɔ anga, na bɛyelale suakpole ne.

english_verse: Joshua captured all the towns where the enemy kings had ruled. These towns were built on small hills, and Joshua did not set fire to any of these towns, except Hazor. The Israelites kept the animals and everything of value from these towns, but they killed everyone who lived in them, including their kings. That's what the Lord had told his servant Moses to do, that's what Moses had told Joshua to do, and that's exactly what Joshua did.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele ye sonvolɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Mosisi hanle hilele Dwɔhyua kɛ ɔyɛ a, yɛɛ Dwɔhyua noko lile zolɛ. Ɔyɛle debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la. Maanle mɔɔ Dwɔhyua honle vale la

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne amuala, azɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo nee bɛ ndololeɛ nu, maanle ne sɔlɔ nee ye nyiakɛ, Gohyɛn azɛlɛ ne nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la ye nyiakɛ, nee Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a yɛle bɛ zɔhane manle bɛ nee Yizilayɛma honle, amaa ɔlua zo bɛabua bɛ fɔlɛ, bɛahu bɛ, bɛabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu a. Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi kɛ ɔyɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Dwɔhyua hɔle hɔzɛkyele kakanyinlima ekpunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Anakema mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ne mɔ azo la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Hibulɔn, Dibɛ, Anabe yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda awoka ne mɔ azo nee Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu la, Dwɔhyua hunle bɛ muala na ɔzɛkyele bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Anakema sonla ko bɔbɔ anga Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo. Ekyi bie a hale Gaza, Gate, yɛɛ Ahyedɔdo a.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne amuala, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la. Dwɔhyua vale azɛlɛ ne manle Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ na bɛdɛnla zolɛ. Ɔhyɛle nu ngyebangyeba ɔmanle Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ. Akee Yizilayɛma liele bɛ ɛnwomenle na bɛgyakyile konle.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛho ɛva azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la Dwɔdan aduduleɛ la, ɔvi Anɔn Bɔnza ɔlua Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anloa toonwo ɔkɔdwu azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ wɔ Hɛmɔn Boka. Arelemgbunli nwiɔ yɛɛ bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim a.

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Ko a le Saehɔn, mɔɔ le Amɔle belemgbunli ne mɔɔ ɛnee de Hɛhyebɔn la. Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko boka ye belemgbunli maanle ne anwo, ɔvi Alowɛ nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza zɔhane avinli la, toonwo ɔkɔkpula Azule Gyeebɔko mɔɔ la Amɔlema ɛweɛne zo la.

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: Dwɔdan Bɔnza, ɔvi Galeli Tandane ne nyiakɛ, ɔkɔ Bɛte Gyɛhyemo toonwo mɔɔ kɔgua ye Pesega Boka ne abo la boka Belemgbunli Saehɔn maanle ne anwo.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: Eza bɛlile Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la anwo zo konim. Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo le menli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Relɛfeeyemma mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ bo ɛdu la anu ko. Ɔɔgo lile ye ebia ne wɔ Ahyetalo nee Ɛdelɛyae.

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: Hɛmɔn Boka, Salika, yɛɛ Beehyan azɛlɛ ne amuala kɔgua Gɛhyɛ nee Meeyaka ɛweɛne ne mɔ azo, Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko mɔɔ kɔkpula Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ wɔ Hɛhyebɔn la azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne zo la amuala boka Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo maanle ne anwo.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi nee Yizilayɛma a lile arelemgbunli nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ anwo zo konim a. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ Mosisi vale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ manle Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Arelemgbunli mɔɔ Dwɔhyua lile bɛ nwo zo konim la

english_verse: Later, Joshua and the Israelites defeated many kings west of the Jordan River, from Baal-Gad in Lebanon Valley in the north to Mount Halak near the country of Edom in the south. This region included the hill country and the foothills, the Jordan River valley and its western slopes, and the Southern Desert. Joshua and the Israelites took this land from the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. Joshua divided up the land among the tribes of Israel. The Israelites defeated the kings of the following towns west of the Jordan River:
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ɛhye la awoka ne mɔ azo, ɔlua adɔleɛ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, Dwɔdan Bɔnza nee ye awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ, aduduleɛ ndololeɛ ne anu ɔba ɛsɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ la azo. Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ de azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la a le Hɛtema, Amɔlema, Keenama, Pɛlɛzema, Haevaema, yɛɛ Gyibɛsema.

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua akee ɛli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo na yeyɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnyi, wɔli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo, noko azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo tɛbɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a.

english_verse: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Wulubɛn nee Gaade mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ nee Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne asa hanle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne aduduleɛ la. Mosisi a vale manle bɛ a.

english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: Bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ dwu Alowɛ nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la, nee Midɛba boka ne mɔɔ azo le sɛsɛ la toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Daebɔn la.

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu Amɔnoma ɛweɛne zo yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ Amɔle belemgbunli Saehɔn ziele bɛ la. Belemgbunli zɔhane dɛnlanle Hɛhyebɔn.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Mosisi anva azɛlɛ ammaa Livae abusua ekpunli ne. Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Mosisi la, bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ a le azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔɔ bɛyela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne la anu bie. Wulubɛn azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Mosisi vale azɛlɛ ne manle Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne, kɛmɔ bɛ mrɛladane ne mɔ de la kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: Bɛ azɛlɛ ne anloa pɛ Alowɛ nee suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la, nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne mɔɔ bikye Midɛba la azo.

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ boka azo sɛsɛ ne azo la amuala, nee Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ le Amɔlenli ne mɔɔ dɛnlanle Hɛhyebɔn la belemgbunli maanle ne amuala. Mosisi lile Belemgbunli Saehɔn anwo zo konim, ɔlile Medean arelemgbunli mɔɔ le Yivae Rilikɛm, Zuuli, Huuli, yɛɛ Riliba noko anwo zo konim. Menli ɛhye mɔ nleanle azɛlɛ ne manle Belemgbunli Saehɔn.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Biyɔ mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la ara Beelam ɔdaye ɔboka menli mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hunle bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Azule Dwɔdan ne a le Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne adɔleɛ ɛweɛne a. Azuamgbole nee azua ngyikyi ɛhye mɔ a bɛvale bɛmanle Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra kɛ bɛva bɛ bɔkɔɔ a. Gaade azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Mosisi eza vale azɛlɛ ne bie manle Gaade abusua ekpunli ne kɛ bɛva.

english_verse: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Bɛ azɛlɛ ne fa Gyeezɛ nee Geleade azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala, Amɔnoma azɛlɛ ne foa ko toonwo kɔkpula Alowɛ wɔ Relaba aduduleɛ afoa nu.

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne eza bɔ ye wɔ Hɛhyebɔn, ɔtɛlɛ ɔkɔ Releemate Mezepa nee Bɛtonem, ɔvi Meehaneeyem ɔkɔ Lodiba ɛweɛne zo.

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: Wɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu noko, Bɛte Hɛlam, Bɛtenemela, Sɛko, yɛɛ Zeefɔn boka nwolɛ. Ɛhye mɔ a le Belemgbunli Saehɔn mɔɔ wɔ Hɛhyebɔn la belemgbunli maanle ne mɔɔ ɛha la a. Bɛ adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Azule Dwɔdan ne mɔɔ kɔkpula Galeli sɔlɔ la.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Azuamgbole nee ngyikyi mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Gaade abusua ekpunli ne kɛ bɛva la ɛne. Manasɛ Aduduleɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Mosisi eza vale azɛlɛ ne bie manle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Their land started at Mahanaim and took in the region that King Og of Bashan had ruled, including Ashtaroth and Edrei, the two towns where he had lived. The villages where the Jair clan settled were part of Manasseh's land, and so was the northern half of the region of Gilead. The clans of this half of Manasseh had
translation_verse: Geleade azɛlɛ ne foa ko, Ahyetalo, yɛɛ Ɛdelɛyae mɔɔ le Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo azuamgbole wɔ ye maanle ne anu la boka nwolɛ. Bɛvale ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛmanle Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne mɔɔ le ɔ ra Meekɛ asa azo la.

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo wɔ Mowabe la yɛɛ ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko aduduleɛ nee Dwɔdan la a.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Na Mosisi anva azɛlɛ biala ammaa Livae abusua ekpunli ne. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne a le bɛ agyadeɛ a.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Kenle ko Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ne bie mɔ rale Dwɔhyua anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Gelegale. Na Kalɛbe mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Gyɛfɛni mɔɔ le Kinɛzenli la zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Ɛze mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Keedɛhye Baanɛya hilele Nyamenle sonvolɛ Mosisi, mɔɔ fane me nee ɛ nwo la.

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ nee me hɔle la manle yɛ menli ne mɔ ahonle dule. Noko nɔhalɛ nu, menyɛle tieyɛ memanle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Na Kɛmɔ menyɛle zɔhane la ati, Mosisi bɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ me nee me mra yɛbanyia azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mengɔle zolɛ la kɛ ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I'm just as strong today as I was then, and I can still fight as well in battle.
translation_verse: Kɛkala bɔbɔ, me nwo tɛyɛ se kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Mosisi zoanle me la. Me nwo tɛyɛ se wɔ konle nee debie biala ɛyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Yemɔti fa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la maa me. Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɔle me ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee me menli ne yɛrale la. Yɛhanle yɛhilele wɔ kɛ menli kakanyinli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ ‘Anakema’ la wɔ maanle ne anu, na bɛdede azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane la azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa me yeamaa meavoa bɛ, kɛmɔ ɔdaye yeha la.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua yilale Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe na ɔvale suakpole Hibulɔn ɔmanle ye kɛ ye agyadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, Hibulɔn tɛde Kalɛbe abo zo amra ɛdeɛ. Gyɛfɛni le Kinɛzenli. Kalɛbe yɛle tieyɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Hibulɔn duma dɛba a le Aabasuazo . Na anzonudwolɛ akee rale maanle ne anu.

english_verse: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ye nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne vi Nyevile Ngyenle ne nyiakɛ ebolo ne anloa ɔkɔ aze.

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: Ɔvi Akelabem Bɔnza ne nyiakɛ ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu Zen, ɔlua Keedɛhye Baanɛya nyiakɛ, ɔpɛ nu Hɛzelɔn, ɔfo ɔkɔ Edaa, ɔbele ɔkɔ Kaakaa,

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: ɔkɔ Azemɔn, ɔlua azudenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo la anloa toonwo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Ɛnee Dwuda azɛlɛ ne, ye nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne.

english_verse: Judah's eastern border ran the full length of the Dead Sea. The northern border started at the northern end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Nyevile Ngyenle ne, ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔdwu tandane ne anu ebolo ne mɔɔ Dwɔdan ne se gua nu la anloa. Sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ ebolo ɛhye anu,

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: ɔlua Bɛte Hɔgela, ɔfa ye boka tɛtɛlɛ ne mɔɔ keda Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne azo la anwo. Akee ɔfa ye ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ ye anwuma, ɔkɔdwu Bohan Bolɛ ne anwo ,

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: ɔvi Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ɔkɔ Dibɛ, na yeabele ye ɛbɔ nu yeavinde Gelegale ɛleka mɔɔ nee Adɛmem anye bɔ zolɛ la, wɔ bɔnza ne nyiakɛ. Akee ɔlua Ɛnhyimɛhye azule ne anloa, ɔdwu Ɛnlogɛle.

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Akee ɛweɛne ne dua Henɛm Bɔnza wɔ boka ne mɔɔ bɛkyekyele Gyibɛsema suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm zolɛ la nyiakɛ. Ɛweɛne ne akee kɔdua boka ne azo wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza ne adɔleɛ, ɔkɔsɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne sɔlɔ.

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ Nɛfetowa Nzubula ne mɔ azo, ɔdwu azuamgbole ne mɔɔ bikye Yifolɔn Boka la. Ɔbele ɛkɛ ne ɔkɔ Beeyala

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: na ɔfa ye wɔ Beeyala adɔleɛ ɔkɔ Siyɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, ɔlua Gyialem Boka ne sɔlɔ, ɔtolo ɔkɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye, ɔpɛ nu Temena.

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛkɛ ne la ɔ nee Dibɛ amra hɔhonle.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua la, ɔvale Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne bie ɔmanle Kalɛbe mɔɔ le Gyɛfɛni mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔbɔ Dwuda abusua ne bie la ara ne. Kalɛbe nyianle Hibulɔn, suakpole ne mɔɔ le Enake ɔ ze Aaba ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Kalɛbe dule Enake abo zo amra ne wɔ suakpole ne azo. Bɛmɛ a le Hyihyae, Ahaeman, yɛɛ Talemae nee bɛ sua nu amra.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Kalɛbe hanle kɛ, “Nrenya biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛho kɛva Keleate Sifɛ la, mebava me ra raalɛ Akesa meamaa yeagya ye.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, and Caleb let him marry Achsah.
translation_verse: Kalɛbe adiema nrenya Kinaze ara Ɔteneɛle a honle vale suakpole ne a, yemɔti Kalɛbe vale ɔ ra raalɛ Akesa manle ɔgyale ye.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ bɛdie ye atɔfolɛ la, Ɔteneɛle zele ɔ ye kɛ ɔbiza ɔ ze ɔmaa ɔmaa ye azɛlɛ. Akesa vi ye asoaso ne azo dwule aze, na Kalɛbe bizale ye deɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Mekpondɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ zolɛ la, ɔboalekɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa me la di nzule nwo ehyia.” Yemɔti Kalɛbe vale ɛleka bie mɔɔ nzubula dɔɔnwo wɔ la manle ye wɔ azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ nee ye nyiakɛ. Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne:

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: Lɛbeeyo, Hyelehem, Eyen, yɛɛ Relemɔn: bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole abulanwiɔ nee ngɔnla, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Hyaleeyem, Gɛdila, yɛɛ Gɛdiloteeyem: bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nna, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Gɛdilo, Bɛtedeegɔn, Neeyama, yɛɛ Makidaa: azuamgbole bulu nee nsia, nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne la ɛne: bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Atalo Ada ɔkɔ aduduleɛ, ɔdwu Sɔlɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn,

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: Bɛvale azua nee namunamu mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ ɛweɛne zo la noko bɛmanle Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Noko bɛanvoa Keenama mɔɔ de Gizɛ la, yemɔti Keenama nee Yifelaemma ɛdɛnla toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, na bɛmaa Keenama yɛ gyima kɛ bɛle ahanra.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manasɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne vi Ahya kɔkpula Mekemita wɔ Hyikɛm aduduleɛ. Ɔdwu ɛkɛ a ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti nyiakɛ na ɔfa Ɛntapua maanle ne ɔboka nwolɛ.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Tapua azɛlɛ ne le Manasɛ ɛdeɛ, noko Tapua sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ ɛweɛne zo la, yemɔ ɔle Yifelaem abo zo amra ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: Yesakaa nee Ahya bɛ azɛlɛ ne, zolɛ yɛɛ Bɛte Hyan nee Yebelɛyam wɔ a, noko bɛle Manasɛ ɛdeɛ. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ azua nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la de a. Eza Dɔɔ , Ɛndɔɔ, Teeyanake, Mɛgedo, yɛɛ azua nee namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la le Manasɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Manasɛma angola andu menli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo la, yemɔti Keenama dɛnlanle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: Nzinlii bɔbɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma anwo yɛle se kpalɛ la bɛandu Keenama ne amuala. Bɛmanle Keenama ne yɛle gyima manle bɛ. Yifelaem nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ biza alie azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Dwosefi abo zo amra ne zele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔva azɛlɛ ne ɛkpɔ ko ala a wɔmaa yɛ a? Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila yɛ ɛmaa yɛ nwo ɛzo kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua buale bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛ nwo ɛzo na Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo ɛyɛ ekyi ɛmaa bɛ a, ɛnee bɛhɔ Pɛlɛzema nee Relɛfeeyemma azɛlɛ ne azo, bɛhɔzo kpɔkɛ ne bie bɛziezie ɛkɛ ne bɛva.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Awoka ne mɔ azo azɛlɛ ne le ekyi maa yɛ. Keenama noko mɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la lɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Bɛte Hyan nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye la nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Gyɛzɛli Bɔnza ne anu la amuala dedɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua zele Yifelaem nee Manasɛ Adɔleɛ amra ne kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, bɛ nwo zonle yɛɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se. Azɛlɛ ne, bɛbanyia mɔɔ bo ko la.

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: Awoka ne mɔ anu lɔ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Ɔle kpɔkɛ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛhɔva bɛzo, bɛvi ɔ ti bɛhɔkpula ɔ bo na bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ. Keenama lɛ konle mbulalɛ ehwili, eza bɛ nwo yɛ se ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbavoa bɛ bɛavi ɛkɛ ne.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma honle vale azɛlɛ ne la, nzinlii bɛ muala bɛyiale Hyaelo na bɛzile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: There were still seven tribes without any land,
translation_verse: Ɛnee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli nsuu wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛtɛmanle bɛ azɛlɛ ne bie a.

english_verse: Just before the men left camp, Joshua repeated their orders: “Explore the land and write a description of it. Then come back to Shiloh, and I will find out from the Lord how to divide the land.”
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua akee zele menli mɔɔ bɛyele bɛ bɛmanle ye la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ azɛlɛ ne amuala azo na bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ ngɛlata zo bɛrɛlɛ me. Mebagua nzeleba wɔ Hyaelo ɛke meabiza Ɛdɛnkɛma nwolɛ edwɛkɛ meamaa bɛ.”

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye la akee menli ne guale adenle zo. Bɛhɔkpɔlale azɛlɛ ne amuala na bɛhilele kɛ bɛzi bɛhyɛ nu nsuu ne la wɔ kɛlata zo. Bɛhɛlɛle azua ne mɔ amuala aluma na bɛziale bɛrale Dwɔhyua anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Hyaelo azokoɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Dwɔhyua guale nzeleba bizale nwolɛ manle bɛ, ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle mbusua ekpunli nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la. Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne a bɛlumuale bɛmanle ye azɛlɛ ne bie a. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne la Dwuda nee Dwosefi mbusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ ne mɔ avinli.

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Dwɔdan ne anloa, ɔlua boka ne ndololeɛ nu wɔ Gyɛleko anwuma, ɔse ye adɔleɛ ɔlua awoka ne mɔ azo ɔkɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ wɔ Bɛteevɛn.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ɛweɛne ne eza bu ɛleka bie finde awoka ne mɔ adɔleɛ afoa nu, ɔfa nyiakɛ ɔkɔ Keleate Beeyale mɔɔ le Dwudama azɛlɛ la. Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ne adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: Nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ Keleate Gyialem kandiba ɔkɔ Nɛfetowa nzubula ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: Akee ɔlua boka ne mɔɔ awie gyi zolɛ a ɔnwu Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu la abo, wɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne sɔlɔ. Akee ɔfa nyiakɛ, ɔlua Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu, ɔlua Gyibɛse boka ne nyiakɛ, ɔfinde Ɛnlogɛle.

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Akee ɔkakyi ɔ nye ɔfa ɛbɔ nu, ɔlua Ɛnhyimɛhye, ɔkɔ Gɛlaelo mɔɔ nee Adɛmem bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ la. Ɛweɛne ne akee kɔ Bohan Bolɛ ne anwo ,

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: ɔlua boka ne abati mɔɔ anye bɔ Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne azo la, ɔtolo ɔkɔ bɔnza ne anu;

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: ɔkɔfa Bɛte Hɔgela boka ne sɔlɔ na ɔkɔgua ye wɔ Nyevile Ngyenle ne sɔlɔ ebolo ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne bɔ nyevile ne anu la. Ɛnee nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne ɛne.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Azule Dwɔdan ne a le aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne a. Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛweɛne ne ɛne.

english_verse: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛvale bɛmanle Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne anu amra. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne wolole Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne ɛdeɛ ne anu.

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: Bɛte Lɛbeeyo, yɛɛ Hyaluhɛn boka nwolɛ: bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nsa, nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.

english_verse: and continued north to Gath-Hepher, Ethkazin, and Rimmonah, where it curved toward Neah
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛke ɔfa aduduleɛ ɔkɔ Gate Hifɛ nee Ɛtekeezen, ɔbele ɔkɔ Nia afoa nu, ɔdwu Relemɔn.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: Eza Eyen, Relemɔn, Yitɛ, yɛɛ Ahyan: azuamgbole nna, boka azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la;

english_verse: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.
translation_verse: yɛɛ azua mɔɔ zuozua azuamgbole ne mɔ toonwo kɔdwu Beeyala Biyɛ mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ la. Azɛlɛ mɔɔ Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne nyianle ye kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Dwuda azɛlɛ ne yɛle kpole bole zolɛ la ati, bɛvale bie bɛmanle Semɛyɔn abusua ekpunli ne. Zɛbulɛn azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Ye sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne noko fa Hanatɔn na ɔkɔwie Yefetahɛle Bɔnza.

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Azua ɛhye mɔ a wɔ zolɛ a: Kata, Nahalale, Hyemelɔn, Yedala, yɛɛ Bɛtelɛhɛm. Bɛ muala bɛle azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ, yɛɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee azua ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli ne nyianle yɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo. Yesakaa azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Yesakaa abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo. Ahya azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: Ɛweɛne ne lua aduduleɛ wɔ Bɛtedeegɔn, ɔkɔ Zɛbulɛn nee Yefetahɛle Bɔnza, na ɔfa anwuma ɔdwu Bɛtɛmɛke nee Nayeyɛle, ɔfa ye sɔlɔ ɔdwu Keebulu,

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Yibolɔn, Rilihɔbo, Hamɔn, yɛɛ Kana, na ɔwie Saedɛn.

english_verse: Then it turned west to become the northern border and went to Ramah and the fortress-city of Tyre. Near Tyre it turned toward Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ahya abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo. Nafetalae azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages, including Mahalab, Achzib, Acco, Aphek, and Rehob. Naphtali's Land
translation_verse: Ɛweɛne ne eza dwu Teebɔ, Hyeehazuma, yɛɛ Bɛte Hyimɛhye, ɔkɔwie Dwɔdan ne anloa. Azuamgbole ne mɔ le bulu nee nsia, yɛɛ namunamu zuozua bɛ.

english_verse: The Naphtali clans received this region as their tribal land, and it included
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ namunamu ne mɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne nyianle la azo. Dan azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: The Israelites were still gathered in Shiloh in front of the sacred tent, when Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family leaders of Israel finished giving out the land to the tribes. The Lord had told the people to give Joshua whatever town he wanted. So Joshua chose Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people gave it to him. Joshua went to Timnath-Serah, rebuilt it, and lived there.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛlieza nee Nɛn ara Dwɔhyua nee mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyigyi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ ati la vale awolɛ guale nzeleba bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛzi bɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne la, wɔ Hyaelo. Bɛyɛle ɛhye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu bɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ne. Adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ne la ɛne.

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ a bɛvale bɛyɛle ɛvealeka ne mɔ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma amuala nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de la a. Awie biala mɔɔ ɔ nye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔkɛhu sonla la kola kɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane wɔ ahenle mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔku ye bie ɔtua la asa anu. Bɛngola bɛngu ye, kyesɛ bɛli ye edwɛkɛ bagua nu na yeli fɔlɛ.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwɔhyua kɛ

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: ɔha ɔhile Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛva azuamgbole ne bie mɔ bɛyɛ ɛvealeka, kɛmɔ menzele me akɛlɛ Mosisi kɛ ɔha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɔhile bɛ la.

english_verse: If a person accidentally kills someone and the victim's relatives say it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of the Safe Towns and be safe from the victim's relatives. The one needing protection will stand at the entrance to the town gate and explain to the town leaders what happened. Then the leaders will bring that person in and provide a place to live in their town.
translation_verse: Ɔkola ɔnriandi ɔkɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo ndɛnebualɛ ɛleka ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa la, na ɔkile edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛzi la anu ɔkile mgbanyima ne. Akee bɛbamaa ye ɛleka wɔ sua ne azo, amaa yeadɛnla ɛkɛ.

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Saa sonla ne mɔɔ di nzenralɛ ne la toa ye ba sua ne azo a, bɛmmaye ahenle ne mɔɔ hunle sonla ne la bɛmaa. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɔ nwo bane, ɔboalekɛ tɛ ɔ nye fuu a ɔhunle ahenle a, yɛɛ yeanva ɛya a ɔhunle ye a.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: Ɔbadɛnla sua ne azo toonwo kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛli ye edwɛkɛ bagua nu, na mekɛ ne anu sonla ne mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli la kɛwu la. Ɛnee akee ɔkola ɔsia ɔkɔ ye sua zo, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde mɔɔ ɔnriandile ɔrale la.”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
translation_verse: Yemɔti wɔ Dwɔdan Adɔleɛ, bɛvale Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Galeli mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae awoka ne mɔ azo la, Hyikɛm mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo la, yɛɛ Hibulɔn mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu la.

english_verse: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.
translation_verse: Wɔ Dwɔdan Aduduleɛ noko, bɛvale Bizɛ mɔɔ wɔ Wulubɛn azɛlɛ zo wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko aduduleɛ la, Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade mɔɔ wɔ Gaade azɛlɛ zo la, yɛɛ Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ azɛlɛ zo la.

english_verse: While the Israelites were still camped at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, the family leaders of the Levi tribe went to speak to the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders of the other Israelite tribes. The leaders of Levi said, “The Lord told Moses that you have to give us towns and provide pastures for our animals.”
translation_verse: wɔ Hyaelo mɔɔ wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo la, na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo zele kɛ bɛmaa yɛ azuamgbole bɛmaa yɛdɛnla zolɛ, yɛɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee yɛ nyɛmoa yɛbadidi zolɛ la, wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.”

english_verse: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne azo, Yizilayɛma manle Livaema azuamgbole nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛbadidi zolɛ la wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The leaders asked the Lord to show them in what order the clans of Levi would be given towns, and which towns each clan would receive. The Kohath clans were first. The descendants of Aaron, Israel's first priest, were given
translation_verse: Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra mɔɔ lumuale nyianle bie la a le Kohate asa azo ne. Abusua ekpulike ɛhye le sɛlɛvolɛ Aalɔn abo zo amra, yɛɛ bɛmanle bɛ azuamgbole bulu nee nsa wɔ Dwuda, Semɛyɔn, nee Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did. Towns from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin
translation_verse: Bɛguale nzeleba kolaa na Yizilayɛma ava azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ nee nwolɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la amaa Livaema, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo hanle la.

english_verse: The descendants of Aaron from the Kohath clans of Levi were priests, and they were chosen to receive towns first. They were given
translation_verse: Azuamgbole bulu nee nsa, nee nwolɛ adidileka yɛɛ bɛvale bɛmanle sɛlɛvolɛma ne a. Sɛlɛvolɛma ne le Aalɔn abo zo amra.

english_verse: The clans of Levi that were descendants of Gershon received
