translation_verse: Sɔɔlo zele kɛ, “Meyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ mebulu Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne azo yɛɛ meandie ɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ menzulole menli ne na mendiele bɛmɛ.

english_verse: Please forgive me and come back with me so I can worship the Lord.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mesɛlɛ wɔ, fa me ɛtane kyɛ me, na ɛ nee me ɛhɔ Gelegale maa mengɔnzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma bieko.”

english_verse: “No!” Samuel replied, “You disobeyed the Lord, and I won't go back with you. Now the Lord has said that you can't be king of Israel any longer.”
translation_verse: Na Samoɛle zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Me nee wɔ ɛnrɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ, na ɔdaye noko yekpo wɔ kɛ ɛnle Yizilayɛma belemgbunli bieko.”

english_verse: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the edge of Samuel's robe. It tore!
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Samoɛle hakyile ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ la, Sɔɔlo zɔle ye tɛladeɛ ne anu na ɔsuanle.

english_verse: Samuel said, “The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel away from you today, and he will give it to someone who is better than you.
translation_verse: Na Samoɛle zele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛza wɔ ɛlie Yizilayɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛvi ɛ sa nu ɛnɛ na yeva yemaa sonla mɔɔ le kpalɛ tɛla wɔ la.

english_verse: Besides, the eternal God of Israel isn't a human being. He doesn't tell lies or change his mind.”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ɛmbɔ adalɛ yɛɛ ɔngakyi ɔ nloa, ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ dasanli mɔɔ kakyihakyi ye adwenle la.”

english_verse: Saul said, “I did sin, but please honor me in front of the leaders of the army and the people of Israel. Come back with me, so I can worship the Lord your God.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Meyɛ ɛtane ɛdeɛ, noko di me eni ekyii bɔbɔ wɔ me mgbanyima ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma anyunlu. Ɛ nee me ɛhɔ Gelegale maa mengɔnzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne.”

english_verse: Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Samoɛle nee ye hɔle Gelegale na Sɔɔlo zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Then Samuel shouted, “Bring me King Agag of Amalek!” Agag came in chains, and he was saying to himself, “Surely they won't kill me now.”
translation_verse: Samoɛle zele kɛ, “Bɛva Amalɛke Belemgbunli Egage bɛrɛla ɛke.” Egage vale anwondɛlɛ rale. Ɔzele kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ nu, ewule ɛkpa me ti.”

english_verse: But Samuel said, “Agag, you have snatched children from their mothers' arms and killed them. Now your mother will be without children.” Then Samuel chopped Agag to pieces at the place of worship in Gilgal.
translation_verse: Na Samoɛle zele ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔ dadeɛ ne ɛmaa mrɛladane mraalɛ amra ɛvi bɛ sa la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nli balɛ ɔ sa mgbane wɔ mrɛladane mraalɛ avinli a.” Na Samoɛle pepɛle ye nzokanzoka wɔ Gelegale wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Samuel went home to Ramah, and Saul returned to his home in Gibeah.
translation_verse: Akee Samoɛle hɔle Releema; Sɔɔlo noko hɔle ye sua zo Gebɛya.

english_verse: Even though Samuel felt sad about Saul, Samuel never saw him again. The Lord Chooses David To Be King The Lord was sorry he had made Saul the king of Israel.
translation_verse: Samoɛle annwu Sɔɔlo bieko toonwo ɔdaye Samoɛle ɔwule, noko ɔlile Sɔɔlo anwo nyane. Ɛdɛnkɛma vule ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛle Sɔɔlo Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a.

english_verse: One day he said, “Samuel, I've rejected Saul, and I refuse to let him be king any longer. Stop feeling sad about him. Put some olive oil in a small container and go visit a man named Jesse, who lives in Bethlehem. I've chosen one of his sons to be my king.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale Samoɛle kɛ, “Kenle nyɛ yɛɛ ɛfa wɔali Sɔɔlo anwo nyane a? Mekpo ye, ɔnli Yizilayɛ belemgbunli bieko. Dwazo fa ɔlivi nwole gua wɔ ɛweɛne ne anu. Mesoa wɔ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛmenli Gyɛsi ɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ meye ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ ko kɛ mesie ye belemgbunli.”

english_verse: Samuel answered, “If I do that, Saul will find out and have me killed.” “Take a calf with you,” the Lord replied. “Tell everyone that you've come to offer it as a sacrifice to me,
translation_verse: Samoɛle bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Kɛ menzi mengɔ ye ɛ? Saa Sɔɔlo te nwolɛ bie a, ɔbahu me.” Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye kɛ, “Fa ɛnlankɛ ekyi ko kɔ, na ka ye kɛ, ‘Mera mebabɔ azu meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.’

translation_verse: Anrɛɛ to ɛsalɛ fɛlɛ Gyɛsi wɔ azubɔlɛ ne abo, na mebahile wɔ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la. Ahenle mɔɔ mebaye ye meamaa wɔ la, fa nwole gua ɔ ti zo sie ye belemgbunli.”

english_verse: Samuel did what the Lord told him and went to Bethlehem. The town leaders went to meet him, but they were terribly afraid and asked, “Is this a friendly visit?”
translation_verse: Samoɛle diele mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele ye la na ɔhɔle Suakpole Bɛtelɛhɛm azo. Mgbanyima ne vale sulosulo rayiale ye, na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛrale ye anzonudwolɛ nu ɔ?”

english_verse: “Yes, it is!” Samuel answered. “I've come to offer a sacrifice to the Lord. Get yourselves ready to take part in the sacrifice and come with me.” Samuel also invited Jesse and his sons to come to the sacrifice, and he got them ready to take part.
translation_verse: Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, me nee anzonudwolɛ a rale a; mera kɛ mebabɔ azu meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yemɔti awie biala ɛde ɔ nwo ɛmaa yɛhɔbɔ azu ne.” Ɔmanle Gyɛsi nee ɔ mra ne mɔ noko dele bɛ nwo, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ azubɔlɛ ne abo.

english_verse: When Jesse and his sons arrived, Samuel noticed Jesse's oldest son, Eliab. “He has to be the one the Lord has chosen,” Samuel said to himself.
translation_verse: Bɛdwule ɛkɛ ne na Samoɛle nwunle Gyɛsi ara Yilayabe la, ɔhanle ye ɔ ti akunlu kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye ye a.”

english_verse: But the Lord told him, “Samuel, don't think Eliab is the one just because he's tall and handsome. He isn't the one I've chosen. People judge others by what they look like, but I judge people by what is in their hearts.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Mmanea ɔ nyunlu anzɛɛ ye anyinlima ne anwo, ɔboalekɛ tɛ yemɔ yɛɛ meye ye a, ɔluakɛ mennea sonla kɛmɔ dasanli si nea ye la. Dasanli nea sonla ɛnyelɛ zo ala, na mame, menea sonla ahonle nu.”

english_verse: Jesse told his son Abinadab to go over to Samuel, but Samuel said, “No, the Lord hasn't chosen him.”
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛsi vɛlɛle ɔ ra Abenadabe manle Samoɛle nleanle ye. Na ɔzele kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, tɛ ɛhye a Ɛdɛnkɛma kpondɛ ye a.”

english_verse: Next, Jesse sent his son Shammah to him, and Samuel said, “The Lord hasn't chosen him either.”
translation_verse: Eza Gyɛsi vɛlɛle ɔ ra Hyama manle ɔrale, na Samoɛle zele kɛ, “Tɛ ɛhye a Ɛdɛnkɛma kpondɛ ye a.”

english_verse: One by one, Jesse told all seven of his sons to go over to Samuel. Finally, Samuel said, “Jesse, the Lord hasn't chosen any of these young men.

english_verse: Do you have any other sons?” “Yes,” Jesse answered. “My youngest son David is out taking care of the sheep.” “Send for him!” Samuel said. “We won't start the ceremony until he gets here.”

english_verse: Jesse sent for David. He was a healthy, good-looking boy with a sparkle in his eyes. As soon as David came, the Lord told Samuel, “He's the one! Get up and pour the olive oil on his head.”

english_verse: Samuel poured the oil on David's head while his brothers watched. At that moment, the Spirit of the Lord took control of David and stayed with him from then on. Samuel returned home to Ramah. David Plays the Harp for Saul
translation_verse: Samoɛle vale ɔlivi nwole ɛweɛne ko ne na ɔwolale ɔguale ɔ ti zo wɔ ɔ mediema ne mɔ anyunlu ɛkɛ. Ɛkɛ ne ala Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Devidi anwo zo na ɔvi mekɛ ne anu ɔhale ɔ nwo bɔkɔɔ. Na Samoɛle ziale hɔle Releema. Devidi wɔ Sɔɔlo suakunlu

english_verse: “All right,” Saul answered. “Find me someone who is good at playing the harp and bring him here.”
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo zele ye sonvolɛma ne kɛ, “Bɛhɔkpondɛ sonla mɔɔ ze ye bɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ la na bɛva ye bɛrɛlɛ me.”

english_verse: “A man named Jesse who lives in Bethlehem has a son who can play the harp,” one official said. “He's a brave warrior, he's good-looking, he can speak well, and the Lord is with him.”
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ko zele kɛ, “Gyɛsi mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm la amra mrenya ne mɔ ko ze ye bɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ. Ɔle sonla mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ, ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ, ɔze konle nye zo kpalɛ, ɔ nloa ɛde, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne wɔ ye nu.”

english_verse: Saul sent a message to Jesse: “Tell your son David to leave your sheep and come here to me.”

english_verse: Jesse loaded a donkey with bread and a goatskin full of wine, then he told David to take the donkey and a young goat to Saul.

translation_verse: Golayate vindele radeanle nu zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛra bɛ nee yɛ baho a? Mame, mele Filisitianli, na bɛmɛ, bɛle Sɔɔlo ahanra! Bɛdabɛ bɛye bɛ sonla mɔɔ le katakyie la bɛmaa ɔ nee me yɛva konle ne yɛbɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: and picked up his shepherd's stick. He went out to a stream and picked up five smooth rocks and put them in his leather bag. Then with his sling in his hand, he went straight toward Goliath. David Kills Goliath
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye kpɔma ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔka ye mboane ne la na ɔsesale awolɛ nnu wɔ azudenle ne anu ɔguale ye mboaneneavolɛ kodoku ne anu; ɔvale ye totoabɔ ne, na akee ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkayia Golayate. Devidi di Golayate anwo zo konim

english_verse: One day, Jesse told David, “Hurry and take this sack of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread to your brothers at the army camp.
translation_verse: Kenle ko Gyɛsi zele Devidi kɛ, “Fa ma ngyehye ye kilo bulu nee kpanwo ahunguma bulu ye ka ɛ nwo fa kɔmaa ɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ wɔ konle azokoɛleɛ nehane;

english_verse: And here are ten large chunks of cheese to take to their commanding officer. Find out how your brothers are doing and bring back something that shows that they're all right.
translation_verse: eza fa ‘kyiisi’ bulu ye kɔmaa sonla ne mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la. Nea kɛ ɛ mediema ne mɔ anwo si de la na fa debie fi bɛ nwo lɔ bahile me kɛ amgba ɛnwunle bɛ na bɛte kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: They're with Saul's army, fighting the Philistines in Elah Valley.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo nee ɛ mediema ne mɔ nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yila Bɔnza bɛ nee Filisitiama ɛlɛko.”

english_verse: David obeyed his father. He got up early the next morning and left someone else in charge of the sheep; then he loaded the supplies and started off. He reached the army camp just as the soldiers were taking their places and shouting the battle cry.
translation_verse: Aleɛbahye ne ala Devidi vale mboane ne mɔ wulale awie asa anu, na ɔvale aleɛ ne ɔzile nu ɔhɔle, kɛmɔ ɔ ze Gyɛsi zele ye la. Ɔdwule azokoɛleɛ ne la ɛnee ɛlɔnema ne ɛdu ɛdenrɛ ɛlɛto konle edwɛne ahɔ konle ne anloa.

english_verse: The army of Israel and the Philistine army stood there facing each other.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne nee Filisitia ɛlɔnema ne gyinlanle ye ekpunli ekpunli, bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: David left his things with the man in charge of supplies and ran up to the battle line to ask his brothers if they were well.
translation_verse: Devidi vale ninyɛne ne wulale safohyenle ne mɔɔ nea ninyɛne zo la asa anu, na ɔnriandile ɔhɔle ɛlɔnema ne anu ɔhɔbizale ɔ mediema ne mɔ ahye na ɔbizale bɛ agbɔkɛ nu.

english_verse: While David was talking with them, Goliath came out from the line of Philistines and started boasting as usual. David heard him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ ɛlɛtendɛ la, Golayate vi Filisitiama avinli ragyinlanle ɔ bo zo ne na ɔdeanle nu kɛ ɔkpondɛ nrenya aye ɔ nyunlu nee ye araho. Ɔhehanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔkeha ye dɛba la. Na Devidi dele.

english_verse: When the Israelite soldiers saw Goliath, they were scared and ran off.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ne nwunle Golayate la, bɛ ahonle dule na bɛnwenwenle.

english_verse: They said to each other, “Look how he keeps coming out to insult us. The king is offering a big reward to the man who kills Goliath. That man will even get to marry the king's daughter, and no one in his family will ever have to pay taxes again.”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ne zele kɛ, “Bɛnwu nrenya ɛhye mɔɔ ɛvinde la? Nɔhalɛ, yera ɔbagolo Yizilayɛma anwo. Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu ye la, ɔkɛmaa ye anwonyia kpole kpalɛ; eza ɔkɛva ɔ ra raalɛ ne ɔkɛmaa ye agyalɛ na eza ɔkɛmaa ɔ ze awuke nu amra fanwodi wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu.”

english_verse: David asked some soldiers standing nearby, “What will a man get for killing this Philistine and stopping him from insulting our people? Who does that worthless Philistine think he is? He's making fun of the army of the living God!”
translation_verse: Devidi bizale menli mɔɔ gyigyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Duzu ahyɛlɛdeɛ a sonla mɔɔ kɛhu Filisitianli ye na ɔkɛlie Yizilayɛma ɔkɛvi anyiemgba ɛhye anu la banyia a? Ɔluakɛ, Filisitianli ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la a le nwane, mɔɔ ɔdaye bɔbɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔko ɔtia tease Nyamenle ne ɛlɔnema a?”

english_verse: The soldiers told David what the king would give the man who killed Goliath.
translation_verse: Na menli ne hanle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛhu ye la kɛnyia la hilele ye.

english_verse: David's oldest brother Eliab heard him talking with the soldiers. Eliab was angry with him and said, “What are you doing here, anyway? Who's taking care of your little flock of sheep out in the desert? You spoiled brat! You came here just to watch the fighting, didn't you?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi ka edwɛkɛ ɛhye ahile menli ne la, ɔ diema kpanyinli Yilayabe dele; ɔvale Devidi anwo ɛya kpole na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔra ɛke a? Nwane asa anu a wɔva mboane ne mɔ wɔwula wɔ fienemgbole ne anu a? Ɛle kakula wuwimɔ. Wɔra kɛ ɛbanlea konle ne sinlinyunlu ɔ?”

english_verse: “Now what have I done?” David answered. “Can't I even ask a question?”
translation_verse: Na Devidi bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a meyɛ a? Tɛ edwɛkɛ mgbane a membizale a?”

english_verse: Then he turned and asked another soldier the same thing he had asked the others, and he got the same answer.
translation_verse: Ɔhakyile ɔ nye sonla fofolɛ nwo na ɔbizale ye edwɛkɛ ko ne ala, na mualɛ ko ne ala a bɛvale bɛmanle ye a.

english_verse: Some soldiers overheard David talking, so they told Saul what David had said. Saul sent for David, and David came.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdele Devidi ngehanleɛ ne la, bɛbɔle Sɔɔlo amaneɛ, na Sɔɔlo zoanle manle bɛhɔvale ye.

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” he said, “this Philistine shouldn't turn us into cowards. I'll go out and fight him myself!”
translation_verse: Devidi hanle hilele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Awie biala mmasulo Golayate; medame, wɔ sonvolɛ, me nee Filisitianli ne baho ye mrenyazo.”

english_verse: “You don't have a chance against him,” Saul replied. “You're only a boy, and he's been a soldier all his life.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo zele Devidi kɛ “Kyɛkyɛ, ɛ nee Filisitianli ne ɛnrɛhola ko, ɔluakɛ sumunli ye mbɛda nu yeho toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, na wɔmɔ, ɛle konle nu adɔma.”

english_verse: But David told him: Your Majesty, I take care of my father's sheep. And when one of them is dragged off by a lion or a bear,
translation_verse: Na Devidi zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Wɔ sonvolɛ, menea egya mboane; mekɛ biala mɔɔ awenade anzɛɛ bedi kɛhye bie la,

english_verse: I go after it and beat the wild animal until it lets the sheep go. If the wild animal turns and attacks me, I grab it by the throat and kill it.
translation_verse: mefoa ye toonwo mekye ye, meboda ye, na mesa ye medie. Na saa yeamkponle na ɔba me nwo zo a mesɔ ɔ kɔmenza, memia ye toonwo meku ye.

english_verse: Sir, I have killed lions and bears that way, and I can kill this worthless Philistine. He shouldn't have made fun of the army of the living God!
translation_verse: Wɔ sonvolɛ ɛhu awenade nee bedi mɔ, na Filisitianli ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la bawu kɛ awenade anzɛɛ bedi ne mɔ ko ala la, ɔluakɛ yeanli tease Nyamenle ne ɛlɔnema ne eni.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued me from the claws of lions and bears, and he will keep me safe from the hands of this Philistine. “All right,” Saul answered, “go ahead and fight him. And I hope the Lord will help you.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ liele me vile awenade nee bedi ne mɔ asa anu la balie me avi Filisitianli ɛhye asa anu.” Sɔɔlo zele Devidi kɛ, “Kɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma nee wɔ ɛhɔ.”

english_verse: Saul had his own military clothes and armor put on David, and he gave David a bronze helmet to wear.
translation_verse: Akee Sɔɔlo vale ɔdaye mumua ne ye konle tɛladeɛ wulale Devidi, ɔvale ye konle kɔbele kyɛlɛ ne ɔzoale ye, na ɔvale ye mbulalɛ tɛladeɛ ne ɔwulale Devidi.

english_verse: David strapped on a sword and tried to walk around, but he was not used to wearing those things. “I can't move with all this stuff on,” David said. “I'm just not used to it.” David took off the armor
translation_verse: Devidi vale Sɔɔlo konle dadeɛ ne zianle ɔ nwo. Ɔhyehyɛle ɔ nwo bɔkɔɔ ɔwiele la, yeangola ɔ gyakɛ ko bɔbɔ tu. Na ɔzele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Metɛfale konle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bie metɛsieziele me nwo ɛlɛ, yemɔti mefa mekɔ konle ne a, ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ.” Na Devidi kpolokpolole bɛ guale.

english_verse: Goliath came toward David, walking behind the soldier who was carrying his shield.
translation_verse: Golayate dudule agyakɛ bikyele Devidi; ye sonla ne mɔɔ zo ye konle ninyɛne ne la li ɔ nyunlu. Ɔrale ɔ nyunlu kpalɛ,

english_verse: When Goliath saw that David was just a healthy, good-looking boy, he made fun of him.
translation_verse: na ɔnwunle Devidi la, ɛnee ɔnnwu debie mɔɔ Devidi zɔho a; ɔnwunle ye ala kɛ ɔle kpavolɛ na ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ.

english_verse: “Do you think I'm a dog?” Goliath asked. “Is that why you've come after me with a stick?” He cursed David in the name of the Philistine gods
translation_verse: Ɔzele Devidi kɛ, “Ɛdwenle kɛ mele twea mɔɔ yemɔti ɛ nee me baho a ɛnee ɛfa baka a?” Na Golayate vale ye nyamenle ne wale Devidi amonle.

english_verse: and shouted, “Come on! When I'm finished with you, I'll feed you to the birds and wild animals!”
translation_verse: Ɔzele Devidi kɛ, “Bɛla maa menva wɔ nwonane memaa anwomanyunlu nloma nee ɛbɔkunlu nanemgbole ɛli.”

english_verse: David answered: You've come out to fight me with a sword and a spear and a dagger. But I've come out to fight you in the name of the Lord All-Powerful. He is the God of Israel's army, and you have insulted him too!
translation_verse: Devidi buale Filisitianli ne kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛ nee konle dadeɛ, atwɛ yɛɛ akuma a ɛra a, na mame, me nee Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛmbu ye la a rale a.

english_verse: Today the Lord will help me defeat you. I'll knock you down and cut off your head, and I'll feed the bodies of the other Philistine soldiers to the birds and wild animals. Then the whole world will know that Israel has a real God.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kenle ye, Ɛdɛnkɛma baye wɔ awula me sa nu, mebabɔ wɔ meado aze na meapɛ ɛ ti. Mebava Filisitia ɛlɔnema ne avunli meamaa anwomanyunlu nloma nee ɛbɔkunlu nanemgbole ali, amaa aleɛabo amra kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ Yizilayɛma lɛ Nyamenle,

english_verse: Everybody here will see that the Lord doesn't need swords or spears to save his people. The Lord always wins his battles, and he will help us defeat you.
translation_verse: na menli mɔɔ ɛyia ɛke la kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnva dadeɛ nee atwɛ a die ye menli a, ɔluakɛ konle ne le ye ɛdeɛ, na Ɛdɛnkɛma baye bɛ kɔsɔɔti amaa yɛ.”

english_verse: He put a rock in his sling and swung the sling around by its straps. When he let go of one strap, the rock flew out and hit Goliath on the forehead. It cracked his skull, and he fell facedown on the ground.
translation_verse: Devidi yele bozane ko ye kodoku ne anu, ɔvale ɔwulale ye totoabɔ ne anu, ɔdole ɔbɔle Golayate. Bolɛ ne yiale ɔ nwoma azo na ɔminle ɔhɔle nu. Golayate dule dɔle aze mutule nu.

english_verse: David defeated Goliath with a sling and a rock. He killed him without even using a sword.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, Devidi vale totoabɔ mgbane hunle Golayate na ɔlile ɔ nwo zo konim. Devidi anva dadeɛ, ɔvale ɔ sa mgbane.

english_verse: David ran over and pulled out Goliath's sword. Then he used it to cut off Goliath's head. When the Philistines saw what had happened to their hero, they started running away.
translation_verse: Akee Devidi nriandile hɔvole gyinlanle Golayate anwo zo, ɔhwenle Golayate mumua ne dadeɛ ne wɔ ye boa ne anu, na ɔvale ɔpɛle Golayate ati. Mɔɔ Filisitiama nwunle kɛ bɛhu bɛ sonla anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ li bɛ ti la, bɛguale ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: But the soldiers of Israel and Judah let out a battle cry and went after them as far as Gath and Ekron. The bodies of the Philistines were scattered all along the road from Shaaraim to Gath and Ekron.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama vale fɛlɛkolilɛ nee ɛwudolɛ voanle Filisitiama ndinlizo toonwo bɛhɔdwule Gate yɛɛ Ɛkelɔn nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa. Adenle ne mɔɔ vi Gate kɔ Ɛkelɔn nee Hyeeyaleeyem la anu yɛle avunli ngome.

english_verse: When the Israelite army returned from chasing the Philistines, they took what they wanted from the enemy camp.
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛma gyakyile bɛ ɛvoanlɛ na bɛziale bɛrale Filisitiama azokoɛleɛ ne, bɛravulovulale bɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔle.

english_verse: David took Goliath's head to Jerusalem, but he kept Goliath's weapons in his own tent. David Becomes One of Saul's Officers
translation_verse: Na Devidi vale Golayate ati ne hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɔgyakyile Golayate konle ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ ɔdaye ye ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu. Bɛva Devidi bɛhɔ Sɔɔlo anyunlu

english_verse: After King Saul had watched David go out to fight Goliath, Saul turned to the commander of his army and said, “Abner, who is that young man?” “Your Majesty,” Abner answered, “I swear by your life that I don't know.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo nwunle kɛ Devidi ɛlɛkɔ ɔ nee Filisitianli ne ahɔho la, ɔbizale Abenɛɛ mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anwo zo la kɛ, “Nwane ara a le kpavolɛ ɛhye?” Abenɛɛ buale ye kɛ, “Nana, metane wɔ kɛ menze.”

english_verse: “Then find out!” Saul told him.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Ɛnee kɔ kɔbiza.”

english_verse: and Saul asked, “Who are you?” “I am David the son of Jesse, a loyal Israelite from Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo bizale ye kɛ, “Kpavolɛ, ɛ ze a le nwane?” Devidi buale ye kɛ, “Wɔ sonvolɛ nrenya Gyɛsi mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm la ara nrenya a le me.”

english_verse: From that time on, Saul kept David in his service and would not let David go back to his own family.
translation_verse: Na ɔvi kenle ko ne Sɔɔlo ammaa Devidi angɔ ɔ ze sua nu.

english_verse: Jonathan liked David so much that they promised to always be loyal friends.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan nee Devidi yɛle agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ngyekyeleɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔkulo Devidi kɛ ɔdaye ɔ nwo la.

english_verse: Jonathan took off the robe that he was wearing and gave it to David. He also gave him his military clothes, his sword, his bow and arrows, and his belt.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔnatan yele ɔdaye ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la ɔmanle Devidi wulale, ɔvale ye konle tɛladeɛ ne, ye dadeɛ ne, ye ɛda ne nee ye akyeso ne kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Devidi.

english_verse: David was a success in everything that Saul sent him to do, and Saul made him a high officer in his army. That pleased everyone, including Saul's other officers. Saul Becomes David's Enemy
translation_verse: Ɛzoanlɛ nee gyima biala mɔɔ Sɔɔlo vale manle Devidi la, ɔyɛle bɛ muala gyɛlɛɛnye; yemɔti Sɔɔlo yɛle ye safohyenle wɔ ye ɛlɔne ne anu. Awie biala, bɔbɔ Sɔɔlo sonvolɛma ne akunlu dwole fɔɔnwo wɔ Devidi gyinlabelɛ ne anwo. Sɔɔlo nyia Devidi anwo adwenle ɛtane

english_verse: David had killed Goliath, the battle was over, and the Israelite army set out for home. As the army went along, women came out of each Israelite town to welcome King Saul. They were celebrating by singing songs and dancing to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi hunle Filisitianli ne na bɛsia bɛara sua nu la, mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la vindele vale akɛya ɛwozolɛ, edwɛnedolɛ yɛɛ agolezilɛ rayiale Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo.

english_verse: They sang: Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand!
translation_verse: Wɔ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne anu bɛdole edwɛne bɛzele kɛ, “Sɔɔlo ɛhu apenle apenle, na Devidi ɛhu apenle apenle bulu.”

english_verse: This song made Saul very angry, and he thought, “They are saying that David has killed ten times more enemies than I ever did. Next they will want to make him king.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo vale ɛya kpole, ɔluakɛ edwɛne ne agbɔkɛ ne mɔ anyɛ ye fɛ. Ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛva apenle apenle bulu bɛmaa Devidi, yɛɛ mame, bɛva apenle apenle ala a bɛmaa me a. Duzu bieko yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia a? Me belemgbunli maanle ne ala.”

english_verse: The next day the Lord let an evil spirit take control of Saul, and he began acting like a crazy man inside his house. David came to play the harp for Saul as usual, but this time Saul had a spear in his hand.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Nyamenle manle sunsum ɛtane bie dwule Sɔɔlo anwo zo, na ɔdeɛdeanle nu mgbane mgbane wɔ ye sua ne anu. Devidi bɔle ye sanwule ne, kɛmɔ ɔbɔ ye dɛba ne ala la. Mekɛ zɔhane ɛnee Sɔɔlo lɛ ye atwɛ ne ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Saul thought, “I'll pin David to the wall.” He threw the spear at David twice, but David dodged and got away both times.
translation_verse: Ɔvale adwenle kɛ, “Mebɛtɛ Devidi wɔ bane ne anwo.” Yemɔti ɔdole atwɛ ne fane nwiɔ na Devidi yele ɔ nwo ɛkɛ fane nwiɔ ne.

english_verse: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was helping David and was no longer helping him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo sulo Devidi kpole, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne ɛva Devidi na Sɔɔlo ɛdeɛ ne ɛvi ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord helped David, and he and his soldiers always won their battles.
translation_verse: na ɔlile bɛ muala anu konim, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye lua.

english_verse: But everyone else in Judah and Israel was loyal to David, because he led the army in battle.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛdeɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhulole Devidi edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ saleɛ doa ye. Devidi gya Sɔɔlo ara raalɛ

english_verse: One day, Saul told David, “If you'll be brave and fight the Lord's battles for me, I'll let you marry my oldest daughter Merab.” But Saul was really thinking, “I don't want to kill David myself, so I'll let the Philistines do it for me.”
translation_verse: Akee Sɔɔlo zele Devidi kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ kpanyinli Milabe ɛne. Mefa ye meamaa wɔagya; debie mɔɔ hyia wɔ afoa nu la a le kɛ ɛkɛzi ahonle ɛkɛli nɔhalɛ ɛkɛmaa me na ɛkɛho ɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

english_verse: David answered, “How could I possibly marry your daughter? I'm not very important, and neither is my family.”
translation_verse: Devidi buale kɛ, “Na mame bɔbɔ a le nwane, yɛɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu, egya sua nu amra bɔbɔ a le nwane mɔ, kɛ medame menwɔyɛ belemgbunli ara raalɛ ɔ hu a?”

english_verse: But when the time came for David to marry Saul's daughter Merab, Saul told her to marry Adriel from the town of Meholah.
translation_verse: Na mekɛ ne dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa Sɔɔlo ara raalɛ Milabe bɛmaa Devidi gya la, akee bɛvale ye bɛmanle nrenya fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Edeleɛle mɔɔ vi Mɛhola la.

english_verse: Saul had another daughter. Her name was Michal, and Saul found out that she was in love with David. This made Saul happy,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo ara raalɛ Maekale hulole Devidi kpole. Mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele Sɔɔlo la ɔ nye liele nwolɛ somaa.

english_verse: and he thought, “I'll tell David he can marry Michal, but I'll set it up so that the Philistines will kill him.” He told David, “I'm going to give you a second chance to marry one of my daughters.”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo hanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ, “Mefa ye meamaa Devidi; mefa meazua ye ɛhane, amaa Filisitiama ahu ye.” Yemɔti eza Sɔɔlo zele Devidi kɛ, “Memaa wɔagya me ra raalɛ ne.”

english_verse: Saul ordered his officials to speak to David in private, so they went to David and said, “Look, the king likes you, and all of his officials are loyal to you. Why not ask the king if you can marry his daughter Michal?” “I'm not rich or famous enough to marry princess Michal!” David answered.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛma ne dɛle guale Devidi anzo nu toonwo bɛmanle ɔzele kɛ, “Medame mumua ne, membɔnle nzule, membɔnle nza; bɛnea a ɔle debie ekyi kɛ menwɔgya belemgbunli ara raalɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The officials went back to Saul and told him exactly what David had said.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛma ne zele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Devidi edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛha la ɛne.”

english_verse: Saul was hoping that the Philistines would kill David, and he told his officials to tell David, “The king doesn't want any silver or gold. He only wants to get even with his enemies. All you have to do is to bring back proof that you have killed
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo zele kɛ, “Bɛhɔze Devidi kɛ, belemgbunli ɛmkpondɛ agyalɛ ne anwo debie biala. Ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔsenra ye kpɔvolɛma ne, yemɔti mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la a le Filisitiama ɛya ko mrenyanu ati nwoma ne mɔ.”

english_verse: The officials told David, and David wanted to marry the princess. King Saul had set a time limit, and before it ran out,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo sonvolɛma ne hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Devidi la, ɔyɛle ye fɛ kpole kɛ ɔbagya belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne a. Ɔka ekyii na atɔfolɛlielɛ mekɛ ne adwu la,

english_verse: King Saul knew that she loved David, and he also realized that the Lord was helping David.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ Sɔɔlo nwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Devidi lua na Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kulo ye edwɛkɛ la,

english_verse: The Philistine rulers kept coming to fight Israel, but whenever David fought them, he won. He was famous because he won more battles against the Philistines than any of Saul's other officers.
translation_verse: Filisitiama rale fane dɔɔnwo kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho, na mekɛ biala Devidi lile bɛ nwo zo konim. Ɔlile konim dɔɔnwo ɔdɛlale Sɔɔlo mgbanyima mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema anwo zo la kɔsɔɔti. Yemɔti Devidi duma nee ye nganeɛ dwule maanle ti nee maanle bo.

english_verse: One day, Saul told his son Jonathan and his officers to kill David. But Jonathan and David were best friends,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo zele ɔ ra Dwɔnatan nee ye sonvolɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ bɛhu Devidi. Dwɔnatan ɛnee kulo Devidi edwɛkɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: The next morning, Jonathan reminded Saul about the many good things David had done for him. Then he said, “Why do you want to kill David? He hasn't done anything to you. He has served in your army and has always done what's best for you. He even risked his life to kill Goliath. The Lord helped Israel win a great victory that day, and it made you happy.”
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole nzeleba ɔhunle Golayate, na Ɛdɛnkɛma lile konim manle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti. Ɛnwunle ye la, ɛlile fɛlɛko, na duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɛku Devidi mgbane gyɛne ne ala, ɛka mogya mɔɔ ɛnli fɔlɛ la ɛgua ɛ?”

english_verse: Saul agreed and promised, “I swear by the living Lord that I won't have David killed!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo diele Dwɔnatan na ɔhanle ndane kɛ, “Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze la, bɛnrɛhu Devidi ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan went to David and told him what Saul had said. Then he brought David to Saul, and David served in Saul's army just as he had done before.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan vɛlɛle Devidi na ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne kɔsɔɔti ɔhilele ye. Ɔvale Devidi ɔhɔle ɔ ze anyunlu, na Sɔɔlo nee ye dɛnlanle, na Devidi zonlenle belemgbunli ne kɛ dɛba ne ala la.

english_verse: The next time there was a war with the Philistines, David fought hard and forced them to retreat. Michal Helps David Escape
translation_verse: Konle zile Yizilayɛma nee Filisitiama avinli bieko. Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne lile Filisitiama anwo zo konim bɔkɔɔ. Bɛhunle Filisitiama dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, na mɔɔ hale la guale ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: One night, David was in Saul's home, playing the harp for him. Saul was sitting there, holding a spear, when an evil spirit from the Lord took control of him. Saul tried to pin David to the wall with the spear, but David dodged, and it stuck in the wall. David ran out of the house and escaped.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo dole ye atwɛ ne kɛ ɔbɛtɛ Devidi wɔ bane ne anwo. Devidi yele ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na atwɛ ne hɔminle bane ne anu. Devidi nriandile vindele na ɔyele ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: Saul sent guards to watch David's house all night and then to kill him in the morning. Michal, David's wife, told him, “If you don't escape tonight, they'll kill you tomorrow!”
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne nɔsolɛ, Sɔɔlo zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔzinza Devidi sua ne na nwonlomɔ bɛ sa aha ye bɛahu ye. Na Devidi aye Maekale hwenle Devidi anzo kɛ, “Saa ɛnɛ nɔe wɔanye ɛ nwo zo a, nwonlomɔ mangyee ne bɛbahu wɔ.”

english_verse: She helped David leave through a window and climb down to the ground. As David ran off,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Maekale dwulale Devidi aze wɔ nvɛnzɛlɛ nu manle ɔnriandile.

english_verse: Michal put a statue in his bed. She put goat hair on its head and dressed it in some of David's clothes.
translation_verse: Akee Maekale vale ananze dedale ye kɛ sonla la wɔ ɛsokpa ne azo. Ɔvale esumi mɔɔ bɛva abɔnkye enrinli bɛwula la ɔzɔle ɔ ti, na ɔdule ɛdanlɛ ɔguale ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The next morning, Saul sent guards to arrest David. But Michal told them, “David is sick.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo soanvolɛma mɔɔ hɔle kɛ bɛkahye Devidi la dwule sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, ɔ ye zele bɛ kɛ, “Devidi ɛnde kpɔkɛ.”

english_verse: Saul sent the guards back and told them, “Bring David to me—bed and all—so I can kill him.”
translation_verse: Sonvolɛma ne hɔbɔle Sɔɔlo amaneɛ, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔdwu ye nee ye ɛsokpa ne amuala bɛrɛlɛ me bɛmaa mengu ye.”

english_verse: When the guards went in, all they found in the bed was the statue with the goat hair on its head.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ sonvolɛma ne hɔle la, bɛnwunle kɛ ananze a la ɛsokpa ne azo na abɔnkye enrinli esumi zɔ ɔ ti a.

english_verse: “Why have you tricked me this way?” Saul asked Michal. “You helped my enemy get away!” She answered, “He said he would kill me if I didn't help him escape!” Samuel Helps David Escape
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo bizale Maekale kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ wɔbɛlɛbɛla me zɛhae wɔmaa me kpɔvolɛ ɛvi me sa ɛ?” Maekale buale Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Ɔnwunlonwunlanle me kɛ saa meamboa ye meammaa yeanriandi a, ɔkɛhu me.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, David went to Samuel at Ramah and told him what Saul had done. Then Samuel and David went to Prophets Village and stayed there.
translation_verse: Devidi nriandile hɔle Samoɛle anwo lɔ wɔ Releema na ɔvale nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Sɔɔlo ɛyɛ ye la amuala ɔbɔle ye amaneɛ. Na ɔ nee Samoɛle hɔdɛnlanle Naeyo.

english_verse: Someone told Saul, “David is at Prophets Village in Ramah.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔbɔle Sɔɔlo amaneɛ kɛ Devidi wɔ Naeyo mɔɔ wɔ Releema la.

english_verse: Saul sent a few soldiers to bring David back. They went to Ramah and found Samuel in charge of a group of prophets who were all prophesying. Then the Spirit of God took control of the soldiers and they started prophesying too.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɔɔlo zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔhye ye, na mɔɔ bɛnwunle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ Samoɛle li bɛ ti, na bɛlɛsi agole bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la, Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Sɔɔlo soanvolɛma ne anwo zo, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛzile agole bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ.

english_verse: When Saul heard what had happened, he sent some more soldiers, but they prophesied just like the first group. He sent a third group of soldiers, but the same thing happened to them.
translation_verse: Bɛrahanle edwɛkɛ ne bɛhilele Sɔɔlo na ɔzoanle menli fofolɛ, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔbokale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ekpunli ne anwo. Eza Sɔɔlo zoanle menli bieko, ɛhye tɔ zolɛ fane nsa, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔbokale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ekpunli ne anwo.

english_verse: Finally, Saul left for Ramah himself. He went as far as the deep pit at the town of Secu, and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” “At Prophets Village in Ramah,” the people answered.
translation_verse: Akee ɔdaye mumua ne ɔzile nu kɛ ɔkɔ Releema. Ɔradwule bula kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ Siku la anwo la, ɔbizale kɛ, “Samoɛle nee Devidi, nienwu yɛɛ bɛwɔ a?” Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Bɛwɔ Naeyo mɔɔ wɔ Releema la.”

english_verse: Saul left for Ramah. But as he walked along, the Spirit of God took control of him, and he started prophesying. Then, when he reached Prophets Village,
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔle Naeyo mɔɔ wɔ Releema la, na ye ɛhɔlɛ nu, Nyamenle Sunsum ne dwule ɔdaye noko ɔ nwo zo, na mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la ɛnee ɔlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule Naeyo mɔɔ wɔ Releema la.

english_verse: he stripped off his clothes and prophesied in front of Samuel. He dropped to the ground and lay there naked all that day and night. That's how the saying started, “Is Saul now a prophet?”
translation_verse: Ɔdaye noko ɔyeyele ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ na ɔhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne wɔ Samoɛle anyunlu ɛkɛ ne. Kenle ko ne ewia ne nee nɔe ne ɔlɛle ɔ nwo zɔ.

english_verse: David escaped from Prophets Village. Then he ran to see Jonathan and asked, “Why does your father Saul want to kill me? What have I done wrong?”
translation_verse: Devidi vi Naeyo mɔɔ wɔ Releema la nriandile hɔle Dwɔnatan anwo lɔ. Ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a meyɛ a? Duzu fɔlɛ a medi a? Duzu ɛtane a meyɛ metia ɛ ze mɔɔ yemɔti ɔlɛkpondɛ me yeahu me a?”

english_verse: “My father can't be trying to kill you! He never does anything without telling me about it. Why would he hide this from me? It can't be true!”
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan buale ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpa ɛgua; ɛnrɛwu. Nea, egya ɛnrɛyɛ debie biala, kpole o, ekyi o, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtɛfetele zolɛ ɔtɛkilele me la. Na duzu ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ egya fea me edwɛkɛ nu a? Ɔnle nɔhalɛ.”

english_verse: “Jonathan, I swear it's true! But your father knows how much you like me, and he didn't want to break your heart. That's why he didn't tell you. I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I'm only one step ahead of death.”
translation_verse: Devidi buale kɛ, “Ɛ ze ze ye wienyi kɛ ɛkulo me edwɛkɛ, yemɔti yedwenle nwolɛ kɛ, ‘Menrɛmaa Dwɔnatan ɛnrɛde nwolɛ bie, anrɛɛ ɔkɛli nyane.’ Na nɔhalɛ nu, meka Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ me ngoane mɔɔ ɛha la le ezinra zɛhae.”

english_verse: Then Jonathan said, “Tell me what to do, and I'll do it.”
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan zele Devidi kɛ, “Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛbiza la, menwɔyɛ menwɔmaa wɔ.”

english_verse: David answered: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and I'm supposed to eat dinner with your father. But instead, I'll hide in a field until the evening of the next day.
translation_verse: Devidi zele Dwɔnatan kɛ, “Ɛhyema le Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia na ɔnle kɛ ɔkpa me ti. Ɔwɔ kɛ mekɔ belemgbunli sua nu me nee ye kɔkpula yɛ sa. Na saa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnee maa me adenle maa menriandi mengɔnvea fienemgbole ne anu lɔ toonwo kenle nsa ne azo nɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: If Saul wonders where I am, tell him, “David asked me to let him go to his hometown of Bethlehem, so he could take part in a sacrifice his family makes there every year.”
translation_verse: Saa wɔ papa nwu kɛ meamba na ɔbiza me bo zo a, ka kile ye kɛ, ‘Devidi zɛlɛle me adenle kɛ ɔbɔ hwii yeahɔ ye sua zo Bɛtelɛhɛm,’ ɔluakɛ ye abusua ne ɛlɛbɔ bɛ ɛvolɛ abusua azu ne.

english_verse: If your father says it's all right, then I'm safe. But if he gets angry, you'll know he wants to harm me.
translation_verse: Saa ɔkponle zolɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ melɛ ngoane. Saa ɔfa ɛya a ɛnee ɔkile kɛ yezi pi kɛ ɔku me.

english_verse: Be kind to me. After all, it was your idea to promise the Lord that we would always be loyal friends. If I've done anything wrong, kill me yourself, but don't hand me over to your father.
translation_verse: Me diema, wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhanle ndane ɛbɔle me la, di zolɛ na nwu me anwunvɔne wɔ ɛhye anwo. Na saa ɛnea na fɔlɛlilɛ bie wɔ me afoa nu a, ɛnee ɛdawɔ mumua ne ku me. Duzu ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa me ɛkɔmaa wɔ papa kɛ ɔhu me a?”

english_verse: “Don't worry,” Jonathan said. “If I find out that my father wants to kill you, I'll certainly let you know.”
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan zele kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpa ɛgua; saa meze kɛ egya ɛva adwenle kɛ ɔku wɔ a, anrɛɛ ɛnea a menrɛha menrɛhile wɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: “Let's go out to this field, and I'll tell you,” Jonathan answered. When they got there,
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan zele Devidi kɛ, “Bɛla, maa yɛhɔ fienemgbole nu lɔ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle fienemgbole ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: Jonathan said: I swear by the Lord God of Israel, that two days from now I'll know what my father is planning. Of course I'll let you know if he's friendly toward you.
translation_verse: Akee Dwɔnatan zele Devidi kɛ, “ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛli yɛ daselɛ. Ɛhyema bekezɛ anzɛɛ ye alehyenlɛ nu bekezɛ ala me nee egya badendɛ. Saa ɔlɛ ɛ nwo adwenle kpalɛ a, mebado wɔ nrɛlaleɛ.

english_verse: But if he wants to harm you, I promise to tell you and help you escape. And I ask the Lord to punish me severely if I don't keep my promise. I pray that the Lord will bless you, just as he used to bless my father.
translation_verse: Saa ɔlɛ ɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane biala na meammaa wɔande, na eza meanlie wɔ ngoane a, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua me kakɛ ɛgua me bie zo. Ɛdɛnkɛma nee wɔ ɛlua, kɛmɔ ɔ nee egya lua la.

english_verse: Jonathan and David made an agreement that even David's descendants would have to keep. Then Jonathan said, “I pray that the Lord will take revenge on your descendants if they break our promise.”
translation_verse: maa ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛbɔ yɛ nwo la anu ɛmia. Saa ɛmaa agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne tete a, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua wɔ kakɛ.”

english_verse: Jonathan thought as much of David as he did of himself, so he asked David to promise once more that he would be a loyal friend.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan manle Devidi bɔle ɛwɔkɛ bieko kɛ ɔkulo ye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwɔnatan kulo Devidi kɛ ɔdaye ɔ nwo.

english_verse: After this Jonathan said: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, and people will wonder where you are, because your place at the table will be empty.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔnatan zele ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛhyema le Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia la, saa wɔamba ɛkponledolɛ ne bie a, awie biala banwu ye, ɔluakɛ wɔ ebia ne bagyinla ɛkɛ ne mgbane.

english_verse: By the day after tomorrow, everyone will think you've been gone a long time. Then go to the place where you hid before and stay beside Going-Away Rock.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nsa ne azo bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛbanwu ye kpalɛ a, yemɔti nriandi kɔvea ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkenle edwɛkɛ ne hyelele zolɛ la ɛhɔveale la, wɔ awolɛ edukue ne anzi.

english_verse: I'll shoot three arrows at a target off to the side of the rock,
translation_verse: Mebado ɛda ɛkɛ ne fane nsa kɛ asɛɛ mefa meazukoa anyendenrɛlɛ la.

english_verse: and send my servant to find the arrows. You'll know if it's safe to come out by what I tell him. If it is safe, I swear by the living Lord that I'll say, “The arrows are on this side of you! Pick them up!”
translation_verse: Na mebazoa me sonvolɛ ne kɛ ɔhɔkpondɛ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ. Saa meka mekile me sonvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Nea, ɛda mbaka ne mɔ wɔ wɔ foa ko ɛke, kɔva’ a, ɛnee finde bɛla, na meka Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ munzule biala ɛnrɛnyia wɔ.

english_verse: But if it isn't safe, I'll say to the boy, “The arrows are farther away!” This will mean that the Lord wants you to leave, and you must go.
translation_verse: Na saa meka mekile me sonvolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Nea, ɛda mbaka ne mɔ wɔ ɛ nyunlu lɔ’ a, ɛnee kɔ moa, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a se ɛhɔ a.

english_verse: But he will always watch us to make sure that we keep the promise we made to each other.
translation_verse: Na ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ yɛ nwo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbaboa yeamaa yɛali zolɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: So David hid there in the field. During the New Moon Festival, Saul sat down to eat
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi hɔveale fienemgbole ne anu. Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne dwule la, Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo radɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi debie.

english_verse: by the wall, just as he always did. Jonathan sat across from him, and Abner sat next to him. But David's place was empty.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛnlanle ebia ne mɔɔ zua bane ne mɔɔ dahuu ɔtɛnla nu la anu, Dwɔnatan dɛnlanle ebia ne mɔɔ nee belemgbunli anye bɔ zolɛ la azo, yɛɛ Abenɛɛ dɛnlanle Sɔɔlo foa ko, na Devidi ebia ɛdeɛ ne awie biala andɛnla zolɛ.

english_verse: Saul didn't say anything that day, because he was thinking, “Something must have happened to make David unfit to be at the Festival. Yes, something must have happened.”
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne Sɔɔlo anga ɛhwee, ɔdwenlenle kɛ edwɛkɛ bie mɔɔ ɛmmaa Devidi anwo ɛnde la ɛzi ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: The day after the New Moon Festival, when David's place was still empty, Saul asked Jonathan, “Why hasn't that son of Jesse come to eat with us? He wasn't here yesterday, and he still isn't here today!”
translation_verse: Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la ɛkponledolɛ ne abo, Devidi ebia ne eza dɔle mgbane. Na Sɔɔlo bizale ɔ ra Dwɔnatan kɛ, “Duzu ati a anoma nee ɛnɛ, Gyɛsi ara Devidi amba ɛkponledolɛ ye bie a?”

english_verse: Jonathan answered, “The reason David hasn't come to eat with you is that he begged me to let him go to Bethlehem. He said, ‘Please let me go. My family is offering a sacrifice, and my brother told me I have to be there. Do me this favor and let me slip away to see my brothers.’ ”
translation_verse: Ɔse, ‘Maa me adenle maa mengɔ, ɔluakɛ yɛ abusua ne ɛlɛbɔ azu, na me mediema ne mɔ ɛhɛla me kɛ membɛla. Yemɔti, saa mezɔ ɛ nye a, ɛnee maa mengɔnwu bɛ.’ Ɛhye ati a ɔnle belemgbunli ɛvoyialilɛ ye abo a.”

english_verse: Saul was furious with Jonathan and yelled, “You're no son of mine, you traitor! I know you've chosen to be loyal to that son of Jesse. You should be ashamed of yourself! And your own mother should be ashamed that you were ever born.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo vale Dwɔnatan anwo ɛya kpole na ɔyɛle ye aholoba kɛ, “Raalɛ kpamgbanvolɛ ra! Menwu ye wienyi kɛ wɔva ɛ nwo wɔbɔnle Devidi na ɛlɛgua ɛdawɔ nee ɛ nli sonlamgbane ne bɛ nyunlu aze.

english_verse: You'll never be safe, and your kingdom will be in danger as long as that son of Jesse is alive. Turn him over to me now! He deserves to die!”
translation_verse: Nwu ye wienyi kɛ, sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ Devidi de ngoane nu la, ɛnrɛnyia belemgbunli ɛnrɛli ye ɛlɛ wɔ maanle ɛhye anu. Maa bɛhɔva ye bɛrɛla ndɛndɛ na menye ye zo!”

english_verse: “Why do you want to kill David?” Jonathan asked. “What has he done?”
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan bizale ɔ ze kɛ, “Duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛku Devidi a? Duzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ yeyɛ a?”

english_verse: Saul threw his spear at Jonathan and tried to kill him. Then Jonathan was sure that his father really did want to kill David.
translation_verse: Na ɛkɛ ne ala Sɔɔlo dole atwɛ kɛ ɔku Dwɔnatan. Ɛhye manle Dwɔnatan nwunle ye wienyi kɛ ɔ ze ɛvua ɛtafe zolɛ kɛ ɔku Devidi.

english_verse: Jonathan was angry and hurt that his father had insulted David so terribly. He got up, left the table, and didn't eat anything all that day.
translation_verse: Ɛya hunle Dwɔnatan kpole manle ɔvile ɛkponledolɛ ne abo ɔdwazole. Yeanli Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la aleɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔlɛdi Devidi anwo nyane kɛ ɔlua ɔ ti ɔ ze ɛbɔ ye aholoba ɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze a.

english_verse: In the morning, Jonathan went out to the field to meet David. He took a servant boy along
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ la, Dwɔnatan vale kakula ko ɔ nee ye hɔle fienemgbole ne anu, kɛmɔ ɔ nee Devidi bɛhanle bɛziele la.

english_verse: and told him, “When I shoot the arrows, you run and find them for me.” The boy started running, and Jonathan shot an arrow so that it would go beyond him.
translation_verse: Ɔzele kakula ne kɛ, “Meto ɛda na nriandi kɔkpondɛ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ.” Mɔɔ kakula ne ɛlɛnriandi ahɔ la, ɔdole ɛda ne ɔmanle ɛda baka ne dɛlale ye hɔdɔle ɔ nyunlu moa nehane.

english_verse: When the boy got near the place where the arrow had landed, Jonathan shouted, “Isn't the arrow on past you?”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ kakula ne dwule ɛleka mɔɔ ɛda baka ne hɔdɔle la, Dwɔnatan deanle nu zele ye kɛ, “Ɛda baka ne wɔ ɛ nyunlu moa lɔ.

english_verse: Jonathan shouted to him again, “Hurry up! Don't stop!” The boy picked up the arrows and brought them back to Jonathan,
translation_verse: Mmagyinla ɛkɛ ne! Ka ɛ nwo!” Kakula ne sesale ɛda mbaka ne mɔ na ɔziale ɔrale Dwɔnatan anwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: but he had no idea about what was going on. Only Jonathan and David knew.
translation_verse: Kakula ne yemɔ ɔnze nwolɛ bie; Dwɔnatan nee Devidi a te nyɛleɛ ne abo a.

english_verse: Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and told him, “Take these back into town.”
translation_verse: Na Dwɔnatan vale ye ninyɛne ne mɔ manle kakula ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Fa kɔ sua zo.”

english_verse: After the boy had gone, David got up from beside the mound and bowed very low three times. Then he and Jonathan kissed each other and cried, but David cried louder.
translation_verse: Kakula ne hɔle ala la, yɛɛ Devidi vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvea la vindele a. Ɔrabutule, ɔbɔle ɔ ti aze fane nsa, na ɔ nee Dwɔnatan bɛmetanle bɛ nwo bɛyɛle bɛ nwo atuu na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛzunle. Na ɛnee Devidi nyane ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛdi la bo zolɛ.

english_verse: Jonathan said, “Take care of yourself. And remember, we each have asked the Lord to watch and make sure that we and our descendants keep our promise forever.” David left and Jonathan went back to town.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔnatan zele Devidi kɛ, “Kɔ anzonudwolɛ nu; sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛkyekye na yɛli amonle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbanlea kɛ ɛdawɔ nee medame, ɛ bo zo amra nee me bo zo amra bali ɛwɔkɛ ne azo dahuu.” Devidi vale ɔ ti bɔle nu, na Dwɔnatan ɔdaye ɔziale ɔhɔle sua nu.

english_verse: David went to see Ahimelech, a priest who lived in the town of Nob. Ahimelech was trembling with fear as he came out to meet David. “Why are you alone?” Ahimelech asked. “Why isn't anyone else with you?”
translation_verse: Devidi hɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Ahemɛlɛke anwo lɔ wɔ Nɔɔbo. Ahemɛlɛke vale anwowozolɛ ngome rayiale ye adenle na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ ngomekye ala a wɔra na awie ɛmboka ɛ nwo ɛ?”

english_verse: “I'm on a mission for King Saul,” David answered. “He ordered me not to tell anyone what the mission is all about, so I ordered my soldiers to stay somewhere else.
translation_verse: Devidi buale ye kɛ, “Belemgbunli ɛzoa me, na ɔse, ‘Ɛzoanlɛ mɔɔ mezoa wɔ la, mmamaa awie biala te nwolɛ bie fee.’ Na me mgbavolɛ ne mɔ, mehile bɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyia me la.

english_verse: Do you have any food you can give me? Could you spare five loaves of bread?”
translation_verse: Duzu aleɛ a wɔ ɛke a? Maa me kpanwo ahunguma nnu anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛ la bie.”

english_verse: “The only bread I have is the sacred bread,” the priest told David. “You can have it if your soldiers didn't sleep with women last night.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne zele Devidi kɛ, “Menlɛ kpanwo biala wɔ ɛke kɛ kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ ala. Debie mɔɔ hyia la a le kɛ saa wɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛtɛfale bɛ nwo ɛtɛkanle mraalɛ kenle nsa ye ala ɛdeɛ a.”

english_verse: “Of course we didn't sleep with women,” David answered. “I never let my men do that when we're on a mission. They have to be acceptable to worship God even when we're on a regular mission, and today we're on a special mission.”
translation_verse: Devidi buale kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, bɛtɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtɛkanle mraalɛ. Saa yɛtu adenle gyɛne bɔbɔ a, yɛ nee mraalɛ ɛnli ngitanwo biala, na akee mɔɔ yɛlɛtu adenle mɔɔ hyia kpole zɛhae la.”

english_verse: The only bread the priest had was the sacred bread that he had taken from the place of worship after putting out the fresh loaves. So he gave it to David.
translation_verse: Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ ne manle Devidi kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, ɔluakɛ ɛnee kpanwo mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ala a le mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛva bɛzie Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la. Saa bɛye bɛfi azukponle ne azo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa fofolɛ wuluwulu bɛsie ɔ bo zo ne.

english_verse: David asked Ahimelech, “Do you have a spear or a sword? I had to leave so quickly on this mission for the king that I didn't bring along my sword or any other weapons.”
translation_verse: Na Devidi zele Ahemɛlɛke kɛ, “Ɛkɛnyia atwɛ anzɛɛ dadeɛ bie ɛkɛmaa me ɔ? Belemgbunli ɛzoanlɛ ne yɛle mgbemgbene nu, na kɛmɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meka me nwo ndɛndɛ la ati me rɛle vile, meanva bie.”

english_verse: The priest answered, “The only sword here is the one that belonged to Goliath the Philistine. You were the one who killed him in Elah Valley, and so you can take his sword if you want to. It's wrapped in a cloth behind the statue.” “It's the best sword there is,” David said. “I'll take it!” David Tries To Find Safety in Gath
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne zele kɛ, “Filisitianli Golayate mɔɔ ɛhunle ye wɔ Yila Bɔnza la dadeɛ ne kyekye ɛdanlɛ nu gyi ɛleka mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma tɛladeɛ Yifɔdo ne henda la. Saa ɛkulo a, fa yemɔ, ɔluakɛ dadeɛ gyɛne biala ɛnle ɛke.” Devidi zele kɛ, “Dadeɛ biala nee ye ɛnzɛ; fa maa me.”

english_verse: David kept on running from Saul that day until he came to Gath, where he met with King Achish.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi vile ɛkɛ ne, ɔnriandile Sɔɔlo na ɔhɔle Gate Belemgbunli Ekehye anwo lɔ.

english_verse: The officers of King Achish were also there, and they asked Achish, “Isn't David a king back in his own country? Don't the Israelites dance and sing, ‘Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand’?”
translation_verse: Ekehye mgbanyima ne mɔ zele bɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Na tɛ Devidi ɛhye a le ye maanle ne anu belemgbunli a? Nrenya ne mɔɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ dole ɔ nwo edwɛne, zile agole la ɛne. Bɛ edwɛne ne se, ‘Sɔɔlo hunle apenle apenle, na Devidi hunle apenle apenle bulu.’ ”

english_verse: David thought about what they were saying, and it made him afraid of Achish.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ɛhye gyegyele Devidi adwenle kpole na ɔmanle ɔzulole Belemgbunli Ekehye.

english_verse: So right there in front of everyone, he pretended to be insane. He acted confused and started making scratches on the doors of the town gate, while drooling in his beard.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔhakyile ye subane bɔkɔɔ wɔ menli ne anyunlu na ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ asɛɛ sɛnvolɛ bie la. Ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle suakunlu ɛkɛ ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anwo na ɔhwinle nyɛlɛ ɔguale ɔ kɛsa anu nee ye ɛbolɛ zo.

english_verse: “Look at him!” Achish said to his officers. “You can see he's crazy. Why did you bring him to me?
translation_verse: Na Ekehye zele kɛ, “Bɛze kɛ sonla ne ɛzɛ, duzu ati a bɛva ye bɛrɛlɛ me ɛ?

english_verse: I have enough crazy people without your bringing another one here. Keep him away from my palace!”
translation_verse: Na meze bɛ kɛ mehyia bɔnavolɛ nwo mɔɔ yemɔti bɛva ye bɛra bɛmaa yearayɛ mgbane mgbane yeahile me wɔ me suakunlu ɛke a?”

english_verse: When David escaped from the town of Gath, he went to Adullam Cave. His brothers and the rest of his family found out where he was, and they followed him there.
translation_verse: Devidi vile suakpole Gate azo nriandile hɔveale bolɛ bɔne bie anu wɔ Adulam. Mɔɔ ɔ mediema nee ye mbusuafoɔ ne mɔ dele kɛ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la bɛdoale ye.

english_verse: A lot of other people joined him too. Some were in trouble, others were angry or in debt, and David was soon the leader of
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye anzɛɛ tua kakɛ anzɛɛ akunlu ɛndwo mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la anwo la nriandile doale ye. Bɛ dodo kɛyɛ ɛya nna, na ɔyɛle bɛ kpanyinli ɔlile bɛ ti.

english_verse: David left Adullam Cave and went to the town of Mizpeh in Moab, where he talked with the king of Moab. “Please,” David said, “let my father and mother stay with you until I find out what God will do with me.”
translation_verse: Devidi vi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhɔle Mezepa mɔɔ wɔ Mowabe maanle nu la na ɔhɔzele Mowabe belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa egya nee ɔmɔ ɛwoa ɛ nwo ɛke kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔnwu mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛyɛ kɛmaa me la.”

english_verse: So he brought his parents to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him while David was in hiding.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi manle ye awovolɛ ne woale Mowabe belemgbunli ne anwo ɛkɛ, wɔ mekɛ tendenle ne mɔɔ ɔlile wɔ bolɛ bɔne ne anu la.

english_verse: One day the prophet Gad told David, “Don't stay here! Go back to Judah.” David then left and went to Hereth Forest. Saul Kills the Priests of the Lord
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gaade razele Devidi kɛ, “Ɛvi ɛke finde kɔ Dwuda maanle nu.” Yemɔti Devidi vindele na ɔhɔle Hɛlɛte kpɔkɛ nu.

english_verse: Saul was sitting under a small tree on top of the hill at Gibeah when he heard that David and his men had been located. Saul was holding his spear, and his officers were standing in front of him.
translation_verse: Kenle ko bie ɛnee Sɔɔlo wɔ Gebɛya; ɔde baka kpole bie mɔɔ gyi boka bie azo la abo, na ɔlɛ ye atwɛ ne ɔ sa nu, na ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye. Bɛrahanle bɛhilele ye kɛ bɛnwu Devidi nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ.

english_verse: He told them: Listen to me! You belong to the Benjamin tribe, so if that son of Jesse ever becomes king, he won't give you fields or vineyards. He won't make you officers in charge of thousands or hundreds as I have done.
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo zele ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Bɛngyaman asa azo, bɛdie; bɛnea a ɛnee Gyɛsi ara Devidi bamaa awie biala ɛya avule nee vanye egyinli, na yeayɛ awie biala ye ɛlɔnema apenle apenle nwo zo safohyenle anzɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema ɛya ɛya nwo zo neavolɛ ɔ,

english_verse: But you're all plotting against me! Not one of you told me that my own son Jonathan had made an agreement with him. Not one of you cared enough to tell me that Jonathan had helped one of my officers rebel. Now that son of Jesse is trying to ambush me.
translation_verse: mɔɔ yemɔti bɛ muala bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛko bɛatia me a? Bɛ nuhua biala ɛngola ɛnga ɛngile me kɛ me kunlu ralɛ nrenya nee Gyɛsi ara ne ɛva me nwo adwenle. Me edwɛkɛ ɛngyia bɛ nuhua biala la ati, bɛngola bɛnyɛ me anzote bɔbɔ kɛ me ra ne ɛli ɛwula me sonvolɛ Devidi kɛ ɔzia me ɔhu me toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.”

english_verse: Doeg the Edomite was standing with the other officers and spoke up, “When I was in the town of Nob, I saw that son of Jesse. He was visiting the priest Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Yidɔmenli Dowɛge nee Sɔɔlo sonvolɛma ne mɔ a gyi ɛkɛ a, na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Menwunle kɛ Gyɛsi ara ne wɔ Ahaetɛbe ara Ahemɛlɛke anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Nɔɔbo.

english_verse: Ahimelech talked to the Lord for him, then gave him food and the sword that had belonged to Goliath the Philistine.”
translation_verse: Ahemɛlɛke bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Devidi yɛ la, eza ɔmanle ye aleɛ na ɔvale Filisitianli Golayate konle dadeɛ ne ɔmanle ye.”

english_verse: Saul sent a message to Ahimelech and his whole family of priests at Nob, ordering them to come to him. When they came,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo manle bɛhɔvale Ahaetɛbe ara sɛlɛvolɛ Ahemɛlɛke nee ɔ ze awuke nu amra mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma wɔ Nɔɔbo la bɛrale.

english_verse: Saul told them, “Listen to me, you son of Ahitub.” “Certainly, Your Majesty,” Ahimelech answered.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo zele Ahemɛlɛke kɛ, “Ahaetɛbe ara, tie!” Ahemɛlɛke buale kɛ, “Nana, melɛtie.”

english_verse: Saul demanded, “Why did you plot against me with that son of Jesse? You helped him rebel against me by giving him food and a sword, and by talking with God for him. Now he's trying to ambush me!”
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati yɛɛ ɛdawɔ nee Gyɛsi ara ne bɛhɔ me ti akpamo, bɔbɔ wɔmaa ye kpanwo nee konle dadeɛ, na eza wɔbiza ɔ ti wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne wɔmaa ye, amaa ɔlua zolɛ ɔlɛko yeatia me, na sumunli kɛ de la yedɛ me toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ, ɔkpondɛ me yeahu me a?”

english_verse: “Your Majesty, none of your officers is more loyal than David!” Ahimelech replied. “He's your son-in-law and the captain of your bodyguard. Everyone in your family respects him.
translation_verse: Ahemɛlɛke buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Wɔ wɔ sonvolɛma kɔsɔɔti anu, nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ di nɔhalɛ nee Devidi, ɛ ra raalɛ ne ɔ hu ne mɔɔ le sinzavolɛma kpanyinli, na bɛdi ye eni kpole wɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛke la sɛ a?

english_verse: This isn't the first time I've talked with God for David, and it's never made you angry before! Please don't accuse me or my family like this. I have no idea what's going on!”
translation_verse: Na ɛnɛ ala a le kenle mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ mebiza ɔ ti wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne memaa ye a? Mɔɔ fane ɛ ti akpamovalɛ nwo, medame anzɛɛ egya awuke nu sonla biala ɛnze nwolɛ ɛhwee. Yemɔti, Nana, mmafa edwɛkɛ ɛhye ɛsuzu yɛ.”

english_verse: “Ahimelech,” Saul said, “you and your whole family are going to die.”
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Ahemɛlɛke, ɛdawɔ nee ɛ ze awuke nu amra kɔsɔɔti, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku bɛ.”

english_verse: Saul shouted to his bodyguards, “These priests of the Lord helped David! They knew he was running away, but they didn't tell me. Kill them!” But the king's officers would not attack the priests of the Lord.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli zele ye sinzavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛhu Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, ɔluakɛ bɛ nee Devidi vale akpamo na bɛanga bɛangile me kɛ yenriandi.” Na sinzavolɛma ne mɔ angulo kɛ bɛkɛhu Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ anu ko bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Saul turned to Doeg, who was from Edom, and said, “Kill the priests!” On that same day, Doeg killed
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo zele Dowɛge kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ku bɛ!” Na Dowɛge hunle sɛlɛvolɛma abulatwɛ nee nnu ne mɔɔ ɛnee wula sɛlɛvolɛ tɛladeɛ fufule ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Yifɔdo” la.

english_verse: Then he attacked the town of Nob, where the priests had lived, and he killed everyone there—men, women, children, and babies. He even killed their cattle, donkeys, and sheep. Only Abiathar Escapes from Nob
translation_verse: Eza Sɔɔlo manle bɛhunle suakpole Nɔɔbo ezuavolɛ mɔɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti asɛɛ bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma la. Bɛhunle mrenya nee mraalɛ, ngakula nee nlɔma, nlankɛ, asoaso nee mboane.

english_verse: Ahimelech's son Abiathar was the only one who escaped. He ran to David
translation_verse: Na Ahemɛlɛke amra mrenya ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Abayata la nriandile, na ɔhɔle Devidi anwo lɔ.

english_verse: and told him, “Saul has murdered the Lord's priests at Nob!”
translation_verse: Ɔvale kɛ Sɔɔlo ɛmaa bɛzi bɛhu Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma kɔsɔɔti la ɔbɔle ye amaneɛ.

english_verse: David answered, “That day when I saw Doeg, I knew he would tell Saul! Your family died because of me.
translation_verse: Devidi zele Abayata kɛ, “Menwunle Dowɛge wɔ ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ne ala la, ɛnee meze kɛ ɔbahɔha yeahile Sɔɔlo. Yemɔti medi ɛzonle. Ɔlua me ti yɛɛ ɛ ze awuke nu amra kɔsɔɔti ɛwu a.

english_verse: Stay here. Isn't the same person trying to kill both of us? Don't worry! You'll be safe here with me.”
translation_verse: Mmasulo, boa ɛke; ahenle mɔɔ kpondɛ me ahu me la asa ka wɔ a, ɔbahu wɔ; saa ɛde me nwo ɛke a, ɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo.”

english_verse: One day some people told David, “The Philistines keep attacking the town of Keilah and stealing grain from the threshing place.”
translation_verse: Bɛrahanle bɛhilele Devidi kɛ, Filisitiama nee Kiayelama ɛlɛko na bɛlɛwua bɛ abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛbu la amuala.

english_verse: David asked the Lord, “Should I attack these Philistines?” “Yes,” the Lord answered. “Attack them and rescue Keilah.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Me nee Filisitiama ɛhɔho ɔ?” Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Devidi kɛ, “Kɔ kɔho tia Filisitiama na die Kiayela.”

english_verse: But David's men said, “Look, even here in Judah we're afraid of the Philistines. We will be terrified if we try to fight them at Keilah!”
translation_verse: Na Devidi asa zo ne zele ye kɛ, “Nea, Dwuda maanle ye anu bɔbɔ yɛsulo, na Kiayela yɛɛ akee yɛkɔ yɛ nee Filisitiama ahɔho a?”

english_verse: David asked the Lord about it again. “Leave at once,” the Lord answered. “I will give you victory over the Philistines at Keilah.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi eza bizale Ɛdɛnkɛma bieko, na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Dwazo kɔ Kiayela, ɔluakɛ mebaye Filisitiama meamaa wɔ.”

english_verse: David and his men went there and fiercely attacked the Philistines. They killed many of them, then led away their cattle, and rescued the people of Keilah.
translation_verse: Devidi nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ hɔle Kiayela na bɛ nee Filisitiama hɔhonle, bɛhunle bɛ somaa ne ala na bɛzoale bɛ nlankɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔle. Na Devidi liele Kiayela ezuavolɛ ne ngoane.

english_verse: David heard about Saul's plan to capture him, and he told Abiathar, “Let's ask God what we should do.”
translation_verse: Devidi dele kɛ Sɔɔlo nee ye ɛlɔnema ɛlɛba ɔ nwo zo la, ɔzele sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata kɛ, “Fa yifɔdo ne bɛla.”

english_verse: David prayed, “Lord God of Israel, I was told that Saul is planning to come here. What should I do? Suppose he threatens to destroy the town because of me.
translation_verse: Akee Devidi zele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, wɔ sonvolɛ ye ɛde kɛ Sɔɔlo ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔba Kiayela yearazɛkye sua ye wɔ medame me ti.

english_verse: Would the leaders of Keilah turn me over to Saul? Or is he really coming? Please tell me, Lord.” “Yes, he will come,” the Lord answered.
translation_verse: Ɛnea a Kiayela ezuavolɛ baye me amaa ye ɔ? Kɛmɔ wɔ sonvolɛ ye ɛde la, ɛnea a Sɔɔlo bara amgba ɔ? O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, ka kile me.” Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔbara.”

english_verse: David asked, “Would the leaders of Keilah hand me and my soldiers over to Saul?” “Yes, they would,” the Lord answered.
translation_verse: Na Devidi zele kɛ, “Ɛnea a Kiayela ezuavolɛ ye baye me nee me ɛlɔnema amaa Sɔɔlo ɔ?” Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Bɛbaye wɔ bɛamaa.”

english_verse: David stayed in hideouts in the hill country of Ziph Desert. Saul kept searching, but God never let Saul catch him.
translation_verse: Devidi veale fienemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Zefe la anu wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo. Sɔɔlo bɔle mɔdenle kpondɛle ye biala, na Nyamenle anye Devidi ammaa ye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: One time, David was at Horesh in Ziph Desert. He was afraid because Saul had come to the area to kill him.
translation_verse: Devidi nwunle kɛ Sɔɔlo kpondɛ kɛ ɔku ye. Ɛnee Devidi wɔ Hɔlɛhye mɔɔ wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Zefe la anu.

english_verse: But Jonathan went to see David, and God helped him encourage David.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔnatan hɔle ɔ nwo lɔ na ɔhɔzile ye ahonle kɛ, “Wɔ adenle biala anu, Nyamenle bazinza wɔ.”

english_verse: “Don't be afraid,” Jonathan said. “My father Saul will never get his hands on you. In fact, you're going to be the next king of Israel, and I'll be your highest official. Even my father knows it's true.”
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Mmasulo, ɔluakɛ egya Sɔɔlo asa ɛnrɛha wɔ ɛnrɛhu wɔ ɛlɛ. Ɔze ye wienyi kɛ ɛbali Yizilayɛ belemgbunli na medame noko meadɛnla ɛ sa fema zo.”

english_verse: They both promised the Lord that they would always be loyal to each other. Then Jonathan went home, but David stayed at Horesh. David Escapes from Saul
translation_verse: Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛbɔle bɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛyɛ mediema dahuu. Devidi woale Hɔlɛhye, na Dwɔnatan ziale hɔle sua nu.

english_verse: Some people from the town of Ziph went to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Your Majesty, David has a hideout not far from us! It's near Horesh, somewhere on Mount Hachilah south of Jeshimon.
translation_verse: Menli bie vi Zefe hɔle Sɔɔlo anwo lɔ wɔ Gebɛya hɔzele ye kɛ, “Devidi vea yɛ maanle ne anu wɔ Hɔlɛhye wɔ Hakaela Boka, wɔ Dwuda fienemgbole ne nyiakɛ.

english_verse: Saul told them: You've done me a big favor, and I pray that the Lord will bless you.
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo zele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ nyele ɛhye bɛmaa me a.

english_verse: Now please do just a little more for me. Find out exactly where David is, as well as where he goes, and who has seen him there. I've been told that he's very tricky.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ, bɛhɔnlea ye boɛ; bɛnlea ɛleka fɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔvea la, ɔluakɛ mede kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ ɛvɛlɛ.

english_verse: Find out where all his hiding places are and come back when you're sure. Then I'll go with you. If he is still in the area, or anywhere among the clans of Judah, I'll find him.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔnleɛnlea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔyɛ a ɔfeɛvea la kpalɛ, na bɛrabɔ me amaneɛ, na me nee bɛ ahɔ. Na saa amgba ɔwɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu ɛdeɛ a, yemɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, me sa baha ye meahye ye.”

english_verse: The people from Ziph went back ahead of Saul, and they found out that David and his men were still south of Jeshimon in the Maon Desert.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛziale bɛlumuale Sɔɔlo anyunlu wɔ Zefe. Ɛnee Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne wɔ Meeyɔn fienemgbole ne anu, wɔ bɔnza bie mɔɔ awie fee ɛngɔ ɛkɛ na ɔwɔ Dwuda fienemgbole ne nyiakɛ la anu.

english_verse: Saul and his army set out to find David. But David heard that Saul was coming, and he went to a place called The Rock, one of his hideouts in Maon Desert. Saul found out where David was and started closing in on him.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo nee ye ɛlɔnema ne zile nu kɛ bɛkakpondɛ ye. Devidi dele nwolɛ bie; yemɔti ɔhɔle awoka bie anu wɔ Meeyɔn fienemgbole ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: Saul was going around a hill on one side, and David and his men were on the other side, trying to get away. Saul and his soldiers were just about to capture David and his men,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo dwule boka ne foa ko la, ɛnee Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne noko wɔ ye foa ko. Devidi nwunle kɛ Sɔɔlo nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ɛkpumgbu bɛ kpalɛ na asɛɛ bɛhye bɛ, yemɔti ɔ nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hanle bɛ nwo ndɛndɛ kɛ bɛye bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: when a messenger came to Saul and said, “Come quickly! The Philistines are attacking Israel and taking everything.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ ɛbɔfoɔ razele Sɔɔlo kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo bɛla sua nu ndɛndɛ, ɔluakɛ Filisitiama ɛrava maanle ne.”

english_verse: Saul stopped going after David and went back to fight the Philistines. That's why the place is called “Escape Rock.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɔɔlo gyakyile Devidi ɛvoanlɛ na ɔziale ɔhɔle kɛ ɔ nee Filisitiama kaho. Ɔlua ɛhye ati bɛvɛlɛle boka zɔhane Avinlitetelɛ Boka.

english_verse: David left and went to live in the hideouts at En-Gedi.
translation_verse: Devidi vile ɛkɛ ne hɔle afea wɔ Ɛngidae maanzinli nu.

english_verse: When Saul got back from fighting off the Philistines, he heard that David was in the desert around En-Gedi.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sɔɔlo nee Filisitiama wiele ko na ɔziale ɔrale la, bɛhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ Devidi wɔ Ɛngidae fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: There were some sheep pens along the side of the road, and one of them was built around the entrance to a cave. Saul went into the cave to relieve himself. David and his men were hiding at the back of the cave.
translation_verse: Ɔdwule mboane tunli bie anwo wɔ adehane ne la, ɔnwunle bolɛ bɔne bie wɔ ɛkɛ, na Sɔɔlo makyile ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔkayɛ ɔ nwo boɛ. Ɔrale kɛ, bɔne zɔhane anu ala, na ɔkunlu nehane yɛɛ Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne vea a.

english_verse: They whispered to David, “The Lord told you he was going to let you defeat your enemies and do whatever you want with them. This must be the day the Lord was talking about.” David sneaked over and cut off a small piece of Saul's robe, but Saul didn't notice a thing.
translation_verse: Na Devidi ɛlɔnema ne zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ kenle ye le wɔ kenle. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze wɔ kɛ, ‘Mebaye wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne meawula ɛ sa nu, na wɔayɛ ye debie biala mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la.’ ” Devidi dwazole yɛle nyaa hɔpɛle Sɔɔlo tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la sinli mɔɔ Sɔɔlo annwu ye a.

english_verse: Afterwards, David was sorry that he had even done that,
translation_verse: Akee Devidi adwenle bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔgyegye ye, kɛ yepɛ Sɔɔlo tɛladeɛ ne sinli a.

english_verse: and he told his men, “Stop talking foolishly. We're not going to attack Saul. He's my king, and I pray that the Lord will keep me from doing anything to harm his chosen king.” Saul left the cave and started down the road.
translation_verse: Na Devidi gogole ye menli ne ahonle kɛ bɛmmayɛ Sɔɔlo ɛhwee. Sɔɔlo vile bɔne ne anu vindele, na ɔzanle ye zo kɛ ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Soon, David also got up and left the cave. “Your Majesty!” he shouted from a distance. Saul turned around to look. David bowed down very low
translation_verse: Devidi noko vindele doale ye na ɔvɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Me menle, me belemgbunli.” Sɔɔlo dole ɔ nye ɔ nzi. Devidi vale enililɛ bɔle ɔ ti aze manle ye,

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, why do you listen to people who say that I'm trying to harm you?
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛtie menli mɔɔ se wɔ kɛ ‘Devidi kpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ’ la anloa ɛ?

english_verse: You can see for yourself that the Lord gave me the chance to catch you in the cave today. Some of my men wanted to kill you, but I wouldn't let them do it. I told them, “I will not harm the Lord's chosen king!”
translation_verse: Nea, ɛnɛ demua ye, wɔ bɔne ye anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele wɔ manle me. Me ɛlɔnema ne bie mɔ zele me kɛ mengu wɔ, noko menzele wɔ anwunvɔne. Menzele kɛ, ‘Menrɛhu wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye wɔ kɛ ɛle belemgbunli a.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, look at what I'm holding. You can see that it's a piece of your robe. If I could cut off a piece of your robe, I could have killed you. But I let you live, and that should prove I'm not trying to harm you or to rebel. I haven't done anything to you, and yet you keep trying to ambush and kill me.
translation_verse: Nana, nea, wɔ tɛladeɛ ne sinli a melɛ ye me sa nu la. Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ mempɛle wɔ tɛladeɛ ne sinli na meangu wɔ la le sɛkɛlɛneɛ kpole kile kɛ menlɛ ɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane biala, yɛɛ metɛtele ɛ nwo atua. Metɛyɛle ɛtane biala metɛtiale wɔ, noko wɔyele ɛ nwo ɛsesebɛ ala kɛ ɛkpondɛ me wɔahu me.

english_verse: I'll let the Lord decide which one of us has done right. I pray that the Lord will punish you for what you're doing to me, but I won't do anything to you.
translation_verse: Yɛ mu nwiɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbua mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma badua wɔ kakɛ wɔ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ wɔva wɔyɛ me la anwo. Mame, menrɛva me sa menrɛha wɔ yɛɛ menrɛyɛ wɔ ɛhwee.

english_verse: An old proverb says, “Only evil people do evil things,” and so I won't harm you.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛze tete ɛrɛlɛ ne mɔɔ se, ‘Ɛtu ayidane a, bie ka ɛ nloa’ la, na mame, menrɛlie me sa anwo ɛzonle ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Why should the king of Israel be out chasing me, anyway? I'm as worthless as a dead dog or a flea.
translation_verse: Na nwane a Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne ɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔku ye a? Na nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛfoa ye ndinlizo a? Twea funli ɔ, ɛzozoa ɔ!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will help me escape and show that I am in the right.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma babua yɛ mu nwiɔ ndɛne yeanwu nuhua mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la. Ɔnleɛnlea edwɛkɛ ne anu, ɔlie me ti na ɔlie me ɔvi ɛ sa nu.”

english_verse: “David, my son—is that you?” Saul asked. Then he started crying
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi wiele tendɛ la, Sɔɔlo zele kɛ, “Asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ me ra Devidi ɛ?”

english_verse: and said: David, you're a better person than I am. You treated me with kindness, even though I've been cruel to you.
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo dukuele nu zunle. Ɔzele Devidi kɛ, “Ɛle tenlenenli bɔkɔɔ ɛtɛla me. Wɔyɛ me boɛ, na mame, meva ɛtane medua wɔ kakɛ.

english_verse: You've told me how you were kind enough not to kill me when the Lord gave you the chance.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kenle ko ye, wɔhile kɛ ɛkulo me, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yele me manle wɔ bɔkɔɔ, na wɔangu me.

english_verse: If you really were my enemy, you wouldn't have let me leave here alive. I pray that the Lord will give you a big reward for what you did today.
translation_verse: Fane nyɛ yɛɛ saa sonla sa ka ye kpɔvolɛ a ɔkɛgyakyi ye ɔkɛmaa ɔkɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ a? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ wɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ wɔmaa me ɛnɛ la anwo.

english_verse: I realize now that you will be the next king, and a powerful king at that.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, menwu kɛ ɛbali belemgbunli, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli maanle ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Promise me with the Lord as your witness, that you won't wipe out my descendants. Let them live to keep my family name alive.
translation_verse: Yemɔti fa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛnrɛbɔ me bo zo amra abo zo, amaa me duma nee me abusua ne duma amminli.”

english_verse: So David promised, and Saul went home. David and his men returned to their hideout.
translation_verse: Devidi bɔle Sɔɔlo ɛwɔkɛ ne. Sɔɔlo ziale hɔle sua nu, na Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ziale hɔveale bɛ bo zo ne.

english_verse: One day, Nabal was in Carmel where his servants were cutting the wool from his sheep. David was in the desert when he heard about it.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Neebale ɛlɛpepɛ ye mboane ne mɔ anwo enrinli wɔ Kamɛle, na Devidi dele ye wɔ fienemgbole ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: So he sent ten men to Carmel with this message for Nabal: I hope that you and your family are healthy and that all is going well for you.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ a bɛze ye kɛ Devidi se, ‘Anzonudwolɛ ɛha wɔ, anzonudwolɛ ɛha wɔ awuke nu amra na anzonudwolɛ ɛha debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: I've heard that you are cutting the wool from your sheep. When your shepherds were with us in Carmel, we didn't harm them, and nothing was ever stolen from them.
translation_verse: Mede kɛ ɛlɛpepɛ wɔ mboane ne mɔ anwo enrinli. Memaa wɔade kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ wɔ mboaneneavolɛma ne nee yɛ de Kamɛle ɛke la, yɛanyɛ biala ɛtane, awie biala anva ɔ sa anga bɛ debie biala.

english_verse: Ask your shepherds, and they'll tell you the same thing. My servants are your servants, and you are like a father to me. This is a day for celebrating, so please be kind and share some of your food with us.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ mumua ne biza bɛ na bɛbaha nɔhalɛ ne bɛahile wɔ. Yɛwɔ ɛvolɛ nu, yemɔti Devidi se ɛlie yɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, debie biala mɔɔ ɛfa ɛmaa wɔ sonvolɛma nee ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ Devidi a ɔyɛ anyenzɔlɛ la, fa maa yɛhɔ.’ ”

english_verse: David's men went to Nabal and gave him David's message, then they waited for Nabal's answer.
translation_verse: Devidi soanvolɛma ne hɔhanle nrɛlaleɛ ne hilele Neebale na bɛhendɛle kɛ bɛdie mualɛ.

english_verse: This is what he said: Who does this David think he is? That son of Jesse is just one more slave on the run from his master, and there are too many of them these days.
translation_verse: Neebale zele Devidi soanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Devidi! Yemɔ a le nwane? Gyɛsi ara nrenya a le nwane? Metɛtele ye duma bɔbɔ ɛlɛ. Kenle nsa ye, sonvolɛma dɔɔnwo vi bɛ menle mɔ anwo ɛnriandi.

english_verse: What makes you think I would take my bread, my water, and the meat that I've had cooked for my own servants and give it to you? Besides, I'm not sure that David sent you!
translation_verse: Mame, menrɛva me kpanwo nee me nzule nee me nane mɔɔ meku ye meamaa menli mɔɔ pepɛ me mboane nwo enrinli la menrɛmaa menli mɔɔ menze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛvi la.”

english_verse: The men returned to their camp and told David everything Nabal had said.
translation_verse: Yemɔti soanvolɛma ne ziale vale edwɛkɛ ne hɔbɔle Devidi amaneɛ.

english_verse: He's a bully who won't listen to anyone. Isn't there something you can do? Please think of something! Or else our master and his family and everyone who works for him are all doomed.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, dwenle ɛhye anwo ɛsesebɛ na bu nwolɛ amaamuo kpalɛ. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye kola twe munzule maa yɛ menle ne nee ye awuke nu amra; yɛɛ ɔnlɛ subane noko bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛka ye edwɛkɛ a ɔfa a.”

english_verse: and told her servants, “Take this on ahead, and I'll catch up with you.” She didn't tell her husband Nabal what she was doing.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele ye mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛva bɛlumua me nyunlu, medame me gyakɛ gyi adenle zo melɛba.” Na yeambɔ ɔ hu amaneɛ.

english_verse: Abigail was riding her donkey on the path that led around the hillside, when suddenly she met David and his men heading straight at her.
translation_verse: Abegeli de ye asoaso ne azo ɔlɛkɔ, na ɔbule amie ko bie wɔ boka ne agye nu la, ɔnwunle kɛ ɔ nee Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ɛlɛyia.

english_verse: David had just been saying, “I surely wasted my time guarding Nabal's things in the desert and keeping them from being stolen! I was good to him, and now he pays me back with insults.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Devidi ɛlɛdwenle nwolɛ kɛ, “Na duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ membɔle sonla zɔhane agyadeɛ ne anwo bane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu a? Ye debie sinli bɔbɔ amminli. Moalɛ kpole ɛhye mɔɔ menvale memboale ye la nwolɛ kakɛ mɔɔ yeva yedua me la ɛne.

english_verse: I swear that by morning, there won't be a man or boy left from his family or his servants' families. I pray that God will punish me if I don't do it!”
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ, saa meangu bɛ meambɔ bɛ bo zo kolaa na maanle nu atete a, Nyamenle ɛhu me.”
