english_verse: Joab was the commander of Israel's entire army. Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of David's bodyguard.
translation_verse: Dwowabe nea Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo. Bɛnaya nea belemgbunli ne sinzavolɛma anwo zo;

english_verse: Adoram was in charge of the slave-labor force. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept government records.
translation_verse: Adɔlam nea menli mɔɔ yɛ akɛlɛ gyima la anwo zo; Ahaelɛde ara Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛlɛhɛlɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛsisi la.

english_verse: Sheva was the secretary. Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.
translation_verse: Hyiva le kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ. Zeedɔko nee Abayata le sɛlɛvolɛma,

english_verse: Ira from Jair was David's priest.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Ayela mɔɔ vi Gyeeyɛɛ la le Devidi sɛlɛvolɛ.

english_verse: He said, “What can I do to make up for what Saul did, so that you'll ask the Lord to be kind to his people again?”
translation_verse: Devidi bizale Gebɛyɔnoma kɛ, “Duzu a menyɛ memaa bɛ a? Ɛtane mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ la, duzu debie yɛɛ meyɛ a bɛ kunlu kɛdwo na bɛayileyila Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne a?”

english_verse: They replied, “Saul tried to kill all our people so that none of us would be left in the land of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛzele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ amkpondɛ yɛ nee ngoane na ɔhulole kɛ anrɛɛ ɛnee ɔkɛye yɛ ɔkɛvi Yizilayɛ maanle ye anu la,

english_verse: Give us seven of his descendants. We will hang these men near the place where the Lord is worshiped in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, the Lord's chosen king.” “I'll give them to you,” David said.
translation_verse: yemɔ yɛɛ bɛye ɔ bo zo amra mrenya ne mɔ anu nsuu bɛmaa yɛ bɛmaa yɛbɔ bɛ akɔnvo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu wɔ Sɔɔlo mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ziele ye belemgbunli la sua zo Gebɛya a.” Belemgbunli ne buale kɛ, “Menwɔva menwɔmaa bɛ.”

english_verse: David had made a promise to Jonathan with the Lord as his witness, so he spared Jonathan's son Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ Devidi nee Sɔɔlo ara Dwɔnatan vale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle bɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ la ati, Devidi gyakyile Dwɔnatan ara Mɛfebɔhyɛte, mɔɔ le Sɔɔlo anlɔnra ne,

english_verse: turned them over to the Gibeonites, who hanged all seven of them on the mountain near the place where the Lord was worshiped. This happened right at the beginning of the barley harvest. Rizpah Takes Care of the Bodies
translation_verse: ɔmanle Gebɛyɔnoma ne mɔ. Bɛbɔle bɛ akɔnvo wɔ boka ne azo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Bɛ muala bɛwule kenle ko. Bɛbɔle ma ɛdelɛ bo ala la yɛɛ bɛhunle bɛ a.

english_verse: Rizpah spread out some sackcloth on a nearby rock. She wouldn't let the birds land on the bodies during the day, and she kept the wild animals away at night. She stayed there from the beginning of the harvest until it started to rain. The Burial of Saul and His Descendants
translation_verse: Na Eyiya ara raalɛ Relezepa vale ɛrele bɔle kpɔda wɔ bolɛ ne anwo, ɛleka mɔɔ avunli ne mɔ hendɛhenda la. Ɔdɛnlanle ɔ bo ɔzinzale avunli ne mɔ, ɔvi ɛbuhenle ne mɔlebɛbo toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ ezule dɔle guale bɛ nwo zo la. Yeammaa nloma annyia adenle ambansuso avunli ne wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ nanemgbole noko annyia adenle anli bɛ nɔɔzo.

english_verse: David had their bones taken to the land of Benjamin and buried in a side room in Saul's family burial place. Then he gave orders for the bones of the men who had been hanged to be buried there. It was done, and God answered prayers to bless the land. The Descendants of the Rephaim (
translation_verse: Bɛziele Sɔɔlo nee ɔ ra Dwɔnatan mbowule ne mɔ wɔ Sɔɔlo ɔ ze Kehye nla ne anu wɔ Zila, wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu. Akee bɛyɛle mɔɔ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele bɛ la amuala. Na Nyamenle diele maanlema ne nzɛlɛlɛ. Bɛ nee Filisitia menli kakanyinlima konle ne mɔ (

english_verse: There was another war, this time in Gath. One of the enemy soldiers was a descendant of the Rephaim. He was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.
translation_verse: Eza konle bieko zile Gate. Nrenya kakanyinli bie wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ mrɛlɛsɛka ne mɔ le nsia nsia; bɛ muala bɛle abulanwiɔ nee nna. Ɔle menli kakanyinlima ne mɔ abo zo amra ne mɔ bie.

english_verse: One time David got very tired when he and his soldiers were fighting the Philistines.
translation_verse: Eza Filisitiama nee Yizilayɛma nyianle konle bieko. Na Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne nee Filisitiama hɔhonle. Wɔ konle ne anu, mɔɔ ɛnee akee Devidi ɛvɛ kpole kpalɛ la,

english_verse: One of the Philistine warriors was Ishbibenob, who was a descendant of the Rephaim, and he tried to kill David. Ishbibenob was armed with a new sword, and his bronze spearhead alone weighed about three and a half kilograms.
translation_verse: Filisitia menli kakanyinlima ne mɔ anu ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yehyebaebinɔbo na ɔlɛ kɔbele atwɛ mɔɔ ye ɛnlomboɛ kɛyɛ kilo nsa nee foa ko, na ɔlɛ konle dadeɛ fofolɛ la yɛle kɛ ɔkahu Devidi.

english_verse: But Abishai came to the rescue and killed the Philistine. David's soldiers told him, “We can't let you risk your life in battle anymore! You give light to our nation, and we want that flame to keep burning.”
translation_verse: Na Zɛluaya ara Abehyae raboale ye; ɔtetale Filisitianli kakanyinli ne na ɔhunle ye. Akee Devidi menli ne hanle ndane dole ɔ nwo kɛ, “Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, ɛngɔ konle bieko, anrɛɛ ɛkɛmaa Yizilayɛ kɛnlaneɛ ne kɛnlu.”

english_verse: There was another battle with the Philistines at Gob, where Sibbecai from Hushah killed a descendant of the Rephaim named Saph.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi eza Filisitiama nee Yizilayɛma nyianle konle bieko wɔ Gɔɔbo. Konle ne anu, Sebɛkae mɔɔ vi Huhya la hunle kakanyinlima ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saafe la.

english_verse: There was still another battle with the Philistines at Gob. A soldier named Elhanan killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam. Elhanan's father was Jari from Bethlehem.
translation_verse: Eza Filisitiama hanle konle bieko wɔ Gɔɔbo, na Gyeeyɛɛ mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm la ara Ɛleheenan hunle Golayate mɔɔ vi Gate la. Ye atwɛ baka ne kpole nee ye ɛnlomboɛ le kɛ ndanlɛnwolɛ melahyinli baka la.

english_verse: But when he made fun of Israel, David's nephew Jonathan killed him. Jonathan was the son of David's brother Shimei.
translation_verse: Ɔgolole Yizilayɛma anwo na Devidi adiema Hyemɛyae ara Dwɔnatan hunle ye.

english_verse: David and his soldiers killed these four men who were descendants of the Rephaim from Gath.
translation_verse: Menli nna ɛhye mɔ le menli kakanyinlima mɔɔ vi Gate la abo zo amra ne mɔ bie, na Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne hunle bɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ɔliele me ɔvile me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ anwo yɛ se, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛkyi me la asa anu, ɔluakɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ ne bo me nwo zo.

english_verse: David sang a song to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, especially Saul. These are the words to David's song:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma liele Devidi wɔ Sɔɔlo nee ye kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la asa anu la, ɔdole edwɛne ɛhye ɔyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ:

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle avinli; na meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa wɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me bodane, ɔle me aranemgbole nee me dievolɛ.

english_verse: You are the rock where I am safe. You are my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter. You rescue me and keep me safe from violence.
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle, me bodane mɔɔ mefea nu a, ɔpepɛ ɔdie me na ɔfa me ɔsie gyɛlɛɛnye. Ɔle me aranemgbole nee me ɛvealeka, ɔle me dievolɛ, ɔdie me ɔfi konle nu.

english_verse: I praise you, our Lord! I prayed to you, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mesu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ fɛta ayɛlɛyelɛ, ɔdie me ɔfi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Death, like ocean waves, surrounded me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Ewule azɛlɛkye bɔle yiale me; azɛlɛkye sɛkyelera bule vale me nwo zo.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ nyɛma bɛkɛbɛkale me, na funli kuma zuale me ɛhane.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Wɔ me ngyegyelɛ nu, menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma; menzɛlɛle me Nyamenle kɛ ɔboa me. Ɔdele me ne wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na me ɛzunlɛ dwule ɔ nzo nu.

english_verse: Earth shook and shivered! The columns supporting the sky rocked back and forth. You were angry
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ bɔle twitwi na ɔkpusule, anwumaneamra abo kpusule na bɛdudule, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle vale ɛya.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Esike vi ɔ bonyi nu kpunle, na senle gɔhyee vi ɔ nloa anu vindele, samɛnlankɛ mgbomgbɔɔnwo vi ɔ nwo kpomgbɔle guale.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle anwomanyunlu kpakyele nwiɔ na ɔdwule aze, awozinli kabii wɔ ɔ gyakɛ abo.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures. You appeared with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛnlanle tease abɔdeɛ zo ɔdule, bɛnwunle kɛ ɔluolua anwomanyunlu.

english_verse: Darkness was your tent! Thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ɔvale awozinli ɔmundunle ɔ nwo, nzulemungu kisii bɔle yiale ye;

english_verse: Fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: ɛsɛnlɛmanye guaanye vi wienyi ne mɔɔ li ɔ nyunlu la anu kpakyele.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hulule anwuma lɔ, na Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ane lieliele.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔtotole ye ɛda ne mɔ ɔbɔle kpɔvolɛma ne asande; ɔkpakyele ɛsɛnlɛmanye, na bɛnriandile.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Nyevile bo azɛlɛ ne yele dɔle zo, ewiade adiabo ne mɔ anwo yele guale zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hwile ye kpɔvolɛma anyunlu, na ɔvale ɔ bonyi nu anwoma ɔkpanle bɛ nu la.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vi anwuma dwule razɔle me, ɔyele me ɔvile azule buma ne anu.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Menwunle me nyunlu la, bɛratetale me; na Ɛdɛnkɛma liele me ti.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ɔyele me ɔvile munzule nu; ɔliele me, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nye liele me nwo.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lole me, wɔ me pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, me sa anwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ ti, ɔlole me.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Meli Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ azo, metɛkakyile me nzi metɛsile me Nyamenle amumuyɛ nu.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never turn away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Menlile ye mɛla ne mɔ amuala azo; meambulu ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Meanli fɔlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu, mendwenle me nwo menvile fɔlɛlilɛ nwo.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Yemɔti me pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, me nwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu ti, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlo me.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle nɔhalɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛmaa wɔ la; mɔɔ nvonleɛ ɛnle ɔ nwo la, ɛmaa ɔnwu kɛ nvonleɛ ɛnle ɛ nwo.

english_verse: With all who are sincere you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ɛ nwo te maa menli mɔɔ anwo te la, na ɛyɛ kokonyinli wɔ maamɔvoma anwo zo.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you look for ways to put down the proud.
translation_verse: Ɛdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la, na ɛbɛlɛ adubɛnwoma aze.

english_verse: Our Lord and God, you are my lamp. You turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ, ɛle me kɛnlaneɛ; O me Nyamenle, ɛkpa me awozinli.

english_verse: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
translation_verse: Ɛmaa medi ɛlɔne nwo zo konim, medua me Nyamenle ne tumi zo mesɛkye bɛ nwo banebɔlɛ.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhye, ye nyɛleɛ di munli, ye edwɛkɛ ɛnli mgbanwo! Ɔle enyinlike ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtane ye la.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a le nwane? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ. Nwane a le bodane a? Kyesɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: You are my strong fortress, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhye le me ɛvealeka ɛsesebɛ, ɔmaa me adenle nu yɛ wienyi.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔzieziele me gyakɛ kɛ kɛtɛboɛ, me nwo kɔlɔnwo wɔ awoka zo.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ɔtete me konle nu, amaa meahola ɛda mɔɔ anu yɛ se la to.

english_verse: You alone are my shield, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔva wɔ ngoanelielɛ enyinlike ne wɔwowa me, wɔ moalɛ ne ɛmaa meyɛ sonlakpole.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ɛvale me ɛziele azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛlɛ la azo, na meamkpo aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Menvoanle me kpɔvolɛma menzɛkyele bɛ, meangyinla toonwo menwiele bɛ ku.

english_verse: I destroyed them! I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Membobɔle bɛ, menuanle bɛ bo zo; bɛguale aze, bɛangola me nyunlu gyinla.

english_verse: You helped me win victories and forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle me konle nu anwosesebɛ; ɛmanle menlile me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle me kpɔvolɛma nriandile vile me nyunlu, menzɛkyele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛle moalɛ, na bɛannyia bie; bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeanlie zo.

english_verse: I ground them to dust, and I squashed them like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Mendinle bɛ kɛ munlutu, mentietiale bɛ nwo zo kɛ awɔdenle zo ndɛtɛlɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from my stubborn people and made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Ɛliele me ɛvile menli mɔɔ dele atua la asa anu; ɛyɛle me maanle maanle belemgbunli; na menli mɔɔ menze bɛ la zonlenle me.

english_verse: They have lost all courage and from their fortresses they come trembling.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo mɔra tu, na bɛfa anwowozolɛ bɛfi bɛ ɛvealeka ne mɔ bɛfinde.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you! You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze! Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha me pepɛdievolɛ ne! Bɛbɔ me ngoanelielɛ pepɛdievolɛ Nyamenle ne nolo!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ maanle menlile me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim, na ɔbɛlɛle maanle maanle aze wɔ me nyunlu a;

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies, and you made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ liele me vile me kpɔvolɛma asa anu la, manle menlile me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim, na ɔliele me ɔvile nzakadolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Nyamenle maa ye belemgbunli ne di konim mgbole; ɔkile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔmaa sonla ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la, Devidi nee ɔ bo zo amra, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord has told me what to say.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dua me nwo zo tendɛ; ye edwɛkɛ ne dua me nloa.

english_verse: Our Mighty Rock, the God of Jacob, told me, “A ruler who obeys God and does right
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdendɛ; Yizilayɛ pepɛdievolɛ ne ɛze me kɛ, “Belemgbunli mɔɔ fa pɛlepɛlelilɛ sie ye menli, na ɔfa Nyamenlezulolɛ ɔsie bɛ la,

english_verse: is like the sunrise on a cloudless day, or like rain that sparkles on the grass.”
translation_verse: kpakye bɛ nwo zo kɛ nwonlomɔ ewia, ɔle kɛ nwonlomɔ sɛnzɛne mɔɔ amungu ɛnle ɔ nyunlu, ɔle kɛ ezule mɔɔ maa ndile fifi la.”

english_verse: I have ruled this way, and God will never break his promise to me. God's promise is complete and unchanging; he will always help me and give me what I hope for.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, kɛ Nyamenle bayila me bo zo amra la ɛne, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nee me ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛntulu ɛlɛ a, ɔle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛnrɛtulu nu noko ɛlɛ, ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɛngakyi ɛlɛ a. Ɔbamaa meakpazi wɔ me anyelazo nu, na meanyia moalɛ kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: But evil people are pulled up like thornbushes. They are not dug up by hand,
translation_verse: Anzenyamenlema le kɛ mbowunzaka mɔɔ bɛfuandi bɛgua la, ɔluakɛ bɛfa bɛ sa bɛfula a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: but with a sharp spear and are burned on the spot. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɔsɔ bɛ nu la, kyesɛ ɔfa bulalɛ anzɛɛ atwɛ baka; bɛbayela bɛ bɔkɔɔ. Devidi ɛlɔnema ne anu katakyiema (

english_verse: except Eleazar. He killed Philistines until his hand was cramped, and he couldn't let go of his sword. When Eleazar finished, all the Israelite troops had to do was come back and take the enemies' weapons and armor. The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: na ɔgyinlanle ɔ gyakɛ anu kpundii ɔ nee Filisitiama honle toonwo ɔ sa nyianle mɔɔ ɛnee akee ɔgyakyi dadeɛ ne anu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a. Ɛdɛnkɛma lile konim kenle ko ne. Konle ne wiele la, Yizilayɛma ziale hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛlieza wɔ la na bɛhɔyeyele avunli ne mɔ konle adɛladeɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: and certainly just as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was the commander of the Thirty Warriors, but he still did not become one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Ɔnyianle duma kpole wɔ katakyiema “Abulasa Ne” avinli na ɔyɛle bɛ kpanyinli, noko yeando katakyiema “Nsa Ne.”

english_verse: These are the names of David's warriors: Ishbosheth the son of Hachmon was the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle, he killed
translation_verse: Katakyiema mɔɔ ɛnee Devidi lɛ bɛ la aluma ɛne: mɔɔ lumua la a le Dwohyɛbe Bahyibɛte mɔɔ vi Takemɔn, mɔɔ li “Nsa Ne” ati la. Ɔvale atwɛ ɔ nee menli ɛya mɔtwɛ honle na ɔhunle bɛ muala.

english_verse: The next one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite. One time when the Philistines were at war with Israel, he and David dared the Philistines to fight them. Every one of the Israelite soldiers turned and ran,
translation_verse: Katakyiema nsa ne, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a le Ɛlieza; Dodo mɔɔ vi Aho abusua nu la ara ɔ. Kenle ko ɔ nee Devidi bɛhɔdoale Filisitiama mɔɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa la na bɛ nee bɛ honle. Yizilayɛma nriandile,

english_verse: but Shammah stood in the middle of the field and killed the Philistines. The crops were saved, and the Lord gave Israel a great victory.
translation_verse: na Hyama gyinlanle ɔ gyakɛ anu kpundii wɔ ɛya ne anu. Ɔbɔle nwolɛ bane na ɔhunle Filisitiama bɔkɔɔ; Ɛdɛnkɛma lile konim kpole bie.

english_verse: One year at harvest time, the Three Warriors went to meet David at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Ɛbuhenle ne anu, ɛnee Filisitiama ɛyɛ bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza, na “Abulasa Ne” anu menli nsa rale Devidi anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Adɛlam bolɛ bɔne ne anu.

english_verse: and he was very thirsty. He said, “I wish I had a drink from the well by the gate at Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Akee Devidi anwo lɔle sua nu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Anrɛɛ meanyia awie aza nzule wɔ bula ne mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa la bie arɛlɛ me yeamaa meanlo.”

english_verse: The Three Warriors sneaked into the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. But after they brought the water back to David, he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as a sacrifice
translation_verse: Na katakyiema nsa ne bɔle vale Filisitiama azokoɛleɛ ne hɔle Bɛtelɛhɛm hɔzale nzule wɔ bula ne mɔɔ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa la bie rɛlɛle Devidi. Bɛ nee ye rale la yeanno. Ɔguale ye aze ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma;

english_verse: and said to the Lord, “I can't drink this water! It's like the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: na ɔzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, menrɛhola nzule ɛhye no. Saa meyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee menlo menli ne mɔɔ vale bɛ ngoane dole nzeleba hɔzale la mogya.” Yemɔti yeanno. Ɛhye a le ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ katakyiema nsa ne yɛle a.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. He killed two of Moab's best fighters, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada mɔɔ vi Kabezili la ara Bɛnaya ɔdaye ɔle ɛlɔnenli katakyie kpalɛ; ɔyɛle ninyɛne mgbole na eza ɔhunle Mowabe ɛlɔnema nwiɔ mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la. Eza ɔhunle awenade wɔ kuma bie anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ezukɔtweaba ɛlɛtɔ la.

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Dwowabe adiema Abehyae a le katakyiema “Abulasa Ne” kpanyinli a. Ɔvale ye atwɛ ne ɔ nee menli ɛya nsa honle ɔhunle bɛ kɔsɔɔti na ɔnyianle duma kpole wɔ bɛdabɛ “Abulasa Ne” anu.

english_verse: Another time, he killed an Egyptian, as big as a giant. The Egyptian was armed with a spear, but Benaiah only had a club. Benaiah grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Eza ɔhunle Yigyibitinli nrenya anwo fɛlɛko bie. Ɛnee Yigyibitinli ne lɛ atwɛ. Bɛnaya lɛ kokolobaka ala; ɔzale Yigyibitinli ne ɔliele ye atwɛ ne na ɔvale ɔwɔle ye ɔhunle ye.

english_verse: Some of the Thirty Warriors were: Asahel the brother of Joab Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem Shammah from Harod Elika from Harod Helez the Paltite Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa Abiezer from Anathoth Mebunnai the Hushathite Zalmon the Ahohite Maharai from Netophah Heleb the son of Baanah from Netophah Ittai the son of Ribai from Gibeah of the tribe of Benjamin Benaiah from Pirathon Hiddai from the streams on Mount Gaash Abialbon from Beth-Arabah Azmaveth from Bahurim Eliahba from Shaalbon Jashen Jonathan the son of Shammah the Hararite Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai from Maacah Eliam the son of Ahithophel from Gilo Hezro from Carmel Paarai the Arbite Igal the son of Nathan from Zobah Bani the Gadite Zelek from Ammon Naharai from Beeroth, who carried the weapons of Joab the son of Zeruiah Ira the Ithrite Gareb the Ithrite Uriah the Hittite There were
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ boka katakyiema “Abulasa Ne” anwo la ɛne: Dwowabe adiema nrenya Asahɛle Dodo mɔɔ vi Bɛtelɛhɛm la ara nrenya Ɛleheenan Hyama nee Yilaeka mɔɔ vi Hɛlɔdo la Hilɛze mɔɔ vi Pɛlɛte Yekɛhye mɔɔ vi Tɛkowa la ara nrenya Ayela Abayizɛ mɔɔ vi Anato Mɛbɛnae mɔɔ vi Huhya Zalemɔn mɔɔ vi Aho Meehalae mɔɔ vi Nɛtɔfa Beeyana mɔɔ vi Nɛtɔfa la ara nrenya Hilɛbe Relaebeeyae mɔɔ vi Gebɛya na ɔvi Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne anu la ara nrenya Yeteyae Bɛnaya mɔɔ vi Paeleetɔn Hedeeyae mɔɔ vi mbɔnza ne mɔ mɔɔ zua Geeyahye la anu la Ebayalebɔn mɔɔ vi Aaleba Azemeevɛte mɔɔ vi Bahulem Yilayaba mɔɔ vi Hyeeyalebɔn Gyahyɛn amra mrenya ne mɔ Dwɔnatan Hyama mɔɔ vi Hɛla Hyɛlaa mɔɔ vi Hɛla la ara nrenya Ehayam Ahahyebae mɔɔ vi Meeyaka la ara nrenya Yilefɛlɛte Ahetɔfɛle mɔɔ vi Gaelo la ara nrenya Yilayam Hɛzelo mɔɔ vi Kamɛle Peeyalae mɔɔ vi Arelabe Neetan mɔɔ vi Zoba la ara nrenya Ayegale Beenae mɔɔ vi Gaade Zilɛke mɔɔ vi Amɔn Neehalae mɔɔ vi Bilo mɔɔ yemɔ a soa Zɛluaya ara Dwowabe konle ninyɛne ne la Ayela nee Gɛlɛbe mɔɔ vi Gyatɛɛ Hɛtenli Yulaya Bɛ muala bɛle katakyiema abulasa nee nsuu.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty! Why have you come to see me?” David answered, “I've come to buy your threshing place. I have to build the Lord an altar here, so this disease will stop killing the people.”
translation_verse: Na Alɔna bizale kɛ, “Duzu ati a Nana ɛra ye sonvolɛ ye ɛke a?” Devidi buale ye kɛ, “Mera kɛ mebadɔ wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ye, meazi azukponle wɔ ɛke meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, amaa ewule nzane ye azi aze.”

english_verse: They went to Gilead and to Kadesh in Syria. Then they went to Dan, Ijon, and on toward Sidon.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhɔle Geleade nee Keedɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Hɛtema maanle nu la, na bɛrale Dan; bɛvi Dan la, bɛhɔle Saedɛn adɔleɛ.

english_verse: So David told Joab and the army officers, “Go to every tribe in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north all the way south to Beersheba, and count everyone who can serve in the army. I want to know how many there are.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti belemgbunli ne zele Dwowabe nee safohyenlema ne mɔ, mɔɔ nee ye wɔ la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu, ɔvi Dan mɔɔ kɔkpula Biyɛ Hyiba la na bɛdia bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛmaa menwu bɛ dodo.”

english_verse: But when David refused to change his mind, Joab and the army officers went out and started counting the people.
translation_verse: Noko belemgbunli ne manle bɛlile ye edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ne azo. Yemɔti Dwowabe nee ye safohyenlema ne vile belemgbunli ne anyunlu na bɛhɔle menli ne ɛdianlɛ.

english_verse: They crossed the Jordan River and began with Aroer and the town in the middle of the river valley. From there they went toward Gad and on as far as Jazer.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛle Dwɔdan ne na bɛyɛle bɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ Alowɛ. Bɛbɔle ɔ bo wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne avinli la azo na bɛhɔle Gate nee Gyeezɛ.

english_verse: After they had gone through the whole land, they went back to Jerusalem. It had taken them
translation_verse: Siane ngɔnla kenle abulanwiɔ yɛɛ bɛwiele menli ne tia a; bɛhɔle maanle ne anu azua ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo na bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Araunah looked and saw David and his soldiers coming up toward him. He went over to David, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Alɔna manle ɔ nye zo la, ɔnwunle kɛ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛba ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Ɔhɔyiale bɛ na ɔdule ɔdɔle belemgbunli ne agyakɛ anu, ɔbutule ɔ nyunlu aze na ɔbizale ye ahye.

english_verse: David saw the angel killing everyone and told the Lord, “These people are like sheep with me as their shepherd. I have sinned terribly, but they have done nothing wrong. Please, punish me and my family instead of them!” David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place (
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi nwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkuhu menli ne mɔ la, ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Mame, meze kɛ meyɛ ɛtane na mebɔ munzule, na mboane ɛhye mɔ, duzu a bɛyɛ a? Mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa wɔ ndeanlɛ ne ɛyɛ me ngome nee egya awuke nu amra ɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: After everyone had been counted, David realized he had done wrong. He told the Lord, “What I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Lord, please forgive me.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi wiele menli ne tia la ye adwenle bule ye fɔlɛ. Na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, meyɛ ɛtane kpole wɔ mɔɔ meyɛ la anwo. Mesɛlɛ wɔ, fa wɔ sonvolɛ, me ɛtane kyɛ me, ɔluakɛ meli ngoaseasɛm.”

english_verse: Before David even got up the next morning, the Lord had told David's prophet Gad
translation_verse: Nwonlomɔ ne mɔɔ Devidi dwazole la, Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne dwule Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gaade mɔɔ yemɔ a ɔka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɔkile Devidi la anwo zo na ɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: to take a message to David. Gad went to David and told him: You must choose one of three ways for the Lord to punish you: Will there be seven years when the land won't grow enough food for your people? Or will your enemies chase you and make you run from them for three months? Or will there be three days of horrible disease in your land? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God, who sent me.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gaade rale Devidi ɛkɛ rahanle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle la hilele ye, na ɔbizale Devidi kɛ, “Boni a ɛkulo a? Ɛvolɛ nsa ɛhɔnezilɛ wɔ wɔ maanle ye anu, siane nsa ɛnriandilɛ mɔɔ ɛnriandi wɔ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu anzɛɛ kenle nsa ewule nzane wɔ wɔ maanle ye anu? Dwenle nwolɛ na maa me nwolɛ mualɛ maa menva mengɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

english_verse: David was really frightened and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Na Devidi zele Gaade kɛ, “Mewɔ anwongyelelɛ nu! Noko akee kɛ dasanli kɛdua me kakɛ la, maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne ɛdua me kakɛ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ, ye anwunvɔnezelɛ le kpole.”

english_verse: So that morning, the Lord sent an angel to spread a horrible disease everywhere in Israel, from Dan to Beersheba. And before it was over,
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne dendenle ɔ sa kɛ ɔbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle wɔ suakpole ne ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo na ɔzele Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kɛ, “Gyakyi! Ɛhye ala le kpalɛ!” Ɛnee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne wɔ Gyibɛsenli Alɔna ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne.

english_verse: Araunah said, “Take whatever you want and offer your sacrifice. Here are some oxen for the sacrifice. You can use the threshing-boards and the wooden yokes for the fire.
translation_verse: Na Alɔna zele Devidi kɛ, “Nana, fa azɛlɛ ne na eza fa debie biala mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la bɔ azu ne maa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Nlankɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛfa wɔayɛ azubɔdeɛ wɔabɔ azu ne la ɛne, nyɛmoa ne mɔ akɔme mbaka ne mɔ nee ndaboa ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛwozo ma ne la ɛne. Fa bɛ muala yɛ ɛyɛne.”

english_verse: Take them—they're yours! I hope the Lord your God will be pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Alɔna vale ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti manle belemgbunli ne na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛlie wɔ azu ne.”

english_verse: But David answered, “No! I have to pay you what they're worth. I can't offer the Lord my God a sacrifice that cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing place and the oxen for
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele Alɔna kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, metua ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti kakɛ, ɔboalekɛ nane ɛyelalɛ azu mɔɔ mebɔ meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, mɔɔ membɔ nwolɛ kakɛ la, menrɛbɔ.” Yemɔti Devidi dɔle ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne nee nlankɛ ne mɔ dwɛtɛ fufule ngoko abulanlu.

english_verse: Then he built an altar for the Lord. He offered sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. The Lord answered the prayers of the people, and no one else died from the terrible disease.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzile azukponle ne ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔbɔle nane ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azu. Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ ne na ewule nzane ne gyakyile Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: King David was now an old man, and he always felt cold, even under a lot of blankets.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne hɔle bie la ɛnee Belemgbunli Devidi akee ɛyɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ. Bɛfa ahundu bɛmundumundu ɔ nwo bɔbɔ a ɔ nwo ɛnyɛ wuluwulu.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we will look for a young woman to take care of you. She can lie down beside you and keep you warm.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ye sonvolɛma ne hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛkpondɛ bɛlɛra bie yɛmaa ɔ nee wɔ ɛdɛnla na ɔnlea wɔ. Eza ɔbala ɛ nwo ɛkɛ na ɛ nwo ayɛ wuluwulu.”

english_verse: They looked everywhere in Israel until they found a very beautiful young woman named Abishag, who lived in the town of Shunem. They brought her to David, and she took care of him. But David did not have sex with her. Adonijah Tries To Become King
translation_verse: Bɛlɛra ne anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɛnee ɔnea Belemgbunli Devidi na ɔyɛ ɔ nwo debie biala a, noko belemgbunli ne anva ɔ sa anga ye. Adonaegya yɛ ɔ nwo belemgbunli

english_verse: Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith. He was Absalom's younger brother and was very handsome. One day, Adonijah started bragging, “I'm going to make myself king!” So he got some chariots and horses, and he hired
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔ ze Devidi angulo kɛ ɔ ra ne kɛva ɛya la ati, kenle ko bɔbɔ yeambiza ye nwolɛ edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔyɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye a?” Adonaegya le Abesalɛm anzi ralɛ yɛɛ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Adonijah himself was afraid of what Solomon might do to him, so he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Adonaegya noko zulole Sɔlɔmɔn, yemɔti ɔhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔhɔzɔle azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ nwiɔ ne anu.

english_verse: Adonijah met with Joab the son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest and asked them if they would help him become king. Both of them agreed to help.
translation_verse: Ɔzuzule nwolɛ ɔhilele raalɛ Zɛluaya ara Dwowabe nee sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛliele nzuzulɛ ne bɛdole nu na bɛzile ye adua na eza bɛlile ɔ nzi.

english_verse: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards all refused.
translation_verse: Noko sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee Gyɛhɔyada ara Bɛnaya, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan, Hyemɛyae nee Riliyae yɛɛ Devidi ɛlɔne nu katakyiema ne mɔ anli angɔ Adonaegya anzi.

english_verse: Adonijah invited his brothers and David's officials from Judah to go with him to Crawling Rock near Rogel Spring, where he sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves.
translation_verse: Kenle ko bie Adonaegya hunle nlankɛ nee mboane nee nyɛmoa ngakyile mɔɔ ɛlɔ la na ɔvale ɔbɔle azu wɔ Nwɔlɛ Bolɛ ne mɔɔ zua Ɛnlogɛle la azo. Ɔdole ɛsalɛ ɔvɛlɛle ɔ mediema mɔɔ le belemgbunli amra mrenya ne mɔ nee belemgbunli mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la amuala.

english_verse: But he did not invite Nathan, Benaiah, David's bodyguards, or his own brother Solomon.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yeanvɛlɛ bɛ la a le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan, Bɛnaya, Devidi ɛlɔne nu katakyiema ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɔ diema Sɔlɔmɔn. Bɛyɛ Sɔlɔmɔn belemgbunli

english_verse: When Nathan heard what had happened, he asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother: Have you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has made himself king? But David doesn't know a thing about it.
translation_verse: Neetan zele Sɔlɔmɔn ɔ nli Batehyɛba kɛ, “Asoo ɛtɛtele kɛ menli bie bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ Adonaegya mɔɔ le Hagete ara ne belemgbunli, mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi ɛnze nwolɛ bie la?

english_verse: You and your son Solomon will be killed, unless you do what I tell you.
translation_verse: Bɛla maa yɛva nwolɛ adwenle, amaa ɛ nee ɛ ra Sɔlɔmɔn bɛanyia bɛ ti.

english_verse: Go say to David, “You promised me that Solomon would be the next king. So why is Adonijah now king?”
translation_verse: Ka ɛ nwo kɔnwu Belemgbunli Devidi kɛ, ‘Nana, mekakye kɛ ɛbɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ me ra Sɔlɔmɔn a kenle bie bali wɔ agya, azie maanle ye a. Na duzu ati a akee bɛva Adonaegya bɛzie belemgbunli a?’

english_verse: While you are still talking to David, I'll come in and tell him that everything you said is true.
translation_verse: Na mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee Belemgbunli Devidi ɛlɛtendɛ la mebavinde ɛkɛ ne na meado wɔ edwɛkɛ ne azo.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, David was in his bedroom where Abishag was taking care of him because he was so old. Bathsheba went in
translation_verse: Yemɔti Batehyɛba hɔnwunle Belemgbunli Devidi wɔ ye suakunlu ɛkɛ. Mekɛ ne anu, ɛnee kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi anye ɛvi dɔɔnwo la ati, ɔvea sua nu yɛɛ bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ vi Hyunɛm mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Abehyage la a nea ye a.

english_verse: and bowed down. “What can I do for you?” David asked.
translation_verse: Batehyɛba hotole bizale belemgbunli ne ahye. Na belemgbunli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkpondɛ a?”

english_verse: Bathsheba answered: Your Majesty, you promised me in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be the next king.
translation_verse: Batehyɛba buale kɛ, “Nana, mekakye kɛ ɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛbɔle me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛ ra Sɔlɔmɔn a bali wɔ agya, azie maanle ne a.

english_verse: But Adonijah has already been made king, and you didn't know anything about it.
translation_verse: Noko kɛkala, Adonaegya ɛlɛdi belemgbunli mɔɔ wɔmɔ Nana, ɛnze nwolɛ ɛhwee a.

english_verse: He sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. And he invited Abiathar the priest, Joab your army commander, and all your sons to be there, except Solomon, your loyal servant.
translation_verse: Yehu nlankɛ, nyɛmoa mɔɔ ɛlɔ nee mboane dɔɔnwo yebɔ azu, na yevɛlɛ nana amra mrenya ne mɔ amuala nee sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata nee safohyenle kpanyinli Dwowabe, noko yeanvɛlɛ wɔ kakula Sɔlɔmɔn.

english_verse: Your Majesty, everyone in Israel is waiting for you to announce who will be the next king.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, Nana, wɔmɔ yɛɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛnea wɔ a. Bɛtie kɛ ɛkɛze kɛ asomasi yɛɛ di me agya adɛnla belemgbunli ebia ne azo a.

english_verse: If you don't, they will say that Solomon and I have rebelled. They will treat us like criminals and kill us as soon as you die.
translation_verse: Nana, saa wɔannea wɔanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye wɔando ɛkɛ ne na kenle bie ɛkɔ wɔ ɛkɛla nzi a, bɛbaze me nee me ra Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ a.”

english_verse: Someone told David that he was there, and Nathan came in. He bowed with his face to the ground
translation_verse: Bɛhanle bɛhilele belemgbunli ne kɛ Neetan ɛra. Neetan rabutule belemgbunli ne anyunlu bizale ye ahye

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, did you say that Adonijah would be king?
translation_verse: na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nana, asoo ɛhanle kɛ Adonaegya bali wɔ agya adɛnla wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne azo?

english_verse: Earlier today, he sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. He invited the army commanders, Abiathar, and all your sons to be there. They are already eating and drinking and shouting, “Long live King Adonijah!”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ kenle ye ala, yehu nlankɛ, nyɛmoa mɔɔ ɛlɔ nee mboane dɔɔnwo yebɔ azu na yedo ɛsalɛ yevɛlɛ Nana amra ne mɔ amuala, Safohyenlema Kpanyinli Dwowabe yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata. Bɛlɛdi bɛno na bɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Nyamenle ɛyila belemgbunli Adonaegya ɛmaa ɔnyi ɔhyɛ.’

english_verse: But he didn't invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.
translation_verse: Noko mame, wɔ sonvolɛ, nee sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee Gyɛhɔyada ara Bɛnaya yɛɛ Sɔlɔmɔn ɛdeɛ, yeanvɛlɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Did you say they could do this without telling the rest of us who would be the next king? Solomon Becomes King
translation_verse: Na Nana, amuanrɛɛ wɔyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye yɛɛ wɔambɔ zolɛ wɔangile yɛ sonla holɛ ko mɔɔ saa ɛkakyi ɛ nwo a ɔbali ebia ne la a.”

english_verse: David said, “Tell Bathsheba to come here.” She came and stood in front of him.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi buale kɛ, “Bɛvɛlɛ Batehyɛba bɛmaa me.” Bɛvɛlɛle Batehyɛba na ɔragyinlanle belemgbunli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then he said, “The living Lord God of Israel has kept me safe. And so today, I will keep the promise I made to you in his name: Solomon will be the next king!”
translation_verse: suzuamgba ala mɔɔ meneanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne membɔle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ‘ɛ ra Sɔlɔmɔn a bali me agya adɛnla ebia ne azo’ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ meyɛ ye ɛnɛ demua ye a.”

english_verse: Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and said, “Your Majesty, I pray that you will live a long time!”
translation_verse: Na Batehyɛba hotole nidi nu wɔ belemgbunli ne anyunlu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa me menle, Belemgbunli Devidi ɛdɛnla ngoane nu dahuu.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to come here.” When they arrived,
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Devidi zele kɛ, “Bɛvɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan nee Gyɛhɔyada ara Bɛnaya bɛmaa me.” Bɛvɛlɛle bɛ bɛmanle bɛrale.

english_verse: he told them: Take along some of my officials and let Solomon ride my own mule to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva Sɔlɔmɔn bɛdɛnla medame mumua ne me ɛkpɔnwɔndua ne azo na bɛva me sonvolɛma ne mɔ bɛboka ɔ nwo bɛ nee ye ɛhɔ Gaehɔn.

english_verse: When you get there, Zadok and Nathan will pour olive oil over Solomon's head to show that he is the new king of Israel. Then order someone to blow a trumpet and tell everyone to shout, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Saa bɛdwu ɛkɛ a bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan ɛkpokpa ye nwole kɛ ɔle Yizilayɛma belemgbunli. Bɛwie a bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu bɛze kɛ, ‘Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛnyi ɛhyɛ.’

english_verse: Bring him back here, and he will take my place as king. He is the one I have chosen to rule Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ na akee bɛli ɔ nzi bɛva ye bɛradɛnla me ebia ne azo, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔdi me gyakɛ anu yeali Yizilayɛma belemgbunli a. Meva ye mezie Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama belemgbunli.”

english_verse: Benaiah answered, “We will do it, Your Majesty. I pray that the Lord your God will let it happen.
translation_verse: Bɛnaya, mɔɔ le Gyɛhɔyada ara ne liele zolɛ, “Amen! Ɛhye ɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ le Nana ɔdaye ye Nyamenle ne anloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has always watched over you, and I pray that he will now watch over Solomon. May the Lord help Solomon to be an even greater king than you.”
translation_verse: Na kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Belemgbunli Devidi ɛzi ɛdɛnla la zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔ nee Sɔlɔmɔn ɛdɛnla, na ɔmaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛhɔ zolɛ ɛdɛla Belemgbunli Devidi ɛdeɛ ne bɔbɔ a.”

english_verse: Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah left and took along the two groups of David's special bodyguards. Solomon rode on David's mule as they led him to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Yemɔti sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan nee Bɛnaya, yɛɛ Kɛlɛtema nee Pɛlɛtema mɔɔ le belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ye sonvolɛma la hɔvale Sɔlɔmɔn dɛnlanle Belemgbunli Devidi ɛkpɔnwɔndua ne azo na bɛ nee ye hɔle Gaehɔn.

english_verse: Zadok the priest brought some olive oil from the sacred tent and poured it on Solomon's head to show that he was now king. A trumpet was blown and everyone shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Ɛke yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko vale nwole wɔ nane ɛweɛne nu mɔɔ ɔ nee ye vi Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la rale rawolale guale Sɔlɔmɔn ati zo a. Akee bɛwule aweɛne tendenle nu na ɛlɔne ne amuala zulole zolɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛyila Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛmaa ɔnyi ɔhyɛ.”

english_verse: Then they played flutes and celebrated as they followed Solomon back to Jerusalem. They made so much noise that the ground shook.
translation_verse: Menli ne kɔsɔɔti lile ɔ nzi, bɛbɔle fulutu bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole kpalɛ bɛmanle bɛ ne pɛle gua.

english_verse: Adonijah and his guests had almost finished eating when they heard the noise. Joab also heard the trumpet and asked, “What's all that noise about in the city?”
translation_verse: Adonaegya nee menli mɔɔ ɔdole ɛsalɛ ɔvɛlɛle bɛ la amuala wiele debie di la bɛdele dede ne mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛyɛ la. Dwowabe dele aweɛne tendenle ne ane la ɔbizale kɛ, “Na duzu dede a wɔ sua zo lɔ la?”

english_verse: Just then, Jonathan son of Abiathar came running up. “Come in,” Adonijah said. “An important man like you must have some good news.”
translation_verse: Ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ la, sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata ara Dwɔnatan rale ɛkɛ. Adonaegya vɛlɛle ye zele ye kɛ, “Nrenyakpa ɛne! Ayi, bɛla babɔ me amaneɛ fɛlɛko.”

english_verse: Jonathan answered: No, I don't! David has just announced that Solomon will be king.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan buale ye kɛ, “Me amaneɛ ɛnyɛ fɛ. Mɔɔ ɛzi la a le kɛ, Belemgbunli Devidi ɛva Sɔlɔmɔn ɛzie ebia.

english_verse: Solomon rode David's own mule to Gihon Spring, and Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and David's special bodyguards went with him. When they got there, Zadok and Nathan made Solomon king. Then everyone celebrated all the way back to Jerusalem. That's the noise you hear in the city.
translation_verse: ɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan ɛkpokpa ye nwole wɔ Gaehɔn. Fɛlɛko a le duzu? Sua zo lɔ ɛkpudwu zɛhae ala. Ɛnee dede ne mɔɔ bɛte la, ɔ bo ɛne.

english_verse: Solomon is now king.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn ɛli ebia ne.

english_verse: And listen to this! David's officials told him, “We pray that your God will help Solomon to be an even greater king!” David was in his bed at the time, but he bowed
translation_verse: Eza yeanga ye zɔ, belemgbunli mbɔlɔba ne mɔ amuala ɛrayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi mo na bɛze ye kɛ, ‘Wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛmaa Sɔlɔmɔn duma ɛyɛ kpole ɛdɛla wɔ duma ne na ɔmaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛhɔ zolɛ ɛdɛla wɔ ɛdeɛ ne.’ Bɛhanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye la belemgbunli bɔle ɔ ti aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔla ye ɛkpa ne azo la

english_verse: and prayed, “I praise you, Lord God of Israel. You have made my son Solomon king and have let me live to see it.”
translation_verse: na ɔzele kɛ, ‘Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛmaa ɛnɛ kenle ye me kunlu ralɛ ɛli me ebia ye wɔ medame me nye zo la.’ ”

english_verse: Adonijah's guests shook with fear when they heard this news, and they left as fast as they could.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ɛhye manle menli mɔɔ rale Adonaegya ɛkponledolɛ ne abo la zulole na bɛpenle ɛkɛ ne ala bɛzandele.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon, “Adonijah is afraid of you and is holding onto the corners of the altar. He wants you to promise that you won't kill him.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔhanle bɛhilele Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ Adonaegya ɛzulo ye, yemɔti yehɔdane azukponle ne, na ɔse, “Kyesɛ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn bɔ me ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔnrɛva ɔ sa ɔnrɛha me kolaa na meavi ɛke.”

english_verse: Solomon answered, “If Adonijah doesn't cause any trouble, I won't hurt him. But if he does, I'll have him killed.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn buale ye kɛ, “Saa ɔkile subane kpalɛ a, ɔ ti enrinli ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛde ɛnrɛdɔ. Na saa ɔdi ɛtane a, yemɔ ɔbawu.”

english_verse: Then he sent someone to the altar to get Adonijah. After Adonijah came and bowed down, Solomon said, “Adonijah, go home.”
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zoanle manle bɛhɔvale Adonaegya wɔ azukponle ne anwo bɛrale. Adonaegya rahotole Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn anyunlu ɛkɛ na Sɔlɔmɔn zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ sua nu.”

english_verse: Not long before David died, he told Solomon:
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi bahɔ ewule nu la, ɔvɛlɛle ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn na ɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: My son, I will soon die, as everyone must. But I want you to be strong and brave.
translation_verse: “Ɔka ekyii mekɔ me ɛkɛla nzi, yemɔti gyinla kpundii kɛ ralɛ nrenya,

english_verse: Do what the Lord your God commands and follow his teachings. Obey everything written in the Law of Moses. Then you will be a success, no matter what you do or where you go.
translation_verse: na di gyima mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛze wɔ kɛ ɛli la. Dua ye adenle ne azo, di ye mɛla ne mɔ nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Mosisi mɛla buluku ne anu la, amaa wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne adenrɛ na wɔakpazi wɔ adenle nee nyɛleɛ biala anu.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always faithfully obey the Lord. If you do, he will keep the solemn promise he made to me that someone from our family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Saa ɛyɛ ɛhye a yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle me la bayɛ nɔhalɛ a. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Saa ɛ mra ne mɔ nea boɛ na bɛfa bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛtoa me bo zo nɔhalɛ nu a, yemɔ ɛ bo zo amra ɛnrɛvi Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ebia ne azo ɛlɛ.’

english_verse: Solomon, don't forget what Joab did to me by killing Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of Israel's army. He killed them as if they were his enemies in a war, but he did it when there was no war. He is guilty, and now it's up to you to punish him
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bieko la a le kɛ, ɛdawɔ ɛze mɔɔ Zɛluaya ara Dwowabe vale yɛle me na ɔhunle Yizilayɛ safohyenle mgbanyinli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ le Abenɛɛ ara Nɛɛ nee Gyita ara Ameesa la. Ɔhunle menli nwiɔ ɛhye wɔ anzonudwolɛ mekɛ nu ɔziele menli mɔɔ Abenɛɛ nee Ameesa hunle bɛ wɔ konle nu la abo zo; ɔmanle mengyinlanle gyinlabelɛ ɛtane, na kɛkala nwolɛ ngyelelɛ ɛdo me.

english_verse: in the way you think best. Whatever you do, don't let him die peacefully in his old age.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ fa nwolɛ adwenle, noko mmamaa Dwowabe wu ɔ ti anwo ewule.

english_verse: Be sure to do something about Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim in the territory of Benjamin. He cursed and insulted me the day I went to Mahanaim. But later, when he came to meet me at the Jordan River, I promised that I wouldn't kill him.
translation_verse: “Akee Bɛngyamanenli Gila ara Hyemɛyae mɔɔ vi Bahulem la ɔdaye ɔwɔ ɛkɛ. Kenle mɔɔ mengɔle Meehaneeyem la ɔbɔle me sasa kpole bie, noko me nee ye yiale Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa la menvale Ɛdɛnkɛma menganle ndane kɛ menrɛhu ye.

english_verse: Now you must punish him. He's an old man, but you're wise enough to know that you must have him killed. David Dies
translation_verse: Noko mmamaa ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔdi. Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛze wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ la, ɛbanwu adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa ye ɛse zolɛ la. Maa ɔva ɔ ti kanrɛlɛ ne ɔdua.” Devidi ewule

english_verse: he saddled his donkey and went after them. He found them and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Hyemɛyae vole ye asoaso zo hɔle Ekehye ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkakpo bɛ bo zo; ɔhɔnwunle ye ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ na ɔvale bɛ ɔziale ɔrale.

english_verse: Joab's family will always suffer because of what he did, but the Lord will always bless David's family and his kingdom with peace.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli nwiɔ zɔhane mogya bagua ɔdaye Dwowabe nee ɔ bo zo amra ati zo a; Devidi nee ɔ bo zo amra mɔɔ di ye ebia ne la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa saleɛ ɛdoa bɛ dahuu!”

english_verse: His son Solomon became king and took control of David's kingdom. Adonijah Is Killed
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn lile ɔ ze Devidi agya na ye belemgbunlililɛ ne hɔle zolɛ. Adonaegya ewule

english_verse: One day, Adonijah went to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and she asked, “Is this a friendly visit?” “Yes.
translation_verse: Akee Adonaegya mɔɔ le Hagete ara ne rale Sɔlɔmɔn ɔ nli Batehyɛba ɛkɛ. Batehyɛba bizale ye kɛ, “Ɔle bɛtɛɛ ɔ?” Adonaegya buale kɛ, “Ɔle bɛtɛɛ.”

english_verse: I just want to talk with you.” “All right,” she told him, “go ahead.”
translation_verse: Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Mebabɔ wɔ adawu ekyi bie.” Batehyɛba zele kɛ, “Ka maa mendie.”

english_verse: “You know that I was king for a little while,” Adonijah replied. “And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.
translation_verse: Adonaegya hanle kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ ɛnee belemgbunlililɛ ne le me ɛdeɛ, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma amuala ze sie a. Noko kɛkala, ninyɛne ɛhakyi ɛmaa ebia ne ɛhɔli me diema Sɔlɔmɔn ɛkɛ. Ɛhye kile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛva ɛmaa ye a.

english_verse: Would you do me a favor?” “What do you want?” Bathsheba asked.
translation_verse: Na melɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ ko meto ɛ nyunlu na mmaye me rɛle ɛto me sa nu.” Batehyɛba bizale ye kɛ, “Yemɔ a le duzu?”

english_verse: “All right,” she said. “I'll ask him.”
translation_verse: Batehyɛba buale ye kɛ, “Mede, mebava wɔ edwɛkɛ ne meado belemgbunli anyunlu.”

english_verse: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Batehyɛba hɔle Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabɔ Adonaegya adawu ne yeahile ye. Belemgbunli ne dwazole bɔle ɔ ti aze manle ɔ nli na ɔdɛnlanle aze. Ɔvɛlɛle ɔmanle bɛrɛlɛle ɔ nli ebia wɔ ye fema zo,

english_verse: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, “Would you do me a small favor?” Solomon replied, “Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.”
translation_verse: na ɔ nli hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ debie ekyi; dwenle nwolɛ, mebodo wɔ, mmakɔsɔ ɛ ti.” Belemgbunli zele ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, duzu debie ɔ? Biza na mebabua wɔ gyɛlɛɛnye.”

english_verse: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bizale ɔ nli kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛbiza Abehyage agyalɛ wɔamaa Adonaegya ɛ? Saa zɔhane ɛdeɛ a ɛnee die Yizilayɛ maanle ne amuala noko boka nwo maa Adonaegya ɛ. Yemɔ a ɔle adiema koatee a. Eza yeanga ye zɔhane, sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata nee Dwowabe wɔ ɔ nzi.”

english_verse: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne hanle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Deɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Adonaegya ɛbiza la, saa meammaa yeanva ɔ ti kanrɛlɛ ne yeandua a Nyamenle ɛdua me kakɛ ɛgua me bie zolɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ tease Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛlie me ebia ye, mɔɔ le egya Devidi ebia ye ɛzie aze ɛmaa me, na yebɔ me atɛnlase la, ɔwɔ kɛ Adonaegya tɔ amolɛ nu ɛnɛ demua ye!”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “go kill Adonijah.” So Adonijah died. Abiathar Is Sent Back Home
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn amgba zoanle Gyɛhɔyada ara Bɛnaya manle ɔhɔhunle Adonaegya. Abayata ɛvoanlɛ nee Dwowabe ewule

english_verse: Solomon sent for Abiathar the priest and said: Abiathar, go back home to Anathoth! You ought to be killed too, but I won't do it now. When my father David was king, you were in charge of the sacred chest, and you went through a lot of hard times with my father.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne hanle hilele sɛlɛvolɛ Abayata kɛ, “Kɔ wɔ maanle nu wɔ Anato. Ɛfɛta ewule, noko menrɛmaa bɛnrɛhu wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛnleanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo wɔ egya Devidi mekɛ zo a. Eza ɛ nee egya bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo.”

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Sɔlɔmɔn yele Abayata gyima nu kɛ ɔnle Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛ bieko. Ɔyɛle ɛhye, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle wɔ Yilae abusua ne anwo wɔ Hyaelo la ayɛ nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Dwowabe dele mɔɔ ɛzi la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɔgyi Adonaegya anzi, ɛnee ɔnle Abesalɛm anzi. Na ɔnriandile ɔhɔwolole Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔhɔdanenle azukponle ne.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn dele kɛ Dwowabe ɛnriandi ɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu, ɛhɔdane azukponle ne. Na Sɔlɔmɔn zoanle Bɛnaya kɛ ɔhɔhu Dwowabe.

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Na Bɛnaya hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu hɔzele Dwowabe kɛ, “Belemgbunli se ɛvinde ɛrɛla.” Dwowabe buale kɛ, “Mendu me gyakɛ. Mewu ɛke ala.” Bɛnaya hɔbɔle belemgbunli amaneɛ bieko kɛ, “Nana, Dwowabe se ɔndu ɔ gyakɛ na ɔwu yeala ɛkɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua ye kakɛ wɔ ye amumuyɛ ne mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔhunle Abenɛɛ mɔɔ le Yizilayɛ Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne nee Ameesa mɔɔ le Dwuda Safohyenlema Kpanyinli, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ egya Devidi ɛnze nu la. Ɛnee mrenya nwiɔ ɛhye le kpalɛ yɛɛ eza bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛtɛla ye.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Bɛnaya hɔle azukponle ne anwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu hɔhunle Dwowabe na bɛziele ye wɔ ɔdaye ye awuke nu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn vale Bɛnaya lile Dwowabe agyakɛ anu kɛ ɔle Safohyenlema Kpanyinli na ɔvale Abayata gyinlabelɛ ne ɔmanle sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko. Hyemɛyae ewule

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Akee belemgbunli zoanle manle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Hyemɛyae na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Si sua wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke na tɛnla nu. Mmatu ɛ bo ɛkɔ ɛleka biala.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Kakye kɛ, kenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛpɛ Azule Kedelɔn ne la ɛnee wɔ ewule mekɛ ɛdwu yɛɛ wɔ mogya bagua ɛdawɔ ɛ ti zo.”

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Hyemɛyae buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Mɔɔ wɔha la, menzu wɔ kpolera; mebali zolɛ.” Yemɔti Hyemɛyae dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm hyɛle kpalɛ.

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ nsa anzi Hyemɛyae ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ anu nwiɔ nriandile hɔle Gate Belemgbunli Ekehye, mɔɔ le Meeyaka ara ne anwo lɔ. Bɛbɔle Hyemɛyae amaneɛ kɛ, “Wɔ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ wɔ Gate.”

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn dele kɛ Hyemɛyae vi Gyɛlusalɛm ɛpɛ azule ɛhɔ Gate ɛzia la,

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle ye na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, memanle ɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlile amonle ɛhilele me kɛ ɛnrɛdu ɛ bo ɛlɛ, na kenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛdu ɛ bo ɛkɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke ɛkɛhɔ ɛleka biala la ɛnee ɛze kɛ wɔwu ala ɛne? Se ɛzele me kɛ wɔde na ɛkɛli me mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: Duzu ati yɛɛ akee wɔdo ndane ne mɔɔ ɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhanle la na wɔbulu me mɛla ne azo ɛ?

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: Se ɛze ye ɛ ti anu, nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane mɔɔ ɛyɛle ɛtiale egya Devidi la? Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔ munzule abɔ ɛ ti.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn ɛdeɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila ye kosoɛɛ na saleɛ adoa egya Devidi ebia ne.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Nzinlii belemgbunli manle Bɛnaya tumi kɛ ɔhɔhu Hyemɛyae, na ɔhɔhunle ye. Yemɔti tumi kɔsɔɔti akee ralile Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn asa anu.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛnee bɛtɛsile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua bɛtɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma la ati, menli bɔle azu wɔ azukponle biala azo.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Akee debie mɔɔ wɔambiza bɔbɔ la, mebava meaboka nwo. Ɛbanyia ɛ nwo, wɔanyia ɛ nyunlu wɔadɛla belemgbunli biala.

english_verse: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn lile ɔ ze Devidi mɛla zo, ɔhulole Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔdoale ɔ bo zo, noko ɔbɔle azu wɔ azukponle ngakyile zo.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɔ nwo hilele ye wɔ ɛlalɛ nu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu a ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a?”

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn buale kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔ akɛlɛ, egya Devidi lile nɔhalɛ manle wɔ, ɔvale ye ahonle kɔsɔɔti ɔdiele ɛ ne, na ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ sɔ ɛ nye la, ɛhulole ye edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ. Ɛhye ati wɔhyɛ ye ralɛ nrenya wɔmaa ɛnɛ mede ɔ bo zo ne.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, mele kakula somaa mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie, noko wɔva me wɔzie belemgbunli, wɔ egya Devidi abo zo ne.

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: Meradɛnla wɔ menli pemgbenleamgbe ye mɔɔ awie ɛnze bɛ nloa mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye bɛ la avinli.

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati mebodo wɔ, maa me nrɛlɛbɛ maa menva menzie wɔ menli ne na maa mengola menwu debie mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le ɛtane la. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane ɛdeɛ a, menrɛhola wɔ menli ne sie.”

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔambiza me wɔanlie ngoane tendenle nee anwonyia wɔammaa ɛ nwo, yɛɛ eza wɔanze kɛ mengu wɔ kpɔvolɛma, na wɔbiza kɛ ɛkpondɛ ndelebɛbo wɔava wɔanwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le ɛtane la,

english_verse: So I'll make you wiser than anyone who has ever lived or ever will live.
translation_verse: mebayɛ meamaa wɔ. Nea, memaa wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ kpole nee ndelebɛbo dɔɔnwo meadɛla awie biala mɔɔ bɛwo ye bɛdo azɛlɛ ye azo la anzɛɛ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛbawo ye la.

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Eza saa ɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo, kɛmɔ ɛ ze Devidi lile la a mebamaa wɔ ngoane tendenle.”

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn dunwuele la ɔnwunle kɛ Nyamenle ɛdendɛ ɛhile ye wɔ ɛlalɛ nu. Nzinlii ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm, ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne wɔ la na ɔyelale nane ɔbɔle azu na eza ɔbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma. Eza ɔdole ye menli ne amuala ɛkponle. Sɔlɔmɔn bua ndɛne ɛsesebɛ bie

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Kenle ko tuutuu mraalɛ nwiɔ bie vale bɛ edwɛkɛ radole belemgbunli anyunlu.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Ko hanle kɛ, “Nana, me nee raalɛ ɛhye de awuke ko anu yɛɛ menwole ralɛ mendole ɔ gyakɛ azo.

english_verse: and three days later her baby was born. Nobody else was there with us.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nsa ne azo yɛɛ ɔdaye noko ɔwole a. Yɛ mu nwiɔ ala a yɛwɔ awuke ne anu a; awie biala ɛmboka yɛ nwo.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔlale ɔ ra nrenya ne anwo zo ɔbɛtɛle ye ɔhunle ye.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Ɔdwazole nɔe ne kɛyɛ alevinli-mu-nwiɔ-avinli mɔɔ ɛnee metɛbɔ nafelɛ nu la, ɔradwule me ra nrenya ne wɔ me kunlu ɛkɛ ɔhɔdole ye ɛkpa ɛdeɛ ne azo, na ɔvale mɔɔ ɛwu la ɔradole me ɛdeɛ ne abo zo ne wɔ me ɛkpa ne azo.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Aleɛbahye ne menyɛle kɛ memaa me ra ne nyɛfonlɛ la menwunle kɛ yewu. Na nwonlomɔ ne ala mɔɔ maanle nu tetele la, meneanle ye kpalɛ na menwunle kɛ tɛ me ra ne ɔ.”

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Raalɛ ko ne buale kɛ, “Ɔle adalɛ! Medame me ra ɛdeɛ ne a anye wɔ zolɛ la. Wɔ ɛdeɛ ne a ɛwu la.” Alumua raalɛ ne ɔdaye ɔse, “Kyɛkyɛ! Me ra ne a anye wɔ zolɛ la, wɔ ɛdeɛ ne a ɛwu la.” Na edwɛkɛ ne bɔle kpolera wɔ belemgbunli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvale dadeɛ bɛrale

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole ralɛ ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la ahonle hwenle na ɔhanle kɛ, “O Nana, fa kakula ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la maa raalɛ ko ne na mmaku ye.” Na raalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne dele ye ɔ nloa na ɔhanle kɛ, “Maa bɛhyɛ nu, ɛnee wɔannyia ye yɛɛ medame noko meannyia ye!”

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Na Sɔlɔmɔn zele kɛ, “Mmaku kakula ne. Fa ye maa raalɛ ne mɔɔ lumuale rale la. Ɔdaye a ɔwole ralɛ ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la a.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma dele ndɛne ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn buale la, bɛ muala bɛlile ye eni. Bɛnwunle kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa ye nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ ɔbava yeabu maanle ne a.

english_verse: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn dule mgbanyima bulu nee nwiɔ kɛ bɛle maanzinli zo neavolɛma. Bɛnea bɛmaa maanzinli ko biala anu amra fa aleɛ kɔmaa belemgbunli nee ye sua nu amra toonwo siane ko na yeado maanzinli fofolɛ nu amra.

english_verse: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima bulu nee nwiɔ ne a le: Bɛnhɔɔ: ɔnea Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo maanzinli ne azo.

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Bɛndikɛɛ: ɔnea azuamgbole Meekaze, Hyeeyalebem, Bɛte Hyimɛhye, Yilɔn yɛɛ Bɛte Heenan.

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Bɛnabinadabe mɔɔ gya Sɔlɔmɔn ara raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Teefate la: ɔnea Dɔɔ maanzinli zo.

english_verse: The son of Geber was in charge of the town of Ramoth in Gilead and the villages in Gilead belonging to the family of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh. He was also in charge of the region of Argob in Bashan, which had
translation_verse: Bɛngibɛ: ɔnea suakpole Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la nee Geleade namunamu mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ anlɔnra Gyeyɛɛ abusua ne azɛlɛ zo la. Eza ɔnea Aagɔbo maanzinli ne mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la. Bɛle azuamgbole abulasia mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane na bɛfa mbulalɛ bɛgua bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anzi bɛtoto nu a.

english_verse: Ahimaaz was in charge of the territory of Naphtali and was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath.
translation_verse: Ahaemaaze mɔɔ gya Sɔlɔmɔn amra mraalɛ ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Basemate la a nea Nafetalae maanzinli ne a;

english_verse: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.
translation_verse: Huhyae ara Beeyana nea Ahya maanzinli ne nee Bialotu sua zo.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.
translation_verse: Palua ara Gyɛhɔhyafate nea Yesakaa maanzinli zo.

english_verse: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Yila ara Hyemɛyae nea Bɛngyaman maanzinli zo.

english_verse: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah. The Size of Solomon's Kingdom
translation_verse: Gibɛ mɔɔ le Yulae ara ne nea Geleade, Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn nee Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. Ɛye amɛnladoma bulu nee nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ a, eza bɛlɛ amɛnlado kpanyinli ko mɔɔ nea maanle ne kɔsɔɔti azo a. Sɔlɔmɔn maamulɛ kɛnlɛma ne

english_verse: Solomon ruled every kingdom between the Euphrates River and the land of the Philistines down to Egypt. These kingdoms paid him taxes as long as he lived.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn ziele maanle ne kɔsɔɔti, ɛbɔ ye Azule Yufileti mɔɔ bagua Filisitiama azɛlɛ zo, ɔdwu Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo amuala la rahotole Sɔlɔmɔn na bɛduale adwule mɔɔ fɛta la bɛmanle ye.

english_verse: Solomon ruled the whole region west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and he was at peace with all of the countries around him.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Sɔlɔmɔn sie Azule Yufileti adɔleɛ maanzinli ne mɔ amuala, ɛbɔ ye Tefesa mɔɔ kɔ Gaza, arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ la amuala wɔ ɔ bo, yɛɛ ɔ nee maanle maanle mɔɔ nee ye bɔ ɛweɛne la anloa sɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la, Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ maanlema anzo nu dwole bɛ, ɔvi Dan maanzinli nu mɔɔ kɔ Biyɛhyiba la, awie biala anwo dɔle ye; ɔlɛ ye vanye nee feege ɛya mɔɔ ɔdidi nuhua a.

english_verse: He was wiser than anyone else in the world, including the wisest people of the east and of Egypt. He was even wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Mahol's three sons, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. Solomon became famous in every country around Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛlale menli kɔsɔɔti nrɛlɛbɛ; ɔnwunle nrɛlɛbɛ ɔdɛlale Ɛzela anlɔnra Yitan, Himan, Kalekɔlo nee Daada mɔɔ le Meeholo amra ne mɔ. Sɔlɔmɔn nganeɛ dwule maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle mbaka nwo edwɛkɛ, ɔvi Lɛbanɔn sida baka nwo zo ɔkɔkpula nyinlanyinla mɔɔ fifi bane nwo la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ɔhanle nane, nloma, nee nane mɔɔ twenle bɛ nwo aze la nee fɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.
translation_verse: Na menli nee arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ maanle gyɛne gyɛne nu mɔɔ dele ye nganeɛ la radiele ye nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ne bie.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Helam mɔɔ vi Taya la agɔnwo kokye a le Devidi, yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdele kɛ bɛva Sɔlɔmɔn bɛli ebia ne la, ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛma wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord. So I've decided to do that.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati menyia adwenle kɛ mesi sua meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ se la. Ɔzele egya Devidi kɛ, ‘Ɛ ra ne mɔɔ mebava ye meazie wɔ ebia ne azo la bazi me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.’

english_verse: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.
translation_verse: Yemɔti maa bɛpɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka bɛmaa me. Me sonvolɛma baraboka wɔ menli ɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛmaa bɛapɛ mbaka ne bɛamaa me la anwo. Mebadua wɔ menli ne mɔ ɛkpabɔlɛ kakɛ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛpɛ ɛkɛmaa me la; ɔluakɛ yɛ maanle ye anu, ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ yɛnlɛ awie biala mɔɔ ze dubinli mbaka ɛpɛlɛ nye zo la kɛ Saedɛnema ala.”

english_verse: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, “I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation!”
translation_verse: Helam dele Sɔlɔmɔn nrɛlaleɛ ne la ɔ nye liele kpole na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo kɛ yehyɛ Devidi ralɛ nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnɛ ɛlɛsie ɛlɔne kpole ɛhye a.”

english_verse: Then he sent back his answer: I received your message and will give you all the cedar and pine logs you need.
translation_verse: Na Helam vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Mede wɔ nrɛlaleɛ ne. Mebali sida mbaka nee sepelɛse mbaka biala mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la anwo gyima.”

english_verse: My workers will carry them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea. They will tie the logs together and float them along the coast to wherever you want them. Then they will untie the logs, and your workers can take them from there. To pay for the logs, you can provide the grain I need for my household.
translation_verse: Me menli ne bahwe mbaka ne mɔ vi Lɛbanɔn aragua ɛnweanloa na bɛakyekye bɛ avile bɛava bɛalua nyevile zo bɛahɔgua ɛleka mɔɔ ɛkɛhile la, na ɛ sa aha bɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdawɔ noko ɛboa me ɛmaa bɛfa aleɛ bɛbɛlɛ me nee me awuke nu amra.

english_verse: The Lord kept his promise and made Solomon wise. Hiram and Solomon signed a treaty and never went to war against each other. Solomon's Workers
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lile ye ɛwɔkɛ zo na ɔmanle Sɔlɔmɔn nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ, yemɔti anzonudwolɛ rale Helam nee Sɔlɔmɔn avinli na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛle agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ.

english_verse: He ordered the workers to cut and shape large blocks of good stone for the foundation of the temple.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne manle bɛkpukekpukele awolɛ mgbole mɔɔ anwo hyia na bɛsonle bolɛ la kɛ bɛva bɛwula sua ne abo.

english_verse: Solomon's and Hiram's men worked with men from the city of Gebal, and together they got the stones and logs ready for the temple.
