english_verse: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed
translation_verse: Seleama nee Yizilayɛma guale ye ekpunli ekpunli dedee kenle nsuu. Kenle nsuu ne azo a konle dele a; Yizilayɛma hunle Selea ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dua aze la apenle ngoko ɛya wɔ kenle ko ne.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.”
translation_verse: Ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Nana, yɛde kɛ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli se anwunvɔne; bɛmaa yɛheda ɛrele na yɛbɔ file yɛgua yɛ kɔme yɛhɔnwu Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ ɔkɛnwu wɔ anwunvɔne na yeangu wɔ.”

english_verse: Benhadad's officials were trying to figure out what Ahab was thinking, and when he said “brother,” they quickly replied, “You're right! You and Benhadad are like brothers.” “Go get him,” Ahab said. When Benhadad came out, Ahab had him climb up into his chariot.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Bɛneheedade menli ne mɔ ɛlɛsɛlɛ kɛ belemgbunli Ehabe kɛmaa bɛ mualɛ kpalɛ, yemɔti ɔ nloa ampe na bɛabua ye kɛ, “Ɛ diema Bɛneheedade wɔ ɛkɛ.” Ehabe zele kɛ, “Bɛhɔva ye bɛrɛla.” Bɛneheedade rale la Ehabe zele ye kɛ ɔravo ye ehwili ne anu.

english_verse: Benhadad said, “I'll give back the towns my father took from your father. And you can have shops in Damascus, just as my father had in Samaria.” Ahab replied, “If you do these things, I'll let you go free.” Then they signed a peace treaty, and Ahab let Benhadad go. A Prophet Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Bɛneheedade hanle hilele Ehabe kɛ, “Mebazia meava azuamgbole mɔɔ egya zale ɛ ze liele la amuala meamaa wɔ. Eza mebamaa wɔabukebuke gualilɛ ɛleka ɛleka wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, kɛmɔ egya yɛle ye wɔ Samɛlea la.” Ehabe buale kɛ, “Saa wɔze zɔ a ɛnee mebadwula wɔ.” Ɔ nee ye yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ bɛhyele ɔ bo na akee ɔdwulale ye kɛ ɔhɔ. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie twi Ehabe anyunlu

english_verse: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, “Hit me!” But the friend refused,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ekpunli ne anu sonla ko hɔzele ɔ gɔnwo kpɔmanvolɛ ko kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, bɔ me!” Na ɔ gɔnwo ne ambɔ ye.

english_verse: and the prophet told him, “You disobeyed the Lord, and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you.” The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ, “Wɔanli Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ zo, yemɔti saa ɛvi me nwo ɛke ɛye ɛ nwo ala a, awenade bahye wɔ.” Amgba ɔyele ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala la ɔ nee awenade yiale na awenade ne hunle ye.

english_verse: The prophet found someone else and said, “Hit me!” So this man beat him up.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko ne ala hɔyiale awie fofolɛ wɔ adevinli na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ayi, bɔ me!” Nrenya ne finle ye manle ɔbodale.

english_verse: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne vale ɛdanlɛ bɔle ɔ nye bɔlɛ mɔɔ bɛnnwu ye sonla holɛ la na ɔhɔgyinlanle adenle nu ɔhendɛle belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: When Ahab went by, the prophet shouted, “Your Majesty, right in the heat of battle, someone brought a prisoner to me and told me to guard him. He said if the prisoner got away, I would either be killed or forced to pay
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne dwule ɛkɛ ne la, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne deanle nu vɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Wɔ akɛlɛ, mengɔle konle ne anloa bie, na ɛlɔnema ne ko vale nrenya bie manle me na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Fa nrenya ɛhye sie; saa wɔannea ye boɛ na ɛmaa ɔnriandi a, ɛbava ɛ ti kanrɛlɛ ne wɔadua anzɛɛ ɛbadua dwɛtɛ fufule apenle nsa.’

english_verse: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped.” Ahab answered, “You will be punished just as you have said.”
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ wɔ akɛlɛ, me nwo hyelele me na medi akɔneaba la, sonla ne ɛnriandi.” Belemgbunli ne buale ye kɛ, “Ɛ ngome wɔbua ɛ nwo ndɛne. Ɛbadua nwolɛ ndeanlɛ ne.”

english_verse: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.
translation_verse: Na ɛkɛ ne ala Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne akee yele ɔ nyunlu ɛdanlɛ ne, na belemgbunli ne nwunle kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ bie ɔ.

english_verse: The prophet said, “The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, ‘Wɔmaa sonla ne mɔɔ meha kɛ bɛhu ye la ɛnriandi, yemɔti ɛbava wɔ ngoane wɔadua. Eza wɔmaa ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye bɛ la ɛvi ɛsalɛ, yemɔti, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye wɔ ɛlɔnema ɛdeɛ ne.’ ”

english_verse: Naboth owned a vineyard in Jezreel near King Ahab's palace.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ Gyɛzɛlii ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Neebɔto. Ɔlɛ ye vanye ɛya zua Samɛlea Belemgbunli Ehabe awuke ne.

english_verse: One day, Ahab said, “Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.”
translation_verse: Kenle ko Belemgbunli Ehabe zele Neebɔto kɛ, “Wɔ vanye egyinli ne bikye me, yemɔti fa maa me maa menva menyɛ me tola menluolua ɛfane nee nya nya wɔ nu na mebamaa wɔ vanye ɛya kpalɛ fofolɛ. Saa ɛkulo noko a mebadua ye kakɛ meamaa wɔ.”

english_verse: Naboth answered, “This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.”
translation_verse: Neebɔto buale Ehabe kɛ, “Menlile me mgbanyinli agya a menvale ɛya ne a; ɔle me mgbanyinli debie, yemɔti saa meminli ɔ bo zo a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ. Nyamenle ɛkpa ɛhye ɛgua!”

english_verse: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Neebɔto hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpa ɛgua kɛ menwɔva me mgbanyinli agyadeɛ menwɔmaa wɔ” la, ɛya nee nyane hunle Belemgbunli Ehabe kpole; ɔhɔle sua nu ɔhɔlale ye mgba ne azo, ɔhakyile ɔ nye bane nwo na ɔkpole aleɛ.

english_verse: Jezebel his wife came in and asked, “What's wrong? Why won't you eat?”
translation_verse: Ɔ ye Gyɛzɛbɛle rabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛbɔ na yemɔti wɔkpo aleɛ ɛ?”

english_verse: “I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or to let me give him a better one,” Ahab replied. “And he told me I couldn't have it.”
translation_verse: Ehabe buale ɔ ye kɛ, “Meha mehile Neebɔto mɔɔ vi Gyɛzɛlii ɛke la kɛ ɔva ye vanye ɛya ne ɔmaa me na memaa ye fofolɛ anzɛɛ ɔdɔne ye ɔmaa me a ɔbua ɔse me kɛ, ‘Mefa me vanye ɛya ne memaa wɔ a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ!’ ”

english_verse: “Aren't you the king of Israel?” Jezebel asked. “Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.”
translation_verse: Ɔ ye zele ye kɛ, “Na tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛsie Yizilayɛ maanle ye ɔ? Wɔmɔ dwazo di debie maa ɛ nye ɛlie na Neebɔto ɛya ne, mame, mebava meamaa wɔ!”

english_verse: After receiving her letters, they did exactly what she had asked.
translation_verse: Gyɛzɛlii suakpole ne azo amra nee bɛ mgbanyima yɛle mɔɔ Gyɛzɛbɛle hilele bɛ wɔ ye ngɛlata ne mɔ anu la.

english_verse: They told the people that it was a day to go without eating, and when they all came together, they seated Naboth at the front.
translation_verse: Bɛmanle menli ne hyele ɛhɔne na bɛvale Neebɔto bɛraziele bɛ ayia ne anu.

english_verse: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.
translation_verse: Agbamgbanvolɛ nwiɔ ne ragyinlanle Neebɔto anyunlu na bɛhanle bɛzile ɔ nyunlu wɔ menli ne anyunlu kɛ, “Neebɔto, wɔdindi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu; eza wɔwa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne amonle.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛvale Neebɔto bɛhɔle suakpole ne kandiba na bɛzile ye awolɛ bɛhunle ye.

english_verse: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, “Naboth is dead.”
translation_verse: Akee bɛhɛlale Gyɛzɛbɛle nrɛlaleɛ kɛ, “Bɛzi Neebɔto awolɛ bɛhu ye.”

english_verse: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, “Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.”
translation_verse: Gyɛzɛbɛle dele nrɛlaleɛ ne ala la, ɔhanle ɔhilele Ehabe kɛ, “Neebɔto ɛwu. Dwazo kɔva Neebɔto vanye ɛya ne mɔɔ ɔdule ɔ gye kɛ ɔnrɛdɔne ye ɔnrɛmaa wɔ la.”

english_verse: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard. Elijah Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Na ɛkɛ ne ala Ehabe dwazole kɛ ɔkava Neebɔto vanye ɛya ne.

english_verse: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaegya mɔɔ vi Tehyebi la kɛ,

english_verse: “King Ahab of Israel is in Naboth's vineyard right now, taking it over.
translation_verse: “Kɔ Samɛlea na ɛbanwu Belemgbunli Ehabe wɔ Neebɔto vanye ɛya ne anu kɛ ɔlɛfa ɛya ne yeayɛ ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Go tell him that I say, ‘Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood.’ ” When Elijah found him,
translation_verse: Kɔze ye kɛ, ‘Ehabe, Ɛdɛnkɛma se membiza wɔ kɛ, saa wɔhu sonla ne a eza ɛfa ye ɛya ne wɔaboka nwolɛ ɔ? Ka kile ye kɛ, Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Ɛleka mɔɔ ahwea tafele Neebɔto mogya ne la ɛkɛ ne ala yɛɛ bɛbatafe ɛdawɔ noko wɔ mogya ɛdeɛ ne a.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab said, “So, my enemy, you found me at last.” Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.
translation_verse: Ehabe nwunle Yilaegya ala la ɔhanle kɛ, “Hue e! Me kpɔvolɛ ɛvinde me.” Yilaegya buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, mevinde wɔ! Ɔboalekɛ wɔbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ wɔmɔ, amumuyɛ ala a ɛyɛ wɔatia Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, ‘Nea, mebamaa munzule ara ɛ nwo zo. Mebabɔ ɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Mebahu mrenya, alehelɛ anzɛɛ ahanra mɔɔ wɔ wɔ sua nu la amuala. Ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha!

english_verse: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ wɔ sua nu kɛmɔ menyɛle Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam nee Ahaegya ara Beeyahya azua nu la. Ɔboalekɛ wɔha me ɛya yɛɛ wɔmaa Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ ɛtane.’

english_verse: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma se, menze wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛ ye Gyɛzɛbɛle, ahwea batete ye nwonane wɔ Gyɛzɛlii suakpole ne azo.

english_verse: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Saa awie biala mɔɔ bɔ Ehabe abusua ne bie la wu sua zo a, ahwea bali ye nwonane; ɔwu ɛbɔ nu noko a, nloma basuso ye nwonane.’ ”

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: Bɛze ye kɛ, ‘Belemgbunli se, Fa sonla ɛhye sie na maa bɛmaa ye aleɛ mɔɔ ɛnza ye di la nee nzule ekyi bie kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔzia menwɔradwu sua nu anzonudwolɛ nu la.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab asked his officials, “Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe bizale ɔdaye ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Asoo bɛze kɛ yɛdayɛ a yɛlɛ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la azɛlɛ ne ɔ? Se bɛze kɛ Selea belemgbunli a tɛsie bɛ a? Yɛtɛdiele yɛtɛfile Selea belemgbunli ne asa anu.”

english_verse: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians?” “Just tell me what to do,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbizale Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Se ɛ nee me kɛhɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la na yɛkɛhɔlie sua ne?” Gyɛhɔhyafate buale ye kɛ, “Medame, me ɛlɔnema yɛɛ me mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nwo kɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ la.

english_verse: But first, let's ask the Lord.”
translation_verse: Noko maa yɛlumua yɛbiza yɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale kɛ, “Kɔ na Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔali bɛ nwo zo konim.” Gyɛhɔhyafate bizale kɛ, “Yemɔti Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bieko ɛnle maanle ye anu mɔɔ yɛkɔbiza ye a ɔyɛ boɛ a?”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe vɛlɛle ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ko na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ka ɛ nwo fɛlɛ Maekaya maa me.”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne nee Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate mɔɔ vi Dwuda la zieziele bɛ nwo na bɛdɛnlanle bɛ mbia nu wɔ Samɛlea suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwozo awule la. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala noko yiale ɛkɛ ne na bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhilele bɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Kɛneeyana ara Zɛdikaya vale bulalɛ yɛle mɛne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ɛbava ɛhye wɔavoa Seleama dedee kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛbɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ la.”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth, and they promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala nrɛlaleɛ ne hɔle ko kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la bɛhɔho. Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛali konim.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ hɔle Maekaya ɛvɛlɛlɛ la zele ye kɛ, “Ayi, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala nrɛlaleɛ ne ɛyɛ ko; biala ka kpalɛ maa belemgbunli. Yemɔti anrɛɛ maa wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɛla bɛ ɛdeɛ ne anwo.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Maekaya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛva kɛmaa me la ala a mebaha a.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went to Ahab, and Ahab asked, “Micaiah, should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ɔradwule belemgbunli anyunlu la ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Maekaya, me nee Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate yɛhɔ Releemɔto yɛhɔdoa bɛ yɛ nee bɛ ɛho anzɛɛ yɛgyakyi bɛ?” Maekaya buale kɛ, “Ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho na ɛbali konim. Ɛdɛnkɛma baye bɛ amaa wɔ.”

english_verse: “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth!” Ahab shouted. “What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bizale ye kɛ, “Se dahuu mese wɔ kɛ anrɛɛ ɛha nyamenlezo nɔhalɛ ne ɛhile me? Fane nyɛ yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ meka ye a?”

english_verse: He answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers walking around in the hills like sheep without a shepherd to guide them. The Lord said, ‘This army has no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Maekaya buale kɛ, “Menwu Yizilayɛma amuala kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛzande awoka zo na bɛnlɛ bɛ menle la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Mboane ɛhye mɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ menle, yemɔti biala ɛzia ɛhɔ ye sua nu anzonudwolɛ nu.’ ”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: Listen to this! I also saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Maekaya buale kɛ, “Zɔhane ati bɛdie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la. Menwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ebia nu na anwuma soanvolɛma ɛbɔ ɛyia ye; bɛgua ye bɛne nee fema,

english_verse: This is exactly what has happened, Ahab. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Akee Maekaya vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛbɛlɛbɛla wɔ. Ɔdaye Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne, ɔse munzule a bado wɔ a.”

english_verse: Zedekiah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Zɛdikaya rabɔle Maekaya anzo nu na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne sie mame ahane na ɔbaka nrɛlaleɛ ɔkile wɔmɔ ɛ?”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Ehabe zele kɛ, “Bɛhye Maekaya bɛhɔmaa amɛnlado Emɔn mɔɔ nea suakpole ye azo la na bɛva ye bɛdwu belemgbunli ara Dwowahye anyunlu.

english_verse: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab where two pieces of his armor joined. He shouted to his chariot driver, “I've been hit! Get me out of here!”
translation_verse: Na Seleanli ko dole ye ɛda ne ngyengyene nu bie ala, na ɔhɔwɔle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe wɔ ye mbulalɛ tɛladeɛ ne ayia ne mɔ bie avinli. Na ɔhanle ɔhilele ahenle mɔɔ ka ye konle ehwili ne la kɛ, “Meboda, kakyi ɛ nwo fa me fi konle ye anloa kɔ sua nu!”

english_verse: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe nee Gyɛhɔhyafate, Dwuda belemgbunli ne hɔle Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la.

english_verse: Before they went into battle, Ahab said, “Jehoshaphat, I'll disguise myself, but you wear your royal robe.” Then Ahab disguised himself and went into battle.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Mame, mebahakyi me nwo mɔɔ bɛnrɛnwu me sonla holɛ ko a, na wɔmɔ, anrɛɛ wula wɔ belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne.” Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne hakyile ɔ nwo hɔle konle ne anloa.

english_verse: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But when Jehoshaphat shouted out to them,
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ bɛnwunle Gyɛhɔhyafate la bɛdwenlenle kɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne ɔ, na bɛhakyile bɛ nye ɔ nwo zo. Gyɛhɔhyafate deanle nu na ɔguale ndwɛlɛ aze.

english_verse: they realized he wasn't Ahab, and they left him alone.
translation_verse: Bɛdele ɔ ne la bɛnwunle kɛ tɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne ɔ, yemɔti bɛandoa ye bieko.

english_verse: As the sun was going down, someone in Israel's army shouted to the others, “Retreat! Go back home!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee asɛɛ sɛnzɛne ɛdɔ nzule nu la, Yizilayɛma deanle nuhua kɛ, “Awie biala ɛye ɔ nwo zo ɛhɔ ye sua zo; awie biala ɛhɔ ye maanle nu!”

english_verse: Ahab's body was taken to Samaria and buried there.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Ehabe hale esike nu na bɛ nee ye rale Samɛlea bɛraziele ye.

english_verse: Some workers washed his chariot near a spring in Samaria, and prostitutes washed themselves in his blood. Dogs licked Ahab's blood off the ground, just as the Lord had warned.
translation_verse: Bɛnrinzinle ye konle ehwili ne anu wɔ Samɛlea nzubula ne anloa, na ahwea ratafele ye mogya ne, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ bɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla la biale ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ ne se la.

english_verse: Everything else Ahab did while he was king, including the towns he strengthened and the palace he built and furnished with ivory, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhɛlɛle Ehabe gyima mɔɔ ɔlile la, ye sua mɔɔ ɔvale ɛzɛlɛ ɔzile, nee azuamgbole mɔɔ ɔkyekyele la amuala anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu.

english_verse: Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became king. King Jehoshaphat of Judah (
translation_verse: Ehabe wule la ɔ ra nrenya Ehazaya a lile ebia ne a. Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate (

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in Ahab's fourth year as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ ebia zo la yɛɛ Belemgbunli Esa ara Gyɛhɔhyafate bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi Dwuda ebia ne a.

english_verse: The country of Edom had no king at the time, so a lower official ruled the land.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee belemgbunli ɛnle Yidɔm. Dwuda belemgbunli yɛɛ dule sonla mɔɔ ɛnee gyi ɔ gyakɛ anu nea maanzinli ne azo a.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat had seagoing ships built to sail to Ophir for gold. But they were wrecked at Ezion-Geber and never sailed.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate bobɔle gualilɛ meli mɔɔ kɔ Ofɛ kɛ bɛkakpondɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛara, noko bɛandwu. Ɔboalekɛ meli ne mɔ nlomanle wɔ Ɛzeɔngibɛ.

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Ahab offered to let his sailors go with Jehoshaphat's sailors, but Jehoshaphat refused.
translation_verse: Ehabe ara Ehazaya hanle hilele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ ɔmaa ye menli ne mɔ ɛraboka ye menli ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anwo bɛhɔ Ofɛ, na Gyɛhɔhyafate anlie ando nuhua.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Ahaziah of Israel
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔhyafate hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze Devidi suakpole zo, na ɔ ra Gyɛhɔlam lile ye agya. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehazaya

english_verse: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Ehazaya mɔɔ le Ehabe ara ne rale Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la ɛnee Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate ɛli Dwuda belemgbunli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsuu. Ehazaya lile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea.

english_verse: Ahaziah disobeyed the Lord, just as his father, his mother, and Jeroboam had done. They all led Israel to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ ze Ehabe nee ɔ nli Gyɛzɛbɛle nee Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam subane ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma amuala yɛle ɛtane la.

english_verse: Ahaziah worshiped Baal and made the Lord God of Israel very angry, just as his father had done.
translation_verse: Ehazaya zonlenle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, kɛmɔ ɔ ze yɛle ala la, na ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vale ɛya.

english_verse: Soon after King Ahab of Israel died, the country of Moab rebelled against his son King Ahaziah. One day, Ahaziah fell through the wooden slats around the porch on the flat roof of his palace in Samaria, and he was badly injured. So he sent some messengers to the town of Ekron with orders to ask the god Baalzebub if he would get well.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehazaya vi ye sua ne ati zo bane ne azo dɔle aze wɔ ye belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ wɔ Samɛlea, na azedɔlɛ ne bɔle ye anwonyane. Yemɔti ɔzoanle kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Filisitia suakpole Ɛkelɔn azo bɛhɔbiza bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe saa menwɔde kpɔkɛ a.”

english_verse: About the same time, an angel from the Lord sent Elijah the prophet from Tishbe to say to the king's messengers, “Ahaziah has rejected Israel's own God by sending you to ask Baalzebub about his injury.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ zele Yilaegya mɔɔ vi Tehyebe la kɛ, “Dwazo na kɔyia menli mɔɔ Samɛlea belemgbunli ne ɛzoa bɛ la na biza bɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛnee bɛnea a Nyamenle ɛnle Yizilayɛ ati yɛɛ bɛlɛkɔ Ɛkelɔn bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe ɛkɛ bɛahɔbiza anwonyane ne anwo la ɔ?’

english_verse: Tell him that because he has done this, he's on his deathbed!” And Elijah did what he was told.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma se, bɛze belemgbunli ne kɛ, ‘Anwonyane ne mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ la, ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ, ɛbawu.’ ” Yilaegya hɔle.

english_verse: When the messengers returned to Ahaziah, he asked, “Why are you back so soon?”
translation_verse: Na soanvolɛma ne noko ziale hɔle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ. Belemgbunli ne bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛzia bɛra a?”

english_verse: “A man met us along the road with a message for you from the Lord,” they answered. “The Lord wants to know why you sent us to ask Baalzebub about your injury and why you don't believe there's a God in Israel. The man also told us that the Lord says you're going to die.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nrenya bie rayiale yɛ na ɔzele yɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛzia bɛhɔze belemgbunli ne mɔɔ zoanle bɛ la kɛ: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ɛnee ɛnea a Nyamenle ɛnle Yizilayɛ ati yɛɛ ɛlɛkɔ Ɛkelɔn bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe ɛkɛ wɔahɔbiza ɛ nwo a? Zɔhane ati, anwonyane ne mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ la, ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ, ɛbawu.’ ”

english_verse: “He was hairy and had a leather belt around his waist,” they answered. “It must be Elijah!” replied Ahaziah.
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nrenya ne wula enrinli ɛdanlɛ tɛladeɛ na nwoma akyeso hye ye avinli.” Belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Yilaegya mɔɔ vi Tehyebe la ɔ.”

english_verse: “If I am a man of God,” Elijah answered, “God will send down fire on you and your
translation_verse: Yilaegya buale ye kɛ, “Saa mele Nyamenle sonla a ɛnee senle vi anwuma ɛrayela wɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.” Ɛkɛ ne ala senle vi anwuma rayelale safohyenle ne nee ye ɛlɔnema abulanlu ne.

english_verse: Fire has already wiped out the other officers and their soldiers. Please don't let it happen to me.”
translation_verse: Nea, senle vi anwuma rayelale alumua safohyenlema nwiɔ ne nee bɛ ɛlɔnema abulanlu abulanlu ne. Noko mesɛlɛ wɔ, nwu me anwunvɔne na maa menyia me ti.”

english_verse: The angel from the Lord said to Elijah, “Go with him and don't be afraid.” So Elijah got up and went with the officer.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele Yilaegya kɛ, “Mmasulo. Dwazo ɛ nee ye bɛhɔ.” Yemɔti Yilaegya dwazole na ɔ nee ye bɛhɔle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ, na ɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: When Elijah arrived, he told Ahaziah, “The Lord wants to know why you sent messengers to Ekron to ask Baalzebub about your injury. Don't you believe there's a God in Israel? Ahaziah, because you did that, the Lord says you will die.”
translation_verse: “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, ‘Kɛmɔ wɔzoa menli kɛ bɛhɔ Ɛkelɔn bozonle Beeyalezibɛbe ɛkɛ bɛhɔbiza ɛ nwo la, ɛnee ɛnea a Nyamenle ɛnle Yizilayɛ ɔ? Zɔhane ati ɛvi wɔ anwonyane ne anu ɛnrɛdwazo, ɛbawu.’ ”

english_verse: Ahaziah died, just as the Lord had said. But since Ahaziah had no sons, Joram his brother then became king. This happened in the second year that Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Yilaegya anwo zo hanle la, Belemgbunli Ehazaya wule na ɔ diema Dwɔlam lile ebia ne. Ehazaya ɛnee ɛnlɛ ɔ ra nrenya yɛɛ ɔlile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ ebia ne azo. Ɔ ze a le Dwuda belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehazaya yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli, Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Not long before the Lord took Elijah up into heaven in a strong wind, Elijah and Elisha were leaving Gilgal.
translation_verse: Mekɛ dwule kɛ akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bafa Yilaegya wɔ ahumuakyima nu kɔ anwuma. Yilaegya nee Yilaehya vi Gelegale zile nu,

english_verse: Elijah said to Elisha, “The Lord wants me to go to Bethel, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will stay with you no matter what!” And he went with Elijah to Bethel.
translation_verse: na Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Bɛtɛle.” Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle Bɛtɛle.

english_verse: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, “Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master?” “Yes, I do,” Elisha answered. “But don't remind me of it.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtɛle la razele Yilaehya kɛ “Asoo ɛze kɛ ɛnɛ demua ye Ɛdɛnkɛma barava ɛ menle ye ahɔ ɔ?” Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, meze; noko bɛmɛ bɛmua bɛ nloa.”

english_verse: Elijah then said, “Elisha, now the Lord wants me to go to Jericho, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life, that I will stay with you no matter what!” And he went with Elijah to Jericho.
translation_verse: Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Gyɛleko.” Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle Gyɛleko.

english_verse: A group of prophets who lived there asked Elisha, “Do you know that today the Lord is going to take away your master?” “Yes, I do,” Elisha answered. “But don't remind me of it.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la razele Yilaehya kɛ, “Asoo ɛze kɛ ɛnɛ demua ye Ɛdɛnkɛma barava ɛ menle ye ahɔ ɔ?” Yilaehya buale bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, meze, bɛmɛ bɛyɛ koonwu.”

english_verse: Elijah then said to Elisha, “Now the Lord wants me to go to the Jordan River, but you must stay here.” Elisha replied, “I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will never leave you!” So the two of them walked on together.
translation_verse: Yilaegya zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, kendɛ ɛke na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa me wɔ Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa.” Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ɛdawɔ kɛ menrɛkpɔkye me nwo menrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ.” Yemɔti bɛzile nu bɛhɔle.

english_verse: Fifty prophets followed Elijah and Elisha from Jericho, then stood at a distance and watched as the two men walked toward the river.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo ne mɔ anu abulanlu doale bɛ na bɛgyinlanle amozi ekyi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yilaegya nee Yilaehya gyi azule ne anloa la.

english_verse: When they got there, Elijah took off his coat, then he rolled it up and struck the water with it. At once a path opened up through the river, and the two of them walked across on dry ground.
translation_verse: Yilaegya yele ye ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ gua ɔ nwo zo la, ɔbɛkale na ɔvale ɔfinle azule ne anu. Azule ne kpakyele nwiɔ, pianle hɔle foa ko nee foa ko. Ɔyele azɛlɛ resee ɔdole ɛkɛ ne na bɛpɛle bɛhɔle ɔ nzi lɔ.

english_verse: After they had reached the other side, Elijah said, “Elisha, the Lord will soon take me away. What can I do for you before that happens?” Elisha answered, “Please give me twice as much of your power as you give the other prophets, so I can be the one who takes your place as their leader.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛpɛle bɛhɔle azule ne anzi lɔ la, Yilaegya akee zele Yilaehya kɛ, “Biza me debie mɔɔ menyɛ memaa wɔ la kolaa na bɛarava me bɛahɔ.” Yilaehya buale kɛ, “Mebodo wɔ, maa menyia wɔ sunsum ne mɔnwo.”

english_verse: “It won't be easy,” Elijah answered. “It can happen only if you see me as I am being taken away.”
translation_verse: Yilaegya zele kɛ, “Wɔbiza debie ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ. Noko saa bɛbava me bɛahɔ na ɛnwu me ɛhɔlɛ nu a, ɛbanyia mɔɔ wɔbiza la, na saa wɔannwu me a, yemɔ ɛnrɛnyia ye.”

english_verse: Elijah and Elisha were walking along and talking, when suddenly there appeared between them a flaming chariot pulled by fiery horses. At once, a strong wind took Elijah up into heaven.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛtendɛ la ɛnee bɛ gyakɛ wɔ zolɛ, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala senle ehwili mɔɔ senle mgbɔnwɔ ɛlɛtwe ye la rakpakyele bɛ avinli, na anwoma kpole ne manle Yilaegya zo ɔ nee ye hɔle anwuma.

english_verse: Elisha saw this and shouted, “Israel's cavalry and chariots have taken my master away!” After Elijah had gone, Elisha tore his clothes in sorrow.
translation_verse: Yilaehya nwunle ye na ɔdeanle ɔvɛlɛle Yilaegya kɛ, “Egya! Egya! Yizilayɛ konle ehwili ne nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ la, bɛmɛ ɛhye o!” Na yeannwu ye bieko. Nyane ngome manle Yilaehya yele ɔdaye mumua ne ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la na ɔdele nu nwiɔ.

english_verse: Elijah's coat had fallen off, so Elisha picked it up and walked back to the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ɔvale Yilaegya aguzo ne mɔɔ wɔlɔle guale aze la na ɔziale ɔ nzi. Ɔradwule Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa,

english_verse: He struck the water with the coat and wondered, “Will the Lord perform miracles for me as he did for Elijah?” As soon as Elisha did this, a dry path opened up through the water, and he walked across.
translation_verse: ɔvale Yilaegya aguzo ne mɔɔ guale aze la ɔfinle azule ne anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Yilaegya Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” Na ɛkɛ ne ala azule ne kpakyele nwiɔ na ɔpɛle ɔrale ɔ nzi nehae.

english_verse: When the prophets from Jericho saw what happened, they said to each other, “Elisha now has Elijah's power.” They walked over to him, bowed down,
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma asa azo mɔɔ vi Gyɛleko la nwunle ye na bɛhanle kɛ “Yilaegya sunsum ne ɛdwu Yilaehya anwo zo.” Na bɛrayiale ye na bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle ye.

english_verse: They kept begging until he was embarrassed to say no. He finally agreed, and the prophets sent the men out. They looked three days for Elijah but never found him.
translation_verse: Bɛamkponle na bɛdinle zolɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɔkpondɛ ye. Ɛhye manle Yilaehya ati zile aze na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ. Bɛzoanle menli abulanlu ne bɛmanle bɛhɔkpondɛle ye dedee kenle nsa. Noko bɛannwu ye.

english_verse: They returned to Jericho, and Elisha said, “I told you that you wouldn't find him.” Elisha Makes the Water Pure at Jericho
translation_verse: Na bɛziale bɛrale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ wɔ Gyɛleko. Ɛnee ɔlɛkendɛ bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Se menzele bɛ kɛ bɛmmakɔ.” Yilaehya nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ

english_verse: One day the people of Jericho said, “Elisha, you can see that our city is in a good spot. But the water from our spring is so bad that it even keeps our crops from growing.”
translation_verse: Menli bie mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛleko la hɔhanle hilele Yilaehya kɛ, “Yɛmenle, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛnwu ye la, suakpole ye le kɛnlɛma noko nzule ne ɛnle kpalɛ yɛɛ ɔmaa nrenzɛvolɛ ko kpɔne.”

english_verse: He replied, “Put some salt in a new bowl and bring it to me.” They brought him the bowl of salt,
translation_verse: Yilaehya zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva dwora fofolɛ na bɛgua ngyenle nu bɛrɛlɛ me.” Bɛvale bɛrɛlɛle ye.

english_verse: and he carried it to the spring. He threw the salt into the water and said, “The Lord has made this water pure again. From now on you'll be able to grow crops, and no one will starve.”
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔhɔle nzubula ne mɔɔ bɛsa la anloa na ɔvuandinle ngyenle ne ɔguale nu, na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Meyɛ nzule ye nzukpa. Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, awie no bie a ɔnwu yɛɛ ɔmkpɔne ɛkolɛ bieko.”

english_verse: The water has been fine ever since, just as Elisha said. Some Boys Make Fun of Elisha
translation_verse: Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane nzule ne ɛyɛ nzukpa toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a, kɛmɔ Nyamenle manle Yilaehya hanle la.

english_verse: Elisha left and headed toward Bethel. Along the way some boys started making fun of him by shouting, “Go away, baldy! Get out of here!”
translation_verse: Yilaehya akee hɔle Bɛtɛle. Mɔɔ ɔlua adenle nu ɔlɛkɔ la, ngakula mrenya bie vi sua ne azo vindele ragolole ɔ nwo kɛ, “Atizo kpawee, ɛvi ɛke kɔ!”

english_verse: Elisha turned around and stared at the boys. Then he cursed them in the name of the Lord. At once two bears ran out of the woods and ripped to pieces
translation_verse: Yilaehya hakyile ɔ nwo nleanle bɛ na ɔvale Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔwale bɛ amonle; na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛdi mbelɛ nwiɔ vi kpɔkɛ ne anu vindele ratetele bɛ nuhua abulanla nee nwiɔ anu.

english_verse: Elisha went up to Mount Carmel, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Yilaehya vi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhɔle Kamɛle Boka na nzinlii ɔziale ɔhɔle Samɛlea.

english_verse: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Jehoshaphat's eighteenth year as king of Judah. Joram ruled twelve years from Samaria
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔhyafate nyianle ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ bɛvale Ehabe ara Dwɔlam bɛziele Yizilayɛ belemgbunli wɔ Samɛlea a. Dwɔlam lile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ.

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He tore down the stone image his father had made to honor Baal, and so he wasn't as sinful as his parents.
translation_verse: Yeambɔ ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ ɔ ze nee ɔ nli bɔle la bie ɛdeɛ, noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔbubule ɔ ze sua ne mɔɔ ɔzile ɔmanle bozonle Beeyale la;

english_verse: But he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam son of Nebat had led Israel to do. The Country of Moab Rebels against Israel
translation_verse: noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Nibate la yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane la bie. Yeandwe ɔ nwo yeanvi nwolɛ.

english_verse: For many years the country of Moab had been controlled by Israel and was forced to pay taxes to the kings of Israel. King Mesha of Moab raised sheep, so he paid the king of Israel
translation_verse: Mowabe Belemgbunli Mihya gyima mɔɔ yɛ la a le mboane ɛzielɛ. Ɛvolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa mboane mralɛ apenle ngoko ɛya ko, yɛɛ mboane nyinli apenle ngoko ɛya ko anwo enrinli ɔkɔmaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: But soon after the death of Ahab, Mesha rebelled against Israel.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehabe wule la, Mowabe belemgbunli ne dele atua wɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne anwo zo.

english_verse: One day, Joram left Samaria and called together Israel's army.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Dwɔlam vale ɛlɔnema vile Samɛlea na ɔboɔboale Yizilayɛma amuala anloa.

english_verse: He sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of Judah, “The king of Moab has rebelled. Will you go with me to attack him?” “Yes, I will,” Jehoshaphat answered. “I'm on your side, and my soldiers and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔmanle Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Mowabe belemgbunli ne ɛde atua; yemɔti baboa me maa me nee ye ɛhɔho.” Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate buale kɛ, “Menwɔhɔ. Mewɔ ɛke memaa wɔ yɛɛ me menli nee me mgbɔnwɔ muala le wɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: But which way should we go?” “We will march through Edom Desert,” Joram replied.
translation_verse: Nienwu a yɛpe yeahɔ a?” Dwɔlam buale kɛ, “Yɛpe Yidɔm fienemgbole ne anu.”

english_verse: So Joram, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom led their troops out. But seven days later, there was no drinking water left for them or their animals.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Dwɔlam nee Dwuda nee Yidɔm arelemgbunli zile nu hɔle. Bɛdiale bɛbɔle mgbɔlɔka dedee kenle nsuu la ɛnee akee bɛnnyia nzule. Nzule mɔɔ wɔ bɛ bɔlɛ nu la ɛwie bɔkɔɔ, menli bɔbɔ ɛnnyia bie ɛnno na yeayɛ bɛ nyɛmoa mɔɔ zo bɛ ninyɛne la.

english_verse: Joram cried out, “This is terrible! The Lord must have led us out here to be captured by Moab's army.”
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Aa! amgba Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛvɛlɛ yɛdayɛ arelemgbunli nsa ye wɔ ɛke kɛ ɔbaye yɛ yeamaa Mowabema ahu yɛ! ”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat said, “Which of the Lord's prophets is with us? We can find out from him what the Lord wants us to do.” One of Joram's officers answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was one of Elijah's closest followers.”
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔhyafate bizale kɛ, “Na Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛnle ɛke ɛleka bie mɔɔ yɛkola yɛdua ɔ nwo zo yɛbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ?” Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ ko buale kɛ, “Hyeefate ara Yilaehya wɔ ɛke. Yemɔ yɛɛ anrɛɛ boa Yilaegya wɔ ye gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu a.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat replied, “He can give us the Lord's message.” The three kings went over to Elisha,
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔhyafate zele kɛ, “Ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔmanvolɛ bɔkɔɔ”. Yemɔti Dwuda, Yizilayɛ nee Yidɔm arelemgbunli nsa ne hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: and he asked Joram, “Why did you come to me? Go talk to the prophets of the foreign gods your parents worshiped.” “No,” Joram answered. “It was the Lord who led us out here, so that Moab's army could capture us.”
translation_verse: Yilaehya bizale Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ wɔ me ɛkɛ ne a? Toa ɛ ze nee ɛ nli Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ kɔbiza bɛ.” Dwɔlam buale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛye yɛdayɛ arelemgbunli nsa ye ɛmaa Mowabema kɛ bɛhu yɛ a.”

english_verse: Elisha said to him, “I serve the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as he lives, I swear I wouldn't even look at you if I didn't respect King Jehoshaphat.”
translation_verse: Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Meka Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ mesonle ye la kɛ, saa tɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate nidi ti a anrɛɛ menrɛbikye wɔ bɔbɔ na meanlea ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Then Elisha said, “Send for someone who can play the harp.” The harpist began playing, and the Lord gave Elisha this message for Joram:
translation_verse: Bɛvɛlɛ awie mɔɔ bɔ getaa la bɛmaa me.” Mɔɔ ahenle ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbɔ getaa ne ala la yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne dwule Yilaehya anwo zo a,

english_verse: The Lord says that this dry riverbed will be filled with water.
translation_verse: na ɔzele kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne: Mebamaa azudenle ye mɔɔ ɛsesa la ayi.

english_verse: You won't feel any wind or see any rain, but there will be plenty of water for you and your animals.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛnrɛde kɛ anwoma ɛlɛtu anzɛɛ ezule ɛlɛtɔ noko azule ne mɔ bayiyi, amaa bɛanyia bie bɛanlo na bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ nyɛmoa anyia bie anlo.

english_verse: That simple thing isn't all the Lord is going to do. He will also help you defeat Moab's army.
translation_verse: Ɛhye le debie ekyi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo. Eza ɔbaye Mowabema yeamaa bɛ

english_verse: You will capture all their walled cities and important towns. You will chop down every good tree and stop up every spring of water, then ruin their fertile fields by covering them with rocks.
translation_verse: na bɛbali bɛ nwo zo konim bɛava bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane nee sua biala mɔɔ hyia la. Bɛbabu baka kpalɛ biala bɛado aze, bɛasisi bɛ azudenle kɔsɔɔti na bɛava awolɛ bɛazɛkye bɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.”

english_verse: The next morning, while the sacrifice was being offered, water suddenly started flowing from the direction of Edom, and it flooded the land.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ, kɛyɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, nzule vi Yidɔm afoa nu rabule azɛlɛ nwo kɔsɔɔti faanwo.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Moab had heard that the three kings were coming to attack them. They had called together all of their fighting men, from the youngest to the oldest, and these troops were now standing at their border, ready for battle.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mowabema dele kɛ arelemgbunli nsa ne ɛra nee bɛ baho la, bɛvɛlɛle awie biala mɔɔ kola konle tɛladeɛ wula la, ngakula nee mgbanyinli kɔsɔɔti na bɛzieziele bɛ kɛ bɛhɔ konle ne anloa.

english_verse: When they got up that morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it look red. The Moabite troops took one look
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdwazole nwonlomɔ ne, na sɛnzɛne ne kpɔgyale ɔ nwo zo ekyii la, bɛnwunle kɛ nzule ne mɔɔ nee bɛ nye bɔ zo la anye ɛyɛ kɔkɔlɛ kɛ mogya.

english_verse: and shouted, “Look at that blood! The armies of those kings must have fought and killed each other. Come on, let's go take what's left in their camp.”
translation_verse: Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Nea mogya ngome. Yɛ kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema nsa ne ɛpɛ bɛ nwo ɛho ɛhuhu bɛ nwo. Mowabema e, bɛmaa yɛhɔve bɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ.”

english_verse: But when they arrived at Israel's camp, the Israelite soldiers came out and attacked them, until they turned and ran away. Israel's army chased them all the way back to Moab, and even there they kept up the attack.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ bɛhɔdwule Yizilayɛma azokoɛleɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma dwazole Mowabema ne anwo zo bɛhanle bɛ senle bɛmanle bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze. Yizilayɛma belele zile bɛ zo na bɛhuhunle dɔɔnwo wɔ adenle nu.

english_verse: The Israelites destroyed the Moabite towns. They chopped down the good trees and stopped up the springs of water, then covered the fertile fields with rocks. Finally, the only city left standing was Kir-Hareseth, but soldiers armed with slings surrounded and attacked it.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma hɔvole Mowabema azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bɛbɔle bɛ na bɛzɛkyele bɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.
