translation_verse: Na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ na nea kɛ mezi meva me nwo amuala memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la.” Na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdɛnlanle ehwili ne anu bɛhɔle Samɛlea.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Bɛdwule ɛkɛ ne la, Gyihu hunle Ehabe anwo amra ne mɔɔ hale la amuala; yeangyakyi ko bɔbɔ. Ɛhye yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele Yilaegya kɛ ɔbazi a. Bɛhu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Beeyale la amuala

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Akee Gyihu vɛlɛle Samɛlea ezuavolɛ ne manle bɛyiale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Belemgbunli Ehabe zonlenle bozonle Beeyale ekyii bie, na mame Gyihu, mebazonle ye kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛvɛlɛ Beeyale ahɔmenle ne mɔ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la kɔsɔɔti nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛye ngonyia la amuala, bɛmmamaa bie ka amozi, ɔluakɛ melɛ azu kpole bie mebɔ memaa Beeyale. Mɔɔ kɛva ɔ nwo kɛvea la bɛkɛhu ye.”

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Akee Gyihu zele kɛ, “Bɛhile kenle bɛmaa yɛzonle Beeyale yɛli ye eni.” Bɛbɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Gyihu manle bɛvale nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Beeyale la amuala anloa yiale. Biala fee anga amozi. Bɛ muala bɛhɔle Beeyale bozonle sua ne anu bɛmanle sua ne yile, ɔvi ɔ ti ɔhɔdwule ɔ bo.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele ahenle mɔɔ nea adɛladeɛ ne mɔ azo la kɛ ɔva adɛladeɛ ne mɔ ɔvinde na ɔhyɛ ɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛra bazonle bozonle ne la. Yemɔti bɛvale adɛladeɛ ne bɛrɛlɛle menli ne.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Akee Gyihu nee Dwɔnadabe wolole sua ne anu. Ɔzele menli mɔɔ ɛra bazonle Beeyale la kɛ, “Bɛnleɛnlea nuhua saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie wɔ yɛ avinli a. Bɛmaa ɔha yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛsonle bozonle Beeyale la angome.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyihu vale nane ne mɔɔ bɛyela ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Beeyale la manle bɛ wiele la, ɔvindele na ɔrazele menli mɔɔ ɛzia la kɛ, “Bɛhɔ nuhua bɛhɔhu awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛmmamaa ko bɔbɔ fi ɛsalɛ.” Ɛkɛ ne ala ɛlɔnema ne wolole bozonle sua ne anu na bɛhunle awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la na bɛhwenlenle bɛ avunli aze bɛvindele. Akee bɛwolole bɛhɔle ɛleka mɔɔ bozonle ne ananze ne wɔ la,

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: na bɛdule sika ne mɔɔ bɛkpɔnla ye ɛkɛ ne la bɛvindele bɛrayelale ye.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛyelale Beeyale sika ne, bɛyelale ye bozonle sua ne na bɛvale ɛkɛ ne bɛyɛle ɛfo. Ɛnɛ bɔbɔ ala ɔtɛde zɔhane.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Noko Gyihu andwe ɔ nwo anvi Gyɛlɔbowam ninyɛndane ne mɔ anwo. Ɔdaye noko ɔmanle Yizilayɛma zonlenle nlankɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la, kɛmɔ Gyɛlɔbowam yɛle wɔ Bɛtɛle nee Dan la.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyihu kɛ, “Kɛmɔ wɔyɛ mɔɔ sɔ me nye na wɔyɛ Ehabe sua nu amra, kɛmɔ mekpondɛ la ati, mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛ bo zo amra bali Yizilayɛ ebia ne bie toonwo yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo nna ne azo.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Noko Gyihu annea ɔ nwo boɛ, yeanli Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne azo nɔhalɛ nu, yeangyakyi ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la anzi ɛlilɛ. Gyihu Ewule

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔpɛ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne foa ko yeagua. Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle honle vale Yizilayɛ maanle ne,

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: ɔbɔle ye Dwɔdan aduduleɛ afoa nu ɔvale Geleade nee Beehyan azɛlɛ ne amuala, ɔdwule Alowɛ wɔ Azule Annɔn ne anloa. Azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a Gade, Wulubɛn nee Manasɛ Aduduleɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ de a.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Akee gyima mɔɔ hale mɔɔ Gyihu yɛle nee ye nyɛleɛ ne amuala, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyihu hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea. Ɔ ra Gyɛhowahaze a lile ebia ne a.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne vale Belemgbunli Devidi atwɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ manle bɛ. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛnee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛhɔyada vale Dwowahye vindele, ɔzoale ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne na ɔvale mɛla buluku ne mɔɔ maa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne di munli la ɔmanle ye. Akee bɛguale nwole wɔ Dwowahye ati zo na bɛziele ye belemgbunli. Menli ne bɔle bɛ sa nu na bɛdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ!”

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Gyihɔhyɛba nleanle kakula ne ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔvea Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Atalaya a ɛlɛdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Dwowahye kali belemgbunli la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ nsuu.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Ehazaya wule la, ye ɛvolɛ nsuu ne azo, sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada zoanle manle bɛhɔvale belemgbunli sinzavolɛma, nee belemgbunli sua nu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ bɛrale Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔ nee bɛ yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na ɔmanle bɛlile amonle bɛhyele ɔ bo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na akee ɔvale Belemgbunli Ehazaya ara nrenya Dwowahye ɔhilele bɛ,

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ mekpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɛne: Bɛhyɛ bɛ nuhua ekpunli nsa. Ekpunli ko ne mɔɔ bara gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la ɛhyɛ bɛ nwo nsa. Ko ɛzinza belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ,

english_verse: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
translation_verse: ko ɛhɔzinza Sɛɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne, na ko ne mɔɔ kɛha la ɛgyinla sinzavolɛma ne anzi wɔ anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa.

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Ekpunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɛmba gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne la bahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ahɔzinza belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Bɛzinza Belemgbunli Dwowahye kpalɛ kpalɛ. Bɛhwe bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ na ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɔ la bɛli ɔ nzi. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛze kɛ ɔba bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛhu ye.”

english_verse: The commanders followed Jehoiada's orders. Each one called together his guards—those coming on duty and those going off duty.
translation_verse: Safohyenlema ne yɛle tieyɛ manle Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada na bɛvale bɛ ɛlɔnema ne bɛrale, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle gyima nu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ gyima nu la amuala.

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmanle sinzavolɛma ne hwenle bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ na bɛgyinlanle ketee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ nee azukponle ne anwo kɛ bɛsinza belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: na ɔkamaa ɔ nye zo la, ɔnwunle kɛ belemgbunli fofolɛ gyi sua ne mpila ne mɔ ko anwo, kɛmɔ amaamuo ne se la. Safohyenlema ne nee menli mɔɔ bɔ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ la gyigyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anye ɛlie, na bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne zɛhae ala. Ɛkɛ ne ala Atalaya vale ɛya suosuanle ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu na ɔdeanle nu kɛ, “Maamɔlɛ! Maamɔlɛ! Ɛhye le maamɔvo ɛbɛla.”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada angulo kɛ bɛkɛhu Atalaya wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu, yemɔti ɔzele safohyenlema ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛva ye bɛlua sinzavolɛma ɛhonlone ne mɔ avinli bɛvinde, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ kɛ ɔbalie ye la, bɛhu ye.”

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada manle Belemgbunli Dwowahye nee menli ne nee Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛkyekyele ɔ bo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye menli. Eza ɔmanle belemgbunli nee menli ne yɛle ngyekyeleɛ.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Akee menli ne amuala hɔle Beeyale bozonle sua ne anwo na bɛbubule ye bɛguale. Bɛbubule ye azukponle ne nee ye ananze ne mɔ amuala na bɛhunle Beeyale kɔmenle Matan wɔ azukponle ne mɔ anyunlu. Gyɛhɔyada vale sinzavolɛma manle bɛrazinzale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Akee ɔdaye, safohyenlema ne, belemgbunli sinzavolɛma ne, yɛɛ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne sinzavolɛma ne lile belemgbunli ne anyunlu nee ye vi Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu hɔle belemgbunli sua nu. Menli ne amuala doale bɛ. Dwowahye vale Sinzavolɛma Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu a hɔdɛnlanle ye belemgbunli ebia ne anu a.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala anye liele. Bɛhunle Atalaya la, suakpole ne azo guale diinyi. Bɛhunle ye wɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔ ye ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ nu ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, ɔboalekɛ sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada hilehilele ye.

english_verse: Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled
translation_verse: Gyihu dɛnlanle Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo ɛvolɛ nsuu la yɛɛ bɛvale Dwowahye bɛziele Dwuda belemgbunli a, na ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ ne ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanla. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ nli Zaebaya. Ɔvi Biyɛhyiba.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Ezukoa mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛdua azubɔdeɛ kakɛ, anzɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane nwo azubɔdeɛ la, yemɔ bɛnva bɛmba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Noko akee bɛanzɛkye awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ; menli hɔle zo bɔle azu na bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka zɔhane mɔ.

english_verse: One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts,
translation_verse: Kenle ko Dwowahye vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, anrɛɛ bɛzie ezukoa ne mɔɔ menli batua maa bɛbɔ azu, adwule mɔɔ menli ne tua ye dahudahu, nee ezukoa mɔɔ menli ne yeye bɛ ahonle nu fa kyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la bie.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ Dwowahye lile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la ɛnee sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛtɛyɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo gyima biala.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada nee sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛnyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ a? Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛ biala ɛnzie ezukoa mɔɔ kɛrali ɔ sa nu la bieko. Bɛva bɛrɛla amaa bɛava bɛayɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛkye la boɛ.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne kponlenle ɛhye azo na eza bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ tɛ bɛmɛ a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ a.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada bobɔle ɛlɛka, ɔfitile ɔ ti zo na ɔvale ɔziele azukponle ne anwo mɔɔ kɛ ɛwolo Sua ne anu ala la ɛnee ɔgyi fema zo ɛkɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kɛrayɛ gyima wɔ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa la fa ezukoa biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye wɔ menli mɔɔ rale ɛzonlenlɛ la lɔ la gua ɛlɛka ne anu.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Saa ezukoa ne so ɛlɛka ne anu a, ɛnee belemgbunli kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne banea maa bɛtia bɛwulowula ye ahodoku nu.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Bɛwie a bɛkɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle la bɛwula buluku nu na bɛfa ezukoa ne bɛmaa sonla ne mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyima zo la, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko ɔfa ɔtua kapentama, menli mɔɔ si sua la,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: menli mɔɔ gua belekese nee menli mɔɔ kpukekpuke awolɛ la kakɛ a. Ɔfa bie ɔtɔ mbaka mgbole nee awolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sua ne boɛ la na ɔtua sua ne anwo kakɛ biala.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Bɛnva ezukoa ne bie bɛndua dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo, ahyɛnze kuloonwu, aweɛne anzɛɛ ahɛnlaneɛ nwo ninyɛne, anzɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la kakɛ.

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ nea gyima ne azo la lile nɔhalɛ kpalɛ manle ɔrale kɛ ɛnee ɔngyia bɔbɔ kɛ awie kɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrabu mgbonda.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle vale konle doale suakpole Gate azo amra na ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim. Ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔkateta Gyɛlusalɛmma noko.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwowahye sesale azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ, Gyɛhɔhyafate, Gyɛhɔlam nee ɔ ze Ehazaya ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa ɛva ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ ɔdaye Dwowahye ye azubɔlɛ ninyɛne, ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne gya nu la amuala kɔsɔɔti manle bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle, na Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle vale ye ɛlɔnema ne vile Gyɛlusalɛm hɔle.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Dwowahye yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dwowahye safohyenlema ne hɔle ɔ ti akpamo, na nuhua nwiɔ, Hyemɛyate ara Dwozaka yɛɛ Hyomɛ ara Gyɛhozabade, hyele ye hunle ye wɔ sua bie mɔɔ gyi kuma ne mɔɔ bɛduale ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm aduduleɛ la azo la anwo wɔ Sela adenle zo. Na bɛziele ye wɔ arelemgbunli azie ne mɔɔ wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo la azo. Ɔ ra Amazaya a lile ebia ne a.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele ye kɛ, “Buke nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la.” Belemgbunli ne dukuele nvɛnzɛlɛ ne. Akee Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “To wɔ ɛda ne.” Gyɛhowahye dole ɛda ne ala la Yilaehya deanle nu, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛda ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeali Seleama anwo zo konim la. Ɛ nee Selea baho wɔ Efɛke toonwo kɔkpula kɛ ɛkɛbɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ la.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane. Yeangyakyi ye ninyɛndane ne ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya, ɔlua zo ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle nee ɔ ra Bɛneheedade manle bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia konle la.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Nzinlii Gyɛhowahaze zunle vɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔdiele ye, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee akee Seleama ɛlɛsisi Yizilayɛma somaa.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Yizilayɛma nyianle awie lile bɛ ti na bɛhonle bɛliele bɛ nwo bɛvile Seleama asa anu. Yemɔti akee Yizilayɛma anzo nu dwole bɛ kɛ dɛba ne la.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahaze yɛle, ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle, nee ye akɛnrasesebɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la amuala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea. Ɔ ra Gyɛhowahye lile ebia ne ziele Yizilayɛma. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Yilaehya zele ye kɛ, “Sua wɔ ɛda ne.” Na Gyɛhowahye zuale ɛda ne. Yilaehya vale ɔ sa guale belemgbunli ne asa azo.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye noko ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yeandwe ɔ nwo yeanvi Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ vale Yizilayɛma hɔle munzule nu la anwo.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye yɛle nee ye anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɔhilele wɔ Yizilayɛma nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya bɛ konle ne anu la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Gyɛhowahye hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Samɛlea alehelɛ alaleɛ ne na ɔ ra Gyɛlɔbowam a lile Yizilayɛ ebia ne a, na bɛvɛlɛle ye Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya ewule

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Anwonyane mɔɔ rale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaehya ɛhunlɛ la bɔle ye. Na mɔɔ ɔla anwonyane ne anu la, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye rakpɔlale ye. Ɔnwunle Yilaehya la ɔzunle na ɔzele kɛ, “O egya, egya! Yizilayɛ konle ehwili ne nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ la, bɛmɛ ɛhye o!”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Akee Yilaehya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Fula ɛda mbaka ne mɔ.” Na Gyɛhowahye vulale. Yilaehya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Fa ɛda mbaka ne mɔ fi azɛlɛ nwo.” Na belemgbunli ne vale finle azɛlɛ nwo fane nsa na ɔgyakyile.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Yilaehya vale ɔ nwo ɛya na ɔzele kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfi ye aze fane nnu anzɛɛ nsia; anrɛɛ ɛnee wɔzɛkye Seleama wɔwie ala ɛne, mɔɔ bɛ bo zo ɔwɔ kɛ minli bɔkɔɔ a. Kɛkala ɛdeɛ, ɛbali Seleama anwo zo konim fane nsa ala.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Yilaehya wule na bɛziele ye. Ɛvolɛ biala Mowabe ɛlɔnema ba Yizilayɛma anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu wɔ nyenyensuo mekɛ.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Kenle ko Yizilayɛma hɔle kazie nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛwu la, bɛnwunle kɛ Mowabe nwule ɛlɔnema ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo. Yemɔti bɛvuandinle funli ne bɛdole Yilaehya nla ne anu na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle. Funli ne dɔle Yilaehya mbowule ne azo ala la ɔdunwuele na ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle. Yizilayɛma nee Seleama konle ne

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle di ye belemgbunli ne la ɔmanle Yizilayɛma anwo hyelele bɛ kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛhowahaze a di belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ la.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle bɛ anwunvɔne. Yeammaa adenle yeammaa bɛanzɛkye Yizilayɛma. Ɔboale bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nee Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyɛkɔbo lɛ ngyekyeleɛ. Yemɔti ɔ rɛle ɛtɛfile ye menli ne.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle wule la, ɔ ra Bɛneheedade a lile belemgbunli a.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye lile Bɛneheedade anwo zo konim fane nsa na ɔliele Yizilayɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ Seleama honle vale wɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahaze mekɛ zo la. Gyɛhowahye ɔ ze a le Gyɛhowahaze.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Ɔhonle ɔliele azuamgbole mɔɔ Yizilayɛma minlinle bɛ wɔ konle nu la amuala; ɔvi Heemate Ademgbolezo mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ toonwo kɔdwu Nyevile Wulera ne anloa wɔ nyiakɛ nehane. Ɛhye a Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ Dwona, Ametae ara ne anwo zo hanle wɔ Gate Hifa la.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyɛhowahaze ara Gyɛhowahye lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ Dwowahye ara Amazaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔvale ɔ nlenya Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ. Ɔyɛle ninyɛndane ne mɔɔ ɔ nlenya yɛle a ɔmanle Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle ɛtane la bie.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la, noko yeanwie ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ fa. Ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔ ze Dwowahye yɛle la bie.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti ɛnee menli kpu ɛyɛlɛ bɔ azu wɔ ɛleka ɛleka zɔhane mɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ belemgbunli tumi ne amuala ralile ɔ sa nu la, Amazaya manle bɛhunle safohyenlema ne mɔɔ hunle ɔ ze la.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: Noko akee yeangu bɛ mra ne mɔ, na ɔlile Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Mosisi la azo. Mɛla ne se; “Ɔnle kɛ awovolɛma ɛtane ti bɛku mralɛ; yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ mralɛ ɛtane ti bɛku awovolɛma. Awie biala ɔdaye ɔwɔ kɛ di ye ɛtane mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ la anwo ɛzonle.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Akee tie, Amazaya, kɛmɔ wɔli Yidɔmma anwo zo konim la ati yɛɛ ɛlɛtu ɛ nloa anu a. Maa ɛ kunlu ɛdwo ɛ nyunlu mɔɔ wɔnyia ye la anwo na tɛnla wɔ ɛleka bie. Duzu ati a ɛtwehwe munzule wɔamaa ɛ nwo nee wɔ menli ne ɛ?”

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Akee Amazaya zoanle manle bɛhɔzele Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛva yɛ kɛnra yɛbɔ zo.”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye manle bɛvale mualɛ ɛhye bɛhɔmanle ye, “Kenle ko kolokolonyɛma bie mɔɔ wɔ Lɛbanɔn awoka zo la vale nrɛlaleɛ manle bɛhɔmanle sida baka bie kɛ, ‘Fa ɛ ra raalɛ ne maa memaa me ra nrenya ɛgya ye. Na Lɛbanɔn nane kpole bie ratietiale kolokolonyɛma ne azo.’

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Noko Amazaya andie, yemɔti belemgbunli Gyɛhowahye vale ɛlɔnema nee bɛ hɔhonle wɔ Bɛte Hyimɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Gyɛhowahye lile Dwudama anwo zo konim na Amazaya ɛlɔnema ne guale ɛbɔ nu; biala nriandile hɔle ye sua zo.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Gyɛhowahye hyele Amazaya, na akee ɔhɔvole Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔbubule suakpole ne bane ne foa ko, ɔvi Yifelaem Anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa ɔhɔkpulale Muleɛ Anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa. Ye tendenle le kɛyɛ mita ɛya nwiɔ.

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Gyɛhowahye zoale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke biala mɔɔ ɔ sa dɔle zo, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne nee belemgbunli sua nu gya ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala hɔle Samɛlea. Eza ɔhyele menli ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Gyɛhowahye yɛle, ye anwosesebɛ nee kɛ ɔzile ɔ nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Amazaya honle la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Akee Dwudama vale ɔ ra Yuzaya mɔɔ ɛnee ɛli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsia la ziele Dwuda belemgbunli.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Yuzaya nee Yilatema honle, ɔvale sua ne na ɔkyekyele ye fofolɛ. Ɛhye zile mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ ze ɛwu la. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled
translation_verse: Amazaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ bɛvale Gyɛhowahye ara Gyɛlɔbowam bɛziele Yizilayɛ belemgbunli wɔ Samɛlea a. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanla nee ko.

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma anzosesebɛ ɛmaa bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ kpole, yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔboa bɛ a.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Noko ɛnee ɔnle Ɛdɛnkɛma adwenle nu kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo yeazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ, yemɔti ɔluale Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la anwo zo ɔliele bɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la yɛle, ye anwosesebɛ wɔ konle nu, nee kɛ ɔzile ɔliele Dɛmasekɛse mɔɔ kɔkpula Heemate mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Pɛkahaya yɛle, nee ye nyɛleɛ, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulanlu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Mɛnahɛm ara Pɛkahaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nwiɔ.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Yuzaya vale ɔ ze Amazaya agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Noko yeammaa bɛanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti menli ne hɔle zo kpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka zɔhane mɔ na bɛbɔle azu wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ewule kokobɛ dilale Yuzaya toonwo ɔhɔle ewule nu. Yemɔti ɔdɛnlanle sua gyɛne nu, ɔyele ɔ sa wɔ maanle ne ɛbulɛ nwo. Ɔ ra Dwɔtam yɛle ɔ ze gyima ne manle ye na ɔziele maanle ne.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Gyima biala mɔɔ Yuzaya lile, nee nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Yuzaya hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Zɛkalaya

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ tɔ zo Nwiɔ la ara Zɛkalaya ralile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne siane nsia ala.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Gyeebɛhye ara Hyalɛm vuale ɔ ti; ɔ sa hanle ye wɔ Yebelɛyam ɔhunle ye na ɔlile ebia ne.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Belemgbunli Gyihu kɛ, “Ɛ bo zo amra bali Yizilayɛ ebia ne bie toonwo yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo nna ne azo” la, yɛle nɔhalɛ. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Hyalɛm

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ngɔnla wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Gyeebɛhye ara Hyalɛm bɔle belemgbunlililɛ bɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea ɔlile belemgbunli siane ko.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuzaya lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee ngɔnla wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Geedae ara Mɛnahɛm ralile Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ebia ne a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea na ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma amuala yɛle ɛtane la bie.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ vi Aselea ralile Yizilayɛma nvunu, ɔvale konle ɔdoale bɛ. Mɛnahɛm vale dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle ngoko abulasa nee nna manle Paelisɛ, amaa yeaboa ɔdaye Mɛnahɛm wɔ ye maanle ne ɛbulɛ nu.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ ze Yuzaya agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Mɛnahɛm yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu, na ɔ ra Pɛkahaya lile ebia ne. Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pɛkahaya

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la bie.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔvale Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam agyakɛ, ɔbɔle ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔɔ manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la bie.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Wɔ Belemgbunli Pikaa mekɛ zo, Aselea Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ vale ɛlɔne rahonle vale Ayedwɔn, Ebɛle Bɛte Meeyaka, Gyanowa, Kidɛhye, yɛɛ Heezɔ nee Galeli, Geleade nee Nafetalae maanzinli ne mɔ amuala, na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Aselea.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Yuzaya ara Dwɔtam lile Dwuda ebia ne ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ la, Yila ara Hohyia vuale Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa ati na ɔhunle ye ɔlile ebia ne.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Debie biala nee nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ Pikaa yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwɔtam (

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Relɛmalaya ara Pikaa lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Belemgbunli Yuzaya ara Dwɔtam bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Noko bɛanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle la, yemɔti menli hɔle zo kpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ bɔle azu. Dwɔtam a zile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Sɔlɔ Anlenkɛ kpole ne a.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Debie biala nee nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ Dwɔtam yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dwɔtam mekɛ zo yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lumuale manle adenle manle Selea Belemgbunli Rilizen nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa vale konle radoale Dwudama a.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Dwɔtam hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne na ɔ ra Ehaze lile ebia ne.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Pikaa lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsuu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Dwɔtam ara Ehaze bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Ehaze hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo alehelɛ alaleɛ ne. Ɔ ra Hɛzikaya lile ebia ne.

english_verse: Uriah did everything Ahaz told him.
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya yɛle, kɛmɔ belemgbunli ne zele la.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔvale Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli agyakɛ, yɛɛ ɔbɔle bɛ ɛbɛla ɛtane ne bie. Ɔbɔle munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ne azo la bɔ la bie, na ɔvale ɔdaye ɔ ra nrenya ɔyelale ye ɔzɔle amonle. Ɛbɛla ɛtane zɛhae a manle Ɛdɛnkɛma dule menli zɔhane mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ba azɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle azu wɔ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ awoka zo, nee mbaka bo na ɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Ehaze zoanle menli wɔ Aselea Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Mele wɔ sonvolɛ nee ɛ ra nrenya. Bɛla balie me fi Selea nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ zo konle doa me la asa anu.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Ehaze vale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee belemgbunli ne gya nu la yɛle ahyɛlɛdeɛ hɔmanle Aselea belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Tegelate Paelisɛ diele Ehaze modolɛ ne na ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ɔrale Dɛmasekɛse ɔrahonle ɔvale suakpole ne, ɔhunle Belemgbunli Rilizen na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Kɛɛ.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Ehaze hɔle Dɛmasekɛse kɛ ɔkayia Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ la, ɔnwunle azukponle ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la na ɔmanle bɛyɛle bie kɛ yemɔ ala la bɛhɔmanle Sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɛlɛvolɛ Yulaya zile azukponle ne bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhendeɛ ne la pɛpɛ. Ɔzile ɔwiele na Ehaze vi Dɛmasekɛse azia ara.

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: yemɔti ɔyelale nane azubɔdeɛ nee ma azubɔdeɛ wɔ zolɛ na ɔguale nwanye azubɔdeɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ mogya wɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la gyi azukponle fofolɛ ɛhye nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne avinli, na Ehaze manle bɛyele ye ɛkɛ bɛhɔziele azukponle fofolɛ ne sɔlɔ.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele Yulaya kɛ, “Fa me azukponle kpole ɛhye, yela nwonlomɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee nɔsolɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ belemgbunli nee menli ne ɛyelalɛ nee ma azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ zolɛ. Wola nane mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛbɔ azu la mogya ne gua zo. Na gyakyi kɔbele azukponle ne maa me na meabiza wɔ zolɛ.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Ehaze dudule kɔbele ehwili ngyikyi ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, na ɔyeyele ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi nuhua la. Eza ɔmanle angola ne mɔɔ gyi kɔbele nlankɛ bulu nee nwiɔ zo la zo ɔziele ye bolɛ bama zo.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmaa Aselea belemgbunli ne anye alie la, Ehaze eza dudule sɛlɛdwee ne mɔɔ bɛbo ye wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ belemgbunli ne tɛnla wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la na ɔmanle bɛduale anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ala a fa nu ba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze yɛle la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Ehaze lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, yɛɛ Yila ara Hohyia bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ a. Ɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea na ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ ngɔnla.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma noko yeangɔ ɔ nyunlu dɔɔnwo kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ lumua ɔ nyunlu la yɛle la.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Aselea Belemgbunli Hyalemanizɛ vale konle doale ye. Hohyia manle ɔ sa zo na ɔduale adwule ɔmanle Hyalemanizɛ ɛvolɛ biala.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ko bie anu, Hohyia andua ye adwule ne ammaa Aselea belemgbunli ne. Ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔmanle Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Soo kɛ ɔraboa ye. Hyalemanizɛ dele la, ɔmanle bɛhyele Hohyia bɛdole efiade. Samɛlea ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: Shalmaneser invaded Israel and attacked the city of Samaria for three years,
translation_verse: Akee Hyalemanizɛ vale ɛlɔne rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo na ɔhɔtetale Samɛlea. Ye ɛvolɛ nsa ne azo,

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛnee Hohyia ɛli ɛvolɛ ngɔnla wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, Aselea belemgbunli ne honle vale Samɛlea na ɔhyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle Aselea maanle nu. Ɔmanle bie mɔ dɛnlanle Aselea suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Heela la azo nee Azule Heebɔ ne anloa wɔ Gozan maanzinli nu. Ɔvale bie mɔ noko ɔhɔguale Midea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Samɛlea bɔle, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ liele bɛ vile Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne abo na ɔ nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti rale la. Bɛzonlenle awozonle,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: bɛzukoale bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo la yɛ la bie. Ɛdɛnkɛma dule menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ba la. Eza bɛlile amaamuo mɔɔ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ hyehyɛle manle bɛ la angome azo.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma yɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛngulo la. Bɛsisile awozonle azua wɔ azuamgbole, azua azua nee namunamu zo.

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze na bɛvale awolɛ bɛsisile mpila bɛzieziele ananze ne mɔ zolɛ, wɔ awoka zo nee mbaka bo.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: Bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛleka ɛhye mɔ, na bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ la yɛle la bie. Bɛyɛle ninyɛndane bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya,

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: na bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ se bɛmmasonle awozonle la.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye soanvolɛma nee kpɔmanvolɛma ɛrahakye Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama fane dɔɔnwo kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɛli me edwɛkɛ nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Mɛla ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nlenya mɔ, na menluale me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo menvale membɛlɛle bɛ la azo.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Noko bɛandie, yɛɛ bɛanli zolɛ. Bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la; bɛanlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛanli.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Bɛkpole ye mɛla ne mɔ, bɛanli ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele la azo yɛɛ bɛambu ye kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne mɔ bie. Bɛzonlenle mmonle mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zo la na bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛyɛle mgbane. Bɛlile maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la amaamuo zo, na bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ kɛ bɛmmasukoa bɛyɛ mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ la bie la anwo.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Bɛbulule Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la kɔsɔɔti azo, na bɛvale ninyɛne bɛholole bɛguale nlankɛ nyinli ananze nwiɔ bɛzonlenle bɛ. Eza bɛyɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze, na bɛzonlenle anwomanyunlu ninyɛne nee bozonle Beeyale.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Yizilayɛma anwo ɛya kpole na ɔbɔle bɛ bo zo. Yeangyakyi bie kɛ Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne ala.

english_verse: but they also disobeyed the Lord's commands and acted like the Israelites.
translation_verse: Noko Dwudama bɔbɔ anli Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo. Bɛzukoale bɛbule amaamuo ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hɔvale rale la bie.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole Yizilayɛ abo zo amra ne kɔsɔɔti, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma deanle bɛ atisesebɛ nu ɔhɔdwule kɛ akee bɛ bo zo bɔle bɔkɔɔ la.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dele Dwudama vile Yizilayɛma anwo la, Yizilayɛma yɛle Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam bɛ belemgbunli. Gyɛlɔbowam manle bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔmanle bɛyɛle ɛtane kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: manle Ɛdɛnkɛma akee zɛkyele bɛ na ɔyele bɛ ɔvile ɔ nye zo, kɛmɔ ɔluale ye sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɔhakyele bɛ kɛ ɔbayɛ la. Yemɔti bɛhyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Aselea. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛde kɛkala a. Aseleama tɛnla Yizilayɛ

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli ne vale menli vile azuamgbole Babelɔn, Kuutu, Yeva, Heemate, yɛɛ Sifaveeyem azo na ɔmanle bɛradɛnlanle Samɛlea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo. Menli mɔɔ vi azua ɛhye mɔ azo la radɛnlanle Samɛlea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo kpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Alumua ne mɔɔ bɛradɛnlanle maanle ne anu la bɛanzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔti ɔmanle awenade rahyehyele bie mɔ.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: Bɛmanle Aselea belemgbunli ne dele kɛ menli mɔɔ yeva bɛ yeragua azɛlɛ ne azo la ɛnze ɛkɛ ne nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ anloa kyi, yemɔti nyamenle ne ɛmaa awenade ɛlɛkyehye bɛ ahu bɛ.

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele kɛ, “Bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛhyele bɛ yɛ nee bɛ rale la anu ko ɛhɔ ɛhɔdɛnla lɔ na ɔhilehile bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛnli sɛlɛvolɛ ko bie mɔɔ bɛdule ye bɛvile Samɛlea la ziale hɔdɛnlanle Bɛtɛle na ɔhilehilele menli ne kɛ bɛsi bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.
translation_verse: Noko menli mɔɔ hɔdɛnlanle Samɛlea la hɔle zolɛ yɛle bɛ mmonle na bɛvale bɛ bɛziele awozonle azua mɔɔ Yizilayɛma sisile la anu. Maanle ko biala yɛle ye amonle ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye wɔ bɛ sua zo lɔ la.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Babelɔnoma yɛle bɛ bozonle Sɛko Bino ananze; Kuutuma yɛle bɛ bozonle Nɛgale ananze; Heematema yɛle bɛ bozonle Ahyaema ananze;

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: Yevama yɛle bɛ bozonle Nebehaze nee Taatake ananze; yɛɛ Sifaveeyemma yelale bɛ mra bɔle azu manle bɛ awozonle Adelamɛlɛke nee Anamɛlɛke.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko eza bɛzonlenle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛ maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvi nuhua bɛrale la amaamuo ne mɔ de la.

english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: Kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛtɛbu bɛ amaamuo dɛba ne. Bɛnzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ bɛnli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Gyekɔbo, mɔɔ nzinlii ɔdonle ye Yizilayɛ la, abo zo amra ne la azo.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmasonle awozonle biala, bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛkoto bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ menvale tumi kpole menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la. Bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa me na bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa me.

english_verse: Never worship any other god, always obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ nee me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ mehɛlɛ memaa bɛ la azo. Bɛmmasonle awozonle biala,

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la.

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na mebalie bɛ meavi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.”

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Noko menli zɔhane mɔ andie na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle mɔɔ tete ne ɛnee bɛ amaamuo kile la.

english_verse: They did worship the Lord, but they also worshiped their own idols. Their descendants did the same thing.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli zɔhane zonlenle mmonle, na ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛ bo zo amra tɛyɛ zɔhane debie ko ne ala.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛkakye bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa Hɛzikaya bɛlɛbɛla bɛ. Hɛzikaya ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ,

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah! Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Bɛmmatie Hɛzikaya. Aselea belemgbunli ne se bɛvi suakpole ne azo bɛvinde bɛrabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa ye. Bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbamaa bɛ adenle yeamaa awie biala ɔdaye yeali ye vanye mbaka zo ma, nee ye feege mbaka ma, na bɛanlo bɛdabɛ bɛ bula nu nzule,

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: Ɔzɛkyele awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ, ɔbubule awolɛ mpila ne mɔ na ɔzɛkyele bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ. Eza ɔbubule kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ne mɔɔ Mosisi yɛle mɔɔ bɛvɛlɛle ye Nehɛhyetan la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli kɔkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne sonle ye.

english_verse: Hezekiah trusted the Lord God of Israel. No other king of Judah was like Hezekiah, either before or after him.
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya vale ɔ rɛle wulale Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anu. Dwuda annyia belemgbunli bieko mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la, yɛɛ bie anlumua ɔ nyunlu mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: Ɔlile nɔhalɛ ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, yeandu ye edwɛkɛ zo ɛlɛ. Ɔlile mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Mosisi la azo kpalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye lua yɛɛ ɔkpazile wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la anu. Ɔdele Aselea belemgbunli ne anwo atua na ɔkpole kɛ ɔkɛboa belemgbunli ne abo.

english_verse: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee Filisitiama honle, ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim na ɔzɛkyele bɛ azuamgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti. Gaza nee ye namunamu ne mɔ boka azua mɔɔ ɔzɛkyele bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Hohyia ɔdaye yeli ɛvolɛ nsuu wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la, Aselea Belemgbunli Hyalemanizɛ rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo, ɔtetale Samɛlea na bɛduale bɛ adenle.

english_verse: and captured it three years later, in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule and the ninth year of Hoshea's rule.
translation_verse: Ɔkanyia ɛvolɛ nsa la yɛɛ Samɛlea bɔle a. Ɛnee Hɛzikaya ɛli ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ ye ebia ne azo yɛɛ Hohyia ɛli ɛvolɛ ngɔnla.

english_verse: The king of Assyria took the Israelites away as prisoners; he forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli ne hyele Yizilayɛma bie mɔ nuokɛ hɔle Aselea na ɔmanle bie mɔ hɔdɛnlanle Heela, bie mɔ dɛnlanle Azule Heebɔ ne anloa wɔ Gozan maanzinli nu, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko dɛnlanle Midea azuamgbole ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: Samɛlea bɔle, ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma anyɛ tieyɛ ammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛbulule ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yɛle la azo, na bɛdule bɛ gye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle Mosisi la anwo. Bɛandie ye yɛɛ bɛanyɛ tieyɛ bɛammaa ye. Aseleama nwunlonwunla Gyɛlusalɛmma (

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne kɛnyia nwolɛ ɔkɛva bɛ ɔkɛhɔgua maanle mɔɔ ye azɛlɛ ne le kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ye la anu la. Ɛkɛ ne, vanye ɛya avule mɔɔ bamaa bɛ nwanye bɛanlo nee abɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ kpanwo la anwo ɛngyia. Ɔlivi mbaka wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole nee wolɛ ɛbu. Saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile bɛ la a bɛlɛ bɛ ti, bɛnrɛwu. Bɛmmamaa Hɛzikaya yɛ bɛ koasea ɔmaa bɛdwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlie bɛ.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Na safohyenle mgbanyinli ne mɔ ko zele bɛ kɛ, Aselea belemgbunli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ si Hɛzikaya ahonle la.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Aselea safohyenle ne eza zɔle zo kɛ, “Anzɛɛ bɛka bɛahile me kɛ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anu ɔ? Tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma azua ne yɛɛ ye azukponle ne mɔ a Hɛzikaya ɛmaa bɛbubu bɛ na yeze Dwudama amuala nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la kɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la azo ala a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ azu na bɛsonle la ɔ?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna wɔ ebia ne azo la, Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe rale azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛlie nwolɛ bane mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la amuala anwo zo, ɔ nee bɛ honle ɔlile bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya zoanle manle bɛvale nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔmanle Sɛnakɛlebe mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Leekehye la kɛ, “Meyɛ ɛtane, mekpa wɔ kyɛlɛ, mmaba ɛ nyunlu bieko na menwɔdua ezukoa biala mɔɔ ɛdie la.” Aselea belemgbunli ne buale kɛ Hɛzikaya ɛradua dwɛtɛ fufule kilo apenle bulu yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke kilo apenle ko ɛmaa ye.

english_verse: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord's temple and the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya kpokpole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee suakunlu ɛkɛ ne gya nu dwɛtɛ fufule kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: ɔwokewokele ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ bɛholo bɛgua Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anwo la nee mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔmanle bɛholole bɛguale nlenkɛ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo la na bɛvale ɔ muala bɛhɔmanle Sɛnakɛlebe.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli ne akee vale ɛlɔne ekpunli kpole kpalɛ ko vi Leekehye kɛ bɛ nee Hɛzikaya kaho wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Safohyenle mgbanyinli nsa a lile ɛlɔnema ne ati a. Bɛdwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛhɔvale ɛleka mɔɔ menli mɔɔ nwo ndanlɛ la yɛ bɛ gyima la adenle ne. Adenle zɔhane zua kuma ne mɔɔ bɛvu na nzule dua nuhua vi sɔlɔ nzule ne anu ba la.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Akee bɛzoanle kɛ bɛhɔvɛlɛ Hɛzikaya na Hɛzikaya mbɔlɔba nsa vindele kɛ bɛkayia bɛ. Bɛmɛ a le Belekaya ara Yilayakem mɔɔ nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Hyɛbena mɔɔ le kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛɛ Esafe ara Dwowaa mɔɔ yemɔ a nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne ngɛlata zo la.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ɔbizale kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa bɛ nloa a bɛko a? Saa bɛte Aselea belemgbunli anwo atua a nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ kɛlie bɛ a?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye la kɛ Yigyibiti baraboa bɛ, na yemɔ bɔbɔ, ɔle baka bie mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeabu la. Ɛkomo zolɛ a ɔbabu yeawɔ ɛ sa akunlu. Menli mɔɔ fa bɛ rɛle wula Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne anu la kɛ wie ye la ɛne.”

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people. He will give you
translation_verse: Megyinla Aselea belemgbunli ne agyakɛ anu me nee bɛ ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Saa bɛkɛnyia nwolɛ menli dodo ne a anrɛɛ memaa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ apenle nwiɔ kɛkala.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mumua ne, bɛndwu Aselea safohyenlema anu kakula kpalɛ bɔbɔ ɛleka bie, noko bɛ nye la kɛ Yigyibitima kɛva konle ehwili nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la kɛrɛlɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Na Yilayakem, Hyɛbena, yɛɛ Dwowaa hanle hilele safohyenle ne kɛ, “Yɛmenle, yɛsɛlɛ wɔ ka Arelameeyeke kile yɛ na yɛte. Mmaka Hibulu ɛmaa menli mɔɔ gua bane ye ati zo ɛke la te mɔɔ ɛlɛka la.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Safohyenle ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ ngome nee bɛ belemgbunli ne ati yɛɛ me menle zoanle me kɛ memanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ mengile bɛ a, na menli mɔɔ gua bane ne ati la ɛmboka nwolɛ? Metendɛ meahile menli mɔɔ gua bane ne ati la bɛdabɛ noko, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛbali bɛ ebinli, bɛanlo bɛ miene.”

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Akee safohyenle ne dwazole gyinlanle na ɔvale Hibulu aneɛ ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛlɛka ahile bɛ la.

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɔdi bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu. Bɛmmadwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlie bɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɛzi Aselea ɛlɔnema aze kɛ bɛmmako bɛfa bɛ.

translation_verse: Ɔsisile awozonle azukponle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha kɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ye la anu.
