english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Yitan ara nrenya a le Azalaya. Belemgbunli Devidi abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hɛzelɔn wole mralɛ mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyɛlamii, Relam, yɛɛ Kalɛbe.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔɔ vi Relam anwo zo badwu Gyɛsi anwo zo la ɛne: Relam, Amenadabe, Neehyɔn

english_verse: Obed, and Jesse.
translation_verse: Obɛde, yɛɛ Gyɛsi.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Eza ɔwole mralɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Zɛluaya nee Abegeli. Gyɛsi ara raalɛ Zɛluaya wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Abehyae, Dwowabe, yɛɛ Asahɛle.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Gyɛsi ara raalɛ Abegeli gyale Gyitɛ, mɔɔ le Yehyemeeyɛle abo zo sonla la na ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ nrenya, bɛdonle ye Ameesa. Hɛzelɔn abo zo amra

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hɛzelɔn ara Kalɛbe gyale Azuba na ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ raalɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛleyo. Ɔdaye noko ɔwole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyihyɛ, Hyobabe, yɛɛ Adɔn.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Azuba wule la, Kalɛbe gyale Yifelate na ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Huuli.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Huuli ara a le Yulae yɛɛ ye anlɔnra a le Bɛzali.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hɛzelɔn wule la, ɔ ra Kalɛbe gyale Ɛfelate mɔɔ le ɔ ze aye kunlanvolɛ ne. Bɛwole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ahyɔɔ; yemɔ a ɔwole Tɛkowa mɔɔ kyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tɛkowa la a. Gyɛlamii abo zo amra

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Gyɛlamii mɔɔ le Hɛzelɔn ara kpanyinli ne wole mrenya nnu. Bɛmɛ a le Relam, yemɔ a ɔle kpanyinli a, yɛɛ akee Bunaa, Ɔlɛn, Ozɛm, yɛɛ Ahaegya.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam wole mrenya nwiɔ: Hyameeyae nee Gyeeda. Hyameeyae noko wole mrenya nwiɔ: Needabe nee Abaehyɔ.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abaehyɔ gyale raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Abeheli na ɔ nee ye wole Aaban nee Molede.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Abaehyɔ adiema Needabe wole mrenya nwiɔ: Silɛde nee Apeeyem. Silɛde anwo ralɛ nrenya na yeawu.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apeeyem ara a le Ayehyae; Ayehyae wole Hyihyan yɛɛ Hyihyan wole Aaleeyae.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Hyameeyae adiema Gyeeda wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Gyitɛ nee Dwɔnatan. Gyitɛ anwo ralɛ nrenya na yeawu.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan wole mrenya nwiɔ: Pilɛte nee Zeeza. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Gyɛlamii abo zo amra.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Na Hyihyan vale ɔ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ ko manle Gyaaha gyale, ɔ nee ye wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ateeyae.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Gyɛkamaya, yɛɛ Yilaehyama. Kalɛbe abo zo amra bie mɔ

english_verse: Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron,
translation_verse: Gyɛlamii adiema Kalɛbe ara nrenya kpanyinli ne, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mihya. Mihya wole Zefe mɔɔ wole Malihya, mɔɔ le Hibulɔn ɔ ze ne.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hibulɔn wole mrenya nna: Kɔla, Tapua, Rilikɛm, yɛɛ Hyima.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Hyima ara a le Releeham yɛɛ ye anlɔnra a le Dwɔkowam. Rilikɛm mɔɔ wole Hyameeyae la adiema a le Hyima.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Hyameeyae a wole Meeyɔn a, yɛɛ Meeyɔn a wole Bɛtezɛ a.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kalɛbe lɛ ye mgbɔnla bie, bɛfɛlɛ ye Yifaa. Ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Hɛlan, Maza, yɛɛ Geezɛze. Hɛlan ɔdaye ɔwole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Geezɛze.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kalɛbe lɛ ye mgbɔnla bieko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Meeyaka. Ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Hyibɛ nee Tɛheena.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Nzinlii Meeyaka wole mrenya nwiɔ bieko. Bɛmɛ a le Hyeeyafe mɔɔ kyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mademana la; yɛɛ Hyiva, mɔɔ ɔdaye noko ɔkyekyele Makebina nee Gebɛya azua ne mɔ la. Kalɛbe eza lɛ ɔ ra raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Akesa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: Ɔ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Salema la a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a, yɛɛ ɔ ra nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛlɛfe. Yemɔ a ɔkyekyele Bɛtegeeda a.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Hyobale mɔɔ kyekyele Keleate Gyialem la abo zo amra a le menli mɔɔ de Haloyi la yɛɛ Mɛnuhotu ezuavolɛ ne foa ko.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: Mbusua ekpulike ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Keleate Gyialem la bɛdabɛ bɛle Hyobale abo zo amra: Yetelama, Putima, Hyumanema, yɛɛ Mehyelama.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salema a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a. Ɔ bo zo amra a le Nɛtofatema, Atolo Bɛte Dwowabema, yɛɛ Zolama. Menli ɛhye mɔ bɔ Manahate abusua ne bie.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: Dwotam wole Ehaze, Ehaze wole Hɛzikaya, Hɛzikaya wole Manasɛ,

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Ɛye ɛhye mɔ ɛsie ahane a, Belemgbunli Devidi eza nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ wole mralɛ mrenya dɔɔnwo. Ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Teemaa. Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn abo zo amra

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Dwosaya wole mrenya nna. Bɛmɛ a le Dwoheenan, ɔ ra kpanyinli ne, Gyɛhɔyakem, Zɛdikaya, yɛɛ Dwowahaze.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyakem wole mrenya nwiɔ. Gyɛhɔyakɛn yɛɛ Zɛdikaya. Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn abo zo amra

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn mɔɔ Babeloniama hyele ye nuokɛ hɔle nlɔnu la abo zo amra ɛne: Gyɛhɔyakɛn wole mrenya nsuu. Bɛmɛ a le Hyealeteɛle,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malekaelam, Pɛdaya, Hyɛneza, Gyɛkamaya, Hohyama, yɛɛ Nɛdabaya.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pɛdaya wole mrenya nwiɔ, Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Hyemɛyae. Zɛlɛbabɛle wole Mɛhyɛlam nee Hananaya, yɛɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyɛlomete.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Eza ɔwole mrenya nnu: Hahyuba, Ohɛle, Bɛlikaya, Hasadaya, yɛɛ Dwuhyabe Hɛsɛde.

english_verse: Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah,
translation_verse: Hananaya wole mrenya nwiɔ, Pɛlataya nee Gyɛhyaya. Gyɛhyaya wole Relɛfaya, Relɛfaya wole Aanan, Aanan wole Obadaya, Obadaya wole Hyɛkanaya,

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Hyɛkanaya wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hyɛmaya, yɛɛ ɔlɛ nlɔnra nnu. Bɛmɛ a le Hatɛhye, Yigɛyale, Balaya, Nialaya, yɛɛ Hyeefate.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nialaya wole mrenya nsa: Ɛleyoyinae, Hɛzikaya, yɛɛ Azelaekam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Ɛleyoyinae wole mrenya nsuu: Hodavaya, Yilayahyebe, Pɛlaya, Akɛbe, Dwoheenan, Dɛlaya, yɛɛ Aneenae.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Dwuda abo zo amra ne bie mɔ ɛne: Pɛlɛze, Hɛzelɔn, Kaamae, Huuli, yɛɛ Hyobale.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Hyobale ara a le Riliaya, Riliaya wole Gyeehate, Gyeehate wole Ahumae nee Leehade mɔɔ bɛ bo zo amra a wɔ Zola la.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Huuli a le Kalɛbe nee ɔ ye Yifelate amra mrenya ne mɔ anu kpanyinli a, yɛɛ ɔ bo zo amra a kyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm a. Huuli amra mrenya nsa: Yitam, Pɛnuwɛle, yɛɛ Yizɛ. Yitam wole mrenya nsa: Gyɛzelii, Yehyema, yɛɛ Yedebahye. Eza ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hazɛlɛponae. Pɛnuwɛle a kyekyele suakpole Gidɔ a, yɛɛ Yizɛ a kyekyele Huhya a.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Ahyɔɔ, mɔɔ wole Tɛkowa mɔɔ kyekyele Tɛkowa la gyale mraalɛ nwiɔ, Hila nee Neeyala.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee Neeyala wole mrenya nna: Ahuzam, Hifɛ, Timɛnae, yɛɛ Heeyahahyetalae.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Ahyɔɔ nee Hila wole mrenya nsa: Zilɛte, Yezaa, yɛɛ Ɛtenan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Kɔɔzo a wole Anubu nee Zobiba a. Bɛ nla ne vi Hɛlɛm ara Ahaahɛle abusua ekpulike ne anu.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyeebɛze. Bɛdi ye eni kpole wɔ ɔdaye ye abusua ne anu bɛtɛla awie biala. Ɔ nli donle ye Gyeebɛze, ɔluakɛ ɔwo ye la ɔdele nyane kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Na Gyeebɛze zɛlɛle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ, “Yila me, Nyamenle, na maa me azɛlɛ kpole. Ɛ nee me ɛlua na ye me fi munzule mɔɔ kɛmaa menwɔde nyane la anu.” Na Nyamenle diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ, ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la ɔmanle ye. Mbusua bie mɔ noko aluma

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Hyuhya adiema Kalɛbe wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mihɛ. Mihɛ wole Ɛhyetɔn,

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Ɛhyetɔn wole mrenya nsa: Bɛteleefa, Pasia, yɛɛ Tɛhena. Tɛhena a kyekyele suakpole Neehahye a. Menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo amra dɛnlanle Rilika.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kinaze wole mrenya nwiɔ, Ɔteneɛle nee Sɛlaya. Ɔteneɛle ɔdaye ɔwole mrenya nwiɔ, Heetate nee Miyonotae.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Miyonotae wole Ɔfela. Sɛlaya wole Dwowabe, mɔɔ kyekyele Dwinvolɛma Bɔnza la. Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ɛhye azo la le dwinvolɛ.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe wole mrenya nsa: Ayelu, Yila, yɛɛ Neeyam. Yila a wole Kinaze a.

english_verse: Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
translation_verse: Ɛzela wole mrenya nna: Gyitɛ, Milɛde, Yifɛ, yɛɛ Gyalɔn. Milɛde gyale Yigyibiti belemgbunli ara raalɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Bitaya. Ɔ nee ye wole ralɛ raalɛ, Meleam, yɛɛ mrenya nwiɔ, Hyameeyae nee Yehyeba. Yehyeba a kyekyele Ɛhyetɛmowa a. Milɛde eza gyale raalɛ bie mɔɔ vi Dwuda abusua nu la, na ɔ nee ye wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Gyilɛde, mɔɔ kyekyele Gidɔ la; Hibɛ mɔɔ kyekyele Soko la, yɛɛ Gyakuteɛle. Ɔdaye ɔkyekyele sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zanowa la.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodaya gyale Neeham adiema raalɛ. Bɛ bo zo amra a le abusua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gaam la. Bɛdɛnlanle sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kiyaela la azo. Eza bɛ bie mɔ a le Meeyaka abusua ne mɔɔ bie mɔ dɛnlanle Ɛhyetɛmowa sua zo la.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Hyaemɔn wole mrenya nna: Amenɔn, Relena, Bɛneheenan, yɛɛ Taelɔn. Yehyae wole mrenya nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Zohɛte nee Bɛnzohɛte. Hyila abo zo amra

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Bɛwɔ belemgbunli ne gyima nu bɛnwo mbuakɛ nee dwora bɛmaa belemgbunli ne. Bɛdɛnlanle Nɛtaem nee Gɛdɛla. Semɛyɔn abo zo amra

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Semɛyɔn wole mrenya nnu: Nɛmuwɛle, Gyeemen, Gyɛlebe, Zila, yɛɛ Hyeeyɛle.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Hyeeyɛle ara a le Hyalɛm: ye anlɔnra a le Mebesam, yɛɛ ye angabɛnzo a le Mehyema.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Akee abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne ndoazo ɛne: Mehyema wole Hamuwɛle, Hamuwɛle wole Zakɛ, yɛɛ Zakɛ wole Hyemɛyae.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Eza bɛdɛnlanle ɛleka nnu bieko. Ɛleka ne mɔ a le Yitam, Eyen, Relemɔn, Tokɛn, yɛɛ Ahyan,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: nee namunamu mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne toonwo kɔdwu sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Beeyalate la nyiakɛ mɔɔ di kɔ adɔleɛ la. Bɛ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle la tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzie toonwo la, yemɔ ɛne.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ a le bɛ mbusua ne mɔ mgbanyinli a: Mɛhyobabe, Gyamelɛke, Amazaya ara Dwohyaa, Dwowɛle, Gyihu , Ɛleyoyinae, Gyeyakoba, Gyɛhyohaya, Asaya, Adeɛle, Gyɛsemeɛle, Bɛnaya, Zaeza Bɛ abusua ne hɔle zolɛ dɛlɛle la ati,

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: bɛdɛlɛle bɛhɔle adɔleɛ toonwo asɛɛ Gidɔ bɛkpondɛle adidileka bɛmanle bɛ nyɛmoa wɔ bɔnza ne mɔɔ bɛhye sua ne nu la aduduleɛ.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Bɛnyianle azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ na bɛ nyɛmoa didi zolɛ a ɔyɛ boɛ la; azɛlɛ ne tɛlɛ, ɛkɛ ne le sulokoko, yɛɛ anzonudwolɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. Menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne la vi Ham.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Bɛhunle Amalɛkema mɔɔ hale ɛkɛ ne la, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛde toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo ara nrenya kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Wulubɛn la abo zo amra ɛne. (Kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔ ze mraalɛ ne mɔ ko la ati, ye awolɛ kpanyinli gyinlabelɛ ne bɔle ye, na bɛvale zɔhane gyinlabelɛ ne bɛmanle Dwosefi.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo ara kpanyinli Wulubɛn wole mrenya nna: Heenɔko, Paluu, Hɛzelɔn, yɛɛ Kaamae.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: Dwowɛle abo zo amra, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo la ɛne: Hyɛmaya, Gɔɔgo, Hyemɛyae, Maeka, Riliaya, Beeyale, yɛɛ Biyɛla. Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelizɛ hyele Biyɛla mɔɔ ɛnee gyi Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne ati la, na ɔdule ye ɔvile maanle ne anu.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: yɛɛ Biyɛla, mɔɔ le Ezaze ara na ɔle Hyima anlɔnra la. Ɔvi Dwowɛle abusua nu. Abusua ɛhye bɔle ye nzeseɛ wɔ Alowɛ, bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle ye sɔlɔ afoa nu toonwo bɛhɔdwule Nibo nee Beeyale Miyɔn.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ɛnee bɛlɛ nyɛmoa dɔɔnwo wɔ Geleade azɛlɛ zo, yemɔti bɛvale azɛlɛ ne toonwo bɛhɔdwule Azule Yufileti ne anloa mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo mekɛ zo, Wulubɛn abusua ekpunli ne hɔholole Heegama anwo zo, bɛhunle bɛ bɛvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ Geleade aduduleɛ la, na bɛdɛnlanle bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu. Gaade abo zo amra

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gaade abusua ekpunli ne anu amra dɛnlanle Wulubɛnema sɔlɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Beehyan la azo; bɛdabɛ bɛbɔle ye ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle ye aduduleɛ toonwo bɛhɔdwule Saleka.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛle Hulae ara Abeheli abo zo amra; bɛ mgbanyima a le ɛhye mɔ: Abeheli, Hulae, Gyalowa, Geleade, Maekeɛle, Gyɛhyehyae, Gyaado, Bɛɛze,

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Ehae mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Abedeɛle na ɔle Gunae anlɔnra la a le mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ kpanyinli a.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Bɛdɛnlanle Beehyan nee Geleade nee azua mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la azo, yɛɛ Hyɛlɔn azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee Heegama mɔɔ wɔ Gyitɛ, Nɛfehye, yɛɛ Nodabe la nyianle konle.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale Nyamenle anu na bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔboa bɛ. Na Nyamenle diele bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na ɔmanle bɛlile Heegama nee bɛ boavolɛma anwo zo konim.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Bɛhunle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anu dɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee konle ne le Nyamenle konle. Na bɛdɛnlanle maanle zɔhane anu toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele Yizilayɛma nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la. Menli mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ la

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ la dɛnlɛdɛnlanle Beehyan azɛlɛ zo wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu toonwo bɛ nloa dwule Beeyale Hɛmɔn, Sinɛɛ, yɛɛ Hɛmɔn Boka, na bɛlɔle kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Bɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ɛne: Yifɛ, Yehyae, Yilayɛle, Azeleɛle, Gyɛlɛmaya, Hodavaya, yɛɛ Gyaadeɛle. Bɛle safohyenlema mɔɔ di munli a, yɛɛ bɛgyigyi bɛ mbusua ne mɔ ati kpundii. Bɛdu mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la bɛvi bɛ maanle nu

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Noko menli ne anli nɔhalɛ ammaa bɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne. Bɛkpole ye na bɛzonlenle maanle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle dule bɛ la awozonle ne mɔ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Nyamenle manle Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Pɛɛle lile maanle ne nvunu na ɔhonle ɔvale bɛ. Ɔdule Wulubɛnema, Gaadema, yɛɛ Manasɛ Aduduleɛ amra ɔvile maanle ne anu ɔmanle bɛhɔdɛnlanle Heelaa, Heebɔ, yɛɛ Hɛla, nee Azule Gozaa ne anloa kpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate wole mrenya nna: Amelam, Yezaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amelam wole mrenya nwiɔ: Aalɔn nee Mosisi. Eza ɔwole raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Meleam. Aalɔn wole mrenya nna: Needabe, Abaehu, Ɛlieza, yɛɛ Yitamaa.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza dule Gyɛhozadake nee menli bie wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu. Livae abo zo amra ne bie mɔ

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Livae wole mrenya nsa: Gɛhyɔn, Kohate, yɛɛ Mɛlɛlae.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Mrenya nsa ɛhye, ko biala wole mralɛ mrenya. Gɛhyɔn wole Lebenae nee Hyemɛyae,

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate wole Amelam, Yezaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle;

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Ɛlekeena wole mrenya nwiɔ: Ameesae nee Ahaemo.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samoɛle wole mrenya nwiɔ: Dwowɛle a le kpanyinli a, yɛɛ Abaegya a le kakula a.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Hyemɛya, Hagaya, yɛɛ Asaya. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi vale Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu ɛzonlenlɛ edwɛndolɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ ne wulale bɛ sa nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛziele aze la ɛne:

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ hakyihakyile bɛ nwo yɛle edwɛndolɛ gyima ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn zile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Bɛyele bɛ mediema Livaema mɔɔ hale la kɛ bɛmɛ bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima mɔɔ ɛha Nyamenle Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu la. Aalɔn abo zo amra

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Aalɔn nee ɔ bo zo amra a bɔle ɛyelalɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ɛkpunlɛ azu wɔ azukponle ne mɔ azo na bɛyɛle Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne gyima ne a. Bɛluale Nyamenle sonvolɛ Mosisi ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo bɛyɛle mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma amuala.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle la nee bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ ɛne: Aalɔn abo zo amra mɔɔ le Kohate abusua nu amra la a lumuale nyianle azɛlɛ ne bie a.

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Bɛnyianle Hibulɔn azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la,

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: na ɛya ɛya nee namunamu mɔɔ bikye suakpole ne la bɛvale bɛmanle Gyɛfɛni ara Kalɛbe.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman abusua ekpunli ne maanzinli ne anu, bɛvale Giba, Alɛmɛte, yɛɛ Anato nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la bɛmanle bɛ. Azuamgbole mɔɔ Kohate abusua ne anu amra nyianle la le bulu nee nsa.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Kohate abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la, bɛguale nzeleba na bɛhyɛle azuamgbole bulu mɔɔ wɔ Manasɛ Adɔleɛ la bɛmanle bɛ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Bɛvale azuamgbole bulu nee nsa bɛvile Yesakaa, Ahya, Nafetalae, yɛɛ Manasɛ mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan la azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo na bɛhyɛle bɛmanle Gɛhyɔn abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne anu amra.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛvale azuamgbole bulu nee nwiɔ bɛvile Wulubɛn, Gaade, yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo bɛmanle Mɛlɛlae abo zo amra ne a.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma vale bɛ azuamgbole nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la manle Livaema.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Kohate abo zo amra ne bie mɔ nyianle azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ Yifelaem azɛlɛ zo la bie.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Manasɛ abusua ekpunli foa ko ne azɛlɛ ne bie eza hɔle Gɛhyɔn abusua ne ɛkɛ. Azua ne mɔ a le Golan mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan, yɛɛ Ahyetalo, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Nafetalae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra nyianle Kidɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Galeli, Hamɔn, yɛɛ Keleateeyem, nee azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛdidi zolɛ la.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Mɛlɛlae abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la nyianle Zɛbulɛn abusua ekpunli nu amra azɛlɛ ne bie. Bɛmɛ a le Relemɔno, yɛɛ Teebɔ, nee bɛ namunamu.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Yesakaa amra mrenya nna: Tola, Pua, Gyahyɛbe, yɛɛ Hyemelɔn.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlenya Yifelaem zunle bɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, na ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ rakyekyele ɔ rɛle.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Ɛzae ara a le Yezilahaya, yɛɛ Yezilahaya amra mrenya nna: Maekeɛle, Obadaya, Dwowɛle, yɛɛ Yehyaya. Bɛ muala bɛdi mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ awuke nu.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa abo zo amra ɛne: Suwa, Haanɛfɛ, Hyuwale, Bilae, Yemela,

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman amra mrenya nsa: Bila, Bikɛ, yɛɛ Gyɛdeyeeyɛle.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bila wole mrenya nnu: Ɛzebɔn, Ɛzae, Ɛzeɛle, Gyɛlemo, yɛɛ Ayelae. Menli nnu ye, bɛle mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛdi munli wɔ konle nu. Bɛ bo zo amra le menli apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ menli abulasa nee nna.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bikɛ amra mrenya ngɔnla: Zɛmaela, Dwowahye, Ɛleyizɛ, Ɛleyoyinae, Ɔmelae, Gyɛlemo, Abaya, Anato, yɛɛ Alɛmɛte.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Yifelaem abo zo amra abusuandoazo ne ɛne: Hyutilaa, yɛɛ Bɛlɛde, Teehate, Ɛliada, Teehate,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Gyɛdeyeeyɛle wole nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Belehan. Belehan wole Gyiyɛhye, Bɛngyaman, Yihɛde, Kɛmeeyana, Zitan, Tahyehye, yɛɛ Ahaehyeehaa.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Yulam ara nrenya a le Bidan. Bɛ muala bɛle Meekɛ ara Geleade abo zo amra. Meekɛ ɔ ze a le Manasɛ.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Hyɛpem nee Hɛpem bɛ ze a le Ɛɛ. Huhyem ɔ ze a le Ehɛ. Nafetalae abo zo amra

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Nafetalae wole mrenya nna: Gyaazeɛle, Gunae, Gyizɛ, yɛɛ Hyalɛm. Manasɛ abo zo amra

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manasɛ amra mrenya nwiɔ: ɔ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔɔ vi Alam la a wole bɛ a. Bɛmɛ a le Aseleɛle yɛɛ Meekɛ mɔɔ wole Geleade la.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Meekɛ gyale mraalɛ manle Hɛpem nee Hyɛpem. Ɔ diema raalɛ a le Meeyaka yɛɛ ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a le Zilɔfɛhade. Zilɔfɛhade wole mraalɛ ngome.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Meekɛ aye Meeyaka wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ na ɔdonle bɛ Pilɛhye yɛɛ Hyilɛhye. Pilɛhye amra mrenya a le Yulam nee Releekɛm,

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Geleade adiema raalɛ Hamolɛkɛte wole mrenya nsa: Ayehyɔdo, Ebayizɛ, yɛɛ Mahelaa.

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Zeebade, Hyutilaa, Yizɛ, yɛɛ Ɛlɛyade. Yizɛ nee Ɛlɛyade a menli mɔɔ wɔ Gate la hunle bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkawua Gatema nlankɛ la.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Na ɔ nee ɔ ye hɔle nla nu bieko la, ɔ ye nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. Ɔdonle ye Bɛlaya, ɔluakɛ munzule ɛzi ye abusua ne anu.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Yifelaem ara raalɛ Hyiila a kyekyele Aleze nee Sɔlɔ Bɛte Hɔlɔn nee Ɛzɛn Hyiila a.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Yifelaem lɛ ɔ ra nrenya ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Rilifaa. Rilifaa abo zo amra a le Rilihyɛfe, Tilaa, Teehan,

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nɛn, yɛɛ Dwɔhyua.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Maanle mɔɔ bɛvale bɛdɛnlanle nu bɔkɔɔ la a le Bɛtɛle nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye, Neeyalan aduduleɛ afoa nu, Gizɛ adɔleɛ afoa nu nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ, yɛɛ Hyikɛm nee Aya nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Eza bɛ nee Manasɛma ɛweɛne zo, bɛziele azuamgbole Bɛte Hyan, Teeyanake, Mɛgedo, yɛɛ Dɔɔ nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la. Ɛnee Gyekɔbo ara Dwosefi abo zo amra ne ɛleka mɔɔ dɛnlanle la, bɛmɛ ɛne. Ahya abo zo amra

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Ahya abo zo amra ɛne: Yemena, Yehyeva, Yehyevae, Bɛlaya, yɛɛ bɛ diema raalɛ Sɛla.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Bɛlaya amra mrenya nwiɔ: Hibɛ yɛɛ Malekeɛle mɔɔ wole Bɛzeeyete la.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Hibɛ amra mrenya nsa: Gyafelɛte, Hyomɛ, yɛɛ Hotam. Bɛ diema raalɛ a le Hyua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Gyafelɛte amra mrenya nsa: Peesake, Bemehale, yɛɛ Ahyevate.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Gyafelɛte adiema Hyomɛ amra mrenya nsa: Wuloga, Gyɛhɛba, yɛɛ Ɛlam.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Gyafelɛte adiema nrenya Hotam amra mrenya nna: Zofa, Yemena, Hyilɛhye, yɛɛ Emale.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Bizɛ, Hɔɔdo, Hyama, Hyelehya, Yetelan, yɛɛ Biyɛla.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Gyitɛ abo zo amra a le Gyɛfɛni, Pesepa, yɛɛ Ala,

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: yɛɛ Ɛla abo zo amra a le Alaa, Haneɛle, yɛɛ Relezea.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman ara nrenya kpanyinli a le Bila. Mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ doɔdoa zolɛ la a le Ahyebɛle, Ahɛla,

english_verse: Nohah, and Rapha.
translation_verse: Noha, yɛɛ Releefa.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bila amra mrenya ne mɔ ɛne: Adaa, Gila, Abaehɛde,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abaehyua, Neeyaman, Ahowa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gila, Hyɛfufan, yɛɛ Hulam.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Yihɛde amra mrenya ɛne: Neeyaman, Ahaegya, yɛɛ Gila mɔɔ le Hɛgelam, mɔɔ wole Ɛza nee Ahaehɛde la. Yihɛde amra mrenya ne mɔ le mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ bɛ ze mɔ awuke nu wɔ Giba. Nzinlii bɛdule bɛ ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔdɛnlanle Manahate. Ɛza ɔ ze Gila nee Ahaehɛde a lile bɛ ti manle bɛdule bɛhɔle a.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ɛlepeeyale wole mrenya nsa: Yibɛ, Maehyam, yɛɛ Hyimɛde. Hyimɛde a kyekyele azuamgbole Ono nee Lɔɔdo nee azua ngyikyi mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la a. Bɛngyaman abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Gate nee Ayegyalɔn la

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Bɛlaya nee Hyima le mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ menli mɔɔ hɔdɛnlanle Ayegyalɔn la anu. Bɛhɔhonle bɛvale suakpole Gate na bɛvoanle menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: Maekeɛle, Yehyepa, yɛɛ Dwoha, bɛ muala bɛle Bɛlaya abo zo amra. Bɛngyaman abo zo amra mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la

english_verse: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.
translation_verse: Hyemɛyae abo zo amra bie mɔ a le Gyeekem, Zekelae, Zabedae, Ɛleyinae, Zelɛtae, Yilayɛle, Adaya, Bɛlaya, yɛɛ Hyemelate.

english_verse: Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel.
translation_verse: Hyeehyake abo zo amra a le Yehyepan, Yibɛ, Yilayɛle, Abedɛn, Zekelae, Heeman, Hananaya, Yilam, Antotaegya, Yefɛdaya, yɛɛ Pɛnuwɛle.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: Gyɛloham abo zo amra a le Hyamehyɛlae, Hyihalaya, Atalaya, Gyeeyalɛhyaya, Yilaegya, yɛɛ Zekelae.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ a le mbusua mgbanyinli nee bɛ bo zo amra mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la. Bɛngyamanema mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gebɛyɔn nee Gyɛlusalɛm la

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Gebɛyɔn ɔ ze Gyɛyeyɛle a kyekyele sua bɔdenle Gebɛyɔn a. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ye Meeyaka,

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli a le Abedɛn. Ɔ mra mrenya mɔɔ ɛha la a le Zɔɔ, Kehye, Beeyale, Nɛɛ, Needabe,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gidɔ, Ahayo, Zikɛ,

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: yɛɛ Mekelo mɔɔ le Hyemɛya ɔ ze ne. Bɛ nee bɛ nwo amra dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛ nee bɛ mbusua mɔɔ ɛha la anye bɔ zolɛ. Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛɛ ara a le Kehye, yɛɛ Kehye ara a le Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo. Sɔɔlo wole mrenya nna: Dwɔnatan, Malekaehyua, Abenadabe, yɛɛ Ɛhyebeeyale.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan ara nrenya a le Mɛlebeeyale mɔɔ wole Maeka la.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Maeka wole mrenya nna: Paetɔn, Milɛke, Tɛlɛga, yɛɛ Ehaze.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ehaze wole Gyɛhowada, yɛɛ Gyɛhowada wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Alɛmɛte, Azemeevɛte, yɛɛ Zemelae. Zemelae wole Moza,

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Ezɛle wole mrenya nsia: Azelaekam, Bokɛlu, Yehyemeeyɛle, Hyialaya, Obadaya, yɛɛ Heenan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Ezɛle adiema nrenya Yihyɛke wole mrenya nsa: Yulam a le kpanyinli a; Gyiwɛhye doa ye, yɛɛ Yilefɛlɛte doa Gyiwɛhye.

english_verse: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛziale bɛrale bɛ azua zo bɛrayɛle bɛ gyima la a le Yizilayɛma bie mɔ, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Menli vi Dwuda, Bɛngyaman, Yifelaem, yɛɛ Manasɛ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ anu hɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ɛhye mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm: Gyɛdaya, Gyɛhɔyalebe, yɛɛ Gyeeken Azalaya, ɔ ze a le Helekaya ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Mɛhyɛlam, Zeedɔko, Mɛlayo, yɛɛ Ahaetɛbe Adaya, ɔ ze a le Gyɛloham, yɛɛ ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Pahyɔ nee Malekaegya Meeyasae ɔ ze a le Adeɛle, yɛɛ ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Gyazɛla, Mɛhyɛlam, Mɛhyelɛmete, yɛɛ Yemɛ.

english_verse: Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah. The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu amra ɛhye mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm: Hyɛmaya, ɔ ze a le Hasehyɛbe, ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Azelaekam, Hahyabaya mɔɔ vi Mɛlɛlae abusua nu, Bakebakaa, Hilɛhye, yɛɛ Geelale. Matanaya, ɔ ze a le Maeka, ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Zekelae yɛɛ Esafe Obadaya, ɔ ze a le Hyɛmaya, ye mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a le Geelale yɛɛ Gyɛdutɛn. Bɛlikaya, ɔ ze a le Esa, yɛɛ ɔ nlenya a le Ɛlekeena mɔɔ dɛnlanle Nɛtɔfa namunamu ne mɔ anu la. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma mɔɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm la

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma ɛhye mɔ nee bɛ nwo amra dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm: Hyalɛm, Akɛbe, Talemɔn, yɛɛ Ahaeman. Bɛ kpanyinli a le Hyalɛm.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: Ɔvi tete toonwo mɔɔ ɔradwule bɛ mekɛ zo la, bɛ nlenya mɔ dɛnlanle Belemgbunli Anuhɔlɛ ne foa ko mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la. Alumua ne ɛnee bɛmɛ a bɛsinza Livaema azokoɛleɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ a.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Hyalɛm, ɔ ze a le Kɔli, yɛɛ ɔ nlenya a le Yibayasafe. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛbɔ Kɔla abusua ne bie la a zinzale adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma nu la a. Zɔhane ala a bɛ mgbanyinli yɛle a. Bɛzinzale Ɛdɛnkɛma azokoɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Ɛlieza ara Fenɛhaze, Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye ɛdɛnla! Ɔnleanle bɛ nwo zo wɔ mekɛ bie anu.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Mɛhyɛlɛmaya ara Zɛkalaya a ɛnee le Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ sinzavolɛ a.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne lɛ anuhɔlɛ kpole ko wɔ ye tɛba nu ko biala: sɔlɔ, nyiakɛ, aduduleɛ, yɛɛ adɔleɛ.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Sinzavolɛma ɛhye mɔ anwo amra vi bɛ namunamu ne mɔ anu baboa maa bɛsinza toonwo kenle nsuu na bɛahakyi bɛ.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sinzavolɛ mgbanyinli nna ne le Livaema yɛɛ bɛmɛ a bɛdi ɛzonle wɔ gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu a. Eza bɛdi ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ nu la anwo ɛzonle.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Bɛ azua nu bikye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛkɛ ne ala, ɔboalekɛ ɔle bɛ gyima kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsinza sua mumua ne na nwonlomɔ biala bɛtukuedukue sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ. Livaema mɔɔ ɛha la

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Livaema mɔɔ ɛha la bie mɔ gyima a le ahyɛnze nee dwora ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la azo ɛnleanlɛ. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛbava bie la bɛtia, yɛɛ bɛfa bɛsia bɛba noko a eza bɛtia.

english_verse: But only the priests could mix the spices.
translation_verse: Noko ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛfonlɔfonlanlɛ ne le sɛlɛvolɛma ne gyima.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Livaenli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Matetaya, mɔɔ le Hyalɛm ara nrenya kpanyinli ne, mɔɔ vi Kɔla abusua nu la yɛ keeki ndɛbandɛba mɔɔ bɛfa esamo nee ɔlivi nwole bɛyɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Kohate abusua nu la a yɛ kpanwo ngunguma bulu nee nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala bɛfa bɛgua ɛkponle zo bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la a.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Livae abusua ne anu mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ a nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu edwɛndolɛ zo a. Mbusua mgbanyinli ɛhye mɔ dede Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ekpumgbunli ne bie mɔ anu; bɛnyɛ gyima gyɛne biala, ɔboalekɛ bɛyɛ gyima nɔɔzo nee ewiazo.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ bɛbobɔ bɛ aluma wɔ ɛke la le mbusua mgbanyinli wɔ Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu. Bɛ muala bɛdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm. Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo mgbanyinli nee ɔ bo zo amra (

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: mɔɔ wole Hyemɛya la. Bɛ nee bɛ nwo amra ne mɔ amuala dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛ nee bɛ mbusua mɔɔ ɛha la anye bɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Gebɛyɔn ɔ ze Gyiyayɛle a kyekyele suakpole Gebɛyɔn na ɔdɛnlanle ɛkɛ a. Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ye Meeyaka.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Ɔ ra nrenya kpanyinli a le Abedɛn, yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya mɔɔ ɛha la a le Zɔɔ, Kehye, Beeyale, Nɛɛ, Needabe,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gidɔ, Ahayo, Zɛkalaya, yɛɛ Mekelo,

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nɛɛ wole Kehye, yɛɛ Kehye wole Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo. Sɔɔlo wole mrenya nna: Dwɔnatan, Malekaehyua, Abenadabe, yɛɛ Ɛhyebeeyale.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Filisitiama nee Yizilayɛma honle wɔ Gelebowa Boka na bɛhunle Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ guale ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo wule, ɔboalekɛ yeanli nɔhalɛ yeammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yeanli Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ eza ɔbizale moalɛ ɔvile mɔwuamra lɔ.

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filisitiama voanle Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo nee ɔ mra ne mɔ dedee bɛ sa hanle ɔ mra ne mɔ anu nsa bɛhunle bɛ. Bɛmɛ a le Dwɔnatan, Abenadabe, yɛɛ Malekaehyua.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Konle ne akee telele Sɔɔlo asa azo, na ɛda hanle ye manle ɔbodale kpole bie.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɔɔlo zele ye sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ soa ye konle ninyɛne ne la kɛ, “Twe wɔ dadeɛ ne wɔ me maa menwu, anrɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la kɛragolo me nwo.” Na ye sonvolɛ ne anyɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔsulo kpole. Yemɔti Sɔɔlo vale ɔdaye ye dadeɛ ne wɔle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ye sonvolɛ ne nwunle kɛ Sɔɔlo ɛwu la, ɔdaye noko ɔvale ye dadeɛ ne ɔwɔle ɔ nwo na ɔwule.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Ɛnee kɛ Sɔɔlo zile wule la ɛne: ɔdaye, ɔ mra nsa ne nee ye sua nu amra amuala gulule nu wule.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.

translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Ɛza anwo ɛya na ɔmanle ɔwule ɛkɛ ne ala, ɔluakɛ ɔzɔle Ɛlɛka ne anu. Ɔdɔle amolɛ nu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔvi mekɛ ne, bɛvɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Pilɛze Ɛza toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. Na ɔyelale Devidi, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya ɛdea Ɛza.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi anva ɛlɛka ne angɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔgyakyile ye wɔ nrenya bie mɔɔ wɔ Gate mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Obɛde Yidɔm la sua nu.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔwoale ɛkɛ ne siane nsa na Ɛdɛnkɛma yilale Obɛde Yidɔm nee ye sua nu amra, nee debie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Devidi hɔtetale bɛ wɔ Beeyale Pɛleezem, na ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim. Ɔzele kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛlua me nwo zo ɛbu ɛva me kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema anwo zo kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛyi ɛbulu aze la.” Yemɔti bɛdonle ɛkɛ ne Beeyale Pɛleezem.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Devidi yɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle zele ye la, yemɔti ɔhunle Filisitia ɛlɔnema ɔvi Gebɛyɔn toonwo ɔhɔdwule Gizɛ.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Taya Belemgbunli Helam zoanle menli wɔ Devidi ɛkɛ ne. Menli mɔɔ rale la bie mɔ le menli mɔɔ fa awolɛ sisi azua a, yɛɛ bie mɔ le kapentama; bɛvale sida mbaka bɛrale kɛ bɛbazi sua bɛamaa Devidi.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ ne, Devidi gyale mraalɛ dɔɔnwo na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Devidi duma hɔle ɛleka biala na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle maanle kɔsɔɔti zulole ye.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Filisitiama dele kɛ bɛzie Devidi Yizilayɛ maanle ne kpokpoti belemgbunli la, bɛzoanle ɛlɔnema kɛ bɛhɔhye ye bɛrɛla. Yemɔti Devidi ɔdaye ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema na ɔ nee bɛ yiale.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Filisitiama rale Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne anu na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsɛkye Yizilayɛma aleɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Devidi bizale Nyamenle kɛ, “Mendoa Filisitiama me nee bɛ ɛhɔho ɔ?” Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔbɔ ye zo na mebamaa wɔali bɛ nwo zo konim.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filisitiama ne nriandi ahɔ la, bɛgyakyile bɛ mmonle ne mɔ aze na Devidi manle bɛyelale bɛ muala.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne angɔ bie, eza Filisitiama ziale rale Relɛfeeyem Bɔnza ne anu bieko na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛwua Yizilayɛma aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlua la.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: Eza Devidi bizale Nyamenle bieko saa ɔdoa bɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛhɔho a, na Nyamenle buale kɛ, “Ɛ nee bɛ bɛmmafa bɛ kɛnra bɛbɔ zolɛ; bu bɛ nzi fa mbaka ne mɔ anu na kendɛ ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Na saa ɛte ɛlɔnema ne agyakɛ abo kilikili ne wɔ mbaka ne mɔ ati zo a, finde ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlumua ɛ nyunlu yehɔzɛkye Filisitia ɛlɔnema ne dɛbadɛba.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: Devidi sisile ɔdaye ɔ ti anwo azua wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo. Eza ɔzieziele ɛleka mɔɔ ɔbava Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne yeazie la, na ɔzile ndanlɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbava Ɛlɛka ne bɛazie nu a.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: Akee Devidi boɔboale Yizilayɛma amuala anloa wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkava Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛarazie ye ɛleka ne mɔɔ yeziezie yemaa ye la.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Eza ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvale Aalɔn abo zo amra ne nee Livaema.

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: Dwowɛle vi Gɛhyɔn abusua nu rale, ɔlile menli ɛya ko abulasa ati.

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Hyɛmaya vi Yilaezeefan abusua nu rale, ɔlile menli ɛya nwiɔ ati.

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Yilayɛle vi Hibulɔn abusua nu rale, ɔlile menli abulatwɛ ati,

translation_verse: yɛɛ Amenadabe lile Ɛzeɛle abusua ne ati, ɔlɛ menli ɛya ko bulu nee nwiɔ.

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Akee Devidi vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma Zeedɔko nee Abayata, yɛɛ Livaema nsia, Yuleɛle, Asaya, Dwowɛle, Hyɛmaya, Yileɛle, yɛɛ Amenadabe.

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛkenle ɛnee bɛnle ɛkɛ ne na bɛazoa la ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne deanle yɛ kɛ yɛanzonle ye wɔ adenle kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdua nu yɛsonle ye la anu.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne ziele bɛ nwo nwuanzanwuanza, amaa bɛahɔva Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Livaema ne vale mbaka sosɔle ye na bɛzoale ye bɛ kɔme zo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma luale Mosisi anwo zo hanle la.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: Devidi zele Livae mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ kɛ bɛye Livaema ne bie mɔ bɛmaa bɛdo edwɛne, bɛva getaa nee sɔnwosɔnwo bɛbɔ agole anyelielɛ nu bɛdoa bɛ.

english_verse: The men chosen to play the cymbals were Heman the son of Joel, his relative Asaph the son of Berechiah, and Ethan the son of Kushaiah from the Merari clan. Some of their assistants played the smaller harps: they were Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah. Others played the larger harps: they were Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Azaziah, and two of the temple guards, Obed-Edom and Jeiel.

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Na bɛvale nlankɛ nsuu nee mboane nsuu bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ ɔboale Livaema ne mɔɔ zoale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne la.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti vale anyelielɛ, aweɛnebɔlɛ, mɛne, sɔnwosɔnwo nee getaa bɔle agole lile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anzi toonwo bɛradwule Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne dwule Devidi Suakpole ne azo la, Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo ara raalɛ Maekale nleanle ye nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu na ɔnwunle kɛ Belemgbunli Devidi anye ɛlie na ɔlɛwuluwulu ɔsi agole la, ɔvale ɛya kpole.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Devidi wiele azu ne bɔ la, ɔyilale menli ne kɔsɔɔti wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu,

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: na ɔhyɛle aleɛ ɔmanle bɛ muala, ɔmanle Yizilayɛ raalɛ ko nee nrenya ko biala kpanwo kunguma ko, nane ndondo ekyi, yɛɛ vanye ma welera.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Devidi yele Livaema bie mɔ kɛ bɛgyinla Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu na bɛli menli ne ati bɛmaa bɛdo moyɛlɛ nee ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛra ye ɛzonlenlɛ la.

translation_verse: yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nwiɔ, Bɛnaya nee Gyaheezeɛle bɔ aweɛne ndendenle wɔ Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anyunlu dahuu.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.

translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa ye, bɛha ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la!

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
