english_verse: Say to him, “Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛha kɛ, “O Nyamenle, yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ, die yɛ; boɔboa yɛ nloa na die yɛ fi maanle maanlema asa anu, amaa yɛayɛ wɔ mo yɛaye wɔ duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, ɛnɛ nee dahuu. Na menli ne amuala liele zolɛ “Amen,” na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ. Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Gebɛyɔn

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi akee yele Esafe nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ Livaema ne ziele ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛmɛ a ɛzonlenlɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne gyi nu la anu la wɔ bɛ sa nu a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima ne alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ sɛlɛvolɛma yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Gebɛyɔn wɔ bɛ sa nu a.

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: Nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛkponle ne azo bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mɛla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Yizilayɛma la anu la.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛboa la a le Himan nee Gyɛdutɛn, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛboɔboale bɛyele bɛ, bɛbobɔle bɛ aluma kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo la, ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Himan nee Gyɛdutɛn a aweɛne ndendenle ne nee sɔnwosɔnwo ne mɔ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛto ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne la wɔ bɛ sa nu a. Gyɛdutɛn abusua nu amra yɛɛ nlankɛ ɛzinzalɛ gyima ne wɔ bɛ sa nu a.

english_verse: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_verse: Akee awie biala hɔle sua nu, na Devidi ɔdaye ɔvale ye nyilalɛ ne ɔhɔle ye sua nu.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi akee ɛbu ye awuke na ɔde nu. Kenle ko ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nea, mame mede sua mɔɔ bɛva sida mbaka bɛzi la anu, na Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne, yemɔ ɔgyi ndanlɛ sua nu.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Noko ɛhye mɔ bɔbɔ le ɛ nye zo debie ekyi, O Nyamenle, eza wɔbɔ me ɛwɔkɛ mgbole wɔ me bo zo amra anwo wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bara la anu. Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, dahuu ɛyɛ me sonlakpole.

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Noko kenle ko ne nɔe ne Nyamenle zele Neetan kɛ,

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Kɔha kile me sonvolɛ Devidi kɛ, ‘Kɛ mese la ɛne: Tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛsi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua wɔamaa meadɛnla nuhua a.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ menyele Yizilayɛma menvile Yigyibiti toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la, metɛtɛnlanle ɛzonlenlɛ sua nu ɛlɛ. Ndanlɛ sua nu ala yɛɛ dahuu mede a, yɛɛ bɛtwili me bɛba a.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Me nee Yizilayɛma yɛ adendulɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, metɛbizale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ meye bɛ kɛ bɛli menli ne ati la bie kɛ duzu ati yɛɛ ɛtɛsisile sida mbaka ɛzonlenlɛ sua ɛtɛmanle me a.’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛhɔle la me nee wɔ a hɔle a. Memaa wɔli wɔ kpɔvolɛma amuala anwo zo konim. Akee mebamaa wɔanyia duma kpole kɛ menli mgbole mgbole mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Saa ɛwu a, mebamaa ɛ kunlu mralɛ mrenya ne mɔ ko ayɛ belemgbunli, na ye belemgbunlililɛ ne bayɛ kpole.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ mebamaa yeazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua yeamaa me a, na mebanlea noko kɛ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne gyi kpundii dahuu.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ ɔ ze na yeayɛ me ra. Menrɛgyakyi ɔ nzi ɛlilɛ kɛmɔ mengyakyile Sɔɔlo la. Menyele Sɔɔlo ɛkɛ ne, amaa wɔali belemgbunli.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Mebava ɛ ra zɔhane meayɛ me menli ne amuala kpanyinli na yeanlea me belemgbunli maanle ne azo dahuu. Ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ!’ ”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Neetan hanle edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle hilele ye nee mɔɔ ɔyele ɔhilele ye la amuala hilele Devidi. Devidi moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne (

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Duzu edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee menga a. Ɛze me kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ eza dahuu ɛbu wɔ sonvolɛ ye bie.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Devidi hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔdɛnlanle aze, na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, na mame a le nwane, yɛɛ me sua nu amra a le nwane mɔ, mɔɔ wɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛhye mɔ wɔmaa me a?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ a wɔhyehyɛ a yɛɛ ɔle wɔ ɛhulolɛ kɛ wɔyɛ ɛhye wɔmaa me, amaa meanwu kenlebie me kpoleyɛlɛ.

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, awie biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ. Yɛze dahuu kɛ ɛdawɔ ala yɛɛ ɛle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Maanle biala ɛnle ewiade ye anu mɔɔ nee Yizilayɛ sɛ a. Ɛyele bɛ ɛvile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu na ɛrayɛle bɛ wɔ menli. Ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane mɔɔ ɛyɛle ɛmanle bɛ la manle wɔ duma kpondenle ewiade ye. Ɛliele wɔ menli ne ɛvile Yigyibiti na ɛvoanle maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛha la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ wɔ menli ne ɛlɛba la.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ Yizilayɛma wɔ menli dahuu, na wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔyɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: Wɔ duma bayɛ kpole, na menli aha ye dahuu kɛ, ‘Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a le Yizilayɛ Nyamenle a.’ Na ɛbamaa me belemgbunlililɛ ne adɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle, kɛmɔ wɔye ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔhile medame, wɔ sonvolɛ, na wɔha wɔhile me kɛ ɛbamaa me bo zo amra ayɛ arelemgbunli la ati a menyia anwosesebɛ melɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye a.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛle Nyamenle a, yɛɛ wɔbɔ me ɛwɔkɛ kpole ɛhye a.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, yila me bo zo amra, amaa bɛazɔ ɛ nye dahuu. Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ a wɔyila bɛ a, na wɔ nyilalɛ ne nee bɛ badɛnla dahuu.”

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Devidi hɔtetale Belemgbunli Hadadizɛ mɔɔ sie Selea maanle ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zoba, mɔɔ zua Heemate maanzinli ne la, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Hadadizɛ ɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle araze Yufileti sɔlɔ ahɔva ɛkɛ ne azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Devidi honle liele ezukoa nvutuke enyinlike ne mɔ mɔɔ Hadadizɛ safohyenlema ne mɔ dedɛ la na ɔvale bɛ muala ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Seleama mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la manle ɛlɔnema hɔle kɛ bɛhɔboa Belemgbunli Hadadizɛ, na Devidi nee bɛ bɔle ye zo na ɔhunle nuhua apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ɛlɔnema ɔhɔguale bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo ɔmanle menli ne yɛle ye ngɛkɛlɛ na bɛduale adwule bɛmanle ye. Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Devidi lile konim wɔ konle biala anu.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔzoanle ɔ ra Dwolam kɛ ɔhɔbiza Belemgbunli Devidi ahye na ɔyɛ ye mo kɛ yeli Hadadizɛ anwo zo konim a. Toyi nee Hadadizɛ ɛho fane dɔɔnwo. Dwolam vale ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule nee kɔbele ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne rɛlɛle Devidi.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi dule ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ziele ahane kɛ bɛva bɛboka ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ ɔzale maanle maanle mɔɔ ɔlile bɛ nwo zo konim la ɔliele la anwo bɛva bɛzonle Nyamenle. Ɔliele ezukoa nvutuke ne nee dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔ ɔvile maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ ɛkɛ: Yidɔm, Mowabe, Amɔn, Filisitia, yɛɛ Amalɛke.

english_verse: Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed
translation_verse: Abehyae mɔɔ ɔ nli a le Zɛluaya la nee Yidɔmma honle wɔ Ngyenle Bɔnza ne anu na ɔhunle bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko bulu nee mɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler. Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war. A List of David's Officials (
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ye ɛlɔnema azokoɛleɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Yidɔm amuala, na ɔmanle menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la yɛle Belemgbunli Devidi ngɛkɛlɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Devidi lile konim wɔ ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
translation_verse: Abehyae adiema Dwowabe a le ɛlɔnema ne safohyenlema kpanyinli a. Ahaelɛde ara Gyɛhɔhyafate le kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ, ɔnea ɛlɔnema ne ninyɛne zo.

english_verse: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests. Shavsha was the secretary.
translation_verse: Ahaetɛbe ara Zeedɔko nee Abayata ara Ahemɛlɛke le sɛlɛvolɛma. Sɛlaya le kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ;

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard. David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada ara Bɛnaya a nea Devidi sinzavolɛma anwo zo a; yɛɛ Belemgbunli Devidi amra mrenya ne mɔ dedɛ gyima nu gyinlabelɛ mgbole.

english_verse: David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died. But when David's officials arrived at Ammon,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi zele kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ me nee Heenɛn yɛ agɔnwolɛ kpalɛ, kɛmɔ ɔ ze Neehahye nee me yɛle la.” Yemɔti Devidi zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔyɛ ye gyakɔ. Bɛdwule Amɔn na bɛhɔbizale Belemgbunli Heenɛn ahye la,

english_verse: Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians.
translation_verse: Dwowabe nwunle kɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema ne babu bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi. Yemɔti ɔvale Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la kɛ bɛzɔ Seleama konle ɛdeɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne hɔle bie la Amɔn Belemgbunli Neehahye hɔle ayile nu, na ɔ ra Heenɛn lile ebia ne.

english_verse: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Belemgbunli Hadadizɛ abo la nwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛbo bɛ la, bɛ nee Devidi yɛle anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛyɛle Devidi ngɛkɛlɛ. Seleama anli bɛ edwɛkɛ ambɔ Amɔnoma ɛboalɛ zo bieko ɛlɛ.

english_verse: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
translation_verse: Amɔn mgbanyima ne mɔ zele bɛ belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Ɛdwenle kɛ asɛɛ ɛ ze anwo ɛhulolɛ nee ye nidi ti yɛɛ Devidi ɛzoa menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛrayɛ wɔ gyakɔ a? Ɔnle zɔhane fee! Yezoa bɛ ɛke kɛ bɛranleɛnlea yɛ azɛlɛ ye amaa yearaho yeava.”

english_verse: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.
translation_verse: Heenɛn hyele menli mɔɔ Devidi zoanle bɛ la, ɔmanle bɛkpale bɛ kɛsa, bɛpepɛle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ azo bɛmanle ɔlile bɛ nze zo, na akee ɔgyakyile bɛ ɔmanle bɛhɔle.

english_verse: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
translation_verse: Nyiane mɔɔ hanle bɛ la ammaa bɛangola sua nu dwu. Mɔɔ Devidi dele mɔɔ ɛzi la, ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛdɛnla Gyɛleko kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ kɛsa ne mɔ kɛwie fi la na bɛara.

english_verse: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Devidi dele mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la anwo bie la, ɔmanle Dwowabe nee ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala hɔle.

english_verse: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
translation_verse: Amɔnoma vindele ragyinlanle bɛ suakpole Relaba anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa, yɛɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɛra baboa Amɔnoma la gyinlanle kandiba ne fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛha la ɔmanle ɔ diema Abehyae kɛ ɔli bɛ ti. Abehyae manle bɛgyinlanle kɛ bɛ nee Amɔnoma ko.

english_verse: Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.
translation_verse: Dwowabe zele kɛ, “Saa bɛnwu kɛ Seleama asa ɛlɛkomo me nwo zo a, bɛraboa me; saa medame menwu kɛ Amɔnoma asa ɛlɛkomo bɛ nwo zo a, mebaraboa bɛ.

english_verse: Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
translation_verse: Bɛzi bɛ ahonle na bɛgyinla kpundii. Bɛmaa yɛho kpalɛ yɛmaa yɛ menli ne nee yɛ Nyamenle ne azuamgbole ne mɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ ɛyɛ ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.
translation_verse: Dwowabe nee ye menli ne mɔ hɔtetale Seleama na Seleama ne nriandile.

english_verse: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Amɔnoma nwunle kɛ Seleama ɛgua ndwɛlɛ aze la, bɛnriandile Abehyae na bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ suakpole ne azo. Na Dwowabe nee ye ɛlɔnema ziale hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
translation_verse: Seleama nwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛbo bɛ, yemɔti bɛhɔle bɛ maanzinli ne mɔ anu bɛhɔvale ɛlɔnema bɛrale. Ɛlɔnema ɛhye mɔ vi Azule Yufileti ne aduduleɛ afoa nu, yɛɛ bɛ kpanyinli a le safohyenle Hyobake. Hyobake a le safohyenlema kpanyinli mɔɔ nea Zoba Belemgbunli Hadadizɛ ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo a.

translation_verse: Noko Belemgbunli Devidi amkponle. Ɔmanle Dwowabe lile mɔɔ ɔhanle la azo. Dwowabe hɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala, ɔdianle menli ne na ɔziale ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm.

translation_verse: Na Devidi zɛlɛle zɛhae, “O Nyamenle, medame a medi fɔlɛ a. Medame a menganle kɛ bɛhɔdia menli ne a. Na menli ɛhye mɔ, bɛtɛyɛle ɛhwee. Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, tea me nee egya sua nu amra, na gyakyi wɔ menli ne mɔ.”

translation_verse: ‘Ɛvolɛ nsa ɛhɔne, anzɛɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ foa wɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema agua ɛbɔ nu ahu bɛ bie mɔ dedee siane nsa, anzɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ kenle nsa, mɔɔ ye soanvolɛ fa munzule, nyane, abodelɛ, nee ewule arado maanle ye anu ɛleka biala la, nuhua boni yɛɛ ɛkulo a?’ Nea nuhua fa ko maa mengɔnga mengile Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

english_verse: David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
translation_verse: Devidi zele Gaade kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ ɛdo me, mennwu mɔɔ meka a. Noko mmamaa sonla sa ka me. Maa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔdea me, ɔluakɛ yemɔ, ye anwunvɔnezelɛ le kpole.”

translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ewule nzane rale Yizilayɛ, na menli apenle ngoko abulasuu wule.

translation_verse: Mɔɔ Alɔna nwunle kɛ Devidi ɛlɛba ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, ɔvindele ɔrabutule ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔvale ɔ nye ɔbutule aze.

translation_verse: Alɔna zele kɛ, “Nana, fa yɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la. Mmatua ye kakɛ. Fa ɛnlankɛ ɛhye mɔ yela bɛ bɔ azu wɔ azukponle ne azo, na fa ndaboa mɔɔ yɛfa yɛwozo hwiiti ne la yɛ ɛyɛne. Eza yɛlɛ hwiiti wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛkola ɛfa ɛyɛ ma azubɔdeɛ a. Mefa bɛ muala memaa wɔ.”

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛhyɔn wole mrenya nwiɔ: Leedan, yɛɛ Hyemɛyae.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Leedan wole mrenya nsa: Gyɛhayɛle, Zitam, yɛɛ Dwowɛle.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ a le Leedan abusua ekpulike ne mgbanyinli a.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Hyemɛyae wole mrenya nna: Gyeehate a le kpanyinli a, Zaena li ɔ nzi, Gyiyɛhye doa ye, yɛɛ Bɛlaya a le kakula a. Gyiyɛhye nee Bɛlaya annyia bɛ bo zo amra dɔɔnwo, yemɔti bɛbɔle bɛ nu bɛdianle bɛ kɛ abusua ko.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate wole mrenya nna: Amelam, Yezehaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amelam a wole Aalɔn nee Mosisi a. (Bɛdule Aalɔn nee ɔ bo zo amra bɛziele ahane kɛ bɛmɛ ala a bɛnlea ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo te na bɛfa bɛsonle Nyamenle la azo dahuu a, eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la, na bɛsɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nyilalɛ bɛmaa menli ne dahuu a.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gɛhyɔn amra ne mɔ kpanyinli a le Hyɛbuwɛle.

english_verse: Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children.
translation_verse: Ɛleyizɛ wole ralɛ nrenya kokye. Yemɔ a le Rilihabaya. Noko Rilihabaya nyianle ɔ bo zo amra dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.
translation_verse: Yezehaa a le Kohate ara nrenya mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ a. Ɔwole ralɛ nrenya ko. Yemɔ a le Hyɛlomete mɔɔ gyi abusua ne ati la.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Kohate ara nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, Hibulɔn, wole mrenya nna. Bɛmɛ a le Gyɛlaya, Amalaya, Gyɛheezeɛle, yɛɛ Gyɛkamɛyam.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Mɛlɛlae wole mrenya nwiɔ, bɛmɛ a le Malae, yɛɛ Muhyae. Malae ɔdaye ɔwole mrenya nwiɔ: Ɛlieza yɛɛ Kehye.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Mɛlɛlae ara nrenya ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, Muhyae, wole mrenya nsa. Bɛmɛ a le Malae, Yida, yɛɛ Gyɛlɛmo.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Devidi zele bɛ kɛ, “Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne ɛmaa ye menli ne anzo nu ɛdwo bɛ, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbadɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke dahuu.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔngyia kɛ eza Livaema ne kɛzoa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ la kɛkpɔsa.”

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: Bɛ gyima a le kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboa Aalɔn abo zo amra ne mɔɔ bɛmɛ a bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma la wɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ gyima ne anu na bɛnea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ nee alie ne mɔ azo boɛ, bɛnea kɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ wɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu la, awie ɛnrɛgua nwolɛ evinli.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la azo a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea esamo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu, kpanwo ne mɔɔ mgbɔvonle ɛnle nu, esamo ne mɔɔ bɛva ɔlivi nwole bɛfete, yɛɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdondo la azo a. Eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsuzu na bɛtila Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ anloa.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: nee mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛlɛyela nane bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ, nee ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha la ɛlilɛ nu la. Bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ kile Livaema dodo mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ gyima wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu mekɛ biala a.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne wɔ bɛ sa nu a, na bɛboa bɛ mediema Aalɔn abo zo amra ne mɔ wɔ bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu a.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛle ekpunli ɛhye mɔ ko biala duma nee nuhua menli ne aluma bɛwulale buluku nu na bɛhilele mekɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔkɔ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔkɔyɛ ye ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya Aalɔn luale Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɛla zo hyehyɛle la. Livaema ne mɔ

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Livae abo zo amra mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ bie mɔ ɛne: Amelam nee ɔ ra Hyɛbuwɛle abo zo amra kpanyinli a le Gyɛdaya.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Rilihabaya abo zo amra kpanyinli a le Yehyaya.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Yezaa nee ɔ ra Hyɛlomete abo zo amra kpanyinli a le Gyeehate.

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hibulɔn abo zo amra: Gyɛlaya a lumua a, Amalaya doa ye, Gyɛheezeɛle li ɔ nzi, yɛɛ Gyɛkamɛyam a li amozi a.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Ɛzeɛle nee ɔ ra Maeka abo zo amra kpanyinli a le Hyeemɛ.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: Mɛlɛlae abo zo mra: Malae, Muhyae, yɛɛ Gyeeyazaya.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Gyeeyazaya wole mrenya nsa: Hyoham, Zakɛ, yɛɛ Yebelae.

english_verse: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.
translation_verse: Malae wole mrenya nwiɔ: Ɛlieza nee Kehye. Ɛlieza anwo nrenya, na Kehye wole nrenya ko. Yemɔ a le Gyɛlamii.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Muhyae wole mrenya nsa: Malae, Yidɛ, yɛɛ Gyɛlemo. Ɛhye mɔ amuala le Livae mbusua mgbanyinli.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Abusua kpanyinli ne nee ɔ mediema ngakula ne mɔ ko a guale nzeleba hyɛle gyima ne a, kɛmɔ bɛ busuanli Aalɔn abo zo amra sɛlɛvolɛma ne yɛle la. Belemgbunli Devidi, Sɛlɛvolɛ Zeedɔko, Ahemɛlɛke, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua mgbanyinli nee Livae mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ a nleanle manle bɛguale nzeleba ne bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ ne a.

english_verse: There were
translation_verse: . Ahyalila

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: Yilam, Gyihoheenan, yɛɛ Ɛleɛhoyinae.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Hyɛmaya mɔɔ le Obɛde Yidɔm ara kpanyinli ne wole mrenya nsia: Ɔtenae, Relɛfeeyɛle, Obɛde, Ɛlezeebade, Ɛlaehu, yɛɛ Sɛmakaya. Bɛ nwo hyia wɔ bɛ abusua ne anu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ. Amozi ɛdeɛ nwiɔ ne bɔbɔ mɔdenlebɔ ne bo zolɛ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Helekaya, Tɛbalaya, yɛɛ Zɛkalaya. Ɛka bɛ muala ɛbɔ nu a ɛnee menli bulu nee nsa a vi Hosa sua nu mɔɔ yɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzinzalɛ gyima ne bie a.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sinzavolɛma ne anu ekpunli ekpunli, kɛmɔ bɛ mbusua ekpulike ne mɔ de la, na bɛhyɛle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyima ne bɛmanle bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛhyɛle bɛmanle Livaema la.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Abusua ekpulike ko biala anu amra, bɛguale bɛ ti nzeleba, bɛannea kɛ bɛzonle anzɛɛ bɛanzo, na bɛhilele menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sinza anlenkɛ kpole ko biala la.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Nzeleba ɛgualɛ ne anu, Hyɛlimaya a aduduleɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne bɔle ye a, yɛɛ ɔ ra Zɛkalaya a vale sɔlɔ anlenkɛ ne a. Zɛkalaya le sonla mɔɔ tu folɛ kpalɛ a.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Obɛde Yidɔm a asa hanle nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne a, yɛɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ sinza ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa aleɛ nee ninyɛne bɛsie nu la.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Hyɛpem nee Hosa a sinza adɔleɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne nee Hyalɛkɛte anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ adenle zo la a. Bɛhyehyɛle ɛzinzalɛ gyima ne mɔɔ saa ko kpɔne a ɛnee ko ɛrali ɔ gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Sinzavolɛma nsia a sinza aduduleɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne alehyenlɛ biala a, nna wɔ sɔlɔ, yɛɛ nna wɔ nyiakɛ. Ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa ninyɛne bɛsiezie nu la, menli nna a alehyenlɛ biala sinza a, ekpumgbunli ko biala ɛdeɛ nwiɔ.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɔne adɔleɛ kpɔda ne mɔ anwo la, sinzavolɛma nna a wɔ adenle nu a, yɛɛ kpɔda ne mɔ mumua ne ɛdeɛ nwiɔ.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Ɛzinzalɛ gyima ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle Kɔla nee Mɛlɛlae mbusua ne mɔ la ɛne. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyima mɔɔ hale la

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Livaema bie mɔ noko lile gyima ngakyile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ahaegya a nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya ne nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle la azo a.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Leedan le Gɛhyɔn amra mrenya ne mɔ ko, ɔ bo zo amra bɔle ɛdane dɔɔnwo, ɔ ra Gyihayɛle abusua ne boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Leedan amra mrenya nwiɔ ne mɔɔ hale la a nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya nee ekpumgbunli mɔɔ bɛfa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛsiezie nu la azo a. Bɛmɛ a le Zitam nee Dwowɛle.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Bɛmanle Amelam, Yehaa, Hibulɔn, yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle abo zo amra noko gyima.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Hyɛbuwɛle mɔɔ vi Mosisi ara Gɛhyɔn abusua nu la a le kpanyinli mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya wɔ ɔ sa nu a.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Hyɛlomete nee ye awuke nu amra a nea ninyɛne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi, mbusua mgbanyinli, safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema apenle nee ɛya nwo zo, yɛɛ Safohyenlema Mgbanyinli ɛdu ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa Nyamenle la a.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Bɛdule ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdule bɛ ahu wɔ ɛlɔne nu la bie bɛziele ahane kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu gyima.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Hyɛlomete nee ye awuke nu amra a debie biala mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ahane kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la wɔ bɛ sa nu a. Ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ, Samoɛle, Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo, Nɛɛ ara Abenɛɛ, yɛɛ Zɛluaya ara Dwowabe vale manle Nyamenle la boka nwolɛ. Livaema mɔɔ ɛha la gyima

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Wɔ Yezehaa abo zo amra ne anu, Kɛnanaya nee ɔ mra yɛɛ bɛvale maanlebulɛ ne bɛwulale bɛ sa nu a. Bɛme a bɛle kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛma nee ndɛnebuavolɛma mɔɔ siezie Yizilayɛma avinli a.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Dwowabe mɔɔ ɔ nli a le Zɛluaya la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia menli ne, noko yeandwu ɛleka bie. Nyamenle deanle Yizilayɛma wɔ menli ɛdianlɛ ɛhye anwo, yemɔti menli dodo mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la bɛangɛlɛ ye wɔ Belemgbunli Devidi mbuluku ne mɔ anu. Belemgbunli ninyɛne ne anwo amaamuobuvolɛma

english_verse: Here is a list of the leaders of each tribe in Israel: Eliezer son of Zichri was over Reuben; Shephatiah son of Maacah was over Simeon; Hashabiah son of Kemuel was over the Levites, and Zadok the priest was over the descendants of Aaron; Elihu the brother of David was over Judah; Omri son of Michael was over Issachar; Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was over Zebulun; Jerimoth son of Azriel was over Naphtali; Hoshea son of Azaziah was over Ephraim; Joel son of Pedaiah was over West Manasseh; Iddo son of Zechariah was over East Manasseh; Jaasiel son of Abner was over Benjamin; Azarel son of Jeroham was over Dan.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛnee bu Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anwo amaamuo la ɛne: Abusua Ekpunli Amaamuobuvolɛ Wulubɛn Zekelae ara Ɛleyizɛ Semɛyɔn Meeyaka ara Hyɛfataya Livae Kɛmuwɛle ara Hahyabaya Aalɔn Zeedɔko Dwuda Belemgbunli Devidi adiema Ɛlaehu Yesakaa Maekeɛle ara Ɔmelae Zɛbulɛn Obadaya ara Yehyemaya Nafetalae Azelayɛle ara Gyɛlɛmo Yifelaem Azazaya ara Hohyia Manasɛ Adɔleɛ Pɛdaya ara Dwowɛle Manasɛ Aduduleɛ Zɛkalaya ara Yedo Bɛngyaman Abenɛɛ ara Gyeeyaseɛle Dan Gyɛloham ara Azalii

english_verse: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi andia menli mɔɔ ɛtɛdile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ la, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔmaa Yizilayɛma azo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Dwɔnatan, Belemgbunli Devidi awuvuanyi ne le sonla mɔɔ tu folɛ kpalɛ a, yɛɛ ɔle abɔlɔba. Yemɔ nee Gyɛhayɛle a hilele belemgbunli amra mrenya ne mɔ nwoma a.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Ahetofɛle tu belemgbunli ne folɛ, yɛɛ Aakaenli Huhyae le belemgbunli ne agɔnwo na eza ɔtu ye folɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Ahetofɛle wule la, Abayata nee Bɛnaya ara Gyɛhɔyada yɛle belemgbunli ne folɛdulɛma. Dwowabe a le belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne safohyenlema kpanyinli a.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi akee yɛle kɛ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima kɔsɔɔti ɛrayia Gyɛlusalɛm. Yemɔti mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mgbanyinli, mgbanyima mɔɔ maanle ne anu gyima nwo amaamuo wɔ bɛ sa nu, mbusua mgbanyinli, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnea belemgbunli nee ɔ mra ne mɔ nyɛmoa nee gya zo, suakunlu ɛkɛ ne mgbanyima kɔsɔɔti, safohyenle mgbanyinli mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema apenle nee ɛlɔnema ɛya nwo zo, yɛɛ maanle ne anu adile adile rayiale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Devidi dwazole gyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me mediema nee me ɛlɔnema, bɛdie me. Menyɛle me adwenle kɛ mesi sua meamaa bɛava Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne, mɔɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne agyakɛ abo ebia la bɛazie nuhua mɔɔ bɛndu ɔ bo bieko ɛlɛ a. Meboɔboa me nwo kɛ mesi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Noko yedua me kɛ memmasi, ɔboalekɛ mele ɛlɔnenli mɔɔ meha mogya dɔɔnwo megua a.

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, nleanle nu yele me nee me bo zo amra kɛ yɛli belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo dahuu. Ɔnleanle nu ɔyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne kɛ bɛli Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati, yɛɛ ɔnleanle nu ɔyele egya abusua ekpulike ne ɔvile Dwudama amuala avinli. Akee ɔnleanle abusua ekpulike zɔhane anu la, ɔyele me, ɔ nye liele kɛ ɔkɛye me ɔkɛvi egya awuke nu ɔkɛzie me Yizilayɛma belemgbunli.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle me mralɛ mrenya dɔɔnwo, na ɔnleanle nu ɔyele Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ yemɔ a ɔzie Yizilayɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye belemgbunli maanle ne a.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Ɛ ra Sɔlɔmɔn ala yɛɛ bazi me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a. Menlea nu meye ye kɛ ɔle me ra, na mebayɛ ɔ ze.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Saa ɔdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo boɛ kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔdi zolɛ la a, mebamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ahɔ zolɛ dahuu.’

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, me maanlema, meka ye wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ye anyunlu ɛke, nee bɛdabɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma menli Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ bɛrayia ɛke la bɛ nyunlu kɛ, debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛhyehyɛ ɛmaa yɛ la, bɛdie, na bɛyɛ, amaa bɛahɔ zo bɛadɛnla azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ɛhye azo na menli mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la noko asa aha ye ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Me ra, mese wɔ kɛ, die ɛ ze Nyamenle ne to nu na fa wɔ ahonle muala nee adwenle mɔɔ di munli la sonle ye. Ɔze yɛ adwenle nee mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la. Saa ɛkɔ ye ɛkɛ ne a, ɔbalie wɔ. Na saa ɛkakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi ye a, ɔbakpo wɔ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu ye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye wɔ kɛ ɛzi ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne. Si, fa wɔ ahonle nee wɔ anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti si.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Devidi vale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo ngɛlata mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ, mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛsi bɛazi sua ne la wɔ zolɛ la manle Sɔlɔmɔn. Wɔ ngɛlata ne mɔ azo, bɛhile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne, nwolɛ azua, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsie ninyɛne, anwuma ekpumgbunli ne mɔ, suakunlu ne mɔ, yɛɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne mɔɔ ɛkɛ ne a bɛbava sonla mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la ɛtane bɛahyɛ ye la.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Eza ɔvale debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ye adwenle nu kɛ ɔbayɛ la anwo ngɛlata ɔmanle Sɔlɔmɔn. Ngɛlata ne mɔ kile kɛ bɛbazi bɛazi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbali edwɛkɛ baguasee, nee ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ye ɛyia, ye ekpumgbunli mɔɔ bɛbava ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛazie nu la.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Devidi eza vale kɛ yezi yehyehyɛ ye kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema bazi ayɛ gyima, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo gyimayɛlɛ, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ boɛ ɛnleanlɛ nwo ngɛlata manle Sɔlɔmɔn.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: Ɔhilele dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke dodo mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ kyɛnze ko biala,

english_verse: including the lampstands and lamps,
translation_verse: kɛnlaneɛ ko biala, kɛnlaneɛ baka,

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: dwɛtɛ fufule ɛkponle ne mɔ, nee ezukoa nvutuke ɛkponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbava kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la bɛagua zolɛ la.

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: nee ezukoa nvutuke tagyee dodo mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛbayela ɛyɛlɛ zo nee ehwili ne mɔɔ bazoa abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ na bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ anu bɛheda Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne azo la.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi zele kɛ, “Bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ ngɛlata zo, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne zele me kɛ menyɛ la.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi zele ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Yɛ ɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na si wɔ ahonle. Bɔ gyima ne abo, mmamaa debie biala si wɔ adenle. Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ mesonle ye la nee wɔ balua. Ɔnrɛgyakyi ɛ nzi ɛlilɛ, ɔ nee wɔ balua toonwo yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛwie gyima biala mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la yɛ la.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Bɛhile sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la. Dwinvolɛma mɔɔ ze gyima la ɛvua kɛ bɛkɛboa wɔ, yɛɛ menli ne kɔsɔɔti nee bɛ mgbanyima wɔ ɛ sa nu.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: Mebɔ mɔdenle biala mɔɔ menwɔhola la meboɔboa ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la anloa: ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, mbulalɛ, mbaka, awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ nee mgbɔba ngakyile, awolɛ memeamemea nee mabolo awolɛ.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: nee adwinli mɔɔ dwinvolɛma ne bali la amuala anwo. Nwane yɛɛ ɔdaye noko ɛnɛ kenle ye ɔkɛyeye ye ahonle nu na ɔkɛboa, ɔkɛva ɔ nwo ɔkɛbɔ azu ɔkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Na mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ, awuke nu mgbanyinli, safohyenlema, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbu belemgbunli sua nu amaamuo ne la vale anyelielɛ

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ mgbɔba la, bɛvale bɛmanle bɛguale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya ne anu. Gyɛhayɛle mɔɔ bɔ Gɛhyɔn, mɔɔ vi Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu la abusua ne bie la a nea gya ɛhye azo a.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Menli ne yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale ninyɛne ne manle Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛ nye liele kɛ bɛhola bɛyeye ninyɛne dɔɔnwo zɛhae a. Belemgbunli Devidi ɔdaye noko ɔ nye liele kpole kpalɛ. Devidi ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi yele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu hanle kɛ, “Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha wɔ dahuu!

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Ɛle kpole, ɛlɛ tumi, ɛle nwuanzanwuanza, ɛle katakyie, ɛle belemgbunli. Debie biala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la le wɔ ɛdeɛ, na ɛdi bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Anwonyia nee ezukoa kɔsɔɔti vi wɔ ɛkɛ; ɛfa wɔ anwosesebɛ nee tumi ɛsie debie biala. Ɛkola ɛmaa awie nyia anwosesebɛ na ɔyɛ kpole.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyamenle, yɛyɛ wɔ mo, yɛye wɔ duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: “Noko me nee me menli ye, yɛngola yɛmmaa wɔ ɛhwee, ɔboalekɛ debie biala mɔɔ yɛlɛ la le ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ vi wɔ ɛkɛ ne a. Ɛdawɔ wɔ ɛdeɛ yɛɛ yɛzia yɛva yɛrɛlɛ wɔ a.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ yɛle nyɛvolɛ wɔ ɛbɛla ɛsɛlɛ ye azo na yɛle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛra nlɔnu wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a, kɛmɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la. Yɛ mekɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo le kɛ ɛlawolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛse, ɔngyɛ ɛnee yepɛ nuhua.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, yɛva anwoneɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti yɛra kɛ yɛfa yɛazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua yeade wɔ duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo, noko ninyɛne ne amuala le wɔ ɛdeɛ, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛvale ɛmanle a.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ ɛsɔ awie biala ɛnea na ɛ nye die mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la anwo. Meyeye me ahonle nu, nɔhalɛ nu yɛɛ meva ɛhye mɔ amuala memaa wɔ a, yɛɛ menwu kɛ me menli ye ɛzi ɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ nee anyelielɛ ɛva ninyɛne ɛrabɔ azu ɛmaa wɔ a.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya mɔ Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, maa tunwomaa sunsum ye mɔɔ menli ye ɛnyia ye la ɛdɛnla bɛ nu dahuu na ɔnyi, na maa bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa wɔ.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Maa me ra Sɔlɔmɔn ahonle kpalɛ maa ɔli debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛze ye la azo na ɔzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ yemɔti meboɔboa ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anloa la.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Akee Devidi zele ɛlɔne mɔɔ ɛyia la kɛ, “Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.” Na menli ne amuala yeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne. Bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛvale enililɛ bɛmanle belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati kenle ko ne bɛ nye liele na bɛlile, bɛnlonle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu. Eza bɛzoale Sɔlɔmɔn bieko kɛ ɔle belemgbunli. Bɛkpokpale ye nwole bɛdule ye bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔle bɛ belemgbunli na bɛyɛle Zeedɔko bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɔlɔmɔn lile ɔ ze Devidi agya wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yehyehyɛ la azo. Ɔyɛle belemgbunli kpole, na Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti yɛle tieyɛ manle ye.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Safohyenlema nee ɛlɔnema ne amuala nee Devidi amra mrenya mɔɔ hale la amuala vuale kɛ bɛkɛli nɔhalɛ bɛkɛmaa Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ ɔle belemgbunli.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Sɔlɔmɔn anwo yɛle maanlema ne kɔsɔɔti ɛzulolɛ, na ɔmanle ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu ɔdɛlale Yizilayɛ belemgbunli biala. Devidi belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Gyɛsi ara Devidi ziele Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle nwosonwoso na yeawu, ɔnyianle ɔ nwo yɛɛ bɛlile ye eni. Ɔ ra Sɔlɔmɔn a lile ye agya a.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi anwo edwɛkɛ nee ye nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛma Samoɛle, Neetan, yɛɛ Gaade Mbuluku nsa ne anu.

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: Mbuluku ne mɔ kile kɛ ɔzile ɔlile ye belemgbunli ne, tumi mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye, nee debie biala mɔɔ zile ɔ nwo zo, nee mɔɔ zile Yizilayɛma nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anwo zo la.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn manle ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bule kɛ awolɛ la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na ɔmanle sida mbaka bule kɛ Hyifɛla sikamɔ mbaka la.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn hunle nyɛmoa apenle, yelale bɛ bɔle azu wɔ kɔbele azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la azo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Nyamenle yele ɔ nwo hilele Sɔlɔmɔn na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Biza debie mɔɔ menyɛ memaa wɔ la.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn buale Nyamenle kɛ, “Wɔhile ɛhulolɛ kpole mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la wɔ me ze Devidi anwo na wɔva me wɔzie belemgbunli wɔzie egya agyakɛ anu.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, maa wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbɔle egya Devidi la ɛyɛ zɔhane, ɔluakɛ wɔva me wɔzie menli mɔɔ zonle kɛ ɛnwea la belemgbunli.

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Nyamenle buale Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛhye a wɔ wɔ ahonle nu, na wɔambiza agyadeɛ, anwonyia, enililɛ, anzɛɛ wɔanze me kɛ mengu menli mɔɔ kpɔ wɔ, na wɔambiza ngoane tendenle bɔbɔ, na wɔbiza kɛ ɛkpondɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo wɔava wɔazie me menli ne mɔɔ ɛdi bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli la,

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Yemɔti Sɔlɔmɔn vile Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne anyunlu na ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm. Na akee ɔziele Yizilayɛ maanle ne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Sua ne mɔɔ mesi la bayɛ kpole kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne le kpole tɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze, mɔɔ ɛmaa Belemgbunli Devidi ɛwo ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ, mɔɔ lɛ adwenle nee ndelebɛbo, mɔɔ bazi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeabu ye belemgbunli awuke a.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nea, mesi sua meamaa bɛazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne wɔ nu. Mebadu sua ne meazie ɛkɛ meamaa ye na bɛayela ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɔ evuanlɛ la bɛamaa ye, na yɛava yɛ kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza azubɔdeɛ ne yeamaa ye dahuu. Yɛbayela nane yeabɔ azu wɔ ɛkɛ ne nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ, Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, nee Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ, yɛɛ ɛvoyia ngakyile mɔɔ ɛha la ɛlilɛ nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a ɛhyehyɛ na yeyila zolɛ yemaa Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane dahuu a.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: tie bɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, na fa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ. Ɛ ngomekye yɛɛ ɛze sonla ahonle nu a, yɛ maa awie biala kɛmɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ se la,

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnle Yizilayɛnli la te wɔ nganeɛ wɔ ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ wɔyɛ, wɔ tumi nee wɔ ɛlolɛ, na ɔvi ye maanle nu moa moa ɔba kɛ ɔbazonle wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu a,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just as your own people Israel do, and they will know that I have built this temple in your honor.
translation_verse: tie ye wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la na yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la maa ye. english_verse: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: “Saa wɔ menli ne kɔ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kpɔvolɛma kaho na adenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva zo ɛkɛzoa bɛ la, saa bɛkakyi bɛ nye wɔ suakpole ɛhye mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔkpa nu wɔdu wɔmaa ɛ nwo la azo nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ mezi memaa wɔ la anwo na bɛsɛlɛ a,

english_verse: Later, they may feel sorry for what they did and ask your forgiveness. Answer them when they pray toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, here in this land you gave their ancestors. translation_verse: tie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee bɛ modolɛ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, gyinla bɛ nzi na fa wɔ menli ne mɔɔ ɛvo wɔ la ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, hear us when we pray in this temple.
translation_verse: “O me Nyamenle, maa ɛ nye ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo na tie yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛyɛ wɔ ɛke la.

english_verse: Come to your new home, where we have already placed the sacred chest, which is the symbol of your strength. I pray that when the priests announce your power to save people, those who are faithful to you will celebrate what you've done for them.
translation_verse: Dwazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, na ɛ nee wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ kile wɔ tumi kpole ne la ɛwolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ ɛkɛ ne na bɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Yila wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu na maa wɔ menli anye ɛlie kɛ ɛle kpalɛ ɛmaa bɛ a.

english_verse: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.

translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nwunle senle ne kɛ ɔvi anwuma yerayela azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la, bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze na bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛyɛle ye mo kɛ, “Ɔle kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.”

translation_verse: Na bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la, na bɛdoale nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bie mɔ bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle bɛ na bɛzonlenle bɛ; yemɔti yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa munzule ɛhye ɛdo bɛ a.’ ”

english_verse: Everybody stood up during the ceremony. The priests were in their assigned places, blowing their trumpets. And the Levites faced them, playing the musical instruments that David had made for them to use when they praised the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne gyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyinla la, Livaema ne noko gyinlanle bɛ bo zo ne na bɛvale edwɛnedolɛ nwo ninyɛne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi vale manle bɛ la bɛdole edwɛne bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.” Sɛlɛvolɛma ne bɔle aweɛne ndendenle nu na menli ne amuala dwazole gyinlanle.

english_verse: If my own people will humbly pray and turn back to me and stop sinning, then I will answer them from heaven. I will forgive them and make their land fertile once again.

translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛkala, meva Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye na medu ye mezie ɛkɛ memaa me nwo mekɛ biala kɛ nuhua yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle me a. Me nye nee me ahonle bawoa ɛkɛ ne mekɛ biala.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. Instead, they were his soldiers, officers, army commanders, and cavalry troops. translation_verse: Noko Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, Sɔlɔmɔn ammaa bɛanyɛ mialera nu gyima kɛ ahanra. Ɔyɛle bɛ ye ɛlɔnema, ye mgbanyima nee safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ye konle ehwili nee mgbɔnwɔ ɛhanlɛ ɛlɔnema anwo zo a.

translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn eza kyekyele azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Helam vale manle ye la fofolɛ, na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma bie mɔ hɔdɛnlanle zolɛ.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn vale Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee yegya ye la rale Devidi suakpole zo wɔ sua ne mɔɔ yezi yemaa ye la anu. english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn bɔle ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne mɔɔ yezi ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la azo manle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu ne kɛmɔ Mosisi Mɛla ne kile kɛ bɛyɛ ye kenle ko biala la: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne nee ɛvoyia nsa ne, Angye Ɛvoyia ne, Bɛyɔba Ɛvoyia ne, yɛɛ Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne.

translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔ ze Devidi hyehyɛle la, Sɔlɔmɔn hyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma gyima ne manle bɛ. english_verse: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.

translation_verse: Na Hyiba belemgbunli raalɛ ne hanle hilele Sɔlɔmɔn kɛ, “Ayi, bɛle nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane ɛ nwo nee wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ne anwo, mɔɔ mendele wɔ me maanle nu lɔ la le nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.

english_verse: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.
