english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the records of Nathan the prophet, Ahijah the prophet from Shiloh, and Iddo the prophet who wrote about Jeroboam son of Nebat.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne bieko mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle nee ye nyɛleɛ, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne, Ahaegya mɔɔ vi Hyaelo la Nyamenle Nrɛlaleɛ Buluku ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle Sonla Yedo Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ Buluku ne mɔ anu. Yedo buluku ne eza ka Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ lile ebia wɔ Yizilayɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.
translation_verse: Awenade ananze bulu nee nwiɔ noko gyigyi kpolike ne mɔ azo, kpolike ko biala ati nee ɔ ti lɛ awenade nwiɔ. Belemgbunli ebia mɔɔ le zɛhae la bie ɛnle belemgbunli maanle biala anu.

english_verse: Solomon's cups and dishes in Forest Hall were made of pure gold, because silver was almost worthless in those days.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn dwora mɔɔ ɔno nu la amuala le ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ dwora mɔɔ wɔ sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Lɛbanɔn Kpɔkɛmile la anu la le ezukoa nvutuke tagyee. Sɔlɔmɔn mekɛ zo ɛnee bɛnva dwɛtɛ fufule bɛnyɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ ye meli mɔɔ nee Helam sonvolɛma kɔ Sepeen a. Ɛvolɛ nsa biala meli ne mɔ vi Sepeen ba. Bɛba a bɛfa ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, ɛzɛlɛ, motimo, yɛɛ ahomu bɛba.

english_verse: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn nwunle nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔnyianle ɔ nwo ɔdɛlale arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
translation_verse: Ko biala mɔɔ rale la rahyɛle Sɔlɔmɔn ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la, adɛladeɛ, alufuanlɛ, ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ, mgbɔnwɔ, yɛɛ mgbɔnwɔndua. Ɛhye hɔle zolɛ ɛvolɛ biala.

english_verse: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔziele arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa wɔ Filisitiama azɛlɛ zo toonwo ɔhɔguale Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo.

english_verse: While Solomon was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as the sycamore trees in the western foothills.
translation_verse: Na Sɔlɔmɔn manle dwɛtɛ fufule bule yɛle kɛ awolɛ la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ sida mbaka bule kɛ Hyifɛla sikamɔ mbaka.

english_verse: Solomon's horses were brought in from other countries, including Musri. Solomon Dies (
translation_verse: Bɛ nee mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ la vi Yigyibiti nee maanle dɔɔnwo anu a ba a. Sɔlɔmɔn ebialilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ (

english_verse: he died and was buried in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze Devidi Suakpole zo, na ɔ ra Rilihɔbowam lile ebia ne.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to Shechem where everyone was waiting to crown him king.
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam hɔle Hyikɛm. Ɛkɛ ne a ɛnee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ gua ɛlɛkendɛ ye azie ye belemgbunli a.

english_verse: Three days later, Jeroboam and the others came back.
translation_verse: Kenle nsa ne dwule la, Gyɛlɔbowam nee menli ne kɔsɔɔti rayiale Rilihɔbowam, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ ala la.

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he returned from Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Nibate ara Gyɛlɔbowam mɔɔ ɛnriandi Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn la wɔ Yigyibiti. Na mɔɔ ɔdele edwɛkɛ ne la ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔziale ɔrale.

english_verse: The people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Na sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ zoanle manle bɛhɔvale ye na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Rilihɔbowam anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: “Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ ze Sɔlɔmɔn sisile yɛ kpole kpalɛ na ɔzoale yɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ. Yemɔti nea na te mɔɔ ɛ ze kyekyele zoale yɛ la azo maa yɛ nwo ɛdɔ yɛ na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.”

english_verse: Rehoboam replied, “Come back in three days for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na ɔdi kenle nsa a bɛzia bɛradie nwolɛ mualɛ.” Yemɔti menli ne ziale hɔle.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam vale edwɛkɛ ne dole ye mgbanyima mɔɔ boale ɔ ze Sɔlɔmɔn wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la anyunlu na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu folɛ a bɛtu me wɔ ɛhye anwo na meava meabua menli ne a?”

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should be kind and promise to make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛkile ahunlunyele ɛmaa menli ne, ɛmaa bɛ nye die, na ɛka ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ ɛkile bɛ a, bɛbazonle wɔ dahuu.”

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Na Rilihɔbowam anva mgbanyima ne mɔ folɛdulɛ ne na ɔ nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔ nee bɛ tu na ɛnɛ bɛyɛ ye folɛdulɛma la vale adwenle.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Menli ne se mende bɛ ɛvɛlɛ zo ekyii na kɛ bɛ adwenle se bɛ ɛ? Duzu mualɛ a menva memaa bɛ a?”

english_verse: His younger advisors said: Here's what we think you should say to them: “Compared to me, my father was weak.
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Me sa amozi ɛrɛlɛsɛka ne bɔbɔ le kpole tɛla egya anze.

english_verse: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Saa egya zoale bɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ a, mame, mebazoa bɛ adesoa mɔɔ tɛla egya ɛdeɛ ne. Egya vale nɛnemile a bole bɛ a, na mame, mebava empele mɔɔ anloa yɛ nyane kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛbɔlɛ la a meabila bɛ a.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam dendɛle ɛya zo hilele bɛ, ɔkpole mgbanyima ne mɔ folɛdulɛ ne.

english_verse: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam dendɛle, kɛmɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ zele ye la na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya zoale bɛ adesoa ɛnlomboɛ, na mame, mebava bie meaboka nwolɛ. Egya vale nɛnemile a bole bɛ a, na mame, mebava empele mɔɔ anloa yɛ nyane kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛbɔlɛ la a meabila bɛ a.”

english_verse: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam dwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, ɔboɔboale Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne anu amra ɛlɔnema apenle ngoko abulatwɛ anloa kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma kaho, na bɛamaa Rilihɔbowam ali maanle ne amuala azo belemgbunli.

english_verse: as well as with shields and spears. He used these fortified cities to keep control of Judah and Benjamin. The Priests and the Levites Support Rehoboam
translation_verse: Ɔvale atwɛ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike ɔhɔle azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ biala azo, amaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se. Na ɔlile ye belemgbunli ne wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu ala. Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ba Dwuda

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Nyamenle sonla Hyɛmaya kɛ,

english_verse: “The Lord warns you not to go to war against the people from the northern tribes—they are your relatives. Go home! The Lord is the one who made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord's message and did not attack Jeroboam and his troops. Rehoboam Fortifies Cities in Judah
translation_verse: ‘Bɛmmakɔ bɛ nee bɛ mediema ne mɔ kɔko. Awie biala ɛzia ɛhɔ ye sua zo, ɔluakɛ medame a meyɛ ɛhye a.’ ” Yemɔti bɛdiele Ɛdɛnkɛma ane, na bɛ nee Gyɛlɔbowam angɔngo. Rilihɔbowam bɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo bane

english_verse: Rehoboam ruled from Jerusalem, and he had several cities in Judah turned into fortresses so he could use them to defend his country. These cities included
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔkyekyele azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ ɔbɔle nwolɛ bane wɔ Dwuda.

english_verse: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
translation_verse: Ɔkyekyele Bɛtelɛhɛm, Yitam, Tɛkowa,

english_verse: Beth-Zur, Soco, Adullam,
translation_verse: Bɛtezɛ, Soko, Adɛlam,

english_verse: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
translation_verse: Gate, Malihyaa, Zefe,

english_verse: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
translation_verse: Adoleeyem, Leekehye, Azika,

english_verse: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin,
translation_verse: Zɔla, Ayegyalɔn, yɛɛ Hibulɔn. Azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ a bɛbɔle nwolɛ bane wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu a.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛbɔle aranemgbole ne mɔ anwo bane kpalɛ na ɔyele menli mɔɔ nea zolɛ a, na ɔvale aleɛ, nwole, nee nwanye ɔhɔziele ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la amuala vi ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdede la rale Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Dwuda.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Livaema vile ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdede la na bɛgyakyile bɛ nwo ninyɛne bɛrale Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam nee ɔ bo zo amra yele bɛ gyima nu kɛ bɛnle Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma bieko.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɔbowam ɔdaye ɔyele ye sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ nea ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mbɔnsam ninyɛne ne mɔ nee ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsɔ bɛ nlankɛ ananze mmonle mɔɔ ɔdaye yeyɛ la.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu kɛ bɛsonle Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne la vi Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm hɔbɔle azu manle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Bɛmanle Dwuda maanle ne gyinlanle na bɛmanle Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam nyianle gyinlagyakɛ ɛvolɛ nsa, ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ nsa ne anu, bɛvale Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn agyakɛ na bɛyɛle mɔɔ Devidi nee Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle la bie. Rilihɔbowam awuke nu amra

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam nee ye wole mralɛ mrenya nsa, Gyiyɛhye, Hyamaleeya, yɛɛ Zeeham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Nzinlii ɔgyale Abesalɛm ara Meeyaka na ɔ nee ye wole Abaegya, Ateeyae, Zaeza, yɛɛ Hyɛlomete.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ ɔmanle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ gyima wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu, na ɔkpondenle bɛ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo. Ɔmanle bɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ sa ka ye la na ɔgyigyale mraalɛ ɔmanle bɛ.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ ɔkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ati, mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam lile ɛvolɛ nnu wɔ Dwuda ebia ne azo la, Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Hyaehyake ratetale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔhonle ɔvale Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la toonwo ɔradwule Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya rale Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam nee Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ ɛnee Hyaehyake ati bɛyia Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Bɛkpo me, yemɔti medame noko mekpo bɛ memaa Hyaehyake.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala, belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nlunle bɛ nwo na bɛhanle bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle kɛ menli ne ɛnlu bɛ nwo la, ye edwɛkɛ ne zile Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya anwo zo bieko kɛ, “Menli ne ɛnlu bɛ nwo, yemɔti menrɛbɔ bɛ bo zo, mebalie bɛ. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛnrɛnwu me ɛya ne amuala, noko Hyaehyake baho ava ye.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ ahanra bɛamaa Hyaehyake, amaa bɛanwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ me ɛzonlenlɛ nee maanle gyɛne gyɛne nyamenle ne mɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu la.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam vale kɔbele yɛle bie ziele bɛ bo zo, na ɔvale ɔwulale sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sinza belemgbunli ɛkɛ ne la mgbanyima ne mɔ asa anu.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛlɛkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, sinzavolɛma ne basoa di ɔ nyunlu kɔ eza bɛsoa bɛba, na akee yeava yeahɔzie bɛ bo zo ne wɔ sinzavolɛma sua ne anu.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔnlunle ɔ nwo la ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ye ɛya kpole ne ɔ nwo zo, yeangu ye, na eza Dwuda maanle ne anu yɛle kpalɛ. Rilihɔbowam belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rilihɔbowam nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Hyɛmaya nee Nyamenle Sonla Yedo Tetedwɛkɛ Mbuluku ne mɔ anu. Ɛnee mekɛ biala konle wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam avinli.

english_verse: When Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Abijah became king.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo; ɔ ra nrenya Abaegya a lile ebia ne a.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ ebia ne azo la yɛɛ Abaegya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: Akee Dwudama bɔle bubu na Nyamenle manle Gyɛlɔbowam nee Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema ne lile akoatɔ wɔ Abaegya nee Dwuda ɛlɔnema anyunlu.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ kɛmɔ bɛ nwo zonle na bɛdedɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nlankɛ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ Gyɛlɔbowam ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛ nyamenle la ati, bɛ nee Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma belemgbunli maanle ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la baho.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm a ɔlile ebia ne a, yɛɛ ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ nsa. Ɔ nli a le Yulayɛle mɔɔ vi Gebɛya la ara raalɛ Maekaya. Konle zile Abaegya nee Gyɛlɔbowam avinli.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Abaegya gyinlanle Zɛmaleeyem Boka, wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo na ɔzele kɛ, “Gyɛlɔbowam nee Yizilayɛma amuala bɛdie me!

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne vale Yizilayɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne manle Devidi nee ɔ bo zo amra, na ɔ nee ye yɛle ngyekyeleɛ kɛ bɛbali ebia ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Menli agbamgbanvolɛ bie bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔlile ɔ nzi na bɛkpole Sɔlɔmɔn ara Rilihɔbowam wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Rilihɔbowam le kakula na ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle na yeahola yeagyinla bɛ nloa la.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Bɛvoa Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ le Aalɔn abo zo amra la, nee Livaema kɔsɔɔti na bɛdabɛ bɛye bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma kɛ maanle gyɛne gyɛne ne mɔ yɛ ye la. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛva ɛnlankɛ nyinli ekyi ko anzɛɛ mboane nyinli ngyikyi nsuu kɛrabia ɔ nwo la ɛnee bɛyɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɔko bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnzɔho ɛhwee la anyunlu a.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: “Na yɛmɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma a le yɛ Nyamenle a, yɛɛ yɛtɛkpole ye. Yɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu maa yɛ na bɛle Aalɔn abo zo amra a, yɛɛ yɛlɛ Livaema mɔɔ boa bɛ a.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ biala na bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ, bɛfa kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛgua ezukoa nvutuke ɛkponle ne azo, bɛnea ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka ne mɔ azo, amaa ahɛnlaneɛ mɔɔ gyigyi zo la ada nɔsolɛ biala. Ɔluakɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛze yɛ la, na bɛmɛ, bɛkpo ye.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea o, na Nyamenle nee yɛ a lua a, yɛɛ yemɔ yɛɛ li yɛ ti a. Ye sɛlɛvolɛma ne babɔ bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu bɛamaa konle ne atia bɛ. O Yizilayɛma, bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mmako, ɔluakɛ bɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛlɔbowam ɛzoa ɛlɔnema ɛmaa bɛbu Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne anzi, ɛhye ati ɛnee Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne ɛha avinli, Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Dwuda lile Yizilayɛma anwo zo konim kenle ko ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne anu.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abaegya voanle Gyɛlɔbowam na ɔhonle ɔvale azuamgbole: Bɛtɛle nee ye namunamu, Gyɛhyeena nee ye namunamu, yɛɛ Yifolɔn nee ye namunamu boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɔbowam amkpazi bieko ɛlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Abaegya de aze la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle anwonyane bɔle ye na ɔwule.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Abaegya gyima mɔɔ hale la, ye nyɛleɛ nee ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Yedo Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Esa yɛle mɔɔ le kpalɛ la na ɔzɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne anye.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ɔbubule azukponle gyɛne gyɛne ne mɔ nee ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la. Ɔbubule bɛ awozonle mpila sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ na ɔpɛle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ baka ne ɔdole.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔhyehyɛle kɛ Dwudama kɔsɔɔti ɛzonle bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, na bɛli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: Ɔkyekyele azuamgbole wɔ Dwuda na ɔmanle bɛbɔle nwolɛ bane, ɔluakɛ ɛnee maanle ne lɛ anzonudwolɛ. Yeango konle biala wɔ ɛvolɛ zɔhane mɔ anu, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele Dwudama kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛkyekye azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ na yɛlie nwolɛ bane yɛyia, yɛmaa bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ mbulalɛ gugua bɛ nzi, na yɛsisi tawa mɔɔ bɛgyinla zolɛ bɛsinza la. Azɛlɛ ye tɛde yɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne kpondɛ la. Yɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko yemaa yɛ anzonudwolɛ.” Yemɔti bɛkyekyele azuamgbole ne mɔ na bɛkpazile.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Esa hɔyiale bɛ, na bɛvale konle ne bɛbɔle zo wɔ Zɛfata bɔnza ne mɔɔ wɔ Malihyaa la anu.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Esa zɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola boa, kɛ ɛdawɔ ala yɛɛ ɛkɛgyinla tumima nee koahweabanema avinli a. Boa yɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ yɛ rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a, yɛɛ wɔ duma nu a yɛra yɛbadoa menli pemgbenleamgbe ɛhye mɔ yɛ nee bɛ aho a. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ a ɛle yɛ Nyamenle a. Mmamaa dasanli di ɛ nwo zo konim.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma lile Sudanema anwo zo konim, na ɔmanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne guale ndwɛlɛ aze wɔ Belemgbunli Esa nee Dwuda ɛlɔnema anyunlu.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Esa nee ye ɛlɔnema ne voanle bɛ toonwo hɔdwule Gilaa, na bɛhunle Sudanema amuala. Ko bɔbɔ anga, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye ɛlɔnema lile bɛ nwo zo konim. Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne zoale ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ konle ne anu la hɔle.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkyele azuamgbole mɔɔ zuozua Gilaa la amuala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole kpalɛ. Bɛsesale ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ninyɛne wɔ azua ne mɔ azo kpalɛ.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eza bɛhɔyiale mboaneneavolɛma bie, bɛhunle bɛ na bɛzoale bɛ mboane ɛwolaa ne nee bɛ afunlumu ne mɔ bɛhɔle. Akee bɛziale bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne dwule Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Azalaya anwo zo. Azalaya ɔ ze a le Odɛde.

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔyiale Belemgbunli Esa na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Esa, yɛɛ Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema amuala, bɛdie me. Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ lua, kɛmɔ bɛ nee ye lua la. Saa bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo a, bɛkɛnwu ye, na saa bɛkpo ye a, ɔbakpo bɛ.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛnzonle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛnlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ kilehile bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ mɛla.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Na saa munzule to bɛ a yɛɛ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo na bɛnwu ye a.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane mɔ anu awie biala annyia anzonudwolɛ angɔ amba. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la anwo zo.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua kpakyekpakyele, maanle honle tiale maanle, suakpole honle tiale suakpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛva ngyegyelɛ ɛrado bɛ avinli.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Esa dele Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Azalaya Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, ɔzile ahonle na ɔmanle bɛyeyele mmonle mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala, nee azuamgbole mɔɔ yeho yeva bɛ wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la amuala azo. Akee ɔyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la boɛ.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo vi Yifelaem, Manasɛ, nee Semɛyɔn maanzinli ne mɔ anu wɔ Yizilayɛ ɛdu ɛradoa Belemgbunli Esa, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nee ye lua. Belemgbunli Esa boɔboale bɛ kɔsɔɔti nee Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema amuala anloa.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛyiale nu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu wɔ ebia ne azo la, ye siane nsa ne azo.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Na bɛyɛle ngyehyɛlɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛ ahonle nee bɛ ɛkɛla muala bɛazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ɛnelɛ kpole bɛdeɛdeanle nu, bɛbɔle aweɛne ndendenle nee ɛweɛne na bɛvale Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛlile amonle,

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: na Dwudama amuala anye liele kpole wɔ ɛhye anwo. Ɔluakɛ bɛvale bɛ ahonle muala a bɛhanle ndane bɛlile amonle ne a. Bɛvale bɛ ɛhulolɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na Ɛdɛnkɛma liele bɛ dole nu na ɔmanle bɛ nzo nu dwole bɛ wɔ adenle biala anu.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Esa dule ɔ nli Meeyaka ebia zo kɛ ɔnle ɛhyenlema bieko, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee yeyɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela bɛkyi ananze ne yezie ɔ nwo ɔsonle ye. Esa bubule bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ananze ne, ɔpele na ɔhɔyelale ye wɔ azudenle Kedelɔn ne anloa.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, noko Belemgbunli Esa lile nɔhalɛ manle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ ze ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle la, nee ɔdaye ye ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala, dwɛtɛ fufule, nee ezukoa nvutuke yɛɛ ahyɛnze kɔsɔɔti ɔrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Na konle bieko anzi toonwo Belemgbunli Esa lile ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nnu wɔ ebia ne azo.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Yemɔti Esa vale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya nu nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne manle bɛhɔmanle Selea Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, na ɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Maa yɛyɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ, kɛmɔ yɛ ze mɔ yɛle la. Melɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke ɛhye mɔ mearɛlɛ wɔ, amaa wɔazɛkye agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la wɔ nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Beeyahya avinli la, na Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne aye ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la ahɔ.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Bɛneheedade kponlenle Belemgbunli Esa nzuzulɛ ne azo na ɔzoanle ɛlɔnema ɔmanle bɛhɔtetale Yizilayɛ azuamgbole ne bie mɔ. Bɛhonle bɛvale Yidwɔn, Dan, Ebɛle Bɛte Meeyaka, yɛɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ Nafetalae mɔɔ bɛsie konle ninyɛne zolɛ la.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Beeyahya dele ɛhye anwo bie la, ɔgyakyile Releema ɛkyekyelɛ nee nwolɛ gyima biala.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Esa vale Dwudama amuala manle bɛhɔzoale awolɛ nee ndaboa mɔɔ Beeyahya lɛ ɛlɛkyekye Releema la, na ɔvale ɔrakyekyele Giba nee Mezepa. Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Haneenae

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu ala, Nyamenle sonla Haneenae rale Dwuda Belemgbunli Esa ɛkɛ ne razele ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛ rɛle ɛwulale Selea belemgbunli ne anu na wɔanva ɛ rɛle wɔanwula Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne anu la ati, Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ɛnriandi wɔ ɛwie ala ɛne.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Na ɛnee Sudan nee Lebeya ɛnlɛ ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe nee konle ehwili yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la dɔɔnwo ɔ? Noko kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛ rɛle ɛwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma nu la, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Mekɛ guale nu la ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔla Ehabe wɔ Samɛlea. Ehabe noko hunle mboane nee nlankɛ dɔɔnwo zonle Gyɛhɔhyafate nee ye menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ rale la ɛyɛvolɛ, na ɔlile ye adwenle kɛ ɔmaa bɛhɔteta Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la.

english_verse: and finally asked, “Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth?” “Yes,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army is at your command.

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne nee Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate zieziele bɛ nwo na bɛhɔdɛnlanle aze wɔ suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Samɛlea la anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwozo ma ne la. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala rahanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne hilele bɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Na bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ le Kɛneeyana ara Zɛdikaya vale bulalɛ yɛle mɛne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Ɛbava ɛhye wɔaha Seleama wɔagua toonwo wɔabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Zɔhane nrɛlaleɛ ne ala a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ hale la hanle a. Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Nana, kɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la kɔli konim. Ɛdɛnkɛma baye suakpole ne amaa Nana somaa.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Akee ahenle mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye kɛ ɔhɔva Maekaya la zele ye kɛ, “Ayi, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala anloa ɛyɛ ko, bɛbɔ saleɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne. Ɛdawɔ noko maa ɛ nloa nee bɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɛyɛ ko.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Maekaya zele ye kɛ, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, mɔɔ me Nyamenle ne kɛva kɛmaa me la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ mebaha a.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”
translation_verse: Maekaya radwule belemgbunli ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Belemgbunli Ehabe bizale ye kɛ, “Maekaya, yɛhɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la yɛhɔdoa menli ne yɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔho, anzɛɛ mengyakyi?” Maekaya buale kɛ, “Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔli konim; bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛ.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”

translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehabe zele kɛ, “Bɛhye Maekaya na bɛva ye bɛhɔmaa Emɔn, mɔɔ le suakpole ye amɛnlado ne, nee belemgbunli ara Dwowahye;

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.

translation_verse: Noko akee, bɛnwu kpalɛ ekyi bie wɔ wɔ nuhua, ɔluakɛ wɔzɛkye bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ na wɔdua bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ maanle ye anu. Eza wɔva wɔzie wɔ ahonle nu kɛ ɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma ala.” Gyɛhɔhyafate kakyihakyi ninyɛne

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ ɔyɛ a ɔkɔkpɔlɔkpɔla ye menli ne mɔ, ɔvi Biyɛhyiba toonwo kɔdwu Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ la, na ɔmanle bɛziale bɛrazonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne.

translation_verse: Ɔyeyele ndɛnebuavolɛma wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo, suakpole biala azo ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, ɔluakɛ bɛnyɛ bɛ gyima ne bɛmmaa sonla, bɛyɛ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔbaboa bɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛbua ndɛne la.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
translation_verse: Bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛkɛze kɛ bɛyɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛnli mɔguazo, ɔnnea sonla nyunlu, yɛɛ ɔnlie ndoloboa.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eza Gyɛhɔhyafate yeyele Livaema, nee sɛlɛvolɛma bie mɔ, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛli menli mɔɔ kɛvo Nyamenle Mɛla ne la edwɛkɛ na bɛziezie kpolera biala mɔɔ kɛdɔ bɛ avinli la.

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ mediema mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo la ba na ɔ nee kɔdiawuyɛlɛ, mɛladonlɛ, mɛla anzɛɛ amaamuo ɛzɛkyelɛ edwɛkɛ bie ba bɛ nyunlu a, bɛhilehile bɛ, amaa bɛanyɛ bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na ye ɛya ne ara bɛdabɛ nee bɛ mra anwo zo. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ na bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la ɛne.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Akee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Amalaya a banlea na yeagua Nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu kpolerazulɛ biala abo a, Yehyemeeyɛle ara Zɛbadaya, Dwuda amɛnlado ne yɛɛ banlea agua maanle ye anu edwɛkɛ biala abo a, yɛɛ Livaema ne mɔ banlea amaa edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha wɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la ayɛ zɔhane, kɛmɔ bɛhanle la. Bɛzi ahonle bɛyɛ gyima ne na Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la.”

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Na awie mɔ bie rahanle hilele Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ vi Yidɔm nee nyevile ne anzi lɔ ɛlɛba aradoa wɔ nee wɔ aho. Kɛkala bɔbɔ, bɛwɔ Hazazɔn Teemaa.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ hanle Gyɛhɔhyafate na ɔzɛlɛle moalɛ ɔvile Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne, na ɔzele kɛ Dwudama kɔsɔɔti ɛhye ɛhɔne.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Na Dwudama amuala yiale kɛ bɛsɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ, menli vi Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala azo rale nzɛlɛlɛ ne bie.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Na Gyɛhɔhyafate dwazole gyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo, wɔ Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala anyunlu,

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle, wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛwɔ anwuma na ɛsie arelemgbunli maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la a. Wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛ tumi nee anwosesebɛ mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛ nyunlu gyinla a.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: O yɛ Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛvoanle menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛvile Yizilayɛma anyunlu, na ɛvale azɛlɛ ne ɛmanle ɛ gɔnwo Ebileham abo zo amra bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: Bɛdɛnla zo mekɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛzi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza bɛmaa wɔ, na bɛzɛlɛ wɔ kɛ,

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: saa munzule fa yɛ aze: konle, ndeanlɛ, ewule nzane anzɛɛ ɛhɔne ba a, yɛragyinla sua ɛhye anyunlu ɛke, wɔ ɛ nyunlu, kɛmɔ wɔ duma a la sua ye azo la, na yɛlua yɛ nyane ne anu yɛdea yɛvɛlɛ wɔ na ɛkɛdie yɛ.

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: “Kɛkala, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, nee Yidɔmma ɛva yɛ aze. Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vi Yigyibiti ba la, wɔammaa bɛanva bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, bɛbule bɛhoanenle bɛ, yemɔti bɛambɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Now they are coming to take back the land you gave us.
translation_verse: Akee nea, yɛ moyɛlɛ a le kɛ bɛba bɛaravoa yɛ bɛavi azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ wɔva wɔmaa yɛ kɛ yɛdɛnla zo kpɔkpɔ la azo.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: O yɛ Nyamenle, tea bɛ maa yɛ. Ɔluakɛ menli ɛwolaa ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛba yɛ nwo zo la, yɛnrɛhola bɛ nyunlu gyinla. Yɛnnwu mɔɔ yɛyɛ bɔbɔ a, ɛ nyunlu ala a yɛ nye gyi a.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, ɛnee Dwudama amuala nee bɛ mraalɛ nee bɛ mra gyi nzisi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Gyaheezeɛle zele kɛ, “Bɛdie, Dwudama amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, yɛɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate, bɛdie! Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Bɛmmasulo, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ kɛ menli ɛwolaa ɛhye ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo a. Ɔluakɛ konle ne ɛnle bɛ konle. Ɔle Nyamenle ɔdaye ye konle.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Ɛhyema bɛhɔholo bɛ nwo zo. Bɛbava Zeze ademgbole nu a bɛavo bɛara a. Bɛbanwu bɛ wɔ bɔnza ne ati lɔ wɔ Gyɛluwɛle fienemgbole ne aduduleɛ.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛho bɔbɔ wɔ konle ɛhye anu. Bɛmɛ bɛgyinla bɛ bo zo ne, bɛmmatu bɛ bo, na bɛnlea kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bazi aho bɛ ti ali konim la.’ Bɛmmasulo, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ. Ɛhyema bɛhɔteta bɛ na Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ bahɔ.”

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Livaema mɔɔ bɔ Kohate nee Kɔla mbusua ne bie la dwazole deɛdeanle nu yele Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Bɛdwazole ndɛndɛ wɔ aleɛbahye ne ala na bɛhɔle Tɛkowa fienemgbole ne anu. Mɔɔ bɛkɔ la, Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate ragyinlanle adenle ne anloa na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdie me! Bɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛli, na bɛbali konim. Bɛlie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne bɛli, na bɛbaho bɛadɔ zolɛ.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Akee ɔ nee menli ne bɛhanle bɛ ti bɛkpulale nwolɛ na ɔyele menli mɔɔ ɛwula ɛzonlenlɛ adɛladeɛ ɛli ɛlɔnema ne ati la, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ bɛze kɛ, “Bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Amɔnoma nee Mowabema bɔle nu hunle Yidɔm ɛlɔnema ne amuala bɔle bɛ bo zo. Bɛwiele Yidɔmma ku la, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛhakyile bɛ nye bɛbɔle ye zo na bɛpɛle bɛ nwo bɛhuhunle bɛ nwo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Dwuda ɛlɔnema ne dwule fienemgbole ne anu tawa ne mɔɔ bɛgyinla zo bɛneɛnlea maanle nu la anwo la, bie mɔ vole zolɛ na bɛnwunle kɛ, menli ɛwolaa ne kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ avunli na bɛgua azɛlɛ ne anwo. Ko bɔbɔ anvi ɛsalɛ.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Kenle nna ne azo bɛ muala bɛrayiale “Bɛleeka” Bɔnza, na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ. Zɔhane ati, bɔnza zɔhane, ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛleeka Bɔnza.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Na maanle maanle dɔɔnwo mɔɔ dele kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zile liele Yizilayɛma ati honle tiale bɛ kpɔvolɛma la zulole Nyamenle.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate akee ziele maanle ne anzonudwolɛ nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle bɔle ɔ nwo bane. Gyɛhɔhyafate belemgbunlililɛ ne awieleɛ (

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate vale ɔ nwo bɔnenle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Ehazaya, mɔɔ yɛle amumuyɛ kpole la na ɔ nee ye yɛle agɔnwolɛ.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Noko yeanzɛkye ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, yɛɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛtɛfale bɛ ahonle muala ɛtɛmanle bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne kɛ yemɔ ala a bɛkɛzonle ye a.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛhɔhyafate gyima mɔɔ ɔlile, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne, mɔɔ ɛnle ɛke la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Haneenae ara Gyihu anwo Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu la anu.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee Ehazaya bɔle nu bɛbobɔle meli dɔɔnwo wɔ Yizeɔngibɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛahɔ Tahyehye.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Na Dɔdavahu mɔɔ vi Malihyaa la ara Ɛleyizɛ vale Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne manle Gyɛhɔhyafate kɛ, “Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ wɔva ɛ nwo wɔbɔnle Ehazaya la, Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye mɔɔ wɔyɛ la.” Na meli ne mɔ hɔnlomanle adenle nu, bɛandwu Tahyehye.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔhyafate hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze mɔ anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo na ɔ ra nrenya Gyɛhɔlam lile ebia ne. Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam (

english_verse: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔhyafate ara Gyɛhɔlam lɛ ɔ mediema mrenya nsia. Bɛmɛ a le Azalaya, Gyɛheɛle, Zɛkalaya, Azalayahu, Maekeɛle, yɛɛ Hyɛfataya.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Ye mekɛ zo Yidɔmma dele atua kɛ bɛnrɛzonle Dwuda belemgbunli ne bieko, na bɛdabɛ bɛziele bɛ belemgbunli ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Filisitiama nee Arelabema bie mɔɔ dɛnlanle ɛleka mɔɔ zua Sudanema la dwazole Gyɛhɔlam anwo zo.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Bɛ ze manle bɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ Dwuda azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la. Noko ɔvale maanle ne ɔmanle Gyɛhɔlam, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a ɔle ralɛ nrenya kpanyinli a.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyɛhɔlam ralile ɔ ze ebia ne na ɔnyianle gyinlagyakɛ la, ɔmanle bɛhunle ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ amuala, nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne bie mɔ.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Ɔvale Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ agyakɛ, ɔbɔle Ehabe sua nu amra ɛbɛla ne bie, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔgya Ehabe ara raalɛ. Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma,

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ambɔ Devidi sua nu amra abo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma nee Devidi ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na yebɔ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbamaa kɛnlaneɛ ada ye nee ɔ bo zo amra sua nu dahuu.

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛhɔlam vale ye safohyenlema nee ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ tɛnla ehwili nu ko la na kenle ko nɔɔzo bɛdwazole bɛhɔtetale Yidɔm. Yidɔmma bɛnrale yiale bɛ, noko bɛbɔle mɔdenle bɛwolole bɛ sa abo.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔvi mekɛ ne toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la, Yidɔmma di bɛ ti anwo. Mekɛ zɔhane ala anu Lebena ɔdaye ɔdele atua kɛ bɛnrɛzonle Dwuda belemgbunli ne bieko, ɔboalekɛ yegyakyi Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne anzi ɛlilɛ.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Yeanga ɛhye angome, eza ɔyɛle ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, na ɔmanle Gyɛlusalɛm amuala yɛle ɛtane tiale Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔminlinle Dwudama bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Yilaegya manle bɛvale kɛlata bɛrɛlɛle Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ ze Devidi Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ wɔanva ɛ ze Gyɛhɔhyafate anzɛɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Esa agyakɛ,

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: na wɔva Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli agyakɛ, wɔmaa Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛm amra amuala ɛyɛ ɛtane, kɛmɔ Ehabe sua nu amra manle Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane la, na wɔhu ɛ mediema mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ bɛ ze le ko, na bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla ɛdawɔ mumua ne la,

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ewule nzane aradɔ wɔ menli ne, ɛ mra nee wɔ mraalɛ anwo, na yeazɛkye wɔ agyadeɛ kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ mumua ne noko ɛbanyia ɛkolɛ ewule mɔɔ babɔ wɔ anwonyane mɔɔ anu bayɛ se alehyenlɛ biala la.’ ”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Bɛravale Dwuda aze na bɛzoale nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛ sa hanle bɛ, mɔɔ le belemgbunli sua nu amra ɛdeɛ la bɛhɔle. Bɛhyele ɔ mra mrenya nee ye mraalɛ noko bɛhɔle, na bɛgyakyile ye ralɛ nrenya kazima Ehazaya ala.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɛkolɛ ewule mɔɔ awie ɛngola ye ayile yɛ la dɔle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ nwiɔ la, ɛnee akee ewule ne ɛdɛla zolɛ. Ɔ ko manle zo na ɔvale abodelɛ kpole ɔwule. Ye menli ne ambɔ sendɔlɔra anzu ye, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle arelemgbunli mɔɔ lumua la.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyihu bɔ Ehabe sua nu amra abo zo la, ɔyiale Dwuda mgbanyima nee Ehazaya amediema mrenya mɔɔ rale bakpɔla Dwɔlam la na ɔhunle bɛ muala.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛkpondɛle Ehazaya ɔdaye mumua ne toonwo bɛhɔnwunle ye kɛ ɔvea Samɛlea, na bɛhyele ye bɛrɛlɛle Gyihu na bɛhunle ye. Ɔ nlenya Gyɛhɔhyafate, mɔɔ vale ye ahonle muala zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma la ati, bɛziele ye. Na ɛnee akee awie biala ɛnle Ehazaya sua nu mɔɔ sie Dwuda maanle ne a. Dwuda Belemgbunli Raalɛ Atalaya (

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Ehabe nee ye sua nu amra yɛle la. Ɔluakɛ ɔ ze wule la ɛnee Belemgbunli Ehabe sua nu amra a tu ye folɛ a.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Ɔlile menli zɔhane mɔ folɛdulɛ zo na ɔ nee Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Dwɔlam bɔle nu hɔhonle tiale Selea Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle wɔ Releemɔto mɔɔ wɔ Geleade la. Seleama ne bodale Dwɔlam,

english_verse: and he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. And Ahaziah later went there to visit him.
translation_verse: na ɔziale ɔrale Gyɛzɛlii kɛ ɔbayɛ ɔ nwo ayile, na Dwuda belemgbunli ne hɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔla ye.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Na ɛnee Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ kɛ wɔ Dwɔlam ɛkpɔlalɛ nu yɛɛ Ehazaya balua ayia munzule a. Mɔɔ Ehazaya dwule Dwɔlam anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Gyɛzɛlii la, ɔ nee ye bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkayia Nemehyae ara Gyihu mɔɔ ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛkpokpa ye nwole kɛ ɔbɔ Ehabe sua nu amra abo zo la adenle.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Ehazaya adiema raalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nli ɛnle ko la wuale Ehazaya amra mrenya ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwowahye la, na ɔvale ye nee ye bafiavolɛ ne ɔveale sua bie akunlu. Bɛfɛlɛ raalɛ ne Gyihohyiba. Ɔ ze a le Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔlam yɛɛ ɔ hu a le sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada. Ɔyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ ɔ diema nrenya a le Belemgbunli Ehazaya, na ɔvale kakula ne ɔveale Atalaya. Yemɔti ɔ sa anga Dwowahye yeangu ye.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ehazaya ɔ nli Atalaya dele kɛ ɔ ra ne ɛwu la, ɔmanle bɛhunle Dwuda dehelɛ abusua ne anu amra amuala.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Kakula ne nee bɛ dɛnlanle ɛvolɛ nsia, bɛvale ye bɛveale Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee Atalaya a di belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a.

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ bara gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la bahyɛ bɛ nwo nu nsa. Ekpunli ko bazinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ,

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli ne amuala lile fɛlɛko, na akee anzonudwolɛ rale suakpole ne azo, ɔluakɛ bɛhu Atalaya.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Atalaya lile Dwuda ebia ne ɛvolɛ nsia. Wɔ ye ɛvolɛ nsuu ne anu, sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada zile ɔ kɛnra ɔ nee safohyenlema mɔɔ nea ɛlɔnema ɛya ɛya nwo zo la yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ. Safohyenlema ne mɔ a le Gyɛloham ara Azalaya, Gyihɔheenan ara Yehyemeeyɛle, Obɛde ara Azalaya, Adaya ara Meeyasaya, yɛɛ Zekelae ara Yilaehyafate.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Na bɛ muala bɛ nee Dwowahye yiale nu wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛbɔle kpɔkɛ, bɛkyekyele ɔ bo. Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, belemgbunli ne ara nrenya ne ɛne! Bɛboa bɛmaa ɔli belemgbunli, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Devidi abo zo amra anwo la.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: ekpunli ko bahɔzinza suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, na ekpunli ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la ahɔgyinla Adiabo Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa. Menli ne kɔsɔɔti baha Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa awie biala wolo Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ala. Bɛkola bɛwolo, ɔboalekɛ bɛmɛ, bɛ nwo te. Na menli mɔɔ ɛha la ɔwɔ kɛ di mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ la azo na bɛgyinla alie nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Livaema bahɔgyinla belemgbunli ne anwo ɛkɛ azinza ye. Bɛbahwe bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ na bɛali belemgbunli ne anzi wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɔ la. Bɛhu awie biala mɔɔ kɛpele kɛ ɔba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.”

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Livaema nee Dwudama amuala lile ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada vale manle bɛ la azo. Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada anzɛkye sɛlɛvolɛ ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ la. Yemɔti ekpunli ko biala vale ye menli mɔɔ ba gyima nee mɔɔ ɛnle gyima nu kenle ko ne la amuala rale gyima Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada yele Belemgbunli Devidi atwɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la manle safohyenlema ne mɔ.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmanle menli ne gyinlanle nvonvɔɔnwo, ko biala lɛ dadeɛ na bɛbɛnrale bɛyiale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, ɔvi ye nyiakɛ ɔkɔ ye sɔlɔ afoa nu, yɛɛ azukponle ne anwo, kɛ bɛzinza belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalaya dele alɛra ne mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛyɛ nee belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛlɛyeyɛ ye la. Ɛhye anzi ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu,

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: na ɔhɔnwunle kɛ belemgbunli ne gyi ye mpila ne anwo wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne, safohyenlema ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle la gyigyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na menli ne kɔsɔɔti anye ɛlie, bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne, na Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu edwɛndolɛma li bɛ ti bɛlɛto edwɛne na bɛlɛbɔ agole bɛazi. Atalaya suosuanle ye adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu ɛkɛ ne ala, na ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Maamɔlɛ ɛbɛla a le ɛhye! Maamɔlɛ ɛbɛla a le ɛhye!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Na Gyɛhɔyada zele safohyenlema mɔɔ ɛlɛnea ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo la kɛ, “Bɛmmaku ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu. Bɛva ye bɛlua sinzavolɛma ne avinli bɛvinde, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ kɛ ɔbalie ye la, bɛhu ye.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Bɛhyele Atalaya na bɛvale ye bɛhɔle “Ɛkpɔnwɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole” ne mɔɔ di kɔ belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la anloa bɛhɔhunle ye. Gyɛhɔyada kakyihakyi ninyɛne (

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada nee belemgbunli ne yɛɛ menli ne amuala yɛle ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛhyele ɔ bo kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a bɛkɛzonle ye a.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala hɔle bozonle Beeyale ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anwo na bɛhɔbubule ye bɛguale, bɛbubule ye azukponle ne mɔ nee ye ananze ne mɔ na bɛhunle Beeyale kɔmenle Matan wɔ bozonle ne azukponle ne mɔ anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Na Gyɛhɔyada manle menli zinzale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne na ɔvale bɛ ɔwulale sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ Devidi hyehyɛle kɛ bɛnlea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyimayɛlɛ zo la asa anu. Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu la, na bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi hyehyɛle la.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle sinzavolɛma gyinlegyinlanle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa, amaa awie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la anwolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Akee safohyenlema ne, menli titile ne mɔ, nee arane mgbanyima ne mɔ lile belemgbunli ne anyunlu na bɛvale ye bɛluale anwuma anlenkɛ kpole ne anu bɛrale belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, na bɛvale ye bɛdɛnlanle belemgbunli ebia ne anu.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Dwowahye yɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada de aze la.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne nee Gyɛhɔyada vale ezukoa ne manle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnea Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo gyimayɛlɛ zo la. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛvale ezukoa ne bɛbɔle kapentama nee belekyama, yɛɛ akee menli mɔɔ ze mbulalɛ nee kɔbele adwinli di la ɛkpa bɛmanle bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛziele ye wɔ Devidi Suakpole zo wɔ arelemgbunli ne mɔ avinli, wɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle Yizilayɛma, ye ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔzonlenle Nyamenle, nee ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la ati.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada gyale mraalɛ nwiɔ manle ye, na ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Mekɛ guale nu la, Dwowahye yɛle kɛ ɔyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne mɔ rayiale na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, bɛhɔlielie ezukoa mɔɔ kɛza la bɛrɛla na ɛvolɛ biala bɛava bɛayɛ bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ. Bɛmaa ɛhye ɛhyia bɛ na bɛyɛ ye ndɛndɛ.” Noko ɛhye angyia Livaema ne.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yemɔti belemgbunli ne manle bɛvɛlɛle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Gyɛhɔyada bɛrale, na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛtɛmanle Livaema ɛtɛkɔdieliele adwule ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ, Mosisi, hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ kɛ bɛlie wɔ menli ne mɔ ɛkɛ bɛva bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ndanlɛ Sua ne boɛ la bɛtɛfile Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛm amra ɛkɛ ne a?”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Yemɔti belemgbunli ne manle bɛbobɔle ɛlɛka bɛziele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbɔle nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda amuala kɛ awie biala ɛradua ye adwule ɛdeɛ ne ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ Nyamenle sonvolɛ, Mosisi, hyehyɛle manle Yizilayɛma wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Na menli ne amuala nee mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala anye liele na bɛraduale bɛ adwule ne bɛguale ɛlɛka ne anu, hɔdwule kɛ bɛ muala bɛwiele ye tua la.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Kenle ko biala Livaema ne fa ɛlɛka ne kɔ maa belemgbunli mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli ne mɔ nea nu. Saa bɛnea nu na ezukoa mɔɔ wɔ nu la zonle a, ɛnee belemgbunli ne kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne yɛɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne abɔlɔba ne banea wola sie na bɛmaa bɛfa ɛlɛka ne bɛkɔsie ɔ bo zo ne. Bɛyɛle ye zɛhae kenle biala na bɛnyianle ezukoa dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ne la hunle bɛ nwo yɛle gyima ne kpalɛ, na bɛwiele sua ne boɛ yɛ. Bɛyɛle ye kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, na eza bɛmanle sua ne anwo gyinlanle ye kpalɛ.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele gyima ne yɛ la, bɛvale ezukoa ne mɔɔ hale la bɛhɔmanle belemgbunli ne nee Gyɛhɔyada. Belemgbunli Dwowahye nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Gyɛhɔyada vale ezukoa ne mɔɔ hale la yɛle ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsonle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, nee dwora mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ nu la. Eza bɛyɛle dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke dwora. Bɛhakyi Gyɛhɔyada maamulɛ ne Bɛbɔle azu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛhɔyada de aze la.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Gyɛhɔyada wule la, Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ dɛle guale Belemgbunli Dwowahye anzo nu toonwo bɛmanle ɔdiele bɛ ne.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyile ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na bɛhɔzonlenle bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ, na bɛzɔle mmonle. Na Nyamenle ɛya ne rale Gyɛlusalɛm amra nee Dwudama amuala anwo zo.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Nyamenle zoanle ye kpɔmanvolɛma manle bɛrabɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɛzia bɛrazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, noko bɛandie bɛ.
