translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Aselea Belemgbunli Tegelate Paelisɛ kɛraboa Ehaze la, ɔvale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo ɔrɛlɛle ye.

english_verse: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: ɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ ɔbɔle azu wɔ Henɔm Bɔnza, na ɔyelale ɔ mra mrenya ɔbɔle azu. Ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnee de azɛlɛ ne azo la bɔle a Ɛdɛnkɛma dule bɛ vile Yizilayɛma anyunlu la bie.

english_verse: Ahaz and the people of Judah sinned and turned away from the Lord, the God their ancestors had worshiped. So the Lord punished them by letting their enemies defeat them. The king of Syria attacked Judah and took many of its people to Damascus as prisoners. King Pekah of Israel later defeated Judah and killed
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze yɛle ɛtane la ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne manle Selea belemgbunli ne ralile ɔ nwo zo konim na ɔhyele Dwudama dɔɔnwo nuokɛ ɔhɔle Dɛmasekɛse. Ɛdɛnkɛma eza manle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Pikaa, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Relɛmalaya la, lile Ehaze anwo zo konim na ɔhunle Dwuda ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze ko kpalɛ la anu apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanwiɔ kenle ko. Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne manle ɛhye zile Dwudama anwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛkpo ye.

english_verse: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee eza kɛkala bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛsisi Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ nee mrenya anwo zo bɔkɔɔ na bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ ahanra. Na bɛnze kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nyamenle ne ɔ?

english_verse: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.
translation_verse: Akee bɛdie me ɛ! Bɛ mediema ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛra la, bɛva bɛ bɛzia bɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva bɛ nwo ɛya.”

english_verse: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong,
translation_verse: Mgbanyima nna bie, Gyɛhoheenan ara Azalaya, Mɛhyelɛmo ara Bɛlikaya, Hyalɛm ara Gyɛhezekaya, yɛɛ Hadeleeyae ara Ameesa, mɔɔ bɔ Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne bie la bɛdabɛ bɛdwazole bɛtiale ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ vi konle ne anloa ɛlɛba la,

english_verse: and they said: If you bring these prisoners into Samaria, that will be one more thing we've done to sin against the Lord. And he is already angry enough with us.
translation_verse: na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmafa menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la biala bɛba ɛke. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee bɛlɛmaa yɛayɛ ɛtane kpole yɛatia Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛadɛla dɛba ɛdeɛ ne. Yɛdayɛ mumua ne yɛ ɛtane mɔɔ yɛzo la, yɛngola ye, yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛya mɔɔ ɛva wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo la le kpole.”

english_verse: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛlɔnema ne gyakyile menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ la nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ la amuala wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The four leaders took some of the stolen clothes and gave them to the prisoners who needed something to wear. They later gave them all a new change of clothes and shoes, then fixed them something to eat and drink, and cleaned their wounds with olive oil. They gave donkeys to those who were too weak to walk, and led all of them back to Jericho, the city known for its palm trees. The leaders then returned to Samaria. Ahaz Asks the King of Assyria for Help (
translation_verse: Na mgbanyima nna ne mɔɔ bɛ aluma a bɛbobɔ la vale menli ne nee ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ne nee bɛ rale la; bɛvale ninyɛne ne anu adɛladeɛ ne bie bɛmanle menli ne mɔɔ lɛ bɛ nwo zɔ la wulale, bɛmanle bɛ mgbɔlaboa bɛwulale, bɛmanle bɛ aleɛ nee nzule, na bɛmanle bɛbiale. Bɛmanle menli mɔɔ anwo ɛyɛ bɛ bɛtɛɛ la zo bɛguale asoaso zo, na bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔmanle bɛ nwo amra wɔ Gyɛleko, suakpole ne mɔɔ mrɛlɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ zolɛ la. Akee mgbanyima ne mɔ ziale hɔle Samɛlea. Ehaze biza Aselea moalɛ (

english_verse: Some time later, the Edomites attacked the eastern part of Judah again and carried away prisoners. And at the same time, the Philistines raided towns in the western foothills and in the Southern Desert. They conquered the towns of Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo, including the villages around them. Then some of the Philistines went to live in these places. Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria and begged for help.
translation_verse: Filisitiama noko rale Dwuda anwo zo wɔ Dwuda nyiakɛ nee ye adɔleɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo la azo na bɛvale Bɛte Hyimɛhye, Ayegyalɔn, Gɛdilo, Soko nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, Temena nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, yɛɛ Gemezo nee ye namunamu ne mɔ, na bɛdɛnlanle zolɛ.

english_verse: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.
translation_verse: Ɔlua Ehaze ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Dwuda yɛle kɛ maanle mgbane bie la, ɔboalekɛ Ehaze ɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma na yeyɛ Dwudama mgbane mgbane.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: Ehaze sesale ezukoa mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ, nee mɔɔ wɔ ye mgbanyima ne mɔ sua nu la amuala hɔmanle Aselea belemgbunli ne, noko ngyenle ande tolo. Ehaze ɛtane ne mɔ

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne yɛle kpole la, Belemgbunli Ehaze akee arɛle vile Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle Dɛmasekɛsema awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛli ɔ nwo zo konim la azo ɔhɔbɔle azu ɔmanle bɛ na ɔzele kɛ, “Selea awozonle ne mɔ boale bɛ, yemɔti mebɔ azu meamaa awozonle ne mɔ na bɛaboa medame noko.” Na bɛmɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee bɛmanle ɔdaye nee Yizilayɛma amuala nwunle bɛ nyunlu a.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ehaze sesale Nyamenle sua ne anu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, ahyɛnze nee dwora ne mɔ, na ɔpepɛle bɛ nu azinli azinli, ɔtotole Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu, na ɔyɛle azukponle dɔɔnwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛleka biala.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: Ɔsisile ɛleka ɛleka wɔ Dwuda suakpole biala azo mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ bɛmaa awozonle, na ɔhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne ɛya kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Akee ye nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Ehaze hɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛanva ye bɛangɔ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli alaleɛ ne. Ɔ ra Hɛzikaya lile ebia ne.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ nlenya Devidi agyakɛ, ɔyɛle mɔɔ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye la. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛnluanlɛ

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔhanle bɛhilele ye kɛ, “Yɛnlua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne yɛwie, yɛnlua ɛyelalɛ azukponle ne nee nwolɛ ahyɛnze nee dwora ne mɔ amuala, yɛɛ ɛkponle ne mɔɔ bɛfa kpanwo nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛgua zolɛ la nee nwolɛ ahyɛnze ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale Livaema ne ɔziele bɛ bo zo ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔmanle bɛ sɔnwosɔnwo, yɛɛ getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi, Gaade mɔɔ ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile Devidi, nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Neetan hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne la, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo hyehyɛle a.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele azu ne bɔ la, belemgbunli ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala dule guale na bɛzonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: Ɔvale Livaema nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ɔrale. Ɔboɔboale bɛ nloa wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie wienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la anwo,

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Livaema, bɛdie me! Bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle, na bɛnlua Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye, na bɛdu nuhua evinli ne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Yɛ ze mɔ anli nɔhalɛ, bɛyɛ mɔɔ le ɛtane la bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne. Bɛkpo ye na bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma de la.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Bɛtotole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu, bɛnluanle nuhua ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ. Bɛamkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ bɛambɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛammaa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo ɛya kpole a, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye dua ye la. Mɔɔ yeva yehile yɛ la ɛmaa awie biala ahonle ɛdu, yeyɛ azibɛnwo na yɛyɛ awie biala kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati bɛnlea, yɛ ze mɔ ɛwu konle nu, bɛhye yɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ nee yɛ ye mɔ nuokɛ bɛhɔ.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: “Kɛkala, mebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ me nee Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne yɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, amaa yeaye ye ɛya kpole ne yɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Me mra mrenya, bɛmmayɛ kpasaa wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye bɛ kɛ, bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛgyinla ɔ nyunlu bɛzonle ye, bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa ye na bɛli menli ne ati bɛmaa bɛzonle ye a.”

english_verse: When Hezekiah finished talking, the following Levite leaders went to work: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the Kohath clan; Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel from the Merari clan; Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah from the Gershon clan; Shimri and Jeuel from the Elizaphan clan; Zechariah and Mattaniah from the Asaph clan; Jehuel and Shimei from the Heman clan; Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthun clan.
translation_verse: Livaema ɛhye mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Kohate abusua nu la a le Ameesae ara Meehate yɛɛ Azalaya ara Dwowɛle. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Mɛlɛlae abusua nu la a le Abedae ara Kehye yɛɛ Gyɛhalɛle ara Azalaya. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Gɛhyɔn abusua nu la a le Zemena ara Dwowaa yɛɛ Dwowaa ara Yidɛn. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Yilaezeefan abusua nu la a le Hyemelae yɛɛ Gyiyayɛle. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Esafe abusua nu la a le Zɛkalaya yɛɛ Matanaya. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Himan abusua nu la a le Gyɛhuwɛle yɛɛ Hyemɛyae. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Gyɛdutɛn abusua nu la a le Hyɛmaya yɛɛ Ɛzeɛle.

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ boɔboale bɛ sa zo ne mɔ anloa, bɛnluanle bɛ nwo, na kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele bɛ la se la, bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkanlua Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne wolole hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ na bɛhɔkpoɔkpoanle ɛkɛ ne bɛyele debie ɛtane biala mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye ɛkɛ ne la bɛvindele alie ne anwo. Na Livaema ne zoale ewula ne amuala hɔguale azudenle Kedelɔn ne anu.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la kenle ne mɔɔ lumua ala la azo yɛɛ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkpoɔkpoa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a. Ye kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo akee bɛrale sua mumua ne akunlu, na bɛvale kenle mɔtwɛ bɛzieziele Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu. Yemɔti siane ko ne anu kenle bulu nee nsia ne azo yɛɛ bɛwiele gyima biala yɛ a. Bɛtu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛawula Nyamenle asa anu bieko

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Akee ahyɛnze ne mɔ mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze kpole Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɔzɛkyele bɛ la, yɛziezie bɛ na yɛnlua bɛ. Kɛkala, bɛ muala bɛgyigyi Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne anyunlu.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya boɔboale ye mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la anloa na bɛhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛvale nlankɛ nyinli nsuu, mboane nyinli nsuu, mboane mralɛ nsuu, yɛɛ akee mbɔnkye nyinli nsuu kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ ɛtanefakyɛ azu wɔ belemgbunli nee ye awuke nu amra, Dwuda maanle ne amuala, yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ati. Belemgbunli zele sɛlɛvolɛma ne, Aalɔn abo zo amra ne mɔ kɛ bɛbɔ azu ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Akee bɛvale mbɔnkye nyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛtanefakyɛ azu ne la bɛrɛlɛle belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne, na bɛvale bɛ sa bɛguale bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ hunle mbɔnkye ne mɔ na bɛvale bɛ mogya ne bɛbɔle ɛtanefakyɛ azu wɔ azukponle ne azo, bɛvale bɛkpɔdale Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati. Ɔluakɛ belemgbunli ne zele kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne nee ɛtanefakyɛ azu ne wɔ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Livaema ne vale bɛ agolebɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Devidi yɛle la, na sɛlɛvolɛma ne vale bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ na bɛhɔgyinlanle bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya yɛle kɛ bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne wɔ azukponle ne azo. Mɔɔ bɛbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu ne abo la, bɛbɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne ɛdolɛ bo, bɛbɔle aweɛne ndendenle ne na bɛbɔle agolebɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi yɛle manle bɛ la.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee ye mgbanyima ne zele Livaema ne kɛ bɛdo edwɛne ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Devidi nee Esafe yɛle la bie bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na bɛvale anyelielɛ bɛdole edwɛne, bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛyeyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya zele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛkala, bɛ nwo ɛde ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, zɔhane ati bɛrɛla, bɛva bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne nee moyɛlɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu.” Na menli ne mɔɔ rayiale la vale bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne nee moyɛlɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne rale, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne rale.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne anwo anzo la ati, ɛnee bɛngola ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo gyima di. Yemɔti bɛmanle Livaema ne boale bɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule kɛ gyima ne wiele na sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la noko nluanle bɛ nwo la; nɔhalɛ, ɛnee Livaema ne ahonle nu te wɔ bɛ nwo ɛnluanlɛ ne anu tɛla sɛlɛvolɛma ne.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa ɛye ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne bebelebe ɛhye ɛsie ahane a, sɛlɛvolɛma ne a eza ɔwɔ kɛ yela nane ɛnlome bɔ anzonudwolɛ azu ne, na bɛgua nwanye ne mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛboka azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛkɛra la, bɛye ɛdɛne kolaa na bɛabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne a. Yemɔti akee bɛbɔle ɛzonlenlɛ bo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bieko.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee menli ne amuala anye liele wɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ɛmaa menli ne la anwo, ɔluakɛ gyima zɛhae mɔɔ bɛlile la zenle waa.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛyɛle ye mɛla na bɛbɔle ye nolo wɔ Yizilayɛ amuala, ɔvi Biyɛhyiba mɔɔ kɔdwu Dan la, kɛ menli ne ɛrɛla ɛmaa bɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛtɛbale dɔɔnwo ɛlɛ kɛ bɛbali ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛzoanle menli wɔ Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda amuala, bɛvale ngɛlata bɛvile belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngɛlata ne mɔ anu la se: “O Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma, Ebileham, Ayezeke, nee Gyekɔbo bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, amaa ɔdaye noko yeahakyi ɔ nye wɔ bɛdabɛ ekyi ne mɔɔ bɛha mɔɔ Aselea arelemgbunli angu bɛ la anwo zo.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ yɛle la. Bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛrɛla ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ yede nwolɛ wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu, na bɛrazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, na ye ɛya kpole ne avi bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛsia bɛba Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne a, menli mɔɔ hyele bɛ mediema nee bɛ mra hɔle la baze bɛ anwunvɔne na bɛamaa bɛazia bɛara sua nu. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne se anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔ ti akunlu le kpalɛ. Saa bɛsia bɛba ye ɛkɛ ne a, ɔnrɛhakyi ɔ nzi ɔnrɛzi bɛ.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Menli ekyi bie mɔɔ wɔ Ahya, Manasɛ, yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn la yɛɛ nlunle bɛ nwo na bɛrale Gyɛlusalɛm a.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Nyamenle tumi ne noko yɛle gyima wɔ Dwuda manle menli ne amuala yɛle ko, na bɛyɛle debie biala mɔɔ belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ luale Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu hanle hilele bɛ la. Bɛli Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ rale Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛbali Angye Ɛvoyia ne wɔ siane nwiɔ ne anu, ɛlɔne mɔɔ rale la le kpole.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Bɛkpale bɛguale na bɛdudule azukponle dɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ zo la amuala na bɛhɔvuandinle bɛ bɛguale Kedelɔn bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye nzɛlɛlɛ ne, ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔhyɛle bɛ, yeanyɛ bɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale Gyɛlusalɛm la vale anyelielɛ lile Angye Ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu. Mekɛ ne anu, sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne vale bɛ anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti dole edwɛne bɔle agole yele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Na Hɛzikaya yele Livaema ne mɔɔ hilele bɛ mɔdenlebɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ ne anu la ayɛlɛ. Ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ Menli ne lile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne toonwo kenle nsuu, bɛbɔle anzonudwolɛ azu na bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne mo.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Dwudama amuala, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ne mɔ, nee ɛlɔne mɔɔ vi Yizilayɛ rale, nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de Dwuda, yɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ vi Yizilayɛ rale la amuala anye liele.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Anyelielɛ kpole kpalɛ rale Gyɛlusalɛm, ɔluakɛ ɔvi Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi la mekɛ zo toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu mekɛ zɔhane la, debie zɛhae, bie ɛtɛsile Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne zɛlɛle Nyamenle nyilalɛ manle menli ne, na bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dwule Nyamenle anzo nu wɔ anwuma lɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ ɔde la.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya ziale hyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema anu ekpunli ekpunli, yɛɛ ekpunli ko biala nee ye gyima. Bɛmɛ a le sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ nea ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne zo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo bɛaye ye ayɛlɛ la.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa bɛkɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne aluma a bɛkɛlɛ bɛ mra ngyikyi, bɛ mraalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛboka nwolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛnea bɛ nwo boɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: Eza belemgbunli ne zele menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kɛ bɛva azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ne ɛdeɛ la bɛrɛlɛ bɛ, amaa bɛanyia adenle bɛava bɛ mekɛ muala bɛali bɛ gyima ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kpondɛ la.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala wiele la, Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale la hɔle Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, bɛhɔbubule mpila ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsisi, bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ, ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sonle la, nee azukponle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu, nee Yifelaem nee Manasɛ maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala. Akee awie biala hɔle ye sua zo.

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli afoa nu ɛdeɛ a le kɛ, ɔvale nane ɔmanle bɛvale bɛbɔle nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ ɛyelalɛ azu ne mɔ, nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛyelalɛ azu ne mɔ, Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ azu ne mɔ, nee ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha la azu ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla Buluku ne anu la.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye kpondenle na ɔdwule amaanvoa la, Yizilayɛma vale bɛ ma mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛdele la, nwanye, nwole, wolɛ, nee bɛ bɛyɔba biala dɔɔnwo rale, yɛɛ bɛvale bɛ ninyɛne ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne bɛrale.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Dwudama nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ dede Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la hyɛle bɛ nlankɛ nee mboane nu bulu bulu na bɛdule ɛkpɔ ngoko bɛrale. Eza bɛvale bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne la bɛrale. Ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ rale la zonle kpalɛ na bɛhuohuanle bɛ edukue edukue.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Siane nsa ne anu, bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ ba, yɛɛ bɛvale bɛrale dedee ɔhɔdwule siane nsuu ne anu.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ranwunle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛra la somaa la, bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ na bɛyele ye menli Yizilayɛma noko ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Na Hɛzikaya bizale sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: Na Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Azalaya, mɔɔ vi Zeedɔko sua nu la buale ye kɛ, “Sumunli kɛ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ ba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu ɛke la, dahuu yɛ sa kɔ yɛ nloa, bie bɔbɔ ka. Yɛnyia ninyɛne ɛwolaa ɛhye yɛzie ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila ye menli ne.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya manle bɛsisile ekpumgbunli dɔɔnwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo na bɛzieziele nuhua.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Bɛdule Livaema bulu mɔɔ nee bɛ yɛ gyima a. Bɛmɛ a le Gyɛheɛle, Azazaya, Neehate, Asahɛle, Gyɛlimo, Dwozabade, Yilayɛle, Yesemakaya, Meehate, yɛɛ Bɛnaya. Menli bulu ɛhye mɔ wɔ Konanaya nee ɔ diema Hyemɛyae abo. Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Azalaya a yele bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ zɔhane gyima ne a.

english_verse: Kore son of Imnah was assigned to guard the East Gate, and he was put in charge of receiving the offerings voluntarily given to God and of dividing them among the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Livaenli Yemena mɔɔ sinza Aduduleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne la ara Kɔli a nea azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyeyele bɛ ahonle nu bɛvale bɛrɛlɛle Nyamenle la azo a, na ɔnea ɔfa mɔɔ bɛva bɛzie ahane bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɔsie, na ɔfa mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ azu nwuanzanwuanza la ɔmaa.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: Bɛngyɛ ye mbusua nu. Nrenya biala mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulasa mɔɔ kɔ, na ɔkola ɔyɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu gyima ne bie alehyenlɛ biala la nyia bie, kɛmɔ ye gyinlabelɛ ne si de la.

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Akee menli wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ Aalɔn abo zo amra nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne bie mɔ dede zolɛ la azo; bɛmɛ a bɛnea na bɛfa aleɛ bɛkɔmaa nrenya biala mɔɔ boka sɛlɛvolɛma abusua ne nee awie biala mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye duma bɛboka Livae mbusua ne mɔ anwo la a.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne kpazile, ɔboalekɛ ɔdule ɔ nwo ɔmanle ye Nyamenle ne na ɔkpɔlale ɔ kunlu ɔlile gyima biala mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, anzɛɛ Nyamenle Mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ nu la.

english_verse: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne zoanle bɛ la deanle nu hanle ɛhye mɔ wɔ Dwuda aneɛ nu hilele menli mɔɔ ɛnee dede Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne azo la, amaa bɛ ahonle adu na bɛanyia adenle bɛava suakpole ne.

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ bɛnze mɔɔ medame yɛɛ egya mɔ yɛva yɛyɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle gyɛne gyɛne nu la ɔ? Asoo bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ holale liele maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ vile me sa nu?

english_verse: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma liele Hɛzikaya nee Gyɛlusalɛmma vile Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe asa anu nee ye kpɔvolɛma amuala asa anu, na ɔmanle bɛnyianle anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ɔ nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la hɔle kɛ bɛkadua nzubula biala mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne kandiba la, amaa saa Aseleama bikye Gyɛlusalɛm a bɛannyia nzule bɛanno. Mgbanyima ne mɔ lile menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ ati na bɛhɔsisile nzubula ne mɔ nee azudenle ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu la, yemɔti ɛnee nzule vi nzubula ne mɔ nee azudenle ne anu ɛnze, na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔnle kɛ Aselea arelemgbunli banwu kɛ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛke.”

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Akee belemgbunli ne manle bɛliele suakpole ne bane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha ɛgua la, na bɛsisile tawa wɔ zolɛ; eza ɔmanle bɛmiemianle bane ne mɔɔ bɛlie bɛ wɔ suakpole ne aduduleɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee kuma kpole ne mɔɔ bɛduale ye la wɔ la anu. Eza ɔmanle bɛyɛle atwɛ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:

translation_verse: Menli ne noko yɛle gyima ne nɔhalɛ nu. Menli mɔɔ ɛnee nea gyimayɛvoma ne anwo zo la a le Gyeehate nee Obadaya, bɛle Livaema mɔɔ vi Mɛlɛlae abusua nu, yɛɛ akee Zɛkalaya nee Mɛhyɛlam mɔɔ vi Kohate abusua nu la.

english_verse: were in charge of carrying supplies and supervising the workers. Other Levites were appointed to stand guard around the temple.

english_verse: While the money was being given to these supervisors, Hilkiah found the book that contained the laws that the Lord had given to Moses.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛye ezukoa ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛra Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛavinde la, Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Helekaya nwunle buluku ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɔluale Mosisi anwo zo ɔvale ɔmanle la wɔ nu la.

english_verse: Hilkiah handed the book to Shaphan the official and said, “Look what I found here in the temple—The Book of God's Law.”
translation_verse: Helekaya zele Hyeefan mɔɔ le belemgbunli abɔlɔba ne la kɛ, “Menwu Mɛla buluku ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu;” na ɔvale buluku ne ɔmanle Hyeefan.

english_verse: They have collected the money from the temple and have given it to the men supervising the repairs.
translation_verse: Bɛwola ezukoa ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la na yɛva yɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnea gyima ne azo la nee gyimayɛvoma ne.”

english_verse: But there's something else, Your Majesty. The priest Hilkiah gave me this book.” Then Shaphan read it aloud.

english_verse: When Josiah heard what was in The Book of God's Law, he tore his clothes in sorrow.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne dele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla buluku ne anu la, ɔsuosuanle ye adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu.

english_verse: “The Lord must be furious with me and everyone else in Israel and Judah, because our ancestors did not obey the laws written in this book. Go find out what the Lord wants us to do.”
translation_verse: “Bɛbɔ me ti, Dwudama nee bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma ekyi mɔɔ ɛha la ati bɛhɔbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛdie mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile yɛ wɔ buluku ye mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la anwo la. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva yɛ nwo ɛya kpole, kɛ yɛ ze mɔ angola anli Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ zo, bɛanyɛ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la.”

english_verse: “Josiah, I am the Lord! And I intend to punish this country and everyone in it, just as this book says.
translation_verse: Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea suakpole ye nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala, na meava munzule ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ne anu la amuala meagua Dwudama anwo zo, kɛmɔ bɛgenga bɛhile belemgbunli ne ala la.

english_verse: The people of Judah and Israel have rejected me. They have offered sacrifices to foreign gods and have worshiped their own idols. I can't stand it any longer. I am furious.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi me ɛzonlenlɛ na bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne na bɛlua bɛ sa anloa gyima zo bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ bɛha me ɛya. Yemɔti mebadea azɛlɛ ɛhye azo amra kpalɛ kpalɛ. Bɛkpɔda me a menrɛdie!

english_verse: “Josiah, listen to what I am going to do. I noticed how sad you were when you heard that this country and its people would be completely wiped out. You even tore your clothes in sorrow, and I heard you cry.
translation_verse: ɛnlunle ɛ nwo na ɛbɛlɛle ɛ nwo aze wɔ me nyunlu, na suakpole ye nee menli ne mɔ mɔɔ mebadea bɛ la ati ɛlile nyane, ɛsuosuanle wɔ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu na ɛzunle la ati, medame noko medie wɔ ɛzunlɛ ne.”

english_verse: King Josiah called together the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dwosaya zoanle manle bɛhɔyieyiale Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm mgbanyima ne amuala.

english_verse: Then he went to the Lord's temple, together with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, the priests, and the Levites. Finally, when everybody was there, he read aloud The Book of God's Law that had been found in the temple.
translation_verse: Akee belemgbunli ne nee Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ, Gyɛlusalɛmma, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, nee menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, mgbolema nee koahweabanema hɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔmanle bɛgengale buluku ne mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛhilele bɛ.

english_verse: Then he asked the people of Jerusalem and Benjamin to make that same promise and to obey the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu nee Gyɛlusalɛm la dwazole na bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛkɛli zolɛ. Na Gyɛlusalɛmma yɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne nee bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne se la.

english_verse: Josiah destroyed all the idols in the territories of Israel, and he commanded everyone in Israel to worship only the Lord God. The people did not turn away from the Lord God of their ancestors for the rest of Josiah's rule as king.
translation_verse: Na Dwosaya yeyele munzule ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu la amuala guale, na ɔmanle menli ne zonlenle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nyamenle ne. Wɔ ye mekɛ zo amuala menli ne angakyi bɛ nzi anzi bɛ ze mɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛzonlenle ye dahuu.

english_verse: During the battle an Egyptian soldier shot Josiah with an arrow. Josiah told his servants, “Get me out of here! I've been hit.”
translation_verse: Wɔ konle ne anu, menli mɔɔ to ɛda la bie dole ye ɛda ne wɔle Belemgbunli Dwosaya; na belemgbunli ne zele ye sonla ne mɔɔ ka ye konle ehwili ne la kɛ, “Meboda na ye me fi konle ye anloa.”

english_verse: Neco sent the following message to Josiah: I'm not attacking you, king of Judah! We're not even at war. But God has told me to quickly attack my enemy. God is on my side, so if you try to stop me, he will punish you.
translation_verse: Niko zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔze Belemgbunli Dwosaya kɛ, “Dwuda belemgbunli, yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛnlɛ edwɛkɛ biala. Tɛ wɔmɔ ti yɛɛ melɛba a. Mɔɔ ɛha me la yɛɛ melɛba ɔ nwo zo a, yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛze me kɛ menyɛ ye waa. Mmatenda Nyamenle agyakɛ anu, na ɔgyi me nzi. Ɛtenda Nyamenle agyakɛ anu a, ɔbazɛkye wɔ.”

english_verse: Josiah commanded that Passover be celebrated in Jerusalem to honor the Lord. So, on the fourteenth day of the first month, the lambs were killed for the Passover celebration.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dwosaya luale Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu lile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛhunle Akpabɛnwo boane ne wɔ siane ne mɔɔ lumua la ye kenle bulu nee nna ne azo.

english_verse: When the people bring you their Passover lamb, you must kill it and prepare it to be sacrificed to the Lord. Make sure the people celebrate according to the instructions that the Lord gave Moses, and don't do anything to make yourselves unclean and unacceptable.
translation_verse: Bɛhu Akpabɛnwo mboane ne mɔ na bɛnlua bɛ nwo, na bɛboa bɛ mediema ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale Mosisi anwo zo ɔhanle la.”

english_verse: Josiah's officials also voluntarily gave some of their animals to the people, the priests, and the Levites as sacrifices. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, who were the officials in charge of the temple, gave the priests
translation_verse: Ye mgbanyima ne mɔ noko yeyele bɛ ahonle nu vale ninyɛne manle menli ne amuala, sɛlɛvolɛma ne, yɛɛ Livaema ne mɔ. english_verse: Conaniah, his two brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad were leaders of the Levites, and they gave the other Levites
translation_verse: Livaema mgbanyinli ɛhye mɔ: Konanaya, nee ɔ mediema Hyɛmaya nee Nɛtaniile, akee Hahyabaya, Gyiayɛle, yɛɛ Dwozabade vale mboane nee mbɔnkye mralɛ apenle nnu nee nlankɛ nyinli ɛya nnu manle Livaema ne kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu wɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne anu.

english_verse: When everything was ready to celebrate Passover, the priests and the Levites stood where Josiah had told them.
translation_verse: Mekɛ dwule kɛ akee bɛbɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne nzɛlɛlɛ bo la, sɛlɛvolɛma ne hɔgyinlanle bɛ bo zo ne, yɛɛ Livaema ne noko hɔle bɛ ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu, kɛmɔ belemgbunli ne zele bɛ la.

english_verse: Then the Levites killed and skinned the Passover lambs, and they handed some of the blood to the priests, who splattered it on the altar.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhunle Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia mboane mralɛ ne mɔ, na sɛlɛvolɛ ne liele mogya ne kpondenle na Livaema ne yele mboane ne mɔ nwoma.

english_verse: The Levites set aside the parts of the animal that the worshipers needed for their sacrifices to please the Lord, just as the Law of Moses required. They also did the same thing with the bulls.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhyɛle nane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu ne la bɛmanle menli ne, kɛmɔ bɛ mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ de la, amaa bɛava bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ Mosisi Mɛla buluku ne anu la. Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ bɛyɛle nlankɛ ne mɔ a.

english_verse: They sacrificed the Passover animals on the altar and boiled the meat for the other offerings in pots, kettles, and pans. Then they quickly handed the meat to the people so they could eat it.
translation_verse: Livaema ne dondonle Akpabɛnwo boane ne, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne se la, na bɛdonle azubɔdeɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ siase, danesɛne mgbole, nee ahyɛnze nu, na bɛvale bɛmanle menli ne amuala.

english_verse: All day long, the priests were busy offering sacrifices and burning the animals' fat on the altar. And when everyone had finished, the Levites prepared Passover animals for themselves and for the priests.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, akee bɛdonle bie bɛmanle bɛ nwo nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee Aalɔn abo zo amra ne, mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma ne la asa lɛ, bɛlɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu nee nane ɛnlome azu ne. english_verse: During the celebration some of the Levites prepared Passover animals for the musicians and the guards, so that the Levite musicians would not have to leave their places, which had been assigned to them according to the instructions of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king's prophet. Even the guards at the temple gates did not have to leave their posts.
translation_verse: Esafe abo zo amra ne noko ɛnee anye ɛbolo ɛlɛto edwɛne, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi, Esafe, Himan, nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛdutɛn hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne la. Nlenkɛ sinzavolɛma ne noko anvi bɛ bo zo ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛ mediema Livaema ne vale bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ rɛlɛle bɛ.

english_verse: So on that day, Passover was celebrated to honor the Lord, and sacrifices were offered on the altar to him, just as Josiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya hyehyɛle la, kenle ko ne bɛlile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, bɛbɔle ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo bɛmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: The worshipers then celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread for the next seven days.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale la lile ɛvoyia ne nee Angye Ɛvoyia ne kenle nsuu.

english_verse: People from Jerusalem and from towns all over Judah and Israel were there. Passover had not been observed like this since the days of Samuel the prophet. In fact, this was the greatest Passover celebration in Israel's history!
translation_verse: Sumunli Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Samoɛle mekɛ zo, bɛtɛdile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne zɛhae ɛlɛ. Arelemgbunli mɔɔ rale hɔle la, biala anli ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya, sɛlɛvolɛma ne, Livaema, Dwudama nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale, nee Gyɛlusalɛmma lile la.

english_verse: Some time later, King Neco of Egypt led his army to the city of Carchemish on the Euphrates River. And Josiah led his troops north to meet the Egyptians in battle.
translation_verse: Ɛhye amuala anzi, mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Dwosaya ɛwie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne boɛ yɛ la, Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Niko vale konle doale Kaakimehyema mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti ne anloa la, na Dwosaya vale ye ɛlɔnema hɔle kɛ ɔkadoa ye ɔ nee ye bɛaho.

english_verse: But Josiah ignored Neco's warning, even though it came from God! Instead, he disguised himself and marched into battle against Neco in the valley near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Noko Belemgbunli Dwosaya anzia, na ɔhakyile ɔ nwo sonla gyɛne kɛ ɔkadoa ye ɔ nee ye aho. Yeandie edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale duale Niko anloa manle ɔhanle la, na ɔ nee Niko ɛlɔnema ne bɔle konle zo wɔ Mɛgedo fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: They carried Josiah out of his chariot, then put him in the other chariot he had there and took him back to Jerusalem, where he soon died. He was buried beside his ancestors, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ye sonvolɛ ne yele ye vile konle ne anloa, ɔvale ye ɔradole ye konle ehwili ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la anu, na ɔ nee ye rale Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔhɔle ayile nu na bɛwulale ye mrɛlatɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ ze mɔ anu. Na Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛm amra amuala zunle ye.

english_verse: Jeremiah the prophet wrote a funeral song in honor of Josiah. And since then, anyone in Judah who mourns the death of Josiah sings that song. It is included in the collection of funeral songs.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya ɔdaye ɔhyehyɛle ɛzunlɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ wɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya anwo. translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dwosaya nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɛha, ye ɛbɛla kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle mɔɔ fane ye tieyɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne anwo, nee ye gyima mɔɔ ɔlile,

english_verse: is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne mɔɔ kɔdwu awieleɛ ne la, bɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda Arelemgbunli Tetedwɛkɛ Buluku ne anu.

english_verse: The message said: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven has made me the ruler of every nation on earth. He has also chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over any of his people who want to go back to Judah.
translation_verse: “Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse se, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛva maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la kɔsɔɔti ɛmaa me, na yeze me kɛ menzi ɛzonlenlɛ sua memaa ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la. Nyamenle menli biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nee ye ɛlua. Bɛmaa ye adenle kɛ ɔhɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar also carried off many of the valuable things in the Lord's temple, and he put them in his palace in Babylon.
translation_verse: Nɛbukadenɛza eza sesale ahyɛnze mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la dɔɔnwo hɔle Babelɔn na ɔhɔziele bɛ wɔ ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah. He arrested Jehoiakim and put him in chains, and he sent him to the capital city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza rale ɔ nwo zo na ɔhyele ye, ɔguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na ɔ nee ye hɔle Babelonia.

english_verse: The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔmanle Babelonia belemgbunli ne nee ye ɛlɔnema ne rale bɛ nwo zo bɛrahunle Dwuda mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandile bɛhɔveale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la kɔsɔɔti. Bɛanvavi kpavolɛ anzɛɛ bɛlɛra, anzɛɛ sonla koatee ko bɔbɔ. Bɛhunle bɛ muala.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar carried off everything that was left in the temple; he robbed the treasury and the personal storerooms of the king and his officials. He took everything back to Babylon.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhwenle debie biala mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, ngyikyi nee mgbole, nee ezukoa, belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, nee belemgbunli mgbanyima ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azua nu la bɛhɔle Babelɔn.

english_verse: In the spring of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had Jehoiachin arrested and taken to Babylon, along with more of the valuable items in the temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah king of Judah. King Zedekiah of Judah (
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlile ebia ne la ala anu, nyenyensuo mekɛ ne anu, Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza zoanle manle bɛhɔvale ye bɛhɔle Babelonia, na bɛsesale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu dwora nee ahyɛnze biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bɛhɔle, na bɛyɛle ɔ diema Zɛdikaya Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli. Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya (

english_verse: The survivors were taken to Babylonia as prisoners, where they were slaves of the king and his sons, until Persia became a powerful nation.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhyele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛangu bɛ la amuala nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia, na bɛmanle bɛhɔzonlenle Babelonia belemgbunli ne nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ toonwo ɔhɔdwule kɛ akee Pɛhyea Belemgbunli Maanle ne rale zolɛ la.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord his God and refused to change his ways, even after a warning from Jeremiah, the Lord's prophet.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔyɛle la anzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne anye, Ɛdɛnkɛma luale ye kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo dendɛle hilele ye, noko yeannu ɔ nwo. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ (

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya dele Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza mɔɔ manle ɔvale Nyamenle ɔhanle ndane la anwo atua. Ɔyɛle anzosesebɛ na ɔzuanle anyetele kɛ ɔnrɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma mgbanyinli ne mɔ nee menli kɔsɔɔti bɔle zɔhane ɛbɛla ne bie na bɛzukoale bɛyɛle munzule ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ yɛ la bie. Bɛvale evinli bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, mɔɔ yeyɛ ye nwuanzanwuanza la.

english_verse: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne, zoanle menli manle bɛrabɔle bɛ kɔkɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔse ye menli ne nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwunvɔne.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (
translation_verse: Noko bɛhɔle zo bɛzile menli mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle bɛ la amgbu, bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie bɛ edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛgolole Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne anwo toonwo bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya kpole mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ a.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.
translation_verse: Bɛdole senle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na bɛbubule Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ, na bɛyelale Belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, bɛzɛkyele ye ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la amuala.

english_verse: In the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord had Cyrus send a message to all parts of his kingdom. This happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had promised.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛvale Saelɛse bɛziele Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli la, ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo ɔhanle la yɛle zɔhane. Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle belemgbunli ne ahonle manle ɔbɔle nolo wɔ ye belemgbunli maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala anu na eza ɔhɛlɛle ɔhɔmanle bɛ kɛ:

english_verse: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven, who is also the God of Israel, has made me the ruler of all nations on earth. And he has chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over and encourage any of his people who want to go back to Jerusalem and help build the temple.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nee ye menli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ yɛ avinli la ɛdɛnla. Bɛmaa bɛ adenle bɛmaa bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la na bɛhɔzi Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko.

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Bɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala boale bɛ. Bɛmanle bɛ ahyɛnze mɔɔ bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ la, nane mɔɔ soa ninyɛne, aleɛ, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, yɛɛ akee ahunlundwolɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahɔbɔ azu la.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi Belemgbunli Saelɛse noko yele ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza yeyele hɔle la amuala manle bɛ. Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm hɔle la, ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔguale ye awozonle sua ne anu.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: Pɛhyea Belemgbunli Saelɛse manle bɛyele ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala bɛvindele na bɛvale bɛwulale Metelɛde, mɔɔ le belemgbunli ne gyasievolɛ la asa anu. Ɔdaye noko ɔdianle bɛ muala ɔwulale Hyɛhyebazaa, mɔɔ le Dwuda amɛnlado la asa anu.

english_verse: Here is a list of the families of temple workers whose descendants returned: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth, Keros, Siaha, Padon, Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub, Hagab, Shamlai, Hanan, Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah, Besai, Asnah, Meunim, Nephisim, Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur, Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha, Barkos, Sisera, Temah, Neziah, and Hatipha.
translation_verse: Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sonvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne: Zaeha, Hasufa, Tabeeyo, Kilɔso, Sayaha, Peedɔn, Lɛbeena, Hagaba, Akɛbe, Heegabe, Hyamelae, Heenan, Gedɛle, Geehaa, Riliaya, Rilizen, Nɛkoda, Gazam, Ɛza, Pasia, Bisae, Asena, Mɛyunem, Nɛfesem, Bakebɛke, Hakufa, Haahɛ, Bazelɛte, Mɛhaeda, Haahya, Baakɔso, Sesɛla, Tima, Nɛzaya, yɛɛ Hataefa.

english_verse: Here is a list of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn ngɛkɛlɛ abo zo amra mɔɔ ziale rale la ɛne: Soteeyae, Hasofɛlɛte, Pɛluda, Gyeeyala, Daakɔn, Gedɛle, Hyɛfataya, Hatele, Pokɛlɛte, Hazɛbayem, yɛɛ Emae.

english_verse: The families of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove that they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Eza sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike bie mɔɔ le Habaya, Hakɔzo, yɛɛ Bazeleeyae abo zo amra la rale. Menli ɛhye mɔ nleɛnleanle ngɛlata ne mɔ anu la bɛannwu bɛ mbusua ne mɔ aluma wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ anu, na ɔlua zolɛ bɛyele bɛ bɛvile sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne anu kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Amɛnlado ne zele bɛ kɛ bɛmmadi aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la bie kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ bie ɛva “Yulem” nee “Tɛmem” ɛbiza Nyamenle la.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ nlɔnuma ne mɔ radwule Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ wɔ nu la bie mɔ vale ahunlundwolɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne manle kɛ bɛva bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala.

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Akee sɛlɛvolɛma ne, Livaema ne, nee menli ne bie mɔ dɛnlanle Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye namunamu ne mɔ azo. Edwɛndolɛma, Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma, nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ hɔle bɛ azua zo, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔle bɛ azua zo.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yizilayɛma akee nyianle ɛleka dɛnlanle wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la, ye siane nsuu ne azo, bɛ muala bɛ nloa yiale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Na Gyɛhozadake ara nrenya Dwɔhyua, nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne, nee Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlɛbabɛle nee ye mbusuafoɔ zile Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne azukponle ne bieko, amaa bɛayela nane zolɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle sonla Mosisi Mɛla ne anu la.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnee bɛsulo menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ɛdeɛ, noko bɛzile azukponle ne wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala. Na bɛyelale nane wɔ zolɛ bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ biala.

english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Akee bɛlile Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛyelale nane bɛbɔle azu dahuu biala, kɛmɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne kile la.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Eza bɛyelale nane bɛbɔle azu ngakyile ngakyile ne mɔ, Siane Fofolɛ azubɔlɛ nee azu ngakyile mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu la amuala. Eza bɛvale awie biala ɔdaye ye ahunlundwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔrale la bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Kenle ne mɔɔ lumua siane nsuu ne anu la yɛɛ bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbɔ azu ne mɔ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma a, noko ɛnee bɛtɛwulale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne aze. Bɛbɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bo bieko

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Akee bɛvale ezukoa bɛmanle menli mɔɔ si sua la nee kapentama, yɛɛ bɛvale aleɛ, nza, nee nwole bɛhɔmanle menli mɔɔ wɔ Saedɛn nee Taya la, amaa bɛava sida mbaka mgbole bɛalua nyevile nye bɛvi Lɛbanɔn bɛara Dwɔpa. Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse a manle adenle kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Menli ne vi nlɔnu rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ, siane nwiɔ ne azo yɛɛ bɛbɔle sua ne ɛzilɛ bo a. Zɛlɛbabɛle, Dwɔhyua, nee bɛ mediema mɔɔ ɛha la, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ muala bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala zɔle nu kɛ bɛsi sua ne. Bɛvale Livaema mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ mɔɔ kɔ la kɛ bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Gyɛhu nee ɔ mra nee ɔ mediema, yɛɛ Kademeɛle nee ɔ mra bɔle nu bɛ nee Hɛneedade abo zo amra mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛle Livaema la nleanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛlɛsi ye bieko la azo.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne wula sua ne aze la, sɛlɛvolɛma ne wulale bɛ adɛladeɛ na bɛvale bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ, yɛɛ Livaema mɔɔ le Esafe abo zo amra la vale sɔnwosɔnwo na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi hyehyɛle la.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Bɛdole ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne bɛmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛzele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ, ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa Yizilayɛma dahuu.” Menli ne amuala deanle nu yele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adiabo ɛwulalɛ gyima ne abo.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli, Livaema mgbanyinli, nee mbusua mgbanyinli bie mɔ mɔɔ nwunle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua dɛba ne la nwunle kɛ bɛlɛwula Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aze bieko la, bɛzunle, bɛyele awolɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko anye liele.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Ɛzunlɛ nee anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne bɔle nu mɔɔ ɛnee akee awie ɛngola ɛnnwu ɛdeanlɛ mɔɔ kile ɛzunlɛ anzɛɛ anyelielɛ a, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee menli ne ɛlɛteɛdea di wulupe na bɛ ne pɛ gua.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛngulo Dwudama nee Bɛngyamanema edwɛkɛ la dele kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la ɛzia ɛra na bɛlɛsi Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛhɔle Zɛlɛbabɛle nee mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛhɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛboka bɛ yɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, ɔboalekɛ yɛsonle bɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la ala. Eza sumunli kɛ Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Yisahadɛn nee yɛ rale ɛke la, mekɛ biala yɛbɔ azu yɛmaa Nyamenle.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Na Zɛlɛbabɛle, Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ buale bɛ kɛ, “Yɛngyia bɛ moalɛ wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nu gyima biala anwo. Yɛdayɛ yɛbazi Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, kɛmɔ Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Saelɛse ɛze yɛ la.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛsɛkye Dwudama adwenle, na bɛhanle bɛ ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ ɛnee akee bɛkɔ gyima ne anwo bɔbɔ a bɛsulo.

english_verse: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work. Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle menli ɛkpa kɛ bɛdendɛ bɛtia bɛ na bɛzɛkye sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo adwenle ne. Bɛyɛle ɛhye, ɔvi Belemgbunli Saelɛse mekɛ zo toonwo ɔradwule Belemgbunli Dalayɛse mekɛ zo. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkyekyelɛ bieko anwo ngyegyelɛ

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛvale Zɛzɛse bɛziele Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli la, menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu mɔɔ ɛngulo Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma edwɛkɛ la hɛlɛle kɛlata hɔdoanle bɛ.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Eza mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ralile ebia ne la, Behyelam, Metelɛdate, Tabiile, nee menli bie mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ akpamo la hɛlɛle Yizilayɛma ati kɛlata hɔmanle belemgbunli ne. Bɛhɛlɛle kɛlata ne wɔ Arelam aneɛ nu yɛɛ bɛhilele ɔ bo bɛhilele belemgbunli ne a.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ kɛlata ne anu la ɛne: “Yɛlɛ yɛkamaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse.

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: “Yɛmaa Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ade kɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ vi wɔ maanle ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ anu lɔ rale la ɛhɔdɛnla aze wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛlɛkyekye suakpole zɔhane bieko. Ɛze kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛngyɛ na ade atua, yɛɛ bɛ ti yɛ se. Kɛkala, asɛɛ bɛwie ye bane ne mɔ boɛ yɛ yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ boɛ.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Yɛkulo kɛ belemgbunli te kɛ saa bɛwie suakpole ɛhye kyekye bieko na ye bane ne mɔ tɔ nuhua a, menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la ɛnrɛdua gua nu adwule anzɛɛ adwule biala bieko. Na ɛhye bamaa belemgbunli gya ne adɔ sinli.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛwɔ ɛke yɛmaa belemgbunli na yɛnrɛhulo kɛ ɛhye kɛzi la, yɛlɛ nzuzulɛ ɛhye yɛlɛbɛlɛ wɔ kɛ

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: ɛmaa bɛnleɛnlea wɔ mgbanyinli ngɛlata ne mɔ anu. Wɔ nuhua, ɛbanwu kɛ suakpole ɛhye azo amra ɛngyɛ na ade atua. Bɛ atuadelɛ ne vi tete, na bɛyɛ ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo bɛmaa arelemgbunli nee maanzinli zo neavolɛma. Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛzɛkyele suakpole ɛhye a.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Nana, saa ɛmaa adenle ɛmaa bɛkyekye suakpole ɛhye bieko, bɛdie ye bane ne bɛyia a, ɛbalɛ ɛ sa mgbane wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ.”

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne vale mualɛ ɛhye hɔmanle bɛ: “Melɛ mekamaa Amɛnlado Rilihɛm, kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Hyemehyae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea nee Yufileti Adɔleɛ la. Mebiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: “Me sa ɛha kɛlata ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle me la. Bɛgenga, bɛhile ɔ bo bɛhile me.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: “Memaa bɛnleɛnlea ngɛlata mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la anu kpalɛ na menwu kɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma lɛ tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛmbu arelemgbunli a. Bɛngyɛ na bɛade arelemgbunli nwo atua, yɛɛ mekɛ biala bɛgyegye kpalɛ.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Gyɛlusalɛm lɛ arelemgbunli anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ se a, na bɛziele maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti Adɔleɛ afoa nu la amuala. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛmanle menli duale adwule manle bɛ.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛ mɛla maa menli zɔhane mɔ ɛgyakyi gyima ne ndɛndɛ zo, yɛɛ eza ɔnle kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole ne bieko kɔkpula kɛ menwɔli mɛla bieko kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole ne la.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Nea boɛ, mmabu ɛ nye ɛgua edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo. Yɛ ye ndɛndɛ na bɛanyɛ bɛanzɛkye debie.”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛgengale Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse kɛlata ne bɛhilele Rilihɛm, Hyemehyae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ala la, ndɛndɛ ne ala, bɛhɔle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo zo na bɛholole bɛ nwo zo bɛmanle bɛgyakyile suakpole ne ɛkyekyelɛ. Bɛbɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ bo bieko

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Nyamenle Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛzilɛ hale ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule kɛ bɛvale Dalayɛse bɛziele Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle belemgbunli na ye ɛvolɛ nwiɔ ne azo.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Hagae nee Zɛkalaya, mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Yido la lua Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne duma nu lɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛlɛmaa Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm la.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Na Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlɛbabɛle nee Gyɛhozadake ara Dwɔhyua dwazole na bɛbɔle ɔ bo bieko kɛ bɛsi Nyamenle Sua ne wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nwiɔ ne boale bɛ.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Ndɛndɛ ne ala Yufileti Adɔleɛ Amɛnlado Tatenae, nee Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ arane mbɔlɔba rale Gyɛlusalɛm rabizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a manle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye ɛzilɛ zo bieko a?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Eza bɛbizale bɛ bɛliele menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsi sua ne la kɔsɔɔti aluma.

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Na ɛnee Nyamenle anye wɔ Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anwo zo la ati, bɛandua bɛ kɛ bɛmmasi sua ne. Bɛvale nwolɛ edwɛkɛ bɛhɔmanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛkendɛ bɛadie nwolɛ mualɛ kolaa na bɛkɛyɛ debie a bɛayɛ.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: “Yɛlɛ yɛkamaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse. Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛva anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: “Yɛmaa belemgbunli ade kɛ yɛhɔle Dwuda maanzinli nu na yɛhɔnwunle kɛ bɛlɛsi Nyamenle bedevinli ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bieko. Menli ne mɔ lɛ awolɛ mgbole a ɛlɛsi a na bɛfa mbaka mgbole bɛwulowula ye bane ne mɔ anu. Menli ne lɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenle, bɛdo bɛ rɛle aze yɛɛ bɛlɛsi sua ne a, na ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: “Yɛbizale bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ bɛhile yɛ ahenle mɔɔ manle bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la.

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Eza yɛbizale menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsi sua ne la aluma amaa yɛahɛlɛ menli mɔɔ li bɛ ti la aluma yɛarɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: “Na bɛbuale yɛ kɛ, ‘Yɛle Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la sonvolɛma. Yɛlɛsi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye mɔɔ bɛzile ye mɔmoane la bieko. Ɔle sua mɔɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli kpole bie a zile wiele a.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ hanle Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛya la ati, ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle Kyaledianli Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza. Na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔzɛkyele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye, na ɔhyele menli ne bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔhɔle Babelonia a.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Hyɛhyebazaa zɔhane a rawulale Nyamenle Sua ye aze wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke a, yɛɛ ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la yɛtɛgua zolɛ yɛtɛsi sua ye, yɛtɛnyianle yɛtɛwiele fee.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye ati saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnee ɔmaa bɛnleɛnlea ye ngɛlata ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ye ngɛlata ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la anu kɛ saa amgba Belemgbunli Saelɛse manle bɛ zɔhane mɛla ne kɛ bɛzi Nyamenle Sua ɛhye mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la bieko a. Na akee belemgbunli ɛmaa yɛnwu mɔɔ ɔkulo kɛ yɛyɛ ye wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo la.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile mɛla manle bɛnleɛnleanle ye ngɛlata mɔɔ wɔ ye ngɛlata ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la anu.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Na bɛnwunle mɛla ne wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛkebatana mɔɔ wɔ Midea maanzinli nu la kɛ bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ nu:

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Bɛva awolɛ mgbole bɛdo ye fadum ɛhonlone nsa na bɛva mbaka bɛzɔ zolɛ ɛhonlone ko. Nwolɛ kakɛ ne amuala, bɛde bɛvi belemgbunli gya ne anu.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Akee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle, mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza yeyele bɛ vile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm rale Babelɔn la, bɛva bɛ muala bɛhɔzie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.’ ” Dalayɛse se bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛzi sua ne

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Dalayɛse vale mualɛ ɛhye hɔmanle bɛ. Ɔse, “Melɛ mekamaa Yufileti Adɔleɛ Amɛnlado Tatenae, nee Hyita Bɔzenae, nee bɛdabɛ arane mbɔlɔba kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ maanzinli ne anu la. Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ nwo.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa bɛ nwo bɛdielie Nyamenle Sua ɛhye ɛzilɛ nu. Bɛmaa Dwuda amɛnlado ne nee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛzi Nyamenle Sua ɛhye bieko wɔ ɔ bo zo ne ala.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la, saa nlankɛ nyinli o, mboane o, anzɛɛ mboane mralɛ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la o, hwiiti, ngyenle, nwanye, anzɛɛ nwole, kɛmɔ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kpondɛ la, fa maa bɛ kenle biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza la, mmamaa ɔkpa nwolɛ fee,

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: amaa bɛabɔ azu mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anye na bɛazɛlɛ bɛamaa belemgbunli nee ɔ mra mrenya kpalɛyɛlɛ.
