english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Akee meli mɛla ɛhye kɛ: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhakyi mɛla ne mɔɔ meli la, bɛhwe ye sua ne anu mgbunla ne mɔ ko, bɛzinzi ɔ ti na bɛva bɛwɔ ɔ kunlu bɛmaa ɔvinde ɔ nzi, na akee bɛgologolo ye sua ne bɛgua.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɔdaye yehyehyɛ kɛ ye duma ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la, ɛmaa bɛdu belemgbunli anzɛɛ bɛhu maanlema mɔɔ kɛdwazo kɛ bɛsɛkye mɛla ɛhye, anzɛɛ bɛsɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la. Medame Dalayɛse a meyɛ mɛla ɛhye a. Bɛmaa awie biala ɛli zolɛ kpalɛ.” Bɛdu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛwula Nyamenle asa anu

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ hɔle sua ne ɛzilɛ zo na bɛhɔle bɛ nyunlu kpalɛ. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Hagae nee Yido ara Zɛkalaya a ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ a. Bɛwiele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne hyehyɛle la nee mɛla mɔɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle arelemgbunli nsa ne, Saelɛse, Dalayɛse, nee Atazɛzɛse lile la se la.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne si wɔ siane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Eda la anu, ye kenle nsa ne azo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Dalayɛse ɛli ɛvolɛ nsia wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo la.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Na menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la, sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la vale anyelielɛ bukele Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne na bɛdule bɛwulale Nyamenle asa anu.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɔ sua ne ɛbukelɛ nee ye ɛdulɛ mɔɔ bɛtu bɛawula Nyamenle asa anu la, bɛvale nlankɛ nyinli ɛya ko, mboane nyinli ɛya nwiɔ, yɛɛ mboane mralɛ ɛya nna a bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Nyamenle a. Akee bɛvale mbɔnkye nyinli bulu nee nwiɔ bɛbɔle ɛtanefakyɛ azu bɛmanle Nyamenle wɔ Yizilayɛma amuala ati. Bɛbɔle abusua ekpunli ko biala ati bɛvale abɔnkye ko bɛbɔle azu.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Akee bɛhyɛle sɛlɛvolɛma gyima ne bɛmanle bɛ. Bɛhyɛle bɛ nu ekpunli ekpunli. Bɛyɛle Livaema noko zɔhane ala, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi buluku ne anu mɔɔ fane Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo la. Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ bulu nee nna la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la lile Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema mɔɔ wɔ nu la nluanle bɛ nwo na bɛyɛle menli mɔɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu bɛ nwo ɛde a. Livaema ne a hunle Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia Boaneralɛ ne a, bɛbɔle azu ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ ti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi nlɔnu bɛra la ati, yɛɛ bɛ mediema sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ amuala ati.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ vi nlɔnu rale la nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu na bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛzonlenlɛ ɛtane ɛtane nwo na bɛra bɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne la, lile Akpabɛnwo aleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Bɛvale fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛlile Angye Ɛvoyia ne toonwo kenle nsuu. Bɛ nye liele, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛhakyi ye nyɛleɛ na yeboa bɛ yemaa bɛzi Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Bɛvi Babelonia bɛdule bɛ bo wɔ siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, na Nyamenle duma nu nee ye moalɛ zo, bɛradwule Gyɛlusalɛm siane nnu ne anu, ye kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Ɛzela le sɛlɛvolɛ nee kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛbe Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne anu a. Kɛlata mɔɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse hɛlɛle manle ye la ɛne:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Medame, Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye meamaa sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela mɔɔ le Anwuma Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ la a.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima nsuu ne mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la yɛɛ ɛzoa wɔ kɛ ɛhɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhɔnleɛnlea menli ne ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu kɛ bɛlɛdi Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ la azo a.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Eza fa dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔɔ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la ɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu ɛva ɛmaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua a wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la noko kɔ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Akee fa ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule biala mɔɔ ɛkɛnyia ye wɔ Babelonia nee azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma nee bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛbɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ati ɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu ɛva ɛmaa la amuala kɔ.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛ sa ka ezukoa ɛhye a, nea na fa tɔ nlankɛ nyinli, mboane nyinli, nee mboane mralɛ, abɛlɛ nee nwanye, na fa bɛ muala bɔ azu wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu azukponle ne azo.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛwie a, akee ɛ nee ɛ mediema Dwuuma ne mɔ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, kɛmɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛhulolɛdeɛ de la.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Akee debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛhyia nwolɛ wɔ wɔ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo mɔɔ hyia kɛ ɛkɔtɔ la, die ezukoa fi belemgbunli gya ne anu na fa kɔdɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: “Akee medame, Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse, meyɛ mɛla ɛhye na mese me gya sievolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ la amuala kɛ: Debie biala mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela, mɔɔ le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la Mɛla kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne kɛbiza bɛ la, bɛnlea na bɛyɛ ye gyɛlɛɛnye bɛmaa ye.

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Anwuma Nyamenle ne kɛhile kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la, bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛyɛ, amaa Nyamenle anva me nee me bo zo amra mɔɔ bali belemgbunli la anwo ɛya.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Eza bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdie sɛlɛvolɛma, Livaema, edwɛndolɛma, sinzavolɛma, nee gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anwo la adwule biala.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ Ɛzela, dua Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa wɔ la azo ye menli mɔɔ ze wɔ Nyamenle ne Mɛla ne la, yɛ bɛ edwɛkɛdivolɛma nee ndɛnebuavolɛma maa bɛnlea bɛmaa pɛlepɛle ɛrɛla menli mɔɔ wɔ Yufileti Adɔleɛ la avinli. Na kilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze mɛla ne la amuala.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ anli wɔ Nyamenle ne mɛla zo anzɛɛ anli belemgbunli ne mɛla zo la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ anzɛɛ bɛtu ye bɛfi maanle ne anu, anzɛɛ bɛsa ye bɛdie ɔ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, anzɛɛ bɛto ye efiade.” Ɛzela ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Ɛzela zele kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne. Yemaa Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ahonle kpalɛ kɛ ɔli Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la eni wɔ adenle zɛhae anu.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo, menyia me nyunlu wɔ belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ tu ye folɛ la, yɛɛ ye mbɔlɔba mgbole ne mɔ anyunlu. Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne ɛmaa me anwosesebɛ, na ɔlua zolɛ medame noko menzile ahonle na memboɔboale Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli ne bie mɔ anloa na me nee bɛ ziale rale.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Mbusua mgbanyinli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia mɔɔ nee me ziale rale Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse mekɛ zo la aluma ɛne:

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nwo te wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ noko anwo te. Dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee ezukoa nvutuke ne le azubɔlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahɔbɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Memboɔboale menli ne amuala anloa wɔ azule ne mɔɔ bɛdukue ye na ɔse ɔkɔ Aheeva sua zo la anloa, na yɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne kenle nsa. Meneɛnleanle menli ne mɔ nee sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ anu la, menwunle kɛ Livaenli biala ɛnle nu.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati menvɛlɛle mgbanyima ngɔnla nee kilehilevolɛma nwiɔ. Mgbanyima ne mɔ a le Ɛlieza, Ɛleɛle, Hyɛmaya, Ɛleneetan, Gyɛlebe, Ɛleneetan, Neetan, Zɛkalaya, yɛɛ Mehyɛlam; menli ɛhye mɔ le mbusua mgbanyinli. Akee menvɛlɛle Dwɔyalebe nee Ɛleneetan kɛ bɛle kilehilevolɛma.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Menzoanle bɛ wɔ Kasefaya wɔ Dwuuma kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yedo la ɛkɛ ne. Menvale nrɛlaleɛ memanle bɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa Yedo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sonvolɛma ne kɛ bɛva sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛraboka yɛ nwo.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Na ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo, bɛvale Hyɛlibaya, mɔɔ le Livae ara Malae abusua nu amra ne bie, mɔɔ lɛ adwenle na ɔle Yizilayɛnli tɛnyetɛnye la, yɛɛ ɔ mra nee ɔ mediema ne mɔ bɛrɛlɛle yɛ, bɛlua bulu nee mɔtwɛ.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Eza bɛvale Hahyabaya nee Gyɛhyaya mɔɔ vi Mɛlɛlae abusua nu la, nee bɛ mediema nee bɛ nwo amra mɔɔ dwu abulanwiɔ la bɛrɛlɛle yɛ.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Aheeva azule ne anloa yɛɛ mengyehyɛle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ muala yɛkye ɛhɔne na yɛbɛlɛ yɛ nwo aze wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlu na yɛsɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔnlea yɛ, yɛ mra nee yɛ nwo ninyɛne zo na ɔzinza yɛ wɔ yɛ adendulɛ nu a.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛhyele ɛhɔne yɛvale yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ yɛdole Nyamenle anyunlu, na ɔdiele yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Akee menyele sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli bulu nee nwiɔ. Bɛmɛ a le Hyɛlibaya nee Hahyabaya, nee bɛ nwo amra bulu.

english_verse: Then I weighed the gifts that had been given for God's temple, and I divided them among the twelve priests I had chosen. There were gifts of silver and gold, as well as the articles that the king, his advisors and officials, and the people of Israel had contributed. In all there were:
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ menzuzule memanle bɛ la ɛne: dwɛtɛ fufule - Tɔno abulanwiɔ nee nwiɔ dwɛtɛ fufule ahyɛnze ɛya ko - kilo abulasuu ezukoa nvutuke - Kilo apenle nsa, ɛya nna ezukoa nvutuke ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu abulanwiɔ-Kilo mɔtwɛ nee foa ko kɔbele ahyɛnze akunlu kuloonwu nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ bɛmaa bɛ kɛnlɛma ɛyɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke la

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea bɛ boɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛzuzu bɛ pɛpɛ pɛpɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛkɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli, Livaema, nee Yizilayɛma mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ la.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Livaema ne liele dwɛtɛ fufule ne, ezukoa nvutuke ne, nee ninyɛne ne mɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛahɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛsia bɛara Gyɛlusalɛm

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la anu kenle bulu nee nwiɔ ne azo yɛɛ yɛvi Aheeva azokoɛleɛ ne yɛzile nu kɛ yɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a. Yɛ Nyamenle ne lole yɛ na ɔzinzale yɛ, ɔbɔle yɛ nwo bane wɔ yɛ adendulɛ nu, na ɔliele yɛ ɔvile yɛ agbɔvolɛ nee nwule sa nu.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Yemɔti yɛhɔdwule Gyɛlusalɛm na yɛliele yɛ ɛnwomenle kenle nsa.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nna ne azo yɛzuzule dwɛtɛ fufule ne, ezukoa nvutuke ne, nee ninyɛne ne mɔ yɛwulale sɛlɛvolɛ Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Yulaya ara ne asa anu wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anu. Fenɛhase ara Ɛlieza yɛɛ Livaema nwiɔ, Gyɛhyua ara Dwozabade nee Benuwae ara Nowadaya wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Eza bɛvale belemgbunli kɛlata ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la bɛmanle mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli nee amɛnladoma mɔɔ nea maanzinli ne mɔ azo wɔ Azule Yufileti Adɔleɛ la. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛboale Yizilayɛma ne mɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne ɛzilɛ nu.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ yɛwiele la, Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne bie mɔ rale me nwo ɛkɛ ne razele me kɛ Yizilayɛma, sɛlɛvolɛma, nee Livaema bie mɔ ɛtɛtwenle bɛ nwo ɛtɛfile menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la munzule ɛbɛla ne mɔ anwo. Menli ɛhye mɔ a le Keenama, Hɛtema, Pɛlɛzema, Gyibɛsema, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, Yigyibitima, yɛɛ Amɔlema.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Dwuuma bie mɔ ɛgya azɛlɛ ne azo amra bie mɔ amra mraalɛ na bɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya noko ɛgya bɛ mra mraalɛ, ɔlua zolɛ yemaa menli nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye mɔ nee azɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛli afonla. Nyɛleɛ ɛtane zɛhae, mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba ne mɔ bɔbɔ a yɛle ye kpalɛ a.

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Mendele ɛhye na ɛya mɔɔ hunle me nee me nwo mɔɔ yelɛyelale me la manle mensuosuanle me tɛladeɛ mɔɔ mewula la anu na mendudule me ti nee me kɛsa enrinli. Nyane nee arɛlebɔlɛ wiele me kyekye na mendɛnlanle aze koonwu.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle dule wɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha wɔ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ vi nlɔnu ɛra la ɛyɛ la anwo la bɔle yiale me, na yɛ muala yɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔhɔdwule nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Ɔdwule nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne la, menvile ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee mede melɛkye ɛhɔne ne la mendwazole, menvale me tɛladeɛ suosuanlera ne ala mengotole, mendɛlɛle me sa nu na menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne kɛ,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: “O me Nyamenle, ɔyɛ me anyiemgba na ɔyɛ me nyiane bɔbɔ kɛ menwɔkpogya me nye zo menwɔnlea wɔ a, ɔluakɛ yɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne ɛbo zolɛ na yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Ɔvi yɛ nlenya mɔ mekɛ zo toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la, yɛvo dɔɔnwo kpalɛ. Ɔlua yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, yɛdayɛ o, yɛ arelemgbunli, nee yɛ sɛlɛvolɛma o, yɛ muala yɛdɔ donvula wɔ arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la asa anu. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛhu yɛ bie mɔ, bɛkpokpo yɛ, bɛhye yɛ bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu, bɛhile yɛ nyane, bɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, wɔ mekɛ ekyi ye anu, wɔlo yɛ na wɔmaa yɛ bie mɔ ɛvi akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu kɛ bɛradɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ɛhye. Wɔ yɛ akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu, ɛmanle yɛ nwo kpundinle yɛ, amaa yɛabɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle ahanra la, yɛ Nyamenle ne arɛle amkpa yɛ nwo zo. Wɔmaa wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛdenrɛ yɛ nwo zo wɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle arelemgbunli anyunlu. Ɔlua zolɛ bɛbɔ yɛ ɛwɔkɛ na bɛmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ kɛ yɛzi yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ ɛbubu la, na yɛyɛ ye boɛ, na wɔazinza yɛ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm amuala.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: “Na kɛkala, O Nyamenle, duzu edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ akee yɛha wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi a? Yɛtietia wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: ɛluale wɔ ngɛkɛlɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ kɛ, ‘Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ bɛahɔva la le azɛlɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la ɛva munzule ɛbɛla ɛzɛkye ye, ɔvi ɔ ti yehɔdwu ɔ bo a.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mrenya gya ɛkɛ ne mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bie, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ mra mraalɛ gya ɛkɛ ne mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bie. Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ nee anzonudwolɛ anzɛɛ ɛkpazilɛ, amaa bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ nwo ayɛ se bɛadidi azɛlɛ ne azo na bɛagyakyi bɛazie bɛ mra nee bɛ nlɔnra wɔ mekɛ biala.’

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Ndeanlɛ biala mɔɔ wɔva wɔdea yɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ ɛzi yɛ nwo zo wɔ yɛ ɛtane nee yɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati la le ekyi, ɛhye ati yɛɛ kɛkala yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛha la yɛtɛte aze a.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Saa ye zɛhae a ɛnee yɛbulu wɔ mɛla ne azo bieko na yɛsia yɛ nee amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ gyigya yɛ nwo a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ. Yɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛbava ɛya kpole na wɔazɛkye yɛ mɔɔ yɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha a.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, wɔmɔ ɛdi pɛlepɛle, noko wɔnwu yɛ anwunvɔne wɔva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔhyɛ yɛ wɔmaa yɛdayɛ ekyi mɔɔ yɛha la yɛtɛte ngoane nu. Yɛka yɛto gua kɛ yɛdi fɔlɛ na yɛnfɛta ɛ nyunlu.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛzela ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne na ɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ ɔlɛka ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, ɔweweɛ ɔ nwo aze wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mraalɛ nee mrenya, nee ngakula, rabɔle yiale ye, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛzunle bɛmanle ɔyɛle alɔbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Na Gyɛhayɛle mɔɔ le Yilam asa azo ne mɔ ko la ara Hyɛkanaya zele Ɛzela kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia Nyamenle kɛ yɛgya nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo mraalɛ ne bie mɔ a, noko Yizilayɛma lɛ anyelazo.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛvua yɛhile yɛ Nyamenle ne na yɛbɔ mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ ewole na yɛvoa bɛ mra ne mɔ, na yɛlua Nyamenle mɛla ne azo yɛyɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ nee menli mɔɔ sulo yɛ Nyamenle ne la kɛha la.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Dwazo na gyima ne le wɔ gyima. Yɛgyi ɛ nzi, yemɔti si wɔ ahonle yɛ.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Na Ɛzela dwazole na ɔmanle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyima, Livaema, nee Yizilayɛma ne mɔ hanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ Hyɛkanaya ɛzuzu la.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛzela vile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu na ɔhɔle Yilayahyebe ara Gyihoheenan sua nu. Ɔlale ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ne nɔe ne, noko yeanli debie yɛɛ yeanno nzule. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔlɛdi nyane wɔ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la yɛle la anwo.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle nolo wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu mɔɔ bɛzia bɛra la kenle nsa kɛ bɛrayia Gyɛlusalɛm. Awie biala mɔɔ kenle nsa ne azo yeamba la, mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛmaa bɛza ye bɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, na bɛdua ye wɔ maanlema avinli.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Dwuda nee Bɛngyaman maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala rayiale Gyɛlusalɛm kenle nsa ne azo. Kenle ne le siane ngɔnla ne ye kenle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ abulanwiɔ la. Na menli ne amuala dɛnlanle aze wɔ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Sua ne anyunlu la. Edwɛkɛ ne anwo ahunlundetelɛ nee ezule mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛtɔ kpole la manle bɛ nwo wozole bɛ.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Na sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela dwazole na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo mɛla kɛ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ a. Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma fɔlɛlilɛ ne akee ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛha bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhile Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ ze mɔ Nyamenle ne, na bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la. Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la anwo na bɛgyakyi bɛ nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgyigya bɛ la.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Na menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala deanle nuhua kɛ, “ Ɔle zɔhane; ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔha la.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Noko menli ne zonle, yɛɛ ezule ne ɛlɛtɔ kpole. Yɛnrɛhola nuhua gyinla zɛhae. Eza noko ɔnle kenle ko anzɛɛ kenle nwiɔ gyima. Ɔluakɛ yɛvo kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Bɛye mgbanyima bɛzie Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke bɛmaa bɛgyinla menli ne kɔsɔɔti agyakɛ anu na bɛhile kenle bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la ɛrɛla ɛranwu bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhile la anu. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhile sua biala azo amra la, saa bɛlɛba a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nee sua ne azo mgbanyima nee ndɛnebuavolɛma a ba a. Na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane kɔkpula kɛ Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne mɔɔ yeva wɔ ɛhye anwo la kɛha aze la.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Asahɛle ara Dwɔnatan nee Tɛkeva ara Gyɛzaya ala yɛɛ tiale nzuzulɛ ɛhye a, yɛɛ Mɛhyɛlam nee Livaenli Hyabɛtae vuale bɛ nzi.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛzia bɛra la yɛle mɔɔ bɛha la. Sɛlɛvolɛ Ɛzela yele mbusua mgbanyinli vale bɛ zieziele bɛ ze mɔ awuke ne mɔ ati na bɛhɛlɛhɛlɛle bɛ aluma. Siane bulu ne anu kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛneɛnlea edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Na ɔkadwu siane nsa ne azo la ɛnee bɛwie edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la anwo la ka. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛgya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ la ɛne

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ ewole, na bɛvale boane nyinli ko kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo azu.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Yemɛ abusua nu amra: Haneenae yɛɛ Zɛbadaya

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Hɛlem abusua nu amra: Meeyasaya, Yilaegya, Hyɛmaya, Gyɛhayɛle, yɛɛ Ɛzaya

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pahyɔ abusua nu amra: Ɛleyoyinae, Meeyasaya, Yehyemeeyɛle, Nɛtanile, Dwozabade, yɛɛ Ɛleesa

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Livaema: Dwozabade, Hyemɛyae, Kɛlaya , Pɛtahaya, Dwuda, yɛɛ Ɛleyizɛ

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Edwɛndolɛma: Yilayahyebe Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sinzavolɛma: Hyalɛm, Tilɛm, yɛɛ Yulae

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛha la: Pɛlɔhye abusua nu amra: Relamaya, Yezaya, Malekaya, Megyamem, Ɛlieza, Malekaegya, yɛɛ Bɛnaya

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Yilam abusua nu amra: Matanaya, Zɛkalaya, Gyɛhayɛle, Abedae, Gyɛlɛmo, yɛɛ Yilaegya

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zatu abusua nu amra: Ɛleyoyinae, Yilayahyebe, Matanaya, Gyɛlɛmo, Zeebade, yɛɛ Azaeza

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bibeyae abusua nu amra: Gyihoheenan, Hananaya, Zabeeyae, yɛɛ Ateleeyae

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Beenae abusua nu amra: Mɛhyɛlam. Malɛke, Adaya, Gyahyɛbe, Hyiale, yɛɛ Gyɛlɛmo

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Peehate Mowabe abusua nu amra: Adena, Kilale, Bɛnaya, Meeyasaya, Matanaya, Bɛzalile, Benuwae, yɛɛ Manasɛ

english_verse: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Hɛlem abusua nu amra: Ɛleyizɛ, Yehyaegya, Malekaegya, Hyɛmaya, Hyemɛyɔn, Bɛngyaman, Malɛke, yɛɛ Hyɛmalaya

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hahyɛm abusua nu amra: Matinae, Matata, Zeebade, Yilefɛlɛte, Gyɛlimae, Manasɛ, yɛɛ Hyemɛyae

english_verse: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Beenae abusua nu amra: Meeyadeeyae, Amelam, Yuwɛle, Bɛnaya, Bɛdaya, Kɛluhae, Vanaya, Mɛlɛmo, Yilayahyebe, Matanaya, Matinae, yɛɛ Gyeeyasu.

english_verse: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;
translation_verse: Benuwae abusua nu amra: Hyemɛyae, Hyɛlimaya, Neetan, Adaya, Makenadɛbae, Hyahyae, Hyɛleeyae, Azalile, Hyɛlimaya, Hyɛmalaya, Hyalɛm, Amalaya, yɛɛ Dwosefi

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nibo abusua nu amra: Gyiyayɛle, Matetaya, Zeebade, Zɛbaena, Gyeedae, Dwowɛle, yɛɛ Bɛnaya

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛnee gya nyɛvolɛ mraalɛ. Bɛbɔle bɛ ewole na bɛmanle bɛ nee bɛ mra ziale hɔle.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: This be be work the Hacaliah son Nehemiah year the of word the his said the. Nehemiah consider Jerusalem of In month the the, the be Artaxerxes, Persia Nation Nation King the old year twenty in throne of the, i, Nehemiah, be here i am nation the city Susa the.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Me mediema mrenya ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Haneenae la nee menli bie vi Dwuda rale. Membizale bɛ kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm si de la, nee kɛ mediema Dwudama mɔɔ nriandile na bɛanva bɛ donvula bɛangɔ Babelonia la agbɔkɛ nu si de la.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Na bɛzele me kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ bɛangye bɛ donvula na bɛwɔ sua nu la de nyiane nee anwongyelelɛ nu. Bɛbubu Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛyela ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mendele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, mendɛnlanle aze na menzunle menyele awolɛ kpalɛ na menlile nyane kenle dɔɔnwo; mengɔle zolɛ mengyele ɛhɔne menzɛlɛle Nyamenle

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: menzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma, mɔɔ ɛle nwanwane, ɛle bedevinli a; wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛsie wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne nee wɔ ɛhulolɛ ne kpundii ɛmaa menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ na bɛdi wɔ mɛla zo la a,

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: gyele ɛ nzo tie wɔ sonvolɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ mefa meado ɛ nyunlu nɔɔzo nee ewiazo meamaa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma la, na nea yɛ. Ɛ mra Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia wɔ. Ɛhɛe, medame, me nee egya awuke nu amra bɔbɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ amumuyɛ kpole kpalɛ yɛtia wɔ, yɛɛ yɛnli wɔ mɛla ne nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi la azo.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ wɔ, kakye mɔɔ ɛhanle ɛhilele wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi la kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma, saa bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me a mebabɔ bɛ asande meagua maanle maanle zo;

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: na saa bɛsia bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo a, yemɔ saa kanza bɔbɔ bɛbɔle asande bɛhɔle maanle ti nee maanle bo a, mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meava bɛ meahɔgua ɛleka ne mɔɔ medame meye mezie ɛkɛ ne memaa bɛ la, amaa me duma ne aha ɛkɛ ne dahuu.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: “Bɛle wɔ sonvolɛma nee wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛdawɔ wɔva wɔ tumi kpole ne nee wɔ anwosesebɛ ne wɔlie bɛ a.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: O Awulae, gyele ɛ nzo tie wɔ sonvolɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ, na tie wɔ sonvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ wɔ duma ne anwo ɛzulolɛ la nzɛlɛlɛ; maa saleɛ ɛdoa wɔ sonvolɛ na maa maanle maanle belemgbunli ne ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne ɛnɛ.” Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee mame a mesu belemgbunli ne nza a.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Wɔ siane Naesan ne anu, wɔ Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ye ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ ne azo, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkpula ɔ sa la, menvale nwanye mengɔmanle ye. Ɛnee kenle ko bɔbɔ ɔtɛnwunle me kɛ melɛdi nyane ɛlɛ.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔbizale me kɛ, “Ɛ nwo ɛtɛtole wɔ, ɛte kpɔkɛ, na duzu ati yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ zɛhae a? Tɛ ɛhwee ɔ, ɛlɛdi nyane kpole kpalɛ wɔ wɔ ahonle nu.” Ɛzulolɛ hanle me kpole

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: na membuale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ. Me nwo ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ le nenya mɔ sɛfonle la ɛdɔ mgbane; na ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛyela.”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne bizale me kɛ, “Duzu a menyɛ memaa wɔ a?” Menzɛlɛle anwuma anwuma Nyamenle ne

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: na menganle mengilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Saa medame, wɔ sonvolɛ anyunlu ɛra anyia wɔ ɛ nyunlu, na eza saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnee soa me wɔ Dwuda, wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ le nenya mɔ sɛfonle zo la azo, amaa meahɔkyekye suakpole ne bieko.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne zele me kɛ , “Ɛkɔ a ɛbali kenle nyɛ, yɛɛ kenlenzu fɔɔnwo yɛɛ ɛbazia wɔara a?” Na menwunle kɛ ɔyɛ belemgbunli ahunlundwolɛ kɛ ɔkɛmaa menwɔhɔ; yemɔti mengilele ye mekɛ.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Na menzɛlɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ belemgbunli ahunlundwolɛ a, ɛnee maa bɛhɛlɛ ngɛlata bɛmaa mengɔmaa amɛnladoma mɔɔ sie maanzinli ne mɔ mɔɔ gua Azule Yufileti adɔleɛ la, amaa bɛamaa me adenle bɛamaa meapɛ nuhua bɛ maanzinli ne mɔ anu meahɔ Dwuda.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Eza maa bɛhɛlɛ kɛlata bɛhɔmaa Esafe mɔɔ sinza belemgbunli kpɔkɛmile ne la, amaa yeamaa me mbaka na meakpakyekpakye meayɛ mgbunla meaduodua aranemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la nlenkɛ mgbole ne, bane ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne, yɛɛ sua ne mɔɔ mebadɛnla nuhua la nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.” Belemgbunli ne yɛle mɔɔ membizale ye biala la manle me, ɔluakɛ ɛnee me Nyamenle ne nee me lua.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli yele safohyenle mgbanyinli nee menli ekpunli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la manle bɛ nee me hɔle. Membale amɛnladoma mɔɔ sie maanzinli ne mɔ mɔɔ gua Azule Yufileti adɔleɛ la ɛkɛ. Menvale belemgbunli ngɛlata ne mɔ memanle bɛ.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Sanebalate mɔɔ vi Bɛte Hɔlɔn, nee Tobaya, mɔɔ le belemgbunli mbɔlɔba ne mɔ ko, mɔɔ vi Amɔn maanzinli nu la dele kɛ awie ɛra Yizilayɛma boɛyɛlɛ ti la, bɛvale ɛya kpole.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Yemɔti membale Gyɛlusalɛm membanlile kenle nsa.

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: Mendwazole nɔe ne na menvale menli ekyi bie menlile me nzi menvindele. Deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛwula me kɛ menyɛ memaa Gyɛlusalɛm la, meanga meangile bɛ. Yɛanva ayɛmoa biala yɛangɔ kɛ ayɛmoa ne mɔɔ mendɛnlanle zolɛ la ala.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Menvindele nɔe ne la, menvale Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu mengɔle Nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ Ɛlɛnrɛne la Nzufeanvea ne anwo na mengɔle Ewula Anlankɛ Kpole ne anloa. Meneɛnleanle Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbubu bɛ la nee nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyela bɛ la.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Akee mentelele zolɛ mengɔle Nzufeanvea Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa na mengɔle Belemgbunli Nzubula ne anwo; na ɛnee akee adenle biala ɛnla ɛkɛ mɔɔ ayɛmoa ne mɔɔ mede zolɛ la dua nu a ɔyɛ boɛ a.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Akee menluale bɔnza ne anloa nɔe ne na meneanle bane ne, na menvale Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa menziale me nzi.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Sua ne azo mgbanyima ne annwu ɛleka mɔɔ mengɔle nee deɛ mɔɔ mengɔnyɛle la, yɛɛ ɛnee eza metɛkanle deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti membale la metɛkilele Dwuuma ne, sɛlɛvolɛma, menli mɔɔ di munli, mgbanyima nee menli mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ bayɛ gyima ne la.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Na nzinlii akee menzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛ nye dua ngyianlɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ nuhua la. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyɛ suadu; bɛyela ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛyɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ boɛ na yɛye yɛ nwo yɛvi nyiane kpole ɛhye anu.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ me Nyamenle ne li me nzi na menganle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne hanle hilele me la mengilele bɛ. Na bɛzele me kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛdwazo yɛyɛ bane ne mɔ boɛ.” Na bɛboɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛbɔ gyima ne abo.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sanebalate mɔɔ vi Hɔlɔn, Amɔnonli Tobaya mɔɔ le sonvolɛ nee Arelabenli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gihyɛm la dele gyima mɔɔ yɛhyehyɛ kɛ yɛyɛ la, bɛgolole yɛ nwo, bɛzile yɛ amgbu na bɛzele kɛ, “Duzu debie a bɛlɛyɛ a? Ɛnee bɛlɛte belemgbunli ne anwo atua ɔ?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Membuale bɛ kɛ, “Anwuma Nyamenle ne bakpogya yɛ sa zo amaa yɛ, ye sonvolɛma, yɛdwazo yɛayɛ bane ne mɔ boɛ. Na bɛmɛ, ɔnyɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ; bɛnlɛ agyadeɛ anzɛɛ sɛfonle biala wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛliele Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ la ɛne: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Yilayahyebe nee ɔ mediema sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ zile Mboane Anlenkɛ Kpole ne. Bɛvale ɛbonle ne mɔ bɛduoduale bɛ, na bɛdule bɛwulale Nyamenle asa anu. Bɛyɛle ye zɔhane toonwo bɛrale Tawa Ɛya ne anwo na bɛdwule Hananile Tawa ne anwo noko.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Gyɛleko amra yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ. Yemelae ara Zakɛ yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasɛnaya sua nu amra zile Fɛlɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne. Bɛzile felɛmo ne, bɛduale anlenkɛ ne kɔlɔkɔlɔ, na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale ɔ nzi.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Yulaya ara Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Hakɔzo anlɔnra ne yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ. Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam, mɔɔ le Mɛhyɛzabili anlɔnra ne yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ. Beeyana ara Zeedɔko yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tɛkowa sua nu amra yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ, noko Tɛkowa ezuavolɛ mgbanyima ne anva bɛ sa anga gyima ne mɔɔ bɛ menle mɔ vale wulale bɛ sa nu la.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasia ara Gyɛhɔyada nee Bisodaya ara Mɛhyɛlam a yɛle Gyɛhyana Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ a. Bɛzile felɛmo ne, bɛduale ye ɛbonle, bɛvale kɔlɔkɔlɔ bɛduale ye, na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale ɔ nzi.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Mɛlataya mɔɔ vi Gebɛyɔn, Gyeedɔn mɔɔ vi Mɛlono, yɛɛ Gebɛyɔnoma nee Mezepama mɔɔ wɔ amɛnlado ne mɔɔ sie maanle ne mɔɔ wɔ Azule Yufileti anzi nehane la abo la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Haahaya ara nrenya sukoadwinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛzeɛle la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ. Hananaya, mɔɔ yɛ anatele nee sakyeɛ evuanlɛ gyima la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule Bane Tɛtɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Huule ara Relɛfaya, mɔɔ sie Gyɛlusalɛm maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Halumafe ara Gyɛdaya, yɛle mɔɔ nee ye sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ. Hahyabeenaya ara Hatɛhye, yɛle mɔɔ zua Gyɛdaya ɛdeɛ ne la boɛ.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Hɛlem ara Malekaegya nee Hahyɛbe, mɔɔ le Peehate Mowabe ara nrenya ne, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ na bɛzile Fonlomo Tawa ne.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohɛhye ara Hyalɛm, mɔɔ sie Gyɛlusalɛm maanzinli ne foa ko la nee ɔ mra mraalɛ yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Heenɛn nee suakpole Zanowa ezuavolɛ ne yɛle Bɔnza Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Bɛliele bane ne mita ɛya nna abulanla bɛhɔdwule Ewula Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo. Bɛduoduale nlenkɛ ne mɔ ɛbonle nee kɔlɔkɔlɔ na bɛvale mbulalɛ bɛguale bɛ nzi.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Malekaegya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Rilikabe, na ɔsie Bɛte Hakɛlɛm Maanzinli ne la, yɛle Ewula Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Ɔzile ye fofolɛ, ɔduale anlenkɛ ne ɛbonle nee kɔlɔkɔlɔ na ɔvale mbulalɛ ɔguale ɔ nzi.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kɔlehozi ara Hyalɛm, mɔɔ sie Mezepa Maanzinli ne la, yɛle Nzufeanvea Anlenkɛ Kpole ne boɛ. Ɔbobɔle ɛbonle fofolɛ ɔduale ye, ɔduale ye kɔlɔkɔlɔ, na ɔvale mbulalɛ ɔguale ɔ nzi. Akee ɔyɛle bane ne mɔɔ vi Hyila Nzubula ne mɔɔ zua belemgbunli ne tola ne la boɛ, toonwo ɔhɔkpulale kpolike ne mɔɔ tolo kɔ Devidi suakpole ne azo la.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Mɔɔ doa ye ɛdeɛ ne la, Azebɛke ara Nihɛmaya, mɔɔ sie Bɛtezɛ Maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle bane ne boɛ, toonwo ɔhɔkpulale ɛleka mɔɔ nee Devidi sɛka ne anye bɔ zolɛ, wɔ nzubula ne nee ɛlɔnema azua ne mɔ anwo la. Livaema mɔɔ yɛle bane ne anwo gyima la

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Livaema mɔɔ yɛle bane ne mɔ dɔɔnwo boɛ zɔle zolɛ la ɛne: Rilihɛm mɔɔ le Beenae ara ne yɛle bane ne mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ. Hahyabaya, mɔɔ sie Kiyaela Maanzinli ne foa ko la, gyinlanle ye menli ne agyakɛ anu yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Hɛneedade ara Beeveeyae, mɔɔ sie Kiyaela maanzinli ne foa ko la, yɛle mɔɔ zɔ zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Gyɛhyua ara Yizɛ, mɔɔ sie Mezepa la, eza yɛle mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ zɔle zolɛ, ɔvi aduzielɛ ɛleka ne, toonwo ɔhɔle bane ne muleɛ zo.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Bɛlɛke mɔɔ le Zabeeyae ara ne, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ zɔle zolɛ hɔdwule Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Yilayahyebe sua ne anuhɔlɛ.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Yulaya ara Mɛlɛmo, mɔɔ le Heekɔzo anlɔnra la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ, ɔvi Yilayahyebe sua ne anuhɔlɛ ɔhɔdwule sua ne ati. Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛle bane ne anwo gyima la

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛle bane ne bie boɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ: Sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ zuozua Gyɛlusalɛm la yɛle bie zɔle zolɛ.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman nee Hahyɛbe yɛle bane ne mɔɔ nee bɛ sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ zɔle zolɛ. Meeyasaya ara Azalaya, mɔɔ le Ananaya anlɔnra ne, ɔdaye ɔyɛle mɔɔ wɔ ye sua ne anyunlu la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Hɛneedade ara Benuwae yɛle bane ne mɔɔ vi Azalaya sua ne anwo kɔdwu bane ne muleɛ zo la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Peelale mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Yuzae la yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ vi ye muleɛ zo. Bane ne muleɛ zo nee belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne tawa ne anye bɔ zolɛ. Tawa ne zua sinzavolɛma sua ne.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Pɛlɔhye ara Pɛdaya yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ, wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu mɔɔ bikye Nzule Anlenkɛ Kpole ne nee tawa ne mɔɔ bɛgyinla zolɛ bɛsinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la. Menli gyɛne mɔɔ yɛle bane ne bie la

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Tɛkowama eza yɛle bane ne ɛleka mɔɔ nee tawa kpole ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne azo la anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ, toonwo bɛhɔdwule Ofɛle bane ne anwo.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma bie yɛle bane ne bie boɛ zɔle zolɛ; bɛvale ye Ɛkpɔnwɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo bɛhɔle ye anwuma. Awie biala yɛle ye sua nyunlu bane ɛdeɛ ne boɛ.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yemɛ ara Zeedɔko noko yɛle mɔɔ nee ye sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la boɛ zɔle zolɛ.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Hyɛlimaya ara Hananaya nee Zeelafe awoba nsia ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Heenɛn la, yɛle bane ne mɔɔ doa ye la boɛ; bɛ fane nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bane ne bie boɛ la ɛne. Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam yɛle bane ne mɔɔ wɔ ye sua ne anyunlu la boɛ.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Sukoadwinli Malekaya yɛle bie zɔle zolɛ hɔdwule sua ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua sonvolɛma nee gualilɛma ne mɔ wɔ nu, mɔɔ nee Mefekade Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anye bɔ zolɛ, na ɔzua ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne aduduleɛ sɔlɔ muleɛ ne azo anwuma la anwo.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Sukoadwinlima nee gualilɛma yɛle mɔɔ li awieleɛ bɔkɔɔ la boɛ, ɔvi ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔ muleɛ ne azo anwuma la anwo bɛhɔzɔle Mboane Anlenkɛ Kpole ne.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sanebalate dele kɛ yɛlɛyɛ bane ne boɛ la, ɔvale ɛya kpole na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔgolo Dwuuma anwo.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee Samɛlea ɛlɔnema anyunlu, ɔzele kɛ, “Duzu a Dwuuma anwo anwunvɔne ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛyɛ a? Na bɛdwenle kɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛva kenle ko bɛkɛwie gyima ne yɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ awolɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛyelɛyela ɛyɛ ewula la bɛkɛhola bɛkɛhakyi bɛ awolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsi sua a ɔyɛ boɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Ɛnee Amɔnonli Tobaya gyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ. Na ɔdaye noko ɔdole zolɛ kɛ, “Duzu bane bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛkɛhola bɛkɛlie a? Ɛzonlɛ bɔbɔ anwo ka ye mgbane a ɔbabubu yeagua.”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Menzɛlɛle kɛ, “O yɛ Nyamenle, tie kɛ bɛlɛsi yɛ amgbu bie a! Maa bɛ amgbuzilɛ ne ɛbɔ bɛ ti. Debie biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, maa bɛyɛ afedeɛ, na maa bɛhye bɛ ɛkpolekɛ zo bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ maanle gyɛne nu.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Mmafea bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ mmafa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛkyɛ bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛfutu wɔ ahonle wɔ banelielɛma ye anyunlu.”

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Yemɔti yɛyɛle bane ne kɔsɔɔti boɛ. Ye anwumahɔlɛ ne noko dwule ye avinli. Ɔluakɛ menli ne anye kpotale gyima ne anwo.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sanebalate nee Tobaya nee Arelebiama nee Amɔnoma nee Ahyedɔdoma dele kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne boɛyɛlɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ kpalɛ na ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ gologolole la kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛtɔ nuhua la, bɛvale ɛya kpole,

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: na bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛkpamonle kɛ bɛba bɛaradoa Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛ nee bɛ aho na bɛava basabasayɛlɛ bɛara suakpole ne azo.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Yɛzɛlɛle yɛ Nyamenle ne na yɛyele sinzavolɛma yɛmanle bɛzinzale sua ne nɔɔzo nee ewiazo.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Dwudama lɛ edwɛne bie mɔɔ bɛto a bɛse, “Yɛ ɛnwomenle ɛwie, yɛyɛ gyima yɛvɛ, Ewula ne tɛso kpalɛ; Yɛangola bane ne die ala ɛne.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne zele kɛ, “Bɛnrɛde nganeɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu ye, Kɔkpula kɛ yɛkɛholo bɛ nwo zo, Yɛkɛhu bɛ na banelielɛ ne kɛpeme ɛkpa.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Dwuuma mɔɔ de bɛ avinli wɔ suakpole ne azo la radinle yɛ aze fane bulu kɛ, “Bɛvi ngameɛngameɛ a bɛbaradoa yɛ bɛ nee yɛ aho a.”

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Yemɔti memanle me menli ne konle ninyɛne: dadeɛ, atwɛ nee ɛda mɔ, na mengyɛle bɛ nuhua awuke awuke na memanle bɛhɔdɛle bane ne anzi ɛleka biala mɔɔ bane ne ɛtɛkɔle anwuma la.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ menli ne arɛle ɛbɔ. Yemɔti menzele mgbanyima ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli nee menli mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ. Bɛhakye kɛ Awulae a le bedevinli a; ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ. Bɛho bɛmaa bɛ mediema, bɛ mra mrenya, bɛ mra mraalɛ, bɛ ye mɔ nee bɛ maanle.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne dele kɛ yɛde bɛ adwenle ne mɔɔ bɛvale la anwo bie na Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔle la ɛtulu. Akee yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛziale yɛhɔzɔle yɛ gyima ne azo.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Ɔvi mekɛ zɔhane menli mɔɔ nee me lua la hyɛle bɛ nwo nu nwiɔ; foa ko yɛle banelielɛ gyima ne yɛɛ foa ko noko yɛle sinzavolɛma bɛwulowulale konle mbulalɛ adɛladeɛ, bɛdedɛle atwɛ nee ɛda yɛɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike. Mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛgyinlanle Dwudama

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛto bane ne la biala lɛ dadeɛ zia ye foa ko. Sonla ne mɔɔ bɔ aweɛne tendenle ne la gyi me foa ko.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Menzele mgbanyima ne mɔ, mbɔlɔba ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ, “Gyima ne le kpole na ɔtɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛ avinli tete.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛde aweɛne tendenle ne ane la, bɛ muala bɛhɔ ɛkɛ. Yɛ Nyamenle ne baho amaa yɛ.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛhɔle gyima ne azo, ɔvi aleɛbahye toonwo ɔkɔkpula aledwolɛ. Menli ne foa ko yɛle gyima ne yɛɛ foa ko zinzale.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Akee menzele menli ne kɛ, “Awie biala nee ye sonla ne mɔɔ boa ye la ɛla Gyɛlusalɛm, amaa nɔɔzo yɛazinza suakpole ne na alehyenlɛ nu yɛayɛ gyima ne.”

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, medame o, anzɛɛ me gɔnwo mɔ o, me sonvolɛma o, anzɛɛ sinzavolɛma o, anzɛɛ sinzavolɛma mɔɔ li me nzi la o, yɛ nuhua biala anye ye tɛladeɛ ne ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛangua yɛ konle ninyɛne ne mɔ aze ɛlɛ; yɛ nzule bɔbɔ gyelegyela yɛ.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Nzinlii menli dɔɔnwo, mrenya nee mraalɛ, dendɛle tiale bɛ mediema Dwuuma.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bie mɔ zele kɛ, “Yɛ nee yɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ, yɛ nwo zonle somaa; bɛmaa yɛhɔkpondɛ aleɛ mɔɔ yɛdi yɛanyia ngoane la.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛva yɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ, yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ nee yɛ azua yɛwula awoba yɛlie abɛlɛ, amaa ɛhɔne ye mɔɔ ɛra la yɛanyia aleɛ yɛali.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛbizale bosea a yɛduale yɛ ɛya avule nee vanye egyinli ne mɔ anwo adwule yɛmanle belemgbunli a.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Yɛdayɛ noko yɛlɛ nwonane kɛ yɛ mediema ne mɔ ala la, yɛɛ yɛ mra ne mɔ le kɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ ala la; noko yɛlɛkye yɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ ɛkpolekɛ zo yɛayɛ bɛ ahanra. Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ bɔbɔ ɛhɔ kanrazonlenlɛ nu dɛbadɛba yɛɛ yɛyɛ nwolɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ nee yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛpɛ ɛli awie mɔ asa anu.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mendele bɛ edwɛkɛ ne la menvale ɛya kpole.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Mendwenlenle nwolɛ na mendeanle mgbanyima ne mɔ nee mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli ne mɔ wɔ nwolɛ. Menzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛlɛdi bɛ mediema ne mɔ ndunlumi.” Menvɛlɛle maanle ayia na menzele bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: “Yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ maanle zo la yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle biala mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ boɛ la, kɛ yɛkɛkpɔne yɛ mediema Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ kanrazonlenlɛ nu la yɛ nee bɛ kɛra sua nu. Akee bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua nu la bɛlɛmia bɛ mediema Dwuuma bɛamaa bɛadɔne bɛ nwo bɛamaa bɛ.” Na mgbanyima ne mɔ ko bɔbɔ andɛ ɔ nloa anu.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menzele bɛ kɛ, “Nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la ɛnle kpalɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo Nyamenle na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la, amaa bɛammaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la adenle bɛanzi yɛ amgbu.

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Me nee agɔnwolɛma nee me sonvolɛma yɛvɛne menli ne ezukoa nee abɛlɛ. Bɛmaa yɛva debie biala mɔɔ bɛtua yɛ la yɛhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kenle ye, bɛva bɛ ɛya avule ne mɔ, bɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ, bɛ ɔlivi ɛya ne mɔ, bɛ azua, ezukoa ngyɛnu ɛya ko ɛkpɔ ko ne, bɛ abɛlɛ, bɛ nwanye nee bɛ ɔlivi nwole mɔɔ bɛliele la kɔsɔɔti bɛmaa bɛ.”

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Na mgbanyima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Yɛfa bɛ debie biala yɛamaa bɛ, yɛɛ yɛnrɛbiza bɛ ɛhwee. Yɛbayɛ ye kɛmɔ wɔha la.” Na menvɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ na memanle mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle ndane wɔ bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɛli bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ la azo.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Akee menyele ɛdanlɛ kodoku ne mɔɔ hye me nze zo la na memkpokpole nuhua na menzele kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ yeanli ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ la azo la, Nyamenle badu ye avi ye sua nu, alie ye debie biala ɔ sa nu yeamaa yeaha ye kpoholokpo ne ala.” Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la liele zolɛ, “Amen”, na bɛyele Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ. Na mgbanyima ne mɔ noko lile bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. Nihɛmaya ɛnle angomedi

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Belemgbunli Atazɛzɛse ɛnyia ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo, toonwo mɔɔ ɔnyianle ɛvolɛ abulasa nee nwiɔ, mɔɔ ɔvale me kɛ menyɛ Dwuda amɛnlado la, medame o, anzɛɛ me sonvolɛma o, yɛ biala anlie ɛkponledolɛ ezukoa ɛlɛ wɔ ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Amɛnlado biala mɔɔ ɛnee li me nyunlu la yɛle adesoa manle menli ne. Bɛliele aleɛ nee nwanye ezukoa, akee asolo nwolɛ kenle ko dwɛtɛ fufule abulanla ne mɔɔ bɛdie la. Bɛ sonvolɛma bɔbɔ wulule gyinlanle menli ne akɔme zo. Na mame, ɔlua Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ ti meanyɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Menvale me anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti menzɔle suakpole ne bane ne boɛyɛlɛ nu. Meamkpondɛ medame me ti anwo agyadeɛ biala. Me sonvolɛma ne kɔsɔɔti zɔle nuhua manle yɛyɛle bane ne boɛ.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Kenle ko biala meku ɛnlankɛ ko, mboane nsia yɛɛ ngɔkɔlɛ, akee kenle bulu biala memaa bɛ nwanye dɔɔnwo. Na kɛmɔ meze ɛvɛlɛ bedevinli mɔɔ menli ne de nwolɛ la ati, meanlie me amɛnlado ɛkponledolɛ ezukoa ne.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, kakye boɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa menli ɛhye mɔ la na yila me wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Sanebalate, Tobaya Arelebianli Gihyɛm nee yɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la dele kɛ mewie suakpole ne bane ne amuala boɛ yɛ na adenle biala fee ɛnla ye ɛleka biala la, ,

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Sanebalate nee Gihyɛm zoanle manle bɛrazele me kɛ, “Ɛ nee yɛ ɛyia Ono fiene ne anu namule ne mɔ ko azo.” Adwenle mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛ la a le kɛ, bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ me debie.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Menvale nrɛlaleɛ mengɔmanle bɛ kɛ, “Melɛyɛ gyima kpole bie, yemɔti menrɛhola ba. Menrɛhola gyima ne gyakyi ba nehane.”

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Bɛzoanle menli fane ngoko nna na medame noko membuale bɛ ko ne ala fane nna.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Kɛlata ne se, “Gihyɛm ɛmaa mede kɛ, bɛlɛkeha ye huhuhuhu wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli kɛ, ɛdawɔ nee Dwuuma bɛnyia adwenle kɛ bɛte belemgbunli anwo atua, ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ suakpole ne bane ne mɔ boɛ a.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Eza ɔse bɛlɛkeha kɛ wɔdu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛ bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda a. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne bade ɛhye anwo bie. Ɛhye ati mesuzu kɛ ɛ nee me yɛkɛyia na yɛkɛva nwolɛ adwenle.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Medame noko menzoanle memanle bɛhɔzele ye kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ wɔha la ɛnle nɔhalɛ. Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛbɔ ɛ ti anu wɔaha a.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛkulo kɛ bɛnwunlonwunla yɛ amaa bɛaze kɛ, “Bɛ sa ɛkpa, bɛangola gyima ne yɛ.” O Nyamenle, kpogya me sa zo ɛ!

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala mengɔle Dɛlaya ara Hyɛmaya mɔɔ le Mɛhɛtabili anlɔnra ne mɔɔ la sua nu na ɔngola finde la sua nu, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔvea Nyamenle sua ne anu Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne na yɛtoto yɛ nwo nlenkɛ nu, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛba ɛnɛ nɔe bɛarahu wɔ.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Na menzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnea me a ɛnee sonla le kɛ medame, menriandi meavea? Kɛ ɛdwenle me ɛ? Menriandi mengɔnvea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛangu me? Metua me nzo. Menrɛyɛ ye fee!”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Na mendele ɔ bo kɛ tɛ Nyamenle a zoanle ye a, na ɔdaye a yebɔ ɔ ti anu yerabɔ me munzule ɛhye a, ɔboalekɛ Tobaya nee Sanebalate ɛbɔ ye ɛkpa.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle ye ɛkpa kɛ ɔraha ɛhye, amaa meazulo na meayɛ ɛhye, meayɛ ɛtane, na meanyia duma ɛtane, me nyunlu agua aze.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Na menzele kɛ, “O me Nyamenle, kakye Tobaya nee Sanebalate bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ na tua bɛ nwolɛ kakɛ. Eza kakye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ raalɛ Nowadaya nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ nyɛleɛ zo bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛka me ɛzulolɛ la noko.” Gyima ne awieleɛ

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Yemɔti kenle abulanlu nee nwiɔ pɛpɛ, wɔ siane Yilɛle ne anu, ye kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu ne la azo yɛɛ banelielɛ ne wiele bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua yɛ la anu la dele la, bɛ ti zile aze na bɛzulole, ɔluakɛ bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne yɛɛ ɛboa yɛ ɛmaa yɛli gyima kpole ɛhye a.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye amuala anu, Dwuu mgbanyima ne nee Tobaya hɛlɛhɛlɛle bɛ nwo ngɛlata.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda maanle nu la wɔ Tobaya anzi, ɔluakɛ Tobaya aye ɔ ze a le Ɛla ara Hyɛkanaya. Eza Tobaya ara nrenya Gyihoheenan ɛgya Bɛlikaya ara Mɛhyɛlam ara raalɛ.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
