english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: “Akee fɛlɛ, na menwɔlie zo; anzɛɛ maa mendendɛ, na bua me.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Me ninyɛndane nee me ɛtane ne mɔ le nyɛ? Maa menwu me mɛladonlɛ nee me ɛtane ne mɔ.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: “Duzu ati a ɛfa ɛ nye ɛfea, na ɛbu me wɔ kpɔvolɛ ɛ?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛkɛnwunlonwunla nya mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye ahɔ la, na ɛkɛnriandi ɛkɛdoa ma abonle?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛkɛlɛ ɛtane ɛtane ɛtia me, na ɛmaa medi me mgbavolɛ nu ɛtane ne mɔ anwo fɔlɛ.

english_verse: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ me kpanwu, ɛnea me adenle biala anu; egyakɛ biala mɔɔ metu la, ɛ nye gyi me nwo.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Sonla sɛkye yɛ mgbane kɛ debie kpɔlɔlera, ɔle kɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛtɛba ɛli la.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Sonla dasanli mɔɔ raalɛ ɛwo ye la mekɛ le ezinraa, yɛɛ nuhua le amaneɛ ngome.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Ɔkpakye kɛ ndotolo, na ɔnwoso; ɔpɛ nu kɛ ɛlawolɛ, na ɔminliminli.

english_verse: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
translation_verse: Sonla zɛhae, ɔdaye ɛnea ye, ɛdi ye edwɛkɛ, ɛbua ye ndɛne?

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛye debie bɔkɔbɔkɔ kɛvi evinli nu a? Awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛhile ye mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbali la, bɛwie, siane dodo mɔɔ ɔbali la, wɔhyehyɛ wɔdo ɛkɛ, na ɔnrɛhakyi ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: “Ye ɛ nye ɔ nwo, na gyakyi ye, amaa yealie ɔ nye, yeali ye mekɛ kɛ ɛkpanli.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ baka bɔbɔ lɛ anyelazo, kɛ bɛpɛ ye bɔbɔ a, ɔbafifi bieko, ɔ nye ɛnrɛgyakyi ɛwɔlɔlɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔnyia ezule la ɛnee yefifi yeyeye ngane kɛ baka ekyi la.

english_verse: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
translation_verse: Sonla wu, na bɛsie ye; sonla gua ɛnwomenle aze a ɛnee ɔwɔ nienwu?

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ tandane we, na azudenle sesa la,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla wu na ɔndwazo ko a. Saa anwuma ɛtɛpɛle nu ɛtɛsenle a, bɛnrɛdwazo bieko, bɛvi nafelɛ nu bɛnrɛdunwue.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: “Anrɛɛ wɔava me wɔavea ɛbolɔ, wɔava me wɔavea toonwo wɔ ɛya ne adwo, anrɛɛ wɔahile me mekɛ, na ɔdwu a wɔahakye me.

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Saa sonla wu a, ɔkɛdɛnla ngoane nu bieko ɔ? Wɔ me ɛzonlenlɛ mekɛ nu mebahendɛ, toonwo me ɛkpɔnelɛ mekɛ adwu.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Ɛbavɛlɛ, na mebalie wɔ zo; ɛ nwo balɔ ɛdawɔ ɛ sa anloa gyima.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Na akee ɛbanlea me gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ nu, na ɛnrɛnlea me ɛtane ne mɔ;

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: ɛbawula me mɛladonlɛ ne kodoku nu wɔakyekye ɔ nloa, na wɔaheda me ninyɛndane zo.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Na boka bɔbɔ dwulu gua aze, yɛɛ bodane tudu fi ɔ bo zo ne;

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: azule kundohundo awolɛ, yɛɛ ɛzezeane pia anwea kɔ; yemɔti ɛmaa sonla anyelazo bɔ ye.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Ɛkolo ɔ nwo zo dahuu na ɔwu bɔkɔɔ; ɛkakyi ɔ nyunlu na ɛye ye ɛfi ɛ nye zo.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Ɔ mra mrenya nyia bɛ nyunlu, na ɔnnwu ye; bɛ nyunlu gua aze, noko ɔnnwu ye.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye mumua ne ye nwonane nu nyane ne ala a ɔte a, na ɔsu ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ nwo.”

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Nea, ɛlɛmaa Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ avi ɛkɛ, na wɔazi Nyamenle anyunlu nzɛlɛlɛ aze.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ bɔbɔ kile wɔ adwenle ɛtane, na ɛfa ɛ nloa ɛkye ɛ nwo ɛhane.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛ nloa a bu wɔ fɔlɛ a, tɛ me ɔ; ɛdawɔ wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ di daselɛ tia wɔ.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: “Ɛdwenle kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle sonla mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛbɔle wɔ a? Anzɛɛ bɛbɔle wɔ kolaa na bɛabɔ awoka ɔ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Wɔdie Nyamenle adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne ɔ? Na ɛdwenle kɛ ɛ ngomekye a ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a?

english_verse: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
translation_verse: Egyɛnema nee mgbanyinli wɔ yɛ avinli, menli mɔɔ le mgbanyinli tɛla ɛ ze la.

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: “Ɛnee Nyamenle arɛlekyekyelɛ ne le ekyi maa wɔ, anzɛɛ ye bɛlɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ ne a le ekyi a?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔ ahonle gyegye wɔ, na ɛkpa yɛ anyehoanlɛ zɛhae ɛ?

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a ɛkakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi Nyamenle, na ɛtendɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ɛhye a?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Nea, Nyamenle ɛnlie ye anwondelɛma bɔbɔ ɛnli, yɛɛ anwuma ɛnde ɔ nye zo;

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: na akee sonla mɔɔ sie munzule na ye subane ɛkpɔlɔ, sonla mɔɔ no ɛtane kɛ nzule la.

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: Tie maa menga mengile wɔ, mɔɔ menwu ye la yɛɛ meka a;

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ɛha, bɛ ze mɔ anva anvea bɛ,

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: kɛ bɛmɛ bɛ ngome yɛɛ bɛvale azɛlɛ ne bɛmanle bɛ a, yɛɛ ɛyɛvolɛ biala andɛnla bɛ nu.

english_verse: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
translation_verse: “Amumuyɛnli te nyane dahuu, ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ ɔbali la, awie ɛnrɛze ye anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛmkpa ɔ nzo nu; saa ɔkpazi a, sɛkyevolɛ ne bara ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: Ɔnlie ɔnli kɛ ɔbavi awozinli nu, ye awieleɛ wie dadeɛ nloa.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Ɔkpɔsɛkpɔsa wɔ aleɛ duma nu, na ɔse kɛ, ‘Aleɛ wɔ ni?’ Ɔze kɛ awozinli kenle ne asɛɛ ɛdo ye.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Nyanenwunlɛ nee arɛlebɔlɛ nwunlonwunla ye; bɛba ɔ nwo zo kɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo ɛlɛkɔ konle la.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ yedende ɔ sa Nyamenle anyunlu, na yedu Tumivolɛ ne anloa yedo,

english_verse: They may be rich and fat,
translation_verse: kɛmɔ yeyɛ belane na ye dwongu nu ɛmia,

english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: ɔnrɛnyia ɔ nwo ɛlɛ, ye anwonyia ɛnrɛhyɛ, yɛɛ ɔ bo ɛnrɛzɔ ndinli ɛlɛ,

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: awozinli ɛnrɛkpa ɔ ti ɛlɛ; sendɔlɔra bayela ye ngane kɔsɔɔti, na ahumu akpoɔkpoa ye ndotolo ne mɔ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
translation_verse: Ɔmmamaa ɔ nye da, ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo; ɔluakɛ anyelazo mgbane a bayɛ ye ahatualɛ a.

english_verse: like a date palm tree without a leaf.
translation_verse: Bɛbadua ye kakɛ bɔkɔɔ na yeawu, yɛɛ ye nya ɛnrɛyɛ amunli bieko.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ kpolo ye ma amunli gua, kɛ ɔlivi baka mɔɔ kpolo ye ndotolo la.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la ɛnrɛnyia bɛ bo zo amra, yɛɛ senle bayela ndanlɛ azua mɔɔ bɛvale ndoloboa bɛsisile la.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Bɛsua nwondomgbɔ ɛhane bɛkye akɛsakɛsa, yɛɛ mɛlɛbɛla ɛyi bɛ ahonle ne mɔ tɛkɛɛ.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ, menyia bɛ nde; bɛle arɛlekyekyevolɛma anwo anwunvɔne.

english_verse: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mgbane mgbane ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ ɔ? Duzu bɔbɔ a yɛ wɔ ɛya mɔɔ yemɔti ɛtendɛ zɔhane a?

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Saa wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛgyi me gyinlabelɛ a, anrɛɛ medame mebahola tendɛ kɛ ɛdawɔ la; anrɛɛ mebawola edwɛkɛ meagua ɛ nwo zo, na meakpusukpusu me ti meahile wɔ.

english_verse: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ mebadendɛ meamaa wɔ anwosesebɛ, na me nloa edwɛkɛ amaa wɔ anwofofolɛ ne aha aze.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Metendɛ a me anwofofolɛ ne ɛnga aze, meyɛ koonwu noko a me anwofofolɛ ne azo ɛnde.

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle ɛmaa mekponzo; yebɔ me bo zo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
translation_verse: Yebɔ me kɔtɔlɔba, na ɛhye di daselɛ tia me; menwa kanzakanza, medame mumua ne medi nwolɛ daselɛ.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: “Yehyi me, yeva ɛya yetete me nu; yenrese ɔ gye yehile me; me kpɔvolɛ koloholo ɔ nye kile me.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Menli ɛdendɛ mgbane mgbane ɛhile me, bɛbobɔ me nzo nu koasea nu; bɛkye bɛ nwo file bɛko bɛtia me.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Nyamenle ye me maa anzenyamenlema, na ɔye me ɔwula amumuyɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Ɛnee mede anzonudwolɛ nu, na ɔtetele me nu; ɔtalele me kɔme ɔfinle me aze ɔmanle mentetele, na ɔvale ɔ nye ɔwulale me nyunlu.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Ye menli mɔɔ to ɛda la bɔ yia me. Ɔkpukekpuke me ɛzizira, ɔnze anwunvɔne; ɔtulu me bɔnyema ɔgua aze.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Mekpomgba ɛrele meheda, na mekpofo ndɛtɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Ɛzunlɛ ngome ɛmaa me nye ɛyɛ ngengaanwo, na me nye anzi ɛyɛ dudukuu,

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: noko menli mgbondedolɛ biala anwo fɔlɛ, yɛɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “O azɛlɛ, mmakeda me mogya zo, yɛɛ mmamaa me ɛzunlɛ ne yɛ mgbane.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Nea, kɛkala bɔbɔ, me dasevolɛ ne wɔ anwuma, yɛɛ mɔɔ di me edwɛkɛ maa me la wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo mɔ si me amgbu; metwi monle mekile Nyamenle,

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔkɛmaa sonla nee Nyamenle avinli kɛzɛ, kɛmɔ sonla nee ɔ gɔnwo bɛ avinli sɛ la.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yeha mekɛ ekyi bie na meahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ mekɔ a menrɛzia la.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla ɛnriandi me, me mekɛ ɛwie, me nye gyi ewule kuma nu.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, amgbuzilɛma ɛbɔ ɛyia me, yɛɛ me nye ala a gyi bɛ nyunlu a.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ fa ɛ nwo di agyinlanu maa me; nwane a kɛva ɔ nwo kɛli agyinlanu kɛmaa me a?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔdo bɛ adwenle nu na bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo la, ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛli konim ɛlɛ.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ pepɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ agyakɛ anzi die bɛ agyadeɛ ne bie la, ɔ mra anye bazi.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Yemaa meyɛ agolobɛnwo sonla wɔ menli nyunlu, na bɛtoto me nyunlu nyɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Alɔbɔlɛ ngome ɛzi me nye, me nvɛyeba ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛwie tuto.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la nwu ɛhye a ɔsi bɛ nwo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie la ko tia anzenyamenlema.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Noko tenlenenli die to nu kɛ ɔle fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnle ɛtanevolɛ la nyi anwosesebɛ nu.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛ muala bɛba bieko bɔbɔ a, menrɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ko bɔbɔ wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: “Me mekɛ ɛkpa nwo, me adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ ɛkpa nwo, me ɛhulolɛdeɛ ɛwie.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Bɛfa aledwolɛ bɛkakyi alehyenlɛ; bɛse, ‘Wienyi bikye awozinli.’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Saa mefa Ɛbolɔ kɛ me sua zo, na metoto me ɛkpa wɔ awozinli nu,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: saa mese funli kuma kɛ, ‘Ɛle me ze’, na mese sonlɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛle me nli,’ anzɛɛ ‘Me diema raalɛ a,’

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: ɛnee me anyelazo wɔ ni? Nwane a kɛnwu me anyelazo a?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Asoo ɔ nee me kɛhɔ ɛbolɔ? Asoo ɔ nee me kɛhɔ ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Beledade hanle kɛ,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Dwobu, na kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛ nloa kɛpe a? Dwenle nwo, na maa yɛdayɛ yɛha bie.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a ɛbu yɛ nane a? Duzu ati a ɛbu yɛ menli mgbane a?

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛya maa ɛkile ɛ nwo nyane la, ɛnee wɔmɔ ɛ ti, sonla vi azɛlɛ ye azo ɛdu, anzɛɛ bɛdu bodane bɛvi ɔ bo zo ne ɔ?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Ɛhɛe, bɛnua amumuyɛnli ne kɛnlaneɛ, ye senle le monzomonzo.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Ye ɛdialɛ anu ɛsesebɛ ne ɛdo, yɛɛ ɔdaye ye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ maa ɔkpo aze.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Ɛhane sɔ ɔ gyakɛ na ɔkye ye ɔsie ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: “Ɛzulolɛ bɔ ye mgbɔlɔka, na ɔfoa ye ndinlizo.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne ngome ɛkpɔlɔ ye, yɛɛ munzule ɛlɛkendɛ ye azedɔlɛ.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Ewule ɛzɛkye ye nwonane, ewule ara kpanyinli bubu ye agbɔkɛ.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Bɛte ye bɛfi ye ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ rɛle ɔwulale nu la anwo, na bɛfa ye bɛkɔmaa belemgbunli ewule anwo ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Bɛfa sɔlefe bɛkpondekponde ye sua ne anu a, awie gyɛne biala kola tɛnla ye ndanlɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ye ndinli kpɔlɔ, yɛɛ ye ngane ne mɔ kyengye.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Bɛye ye bɛfi wienyi nu bɛfuandi ye bɛto awozinli nu, na bɛtu ye ewiade ye anu.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, kɛ anzenyamenlema wie ye la ɛne, mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la tɛnlabelɛ nu kɛ wie ye la ɛne.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Duzu ati a ɛlɛfa ɛdendɛlɛ ngome wɔahu me ɛvɛlɛ ɛ?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Fane kɛyɛ bulu ɛ, aholoba ala a ɛbɔ me a; ɔnyɛ wɔ nyiane bɔbɔ kɛ ɛkɛvo me ɔ?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔle nɔhalɛ bɔbɔ kɛ meyɛ ɛtane a, me ɛtane ne doa me.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Saa ɛbu ɛ nwo ɛtɛla me, na ɛfa me anwubɛnyunlu kɛ me ɛtane nwo ndeanlɛ a,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ɛnee nwu ye kɛ Nyamenle a ɛbua me fɔlɛ, na yegua me asawu a.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Nea, metea nu, ‘Kɔdiawu o!’ noko awie ɛmbua me; metea nu ɛsesebɛ, na pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Yedua me adenle, yemɔti mennyia ɛleka mempe, yemaa awozinli ɛva me.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Yeva me nwo ɛya, na ɔtia me ɔboka ye kpɔvolɛma anwo.

english_verse: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɔnema bɔ nu ba me nwo zo; bɛbɔ bɛyia me na bɛyɛ azokoɛleɛ wɔ me ndanlɛ sua ne anwo.

english_verse: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
translation_verse: “Yemaa me nee me mediema yɛ avinli ɛde, na meyɛ ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ manivolɛma anye zo.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Me sua nu nyɛvolɛ arɛle ɛvi me; me sonvolɛ mraalɛ bu me ɛyɛvolɛ; meyɛ bɛ nye zo ɛyɛvolɛ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Mefɛlɛ me sonvolɛ, na ɔmbua me; ɔwɔ kɛ mekpa ye kyɛlɛ bɔbɔ kolaa.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Me ye bɔbɔ ɛmkpondɛ me nyunlu ɛnnea, ɔmɔ akunlu mralɛ bɔbɔ kyi me.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ngakula bɔbɔ kyi me; memaa me nwo zo a bɛtendɛ bɛtia me.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: Agɔnwolɛma kpalɛ kpalɛ kyi me, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnee mekulo bɛ la ɛhakyi bɛ nzi ɛzi me.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Mewie nwa, me mbowule ɛza ɛgua zo, me gye a maa metɛsɔho sonla a.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: “Bɛnwu me anwunvɔne, bɛnwu me anwunvɔne, ayi mɔ, bɛnwu me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛva ɔ sa ɛha me!

english_verse: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛhakyi bɛ nwo Nyamenle bɛdoa me ndinlizo a? Duzu ati a bɛ kunlu ɛndwo me nwonane ne anwo a?

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “O, me edwɛkɛ fɛta kɛlata! O, anrɛɛ bɛahɛlɛ ye buluku nu!

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ me Dievolɛ ne de aze, na ɔka kenle ko a ɔbalie me;

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: nzinlii mɔɔ bɛkɛzɛkye me nwonane ye la, mevi nwonane ɛhye anu mebanwu Nyamenle,

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Mebanwu kɛ ɔgyi me foa ko, me nye banwu ye, menrɛnwu sonla gyɛne biala. Akee me ɛbolɛ ɛlɛte

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Saa ɛbiza kɛ, ‘Kɛ yɛbazi yɛavoa ye ɛ?’ na bɛse kɛ, ‘Edwɛkɛ ne abo wɔ ye ɛkɛ’ a,

english_verse: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!
translation_verse: ɛnee bɛzulo konle dadeɛ ne, ɔluakɛ konle dadeɛ ne nee ɛya ɛvalɛ ndeanlɛ a lua a, amaa wɔanwu kɛ ndɛnebualɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Zofaa hanle kɛ,

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Mete wɔ aholoba ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ la, yɛɛ melɛ nwolɛ ngakyibɛnzi.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: “Ɛdawɔ, ɛnze ye wienyi kɛ ɔvi tete, mɔɔ bɛbɔle sonla bɛdole azɛlɛ ye azo la,

english_verse: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
translation_verse: amumuyɛnli ɛkpazilɛ ɛndwu moa, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la fɛlɛkolilɛ le sinli?

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Kanza ye tendenle dwu anwuma anwuma, ɔ ti kpula Nyamenle ko abo bɔbɔ a,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: ɔbakpɔlɔ kɛ ɔdaye ye ebinli; na menli mɔɔ ɛnwu ye ɛlɛ la babiza kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ ni?’

english_verse: They will be forgotten like a dream
translation_verse: Ɔbapɛ nu yeaze kɛ ɛlalɛ, na bɛnrɛnwu ye ko; bɛbavoa ye kɛ nɔɔzo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ.

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ nwunle ye la ɛnrɛnwu ye ko, menli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ dɛnlanle la ɛnrɛnwu ye ko.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔ mra babiza ehyianvolɛma moalɛ, na yeakpu ye anwonyia ne.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ɔlɛ kpavolɛ anwosesebɛ wɔ ye nu, noko ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na yeahakyi ndɛtɛlɛ.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛbɛla yɛ ye fɛ, ɔfa ɔfea ɔ tafinlima abo,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: noko ye aleɛ dwu ɔ kunlu a ɔle kɛ ndianwu bɔnyema.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ɔmeme anwonyia na ɔkpu bɛ bieko; Nyamenle yeye bɛ fi ɔ kunlu.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ɔbanlo ndianwu bɔnyema; bɔna baha ye ahu ye.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛnwu azule, azule mɔɔ se kɛ wolɛ nee meleke.

english_verse: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yesisi ehyianvolɛma na yekpo bɛ, yelie sua mɔɔ tɛ ɔdaye a ɔzile la.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔdi a, ɔngyakyi bie, yemɔti ɔnrɛkpazi.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ye anyiabɛnwo ne kɛgyinla zo kpalɛ la, ɛnee munzule doa ye, anwubɛnyunlu bali ye akpanebɛ.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Ɔbanriandi konle bulalɛ biala, noko kɔbele ɛda bawɔ ye avinde ɔ nzi.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Bɛtwe ye bɛfi sonlabaka ne anu, ɔ ti memeamemea ne fi ye bɔnyema ne anu finde; na ɛzulolɛ kpole ka ye.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Awozinli kabii keda ye anwonyia zo; senle mɔɔ tɛ sonla a wudale la bayela ye; ye sua nu debie biala badɔ nzonle.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Anwuma baza ye ninyɛndane agua zo, na azɛlɛ adwazo atia ye.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Bɛbazoa ye awuke nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛahɔ, bɛbawua debie biala wɔ Nyamenle ɛya kenle ne.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: “Amumuyɛnli afoa nu ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔnyia ye Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la ɛne, agyadeɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛmaa ye la ɛne!”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me edwɛkɛ ye kpalɛ, na maa ɔyɛ arɛlekyekyelɛ ɔmaa wɔ.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Maa me adenle maa mendendɛ, saa mewie na ɛkulo a, golo me nwo.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: “Mame, me nee dasanli biala ɛnlɛ butule, yemɔti menzi abotane biala.

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ nea me tɛnlabelɛ nu, ɔnyɛ wɔ nyiane mɔɔ maa ɛfa ɛ sa ɛsɔ ɛ nloa a?

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Saa medwenle nwo a ɛnee me rɛle ɛbɔ, na me nwo wozo me.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: “Duzu ati a ɛtanevolɛma tɛnla aze, yɛ mrelera na bɛnyia tumi mgbole ɛ?

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Bɛ mra bo tila, na bɛ bo zo amra nyi to bɛ.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ ɛnle bɛ awuke nu, yɛɛ Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ɛmba bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Bɛ nlankɛ nyinli yɛ dɔɔnwo; bɛ nlankɛ mbelɛ wo mralɛ, bɛ ko ɛmkpɔne.

english_verse: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
translation_verse: Bɛ mra anwo tɛ bɛ kɛ mboane, yɛɛ bɛ mra di wulupe, si agole.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Bɛto aweɛne nee getaa edwɛne, na bɛsi fulutu nloa agole.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Bɛkpazi, bɛdi bɛ mekɛ, na bɛfa anzonudwolɛ bɛkɔ ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: “Bɛka bɛkile Nyamenle kɛ, ‘Ɛvi yɛ nwo ɛke kɔ! Yɛmkpondɛ wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ biala.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ ɛkpazilɛ vi bɛ mɔdenlebɔ. Metua me nzo kɛ menwɔdie amumuyɛma folɛdulɛ!

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Fane nyɛ yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma kɛnlaneɛ ɛnlu a? Fane nyɛ yɛɛ munzule ɛdo bie a? Fane nyɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛva ɛya ɛdua bie kakɛ a?

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Fane nyɛ yɛɛ ɔbɔ bɛ ɔkɔ kɛ abonle lua anwoma nu, anzɛɛ nya mɔɔ ahumu ɛlɛfa ye ahɔ la a?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: “Wɔmɔ ɛse, ‘Nyamenle fa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ tea bɛ mra.’ Maa ɔdua bɛdabɛ mumua ne kakɛ, amaa bɛanwu ye.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ bɛ nye ɛnwu bɛ ndeanlɛ, na bɛnwu kɛ Tumivolɛ ne ɛya si de la.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa sonla wu a, duzu adwenle bieko yɛɛ ɔlɛ wɔ ye awuke nwo a?

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Asoo awie kɛhola kɛhile Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbua mgbolema ndɛne la?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ noko ɛnde fɛlɛko ɛlɛ, bɛfa nyane ngome bɛkɔ ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Noko bɛ muala bɛkɔ azɛlɛ ye abo, na azonlɛ di bɛ muala.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Nea, meze bɛ adwenle, nee me nwo adwenle ɛtane mɔɔ bɛlɛ la,

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛse, ‘Sonlakpole zɔhane sua wɔ ni? Yɛɛ amumuyɛnli ne noko sua wɔ ni?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: kɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu, bɛgyakyi amumuyɛnli ne, na bɛye ye bɛfi ɛya kenle ne anu ɔ?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee ye kɔ asie a, menli sinza ye nla ne.

english_verse: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
translation_verse: “Na duzu edwɛkɛ kpaziwɔkɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ ɛfa wɔakyekye me rɛle a? Ɛnlɛ mualɛ kpalɛ biala kɛ adalɛ ala.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Ɛlaefaze hanle kɛ,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Asoo sonla nwo le nvasoɛ maa Nyamenle? Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la le nvasoɛ maa ɔdaye ɔ nwo?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Saa ɛdi pɛlepɛle a, duzu bolɛ yɛɛ ɛsonle ɛmaa Tumivolɛ ne a, anzɛɛ ɛbɔ wɔ ɛbɛla ne fɔɔnwo a, duzu nvasoɛ a ɔnyia a?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Asoo wɔ amumuyɛ ne ɛnle kpole? Wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔlie ɛ mediema awoba mgbane gyɛne ne ala, na wɔkpa bɛ nwo ndanlɛ.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Ɛtɛmanle menli mɔɔ ɛvɛ la nzule bɛtɛnonle, yɛɛ ɛtɛmanle menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la aleɛ.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛlɛ bɛ sa mgbane, yɛɛ wɔsisi nrisa wɔwua bɛ.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Yemɔti ngane ɛbɔ wɔ mgbɔlɔka ɛyia, na sulosulo gyegye wɔ.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Awozinli ɛva wɔ, ɛnnwu aze, yɛɛ azule ɛyi ɛva wɔ ɛleka biala.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Asoo Nyamenle ɛnde anwuma hwehwe lɔ? Nea anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra, kɛ bɛ ngɛnlɛma si de la!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Yemɔti a ɛse ‘Duzu a Nyamenle ze a? Asoo ɔkɛhola ndɛne bua wɔ awozinli kabikabi ye anu?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Amungu kabii keda ɔ nye, yemɔti ɔnnwu ɛhwee, na ɔzinze anwuma nee aze bɛ avinli,’ la.

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: “Adenle dɛba ne mɔɔ amumuyɛma ɛva nu la, asoo yemɔ ala a ɛdawɔ ɛbava nu a?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Noko yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmanle bɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ a, na mame, metua me nzo wɔ ɛtanema folɛdulɛ nwo.

english_verse: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate,
translation_verse: Pɛlepɛlelilɛma nwu ɛhye na bɛdi fɛlɛko, menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la sele bɛ maa bɛ ti si aze.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Bɛse kɛ, ‘Nɔhalɛ, bɛbɔ yɛ kpɔvolɛma abo zo, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛgyakyile la, senle ɛmaa bɛdɔ nzonle.’

english_verse: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
translation_verse: “Ɛ nee Nyamenle ɛbɔ nu na nyia anzonudwolɛ, na ɛbakpazi bieko.

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Tie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ, na fa ye edwɛkɛ sie wɔ ahonle nu.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Saa ɛsia ɛkɔ Tumivolɛ ne ɛkɛ bieko, ɛbɛlɛ ɛ nwo aze ɛmaa ye, saa wɔ awuke nu amra gyakyi ɛtanelilɛ,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: saa ɛbu ezukoa nvutuke kɛ munlutu, na ɛbu ezukoa nvutuke awolɛ ‘ɔfɛ’ kɛ azule bo awolɛ,

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: ɛbanyia anyelielɛ wɔ Tumivolɛ ne anu, na wɔakpogya ɛ nye zo wɔanlea Nyamenle.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ɛbavɛlɛ ye, na ɔbadie wɔ; na wɔadua wɔ ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ muala.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛdwenle nwo la bayɛ zɔ, na wienyi bada wɔ adenle nu.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle bɛlɛ mgbanyizonlema aze, na ɔmaa bɛlɛvoma zo.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Ɔpepɛ ɔdie sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie; saa ɛnli fɔlɛ ɛdeɛ a, ɔbapepɛ yealie wɔ.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Ɛnɛ noko me somolɛ ne le kpole kpalɛ, mɔɔ melɛkponle ala la ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlɛtinli me nu.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ meanwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, amaa meahɔvinde ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ menwɔzukoa ye mualɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa me la, na meade mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile me la abo.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Asoo ye tumi ne kpole nwo yɛɛ ɔnea ɔ nee me ali a? Kyɛkyɛ, anrɛɛ ɔkɛgyele ɔ nzo ɔkɛdie me somaa.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne, tenlenenli kola nee ye fa adwenle, na me ndɛnebuavolɛ ne kɛbua me benle dahuu.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Noko nea, mekɔ me nyunlu, na ɔnle ɛkɛ; mekɔ me nzi, noko mennwu ye;

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: mekpondɛ ye me bɛne zo, noko mennwu ye; yɛɛ mekpondɛ ye me fema zo, noko mennwu ye.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Noko yemɔ, ɔze adenle mɔɔ mefa zo la; saa ɔsɔ me ɔnea a, mebavi kɛ ezukoa nvutuke.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Melua ɔ gyakɛ abo zo ne fɔɔnwo; melua ye adenle ne anu, metɛfonle adenle.

english_verse: and I have always treasured his teachings.
translation_verse: Metɛtule ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ metɛtole; ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ sonle bolɛ maa me.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: “Ɔngakyi ɛlɛ; nwane a kɛhola kɛhakyi ye adwenle a? Ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle ɔmanle me la, ɔbayɛ, yɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɔ ti anu.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ awozinli ɛva me, na awozinli kabii ɛheda me nwo zo.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Duzu ati a Tumivolɛ ne ɛnzie ndɛnebualɛ mekɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze ye la ɛnnwu ye mekɛ ne ɛ?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Menli kakyi azɛlɛ ɛweɛne; bɛwua mboane bɛyɛne bɛ.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Bɛkyehye nrisa mralɛ asoaso bɛkɔ; bɛdie ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ nlankɛ nyinli awoba.

english_verse: The poor are trampled and forced to hide
translation_verse: Bɛtua ehyianvolɛma ɛkpazilɛ adenle; na bɛkpuokpua bɛ bɛmaa bɛnriandi bɛfea.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: “Bɛle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo asoaso nyinli, bɛdwazo ndɛ bɛkɔ aleɛkpondɛlɛ wɔ fienemgbole nu bɛmaa bɛ mra.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Bɛbu ɛya mɔɔ tɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la anu aleɛ, na bɛtete amumuyɛma vanye egyinli nu ma.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo bɛdɛ bɛ nwo zɔ bɛda, bɛnlɛ debie bɛnzɔ bɛ ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Awoka zo ezule bo bɛ, na bɛbetɛbeta awolɛ kɛ bɛkpondɛ feabelɛ.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: “Menli bie mɔ te nrisa mralɛ fi nyɛfonlɛ nloa, na bɛdie ehyianvolɛma amra nlɔma awoba.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Noko bie mɔ dɛ bɛ nwo zɔ finde, bɛngeda bie; na bɛfa ɛhɔne bɛsoa bɛyɔba.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Bɛtwihwi ɔlivi ma bɛyɛ nwole, wɔ atisesebɛma egyinli nu; bɛtwihwi vanye ma bɛyɛ nwanye, noko nwolɛ nzuhɔne ku bɛ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Suakpole ne azo, wuleravolɛma kponle, menli mɔɔ ɛbodɛboda la su fɛlɛ moalɛ, noko Nyamenle ɛndie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nu, kɔdiawu ne dwazo kɔsia ku ehyianvolɛma; aledwolɛ nu, ɔle awule.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Nrenya mɔɔ fa awuvolɛ raalɛ la kendɛ aledwolɛ, ɔkeda ɔ nyunlu na ɔka kɛ, ‘Awie ɛnrɛnwu me.’

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Awozinli nu bɛbubu awie mɔ azua, na alehyenlɛ nu bɛtoto bɛ nwo nlenkɛ nu; bɛnze wienyi ne deɛ holɛ.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Awozinli kabikabi le bɛ alehyenlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ a le awozinli nu amundubɛ ne mɔ.” Zofaa

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Zofaa hanle kɛ, “Wɔmɔ ɛse ‘Azuyilɛ pia amumuyɛma kɔ ndɛndɛ, na bɛ afoa nu azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne, bɛwa ye amonle; yɛɛ awie ɛnyɛ gyima wɔ ye vanye egyinli nu.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Ewia pe a wuluwulu maa ezukɔtweaba kolo na ɔsesa, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma minli ɛbolɔ a.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Mrɛladane arɛle fi bɛ; bɛdɔ azonlɛ; bɛ aluma bɔbɔ, bɛngakye; yemɔti amumuyɛnli bu tɔ kɛ baka la.’

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Bɛfo bɛgyinla mota mraalɛ akɔme zo, yɛɛ bɛnze ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Noko Nyamenle fa ye tumi ne maa mgbolema mekɛ tendenle; bɛ anyelazo wie a, bɛmaa bɛ nwo zo bieko.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane, ɔmaa bɛgyinla boɛ; yɛɛ ɔ nye wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Ɔkpogya bɛ zo ekyii, noko ɔngyɛ ɛnee bɛ bo zo ɛminli; bɛnwoso na bɛwu kɛ ndile; bɛbu bɛ kɛ abɛlɛ.

english_verse: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
translation_verse: Saa ɔnle zɔ a, nwane a kɛha kɛ mele adalɛ, kɛhile kɛ mɔɔ meha la ɛnle nɔhalɛ a?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Beledade hanle kɛ,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Tumi nee ɛzulolɛ le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, ɔmaa anzonudwolɛ ba ye anwuma ɛleka ne.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola ye ɛlɔnema tia a? Nwane a ye wienyi ne ɛnda ɔ nwo a?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Nea, siane ne bɔbɔ ɛnda, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra bɔbɔ anyunlu ɛnde wɔ ɔ nye zo;

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: na akee sonla mɔɔ le kɛkɛba sonlɛ la, sonla ra, mɔɔ le sone la!”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Kɛ wɔzi wɔboa sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ tumi, anzɛɛ wɔlie sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la ɛ?

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Wɔdu sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la folɛ kpalɛ, na wɔva wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ne bie wɔmaa ye ala ɛne!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Beledade hanle kɛ, “Azɛlɛ bo lɔ, mɔwuamra anwo wozo bɛ, azule nee bɛ nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ la zolɛ wienyi wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu, yɛɛ Abadɔn nwenle zolɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Ɔtɛlɛ sɔlɔ anwomanyunlu ɔdwu ɛleka mɔɔ debie biala ɛnle la, na ɔmaa azɛlɛ noko sinze mɔɔ debie ɛnlɛ nu a.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nzule gyinla amungu nu, noko amungu ne ɛnkpuke.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Ɔkeda siane ne anyunlu, na ɔfa amungu ɔkeda siane ne anye.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Yepɛ sɛma yedo nzule ne mɔ anye, yeva yegya wienyi nee awozinli ɛweɛne.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Saa ɔtea mpila mɔɔ dedɛ anwomanyunlu la nu a, ɛzulolɛ ka bɛ maa bɛkpusu.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye tumi ɔmanle nyevile guale diinyi; ɔvale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ɔhunle nane sɛkyeravolɛ Releehabe.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye ɛnwomenle ɔmanle anwomanyunlu dele wienyi; ɔvale ye tumi ne ɔhunle nyevile nu nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Nea, ɛhye mɔ bɔbɔ le ye tumi ne anu ekyi bie; ɔ ne ekyi bie a yɛte a, na nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla ye tumi kpole ne anloa a?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Meka tease Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛmaa mewie ye zɛ, na yemaa me ɛkɛla ɛli nyane la kɛ,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: me nloa ɛnrɛkpula munzule edwɛkɛ, na meava me tafinlima meabɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Ɔkɛbɔ me tɔ kɛ menwɔha kɛ bɛle nɔhalɛ a; mebagyinla kpundii kɛ menze nwolɛ bie kɔkpula kɛ menwɔwu.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: “Melɛ me tenleneyɛlɛ ne anu kpundii, menrɛgyakyi nu ɛlɛ; me adwenle ɛmbu me fɔlɛ kenle bie maanle nu.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Bɛmaa me kpɔvolɛ ɛyɛ kɛ amumuyɛnli, na mɔɔ ko tia me la ɛyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnle tenlene la.

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anyelazo wɔ ni, saa Nyamenle ye ye zo a?

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Asoo ɔyia ngyegyelɛ na ɔfɛlɛ a Nyamenle badie ye ɛzunlɛ?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Asoo ɔ nye balie Tumivolɛ ne anwo? Asoo ɔbazu yeavɛlɛ Nyamenle mekɛ biala?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Mebahilehile wɔ kɛ Nyamenle tumi ne si de la; debie biala mɔɔ fane Tumivolɛ ne anwo la, menrɛva menrɛvea.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛ muala bɛnwu ye bɛ nye zo; na duzu ati a akee bɛ muala bɛyɛ mgbane a?” Zofaa

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Na Zofaa hanle kɛ, “Kɛ Nyamenle si tea amumuyɛnli ne la ɛne, yɛɛ agyadeɛ mɔɔ nzisima nyia fi Tumivolɛ ne ɛkɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Saa ɔ mra so dɔɔnwo a, bɛwie dadeɛ nloa; yɛɛ ɔ mra ɛnrɛli bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ kɛha ɔ nzi la, ewule tɔ bɛ avinli sɛkye bɛ; yɛɛ bɛ ye mɔ ɛnrɛzu ɛnrɛye bɛ awolɛ.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ɔbahuohua dwɛtɛ fufule nloa kɛ anwea, na yeahuohua ndakpa nloa kɛ ndɛtɛlɛ edukue,

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: noko mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la a baheda a, na menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la ahyɛ ye dwɛtɛ fufule ne ava.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Ye sua mɔɔ ɔsi la le kɛ kɛdɛba ndenda, ɔle kɛ sinzavolɛ kpɔda.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ɔbala kɛ sukoavolɛ, noko ɔnrɛla zɔ bieko; ɔkatete ɔ nye zo la ɛnee ye anwonyia ne ɛwie.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ monla ye kɛ azuyilɛ; nɔɔzo, ahumuakyima fa ye kɔ.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Aduduleɛ anwoma kpogya ye zo kɔ; ɔtu ye ɔfi ye tɛnlabelɛ ne.

english_verse: without showing mercy, as they try to escape.
translation_verse: Ɔfuandi ye ɔto; ɔnze ye anwunvɔne, ɔnriandi ɔfi ye tumi ne abo.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Ɔnriandi la ɛnee ɔ nwo anwoma ne ɛlɛsu huu, na anwoma ne ane ne ka ye ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Bɛtu bulalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ bo, yɛɛ bɛtwe kɔbele bɛfi awolɛ nu.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Menli ɛndie awozinli kabikabi ne, bɛfunvu azɛlɛ bo ahuma kuloonwu bɛtu awolɛ wɔ awozinli kabikabi ne anu.

english_verse: They dig tunnels in distant, unknown places, where they dangle by ropes.
translation_verse: Bɛfunvu ahuma wɔ bɔnza mɔɔ menli ɛnle nu la anu, ɛleka mɔɔ adendulɛma ɛnze la, bɛkenda nyɛma nwo na bɛdi ehono bɛkɔ bɛba.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Aleɛ vi azɛlɛ nu a ba a, na ɔ bo lɔ, ɔtu ɔfonyia kɛ senle la nu.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Adenle zɔhane, anloma mɔɔ di nane la ɛnze ye, yɛɛ kyɛnyema nye ɛtɛnwunle ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Nane anwo ɛzulolɛ biala agyakɛ ɛtɛtiale ɛkɛ, yɛɛ awenade bɔbɔ ɛtɛpɛle nu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: “Sonla funvu awolɛ mɔɔ yɛ se la anu, na ɔfunvu awoka ne mɔ abo.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ɔpepɛ ndenle wɔ awolɛ ne mɔ anu, na ɔnwu debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ɔsi azudenle ne mɔ, amaa bɛanzenze, na ɔtwe debie mɔɔ vea la ɔfinde wienyi nu.

english_verse: But where is wisdom found?
translation_verse: Noko nienwu yɛɛ yɛkɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a, yɛɛ ndelebɛbo wɔ ni?

english_verse: No human knows the way.
translation_verse: “Dasanli ɛnze ye adenle, yɛɛ bɛnnwu ye wɔ anyewɔzoma anu.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Buma se, ‘Ɔnle me lɔ’, yɛɛ nyevile se, ‘Ɔnle me lɔ’.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Bɛnzu ezukoa nvutuke bɛndɔ, yɛɛ bɛnzu dwɛtɛ fufule bɛndɔ.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Ezukoa nvutuke nee neanleɛ nee ye ɛnzɛ, yɛɛ bɛfa bɛsenza anwodeɛ nee ezukoa nvutuke tagyee a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Yiteɔpea ezukoa bolɛ topaze nee ye ɛnzɛ, yɛɛ bɛfa bɛto ezukoa nvutuke tagyee nwo a bɛnzɛ.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛvea anyewɔzoamra kɔsɔɔti, anwomanyunlu nloma bɔbɔ ɛnze.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ nee Ewule se, ‘Yɛde ye bɛse bɛse.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: “Nyamenle a ze ye adenle, nee ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la a.

english_verse: When God divided out the wind and the water,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔvale tumi ɔmanle anwoma, na ɔzuzule nzule ne mɔ kpole;

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ezule tɔ dwu, na ɔhilele ɛsɛnlɛmanye adenle ne la,

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: “Na ɔzele sonla kɛ, ‘Nrɛlɛbɛ a le kɛ ɛkɛzulo Awulae; yɛɛ ndelebɛbo a le kɛ ɛkɛhwe ɛ nwo ɛkɛvi ɛtane nwo!’ ”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: Ɔse, “O, anrɛɛ meazia meayɛ kɛ me dɛba ne, mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle sinza me la;

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛnee ye kɛnlaneɛ ne ta me nwo zo, na ɔmanle menwunle aze wɔ awozinli nu;

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: kɛmɔ ɛnee me anwonyia ɛyɛ kpole, na Nyamenle agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne wɔ me awuke nu;

english_verse: and all of my children were nearby.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛnee Tumivolɛ ne nee me de, na me mra ɛbɔ ɛyia me;

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛnee meleke ɛbu me nwo zo, na bodane manle nwole bule kɛ azudenle manle me la.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mengɔle suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, mɔɔ menzieziele me ebia na mendɛnlanle aze,

english_verse: while the older ones stood
translation_verse: Mgbanyima gyakyile ɛdendɛlɛ, na bɛvale bɛ sa bɛsosɔle bɛ nloa;

english_verse: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
translation_verse: mgbanyima bɔbɔ yɛle ngungoonwu, na awie biala muanle ɔ nloa.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ menliele ehyianvolɛma mɔɔ zunle vɛlɛle me, na memboale nrisa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awie ɛmboa bɛ la.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ asɛɛ ɛdɔ nzonle la yileyilale me, na memanle ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ dole anyelielɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Membule pɛlepɛlelilɛ tɛladeɛ menwulale, na me nɔhalɛlilɛ yɛle kɛ tɛladeɛ nee abɔtile.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Menyɛle anyenzinliravolɛma anye, na menyɛle abuburama agyakɛ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Menyɛle ehyianvolɛma bɛ ze, na memkpondɛle mɔɔ menze ye la anzi adenle.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mendudule mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la agye, memanle ɔdole mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye ɔ gye nu la aze.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: “Akee mendwenlenle kɛ mebanyi meahyɛ, na meawu meala me sua nu koonwu.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Me ndinli dendenle dwule nzule nu, na me nya ne mɔ nyianle nɔɔzo ɛbɔlɛ,

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: Menli hendɛle diele me, na bɛyɛle ngungoonwu bɛdiele me folɛdulɛ.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Metendɛ mewie a bɛmbuke bɛ nloa bieko, na me edwɛkɛ dɔle bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Bɛhendɛle me kɛ bɛkendɛ ezule; na bɛbukebukele bɛ nloa kɛ asɛɛ bɛkendɛ nyenyesuo.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛnlie bɛ nwo bɛnli la ati, menzelele; na me nloa anwo ɛzelekɛ yɛle akɛnrazilɛ manle bɛ.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mengilele bɛ adenle na mendɛnlanle kɛ belemgbunli, mendɛnlanle kɛ belemgbunli de ye ɛlɔnema avinli, menzɔle bɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ kyekye nyanelilɛma arɛle.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: “Noko nea, me sa nu nlɔma ɛnɛ golo me nwo, bɛ ze mɔ bɔbɔ anrɛɛ nee me ahwea ɛnrɛbɔ nu ɛnrɛzinza me mboane.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ menwɔnyia ye bɛ nwo zo a? Bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ehyia nee ɛhɔne maa bɛdi ɛsɛlɛ zo ɛva ketekete ne.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Bɛtu bɛ bɛfi menli avinli; bɛwudo bɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛwudo awule.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Bɛda ɛzezeane ahuma mgbole nu, yɛɛ azɛlɛ bo nee awolɛ mbɔne nu.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Bɛsu kɛ nane wɔ kpɔkɛ ne mɔ abo; na bɛnyenya bɛ nwo bɛda mbowumbaka bo.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Bɛle gyibivolɛma ekpunli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ, na bɛbo bɛ bɛdu bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Kɛkala bɛfa me bɛto edwɛne, na meyɛ bɛ agolobɛnwo sonla.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Bɛkyi me, bɛmbikye me; bɛnwu me a bɛto me nwo nyɛlɛ.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛbɛlɛ me aze la, yemaa bɛva bɛ ɛya bɛgua me nwo zo.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Kpamgbanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ dwazo me fema zo, bɛtu me mgbaliko, bɛfoa me ndinlizo, na bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo kɛ bɛsɛkye me bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Bɛtua me adenle bɛtinli me nyane nu; noko awie biala ɛnze bɛ kɛ bɛgyakyi.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ kpole ɛha me; me enililɛ ɛze kɛ anwoma, yɛɛ me anwonyia ne ɛminli kɛ amungu.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Kɛkala me ɛkɛla bɔbɔ vi me nu ɛnriandi; nyane ngome ɛva me aze.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo me mbowule nu bu me, yɛɛ me nwo ɛngyakyi me ɛfofolɛ.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛva ɛya ɛzɔ me nu, ye ɛya ne kyekye me kɛ me anwuma tɛladeɛ kɔme.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛvuandi me ɛdo azia nu, yemaa meyɛ kɛ ndɛtɛlɛ nee nzonle.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: “Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ, na ɛnlie me zo; mesɛlɛ, noko ɛndie me.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, meze kɛ ɛbamaa meawu, na meahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ teasema amuala wɔ la.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ memkpondɛle kpalɛ la, ɛtane a rale a; yɛɛ mengendɛle wienyi, na awozinli a rale a.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Me ahonle ɛlɛdi nyane, yɛɛ ɔngyakyi; kɛ nyanelilɛ ne doɔdoa zo ala ɛne.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Dahuu melua awozinli nu, menze sɛnzɛne deɛ holɛ; medwazo menli nu, na mesu mebiza moalɛ.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Me mediema mrenya a le ɛzonlɛ, yɛɛ me gɔnwo mɔ a le soholo.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Me nwonane kpunli na ɔtete ɔgua, yɛɛ me mbowule nu dɔ kɛ ɔgyi senle zo.

english_verse: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.
translation_verse: Me getaa edwɛne ɛhakyi awolɛyelɛ, yɛɛ me fulutu edwɛne ɛhakyi ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Me nee me nye ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ; kɛ menrɛnlea bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya la menrɛhulo ye.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Asoo munzule ɛndo menli mɔɔ ɛnle tenlene la, yɛɛ nyane ɛndo amumuyɛma?

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Asoo ɔnnwu me ndenle ne mɔ, na ɔnnea me gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ ne mɔ ɔ?

english_verse: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
translation_verse: “Saa membɔ adalɛ wɔ me ɛlualɛ nu, na menli mɛlɛbɛla nzi a,

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: ɛnee Nyamenle ɛzuzu me wɔ nɔhalɛ tone zo, na ɔbanwu kɛ menze nwolɛ bie.

english_verse: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to,
translation_verse: Saa mengyakyi nɔhalɛ adenle ne, memaa me nye ɛbɛlɛbɛla me ahonle, na menli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ a,

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ɛnee maa menlua, na sonla gyɛne ɛli; mɔɔ melua la, maa bɛdudu bɛgua.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: “Saa raalɛ ɛhwe me ahonle, na medɛ ye me gɔnwo anlenkɛ nloa a,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: ɛnee maa me ye ɛdo nrenya fofolɛ aleɛ, na maa nrenya gyɛne ɛvo ye ɛzɔlɛ zo.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛhye le munzule kpole, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma nea maa bɛtua menli nwolɛ kakɛ a;

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔle kɛ ɛbolɔ senle, na ɔbayela mɔɔ melɛ la amuala.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: “Saa me sonvolɛ nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ ɛrabɔ me somolɛ, na mekpo ye,

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: na saa Nyamenle dwazo a, duzu a mebayɛ a? Saa ɔbizebiza nuhua a, kɛ menwɔzi menwɔye ɔ nloa ɛ?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Na tɛ mɔɔ bɔle me dole ɔmɔ akunlu la a bɔle ɔdaye ɔ, yɛɛ yeambɔ yɛ wɔ ɛkolɛ nu ɔ?

english_verse: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
translation_verse: “Metɛkpole kɛ menrɛboa ehyianli, anzɛɛ menrɛmaa kunlanvolɛ raalɛ ɛnrɛzu ɔ nye ɛnrɛbɔ nu,

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: anzɛɛ me ngomekye menrɛli me aleɛ, na menrɛmaa nrisa bie ɛnrɛli a.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔvi me ngakula nu, menyɛle nrisa bɛ ze, mevi ɔmɔ akunlu ala la, meneanle ahunlanvolɛ.

english_verse: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
translation_verse: memaa ye kundu mɔɔ meva me mboane enrinli menwo la, na ɔyeye ye ahonle nu ɔyileyila me.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: “Saa mesisi arisa ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ melɛ moalɛ wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ a,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: ɛnee maa me awane vi me bati ɛkpane, na maa me sa baka ne ɛdu ɛdɔ.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee mesulo Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne, yɛɛ eza anrɛɛ menrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla.

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: “Saa menva ezukoa menyɛ me nyamenle, anzɛɛ menva me rɛle menwula ezukoa nvutuke tagyee nu;

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: saa menli fɛlɛko kɛ me anwonyia ɛyɛ kpole, anzɛɛ kɛmɔ me sa ɛyi tɛkɛɛ la;

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: “Metɛdile me kpɔvolɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo fɛlɛko, anzɛɛ metɛdile fɛlɛko kɛ munzule dole ye;

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: metɛfale me nloa metɛkanle ɛtane, metɛwale me kpɔvolɛ amonle kɛ ɔwu;

english_verse: No one ever went hungry at my house,
translation_verse: asoo me awuke nu amra ɛtɛkanle kɛ, ‘Nwane a ɛtɛdile ye debie ɛlɛ a?’

english_verse: and travelers were always welcome.

translation_verse: “Nea, Nyamenle le bedevinli, ɔmkpo bie; yɛɛ ye ndelebɛbo nu mia kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ɔmmaa amumuyɛma ɛndɛnla aze ɛngyɛ, na ɔmaa amaneɛnwunlɛma nyia bɛ gyinlabelɛ.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Ɔnye ɔ nye wɔ tenlenema anwo zo, ɔsiezie bɛ kɛ arelemgbunli na ɔkpogya bɛ zo dahuu.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Saa bɛgua bɛ anga na anwubɛnyunlu kyekye bɛ a,

english_verse: God points out their sin and their pride,
translation_verse: ɛnee Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ nee bɛ ninyɛmunli ne mɔ; kɛ bɛlɛyɛ mgbanyizonle.

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Ɔbuke bɛ nzo ɔmaa bɛte folɛ, ɔmaa bɛtwe bɛ nwo bɛfi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtie ye na bɛsonle ye a, bɛdi bɛ mekɛ ne anwonyia nu, bɛdi bɛ ɛvolɛ ne mɔ wɔ anzonudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Na saa bɛandie ye a, bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa, na bɛawu ewule mɔɔ bɛnde ɔ bo a.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la fa ɛya sie bɛ ahonle nu, kanza bɛwɔ ngyianlɛ nu bɔbɔ a, bɛnzu bɛnvɛlɛ Nyamenle moalɛ.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Bɛwu bɛ mgbavolɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛ awieleɛ wie anyiemgba nu.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Nyamenle dua nyanenwunlɛma nyane zo die bɛ, na ɔdua bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ zo ɔbuke bɛ nzo.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: “Eza Nyamenle yele wɔ vile nyanenwunlɛ nu hɔle ɛleka wienyi mɔɔ anwodɔlɛ wɔ la, na wɔ ɛkponle zo yɛle sosɔɔ.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, bɛva amumuyɛma ndeanlɛ bɛdea wɔ; ndɛnebualɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛbɔ wɔ kpanwu.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Nea boɛ anrɛɛ ɛyavalɛ kɛmaa bɛkɛgolo ɛ nwo; yɛɛ mmamaa ɛkpɔnedeɛ ne kpole ti ɛfo adenle.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Asoo wɔ ɛzunlɛ kɛye wɔ kɛvi nyanenwunlɛ nu, anzɛɛ wɔ anwosesebɛ kɛhola kɛboa wɔ?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nwo dɔ aledwolɛ ne, mekɛ mɔɔ maanle maanle bo zo bɔ la ɛne.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Nea boɛ, mmakakyi ɛkɔyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ wɔhulo ɛhye wɔdɛla amaneɛnwunlɛ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: “Nea, Nyamenle tumi ne le kpole, nwane a le kilehilevolɛ kɛ ɔdaye a?

english_verse: to guide or correct him. Others Have Praised God
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛhola ɛhile ye adenle, anzɛɛ nwane a kɛhola kɛze ye kɛ, ‘Wɔyɛ ɛtane’ a?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ bɛkɛhanvo ye gyima ne, mɔɔ menli ɛdo nwolɛ edwɛne la.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu ye; sonla nwu ye moa moa.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Nyamenle le kpole, noko yɛnze ye; ye ɛvolɛ dodo, bɛnrɛnwu ye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: and supplies us with rain.
translation_verse: na ɔvi anwomanyunlu ɔtɔ ɔmaa sonla nyia bie dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Asoo awie kɛhola kɛde kɛ amungu si tɛlɛdɛlɛ, nee kɛ anwomanyunlu si kuluhulu la abo?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, ɔkpakye ɛsɛnlɛmanye ɔbɔ ɔ nwo mgbɔlɔka, na ɔkeda nyevile buma bo azo.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ azo yɛɛ ɔdua ɔbua maanle maanle ndɛne na ɔmaa aleɛ bu a.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Ɔfa ɔ sa ɔsɔ ɛsɛnlɛmanye, na ɔmaa ɔpe ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Ye ɛpenlɛ ne kile kɛ ɔsi ɔde la, kɛ ye nungule ɛya ne tia ninyɛndane.

english_verse: I am frightened and tremble all over,
translation_verse: “Ɛhye bɔbɔ maa me ahonle tu, na ɔsi me kunlu.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Tie kɛ ɔ ne ɛlɛsi ahulu bie a, nee kpomgbanyekpomgbanye mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔdwu aleɛabo ɛleka biala, yɛɛ ye ɛsɛlɛmanye kpakye a ɔdwu aleɛabo muleɛ biala azo.

english_verse: make us stop and think about God's power,
translation_verse: Ɔkpɔne menli gyima, amaa menli kɔsɔɔti anwu ye gyima.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Akee nane ne mɔ kɔ bɛ nla ɛleka, na bɛboa bɛ tunli nu.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Nyamenle die ɛnwomenle a ɔtɔ ayese, na ɔmaa azule ne mɔ bɔ kunguma ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nzule gyinla amungu nu; na amungu ne mɔ maa ezule fedevede.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nvonleɛ ɛdenrɛlɛ o, ye azɛlɛ ye ati o, anzɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ ti o, ɔmaa ɔsi zɔ.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: O Dwobu, tie ɛhye; gyinla na dwenle Nyamenle nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
translation_verse: Asoo ɛze kɛ Nyamenle si maa ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye amungu ne anu la?

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛze kɛ amungu ne mɔ si sinze anwomanyunlu la? Ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ kpole, ɔyɛ nwanwane gyima.

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ saa nyiakɛ anwoma ne maa ewiade gyinla a, wɔ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ dɔ.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛkɛhola ɛkɛyɛ kɛ ɔdaye, ɛkɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ anwomanyunlu ne, ɛkɛmaa ɔkɛyɛ ɛsesebɛ kɛ neanleɛ la?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Kile yɛ mɔɔ yɛha yɛhile ye la; awozinli ti, yɛnrɛnwu yɛ edwɛkɛ ne dwula.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Asoo bɛha bɛhile ye kɛ mebadendɛ ɔ? Asoo sonla kɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛme ye?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: “Kɛkala, wienyi kpakye anwomanyunlu, mɔɔ anwoma ne ɛye ɔ nyunlu la, menli ɛnrɛhola wienyi ne nea.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Ɛdɔlɔlɛ guanye kɛ ezukoa nvutuke vi sɔlɔ ba; tumi bedevinli ɛbɔ Nyamenle ɛyia.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ ne, yɛnrɛhola yɛnrɛnwu ye; ye tumi nee ye pɛlepɛlelilɛ le kpole, yɛɛ ɔnrɛbu ɔ nye ɔnrɛgua ye tenleneyɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli sulo ye, ɔmbu menli mɔɔ dwenle kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo la bie.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle ahumu ne anu hilele Dwobu.

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Ɔse, Ɛdɛnkɛma “Nwane noko a ɔdaye ɔlɛfa edwɛkɛ mgbane mgbane yeazɛkye adwenle la?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Bɛza kɛ nrenya, mebiza wɔ meamaa wɔaye ɔ nloa.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mewula azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze la ɛnee ɛwɔ ni? Saa ɛse wɔ adwenle ɛdi, ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo a, ka kile me.

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ nwane a dole nyevile ne anlenkɛ nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvi azɛlɛ ti anu ɔkpukele,

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: mɔɔ menvale amungu menyɛle ye ɛdanlɛ, na menvale awozinli kabikabi menyɛle ye tabule,

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: mengyale ye ɛweɛne, na menduoduale ye nlenkɛ, menguale mbulalɛ bɛ nzi,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: na menzele kɛ, ‘Ɛke ala a ɔwɔ kɛ ɛba ɛbadwu a, ɛngɔ ɛ nyunlu ko, na ɛke yɛɛ wɔ azɛlɛkye mgbole babu adwu’ la, ɛnee ɛwɔ nienwu?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Sumunli kɛ bɛwole wɔ la, kenle ko bɔbɔ wɔmaa aleɛ ɛhye yɛɛ wɔmaa aleɛbahye ɛnwu ɔ bo zo,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: amaa yeazɔ azɛlɛ ye anloa ne mɔ yeahegye ye, yeamaa amumuyɛma vi bɛ feabelɛ avinde ɔ?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa azɛlɛ ye yɛ kɛ ɛva mɔɔ bɛzi zo, na ɔmaa ɔ nye da ɛkɛ kɛ ɛdanlɛ.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛngola wienyi ne nea yɛɛ bɛ sa ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛmaa bɛ zo la dwɔlɔdwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Asoo bɛye ɛbolɔ nlenkɛ ne mɔ bɛhile wɔ ɛlɛ, anzɛɛ wɔnwu awozinli kabikabi nlenkɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛ?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Asoo wɔnwu kɛ ewiade kpole si de la? Saa ɛze ɛhye mɔ amuala a, ka kile me.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: “Nienwu yɛɛ wienyi sua zo adenle ne la a, yɛɛ awozinli sua zo wɔ nienwu,

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Ɛze, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛwo wɔ, yɛɛ wɔhyɛ kɛ kpanwenle!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: “Asoo wɔwolo ezukɔtweaba ninyɛnezielɛ sua ne anu, anzɛɛ wɔnwu ezuawolɛ ninyɛnezielɛ sua ne,

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: mɔɔ meva mezie memaa ngyegyelɛ nee konle mekɛ la?

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ wienyi vi ba la adenle, anzɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ aduduleɛ anwoma vi bɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la wɔ ni?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: “Nwane a ɛye ɛzezeane ɛmaa ezule, na yekpakye adenle yemaa ɛsɛnlɛmanye bolɛ,

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔmaa azɛlɛ mɔɔ le resee na yehwie la ayɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ fifi ndile la a?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Asoo ezule lɛ ɔ ze, anzɛɛ nwane a ɛwo ɛbɔlɛ a?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nzule ne mɔ yɛ se kɛ bolɛ, yɛɛ buma nye yɛ ketekete.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛgua ‘Nwɔlɔra nsuu’ ne nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ anzɛɛ ɛkɛhola ɛkɛzanyi nyɛma mɔɔ kyekye ‘Apeansa’ la ɔ?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛhile nwɔlɔra ne mɔ ɛlobɔ, anzɛɛ ɛkɛhola ɛkɛhile ‘Ɛrelera nee ɔ mra’ adenle ɔ?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ɛze anwuma maamɛla ne mɔ ɔ? Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛmaa bɛkɛli zolɛ wɔ aleɛabo ɔ?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛmaa ɛ ne zo ɛkɛze amungu kɛ azuyilɛ ɛmonla wɔ ɔ?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛzoa ɛsɛlɛmanye ne mɔ ɛkɛmaa bɛkɛhɔ, na bɛkɛraze wɔ kɛ, ‘Yɛmɛ ɛne?’

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛhile amungu ne mɔ nrɛlɛbɛ, anzɛɛ ɛmaa ɛbɔlɛ ɛnyia ndelebɛbo a?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛhu nane ɛkɛmaa awenade na ɛkɛmaa awenade mralɛ akunlu kɛdwo bɛ nwo,

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛsise ngoko wɔ bɛ tunli nloa, anzɛɛ bɛkɛhɔ nzia anyebolo nu la?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Saa aleɛ ti ahɔhɔsɛlɛ mralɛ duolua nu su fɛlɛ Nyamenle a, nwane a maa bɛ aleɛ a?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Ɛze mekɛ mɔɔ awoka zo mbɔnkye wo a? Wɔnwu kɛ weɛlɛ si wo la ɔ?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
