translation_verse: Bɛ mra nyi kpɔkɛ bo wienyi nu, na bɛ nwo mia; bɛkpakye bɛ nwo, yɛɛ bɛnzia bɛmba bieko.

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Ɔkyi suakpole zo alɛra ne mɔ; ɔnde nanekavolɛ ne ane.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Awoka ne mɔ azo a le ye adidileka a, na ɔkpondɛ ndile amolɛ ɔdi.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Asoo ɛbɔ nu ɛnlankɛ nyinli bazonle wɔ? Asoo nɔɔzo ɔbala wɔ tunli ne anu?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛkɛhola ye kyekye, ɛkɛmaa ɔkɛvundu azɛlɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɛva bulalɛ ɔ nee wɔ kɛyɛ gyima wɔ mbɔnza nu?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo yɛ se la ati, ɛkɛva ɛ rɛle ɛkɛwula ye nu, na ɛkɛva wɔ gyima muala ɛkɛgua ɔ nwo zo ɔ?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Ɛdie ye ɛdi kɛ ɔbazia yeara yearava wɔ ma ne yeara ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Soholo kola bɔ ɔ ndɛba anu kpalɛ kpalɛ; noko asoo bɛfa bɛto azuazuanloma nwo a ɔkɛyɛ boɛ ɔ?

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔgyakyi ye aholonvia anwea nu, ɔmaa bɛ nwo yɛ wuluwulu.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Ɔ rɛle fi kɛ egyakɛ kola gelegele bɛ, yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole kola tietia zo.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee ɔ mra di ye ketekete, kɛ asɛɛ tɛ ɔ mra ɔ; kanza ye ɛvɛlɛ yɛ mgbane bɔbɔ a, ɔnvane ɔ nwo;

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa ɔ rɛle ɛvi nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ yeammaa ye ndelebɛbo nretee zɛ.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Saa ɔbɔ ɔ ndɛba anu kɛ ɔtu a, ɔsele ɛkpɔnwɔ ne nee ye kavolɛ ne.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Asoo ɛdawɔ a ɛmaa ɛkpɔnwɔ anwosesebɛ a? Ɛdawɔ a ɛmaa ye ɔ kɔme nu enrinli ne a?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛdawɔ a ɛmaa ɔwuluwulu kɛ abɛbɛ a? Ye ɛnwomenlelielɛ bedevinli ne yɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ɔfunvu bɔnza ne anu, na ɔdi ye anwosesebɛ nwo fɛlɛko; ɔfa ye anwosesebɛ muala ɔkɔ konle nloa.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Ɔnze ɛzulolɛ deɛ holɛ, yɛɛ ɔ rɛle ɛmbɔ, ɔnwu dadeɛ a ɔnnriandi.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Ɔ kɛnra azo a ɛda mbaka rede, yɛɛ atwɛ nee ɛtweneɛ pɛ memeamemea a.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Ɔfa atisesebɛ nee ɛya yɛɛ ɔnriandi a; saa ɔte aweɛne tendenle ne ane a, ɔgyinla a, ɔngyinla.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Saa ɔte aweɛne tendenle ne ane a, ɔtea nu, ‘Ɛhɛɛ!’ Ɔte konle ne nganeɛ wɔ moa moa, ɔte safohyenlema ɛhululɛ nee bɛ ɛdeanlɛ ne.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Asoo wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ti yɛɛ kyɛnyema tu, na ɔtɛlɛdɛlɛ ɔ ndɛba wɔ nyiakɛ a?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Ɔde ɛkɛ ne a ɔtoto ɔ nye ɔkpondɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛli; ɔ nye die ye moa moa nehane.

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Ɔ mra no mogya; na ɛleka mɔɔ bɛku menli bɛgua la, ɛkɛ ne a ɔkɔ a.

english_verse: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
translation_verse: “Dwobu, asoo sonla mɔɔ nvonleɛ ala a ɔkpondɛ la nee Tumivolɛ ne su kpolera? Awie mɔɔ nee Nyamenle su kpolera la, bɛmaa ɔye ɔ nloa.” Dwobu

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: Meha ko, menga bieko; fane nwiɔ ɛ, mendɛ me nloa anu ko.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma buale Dwobu wɔ ahumuakyima ne anu. Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Bɛza kpalɛ kɛ nrenya; mebiza wɔ edwɛkɛ, na ye me ɔ nloa.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛdawɔ bɔbɔ ɛbua me fɔlɛ ɔ? Ɛbua me fɔlɛ na wɔali benle ɔ?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛlɛ anwosesebɛ kɛ Nyamenle, yɛɛ ɛkɛhola ɛkɛva ɛnelɛ ɛkɛhulu kɛ ye ɛdeɛ ne la?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Fa mgboleyɛlɛ nee dibilɛ siezie ɛ nwo; na fa anyunlunyia nee kɛnlɛma yɛ ɛ nwo hyeleenyi.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Fu bɛ kɔsɔɔti wula azɛlɛ bo; na kyekye bɛ nye wɔ ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Na menwɔlie menwɔdo nu kɛ, ɛdawɔ wɔ anwosesebɛ kola maa ɛdi konim.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Nea nane kɔliadunli; membɔle ye kɛ membɔle wɔ la; ɔdi ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Nea anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye ɔ nze nu, nee anwosesebɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye ndinli nu la.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ɔsa ɔ dua ketee kɛ sida baka, ɔ gyakɛ ndinli ne mɔ to bɛka nu.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ye mbowule yɛ se kɛ kɔbele, ye agbɔkɛ le kɛ mbulalɛ agbɔma.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: “Yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle asa anloa gyima mɔɔ lumua; ye Bɔvolɛ ne ala a kola twe ɔ nwo dadeɛ a.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔnyia aleɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, ɛkɛ ne a ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole kɔsɔɔti di nwɔhoa a.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Atoatɛlɛ ne mɔ abo yɛɛ ɔda a, na ɔfea ndɔ ne mɔ abo wɔ azia ne anu.

english_verse: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
translation_verse: Atoatɛlɛ ne mɔ maa ye alubo; azia nloa ndile bɔ yia ye.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Nea, saa azule ne tu kpole bɔbɔ a, ɔnzulo; azule Dwɔdan hu gua ɔ nyunlu bɔbɔ a, ye ahonle gyi pi.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Asoo awie kɛhola koba to kye ye, anzɛɛ kɛhola kɛva ɛhane kɛzɔ ɔ bonyi?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛva fɛlɛ koba ɛkɛhye ɛlɛnrɛne, anzɛɛ ɛkɛva nyɛma ɛkɛkyekye ɔ tafinlima ɔ?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛva nyɛma ɛkɛzinla ɔ bonyi nu, anzɛɛ ɛkɛva koba ɛkɛbɔ ye awudwolɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Will it beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Asoo ɔkɛzu ɔkɛbodo wɔ? Asoo ɔkɛdendɛ bɛtɛɛ ɔkɛhile wɔ?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Asoo ɔ nee wɔ bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ, kɛ ɛva ye ɛyɛ wɔ sonvolɛ dahuu?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛ nee ye bali nwɔhoa kɛ ɛ nee anloma la, anzɛɛ ɛbazɔ ye nyɛma kɛ wɔ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ ɛva ɛli nwɔhoa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Asoo gualilɛma bali ye bolɛ? Asoo gualilɛma bahyɛ amaa bɛ nwo?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛkɛhola ɛkɛva atwɛ ɛkɛwɔ ye nwoma ne, anzɛɛ ɛkɛva fɛlɛhyelɛ atwɛ ɛkɛwɔ ɔ ti?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ sa ka ye nea; konle mɔɔ ɔ nee wɔ baho la, ɛnrɛyɛ ko ɛlɛ!

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: “Nea, saa sonla nye bobɔ ye mgbane bɔbɔ a, ye anyelazo yɛ mgbane na ɔ nwo bubu ye.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Awie fee anwo ɛnyɛ ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛha ye a. Na ɛnee akee nwane a kɛhola me nyunlu gyinla a?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛva debie ɛvɛne me mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ metua a? Debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la le me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
translation_verse: “Menrɛyɛ koonwu wɔ ɔ gyakɛ ne mɔ, ye anwosesebɛ bedevinli ne, anzɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ye kɛnlɛma ti.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛkpa ɔ nwo tɛladeɛ a? Nwane a asa kɛhola kɛfiti ye konle tɛladeɛ ndazo ne a?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛzɔ ɔ nloa kɛbuke ye a? Ɔ gye mɔɔ gua ɔ nloa anu la yɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Ɔ nzi le kɛ enyinlike ɛhonlone, bɛbetɛbeta nwo kɛ bɛholo sumi bɛsosɔ bɛ.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Ko beta ko; bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo mɔɔ ɛkpɔkye ko bɔbɔ a ɔnyɛ boɛ a.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Ye ɛnwuasinlɛ sɔ kɛ tɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nye le kɛ mangyee sɛnzɛne.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: Senle gɔhyee vi ɔ nloa anu finde; ɔ nloa anu kpa senle.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Ɔ bonyi nu kpu esike, kɛ nzule mɔɔ gyi senle zo la kpukpuke.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ɔ bonyi nu anwoma kola maa senle sɔ, yɛɛ senle tafinlima vi ɔ nloa anu finde.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Ɔ kɔme baka ne anu yɛ se, ɔ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Ye nwonane belebele gua zo; ɔkyekye ɔ nwo ketekete mɔɔ ɛsianyi nu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Saa ɔmaa ɔ nwo zo a, anwosesebɛma sulo; ɔka ɔ nwo a, bɛtɔ gyebilisanza.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Bulalɛ le ɔ nye zo ɛdɛkɛ, yɛɛ kɔbele le ɔ nye zo baka kpɔlɔlera.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Ahoholombaka le kɛ abɛlɛ baka welera, yɛɛ ɛtweneɛ wɔ ye a ɔsele.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Ɔ kɛnra zo abonle ne le kɛ foandɛkɛ anloa nlane; ɔtɛlɛdɛlɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ma ɛwozolɛ taboa wɔ azia nu.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa buma wu kɛ ɛzɛne mɔɔ gyi senle zo; ɔmaa nyevile yɛ kɛ nwole mɔɔ gyi siase nu.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Ɔtu ɔtenrɛ a ɔgyakyi adenle fufule ɛdenraa ɔ nzi; ɔmaa sonla dwenle kɛ nyevile ne ɛvi egyɛne.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Aleɛabo, ye ɛsaso biala ɛnle ɛke, ɔle abɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛnzulo ɛhwee a.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔmbu debie biala mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo la ɛhwee; ɔdi mgbanyizonlema kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Meze kɛ ɛkola ɛyɛ ninyɛne muala, yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛnzɛkye wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ biala.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Ɛbizale kɛ me ndelebɛbo le nyɛ, mɔɔ mefedevede wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nu a? Yemɔti medendɛ ɛdendɛlɛ mɔɔ mende ɔ bo a, meha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menze a, na ye ɛzulolɛ bo me nwo zo.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: Ɛzele me kɛ mendie na ɛtendɛ, ɛbiza me edwɛkɛ na menye ɔ nloa.

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Me nzo yɛɛ menvale mendele wɔ nganeɛ a, na kɛkala, yemɔ menwu ɛ nyunlu;

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ hilele Dwobu la, akee ɔzele Timanli Ɛlaefaze kɛ, “Meva wɔ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ nwiɔ ne anwo ɛya, ɔluakɛ bɛanga nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane me nwo la, kɛmɔ me sonvolɛ Dwobu hanle la.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛva nlankɛ nyinli nsuu nee mboane nyinli nsuu bɛhɔ me sonvolɛ Dwobu anwo ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ti, na me sonvolɛ Dwobu bazɛlɛ amaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ mebadie ye nzɛlɛlɛ ne, na me nee bɛ ɛnrɛli ye kɛ mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ de la, ɔboalekɛ bɛanga me nwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ kɛ mɔɔ me sonvolɛ Dwobu hanle la.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛlaefaze, Beledade, yɛɛ Zofaa hɔyɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele bɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma diele Dwobu nzɛlɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwobu zɛlɛle manle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ la, Ɛdɛnkɛma akee manle ɔnyianle ye anwonyia ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye dɛba la mɔnwo.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Akee ɔ mediema mrenya nee mraalɛ rale ye sua nu nee ye radole ɛsalɛ; bɛyɛle ye gyakɔ na bɛkyekyele ɔ rɛle wɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa yezi ɔ nwo zo la anwo, na bɛ nuhua ko biala manle ye ezukoa nee ezukoa nvutuke kpɔdelera.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Eza ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nsuu nee mraalɛ nsa.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Wɔ aleɛabo, mraalɛ ɛnle ɛleka biala mɔɔ nee Dwobu amra mraalɛ ne mɔ sɛ anwofɛlɛko a; bɛ ze gyakyile bɛ agyadeɛ kɛ bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ ala la.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Dwobu wule wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee akee yeyɛ ɛrelera nwosonwoso la.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛndie amumuyɛma folɛdulɛ, na ɔnyɛ mɔɔ ɛtanevolɛma yɛ la; ɔnva amgbuzilɛma agɔnwolɛ.

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Nyilalɛ kpalɛ

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Ɔ nye die Ɛdɛnkɛma Mɛla ne anwo, na ɔdwenledwenle nwolɛ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ azule nloa baka, mɔɔ so ma wɔ ye ɛlobɔ nloa, ye nya ɛmkpolo ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɔkpazi debie biala anu.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛnle zɔ, bɛle kɛ abonle mɔɔ anwoma bɔ ye kɔ la.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Yemɔti amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne anu, yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma ɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ wɔ tenlenema avinli.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ze pɛlepɛlelilɛnli adenle; amumuyɛnli adenle fa ye kɔ munzule nu.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a maanle maanle te atua ɛ? Duzu ati a menli fa adwenle ɛtane ɛ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli boɔboa dwenle ɛtane, bɛ maanle mgbanyinli bɔ nu kɔ agyinla tia Ɛdɛnkɛma nee mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la.

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: Bɛse, “Bɛmaa yɛye yɛ nwo wɔ bɛ tumi bo, na yɛye bɛ kpomgbolo ne yɛ kɔme.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ de anwuma lɔ la nea bɛ sele, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmbu bɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Ɔfa ɛya ɔtendɛ ɔkile bɛ, ɔ nwo yelɛyela ye na ɔka bɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Wɔ Zayɔn, me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, yɛɛ mezie me belemgbunli ne a.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne nolo; ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛle me ra nrenya, ɛnɛ yɛɛ mewo wɔ a.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Biza me, na mebamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ayɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ, azɛlɛ ye amuala bayɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Ɛbava tumi kpole wɔazie bɛ, na wɔabubu bɛ kɛ abua.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, O bɛmɛ arelemgbunli, bɛdie na bɛzukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ewiade la, bɛla bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Bɛva ɛzulolɛ bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛva anwowozolɛ bɛdu bɛgua ɔ gyakɛ anu,

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ saa ɔfa ɛya a bɛkɛdɔ nzonle, ɔluakɛ ɔngyɛ na yeava ɛya. Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea ye nu la.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me agbɔvolɛ ɛzo! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la ɛzo.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Dɔɔnwo ɛlɛka me nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛnrɛboa ye.”

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me enyinlike, ɛmaa menyia me nyunlu na ɛkpogya me ti zo.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Metea kpole mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔdie me zo wɔ ye boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Meda medafe na eza metunwue, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a lɛ me a.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Menzulo kpɔvolɛma apenle apenle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me la.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo! O me Nyamenle, die me! Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛtua me kpɔvolɛma kɔsɔɔti kakɛ a, wɔmɔ a ɛtudu amumuyɛma agye a.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Ngoanelielɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma; wɔ nyilalɛ ɛha wɔ menli ne amuala.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, me pepɛdievolɛ, mefɛlɛ a die me zo. Mengyianle la, ɛboale me, nwu me anwunvɔne na tie me nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Kenlenzu a bɛkɛgyakyi me nyunlu aze ɛgualɛ a, ebiamɔ? Kenlenzu a bɛkɛgyakyi mgbane mgbane ɛhanlɛ nee adalɛ nzi ɛlilɛ a?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye fɔɔnwonli ne ɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ. Mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔte me ne.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Bɛva ɛya, na bɛmmayɛ ɛtane; bɛyɛ koonwu na bɛdwenle nwo kpalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛkpa ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ azu mɔɔ anwo te la bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo ka kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kpogya ɛ nye zo nea yɛ, na maa saleɛ ɛdo yɛ.”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa me nye ɛlie dɔɔnwo ɛdɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ abɛlɛ nee nwanye rale dɔɔnwo la.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Akee mebala mealafe anzonudwolɛ nu, ɔluakɛ, wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala, yɛɛ ɛsinza me a.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me edwɛkɛ, na tie me ɛkponlenlɛ.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Me Belemgbunli nee me Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, tie me ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛte me nwonlomɔ nzɛlɛlɛ; nwonlomɔ mebɔ azu memaa wɔ na mekendɛ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ɛnle Nyamenle mɔɔ anye die amumuyɛ nwo a, ɛnlie ɛtane azie.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ adalɛ la; Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi adalɛma nee ahɔdiawu.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpole ne mɔɔ gyi kpundii la ati, mebara wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, mebahakyi me nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo, na meava ɛzulolɛ meazonle wɔ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me kpɔvolɛma ati, fa me dua wɔ tenlene adenle ne anu, na maa wɔ adenle ne ɛyɛ wienyi ɛmaa me.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma ɛnga nɔhalɛ, debie ɛzɛkyelɛ ala a wɔ bɛ adwenle nu a. Bɛ kɔmenzia ɛbuke kɛ azie zo nla, bɛ nloa anu menlemenle, noko adalɛ ngome.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, fa bɛ ɛtane soa bɛ; maa bɛ adwenle ɛtanevalɛ ɛbɔ bɛ ti. Bɛ mɛladonlɛ dɔɔnwo ne ati, ye bɛ fi ɛ nye zo, ɔluakɛ bɛde ɛ nwo atua.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbafea wɔ nuhua la anye ɛlie; na dahuu bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne. Die bɛ ti, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la, bɛava wɔ bɛadu bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛyila tenlenema; ɛfa wɔ ɛlolɛ ne ɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmafa ɛya ɛtea me, anzɛɛ ɛtwe me nzo wɔ wɔ ɛya nu.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, melɛnwu amaneɛ na nwu me anwunvɔne! O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ me ayile na me mbowule nu we me.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla noko ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenlenzu?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛla balie me ngoane; wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me ngoane.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Awie ɛngakye wɔ wɔ ewule kuma nu; nwane a kɛhola kɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ Ɛbolɔ a?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Ɛkponlenlɛ ngome ɛmaa me ɛbolɛ ɛva; aledwolɛ biala me nye monle doa me esumi; me ɛzunlɛ maa me ɛkpa doa tɔfɔɔ.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Nyane ngome ɛmaa me nye ɛyɛ ngengaanwo; me kpɔvolɛma ati, me nye ɛwie yɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma, bɛvi me nwo ɛke bɛhɔ! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛde me ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛde me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma tie me nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Nyiane bahu me kpɔvolɛma amuala, bɛ nye zo ada bɛ; bɛbabɔ anyiemgba na bɛazia bɛ nzi ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, wɔ nuhua yɛɛ menriandi mefea a; die me fi menli mɔɔ tu me mgbaliko la asa anu,

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛkɛhakyi bɛ nwo awenade bɛkɛtete me, na bɛahwili me bɛahɔ mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛhola me die a.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: saa meva ɛtane medua me gɔnwo bie kakɛ, anzɛɛ mgbane gyɛne ne ala mesesa me kpɔvolɛ ninyɛne a,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ɛnee maa me kpɔvolɛ ne ɛvoa me ɛhye me, maa ɔbɔ me ɔdo aze na ɔhu me, ɔgyakyi me funli azɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa ɛya dwazo, dwazo tia me kpɔvolɛma ɛya kpole ne; O me Nyamenle, dwazo na wɔbua ndɛne ne wɔwie.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ menli ne ɛyia nu wɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ, na ɛvi anwuma dwu bɛ avinli.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bua menli ndɛne; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bua me ndɛne, kɛmɔ me pɛlepɛlelilɛ si de nee me boɛ mɔɔ medi la anwo.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: O maa amumuyɛma ɛgyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ; maa tenlenema ɛgyinla kpundii; ɛle pɛlepɛlelilɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ kola sɔ ahonle nee adwenle nea a.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Me enyinlike a le Nyamenle, ɔdie menli mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Nyamenle le pɛlepɛle ndɛnebuavolɛ, ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛnli ɛtane nzi fee a.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Saa amumuyɛnli annu ɔ nwo a, Nyamenle bazi ye dadeɛ ne, yekpo ye ɛda ne, yezinla ye ɛda mbaka ne;

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: yeziezie ye konle ninyɛne anwo ɛzulolɛ ne, yezua ye ɛda mbaka ati senle ne mɔ.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, amumuyɛnli ne nrenzɛ ɛtane, amumuyɛ ngome maa ɔ ko tu, na ɔwo adalɛ.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔfu kuma, na ɔtɔ kuma ne mɔɔ ɔdaye yevu la anu.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ye ngunzi ne bɔ ɔ ti, na ye konle adwenle ne bodɛboda ye.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo mɔɔ fɛta ye pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne, na meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meahanvo Ɛdɛnkɛma, Anwuma Anwumanli ne duma.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Awulae, wɔ duma ne kpole keda azɛlɛ ye amuala azo! Bɛto wɔ anyunlunyia nwo edwɛne wɔ anwuma lɔ,

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: ngakula nee nlɔma a to a. Wɔ kpɔvolɛma ati, wɔbɔ ɛ nwo bane, amaa wɔazi wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne nee mɔɔ di nzenralɛ la aze.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Saa meto me nye anwomanyunlu, menwu ɛ sa anloa gyima, siane nee nwɔlɔra mɔɔ wɔhyehyɛ;

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: ɛnee sonla le duzu mɔɔ ɛdwenle ɔ nwo a; sonla dasanli mɔɔ ɛ nye kuku ɔ nwo zɛhae a?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Noko ɛbɔle sonla ɛmanle Nyamenle dɛlale ye ekyii bie, na wɔva enililɛ nee anyunlunyia wɔwula ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Wɔmaa ye tumi wɔ ɛ sa anloa gyima kɔsɔɔti azo; wɔva debie biala wɔwula ye tumi bo,

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: mboane nee nlankɛ, yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: anwomanyunlu nloma nee nyevile nu fɛlɛ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu la.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Awulae, wɔ duma ne kpole keda azɛlɛ ye amuala azo!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Mebava me ahonle muala meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo; na meaha nwanwane gyima mɔɔ wɔyɛ la amuala.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ ɛ ti, mebava fɛlɛkolilɛ meadu me nwo, O Anwuma Anwumanli, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ me kpɔvolɛma ziale bɛ nzi rale la, bɛdule koti na bɛ bo zo minlinle wɔ ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔbua me benle; wɔbua wɔ ndɛne ne pɛlepɛle nu.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Wɔdea maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la, wɔzɛkye amumuyɛma; wɔminliminli bɛ duma ne abo zo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛma ne abo zo ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ; wɔbɔ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ; awie ɛngakye bɛ bieko.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli dahuu, yeziezie ye belemgbunli ebia ne kɛ ɔbua ndɛne.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Ɔfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɔbua ewiade amra ndɛne; ɔbua menli ne ndɛne pɛlepɛle nu.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le ɛvealeka maa mɔɔ bɛsisi ye la, ɔle ɛvealeka wɔ ngyegyelɛ mekɛ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ze wɔ la fa bɛ rɛle wula wɔ nu, ɔluakɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛtɛkpole menli mɔɔ sonle wɔ la.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ wɔ Zayɔn! Bɛbɔ ye gyima ne mɔ nolo bɛhile maanle maanle.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ di bɛ ti nzenralɛ la arɛle ɛtɛfile bɛ; ɔ rɛle ɛnvi nyanenwunlɛma ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne! Nea mɔɔ menwu ye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la asa anu a. Ye me fi ewule nu,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: amaa meadwu Gyɛlusalɛm anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, na meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meadia ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛmaa me nye ɛlie la, na me nye alie wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la ɛzua ɛhane ɛhye bɛ nwo; bɛgua kuma mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛvu la anu.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile kɛ ɔsi ɔde la, yebua ndɛne ne; amumuyɛma ɛdo bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ ɛhane.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma bawu ahɔ Ɛbolɔ, maanle maanle mɔɔ arɛle fi Nyamenle la, zɔhane ala.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle arɛle ɛnrɛvi ehyianli dahuu, yɛɛ ehyianli anyelazo ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo, mmamaa sonla di ɛ nwo zo konim; maa bɛbua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne wɔ ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka bɛ ɛzulolɛ! Maa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu kɛ bɛle menli ala!

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu ati a ɛwɔ moa zɛhae ɛ? Duzu ati a ɛfa ɛ nwo ɛfea amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu ɛ?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma tu ehyianvolɛma mgbaliko atisesebɛ nu; maa bɛ adwenle mɔɔ bɛva la ɛbu ɛzia bɛ.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ amumuyɛnli fa mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la tu ɔ nwo, yɛɛ mɔɔ di ndunlumi la ɛmbu Nyamenle, ɔkpo ye.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli fa adubɛnwo kpo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ye adwenle muala a le kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛnle ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala ɔkpazi; wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne, ɔnde ɔ bo; ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo ɔkile ye kpɔvolɛma amuala.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ɔdwenle ɔka kɛ, “Menrɛhyia ɛlɛ, munzule ɛnrɛdo me ɛlɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔ nloa anu le amowa, nzisi nee adalɛ ngome; amumuyɛ nee ɛtane vea ɔ tafinlima abo.

english_verse: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ nzia wɔ namunamu nu, ɔfea ɔku menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie. Ɔgua ɔ nye aze ɔkpondɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la,

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: ɔfea ɔ nwo kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia; ɔkɔ menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo nzia, ɔkye ehyianli ye ɛhane nu na ɔtwenle ye ɔkɔ.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ɔtinli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awie la ɔmaa ɔgolo ɔgua, ɔfa ye anwosesebɛ ɔdi ɔ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ɔdwenle ɔka kɛ, “Nyamenle arɛle ɛvi, yeheda ɔ nye, ɔnrɛnwu ye ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo; O Nyamenle, maa ɛ sa zo; mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu nyane la.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Duzu ati a amumuyɛnli kpo Nyamenle, na ɔka kɛ, “Ɔnrɛvɛlɛ me kɛ memambu mgbonda” ɛ?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛnwu ye; ɛhɛe, ɛnwu amaneɛ nee nyane ne, ɛkola ɛsɔ ye ɛ sa mu nwiɔ; mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la fa ɔ nwo maa wɔ; wɔyɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ la boavolɛ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Bubu amumuyɛ nee ɛtanenli ne tumi ne; neɛnlea ye nuhua ye amumuyɛ biala mɔɔ bie ɛnga a.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli dahuu; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle ye la abo zo baminli ye azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie bɛlɛvoma nzɛlɛlɛ, si bɛ ahonle; gyele ɛ nzo tie bɛ.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Di pɛlepɛle maa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze, nee mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la, amaa sonla mɔɔ le ndɛtɛlɛ la anga ɛzulolɛ bieko.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anu a menriandi mefea a; duzu ati a ɛka ɛkile me kɛ, “Tu kɛ anloma la kɔ awoka ne mɔ azo,

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: na amumuyɛma ɛkpo bɛ ɛda ne, bɛzua bɛ ɛda ne mɔ, kɛ bɛfea awozinli nu bɛado kpalɛma.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Na saa bɛsɛkye adiabo ne mɔ a, duzu a tenlenema kɛhola kɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anu, ye belemgbunli ebia wɔ anwuma; ɔnwu menli kɔsɔɔti, ɔsɔ bɛ ɔnea.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma sɔ kpalɛma nee amumuyɛma nea, na ɔkyi mɔɔ kulo konle konle la.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ɔbadɔ senle samanlankɛ nee sɔlefa ezule yeagua amumuyɛma anwo zo; ewia samɛnlankɛ bayi bɛ kɔpo.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlene, ɔkulo ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle la banwu ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, boa yɛ; ɔluakɛ sonlakpalɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ; nɔhalɛma ɛwie menli ne avinli.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Awie biala bɔ adalɛ kile ɔ gɔnwo; bɛ edwɛkɛ biala le egyele zo amanie.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa adalɛma ɛmua bɛ nloa, maa mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu la ɛyɛ koonwu.

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka kɛ, “Yɛfa yɛ nloa yɛali konim, yɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ; yɛ menle a le nwane?” la ɛyɛ koonwu.

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ bɛsisi ehyianvolɛma, na anwongyelelɛma kponle la, akee medwazo na meava bɛ meazie boɛ, kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ la.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔ anwo te, bɛle kɛ ezukoa fufule mɔɔ bɛdu nuhua wɔ fonlomo senle nu fane nsuu la.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɔ yɛ nwo bane, sinza yɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo ɛhye anu.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛbɔ yɛ mgbɔlɔka ɛyia, yɛɛ menli kanvo mɔɔ le munzule la.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenlenzu? Ɛmaa ɛ rɛle avi me bɔkɔɔ ɔ? Ɛfa ɛ nye wɔavea me yeahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Menli nyane me ahonle nu ɔhɔdwu kenlenzu? Menlua ye alɔbɔlɛ nu ɔhɔdwu kenlenzu? Me kpɔvolɛma ɛli me nwo zo konim ɔhɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, dwenle nwo na bua me; pɛ me nyane zo na anrɛɛ menwɔwu.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ me kpɔvolɛ ne baha kɛ, “Meli ɔ nwo zo konim.” Anrɛɛ me kpɔvolɛma bazi agole, ɔboalekɛ bɛdudu me bo.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Noko me rɛle wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anu; mebali fɛlɛko wɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne ati.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Mebado edwɛne meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nee me ɛli ye boɛ.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Koasea edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛnle ɛkɛ.” Bɛzɛkye, bɛbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla, sonla ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ a.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bele ɔ nye anwuma lɔ nea menli, ɔnea saa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bie wɔ nu mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Asoo amumuyɛma mɔɔ di me menli ne nwonane kɛ bɛdi aleɛ, na bɛnzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛnlɛ adwenle?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ɛzulolɛ kpole baha bɛ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nee awolɛndoazo tenlenema lua.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Bɛbazɛkye ehyianli adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma le ye ɛvealeka.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma ngoanelielɛ vi Zayɔn ara! Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma maa ye menli ne eza kpazi a, Yizilayɛma anye balie na bɛali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwane a bahɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a? Nwane a badɛnla wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo a?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ ngehanleɛ, ɔbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɛ nye, na ɔka nɔhalɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ la;

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: sonla zɔhane ɛmbɔ awie mɔ anwo nzekue, ɔnyɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ ɛtane yɛɛ ɔnzɛkye ɔ gɔnwo duma.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Ɔkyi menli mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpo bɛ la, na ɔdi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la eni, ɔbɔ ɛwɔkɛ a ɔdi zolɛ yɛɛ ɔngakyi ɔ nloa.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Ɔmbɔ bosea ɔnlie nzinwo, yɛɛ ɔnlie ndoloboa ɔntia mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la. Sonla mɔɔ yɛ ɛhye mɔ la anwo kɔlɔnwo dahuu.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, bɔ me nwo bane, ɔluakɛ wɔ nuhua yɛɛ menriandi mefea a.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Meka mekile Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Awulae a; menlɛ debie kpalɛ biala kɛ wɔmɔ.”

english_verse: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
translation_verse: Anwondelɛma mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la le menli kpalɛ, me nye die bɛ nwo somaa.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne la, twe amaneɛnwunlɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛ nwo; menrɛbɔ bɛ mogya azu ne bie ɛlɛ, yɛɛ menrɛbɔ bɛ aluma menrɛzonle bɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a le me afoa nu ɛdeɛ nee me debie biala a; wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛlɛ me a.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Me ɛdeɛ ɛdɔ aze anyelielɛ nu ɛmaa me; ɛhɛe, menyia agyadeɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Meye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔkilehile me, yɛɛ aleɛ dwo a me adwenle kakyehakye me.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Mefa Ɛdɛnkɛma mesie me nyunlu dahuu; ɔboalekɛ ɔgyi me sa fema zo, ɛhwee ɛngola me bo tu.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Yemɔti medi fɛlɛko na me nye die, mede, me nwo kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔanye me wɔammaa Ɛbolɔ, yɛɛ wɔammaa wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne amkpɔlɔ.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Ɛkile me ngoane adenle; anyelielɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ, fɛlɛkolilɛ wɔ ɛ sa fema zo dahuu.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ nee me ɛzunlɛ. Gyele ɛ nzo tie me nzɛlɛlɛ, membɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Bua me benle, ɔboalekɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nye dua nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Saa ɛsɔ me ɛnea, saa ɛba me nwo nɔɔzo, saa ɛneɛnlea me nu a, ɛkɛnwu kɛ menle amumuyɛ; menva me nloa menga ɛtane.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ se la, mekpo kɛ menrɛli ɛtane, kɛmɔ menli ne bie mɔ yɛ la.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Melua wɔ adenle ne anu fɔɔnwo, metɛfonle adenle ne.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mefɛlɛ wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛdie me zo; gyele ɛ nzo tie me edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: O, Ngoanedievolɛ mɔɔ die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛvealeka bɛfi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu wɔ ɛ sa fema zo la, kile wɔ nwanwane ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Fa me sie kɛ ɛnyelɛ kuduarizi, fa me fea ɛ ndɛba abo

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
translation_verse: fi amumuyɛma mɔɔ sɛkye me, nee kpɔvolɛma ahɔdiawu mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me la asa anu.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Bɛtu me mgbaliko bɛkye me; kɛkala bɛbɔ bɛyia me; bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛto me aze.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ awenade mɔɔ tete nane nu, bɛle kɛ awenade ralɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo, yia bɛ na ka bɛ gua. Fa wɔ dadeɛ ne die me ngoane fi amumuyɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa wɔ tumi ne die me fi menli sa nu, menli mɔɔ bɛ kyɛfoa a le ewiade la. Maa mɔɔ wɔva wɔzie bɛ la ɛyi bɛ ko; maa bɛ mra ɛnyia bie ɛmaa ɔbo zo; na bɛdabɛ bɛgyakyi bie bɛmaa bɛ mra.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Mame ɛdeɛ, mebalua tenleneyɛlɛ zo meanwu ɛ nyunlu. Saa aleɛ kye na medwazo menea ɛ nyunlu a, wɔ ɛnwunlɛ ne angome bɔbɔ yi me ko.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me anwosesebɛ, mekulo wɔ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me bodane, me aranemgbole nee me dievolɛ, me Nyamenle, me bodane mɔɔ menriandi mefea nu a, me enyinlike, me ngoanedievolɛ nee me ɛvealeka kpundii.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔfɛta ayɛlɛyelɛ a, ɔdie me ɔfi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Ewule nyɛmanyɛma bɛkɛbɛkale me, azɛlɛkye sɛkyera bule vale me nwo zo;

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Me rɛle bɔle la menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma; menvɛlɛle me Nyamenle ne kɛ ɔboa me. Ɔdele me ne wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na me ɛzunlɛ dwule ɔ nzo nu.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye bɔle twitwi na ɔkpusule, awoka ne adiabo ne mɔ kpusule, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle vale ɛya.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Esike vi ɔ bonyi nu vindele, senle gɔhyee vi ɔ nloa anu vindele, samɛnlankɛ woonwu vi ɔ nwo kpomgbɔle guale.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ɔvi anwuma ɔdwule aze, awozinli kabii wɔ ɔ gyakɛ abo.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛnlanle tease abɔdeɛ zo ɔdule; na ndɛndɛ ne ala ɔragyinlanle anwoma ne azo.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ɔvale awozinli ɔhedale ɔ nwo, ɔvale nzulemungu ɔzinzele ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Ezuawolɛ nee senle samɛnlankɛ kpakye fi wienyi ne mɔɔ li ɔ nyunlu la anu.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hulule anwuma lɔ, Anwuma Anwumanli ne ane lieliele; na ezuawolɛ nee senle samɛnlankɛ dɔle.

english_verse: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔtotole ye ɛda ne mɔ ɔbɔle kpɔvolɛma ne asande; ɔkpakyele ɛsɛnlɛmanye, na bɛnriandile.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Nyevile bo azɛlɛ ne yele dɔle zo, ewiade adiabo ne mɔ anwo yele guale zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hwile kpɔvolɛma anyunlu, na ɔvale ɔ bonyi nu anwoma ɔkpanle bɛ nu la.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vi anwuma dwule razɔle me, ɔyele me ɔvile azule buma ne anu.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Ɔliele me ɔvile me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ anwo yɛ se, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛkyi me la asa anu, ɔluakɛ bɛ anwosesebɛ bo me nwo zo.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Menwunle me nyunlu la, bɛratetale me; na Ɛdɛnkɛma liele me ti.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ɔvale me ɔrale ɛleka mɔɔ tɛlɛ la; ɔliele me, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nye liele me nwo.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lole me, wɔ me pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, me sa anwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ ti, ɔlole me,

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ meli Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ azo, metɛkakyile me nzi metɛsile me Nyamenle ne anyefuu nu.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Menlile ye mɛla ne mɔ amuala azo; meambulu ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: Meanli fɔlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu, mendwenle me nwo menvile fɔlɛlilɛ nwo.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma lole me, wɔ me pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, ɔlole me, kɛmɔ me sa anwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ si de wɔ ɔ nye zo la.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Ɛle nɔhalɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛmaa wɔ la, mɔɔ nvonleɛ ɛnle ɔ nwo la, ɛmaa ɔnwu kɛ nvonleɛ ɛnle ɛ nwo.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ɛ nwo te maa menli mɔɔ anwo te la, na ɛyɛ kokonyinli wɔ maamɔvoma anwo zo.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Ɛdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la, na ɛbɛlɛ adubɛnwoma aze.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ, ɛle me kɛnlaneɛ; O me Nyamenle, ɛkpa me awozinli.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhye, ye nyɛleɛ di munli, ye edwɛkɛ ɛnli mgbanwo! Ɔle enyinlike ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtane ye la.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a le nwane? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ. Nwane a le bodane a? Kyesɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ manle me anwosesebɛ, na ɔmanle me adenle nu yɛle wienyi a.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔzieziele me gyakɛ kɛ kɛtɛboɛ, me nwo kɔlɔnwo wɔ awoka zo.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Ɔtete me konle nu, amaa meahola ɛda mɔɔ anu yɛ se la to.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔwowa me wɔlie me ngoane, wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛzɔ me, wɔ moalɛ ne manle menyɛle sonlakpole.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ɛvale me ɛziele azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛlɛ la azo; na meamkpo aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Menvoanle me kpɔvolɛma menzɛkyele bɛ; meangyinla toonwo menwiele bɛ ku.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Membobɔle bɛ, menuanle bɛ bo zo; bɛguale aze, bɛangola me nyunlu gyinla.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle me konle nu anwosesebɛ; ɛmanle menlile me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle me kpɔvolɛma nriandile vile me nyunlu, menzɛkyele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle kɛ bɛkpondɛ moalɛ, na bɛannyia bie; bɛdeanle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na yeanlie zo.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Meti bɛ motomoto kɛ munlutu wɔ anwoma gye nu, mefuandi bɛ megua kɛ kpalɛzo ndɛtɛlɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Ɛliele me ɛvile menli mɔɔ dele atua la asa anu; ɛyɛle me maanle maanle belemgbunli; na menli mɔɔ menze bɛ la zonlenle me.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ anwo mɔra dule, na bɛvale anwowozolɛ bɛvi bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu bɛvindele.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze! Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha me Pepɛdievolɛ ne! Bɛbɔ me ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ lile me ti nzenralɛ la bɛlɛle maanle maanle ne mɔ aze wɔ me nyunlu;

english_verse: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
translation_verse: na ɔliele me ɔvile me kpɔvolɛma asa anu. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛmanle menlile me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim, ɛliele me ɛvile menli mɔɔ ko la asa anu.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle avinli, na meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa wɔ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Nyamenle maa ye belemgbunli ne di konim mgbole; ɔkile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔmaa sonla ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye, Devidi nee ɔ bo zo amra, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Anwumaneamra ɛlɛkile Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne; anwomanyunlu bɔ ɔ sa anloa gyima ne nolo.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ biala ka edwɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ aledwolɛ biala maa nwolɛ adwenle.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Bɛnva ɛnloanlɛ anzɛɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ, awie ɛnde bɛ ne;

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: noko bɛ ne pɛ azɛlɛ ye amuala, bɛ edwɛkɛ dwu ewiade ɛleka biala. Bɛ avinli, Nyamenle ɛyɛ sua ɛmaa sɛnzɛne ne,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: mɔɔ finde kɛ atɔfolɛ nrenya vi ye sua nu ɛlɛfinde; ɔle kɛ sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se, na ɔfa anyelielɛ ɔnriandi ɔdua ye adenle nu.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne di munli, ɔmaa ɛkɛla ne anwo kpundi ye; Ɛdɛnkɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne le kpundii, ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la nwu nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo, ɔmaa ahonle di fɛlɛko; Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo te, ɔmaa ndelebɛbo yɛ gyima.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nwo te, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu; Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne mɔ le nɔhalɛ, bɛ muala bɛle fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛkpondɛlɛ hyia tɛla ezukoa nvutuke, ɔtɛla ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɔbɔ. Ɔyɛ fɛ ɔtɛla wolɛ, ɔpepe ɔtɛla wolɛ mɔɔ ɛwie da la.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Bɛkakyehakye medame, wɔ sonvolɛ; zolɛlilɛ le nyilalɛ kpole.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Awie ɛngola ɛnnwu ɔdaye ye nvonleɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi me nvonleɛ mɔɔ vea la anu.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ akɛlɛ fi anyefuu ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo; mmamaa bɛfo me nwo zo, amaa meanli ɛzonle, amaa meavi mɛladonlɛ mgbole nu.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me bodane nee me dievolɛ, maa me nloa edwɛkɛ nee me ahonle nu nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu na ɔzɔ ɛ nye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdie wɔ wɔ anwongyelelɛ nu! Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne duma ɛbɔ ɛ nwo bane!

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɔva moalɛ ɔvi ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɔraboa wɔ, na ɔva anwosesebɛ ɔvi Zayɔn Boka ɔrɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ amuala ɛzɔ ɔ nye, na ɔlie wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɛ sa ɛha mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la, na ɔmaa wɔ adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ muala ɛyɛ zɔ.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Ɔmaa yɛva anyelielɛ yɛdeɛdea nuhua wɔ wɔ konimlilɛ ne anwo, yɛvola yɛ fɛlɛnra ne mɔ wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne duma nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa mɔɔ ɛkɛbiza la amuala ɛyɛ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la; ɔbabua ye wɔ anwuma lɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, yeava tumi kpole yeamaa yeali konim mgbole.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ fa konle ehwili tu bɛ nloa anu, yɛɛ bie mɔ fa mgbɔnwɔ; na yɛmɛ, yɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne duma a yɛtu yɛ nloa anu a.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa belemgbunli ne ɛli konim; yɛfɛlɛ wɔ a die yɛ zo.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ tumi ne ati, belemgbunli anye die, yɛɛ ɔfa wɔ moalɛ ɔtu ɔ nwo.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Wɔva mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la wɔmaa ye, wɔanzi ye ɛbizalɛdeɛ ne aze.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔlo ye ninyɛne kpalɛ ngome; wɔbɔ ye ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ abɔtile.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ɔbizale ngoane, na ɛvale ɛmanle ye, wɔmaa ye ngoane tendenle.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Wɔ moalɛ ɛmaa ye anyunlunyia ɛyɛ kpole; wɔmaa ye duma kpole nee tumi.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, wɔmaa ye nyilalɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ; ɛye ɛ nyunlu ɛmaa ɔ nye die.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne arɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, na ɔlua Anwuma Anwumanli ne ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, dahuu ɔgyi kpundii.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛ sa bazɔ wɔ kpɔvolɛma amuala nu; ɛbahye awie biala mɔɔ kyi wɔ la.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Saa ɛye ɛ nyunlu a, ɛbamaa bɛazɔ kɛ fonlomo senle. Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ɛya azɛkye bɛ, senle ne bayela bɛ muala wee.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ɛbabɔ bɛ bo zo amra abo zo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na wɔazɛkye bɛ mra wɔavi menli avinli.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Saa bɛsuzu wɔ ɛtane, na bɛyɛ ɛ nwo esiayɛ a, bɛ sa ɛnrɛha wɔ.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛbadende wɔ ɛda ne bɛ nyunlu; ɛbamaa bɛagua ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛyeyɛ wɔ, wɔ tumi ne ati, yɛbado edwɛne yeaye wɔ tumi ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle, me Nyamenle, duzu ati a wɔkpo me a? Duzu ati a melɛkponle na ɛmbamboa me ɛ?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, mefɛlɛ wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, noko ɛnlie me zo; nɔɔzo mefɛlɛ wɔ, noko me nwo ɛndɔ me.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Noko wɔmɔ a ɛle nwuanzanwuanza, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ye wɔ ayɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Yɛ mgbanyima vale bɛ rɛle wulale wɔ nu; bɛhisale wɔ, na ɛliele bɛ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle wɔ, na bɛnyianle ngoane; bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale wɔ nu, na bɛ rɛle ambɔ.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Na mame, mele sonlɛ, menle sonla; menli ɛmbu me, yɛɛ bɛ muala bɛkpo me.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu me la, bɛsi me amgbu bɛkpobi bɛ nloa, bɛkɔsɔ bɛ ti kɛ,

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Ɔvale ye ahonle ɔmanle Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛmaa ɔlie ye, bɛmaa ɔlie ye ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɔ nye die ɔ nwo!”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Noko akee wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛyele me ɛvile ɔmɔ akunlu a; ɛnleanle me gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ ɔmɔ anyɛfo abo.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Bɛvale me bɛdole ɛ nwo zo ɔvi me awolɛ nu; yɛɛ sumunli kɛ ɔmɔ wole me la wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Mmagyakyi me ɛkɔ moa, ɔluakɛ munzule ɛbikye, yɛɛ menlɛ boavolɛ.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nlankɛ nyinli dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ ɛyia me, Beehyan nlankɛ nyinli anwosesebɛ ɛbɔ ɛyia me.

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: Bɛbukebuke bɛ nloa mgbole bɛkile me, kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛtea atete nane la.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Bɛwola me bɛgua kɛ nzule la, me mbowule ɛhoatihoati; me ahonle le kɛ ɛyɛlɛ, yeholo me kunlu.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Me kɔmenzia ɛwe resee kɛ fulonvule nu; me tafinlima ɛbeta me anwuma awudwɔlɛ. wɔdo me aze wɔ ewule ndɛtɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, ahwea ɛbɔ ɛyia me; amumuyɛma kpolane ɛbɔ ɛyia me; bɛfitifiti me sa nee me gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mekola metia me mbowule muala, bɛnea me bɛbu me anyehoanlɛ.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Bɛkyɛ me adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bɛfa, na bɛtwe me bubu ne anwo adunyi.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmate ɛ nwo ɛkɔ moa! O wɔmɔ me boavolɛ, ka ɛ nwo balie me.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Die me fi dadeɛ nloa; die me ngoane fi twea ne agye nu.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Die me fi awenade ne anloa anu, die me fi nlankɛ nyinli ahohonyinli sa nu.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ wɔ duma meahile me mediema; mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ wɔ menli ne ayia kpole ne anu.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ; bɛmɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra amuala, bɛwula ye anyunlunyia, yɛɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma amuala, bɛva enililɛ bɛzulo ye.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔmkpo ehyianvolɛma, yɛɛ ɔmbu ɔ nye ɔngua bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ zo; ɔngakyi ɔ nzi ɔ nzi bɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye a ɔtie bɛ.”

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ menli dɔɔnwo ne ayia kpole ne anu, mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ wɔ menli ne mɔɔ sonle wɔ la anyunlu.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Ehyianli bali ɔ ko ayi, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la baye ye ayɛlɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛnyi bɛhyɛ!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Ewiade amra amuala bahakye Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛazia bɛara ɔ nwo ɛkɛ; maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti badu agua ɔ nyunlu azonle ye.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli, ɔsie maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mgbanyizonlema amuala babɔ bɛ ti aze amaa ye; menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wu la babɔ bɛ ti aze amaa ye, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngola ɛbɛla nu sɔ la babɔ bɛ ti aze amaa ye.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Amozi amra bazonle ye; menli baha Awulae anwo edwɛkɛ ahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la,

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: na bɛabɔ ye ngoanelielɛ ne nolo bɛahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma liele ye menli ne.”

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me neavolɛ; mengyia ɛhwee.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa meda ndile amolɛ zo; ɔfa me ɔkɔ nzukpa mɔɔ gyi diinyi la anwo.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa me anwosesebɛ fofolɛ. Ɔfa me ɔdua ndenle fɔɔnwo nu, ɔlua ɔdaye ye duma ne ati.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Saa melua ewule bɔnza nu bɔbɔ a, menzulo munzule biala, ɔluakɛ ɛ nee me lua, wɔ mboaneneavolɛ baka ne nee wɔ kpɔma ne maa me rɛle kyekye.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Ɛto me ɛkponle wɔ me kpɔvolɛma anyunlu; ɛkpokpa me nwole, me kɔpo yi bulu zo.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, kpalɛ nee saleɛ bali me nzi wɔ me ngoane mekɛ nu amuala; na mebadɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma sua nu dahuu.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ debie biala le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ. Ewiade nee menli mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala le ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Ɔwulale ye adiabo ne wɔ nyevile buma nu, na ɔkyekyele ye wɔ nzule ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛvo Ɛdɛnkɛma boka ne azo a? Yɛɛ nwane a kɛwolo ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Kyesɛ sonla mɔɔ ahonle nu te na ɔnli ɛzonle, sonla mɔɔ ɛnzɔ mmonle, yɛɛ ɔnga ndane adalɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila ye, na ye ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne abua ye benle.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Awolɛndoazo mɔɔ kpondɛ Nyamenle abo zo, na bɛsonle Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne la kɛ de la ɛne.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: O nlenkɛ mgbole, bɛbukebuke! O tete nlenkɛ, bɛbukebuke! Amaa anyunlunyia Belemgbunli ne awolo nu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Nwane a le anyunlunyia Belemgbunli ne? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ, ɔlɛ tumi nee anwosesebɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ, ɔle konle nu katakyie.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: O nlenkɛ mgbole, bɛbukebuke! O tete nlenkɛ, bɛbukebuke! amaa anyunlunyia Belemgbunli ne awolo nu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Nwane a le anyunlunyia Belemgbunli ɛhye? Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ, yemɔ a ɔle anyunlunyia Belemgbunli ne a.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ ala a mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ a.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, wɔ nuhua yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ a, mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze; mmamaa me kpɔvolɛ si me nwo zo agole.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me maa menwu wɔ ndenle ne mɔ; kilehile me wɔ ndenle ne mɔ.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Kilehile me maa menlua wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anu, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle a; wɔ nuhua yɛɛ alehyenlɛ biala me rɛle wɔ a.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
