translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne, nee wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne, ɔluakɛ ɛ nee bɛ vi tete.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Mmakakye me mgbavolɛ nu ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ menyɛle, anzɛɛ me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, wɔ ahunlunyele ne ati, kakye me.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ nee tenlene, yemɔti ɔkilehile ɛtanema ye adenle ne.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Ɔfa mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la ɔdua adenle kpalɛ nu, na ɔkilehile ye ye adenle ne.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ amuala le ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ye ngyehyɛlɛ nee ye mɛla ne mɔ azo la.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne ati, fa me ɛtane kyɛ me, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpole.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nwane a le sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la? Yemɔ yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bahilehile ye adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nu la a.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Ɔbakpazi wɔ ye ɛdɛnlanlɛ nu, na ɔ mra banyia azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma fa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la agɔnwolɛ, na ɔmaa bɛnwu ye ngyekyeleɛ ne.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a menea ye a, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔbaye me yeavi ɛhane nu a.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Kakyi ɛ nye nea me na nwu me anwunvɔne; ɔluakɛ yeha me ngome, yɛɛ melɛte nyane.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Ye me adwenleadwenle ne, na ye me fi me amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Nea me nyane nee me amaneɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ, na fa me ɛtane muala kyɛ me.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ me kpɔvolɛma si zonle, nee kɛ bɛsi bɛkpɔ me ɛkpɔlɛ sanlera la.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: O sinza me, na die me ngoane; mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze, ɔluakɛ menriandi mefea wɔ nu.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Maa me kpalɛyɛlɛ nee me nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛbɔ me nwo bane, ɔluakɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, die Yizilayɛ fi ye amaneɛnwunlɛ muala anu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bua me benle, ɔluakɛ meyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Meva me rɛle mewula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu kpundii.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, neɛnlea me nu na sɔ me nea, sɔ me adwenle nee me ahonle nea.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne a gyi me nyunlu a, medi nɔhalɛ memaa wɔ.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Me nee adalɛma ɛndɛnla, yɛɛ me nee nabalabama ɛndu.

english_verse: or go with evil crowds.
translation_verse: Mekyi nindavoma agɔnwolɛvalɛ, yɛɛ me nee amumuyɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Menrinzi me sa anwo mekile kɛ menli fɔlɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na mebɔ wɔ azukponle ne mgbɔlɔka,

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekulo wɔ sua ne mɔɔ ɛde nu la, ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anyunlunyia ne wɔ la.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Mmafa me ɛboka ɛtanema ɛkpoa me ɛgua, anzɛɛ mmatia me ɛboka kɔdiawuma anwo.

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: Menli zɛhae mɔ dwenle ɛtane nwo, bɛ sa fema nu le ndoloboa ngome.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Na mame, meyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, die me, na nwu me anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Me gyakɛ gyi azɛlɛ sɛsɛ zo; mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ wɔ ye menli ne ayia kpole ne anu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me wienyi nee ngoanelielɛ; menrɛzulo awie biala. Ɛdɛnkɛma le me ɛbɛla nu ɛvealeka; menrɛzulo awie biala.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Saa amumuyɛma teta me, bɛbɔ me nwo nzekue bɔbɔ a, me kpɔvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la badu koti na bɛadu bɛagua.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Saa ɛlɔnema bɛnra yia me a, menrɛzulo ɛhwee; saa konle fa me aze a, me ahonle ɛnrɛdu.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Debie ko yɛɛ mebiza ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ a, na yemɔ yɛɛ mebakpo ɔ bo zo a; kɛ menwɔdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma sua nu dahuu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mede ngoane nu, kɛ menwɔnwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛnlɛma si de, na meabiza moalɛ wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔbava me yeavea ɔ ndɛba abo wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu. Ɔbava me yeavea ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na yeava me yeazie bodane zo anwuma.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Kɛkala akee bɛbakpogya me zo wɔ me agbɔvolɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me la avinli; mebava anyelielɛ meabɔ azu, wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, meado edwɛne, meabɔ agole meayeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metea mefɛlɛ wɔ a, tie me, nwu me anwunvɔne na bua me.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Wɔha kɛ, “Kpondɛ me nyunlu.” Meka ye me ahonle nu mekile wɔ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nyunlu ala a mekpondɛ a.”

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Mmaye ɛ nye ɛto ɛbɔ nu. Mmafa ɛya ɛfoa wɔ sonvolɛ, wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔyɛ me boavolɛ a. Mmato me lɔ, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi me. O me ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle!

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ egya nee ɔmɔ ɛkpo me, na Ɛdɛnkɛma bava me.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ adenle ne, na ɔlua me kpɔvolɛma ati, fa me dua adenle sɛsɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Mmaye me ɛmaa me kpɔvolɛma, ɔluakɛ dasewiama ɛdwazo ɛtia me. Nzakadolɛ ala a wɔ bɛ ti anu a.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Medie medi kɛ mebanwu Ɛdɛnkɛma kpalɛyɛlɛ ne, wɔ teasema azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu; mia ɛ nwo na si wɔ ahonle, ɛhɛe, fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ yɛɛ mefɛlɛ wɔ a, me bodane, mmatuodua ɛ nzo wɔ me nwo; saa wɔandɛne me zo a, menwɔyɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ ɛbolɔ Kuma nu la.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Tie me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, melɛsu meavɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me, yemɔti medende me sa, wɔ wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Mmafa me ɛfonla amumuyɛma ne, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nindavo ɛbɛla, mɔɔ bɛka anzonudwolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛkile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ, noko adalɛ ngome ɛyi bɛ ahonle nu la.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛmbu Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima ne mɔ bie, anzɛɛ ɔ sa anloa gyima ne bie la, ɔbabubu bɛ yeagua, yɛɛ ɔnrɛzi bɛ bieko.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ yede me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me anwosesebɛ nee me enyinlike. Ye nuhua yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ a. Yemɔti menyia moalɛ, yɛɛ medi fɛlɛko, na mefa edwɛndolɛ meye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a le ye menli ne anwosesebɛ a, ɔle mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la ngoanelielɛ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: O die wɔ menli ne na yila wɔ agyadeɛ; yɛ bɛ neavolɛ na nea bɛ boɛ dahuu.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ anwuma amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia nee ye tumi ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia duma ne ayɛlɛ; bɛva nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ane dielie azule ne mɔ anye; anyunlunyia Nyamenle ne kuluhulu, Ɛdɛnkɛma ane dielie azule ne mɔ anye.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: Tumi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ane ne anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma ane ne kile ye belemgbunlililɛ ne.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ane bubu sida mbaka, ɔbubu Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka bɔbɔ.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa Lɛbanɔn awoka wuluwulu kɛ nlankɛ mralɛ, na Hɛmɔn Boka wuluwulu kɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ nyinli.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ane kpomgbɔ senle.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ane kpusu ɛsɛlɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma maa Keedɛhye ɛsɛlɛ kpusu.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ane maa weɛlɛ wo mgbemgbene nu; ɔkpolo mbaka nya ɔgua; na bɛtea nu wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ, “Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ azuyilɛ nye; Ɛdɛnkɛma di belemgbunli dahuu.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye menli ne anwosesebɛ, na ɔva anzonudwolɛ ɔyila ye menli ne.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayeyɛ wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔmaa me zo, wɔammaa me kpɔvolɛma anzi me nwo zo agole.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, menzunle menvɛlɛle wɔ kɛ ɛboa me, na wɔyɛ me ayile.

english_verse: saving me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔye me ɛkɛla wɔvi Ɛbolɔ, wɔye me mɔwuamra anu wɔra ngoane nu.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ Nyamenle menli, bɛdo edwɛne bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, na bɛyɛ ye mo.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ye ɛyavalɛ ɛngyɛ, yɛɛ ye nyeleyɛlɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Ɛzunlɛ bahɔ zo aledwolɛ ne, na alehyenlɛ ne fa anyelielɛ ba.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Na mame, menganle wɔ me ɛkpazilɛ mekɛ nu kɛ, “Awie ɛnrɛhola me.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔlua wɔ ɛlolɛ zo, wɔmaa megyinla kpundii kɛ boka kpole bie; ɛyele ɛ nye ɛdole ɛbɔ nu, na ɛzulolɛ hanle me.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, menzunle menvɛlɛle wɔ; menvale me modolɛ mendole Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu kɛ:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ me ewule zo a? Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ me Ɛbolɔ Kuma nu ɛhɔlɛ zo a? Asoo ndɛtɛlɛ bahola aye wɔ ayɛlɛ? Asoo ɔbaha wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa me nyane ɛhakyi ɛzelekɛ, wɔkpa me ɛrele wɔgua na wɔmaa me nye ɛlie,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: amaa me ɛkɛla anyɛ koonwu na yeaye wɔ ayɛlɛ. O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, mebayɛ wɔ mo dahuu.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ nuhua yɛɛ menriandi mefea a; mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ; die me wɔ wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Gyele ɛ nzo tie me, na die me ndɛndɛ! Yɛ me bodane mɔɔ menriandi mefea ɔ bo a, aranemgbole kpundii mɔɔ mevea nu a me nwo kɔlɔnwo a!

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ɛle me bodane nee me aranemgbole; wɔ duma ne ati di me nyunlu na sinza me.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ye me fi ɛhane mɔɔ bɛzua me la anu, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me ɛvealeka a.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ɛ sa nu yɛɛ mefa me sunsum mewula a; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nɔhavo Nyamenle, wɔlie me ngoane.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛkyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɔ mmonle la; na mame, me rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati mebali fɛlɛko na me nye alie, ɔboalekɛ wɔnwu me amaneɛnwunlɛ; wɔnwu munzule mɔɔ ɛdo me la.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Ɛtɛyele me ɛtɛmanle me kpɔvolɛma; wɔva me wɔzie azɛlɛ tɛtɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ ngyegyelɛ ɛdo me, nyane ngome ɛbɔ me nye; me nwonane ne nee me ɛkɛla ɛwie kɔ.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ alɔbɔlɛ ngome ɛwie me kyekye, yɛɛ me mekɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɛzunlɛ ala a mesu a. Anwubɛnyunlu ɛmaa me nwo ɛvɔ, me agbɔkɛ nu ɛtuto.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Meyɛ agolobɛnwo sonla wɔ me kpɔvolɛma anyunlu, me nwo ka me gɔnwo mɔ ɛzulolɛ. Meyɛ debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ menli mɔɔ ze me la anye zo; bɛnwu me gua zo a bɛnriandi me.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Mevi bɛ adwenle nu kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛwu la; meyɛ kɛ buakɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ la.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mete dɔɔnwo azukuedulɛ ne, ɛzulolɛ wɔ ɛleka biala! Bɛyia bɛfa me nwo adwenle, bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛku me.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu, mese, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Me mekɛ ne wɔ ɛ sa nu; die me fi me kpɔvolɛma nee me kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nye ɛrɛla wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo; dua wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne azo die me.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze, ɔluakɛ mefɛlɛ wɔ; maa amumuyɛma anyunlu ɛgua aze; maa bɛyɛ bɛ nloa kpulu bɛhɔ ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Maa adalɛma ɛdɔ mumule; mgbanyizonle nu bɛtendɛ mgbole bɛtia menli mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: O, wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ ne zonle, wɔva wɔzie wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle wɔ la. Ɛkile ye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbafea wɔ nu la anwo zo, wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anye zo.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Ɛfa bɛ ɛfea ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɛfi menli mɔɔ bɔ adwenle ɛtane la anwo; ɛfa bɛ ɛsie gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ ɛ ndɛba abo ɛfi aholoba nee safule mgbole nwo.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ yehile me ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nwanwane nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛyiale me kɛ suakpole mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Me ahonle dule na menganle kɛ, “Wɔye me wɔvi ɛ nye zo ala ɛne,” Na ɛdele me modolɛ ne, mekɛ mɔɔ menzunle kɛ ɛboa me la.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Nyamenle menli, bɛhulo Ɛdɛnkɛma; Ɛdɛnkɛma sinza mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la, na ɔtua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la kakɛ kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la, bɛzi ahonle na bɛgyinla kpundii.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ bɛva ye mɛladonlɛ bɛhyɛ ye, na bɛva ye ɛtane bɛhyɛ ye la.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmbu ye ɛtane nwo mgbonda la na ɔmbɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Saa meanga me ɛtane a, me adwenle ɛnla, mekponle toonwo menwa.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ kɔsɔɔti ɛ sa yɛle ɛnlomboɛ me nwo zo; me anwosesebɛ ne wiele, ɔwele kɛ nzule mɔɔ wawaa ewia ɛsesa ye la.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Menganle me ɛtane mengilele wɔ; meanvea me amumuyɛ zo. Menganle kɛ, “Meka me mɛladonlɛ meahile Ɛdɛnkɛma!” na ɛvale me ɛtane ɛhyɛle me.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Yemɔti awie biala mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la ɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle; saa nyanelilɛ mekɛ mɔɔ se bobobobo kɛ azule la ba a bie ɛnrɛha ye.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Ɛle me feabelɛ, ɛdie me ɛfi ngyegyelɛ nu; ɛfa wɔ ɛlielɛ tumi ne ɛbɔ me nwo bane.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Mebadu wɔ folɛ, mebahilehile wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa nu la; mebamaa me nye ara ɛ nwo zo na meadu wɔ folɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Mmayɛ ɛ nwo kɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ anzɛɛ ɛkpɔnwɔndua mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo a, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa nyɛma nee empele bɛka wɔ a, anrɛɛ ɛ nwo ɛnrɛdɔ wɔ.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli munzule zonle; na mɔɔ arɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la, ɛhulolɛ kpundii ɛbɔ ye mgbɔlɔka.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ tenlenema, bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la ati! Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Bɛva getaa kpole bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛva nyɛma bulu getaa bɛbɔ agole!

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa ye, bɛbɔ nyɛma bulu getaa ne kpalɛ na bɛdeɛdea nu anyelielɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ; yɛɛ ye gyima kɔsɔɔti di munli.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi azɛlɛ ye.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɔ nloa bɔle anwuma, ɔvale ɔ nloa a ɔbɔle anwumaneamra a.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Ɔboɔboale nyevile ne anloa kɛ nzule mɔɔ wɔ toba nu; ɔguale nyevile buma ne mɔ efiade.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye ɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ewiade amra kɔsɔɔti ɛzulo ye, ɛli ye eni.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔdendɛle, na ɔyɛle zɔ; ɔzele, na ɔyɛle zɔ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma maa maanle maanle adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ yɛ mgbane; ɔsɛkye menli ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhyehyɛ la.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, ɔbɔ kpɔkɛ a ɔka awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha maanle ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma le ye Nyamenle la, nyilalɛ ɛha menli ne mɔɔ yeye bɛ yeyɛ bɛ ye menli la.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ɔde ye belemgbunli ebia nu lɔ, ɔbele ɔ nye ɔnea ewiade amra amuala.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa bɛ adwenle a, yɛɛ ɔnwu mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli biala ɛlɔne kpole ɛngola ɛnlie ye, ɛlɔnenli biala anwosesebɛ kpole ɛngola ɛnlie ye.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Konle ɛkpɔnwɔ ɛnle konimlilɛ anyelazo, yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ kpole ne ɛngola sonla ngoane die.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye la ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne azo la anwo zo,

english_verse: He protects them from death and starvation.
translation_verse: amaa yealie bɛ yeavi ewule nu, na ɛhɔne ba a bɛanwu.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Yɛ ɛkɛla kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma; ɔle yɛ moalɛ nee yɛ enyinlike.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, yemɔ ɔ ti yɛdi fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ yɛ rɛle wɔ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo, ɔluakɛ yɛ anyelazo a le wɔ.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo dahuu; dahuu mebaye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla fa Ɛdɛnkɛma tu ɔ nwo; anwubɛnyunluma ɛdie na bɛli fɛlɛko.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: O bɛ nee me ɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛmaa yɛbɔ nu yɛkpogya ye duma ne zo.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔliele zo, na ɔliele me ɔvile me ɛzulolɛ muala anu.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ nye bɛdo ɔ nwo zo na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie, amaa bɛ nyunlu angua aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Ehyianli ɛhye zunle, na Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye, na ɔliele ye ɔvile ye amaneɛnwunlɛ muala anu.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ sinza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la, na ɔdie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: O bɛzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛnlea na bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɔle kpalɛ! Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ nriandi kɔtane ye la.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ Nyamenle menli, bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la ɛngyia ɛhwee!

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Awenade ngakula bɔbɔ kyia na ɛhɔne ku bɛ, noko bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo la ɛngyia debie kpalɛ biala anwo.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla, O ayi mɔ, bɛdie me, mebahilehile bɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ ne.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Sonla boni a kpondɛ ngoane, na ɔkpondɛ kenle dɔɔnwo, amaa ɔ nye alie kpalɛ nwo a?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Sɔ ɛ nloa, mmaka ɛtane, yɛɛ mmabɔ adalɛ biala.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo, na di boɛ; kpondɛ anzonudwolɛ na di ɔ nzi.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ tenlenema anwo zo, yɛɛ ɔte bɛ ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma fa ɔ nye wula nindavoma anyunlu, kɛ ɔminli bɛ bo zo wɔ ewiade.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Saa tenlenema biza moalɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma tie bɛ, na ɔdie bɛ ɔfi bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bikye mɔɔ nyane ɛha ye la, na ɔdie mɔɔ ye anyelazo ɛwie la.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ nwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ye fi ɔ muala anu.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ɔsie ye gyɛlɛɛnye, ɔmmaa ye bowule ko bɔbɔ ɛmbu.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Ɛtane bahu amumuyɛma; yɛɛ bɛbabua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi tenlenema la ewule fɔlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma die ye sonvolɛma ngoane; bɛnrɛbua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtane ye la ewule fɔlɛ.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ sa nu enyinlike ne, na dwazo baboa me.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ atwɛ ne nee wɔ ɛtweneɛ ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtu me mgbaliko la anwo zo! Ka kile me ɛkɛla kɛ, “Mele wɔ ngoanedievolɛ!”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛku me la anyunlu ɛzi bile, bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze! Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee munzule la anye zo ɛda bɛ na bɛzia bɛ nzi.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kɛ abonle wɔ anwoma gye nu, na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne ɛlɛpia bɛ ahɔ la.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ adenle nu ɛyɛ awozinli, ɛyɛ teteletetele, na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne ɛlɛtu bɛ ako la.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛzuale me ɛhane; mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛpɛle me nwo kuma.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Maa bɛpe kpotekpote arɛlevilɛ nu! Na maa bɛ ngome bɛ ɛhane ɛhye bɛ; maa bɛgua nu bɛwu.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, akee me ɛkɛla anye balie, na meava ye ngoanelielɛ ne meadu me nwo.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Me sonlabaka ne baha kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwane a le kɛ ɛdawɔ a? Wɔmɔ a ɛdie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la. ɛfi mɔɔ anwo yɛ se tɛla ye la asa anu, na ɛdie ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la ɛfi awule asa anu a.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ahɔdiawu alasevolɛ dwazo; bɛbiza me mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie la.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ; me ɛkɛla ɛwie me nwo minli.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Noko mame, mɔɔ bɛnde kpɔkɛ la, mengedale ɛrele, mengyele ɛhɔne, mengilele me nwo nyane. Membɔle me ti aze menzɛlɛle

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: kɛ asɛɛ melɛdi nyane meamaa agɔnwolɛ anzɛɛ adiema nrenya. Menluale kɛ asɛɛ melɛsu ɔmɔ, menzile me ti aze menlile nyane.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Noko mendule koti la bɛyiale bɛzelele, bɛhuohuanle bɛ nloa bɛtiale me; abuburama mɔɔ menze bɛ la zɔle me nwo nzekuebɔlɛ nu a bɛangyakyi.

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: Bɛzile me amgbu dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, bɛzelele me, bɛgolole me nwo.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnea ye zɛ wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu? Die me fi bɛ amumuyɛ ɛtetalɛ nu; die me ngoane fi awenadema ne mɔ asa anu!

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Na mebayɛ wɔ mo wɔ wɔ menli ne nyianu kpole ne anu; na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Mmamaa adalɛma mɔɔ kpɔ me la si me nwo zo agole, yɛɛ mmamaa me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ mgbane gyɛne ne ala kpɔ me la fedevede bɛ nye kile me.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnga anzonudwolɛ edwɛkɛ, bɛtendɛ bɛtia awienvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la, na bɛboɔboa bɛbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuke bɛ nloa bɛka mgbole bɛkile me; bɛka kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɛhɛe! Yɛ nye ɛnwu ye!”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ wɔnwu ye; mmayɛ koonwu! O Awulae, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, ɛle tenlenenli na bua me benle; mmamaa bɛsi me nwo zo agole!

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Mmamaa bɛka bɛkile bɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, akee yɛ kunlu ɛdwo!” Mmamaa bɛka kɛ, “Yɛ sa ɛha ye.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ me anwubɛnyunlu nwo la ɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛbɔ nu! Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛtia me la anyunlu ɛzi bile na bɛbɔ anyiemgba.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Maa menli mɔɔ akunlu anrɛɛ bɛbua me benle la ɛva anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛdea nuhua dahuu, na bɛha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, ɔ nye die ye sonvolɛ ne kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo!”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Na mebabɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne nolo, na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Ɛtane tendɛ kile amumuyɛnli ne wɔ ye ahonle nu; ɔkpo Nyamenle yɛɛ ɔnzulo ye adenle biala anu.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo kɛ ye ɛtane ne ɛnrɛvinde na awie ahyi ye.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Ɔle ngunzi yɛɛ ɔbɔ adalɛ, yegyakyi nrɛlɛbɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee boɛlilɛ.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ɔda ye ɛkpa zo ɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane; ɔfa ndenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la anu; ɔngyi debie mɔɔ le ɛtane la. Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne dwu anwomanyunlu, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne kpole le kɛ Nyamenle awoka ne mɔ, wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ abo kuma le kɛ azule buma; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdie menli nee nane ngoane.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne sonle bolɛ! Menli kɔsɔɔti nriandi fea ɛ ndɛba abo.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Bɛdi bɛ ko yi wɔ wɔ sua nu, na ɛmaa bɛ nzule mɔɔ vi wɔ anyelielɛ azule nu la bɛno.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle ngoane nzufeanvea a; wɔ wienyi ne anu yɛɛ yɛnwu wienyi a.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: O kile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze wɔ la anwo zo, na maa mɔɔ ahonle nu te la wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Mmamaa adubɛnwonli bikye me, mmamaa amumuyɛnli asa ka me.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nea, kɛ amumuyɛma ɛdu ɛgua ɛ, bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua, bɛngola dwazo.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Mmafonla ɛ nwo wɔ amumuyɛma ati; mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ɛtanema!

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ na bɛanwoso kɛ ndile, na bɛawe kɛ nya amolɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu na di boɛ, amaa wɔadɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo, ɛ nwo adɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nye ɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo, na ɔbamaa wɔanyia mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ nwo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma; fa ɛ rɛle wula ye nu, ɔbali yeamaa wɔ.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Ɔbamaa wɔ benlelilɛ ala ali wienyi, wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ada kɛ ewiazo sɛnzɛne.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Gyinla ɛ nwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na si abotane kendɛ ye; mmafonla ɛ nwo wɔ mɔɔ ɛkpazi la anwo, anzɛɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɔ adwenle ɛtane la anwo.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛya, yɛɛ mmamaa wɔ ahonle futu! Mmafonla ɛ nwo; ɔwie munzule.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛbaminli amumuyɛma abo zo; na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la bava azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee amumuyɛnli ne abo zo ɛminli, ɛbahɔnlea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, na ɛnrɛnwu ye.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Na bɛlɛvoma bava azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na bɛ nye alie bɛ ɛkpazilɛ nwo.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli pepɛ tenlenenli agyakɛ anzi, ɔkpɔ ye, na ɔbu ye anyehoanlɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma sele amumuyɛnli ne, ɔluakɛ ɔnwu kɛ ye awieleɛ ɛbikye.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma twe dadeɛ na bɛkpo bɛ ɛda ne mɔ, kɛ bɛku ehyianli ne nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la, kɛ bɛku bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle la;

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: bɛ dadeɛ bawɔ bɛ ngome bɛ ahonle nu, yɛɛ bɛ ɛda ne mɔ babubu.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Ekyi mɔɔ tenlenenli lɛ la le kpalɛ tɛla amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ dɔɔnwo ne.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛbabubu amumuyɛma asa; na Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɔ tenlenema nu.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ze mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la kenle, bɛ agyadeɛ bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ dahuu.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Munzule ba a bɛ nyunlu ɛngua aze, ɛhɔne mekɛ nu bɛlɛ aleɛ molozo.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Noko amumuyɛma abo zo minli; Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔvolɛma anyunlunyia le kɛ ndile, bɛminli, bɛle kɛ esike, bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli biza bosea a ɔndua, na tenlenenli asa do, ɔbuke ɔ sa nu;

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ la bava azɛlɛ ne, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yedua bɛ kakɛ la abo zo baminli.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa sonla tudu ɔ gyakɛ a, na ɔmaa mɔɔ ɔ nye die ɔ nwo la kpazi.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Saa ɔtɔ aze bɔbɔ a, ɔnrɛha ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bakpogya ye zo.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Ɛnee mele kakula, na kɛkala meyɛ kpanyinli; na metɛnwunle kɛ bɛkpo tenlenenli ɛlɛ; yɛɛ metɛnwunle kɛ ɔ mra ɛlɛsɛlɛzɛlɛ aleɛ ali.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Ɔ sa dwu menli nwo zo yɛɛ ɔbɔ awie biala bosea; ɔ mra le nyilalɛ kpole.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo na di boɛ, na wɔadɛnla aze wɔahyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo pɛlepɛlelilɛ; ɔnrɛkpo ye menli ne mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la. Ɔbabɔ tenlenema anwo bane dahuu, na yeaminli amumuyɛma abo zo.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Tenlenema bava azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na bɛadɛnla zolɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔdi pɛlepɛle wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nu.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Ye Nyamenle ne mɛla wɔ ye ahonle nu; ɔndwe ɔ nwo ɔnvi nwolɛ.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli bu tenlenenli anyehoanlɛ, na ɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔku ye.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛye ye ɛnrɛmaa ɔ sa ɛnrɛha ye, bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ a, ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu na dua ye adenle ne anu, na ɔbakpogya wɔ zo yeamaa wɔanyia azɛlɛ ne; ɛbanwu amumuyɛma ɛzɛkyelɛ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Menwu nrenya amumuyɛnli atisesebɛ bie, ye anwonyia hɔle anwuma kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida baka.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Nzinlii menzenle ɛkɛ ne, na nea, ɔnle ɛkɛ; memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Nea sonla ne mɔɔ di boɛ, na nea tenlenenli ne, ɔluakɛ anzonudwolɛ sonla lɛ ɔ bo zo amra.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Na bɛbazɛkye mɛladonlɛma, amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia bɛ bo zo amra.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Tenlenema ngoanelielɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔle bɛ ɛvealeka wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma boa bɛ na ɔdie bɛ ngoane; ɔye bɛ ɔfi amumuyɛma asa anu, ɔdie bɛ ngoane; ɔboalekɛ bɛnriandi bɛbafea ye nu.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmafa ɛya ɛtea me, anzɛɛ mmafa ɛya ɛtwe me nzo!

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛda ne mɔ ɛboda me, yɛɛ ɛ sa ɛla me nwo zo.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛya kpole ne ati me nwonane nu ɛnde, me ɛtane ti, mende kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Me nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛkpɔlɔ na bɛbɔ, ɔboalekɛ meyɛ ngoasea ninyɛne.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Megolo megua mutulɛ nu, alehyenlɛ kɔsɔɔti medi nyane.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nze nu dwe me yɛɛ me nwonane nu ɛnde.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Menwa nrenzenrenze, me ɛnwomenle ɛwie, me ahonle nriandi me kunlu maa mekponle.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Awulae, ɛze me ngyianlɛ muala, me ɛkponlenlɛ ɛnvea wɔ.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Me ahonle si me kunlu, me anwosesebɛ ɛwie; me nye zo ɛyɛ awozinli.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo mɔ gyinla ahane nea me nee me anwubɛnyunlu, yɛɛ me nwo amra ɛmbikye me.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee ewule la suozua me ngane, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee nyane la nwunlonwunla me, yɛɛ dahuu bɛkɔ me ti akpamo.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Mele kɛ anzondiliravolɛ, mende ɛhwee, medɔ mumule, membuke me nloa.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mele kɛ anzondiliravolɛ, ɔmbuke ɔ nloa ɔndwi awie anyunlu.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a; O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbabua me a.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mesɛlɛ kɛ, “Mmamaa bɛsi me nwo zo agole, bɛmɛ mɔɔ metu koti a bɛsele me la!”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ asɛɛ medɔ aze mewie, yɛɛ dahuu mete nyane me nu.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Meka me ɛtane meto gua, medi me ɛtane nwo nyane.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ la le me kpɔvolɛma, ɔboalekɛ medi kpalɛ nzi.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakpo me! O me Nyamenle, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa!

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ka ɛ nwo baboa me, O Awulae, me ngoanedievolɛ!

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, “Mebanlea me nwo boɛ, amaa meanva me nloa meanga ɛtane; mebazɔ me nloa, mekɛ mɔɔ amumuyɛma gyigyi me nyunlu la.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Memuanle me nloa na menyɛle diinyi, menzɔle me nwo biala na yeanyɛ boɛ, me nyanelilɛ ne yɛle kpole,

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: na me ahonle mɔɔ la me kunlu la lɔle katukatu. Mendwenledwenlenle nwolɛ la, me nwo yelɛyelale me; akee mendendɛle menzele kɛ,

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa menwu me awieleɛ, nee me ngoane mekɛ ne tendenle; maa menwu kɛ me mekɛ ne ɛlɛsi anriandi la.”

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Nea, wɔyɛ me mekɛ ne ezinraa, me ngoane mekɛ ɛnle ɛhwee ɛ nye zo. Nɔhalɛ, awie biala ngoane le kɛ anwoma ala la!

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, sonla le kɛ ɛlawolɛ! Nɔhalɛ, sonla fonla ɔ nwo mgbane; ɔkuohua, na ɔnze sonla mɔɔ bava la!

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Awulae, na kɛkala, mekendɛ duzu? Me anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Die me fi me mɛladonlɛ kɔsɔɔti anu. Mmamaa ahoasea sele me!

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Medɔ mumule, membuke me nloa, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Gyakyi me ɛbolɛ; wɔ adɛka ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Saa sonla ɛtane ti ɛtwe ɔ nzo a, ɛsɛkye ye kɛ ɛlɛtɛba sɛkye ye ninyɛnkpa la; nɔhalɛ, sonla biala le kɛ anwoma ala la.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ, na gyele ɛ nzo tie me ɛzunlɛ; mmamaa me monle ɛhwinlɛ yɛ mgbane ɛ nyunlu. Ɔluakɛ mele wɔ ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze, adendulɛnli, kɛ yɛ nlenya mɔ la.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Gyakyi me, amaa meali me ti ekyii, kolaa na meavi nu mɔɔ bɛnnwu me ko a!

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Menzile abotane mengendɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma; na ɔdiele me na ɔdele me ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Ɔyele me ɔvile kuma anu ɛzulolɛ ne anu, ɔyele me ɔvile moto ne anu, na ɔvale me ɔziele bodane zo, ɔmanle mengyinlanle boɛ.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle mendole edwɛne fofolɛ, mendole ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne memanle yɛ Nyamenle ne. Dɔɔnwo banwu ye na bɛazulo, na bɛava bɛ rɛle bɛawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɔ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, na ɔnva ɔ nwo ɔndo mgbanyizonlema anwo, anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ sonle awozonle na bɛkpo Nyamenle la anwo la.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, wɔmaa wɔ adwenle, nee wɔ nwanwane nyɛleɛ wɔ yɛ nwo ɛyɛ mɔnwo; awie biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ! Saa mebɔ nolo meaha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛzonle somaa mɔɔ bɛngola bɛ tia a.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Ɛmkpondɛ azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ; noko wɔmaa me ɛnzonlɛ kɛ menva mendie wɔ. Ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, wɔamkpondɛ ɛhye mɔ biala.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Akee menganle kɛ, “Medame ɛ, mera; bɛhɛlɛ me nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ buluku ne anu;

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, mekulo kɛ meyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ; wɔ mɛla ne wɔ me ahonle nu.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Meha wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ wɔ menli ne amuala yiale la. Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛze la, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛgyakyile wɔ nolobɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Metɛkedale wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ne azo. Meha wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ nee wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ne; meanva wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne meanvea wɔ menli ne wɔ nyianu kpole ne anu.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakpo kɛ ɛkɛze me anwunvɔne, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ɛbɔ me nwo bane dahuu. Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Edw

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Munzule dɔɔnwo, menze bɛ nloa, ɛbɔ ɛyia me; me ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo, mennwu aze; bɛzonle bɛtɛla me ti enrinli; me nwo ɛgolo me.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me! O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la, maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la, maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛɛ, Ɛhɛɛ” la, anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ɛ ti bɛli fɛlɛko. Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la, ɛha ye dahuu kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le bedevinli.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie; na Awulae dwenle me nwo. O me Nyamenle, ɛle me boavolɛ, ɛle me ngoanedievolɛ, mmakyɛ!

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dwenle ehyianvolɛma anwo la! Ɛdɛnkɛma die ye wɔ ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nu;

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ɔ nwo bane na ɔmaa ye ngoane; bɛfɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔle nyilalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnye ye ɛmmaa ye kpɔvolɛma.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma maa ye anwosesebɛ wɔ ye anwondolɛ nu; ye anwonyane nu, ɛyɛ ye ewule biala ayile.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne; meyɛ ɛtane metia wɔ na yɛ me ayile.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma fa adwenle ɛtane ka kɛ, “Kenlenzu a ɔkɛwu na ye duma aminli a?”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ bie ba kɛ ɔbanlea me a, ɔka ye menlemenle, noko ye ahonle nu le asayɛlɛ ngome; ɔfinde ɔkɔ a, ɔkɔbɔ me ewule ne nolo.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Bɛka kɛ, “Anwonyane mɔɔ ɛbɔ ye la le kpole; ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɛdo ye la, ɔnrɛdwazo bieko.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo kpalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ ye nu, mɔɔ nee me yɛto ɛsalɛ ɛyɛba ko anu la, ɛhakyi ɔ nzi ɛzi me.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Noko, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne, na dwazo me, amaa medame noko meadua bɛ kakɛ bie.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bamaa meanwu kɛ ɛ nye die me nwo, kɛ wɔammaa me kpɔvolɛma anli me nwo zo konim.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ medi boɛ la ati, wɔboa me, na wɔva me wɔzie ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, ɔvi aloamɔleɛ kɔdwu melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ! Amen! Amen!

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Kɛ weɛlɛ anwo si dɔ azule mɔɔ se la, O Nyamenle, zɔhane ala yɛɛ me nwo dɔ wɔ a.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Nyamenle anwo nzuhɔne ku me ɛkɛla, tease Nyamenle ne anwo nzuhɔne ku me. Kenlenzu yɛɛ mebara mearanwu Nyamenle anyunlu a?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ, me monle ɛyɛ me aleɛ, na menli biza me dahuu kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ ni?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Meka me nyane edwɛkɛ a, mekakye ɛhye mɔ amuala; kɛ menzile me nee ɛlɔne ne luale, na menlile bɛ ti, yɛdole ɛlɔnwɔne, yɛdole moyɛlɛ edwɛne, yɛvale fɛlɛko yɛdeɛdeanle nu, yɛhɔle Nyamenle sua nu yɛlile ɛvoyia la.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ, duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ? Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu, na mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ, ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nu, Ɛdɛnkɛma kile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne; aledwolɛ nu, meto edwɛne memaa ye, mefa mesɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le me ngoane la.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Meka mekile Nyamenle, me bodane ne kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi me ɛ? Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ medi nyane kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛholo me nwo zo a?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma wowɔ me safule, bɛmaa ɔyɛ me nyane kɛ nganlɛ wɔ me nwonane nu; na bɛkɔ zo bɛbiza me kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ ni?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ, duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ? Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu, ɔluakɛ mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ, ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Bua me benle, O Nyamenle, na die me ti wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la asa anu; die me fi adalɛma nee amumuyɛma asa anu!

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ menriandi mefea wɔ nu a; duzu ati a wɔkpo me a? Duzu ati a medi nyane kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛholo me nwo zo a?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: O soa wɔ wienyi ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛ ne; maa bɛli me nyunlu, bɛva me bɛhɔ wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, nee ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Akee mebahɔ Nyamenle azukponle ne anwo, meahɔ me Nyamenle, me anyelielɛ kpole ne ɛkɛ; na meava getaa kpole meado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, O Nyamenle, me Nyamenle.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ, duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ? Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu, ɔluakɛ mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ, ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, yɛde ye yɛ nzo nu, yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛha ɛhile yɛ, ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛle bɛ mekɛ zo, wɔ mɔmoane mɔmoane ne.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛvoanle maanle maanle, na ɛvale bɛmɛ ɛziele bɛ gyakɛ anu. Ɛmanle menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ nwunle nyane, na ɛmanle bɛmɛ bɛvale bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛanva bɛ dadeɛ bɛango bɛanva azɛlɛ, bɛdabɛ bɛanva bɛ anwosesebɛ bɛanli konim; na ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne nee wɔ anwosesebɛ ne, yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛdalɛ kpole ne ɛlile konim; ɔluakɛ ɛ nye die bɛ nwo.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɛle me Belemgbunli nee me Nyamenle, mɔɔ maa Gyekɔbo di konim a.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Yɛdua ɛ nwo zo a, yɛka yɛ agbɔvolɛ yɛgua; yɛdua wɔ duma nu yɛtietia yɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Menva me rɛle mendo me ɛda zo, yɛɛ me dadeɛ ɛnrɛhola me ngoane die.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔlie yɛ wɔvi yɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu, na wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi yɛ la anye zo ɛda bɛ a.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Yɛva Nyamenle yɛdu yɛ nwo dahuu, na yɛbayɛ ye mo dahuu.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Noko wɔkpo yɛ wɔmaa bɛli yɛ nwo zo konim, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne angɔ konle ne.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa yɛnriandi yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anyunlu, na yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛve yɛ nwo ninyɛne.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ, na wɔkponde yɛ maanle maanle zo.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Wɔdɔne wɔ menli ne anwonyiadeɛ, kɛ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ biala la.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa yɛ nwo ɛyɛ menli mɔɔ zuozua yɛ la ahyi, yɛɛ bɛgolo yɛ nwo, bɛsi yɛ amgbu a.

english_verse: Foreigners joke about us and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa yɛyɛ ɛfenle yɛmaa maanle maanle, yɛ nwo yɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛzelekɛ.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ muala nyiane ala a ku me a; nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi me nyunlu la edwɛkɛ ti, wɔ me kpɔvolɛ ne nee me senravolɛ ne anyunlu.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛra yɛ nwo zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ rɛle ɛtɛfile wɔ, anzɛɛ yɛtɛtulule ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ kyekyele la.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Yɛtɛkpole wɔ wɔ yɛ ahonle nu, yɛɛ yɛtɛkakyile yɛ nzi yɛtɛsile wɔ ndenle ne,

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ ɛye yɛ ɛgua nanemgbole avinli, na ɛfa awozinli kabii ɛkeda yɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Saa yɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ Nyamenle ne duma, anzɛɛ yɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne bie a,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: asoo anrɛɛ Nyamenle ɛnrɛnwu ye ɔ? Ɔluakɛ ɔze ahonle muala anu.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, wɔmɔ ti bɛku yɛ alehyenlɛ biala, na bɛbu yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nwo zo! O Awulae, duzu ati a ɛlɛda ɛ? Dwazo! Mmakpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ!

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔva ɛ nye wɔvea ɛ? Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ nyane nee yɛ amaneɛ ne mɔ ɛ?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Nyane ɛlɛku yɛ ɛkɛla ahɔ ewule nu; yɛmaa yɛ nwo zo a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nwo zo, bɛla baboa yɛ! Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati die yɛ!

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Adwenle kpalɛ ɛyi me ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ, meto edwɛne memaa belemgbunli ne; me tafinlima le kɛ kɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la pɛne.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ tɛla mgbavolɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɛlolɛ ɛyi wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ tɛkɛɛ, yemɔti Nyamenle ɛyila wɔ dahuu.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Dua wɔ belemgbunlililɛ zo kɔli konim maa nɔhalɛ ne, na die fɔɔnwoma ati; maa wɔ tumi ne ɛli konim mgbole.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛda mbaka ti yɛ nla, bɛwɔ bɛwolo belemgbunli ne kpɔvolɛma ahonle nu; maanle maanle tu gua ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Ɛfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ a ɛdi wɔ ebia ne a;

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: ɛkulo pɛlepɛlelilɛ, ɛkyi amumuyɛ. Yemɔti Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne, ɛva anyelielɛ nwole ɛkpokpa wɔ ɛgyakyi ɛ gɔnwo mɔ.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Wɔ adɛladeɛ nu bɔ evuanlɛ, ɔbɔnle alufuanlɛ, kasea, yɛɛ kolɔbo. Edwɛndolɛma dielie ɛ nye wɔ arelemgbunli azua mɔɔ bɛva ɛzɛlɛ bɛziezie nu la anu.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli mralɛ mraalɛ boka mbɛlɛra mɔɔ wɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la anwo; belemgbunli raalɛ ne gyi wɔ fema zo ɛkɛ, yeva Ɔfɛ ezukoa nvutuke yeyɛ ɔ nwo sɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: O ralɛ raalɛ, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie, na dwenle nwo, maa ɛ rɛle ɛvi wɔ menli nee ɛ ze sua nu.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Wɔ anwofɛlɛko ne bahwe belemgbunli ne ahonle; ɔle ɛ menle, yemɔti tie ɔ ne.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tayama barahyɛ wɔ ninyɛne, sukoavolɛma barahyɛ wɔ ninyɛne ngakyile.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne wɔ ye sua ne akunlu, ɔwula ezukoanzule adɛladeɛ.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Bɛva ye bɛhɔ belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ, ye avoanlema mɔɔ ravale ye la doa ye.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛko nu bɛhɔ belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛ mra mrenya bayɛ kɛ ɛ ze mɔ, bɛbayɛ bɛ arelemgbunli wɔ ewiade amuala anu.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mebamaa awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti abɔ wɔ duma; na bɛaye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nyamenle le yɛ ɛvealeka nee yɛ anwosesebɛ, yɛ mgbemgbene nu boavolɛ wɔ anwongyelelɛ nu.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ewiade kakyi ɔ ti aze bɔbɔ a, yɛnrɛzulo, saa awoka tudu kɔgua nyevile buma nu,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: saa nyevile fudu na ɔtulutulu ɔ ti ɔgua zo, na ye ɛvundunlɛ ne maa awoka kpusu a, yɛnrɛzulo.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Azule bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ye nzule maa Nyamenle suakpole ne azo yɛ anyelielɛ; ɔle Anwuma Anwumanli ne tɛnlabelɛ.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Nyamenle de ɛkɛ ne, awie ɛnrɛhola ye sɛkye, Nyamenle baboa ye ndɛndɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ahonle futu, belemgbunlililɛ to bɛka nu, ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ kokye maa azɛlɛ kolo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne nee yɛ de; Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne le yɛ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla, baranlea Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima mɔɔ ɛli, yemaa azɛlɛ ye amuala ɛdɔ mgbane.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛgyakyi konle wɔ azɛlɛ ye amuala azo; ɔbubu ɛda nee atwɛ ne mɔ, ɔfa senle ɔyela konle ehwili ne mɔ!

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: Ɔse: “Bɛgyinla diinyi, na bɛnwu kɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a. Mebo maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo, mebo ewiade amuala anwo zo.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee yɛ de; Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne le yɛ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ bɛ sa nu! Bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle!

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔle belemgbunli kpole wɔ azɛlɛ ye amuala azo.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ɔmanle yɛlile maanle maanle nwo zo konim, na yɛziele maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Ɔkpale nu ɔyele yɛ agyadeɛ ɔmanle yɛ, agyadeɛ mɔɔ ye kulovolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra fa tu bɛ nwo.

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛvo ɛdɛnla ye ebia nu, bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle, bɛtea nu anyelielɛ nu.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle a le ewiade amuala belemgbunli a; bɛdo edwɛne bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Nyamenle le maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli; Nyamenle de ye belemgbunli ebia nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli boɔboa bɛ nloa, kɛmɔ Ebileham Nyamenle ne menli ne yɛ la. Ɔluakɛ ewiade ye enyinlike kɔsɔɔti le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ; ye belemgbunlililɛ le kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne suakpole ne azo!

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Ye boka nwuanzanwuanza ne le kpole, ɔwale, ɔle ewiade amuala anyelielɛ. Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu lɔ, le Belemgbunli kpole ne suakpole.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhile kɛ ɔle pepɛdievolɛ wɔ ye aranemgbole ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, nea, arelemgbunli boɔboale bɛ nloa, bɛlile anlɔma bɛrale ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Bɛnwunle ye ala la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ; bɛ nye zo danle bɛ na bɛnriandile.

english_verse: They trembled all over like women giving birth
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo wozowozole bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Ɛvale aduduleɛ anwoma ne ɛbubule Tahyehye meli ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛde la, yemɔ ala a yɛnwu ye wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma suakpole ne, wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne suakpole ne mɔɔ yekyekye na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ dahuu la azo a.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, yɛdwenle wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo, wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kɛ wɔ duma ne si de la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ dwu ewiade amuala a. Konimlilɛ wɔ ɛ sa fema ne anu.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Maa Zayɔn Boka zo amra ɛli fɛlɛko! Maa Dwudama anye ɛlie, ɔboalekɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Bɛkpɔsa Zayɔn azo, bɛbɔ ye mgbɔlɔka bɛyia, bɛdia ye tawa ne mɔ;

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: bɛnlea ye bane ne mɔ ati zo kpalɛ, bɛhɔ ye aranemgbole ne mɔ anu; amaa bɛaha bɛahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛ,

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: “Nyamenle ne ɛne, ɔle yɛ Nyamenle dahuu. Ɔbahile yɛ adenle mekɛ biala.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛdie ɛhye! Ewiade amra amuala, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: bɛmɛ awienvolɛma nee mgbolema, sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma, bɛdie!

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Mebaha nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ, ndelebɛbo wɔ mɔɔ medwenledwenle nwo la anu.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Mebagyele me nzo meadie ɛrɛlɛ, mebabɔ getaa kpole meaye me agyebɛ nloa.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Duzu ati yɛɛ saa ngyegyelɛ to me, na menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la, bɔ yia me a, menwɔzulo ɛ?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nwo kpɔne, anzɛɛ ye ngoane nwo kakɛ tua maa Nyamenle,

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ye ngoane ɛkpɔnedeɛ ne bolɛ yɛ se. mɔɔ ɔnrɛhola ye tua ɛlɛ,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: amaa yeadɛnla ngoane nu dahuu, na yeanwu ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
