translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, yɛkola yɛnwu kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bɔbɔ wu, koasea nee gyibilito wu, na bɛgyakyi bɛ anwonyia bɛmaa awie mɔ.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Bɛ nla ne mɔ a le bɛ sua nu dahuu a, ɔle bɛ tɛnlabelɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu, noko bɛka a bɛse azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo le bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Sonla kpoleyɛlɛ ɛnlie ye, ɔbawu kɛ nane ala la.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛ nwo bɛdi koasea nu la awieleɛ ɛne, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die bɛ ngome bɛ nwo la awieleɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ mboane la, bɛ muala bɛbawu. Ewule bayɛ bɛ neavolɛ. Pɛlepɛlelilɛma bali bɛ nwo zo konim nwonlomɔ ne ala, na bɛmɛ, bɛ nwonane bakpɔlɔ. Mɔwuamra maanle nu a le bɛ sua nu a.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle bakpɔne me ɛkɛla avi ewule tumi bo, ɔluakɛ ɔbalie me ngoane.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Saa awie nyia ɔ nwo a, mmasulo, saa ye anwonyia yɛ kpole bɔbɔ a, mmasulo.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa ɔwu a ɔnrɛva ɛhwee ɔnrɛhɔ; ɔ nee ye anwonyia ne ɛnrɛhɔ ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Saa ɔde aze la ɛnee ɔ nye die ɔ nwo, na ɔnyia ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ kpalɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo a,

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: ɔbadu adenle ne mɔɔ ɔ ze mɔ dule la, bɛnrɛnwu wienyi ne bieko ɛlɛ

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Sonla ɛnga ye kpoleyɛlɛ nu dahuu, ɔbawu kɛ nane ala la.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, Tumivolɛ Ko ne fɛlɛ na ɔtendɛ ɔkile ewiade amra, ɔvi sɛnzɛne aduduleɛ mɔɔ kɔdwu adɔleɛ.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ta fi Zayɔn, suakpole mɔɔ ye kɛnlɛma di munli.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛba, ɔmba ye bɔnwobɔnwo; sendɔlɔra li ɔ nyunlu, ahumu kpole ɛbɔ ɛyia ye.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Ɔlɛfɛlɛ anwumaneamra nee azɛlɛ, amaa yeabua ye menli ne ndɛne.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Bɛboɔboa me menli nɔhavoma ne anloa, bɛmɛ a bɛbɔle azu bɛ nee me yɛle ngyekyeleɛ a!

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Anwumaneamra kile ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle mumua ne a le ndɛnebuavolɛ a.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “O me menli, bɛdie na metendɛ, O Yizilayɛma, medi daselɛ meatia bɛ. Medame a mele Nyamenle, bɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Menrɛlie nlankɛ nyinli biala menrɛvi bɛ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ menrɛlie abɔnkye nyinli biala wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kpɔkɛ nu nane biala le me ɛdeɛ, awoka apenle apenle zo nlankɛ le me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Meze anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la le me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: “Saa ɛhɔne ku me a, menrɛha menrɛhile bɛ, ɔluakɛ ewiade nee nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Asoo medi nlankɛ nane, anzɛɛ meno mbɔnkye mogya?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle; bɛye bɛ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔle Anwuma Anwumanli ne la.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ me kenle biala mɔɔ ngyegyelɛ kɛdo bɛ la, na mebalie bɛ, na bɛaye me ayɛlɛ.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle se amumuyɛma kɛ, “Duzu adenle a bɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka me mɛla ne mɔ, anzɛɛ bɛka me ngyekyeleɛ ne a?

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛkyi ahwibɛnyunlu, yɛɛ bɛkpɔla me mɛla ne bɛgua bɛ nzo anzi.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu awule a, bɛfa ye agɔnwolɛ; yɛɛ bɛ nee awuvolɛvalɛma tu.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: “Bɛkeha ɛtane ɛtane, yɛɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Bɛtɛnla bɛye bɛ mediema mrenya ndɛne; bɛbɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nli amra mrenya anwo nzekue.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ, noko mendɛne bɛ zo, bɛdwenle kɛ mele kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Na kɛkala metwi bɛ nyunlu, na meava bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ meado gua.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle fi Nyamenle la, bɛyɛ ɛhye nzonlɛ, anrɛɛ menwɔtete bɛ, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛlie bɛ!

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛva moyɛlɛ kɛra kɛ ye azubɔdeɛ la di me eni; mɔɔ kɛva adenle kpalɛ zo la, mebahile ye Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ ne!”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne de la; wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ kpole ne ati, nunu me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Nrinzi me ninyɛndane ne mɔ amuala bɔkɔɔ, na te me nwo fi me ɛtane ne anwo.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ me ɛtane gyi me nyunlu dahuu.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ ala yɛɛ mevo wɔ, na mebɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye wɔ ɛ nyunlu a, amaa wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ayɛ fɔɔnwo na wɔanli ɛzonle wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ nu.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Nea, bɛwole me amumuyɛ nu, yɛɛ ɛtane nu a ɔmɔ nrenzɛle me a.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Nea, ɛkpondɛ nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ sonla nu la; yemɔti kile me nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Fa nyinlanyinla nua me, na me nwo kɛde; bia me, na menwɔyɛ nwohyee menwɔdɛla ezukɔtweaba.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Maa me anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ; maa mbowule mɔɔ wɔbubu nu la anye ɛlie.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Ye ɛ nye fi me ɛtane ne mɔ anwo, na nunu me amumuyɛ ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, bɔ ahonle mɔɔ anu te la wula me nu, na maa me sunsum fofolɛ mɔɔ gyi kpundii la.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Mmafuandi me ɛto, yɛɛ mmaye wɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛfi me nu.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Fa wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo anyelielɛ ne sia bɛlɛ me, na buke wɔ munli nu sɔ me nu.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Na menwɔhilehile mɛladonlɛma wɔ adenle ne, na ɛtanevolɛma bazia ara wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, die me fi ewule nu, wɔmɔ Nyamenle, ɛle me ngoanelielɛ, na mebado wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛne.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: O Awulae, buke me nloa, na mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Ahonle bɛlɛvo a le azubɔlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye a, O Nyamenle, ɛmkpo ahonle mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo na yenlu ɔ nwo la.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Fa fɛlɛkolilɛ yɛ Zayɔn boɛ; die Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ fofolɛ,

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: na ɛ nye alie azubɔlɛ kpalɛ nwo, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee nane mumua ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ; na bɛkɛva nlankɛ bɛkɛbɔ azu wɔ wɔ azukponle zo.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: O katakyie, duzu ati a ɛfa wɔ amumuyɛ ɛtu ɛ nwo zɛhae ɛ? Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Dahuu ɛfa adwenle kɛ ɛsɛkye awie mɔ. Ɛ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ dɛma, ɛpepɛ awie mɔ agyakɛ anzi ndinli.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛ nye die ɛtane nwo ɛtɛla kpalɛ, ɛkulo adalɛbɔlɛ ɛtɛla nɔhalɛhanlɛ.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Ɛkulo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sɛkye awie mɔ la, O adalɛ nabalabanli.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Nyamenle babubu wɔ dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ; ɔbaye wɔ yeavi wɔ sua nu; ɔbadu wɔ yeavi teasema azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Tenlenema banwu ɛhye, na bɛazulo, na bɛazele ye bɛaha kɛ,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea sonla ne mɔɔ anva Nyamenle anyɛ ye ɛvealeka, na ɔvale ɔ rɛle ɔwulale ye anwonyia kpole ne anu na ɔvale ye anwonyia ɔyɛle ye ɛvealeka la.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Na mame, mele kɛ ɔlivi baka amolɛ wɔ Nyamenle sua nu. Me rɛle wɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ wɔ mo dahuu, ɔboalekɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔyɛ a. Mebabɔ wɔ duma ne nolo, wɔ wɔ menli ne anyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Koasea edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛnle ɛkɛ.” Bɛzɛkye, bɛbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla; sonla ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ a.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bele ɔ nye anwuma lɔ nea menli, ɔnea saa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bie wɔ nu, mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Noko bɛ muala bɛminli, bɛ muala bɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ; sonla ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ a, kyɛkyɛ, ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Asoo amumuyɛma mɔɔ di me menli ne nwonane kɛ bɛdi aleɛ, na bɛnzonle Nyamenle la ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo?

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a ɛzulolɛ kpole ɛha bɛ la. ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle bie ɛlɛ la ɛha bɛ! Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle babubu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle ye la mbowule nu; nyiane bahu bɛ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛkpo bɛ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma ngoanelielɛ vi Zayɔn ara! Saa Nyamenle maa ye menli ne eza kpazi a, Yizilayɛma anye balie na bɛali fɛlɛko

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔ duma ne ati, die me; fa wɔ tumi ne die me ti.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me nloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mgbanyizonlema ɛdwazo me nwo zo, amumuyɛma kpondɛ ahu me; bɛnva Nyamenle bɛnyɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Nyamenle le me boavolɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma a me ngoane wɔ ɔ sa nu a.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ɔbava ɛtane yeadua me kpɔvolɛma kakɛ, dua wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne azo bɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Mebava ahonle nu azubɔdeɛ meabɔ azu meamaa wɔ; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔye me wɔvi ngyegyelɛ biala anu, na me nye ɛnwu kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛli akoatɔ.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ!

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Bele ɛ nye nea me, na bua me; me amaneɛnwunlɛ ɛbo me nwo zo.

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma alɛrayɛlɛ ne kpu me ɛbolɛ, ɔlua amumuyɛma nzisi ne ati. Ɔluakɛ bɛgyegye me, bɛva me nwo ɛya, yɛɛ bɛkyi me.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Me ahonle ɛlɛdi nyane kpole, ewule nwo ɛzulolɛ ɛdɔ me nwo zo.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Mesulo yɛɛ me nwo wozo me; sulosulo ɛbɔ me kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Na mese, “Anrɛɛ meanyia abubule ndɛbalɛ! Anrɛɛ menwɔdu menwɔhɔlie me ɛnwomenle;

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: ɛhɛe, anrɛɛ menwɔhɔ moa moa menwɔhɔdɛnla fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ menwɔhɔkpondɛ kpɔda bie abo menwɔdɛnla, menwɔye me nwo menwɔvi anwoma nee ahumu ne anu ndɛndɛ.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: O Awulae, sɛkye bɛ ngyehyɛlɛ biala; mmamaa bɛ adwenle yɛ ko. Ɔluakɛ menwu konle nee nzaka wɔ suakpole ne azo.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ bɛdua bane ne mɔ ati zo, bɛbɔ suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka bɛyia; ninyɛmunli nee ngyegyelɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ,

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Awukade wɔ zolɛ ɛleka biala; nzisi nee awule ɛmkpa ye gua nu.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpɔvolɛ mɔɔ si me amgbu ala, anrɛɛ menwɔhola menwɔgyinla ɔ nloa; ɔnle kpɔvolɛ mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo kile me ala, anrɛɛ menwɔnriandi menwɔvea.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, mɔɔ ɛle me ti pɛne, mɔɔ me nee wɔ tu, na yɛle agɔnwolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ la ɔ.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Ɛnee yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛdi yɛ nwo adwelie; yɛdua nwo yɛkɔ Nyamenle sua nu yɛkɔsonle.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Maa ewule ɛhu bɛ; maa bɛzie bɛ anyewɔzo! Amumuyɛ ɛyi bɛ awuke nee bɛ ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mesu mefɛlɛ Nyamenle; na Ɛdɛnkɛma balie me.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Nɔsolɛ nu, nwonlomɔ nee ewiazo meka me nyane na mesu, na ɔbadie me ne.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Ɔbalie me ɛkɛla yeara ngoane nu, yeavi konle ɛhye mɔɔ megyi ɔ nloa la anu, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me ɛlɛko la zonle.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Nyamenle badie me, na yeaha bɛ aze, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔvi tete ɔle belemgbunli la; ɔboalekɛ bɛnli mɛla zo, yɛɛ bɛnzulo Nyamenle.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo denrɛle ɔ sa tiale ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, ɔtulule ye ngyekyeleɛ ne.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Ɔ nloa anu menlemenle tɛla ngyenle, noko konle ala yɛɛ ɔzo ɔlua a. Ye edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ tɛla asikyelɛ, noko bɛpɛ kɛ konle dadeɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ adesoa ne maa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔbazɔ wɔ nu; ɔnrɛmaa tenlenenli ɛnrɛkpo aze.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛbavuandi bɛ wɔagua kuma kpole ne anu; ahɔdiawu nee ngunzima ɛnrɛli bɛ mekɛ ne foa ko bɔbɔ. Na mame, mebava me rɛle meawula wɔ nu.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ menli tietia me nwo zo; alehyenlɛ biala me kpɔvolɛma sisi me;

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Saa ɛzulolɛ ka me a, mefa me rɛle mewula wɔ nu.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ye edwɛkɛ ti meye ye ayɛlɛ la, me rɛle wɔ ye nu a menzulo, Duzu a sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala bɛkulo kɛ bɛsɛkye me adenle nu; dahuu bɛdwenle me nwo adwenle ɛtane.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Bɛkuohua bɛ nloa, bɛkɔ me nwo nzia, bɛnea me ɛhɔlɛ nee me ɛralɛ nu kɛ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Yemɔti maa bɛ munzule ɛbɔ bɛ ti, O Nyamenle, dua wɔ ɛya ne azo ka menli ne gua.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛze me amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti; fa me monle gua toba nu ɛ! Asoo menli ne aluma ɛnle wɔ buluku nu?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ dwu na mefɛlɛ wɔ a, me kpɔvolɛma bagua ye bɛ nzi. Meze ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle gyi me nzi.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ ye nu la, mewɔ ye nu a menzulo. Duzu yɛɛ sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ la, ɔwɔ kɛ meye; mebava mo azubɔdeɛ meamaa wɔ.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔye me ɛkɛla wɔvi ewule nu, ɛhɛe, wɔzɔ me, wɔammaa meandɔ aze, amaa mealua Nyamenle anyunlu, wɔ wienyi ne mɔɔ ta teasema anwo zo la anu.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Nwu me anwunvɔne, O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ wɔ nuhua yɛɛ me ɛkɛla nriandi fea a; mebanriandi mearavea ɛ ndɛba abo, kɔkpula kɛ ahumu mgbole ne mɔ kɛgua la.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔbazoa yeamaa bɛvi anwuma bɛaralie me, ɔbamaa nyiane ahu menli mɔɔ sisi me la. Nyamenle bamaa ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ara me nwo zo.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Mela awenadema avinli, bɛdi menli adidikpoku nu; bɛ gye le kɛ atwɛ nee ɛda, bɛ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kile wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ! Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ne ɛda ewiade amuala!

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Bɛzuale me ɛhane; nyane bole me nwo zo. Bɛvunle kuma wɔ me adenle nu, na bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛgua nuhua.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, me ahonle gyi kpundii, me ahonle gyi kpundii! Mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Dwazo, me ɛkɛla! Bɛdwazo, me getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi! Mefa ayɛlɛyelɛ meamaa mangyee ye akpudwu.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: O Awulae, mebayɛ wɔ mo, wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti avinli; mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ meahile maanle maanle.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole dwu anwuma, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kile wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ! Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ne ɛda ewiade amuala!

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ maanlebuvoma, asoo bɛka nɔhalɛ? Asoo bɛbua menli ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu?

english_verse: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, ngunzi ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, na bɛdi ɛtane wɔ ewiade ye anu.

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma nee bɛ petebɔlɛ ne vi bɛ nli akunlu, bɛ nvonleɛ vi bɛ awolɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Bɛ nloa anu bɔlɔ le kɛ ɛwɔlɛ bɔlɔ, bɛ nzo ɛdi kɛ ɛwɔlɛ bɔna,

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛnde silikyevoma ane, na yeayɛ ngonyiama edwɛne.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, bubu bɛ gye mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nloa anu la; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tudu awenadema ngyikyi ne mɔ agye ndendenle ne.

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Maa bɛze bɛhɔ kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛdukue la, maa bɛyɛ kɛ ndile, bɛtietia bɛ nwo zo, bɛgyengye.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kɛ ɛnlonkoɛ mɔɔ kolo yɛ ndeteata, maa bɛyɛ kɛ ralɛ mɔɔ ka nzule nu la.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bava ɛya kpole apia bɛ anyewɔzo ahɔ; bɛ nye zo katete bɛ la ɛnee bɛpɛ bɛ bɛgua kɛ ndile amolɛ.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ne nwu nzenralɛ ne a ɔ nye balie; ɔbawudwu amumuyɛma mogya ne.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Menli baha kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, tenlenema ɛnyia bɛ ahatualɛ; nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bua ewiade ndɛne a.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: die me fi menli mɔɔ bɔ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla la asa anu, na die me fi ahɔdiawu ne mɔ asa anu.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, nea, bɛhɔ me nwo nzia, menli atisesebɛ ɛli me ti amonle. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛyɛle ɛtane, metɛtonle mɛla biala,

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: metɛfonle, noko bɛnriandi bɛkɔ me nwo nzia. Maa ɛ nwo zo, bɛla baboa me, na nea!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, ɛle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle. Dwazo tea maanle maanle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti; mmafavi amumuyɛma atisesebɛ ye anu biala.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo biala bɛsia bɛba me nwo zo, bɛkpo kɛ ahwea bɛbɔ suakpole ye mgbɔlɔka.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛlua lɔ ɛ, bɛlɛtea kɛ bɛli tweanga, na bɛnrese bɛ gye, bɛ edwɛkɛ se, “Nwane a kɛde yɛ ne a?”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛsele bɛ, ɛsi maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la amgbu.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: O me Anwosesebɛ, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛle me aranemgbole.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle balua ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne azo ayia me; me Nyamenle bamaa meanwu kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ne ɛho ɛdɔ.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Mmaku bɛ, anrɛɛ me menli ne arɛle kɛvi; fa wɔ tumi ne maa bɛyɛ gyigyiligyigyili, na ka bɛ gua aze, O Awulae, yɛ wowavolɛ.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ nee bɛ munzule adwenle biala ati maa bɛ mgbanyizonle ɛbu ɛzia bɛ. Kɛmɔ bɛbɔ adalɛ na bɛwa amonle la,

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: maa wɔ ɛya kpole ne ɛyela bɛ wee, ɛmaa bɛdɔ nzonle, bɛ bo zo ɛminli, amaa menli anwu kɛ Nyamenle le belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ toonwo ɔdwu ewiade ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo biala bɛsia bɛba me nwo zo, bɛkpo kɛ ahwea bɛbɔ suakpole ye mgbɔlɔka.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Bɛduolua nu bɛkpondɛ aleɛ, na saa bɛ ko anyi a ɛnee bɛlɛkpo.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Na mame, mebado wɔ anwosesebɛ nwo edwɛne; mebado wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛne nwonlomɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ me aranemgbole nee me ɛvealeka wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: O me Anwosesebɛ, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛle me aranemgbole, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ kile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii me nwo zo la.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔkpo yɛ, wɔgologolo yɛ nwo banebɔlɛ; wɔva yɛ nwo ɛya; O, fa yɛ sie yɛ bo zo ne.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa azɛlɛ ɛkpusu, wɔmaa yekpuke; ka mua nwolɛ, na ɔlɛwaye.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa wɔ menli ne ɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo; wɔmaa yɛ nwanye yɛnlo yɛyɛ tindaanwu.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Wɔvola fɛlɛnra wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la, kɛ bɛnriandi bɛradane ye.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Amaa wɔalie menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ la ngoane la, bua yɛ nwolɛ na maa ɛ sa fema zo, maa yɛli konim.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛdendɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔse, “Mebahyɛ Hyikɛm anu konimlilɛ nu na meahyɛ Sɛko Bɔnza meamaa me menli ne.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Geleade le me ɛdeɛ; Manasɛ le me ɛdeɛ; Yifelaem le me kyɛlɛ; Dwuda le me tumi kpɔma;

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Mowabe le me kyɛnze bonkuma mɔɔ menrinzi me sa anwo nu, mefuandi me mgbɔlaboa megua Yidɔm anwo zo; metea nu konimlilɛ nu megua Filisitiama anwo zo.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛhye nwo la azo a? Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ Yidɔm a?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, asoo ɛtɛkpole yɛ ɛ? O Nyamenle, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne angɔ.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: O boa yɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne ati, ɔluakɛ sonla moalɛ le mgbane.

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle boka yɛ nwo a yɛbaho yɛadɔ zo; yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaha kpɔvolɛma ne yeagua a.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, tie me ɛzunlɛ, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: saa nyane bo me nwo zo na mewɔ moa moa a mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ. Fa me kɔzie bodane mɔɔ wɔ anwuma tɛla me la azo.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me ɛvealeka, ɛle me pepɛdievolɛ anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ko tia me kpɔvolɛ ne a.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Maa mendɛnla wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu dahuu, amaa me nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo wɔ ɛ ndɛba abo.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, wɔmɔ Nyamenle, wɔde me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ, na wɔmaa me agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ sulo wɔ la nyia ye la.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Maa belemgbunli ne ɛnyi ɛhyɛ; ɔli mekɛ dɔɔnwo ɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Maa ɔli belemgbunli dahuu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu; maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ɛrɛla ɔ nwo zo ɛzinza ye.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa alehyenlɛ biala melɛye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne a, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ala yɛɛ me ɛkɛla yɛ koonwu kendɛ ye a, ye ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ me ngoanelielɛ vi ba a.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔle me bodane nee me ngoanelielɛ a, ɔle me aranemgbole; awie ɛnrɛli me nwo zo konim.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Kenlenzu yɛɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛkɛgyakyi sonla nwo nziahɔlɛ kɛ bɛku ye a? Sonla mɔɔ bane mɔɔ ɛhyea bɔbɔ la lɛ anwosesebɛ tɛla ye la.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛmaa ye dibilɛ abɔ ye, bɛ anyelielɛ a le adalɛbɔlɛ. Bɛfa bɛ nloa bɛyileyila, noko bɛ kunlu ɛdeɛ, ɔle amowa.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ala yɛɛ me ɛkɛla yɛ koonwu kendɛ ye a, ɔluakɛ me anyelazo muala vi ye ɛkɛ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔle me bodane nee me ngoanelielɛ a, ɔle me aranemgbole; awie ɛnrɛli me nwo zo konim.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anwo zo yɛɛ me ngoanelielɛ nee me enililɛ ne gyi a; Nyamenle le me bodane kpole nee me ɛvealeka.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: O adɛsa, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Nyamenle anu dahuu; bɛha bɛ ngyianlɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhile ye; Nyamenle le yɛ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Awienvolɛma le kɛ anwoma, mgbolema le kɛ ɛlalɛ; ɛgua bɛ tone zo a bɛndo ɛhwee; bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ɛnlomboɛ ɛndo anwoma.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula apobɔlɛ nu, mmafa ɛ nye ɛto ɛwualɛ zo; saa anwonyia nu noko a, mmafa wɔ ahonle ɛto zo.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛdendɛ ko; mede ɛhye fane nwiɔ; kɛ tumi le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: O Awulae, wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii a. Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛtua sonla kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye gyima si de la a.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a, mekpondɛ wɔ, me ɛkɛla anwo ɛlɛdɔ wɔ; me sonla mumua ne ɛlɛpele akpondɛ wɔ, kɛ azɛlɛ resee mɔɔ ɛhwie na ɔlɛkpondɛ nzule la.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menlea ɛ nyunlu wɔ wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, na menwu wɔ tumi ne nee wɔ anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpalɛ tɛla ngoane la, mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la, mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, mebakpogya me sa zo meabɔ wɔ duma.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Bɛli me ɛkɛla adane bɛmaa yeyɛ belane toboo, na mefa fɛlɛkolilɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Saa mela me ɛkpa zo a medwenle ɛ nwo, na me adwenle gyinla ɛ nwo zo nɔe ne amuala.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, wɔyɛ me moalɛ; na mefea ɛ ndɛba abo meto anyelielɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla beta wɔ kyengye; ɛ sa fema ne lɛ me nu.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la bahɔ azɛlɛ bo kuma nu;

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa, na bɛayɛ nanemgbole aleɛ.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle ati, belemgbunli ne anye balie; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ye bɛka ndane la anyunlu bara anyia; ɔluakɛ adalɛma baha bɛ nloa ado nu.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, tie me ne, na ngyegyelɛ ɛdo me; kpɔvolɛ ne anwo ɛzulolɛ ti, die me ngoane.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Ye me fi amumuyɛma awozinli nu kpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ, nee ɛtanema adwenle biala anu.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Bɛsi bɛ tafinlima ne mɔ kɛ dadeɛ, bɛ edwɛkɛ wowɔ kɛ ɛda mbaka.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Bɛsɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne anu kpundii; bɛdi awozinli nu ɛhane ɛzualɛ nwo adwelie; bɛka ye bɛ ti anu kɛ, “Nwane a kɛnwu yɛ a?

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛnwu yɛ maamɔvo ɛbɛla ye anzi a? Yɛdwenle yɛbɔ amumuyɛ nrɛlɛbɛ kpɔkɛ.” Ɔluakɛ sonla biala adwenle nee ye ahonle nu le kuma!

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle bado ye ɛda ne awɔ bɛ; bɛbaboda arɛlevilɛ nu.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Bɛ nloa ne ati, ɔbazɛkye bɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛnwu bɛ la bakpusu ɔ ti.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Akee menli kɔsɔɔti bazulo; bɛbaha gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛli la, na bɛadwenle mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ati bɛmaa tenlenema anye ɛlie, na bɛvea ye nu! Bɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ ahonle nu te la anye ɛlie.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɔfɛta kɛ yɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ Zayɔn; wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛye yɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ yɛmaa wɔ a,

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Saa yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ bo yɛ nwo zo a, ɛfa ɛkyɛ yɛ.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛkɛkpa nu ɛkɛye ye, ɛkɛva ye ɛkɛra kɛ ɔradɛnla wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la. Yɛ kunlu badwo wɔ sua nu, wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɛfa nyɛleɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛye yɛ ɛfi ewule nu, O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, ɛle ewiade amuala anyelazo, nyevile nzi amra amuala anyelazo a le wɔ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Wɔ anwosesebɛ yɛɛ ɛvale ɛhyehyɛle awoka ɛhilele wɔ tumi kpole ne a.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛmaa nyevile gua diinyi, azɛlɛkye gyakyi ɛbulɛ, na menli adwenle begyebegyeyɛlɛ gyakyi;

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ewiade ye ati nee ɔ bo la anwu wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ na bɛazulo wɔ. Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛmaa ɛnyelɛ die alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ a.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Ɛkpɔla azɛlɛ ye na ɛtɔ nzule ɛgua zo; ɛmaa ɔyɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la. Ɛmaa azule ne mɔ yi tɛkɛɛ; ɛmaa bɛ ma yɛ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ kɛ ɛhyehyɛle ye la ɛne.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Ɛtɔ ezule dɔɔnwo ɛgua ɛya avule ne mɔ azo, ɛmaa ɔtuodua bɛ ahuma ne mɔ; ɛtɔ nyenyensuo ɛmaa azɛlɛ ne do, na ɛyila zo ɛmaa mbaka nyi.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Ɛmaa bɛ bɛyɔba so dɔɔnwo; ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva la aleɛ bu.

english_verse: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
translation_verse: Adidileka ne mɔ ndile bele gua zo, anyelielɛ ɛva awoka ne mɔ.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Mboane ɛyi ɛbɔ ne mɔ abo; abɛlɛ ɛyi mbɔnza tɛkɛɛ, na bɛtea nu bɛto anyelielɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Ewiade amra amuala, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdeɛdea nu bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Bɛdo anyunlunyia edwɛne bɛhanvo ye duma ne; bɛyeyɛ ye anyunlunyia nu!

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛhile Nyamenle kɛ, “Wɔ gyima yɛ ɛzulolɛ! Wɔ tumi ne kpole ti wɔ kpɔvolɛma tu gua ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Ewiade amuala sonle wɔ; bɛto ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa wɔ, bɛto edwɛne bɛye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla bɛranlea debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la, ye gyimayɛlɛ wɔ menli avinli yɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle nyevile ne yɛle azɛlɛ resee; menli diale bɛ gyakɛ anu pɛle azule ne. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ yɛ nye liele ye nu a.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Ye tumi ne kpole ti ɔdi belemgbunli dahuu, ɔ nye wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo; mmamaa menli mɔɔ ɛde atua la memaa bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛye yɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, bɛmaa bɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ ne ɛdwu ɛleka biala.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔtɛmaa yɛtɛte aze, na ɔtɛmanle yɛtɛtɔle aze a.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Nyamenle, wɔzɔ yɛ wɔnlea; wɔzɔ yɛ wɔnlea kɛ bɛsɔ dwɛtɛ fufule bɛnea la.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle yɛhɔguale ɛhane nu, na ɛzoale yɛ ɛnlomboɛ;

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: ɛmanle menli tietiale yɛ nwo zo; yɛluale senle nee nzule nu, noko wɔva yɛ wɔra azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛlɛ la azo.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Mebava ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ meara wɔ sua nu; mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ

english_verse: when I was in trouble.
translation_verse: mɔɔ membɔle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mewɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu la.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Nyamenle la, bɛrɛla bɛradie, na mebaha mɔɔ yeyɛ yemaa me la meahile bɛ.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Menzunle kpole kpalɛ menvɛlɛle ye, yɛɛ eza menyeyɛle ye.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Saa ɛnee ɛtane wɔ me ahonle nu a, anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛdie me.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Na nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle ɛdie me; yedie me nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ yeamkpo me nzɛlɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ yeanye ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne me nwo zo!

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔyila yɛ, na ɔmaa ɔ nyunlu ɛda yɛ nwo zo,

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: amaa ewiade amuala anwu wɔ adenle ne, na maanle maanle anwu wɔ ngoanelielɛ tumi ne.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ; maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
translation_verse: Maa maanle maanle anye ɛlie na bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne, ɔluakɛ ɛfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛbua menli ndɛne, na ɛsinza maanle maanle wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ; maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye ɛhye aleɛ dɔɔnwo ɛmaa yɛ, Nyamenle, yɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛyila yɛ.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛyila yɛ; bɛmaa ewiade amuala ɛzulo ye!

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛdwazo ɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma ɛbɔ asande; menli mɔɔ kyi ye la ɛnriandi ɛvi ɔ nyunlu!

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Wuda bɛ kɔ kɛ bɛwuda esike la; kolo bɛ kɛ senle kolo ɛyɛlɛ; maa amumuyɛma ɛminli Nyamenle anyunlu!

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Maa tenlenema ne anye ɛlie; maa bɛli wulupe wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu; maa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛli fɛlɛko.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle; bɛdo edwɛne bɛye ye duma ne ayɛlɛ; bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa mɔɔ tɛnla amungu zo tia la; ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛli wulupe wɔ ɔ nyunlu!

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Nrisa bɛ ze nee ahunlanvolɛ pepɛdievolɛ a le Nyamenle mɔɔ de ye nwuanzanwuanza ɛleka ne la.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Nyamenle maa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la awuke maa ɔboa nu; ɔye pilizama ɔfinde ɔmaa bɛkpazi; na ɔmaa atuadelɛma tɛnla azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛhwie la azo.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛli wɔ menli ne anyunlu, mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ lua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: azɛlɛ kpusule, ezule dɔle, kɛ ɛdawɔ Nyamenle wɔye ɛ nyunlu a; Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne yele ɔ nyunlu la, Saenae Boka kpusule dikyidikyi.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɛmanle ezule dɔle dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛleka biala. na ɛmanle agyadeɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛkye la yɛle boɛ.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyɛmoa nyianle ɛleka nuhua dɛnlanle; wɔ kpalɛ ti, O Nyamenle, ɛmanle ɛhyianvolɛma nyianle bɛ kyɛfoa.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Awulae dendɛle tumi nu; na menli mɔɔ vale edwɛkɛ ne hɔle la zonle.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Bɛse, “Ɛlɔnema nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ ɛlɛnriandi, bɛlɛnriandi!” Mraalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu mɔɔ nee mboane a de la

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: kyɛ konle nu afedeɛ ne fa: abubule ndɛbalɛ mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwo, yɛɛ bɛ ndɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛholo ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛgua nwo.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ ne bɔle arelemgbunli ne mɔ asande la, ezukɔtweaba dɔle Zalemɔn Boka.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: O boka kpole, Beehyan boka; O boka mɔɔ ati zonle, Beehyan Boka!

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: O boka ati dɔɔnwo, duzu ati a ɛ nye ɛbolo boka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo kɛ ɔtɛnla zo la ɛ? Ɛhɛe, ɛkɛ ne a Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla dahuu a.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Ɔvale konle ehwili dɔɔnwo, apenle bulu mɔnwo, apenle apenle kɛyɛ nyɛ, Awulae vi Saenae rale ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Ɛvole boka tendenle ne, ɛzanle menli mɔɔ ɛhyele bɛ la nyɛma zo ɛlile ɛ nzi. ɛliele ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ɛvile menli ɛkɛ, atuadelɛma bɔbɔ hyɛle wɔ bie, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne adɛnla ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Awulae, mɔɔ soa yɛ adesoa ne mɔ dahuu la; Nyamenle le yɛ ngoanelielɛ.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyamenle ne le ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle; na yɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne ati, yɛɛ yɛkola yɛnriandi ewule a.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bagelegele ye kpɔvolɛma ati, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua fɔlɛlilɛ ndenle nu la.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Awulae se, “Me nee bɛ vi Beehyan bazia ara, me nee bɛ vi nyevile kunlu lɔ bazia ara,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: amaa bɛatietia mogya nu, na bɛ ahwea ne mɔ noko anyia bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ avi kpɔvolɛma ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, awie biala ɛnwu wɔ konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔnedolɛ ne; me Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnwɔne ne mɔɔ ɔdole ɔhɔle ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Edwɛndolɛma ne lumua, agolehanlɛma ne li bɛ nzi; mbɛlɛra mɔɔ wozo akɛya la li avinli.

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Bɛngyaman, bɛ nuhua kakula ne a lumua a, Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ɛlɔne, Zɛbulɛn arelemgbunli, Nafetalae arelemgbunli doa zolɛ.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kile wɔ tumi ne; O Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔho wɔmaa yɛ, kile wɔ anwosesebɛ ne.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ati, arelemgbunli soa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Tea nanemgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ vea ndɔ ne mɔ abo, menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ nwo nlankɛ nyinli nee nlankɛ mralɛ la. Tietia menli mɔɔ anye bolo adwulelielɛ la anwo zo; bɔ menli mɔɔ anye die konle nwo la asande.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Maa bɛva kɔbele bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛrɛla; maa Sudanema ɛyɛ ndɛ ɛmaa bɛ sa zo ɛmaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli maanle, bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle; bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Awulae,

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa mɔɔ dua anwomanyunlu la, tete anwomanyunlu; bɛdie, ɔlɛtendɛ, ɔ ne kpole ne dielie.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ Nyamenle kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo, ye belemgbunlililɛ ne keda Yizilayɛma anwo zo, ye tumi ne wɔ anwomanyunlu.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɛvi wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛfinde a ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ; Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔfa tumi nee anwosesebɛ ɔmaa ye menli a. Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, die me! ɔluakɛ azule ɛyi ɛva me.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Memi moto kpole nu; mennyia debie menzɔ nu. Mehɔ azukunlu kpalɛ, yɛɛ azuyilɛ ne se me nwo zo.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Mevɛlɛ dedee me ɛnwomenle ɛwie; me kɔmenzia ɛyɛ resee. Mehendɛ me Nyamenle ne toonwo, akee me nye ɛha adenle zo.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me mgbane gyɛne la zonle tɛla me ti enrinli; menli mɔɔ kpondɛ ahu me la anwo yɛ se, yɛɛ adalɛ ala a bɛbɔ ye me nwo a. Debie mɔɔ meanwua la, ɔwɔ kɛ metua ɔ?

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ ɛze koasea mɔɔ meyɛ la, ɛtane biala mɔɔ meyɛ la la ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ bɛbɔ me aholoba, na nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa a.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ me mediema avinli, ɔmɔ akunlu mralɛ bɔbɔ ɛnze me.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ sɔ kɛ senle wɔ me nu, yɛɛ aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ la amuala gua me nwo zo.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menzunle mengyele ɛhɔne la, menli bɔle me nwolɛ aholoba.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Menvale ɛrele mengedale la, menyɛle ɛfenle memanle bɛ.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Me nwo edwɛkɛ ala yɛɛ bɛgua a bɛka a, yɛɛ nzabovoma fa me to edwɛne.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Na mame, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nzɛlɛlɛ la ɛ nyunlu. O Nyamenle, wɔ mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwu a, dua wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii kpole ne azo bua me.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ nɔhalɛ moalɛ ne die me, mmamaa memi mekɔ moto ne abo; die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu, nee azule buma ne anu.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Mmamaa azuyilɛ ne fa me, anzɛɛ menoma buma ne abo, anzɛɛ ewule kuma keda me nwo zo.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne di munli na bua me, wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ bebelebe ne ati, kakyi ɛ nye nea me.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Mmaye ɛ nye wɔ wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo; ɔluakɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ na ka ɛ nwo bua me.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Twe bikye me, kpɔne me; maa menyia me ti wɔ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛze aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ me la, ɛze me nyiane nee me anyiemgba; ɛze me kpɔvolɛma amuala.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Aholoba ne akee ɛbo me nwo zo, akee meyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ. Memkpondɛle anwunvɔnezelɛ, na meannyia bie; memkpondɛle arɛlekyekyelɛ, na meannyia bie.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me pɔyezen, nzuhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me nzanvinli.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ ɛkponledolɛ ɛhakyi ɛhane; na bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ɛyɛ ɛhane.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ nye ɛzi mɔɔ bɛnnwu debie a; na bɛ gyakɛ ɛbili dahuu kɛ atɛ.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua bɛ nwo zo, na maa wɔ ɛya ne ɛzɔ ɛyela bɛ.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛdɔ mgbane, mmamaa awie tɛnla bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔdea ye la kpɔdekpɔde, na bɛkondɔ mɔɔ wɔboda ye la nganlɛ.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Tea bɛ molozo molozo, mmamaa bɛfa bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Ye bɛ aluma fi teasema buluku ne anu; mmakɛlɛ bɛ aluma ɛboka tenlenema anwo.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Melɛnwu amaneɛ, mete nyane; O Nyamenle, maa me zo na die me.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Mebado edwɛne meaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ; mebava moyɛlɛ meabɔ ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bazɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye adɛla ɛnlankɛ, anzɛɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛwie nyi la.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la ɛnwu ɛhye na bɛ nye ɛlie, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Nyamenle la, bɛzi bɛ ahonle.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma te bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la ane, yɛɛ ɔmkpo ye ɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ngyelelɛ nu la.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Anwuma nee aze ɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle balie Zayɔn, na yeakyekye Dwuda azua ne mɔ fofolɛ; ye sonvolɛma badɛnla ɛkɛ na bɛava azɛlɛ ne;

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: bɛ bo zo amra bava ayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye duma ne la badɛnla ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me! O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la, maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la, maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile!

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛe! Ɛhɛe.” la, anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la, anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ti bɛli fɛlɛko. Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la dahuu ɛha kɛ, “Nyamenle le bedevinli!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Na mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie; O Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo bɛla! Ɛle me boavolɛ nee me dievolɛ; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakyɛ!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me! O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la, maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la, maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile!

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛe! Ɛhɛe.” la, anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la, anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ti bɛli fɛlɛko. Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la dahuu ɛha kɛ, “Nyamenle le bedevinli!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Na mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie; O Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo bɛla! Ɛle me boavolɛ nee me dievolɛ; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakyɛ!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ kunlu yɛɛ menriandi mefea a; mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ!

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Dua wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo boa me na die me; yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me, na die me!

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Yɛ me ɛvealeka bodane, me aranemgbole ɛsesebɛ, na die me. Ɔluakɛ ɛle me bodane nee me aranemgbole.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, die me fi amumuyɛma asa anu, yɛɛ sonla atisesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la asa anu.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ O Awulae, ɛle me anyelazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me mgbavolɛ nu yɛɛ menvale me rɛle menwulale wɔ nu a.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ɔvi me awolɛ nu yɛɛ mengisale wɔ a, wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛyele me ɛvile ɔmɔ akunlu a. Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Meyɛ ndonwo memaa dɔɔnwo, noko wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛle me ɛvealeka ɛsesebɛ a.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ biala, na mebɔ wɔ anyunlunyia ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Mmakpo me wɔ me mrelera nu; saa me anwosesebɛ wie a, mmakpo me.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me kpɔvolɛma keha me nwo edwɛkɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la yia bɔ adwenle,

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: na bɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpo ye; bɛvoa ye bɛhye ye, ɔluakɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ die ye a.”

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Maa menli mɔɔ keha me nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane la anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛhu bɛ; maa nyiane nee anyiemgba ɛbia menli mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ bɛkile me nyane la.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Na mame, me anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu dahuu, yɛɛ mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ kpole kpalɛ dahuu.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ, nee wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala, ɔluakɛ bɛ somaa bo me ndelebɛbo zo.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Mebalua Awulae Nyamenle ne nyɛleɛ mgbole zo meara; mebaye wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne, wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ala ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, ɔvi me mgbavolɛ nu yɛɛ ɛvale me ɛhilehilelɛ a, yɛɛ metɛbɔ wɔ nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ nolo.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa menyi, na me ti zo ɛyɛ nwohyee a, O Nyamenle, mmakpo me, kɔkpula kɛ menwɔbɔ wɔ tumi kpole ne nolo menwɔmaa awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛde bie.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔ tumi nee wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ dwu anwuma lɔ. Wɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole, O Nyamenle, nwane a le kɛ ɛdawɔ a?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ wɔmaa menwu amaneɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ la, ɛbakpogya me zo bieko wɔavi ɛbɛla kuma nu, saa mewɔ azɛlɛ kuma bo bɔbɔ a, ɛbaye me wɔavinde bieko.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Ɛbamaa meanyia me nyunlu molozo, na wɔakyekye me rɛle bieko.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Medame noko mebava getaa kpole meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, O me Nyamenle, wɔ wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati. Mebava getaa ekyi meado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, O Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mebadea nu anyelielɛ nu, mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔha kɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ la; me ɛkɛla mɔɔ ɔdaye noko wɔlie ye la baye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Mebaha wɔ tenlene moalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ dahuu, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la anyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛbɔ anyiemgba.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kilehile belemgbunli ne wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne, na kilehile ɔ ra nrenya ne wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Maa ɔva tenleneyɛlɛ ɔbua ye menli ne ndɛne, na ɔva pɛlepɛle ɔbua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Maa belemgbunli ne ɛlie ehyianvolɛma ati, ɔye mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ɔvi ɛhyianlɛ nu, na ɔbubu mɔɔ di nzisi la dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ menli ne ɛzonle wɔ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ ɔhɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Maa belemgbunli ɛyɛ kɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ doɔloa ndile, ɔyɛ kɛ nyenyensuo, ɔzia azɛlɛ ye.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Maa tenleneyɛlɛ ɛdende ye mekɛ zo, na anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla dahuu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Maa ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛdwu ɛnwea ɛnwea, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa ɔhɔdwu azɛlɛ ye awieleɛ.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Maa ɛsɛlɛ zo amra ɛbu ndwɛlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu, na ye kpɔvolɛma ɛli anwea.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Maa Sepeen nee bɔra ne mɔ arelemgbunli ɛdua adwule ɛmaa ye, na Areleebea nee Yiteɔpea arelemgbunli ɛhyɛ ye ninyɛne.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Maa arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti ɛdu ɛgua ɔ nyunlu, na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛzonle ye.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la fɛlɛ a ɔdie ye zo, ɔdie ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la zo.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ɔnwu mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la anwunvɔne, na ɔdie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ngoane.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Ɔdie bɛ ɔfi nzisi nee konle nu; bɛ mogya sonle bolɛ wɔ ɔ nye zo.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ! Maa bɛva Areleebea ezukoa nvutuke bɛrɛlɛ ye. Maa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne, na bɛzɛlɛ nyilalɛ bɛmaa ye dahuu.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Maa aleɛ ɛbu azɛlɛ ne azo; maa abɛlɛ ɛzi agole wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛvievia mralɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn ɛdeɛ ne la. Maa menli ɛyi azuamgbole ne mɔ azo gbudugbudu, na bɛ nwo ɛzo kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndile.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Ye duma ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, na ye anyunlunyia ɛda kɛ sɛnzɛne. Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛva ye ɛyila bɛ nwo, na maanle maanle ɛzuzu ye boɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne a.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Bɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ dahuu; bɛmaa ye anyunlunyia ɛyi ewiade tɛkɛɛ! Amen. Amen!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Gyɛsi ara Devidi nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ awieleɛ ɛne.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle le kpalɛ maa mɔɔ di boɛ la, ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nye bolole adubɛnwoma, mekɛ mɔɔ menwunle kɛ amumuyɛma ɛkpazi la.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ bɛnde nyane; bɛte kpɔkɛ, bɛ nwonane tutoboo.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ɛngyele bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la; edwɛkɛ ɛndo bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Ɛhyenlɛ ngome ɛmaa bɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ totofoo, mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ ɛyi bɛ ahonle ne mɔ.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Bɛle agolobɛnwo, bɛka ɛtane; bɛtu bɛ nwo na bɛbɔ adwenle kɛ bɛsisi awie mɔ.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Bɛtendɛ bɛtia anwuma, bɛka mgbole wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zo menli tu toa bɛ na bɛyeyɛ bɛ; bɛnnwu ɛtane biala wɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Na bɛka kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Nyamenle anwu ye ɛ? Asoo Anwuma Anwumanli ne lɛ nwolɛ adwenle?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Nea, kɛ amumuyɛma de la ɛne; bɛnyia anwonyia dɔɔnwo, dahuu bɛ nwo tɔ bɛ.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Meyɛ me ahonle nu bɔkɔbɔkɔ mgbane, menrinzi me sa anwo kɛ menze nwolɛ bie mgbane.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ alehyenlɛ muala menwu amaneɛ, nwonlomɔ biala menyia ndeanlɛ.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Saa menganle kɛ, “Mebaha ye zɛhae” a, anrɛɛ meanga nɔhalɛ meangile ɛ mra awolɛndoazo ye.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ mendwenlenle kɛ menwɔzi menwɔde ɛhye abo la, ɔyɛle me nye zo gyima ɛsesebɛ bie,

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ mengɔle Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu; na menwunle bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ɛfa bɛ ɛsie ɛleka teteletetele; ɛmaa bɛtu bɛgua, bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ndɛndɛ ne ala ɛnee bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ, bɛ bo zo ɛminli ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ bie.

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛlafe kɛdunwue la ɛlalɛ, ɔtunwue a ɛmbu ye ɛlalɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ nyane hanle me, mekɛ mɔɔ me ahonle futule la,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: menyɛle koasea anzenwolɛbie, menyɛle kɛ nane la mentiale wɔ.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Noko akee dahuu me nee wɔ a de a; ɛlɛ me sa fema ne anu dahuu.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Ɛfa wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne ɛsinza me, na nzinlii ɛbalie me anyunlunyia nu.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Menlɛ awie wɔ anwuma kɛ ɛdawɔ, yɛɛ memkpondɛ ɛhwee wɔ ewiade kɛ wɔmɔ.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Me nwonane bawie, me ahonle ayɛ bɛtɛɛ, noko Nyamenle le me anwosesebɛ nee me kyɛfoa dahuu.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Na nea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ bɛ avinli twe la baminli; ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnli nɔhalɛ bɛmmaa wɔ la abo zo bɔ.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Na mame, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔbikye Nyamenle; meyɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne me ɛvealeka, amaa meabɔ wɔ gyima ne mɔ nolo.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, duzu ati a wɔpɛ yɛ wɔgua bɔkɔɔ ɛ? Duzu ati a wɔ ɛya kpu esike yelɛyela wɔ adidileka mboane ɛ?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Kakye wɔ menli ne mɔɔ mɔmoane ɛvale bɛ ɛyɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ, na wɔlie bɛ wɔyɛ bɛ wɔ agyadeɛ, abusua ekpunli la. Kakye Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ wɔdɛnla zolɛ ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Kpɔsa ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ la avinli; yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛzɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu debie biala.
