english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛva konimlilɛ ɛdeɛdea nu wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu; bɛdabɛ bɛkpɔnla bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ zo.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Bɛvale akuma bɛbubule anwuma anuhɔlɛ ne anlenkɛ ne.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Bɛvale hamenle nee akuma bɛbubule taboa biala mɔɔ bɛli adwinli bɛgua zo la.

english_verse: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
translation_verse: Bɛdole senle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu; bɛyelale wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne wee.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Yɛtɛnla bɛ kɔme zo kpalɛ kpalɛ;” bɛyelale Nyamenle nyianu ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Yɛnnwu yɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ; Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnze kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛze a.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, kenlenzu yɛɛ kpɔvolɛ ne kɛgyakyi agolobɛnwo ye a? Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ kpɔvolɛ ne sɛkye wɔ duma bɔkɔɔ?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔdo ɛ sa wɔbɛla nu na wɔva ɛ sa fema ne wɔwula ɛ nvɔnlɔma anu ɛ?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Noko ɔvi tete, ɛle Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli mɔɔ die ngoane wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛhyɛle nyevile ne anu, na ɛgelegelele nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne ati azule nye.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Ɛgelegelele Lɛveatan ati, na ɛvale ye nane ɛmanle fienemgbole nu nanemgbole lile.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Ɛmanle nzufeanvea nee azule mralɛ zenzenle, na ɛmanle azudenle sesanle wele resee.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ; ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle sɛnzɛne nee anwumaneamra a.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ a ɛhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ne dwu la a; ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle wawaa nee fɔsɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɛhye, nee kpɔvolɛ ne agolobɛnwo ne, menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sɛkye wɔ duma.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Mmaye wɔ abubule ne ɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole; mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la fee.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Kakye wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ahɔdiawu ɛhɔ nzia wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ahodoka anu awozinli ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Mmamaa mɔɔ bɛsisi ye la anyunlu gua aze; maa ehyianli ne nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, dwazo, na die wɔ duma ne sie aze. Kakye kɛ anzenyamenlema si golo ɛ nwo dahuu la.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, yɛyɛ wɔ mo; yɛyɛ wɔ mo; yɛbɔ wɔ duma na yɛka wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Nyamenle se, “Saa mekɛ ne mɔɔ mehile la dwu a, mebabua ndɛne wɔ ye adenle zo.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Saa azɛlɛ kpusu, maa abɔdeɛ muala kpusu a, medame a mesɔ ye memaa ɔgyinla kpundii a.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Meka mekile adubɛnwonli ne kɛ, ‘Gyakyi adubɛnwo,’ na mese amumuyɛnli ne kɛ, ‘Mmaka mgbole,

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: mmaka mgbole ɛmemaa ɛ nwo zo, anzɛɛ mmatwe ɛ kɔme ɛka mgbole’ ”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ɛnvi aduduleɛ anzɛɛ adɔleɛ, yɛɛ ɔmkpogya ɔ nwo zo ɔnvi ɛsɛlɛ nu ɔmba;

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ala a bua ndɛne a, ɔbɛlɛ bie aze, ɔmaa bie zo.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ kɔpo ɔ sa nu, ɔlɛ nwanye mɔɔ ɛwie be na ɔlɛwu awubue la wɔ nu; ɔbawola ekyi bie yeagua, na azɛlɛ ye azo amumuyɛma banlo ɔ muala.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Na mame, me nye balie dahuu, mebado edwɛne meaye Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ɔbazɛkye amumuyɛma tumi ne na tenlenema tumi ne bayɛ kpole.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛze Nyamenle wɔ Dwuda, ye duma le kpole wɔ Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Bɛkyekye ye tɛnlabelɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, ye sua nu wɔ Zayɔn Boka.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne a ɔbubule kpɔvolɛma ne ɛda ne mɔ, bɛ enyinlike, konle dadeɛ nee konle ninyɛne muala a.

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Wɔ anyunlunyia le kpole, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ le kpole; ɔtɛla awoka mgbole kɔsɔɔti!

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Bɛkpokpole akɛnrasesebɛma bɛliele bɛ sa nu ninyɛne; bɛguale aze bɛwule; ɛlɔnema ne amuala annyia gyinlagyakɛ.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: O Gyekɔbo Nyamenle, ɛdeanle bɛ nu ala la, ɛkpɔnwɔ nee ye kavolɛ ne dule guale.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole! Saa ɛfa ɛya a nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla ɛ nyunlu a?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ anwuma lɔ yɛɛ ɛbuale ndɛne a; azɛlɛ zulole na ɔgyinlanle diinyi,

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazole kɛ ɔbua ndɛne yealie menli mɔɔ bɛsisi bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Sonla ɛyavalɛ wie Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛyavalɛ nee konle ne anzi, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la bali wɔ eni.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛdwu Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, na ye bɛ muala; maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye ye la ɛva bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛrɛlɛ ye, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye a.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɛlɛ arelemgbunli aze a, ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ maa aleɛabo arelemgbunli.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Metea nu kpole mefɛlɛ Nyamenle, metea nu kpole, amaa Nyamenle ade me ne.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Mekpondɛ Awulae wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu; aledwolɛ nu metɛlɛdɛlɛ me sa nu mesɛlɛ, menvɛ fee; me ɛkɛla ɛmkponle kɛ bɛkɛkyekye ɔ rɛle.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Medwenle Nyamenle anwo a, megu ɛnwomenle, medwenledwenle nwo nzɛlɛlɛ nu a, me rɛle bɔ.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛ me nye anzi nwoma ne anu, ɛmmaa menlafe; me rɛle ɛbɔ kpole, mengola tendɛ.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Medwenle mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la anwo, mekakye ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Mendole edwɛne nɔɔzo wɔ me ahonle nu; medwenledwenle nwo meneɛnlea me ahonle nu kɛ:

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Asoo Awulae bakpo me dahuu, mɔɔ ɔnrɛnwu me anwunvɔne ɛlɛ a?

english_verse: Is this the end of your love and your promises?
translation_verse: Asoo ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkpa nwo bɔkɔɔ? Asoo ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛwie bɔkɔɔ?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Asoo Nyamenle arɛle ɛvi kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ahunlunyele? Asoo yeva ɛya yeminli ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Na mese, “Medame me nyane mɔɔ medi la yɛɛ ɛmaa Anwuma Anwumanli ne tumi ɛhakyi a.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Mebahakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la amuala; ɛhɛe, mebahakye wɔ mɔmoane nwanwane gyima ne.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Mebadwenledwenle wɔ gyima ne amuala anwo, na meadwenle wɔ gyima mgbole ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔ adenle le nwuanzanwuanza; nyamenle boni a le kpole kɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne a?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, mɔɔ wɔhile wɔ tumi ne wɔ menli avinli a.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛliele wɔ menli, Gyekɔbo nee Dwosefi abo zo amra.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la, mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la, bɛzulole; ɛhɛe, buma fonyianle.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Nzulemungu dɔle ezule bilididi, anwomanyunlu hulule; wɔ ɛda ne mɔ vedele ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhululɛ ne liele ahumuakyima ne anu, wɔ ɛsɛnlɛmanye ne mɔ kpakyele dale ewiade amuala; azɛlɛ kpusule dikyidikyi.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Wɔ adenle la nyevile ne anu, ɛ gyakɛ abo adenle la buma mgbole ne mɔ anu, noko awie anwu ɛ gyakɛ abo zo.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Ɛhanle wɔ menli ne kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu, Mosisi nee Aalɔn a nleanle bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: O me menli, bɛdie me ngilehilelɛ; bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ!

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Mebabuke me nloa meava mrɛlɛbulɛ meaha bɛ mɔmoane awozinli nu edwɛkɛ,

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: edwɛkɛ mɔɔ yɛde na yɛze, yɛ nlenya mɔ a ɛha ɛhile yɛ a.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛnrɛva yɛnrɛvea bɛ nlɔnra, yɛbaha yɛahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la. Ɛdɛnkɛma lile gyima mgbole, ɔlɛ tumi, yɛɛ ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye ngyehyɛlɛ ɔmanle Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, na ɔlile mɛla ɔmanle Yizilayɛma, ɔzele yɛ nlenya mɔ kɛ bɛhilehile bɛ mra;

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: amaa awolɛndoazo bieko anu amra nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la anwu ye, na bɛdabɛ bɛaha bɛahile bɛ mra;

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: amaa bɛanyia Nyamenle nu anyelazo, amaa bɛ rɛle anvi Nyamenle gyima ne mɔ, na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo;

english_verse: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
translation_verse: amaa bɛanyɛ kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ, bɛanyɛ awolɛndoazo atuadelɛma nee anzosesebɛ; awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛnnea ɛleka ko, mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ɛmmaa Nyamenle la.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Yifelaemma vale ɛda, noko konle kenle ne, bɛguale ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Bɛanli Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne azo, na bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛlua ye mɛla adenle ne anu.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Bɛ rɛle vile mɔɔ yeyɛ, nee nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ yeyɛ yehile bɛ la.

english_verse: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne ɔhilele bɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu, wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ɔkpakyele nyevile ne anu nwiɔ ɔmanle bɛzenle, ɔmanle azule ne dwazole bolonwonwo yɛle kɛ bane.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nu ɔyɛle amungu ɔlile bɛ nyunlu, aledwolɛ nu ɔyɛle senle guaanye.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Ɔkpukele bodane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu na ɔmanle bɛ nzule dɔɔnwo kɛ buma nu nzule la bɛnlonle.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle azudenle vi bodane nu zenzenle, na ɔmanle nzule ne zenle kɛ azule.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Noko bɛyɛle ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛtiale ye, bɛdele Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo atua wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Bɛ ahonle nu, bɛzɔle Nyamenle bɛnleanle, na bɛbizale aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Bɛdendɛle bɛtiale Nyamenle bɛhanle kɛ, “Asoo Nyamenle kɛhola kɛmaa yɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ye azo?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle bolɛ ne ɔmanle nzule vi nu vindele, na azudenle yile bule aze. Asoo eza ɔkɛhola ɔkɛmaa yɛ aleɛ, anzɛɛ ɔkɛmaa ye menli ne nane bɛkɛli?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dele la, ɔvale ɛya kpole, ye ɛya ne zɔle kɛ senle tiale Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne, ye ɛya ne yɛle kpole wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo;

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu, yɛɛ bɛanva bɛ rɛle bɛanwula ye ngoanelielɛ tumi ne anu.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele anwomanyunlu, na ɔbukele anwuma nlenkɛ ne mɔ;

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: ɔmanle mana dɔle kɛ ezule ɔmanle bɛ; na ɔmanle bɛ anwuma aleɛ bɛlile.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Menli lile anwuma soanvolɛma aleɛ; ɔmanle aleɛ bule bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ɔmanle aduduleɛ anwoma bɔle anwuma lɔ, na ɔvale ye tumi ne ɔhwenle nyiakɛ anwoma ne ɔhɔle.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle nane bule bɛ nwo zo kɛ munlutu, nloma yɛle dɔɔnwo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛtetele bɛguale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛde la yɛle totɔɔ.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Bɛlile na bɛ ko yile, ɔboalekɛ ɔmanle bɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la.

english_verse: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne kaye, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛwiele aleɛ ne di la,

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyamenle vale bɛ nwo ɛya, na ɔhunle bɛ nuhua mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ la, na ɔmanle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema anwo hanle aze.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, bɛhɔle zo bɛyɛle ɛtane; ye nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anzi, bɛanlie bɛanli.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛ mekɛ zenle waa kɛ ɛnwomenle, na ɔpɛle bɛ ngoane sinli ɛzulolɛ nu.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle bɛ la, bɛkpondɛle ɔ bo zo; bɛnlunle bɛ nwo na bɛkpondɛle Nyamenle ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Bɛhakyele kɛ Nyamenle le bɛ bodane, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne le bɛ dievolɛ.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Noko bɛvale bɛ nloa bɛbɔle awuye ala; bɛbɔle adalɛ, bɛ nee ye lile amanie.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: Bɛanva bɛ ahonle bɛammaa ye; bɛanli nɔhalɛ wɔ ye ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Noko yemɔ, kɛmɔ ɔse anwunvɔne la ati, ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ɔhyɛle bɛ, yɛanzɛkye bɛ; mekɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmenle ye ɛya ne, yeanva ye ɛya ne amuala yeangua bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Ɔhakyele kɛ bɛle nwonane ala, bɛle kɛ anwoma mɔɔ se na ɔnzia ko la.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Bɛdele ɔ nwo atua dɔɔnwo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, bɛmanle ɔlile nyane wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle fane dɔɔnwo, na bɛhanle Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛya.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛanva ye tumi ne anzɛɛ kenle ne mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile bɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu la bɛangɔ adwenle nu bɔbɔ,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: na yeayɛ ye nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Yigyibiti, anzɛɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu la.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ɔhakyile bɛ azule ne mɔ mogya, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛngola nuhua nzule no a.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔyele nrɛzenra adɔka ɔmanle bɛgyegyele bɛ, ahɛlɛne ɔmanle bɛzɛkyele bɛ azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle nyangomango lile bɛ ɛbɔ nu aleɛ, ɔmanle abɛbɛ lile bɛ egyinli nu aleɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ezuawolɛ ɔzɛkyele bɛ vanye egyinli, na ɔvale nzulemungu ɔzɛkyele bɛ sekamɔ mbaka.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔle ezuawolɛ ɔhunle bɛ nlankɛ, yɛɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye pepenle bɛ mboane nwo zo hunle bɛ.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ɔgyakyile ye ɛya ne anu ɔguale bɛ nwo zo, ɔvale ɛya, abodelɛ, yɛɛ nyane ɔ rale bɛ nwo zo kɛ anwuma soanvolɛma la ɔrazɛkyele bɛ.

english_verse: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
translation_verse: Ɔkpakyele adenle ɔmanle ye ɛya ne; yeanlie biala yeanvi ewule nu, na ɔmanle ewule nzane hunle bɛ muala.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ mrenya kɔsɔɔti, Ham awuke biala anu nyianle ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Akee ɔhanle ye menli ne kɛ mboane na ɔlile bɛ nyunlu, na ɔwowale bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle bɛ nwo bane, yemɔti bɛanzulo; na nyevile ne bule vale bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bɛ ɔrale ye azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, awoka ne mɔ mɔɔ yeva ye tumi yelie la anu.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Ɔvoanle maanle maanle ɔvile bɛ nye zo; ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ, na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle bɛ azua ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Noko bɛzɔle Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne bɛnleanle, na bɛdele ɔ nwo atua; bɛanli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: Bɛkpole ye na bɛyɛle ngunzi kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ; bɛhyibale bɛ nwo kɛ ɛdabaka kyealera.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la bɛhanle ye ɛya; bɛvale bɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛguale la bɛfutule ye ahonle.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nwunle ye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole, na ɔkpole Yizilayɛma bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔkpole ye tɛnlabelɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Hyaelo, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle ye menli ne avinli la.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛhyele ye tumi ne nuokɛ, ɔyele ye anyunlunyia ɔwulale kpɔvolɛma ne asa anu.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle bɛhunle ye menli ne, na ɔkpule ye ɛya ne ɔguale bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ hale esike nu, yɛɛ bɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ annyia agyalɛ angɔ.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma dɔle dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛ ahunlanvolɛ angola awolɛ ye.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Akee Awulae dwazole kɛ asɛɛ ɔvi nafelɛ nu, na ɔlɛtea kɛ katakyie mɔɔ nza wɔ ɔ nye zo la.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle ye kpɔvolɛma guale ɛbɔ nu, na ɔguale bɛ nyunlu aze kpɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ɔkpole Dwosefi awuke nu amra, yeanva Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne;

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: ɔnleanle nu ɔyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne, Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ ɔkulo ye somaa la.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Ɔzile ye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne kɛ ye sua nu mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la; ɔzile ye kpundii kɛ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ yebɔ, na ɔla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ɔnleanle nu ɔyele ye sonvolɛ Devidi, ɔyele ye ɔvile mboane zo ɛnleanlɛ,

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: ɔmanle ɔgyakyile mboane mralɛ ɛnleanlɛ, na ɔ nee ye rale kɛ ɔranlea ye menli Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le ye agyadeɛ la.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ahonle kpalɛ ɔnleanle bɛ, na ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ kpole ɔzinzale bɛ.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la ɛrawolo wɔ agyadeɛ ye anu, bɛgua wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli; bɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔkɔbɔkɔ.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Bɛva wɔ sonvolɛma ne mɔ avunli bɛmaa anwomanyunlu nloma kɛ bɛli, bɛva wɔ menli ne nwonane bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Bɛhwi bɛ mogya bɛgua kɛ nzule, bɛkponde ye Gyɛlusalɛm amuala, yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ na yeazie bɛ.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la bɔ yɛ aholoba, bɛsi yɛ amgbu na bɛsele yɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenlenzu? Asoo ɛfa ɛya mɔɔ ɛnrɛgyakyi ɛlɛ? Asoo ɛmaa wɔ ɛya kpole ne azɔ kɛ senle?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ, nee arelemgbunli maanle mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la anwo zo.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛhu Yizilayɛma amuala, na bɛmaa bɛ tɛnlabelɛ ɛdɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Mmatea yɛ wɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati; maa wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo ndɛndɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ anyelazo ɛwie.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, boa yɛ, wɔ wɔ duma ne anyunlunyia ti; fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ na die yɛ, wɔ wɔ duma ne ati.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Duzu ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ maanle maanle ka kɛ, “Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” a. Maa wɔ sonvolɛma mɔɔ bɛha bɛ mogya bɛgua la anwo nzenralɛ ɛrɛla maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo wɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nye zo.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu; fa wɔ tumi kpole ne die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkahu bɛ la.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: O Awulae, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ aholoba la, kile bɛdabɛ abodelɛ mɔnwo fane nsuu.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Na wɔ menli, wɔ adidileka mboane, yɛbayɛ wɔ mo dahuu; ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo, yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma anwo zo neavolɛ, tie yɛ, wɔmɔ, ɛhanle Dwosefi abo zo amra kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu. Wɔmɔ mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ebia gyi tease abɔdeɛma azo a, ta bɛla,

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: maa Yifelaem, Bɛngyaman, yɛɛ Manasɛ ɛnwu ye. Kile wɔ tumi ne, na balie yɛ!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne; kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo, amaa yɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, ɛfa wɔ menli ne nzɛlɛlɛ nwo ɛya wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa bɛ nyane kɛ bɛli kɛ aleɛ, wɔmaa bɛ monle kɛ nzule kɛ bɛnlo bɛmaa ɔde bɛ.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la zo konle doa yɛ, yɛɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛma yia nu a bɛsele yɛ.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne; kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo, amaa yɛanyia ngoane

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Ɛvale vanye baka ɛvile Yigyibiti ɛrale; ɛvoanle maanle maanle ne mɔ na ɛluale.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Ɛzieziele azɛlɛ ne ɛmanle ye; ɔzɔle ndinli ɔhɔle aze kpalɛ na ɔvale azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ye alubo hedale awoka ne mɔ azo, ɔvale ye ngane ɔguale sida mbaka mgbole zo;

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: ye ngane dwule Mɛdetɛlenia nyevile nu, ɔdendenle ɔdwule Azule Yufileti ne anloa.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a akee wɔbubu ye bane ne mɔ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa adenle ne azo la tete ye ma ɛ?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Kɔkɔte vi kpɔkɛ nu batietia zo, yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu debie biala di bie.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, kakyi ɛ nye bieko! Wɔ anwuma nehane, to ɛ nye nea, na bu vanye baka ɛhye bie,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: baka ne mɔɔ ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛluale, ɛnleanle ɛmanle ɔyɛle kpole ɔmanle wɔ la.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛ ye bɛdo aze, bɛva senle bɛdo nu; twi bɛ nyunlu na bɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ sa to sonla ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ fema zo la anwo zo, sonla ra ne mɔɔ wɔwula ye anwosesebɛ wɔmaa ɛ nwo la!

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Yɛnrɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛnrɛzi wɔ bieko; maa yɛ ngoane, na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne, kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo, amaa yɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Bɛdea nu bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle yɛ anwosesebɛ ne; bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea nu bɛmaa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Bɛvɛlɛ edwɛne ne, bɛbɔ akɛya ne, bɛbɔ getaa ngyikyi ne nee mgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Siane ne fi fofolɛ a bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu, siane ne yɛ mumua a bɛwu nu bɛli ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔle mɛla ɔmaa Yizilayɛma, ɔle Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne mɛla.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Ɔluale Dwosefi abo zo amra anwo zo ɔyɛle ye mɛla, mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtetale Yigyibitima la. Mete ɛnelɛ bie mɔɔ metɛtele ye ɛlɛ a; ɔse,

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Menyele bɛ kɔme zo adesoa; menliele bɛ ahɛndɛne menvile bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Bɛvɛlɛle me wɔ bɛ anwongyelelɛ nu, na menliele bɛ; mewɔ me feabelɛ wɔ ahumu ne anu la, menliele bɛ zo; menzɔle bɛ meneanle wɔ Mɛleba nzubula ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Bɛdie, O me menli, mebɔ bɛ kɔkɔ, O Yizilayɛ, saa bɛkɛdie me angome ɛdeɛ a!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛnyia nyamenle gyɛne biala bɛ avinli; bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne biala.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la. Bɛbuke bɛ nloa kpalɛ, na menwɔmaa bɛ aleɛ.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Na me menli ne andie me ne; Yizilayɛma ɛnva me ɛnyɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mengyakyile bɛ memanle bɛdabɛ bɛ anzosesebɛ ne, kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ me menli ne adie me, anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma alua me adenle ne anu!

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meali bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim, na meava me sa meazie menli mɔɔ kyi bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Ɛdɛnkɛma la baradane ye, bɛ ndeanlɛ bo ɛnrɛdu ɛlɛ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Mebava hwiiti kpalɛ meadane bɛ, na meamaa bɛ bodane nu wolɛ bɛanlo.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛdɛnla ye ebia nu wɔ ayia nwuanzanwuanza ne anu; saa awozonle ne mɔ yia nu a ɔbua bɛ ndɛne kɛ,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Kenlenzu a bɛkɛgyakyi mgbɔvodɛne ɛbualɛ, na bɛkɛgyakyi kɛ bɛdi bɛaboa amumuyɛma a?

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Bɛli pɛlepɛle bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la, na bɛli bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Die mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la; die bɛ fi amumuyɛma asa anu.”

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlɛ adwenle yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo, bɛluolua awozinli nu; azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ ɛkpusu.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Mese, ‘Bɛle nyamenle, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle Anwuma Anwumanli ne amra;’

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: noko bɛbawu kɛ menli wu la, na bɛakpo aze kɛ belemgbunli biala la.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Dwazo, O Nyamenle, bua ewiade ndɛne; ɔluakɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti le wɔ ɛdeɛ!

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu; O Nyamenle, mmayɛ kɛnlanana!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nea, wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛlɛtu fonyia; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi wɔ la ɛmaa bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ wɔ menli ne ati akpamo, bɛtu bɛ nwo azukue wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane la ati.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Bɛse, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ bɛ maanle ne bɔkɔɔ; amaa bɛangakye duma Yizilayɛ ne bieko ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu bɛfa adwenle ko, bɛkyekye bɛkye ɔ bo bɛtia wɔ:

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Yidɔmma nee Yehyemeeyɛlema, Mowabema nee Hagelaema,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gibalema, Amɔnoma, nee Amalɛkema, Filisitiama yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Taya la.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Aseleama noko boka bɛ nwo; bɛmɛ a bɛle Lɔɔto abo zo amra mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ a.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Yɛ bɛ kɛ ɛyɛle Medeanema la, kɛ ɛyɛle Sesɛla nee Gyeeben wɔ Azule Kaehyɔn anloa,

english_verse: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
translation_verse: mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛ wɔ Ɛndɔ, na bɛ avunli kpɔlɔle azɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Yɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi la; na yɛ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ziba nee Zalemɛna,

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Nyamenle adidileka ne yɛhɔva ye azɛlɛ ne bie yɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ” la.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: O me Nyamenle, maa bɛyɛ kɛ munlutu mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ nu la, bɛyɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ luolua anwoma nu la.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa anyiemgba ɛha bɛ, amaa bɛakpondɛ ɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ dahuu; maa bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ anyiemgba nu.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Maa bɛnwu kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ ngomekye, mɔɔ wɔ duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma la a ɛle Anwuma Anwumanli ne mɔɔ sie azɛlɛ ye a.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Wɔ tɛnlabelɛ ne le kɛnlɛma!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ mewɔ ɛkɛ, me nwo dɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Me ahonle nee me nwonane to edwɛne anyelielɛ nu maa tease Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Ngɛsanloma bɔbɔ lɛ ye sane, yɛɛ nyamenleakatiba lɛ ɔ ti anwo sane mɔɔ ɔfa ɔ mra ɔgua nu, wɔ wɔ azukponle ne anwo, O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Belemgbunli nee me Nyamenle.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde wɔ sua nu la, bɛto wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne dahuu.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala bɛkɔ Zayɔn kɛ bɛkazɛlɛ la.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Bɛlua Beeka Bɔnza ne anu a, bɛmaa ɛkɛ ne yɛ nzubula dɔɔnwo; alumua ezule ne maa nzule gyinlegyinla.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Bɛnyia anwosesebɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛhɔlɛ nu; bɛbanwu nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ Zayɔn.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; O Gyekɔbo Nyamenle, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, nea yɛ enyinlike ne; nea sonla ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne kenle ko ɛdɛnlanlɛ le kpalɛ tɛla kenle apenle wɔ ɛleka gyɛne. Menwɔhulo kɛ menwɔyɛ anlenkɛ sinzavolɛ wɔ me Nyamenle ne sua nu tɛla kɛ menwɔdɛnla amumuyɛma ndanlɛ sua nu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le sɛnzɛne nee enyinlike, ɔdaye a ɔmaa ɛlolɛ nee enililɛ a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnva debie kpalɛ biala ɛnvea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlenema la.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ arɛle wɔ wɔ nu la.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnwunle wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwunvɔne; ɛmanle Yizilayɛma kpazile bieko.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ menli ne ɛtane ɛhyɛle bɛ, na ɛmanle bɛnyianle bɛ ti bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Ɛmenle wɔ ɛya ne amuala; ɛgyakyile ɛya biala mɔɔ ɛvale la.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne, na maa ɛ kunlu ɛdwo yɛ nwo.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛfa yɛ nwo ɛya dahuu? Asoo wɔ ɛya ne bawa aha awolɛndoazo muala?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Maa yɛ nwo ɛyɛ se bieko, amaa ɛdawɔ ti wɔ menli ne ali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Maa mendie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne baha la, ɔluakɛ ɔbaha anzonudwolɛ edwɛkɛ yeahile ye menli ne, ɔdaye ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛva bɛ ahonle ɛmaa ye la.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ye ngoanelielɛ ne ɛbikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la, amaa anyunlunyia aha yɛ maanle ye.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ bayia; tenleneyɛlɛ nee anzonudwolɛ bayɛ bɛ nwo atuu.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛlilɛ vi aze bafifi, na tenleneyɛlɛ vi anwuma anlea aze.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava mɔɔ le kpalɛ la amaa, na yɛ azɛlɛ ye bamaa yɛ aleɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Tenleneyɛlɛ bali Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, na yeaziezie adenle ne yeamaa ye.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me, na die me zo, ɔluakɛ meyɛ anwunvɔne yɛɛ mehyia.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Die me fi ewule nu, ɔluakɛ mesonle wɔ; die wɔ sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛva ɔ rɛle ɛwula wɔ nu la.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a, O Awulae, nwu me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ alehyenlɛ muala a.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli fɛlɛko, ɔluakɛ, O Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ mebodo mesɛlɛ wɔ a.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, O Awulae, ɛle kpalɛ yɛɛ fakyɛ wɔ wɔ afoa, ɛkile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ wɔ la anwo zo.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; tie me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: Kenle biala mekɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ, ɔboalekɛ mefɛlɛ wɔ a ɛdie me zo.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: O Awulae, nyamenle biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ, yɛɛ gyima biala ɛndɛla wɔ gyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ la babɔ bɛ ti aze amaa wɔ, O Awulae, na bɛaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛle kpole yɛɛ ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ ɛle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ adenle ne, amaa mealua wɔ nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu; fa me ahonle beta ɛ nwo maa ɔzulo wɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: O Awulae me Nyamenle, mefa me ahonle muala meyɛ wɔ mo, yɛɛ mebaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye me nwo la le kpole; wɔye me ɛkɛla wɔvi Ɛbolɔ

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, adubɛnwoma ɛdwazo me nwo zo; menli amgbamgbanvolɛ kpondɛ ahu me, bɛndwenle ɛ nwo bɔbɔ.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Awulae, ɛle ɛlolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛ Nyamenle, ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Kakyi ɛ nye me nwo zo na nwu me anwunvɔne; fa wɔ anwosesebɛ ne maa wɔ akɛlɛ, na die wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ne ara nrenya ye.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Kile me wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ, amaa menli mɔɔ kyi me la anwu ye na bɛ nyunlu agua aze, ɔboalekɛ wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔboa me na wɔkyekye me rɛle.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Suakpole ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyekyele la wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo;

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo Zayɔn nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ tɛla ɛleka biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle suakpole, bɛka ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ngɛnlɛma ngɛnlɛma.

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Saa meka maanle maanle mɔɔ ze me la a, meye Yigyibiti nee Babelonia; nea, Filisitia, Taya, yɛɛ Sudan boka nwo; bɛse, “Ko ɛhye, bɛwole ye ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Wɔ Zayɔn anwo, bɛbaha ye kɛ, “Ko ɛhye nee ɛhendeɛ ne, bɛwole bɛ ɛkɛ;” ɔluakɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne ɔdaye ɔbamaa yeagyinla.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛlɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anluma a ɔkɛlɛ kɛ, “Ko ɛhye, bɛwole ye ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Edwɛndolɛma nee agolezilɛma amuala se, “Me nyilalɛ kɔsɔɔti vi wɔ ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, alehyenlɛ nu mefɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me; aledwolɛ nu noko mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Maa me nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo ɛdo me, me ngoane ɛbikye Ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Bɛtia me bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi Ewule Kuma nu la; mele sonla mɔɔ menlɛ anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Mele kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛwu na bɛ rɛle ɛvi ye, mele kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛhu ye bɛzie ye, mele kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛngakye bɛ bieko, na bɛye bɛ bɛvi wɔ tumi bo la.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Wɔva me wɔdo Ewule Kuma ne abo lɔ, ɛleka anu kuloonwu anu awozinli ne anu.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Wɔmaa me gɔnwo mɔ ɛkpo me; wɔmaa me nwo ɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ. Meha avinli, mengola menvi ɛsalɛ;

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: nyane ngome ɛbɔ me nye. O Ɛdɛnkɛma, alehyenlɛ biala mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; na memaa me sa zo mesɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne ɛmaa mɔwuamra? Asoo bɛ nwomenle dwazo ye wɔ ayɛlɛ?

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Asoo bɛka wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ ɛbolɔ, anzɛɛ bɛka wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ Abadɔn?

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Asoo bɛnwu wɔ nwanwane ninyɛne ne mɔ awozinli nu, anzɛɛ bɛka wɔ ngoanelielɛ moalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ la maanle nu?

english_verse: Each morning I pray to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Na mame, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; me nzɛlɛlɛ dwu ɛ nyunlu nwonlomɔ biala.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu ati yɛɛ wɔkpo me a? Duzu ati a wɔva ɛ nye wɔvea me a?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ɔvi me ngakula nu, menwu amaneɛ toonwo asɛɛ mewu bɔbɔ, wɔ ndeanlɛ ne mɔ ɛmaa mewie debie yɛ.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛya ne ɛbo me nwo zo; wɔ ɛtetalɛ ɛzulolɛ ne bo me nwo zo.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ biala bɛbɔ bɛyia me kɛ azuyilɛ; bɛbɔ nu bɛba me nwo zo.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa kulovolɛ nee agɔnwolɛ ɛkpo me; me manivolɛ ala a le awozinli.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebado wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛne dahuu; mebabɔ wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne nolo meahile awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne gyi kpundii kɛ anwumaneamra.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ wɔha kɛ, “Me nee me sonla ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye ye la ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, mebɔ me sonvolɛ Devidi ɛwɔkɛ kɛ,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa anwumaneamra ɛye wɔ nwanwaneyɛlɛ ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ayɛlɛ wɔ nwuanzanwuanzama avinli.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ nwuanzanwuanzama ayia ne sulo ye a; ɔle kpole, ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ tɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛyia ye la.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwane a le tumivolɛ kɛ ɛdawɔ, mɔɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ a?

english_verse: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛ tumi wɔ nyevile nwo zo; saa ye azɛlɛkye yɛ begyebegye a ɛmaa bɛgua.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛbubule nane anwo ɛzulolɛ Releehabe, kɛ debie funli bie, ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛbɔle wɔ kpɔvolɛma asande.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Anwuma le wɔ ɛdeɛ, azɛlɛ ye noko le wɔ ɛdeɛ; ewiade nee nuhua ninyɛne muala, ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle a.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛbɔle sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ a; Teebɔ Boka nee Hɛmɔn Boka fa anyelielɛ ye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ le wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne adiabo; ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee nɔhalɛlilɛ a gyi ɛ nyunlu a.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa edwɛndolɛ bɛtea nu bɛfɛlɛ wɔ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua wɔ ahunlunyele wienyi ne anu la.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa wɔ duma ne bɛtu bɛ nwo, na bɛyeyɛ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne la.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle bɛ anwosesebɛ a; wɔ moalɛ zo yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛdi konim a.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ a ɛyele yɛ pepɛdievolɛ ne ɛmanle yɛ a. Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a manle yɛ yɛ belemgbunli ne a. Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle Devidi

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Mɔmoane, ɛdendɛle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu ɛhilele wɔ nɔhalɛ sonvolɛ ne na ɛhanle kɛ, “Mezoa sonla mɔɔ le katakyie la belemgbunli kyɛlɛ, memaa sonla mɔɔ bɛkpa nu bɛye ye menli ne avinli la ɛyɛ kpole.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Menwu me sonvolɛ Devidi; meva me nwole nwuanzanwuanza ne mekpokpa ye;

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: amaa me tumi ne awoa ye nu dahuu, na yeamaa ye anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ ne ɛnrɛhola ɔ nye zo ta ɛlɛ, amumuyɛnli ɛnrɛhola ɔ nwo zo konim di.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Mebabubu ye kpɔvolɛma wɔ ɔ nyunlu, na meabɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi ye la meagua.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Me nɔhalɛlilɛ ne nee me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee ye badɛnla, na me duma nu yɛɛ ye tumi ne bayɛ kpole a.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Mebamaa yeanyia nyevile nwo zo tumi, na yeanyia azule muala anwo zo tumi.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ɔbazu yeavɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Wɔmɔ a ɛle me Ze a; ɛle me Nyamenle nee me ngoanelielɛ Bodane.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Na mebayɛ ye me ra mɔɔ lumua, mɔɔ le belemgbunli mɔɔ bo arelemgbunli muala anwo azo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Mebahile me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔ nwo zo dahuu, yɛɛ me ngyekyeleɛ ne bagyinla ɛkɛ ne kpundii amaa ye.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne adɛnla ɛkɛ dahuu, na ye belemgbunlililɛ adɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu kɛ anwumaneamra

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: “Na saa ɔ bo zo amra kpo me mɛla ne na bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: saa bɛtietia me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo a,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: mebava baka meadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ bɛ mɛladonlɛ ti, na meava empele meabila bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ti.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Noko menrɛye me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɔ nwo zo, yɛɛ mebali nɔhalɛ meamaa ye dahuu.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Menrɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne, yɛɛ menrɛhakyi edwɛkɛ mɔɔ vi me nloa anu vindele la.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Ɔ bo zo amra bali belemgbunli dahuu, ye belemgbunlililɛ bagyinla zo kɛ sɛnzɛne wɔ me nyunlu.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Noko wɔva wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la anwo ɛya, wɔkpo ye na wɔvuandi ye wɔdo.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Wɔtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ kyekyele la; wɔdu ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne wɔdo ndɛtɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Wɔbubu ɔ nwo bane kɔsɔɔti wɔgua; wɔgologolo ye aranemgbole ne mɔ wɔgua.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse ɛkɛ ne la amuala wua ye; ye agɔnwolɛma muala sele ye.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma ɛli konim; wɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma anye ɛlie.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, wɔmaa ye konle dadeɛ ɛtili, wɔammaa yeangola konle ne anloa gyinla.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Wɔlie ye belemgbunli tumi ne ɔ sa nu, wɔvuandi ye belemgbunli ebia ne wɔdo aze.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Wɔpɛ ye kpavolɛlilɛ zo; wɔgua ɔ nyunlu aze. Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kenlenzu? Asoo ɛfa ɛ nye wɔavea yɛ dahuu? Wɔ ɛya ne sɔ kɛ senle la ahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: O Awulae, kakye kɛ ngoane tendenle si de la, ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ la kɔsɔɔti bawu.

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Sonla boni a badɛnla aze dahuu na ɔnrɛwu ɛlɛ a? Nwane a kɛhola kɛlie ye ɛkɛla kɛvi Ɛbolɔ a?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Awulae, wɔ mɔmoane ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne, mɔɔ ɛluale zo ɛbɔle Devidi nɔhalɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la wɔ nienwu?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: O Awulae, kakye kɛ bɛsi bɛbu wɔ sonvolɛ ne sonlamgbane la; wɔ menli ne anwo ndeanlɛ kɔsɔɔti gua me nwo zo.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ala ati, wɔ kpɔvolɛma sele, bɛgolo wɔ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la anwo wɔ ɔ gyakɛ biala mɔɔ ɔtu la anwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu! Amen, Amen!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Nyamenle nee sonla

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ a wɔyɛ yɛ ɛvealeka wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu a.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkabɔ awoka, anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye nee ewiade ye la, ɔvi tete, mɔɔ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɛle Nyamenle.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Ɛmaa sonla sia kɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu, na ɛse ye kɛ, “O sonla ra, sia ɛ nzi!”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛvolɛ apenle ko le ɛ nye zo kɛ anoma ala mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ, anzɛɛ nɔɔzo dɔnehwele bie mɔɔ ɛze la.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Ɛkpoa menli ɛgua; bɛle kɛ ɛlalɛ, bɛle kɛ mangyee ndile,

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: nwonlomɔ ɛnee bɛyɛ dudokoo, bɛ nwo yɛ fɛ; nɔsolɛ ɛnee bɛkpa, bɛnwoso.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Ɛfa ɛya a ɛnee ahonle ɛdu; wɔ ahonle futu a ɛnee yɛwie wu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala gua ɛ nyunlu, yɛ fealera nu ɛtane bɔbɔ ɛ nye gyi nwolɛ.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Ɛfa ɛya a yɛ ngoane pɛ sinli, yɛ mekɛ se kɛ ɛnwomenlegulɛ ko.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Yɛ ngoane mekɛ le ɛvolɛ abulasuu, saa anwosesebɛ wɔ nu a, abulatwɛ; noko nuhua le ɛvɛlɛ nee nyane ngome; ɔngyɛ ɛnee bɛpɛ nu, ɛnee yɛminli.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛnwu wɔ ɛya ne kpole, anzɛɛ wɔ ahonle futu a ɔnrɛzulo wɔ a?

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kilehile yɛ maa yɛnwu yɛ mekɛ, amaa yɛazukoa nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sia bɛla! Kenlenzu? Nwu wɔ sonvolɛ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi yɛ nwonlomɔ biala, amaa yɛ nye alie na yɛali fɛlɛko yɛ ngoane mekɛ nu.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Maa yɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ mekɛ ne ɛwa kɛ yɛ nyanelilɛ mekɛ ne, nee ɛvolɛ dodo mɔɔ yɛnwu amaneɛ la.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ sonvolɛ ɛnwu wɔ gyima ne, na ye wɔ tumi kpole ne kile bɛ mra.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Maa yɛ Awulae yɛ Nyamenle ne anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo, na maa yɛ sa anloa gyima ɛyɛ kpalɛ ɛmaa yɛ, ɛhɛe, maa yɛ sa anloa gyima ɛyɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ vea Anwuma Anwumanli ne anu, na ɔde Tumivolɛ ne tumi ne abo la,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: kola ka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me ɛvealeka nee me aranemgbole; ɛle me Nyamenle mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔbaye wɔ yeavi munzuvolɛ ne ɛhane ne nee ewule nyane kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔbava ɔ ndɛba yeaheda ɛ nwo zo, ɔ ndɛba abo yɛɛ ɛbavea a; ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne le enyinlike nee nwowa.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Ɛnrɛzulo nɔɔzo anu ɛzulolɛ ne, anzɛɛ alehyenlɛ nu ɛda ne.

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: Ɛnrɛzulo nɔɔzo ewule nyane biala, anzɛɛ ewia henlema munzule biala.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Apenle baho adɔ wɔ foa ko, apenle bulu baho adɔ wɔ fema zo, noko ɔnrɛbikye wɔ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɛ nye ala yɛɛ ɛbava wɔanlea bɛ a, na wɔanwu kɛ bɛsi bɛtea amumuyɛma la.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔva Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔyɛ wɔ ɛvealeka, na ɛde Anwuma Anwumanli ne nu la,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: munzule ɛnrɛdo wɔ ɛlɛ, senle ɛnrɛdɔ wɔ sua nu.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔbamaa ye soanvolɛma anlea ɛ nwo zo, azinza wɔ wɔ ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Bɛbalɛ wɔ bɛ sa zo, amaa ɛ gyakɛ amkpula bolɛ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Ɛbatietia awenade nee bɔna nwo zo, ɛbatietia awenade nee nwɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔbeta me ɛhulolɛ nu la ati, mebalie ye; mebawowa ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔze me duma.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Saa ɔfɛlɛ me a, mebalie ye zo; saa ɔkɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a, mebabikye ye, mebalie ye na meali ye eni.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Mebamaa ye ngoane tendenle, na meamaa yeanwu me ngoanelielɛ ne.

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, yɛkɛdo edwɛne yɛkɛye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ, O Anwuma Anwumanli;

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: yɛkɛbɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nolo nwonlomɔ ne, na aledwolɛ nu yɛkɛha wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ;

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ fulutu nee getaa mgbole, na bɛlɛbɔ getaa ngyikyi la.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima ne ɛmaa me nye ɛlie; ɛ sa anloa gyima ne mɔ maa mefa anyelielɛ meto edwɛne.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima le mgbole! Wɔ adwenle nu pi!

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle andi la ɛnrɛnwu ye, sonla mɔɔ le koasea la ɛnrɛde ɛhye abo:

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: kɛ amumuyɛma fifi yɛ dudokoo kɛ ndile, yɛɛ ɛtanema kpazi bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko awieleɛ ne bɛbazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: na wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle tumivolɛ dahuu.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Na nea, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ kpɔvolɛma, wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne amuala abo zo baminli; bɛbabɔ ɛtanema amuala asande.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Wɔmaa me anwosesebɛ ɛyɛ kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli; wɔkpokpa me nwole fofolɛ.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Me nye ɛnwu me kpɔvolɛma azedɔlɛ, me nzo ɛde amumuyɛma ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Tenlenema bakpazi kɛ mrɛlɛ, na bɛanyi kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Bɛlua bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma awuke nu, bɛnyi buzubuzu wɔ Nyamenle alienwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ mrelera bɔbɔ a, bɛso ma, dahuu bɛle duhuduhu yɛɛ nzule wɔ bɛ nu,

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: bɛkile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle; ɔle me ɛvealeka, yɛɛ ɔnli mɔguazo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma di belemgbunli; ɔde ye gunvɛɛnye; Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ebia nu, ɔlɛ tumi. Ɛhɛe, ewiade ɛli munli, bɛnrɛhola ɔ bo tu ɛlɛ;

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: wɔ belemgbunlililɛ vi tete; aloa kabɔ la ɛnee ɛwɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛwɔ anwuma, ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla azule dɔɔnwo ɛhululɛ ne mɔ ane, ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla nyevile azɛlɛkye.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ di munli; nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ fɛta wɔ sua nu, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nzenralɛ Nyamenle, wɔmɔ nzenralɛ Nyamenle, kile wɔ tumi!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: O azɛlɛ ye ndɛnebuavolɛ, dwazo; ma mgbanyizonlema ɛnyia bɛ kyɛfoa!

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kenlenzu yɛɛ amumuyɛma kɛgyakyi bɛ nwo zo ɛmemalɛ a?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Bɛka mgbole, amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ, bɛtu bɛ nwo, bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛfa atisesebɛ bɛsisi wɔ menli ne, na bɛkile bɛ nyane.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Bɛku ahunlanvolɛ nee adenduvoma, na bɛku mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la;

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: na bɛaha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnnwu ye; Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛnnwu ɛhwee.”

english_verse: Can't you fools see? Won't you ever learn?
translation_verse: O menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛmpi a, bɛde ɔ bo! Ahɔnwɔne, kenlenzu a bɛkɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a?

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Ahenle mɔɔ bɔle ɛnzonlɛ la, ɛnde edwɛkɛ ɔ? Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ɛnyelɛ la, ɛnnwu debie ɔ?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtea maanle maanle la, ɛnrɛdea bɛ ɔ? Yemɔ a ɔkilehile menli nrɛlɛbɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ze menli adwenle, ɔze kɛ bɛ adwenle le kɛ ɛnwomenle.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛtea ye, na ɛfa wɔ mɛla ne ɛkilehile ye,

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: kɛ ɛfa wɔazɔ ye wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛpɛ amumuyɛnli ne kuma la.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛnrɛvi ye menli; ɔnrɛkpo menli ne mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ la;

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ bazia ahɔ tenlenema ɛkɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlene la bali zolɛ.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Nwane a dwazo atia amumuyɛma ne amaa me a? Nwane a gyinla atia ɛtanema amaa me a?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma amboa me a, anrɛɛ yeangyɛ biala na meahɔ mɔwuamra anu.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mendwenlenle nwo kɛ, “Metele” la, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne zɔle me.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Saa adwenleadwenle bo me nwo zo a, ɛkyekye me rɛle ɛmaa medi fɛlɛko.

english_verse: who gang up to murder innocent victims.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ bɛtia tenlenema ngoane, na bɛbua mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la ewule fɔlɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ me aranemgbole; me Nyamenle ne le me ɛvealeka bodane.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ɔbamaa bɛ ɛtane abu azia bɛ, na yeabɔ bɛ bo zo wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ti; Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne babɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: O bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛdo edwɛne yɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛmaa yɛva anyelielɛ yɛyeyɛ yɛ ngoanelielɛ bodane ne!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛva moyɛlɛ yɛrɛla ɔ nyunlu; bɛmaa yɛva anyelielɛ yɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne yɛmaa ye!

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle kpole, yɛɛ ɔle Belemgbunli kpole ɔbo nyamenle muala anwo zo.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Ɔ sa nu yɛɛ ewiade ye buma kɔsɔɔti wɔ a, yɛɛ awoka ndendenle ne mɔ noko le ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Nyevile ne le ye ɛdeɛ, ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔyɛle a; ɔvale ɔ sa a ɔhyehyɛle azɛlɛ resee ne a.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: O bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛbɔ yɛ ti aze yɛzonle ye; bɛmaa yɛhoto Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Bɔvolɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔle yɛ Nyamenle, yɛɛ yɛle ye adidileka menli, nee ɔ sa nu mboane. O anrɛɛ ɛnee ɛnɛ bɛkɛdie ɔ ne!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle wɔ Mɛleba, kɛmɔ mekɛ ne anu bɛyɛle wɔ Masa fienemgbole ne anu,

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
