translation_verse: mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ zɔle me nleanle, na bɛgyegyele me, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnwu me gyima la.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Mengyile awolɛndoazo zɔhane ɛvolɛ abulanla, na menganle kɛ, “Bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛsolo, na bɛmbu me ndenle ne mɔ bie a.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ, bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia me ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: O bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ewiade amra, bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛyeyɛ ye; bɛbɔ ye ngoanelielɛ ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ye anyunlunyia ne nolo wɔ maanle maanle avinli, bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ nolo bɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le bedevinli, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye bɛtɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ maanle maanle nyamenle ne mɔ le mmonle; Ɛdɛnkɛma a bɔle anwumaneamra a.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Enililɛ nee tumi ɛbɔ ɛyia ye, anwosesebɛ nee kɛnlɛma ɛyi ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: O ewiade mbusua kɔsɔɔti, bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛyeyɛ ye anyunlunyia nee ye tumi ne.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia mɔɔ fɛta ye; bɛva azubɔdeɛ bɛrɛlɛ ye, na bɛrɛla ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Bɛva anwoziezielɛ nwuanzanwuanza bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma; ewiade amra, bɛzulo ye.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛhile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli! Ɛhɛe, ewiade ye gyi pi, awie ɛnrɛhola ɔ bo tu; ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Bɛmaa anwuma amra ɛli fɛlɛko, na ewiade amra anye ɛlie; bɛmaa nyevile ne nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛhulu;

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye nee mɔɔ wɔ zo la amuala ɛli fɛlɛko! Akee ɛbɔ nu mbaka bava anyelielɛ ado edwɛne

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛba, ɔlɛba yearabua ewiade amra ndɛne. Ɔbava tenleneyɛlɛ yeabua ewiade amra ndɛne, ɔbabua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli; bɛmaa ewiade amra anye ɛlie; bɛmaa maanle maanle mɔɔ gua nyevile nloa la ɛli fɛlɛko!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Amungu nee awozinli kabii ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye; ye belemgbunli ebia ne adiabo a le tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Senle tudu di ɔ nyunlu, na ɔyela ye kpɔvolɛma amuala.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Ye ɛsɛnlɛmanye ne mɔ kpakye ta ewiade ye wienyi; ewiade amra nwu ye na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Awoka kolo kɛ ehuaba wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ewiade ye amuala Awulae ne anyunlu.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Anwumaneamra bɔ ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne nolo, yɛɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nwu ye anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ananze la anyunlu ɛgua aze; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa mmonle bɛtu bɛ nwo la anyunlu ɛgua aze; nyamenle kɔsɔɔti bɔ bɛ ti aze maa ye.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Zayɔnoma te na bɛdi fɛlɛko, yɛɛ Dwudama anye die wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ ati, O Nyamenle.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle kpole ɛtɛla ewiade amuala; ɛle bedevinli ɛtɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi ɛtane la; ɔbɔ ɔdaye ye menli ne anwo bane; ɔdie bɛ ɔfi amumuyɛma asa anu.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Wienyi ta tenlenema anwo zo, yɛɛ mɔɔ ahonle nu te la anye die.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ tenlenema, Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, bɛli fɛlɛko, na bɛyɛ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne mo.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: O bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne! Yeva ye tumi kpole ne, ye tumi nwuanzanwuanza ne yeli konim.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ye konimlilɛ ne ɛla ali wienyi; yemaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu ye konimlilɛ ne.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yehakye ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo la. Ewiade amra amuala ɛnwu yɛ Nyamenle ne konimlilɛ ne.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewiade amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Bɛva getaa bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛbɔ getaa na bɛbɔ agole!

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Bɛva aweɛne ndendenle nee ɛweɛne bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Belemgbunli ne anyelielɛ nu.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa nyevile ne nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛhulu; ewiade nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la amuala ɛwuluwulu!

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa azuyilɛ ne mɔ ɛbɔ bɛ sa nu; na awoka ne mɔ ɛbɔ nu ɛdo edwɛne anyelielɛ nu

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛba yearabua ewiade ndɛne. Ɔbava tenleneyɛlɛ yeazie ewiade, na yeava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua menli ne ndɛne.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le belemgbunli; bɛmaa menli ne anwo ɛwozo bɛ. Ɔde belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ azo anwuma; bɛmaa azɛlɛ ɛkpusu!

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole wɔ Zayɔn; ɔle kpole wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Maa bɛye wɔ duma ne kpole nee ye ɛzulolɛ ayɛlɛ! Nyamenle le nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli bedevinli, pɛlepɛlelilɛ kulovolɛ, wɔmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛlie ebia; wɔmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ ɛra Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Bɛhanvo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne; bɛzonle ye wɔ ɔ gyakɛ abo! Ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mosisi nee Aalɔn boka ye sɛlɛvolɛma ne, Samoɛle boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzonlenle ye la. Bɛdeanle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔliele bɛ zo.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Ɔdendɛle amungu mpila ne anu ɔhilele bɛ; bɛlile ye ngyehyɛlɛ nee ye mɛla mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ la azo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɛliele bɛ zo; ɛyɛle fakyɛ Nyamenle ɛmanle bɛ, noko akee ɛdeanle bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Bɛhanvo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne, bɛzonle ye wɔ ye boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo; ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne le nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Ewiade amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma! Bɛva edwɛndolɛ bɛrɛla ɔ nyunlu!

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ye kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle! Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɔle yɛ a, yɛɛ yɛle ye ɛdeɛ; yɛle ye menli, yɛle ye adidileka mboane.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ; ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu, yɛɛ ye nɔhalɛlilɛ dwu awolɛndoazo muala anwo zo. Gyɛ

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Mebado nɔhalɛlilɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo edwɛne; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ mebado meamaa wɔ a.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Mebalua adenle mɔɔ ngehanleɛ ɛnle nwo la anu; O, kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛra me nwo a? Mebava pɛlepɛlelilɛ meadɛnla me sua nu.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Menrɛva ɛtaneyɛlɛ biala menrɛzie me nyunlu. Mekyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo aze la gyima; me nee bɛ ɛnrɛyɛ debie biala.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Menrɛbikye adalɛma fee, yɛɛ me nee ɛtanema ɛnrɛdu.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ fea sɛkye ɔ gɔnwo duma la, mebazɛkye ye. Sonla mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo, ɔbu ɔ nwo la, menrɛkponle ye.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Mebava ɛnyelɛ kpalɛ meanlea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, amaa bɛ nee me adɛnla; sonla mɔɔ dua ndenle mɔɔ ngehanleɛ ɛnle nwolɛ la anu la, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbazonle me a.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la ɛnrɛdɛnla me sua nu ɛkɛ; awie biala mɔɔ le nabalaba la ɛnrɛgyinla me nyunlu bieko.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ biala mebazɛkye amumuyɛma mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la; mebavoa amumuyɛma kɔsɔɔti meaye bɛ meavi Ɛdɛnkɛma suakpole ne azo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; maa me ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ nye ɛfea me wɔ me ngyianlɛ mekɛ nu. Gyele ɛ nzo tie me; saa mefɛlɛ wɔ a die me zo ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me mekɛ ɛlɛse kɛ esike, me mbowule nu dɔ kɛ fonlomo.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: Me ahonle ɛde kɛ nya, na yenwoso; me rɛle fi bɔbɔ kɛ menwɔli aleɛ.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Me ɛkponlenlɛ ɛyɛ kpole, mewie nwa bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Meyɛ kɛ fienemgbole nu ɛkpɔtɛ, meyɛ kɛ kpadule wɔ suadu zo.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Meyɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɔ ngome ɔgyi sua ti zo, meda a menlafe.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma twi me nyunlu dahuu, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsi me amgbu la fa me duma yɛ ndonwo wa amonle.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Me mekɛ le kɛ nɔsolɛ nu ɛlawolɛ; menwoso kɛ ndile.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle belemgbunli dahuu; wɔ duma ne gyi ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo muala.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Dwazo na nwu Zayɔn anwunvɔne; mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne a; mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhilele la ɛdwu.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ye awolɛ ne sonle bolɛ maa wɔ sonvolɛma na ye ɛzɛkyelɛ ne maa bɛdi nyane.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle bazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne, ewiade arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti bazulo ye anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bakyekye Zayɔn, na yeavinde anyunlunyia nu.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Ɔbadie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ awie la nzɛlɛlɛ, na ɔnrɛkpo bɛ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye bɛmaa awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la, amaa menli mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la aye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ kɛ:

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye anwuma nwuanzanwuanza lɔ, ɔbelele ɔ nye ɔnleanle azɛlɛ ye,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: kɛ ɔtie pilizama ɛkponlenlɛ, na yeatulu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la;

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli kɛwie yia, na maanle maanle kɛyia kɛ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa meyɛ bɛtɛɛ wɔ me mgbavolɛ nu, yepɛ me ngoane zo.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “O me Nyamenle, mmaye me zo wɔ me mgbavolɛ nu. “Wɔmɔ, wɔ ɛvolɛ gyi kpundii, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu.”

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Mɔmoane yɛɛ ɛwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze a, yɛɛ anwumaneamra le ɛ sa anloa gyima.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ bo zo baminli, noko wɔmɔ, ɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu; bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ adɛladeɛ. Ɛdi bɛ ngakyile kɛ ɛdanlɛ, na bɛse bɛkɔ,

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: noko kɛ ɛde la ala a ɛde a, wɔ mekɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wɔ sonvolɛma abo zo amra anwo badɔ bɛ; bɛ bo zo amra badɛnla ɛ nyunlu kpɔkpɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ; mɔɔ wɔ me nu la amuala, bɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, na mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi ye ahunlunyele ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Ɔfa wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala ɔkyɛ wɔ, ɔyɛ wɔ ewule kɔsɔɔti ayile.

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: Ɔdie wɔ ngoane ɔfi Ewule Kuma nu, na ɔkile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa wɔ ɛbɛla nu ninyɛne kpalɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma di pɛlepɛle na ɔbua mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la benle.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ɔlale ye ndenle ne ali wienyi ɔhilele Mosisi, ɔmanle Yizilayɛma nwunle ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli, ɛhulolɛ kpundii ɛyi ye, ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ɔndwi sonla nyunlu dahuu, yɛɛ ɔnva ɛya ɔnzie ɔ kunlu dahuu.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛ anwuma nee azɛlɛ avinli si de tendenle nee kpole la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne de maa menli mɔɔ sulo ye la a.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Kɛ aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ avinli si twe la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔye yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔmaa yɛ nee bɛ avinli twe a.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Kɛ selɛ si nwu ɔ mra anwunvɔne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la anwunvɔne a.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔze kɛ yɛsi yɛde la; ɔkakye kɛ yɛle ndɛtɛlɛ ala.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Sonla ɛdeɛ, ye mekɛ le kɛ ndile; ye ɛkpazilɛ le kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndotolo;

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: kɛ anwoma bɔ ye la ɛnee yekpolo, ɔ bo zo ne ɛnze ye bieko.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la, ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma belemgbunli ebia ne wɔ anwuma, Ɛdɛnkɛma di debie biala anwo zo belemgbunli.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛmɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma, bɛmɛ katakyiema mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔka, na bɛtie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ la.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛmɛ anwuma ɛlɔnema, ye sonvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ biala ɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔdi belemgbunli la. O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, ɛle bedevinli! Anyunlunyia nee enililɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ;

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: ɛfa wienyi ɛkeda kɛ ɛdanlɛ, wɔdɛlɛ anwomanyunlu nu kɛ ndanlɛ sua,

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: wɔzi wɔ sua wɔ anwuma nzule ne mɔ azo. Wɔva amungu ne mɔ wɔyɛ wɔ ɛkpɔnwɔ ehwili, na ɛtɛnla anwoma zo ɛkpɔsa.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Ɛfa anwoma ne mɔ ɛyɛ wɔ soanvolɛma, ɛfa senle nee ɛsɛnlɛmanye ɛyɛ wɔ sonvolɛma.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ a, amaa bɛangola ye kpusu.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɛvale nzule ɛhedale ye kɛ ɛdanlɛ; nzule ne mɔ monlanle awoka ne mɔ.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Ɛdeanle nzule ne mɔ, na bɛnriandile; bɛdele kɛ ɛ ne ɛlɛkulu, na bɛguale ndwɛlɛ aze.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Awoka ne mɔ ati vindele, mbɔnza ne mɔ yele bɛ nwo, na nzule ne mɔ hɔdedale ɛleka mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛle ɛmanle bɛ la.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Ɛhilele nzule ne mɔ ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ bɛtɛla, amaa bɛangeda azɛlɛ ye azo bieko.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ɛmaa nzubula finde mbɔnza ne mɔ anu; bɛsenze bɛdua awoka ne mɔ avinli,

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: bɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nane nyia bie no; ɛbɔ nu asoaso nyia bie nua bɛ ahonle.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Nloma yɛ bɛ sane wɔ ɔ nloa mbaka ne mɔ azo; bɛtɛnla mbaka ngane ne mɔ anu bɛto edwɛne.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛtɔ ezule ɛfi ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la ɛdoɔloa awoka ne mɔ; wɔ nyilalɛ ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
translation_verse: Ɛmaa ndile fifi maa nlankɛ, yɛɛ mbaka fifi maa sonla nyia bie so, amaa yeanyia aleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo;

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: yeanyia nwanye yeamaa sonla nye alie, yeanyia nwole yeamaa ɔ nyunlu ada, na yeanyia aleɛ yeamaa sonla nwo ayɛ se.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Bɛgugua Ɛdɛnkɛma mbaka ne mɔ azo nzule dɔɔnwo, Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔluale la.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Nloma yɛ bɛ sane wɔ zolɛ; bɔngɔ yɛ ye sua wɔ bolonyia mbaka ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Awoka ndendenle ne mɔ le ɛbɔ nu mbɔnkye ɛdeɛ; bodane ne mɔ le abotokila ne mɔ ɛvealeka.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Wɔbɔ siane mɔɔ kile ɛlobɔ ne mɔ; sɛnzɛne ze mekɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtɔ a.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Wɔbɔ awozinli, na ɔle aledwolɛ mɔɔ maa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole finde a.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Awenade mralɛ kpo kpondɛ aleɛ, bɛkpondɛ aleɛ bɛfi Nyamenle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne tudu a, bɛwolowolo na bɛkɔdeda bɛ mbɔne nu.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Sonla kɔ kɔyɛ ye gyima, ɔyɛ gyima toonwo aledwolɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ gyima ne mɔ zonle! Ɛvale nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ɛbɔle bɛ muala a; wɔ abɔdeɛ ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Nyevile ne a la lɔ la, ɔle kpole, ɔle faanwo, nuhua ninyɛne bo anda, anyewɔzo ninyɛne ngyikyi nee mgbole.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Meli dua nyevile zo. yɛɛ Lɛveatan, nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ la ɔdaye ɔdi ye nwɔhoa wɔ nuhua.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala anye la ɛ nwo zo, kɛ mekɛ dwu a ɛkɛmaa bɛ aleɛ.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Saa ɛfa ɛmaa bɛ a, bɛboɔboa ɔ nloa; saa ɛbuke ɛ sa nu a, bɛnyia ninyɛne kpalɛ.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Saa ɛye ɛ nye ɛfea a, ɛnee bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ, ɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle ne a, bɛwu na bɛsia bɛkɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Saa ɛmaa bɛ ɛnwomenle a, bɛlɛ ngoane; na ɛkakyi azɛlɛ ne anye fofolɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, Ɛdɛnkɛma anye ɛlie ye gyima nwo.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Ɔto ɔ nye azɛlɛ ye azo a azɛlɛ ne kpusu, ɔfa ɔ sa ɔka awoka a bɛkpu esike.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede aze la, mebado edwɛne meamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; mede ngoane nu la, mebado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa me Nyamenle.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ kɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ kɛzɔ ɔ nye, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ati me nye die.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ɛtanema abo ɛdu azɛlɛ ye azo, na amumuyɛma abo ɛdu bɔkɔɔ! O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, bɛbɔ ye duma ne nolo; bɛmaa ye nyɛleɛ ɛla ali wɔ maanle maanle avinli.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa ye, bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ amuala nolo.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ati; bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la anye ɛlie.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye anwosesebɛ ne, bɛkpondɛ ɔ nyunlu dahuu.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ ye sonvolɛ Ebileham abo zo amra, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ a, bɛhakye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ yeli la; ye nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee ye ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle a; ye ndɛnebualɛ wɔ ɛkɛ maa ewiade amuala.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɔ rɛle ɛnvi ye ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛlɛ, awolɛndoazo apenle, ɔ rɛle ɛnvi mɔɔ ɔhanle la.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: na ɔzele kɛ, “Mebava Keena azɛlɛ ne meamaa bɛ kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ” la, ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi.

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nwo anzo, na awie ɛmbu bɛ, bɛle adendulɛma wɔ Keena azɛlɛ zo,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: bɛlɛkpɔsa, bɛvi maanle ko anu bɛkɔ ko anu, bɛvi belemgbunli ko abo bɛkɔ menli gyɛne nu la,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: yeammaa awie adenle yeammaa yeansisi bɛ; bɛ ti, ɔdeanle arelemgbunli,

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: ɔhanle kɛ, “Awie biala mmafa ɔ sa ka me menli ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la; awie biala mmagyegye me kpɔmanvolɛma ne.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle ɛhɔne zile azɛlɛ ne azo, ɔmanle bɛ aleɛ kɔsɔɔti wiele.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Ɔzoanle sonla ɔmanle ɔlumuale bɛ nyunlu, Dwosefi, mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye kɛ kanranli la.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Bɛguale ɔ gyakɛ anga, bɛvale bulalɛ kɛba bɛdole ɔ kɔme,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: hɔdwule kɛ mɔɔ ɔhanle la yɛle zɔhane, Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne buale ye benle.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne manle bɛyele ye efiade ne, sonla ne mɔɔ sie menli ne la gyakyile ye.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ye kpanyinli mɔɔ nea ye sua nu ɛkɛ a, na ɔyɛle ye ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azo neavolɛ,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔnlea belemgbunli mbɔlɔba ne mɔ anwo zo, na ɔdu mgbanyima mɔɔ zua belemgbunli la folɛ.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Akee Yizilayɛ rale Yigyibiti, Gyekɔbo hɔdɛnlanle Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ye menli ne wole mralɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛ nwo yɛle se dɛlale bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle kpɔvolɛma ne hyile ye menli ne, na bɛyɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma ne asa.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle ye sonvolɛ Mosisi, yɛɛ Aalɔn mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ bɛ avinli, bɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle awozinli rale, na maanle ne anu yɛle kabii, noko Yigyibitima ne dele ye edwɛkɛ ne anwo atua.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle Yigyibitima ne nzule hakyile mogya, ɔmanle nuhua fɛlɛ muala wule.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo yɛle ahɛlɛne ngome, ahɛlɛne yile bɛ arelemgbunli suakunlu.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle, na nrɛzenra adɔka rale, na ngokowule vale maanle ne.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle ezuawolɛ dɔle, na ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakyele maanle ne anu amuala.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle bɛ vanye nee feege mbaka kɔsɔɔti, na ɔbubule maanle ne anu mbaka kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Ɔdendɛle, na abɛbɛ rale, abɛbɛ mralɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnze bɛ nloa la

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: ralile azɛlɛ ne azo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, na bɛlile bɛ ɛya nu nzoleɛ kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle maanle ne anu belamunli mralɛ kɔsɔɔti, bɛ anwosesebɛ mekɛ nu awolɛ mɔɔ lumua.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Akee ɔlile Yizilayɛma ati ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti, ɔmanle bɛnyianle dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke, ye mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ anu ko bɔbɔ andu koti.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle Yigyibitima fɛ kɛ Nyamenle menli ne ɛlɛkɔ a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ɛdɔ bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma manle amungu hedale bɛ nwo zo, nɔɔzo ɔzɔle senle ɔmanle bɛ wienyi.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Bɛbizale, na Ɛdɛnkɛma rɛlɛle bɛ kyelɛwele, na ɔmanle bɛ anwuma kpanwo molozo.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Ɔkpukele bolɛ, na nzule vi nu vindele; ɔzenle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo kɛ azule.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔhakyele ye ɛwɔkɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne, yɛɛ ye sonvolɛ Ebileham.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔlile ye menli ne anyunlu anyelielɛ nu, ɔvale edwɛndolɛ ɔlile ye menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ati.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Na ɔvale maanle maanle ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛ; na bɛvale menli ne ɛya avule kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: amaa ye menli ne azie ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ; ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Gyɛ

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛha ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la, anzɛɛ kɛhola kɛhile ye ayɛlɛyelɛ muala a?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle, na bɛbɔ tenlene ɛbɛla mekɛ biala la.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛyila wɔ menli ne a, kakye me; saa ɛdie bɛ ngoane a, boa me,

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: amaa meanwu wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye bɛ la ɛkpazilɛ; amaa me nye alie wɔ maanle ne fɛlɛkolilɛ nu, na me nee wɔ menli ne ali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Yɛ nee yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane; yɛyɛ ninyɛndane, yɛyɛ amumuyɛ.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la, bɛandwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo; bɛangakye wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nwo zo la, na bɛdele Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo atua wɔ Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Noko ye duma ne ati, ɔliele bɛ ngoane, amaa yeamaa ye tumi kpole ne ala ali wienyi.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Ɔdeanle Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne, na ɔwele resee; na ɔvale bɛ ɔpɛle buma ne kɛ bɛlua azɛlɛ resee zo.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nzule ne vale kpɔvolɛma ne; ko bɔbɔ anga.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Akee bɛliele ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛlile; bɛdole ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Noko yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ bɛ rɛle vile ye gyima ne mɔ a; bɛangendɛ bɛandie ye folɛdulɛ.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Bɛnyianle atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na bɛzɔle Nyamenle bɛnleanle wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo;

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: ɔvale mɔɔ bɛbizale la ɔmanle bɛ, na ɔyele ewule ɛzulolɛ bie ɔdole bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ azokoɛleɛ ne la anye bolole Mosisi nee Aalɔn, nwuanzanwuanza ko ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye la,

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: azɛlɛ ne kpukele menle Deetan, na ɔhedale Abaelam nee ɔ nwo amra anwo zo.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Eza senle dɔle bɛ avinli; senle ne yelale amumuyɛma ne hunle bɛ.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ nyinli ananze wɔ Saenae, na bɛzonlenle ananze ne mɔɔ bɛguale la.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: Bɛvale Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne bɛmanle ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ di ndile la ananze ne.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Bɛ rɛle vile Nyamenle bɛ Dievolɛ ne, mɔɔ ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole wɔ Yigyibiti,

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔhanle kɛ ɔbɔ bɛ bo zo, na Mosisi mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la, gyinlanle kpundii wɔ ɔ nyunlu, ɔmanle ɔgyakyile ye ɛya ne, yeanzɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Akee bɛkpole azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne, bɛanlie ye ɛwɔkɛ ne bɛanli.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Bɛdendɛle bɛ nzo abo wɔ bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu, bɛanyɛ tieyɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ɔhanle ndane kɛ ɔmaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛadɔ fienemgbole ne anu

english_verse: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: na yeamaa bɛ bo zo amra akponde, azande ahɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle menli ne zonlenle bozonle Beeyale wɔ Piyɔ, na bɛlile aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdo bɛmaa mɔwuamra la.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ nyɛleɛ bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya, na ewule nzane dɔle bɛ avinli.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Na Fenɛhase ragyinlanle kpɔdale bɛ ti, na ewule nzane ne gyakyile.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Bɛkakye ye wɔ ɛhye anwo kɛ ɔle tenlenenli, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Bɛhanle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya wɔ Mɛleba nzubula ne mɔ azo, bɛmanle bɛ ɛtane ne bule ziale Mosisi;

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle bɛmanle ɔdaye ɔvale ɛya, na ɔdendɛle ɛdendɛlɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Bɛanzɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele bɛ la,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: na bɛ nee bɛ bɔle nu dɛnlanle, na bɛzukoale bɛyɛle mɔɔ maanle ne anu amra yɛ la.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Bɛzonlenle bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, na ɔyɛle ɛhane ɔmanle bɛ.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle awozonle.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Bɛhanle mogya mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la bɛguale, bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ mogya, bɛvale bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle Keena awozonle, na bɛvale mogya bɛzɛkyele azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛ nyɛleɛ manle evinli hanle bɛ, na bɛluale bɛ nyɛleɛ zo bɛbɔle nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye menli ne anwo ɛya, na ɔkpole ye agyadeɛ.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle maanle maanle ne mɔ, yemɔti menli ne mɔɔ kpɔ bɛ la ziele bɛ.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne sisile bɛ, na bɛbɛlɛle bɛ aze wɔ bɛ tumi bo.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Ɔliele bɛ fane dɔɔnwo, noko bɛbɔle kpɔkɛ bɛdele ɔ nwo atua, na bɛ ɛtane ti bɛ kpɔvolɛma lile bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Noko akee ɔdele bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne la, ɔ kunlu yelɛyelale ye wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo.

english_verse: You kept your agreement and were so merciful
translation_verse: Bɛ ti, ɔhakyele ye ngyekyeleɛ ne, na ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati ɔhakyile ye adwenle.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, die yɛ, na boɔboa yɛ nloa fi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu, amaa yeayɛ wɔ mo, na yɛali fɛlɛko yeaye wɔ duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, ɔvi tete kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Na menli ne amuala ɛha kɛ “Amen!” Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ luoluale ɛsɛlɛ zo, bɛannwu adenle bɛangɔ suakpole biala azo;

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: ɛhɔne hunle bɛ, nzuhɔne hunle bɛ, bɛ nwo yɛle bɛ bɛtɛɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bɛ ɔluale adenle fɔɔnwo zo, toonwo bɛdwule suakpole zo na bɛdɛnlanle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, wɔ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ nzuhɔne ku ye la nzule, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku ye la, ɔmaa ye aleɛ.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Bie mɔ dɛnlanle awozinli nu, arɛlebɔlɛ nu, pilizama mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ anga na bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛde Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo atua, na bɛkpo Anwuma Anwumanli ne folɛdulɛ ne.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Gyima ɛsesebɛ manle bɛ nwo bɛlɛle bɛ; bɛdule bɛguale, bɛannyia awie amboa bɛ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ɔyele bɛ ɔvile awozinli ne nee arɛlebɔlɛ ne anu, na ɔbubule bɛ anga ne mɔ.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔbubu kɔbele nlenkɛ mgbole, na ɔpepɛ nlenkɛ nzi mbulalɛ nu nwiɔ nwiɔ.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ ɛtane bɔle bɛ anwonyane, na bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ manle bɛnwunle nyane dɔɔnwo;

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: bɛkpole aleɛ ngakyile biala, na bɛbikyele ewule anlenkɛ nloa.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛ nwo zale, na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile ewule nu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔlile ɔmanle menli ne la ati.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ye moyɛlɛ azu, na bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne bɛha ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Bie mɔ vale meli hɔle nyevile zo, bɛhɔlile gua wɔ azule mgbole zo.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Bɛnwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma nyɛleɛ ne mɔ, nee ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ wɔ buma ne anu.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔdendɛle, na ahumu dwazole manle nyevile azɛlɛkye bule mgbole.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛkye ne manle meli ne mɔ zo, finle bɛ buma ne mɔ anu; bɛ anwosesebɛ minlinle manle bɛ nzuzuguazo bɔle bɛ.

english_verse: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
translation_verse: Bɛtotɔle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbo nza, na bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ muala wiele.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu;

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: ɔmanle ahumu ne guale, na azɛlɛkye ne mɔ guale diinyi.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Bɛlile fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ maanle nu ɛgua, na ɔ nee bɛ hɔdwule ahonle ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ zo la azo.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Bɛhanvo ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne kɛyia la, na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ mgbanyima ayia ne anu.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa azule kakyi ɛsɛlɛ, nzubula kakyi azɛlɛ resee;

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la kakyi ngyenle azɛlɛ, wɔ menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nzule bu ɛsɛlɛ zo, azɛlɛ resee kakyi nzubula;

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: ɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku bɛ la tɛnla zolɛ, na bɛkyekye suakpole bɛtɛnla zolɛ.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛso ɛya bɛdua aleɛ, bɛyɛ vanye egyinli, na bɛnyia bɛyɔba dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Ɔyila bɛ, ɔmaa bɛ nwo so dɔɔnwo; ɔmmaa bɛ nlankɛ anwo ɛnyɛ ekyi.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi bɛ nwo zo konim na bɛ nwo yɛ ekyi, bɛsisi bɛ, bɛnwu amaneɛ, na bɛdi nyane a,

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: ɔmaa arelemgbunli mɔɔ sie bɛ la nwu kɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie nwo, na ɔmaa bɛkpɔsɛkpɔsa ɛsɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ɔye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la nyane nu, na ɔmaa bɛ nwo so kɛ nyɛmoa.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Pɛlepɛlema nwu ye na bɛdi fɛlɛko; na amumuyɛma mua bɛ nloa.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛdwenle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo; bɛmaa menli ɛdwenle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, me ahonle gyi kpundii, me ahonle gyi kpundii! Mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ! Me ɛkɛla, dwazo!

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo, getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi! Mebamaa mangyee ye anu akpudwu!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo, wɔ menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti avinli, mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti avinli.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole tɛla anwuma, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne mɔ anu lɔ.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, maa wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne zo anwuma lɔ! Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ɛda ewiade amuala!

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Amaa wɔalie menli mɔɔ ɛkulo bɛ la ngoane; bua me, na dua wɔ tumi ne azo boa yɛ.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, ɔse, “Mebahyɛ Hyikɛm anu konimlilɛ nu, na meahyɛ Sɛko Bɔnza meamaa me menli ne.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Geleade le me ɛdeɛ; Manasɛ le me ɛdeɛ; Yifelaem le me bulalɛ kyɛlɛ; Dwuda le me tumi kpɔma;

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Mowabe le me kyɛnze bonkuma; mefuandi me mgbɔlaboa megua Yidɔm anwo zo; metea nu konimlilɛ nu wɔ Filisitiama anwo zo.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛhye nwo la azo a? Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ Yidɔm a?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, asoo ɛtɛkpole yɛ ɛ? O Nyamenle, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne ɛngɔ.

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: O boa yɛ maa yɛho yɛtia kpɔvolɛ ne, ɔluakɛ sonla moalɛ le mgbane.

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Nyamenle wɔ yɛ afoa a yɛbaho yɛadɔ zo; yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaha kpɔvolɛma ne yeagua a.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: O me ayɛlɛyelɛ Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu!

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ amumuyɛma nee adalɛma ɛdwazo me nwo zo, bɛlɛkeha adalɛ bɛatia me.

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛyia me adenle, na mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛteta me.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Mekulo bɛ, noko bɛmɛ bɛto me ɛzonle, kanza meyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ memaa bɛ bɔbɔ a,

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ, yɛɛ bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ bɛtua me ɛhulolɛ kakɛ.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Ye amumuyɛnli bie maa ɔho ɔtia me kpɔvolɛ ne, maa awie ɛdo ye ɛzonle ɛva ye ɛhɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ a, maa ɔli fɔlɛ, na bɛva ye modolɛ ne kɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ!

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Maa ye mekɛ ɛyɛ ezinraa; maa awie ɛza ye ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Maa ɔ mra ɛyɛ nrisa, na ɔ ye ɛyɛ kunlanvolɛ.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Maa ɔ mra ɛluolua nu ɛzɛlɛzɛlɛ, na bɛvoa bɛ bɛvi bɛ sua bubulera ne anu.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Maa menli mɔɔ ɔtua bɛ kakɛ la ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne muala, na nyɛvolɛ ɛwua ye debie biala.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Mmamaa awie biala se ye anwunvɔne, anzɛɛ nwu ɔ mra nrisa ne mɔ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Maa ɔ bo zo ɛbɔ, na ye duma ɛminli awolɛndoazo nwiɔ ne anu.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɔ ze mɔ ninyɛndane ne mɔ, yɛɛ mmafa ɔ nli ɛtane ne mɔ ɛkyɛ ye.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ye ɛtane ne mɔ dahuu; na maa ewiade amra arɛle ɛvi ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yeangakye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔse anwunvɔne; ɔyɛle menli mɔɔ ɛhyia nee ɛhyianvolɛma kpɔdekpɔde, na ɔtinlinle mɔɔ ɛnwu ɔ nyunlu la edwɛkɛ nu ɔhunle ye.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Ɔhulole amowa; maa amowa ɛbu ɛzia ye! Yeangulo nyilalɛ; maa nyilalɛ ɛbɔ ye!

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ɔvale amowa ɔyɛle ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale, maa ye amowa ne ɛloa ye tɔfɔɔ kɛ nzule, na ɔyɛ kɛ nwole ɔdwu ye mbowule nu.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Maa ɔyɛ kɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula, na ɔyɛ kɛ akyeso mɔɔ dahuu ɔkye la!

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɛhye ɛyɛ me kpɔvolɛma ahatualɛ, ɔyɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtendɛ ɛtane bɛtia me la ahatualɛ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, Awulae me Nyamenle, wɔ duma ne ati, die me ti, ɔboalekɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpalɛ, die me!

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mele ehyianli, yɛɛ mehyia, nyane ɛha me kpole.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Mewie kɔ kɛ nɔsolɛ nu ɛlawolɛ, bɛkpɔla me bɛto kɛ abɛbɛ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔnehyelɛ ɛmaa me gyakɛ anzi ɛtuto, me nwonane ɛwie kɔ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma nwu me a bɛgolo me nwo; bɛnwu me a bɛkpusu bɛ ti.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, boa me! Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me!

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Maa bɛnwu ye kɛ wɔ tumi zo ɔ; na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Maa bɛwa me amonle, na wɔmɔ yila me, maa me kpɔvolɛma anyunlu ɛgua aze, na wɔ sonvolɛma ɛli fɛlɛko.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Maa nyiane ɛhu me kpɔvolɛma, na maa bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɔ bɛ ti.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mebava me nloa meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo kpole kpalɛ; mebaye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ menli ɛwolaa ne anu.

english_verse: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔdie anwunvɔnenli ne ati, ɔdie ye ɔfi menli mɔɔ kulo kɛ bɛku ye la asa anu.

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔ belemgbunli kpɔma kpole ne vi Zayɔn ara. Ɔse, “Di wɔ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo belemgbunli.”

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Wɔ menli ne mɔ bava bɛ nwo amaa wɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛze kɛ ɛdi wɔ ɛlɔnema ati wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la. Wɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bara ɛ nwo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne, kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ. Ɔse, “Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu, kɛmɔ Mɛlekezidɛke yɛle la.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Awulae gyi wɔ fema zo, ɔfa ɛya a ɔbabubu arelemgbunli.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔbadea maanle maanle ne mɔ, na yeamaa avunli ayiyi bɛ ahonleɛ; ɔbahu bɛ arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade amuala la.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ɔbanlo adehane nzule ne bie; yemɔti ɔbakpogya ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Mebayeye me ahonle nu meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, wɔ fɔɔnwoma avinli, wɔ ayia kpole ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima ne mɔ le mgbole, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die nwolɛ la sukoa.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Tumi nee enililɛ wɔ ye gyima nu, yɛɛ ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli, yemaa bɛhakye ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la aleɛ; ɔkakye ye ngyekyeleɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Yeva maanle maanle ne mɔ agyadeɛ yemaa ye menli yehile ye menli ne tumi mɔɔ wɔ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ye debie biala nɔhalɛ nu, ɔle fɔɔnwo; sonla fa ɔ rɛle wula mɔɔ ɔkɛha la anu a ɔyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne mekɛ biala, kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima tenlene nee nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma liele ye menli ne, na ɔ nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. Ye duma ne le kpole, ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ tieyɛ la. Ye ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔ nye die ye mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ɔ bo zo amra bayɛ katakyiema wɔ maanle ne anu; bɛbayila fɔɔnwonli ne abo zo amra.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Ezukoa nee anwonyia wɔ ye sua nu; ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Wienyi kpa menli mɔɔ di boɛ la awozinli, Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, anwunvɔnezelɛnli nee tenlenenli.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa sonla mɔɔ buke ɔ sa nu bɔ bosea, na ɔyɛ debie biala nɔhalɛ nu la.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ pɛlepɛlenli ne abo zo ɛnrɛminli ɛlɛ; bɛbahakye ye dahuu.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ɛnzulo amaneɛ ɛtane, ɔgyinla kpundii na ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ye ahonle gyi pi, ɔnzulo, kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛli ye kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Yebuke ɔ sa nu wɔ ɛhyianvolɛma anwo zo; ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu; bɛbava enililɛ bɛakpogya ye tumi ne zo.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli nwu ye na ɔfa ɛya; ɔdedɛ ɔ nwo bonrane nu na ɔminliminli, amumuyɛnli adwenle yɛ mgbane.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne, ɛnɛ nee dahuu!

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ɔvi sɛnzɛne ne aduduleɛ kɔdwu ye adɔleɛ, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole bo maanle maanle ne mɔ azo, ye anyunlunyia wɔ anwuma tɛla anwumaneamra.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Nwane a le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ de ye ebia nu wɔ anwuma lɔ,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: na ɔto ɔ nye aze ɔnea anwumaneamra nee ewiade a?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Ɔye ehyianli ɔfi ndɛtɛlɛ nu, na ɔkpogya mɔɔ ɛhyia la zo ɔfi nzonle nu,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: ɔmaa bɛ nee arelemgbunli tɛnla, ɔdaye ye menli ne arelemgbunli.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔmaa mɔɔ anwo ralɛ la nyia awuke, ɔyɛ ngakula dɔɔnwo bɛ nli anyelielɛ nu. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra vile nyɛvolɛ avinli la,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Dwuda maanzinli ne yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza, Yizilayɛ yɛle ye maanle.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne nleanle na ɔnriandile; Dwɔdan ne hwenle ziale.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Awoka wuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli, awoka ngyikyi wuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: O Nyevile, duzu a yɛle wɔ mɔɔ ɛnriandile a? O Dwɔdan, duzu ati a ɛhwenle ɛziale a?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: O awoka, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli a? O awoka ngyikyi, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ a?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: O azɛlɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu, saa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu.

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa bodane yɛ azule tandane, na ɛtwɛlɛboɔ yɛ nzubula a.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Tɛ yɛmɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tɛ yɛmɛ, na wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ anyunlunyia ka wɔ, wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati a.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Duzu ati a maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛbiza kɛ, “Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu” a?

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ anwuma; ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Bɛ mmonle ne mɔ le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke, bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ; bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ; bɛlɛ ɛbonyilɛ, noko bɛnde nvoanle.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ ɛsalɛ, noko bɛnva bɛnvua debie; bɛlɛ egyakɛ, noko bɛndia; yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ɛnelɛ bɛnva bɛnyɛ alɛra.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mmonle la le kɛ mmonle ne mɔ ala la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ bɛ nu la de a.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu! Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: O Aalɔn sua nu amra, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu! Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu! Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dwenle yɛ nwo, ɔbayila yɛ; ɔbayila Yizilayɛma amuala; ɔbayila Aalɔn sua nu amra;

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: ɔbayila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, mgbolema nee koahweabanema amuala.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛwo dɔɔnwo, bɛdabɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra amuala.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Anwuma lɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ yeva azɛlɛ ye yemaa menli.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Mɔwuamra ɛnye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛhɔ monvonle la de a.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ, yɛbaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɛnɛ nee dahuu. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Mekulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ yede me ne nee me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɛnzonlɛ ɔdiele me la ati, mebavɛlɛ ye wɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Ewule ngane lile me bɔyia; Ɛbolɔ mbowule sosɔle me; menwunle nyane nee abodelɛ.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Na menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebodo wɔ, die me!”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, ɔle pɛlepɛlenli; yɛ Nyamenle ne se anwunvɔne.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la anwo bane, bɛholole me nwo zo la, ɔliele me.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: O me ɛkɛla, sia balie wɔ ɛnwomenle, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ wɔ boɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔlie me ɛkɛla wɔvi ewule nu, wɔkyikyi me nye anwo monle, na meandu koti la ati,

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: medua Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Menzɔle me diedi nu boɛ, bɔbɔ mɔɔ menganle kɛ, “Menwu amaneɛ kpole” la;

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: menvale ewugyemu menganle kɛ, “Anyelazo wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anu le mgbane”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Duzu yɛɛ menva memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛwolaa ye anwo a?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ngoanelielɛ kɔpo ne zo, na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la, wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Nyamenle menli ne ewule le debie kɛnlɛma wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele wɔ sonvolɛ; mele wɔ sonvolɛ, wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ara nrenya. Wɔzianyi me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ moyɛlɛ azu meamaa wɔ, na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la, wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Mebaye ɛwɔkɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, bɛyeyɛ ye!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye yɛ nwo la le kpole; yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nɔhalɛlilɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha kɛ, “Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Aalɔn abo zo amra ɛha kɛ, “Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛha kɛ, “Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me nyanenwunlɛ nu; Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me na ɔyele me kɔme kpomgbolo.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me afoa, menzulo. Duzu a sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi me nzi kɛ ɔboa me, mebali bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me la anwo zo konim.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛvea Ɛdɛnkɛma akɛnra anu, tɛla kɛ ɔkɛva ɔ rɛle ɔkɛwula dasanli nu.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bɔle yiale me; Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle bɛyiale me, bɛbɔle bɛyiale me wɔ adenle biala anu; Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Bɛvɔle me kɛ wolɛ, na bɛyelale kɛ senle yela mbowule la; Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Bɛtiale me kpole kpalɛ, asɛɛ mendɔle aze, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma boale me.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me anwosesebɛ, me konimlilɛ edwɛne, yelie me ngoane.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Bɛdie, bɛlɛto konimlilɛ edwɛne fɛlɛkolilɛ nu wɔ tenlenema ndanlɛ sua ne anu: “Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne,

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli konim, Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Menrɛwu, mebadɛnla ngoane nu, na meabɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la nolo.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhwi me nyunlu kpole kpalɛ, noko ɔtɛyele me ɔtɛmanle ewule.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Bɛbuke tenleneyɛlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛmaa me, amaa mealua nuhua meawolo, na meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anlenkɛ kpole ne ɛne; tenlenema balua nu awolo.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ wɔbua me, na wɔlie me ngoane a.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Bolɛ ne mɔɔ suasivoma ne kpole la ɛyɛ mgbɛnezo bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia a.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛhye a; yɛnea a ɔyɛ nwanwane.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
