translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛ la ɛne; bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye na yɛli fɛlɛko.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, die yɛ! O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, maa yɛli konim.

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dua Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu wolo la! Yɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu nyilalɛ yɛyila wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle, yɛɛ yemaa yɛ wienyi. Bɛva mbaka ngane bɛdo ɛlɔnwɔne bɛbɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne abo, na bɛbɔ azukponle ne mgbɔlɔka.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayɛ wɔ mo; ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayeyɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ; ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ndenle nu ɛnlɛ ngehanleɛ, na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne de la.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ye ngyehyɛlɛ zo, na bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo,

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ ɛtane biala, na bɛdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Wɔva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ wɔmaa yɛ kɛ yɛli zolɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ me ndenle adenrɛ fɔɔnwo wɔ me Nyamenle ne mɛlalilɛ zo.

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Akee me nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ko, kɛmɔ me nye wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo la.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Mebava ahonle mɔɔ nuhua te la meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔzukoa wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ la.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo; O mmakpo me bɔkɔɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na kpavolɛ adenle nu ayɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ ɛ? Kyesɛ ɔdua wɔ edwɛkɛ zo ɔsinza ɔ nwo.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Mebuke me ahonle nu mekpondɛ wɔ; mmamaa metwe me nwo mefi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Meva wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mezie me ahonle nu, amaa meanyɛ ɛtane meantia wɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha wɔ; kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔhyehyɛ la nolo.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Me nye die wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo kɛmɔ me nye die anwonyia nwo la.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo, na meamaa me nye agyinla wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Me nye balie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo; me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne. Nyamenle mɛla ne anwo fɛlɛkolilɛ

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye kɛnlɛma, amaa meanyia ngoane, na meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Buke me nye, amaa meanwu nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne anu la.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Mele ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo; mmafa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛfea me.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mekɛ biala.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Ɛtea mgbanyizonlema, munzuvoma ne mɔɔ twe bɛ nwo fi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Ye bɛ ndeanlɛ ne fi me nwo zo, ɔluakɛ meli wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli kɔ me nwo akpamo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko wɔ sonvolɛ badwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Medɔ aze; asɛɛ mewu, kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la, maa me anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Menganle me edwɛkɛ la, ɛbuale me; kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Maa mende wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo, na mebadwenledwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Nyane ngome maa me ɛkɛla minli me nwo, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati, maa me anwosesebɛ!

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Ye me fi ndenle ɛtane ɛtane nu, na ɛlolɛ nu ala kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Meva nɔhalɛ adenle ne, meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mezie me nyunlu.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mehisa wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kyengye; mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Mebanriandi meava wɔ mɛla ne mɔ adenle zo, saa ɛmaa me ndelebɛbo yɛ kpole a. Ndelebɛbo nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ndenle, na mebalua nu meahɔ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meava wɔ mɛla ne meazie, na meava me ahonle muala meali zo.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Fa me dua wɔ mɛla adenle ne anu, ɔluakɛ me nye die nwolɛ.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Maa me ahonle ɛbikye wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛdɛla kɛ menwɔnyia me nwo.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Ye me nye fi ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nwo, na maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la, moa zolɛ maa wɔ sonvolɛ.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ye me fi ndeanlɛ ne mɔɔ mesulo ye la anu, ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Nea, me nwo ɛlɛdɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ; maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ati. Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛdwu me nwo zo, maa wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne ɛrɛla, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la,

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: amaa meahola meabua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi me nyunlu la, ɔluakɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Mmaye nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ɛfi me nloa, ɔluakɛ melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Mebali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu, wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: na me nwo badɔ me wɔ me ɛlualɛ nu, ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ nolo meahile arelemgbunli, menrɛze nwolɛ nyiane,

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo; mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ eni, mekulo bɛ; mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo. Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Kakye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ, mɔɔ ɔlua zo wɔmaa menyia anyelazo la.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ɛhye le me arɛlekyekyelɛ wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne maa me ngoane.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la si me amgbu kpole, noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne anwo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Saa medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔɔ vi tete la anwo a, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnee me rɛle ɛkyekye.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Ɛya ku me kpole kpalɛ, wɔ amumuyɛma mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la ati.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ meyɛ me edwɛne wɔ me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ adendulɛ nu.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, aledwolɛ nu mekakye wɔ duma, na medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛhye ɛyɛ me ɛdeɛ, ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. Tu ɛ nwo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le me kyɛfoa; mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Meyeye me ahonle nu mebiza wɔ moalɛ; wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, nwu me anwunvɔne.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Saa medwenle wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo a, mekakyi me nye meba wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Meka me nwo, mensisi aze kɛ menwɔli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma nyɛma ɛkyekye me bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Medwazo alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli meye wɔ ayɛlɛ, wɔ wɔ mɛla tenlene ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Me nee menli mɔɔ sulo wɔ la a tu a; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi wɔ mɛla zo la a me nee bɛ tu a.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ; kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ. Bolɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne sonle la

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye boɛ, kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Maa me nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenubukelɛ, ɔluakɛ medie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ medi.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Menvonle adenle la yɛɛ menwunle me nyunlu a, na kɛkala medi wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛle kpalɛ yɛɛ ɛyɛ kpalɛ; kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwoma bɔ me nwo nzekue, na mame, mefa me ahonle muala medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Bɛ ahonle ɛlafe tuanwu kɛ nane ɛnlome, na mame, me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwunle me nyunlu a, amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ maa me tɛla ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule apenle apenle. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔbɔ me na wɔziezie me a; maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la banwu me na bɛ nye alie, ɔboalekɛ menyia anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, meze kɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo, na wɔdea me nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkyekye me rɛle, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ ne la de la.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Nwu me anwunvɔne, amaa meanyia ngoane, ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne anwo.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Maa adubɛnwoma anyunlu ɛgua aze, ɔboalekɛ bɛva adalɛ bɛli me ɛwɔne; na mame, mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la ɛrɛla me ɛkɛ, amaa bɛanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Mmamaa medi fɔlɛ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo, amaa me nyunlu angua aze. Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ; melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Mehendɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo akee me nye ɛbu, mebiza kɛ, “Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛkyekye me rɛle a?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meyɛ kɛ nwanye nwoma kodoku mɔɔ la senle nu, noko me rɛle ɛtɛfile wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Wɔ sonvolɛ, mengendɛ mengɔndwu kenlenzu? Kenlenzu a ɛkɛdea menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la a?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwoma ɛpɛ me nwo kuma, menli mɔɔ ɛnli wɔ mɛla zo la.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne amuala gyi kpundii; bɛfa adalɛ bɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde; boa me!

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Asɛɛ bɛhu me ala ɛne, noko metɛkpole wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me ngoane, amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne gyi kpundii wɔ anwuma lɔ dahuu.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wɔ nɔhalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo muala; ɛdawɔ a wɔbɔ ewiade ye a, yɛɛ ɔgyi kpundii.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɛzile ɛhyehyɛle bɛ la yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti tɛde ɛnɛ a, ɔluakɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le wɔ sonvolɛma.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Saa me nye anlie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo a, anrɛɛ menwule wɔ me anwubɛnyunlu nu.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔlua bɛ nwo zo wɔmaa me ngoane.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mele wɔ ɛdeɛ, die me; ɔluakɛ mebɔ mɔdenle kɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛhɔ nzia kɛ bɛku me, na mame, medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: O, mekulo wɔ mɛla ne somaa! Medwenledwenle nwolɛ alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne maa menwu nrɛlɛbɛ metɛla me kpɔvolɛma, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ me nu dahuu.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla me kilehilevolɛma amuala, ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ala a medwenledwenle nwolɛ a.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla mgbanyinli, ɔluakɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Metwe me nwo mefi munzule adenle biala anu, amaa meahola meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔhilehile me a.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne yɛ me fɛ somaa, ɔyɛ fɛ ɔtɛla wolɛ.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Medua wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo menyia ndelebɛbo, yemɔti mekyi adalɛ adenle biala. Wienyi mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne le kɛnlaneɛ maa me, ɔle wienyi wɔ me adenle nu.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Meha ndane na memoa zolɛ kɛ menwɔli wɔ pɛlepɛle mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Menwu amaneɛ kpole; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ngoane, kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ se la.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Me ahonle la me sa nu dahuu, noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛzua me ɛhane, noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le me agyadeɛ dahuu; ɛhɛe, me ahonle la nwo.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Meyeye me ahonle nu kɛ meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne se la, wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne bɔ sonla nwo bane

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyi menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle le nwiɔ nwiɔ la, na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Ɛle me ɛvealeka nee me enyinlike; melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛma, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo ɛke, amaa meali me Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Maa me anwosesebɛ, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la, amaa meanyia ngoane; mmamaa me anyelazo wie anyiemgba nu.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Sɔ me nu, amaa me nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo, na meali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛkyi awie biala mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la; ɛhɛe, bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ adwenle biala le mgbane.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Ɛbu ewiade ye amumuyɛma kɛ ewula, yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛzulolɛ ti me nwo wozo me, yɛɛ mesulo wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Meyɛ mɔɔ le pɛlepɛle na ɔtenrɛ la, mmagyakyi me ɛmaa menli mɔɔ sisi me la.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Die wɔ sonvolɛ ati dahuu; mmamaa adubɛnwoma sisi me.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Mehendɛ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne nee wɔ tenlene ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo me nye ɛbu.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne de la, na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Mele wɔ sonvolɛ; maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ metɛla ezukoa nvutuke, metɛla nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛdu nu la.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo la ati, mekyi adalɛ adenle biala. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ yɛ nwanwane; yemɔti mefa me ahonle muala medi zolɛ.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu ngilehilelɛ maa wienyi; ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la nyia ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Kakyi ɛ nye me nwo na nwu me anwunvɔne, kɛmɔ ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, mmamaa mekpo aze, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛtane di me nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Die me fi menli mɔɔ sisi me la asa anu, amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nyunlu ɛda wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo, na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Me nye monle twi bobobobo, ɔboalekɛ menli ɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. b Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle tenlenenli, yɛɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Wɔhyehyɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ tenlene nee nɔhalɛ adenle zo.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Me nwo yelɛyela me kɛ senle, ɔboalekɛ me kpɔvolɛma arɛle fi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Mezɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne menlea ye kpalɛ, na wɔ sonvolɛ mekulo ye somaa.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Mele ekyi, menli ɛmbu me, noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ le fɔɔnwo dahuu, yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Melɛnwu amaneɛ nee nyane ɛdeɛ, noko me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo dahuu; maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meanyia ngoane. Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Mefa me ahonle muala mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bua me! Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; die me, amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Medwazo aleɛbahye na mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me; me anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Aledwolɛ muala me nye gyi zo, amaa meadwenledwenle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, tie me ne; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dua wɔ pɛlepɛleyɛlɛ ne azo die me ngoane.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛtane yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la ɛbikye; bɛnze wɔ mɛla ne fee.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbikye me, yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Menwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu dɛbadɛba, kɛ wɔhyehyɛ wɔdo ɛkɛ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Moalɛ nwo modolɛ

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nea me anwubɛnyunlu na die me, ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Die me ti na kpɔne me; wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, maa me ngoane.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia ngoanelielɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛmkpo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo zo.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ le kpole; wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, maa me ngoane.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Me kpɔvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la zonle, noko menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo memkpɔkye me nwo.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Menea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la a me nwo yelɛyela me, ɔboalekɛ bɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ mesi mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ la! Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, bɔ me ngoane nwo bane.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti le kpɔkɛ ko, yemɔ a le nɔhalɛ; yɛɛ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tunwomaa

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Mgbane gyɛne ala arelemgbunli yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde, noko me ahonle tu wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne maa me nye die kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnyia anwonyia la.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyi yɛɛ mengulo adalɛ, na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ fane nsuu kenle ko wɔ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ mɛla ne la lɛ anzonudwolɛ kpole; debie biala ɛngola ɛmmaa bɛndu koti.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye la wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne azo, na meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ se la.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo; mekulo bɛ somaa!

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Medi wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, ɔluakɛ me ndenle muala la ɛ nyunlu. Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu; ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, maa me ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Maa me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu; ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, die me.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ kɛ ɛkilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ a.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Mebado wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo edwɛne, ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne amuala le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ tumi ne boa me, ɔluakɛ menlea nu meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne, me anyelielɛ a le wɔ mɛla ne.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Maa me ngoane, amaa meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, na maa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛboa me.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Meminli kɛ boane; kpondɛ wɔ sonvolɛ abo zo, ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Me anwongyelelɛ nu mesu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, amaa yeabua me;

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi adalɛma nee mɛlɛbɛlama asa anu.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Duzu yɛɛ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ a? Yɛɛ duzu bieko yɛɛ bɛyɛ wɔ a, wɔmɔ nabalabanli?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Kyesɛ ɛlɔnenli ɛda mbaka nlane, nee baka ɛsesebɛ emunlike mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu la.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Abule ɛbu me kɛ mekɔ Mihyɛke, na metɛnla Kidaa ndanlɛ sua nu a!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Medɛnla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi anzonudwolɛ la sua nu mehyɛ somaa.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Mekulo anzonudwolɛ, noko meka anzonudwolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a, ɛnee yeyɛ konle.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Memaa me nye zo menea awoka ne mɔ. Nienwu yɛɛ me moalɛ vi ba a?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Me moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛmaa ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛhoati, mɔɔ sinza wɔ la ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mɔɔ sinza Yizilayɛ la ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ yɛɛ ɔnrɛlafe.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le wɔ sinzavolɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma keda ɛ nwo zo, na ɔmaa wɔ anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ aledwolɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ wɔ munzule muala anu; ɔbamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ wɔ wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nee wɔ ɛralɛ nu ɔvi ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle me fɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele me kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu!”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛra! Yɛgyi wɔ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ bɛkyekye ye suakpole na ɔle kpondekponde.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne a mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ, Ɛdɛnkɛma mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɔ, kɛ bɛkayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, kɛmɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛma la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛlɛ anzonudwolɛ bɛmaa Gyɛlusalɛm! “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la ɛkpazi!

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ, na anwondɔlɛ ɛyi wɔ tawa ne mɔ.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Me mediema nee me gɔnwo mɔ ati, mebaha kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ!”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne sua ne ati, mebazuzu wɔ boɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛde wɔ belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ anwuma, wɔmɔ yɛɛ memaa me nye zo menea wɔ a.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Nwu yɛ anwunvɔne, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu yɛ anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ yɛnwu akpule yɛhyɛ.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Yɛ ɛkɛla ɛli nyane ɛhyɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde boɛ la amgbuzilɛ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la akpule ti.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a, bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha!

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a, anrɛɛ mɔɔ menli dwazole yɛ nwo zo,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: na bɛvale yɛ nwo ɛya la, anrɛɛ bɛziele yɛ anyewɔzo.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ azuyilɛ ne pianle yɛ hɔle, anrɛɛ azule ne monlanle yɛ,

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: anrɛɛ azule ne ɛzenlɛ kpole ne hedale yɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ anye yɛ ammaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma angu yɛ la.

english_verse: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
translation_verse: Yɛvi ɛsalɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛvi ɛhane nu; ɛhane ne ɛbubu, yɛvi ɛsalɛ!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Yɛ moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la le kɛ Boka Zayɔn mɔɔ ɛnkpusu na ɔgyi kpundii dahuu la.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ awoka ne mɔ bɛnra yia Gyɛlusalɛm la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye bɛnra yia ye menli ne anwo, ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛli belemgbunli wɔ tenlenema azɛlɛ zo dahuu; anrɛɛ tenlenema kɛdwazo kɛli ɛtane.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kpalɛ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nwo bɛyɛ ninyɛndane la Ɛdɛnkɛma badea bɛ nee amumuyɛma amuala. Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Zayɔn kpazile bieko la, yɛyɛle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛka ɛlalɛ la.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Akee yɛ nloa anwo yɛle ɛzelekɛ ngome, na yɛdeɛdeanle nu anyelielɛ nu; na maanle maanle ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa bɛ.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa yɛ; ɔyɛ yɛ fɛ kpole.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa yɛkpazi bieko, kɛ azudenle ne mɔ mɔɔ gua nyiakɛ la!

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa monle bɛdua la, ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdea nu ɛbu!

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɛzunlɛ soa ye ma kɛ ɔkalua la, bava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu, ava ye bɛyɔba ne ara sua nu.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzi sua ne a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsi la fɛ mgbane. Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzinza suakpole ne a, sinzavolɛma solo nafelɛ mgbane.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔnle debie mgbane kɛ ɛkɛdwazo ndɛ na ɛnrɛla ndɛ, ɛkɛva ɛ nwo amuala ɛkɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ; ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo bɛ la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlafe la.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nea, mralɛ mrenya le agyadeɛ mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ a; awolɛ le nyilalɛ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ nu mralɛ mrenya ɛnyialɛ le kɛ ɛda mbaka wɔ ɛlɔnenli asa anu.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ye ɛda mbaka boa ne ɛyi la. Saa ɔ nee ye kpɔvolɛma nyia ɛdendɛlɛ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a, ɔ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha awie biala mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la!

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Ɛbali ɛ sa anloa gyima aleɛ; ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa wɔ na ɛ nye alie.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Ɛ ye bayɛ kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ so la wɔ wɔ sua nu; ɛ mra bayɛ kɛ ɔlivi mbaka mɔɔ ɛwɔlɔwɔlɔ la abɔ ayia wɔ ɛkponle nwo.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Nea, zɛhae nyilalɛ yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la banyia a.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ ɛvi Zayɔn! Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkpazilɛ ne, wɔ wɔ ngoane mekɛ muala anu!

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu ɛ mra amra. Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛ!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ,” bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha.

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ, noko bɛtɛkolale me nwo zo konim di.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Bɛrelerelele me nzi kuma nu, bɛpɛle ye ahuma kɛ ɛyazonlɛnli fa alua aleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlenenli; yepepɛ amumuyɛma nyɛma ne mɔ anu.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Zayɔn la anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛzia bɛ nzi.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kɛ sua ti zo ndile, mɔɔ fifi a ɔngyɛ na yeanwoso la.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mmamaa menli mɔɔ se ɛkɛ ne la ka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ! Yɛyila wɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu!”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mela buma ye anu mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ!

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: O Awulae, tie me ne! Gyele ɛ nzo tie me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ!

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛse ɛdi ɛtane nzi a, Awulae, anrɛɛ nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla a?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ fakyɛ, amaa bɛazulo wɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Mekendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me ɛkɛla kendɛ, yɛɛ me nye la ye edwɛkɛ ne azo;

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: me ɛkɛla kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la, tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo zo! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii, na ɔlɛ ngoanelielɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ɔbalie Yizilayɛma yeavi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛmemanle me nwo zo, me nye ɛtɛtɛlale me ndo; menva ninyɛne mɔɔ le mgbole nee mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ɔmaa me la membɔ me ɛbolɛ.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Na medo me rɛle azule nu, meyɛ koonwu kɛ kakula mɔɔ la ɔ nli akɛnra nu la; me ɛkɛla ɛyɛ koonwu kɛ kakula la.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛ, nyia anyelazo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye Devidi nee amaneɛ kpole mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye;

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee amonle mɔɔ ɔlile ɔhilele Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: kɛ, “Menrɛhɔ me sua ne anu, anzɛɛ menrɛla me ɛkpa ne azo;

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnyia ɛleka menwɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛleka mɔɔ Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne badɛnla la.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Nea, yɛdele Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nganeɛ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm, yɛnwunle ye wɔ Keleate Gyialem ɛya nu.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Yɛhanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu; bɛmaa yɛbutu ɔ gyakɛ abo yɛzonle ye!”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo kɔ wɔ sua ne anu, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ kile wɔ tumi la.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Maa wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ, na maa wɔ menli ne ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdea nu.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Wɔ sonvolɛ Devidi ati, mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi mɔɔ wɔkpokpa ye nwole la.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Devidi ɛwɔkɛ, na ɔnrɛhakyi ɔ nloa ɛlɛ. Ɔse, “Ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔwo bɛ la anu ko yɛɛ mebava meazie wɔ ebia ne azo a.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Saa ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ di me mɛla zo, bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ mebahilehile bɛ la azo a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛ mra mrenya badɛnla wɔ ebia ne azo mekɛ biala.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye Zayɔn; yehulo kɛ ɛkɛ ne a ɔtɛnla a:

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Ɛke le me ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɛleka dahuu; ɛke a mebadɛnla a, ɔluakɛ mehulo ɛke.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Mebamaa yeanyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo; mebamaa ye ehyianvolɛma anyia aleɛ.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ye sɛlɛvolɛma anyia ngoanelielɛ, na meamaa me menli ne mɔɔ wɔ zo la ava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Ɛke a mebamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔ ko adwazo ayɛ belemgbunli kpole a, na mebazinza mɔɔ mekpa nu meye ye belemgbunli la.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Mebamaa ye kpɔvolɛma abɔ anyiemgba, na meamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ayɛ kpole.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ ɔsi ɔle kɛnlɛma nee kpalɛ, kɛ mediema kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla koyɛlɛ nu!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ nwole mɔɔ sonle bolɛ mɔɔ bɛwola bɛgua sonla ti zo, na ɔsonyi ɔgua ɔ kɛsa anu, bɔbɔ kɛ Aalɔn akɛsa anu ɛdeɛ ne, mɔɔ zonyinle guale tɛladeɛ ne akɔme ne anu la.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ Hɛmɔn Boka zo ɛbɔlɛ, mɔɔ tɔ gua Zayɔn awoka ne mɔ azo la! Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbayila bɛ, yeamaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla, bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛmɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, mɔɔ aledwolɛ nu bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne la!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ sa zo wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, na bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ ɛvi Zayɔn, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze la!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne, wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛyeyɛ ye!

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ; bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ!

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Gyekɔbo ɛmaa ɔ nwo, yeva Yizilayɛ yeyɛ ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, yɛɛ yɛ Awulae bo nyamenle muala anwo zo.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo la yɛɛ ɔyɛ a, wɔ anwuma nee aze, nyevile nu nee buma kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a ɔmaa amungu dwazo ewiade ati lɔ a; ɔmaa ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye ezule nu, na ɔtukue anwoma anlenkɛ ɔmaa ɔtu a.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ, menli nee nane mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛwole bɛ la.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ Yigyibitima avinli, ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔtiale Falo ne nee ye sonvolɛma a.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔzɛkyele maanle maanle na ɔhunle arelemgbunli katakyiema a:

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn, yɛɛ Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo, na ɔzɛkyele Keena arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ a.

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ ɔmanle bɛyɛle bɛ agyadeɛ, ye menli Yizilayɛma agyadeɛ.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti bade wɔ nganeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma balie ye menli ne ati, na yeanwu ye sonvolɛma anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mmonle ne mɔ, le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke; bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ, bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie,

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɛnwomenle biala ɛnle bɛ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Maa menli mɔɔ yɛ mmonle la, ɛhɛe, awie biala mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula mmonle nu la, ɛyɛ kɛ mmonle la.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O Aalɔn awuke nu amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: O Livaema, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ vi Zayɔn ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ mɔɔ ɔde Gyɛlusalɛm la. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O bɛyɛ nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne mo; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O bɛyɛ awulae mɔ Awulae ne mo; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole a; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔvale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ɔbɔle anwuma la; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle azɛlɛ tɛtɛlɛ ye wɔ azule ne mɔ avinli la; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle ahɛnlaneɛ mgbole ne mɔ la; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne fi ewia alehyenlɛ nu; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Siane nee nwɔlɔra ta aledwolɛ nu; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ ne mɔ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔyele Yizilayɛma ɔvile Yigyibitima avinli; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔvale tumi kpole, ye tumi ɛsalɛ ne; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔkpakyele Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anu nwiɔ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle Yizilayɛma luale nuhua pɛle; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Na ɔmanle Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nee ye ɛlɔnema wule; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye menli ne ɔpɛle ɛsɛlɛ ne; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle arelemgbunli mgbole; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle arelemgbunli katakyiema; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɔyɛle agyadeɛ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔyɛle ye sonvolɛ Yizilayɛ agyadeɛ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Yɛ nwo hyelele yɛ la ɔhakyele yɛ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔliele yɛ ɔvile yɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa abɔdeɛ kɔsɔɔti aleɛ; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ anwuma Nyamenle ne mo; ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Wɔ Babelɔn azule ne mɔ anloa, yɛdɛnlanle aze yɛzunle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛhakyele Zayɔn la.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Azule ne anloa mbaka ne mɔ azo, yɛhendɛhendanle yɛ getaa ne mɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne a menli mɔɔ hyele yɛ la zele yɛ kɛ yɛdo edwɛne a. Bɛhilele yɛ nyane na bɛzele yɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo Zayɔn edwɛne ne mɔ bie bɛhile yɛ.”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛto Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛne wɔ maanɔne ɛ?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, saa me rɛle fi wɔ a, maa me sa fema ɛnwenwe.

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Saa me rɛle fi wɔ, na meammaa Gyɛlusalɛm angyia me andɛla me anyelielɛ biala a, maa mendɔ mumule!

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye mɔɔ Yidɔmma yɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔle la. Bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛbɔ ye, bɛbɔ ye tɔɔ! Bɛgologolo ye bɛgua aze!”

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: O Babelɔn, wɔmɔ sɛkyeravolɛ! Ahenle mɔɔ bali wɔ nzenralɛ wɔ mɔɔ wɔva wɔyɛ yɛ la anwo la anye balie kpole!

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Ɔ nye balie na yealielie bɛ mra ngakula yeava bɛ ti yeakpulokpula bodane yeahu bɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefa me ahonle muala meyɛ wɔ mo; meto wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ awozonle nyunlu;

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: mekakyi me nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwo lɔ, mebutu meyɛ wɔ mo, wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛ ti, ɔluakɛ wɔkpogya wɔ duma nee wɔ edwɛkɛ zo wɔdɛla debie biala.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ menvɛlɛle wɔ la, ɛliele me zo, na ɛmanle me anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ewiade arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti baye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde ɛ nloa anu edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Bɛbado Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ anwo edwɛne, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne le kpole.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ anwuma bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbu mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la, na mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la ɛmbikye ye.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Saa melua ngyegyelɛ nu a, ɛbɔ me ngoane nwo bane. Ɛtenrɛ ɛ sa ɛsi me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛva ɛya la aze, na ɛfa wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛdie me.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa mɔɔ yehyehyɛ yemaa me la ayɛ zɔ; O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu. Mmakpo ɛ sa anloa gyima.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔnleɛnlea me nu wɔnwu me!

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ɛze me azedɛnlanlɛ nee me ɛdwazolɛ nu; ɛze me adwenle muala.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Ɛneɛnlea na ɛnwu me ndenle muala, saa melɛdie me ɛnwomenle anzɛɛ melɛyɛ gyima a ɛze.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekabuke me nloa bɔbɔ la, ɛnee ɛze mɔɔ mebaha la amuala.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔ me nyunlu, ɛwɔ me nzi, na ɛfa ɛ sa ɛto me nwo zo.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Zɛhae adwenle ne yɛ me nwanwane; ɔwɔ anwuma ɔbo me ndelebɛbo zo.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Saa mekoati wɔ Sunsum ne a, nienwu yɛɛ mekɔ a? Anzɛɛ mekoati wɔ a, nienwu yɛɛ menriandi meahɔ a?

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Saa mefa nwonlomɔ ndɛbalɛ metu faa mekɔ nyevile nzi moa moa lɔ a,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: ɛkɛ ne bɔbɔ, wɔ tumi ne a nee me bahɔ a, yɛɛ wɔ tumi kpole ne a bazɔ me a.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Saa meka kɛ, “Awozinli ɛheda me nwo zo, na me nwo wienyi ne ɛnlu ɛyɛ aledwolɛ” a,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: awozinli ne ɛnle kisii ɛmmaa wɔ, aledwolɛ ne ta wienyi kɛ alehyenlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu, awozinli nee wienyi le debie ko.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ a ɛhyehyɛle debie biala mɔɔ wɔ me nu la a, ɛdawɔ a ɛnwonle me wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu a.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ nee nwanwane. Wɔ gyima yɛ nwanwane! Ɛze me kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkyehyɛ me mbowule, bɛava bɛasisa zo wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu, na fealera nu ala melɛnyi la, ɛnee ɛze kɛ mewɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsɔhonle ɛhwee la ɛnee ɛ nye gyi me nwo; ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ me nwo edwɛkɛ biala wɔ wɔ buluku ne anu; mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbɔle me ɛleka biala bɔbɔ la, ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ kenle dodo mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa me la.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔ adwenle ne mɔ sonle bolɛ maa me! Bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu a ɔle kpole kpalɛ!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Saa mese kɛ metia a, bɛzonle bɛtɛla ɛnwea. Saa metunwue a, ɛnee metɛbɔ ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, anrɛɛ wɔahu amumuyɛma, na kɔdiawuma vi me nwo ahwe bɛ nwo.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Bɛfa adwenle ɛtane bɛtendɛ bɛtia wɔ; wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne tendɛ ɛtane tia wɔ.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, asoo mengyi menli mɔɔ kyi wɔ la? Asoo memkpɔ menli mɔɔ dwazo tia wɔ la?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Mekpɔ bɛ ɛkpɔlɛ sanlera kpalɛ; mebu bɛ me kpɔvolɛma.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Neɛnlea me nu, O Nyamenle, na nwu me ahonle nu! Sɔ me nea, na nwu me adwenle!

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Nea saa amumuyɛ bie wɔ me nu a, na fa me dua ngoane adenle ne anu dahuu.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi ɛtanema asa anu; bɔ me nwo bane wɔ amumuyɛma asa anu.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane wɔ bɛ ahonle nu, na bɛka konle dahuu.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Bɛ nloa yɛ nla kɛ ɛwɔlɛ, bɛ nloa nu bɔlɔ le kɛ ɛwɔbile ɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sinza me wɔ amumuyɛma asa anu; bɔ me nwo bane wɔ kɔdiawuma asa anu; bɛhyehyɛ kɛ bɛkpane me gyakɛ.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwoma ɛzua me ɛhane ɛvea, bɛva nyɛmanyɛma bɛdo nwowa; bɛzuozua me ngane wɔ adehane.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Meka mekile Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ɛle me Nyamenle.” O Ɛdɛnkɛma, gyele ɛ nzo tie me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Awulae, me dievolɛ kpole, wɔheda me nwo zo wɔ konle nu.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakponle mɔɔ amumuyɛnli ne kulo kɛ ɔyɛ la azo; mmamaa ye amumuyɛ adwenle ne di munli.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Maa amumuyɛma mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko la fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ɛhakyi munzule.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Maa samɛnlakɛ ɛkpomgbɔ ɛgua bɛ ti zo! Maa bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua kuma nu mɔɔ bɛndwazo ko ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Chase those cruel liars away! Let trouble hunt them down.
translation_verse: Mmamaa mɔɔ bɔ ɔ gɔnwo anwo nzekue la tɛnla maanle ne anu; maa munzule ɛdu kɔdiawuma ne mgbaliko.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la edwɛkɛ maa ye, na ɔbua mɔɔ ɛhyia la ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu ɔmaa ye.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, tenlenema bayɛ wɔ mo, yɛɛ mɔɔ ye ɛbɛla tenrɛ la badɛnla ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefɛlɛ wɔ a yɛ ndɛndɛ boa me! Saa mefɛlɛ wɔ a gyele ɛ nzo tie me ne!

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Maa me nzɛlɛlɛ ɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ wɔ ɛ nyunlu, na fa me sa mɔɔ memaa ye zo la kɛ nɔsolɛ azubɔlɛ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa sinzavolɛ ɛzinza me nloa, na ɔzinza me nloa babonle ye.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Mmamaa me nye die ɛtane nwo, na mepele amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ nwo. Mmamaa me nee nindavoma tu, yɛɛ mmamaa me nee bɛ to ɛsalɛ ɛyɛba ko anu.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Maa sonlakpalɛ ɛbo me, ɔle anwunvɔnezelɛ; maa ɔhwi me nyunlu, ɔle nwole wɔ me ti zo, memkpo, ɔluakɛ me nzɛlɛlɛ tia amumuyɛma nyɛleɛ ne mɔ dahuu.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Saa bɛye bɛ bɛwula menli mɔɔ babua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ la asa anu a, yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ a.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛde ye bodane zo la mbowule si sande la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ mbowule bazande Ɛbolɔ anuhɔlɛ ne a.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, me nye la ɛ nwo zo; wɔ nuhua yɛɛ menriandi mefea a; mmaye me ɛmaa.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Mmamaa metɔ bɛ ɛhane ne mɔɔ bɛzua me la anu, mmamaa metɔ amumuyɛma ɛhane nu.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Maa amumuyɛma ɛgulu nu ɛgua bɛ ngane ne mɔ anu, na maa me nwo ɛyɛ kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Metea nu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefa me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ meto ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Meye me edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti meto ɔ nyunlu; meka me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekile ye.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Saa me ɛnwomenle wie a, ɛze me ndenle kɔsɔɔti. Adenle ne mɔɔ medua nu la, bɛzua me ɛhane wɔ nu.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Meto me nye fema zo menea, na awie ɛmpili me; ɛvealeka biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa me, awie biala ɛndwenle me nwo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; mese, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle me ɛvealeka a, ɛle me ɛdeɛ wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Ye me fi efiade, amaa meayɛ wɔ mo! Tenlenema babɔ ayia me, ɔluakɛ wɔlo me dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ; tie me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Dua wɔ nɔhalɛ ne azo bua me; wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ati, bua me.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Mmabua wɔ akɛlɛ ndɛne; ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu, awie biala ɛnli benle.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ ne ɛvoa me ndinlizo; yetinli me azɛlɛ ne anwo; yedo me awozinli nu kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu dɛbadɛba la.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Yemɔti me nwo ɛbubu me; me ahonle ɛdu kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mekakye dɛba, medwenledwenle mɔɔ wɔyɛ la anwo; menwu mɔɔ wɔyɛ la amuala.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Metenrɛ me sa memaa wɔ; ɛ nwo nzuhɔne ku me kɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛwe resee la.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo bua me! Me ɛnwomenle ɛwie! Mmafa ɛ nye ɛfea me, anrɛɛ menwɔyɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Maa mende wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo bie nwonlomɔ mangyee ne, ɔluakɛ wɔ nuhua yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ a. Kilehile me adenle mɔɔ menva zo la, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ ala a me nye la ɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu! Menriandi meravea wɔ nu.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Kilehile me maa menyɛ mɔɔ ɛkulo la, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a! Maa wɔ Sunsum kpalɛ ne ɛli me nyunlu, wɔ munzule adenle zo.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne ati, bɔ me ngoane nwo bane! Dua wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo ye me fi ngyegyelɛ nu.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, bɔ me kpɔvolɛma gua, na sɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la amuala, ɔluakɛ mele wɔ sonvolɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, me bodane, mɔɔ kilehile me konle nye zo, na ɔsiezie me ɔmaa mekɔ konle la.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Ɔle me bodane nee me ɛvealeka, me aranemgbole nee me dievolɛ. Ɔle me enyinlike, ye nuhua yɛɛ mefea a, na ɔmaa medi maanle maanle nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, sonla le duzu, mɔɔ ɛbu ye bie zɛhae a, anzɛɛ sonla ra le duzu, mɔɔ ɛdwenle ɔ nwo a?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Sonla le kɛ ɛnwomenle, ye mekɛ le kɛ ɛlawolɛ.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka anwuma aze na bɛla! Fa ɛ sa ka awoka ne mɔ maa bɛkpu esike!

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Kpakye ɛsɛnlɛmanye bɔ bɛ asande; to wɔ ɛda ne mɔ maa wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛgua ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Tenrɛ ɛ sa fi anwuma lɔ, sɔ me na die me fi nzule ne mɔ anu; die me fi nyɛvolɛ asa anu.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛnga nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛdi amonle bɔbɔ a bɛbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, mebado edwɛne fofolɛ meamaa wɔ; mebabɔ ye wɔ nyɛma bulu getaa zo meamaa wɔ,

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛmaa arelemgbunli di konim, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛdie wɔ sonvolɛ Devidi a,

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: die me fi konle dadeɛ atisesebɛ nloa, na die me fi nyɛvolɛ asa anu. Bɛnga nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛdi amonle bɔbɔ a bɛbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Maa yɛ mra mrenya mgbavolɛ nu ɛyɛ kɛ mbaka mɔɔ ɛwie nyi; maa yɛ mra mraalɛ ɛyɛ kɛ mgbɛnezo bolɛ mpila mɔɔ bɛboɔboa kɛ bɛfa bɛazi belemgbunli sua la.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Maa yɛ bonwolo ne mɔ ɛyi, mɔɔ aleɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɛkɛ; maa yɛ mboane ɛda, bɛyɛ apenle apenle nee apenle bulu bulu wɔ yɛ ɛya nu.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Maa yɛ nlankɛ ɛnrenzɛnrenzɛ; mmamaa bɛ ko kpɔne yɛɛ mmamaa bɛdi abawuo. Mmamaa yɛte nyane ɛzunlɛ biala wɔ yɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha menli mɔɔ nyilalɛ ɛhye le bɛ ɛdeɛ la! Nyilalɛ ɛha menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma le bɛ Nyamenle la!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Mebayeyɛ wɔ, me Nyamenle nee me Belemgbunli, na meayɛ wɔ mo dahuu.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Kenle biala mebayɛ wɔ mo, na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole; ye kpoleyɛlɛ, sonla ɛngola ɛnvedevede nu.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Awolɛndoazo biala bahanvo wɔ, na bɛabɔ wɔ gyima mgbole mɔɔ wɔli la nolo.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Mebadwenledwenle wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia nwo, na meadwenledwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
