translation_verse: Menli babɔ wɔ tumi gyima mgbole ne mɔ nolo, na medame mebabɔ wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Bɛbaha wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ dɔɔnwo ne anwo edwɛkɛ, na bɛado wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne anwo edwɛne.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ yɛɛ ɔse anwunvɔne, ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane yɛɛ ye ɛhulolɛ le kpundii.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ maa awie biala, ye anwunvɔnezelɛ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ yebɔ la anwo zo.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ sa anloa gyima kɔsɔɔti bayɛ wɔ mo, Nyamenle menli ne amuala baye wɔ ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Bɛbaha wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia nwo edwɛkɛ, na bɛaha wɔ tumi ne anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Bɛbamaa menli anwu wɔ tumi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ, nee wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anyunlunyia ne kɛnlɛma.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɛle belemgbunli dahuu wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu. Ɛdɛnkɛma le nɔhalɛ wɔ ye edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti anu, yɛɛ ɔle dovolɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma sɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛgua aze la nu, na ɔkpogya bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua aze la zo.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, menli kɔsɔɔti anye la ɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛ aleɛ wɔ ye mekɛ nloa.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Ɛbuke ɛ sa nu, ɛmaa tease abɔdeɛ biala akunlu dwo ɔ nwo.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye la amuala, ɔbikye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye nɔhalɛ nu la.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la nyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la, eza ɔte bɛ ɛzunlɛ na ɔdie bɛ.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la anwo bane; na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, ɔbazɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ; awie biala ɛye ye ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O me ɛkɛla, ye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la, mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ; mebado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meamaa me Nyamenle mekɛ mɔɔ ngoane wɔ me nu la.

english_verse: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula arelemgbunli anu mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula sonla nu, ɔnlɛ moalɛ biala.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Saa ye ɛnwomenle ne fi ye nu a ɔsia ɔkɔ ye ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu; kenle ko ne ala ɛnee ye ngyehyɛlɛ biala ɛzɛkye.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ye boavolɛ a le Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne, na ye anyelazo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne nu la,

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala la. Ɔdi ye ɛwɔkɛ zo dahuu.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Ɔbua mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la ndɛne pɛlepɛle na ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku ye la aleɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma dwula pilizama;

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: ɔtukue mɔɔ anye ɛzi la anye. Ɛdɛnkɛma dwazo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua aze la; ɔkulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle tenlene la.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma sinza nyɛvolɛ, ɔsɔ ahunlanvolɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bɛ ze la, na ɔsɛkye amumuyɛma adenle ne.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bali belemgbunli dahuu, O Zayɔn, wɔ Nyamenle ne bali awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛye yɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ yɛɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne fɛta ye.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyekye Gyɛlusalɛm; ɔboɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la anloa.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Ɔkyekye mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ la arɛle, na ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛboda la ayile.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ɔze nwɔlɔra ne mɔ dodo, na ɔtoto bɛ kɔsɔɔti aluma.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Yɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le kpole, yɛɛ ye tumi le kpole; ye ndelebɛbo, bɛnzuzu.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kpogya mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la zo, ɔfuandi amumuyɛnli ne ɔto aze.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Bɛva moyɛlɛ bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛva getaa bɛbɔ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma!

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Ɔfa amungu ɔkeda anwomanyunlu; ɔmaa ezule tɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na ɔmaa ndile fifi awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa nanemgbole aleɛ, na ɔmaa ahɔhɔsɛlɛ mralɛ mɔɔ su la aleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Ɔ nye ɛnlie ɛkpɔnwɔ anwosesebɛ nwo, yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie ɛlɔnenli akɛnrasesebɛ nwo,

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: na Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la anwo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ anyelazo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anu la.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! O Zayɔnoma, bɛye bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔmaa bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nzi mbulalɛ nu yɛ se; ɔyila bɛ mra mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de la.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa anzonudwolɛ ba bɛ ɛweɛne ne mɔ azo; ɔmaa bɛnyia aleɛ bɛ kunlu dwo bɛ nwo.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ɔtendɛ ɔkile azɛlɛ ye, mɔɔ ɔkɛha la yɛ zɔ ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ezukɔtweaba tɔ yɛ tofotofo kɛ mboane ndɛkɛ, ɔbɔ ɛbɔndwoba ɔkponde kɛ nzonle.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Ɔtɔ ayese ɔgua kɛ awozaka; nwane a kɛhola ye ɛyɛlɛ ne anloa gyinla a?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa bɛ muala bɛkolo; ɔmaa anwoma tu na azule ne mɔ se.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔka ye edwɛkɛ ne ɔkile Gyekɔbo, ɔfa ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ɔmaa Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔtɛyɛle ɛhye ɔtɛmanle maanle biala; bɛnze ye mɛla ne mɔ. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Anwuma amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ anwuma anwuma lɔ!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ! Nyamenle ɛlɔnema, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne nee siane, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, bɛmɛ nwɔlɔra mɔɔ ta, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ anwumaneamra, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, nzule mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ anwuma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle, na bɛrale.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔhyehyɛle bɛ ɔziele ɛkɛ ne wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɔgyale bɛ ɛweɛne mɔɔ bɛmbɔ bɛndɛla a.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ ewiadeamra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛmɛ nyevile nu ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ nee buma muala,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: senle nee ezuawolɛ, ezukɔtweaba nee ɛbɔndwoba, ahumu mɔɔ tie ɔ ne,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, nzoleɛ mbaka nee sida mbaka,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: nanemgbole nee nyɛmoa, ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze nee nloma mɔɔ tu, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli nee menli kɔsɔɔti, tumivolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ewiade la kɔsɔɔti!

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra muala, ngakula nee mgbanyinli bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Ɔluakɛ ye duma bo duma biala azo; ye anyunlunyia bo anwuma nee aze anwo zo.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Yemaa ye menli ne anwosesebɛ, amaa Nyamenle menli ne aye ye ayɛlɛ, ye menli Yizilayɛma mɔɔ la ye ahonle nwo. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛdo ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ ye nɔhalɛ menli ne ayia ne anu!

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛli fɛlɛko wɔ bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne ati; Zayɔnoma ɛli fɛlɛko wɔ bɛ Belemgbunli ne ati!

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Bɛzi agole bɛye ye ayɛlɛ; bɛva ahenle nee getaa bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die ye menli ne anwo; ɔmaa mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la di konim.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la ɛli fɛlɛko anyunlunyia nu; bɛde bɛ ehwili ne mɔ anu a bɛdo edwɛne anyelielɛ nu.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ kpole ne ɛzo bɛ nloa anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛ sa nu,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Bɛbava nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ bɛakyekye arelemgbunli, na bɛava mbulalɛ bɛabɔ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kpanwu,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: kɛ bɛbua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la. Ɛhye le anyunlunyia maa ye menli nɔhavoma ne. Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne; bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ ye anwomanyunlu kpole ne!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ mgbole ne mɔ ati; bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, kɛmɔ ye bedevinli ne si de la.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Bɛva aweɛne tendenle bɛye ye ayɛlɛ; bɛva fulutu nee getaa bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Bɛva ahenle nee agolezilɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ; bɛva getaa nee aweɛne bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ die ɛnwomenle la ɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Devidi ara nrenya Sɔlɔmɔn, Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne mrɛlɛ mɔɔ bule la ɛne:

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Ɔbule mrɛlɛ ne mɔ amaa menli azukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, anyia ngilehilelɛ, na bɛade edwɛkɛ mɔɔ anu pi la abo,

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: bɛadie ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ fane nrɛlɛbɛ ɛbɛla, tenleneyɛlɛ, pɛlepɛlelilɛ, nee boɛlilɛ nwo,

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: amaa mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la anwu nrɛlɛbɛ na mgbavolɛ adwenle nu abuke.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la bade na yeazukoa yeamaa ye adwenle adi, na mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la anyia adwenle mɔɔ anu pi,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: na yeade ɛrɛlɛbulɛ nee edwɛkɛndonwo, nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma edwɛkɛ nee bɛ abɛladolɛ ne mɔ abo. Mgbavolɛ folɛdulɛ

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le adwenle nu ɛbukelɛ mɔlebɛbo, ahoasea kyi nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ nee ngilehilelɛ.

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, tie ɛ ze ngilehilelɛ, yɛɛ mmakpo ɛ nli folɛdulɛ,

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛle ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba abɔtile bɛmaa wɔ, yɛɛ bɛle ɛ kɔme avikpa.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, saa ɛtanevolɛma bɛlɛbɛla wɔ ali wɔ adwenle a, mmakponle zolɛ.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Saa bɛka bɛkile wɔ kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ nzia wɔ adenle nu, yɛhu menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie;

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: maa yɛyɛ yɛ nwo kɛ Ɛbolɔ, yɛme bɛ anyewɔzo, kɛ Ewule Kuma me menli mɔɔ wu la,

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: na yɛbanyia ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la dɔɔnwo; yɛbanyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ yɛ azua nu;

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: yemɔti ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ ko na yɛ muala yɛ gya ɛyɛ ko” a,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: me ra nrenya, ɛ nee bɛ mmatu fee,

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛ gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ ne fa bɛ kɔ munzule nu, yɛɛ bɛle ahɔdiawu.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa anloma anye gyi ɛ nwo na ɛgua ye asawu a, ɛgua ye mgbane.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ kɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ ngoane nwo nzia, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ mogya yɛɛ bɛkɔ nwolɛ nzia a.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: ɔ ne dielie bane ne mɔ ati zo nee suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa na ɔlɛka kɛ:

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “O bɛmɛ anzenwolɛbiema, bɛkulo kɛ bɛka bile nu toonwo ɔkɔdwu kenlenzu? Agolobɛnwoma, bɛ nye die bɛ agolobɛnwo nu toonwo yeahɔdwu kenlenzu, na ahoasea akpo adwenlenubukelɛ ahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Saa metwi bɛ nyunlu a anrɛɛ bɛdie. Nea, mebaha me adwenle kɔsɔɔti meahile bɛ. Mebamaa bɛade me edwɛkɛ ne mɔ abo wienyi.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: na bɛkpɔla bɛ nzo anzi wɔ me folɛdulɛ muala anwo, na bɛyɛ kɛ bɛnrɛva bɛ nyunlu mɔɔ metwi la bɛnrɛyɛ ɛhwee la,

english_verse: “So when you are struck by some terrible disaster,
translation_verse: medame noko mebazele bɛ wɔ bɛ anwubɛnyunlu nu. Saa bɛ nye zo ta bɛ a, mebazi bɛ amgbu.

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Saa edwɛkɛ to bɛ maa bɛ nye zo ta bɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ ahumu ɛva bɛ, na munzule bigyi bɛ kɛ ahumuakyima, na nyane nee amaneɛnwunlɛ fa bɛ aze a, mebazele bɛ.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbazu bɛavɛlɛ me, na menrɛdɛne bɛ zo, bɛbakpondɛ me kpalɛ kpalɛ, na bɛnrɛnwu me.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛhyile adwenlenubukelɛ, na bɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: kɛmɔ bɛyɛle kɛ bɛnrɛbu me folɛdulɛ ne bie, na bɛkpole kɛ menwɔhwi bɛ nyunlu la,

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo aleɛ yɛɛ bɛbali a, na bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ adwenle ɛtane ne abɔ bɛ ti.

english_verse: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie la kakyi bɛ nzi si nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛwu, yɛɛ ahoasea ahunlundwolɛ sɛkye bɛ;

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: na mɔɔ tie me ne la badɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu, ɔ nwo adɔ ye, mɔɔ ɔnrɛzulo munzule biala a.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, saa ɛtie me edwɛkɛ ne, na ɛfa me mɛla ne mɔ ɛsie kpalɛ,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: ɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ ɛtie nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ, na ɛfa wɔ adwenle ɛsie ndelebɛbo zo;

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: ɛhɛe, saa ɛsu kɛ ɛkpondɛ adwenlenunwunlɛ, na ɛmaa ɛ ne zo kɛ ɛkpondɛ ndelebɛbo,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: saa ɛkpondɛ ye kɛ ɛkpondɛ ezukoa fufule, na ɛkpondɛ ye kpalɛ kɛ anwoneɛ mɔɔ vea la a,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ɛbade Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ ne abo na wɔanyia Nyamenle anwo adwenlenubukelɛ,

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma maa nrɛlɛbɛ; ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔmaa adwenle nee ndelebɛbo a.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ɔfa nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ le tenlene la; ɔle enyinlike ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la,

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: ɔsinza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle la ɛbɛlabɔlɛ, na ɔmaa ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛdu bɛ nwo ɛmaa ye la anwo tɔ bɛ.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Saa ɛtie me ne a, ɛbade pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ, boɛlilɛ, yɛɛ adenle kpalɛ biala abo,

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɛbanwu nrɛlɛbɛ na wɔ adwenle abuke kɛnlɛma bie.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Ɛbava wɔ adwenle wɔabɔ ɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka, na wɔ ndelebɛbo azinza wɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Ɛbava wɔ adwenle wɔalie ɛ nwo wɔavi munzule adenle nu, nee mgbane mgbane ɛhanlɛma asa anu.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ kpo ndenle fɔɔnwo ne mɔ na bɛdua awozinli ndenle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye die ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo, yɛɛ bɛ anyelielɛ a le ɛtanelilɛ ala.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛ ndenle nu kyeɛhyea, yɛɛ bɛle mɛlɛbɛla.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Bɛbalie wɔ bɛavi raalɛ kpamgbanvolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne asa anu,

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: raalɛ zɛhae kpo ye mbɛlɛra nu ɔ hu, na ɔkpo ye Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne,

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ye awuke bɔ bɔkɔɔ yɛɛ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu yɛ awozinli.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la ɛnzia, yɛɛ ye ɛbɛla ɛnwie ye boɛ.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛ nee menli kpalɛ ɛdu na dua tenlenema adenle nu,

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ di boɛ la badɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la baha zolɛ.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Bɛbaye amumuyɛma bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛadu ngunzima bɛavi zolɛ.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi me ngilehilelɛ ne; fa me mɛla ne mɔ sie wɔ ahonle nu,

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: na bɛbamaa wɔanyi wɔahyɛ na wɔakpazi ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi kɛ ɛkɛyɛ tieyɛ na ɛkɛli nɔhalɛ; kyekye bɛ mu nwiɔ kenda ɛ kɔme na fa sie wɔ ahonle nu.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bamaa wɔazɔ ɛnyelɛ, wɔanyia dumamɔlɛ kpalɛ wɔ menli nee Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Yeye wɔ ahonle nu fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛsɔ ɛ ngome wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Nwu Nyamenle wɔ wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ muala anu, na ɔbamaa wɔ ndenle adenrɛ fɔɔnwo amaa wɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Mmabu ɛ nwo kɛ ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo;

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: ɔbayɛ ayileyɛlɛ yeamaa wɔ nwonane ne, na yeayɛ wɔ mbowule nu ayile.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ nwo amuala di Ɛdɛnkɛma eni, na fa wɔ egyinli nu bɛyɔba mɔɔ lumua la maa ye,

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: na wɔ bonwolo ne mɔ azo bayi tɛkɛɛ, na wɔ nwanye angola ne mɔ ayi abulubulu zo.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, saa Ɛdɛnkɛma tea wɔ adenrɛdenrɛ wɔ a, mmakpo, yɛɛ saa ɔtwi ɛ nyunlu a, mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛvɛlɛ,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tea mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la, kɛmɔ selɛ tea ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ ɔ nye die ɔ nwo la.

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔkɛnyia ndelebɛbo la,

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye nu la tɛla dwɛtɛ fufule yɛɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia la tɛla ezukoa nvutuke.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ sonle bolɛ tɛla anwoneɛ yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ sonla nye die nwolɛ la nee ye ɛnzɛ.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ lɛ ngoane tendenle wɔ ɔ sa fema ne anu, yɛɛ ɔlɛ anyiabɛnwo nee enililɛ wɔ bɛne ne anu.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ adenle nu le anyelielɛ nee anzonudwolɛ ngome.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ɔle ngoane baka ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɔ nu boɛ la; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɔ nu boɛ la di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye nrɛlɛbɛ a bɔle ewiade a; ɔvale ye ndelebɛbo a ɔbɔle anwumaneamra a.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye adwenle a ɔmanle buma ne mɔ rale, na amungu ne mɔ tɔ ɛbɔlɛ gua azɛlɛ ye azo a.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, sɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenunwunlɛ nu boɛ; mmamaa bɛfi ɛ sa,

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: na bɛbayɛ ngoane nee ɛ kɔme ndweabane.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Saa ɛtɛnla aze a, ɛnrɛzulo, yɛɛ saa ɛda a, wɔ nafelɛ bayɛ wɔ fɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Anyezota ba arɛlevilɛ nu a, mmasulo, yɛɛ saa amumuyɛma ɛzɛkyelɛ mekɛ ne dwu a, mmasulo,

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo; ɔnrɛmaa ɛnrɛdo ɛhane.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Saa ɛyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ a, yɛ menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ bɛ boɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ gɔnwo mɔɔ ɛ nee ye zua bane, na yeva ɔ rɛle yewula wɔ nuhua la anwo adwenle ɛtane.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee awie biala mɔɔ ɛtɛyɛle wɔ ɛtane la mmadi butule.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo awie mɔɔ kulo konle la, yɛɛ mmayɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ la bie,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi sonla mɔɔ ɛnli boɛ la, na ɔmaa mɔɔ di boɛ la nwu ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma maa munzule tɔ amumuyɛma awuke nu, na ɔyila tenlenema awuke.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmbu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu debie la bie, na ɔ nye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la anwo zo.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛbali bɛ eni, na ahoasea anyunlu bagua aze.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: O me mra mrenya, bɛdie bɛ ze ngilehilelɛ na bɛva bɛzie boɛ, amaa bɛanyia ndelebɛbo,

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ melɛmaa bɛ mɛla kpalɛ, bɛmmakpo me ngilehilelɛ ne.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ mele kakula na me nee egya de, mele ekyi bie, na me ngome a ɔmɔ anye die me nwo la,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: egya hilehilele me, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sɔ me nloa edwɛkɛ nu boɛ kpalɛ, di me mɛla zo na wɔanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi, yɛɛ mmakpo me nloa edwɛkɛ. Nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na nyia ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Mmakpo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbazie wɔ boɛ; kulo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbazinza wɔ.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛnwunlɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ a le ɛhye: Nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛnyia ye la, nyia ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Kulo nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔbamaa wɔayɛ sonlakpole; die ye ɛ sa amu nwiɔ, na ɔbamaa wɔanyia ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba abɔtile kɛnlɛma nee belemgbunli kyɛlɛ kɛnlɛma wɔ ɛ ti zo.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, tie na die me edwɛkɛ ne to nu, amaa wɔanyi wɔahyɛ.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mehile wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ndenle ne mɔ; meva wɔ melua tenlene ndenle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Saa ɛlɛtia a ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛdo ɛnrɛbɛka nu, yɛɛ saa ɛlɛnriandi a ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛkpula.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Sɔ folɛdulɛ nu boɛ, mmagyakyi nuhua, sie ye boɛ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ azo yɛɛ wɔ ngoane gyi a.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Mmafa amumuyɛma adenle nu, yɛɛ mmafa ɛtanema adenle nu.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Kpo zɔhane adenle ne bɔkɔɔ, mmafa zolɛ ɛlɛ. Kakyi ɛ nzi si adenle zɔhane na pɛ nuhua kɔ,

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ fa zɔhane adenle zo la ɛnla kyesɛ bɛli ɛtane. Saa bɛtɛmanle awie ɛtɛtule koti a, bɛngola da,

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Tenlenema adenle nu le wienyi kɛ nwonlomɔ sɛnzɛne mɔɔ kɛkpuke la, ɔfi, ɔta toonwo ɔyɛ kɛ sɛnzɛngyinla ewia.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma adenle nu le awozinli kabii, bɛlua nu na bɛkpula a bɛnnwu ye.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, tie me edwɛkɛ ne boɛ; yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie mɔɔ meka la.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Mmamaa bɛminli wɔ adwenle nu; fa sie wɔ ahonle nu.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛle ngoane bɛmaa sonla ne mɔɔ kɛnwu bɛ la, na bɛle ayileyɛlɛ bɛmaa ye nwonane ne.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ ɛsi ɛdwenle la boɛ, ɔluakɛ nuhua yɛɛ wɔ ngoane vi ba a.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Mmaka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ la, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ nloa fula adalɛ edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Nea ɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ ɛnea debie a nea ye boɛ.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ ɛsi ɛtudu ɛ gyakɛ la, amaa wɔ adwenle azi pi wɔ wɔ ndenle nu.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Mmatɔ ɛkɔ fema zo anzɛɛ bɛne zo; twe ɛ gyakɛ fi ɛtane adenle zo.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, tie me nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ne na wɔanwu kɛ me ndelebɛbo si kɔ la,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: amaa wɔanwu kɛ ɛsi wɔabɔ wɔ ɛbɛla ne kpalɛ la, na wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ ahile kɛ ɛlɛ adwenle.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ raalɛ mgbane biala anloa anu yɛ fɛ kɛ wolɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛdendɛlɛ fie tɛla ɛdɔkɛ,

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: noko awieleɛ ne ye ɛnwonle tɛla baka subo, yɛɛ ɔ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ anye nwiɔ.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ɔ gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ twehwe sonla kɔ ewule nu; sonla fa ye adenle zo a, ɔ nee ye dwu Ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Ɔndwenle ngoane adenle nwo; ye ndenle ɛngɔ fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ ɔlɛminli a ɔnnwu ye.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: O me mra mrenya, bɛdie me, bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ melɛka la.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi raalɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la anwo! Bɛmmabikye ye sua ne anuhɔlɛ bɔbɔ,

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛkɛminli bɛ anyunlunyia bɛkɛmaa awie mɔ kɛva, na bɛ ngoane zo kɛde wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze anwunvɔne la asa anu;

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ nyɛvolɛ kɛva bɛ anwonyia, na bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛvɛ bɛhyehyɛ la apɛ ali nyɛvolɛ asa anu.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Akee awieleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ kɛwie, bɛ nwonane kɛwie, na bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛlɛba awieleɛ la, ɛnee yedo bɛ nee ɛkponlenlɛ.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Meandie me kilehilevolɛma ane, yɛɛ meanyɛ ɛnzonlɛ meandie folɛdulɛ.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menwunle ye la a le kɛ, menli ne yiale la, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ na me nyunlu agua aze.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: No ɛdawɔ wɔ buakɛ nu nzule. No ɛdawɔ wɔ bula nu nzule.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Asoo ɛbakponle wɔamaa awie aza wɔ bula nu nzule ado agua mgbane wɔ gua zo?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Maa ɔyɛ ɛ ngome wɔ ɛdeɛ, mmamaa ɔyɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ de la ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ kɛ weɛlɛ belɛ. Maa ɛ nye ɛlie ye anwofɛlɛko ne anwo mekɛ biala, na maa ye ɛhulolɛ ne ɛli ɛ ti.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, duzu ati a ɛkɛmaa raalɛ mgbane biala ɛhulolɛ kɛli ɛ ti, na ɛkɛdɔ raalɛ wɔlɔkavolɛ akɛnra anu ɛ?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla nrenya biala ɛbɛlabɔlɛ la Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ ɔneɛnlea sonla ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli biala ninyɛndane kakyi ɛhane kye ye, yɛɛ ɔkye ye wɔ ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ye koasea ti, ɔminli, yɛɛ ɔnde folɛ la ati, ɔwu ndɛ.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, saa wɔli ɛ gɔnwo bie agyinlanu, wɔva debie wɔwula awoba wɔ ɛyɛvolɛ bie ati,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: saa ɛ nloa ɛvula edwɛkɛ bie na yehwe dwɛwɔlɛ yemaa wɔ a,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ɛnee me ra nrenya, yɛ ɛhye die ɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ wɔva ɛ nwo wɔdo ɛ gɔnwo ne ɛhane nu: ka ɛ nwo kɔ na kɔbodo ɛ gɔnwo ne.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Mmada ɛdafe anzɛɛ mmamuomua ɛ nye ɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Die ɛ nwo kɛ weɛlɛ die ɔ nwo fi bɔvolɛ sa nu la, anzɛɛ kɛ anloma die ɔ nwo fi mɔɔ sua nlomangane la asa anu la.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: O mgbovonle, kɔ ngyigyilira ɛkɛ ne, kɔnlea ye ndenle ne mɔ na sukoa nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Ants don't have leaders,
translation_verse: Bɛnlɛ belemgbunli, bɛnlɛ maanle kpanyinli anzɛɛ maanlebuvolɛ biala,

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ mgbovonle, ɛda wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu? Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛvi nafelɛ nu ɛkɛdwazo a?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Nla ekyi, ngɔsɔkɛbɔlɛ ɛkyi, bɛ sa tobɛkanu ekyi kɛ ɛdie wɔ ɛnwomenle,

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: ɛkanwu ye la ɛnee ehyia ɛyɛ kɛ awule, ɛva wɔ aze, na ɛ nwo ɛhyele wɔ kɛ ɛgyi konle nloa.

english_verse: Worthless liars go around
translation_verse: Sonla mgbane, amumuyɛnli, ɔlua a ɔtendɛ mgbane mgbane,

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: ɔnwosonwoso ɔ nye, ɔsisi ɔ gyakɛ aze, ɔtende ɔ sa,

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane, ɔsie munzule, na ɔtwehwe manzonle ɔto menli avinli.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Yemɔti munzule bado ye arɛlevilɛ nu; ɔkanwu ye la ɛnee bɛbubu ye kɛ abua, ɛsisia ye zolɛ a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Fa bɛ sie wɔ ahonle nu dahuu; kyekye bɛ kenda ɛ kɔme.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Bɛbali ɛ nyunlu wɔ wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nu, ɛda a bɛbazinza wɔ, yɛɛ ɛdwazo a bɛbadendɛ bɛahile wɔ,

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ mɛla ne le kɛnlaneɛ, ngilehilelɛ ne le wienyi, yɛɛ ahwibɛnyunlu ne kile ɛbɛlabɔlɛ adenle.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Bɛtwe wɔ bɛfi raalɛ munzule ne, raalɛ kpamgbanvolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne anwo.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Mmanea ye anwofɛlɛko ne anwo ɛkulo ye, yɛɛ mmamaa ɔ nye anzi enrinli ne di wɔ adwenle,

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ tuutuu biala, bɛfa kpanwo kunguma ko ala a bɛbɔ ye ɛkpa a, na awuvolɛ raalɛ ɛvalɛ kpokpo nrenya ku ye.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Asoo sonla bahola avula samɛnlakɛ agua ɔ kɛnra azo, mɔɔ ye tɛladeɛ ne ɛnrɛyela a?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ asoo sonla bahola atietia samɛnlakɛ zo, mɔɔ ɔ gyakɛ ɛnrɛyela a?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ gɔnwo aye la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ ɛnrɛhɔ a.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Asoo ɛhɔne ɛlɛku sonla, na ɔkɔwua debie ɔdi a, menli ɛmkpo ye ɔ?

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛkye ye a asoo bɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛdua ye mɔnwo nsuu ɔ? Ɔbahwe ye sua nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti yeahɔdua.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa awuvolɛ raalɛ la ɛnlɛ adwenle; sonla mɔɔ yɛ ɛhye la sɛkye ɔ nwo.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ɔ nyunlu bagua aze, ɔ nwo ayɛ nganlɛ, na ye anyiemgba doa ye dahuu,

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ nungule maa sonla fa ɛya kpole, yɛɛ saa ɔlɛdi nzenralɛ noko a anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛlie mgbɔdalɛ biala, yɛɛ ɛkyɛ ye ninyɛne mɔnwo mɔnwo bɔbɔ a ɔ kunlu ɛnrɛdwo.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, di me edwɛkɛ zo na fa me mɛla ne mɔ sie boɛ.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Di me mɛla zo na nyia ngoane. Sie me ngilehilelɛ ne kɛ ɛ nye kuduarizi.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Fa kyekye ɛ sa mrɛlɛsɛka ne mɔ, kɛlɛ bɛ wɔ wɔ ahonle zo.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Ka kile nrɛlɛbɛ kɛ, “Ɛle me diema raalɛ,” na fɛlɛ adwenlenunwunlɛ kɛ ɔle ɛ gɔnwo kpalɛ kpalɛ;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: amaa bɛalie wɔ bɛavi raalɛ mgbane ne asa anu, raalɛ wɔlɔkavolɛ anloa anu menlemenle ne asa anu. Raalɛ adwɔmanenli

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Kenle ko, ɛnee megyi me nvɛnzɛlɛ ne anu me nye dua alie nwo lɔ,

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee aleɛ ɛlɛdwo na maanle nu ɛyɛ yɛɛnye, asɛɛ awozinli ɛra bɔbɔ.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Na nea, raalɛ bie mɔɔ ɛheda ye ɛdanlɛ kɛ tuutuu, na yeyɛ ye adwenle kɛ ɔbɛlɛbɛla ye yeahwe ye yeahɔ la yiale ye.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne le sonla mɔɔ ɛndɛnla ye sua nu yɛɛ ɔtendɛ kpukpakpukpa.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Ɔzɔle kpavolɛ ne, ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo, na ɔyɛle ɔ nyunlu monvoo ɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ azu, na ɛnɛ meye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ amuala;

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: yemɔti kɛkala mera kɛ akee mebayia wɔ. Meyɛ kɛ mebakpondɛ wɔ yɛɛ meranwu wɔ a.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Metoto me ɛkpa ne mewie, meva Yigyibiti lenen ɛdanlɛ kpalɛ mezɛ zolɛ.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Meva alufuanlɛ, kolɔbo, yɛɛ baka evuanlɛ senamɔn meyɛ sua ne anu mukumuku zɛhae.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Bɛla maa yɛlie yɛ nye, yɛhulo yɛ nwo toonwo alehyenlɛ.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Me hu ɛnle sua nu; yedu adenle yehɔ moa.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ la ɔvale ezukoa dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ siane ye bahɔ awozinli na yeara.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ɔvale anloa anu menlemenle nee ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ɔlile ye adwenle.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔlile ɔ nzi ɔ nee ye hɔle kɛ asɛɛ ɛnlankɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ, anzɛɛ kɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ bɛhye ye ɛhane nu

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: toonwo na ɛda kɛwɔ ye kɛtulu ye anyalɛ la. Kɛ anloma si tu faa kɔtɔ ɛhane nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔyɛle a; yeandwenle nwolɛ kɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la kɛwie ye ewule.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Akee kɛkala, me mra mrenya, bɛdie me, na bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle kɔ ye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ zo, yɛɛ bɛmmaminli bɛfa ye adenle zo ɛlɛ,

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛgua ye ɛhane nu la ɛyɛ mgbane; menli mɔɔ yehu bɛ la zonle kpalɛ.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ Adenle la ye sua nu ɛkɛ, ɔla nu kpolomgbolo ɔdwu ewule suakunlu.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Bɛdie, nrɛlɛbɛ ɛlɛfɛlɛ, ndelebɛbo ɛmaa ɔ ne zo ɛlɛfɛlɛ.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Ɔgyi adehane awoka ne mɔ azo, ɔgyi ndenle ngyikyi ne mɔ anu ɔlɛfɛlɛ;

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: ɔlɛfɛlɛ wɔ sua ne azo nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa, ɔtea nu kpole kpalɛ wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ anloa kɛ,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “O menli, melɛfɛlɛ bɛ, melɛfɛlɛ dasanli biala.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛtɛtinle a, bɛzukoa nrɛlɛbɛ; O menli ahoasea, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, ɔluakɛ meka edwɛkɛ kɛnlɛma; mɔɔ vi me nloa anu bavinde la le kpalɛ,

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ mebaha nɔhalɛ ne; me nloa kyi amumuyɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhehanlɛ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ vi me nloa anu la le tenlene edwɛkɛ; adalɛ ɛnle nu anzɛɛ abɛladolɛ ɛnle nu.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Ɔle fɔɔnwo ɔmaa mɔɔ te ɔ bo la, yɛɛ ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa mɔɔ kpondɛ adwenlenubukelɛ la.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Fa me ngilehilelɛ ne na gyakyi dwɛtɛ fufule, fa adwenlenubukelɛ na gyakyi ezukoa nvutuke tagyee.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: “Nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla mgbɔba, debie biala mɔɔ ɛkulo kɛ ɛnyia ye la nee ye ɛnzɛ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Medame nrɛlɛbɛ, menwu adwenle biala anu, melɛ adwenlenubukelɛ yɛɛ adwenle la me ɛdendɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le ɛtane ɛhyilɛ. Mekyi adubɛnwo, mekyi mgbanyizonle, mekyi ɛdendɛlɛ adalɛ.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Metu folɛ, mekile nrɛlɛbɛ adenle kpalɛ, melɛ ndelebɛbo yɛɛ me nwo yɛ se.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Me nwo zo yɛɛ arelemgbunli dua bu maanle, na bɛdi mɛla mɔɔ le tenlene la a.

english_verse: Every honest leader rules with help from me.
translation_verse: Me nwo zo yɛɛ maanle mgbanyinli dua bu maanle, na amɛnladoma dua sie ewiade ye a.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Mekulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo me la, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye bolo bɛkpondɛ me la nwu me.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Anwonyia nee enililɛ le me ɛdeɛ, memaa ɛkpazilɛ nee bɛ nwo ɛnyianlɛ di munli.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Meso ma a ɔsonle bolɛ ɔtɛla ezukoa nvutuke tagyee, me nzoleɛ sonle bolɛ tɛla dwɛtɛ fufule tagyee.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Medua tenleneyɛlɛ adenle nu, medua pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle nu.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Memaa menli mɔɔ kulo me la nyia bɛ nwo, na memaa bɛ gya nu yɛ ɛnlomboɛ.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: “Medame a Ɛdɛnkɛma lumuale bɔle me a, medame a mɔmoane mɔmoane mele ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ lumua a.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle me dɛbadɛba wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ, kolaa na ewiade abɔ ɔ bo.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ buma ɛnle ɛkɛ ne la yɛɛ bɛwole me a, mɔɔ nzubula ɛnle ɛkɛ la yɛɛ bɛwole me a.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Bɛwole me kolaa na bɛabɔ awoka mgbole ne mɔ, bɛwole me kolaa na awoka ngyikyi aragyinlegyinla bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Bɛwole me kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma abɔ ewiade nee kpɔkɛ, kolaa na yeabɔ azɛlɛ.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔ anwumaneamra, mɔɔ ɔpɛ kondongolohwio wɔ azubuma nye la, mewɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkabɔ anwomanyunlu amungu ne mɔ, mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkabɔ buma nu nzule mgbole ne mɔ,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: mekɛ mɔɔ ɔgya nyevile ne ɛweɛne, amaa nuhua nzule ambulu ye mɛla zo, mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwula azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze la,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: ɛnee me nee ye a lua a, kɛ mele dwinvolɛ mɔɔ medi me ti anwo; memaa ɔ nye die dahuu, yɛɛ dahuu biala me nye die wɔ ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Me nye die ye ewiade ye mɔɔ nuhua ɛyɛ gbudugbudu, yɛɛ me nye die menli nwo.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Na kɛkala, me mra mrenya, bɛdie me; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa me ndenle zo la di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Bɛdie folɛdulɛ na bɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛmmakpo mɔɔ bɛkilehile bɛ la.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tie me ne, mɔɔ dahuu gyi me nlenkɛ mgbole nloa, na ɔkendɛ me wɔ me anuhɔlɛ la bali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kpondɛ me la nyia ngoane, yɛɛ ɔsɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye;

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: na mɔɔ asa kɛhoati me la baboda; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la amuala kulo ewule.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzi ye sua na yedwazo mpila nsuu yesosɔ ye.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Yehu ye nane ne mɔ, yefonlɔfonla ye nwanye ne na yedo ye ɛkponle ne yewie.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Akee yezoa ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛhɔgyinlegyinla mgbata ne mɔ azo na bɛdea nuhua bɛvɛlɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la, bɛrɛla ɛke!” Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ adwenle la, ɔse bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Bɛrɛla, bɛrali me aleɛ ne na bɛnlo me nwanye mɔɔ meli ye afonla la.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛtɛtinle la mmatu, na bɛanyia ngoane; bɛva adwenle bɛdo bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ twi sonlamgbane nyunlu la die aholoba, yɛɛ mɔɔ twi sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la anyunlu la boda.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Mmatwi sonla mɔɔ bu ɔ nwo bie la anyunlu, anrɛɛ ɔkɛhyi wɔ. Twi sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la anyunlu, na ɔbahulo wɔ edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Tu sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la folɛ, na ye nrɛlɛbɛ bayɛ kpole; kilehile sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la, na ye adwenle badi kpalɛ.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzukoalɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ, yɛɛ ɛnwu Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a, ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo,

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔlua nrɛlɛbɛ zo yɛɛ wɔ mekɛ bawa na wɔanyia ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo wɔaboka wɔ ngoane mekɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Saa ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a, ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ ɛmaa ɛ nwo; saa ɛtendɛ mgbane mgbane a, nwolɛ ɛzonle ne zo ɛdawɔ ɛ ngome.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Raalɛ koasea tendɛ mgbane mgbane, ɔnli ɔ nwo eni, yɛɛ ɔnze nyiane.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ɔdwazo a ɔtɛnla ye sua ne anlenkɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ sua ne azo mgbata ne mɔ azo,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: ɔfɛlɛvɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛse, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛlɛdwenle bɛ nwo la kɛ,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle la ɛrɛla ɛke!” Na yeaha yeahile mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɛ,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Awule nzule yɛ fɛ, na aleɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvea bɛkɛli la yɛ fɛ somaa.”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Mrenya mɔɔ kɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la ɛnze kɛ bɛkɔ ye ɛkɛ ne a bɛnzia, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛhɔ ye ɛkɛ ne la wɔ Ɛbolɔ sua zo.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔbule la ɛne: Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze anye die, yɛɛ ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ nli di nyane.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Nvasoɛ biala ɛnle anwonyia mɔɔ sonla kɛlua amumuyɛ zo kɛnyia ye la azo, tenleneyɛlɛ die sonla fi ewule nu.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmmaa ɛhɔne ɛngu sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la, na ɔsɛkye amumuyɛnli ne anyebolo anwonyia ɛkpondɛlɛ.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Ehyia ku mgbovonle, yɛɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ ɛyɛlɛ maa sonla nyia ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la nyia nyilalɛ. Amumuyɛnli anloa edwɛkɛ kedɛheda ye kɔdiawu ɛbɛla zo.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Tenlenema ɛhakyelɛ le nyilalɛ, na amumuyɛnli duma baminli.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la di mɛla zo, na koasea ɛdendɛzoma fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa nɔhalɛlilɛ dua la anwo kɔlɔnwo, na sonla mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛtane dua la anwo bala zo.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bu anyehoanlɛ la twe dwɛwɔlɛ ba, na mɔɔ buke ye munli nu tendɛ la fa anzonudwolɛ ba.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, na amumuyɛnli anloa edwɛkɛ kedɛheda ye kɔdiawu ɛbɛla zo.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ɛkpɔlɛ twehwe konle, na ɛhulolɛ kedɛheda nvonleɛ kɔsɔɔti azo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ɛdendɛlɛ nu, na sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la anzi fɛta empele.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la lɛ adwenle, na koasea mɔɔ tendɛ kpukpakpukpa la twe munzule ba.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Sukoavolɛ anwonyia le ye aranemgbole mɔɔ yɛ se; ehyia sɛkye ehyianli.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ahatualɛ a le ngoane, na amumuyɛnli nvasoɛ a le ɛtane.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la lua ngoane adenle nu, na mɔɔ kpo ahwibɛnyunlu la minli.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Sonla biala mɔɔ fea ɛkpɔlɛ zo la le adalɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ le ngunzi la le koasea.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Saa ɛdendɛlɛ so somasoma a, mɛladonlɛ ɛnli mgbanwo, na mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nloa la ze nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le dwɛtɛ fufule kpalɛ; amumuyɛnli adwenle nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ biala.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ maa menli dɔɔnwo nyia aleɛ di, na ahoasea wu, ɔluakɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nyilalɛ maa sonla nyia ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔnva nyanelilɛ biala ɔmboka nwolɛ.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Koasea yɛ debie ɛtane a ɔfa ye nwɔhoalilɛ, na nrɛlɛbɛ nyɛleɛ maa sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ amumuyɛnli sulo ye la bara ɔ nwo zo, na sonlakpalɛ biala nyia debie mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Saa ahumu ne tu se a, amumuyɛnli ne ɛnle ɛkɛ ne bieko, na sonlakpalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Kɛ nzanvinli si nyia egyele, nee kɛ esike si dɔ ɛnyelɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mgbovonle de maa menli mɔɔ soa ye la a.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la lɛ ngoane tendenle, na amumuyɛma mekɛ le ezinraa.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ anyelazo wie fɛlɛkolilɛ nu, na amumuyɛma anyelazo le mgbane.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le ɛvealeka kpole maa sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la, na ɔsɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛtane la.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛdu tenlenema ɛlɛ, na amumuyɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ɛdendɛlɛ fa nrɛlɛbɛ ba, na sonla mɔɔ tendɛ mgbane mgbane la bɛbaye ye zo.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Tenlenema ze mɔɔ bɛka a menli die to nu la, na amumuyɛma ka mɔɔ futu ahonle la.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi tone mɔɔ bɛwua nu la, na ɔ nye die tone mɔɔ bɛnwua nu la anwo.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Saa adubɛnwo yɛ kpole a, anyiemgba a li ɔ nzi a; na mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la nwu nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ biala nɔhalɛlilɛ a sinza ye a, na asiayɛ biala ngunziyɛlɛ sɛkye ye.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Anwonyia nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ wɔ ɛya kenle ne anu, na tenleneyɛlɛ die sonla fi ewule nu.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛlilɛ maa sonlakpalɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ toa zo fɔɔnwo, na amumuyɛnli amumuyɛ bu sia ye.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ tenleneyɛlɛ die ye fi munzule nu, na ngunzinli atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane kye ye nuokɛ.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Saa amumuyɛnli wu a, ye anyelazo minli, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anyelazo ɛnyɛ zɔ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Bɛdie tenlenenli ne bɛfi ngyegyelɛ nu, na amumuyɛnli ne tɔ nu.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la fa ɔ nloa sɛkye ɔ gɔnwo, na tenlenema fa adwenle die bɛ nwo.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Saa ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa tenlenenli a, suakpole ne azo amra amuala anye die, na saa amumuyɛnli wu a, zolɛ le fɛlɛkolilɛ ngome.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Tenlenema nyilalɛ kpogya suakpole zo, na amumuyɛma anloa bɔ suakpole.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛmbu ɔ gɔnwo bie la ɛnlɛ adwenle, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ka ɔ nloa to nu.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Maanle mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ye sinzavolɛ la ɛngyɛ na abɔ; na maanle mɔɔ folɛdulɛma dɔɔnwo wɔ nu la, anwondɔlɛ wɔ nu.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu la bavu ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ kyi agyinlanulilɛ la anwo tɔ ye.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Raalɛ mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni la, bɛdi ye eni, yɛɛ mrenya mɔɔ kulo konle la nyia bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ atiakunlu le kpalɛ la nyia ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne azo nvasoɛ, na atisesebɛnli ne boda ɔ ngome ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli ahatualɛ ɛngyinla, na sonla mɔɔ dua tenleneyɛlɛ ma la nyia ahatualɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ gyi kpundii wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nu la banyia ngoane, na mɔɔ di ɛtaneyɛlɛ nzi la bawu.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi menli mɔɔ lɛ adwenle ɛtane la, na ɔ nye die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la anwo.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Nwu ye kɛ sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ tenlene ɛbɛla la anwo bavi nu.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Raalɛ anwofɛlɛko mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔdelera wɔ kpolike bonyi nu.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ tenlenenli kpondɛ la wie boɛ; mɔɔ amumuyɛnli anye la zo la wie ɛya nu.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Sonla ne bie buke ɔ sa nu fa maa, noko ɔnyia ɔ nwo; bie noko ɛnva ɛhwee ɛmmaa, noko ɔdi ehyia.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ buke ye ahonle nu fa maa la banyia ɔ nwo, yɛɛ mɔɔ yɛ ahunlunyele la, bɛnwu ye anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ye abɛlɛ bɔ abokɛ la, menli wa ye amonle, na mɔɔ fa ye ma finde tɔne ye la nyia nyilalɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ pele kpondɛ kpalɛ bo zo la nyia ɔ nyunlu, yɛɛ munzule to mɔɔ kpondɛ munzule bo zo la.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula ye anwonyia nu la babɔ aze, na mɔɔ le tenlene la bayɛ duhuduhu kɛ nya amolɛ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ gyegye ye awuke nu amra la bali anwoma agya, yɛɛ koasea bayɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ sonvolɛ.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Ma mɔɔ tenlenenli so la le ngoane, na sonla mɔɔ to nzaka la kuhu menli.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Saa bɛbadua tenlenenli kakɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo a, ɛnee kɛ amumuyɛma nee ɛtanema kɛzi kɛwie ye ɛ!

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ biala sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye, na ɔtea sonla mɔɔ bɔ adwenle ɛtane la.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛ sonla ɛmkpazi, na sonla tenlene sɔ ndinli, ɛtu ye a ɔndu.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Yelɛ kpalɛ le ɔ hu kyɛlɛ zo kpɔba, na yelɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɔ hu anyiemgba la le ewule wɔ ɔ hu mbowule nu.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli biala adwenle le fɔɔnwo; amumuyɛnli folɛdulɛ le mɛlɛbɛla.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli edwɛkɛ kɔ mogyahanlɛ nwo nzia, na sonla mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la anloa edwɛkɛ die menli ngoane.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma badu agua, bɛ bo zo aminli, na tenlenema awuke bagyinla.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Sonla adwenle kpalɛ yɛɛ bɛfa bɛkanvo ye a, na sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛnle kpalɛ la, bɛkpo ye.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Sonla bɛlɛvo mɔɔ yɛ ɔ ti anwo gyima la le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo na ɔ nloa anu aleɛ bɔ ye la.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Sonla tenlene biala dwenle ye nyɛmoa nwo, na amumuyɛnli anwunvɔnezelɛ le atisesebɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ so ɛya la nyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nzi la ɛnlɛ adwenle.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli tawa mɔɔ gyi kpundii la bubu gua, na tenlenenli sɔ ndinli gyinla kpundii.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Ɛtanenli anloa edwɛkɛ kakyi ɛhane kye ye, na tenlenenli ye ɔ nwo fi ngyegyelɛ nu.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ maa ɔnyia debie kpalɛ, ɔ kunlu dwo ɔ nwo, yɛɛ sonla biala asa anloa gyima sia ba ye ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Koasea biala adenle le kpalɛ wɔ ɔdaye ɔ nye zo, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ biala tie folɛdulɛ.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Koasea ɛyavalɛ da ali ndɛndɛ, na badwemafo ɛndwenle aholoba ɛbɔlɛ nwo.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ka nɔhalɛ la daselɛlilɛ le fɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di dasewia la bɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Sonla ne bie anloa edwɛkɛ wowɔ kɛ dadeɛ, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ le ayile.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ gyi kpundii mekɛ biala, edwɛkɛ adalɛ ɛngyɛ na yeaminli.

english_verse: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane la bɔ adalɛ, na menli mɔɔ dwenle adwenle kpalɛ la anye die.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛndo tenlenenli biala, na amumuyɛnli anwo lɛ edwɛkɛ ngome.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi menli mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la, na ɔ nye die menli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Badwemafo ɛnva mɔɔ ɔze ye la ɛndu ɔ nwo, na ahoasea bɔ bɛ koasea ne nolo.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kola gyima yɛ la sie maanle, yɛɛ mgbovonle yɛ mianlera nu gyima.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Adwenleadwenle maa sonla yɛ basaa, na edwɛkɛ kpalɛ maa sonla di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ biala twe ɔ nwo fi ɛtane nwo, na amumuyɛnli adenle maa ɔminli.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle sonla biala ɛnrɛnyia mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, na mɔɔ anye bolo yɛ gyima la nyia ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Tenleneyɛlɛ le ngoane adenle, yɛɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ adenle wie ewule.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Kakula nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ tie ɔ ze ngilehilelɛ, na mgbanyizonle biala ɛndie ahwibɛnyunlu.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ maa ɔdi ninyɛne kpalɛ, na mɔɔ ngunzinli kpondɛ la a le konle.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ sinza ɔ nloa la sinza ye ngoane, yɛɛ mɔɔ buke ɔ nloa mgbane mgbane la yia munzule.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle sonla biala akunlu anu a anrɛɛ, noko ɔnnyia ɛhwee; na mɔɔ anye bolo yɛ gyima la nyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli kyi adalɛbɔlɛ, na amumuyɛnli yɛ ye ninyɛne anyiemgba nu.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Tenleneyɛlɛ sinza mɔɔ di boɛ la, yɛɛ ɛtane bu sia amumuyɛnli.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Sonla ne bie yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ yenyia ɔ nwo, noko ɔnlɛ ɛhwee; bie noko yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnlɛ bie, noko yenyia ɔ nwo kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ sonla fa kpɔne ɔ nwo fi ɛbɛlabɔlɛ awoba nu la a le ye anwonyia, na ehyianli ɛnlɛ bie mɔɔ ɔfa ɔdie ɔ nwo a.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli wienyi ta kpole kpalɛ; amumuyɛnli kɛnlaneɛ ɛngyɛ na anlu.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnde folɛ la mgbanyizonle ne fa ye kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, na mɔɔ te folɛ la ze nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Anyiabɛnwo ndɛndɛ wie ndɛndɛ azebɔlɛ, na mɔɔ kuohua ye ngyikyi ngyikyi la nyia bie dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Anyelazo kyɛ a, ɔyɛ anwobubulɛ; na ɛnyia ye a ɔyɛ anyelielɛ.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kpo folɛdulɛ la fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu, na mɔɔ di mɛla zo la banyia nwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ngilehilelɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, amaa mɔɔ tie la abɔ ahoane ewule ngane ne mɔ.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Adwenle kpalɛ ɛvalɛ maa sonla sɔ ɛnyelɛ, na mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ adwenle bɛto ɔ nwo zo a ɔnyɛ boɛ la adenle kɔ munzule nu.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Badwemafo fa adwenle yɛ ye debie biala, na koasea ye ye koasea ne kile.
