english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Soanvolɛ ɛtane fa menli kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, yɛɛ ɛbɔfoɔ kpalɛ fa anzonudwolɛ ba.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnde folɛ la di ehyia na ɔbɔ anyiemgba, na mɔɔ kponle zo maa bɛtwi ɔ nyunlu la nyia ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Saa ɛkpondɛ na ɛnyia ye a ɔmaa anwondɔlɛ, na ɔle bɛkyi ɔmaa ahoasea kɛ bɛkɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛkɛvi ɛtane nwo.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma tu la nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, na mɔɔ nee ahoasea tu la nwu ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Munzule tu ɛtanevolɛma mgbaliko, yɛɛ ɛkpazilɛ le tenlenema ahatualɛ.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ gyakyi ye nlɔnra agyadeɛ, na ɛtanenli anwonyia wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa tenlenema.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ehyianli azɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛla kɛhyɛ la maa ɔnyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, noko amile nu ala bɛsa ye bɛdie.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛngulo ɔ ra la kyi kɛ ɔkɛdea ye, na mɔɔ kulo ɔ ra la anye bolo tea ye.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli lɛ mɔɔ sa ye di la; amumuyɛnli ako ɛnyi ɛlɛ.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Raalɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ kyekye awuke, na raalɛ koasea bɔ awuke.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dua pɛlepɛle adenle nu la sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, na mɔɔ ye ndenle nu kyeɛhyea la kpo ye.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Koasea anloa edwɛkɛ maa ɔdie mbaka, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anloa sinza ye.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ nlankɛ nyinli ɛnle la, abɛlɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ, aleɛ dɔɔnwo ɛnyianlɛ vi ɛnlankɛ nyinli anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Dasevolɛ nɔhavo ɛmbɔ adalɛ, na mɔɔ di dasewia la edwɛkɛ le adalɛ ngome.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwo sonla ɛnnwu nrɛlɛbɛ ɛlɛ, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la lɛ adwenle.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee koasea mmatu, ɔluakɛ ɛnrɛde nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnrɛvi ye ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Badwemafo nrɛlɛbɛ maa ɔnwu ye adenle nu boɛ, na ahoasea nrɛlɛbɛ le mɛlɛbɛla.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛmbu amumuyɛma, na mɔɔ di boɛ la sɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Ahonle a ze ɔdaye ye nyane mɔɔ ɔdi la a, yɛɛ ɔlɛdi fɛlɛko a awie gyɛne ɛnli bie.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli awuke babɔ, na mɔɔ di boɛ la awuke bagyinla.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Adenle ne bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne a ɔle kpalɛ wɔ sonla nye zo, na ye awieleɛ wie ewule.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɛzelekɛ nu bɔbɔ, ahonle ne di nyane; anyelielɛ awieleɛ wie nyanelilɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle la die debie biala di, na badwemafo nea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlɛtudu ɔ gyakɛ yeahɔ la.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nea boɛ na ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi munzule nwo, na koasea ɛndwenle ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔle mgbaha.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle bikye ye la yɛ ye debie koasea nu, na sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la lɛ abotane.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Ɛtanema bɔ bɛ ti aze wɔ kpalɛma anyunlu, yɛɛ amumuyɛma dwu tenlenema anyunlu a bɛtoto bɛ nwo aze.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ehyianli biala anwo amra bɔbɔ ɛngulo ye, noko sukoavolɛ lɛ agɔnwolɛma dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kpo ɔ gɔnwo la le ɛtanevolɛ; nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ adwenle ɛtane la yɛ ɛtane; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kpalɛ la menli bu bɛ yɛɛ bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛkile bɛ.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Nvasoɛ wɔ gyimayɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti azo, na ɛdendɛlɛ mgbane maa bɛdi ehyia.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma abɔtile a le bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ, na ahoasea kɔme ndweabane a le bɛ koasea.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ di daselɛ nɔhalɛ nu la die ngoane, na mɔɔ bɔ adalɛ la le maamɔvo.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la arɛle gyi pi wɔ ye nu, yɛɛ ɔ mra nyia ɛvealeka wɔ Nyamenle anu.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea, amaa sonla abɔ ahoane ewule ngane ne mɔ.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli biala anyunlunyia a le ye menli ne dɔɔnwo, belemgbunli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ menli la nwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɔkyɛ na yeava ɛya la ndelebɛbo le kpole, na mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na ye ahonle afutu la maa ye koaseayɛlɛ yɛ kpole.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Anzonudwolɛ maa nwonane ba bɛ nwo, na nyanenwunlɛ maa bɛkakyi mbowule.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ sisi ehyianli la tindi ye Bɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, na mɔɔ nwu mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwunvɔne la di ye Bɔvolɛ ne eni.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ maa ɔkpo aze, na tenlenenli nyia ɛvealeka wɔ ye nɔhalɛlilɛ nwo.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la ze nrɛlɛbɛ, ahoasea ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ deɛ holɛ.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Tenleneyɛlɛ kpogya maanle zo, yɛɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ gua maanle biala anyunlu aze.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ mɔɔ bɔ ye ɛbɛla nrɛlɛbɛ nu la sɔ belemgbunli anye, belemgbunli anyebolo wɔ mɔɔ bɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla la anwo zo.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Nyelebɛnloa bɛtɛɛ maa ɛya dwo, na ɛdendɛlɛ katekate ka ɛya.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anloa edwɛkɛ maa adwenle, na koasea ka ngoaseasɛm.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ ɛleka biala, ɔnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le ɛtane la amuala.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ le ngoane baka, na amumuyɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ku sunsum.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Koasea kpo ɔ ze ngilehilelɛ, na badwemafo kulo folɛdulɛ.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Anwonyia dɔɔnwo wɔ tenlenenli sua nu; amumuyɛnli anwonyia nwo lɛ munzule.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ɛdendɛlɛ maa adwenle tende. Ahoasea adwenle ɛnle zɔhane.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli azubɔlɛ le kyibadeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma; Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die sonla mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la nzɛlɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma adenle ne le kyibadeɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔkulo mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle nzi la.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kpo adenle la, bɛtea ye kpole kpalɛ; mɔɔ kyi ndeanlɛ la bawu.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ nee Abɛdɛn gua ɛkɛ ne wienyi wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu; mɔɔ vea ahonle nu la ɛnvea Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwo sonla biala ɛngulo folɛdulɛ; ɔyɛ se kɛ ɔkɛhɔ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛkolilɛ maa sonla nyunlu yɛ ɛzelekɛzelekɛ, yɛɛ nyanelilɛ maa sonla nwo bubu ye.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la kpondɛ adwenlenubukelɛ, na ahoasea buke bɛ nloa a ngoaseasɛm ngome.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le munzule, na mɔɔ ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko la mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le anyelielɛ.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Sonla lɛ ekyi na ɔsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla anyiabɛnwo kpole mɔɔ nwolɛ le amaneɛ ngome la.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛva ɛhulolɛ kɛli nya nya tɛla kɛ bɛkɛva ɛkpɔlɛ bɛkɛli ɛnlankɛ dɔlera nane.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeava ɛya la twehwe kpolera, na mɔɔ ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane la si kpolera aze.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle adenle nu le mbowule ngome, na pɛlepɛle adenle nu le kpolomgbolo.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ maa ɔ ze anye die, na ralɛ nrenya koasea kpo ɔ nli.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la, mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ yɛ ye fɛ, na sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la kɔ fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ folɛdulɛ ɛnle nwo la kyea, na saa folɛdulɛma dɔɔnwo wɔ nwo a ɔwie boɛ.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nyelebɛnloa kɛnlɛma maa sonla nye die, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye mekɛ nloa le kpalɛ somaa!

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ adenle fa ye kɔ ngoane nu, amaa yeangɔ Ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bubu mgbanyizonlema azua gua, na ɔgya ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛweɛne.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi amumuyɛma adwenle ɛvalɛ, na ɔ nye die mɔɔ anwo te la edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ anye sɔ kpondɛ nvasoɛ amile nu la twehwe edwɛkɛ maa ye sua nu amra, na mɔɔ kyi ndoloboa la lɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli dwenle na yeabua edwɛkɛ nwo, na amumuyɛnli buke ɔ nloa a, munzule ngome.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛkolilɛ maa sonla nyunlu yɛ ɛzelekɛzelekɛ, yɛɛ amaneɛ fɛlɛko maa sonla te kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ gyele ɔ nzo tie folɛdulɛ kpalɛ la nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma badɛnla.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛndie ngilehilelɛ la kpo ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la nyia ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzukoalɛ, yɛɛ mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee enililɛ a lua a.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ le sonla ɛdeɛ, na nwolɛ mualɛ ne vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Sonla adenle biala le fɔɔnwo wɔ ɔdaye ɔ nye zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ɔsɔ sunsum ne a ɔnea a.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ gyima wula Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu, na wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ muala bali munli.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la gyi kpɔkɛ zo; amumuyɛnli ne bɔbɔ, ye mekɛ dwu a bɛbazɛkye ye.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi sonla mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la; nwu ye kɛ sonla zɛhae ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔyɛ tieyɛ la, bɛdi ɔ ti mgbɔdalɛ, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛnyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Saa sonla ndenle mɔɔ ɔlua nu la sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye a, ɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma bɔbɔ nee ye yɛ ko.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛnyia ekyi na ɛkɛli boɛ, tɛla kɛ ɛkɛnyia ezukoa dɔɔnwo na ɛkɛli nzisi.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Sonla fa ye adwenle suzu mɔɔ ɔbayɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma a kile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la a.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli biala kpɔkɛbɔlɛ kpalɛ lua Nyamenle anwo zo, yemɔti ɔlɛbua ndɛne a ɔ nloa ɛnvula ɛtane.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Tone kpalɛ mɔɔ nzisi ɛnle nu la le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ kodoku ne anu la le ɔ sa anloa gyima.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Ɔle munzule ɔmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ bɛdua tenleneyɛlɛ zo a bɛdi ebia a.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ɛyavalɛ le ewule soanvolɛ; sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la kola gogo ye ahonle.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli te ɔ nyunlu a ɔle ngoane, yɛɛ ye kpalɛyɛlɛ gugua kɛ nyenyensuo.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla kɛ ɛlɛ ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla dwɛtɛ fufule.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Sonlakpalɛ adenle kpolomgbolo ne ɛngyea ɛngɔ ɛleka mɔɔ munzule wɔ la; awie biala mɔɔ sinza ɔ nwo wɔ ye adenle nu la lɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Too much pride will destroy you.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwo sɛkye sonla, yɛɛ bɛ nwo zo ɛmemanlɛ maa sonla tu koti.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛbɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze, ɔ nee ehyianli kɛyɛ ko, tɛla kɛ ɔ nee mgbanyizonlema kɛyɛ ko kɛhyɛ mɔɔ bɛwua la.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tie folɛdulɛ la bakpazi, yɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛfɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔle sonla mɔɔ kola nwu kpalɛ nee ɛtane a, yɛɛ ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma di adwenle.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ le ngoane nzufeanvea maa mɔɔ lɛ bie la, na ahoasea kakɛdualɛ a le kɛ ɛkɛyɛ mgbane mgbane ɛkɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛdendɛlɛ maa adwenle, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa adwenle da.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma le kɛ wolɛ ndɛlamoa, ɔyɛ ɛkɛla ne fɛ yɛɛ ɔmaa sonla te kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Adenle bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne a ɔle kpalɛ wɔ sonla nye zo, na ye awieleɛ wie ewule.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Gyimayɛvolɛ atiakunluwɔzo maa ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔkulo kɛ ɔdi ɔmaa ɔ ko yi.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Sonlamgbane bɔ adwenle ɛtane, yɛɛ ye ɛdendɛlɛ yela kɛ senle.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ la twehwe konle, yɛɛ azukuedulɛ kpakye agɔnwolɛma kpalɛ avinli.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kulo konle la di ɔ gɔnwo adwenle na ɔfa ye ɔdua adenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la anu.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bɔ ɔ nye kile awie mɔ la bɔ ninyɛndane nwo adwenle, yɛɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nloa la maa munzule ba.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Mgbanyinli egyɛne le anyunlunyia abɔtile maa mɔɔ lɛ ye la; ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ a maa bɛnyia ye a.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Menli twe adunyi kpondɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la, na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔkile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla yɛ la a.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛli mgbosawe na ɔ nzo nu kɛdwo ye tɛla kɛ ɔkɛli ye sosɔɔ wɔ awuke mɔɔ nuhua le konle ngome la anu.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kanranli mɔɔ bɔ ye ɛbɛla nrɛlɛbɛ nu la bazie ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ lɛ agyadeɛ na ɔbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla la; ɔ nee ralɛ nrenya ne bahyɛ ye agyadeɛ ne anu kɛ asɛɛ ɔle adiema nrenya la.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛfa senle a bɛsɔ dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛnea a, yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a sɔ ahonle kɔsɔɔti nea a.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la tie amumuyɛnli anloa, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ le adalɛ la tie ngunzinli anloa.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ si ehyianvolɛma amgbu la tindi ye Bɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, yɛɛ mɔɔ anye die munzule nwo la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Mgbanyinli anyelielɛ a le bɛ nlɔnra, yɛɛ mralɛ mrenya anyunlunyia a le bɛ ze mɔ.

english_verse: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
translation_verse: Ndoloboa ɛmanlɛ le kɛ ngonyia bolɛ wɔ mɔɔ fa maa la anye zo; ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɛdo ɔ sa la, ɔkpazi.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛtane kyɛ la kpondɛ ɛhulolɛ, na mɔɔ sɔ edwɛkɛ nu a ɔngyakyi la kpakye agɔnwolɛ nu.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtwi sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la anyunlu a ɔyɛ ye nyane ɔtɛla koasea mɔɔ bɛkɛwulowula ye ahutuku ɛya la.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Sonlatane biala to mgbonde; bɛbazoa soanvolɛ atisesebɛ ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla nee bedi belɛ mɔɔ bɛwua ɔ mra la kɛyia tɛla kɛ ɔkɛyia koasea mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ngoaseade la.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛtane tua kpalɛ kakɛ la, munzule ɛnrɛkpa ye awuke nu ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Mgbonde bo ɛbɔlɛ le kɛ azuledukuelɛ, yemɔti twe ɛ nwo kolaa na butule ne abɔ ɔ bo.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bua amumuyɛnli benle nee mɔɔ bua tenlenenli fɔlɛ la Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi bɛ mu nwiɔ.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a koasea mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɛnyia ezukoa kɛva kɛdɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛ?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Agɔnwolɛma lɛ ɛhulolɛ mekɛ biala, yɛɛ anwongyelelɛ ti a bɛwo adiema nrenya a.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kulo mɛladonlɛ la kulo mgbonde; sonla mɔɔ buke ye anlenkɛ wanaanwo la kulo kɛ bɛsɛkye ye.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ la ɛmkpazi, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ anloa wowɔ la fa ɔ nwo to munzule nu.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya tindandi mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze di nyane, yɛɛ selɛ mɔɔ kɛwo koasea la anye ɛnlie.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Ɛzelekɛ le ayile kpalɛ, yɛɛ adwenleadwenle maa anwofofolɛ.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ati yɛ se la die ndoloboa a ɔdie ye ɔ sa amu nwiɔ ɔfa ɔsɛkye pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la fa sie ɔ nyunlu kɛ ɔsukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, na koasea anye deda.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ ze di nyane yɛɛ ɔyɛ ɛnwonle ɔmaa ɔ nli mɔɔ wole ye la.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛbɔ sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la kakɛ; ɔle nvonleɛ kɛ bɛkɛbila sonla titile empele.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛndendɛ dɔɔnwo la lɛ adwenle, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle la azule nu la lɛ ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnzo menli avinli la bua ɔ nwo benle ɔfa ɔsɛkye ndɛnebualɛ kpalɛ biala.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Koasea anye ɛnlie ndelebɛbo nu, ye ɛdeɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye adwenle nu la ala yɛɛ ɔkulo kɛ ɔka a.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ le azule buma, yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo le kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛdukue la.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛhyea bɛ nzo bɛkɛli sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la edwɛkɛ anzɛɛ bɛkɛbua sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la mgbɔvodɛne.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Koasea anloa twehwe mgbonde, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ twehwe ɛbolɛ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Koasea anwubɛnyunlu vi ɔ nloa; ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ le ɛhane maa ɔdaye mumua ne.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tu azukue la anloa edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ kɛ aleɛ fɛlɛko; ɔdwu bɛ kunlu ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le mgbaha wɔ gyimayɛlɛ nu la adiema nrenya a le sonla mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne la.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne le aranemgbole; sonla mɔɔ le tenlene la nriandi kɔfea nu a, ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Sukoavolɛ anwonyia le ye suakpole ɛsesebɛ; ɔle kɛ bane tendenle ɔbɔ ɔ nwo bane.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Andeamua le koasea; ɔ nyunlu gua aze.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Saa sonla nwo to ye a ye kpɔkɛdelɛ a le ɔdaye ye adwenle, na saa ɔngola ɔ nwo sɔ a, nwane a sɔ ye a?

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Sonla ahyɛlɛdeɛ buke adenle maa ye na ɔfa ye ɔfinde menli mgbole nyunlu.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dumua ka ye tendile la, ɛnea a ɛnee ɔdi benle, kyesɛ ko ne ɔdaye ɔka ye tendile na ɔbizebiza ye kpuyia.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Adunyi pɛ butule biala azo na ɔkpɔda menli mɔɔ ko tia bɛ nwo la.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Saa ɛboa adiema nrenya a ɔle kɛ suakpole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la, na saa ɛ nee ye di butule a ɔle kɛ wɔdo ɛ nwo efiade la.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Sonla anloa edwɛkɛ a maa ɔ kunlu dwo ɔ nwo a; ye ɛdendɛlɛ a maa ye anzonudwolɛ a.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Ɛtafinlimalɛ tumi nu yɛɛ ewule nee ngoane wɔ a; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la di ye nzoleɛ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nrenya mɔɔ kɛgya raalɛ la ɛkpondɛ debie kpalɛ; ɔmaa ɔsɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ehyianvolɛ tendɛ a ɔkpa kyɛlɛ, na sukoavolɛ bua nwolɛ a ɔka ye mgbane mgbane.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Agɔnwolɛma bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ a, bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle agɔnwolɛma, na agɔnwolɛ ne bie tɛla bɛ nli akunlu.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ehyianli mɔɔ fa adwenle dua la le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ tendɛ mgbane mgbane na ɔle koasea la.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa sonla nrenya kɛ ɔkɛyɛ atianunzule, yɛɛ mɔɔ tia hyee la ɛngyɛ na avo adenle.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Sonla bɔ ɛbɛla mgbane na ɔte ɔfa ɔ nwo zo a, ɔfa Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo ɛya.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Sonla lɛ ezukoa a ɔlɛ agɔnwolɛma dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ezukoa la, ɔ gɔnwo mɔ kpo ye.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo kpondɛ kɛ bɛsɔ sonla mɔɔ asa do la anye, yɛɛ awie biala fa sonla mɔɔ kyɛ ninyɛne la agɔnwolɛ.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Ehyianli amediema mrenya kɔsɔɔti bɔbɔ kpo ye, na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ mɔɔ akee agɔnwolɛma ɛnrɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛnrɛvi ɔ nwo ɛnrɛhɔ moa ɛ? Ɔka edwɛkɛ ɔkile bɛ bɔbɔ a bɛndɛne ye zo.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ la kulo ɔ nwo; sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la bakpazi.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ koasea kɛdɛnla anwonyia avinli, yɛɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ kanranli kɛzie alehelɛ.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Adwenle kpalɛ ɛmmaa sonla ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa ye kɛ ɔkɛbu ɔ nye ɔkɛgua nvonleɛ zo.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli fa ɛya a ɔle kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkpo la, noko ye nyeleyɛlɛ le kɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔ ndile zo la.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya koasea maa ɔ ze nwu amaneɛ, yɛɛ yelɛ butulelilɛ le kɛ ezule mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ, mɔɔ ɛmpe ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Sua nee anwonyia le agyadeɛ mɔɔ vi selɛma ɛkɛ, na yelɛ mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la Ɛdɛnkɛma a fa maa a.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Mgbovonleyɛlɛ maa bɛdafe mgbole, yɛɛ ɔmaa ɛhɔne ku bɛ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo la lɛ ngoane, na mɔɔ kpo Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne la bawu.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la bɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bosea, na ɔbadua ye kakɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ nwo.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tea ɛ ra nrenya wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ anyelazo wɔ ɛkɛ la; mmanea ye ɛmaa ɔsɛkye.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɛya mgbole la nwu ɔ bo aleɛ, ɔluakɛ saa ɛdie ye ɛfi munzule ko anu a, eza ɛbalie ye wɔavi bieko anu.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Tie folɛdulɛ na die ngilehilelɛ to nu, amaa wɔanwu nrɛlɛbɛ na kenle bie wɔava wɔabɔ wɔ ɛbɛla.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Sonla adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ zonle dɔɔnwo, noko mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛhyehyɛ la a bali munli a.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ wɔ sonla ɛkɛ ne la a le nɔhalɛlilɛ; ehyianli le kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ le adalɛ la.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ fa sonla kɔ ngoane nu, yɛɛ mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la lɛ ngoane, munzule ɛnrɛdo ye.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle sonla fa ɔ sa to ɛyɛba nu a ɔnye ye ɛlɛ; ɔ sa mɔɔ ɔfa yeahɔ ɔ nloa anu bɔbɔ la, ɔngola.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Bɔ agolobɛnwonli ne, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la bazukoa nrɛlɛbɛ; tea sonla mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la, na ye adwenle nu babuke.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, ɛkulo a gyakyi ngilehilelɛ ɛdielɛ na ɛbanwu kɛ wɔminli wɔvi ɛdendɛlɛ mɔɔ maa adwenle la anwo.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Dasevolɛ mgbane si pɛlepɛlelilɛ amgbu, yɛɛ amumuyɛnli anloa ka ɛtane.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtea agolobɛnwonli biala, na bɛbila koasea biala empele.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Nwanye ɛnlonlɛ maa bɛsi sonla amgbu; nza ɛsesebɛ ɛnlonlɛ maa sonla gyibi; sonla mɔɔ kɛmaa nza kɛgya ye la ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli fa ɛya a ɔle kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkulu la; sonla mɔɔ kɛmaa belemgbunli kɛva ɛya la minli ye ngoane.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Koasea biala di butule; sonla mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni la twe ɔ nwo fi butule nwo.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Ɛyazonlɛ mekɛ dwu a mgbovonle ɛnzo bie; ɛbuhenle ne dwu a ɔkpondɛ bie, na ɔnnyia bie.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Sonla adwenle mɔɔ wɔ ɔ ti anu la le kɛ azule buma, mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la baza bie.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Awie biala die ɔ nwo di, noko sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la bɛnnyia ye.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ bɛ ze le tenlenenli na ɔfa adwenle ɔbɔ ye ɛbɛla la.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛha kɛ, “Me ahonle nu te, ɛtane fee ɛnle me nwo” a?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Adalɛ tone awolɛ ngakyile nee adalɛ ɛzuzudeɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti le Ɛdɛnkɛma kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Kakula bɔbɔ fa ye nyɛleɛ kile ye subane, saa ɔle kpalɛ o, ɔle ɛtane o.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnzonlɛ mɔɔ te edwɛkɛ nee ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ nwu debie, Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛbɔ bɛ mu nwiɔ a.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Mmakulo nafelɛ somasoma, anrɛɛ ehyia kɛhu wɔ; fede ɛ nye yɛ gyima na ɛbanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Saa sonla di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu a, die ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ sie nu, yɛɛ saa ɔdi menli mɔɔ ɛnvi maanle ne anu la agyinlanu a, fa ɔdaye mumua ne sie nu awoba.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Saa sonla fa mɛlɛbɛla di awie aleɛ a ɔbayɛ ye fɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, na nzinlii ɔbayɛ ɔ nloa anu awozaka tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Folɛdulɛ zo yɛɛ bɛdua bɛfa adwenle a; dua nrɛlɛbɛ folɛdulɛ zo na wɔaha konle.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Saa sonla wa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli amonle a, ye kɛnlaneɛ banlu yeamaa awozinli kabii ava ye.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Anyiabɛnwo ndɛndɛ awieleɛ ɛnwie nyilalɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Mmaka kɛ, “Mebali nzenralɛ;” kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma na ɔbaboa wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Ɛzuzudeɛ ngakyile le Ɛdɛnkɛma kyibadeɛ, yɛɛ adalɛ tone ɛnle kpalɛ.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa sonla tudu ɔ gyakɛ a; kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla ade ɔdaye mumua ne ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ bo ɛ?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Ɔle munzule kɛ sonla kɛha ye ndɛndɛ kɛ, “Nwolɛ te,” na saa ɔbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne ɔwie a akee nzinlii yeadɛnla yeadwenle nwolɛ.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Sonla sunsum mɔɔ wɔ ye nuhua la le Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛnlaneɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔneɛnlea ye nuhua ɔnwu ye ɛleka biala a.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ nee pɛlepɛle la di ebia kyɛ, na ye tenleneyɛlɛ maa ye belemgbunlililɛ di munli.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ anyunlunyia a le bɛ anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ mrenya mgbanyinli anwofɛlɛko a le bɛ egyɛne.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ahɛlɛ mɔɔ kpakye la nrinzi ɛtane, yɛɛ empele ɛlielɛ nrinzi sonla munli nu ɛtane biala.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli biala adwenle le kɛ azudenle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu; ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la yɛɛ ɔmaa ɔse ɔdua a.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Sonla adenle biala le kpalɛ wɔ ɔ nye zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔ ɔnea ahonle nu.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Tenlene ɛbɛla nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ sɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye kpalɛ tɛla azubɔlɛ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Adubɛnwo nee mgbanyizonle ɛyɛlɛ le amumuyɛnli kɛnlaneɛ, yɛɛ bɛle ɛtane.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ anye bolo ye gyima nwo la adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ maa ɔnyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na sonla mɔɔ pe yɛ debie la ɛnnyia ɛhwee.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa adalɛ nyia anwonyia la gya le kɛ kpukpuke, yɛɛ ɔle ewule ɛhane ɔmaa ye.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma konle ɛhulolɛ bahu bɛdabɛ mumua ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛli boɛ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la adenle kyeɛhyea, na mɔɔ anwo te la nyɛleɛ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla anwuma ekpumgbunli kodoka bie anu tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ kulo butule la kɛdɛnla sua ko anu.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli biala kulo ɛtanelilɛ; ɔnze agɔnwolɛ bɔbɔ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtea agolobɛnwonli a, mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la sukoa nrɛlɛbɛ; saa bɛtu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ folɛ a ye adwenle nu buke.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli Ko Ne nwu mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ amumuyɛma sua nu la na ɔsɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ehyianvolɛma su fɛlɛ ye a ɔtuodua ɔ nzo la, kenle bie ɔdaye ɔbazu na awie ɛnrɛdɛne ye zo.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Fealera nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ maa ɛya dwo, na ndoloboa mɔɔ bɛsoa ye bɛ kɛnra azo la ka ɛya kpole.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Saa pɛlepɛle yɛ gyima a, mɔɔ di boɛ la anye die, na amumuyɛma arɛle bɔ.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ twe ɔ nwo fi ndelebɛbo adenle nu la die ye ɛnwomenle wɔ mɔwuamra avinli.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kulo anyelielɛ la bali ehyia, yɛɛ mɔɔ kulo nwanye nee nwole la ɛnrɛnyia ɔ nwo.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli le tenlenenli ɛkpɔnedeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la le sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la ɛkpɔnedeɛ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla ɛsɛlɛ zo tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ di butule na ɔ kunlu ɛndwo ɔ nwo la kɛdɛnla.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Gyadeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la kyɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ sua nu, koasea asa ka ye a ɔsɛkye ye.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di tenleneyɛlɛ nee kpalɛyɛlɛ nzi la banyia ngoane, yeanyia ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ to katakyiema suakpole sɔ nea, na ɔgologolo bɛ aranemgbole mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛzɔ ye la ɔgua.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ka ɔ nloa to nu na ɔndendɛ dɔɔnwo la twe ɔ nwo fi ngyegyelɛ nu.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo, tu ɔ nloa anu, na ɔyɛ ye debie adubɛnwo nu la, ye duma a le “Agolobɛnwo!”

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Sonla mgbovonle atiakunluwɔzo a ku ye a, ɔluakɛ ɔkpo kɛ ɔnrɛyɛ gyima.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli azubɔlɛ le Nyamenle kyibadeɛ, na saa akee ɔfa adwenle ɛtane ɔbɔ azu a ɛnee kɛ ɔde ɛ?

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di adalɛ daselɛ la ɛnrɛhyɛ, na mɔɔ te na yeabua la bagyinla kpundii.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la yɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle sonlakpole, na sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la dwenle ye adenle nu boɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ, ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ folɛdulɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola gyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Bɛsiezie ɛkpɔnwɔ bɛkendɛ konle kenle ne, na konimlilɛ ne le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Tete kakula wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa zo la anu na saa ɔnyi a ɔnrɛvi zolɛ.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Sukoavolɛ sie ehyianli, yɛɛ mɔɔ biza bosea la le sonla mɔɔ bɔ ye bosea la kanranli.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dua ndunlumi la babu munzule, na ye ɛya empele ne badɔ aze.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ asa do la banyia nyilalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔ nee ehyianvolɛma kyɛ ye aleɛ.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Foa agolobɛnwonli ne fi ɛ nwo, na ɛbanwu kɛ manzonle bawie, yɛɛ butule nee aholoba ɛbɔlɛ bo bagua.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kulo ahonle mɔɔ anu te, na ye ɛdendɛlɛ yɛ fɛ la bayɛ belemgbunli ne agɔnwo.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la anwo zo, na ɔfuandi mɔɔ le adalɛ la edwɛkɛ ɔgua.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Mgbovonle sonla edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Awenade la gua ne azo, ɔkɛhu me!”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Raalɛ mɔɔ le mgbane la anloa le kuma belemele; nrenya mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɔ nwo ɛya la badɔ nu.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Ngoaseade yɛ kakula biala fɛ, na ndeanlɛ baka ne maa ye ngoaseade ne fi ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ sisi ehyianli fa nyia ɔ nwo, anzɛɛ mɔɔ ɔnyia ye a ɔfa ɔmaa sukoavolɛ la bali ehyia. Nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ abulasa ne

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Tie nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ na fa wɔ adwenle kɔ me adwenlenubukelɛ ngilehilelɛ zo,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa ɛfa ɛsie na dahuu ɔla ɛ nloa a, ɔbayɛ kpalɛ yeamaa wɔ.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Meha mehile wɔ ɛnɛ, ɛdawɔ ala, amaa wɔava ɛ rɛle wɔawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Mehɛlɛ edwɛkɛ abulasa mɔɔ kɔ adwenle nu na ɔhyia ndwenlenwo la memaa wɔ,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: mehile wɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ nee mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la, amaa saa menli soa wɔ a wɔava mualɛ mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la wɔarɛlɛ bɛ. -

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Mmawua ehyianli na ɔyɛ anwunvɔne, anzɛɛ mmamia mɔɔ ɛnyia edwɛkɛ na ɔgyi bagua nu la,

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bali ye edwɛkɛ amaa ye na yeazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɛkye menli mɔɔ ehyia la ɛbɛlabɔlɛ la. -

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Mmafa sonla mɔɔ ye ahonle bikye ye la agɔnwolɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nee sonla mɔɔ fa ɛya mgbane mgbane la mmatu,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: anrɛɛ ɛkɛva ɔ gyakɛ na ɛkɛva ɛ nwo ɛkɛdo ɛhane nu. -

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Mmadi awie mɔɔ tua kakɛ la agyinlanu, ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛbadua.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Saa wɔangola ye tua a, bɛbalie ɛ nwo ninyɛne na bɛaye ɛ bo ɛkpa bɔbɔ. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Mmatu ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɛ nlenya mɔ ɛkpɔnla la. -

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Ɛze sonla mɔɔ asa anloa adwinli le kɛnlɛma la ɔ? Ɔbagyinla arelemgbunli nyunlu; ɔnrɛgyinla menli mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la anyunlu.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Mmadi sonla mɔɔ le abolɛ la aleɛ; mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ye aleɛ sosɔɔ ne,

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Saa ɛtɛnla aze kɛ ɛ nee kpanyinli bie di debie a, nea ahenle mɔɔ ɛ nee ye ɛlɛdi aleɛ ne la kpalɛ;

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: saa kanza ɛ kɔmenzia ɛlɛme bɔbɔ a, sɔ ɛ nwo.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo aleɛ sosɔɔ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɔfa yeazɔ wɔ yeanlea. -

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔbaha yeahile wɔ bɔbɔ kɛ, “Di debie, no nza ne bie!” noko tɛ ɔ kunlu anu ɔ; ɔlɛsese mɔɔ ɛlɛdi la amuala.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Mmapele kɛ ɛkɛnyia ɛ nwo, bɔ mɔdenle sɔ ɛ nwo,

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ezukoa lɛ ndɛbalɛ; ɔkola ɔtu arɛlevilɛ nu kɛ kɔleɛ ɔminliminli ɛ nye zo. -

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Ye mekɛ dwu a ɛbave mɔɔ wɔli la amuala, yeamaa wɔ edwɛkɛ ngɛnlɛma ne ayɛ mgbane. -

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Mmaka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ ɛkile koasea, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛva wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ɔnrɛyɛ ɛhwee. -

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Mmatu ɛweɛne dɛba ɛfi ɔ bo zo ne ɛlɛ anzɛɛ mmasa menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ la ɛdie bɛ ɛya,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, tie, nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na dwenle wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee nzabovoma mmatu, yɛɛ ɛ nee aleɛmgbolema mmadua,

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ nzabovoma nee aleɛmgbolema bali ehyia, yɛɛ nafelɛ mgbole maa sonla keda avuazinli. -

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Tie ɛ ze mɔɔ wole wɔ la edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nli yɛ ɛrelera a, mmakpo ye.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Su ezukoa tɔ nɔhalɛ, nrɛlɛbɛ, ngilehilelɛ, yɛɛ ndelebɛbo; mmatɔne bie.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ɔ ze anye balie kpole, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛwo kakula nrenya nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ la bali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, fa wɔ ahonle maa me, na fa me gyakɛ,

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ raalɛ tuutuu le ewule kuma belemele, yɛɛ raalɛ gyantɛla le bula.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ nzia kɛ awule na ɔmaa mrenya bɔ adwɔmane. -

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnla nza bo bɛkyɛ na bɛfa nwanye ngakyile bɛfonla nu bɛno la ɔ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo nwanye mɔɔ ɛwie be, ɔ nye le kɔkɔlɛ, na ɛgua ye kɔpo nu a ɔwu awubue na ɔgua aze bɛtɛɛ la.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Ɛ nye banwu ninyɛne ngakyile yɛɛ wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ bayɛ mgbane mgbane.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Ɛbayɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ la nyevile nu la, anzɛɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ la meli avela baka ti zo la.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Ɛbaha kɛ, “Bɛbɔle me, na meamboda; bɛbole me, na meande ye me nwonane nu. Kenlenzu a me nye zo kɛtete me a? Mebakpondɛ nza bieko meanlo.”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Mmamaa wɔ adwenle gyegye wɔ wɔ amumuyɛma ati, yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ nye bolo bɛ;

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ɛtanema, yɛɛ mmanyia ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɛ nee bɛ kɛdɛnla,

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛtwehwe kpolera, yɛɛ bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ku sunsum. -

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ amumuyɛnli anye ɛnla debie zo. Bɛbanlua amumuyɛnli ne kɛnlaneɛ ne. -

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Bɛfa nrɛlɛbɛ a bɛsi sua a, bɛfa ndelebɛbo a bɛkyekye awuke a,

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛfa adwenle na bɛahola bɛava ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bɛaziezie sua nu. -

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na di belemgbunli eni, yɛɛ mmatu biala anloa ɛto,

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛfa adwenle a bɛko konle a, yɛɛ folɛdulɛ kpalɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛdi konim. -

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ munzule kola fi bɛ ɛkɛ ne ba arɛlevilɛ nu, na nwane a ze ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛzɛkye wɔ a? Nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ bieko

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ bo koasea nwo zo; koasea dwu bagua nu a ɔmbuke ɔ nloa. -

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ noko le nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma anloa edwɛkɛ. Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛli mɔguazo.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dwenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔdi ɛtane la, bɛbavɛlɛ ye munzuvolɛ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ngoaseade nwo adwenle ɛbɔlɛ le ɛtane, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ le agolobɛnwo la le menli kyibadeɛ. -

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ka kile amumuyɛnli kɛ, “Ɛdi benle” la, menli kɔsɔɔti babɔ ye sasa, maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bahyi ye.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ na ɛ rɛle bɔ a, ɛnee noko wɔ anwosesebɛ le ekyi. -

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi amumuyɛma anyunlu la anye balie, na bɛbanyia nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la. Sɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛpele kɛ bɛnrɛhɔ ahunleɛ la.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Saa ɛka kɛ, “Bɛnlea, yɛnze ɛhye anwo ɛhwee” a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ mɔɔ ze ahonle muala anu la noko ɛnze ɔ? Asoo mɔɔ nea ɛ nwo zo la ɛnze, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdua sonla kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ si de la ɔ? -

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ maa nyelebɛnloa kpalɛ la, bɛfo ɔ nvoka anwo.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, no wolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ, yɛɛ kɛ wolɛ ndɛlamoa ne anu nzule mɔɔ ɛlɛpepe la si yɛ fɛ la,

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: zɔhane ala yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ de maa wɔ ɛkɛla a; saa ɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔbayɛ anyelazo kpole yeamaa wɔ kenle bie, yɛɛ wɔ anyelazo ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ. -

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Boɔboa ɛ nwo sie; duolua ɛbɔ nu kpondɛ nwolɛ ninyɛne ne amuala sie kolaa na wɔarazi wɔ sua ne.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Mmakɔ nzia wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ tenlenenli de la, kɛmɔ amumuyɛnli yɛ la; mmatwe konle ɛto ye sua nu,

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa tenlenenli tɔ aze fane nsuu bɔbɔ a, ɔdwazo; na amumuyɛnli ne, munzule sɛkye ye. -

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Mmadi daselɛ ɛtia ɛ gɔnwo mgbane gyɛne ne ala, yɛɛ mmabɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Saa wɔ kpɔvolɛ kpo aze a, mmadi nwolɛ fɛlɛko, yɛɛ saa ɔtu koti a, mmamaa ɛ nye die nwolɛ,

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛnwu ye, ɔ nye ɛnrɛlie nwolɛ, na ɔkɛye ye ɛya ne ɔkɛvi ɔ nwo zo. -

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Mmaka kɛ, “Mɔɔ yeyɛ me la, medame meyɛ ye bie; metua ye kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Menzenle mgbovonle sonla bie ɛya avule nu, sonla ne mɔɔ yɛle vanye egyinli ne la ɛnlɛ adwenle.

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: Na nea, mbowule ngome ɛva ɛya ne; nuhua ndile ɛyɛ tesuu zɛhae, yɛɛ awolɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛliele ye bane ne la ɛgologolo ɛgua.

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Menwunle ye la mendwenlenle nwolɛ. Meneanle ye kpalɛ na menyianle ezukoalɛdeɛ wɔ nu.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Nafelɛ ekyi, ngɔsɔkɛbɔlɛ ekyi, ɛsalɛ mɔɔ bɛto bɛbɛka nu bɛdie ɛnwomenle ekyi,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ noko le Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn mrɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔbule, mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya mbɔlɔba ne mɔ hɛlɛle bɛ wɔ kɛlata zo la.

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛva ninyɛne ɔkɛvea, yɛɛ ɔle anyunlunyia ɔmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛkpondɛ ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ anwomanyunlu wɔ anwuma, na azɛlɛ ye le buma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ arelemgbunli adwenle ɛnlɛ nvedenvedenu a.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Saa ɛtu dwɛtɛ fufule nu evinli ne a, dwinvolɛ nyia debie fa di adwinli kpalɛ.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Saa ɛtu amumuyɛma ɛfi belemgbunli anwo a, tenleneyɛlɛ bamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ali munli.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Mmamemaa ɛ nwo zo wɔ belemgbunli anyunlu anzɛɛ mmapele ɛkɔtɛnla mgbanyinli ɛleka.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛze wɔ kɛ, “Badɛnla ɛke,” tɛla kɛ bɛkɛye wɔ bɛkɛvi belemgbunli anyunlu bɛkɛhɔ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la ɛleka.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Mmapele ndɛndɛ ɛfa mɔɔ wɔnwu ye la ɛkɔ kɔɔto, ɔluakɛ saa akee ɛ gɔnwo ne gua ɛ nyunlu aze a, duzu a ɛkɛyɛ a?

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Saa ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo nyia edwɛkɛ a, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛziezie; mmasa ɛ gɔnwo anwo edwɛkɛ ɛgua zolɛ,

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ mɔɔ kɛde la kɛgua ɛ nyunlu aze, yɛɛ wɔ duma mɔɔ kɛzɛkye la ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha ye wɔ ye adenle zo la le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke ampolo mɔɔ la dwɛtɛ fufule pɛlɛte nu la.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Saa sonla mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la twi sonla mɔɔ le tieyɛ la anyunlu a ɔle kɛnlɛma kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔdelera anzɛɛ kpɔba.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Soanvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la le kɛ ɛbuhenle nu nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ; ɔnua ɔ menle ne mɔɔ soa ye la ahonle.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu kɛ ɔfa debie yeahyɛ a ɔnyɛ la le kɛ amungu nee anwoma mɔɔ ɛndɔ ezule la.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ lɛ abotane la kola ka edwɛkɛ toonwo maa belemgbunli fa; ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ bubu mbowule nu.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Mmayɛ twolatwola wɔ ɛ gɔnwo sua nu, anrɛɛ ɛ nwo kɛvonle ye na ɔkɛkpo wɔ.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di dasewia tia ɔ gɔnwo la le kɛ konle kokolobaka anzɛɛ konle dadeɛ, anzɛɛ ɛda baka ati nlane.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ na ɛfa ɛ rɛle ɛwula sonlamgbane nu a ɔle kɛ egyele mɔɔ ɛkpɔlɔ anzɛɛ egyakɛ mɔɔ tele la.

english_verse: Singing to someone in deep sorrow is like pouring vinegar in an open cut.
translation_verse: Saa ɛto edwɛne ɛmaa sonla mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ la a ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkpa sonla nwo ɛdanlɛ wɔ ɛyɛlɛ mekɛ nu anzɛɛ ɛlɛfa nzanvinli wɔado hanlɛ nu la.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku wɔ kpɔvolɛ a, maa ye aleɛ ɔli, yɛɛ saa nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye a, maa ye nzule ɔnlo,

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee ɛlɛkuohua samɛnlakɛ ɔ ti zo, na Ɛdɛnkɛma bayila wɔ.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔ anwoma ne maa ezule tɔ, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ keha ɔ gɔnwo anzi edwɛkɛ ɛtane la ka ɛya.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛdɛnla sua zo anwuma ekpumgbunli ne kodoka bie anu tɛla kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ mɔɔ di butule la kɛdɛnla.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ fɛlɛko mɔɔ vi amaanvoa la le kɛ nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ mɔɔ nua ahonle la.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Saa sonlakpalɛ maa adenle maa sonla mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la wolo ye a ɔle kɛ nzubula mɔɔ ɛbolo anzɛɛ nzufeanvea mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye la.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛnlo wolɛ dɔɔnwo, yemɔti nea kɛ menli si kanvo wɔ la boɛ.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛngola ɔ nwo zo komo la le kɛ suakpole mɔɔ bɛbubu nwolɛ bane ne amuala bɛgua la.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Enililɛ ɛnfɛta koasea; ɔle kɛ ezukɔtweaba mɔɔ tɔ wawaa nu anzɛɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ ɛbuhenle nu la.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Amowa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la ɛndila. Ɔle kɛ ngɛsanoma mɔɔ di tutɛnla anzɛɛ nyamenleakatiba mɔɔ di ahyimango la.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Ɛkpɔnwɔ fɛta empele, asoaso fɛta nyɛma, yɛɛ koasea fɛta feaba wɔ ɔ nzi kuma nu.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Koasea biza koasea edwɛkɛ a mmaye ɔ nloa, anrɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ kɛ ɔdaye la.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Bua koasea edwɛkɛ nwo maa ɔde ye koasea bo, anrɛɛ ɔkɛdwenle kɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɛkɛva nrɛlaleɛ ɛkɛzoa koasea la, pɛ ɛ ngome ɛ gyakɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛlɛtwehwe konle.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Ahoasea avane mrɛlɛbulɛ le kɛ abubura gyakɛ, bɛle kpokpɔdwɔɔ, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ɛdi koasea eni a ɔle kɛ wɔva bolɛ wɔwula totoabɔ nu wɔbɔ ye kpɔkɛ la.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Ahoasea bu mrɛlɛ a ɔle kɛ nzanli ɛlɛtu bowule mɔɔ ɛwɔ ɔ sa akunlu la.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bɔ koasea anzɛɛ nzanli ɛkpa la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ to ɛda mgbane mgbane la, ɔboda awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze la.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Koasea kile ye koaseayɛlɛ kɛ twea la, ɔfe a ɔsia ɔdi.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Wɔnwu sonla mɔɔ ɔ nye zo a ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɔ? Koasea bɔbɔ tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛ.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Mgbovonle edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Awenade la adenle nu! Awenade luolua guabile ne mɔ azo!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle kakyihakyi ɔ nwo wɔ ye ɛkpa zo kɛmɔ ndɛla maa anlenkɛ pɛnepɛne ɔ nwo la.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Mgbovonle fa ɔ sa to ɛyɛba nu a, ɔyɛ ye ɛvɛlɛ bɔbɔ kɛ ɔkɛye ɔkɛwula ɔ nloa anu.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Mgbovonle anye zo a ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ ɔtɛla menli nsuu mɔɔ kola dwenle bua edwɛkɛ nwo kpalɛ la.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ nwo dielie butule mɔɔ ɛnle ye ɛdeɛ la anu la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ sɔ twea mɔɔ lua ye aze la anzo la.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛne ɛnle senle nu a ɔnu, yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ azukuedulɛ ɛnle la, butule ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ tu azukue la anloa edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ kɛ aleɛ fɛlɛko; ɔdwu bɛ kunlu ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Ɛdendɛlɛ bɛtɛɛ mɔɔ munzule adwenle li ɔ nzi la le kɛ ɛyɛba mɔɔ bɛyɛ nuhua nee nwolɛ tonlotonlo la.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ biala ka menlemenle, na ye ahonle nu, ɔle adalɛ;

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: saa ɔtendɛ kɛnlɛma bɔbɔ a, mmadie ye ɛdi, ɔluakɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ye ahonle nu.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ pɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo kuma la badɔ nu, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kundo bolɛ la, bolɛ tɔ ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Adalɛ biala kyi menli mɔɔ yebɛlɛbɛla bɛ la, yɛɛ adalɛ nganvolɛ sɛkye sonla.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛhyema ɛtu ɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ ɛnze mɔɔ alehyenlɛ nee ye lua a.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Bolɛ yɛ ɛnlomboɛ yɛɛ ɛnwea yɛ ɛnlomboɛ, na koasea ahyihanlɛ yɛ ɛnlomboɛ tɛla bɛ mu nwiɔ.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Ɛya ati yɛ se, yɛɛ ahyi yɛ ahyi, na nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla nungule anyunlu a?

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Ɛtwi sonla nyunlu wɔ wienyi nu a ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vea la.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Agɔnwolɛ bɔ wɔ hanlɛ a ɔle kpalɛ, na saa kpɔvolɛ yɛ wɔ atuu dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo a, nea ye boɛ.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ako ɛyi la, wolɛ ɛnyɛ ye fɛ, na mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la, debie ɛnwonle biala yɛ ye fɛ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛdu kɛvi ye sua nu la le kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛdu ɛvi ye sane nu la.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Nwole evuanlɛ nee anatele maa sonla nye die, na amaneɛnwunlɛ maa sonla di nyane.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi ɛ gɔnwo nee ɛ ze agɔnwo, yɛɛ saa edwɛkɛ to wɔ a, mmakɔ ɛ diema nrenya sua nu. Agɔnwolɛ mɔɔ bikye wɔ la le kpalɛ tɛla adiema nrenya mɔɔ nee wɔ bɛ avinli twe la.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, nwu nrɛlɛbɛ na maa me nye ɛlie, amaa saa awie ka me nwo edwɛkɛ a meahola ye bua.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo la nwu munzule na ɔtwe ɔ nwo, na mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la kɔtɔ nu na ɔnwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Saa sonla di ɛyɛvolɛ agyinlanu a, kpa ɔ nwo ɛdanlɛ sie nu; saa awie di ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnvi maanle ne anu la agyinlanu a, fa ɔdaye mumua ne wula awoba.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛdwazo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala kɛdea nu kɛyɛ ɔ gɔnwo bie mo la, ye moyɛlɛ ne le kɛ ɔlɛwa ye amonle ala la.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Raalɛ mɔɔ kulo butule la le kɛ alehyenlɛ nu ezule mɔɔ tɔ na ɔmpe ɛlɛ la;

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: saa ɛse ɛtua ye a ɔle kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkye anwoma, anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ɔ sa fema azɔ nwole nu la.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Bulalɛ si bulalɛ maa ɔyɛ nla, yɛɛ sonla yɛ sonla maa ɔyɛ sonla.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ nea ye feege egyinli boɛ la di nu aleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ sinza ɔ menle la nyia ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Sonla nea nzule nu a kɛ ɔsi ɔnwu ɔ nyunlu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla adwenle kile ye sonlazule a.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ nee Abadɔn ako ɛnyi ɛlɛ, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla nye de a, ɔnea ɔnea a ɔnvɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Bɛfa senle bɛtu dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke nu evinli, yɛɛ bɛnea sonla subane na bɛaye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Fa koasea nee abɛlɛ gua dubua nu so nwolɛ, ye koasea ne vi ɔ nwo ɛnrɛdu.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu kɛ wɔ nyɛmoa ne mɔ si de la, na ɛnea wɔ nlankɛ ne mɔ boɛ,

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ anyiabɛnwo ɛndɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Asoo belemgbunlililɛ tɛnla ɛkɛ ne awolɛndoazo muala anu?

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Saa ndile yela, na fofolɛ fifi, mɔɔ ɛkɛpɛ awoka ne mɔ azo ndile nee nya ne mɔ amuala la,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: mboane ne mɔ bamaa wɔ ɛdanlɛ wɔaheda, yɛɛ mbɔnkye ne mɔ bamaa wɔ ezukoa.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Ɛbanyia mbɔnkye nyɛfonzule mɔɔ sa wɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra no la wɔ wɔ ɛkponle zo, yɛɛ ɛbanyia bie wɔanlea wɔ sonvolɛ mraalɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma nriandi mekɛ mɔɔ awie ɛndoa bɛ la, na tenlenema akɛnra yɛ se kɛ awenade.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Saa maanle yɛ ɛtane a, ye arelemgbunli so dɔɔnwo; maanle mɔɔ lɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo nee adwenle la gyinla kyɛ.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ehyianli mɔɔ sisi ehyianli la le kɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ bilididi sɛkye aleɛ la.

english_verse: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo mɛla la yeyɛ amumuyɛma, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi mɛla zo la ko tia amumuyɛma.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la ɛnde pɛlepɛlelilɛ bo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la te ɔ bo kpalɛ.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ehyianli mɔɔ fa adwenle to ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo la le kpalɛ tɛla sukoavolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ subane la.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ di mɛla zo la ze nrɛlɛbɛ, na ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ nee adidikpokuma a tu la gua ɔ ze anyunlu aze.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dua awie mɔ ngyianlɛ zo fa nzinwo nyia ɔ nwo la ezukoa pɛ di menli mɔɔ se ehyianvolɛma anwunvɔne la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Saa sonla tuodua ɔ nzo kɛ ɔnrɛdie mɛla ne a, ye nzɛlɛlɛ bɔbɔ le kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛbɛlɛbɛla sonlakpalɛ kɛmaa ɔkɛbɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane la badɔ ɔdaye ye kuma mɔɔ yevu la anu. Sonla mɔɔ ɛnli ɛzonle la banyia agyadeɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Sukoavolɛ dwenle kɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ, na ehyianli mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la maa ɔ nwo da zolɛ.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Saa tenlenenli di konim a, menli di fɛlɛko kpole, na saa amumuyɛnli dwazo a, menli nriandi fea.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
