translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fea ye mɛladonlɛ zo la ɛnrɛkpazi, na sonla mɔɔ ka ye ɛtane na ɔgyakyi ye ɛyɛlɛ la, bɛse ye anwunvɔne.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma dahuu la, na sonla mɔɔ le anzosesebɛ la badɔ munzule nu.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Maanlebuvolɛ mɔɔ le amumuyɛ na ɔsie ehyianvolɛma la le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkpo anzɛɛ bedi mɔɔ ɛnwu nane na ɔlɛkye ye la.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Maanlebuvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo la ati yɛ se yɛɛ ɔdi nzisi, na sonla mɔɔ kyi nzisi la nyi kyɛ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa sonla mɔɔ di fɔlɛ kɛ yehu sonla la ɛyɛ nriandivolɛ toonwo ɛhɔ ewule nu; awie biala mmaboa ye.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa nɔhalɛ dua la, bɛbalie ye ngoane, na mɔɔ ye adenle nu kyeɛhyea la badɔ kuma nu.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ so ɛya la banyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ di ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nzi la, ehyia bahu ye kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo baha sonla mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la, na mɔɔ pele nyia ɔ nwo ndɛndɛ la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Mɔguazolilɛ ɛnle kpalɛ, noko aleɛ duma nu ti, sonla ne bie bali mɔguazo ayɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le akyɛbɛ la pele anwonyia nwo, ɔndwenle nwolɛ kɛ kenle bie ɔbahyia.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ wua ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli na ɔka kɛ “Ɔnle mɛladonlɛ” la, le sonla mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne la agɔnwo.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le angomedi la twehwe konle, na mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la banyia ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle to ɔ ngome ɔ nwo zo la le koasea, na mɔɔ fa nrɛlɛbɛ dua la, bɛbalie ye ngoane.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ nyia ye a ɔmaa ehyianvolɛma bie la ɛnrɛli ehyia, na mɔɔ ɔnyia ye a ɔfa ɔ nye ɔfea la, menli dɔɔnwo bawa ye amonle.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Saa amumuyɛma dwazo a, menli nriandi fea, na saa bɛ bo zo minli a, tenlenema kpazi.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bɛtwi ɔ nyunlu a ɛnee anzosesebɛ ala a ɔyɛ la banwu ɔ nyunlu arɛlevilɛ nu mɔɔ ɔnrɛhola ɔ nloa gyinla a.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Saa tenlenema ɛlɛbu maanle a, menli ne anye die, na saa amumuyɛma ɛlɛbu maanle a, menli ne su bɛ kunlu.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kulo nrɛlɛbɛ la maa ɔ ze di fɛlɛko, na sonla mɔɔ nee tuutuuma a tu la sɛkye ye debie biala.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la fa anzonudwolɛ ba ye maanle ne anu, na mɔɔ dahuu kpondɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ la sɛkye maanle ne.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dahuu kanvo ɔ gɔnwo adalɛ nu la sua ɔ gɔnwo ne ɛhane.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di ɛtane la mɛladonlɛ kakyi ɛhane kye ye, na sonla mɔɔ di boɛ la to edwɛne na ɔ nye die.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli ze kpalɛ mɔɔ di wɔ ehyianvolɛma la, na mɔɔ ati yɛ se la ɛnde zɛhae adwenle ne abo.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Agolobɛnwoma maa senle tɔ suakpole zo, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma maa ɛya dwo.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Saa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nee koasea su kpolera a, koasea ne teɛdea nu sele mgbole mgbole; ɔmmaa bɛnnyia bɛ nzo fee.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Koasea fa ɛya a, ɔye ɔkile, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ fa ɛya a, ɔkomo ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Saa maanlebuvolɛ di adalɛ ngehanleɛ nzi a, ye mgbanyima yɛ amumuyɛ.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Ehyianli nee nzisinli sɛ debie ko anwo, Ɛdɛnkɛma maa bɛ mu nwiɔ ɛnyelɛ.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Saa belemgbunli bua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne pɛpɛ a, ɔbali ye ebia ne yeahyɛ.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Empele nee ndeanlɛ maa kakula nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, na kakula mɔɔ bɛkɛdu ɔ nwo bɛkɛhyɛ ye la gua ɔ nli anyunlu aze.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Saa amumuyɛma bu maanle a, mɛladonlɛ so dɔɔnwo, na tenlenema banwu bɛ azedɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Saa ɛ ra nrenya yɛ ɛtane a tea ye, ɔbamaa ɛ nzo nu adwo wɔ na ɛ nye alie.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnga Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la, menli yɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la; nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ di mɛla zo la.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Bɛnva bɛ nloa mgbane bɛndea akɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔbade ɔ bo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔnrɛpili.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Wɔnwu sonla mɔɔ anloa yɛ ndɛ la ɛlɛ ɔ? Koasea lɛ anyelazo dɔɔnwo tɛla ye.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ ye sonvolɛ vi ye ngakula nu la, ɔ nye zo katete ye la ɛnee yeli ye agya.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeava ɛya la twehwe mgbonde nee konle, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛya wɔ ye ahonle zo la fa mɛladonlɛ dɔɔnwo ba.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ nee awule tu la kyi ɔdaye mumua ne ye ngoane; ɔte amowa ne, noko ɔngola ɔnga nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le sulosulo la sua ɔ nwo ɛhane, na mɔɔ arɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la anwo le kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo kulo kɛ bɛsɔ maanlebuvolɛ ne anye, noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ sonla nyia pɛlepɛlelilɛ a.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Gyeki mɔɔ vi Masa la ara Egɛ anloa edwɛkɛ ɛne. Nrenya ne hanle hilele Ayeteɛle, ɛhɛe, ɔhanle ɔhilele Ayeteɛle nee Yukale kɛ:

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: “Medame, nɔhalɛ, meyɛ mgbane. Menlɛ ndelebɛbo mɔɔ sonla ɔwɔ kɛ nyia la.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Metɛsukoale nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ menlɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anwo adwenle.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛvo ɛhɔ anwuma ɛzia ɛra a? Nwane a ɛhola ɛhye anwoma ɔ sa nu a? Nwane a ɛva ye tɛladeɛ ɛkyekye nzule a? Nwane a ɛhyehyɛ azɛlɛ ye muleɛ ne mɔ a? Kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛ, yɛɛ kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ra ne ɛ? Nɔhalɛ, ɛze!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: “Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ biala yɛ nɔhalɛ; ɔle enyinlike ɔkeda bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandi bɛba ye ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Mmafa edwɛkɛ ɛboka ye edwɛkɛ nwo, anrɛɛ ɔkɛdea wɔ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɛle adalɛ.” Mrɛlɛbulɛ bieko

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Ninyɛne nwiɔ yɛɛ mebiza ye wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne a, Nyamenle, yɛ maa me kolaa na meawu:

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Ye adalɛbɔlɛ nee adalɛ ɛbɛla biala fi me nu bɔkɔɔ; mmamaa medi ehyia anzɛɛ menyia me nwo. Maa menyia aleɛ mɔɔ menwɔhyia nwolɛ la ala,

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ me ko yi a, menwɔkpo wɔ na menwɔbiza kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma a le nwane?” Anzɛɛ anrɛɛ menwɔli ehyia, menwɔwua, na menwɔgua me Nyamenle ne duma ne anwo evinli.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Mmatoɔdoa sonvolɛ ɛkile ɔ menle, anrɛɛ ɔkɛwa wɔ amonle ɔkɛmaa ɛkɛli fɔlɛ.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛnea a bɛ nwo te, noko bɛ nwo le evinli ngome.

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a le: Ɛbolɔ sua zo, raalɛ mɔɔ le mota, azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ nzule ɛnyi ye ɛlɛ, yɛɛ senle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ mɔɔ bɛnnua ye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ si ɔ ze amgbu na ɔmbu ɔ nli bie la, mbɔnza nu ahɔhɔsɛlɛ badudu ɔ nye na mgbɔtɛ arali.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a le: Kɛ kɔleɛ si tu dua anwomanyunlu, kɛ ɛwɔlɛ si dua bodane zo, Kɛ meli si dua nyevile kunlu, yɛɛ kɛ nrenya nee raalɛ adwenle si yia ɛhulolɛ nu la.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la subane ɛne: ɔdi, ɔkyikyi ɔ nloa anwo na yeaha kɛ, “Medame, metɛyɛle nyɛleɛ ɛtane biala!”

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Ninyɛne nsa yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye zo mɔɔ ɔngola bɛ a, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la maa ɔgyinla a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a le: Kanranli mɔɔ kɛli ebia, Koasea mɔɔ kɛli ɔ ko kɛyi,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: raalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛngulo ye na ɔkɛnyia ɔ hu, yɛɛ sonvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ kɛli ɔ menle raalɛ agya la.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Ninyɛne nna wɔ aleɛabo mɔɔ le ngyikyi kpalɛ, na bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ a. Bɛmɛ ɛne:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Ngyigyilira: Bɛ nwo ɛnyɛ se, noko wawaa nu bɛkpondɛ bɛ aleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛbahyia nwolɛ la.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Azulenupema: Bɛnle katakyiema, noko bɛ alaleɛ wɔ bodane ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Abɛbɛ: Bɛnlɛ belemgbunli, noko bɛse kɛ bɛkɔ a, bɛkɔ ye ɛhonlone ɛhonlone.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Kekelebetile: Sonla kola kye bɛ ɔ sa nu, noko bɛwɔ arelemgbunli azua nu.

english_verse: Those fearless lions who rule the jungle,
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a le: Awenade, ɔle nane kɔsɔɔti bɛ katakyie. Ɔnzulo ɛhwee.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: Abɔnkye nyinli nee akɔlɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu bɛ gyakɛ, yɛɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu ɔ gyakɛ wɔ ye maanlema anyunlu la.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Saa wɔyɛ koasea, wɔmemaa ɛ nwo zo, anzɛɛ wɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane a, ɛnee kakyi wɔ adwenle.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa ɛka ɛnlankɛ nyɛfonzule nu somasoma a, ɔpɛ mgbokɛ, ɛmia ebonyile somasoma a, mogya vi nu finde, yɛɛ ɛka sonla ɛya somasoma a, ɔwie konle.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Masa Belemgbunli Lɛmuwɛle ɔ nli vale dule ye folɛ la ɛne:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: “Duzu ɔ, me ra nrenya? Me ko ɛzɛne, duzu ɔ? Duzu ɔ, me ra nrenya mɔɔ menluale ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ zo a menwole ye a?

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Mmasɛkye wɔ anwosesebɛ wɔ mraalɛ nwo. Mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛmaa menli mɔɔ sɛkye arelemgbunli la.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa arelemgbunli, O Lɛmuwɛle. Ɔnle kpalɛ ɔmmaa arelemgbunli kɛ bɛkɛnlo nwanye anzɛɛ maanlebuvolɛma kɛ bɛ ti akunlu kɛra nza ɛsesebɛ zo,

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛkɛbo na bɛ rɛle kɛvi mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛli bɛdo ɛkɛ la, na bɛkɛzɛkye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Fa nza ɛsesebɛ maa sonla mɔɔ anye gyi ewule nu la, na fa nwanye maa menli mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ kpole la.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Maa bɛnlo na bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ ehyia, na bɛangakye bɛ anwubɛnyunlu ne bieko.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: “Ka maa menli mɔɔ le mumule la, na di menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la edwɛkɛ maa bɛ.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Buke ɛ nloa, bua ndɛne tenlene nu, na gyinla maa ehyianvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la.” Yelɛ kpalɛ

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Yelɛ kpalɛ, nwane a kɛnyia ye a? Ɔsonle bolɛ ɔtɛla anwoneɛ.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ɔ hu fa ɔ rɛle wula ye nu, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyia ɛhwee.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Yelɛ ne yɛ ɔ hu boɛ, ɔngyegye ye wɔ mekɛ tendenle muala mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔkpondɛ mboane enrinli nee bolɔfodɔ dwɛsɛ na ɔfa ɔnwo ninyɛne.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ gualilɛ meli, ɔfa aleɛ ɔfi moa moa ɔba.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Ɔdwazo ndɛ mɔɔ aleɛ ɛtɛwiele kye la ɔkpondɛ aleɛ ɔmaa ye sua nu amra, na ɔkile ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ gyima ɔmaa bɛyɛ.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Ɔkpondɛ azɛlɛ ɔtɔ, na ɔfa ɔdaye ye ezukoa ɔtɔ ma ɔyɛ vanye egyinli.

english_verse: and she always works hard.
translation_verse: Dahuu ɔmaa ɔ nwo yɛ se na ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Ɔnea ɔnwu kɛ ye gualilɛ zo ɛra nvasoɛ. Ye kɛnlaneɛ ɛnnu nɔɔzo.

english_verse: She spins her own cloth,
translation_verse: Ɔdaye ɔbɛka ye nyɛma, ɔnwo ye ndanlɛ.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Saa ezukɔtweaba ɛlɛtɔ a ɔ kunlu ɛndu wɔ ye sua nu amra ati, ɔluakɛ ye sua nu amra amuala wula mboane enrinli kɔkɔlɛ adɛladeɛ.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɔnwo ɔdaye ye ɛkpa zo ndanlɛ, na ɔwula lenen adɛladeɛ nee adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma anye buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ɔ hu kɔtɛnla bagua ne anu wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a, awie biala nwu ye wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ avinli.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ɔnwo lenen adɛladeɛ ɔtɔne bɛ; ɔnwo ndabule ɔtɔne bɛ ɔmaa gualilɛma.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo yɛ se, yɛɛ bɛdi ye eni; ɔnzulo mekɛ mɔɔ bara la.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Ɔtendɛ nrɛlɛbɛ nu, yɛɛ ye ngilehilelɛ fane kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ɔnea ye sua nu amra boɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu, yɛɛ ɔnli ɔ sa anzi aleɛ.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ɔ mra dwazo na bɛyileyila ye. Ɔ hu noko zɔhane ala, na ɔye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: Ɔ hu ka kɛ, “Mraalɛ dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ wɔ bɛ hu mɔ anwo, na wɔmɔ, ɛtɛla bɛ kɔsɔɔti.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Sili le mɛlɛbɛla, yɛɛ anwofɛlɛko le debie mgbane, na raalɛ mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Kanvo yelɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye gyima mɔɔ ɔyɛ la anwo, na maa bɛye ye ayɛlɛ bagua nu wɔ ɔ sa anloa gyima nwo.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Nolobɔvo ne, Devidi ara nrenya ne, mɔɔ le Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne edwɛkɛ ne ɛne.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Nolobɔvo ne se, ɔle mgbane, mgbane, ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane, ɔ muala le mgbane.

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Duzu nvasoɛ a sonla nyia ye wɔ ɛvɛlɛ kpole ye mɔɔ ɔfɛ aleɛabo la anwo a?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Awolɛndoazo ko kɔ, awolɛndoazo ko ba, noko kɛ ewiade ne de ala la a ɔde a.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne tudu, sɛnzɛne ne tɔ, na ɔka ɔ nwo waa ɔkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔtudu la.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Anwoma ne bɔ kɔ nyiakɛ, ɔpɛne ɔ nwo ɔkɔdi sɔlɔ; ɔpɛnepɛne ɔ nwo toonwo na eza ɔbadua ɔ bo zo ne bieko.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Azule kɔsɔɔti se gua nyevile nu, noko nyevile ne ɛnyi ɛlɛ; bɛsia bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ bo la, na bɛbɔ ɔ bo bɛse bieko.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti wie ɛvɛlɛ, ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ dasanli ɛnrɛhola ye ka a. Ɛnyelɛ nea a ɔnvɛ, yɛɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie a ɔnyi.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛzi la yɛɛ bazi a, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la yɛɛ bɛbayɛ a; debie fofolɛ biala ɛnle aleɛabo.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Asoo debie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha kɛ, “Bɛnlea, ɛhye le fofolɛ” ɔ? Ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dɛbadɛba kolaa na bɛawo yɛ.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛngakye mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhakye ninyɛne mɔɔ nzinlii basisi menli mɔɔ bara la mekɛ zo la. Adwenlekilevo ne anwubielɛ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Medame Nolobɔvo, medɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm meli Yizilayɛ belemgbunli.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Membɔle mɔdenle kɛ mefa nrɛlɛbɛ meavedevede ninyɛne nu meazukoa debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye ewiade ye anu la. Na menwunle kɛ ɔle gyima mɔɔ ye ɛyɛlɛ ɛnyɛ fɛ na Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa menli kɛ bɛyɛ a.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Menwu debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye aleɛabo la, na nea, ɔ muala le mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ kyea la bɛtenrɛ ye a ɔndenrɛ, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la bɛndia.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Menwu nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ medɛla belemgbunli biala mɔɔ ɛli ebia wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la; yɛɛ me ti ɛdi nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenle nu.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Membɔle mɔdenle kɛ menea ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ, ɛzɛlɛde, yɛɛ ngoaseade nu la. Na menwunle kɛ ɛhye noko le kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo nee abodelɛ dɔɔnwo a lua a, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ye adwenle kɛbuke dɔɔnwo la twehwe nyanelilɛ dɔɔnwo maa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Medielie me nye meanlea kɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ si de la.” Na nea, ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Menganle ye wɔ ɛzelekɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɔle ɛzɛlɛde” yɛɛ menganle ye wɔ anyelielɛ noko nwo kɛ, “Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ zolɛ a?”

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Memanle me nrɛlɛbɛ zinzale me na menvale me adwenle memkpondɛle adenle mɔɔ medua zolɛ meava nwanye mealielie me nye, na meazɔ ngoaseadeyɛlɛ nu kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ maa menli, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ aleɛabo wɔ bɛ ngoane mekɛ ekyi ye anu la.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Menyɛle ninyɛne mgbole; mensisile azua na menzonle me ti anwo vanye egyinli.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Mengyele me ti anwo tola nee ma tola na menluale mbaka mɔɔ so ma ngakyile ngakyile la wɔ nu.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Membɔle nzule bula mɔɔ mesa nuhua nzule megugua mbaka mɔɔ menwɔlua la azo.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mendɔle ahanra, mrenya nee mraalɛ, na menyianle ahanra mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ medame me awuke nu la. Eza menyianle nlankɛ nee nyɛmoa mendɛlale awie biala mɔɔ ɛdɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Memboɔboale dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke yɛɛ arelemgbunli nee maanzinli maanzinli gyadeɛ nloa. Menyianle mrenya nee mraalɛ edwɛndolɛma, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ sonla nrenya anye die nwo la, mgbɔnla dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menyɛle sonlakpole mendɛlale menli mɔɔ li me nyunlu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, yɛɛ me nrɛlɛbɛ ne ammaa meamkpo aze.

english_verse: I got whatever I wanted and did whatever made me happy. But most of all, I enjoyed my work.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ mekpondɛle la, menyianle ye. Meambɔ me nwo abolɛ wɔ anyelielɛ nu. Debie biala mɔɔ menyɛle gyima menyianle ye la me nye liele nwolɛ. Ɛhye a le me ɛvɛlɛ nwo ahatualɛ a.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Akee mendwenlenle mɔɔ meyɛ la amuala nee ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ mevɛ bɛ ɛyɛlɛ nu la anwo, na menwunle kɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala le mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la. Debie biala anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ wɔ aleɛabo.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Yemɔti membɔle ɔ bo kɛ medwenle nrɛlɛbɛ, ɛzɛlɛde, yɛɛ ngoaseade nwo meade bɛ bo, ɔluakɛ duzu a sonla mɔɔ bali belemgbunli agya la kɛhola kɛyɛ a? Kyesɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne ɛyɛ ye dɛba la ala.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ngoaseade, kɛmɔ wienyi le kpalɛ tɛla awozinli la.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anye gyi ɔ ti anwo, na koasea dua awozinli nu. Noko akee menwunle kɛ bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ le ko.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Akee menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ, “Mɔɔ si koasea nwo zo la a bazi medame noko me nwo zo a. Duzu ati yɛɛ akee menwu nrɛlɛbɛ kpole zɛhae a?” Na menganle mengilele me nwo kɛ ɛhye noko le mgbane.

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mengyile ɛbɛlabɔlɛ, ɔboalekɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye aleɛabo la twe edwɛkɛ nyane maa me, ɔluakɛ ɔ muala le mgbane, yɛɛ ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Mengyile me ɛvɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ mevɛ aleɛabo la, ɔluakɛ menwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ megyakyi debie biala memaa me kɔliagya;

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: na nwane a ze a, saa ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anzɛɛ ɔle koasea a? Noko akee ɔbahendehende debie biala mɔɔ meva me nrɛlɛbɛ mevɛ mekpondɛ la azo. Ɛhye noko le mgbane.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menvule me nwo kɛ mevɛ ɛvɛlɛ kpole ɛhye wɔ aleɛabo a,

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a, ɔwɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛva nrɛlɛbɛ, adwenle, nee ɔ sa anloa gyima ɛkpondɛ debie la gyakyi ɔ muala maa sonla mɔɔ anvɛ fee la maa ɔfa ɔyɛ ɔ nwo kutukɛtɛɛ. Ɛhye noko le mgbane yɛɛ ɔle munzule kpole.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ sonla nyia ye wɔ gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ nee ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛ aleɛabo la azo a?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ye mekɛ kɔsɔɔti le nyanedelɛ ngome, yɛɛ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu le abodelɛ ngome. Nɔɔzo bɔbɔ ɔda a ye adwenle ɛnla. Ɛhye noko le mgbane.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Debie kpalɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa sonla ɛndɛla kɛ ɔkɛli na ɔkɛnlo, na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye wɔ ye ɛvɛlɛ nwo. Menwunle kɛ ɛhye noko vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ,

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa ɛkoati yemɔ a nwane a kɛnyia ye kɛli anzɛɛ kɛhola kɛlie ɔ nye a?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle maa sonla ne mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la nrɛlɛbɛ, adwenle, yɛɛ anyelielɛ, na ɛtanevolɛ ne ɛdeɛ, ɔmaa ɔsesa ɔkuohua bɛ nloa ɔmaa mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la. Ɛhye noko le mgbane; ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Debie biala lɛ ye ɛlobɔ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la lɛ ye mekɛ:

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwo sonla, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ sonla wu; mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdua, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbu mɔɔ bɛlua la;

english_verse: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving,
translation_verse: mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛminli debie; mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsie, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfuandi bɛto;

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkile ɛhulolɛ, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkile ɛkpɔlɛ; mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ konle, yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ ba.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ gyimayɛvo nyia fi ye ɛvɛlɛ nu a?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Menwu gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa menli kɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Yeyɛ debie biala kɛnlɛma wɔ ye mekɛ nloa; eza yeva mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ yewula sonla adwenle nu noko, amaa sonla annwu mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo mɔɔ kɔ awieleɛ.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Meze kɛ debie kpalɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ɛmmaa bɛ tɛla kɛ bɛkɛli fɛlɛko na bɛkɛlie bɛ nye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Eza ɔle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa sonla kɛ awie biala kɛli kɛnlo na ɔkɛlie ɔ nye wɔ ye ɛvɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛ la bawoa ɛkɛ dahuu; bɛnva bie bɛmboka nwolɛ, yɛɛ bɛnye bie bɛnvi nuhua. Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye zɔhane amaa menli azulo ye.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la wɔ ɛkɛ ne dɛbadɛba; mɔɔ bara la, ɛra ɛlɛ; yɛɛ Nyamenle kpondɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la abo zo. Pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛnle ewiade

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Bieko, menwu ye wɔ aleɛabo kɛ ɛleka bɔbɔ mɔɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ wɔ la, amumuyɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ tenleneyɛlɛ wɔ la, ɛtaneyɛlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Menganle ye me ahonle nu kɛ Nyamenle babua tenlenema nee amumuyɛma ndɛne, ɔluakɛ yehile debie biala nee gyima biala mekɛ.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ fane menli nwo la, menganle ye me ahonle nu kɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛsɔ bɛ anlea, ahile bɛ kɛ bɛle kɛ nane ala la.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli nee nane kɔsɔɔti awieleɛ le ko; sonla wu, kɛmɔ nane wu la. Bɛ muala bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle, sonla anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛndɛla nane, ɔluakɛ ɔ muala le mgbane.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛkɔ ɛleka ko, bɛ muala bɛvi ndɛtɛlɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛ muala bɛsia bɛkɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu bieko.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Nwane a ze kɛ sonla sunsum kɔ anwuma na nane sunsum kɔ azɛlɛ bo a?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menwunle kɛ debie kpaziwɔkɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ tɛla kɛ sonla kɛdidi ye gyima nwo, ɔluakɛ ye afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne ala ɛne. Nwane a kɛhola kɛva ye kɛra kɛmaa ɔkɛnwu mɔɔ bazi ye ewule nzi la a?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Eza menwunle nzisi mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ aleɛabo la. Na nea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la, monle ebia bɛ, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ awie ɛnkyekye bɛ rɛle. Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ la lɛ tumi, yemɔti bɛnlɛ awie ɛnkyekye bɛ rɛle.

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Na mendwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la ɛli ye moavolɛ ɛdɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye boɛ kpalɛ bɛdɛla mɔwuamra nee anyewɔzoamra la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ na bɛanwu munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ye aleɛabo la.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ ɛvɛlɛ muala nee sonla asa anloa gyima kɔsɔɔti gyi sonla agɔnwo anwo anyebolo zo. Ɛhye noko le mgbane; ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Koasea yɛɛ fa ɔ sa sia ye ɛzɔlɛ avinli na ɔkye ɛhɔne a.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛnyia ekyi na ɛkɛnyia anzonudwolɛ tɛla kɛ ɛkɛva ɛ sa nwiɔ ɛkɛhu ɛ nwo ɛvɛlɛ na ɛkɛpele kɛ ɛkye anwoma.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Eza menwu kɛ debie bieko le mgbane wɔ aleɛabo.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Sonla ne bie ɛnlɛ ye awie, ɔnlɛ ralɛ, ɔnlɛ adiema nrenya, noko ye ɛvɛlɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɔ kunlu ɛndwo ye anwonyia nwo, yɛɛ ɔmbiza ɔ nwo kɛ, “Na nwane ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ melɛku me nwo ɛvɛlɛ na mekpo anyelielɛ a?” Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane na ɔle gyima funli.

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Menli nwiɔ le kpalɛ tɛla sonla ko, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛbɔ nu a bɛkola bɛyɛ gyima bɛnyia zolɛ nvasoɛ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa ko tɔ aze a, ko ne badwazo ye. Na munzule ɛha mɔɔ le baholɛ la, ɔ ngome la ati saa ɔtɔ aze a, awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔboa ye yeamaa yeadwazo a.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Bieko, saa menli nwiɔ da a bɛ nwo yɛ wuluwulu, na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla ko ahola amaa ɔ nwo ayɛ wuluwulu ɛ?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Saa awie teta menli nwiɔ a, bɛkɛhola bɛkɛgyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu bɛkɛdɛla sonla ko. Nyɛma bɔ nwolɛ nsa a nuhua ɛdelɛ ɛnla aze.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Ehyianli kola fi ye ehyia ne anu ɔbadi belemgbunli wɔ ye maanle nu, anzɛɛ awie kola fi efiade nla badi belemgbunli. Na saa ye mgbanyinli nu ɔyɛ koasea mɔɔ ɔnde folɛ la a, ɛnee kpavolɛ ehyianli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛɛ.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Meneanle menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la, na menwunle kɛ kpavolɛ egyegyebaa bie wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ bali belemgbunli a.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Menli ne zonle kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔdaye a ɔsie bɛ muala a. Noko bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛrale amozi la, biala anye anlie ɔ nwo. Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye noko le debie mgbane. Ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma la.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Saa ɛkɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a anrɛɛ nea boɛ. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛhɔ ɛkɛ ɛkɛhɔdie tɛla kɛ ɛkɛbɔ azu, kɛmɔ ahoasea yɛ la, ɔluakɛ bɛnze kɛ bɛlɛyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Dwenle nwolɛ kolaa na wɔabuke ɛ nloa, yɛɛ mmabɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛdwenlenle nwolɛ la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle wɔ anwuma yɛɛ wɔmɔ ɛwɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yemɔti maa wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ nzinrenzinra.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Saa ɛbɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ a mmakyɛ na wɔaye, ɔluakɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie ahoasea nwo. Ye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛkɛbɔ la.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛnrɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ fee tɛla kɛ ɛkɛbɔ na ɛnrɛye.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɛ nloa fa wɔ kɔ ɛtane nu na akee wɔaha wɔahile Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kɛ tɛ ɛ nye fuu ɔ. Duzu ati a ɛkɛyɛ ɛkɛmaa Nyamenle kɛva ɛ nwo ɛya, na ɔkɛzɛkye ɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ wɔyɛ la ɛ?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛlalɛhanlɛ ɛlɛso la, ɛnee wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ ɛlɛso; wɔmɔ sulo Nyamenle. Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ le mgbane

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Saa ɛnwu kɛ maanzinli bie anu bɛlɛsisi ehyianvolɛma, bɛnli pɛlepɛle bɛmmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmaa bɛ nwo ɛndɔ bɛ a, mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ azibɛnwo, ɔluakɛ kpanyinli biala lɛ kpanyinli mɔɔ sie ɔdaye, yɛɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ sie bɛ a.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala bɔbɔ, belemgbunli ati zɔ egyinli ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne mɔ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ anye bolo ezukoa la akunlu ɛndwo ye ezukoa nwo ɛlɛ; yɛɛ mɔɔ anye bolo anwonyia la akunlu ɛndwo mɔɔ yenyia ye la anwo. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Saa aleɛ bu a, menli dɔɔnwo nyia bie di. Nvasoɛ mɔɔ aleɛ menle ne nyia ye la a le kɛ ɔnwu kɛ bɛlɛdi.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Saa gyimayɛvo nyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo di anzɛɛ yeannyia ye dɔɔnwo yeanli bɔbɔ a, ɔdafe botoo; na sukoavolɛ, kanza aleɛ bu ɔ nwo zo bɔbɔ a, adwenleadwenle ɛmmaa ɔnla.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Menwu munzule kpole bie wɔ aleɛabo: sonla fa ye ezukoa sie toonwo maa ezukoa ne kakyi ɔ kɔme nu munzule.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ezukoa ne mgbane mgbane ɔmaa ɔ muala fi ɔ sa; ɔle selɛ, ɔlɛ ɔ ra nrenya, noko ɔ sa nu fuenyi.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Kɛ sonla zile vi ɔ nli akunlu rale la yɛɛ ɔbazia yeahɔ a. Ɔlɛ ɔ nwo zɔhane a ɔrale a, yɛɛ ɔnrɛva ye gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anu debie ɔnrɛlɛ ɔ sa nu ɔnrɛhɔ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Ɛhye noko le munzule kpole. Kɛ sonla zile rale la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbahɔ a. Na duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ ɔnyia ye kɛ ɔkye anwoma a?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Sonla bɔ ye ɛbɛla ne kɔsɔɔti wɔ awozinli nee nyane, akpule, ɛya nee anwonyane nu.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Nea, debie mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ: mekɛ ezinraa ɛhye mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa sonla la, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔkɛli, ɔkɛnlo na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye wɔ ɔdaye ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a le sonla afoa nu ɛdeɛ a.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle maa sonla anwonyia nee agyadeɛ nee tumi kɛ ɔva ɔlie ɔ nye, na ɔzɔ ye kyɛfoa nu, ɔnyia anyelielɛ wɔ ye gyima nwo a, ɛnee nwu ye kɛ ɔle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla zɛhae ɛnrɛdwenle ye ngoane mekɛ nwo dɔɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle bamaa yeahɔ zolɛ yealie ɔ nye.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Menwu munzule bie wɔ aleɛabo, na ɔgyi menli nwo zo kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Nyamenle maa sonla ne bie nyia anwonyia, agyadeɛ, yɛɛ enililɛ, nɔhalɛ, ɔlɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, noko Nyamenle ɛmmaa ye tumi ɛmmaa ɔnlidi nwolɛ ɔnva ɔnlie ɔ nye. Ɛyɛvolɛ bie yɛɛ badi a. Ɛhye le debie mgbane; ɔmaa sonla edwɛkɛ yɛ nyane kpalɛ.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Saa sonla wo mralɛ ɛya ko, ɔnyi ɔdi ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo, ɔyɛ kpanyinli kpalɛ na yeanlie ɔ nye wɔ ɛbɛla nu ninyɛne kpalɛ nwo, na ɔwu na ye ɛzielɛ nu anyɛ kɛnlɛma a, ɛnee ralɛ mɔɔ kɛkpɔne la tɛla ye ɛkpɔyɛɛ.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Eza yemɔ yeannwu sɛnzɛne ne anzɛɛ debie biala, noko ɔnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɔtɛla sonla ne mɔɔ kɛli ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo la.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Saa sonla di ɛvolɛ apenle nwiɔ bɔbɔ na yeanli ɔ ti ɛlɛ a, bɛ muala bɛkɔ ɛleka ko.

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Sonla ɛvɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti wie aleɛlilɛ ko ye ala, noko ɔ ti akunlu ɛnye aleɛ zo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Ɛnee duzu a nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ fa tɛla koasea a? Yɛɛ saa ehyianli nwu kɛ bɛsi bɛsɔ ɛbɛla sa la a, duzu a ɔnyia ye a?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ kunlu kɛdwo mɔɔ ɛlɛ la anwo tɛla kɛ dahuu ɛkɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkpondɛ fofolɛ. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane na ɔle kɛ ɛlɛkye anwoma.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ ɛzi la ɛnee bɛha bɛdo ɛkɛ dɛba, yɛɛ yɛ muala yɛze kɛ sonla si de la, bɛ nee sonla mɔɔ anwo yɛ se tɛla bɛ la ɛnli butule.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Ɛdendɛlɛ dɔɔnwo maa bɛka mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɔmmaa sonla ɛbɛla ɛngakyi.

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛnwu debie mɔɔ le kpalɛ maa sonla wɔ ye ngoane mekɛ ezinraa ɛhye mɔɔ se waa kɛ ɛlawolɛ la anu a? Saa sonla wu a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeanwu mɔɔ bazi ɔ nzi wɔ aleɛabo la ɛ?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Dumamɔlɛ kpalɛ le kpalɛ tɛla nwole evuanlɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la; yɛɛ ewule kenle le kpalɛ tɛla awolɛ kenle.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛhɔ awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛdi nyane nu la anu tɛla kɛ ɛkɛhɔ awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛto ɛkponle wɔ nu la anu, ɔluakɛ menli kɔsɔɔti awieleɛ ɛne, na anyewɔzoamra bava azie bɛ ti anu.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Nyanelilɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ɛzelekɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔmaa sonla nyunlu yɛ alɔbɔlɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔmaa wɔ ndelebɛbo yɛ kpole.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛmaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma kɛhwi ɔ nyunlu tɛla kɛ ɔkɛdie ahoasea edwɛndolɛ.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Saa koasea sele a, ɔle kɛ mbowule ɛyɛne ɛlɛtite senle nu la. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, nzisi maa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ yɛ koasea, yɛɛ ndoloboa ɛlielɛ sɛkye subane.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Debie biala awieleɛ le kpalɛ tɛla ye mɔlebɛbo; yɛɛ abotanezilɛ le kpalɛ tɛla mgbanyizonleyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛya ndɛndɛ, ɔluakɛ koasea a fa ɛya sie ye nu a.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Mmabiza kɛ, “Duzu ati a mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la le kpalɛ tɛla adwuleso mekɛ ye ɛ?” Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ biala ɛnle nu kɛ ɛkɛbiza ɛhye.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nrɛlɛbɛ kola bɔ sonla nwo bane kɛ ezukoa la. Yɛɛ adwenlebukelɛ nwo nvasoɛ a le kɛ nrɛlɛbɛ bɔ mɔɔ lɛ ye la anwo bane.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Dwenle mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la anwo. Nwane a kɛhola mɔɔ yehyeɛhyea ye la tenrɛdenrɛ a?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛkpazilɛ mekɛ nu, di fɛlɛko, yɛɛ saa ehyia to wɔ a, dwenle na kakye kɛ Nyamenle a maa gyinlabelɛ nwiɔ ne ba a, amaa sonla annwu debie biala mɔɔ bazi ɔ nzi la.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Wɔ me ɛbɛla mekɛ mgbane ɛhye anu, menwu debie biala; sonla tenlene wu ye tenleneyɛlɛ nu, yɛɛ amumuyɛnli ngoane wa wɔ ye munzule ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Yemɔti mmayɛ kpalɛ somasoma, yɛɛ mmanwu nrɛlɛbɛ somasoma; duzu ati a ɛkɛzɛkye ɛ nwo a?

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Mmayɛ amumuyɛ somasoma, yɛɛ mmayɛ koasea. Duzu ati a ɛkɛhu ɛ nwo na wɔ ewule mekɛ adwu a?

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Saa ɛsɔ debie ɛhye anu a, mmagyakyi ko ne anu, ɔluakɛ sonla mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle la bavi ɔ muala anu.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ maa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ anwosesebɛ tɛla menli bulu mɔɔ sie suakpole ko la.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛkɔ edwɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ menli ka la azo anrɛɛ ɛkɛde kɛ wɔ sonvolɛ ɛlɛbɔ wɔ sasa;

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Meva nrɛlɛbɛ mezɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala menlea. Menganle kɛ, “Menyɛle kɛ meyɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, noko meannwu nrɛlɛbɛ.”

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Menyɛle me adwenle kɛ menea, meavedevede nu na meakpondɛ nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti abo, na meanwu atisesebɛ mɔɔ le ngoaseadeyɛlɛ nee koaseayɛlɛ mɔɔ le ɛzɛlɛde la.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Menwunle debie mɔɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ tɛla ewule la; yemɔ a le raalɛ mɔɔ ye ɛhulolɛ le kɛ ɛhane anzɛɛ avonle, na ɔ sa mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɛla ye kulovolɛ la le kɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ la. Sonla mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la kola die ɔ nwo; na ɛtanevolɛ ɛdeɛ ɔkye ye.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Bɛdie, kɛ Nolobɔvo ne se la ɛne, menwunle ɛhye ngyikyi ngyikyi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛkpondɛ bɛ nyelebɛnloa la.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Mekpondɛkpondɛ nyelebɛnloa fofolɛ, noko metɛnyianle bie. Menwunle nrenya ko wɔ mrenya apenle avinli mɔɔ medi ye eni a, na wɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ avinli, meannyia bie.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ mezukoa la ala ɛne: Nyamenle bɔle sonla fɔɔnwo, na sonla ɛbɔ adwenle dɔɔnwo ɛmaa ɛbɛla ɛyɛ kpomgbondee.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Nwane a le kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ne a, yɛɛ nwane a ze ninyɛne bo kile a? Sonla nrɛlɛbɛ maa ɔ nyunlu yɛ gyakogyako na ɔ nyunlu ɛmunlanlɛ kakyi ɛzelekɛ. Yɛ tieyɛ maa belemgbunli

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Di edwɛkɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli kɛha la azo, na mmamaa wɔ adwenle sɛkye kɛ wɔbɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ a.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne kola yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la, yemɔti saa edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛba la ɛnle kpalɛ a fi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɔ.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli kɛha la le tumi, yɛɛ nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhola kɛze ye kɛ, “Na duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ di mɛla zo la anwo ɛnrɛbu ɛbonle, yɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ze mekɛ ne nee adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua nu ɔyɛ la.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ debie biala lɛ ye mekɛ nee ye adenle noko akee sonla ɔdaye ye munzule doa ye kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnlɛ tumi mɔɔ ɔkola ɔmaa ye sunsum ne tɛnla ye nu dahuu, anzɛɛ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ lɛ tumi wɔ ye ewule mekɛ zo; ɔle konle mɔɔ bɛkɔ a bɛnzia a, yɛɛ amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛnlie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ la ɛnvi nu. Amumuyɛma nee tenlenema

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Menwunle ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ aleɛabo, mekɛ mɔɔ bie mɔ lɛ tumi ɛlɛsisi bie mɔ bɛamaa bɛanwu amaneɛ la anwo la.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ bɛzie amumuyɛma; ɛnee bɛdi ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anu wolofinde, na menli kanvo bɛ wɔ suakpole ne azo, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ la. Ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛndua amumuyɛyɛlɛ nwo kakɛ ndɛndɛ la ati, menli fa sie bɛ nyunlu yɛ amumuyɛ dahuu.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Ɛtanevolɛ yɛ ninyɛmunli fane ɛya na ye ngoane yɛ tendenle, noko meze kɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa menli mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle la, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nyunlu, bɛsulo ye;

english_verse: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.
translation_verse: na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ngoane ɛnrɛwa kɛ ɛlawolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnzulo Nyamenle.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Debie mgbane bie kɔ zolɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu, tenlenema nyia amumuyɛma ndeanlɛ, yɛɛ amumuyɛma nyia tenlenema ahatualɛ. Na menganle kɛ ɛhye noko le debie mgbane.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menwu ye wienyi kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla dielie ɔ nye, ɔboalekɛ ye fɛlɛkolilɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la a le kɛ ɔkɛli, ɔkɛnlo na ɔkɛlielie ɔ nye. Yeanyɛ boɛ bɔbɔ a, mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye wɔ ewiade, mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ gyima la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdielie ɔ nye.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ mendwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ mesukoa nrɛlɛbɛ, na meanwu mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi ewiade, mɔɔ yemɔti sonla si epe nɔɔzo nee ewiazo la,

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: menwunle kɛ sonla ɛnrɛde Nyamenle gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛdi wɔ ewiade la abo. Sonla babɔ mɔdenle kɛ duzu bɔbɔ ala a, ɔnrɛde ɔ bo ɛlɛ. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma baha kɛ bɛze, noko bɛnze.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Mendwenlenle ɛhye anwo na meneɛnleanle ɔ muala anu kɛ menea kɛ Nyamenle si nea nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nee tenlenema nee bɛ nyɛleɛ zo la, saa ɛhulolɛ o, saa ɛkpɔlɛ o, awie biala ɛnze. Debie biala mɔɔ gyi bɛ nye zo la le mgbane,

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ le ko: tenlenema nee amumuyɛma, kpalɛma nee ɛtanevolɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo te nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnde, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ azu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbɔ azu la, bɛ muala bɛbawu. Sonla mɔɔ le kpalɛ la ɛndɛla ɛtanevolɛ; sonla mɔɔ ka ndane la ɛndɛla sonla mɔɔ ɛnga ndane la.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ko ne ala a wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛ muala a, na ɛhye noko le munzule mɔɔ ka debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la. Sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ sonla de ngoane nu la, ɛtane nee ɛzɛlɛsɛm ɛyi bɛ adwenle tɛkɛɛ. Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ na bɛwu.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Noko akee awie biala mɔɔ de ngoane nu la lɛ anyelazo, ɔluakɛ twea anyewɔzo tɛla awenade funli.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ anyewɔzoamra ze kɛ bɛbawu, na mɔwuamra ɛnze ɛhwee, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ahatualɛ bieko; awie ɛngakye bɛ bieko.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛhulolɛ, bɛ ɛkpɔlɛ, nee bɛ anyebolo muala ɛwie, yɛɛ bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ɛnle debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la anu bieko.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Kɔ zolɛ, di wɔ aleɛ anyelielɛ nu, na fa anyelielɛ no wɔ nza, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlie debie biala mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɛdo nu.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Dahuu maa wɔ adɛladeɛ anye ɛyɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ; yɛɛ mmamaa nwole kpa ɛ ti zo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ tendenle biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa wɔ, mɔɔ ɛdi ye wɔ ewiade ɛbɛlabɔlɛ mgbane ye anu la, fa ɛ ye ne mɔɔ ɛkulo ye la dielie ɛ nye, ɔboalekɛ ɛvɛlɛ totohyia ye mɔɔ ɛlɛfɛ aleɛabo la, wɔ afoa nu ɛdeɛ ne ala ɛne.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ ɛkɛzɔ nu kɛ ɛyɛ la, fa wɔ anwosesebɛ yɛ, ɔluakɛ gyima anzɛɛ ndwenlenwo anzɛɛ adwenle anzɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛ biala ɛnle Ɛbolɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: Eza menwunle kɛ aleɛabo, tɛ menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la a dahuu di konim wɔ ɛnriandilɛ nu a, yɛɛ tɛ anwosesebɛma angome a dahuu di konim wɔ konle nu a. Tɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma angome a dahuu asa kɔ bɛ nloa a, tɛ sonla mɔɔ lɛ adwenle la angome a nyia ɔ nwo a, yɛɛ tɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze debie yɛ kpalɛ la angome a nyia gyinlabelɛ kpole a. Tɛ mekɛ ne amuala a bɛdi ye moavolɛ a.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Sonla ɛnze ye mekɛ; kɛmɔ avonle kola yɛ munzule kye fɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɛhane kola kye anloma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛhane kola kye dasanli wɔ munzule mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nye ɛnla la a. Nrɛlɛbɛ nee Koaseayɛlɛ nwo adwenleadwenle

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: Eza menwu nrɛlɛbɛ nwo ndonwo ɛhye wɔ aleɛabo, na ɔyɛ me azibɛnwo kpole.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Suakpole ekyi bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ menli ekyi bie a wɔ zolɛ a. Belemgbunli kpole bie ratetale ye, ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema ɔbɛnrale ɔyiale ye na ɔboɔboale ɔ nwo kɛ ɔbubu nwolɛ bane ne yeagua.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Na nrenya ehyianli nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bie mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la vale ye nrɛlɛbɛ ne pepɛle liele suakpole ne. Noko awie biala angakye mɔɔ ehyianli ne yɛle la.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Bɛanwu nrenya ehyianli ne nrɛlɛbɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛandie ye edwɛkɛ, noko mese, nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛha ye bɛtɛɛ la le kpalɛ tɛla belemgbunli ɛdeɛdeanlɛ wɔ ahoasea avinli.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ le kpalɛ tɛla konle adu, na ɛtanenli kokye sɛkye ninyɛne kpalɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Nrɛzenra avunli maa mɔɔ yɛ sakyeɛ la nwole evuanlɛ bɔ nvoanle, yɛɛ koaseayɛlɛ ekyi sɛkye nrɛlɛbɛ kpole nee enililɛ.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ adwenle tɔ fema zo, na koasea adwenle tɔ bɛne zo.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Koasea lua adenle zo bɔbɔ a, ɔkile ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnlɛ adwenle, yɛɛ ye nyɛleɛ ka kile awie biala kɛ ɔle koasea.

english_verse: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.
translation_verse: Saa wɔ belemgbunli fa ɛ nwo ɛya a, mmagyakyi gyima ɛkɛ ne ala; saa ɛsie ɛ nwo diinyi a, wɔannea a wɔ ɛtane mgbole mɔɔ wɔyɛ bɔbɔ la, bɛbava bɛahyɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Rulers do some things that are terribly unfair:
translation_verse: Menwu munzule bie wɔ aleɛabo, kɛ ɔle nvonleɛ mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ɛkɛ a ba a.

english_verse: They honor fools, but dishonor the rich;
translation_verse: Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la tumi gyinlabelɛ na bɛkpo sukuavolɛma.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Menwu kɛ ahanra dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na menli mɔɔ le arelemgbunli la lua aze kɛ ahanra.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fu awie mɔ anwo kuma la bahoati adɔ nuhua; sonla mɔɔ bɔ bane nu finde la, ɛwɔlɛ ka ye.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kpukekpuke awolɛ la, bolɛ boda ye, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kpakyekpakye mbaka la, bie boda ye.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Saa akuma tili na wɔanzi a, ɛfa ɛ nwonane ɛyɛ gyima; na nrɛlɛbɛ boa sonla maa ɔko ɔtɔ zolɛ

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Saa sonla mɔɔ ze ɛwɔlɛ sili kye la maa ɛwɔlɛ dumua ka ye kolaa na yeahye ɛwɔlɛ ne sili a, ɛnee nvasoɛ biala ɛnle silikyevolɛ ne anwo zo.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nloa edwɛkɛ maa menli di ye eni, na koasea ka edwɛkɛ a ɔsɛkye ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Ɔfa ngoaseasɛm ɔbɔ ye edwɛkɛ bo na yeava amumuyɛ ɛzɛlɛsɛm yeadwula ye.

english_verse: They never tire of talking, but none of us really know what the future will bring.
translation_verse: Koasea tendɛ a ɔ nloa ɛmpe. Awie ɛnze mɔɔ bazi a, yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛnga mɔɔ bazi ye ewule nzi la ɛngile ye.

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Koasea ɛvɛlɛ gyegye ye adwenle, yemɔti ɔngola ɔnnwu suakpole ne adenle.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Maanle mɔɔ ye belemgbunli ne le kakula, na ye mgbanyima to ɛkponle nɔɔzo toonwo alehyenlɛ la, ye gyakɔ!

english_verse: But a nation will prosper when its ruler is mature, and its leaders don't party too much.
translation_verse: Na maanle mɔɔ lɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ bɛtete ye na ɔdaye ɔkola ɔfa adwenle, na ye mgbanyima to ɛkponle wɔ mekɛ kpalɛ nu nyia anwosesebɛ, na bɛnno bɛmbo la anwo le moavolɛ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Saa sonla yɛ mgbovonle toonwo ye sua tete a, sua ne nwu, na ɔfolo ɔgua nu.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Aleɛ maa sonla sele, nza maa sonla nye die, na ezukoa pɛ debie biala azo.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Mmaka ɛ ne aze ɛbɔ belemgbunli ne anwo tokule, yɛɛ mmafea wɔ suakunlu bɔbɔ ɛbɔ sukoavolɛ anwo tokule. Anloma anzɛɛ kɛkɛba biala mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la bahola ahɔha mɔɔ wɔha la ahile bɛ.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Fuandi wɔ kpanwo ne to azule ne anye, na kenle bie ɛ sa baha ye.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Bubu bie maa menli nsuu anzɛɛ mɔtwɛ bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnze munzule mɔɔ kenle bie bazi azɛlɛ ye azo a.

english_verse: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dahuu nea anwoma ne la ɛnrɛlua debie biala, yɛɛ mɔɔ nea kɛ anwomanyunlu si de la, ɛnrɛbu ye bɛyɔba.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ sonla ɛnze anwoma adenle na ɔnze kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ mogya kakyi sonla wɔ nrenzɛvolɛ kunlu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla ɛnze Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛ debie biala la gyima a.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Dua wɔ ma ne nwonlomɔ, na eza dua bie nɔsolɛ nu. Ɔluakɛ ɛnze mɔɔ kɛyɛ kpalɛ a, saa bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ anzɛɛ ko kɛyɛ kpalɛ kɛdɛla ko a, ɛnze.

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Wienyi le kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ ɔyɛ anyelielɛ kɛ sonla kɛnwu sɛnzɛne ne.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Saa sonla tɛnla ngoane nu ali ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo a, bɛmaa ɔlie ɔ nye wɔ ɔ muala anu; noko bɛmaa ɔhakye kɛ munzule kenle ne mɔ bazo. Mɔɔ ba la amuala le debie mgbane. Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra folɛdulɛ

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, bɛlie bɛ nye wɔ bɛ ngakula nu. Bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛde mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra la. Bɛli bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi, na bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la. Noko bɛhakye kɛ Nyamenle babua bɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ la anwo ndɛne.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Bɛye ɛyavalɛ bɛvi bɛ adwenle nu na bɛye anwofofolɛ biala bɛvi bɛ nwonane nu, ɔluakɛ mgbavosɛm nee mbɛlɛrasɛm nee ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu fɛlɛkolilɛ le debie mgbane.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Eza mekɛ mɔɔ bɛle mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra la, bɛhakye bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne kolaa na munzule mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbikye mgbanyifoa la adwu, na bɛaha kɛ, “Me nye ɛnlie ɛbɛla nu.”

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye ye kolaa na sɛnzɛne ne, anzɛɛ wienyi ne, siane ne, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ ayɛ bɛ nye zo monzomonzo, mɔɔ ezule pe bɔbɔ a amungu ne mɔ ɛmpɛ nuhua ɛnze ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Bɛ nzo badi mɔɔ bɛnrɛde gua ne azo alɛra biala a. Saa bɛlɛti ma bɔbɔ a bɛnrɛde melahyinli ne ane, noko anloma ɛzunlɛ badunwue bɛ avi nafelɛ nu, na menli mɔɔ kulo edwɛne la ɛnrɛde edwɛndolɛ bieko.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Eza bɛbazulo ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la, yɛɛ ɛzulolɛ bara bɛ adenle nu, bɛ ti enrinli bayɛ egyɛne; ɛdialɛ bɔbɔ bayɛ se amaa bɛ na bɛ atiakunluwɔzo aye, ɔboalekɛ sonla ɛlɛkɔ ye ɛkɛla nzi, na nyanelilɛma bazu akpɔsa gua bile ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye Bɔvolɛ ne kolaa na bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ndweabane ne ade, anzɛɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke bonkuma ne abɔ; anzɛɛ bɛ dwora abɔ nzufeanvea bula ne azo anzɛɛ nyɛma ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto bula ne la ade.

english_verse: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
translation_verse: Munlutu bazia ahɔ ndɛtɛlɛ nu kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la, na sunsum ne azia ahɔ Nyamenle mɔɔ vale manle la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Nolobɔvo ne se, mgbane nu mgbane ɔ. Ɔ muala le mgbane. Edwɛkɛ ne sikalɛ

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Ɛye kɛ Nolobɔvo ne si ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛsie ahane a, eza ɔhilehilele menli ne adwenle nu ɛbukelɛ, debie ɛzuzulɛ nee debie ɛzukoalɛ na ɔdɔle alagye kpalɛ ɔzieziele mrɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔbule la.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: Nolobɔvo ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔkpondɛ edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛ fɛ la na edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhɛlɛle la le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvoma edwɛkɛ le kɛ mboaneneavolɛma agbɔma ati ndwondwɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛka mboane la, yɛɛ mrɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa la kyɛ kɛ agbɛlɛko mɔɔ bɛva bɛbobɔ debie nu la. Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le kɛ mboaneneavolɛ mɔɔ nea yɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛ nwo zo la a ɛva ɛmaa yɛ a.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: Me ra nrenya, nea boɛ wɔ debie bieko mɔɔ li ɛhye mɔ anzi la anwo. Mbuluku ɛhɛlɛlɛ ɛnlɛ ye awieleɛ, yɛɛ ɛzukoalɛ dɔɔnwo maa ɛvɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛdie edwɛkɛ ne adwulaleɛ: Bɛzulo Nyamenle, na bɛli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo, ɔboalekɛ sonla gyima mɔɔ la ɔ nwo zo la ala ɛne.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle babua debie biala mɔɔ yɛyɛ, nee awozinli nu nyɛleɛ biala anwo ndɛne, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o.

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: O, anrɛɛ wɔavo me nloa anwo! Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ ne le kpalɛ tɛla nwanye.

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: Wɔ nwole ne mɔɔ ɛkpokpa la bɔ evuanlɛ, Wɔ duma le kɛ nwole mɔɔ bɛlɛwola, yemɔti mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kulo wɔ.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Fa me bɔ ɛ nwo na maa yɛnriandi yɛhɔ. Belemgbunli ne ɛva me ɛra ye sua kunlu. Yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛ nye balie, yɛbahanvo wɔ ɛhulolɛ fɛlɛko ne yɛadɛla nwanye. Ɔnyɛ ɛzulolɛ kɛ mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti kulo wɔ a.

english_verse: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mele bile duhuduhu, na me nwo yɛ fɛ, mele duhuduhu kɛ Kidaa ndanlɛ azua, me kɛnlɛma le kɛ Sɔlɔmɔn suakunlu mgbɛnu ndanlɛ.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ nye foa ko ɛnea me kɛ medu a, ɔboalekɛ sɛnzɛne ne a ɛmaa melu a. Me mediema mrenya ne mɔ vale me nwo ɛya, bɛmanle menyɛle gyima wɔ bɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu; mengyakyile medame me vanye egyinli ɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ, ka kile me, nienwu a ɛbava wɔ nyɛmoa wɔahɔ adidi a? Ɔdwu sɛnzɛnegyinla a nienwu a bɛbalie bɛ ɛnwomenle a? Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mekpɔsa mekpondɛ wɔ wɔ ɛ gɔnwo mɔ nyɛmoa avinli a? Nrenya ne

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ tɛla mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɛnze ɛleka ne ɔ? Dua nyɛmoa ne mɔ agyakɛ abo zo ne, na maa wɔ mbɔnkye ne mɔ ɛdidi mboaneneavolɛma ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ, mefa wɔ meto Yigyibiti belemgbunli ɛkpɔnwɔ belɛ mɔɔ twe ye ehwili ne mɔ la anwo.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Ɛ nzo tɛba nu nee anwoneɛ le kɛnlɛma, ɛ kɔme nee ndweabane kɛnlɛma bɛnga.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Yɛbayɛ ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ yɛamaa wɔ, yɛava dwɛtɛ fufule yɛaduodua nu. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne la ye ebia ne anu la, me nwo anatele ne evuanlɛ yile sua ne tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne le kɛ alufuanlɛ kodoku mɔɔ la me kanra anu la.

english_verse: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne le kɛ “hɛna” ndotolo siakɛ mɔɔ kpakye Ɛngidae vanye egyinli ne mɔ anu la. Nrenya ne

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ, me kulovolɛ; nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ; ɛ nye ma le kɛ abubule nye. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ kpole, me kulovolɛ; nɔhalɛ nu, ɛmaa me nye die kpole! Yɛ ɛkpa mɔɔ yɛda zo la le asuomenle.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Mele kɛ Hyɛlɔn wulosu ndotolo, mbɔnza nu aloa. Nrenya ne
