english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ wɔ mbɛlɛra avinli a ɔle kɛ aloa ndotolo wɔ mbowule nu la. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Saa me kulovolɛ gyi mgbavolɛ avinli a, ɔle kɛ ampolo baka gyi ɛbɔ nu mbaka avinli. Me nye die ye alubo ne anu ɛdɛnlanlɛ, yɛɛ ye ma ne yɛ me fɛ.

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: Ɔvale me ɔhɔle ye ɛkponledolɛ sua ne anu na ɔvale ye ɛhulolɛ fɛlɛnra ne ɔguale me nwo zo.

english_verse: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!
translation_verse: Maa me vanye ma welera maa ɔmaa me anwosesebɛ, na maa me ampolo maa ɔmaa me anwosesebɛ fofolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhulolɛ ngome ɛmaa me nwo ɛdo me.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ yeamaa me ti ala ɔ sa bɛne ne azo, na yeava ɔ sa fema yeado me nwo zo.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese, bɛva weɛlɛ nee ahɛtɛboɛ anwondɛne ne mɔ bɛha ndane kɛ bɛnrɛpele ɛhulolɛ nwo, kɔkpula kɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mekɛ kpalɛ kɛdwu la. Edwɛne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ Raalɛ ne

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: Mete me kulovolɛ ne ane! Ɔvi awoka ne mɔ azo ɔlɛnriandi, yeawuluwulu awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi zo yeara.

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne tendɛ se me kɛ: “Dwazo, me kulovolɛ, me kulovolɛ kɛnlɛmaleɛ, maa yɛhɔ.

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛyɛlɛ mekɛ ne ɛze; ezule ne ɛwie tɔ.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Ndotolo ɛkpakye ɛbɔ biala abo. Edwɛndolɛ mekɛ ɛdwu; bɛte abubule ne mɔ ɛzunlɛ wɔ avule ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Feege mbaka ɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛlɛso, vanye mbaka ɛbɔ ndotolo, bɛmaa maanle nu ɛbɔ evuanlɛ. Dwazo, me kulovolɛ, me kulovokpa, maa yɛhɔ.

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Ɛle kɛ abubule mɔɔ vea bodane mɔɔ ɛkpuke la avinli. Maa menwu ɛ nyunlu kɛnlɛma ne, na mende ɛ ne fɛlɛko ne, ɔluakɛ ɛ ne yɛ fɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu le kɛnlɛma.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Bɛhye ɛzonlɛ ne mɔ bɛmaa yɛ, ɛzonlɛ ngyikyi ne mɔ, mɔɔ sɛkye vanye egyinli ne mɔ la, ɔluakɛ yɛ vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛbɔ ndotolo.” Raalɛ ne

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne le me ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mele ye ɛdeɛ, ɔfa ye nyɛmoa ɔkɔ adidi wɔ aloa avinli.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: Sia ɛ nzi, me kulovokpa, maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ kɛ Bitɛ awoka zo kɛtɛboɛ anzɛɛ weɛlɛ, kolaa na mangyee ne azi, na maanle nu atete.

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo mɔɔ mela me ɛkpa ne azo la, menganle me kulovolɛ ne anwo ɛlalɛ. Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye, menvɛlɛle ye, na yeambua.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Kɛkala akee medwazo meahɔkpɔsa suakpole ye azo, gua ne mɔ azo nee ɛleka wienyi ne mɔ, meakpondɛ me kulovolɛ ne. Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sinza suakpole ne la nwunle me, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ suakpole ne azo mgbɔlɔka la. Membizale bɛ, “Bɛ nye ɛbɔ me kulovolɛ ne anwo zo ɛleka bie ɔ?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Mevi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ala la, menwunle me kulovolɛ ne. Menzɔle ye kɛ menrɛmaa ɔnrɛhɔ, kɔkpula kɛ me nee ye ɛhɔ ɔmɔ sua nu, ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛwole me nu la anu.

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Duzu a vi fienemgbole ne anu ɛlɛba, mɔɔ le bolonwonwo kɛ esike, na ɛyɛlɛ nee alufuanlɛ evuanlɛ ɛyɛ ye mukumuku, ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ gualilɛma a tɔne la?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Sɔlɔmɔn ɛlɛba, bɛzo ye wɔ belemgbunli bonrane nu; katakyiema abulasia a le ye sinzavoma a, bɛle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔne nu katakyiema ne mɔ bie.

english_verse: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
translation_verse: Bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛdedɛ konle dadeɛ; yɛɛ bɛze konle nye zo kpalɛ kpalɛ. Nɔɔzo arɛlevilɛ nu ɛtetalɛ ti, ko biala lɛ dadeɛ zia ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle bonrane, ɔvale Lɛbanɔn mbaka a ɔyɛle a.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Ɔvale dwɛtɛ fufule ɔfɔlele ye mbaka ne mɔ anwo, ɔvale ezukoa nvutuke ɔfɔlele ɔ nzi ne, ɔvale ɛdanlɛ buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ afonla mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ ɛnwo nu la ɔzɛle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛtɛnla la.

english_verse: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
translation_verse: O Zayɔn mraalɛ, bɛranlea Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn, nee ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔ nli vale zoale ye kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛdie ye atɔfolɛ la, kenle ko ne, fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ yile ye ahonle tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: Nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ, me kulovolɛ, nea, ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ! Ɛ nye ma le kɛ abubule ɛdeɛ ne wɔ ɛ ti aguzo ne abo. Wɔ enrinli dwazo senreleenyi kɛ mbɔnkye ekpunli mɔɔ vi Geleade awoka zo ɛlɛtolo la enrinli.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Ɛ gye le nwohyee kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ enrinli, na bɛvi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbiale bɛ la bɛra la. Ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛtule, bɛ muala bɛsɛ sɛsɛ.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Ɛ nloa babonle ne bolo kɛ nyɛma kɔkɔlɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nloa mumua ne nee ɛdendɛlɛ le kɛnlɛma. Ɛ nvoka le kɛ akutue mɔɔ bɛkpuke nuhua wɔ ɛ ti aguzo ne abo.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: Ɛ kɔme tendenle le kɛ Devidi tawa ne mɔɔ bɛfa konle ninyɛne bɛsie nu, enyinlike apenle hendɛhenda nu, bɛ muala bɛle katakyiema enyinlike.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Ɛ nyɛfo nwiɔ ne le kɛ weɛlɛ ngakula nwiɔ, ahɛtɛboɛ ndalɛ mɔɔ didi aloa avinli.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Kyesɛ aleɛ kye na awozinli ne se, mebavo alufuanlɛ boka ye nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ boka ekyi ye azo.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ vi wɔ anwuma dwu aze, me kulovolɛ, ɛdi munli bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Fi Lɛbanɔn awoka ne mɔ azo maa yɛhɔ, me atɔfolɛ raalɛ; fi Lɛbanɔn maa yɛhɔ. Ɛvi Ameena Boka ne azo dwu aze, fi Sinɛ Boka nee Hɛmɔn Boka, ɛleka mɔɔ awenade nee boboduma ngome ɛva ɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Saa menea ɛ nye ma, me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ raalɛ, nee ndweabane mɔɔ gua ɛ kɔme la a, me ahonle di pe pe pe,

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhulolɛ yɛ fɛ me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ raalɛ. Wɔ ɛhulolɛ yɛ fɛ tɛla nwanye; wɔ nwole ne mɔ bɔ evuanlɛ tɛla aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ biala.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Me atɔfolɛ raalɛ, ɛ nloa anwo fɛlɛko le kɛ ndotolo nu nzule fɛlɛko, wolɛ nee meleke wɔ ɛ tafinlima abo; wɔ adɛladeɛ nu evuanlɛ le kɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ vi Lɛbanɔn.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: Me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ ne le tola mɔɔ apipi la ɔ nloa, nzufeanvea mɔɔ bɛdo nuhua.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Nuhua mbaka le kɛ akutue, bɛle ngɛnlɛma, bɛ ma yɛ fɛ, mbaka evuanlɛ hɛna nee naade,

english_verse: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.
translation_verse: naade nee safolɔn, kalamɛse nee senamɔn, nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ mbaka kɔsɔɔti, alufuanlɛ nee kolɔbo, nee aledonlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ,

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: nzufeanvea, ngoane nzule bula, yɛɛ Lɛbanɔn azule se dua tola ne anu. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Dwazo! O Sɔlɔ Anwoma, O Nyiakɛ Anwoma, bɔ bɛla! Bɔ me tola ye anu maa nuhua evuanlɛ ne ɛdwu moa. Maa me kulovolɛ ne ɛrɛla ye tola ye anu, ɛrali nuhua ma fɛlɛko ne mɔ.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: Me diema raalɛ, me atɔfolɛ, mera me tola ne anu. english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menlale la ɛnee me ahonle ɛlɛsi. Tie, me kulovolɛ ne ɛlɛbɔ me anlenkɛ nu! Nrenya ne Buke anlenkɛ ne, me diema raalɛ, me abubule, me kulovolɛ mɔɔ di munli, ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ me ti zo, na me ti enrinli ɛloa tɔfɔɔ. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Meye me nwo dɛbadɛba; duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ mekeda me nwo bieko a? Menrinzi me gyakɛ anwo; duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ bɛ evinli a?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne zɔle anlenkɛ ne ɛlakolo ne anu, na me kunlu dele me.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Mendwazole kɛ mebuke me kulovolɛ ne, na me sa anwo alufuanlɛ ne manle me sa telele; menzɔle kɔlɔkɔlɔ ne anu la, me sa mrɛlɛsɛka anwo alufuanlɛ ne telele.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Membukele me kulovolɛ ne anlenkɛ ne, na me kulovolɛ ne ɛzia ɛhɔ. Ɛnee me ɛkɛla ɛlɛsu kɛ ɔkɛde ɔ ne. Memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye; menvɛlɛle ye, na meande ye nganeɛ.

translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ ne anwo yɛ fɛ, eza ɔte kpɔkɛ; saa ɛye menli apenle bulu a ɔdaye ala.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Ɔ ti sonle bolɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke, ɔ ti enrinli belebele gua zo ɔle duhuduhu kɛ kɔkɔsɛlɛ.

english_verse: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.
translation_verse: Ɔ nye ma ngɛnlɛma le kɛ abubule mɔɔ bɛbia ye meleke nu, na ɔgyi nzubula nloa la, ɔfɛta ye somaa.

english_verse: His face is a garden of sweet-smelling spices; his lips are lilies dripping with perfume.
translation_verse: Ɔ nvoka le ngɛnlɛma kɛ aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ kofie mɔɔ zolɛ bɔ evuanlɛ la. Ɔ nloa babonle le kɛ aloa mɔɔ kpu alufuanlɛ nzule la.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Ɔ sa mbaka le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma, mgbɔdelera mɔɔ mgbɔba duodua nu la gua ɔ sa. Ye nwonane le tonlotonlo kɛ ɛzɛlɛ mɔɔ ezukoa bolɛ safaya betɛbeta nu la.

english_verse: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.
translation_verse: Ye ɛzɔlɛ le kɛ alabaseta adoba mɔɔ gyigyi ezukoa nvutuke zo. Ɔgyi zo sengɔɔnwo kɛ Lɛbanɔn awoka nee sida mbaka.

english_verse: His kisses are sweet. I desire him so much! Young women of Jerusalem, he is my lover and friend.
translation_verse: Ye ɛdendɛlɛ yɛ fɛ kpole, ye debie biala twe ahonle. Me kulovolɛ ne nee me gɔnwo ne kɛ de la ɛne, O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ.

english_verse: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.
translation_verse: Ɔ sa mbaka le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke kpɔma, mgbɔdelera mɔɔ mgbɔba duodua nu la gua ɔ sa. Ye nwonane le tonlotonlo kɛ ɛzɛlɛ mɔɔ ezukoa bolɛ safaya betɛbeta nu la.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.

english_verse: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ ɛle me diema nrenya, mɔɔ ɔmɔ a nloanle wɔ nyɛfonlɛ a! Saa me nee wɔ yiale alie nwo a, anrɛɛ menwɔvo ɛ nloa anwo, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛdwenle nwolɛ.

english_verse: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ me nee wɔ kɛhɔ ɔmɔ mɔɔ nrenzɛle wole me la sua nu, na wɔahile me ɛhulolɛ deɛ holɛ. Anrɛɛ menwɔmaa ɛkɛnlo nwanye mɔɔ ninyɛne evuanlɛ wɔ nu la, me ma ne mɔɔ le kɛ akutue la anu nza.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ yeamaa me ti ala ɔ sa bɛne ne azo, na yeava ɔ sa fema ne yeado me nwo zo.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ, mese, bɛmmapele ɛhulolɛ nwo kɔkpula kɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mekɛ kpalɛ kɛdwu la. Edwɛne mɔɔ to zo nsia Mraalɛ ne mɔ

english_verse: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
translation_verse: Nwane a vi fienemgbole ne anu ɛlɛba, mɔɔ ɔ nee ye kulovolɛ bɛdedɛ bɛ sa a? Raalɛ ne Mendunwuele wɔ wɔ ampolo baka ne abo, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwole wɔ la. Ɛkɛ ne a mɔɔ wole wɔ la ako hanle ye a.

english_verse: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
translation_verse: Fa me yɛ ɛyɛlɛ sɔ wɔ ahonle ne anloa yɛ me nzonlɛyɛdeɛ wɔ ɛ sa anwo. Ɔluakɛ ɛhulolɛ yɛ se kɛ ewule, yɛɛ nungule ati yɛ se kɛ funli kuma. Ɔpɛ fɛlɛ a ɔle senle, na ɔsɔ kɛ sendɔlɔra.

english_verse: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Nzule ɛngola ɛhulolɛ nua, yɛɛ azuyilɛ ɛngola ye monla. Saa sonla fa ye sua nu anwonyia kɔsɔɔti kɛ ɔfa yeadɔ ɛhulolɛ a, mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la a le amgbuzilɛ. Raalɛ ne amediema mrenya

english_verse: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
translation_verse: Yɛlɛ yɛ diema raalɛ kakula, ɔtɛsuozuale nyɛfonlɛ. Saa kpavolɛ bie babiza ye agyalɛ a, duzu a yɛkɛyɛ yɛkɛmaa adiema raalɛ ne a?

english_verse: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Saa ɔle bane a, yɛbazi dwɛtɛ fufule tawa yeamaa ye; na saa ɔle anlenkɛ kpole a, yɛbava sida ndaboa yɛabobɔ. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
translation_verse: Mele bane, yɛɛ me nyɛfo le ye tawa ne mɔ. Me kulovolɛ ne anye zo a, mele sonla mɔɔ nee anzonudwolɛ lua a. Nrenya ne

english_verse: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ vanye egyinli wɔ Beeyale Heemɔn. Ɔfa egyinli ne ɔmaa menli kɛ bɛnlea zo; ko biala fa ma ne anu ezukoa dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko babu mgbonda maa ye.

english_verse: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
translation_verse: Melɛ me vanye egyinli, me ti anwo vanye egyinli. O wɔmɔ Sɔlɔmɔn, ɛnyia dwɛtɛ fufule apenle ko a, menli mɔɔ nea ɛya ne la biala nyia ɛya nwiɔ.

english_verse: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
translation_verse: O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛwɔ tola ne anu, me gɔnwo mɔ ɛlɛkendɛ adie ɛ ne; maa mende ɛ ne. Raalɛ ne

english_verse: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
translation_verse: Me kulovolɛ, ka ɛ nwo bɛla, maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ ndɛ kɛ kɛtɛboɛ, anzɛɛ weɛlɛ nyinli mɔɔ wɔ awoka mɔɔ aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ fifi zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
translation_verse: Emɔzo ara nrenya Ayezaya ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle yele hilele ye, mɔɔ fane Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuda Arelemgbunli Ɛzaya, Dwotam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya di ebia la ɛne. Nyamenle twi ye menli ne anyunlu

english_verse: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Anwuma amra, bɛdie, aze amra, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Metete ngakula mrenya memaa bɛnyi, na bɛde me nwo atua.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.”
translation_verse: Ɛnlankɛ ze ɔ menle, asoaso ze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ menle maa ye aleɛ la; na Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ le medame me menli la ɛnze me, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo.”

english_verse: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Aa, maanle mɔɔ ɛtane ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a, menli mɔɔ ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ ɛli bɛ ti a, esiayɛɛ mralɛ, menli mɔɔ nzisi ala a bɛdi a, bɛbɔ munzule! Bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛhyi Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, na bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
translation_verse: Fane nyɛ yɛɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛtea bɛ kolaa na bɛagyakyi atuadelɛ a? Bɛ ti kanrɛlɛ mumua ne ɛnde kpɔkɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle ɛwu.

english_verse: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
translation_verse: Ɔvi bɛ gyakɛ akunlu toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu bɛ ti zo la ɛkpɔdekpɔde ɛyɛ nganlɛ ngome na bɛtwihwi mogya; ɛhye ati bɛnde kpɔkɛ. Bɛmɛ a, bɛmmia, yɛɛ bɛnkyekye zo, yɛɛ bɛnva nwole bɛntoto nu.

english_verse: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
translation_verse: Bɛ maanle ne ɛdɔ mgbane, bɛyela bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ; bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, nyɛvolɛ ɛva bɛ azɛlɛ ne, bɛzɛkye debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la.

english_verse: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm ala a ɛha kɛ vanye egyinli nu kpɔda anzɛɛ ndɔlɔra avule nu kpɔda, na yeyɛ kɛ suakpole mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la.

english_verse: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
translation_verse: Saa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anvavi, angyakyi yɛ menli ekyi a anrɛɛ yɛyɛle kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la.

english_verse: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma, mɔɔ bɛyɛ kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla amra la, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne nee ye ngilehilelɛ ne.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Bɛ azubɔlɛ bebelebe ne ɛnzɔ me nye. Bɛ mboane ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la anu ɛnlome azubɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa me la ɛyɛ boɛ. Me nye ɛnlie nlankɛ, mboane mralɛ anzɛɛ mbɔnkye nyinli mogya nwo bieko.

english_verse: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
translation_verse: Nwane a hanle hilele bɛ kɛ saa bɛba me nyunlu a bɛsisi bɛ gyakɛ aze wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a?

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa azubɔdeɛ mgbane biala bɛfinde me nyunlu; mekyi bɛ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ ne. Memkpondɛ kɛ menwu Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ ne nee bɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔ. Memkpondɛ kɛ menwu ɛtanema ayia biala.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Mekyi bɛ Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyialilɛ ne nee bɛ ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti. Bɛbu me kɔme, mengola bɛ soa bieko.

english_verse: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong
translation_verse: Bɛbia bɛyɛ bɛ nwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ, bɛye ɛtane biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛla nu la bɛvi me nye zo. Bɛgyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ,

english_verse: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
translation_verse: bɛzukoa boɛlilɛ, bɛkpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ bo zo, bɛgyakyi nzisililɛ, bɛlie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la ati, na bɛkpa ahunlanvolɛ ti kyɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ yɛ avinli, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛla zo kɛ ɛbenle bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbayɛ fufule kɛ ezukɔtweaba. Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbolo kɛ ebo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbayɛ nwohyee kɛ boane enrinli.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Saa bɛkponle zo, bɛyɛ tieyɛ a, bɛbali debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la bie.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na saa bɛkpo na bɛte atua a bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meha a.” Ɛtanevolɛma suakpole ne

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ nɔhavoma suakpole ne ɛnɛ ɛhakyi tuutuuma suakpole a. Anrɛɛ bɛdi pɛlepɛle wɔ zolɛ! Anrɛɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ, na ɛnɛ, ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ.

english_verse: Your silver is fake, and your wine is watered down.
translation_verse: Bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ, bɛ nwanye ɛyɛ nzule nzule.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Bɛ arelemgbunli le atuadelɛma yɛɛ bɛva nwule agɔnwolɛ. Awie biala kulo ndoloboa yɛɛ bɛpele bɛkpondɛ ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne. Bɛnlie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la ati, yɛɛ bɛndwenle ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Katakyie Ko ne se, “Aa, akee mebawola me ɛya ne meagua me kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo, na meali menli mɔɔ kyi me la nzenralɛ.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Mebava me sa meazie ɛ nwo. Mebaye evinli nee debie mgbane biala mɔɔ wɔ wɔ nuhua la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mebava wɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma ne meamaa wɔ kɛ alumua ne la, na meamaa wɔ folɛdulɛma, kɛmɔ alumua ne ɔde la. Na nzinlii bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ suakpole mɔɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Bɛbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛalie Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛava tenleneyɛlɛ bɛalie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnlu bɛ nwo la.

english_verse: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
translation_verse: Bɛbazɛkye ɛtanema nee atuadelɛma, na bɛahu menli mɔɔ kpo Ɛdɛnkɛma la amuala.

english_verse: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ bɛ nyiane kɛ bɛ nye liele oku mbaka nu a, yɛɛ bɛ nye banwoso wɔ tola ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyele la anwo.

english_verse: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛbayɛ kɛ oku baka mɔɔ ye nya ɛnwoso la anzɛɛ tola azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nu la.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se la, bɛbahwenle bɛ aze, na bɛ nyɛleɛ bayɛ senle mgbomgbɔ ayela bɛ nee bɛ gyima, na awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua.

english_verse: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Emɔzo ara nrenya Ayezaya edwɛkɛ mɔɔ hanle, mɔɔ fane Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo la ɛne:

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Ɔbara kɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la, boka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la bayɛ boka mɔɔ wale tɛla boka biala; bɛbamaa ye zo wɔ awoka kɔsɔɔti avinli, na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti banriandi ahɔ zo.

english_verse: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo bara ɛkɛ na bɛaha kɛ, “Bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne azo, yɛhɔ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne Sua nu, amaa yeahilehile yɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ, na yɛalua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu. Ɔluakɛ mɛla ne vi Zayɔn a bara a, yɛɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne vi Gyɛlusalɛm a bara a.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Ɔbabua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne, yeali menli dɔɔnwo edwɛkɛ; na bɛbabolo bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛyazonlɛ mbulalɛ, na bɛabolo bɛ atwɛ ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛdedadeɛ. Maanle ko nee maanle ko ɛnrɛho bieko, yɛɛ bɛnrɛzukoa konle ɛhonlɛ bieko.

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛlua Ɛdɛnkɛma wienyi ne anu. Bɛbazɛkye mgbolehanlɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: O Nyamenle, wɔkpo wɔ menli ne, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne! Ɔboalekɛ ngonyiama mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ la ɛva azɛlɛ ne yɛɛ bɛnea menli nyunlu bɛbɔ bɛ munzule, kɛmɔ Filisitiama yɛ ye la. Bɛ sa ɛkpula nyɛvolɛ asa anzi na bɛyɛ mɔɔ nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ yɛ la bie.

english_verse: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
translation_verse: Dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke ɛyi bɛ azɛlɛ ne tɔ, awie ɛnze bɛ anwonyia nloa. Bɛ mgbɔnwɔ zonle kpalɛ yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛndia bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: Mmonle ɛva azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛsonle bɛdabɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati sonla ɛdo ɔ nwo aze, yebɔ ɔ nwo anyiemgba. Mmafa ɛkyɛ bɛ ɛlɛ!

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Bɛnriandi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne, na bɛhɔvea awolɛ nu nee azɛlɛ bo.

english_verse: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
translation_verse: Bɛ adubɛnwo ne kɔsɔɔti bawie na bɛ mgbolede ne abo agua. Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye ala yɛɛ bɛbayeyɛ ye mekɛ zɔhane anu a.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbava ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛyɛ mgbolede, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ tumi la bali yeaha bɛ aze fɛɛnye a.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane, ɔbazɛkye Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka mɔɔ ɛnyi ɛhɔ anwuma, Beehyan oku mbaka;

english_verse: all high mountains and hills,
translation_verse: awoka mgbole mɔɔ anwo zo wɔ anwuma nee awoka ngyikyi;

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: Tahyehye meli ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, yɛɛ adwinli kɛnlɛma biala.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Sonla adubɛnwo muala bara awieleɛ, yɛɛ mgbolede mɔɔ menli yɛ la amuala abo bagua; Ɛdɛnkɛma angomekye ala yɛɛ bɛbayeyɛ ye mekɛ zɔhane anu a.

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Na bɛbazɛkye mmonle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ ɔ nee azɛlɛ ye azo amra di la, menli banriandi ahɔvea awolɛ mbɔne nu nee azɛlɛ bo ahuma nu, bɛavi ye ɛya kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne anwo.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli bavuandi bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo na bɛsonle bɛ la agua. Bɛbagyakyi bɛ bɛamaa abotokila nee akpanlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ ɔ nee azɛlɛ ye azo amra di la, menli banriandi ahɔvea awolɛ nee awoka adokule nu bɛavi ye ɛya kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne nee ye belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne anwo.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi sonla mɔɔ ɛnwomenle ala a ɔdie la anwo. Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ sonla nwo zo a?

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Awulae Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛye debie biala, aleɛ nee nzule, nee awie biala mɔɔ menli ne ati zɔ ye la avi Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda.

english_verse: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
translation_verse: Katakyiema, ɛlɔnema, ndɛnebuavolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo, maanle mgbanyinli,

english_verse: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ngakula mrenya ayɛ arelemgbunli, na ngakula ndetendete azie maanle ne.

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Menli ne basisi bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko; awie biala basisi ɔ gɔnwo anzɛɛ ɔ diema. Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra bayɛ mgbanyizonle ahile mgbanyinli, yɛɛ kpamgbanvolɛma badu bɛ nwo ahile menli mɔɔ lɛ dibilɛ la.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu sonla bazɔ ɔ diema mɔɔ ɔ nee ye wɔ abusua ekpulike ko anu la na yeaze ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ ndanlɛ ɛkeda, yemɔti yɛ yɛ abusua kpanyinli na nea yɛ nwo zo wɔ yɛ ngyianlɛ nee yɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ye anu.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Na adiema ne baha kɛ, “Menrɛhola menrɛli bɛ kpanyinli. Menlɛ aleɛ anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ wɔ me sua nu. Bɛfa me bɛdi kpanyinli a ɔnyɛ boɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Dwuda maanle ne ɛzɛkye, Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ nee bɛ nyɛleɛ muala tia Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛngulo kɛ bɛnwu ye anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Bɛ mɔguazo ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Bɛka bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ baguasee kɛ Sodɔm la. Bɛnvea nwolɛ. Munzule ɛha bɛ! Ɔluakɛ bɛhwe munzule bɛmaa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Maa tenlenema ɛde kɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbadidi bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha amumuyɛnli ne! Ɔnrɛwie boɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la, bɛbayɛ ye bie bɛazie ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Ngakula yɛɛ akee sisi me menli ne a, yɛɛ mraalɛ a sie bɛ a. O me menli, bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛda bɛ nye zo, ɛminli bɛ ndenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua nu la. Ɛdɛnkɛma bua ye menli ne ndɛne

english_verse: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma akee ɛrava ye gyinlabelɛ ne na yeboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔbua ye menli ne ndɛne.

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma de ye ndɛnebualɛ ebia nu kɛ ɔbua ye menli ne mgbanyima ne nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ ndɛne. Ɔse, “Bɛdabɛ yɛɛ bɛzɛkye vanye egyinli ne anu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a. Ehyianvolɛma ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ azua nu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛsisi me menli ne zɛhae, na bɛfa ehyianvolɛma anyunlu bɛkyikyi aze ɛ? Medame Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle a mebiza bɛ a.” Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Kɛmɔ Gyɛlusalɛm mraalɛ memaa bɛ nwo zo, bɛtia a bɛtoto bɛ kɔme, bɛtwe bɛ nye anzi bɛkile mrenya, bɛbɔ bɛ gyakɛ aze bɛtia ahulomrenya nu la,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa bɛ ti anwo atulu abonle na meakpa bɛ nwo.”

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ɛnrɛbɔ evuanlɛ, bɛ nwo babɔ ɛnyane; bɛnrɛhye falɛ, bɛbahye nyɛma; bɛ ti enrinli ngɛnlɛma ne, bɛnrɛyɛ bɛ bieko, bɛ ti zo bakpa; bɛnrɛwula adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma, bɛbava ɛrele bɛakyekye bɛ nwo, na bɛ anwofɛlɛko ne bahakyi anyiemgba.

english_verse: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
translation_verse: Mrenya ne mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa yɛɛ bɛ katakyiema bawu konle nu.

english_verse: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Bɛ suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bazu aye awolɛ; suakpole mumua ne bayɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ bɛkpa ɔ nwo na ɔkpofo azɛlɛ nwo la.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, mraalɛ nsuu bahɔzɔ nrenya ko na bɛaze ye kɛ, “Yɛdayɛ yɛbali yɛ nloa anu ndɔnie, yɛadɔ yɛ ndanlɛ yɛaheda; wɔmɔ fa wɔ duma to yɛ nwo zo ala na ye anyiemgba ne fi yɛ nwo zo.” Gyɛlusalɛm bakpazi bieko

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma mbaka ne mɔ ngane bayɛ mgbole ngɛnlɛma. Yizilayɛma mɔɔ baha la anye balie mbaka ne nee bɛ nzoleɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Awulae bava ye ɛyelalɛ sunsum ne nee ye ndɛnebualɛ tumi ne abia Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo evinli ne amuala, na yeanrinzi mogya mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Zayɔn Boka ɛleka biala ayɛ amungu kumɔɔnwo aheda ye menli mɔɔ ɛyia la anwo zo wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, na yeayɛ esike nee sendɔlɔra wɔ nɔɔzo. Ɔluakɛ ye anyunlunyia ne bayɛ kɛ ɛdanlɛ abo kpɔda aheda bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ alubo yeamaa bɛ alehyenlɛ nu na bɛande wuluwulu ne, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ ɛvealeka nee ebuo wɔ ezule nee ahumu mekɛ nu.

english_verse: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa mendo edwɛne memaa me kulovolɛ, ye vanye egyinli ne anwo ɛhulolɛ edwɛne. Ɛnee me kulovolɛ ne lɛ ye vanye egyinli wɔ boka bie mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: Ɔvundunle azɛlɛ ne ɔyeyele zolɛ awolɛ ne mɔ, na ɔluale ye vanye ma kpalɛ; ɔzile tawa wɔ egyinli ne avinli, na ɔvunle kuma mɔɔ ɔbahwihwi vanye ma ne nu la. Akee ɔhendɛle kɛ ye vanye egyinli ne kɛzo ma kpalɛ, na vanye ma ne bolole la ɛnee biala yɛ ɛnwonle.

english_verse: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
translation_verse: Yemɔti me kulovolɛ ne se, “O bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma nee bɛmɛ Dwudama, mebodo bɛ, bɛbua me nee me vanye egyinli ye edwɛkɛ ne bɛmaa me.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Duzu debie a anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ wɔ me vanye egyinli ne anu mɔɔ meanyɛ a? Ɛnee me nye la kɛ ɔkɛzo vanye ma kpalɛ, na duzu ati a ɔzole ma ɛnwonle a?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: “Akee meka meahile bɛ, mɔɔ meyɛ me vanye egyinli ne la ɛne. Mebubu ɛhane ne mɔɔ mehye ye nwolɛ la meamaa nane ali vanye ne. Bane biala mɔɔ melie ye nwolɛ la, mebubu ye meamaa bɛaratietia ma ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
translation_verse: Meto ye ɛkɛ ne mgbane, bɛnrɛbɔ nuhua ndile, yɛɛ bɛnrɛpepɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo. Ndile nee mbowule bafifi ava ye. Eza menrɛmaa ezule ɛnrɛdɔ ɛnrɛgua zolɛ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vanye egyinli ne, yemɔ a le Yizilayɛ abo zo amra ne; menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda la amuala, bɛmɛ a bɛle ye ma ngɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ ɔluale la. Ɛdɛnkɛma nleanle kɛ ɔkɛnwu pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛ nu, na ɔnwunle mogyahanlɛ; ɔnleanle kɛ ɔkɛnwu tenleneyɛlɛ, na nea, ɔnwunle ɛsisilɛ nee ɛzunlɛ. Ɛtane mɔɔ menli yɛ la

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa azua bɛbɔ azua zo, bɛfa ɛya avule bɛbɔ avule zo, bɛmaa yera kɛ akee ɛleka ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ sonla tɛnla a ɔyɛ boɛ a, na bɛgyakyi wɔ kɛ ɛ ngomekye ɛdɛnla azɛlɛ tɛtɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane ɛmaa mede kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, azua dɔɔnwo bayɛ azuadu; azua mgbole ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Ɛlɔnema ne mɔ biala ɛnrɛvɛ, biala ɛnrɛdu koti, biala ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ na yealafe, bɛ akyeso ɛnrɛzianyi yɛɛ bɛ mgbɔlaboa nyɛma ɛnrɛde.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa adalɛ bɛtwehwe dwɛwɔlɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo, na bɛtwe ɛtane kɛ asɛɛ bɛtwe ehwili nyɛma la.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazo aleɛbahye bɛno nza ɛsesebɛ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nɔsolɛ nu bɛsi epe bɛno nwanye toonwo bɛtinda la.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi, fulutu nee akɛya yɛɛ bɛbɔ na bɛno nwanye wɔ bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ bo a; bɛmbu Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima mɔɔ yeli la bie, yɛɛ bɛnnwu ɔ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛmɔ me menli ne ɛnlɛ adwenle la, bɛkye bɛ bɛkɔ nlɔnu; ɛhɔne ku bɛ menli titile ne mɔ toonwo bɛtɔ, yɛɛ nzuhɔne maa bɛdabɛ ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ bɛha la kete.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɛbolɔ ɛbuke ɔ nloa wanaanwo ɛlɛme Gyɛlusalɛm menli titile nee menli ne nee bɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne amuala.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Sonla ti ɛzi aze, menli nyunlu ɛgua aze, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la anye ɛnwoso.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Na Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛhɔ anwuma, Nwuanzanwuanza Nyamenle ne kile maa bɛnwu kɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Akee mboane mralɛ ne mɔ baluolua azua bubulera ne mɔ anu adidi.

english_verse: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Dahuu bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Bɛmaa ɔha ɔ nwo ɔyɛ ye waa, ɔyɛ ye gyima ne ndɛndɛ ɔmaa yɛnlea. Bɛmaa Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛrɛla, ɛrayɛ mɔɔ yehyehyɛ la ɔmaa yɛnlea!”

english_verse: You think you are clever and smart.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛnea a bɛze ndɛne la.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlie duma kɛ bɛkola nza no na bɛkola bɛfa nza ngakyile bɛfonla nu bɛno la.

english_verse: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
translation_verse: Bɛdie ndoloboa na bɛgyakyi menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la, na bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la anwo kyele bɛ.

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ senle si yela ewula na ndile welera si sɔ senle nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ndinli bakpɔlɔ na bɛ ndotolo akpolo azande kɛ munlutu a, ɔluakɛ bɛkpo Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne na bɛhyi Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne dwazole ye menli ne anwo zo, ɔdenrɛle ɔ sa ɔzɛkyele bɛ, na awoka ne mɔ kpusule. Bɛ avunli yɛle kɛ ewula wɔ gua ne mɔ azo. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛtɛdwole, na ɔ sa ne mɔɔ yedenrɛ nu la tɛbɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa maanle bie mɔɔ wɔ moa moa la sɛkɛlɛneɛ, na yeabɔ nvonloma yeavɛlɛ ye, na nea, ɔbara ndɛndɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ yɛ nla, bɛkpo bɛ ɛda ne mɔ, bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ agyakɛ babonle ne mɔ le kɛ ɛtwɛlɛboɔ, yɛɛ bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo ndɛne le kɛ ahumuakyima.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Bɛ ne alɛra le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛtea la, na bɛtea kɛ awenade ngakula la. Bɛkulu bɛ bo na bɛtɔ mɔɔ bɛkye ye la anwo zo, bɛkye ye na bɛtwe ye bɛkɔ, yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛnlie ye.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, bɛbahulu kɛ nyevile. Na saa awie to ɔ nye nea maanle ne a, ɔbanwu kɛ awozinli nee nyane ɛva ye, na amungu ɛheda zo.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ɛzaya wule la ala anu, menwunle kɛ Awulae de belemgbunli ebia nu, hyeleenyi wɔ anwuma, na ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa ɛyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛma mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la ɛbɔ ɛyia ɔ ti zo anwuma. Ko biala lɛ ndɛbalɛ nsia: ɔfa nwiɔ ɔkeda ɔ nyunlu, ɔfa nwiɔ ɔkeda ɔ gyakɛ anwo, yɛɛ ɔfa nwiɔ ɔtu.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”

translation_verse: “Saa mekɛ ne dwu a, Ɛdɛnkɛma bava dadeɛ dɛma mɔɔ yebɔ ye ɛkpa yevi Azule Yufileti ne anzi lɔ, wɔ Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ ne la akpa bɛ ti, bɛ gyakɛ anwo enrinli nee bɛ kɛsa amuala.

Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yizilayɛma

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Awulae ɛdendɛ ɛtia Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, na ɔbaha Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yifelaem nee Samɛlea la amuala banwu kɛ Awulae a ɛyɛ a. Bɛmɛ, bɛtendɛ mgbole na bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛka kɛ,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Belekese ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛdudu ɛgua a, na yɛbava awolɛ mɔɔ bɛze la yeazi yɛ azua ne mɔ. Bɛdudu sekamɔ baka mgbunla ne mɔ, na yɛbava sida mbaka yɛaziezie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord made their enemies attack them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa kpɔvolɛma ne ɛdwazo kɛ bɛrɛla bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Seleama mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ bara yɛɛ Filisitiama mɔɔ vi adɔleɛ bara la ɛbuke bɛ nloa anu wanaanwo kɛ bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛali. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma annu bɛ nwo kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdea bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛamkpondɛ ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma pɛle Yizilayɛma ati nee bɛ dua, mrɛlakɛ nee ndɔ kenle kokye ala.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le kpanyinli nee mɔɔ bɛdi ye eni la a le Yizilayɛma ati ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ kilehile adalɛ ngilehilelɛ la a le dualɛ ne.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli menli ɛhye mɔ anyunlu bɛkile bɛ adenle la minli bɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli mgbanyinli nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ anzi la noma bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Awulae anye ɛnlie bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ anwo, yɛɛ ɔnlɛ anwunvɔnezelɛ ɔmmaa bɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ la. Ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnze Nyamenle na ɔbɔ munzule ɛbɛla, yɛɛ awie biala ka ɛtane. Ɔlua ɛhye mɔ ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo, ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli ne amumuyɛ ne yela kɛ senle, ɔyela mbowunzaka nee kolokolonyɛma; ɔmaa kpɔkɛmile sɔ, ye esike dwazo bolonwonwo kɔ anwuma.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya mɔɔ ɛva la ɛzɔ ɛyela azɛlɛ ne, na menli ne ɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛne mɔɔ wɔ senle nu la; adiema bɔbɔ ɛnze ɔ diema anwunvɔne.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Bɛto bɛ sa fema bɛfa, noko ɛhɔne ku bɛ, yɛɛ bɛdidi bɛkɔ bɛne zo, noko bɛ ko ɛnyi, awie ko biala di ɔ gɔnwo nwonane.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manasɛma teta Yifelaemma yɛɛ Yifelaemma teta Manasɛma na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛabɔ nu bɛateta Dwudama. Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi amumuyɛ mɛla bɛfa bɛsisi me menli ne la; nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnla aze bɛkɛlɛ nzisi mɛla la.

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne dwu na ahumu ne mɔɔ vi moa nehane bara la dwazo a duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a? Nienwu yɛɛ bɛbabɔ bɛ ti a, yɛɛ nienwu a bɛbagyakyi bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ a?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ɛhwee a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, kyesɛ bɛboka menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la anwo anzɛɛ bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la anwo. Ɛhye mɔ anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo; ɔbahɔ zolɛ yeadenrɛ ɔ sa yeadea bɛ. Nyamenle bava Aselea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne ali gyima

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Aa, Aselea, ɔle me baka nee me kpɔma mɔɔ mefa ɛya a

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: mefa metea maanle mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la, yɛɛ eza mesoa ye wɔ menli mɔɔ menwɔva bɛ nwo ɛya la anwo zo, memaa ɔkɔbo bɛ ɔsa bɛ ɔdie bɛ nwo ninyɛne, na ɔtietia bɛ nwo zo kɛ guabile zo ndɛtɛlɛ la.”

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Noko Aselea Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne ɛndwenle ye zɔhane, ɔdaye ɔlɛ ye adwenle ɛdeɛ. Ye adwenle a le kɛ ɔsɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala,

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔse, “Asoo me safohyenlema mgbanyinli ne mɔ amuala ɛnle arelemgbunli?

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Asoo metɛyɛle suakpole Kaleno kɛ menyɛle Kaakɛmehye la? Asoo metɛyɛle Heemate kɛ menyɛle Aapade la? Asoo metɛkonle metɛfale Samɛlea, kɛmɔ menvale Dɛmasekɛse la?

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: nee kɛ menzile menyɛle Samɛlea nee ye mmonle ananze ne mɔ la, asoo tɛ zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava meayɛ Gyɛlusalɛm nee ye mmonle ne mɔ a?”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Na Awulae zele me kɛ, “Saa mewie me gyima muala yɛ wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm a, mebadea Aselea belemgbunli ne nee ye adubɛnwo funli ne mɔɔ ɔlɛfa yeadu ɔ nloa anu nee ɔ nwo zo mɔɔ ɔlɛmemaa la.”

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli ne tu ɔ nloa anu kɛ, “Medame me anwosesebɛ nee me nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ meva meyɛ ɛhye a, ɔluakɛ melɛ ndelebɛbo. Medudu maanle maanle ɛweɛne ne mɔ megua, meza bɛ melie bɛ gya nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti; meyɛ me nwo ɛnlankɛ nyinli meha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede arelemgbunli mbia zo la megua.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ewule adɔ ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la anwo yeamaa bɛanwa, na ye anyunlunyia ne bamaa bɛ nwo adwe bɛ kɛ bɛgua senle nu.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ wienyi ne bayɛ senle; Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne bayɛ senle tafinlima ayela mbowule nee mbowunzaka kenle kokye yeamaa bɛadɔ nzonle.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Mbaka mɔɔ baha ye kpɔkɛ nu la bayɛ ekyi bie mɔɔ kakula kola bɛ tia a. Ekyi bazia ara

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha, nee Gyekɔbo sua nu amra mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la ɛnrɛva bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛwula mɔɔ sisile bɛ la anu, na bɛbava bɛ rɛle bɛawula Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anu nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa wɔ menli Yizilayɛma anwo zonle kɛ ɛnweazo anwea bɔbɔ a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhale la anu ekyi bie a bazia ara a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ, na bɛbalua pɛlepɛlelilɛ zo a bɛazɛkye bɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ɔ muala ara awieleɛ, kɛmɔ yehyehyɛ yedo ewiade ye amuala la. Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Aseleama

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O me menli mɔɔ de Zayɔn, saa Aseleama fa bɛ mbaka ba bɛ nwo zo, bɛlɛsisi bɛ, kɛmɔ Yigyibitima yɛle la a, bɛmmasulo.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na me ɛya ne mɔɔ meva ye bɛ nwo la adwo, na meava ɛya meadea Aseleama.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebaheha me nwo meatia Aseleama na meabila bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛbilale Medeanema wɔ Olɛbe Bodane ne anwo la. Me baka ne badende adwu nyevile nu na meanloma bɛ, kɛmɔ menyɛle Yigyibitima la.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, mebaye ye kpomgbolo ne bɛ kɔme na meabubu ye gyɛnvayile ne mɔɔ la bɛ kɔme zo la.” Kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema teta Yizilayɛma

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema vi Relemɔn ɛrava Eyae na bɛtele zolɛ bɛdwu Megelɔn. Ɛlɔnema ne ɛgyakyi bɛ ninyɛne wɔ Mekemahye;

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: bɛpɛ ademgbole ne bɛhɔla Giba. Menli mɔɔ wɔ Releema la ahonle ɛdu, yɛɛ Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo sua zo Gebɛyama ɛgua ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: O Galemma, bɛdea! Bɛdeɛdea nu! Bɛdie, O Leeyehyema! Anatoma, bɛbua ye!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Mademinama ɛgua ndwɛlɛ aze, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Gibem la ɛlɛnriandi alie bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kenle ye, kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema ne baragyinla Nɔɔbo, bɛbazua bɛ ahɛlɛ ne wɔ Zayɔn Boka, suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava tumi kpole aha bɛ agua kɛ bɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ baka ngane la. Mɔɔ ɛnyi tendenle kpalɛ la, ɔbapɛ ye yeado na yeaha mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la aze.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ɔbava akuma yeaha kpɔkɛmile ne yeagua, na bɛazɛkye Lɛbanɔn nee ye mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Gyɛsi dosinli ne , bakpuke ɛnyelɛ wɔ ye ndinli ne mɔ anu anyi ayɛ Baka Ɛhane.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne bara ɔ nwo zo, ɔbanwu nrɛlɛbɛ, yeanyia ndelebɛbo, ɔbanyia anwosesebɛ, yeayɛ folɛtuvolɛ, ɔbanyia adwenle na yeazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Ɔbava anyelielɛ yeayɛ tieyɛ yeamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔnrɛbua ndɛne ɛnyelɛzo, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyea ɔ nzo ɔnrɛbua ndɛne.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ɔbabua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne pɛlepɛle nu, na yeabua awienvolɛma ndɛne pɛpɛ; ɔbava ɔ nloa yeayɛ baka yeadea azɛlɛ ye azo ɛtanema, yeava ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ yeahu amumuyɛma.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Bedi nee boane ralɛ badɛnla, yɛɛ boboduma nee abɔnkye ralɛ bala ɛleka ko. Ɛnlankɛ ralɛ nee awenade babɔ nu adidi, na kakula yɛɛ banlea bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Ɛnlankɛ nee ezizile babɔ nu adidi, bɛ mra babɔ nu ala ɛleka ko, na awenade bali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ la.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Kakula mɔɔ la nyɛfonlɛ nloa la nee ɛwɔlɛ bali nwɔhoa, yɛɛ kakula mɔɔ ɛdudu agyakɛ la bava ɔ sa awula bɔna bɔne nu.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛboda anzɛɛ bɛnrɛhu awie wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo adwenle bayi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ kɛ nzule mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu la. Menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la bazia ara

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Belemgbunli Devidi abo zo sonla ne bagyinla kɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ la yeamaa maanle maanle. Maanle maanle bakpondɛ ye, na ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la bayɛ anyelielɛ.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Awulae badenrɛ ɔ sa bieko yealie Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la yeavi Aselea, Yigyibiti, Patelɔso, Sudan, Yilam, Babelonia, Heemate, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛnweanloa la asa anu.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ yeahile kɛ ɔlɛboɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛmbu bɛ bie, nee Dwudama mɔɔ ɛkponde la anloa yeavi azɛlɛ ye muleɛ nna ne mɔ azo yeara.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Yifelaem anyebolo ne bavi ɛkɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyegye Dwuda la bɛbazɛkye bɛ; Yifelaem anye ɛnrɛbolo Dwuda, yɛɛ Dwuda ɛnrɛgyegye Yifelaem bieko.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Bɛbabɔ nu bɛara Filisitiama anwo zo wɔ adɔleɛ, yɛɛ bɛbabɔ nu bɛarave menli mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la ninyɛne. Bɛbaho bɛava Yidɔm nee Mowabe, yɛɛ Amɔnoma bayɛ tieyɛ amaa bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye Suwɛze Ebolo ne bɔkɔɔ na yeanwɔha ɔ sa wɔ Azule Yufileti ne azo yeamaa anwoma wuluwulu arasesa ye. Ɔbahyɛ nu nsuu yeamaa menli alua azɛlɛ resee zo apɛ.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛbakpakye ademgbole bɛavi Aselea bɛahɔva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle bɛ nlenya mɔ Yizilayɛma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛbaha kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo, ɔluakɛ ɛvale me nwo ɛya bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɛgyakyile ɛmanle ɔhale, na ɛkyekyele me rɛle.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Nyamenle le me ngoanedievolɛ; menrɛzulo, mebava me rɛle meawula ye nu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le me anwosesebɛ nee me edwɛne, na yeyɛ me ngoanedievolɛ.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Ɛbava fɛlɛkolilɛ wɔado nzule wɔavi ngoanelielɛ bula ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛbaha kɛ, “Bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, bɛbɔ ye duma bɛlie moalɛ; bɛmaa ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ɛla ali wɔ maanle maanle avinli, bɛbɔ ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo bɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ ninyɛne mgbole; bɛmaa awie biala ɛde ɛhye wɔ ewiade amuala anu.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Bɛdeɛdea nu, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne, O Zayɔnoma, ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la le kpole.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Babelɔn anwo, mɔɔ Nyamenle luale Emɔzo ara Ayezaya anwo zo vale dole gua la ɛne:

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: “Fa sɛkɛlɛneɛ sie boka bie mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnle zo la azo, na tea nu ka kile bɛ; nwɔha ɛ sa kile bɛ kɛ bɛwolo titilema nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Medame mumua ne yɛɛ meze me menli mɔɔ medu bɛ memaa me nwo, me katakyiema ne kɛ bɛlua me ɛyavalɛ ne azo bɛli gyima a. Bɛle konimlilɛma mɔɔ mefa bɛ metu me nwo a.”

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, alɛra bie wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ kɛ menli apenle apenle ɛlɛteɛdea nu! Bɛdie, arelemgbunli nee maanle maanle ɛdu ɛfonyia na bɛlɛboɔboa bɛ nloa! Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛboɔboa ye ɛlɔnema anloa ahɔ konle.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Bɛvi moa moa maanle bie anu wɔ ewiade abo lɔ a bɛlɛba a. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye ɛya konle ninyɛne ne mɔ ɛlɛba arazɛkye ewiade ye amuala.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye; ɔle kenle mɔɔ Tumivolɛ ne bava azɛkye ninyɛne a.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Ɛsalɛ biala anu bado, awie biala ahonle badu,

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: na bɛ rɛle abɔ. Bɛ nwo bafofo bɛ, bɛ mbowule nu babubu bɛ na bɛade nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. Bɛbava ɛzulolɛ bɛanleɛnlea bɛ nyunlu ngoko ngoko; bɛ nyunlu baza.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba; ɔle ɛya kenle anu ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ahakyi azɛlɛ ye ɛsɛlɛ, na yeazɛkye ɛtanema amuala yeavi zolɛ a.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra nee bɛ sɔsɔkɛ ne amuala, biala ɛnrɛda; sɛnzɛne ne balu wɔ ye ɛdudulɛ nu, yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛda.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadea ewiade amra amuala wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, yɛɛ mebadea amumuyɛma wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ ati. Mebamaa mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu la agyakyi ye adubɛnwo ne, na meamaa mɔɔ ati yɛ se na ɔnze anwunvɔne la agyakyi ɔ nwo zo ɛmemanlɛ.

english_verse: Survivors will be harder to find than the purest gold.
translation_verse: Mebamaa nrenya nwo ahyia adɛla ezukoa nvutuke, yɛɛ sonla dasanli nwo bahyia adɛla Ofɛ ezukoa nvutuke.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebamaa anwomanyunlu awozo, na azɛlɛ akpusu adudu avi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyi la, wɔ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma me ɛya kenle anu ɛzulolɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: “Menli kɔsɔɔti bayɛ kɛ ahɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ bɛdoa bɛ bɛlɛkye bɛ, anzɛɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛbɔ asande na awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ boɔboa bɛ nloa la. Awie biala banriandi ahɔ ye menli avinli wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu ye la bɛbawɔ ye atwɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhye ye la bawu dadeɛ nloa.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Bɛbava bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛafifi debie bɛatete bɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, bɛbave bɛ sua nu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na bɛamia bɛ ye mɔ bɛ nee bɛ adeda.”

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, melɛmaa Mideama ara Babelɔnoma anwo zo. Bɛmɛ, bɛmbu dwɛtɛ fufule yɛɛ bɛ nye ɛnlie ezukoa nvutuke nwo.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Bɛbava bɛ ɛda ne mɔ bɛahu mgbavolɛ ne mɔ, bɛnrɛze nlɔma bɔbɔ anwunvɔne na yeayɛ ngakula.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle bazɛkye Babelonia, maanle kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ tɛla maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, maanle ne mɔɔ nuhua menli fa ye tu bɛ nwo la, kɛ ɔzɛkyele Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua ɛlɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu. Arelabenli biala ɛnrɛzi ye ndanlɛ sua wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu, yɛɛ mboaneneavolɛma ɛnrɛva bɛ mboane ɛnrɛhɔ ɛkɛ ne adidi.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Nanemgbole bava ɛkɛ ne ayɛ bɛ alaleɛ, yɛɛ bɛ azua ne mɔ bayɛ nyɛmoa mɔɔ kpo la dabelɛ; soholo bahɔdɛnla ɛkɛ ne bie, yɛɛ ɛkɛ ne a mɛnlamenlakɛ barazi bɛ agole a.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Ɛrane bakpo ye tawa ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ ɛzonlɛ bava bɛ suakunlu kɛnlɛma ne mɔ. Ye mekɛ ne ɛbikye. Babelɔn mekɛ ɛwie.”

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma banwu Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne na eza yeava bɛ bieko kɛ ye menli. Ɔbamaa bɛadɛnla bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, nyɛvolɛ baraboka bɛ na bɛava bɛ nwo bɛabeta Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la anu amra baboa Yizilayɛma bɛamaa bɛazia bɛara. Na Yizilayɛma bava nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ ayɛ bɛ ahanra mraalɛ nee mrenya wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛbahye menli mɔɔ hyele bɛ hɔle nlɔnu la nuokɛ na bɛazie menli ne mɔɔ sisile bɛ la. Babelonia belemgbunli ne wɔ mɔwuamra maanle nu

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma maa bɛ nyane nee abodelɛ nee gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ bɛmanle bɛyɛle la ka aze a,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: bɛbado edwɛne bɛagolo Babelonia belemgbunli ne anwo bɛaha kɛ, “Sisiravolɛ ne asa ɛhondo aze, nzisi ɛwie!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbubu amumuyɛma kpɔma ne anu, yezɛkye arelemgbunli amumuyɛma tumi ne,

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye azo amuala ɛyɛ diinyi, anzonudwolɛ ɛra, na bɛkpakye bɛ ne nu bɛto edwɛne.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Sepelɛse nee Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka si ɛ ti zo agole bɛka kɛ, ‘Sumunli kɛ bɛbɛlɛle wɔ aze la, awie ɛtɛbale kɛ ɔbabu yɛ yeagua.’

english_verse: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
translation_verse: “Ɛbolɔ ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ saa ɛba a ɔbarayia wɔ adenle. Azɛlɛ ye azo mgbanyima nwomenle badwazo arayɛ wɔ akoaba, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛle arelemgbunli wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la badwazo bɛ arelemgbunli mbia zo ayia wɔ.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛbadendɛ na bɛaze wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛdawɔ noko wɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ la. Ɛ nee yɛ ɛyɛ pɛ!

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Getaa ɛbɔlɛ mgbole mɔɔ bɛvale bɛlile ɛ nzi, nee enililɛ kpole ne ɛrawie Ɛbolɔ; azonlɛ ɛyɛ wɔ ɛkpa ɛla zo, yɛɛ azone a le wɔ kundu mɔɔ gua ɛ nwo a.’

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: “O Alehyenlɛ Ɛwɔlɔra, Aleɛbahye Ralɛ Nrenya, ɛvi anwuma wɔdɔ aze kpole o! Wɔmɔ mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɛka maanle maanle aze fɛɛnye la, nea aze ko mɔɔ bɛvuandi wɔ bɛdo a!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Ɛvale ɛlile afua kɛ, ‘Mefo meahɔ anwuma lɔ, meadɛla Nyamenle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ. Mebava me belemgbunli ebia ne meazie anwuma lɔ; mebahɔdɛnla sɔlɔ moa moa nehane ayiama boka ne azo;

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: mebavo meahɔ anwuma meadɛla amungu ne mɔ na meayɛ me nwo kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ a bɛ nee wɔ ɛra ɛbolɔ sua zo ɛke wɔ ewule kuma ye abo la.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbanwu wɔ la banlea wɔ kpoonwu na bɛadwenledwenle ɛ nwo bɛabiza kɛ, ‘Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ manle ewiade kpusule na ɔbutubutule arelemgbunlililɛ nye aze la ɛne?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ bɔle azuamgbole, na ɔmanle ewiade yɛle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ la ɛne? Asoo nrenya ne mɔɔ angyakyi menli mɔɔ ɔhyele bɛ nuokɛ ɛlɛ la ɛne?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ne mɔ arelemgbunli deda ye anyunlunyia nu; biala nee ye nla,

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: na wɔmɔ, bɛvuandi wɔ bɛdo moa moa bɛvi wɔ belemgbunli bane nu kɛ ralɛ mɔɔ ye mekɛ andwu na bɛkɛwo ye la. Mɔɔ bɛvale bɛguale ɛ nwo la a le ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dɔle dadeɛ nloa la avunli mɔɔ bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua ewule kuma bo awolɛ nu kɛ asɛɛ ɛle funli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtietia ɛ nwo zo a.
