english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛzie wɔ bɛnrɛboka arelemgbunli nwo, ɔboalekɛ wɔzɛkye wɔ azɛlɛ ne na wɔhu ɛdawɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Awie ɛnrɛbɔ munzule menli ne abo zo amra aluma bieko ɛlɛ.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Bɛhu ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ: Bɛ ze mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwu, anrɛɛ bɛkɛdwazo bɛkɛva ewiade ne na bɛkɛkyekye azuamgbole.” Nyamenle bazɛkye Babelɔn

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadwazo Babelɔn anwo zo na meazɛkye ye; menrɛvavi awie biala, ngakula nee debie biala, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Mebamaa fuke ava azɛlɛ ne; mebamaa nzule apepɛ bula bula agyinlegyinla zolɛ, na meava ɛzɛkyelɛ sane ne meapia ye meahɔgua. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Nyamenle bazɛkye Aseleama

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane kɛ, “Kɛmɔ mehyehyɛ la, zɔhane ala a ɔbayɛ a, yɛɛ kɛmɔ mezuzu la, zɔhane ala a ɔbagyinla a.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye Aseleama mɔɔ wɔ me azɛlɛ ne azo, mebaye me menli ne akɔme kpomgbolo na meazokoɛ bɛ adesoa.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ la ɛkɛ maa ewiade amuala la ɛne, yɛɛ tumi mɔɔ mebava meadea maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti la ɛne.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ a, nwane a kɛhola kɛzɛkye ye a? Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdenrɛ ɔ sa, nwane a kɛhola kɛkpɔla ɔ sa a? Nyamenle bazɛkye Filisitiama

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze hɔle ayile nu la yɛɛ bɛbɔle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye nolo a.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ ne se, “O Filisitiama amuala, bɛmmadi fɛlɛko kɛ baka ne mɔɔ bilale bɛ la ɛbubu, ɔluakɛ ɛwɔlɛ wu a, ɛwɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ finde ɔ nzi, yɛɛ ɔto kolonvia a ɔbobɔ ɛwɔlɛ mɔɔ tu la.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ehyianli belamunli ralɛ bali aleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo badɔ ye. Na bɛmɛ, mebava ɛhɔne meabɔ bɛ menli mɔɔ hale la abo zo na meahu bɛ muala.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: “O Filisitiama, bɛ muala bɛva ɛzulolɛ bɛzu bɛye awolɛ wɔ bɛ azuamgbole zo nee bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa. Ɔluakɛ senle vi sɔlɔ ɛlɛba; bɛle ɛlɔnema mɔɔ bɛ nuhua biala ɛnle foanvoanle a.”

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Duzu mualɛ yɛɛ sonla bava amaa maanle ne soanvolɛma a? “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkyekye Zayɔn, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la anwo badɔ bɛ a.”

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Mowabe anwo la ɛne. Kɛmɔ kenle ko nɔɔzo yɛɛ bɛbɔle suakpole Aale, yɛɛ kenle ko nɔɔzo yɛɛ bɛbɔle suakpole Kɛɛ la, Mowabe maanle ne anu ɛyɛ diinyi.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Daebɔnoma ɛhɔ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle la kazu. Mowabema ɛlɛsu Niboma nee Midɛbama. Awie biala ɛkpa ɔ ti, ɛkpa ɔ kɛsa.

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: Bɛheda ɛrele bɛluolua gua ne mɔ azo, bɛgyinla azua ti zo nee bɛ azuamgbole zo ɛleka wienyi ne mɔ bɛsu bɛtwi monle.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Hɛhyebɔnoma nee Ɛlɛyalima ɛlɛsu. Bɛte bɛ ne wɔ Gyeehaze, yemɔti akee Mowabe ɛlɔnema ɛlɛsu kpole kpalɛ na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Medi Mowabema anwo nyane. Maanle ne anu amra nriandi kɔfea Zowaa nee Ɛgelate Hyɛlehyaya. Bie mɔ fo boka ne kɔ Luhete kɔsu; bɛdwu Hɛloneeyem adenle nu a bɛsu toonwo asɛɛ debie yɛ bɛ.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nemelem nzule ne mɔ ɛsesa, ndile ne mɔ ɛwe, mɔɔ bɔle nrɛlɛne wɔ ɔ bo la ɛyela, ndile amolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati aleɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye, nee bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, bɛzoale bɛ muala bɛpɛle bɛhɔle Welo Kpɔkɛ Bɔnza ne anzi lɔ.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ɛzunlɛ ɛde Mowabe maanle ne anu ɛleka biala. Ɛzunlɛ ne ɛdwu Yigeleeyem nee Biyɛyilem.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Daebɔn azule ne mɔ ɛhakyi mogya, noko mebamaa mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye la ara Daebɔn anwo zo; mebamaa awenade ahye Mowabema mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ na bɛnriandi la ali, na meazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhale azɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Mowabema ɛzoa menli vi Sila ɛmaa bɛva ɛsɛlɛ zo adenle ne anu bɛva mboane bɛhɔmaa Gyɛlusalɛm belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Bɛdwu Azule Anɔn ne anloa a bɛdi tutɛnla kɛ nloma mɔɔ bɛvoa bɛ wɔ bɛ sane nu la.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: Bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Bɛhile yɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la, bɛ nee yɛ ɛli ye pɛlepɛle zo. Bɛheda yɛ nwo zo kɛ nɔɔzo awozinli wɔ ewiazo sɛnzɛngyinla; bɛva menli ne mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la bɛvea, na bɛmmaye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi konle nu la bɛmaa.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛdayɛ Mowabema mɔɔ awie ɛmbu yɛ bie la ɛradɛnla bɛ avinli, na bɛlie yɛ kɛ nriandivolɛma wɔ sɛkyevolɛ ne asa anu.” (Saa nzisi wie na bɛgyakyi azɛlɛ ne ɛzɛkyelɛ, na sɛkyeravolɛ ne vi azɛlɛ ne azo tu a,

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: akee bɛbava ɛhulolɛ kpundii bɛazie ebia; ahenle mɔɔ badɛnla zolɛ la vi Belemgbunli Devidi abusua nu. Ɔbava nɔhalɛlilɛ yeazie menli ne, ɔbayɛ sonla mɔɔ kulo tenleneyɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeabua ndɛne.)

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa Mowabema ɛzu bie. Awie biala ɛzu Mowabe. Bɛnwu amaneɛ yɛɛ nyane ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ Kɛɛ Hɛlɛse vanye ma welera ndɛlamoa ne mɔ ɛbɔ bɛ.”

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Hɛhyebɔn ɛya avule ne mɔ nee Sebema vanye egyinli ne mɔ ɛzɛkye. Ɛbɔ ye Sebema ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ kɔkpula Gyeezɛ, toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu ɛsɛlɛ ne anloa lɔ, ɔpɛ nu ɛkɛ ɔkɔ toonwo ɔkɔgua ye Nyevile Wulera ne anloa la vanye egyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ manle maanle maanle arelemgbunli zile ngosi la ngane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Yemɔti mefa ɛzunlɛ mɔɔ mefa mesu Gyeezɛ la meazu Sebema vanye egyinli ne mɔ. Mesu meagua Hɛhyebɔn nee Ɛlɛyali ati zo, ɔluakɛ bɛ ma nee bɛ bɛyɔba ne mɔ anwo zo a konle nu alɛrayɛlɛ ne ɛragua a.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ ɛvi bɛ ma egyinli ne mɔ anu, awie ɛndeɛdea nu wɔ ɛkɛ. Awie ɛndwihwi nwanye ɛnvi vanye ma nu; vanye ma ɛtetelɛ nu anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne ɛwie.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Yemɔti me ɛkɛla kulu ɔ kunlu kɛ getaa kpole la wɔ Mowabe ati, yɛɛ medi Kɛɛ Hɛlɛse anwo nyane.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Saa Mowabema ye bɛ nyunlu, bɛfa bɛ nyane bɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la kɛ bɛkaye ɛdɛne a, ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ Mowabe anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la ɛne.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Kɛkala Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ɛvolɛ nsa pɛpɛ, mɔɔ le kɛ ɛkpabɔlɛ mekɛ la pɛpɛ, Mowabe maanle ne anyunlunyia badɔ aze. Menli bebelebe ne mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la, ekyi bie a baha a, yɛɛ eza bɛ nwo ɛnrɛyɛ se.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane Dɛmasekɛse anwo la ɛne. Ɔse, “Bɛnlea, Dɛmasekɛse ɛnrɛyɛ suakpole bieko; ɔbayɛ ewula edukue.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Alowɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti badɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ bieko ɛlɛ a. Bɛbayɛ nyɛmoa alaleɛ. Bɛbahɔla ɛkɛ na awie ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Aranemgbole ne mɔ baminliminli Yifelaem, yɛɛ belemgbunlililɛ bavi Dɛmasekɛse; Seleama mɔɔ ɛha la anyunlu bagua aze kɛ Yizilayɛma la. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra anyunlu bagua aze na bɛanwa bɛayɛ nrenzenrenze.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Ma ngoko ngoko bie a baha zolɛ a, kɛ ɔlivi baka mɔɔ bɛtete zolɛ ma ne amuala na yeha kɛyɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa bie wɔ baka ne ati zo nehane, anzɛɛ nna anzɛɛ nnu wɔ baka ne ngane ne mɔɔ so kpalɛ la azo la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle a mese a.”

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli banwu bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne na bɛahakyi bɛ nye Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anwo.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛbu bɛ sa anloa gyima mɔɔ le bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnlea mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛva bɛ sa bɛyɛ bɔbɔ la, na yeayɛ bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne ananze ne mɔ anzɛɛ bɛ ɛyɛlɛkpunlɛ azukponle ne mɔ.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛ se la bayɛ kɛ Haevaema nee Amɔlema azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la. Bɛvile azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bɛnriandile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛlɛba la, na azua ne mɔ badɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ arɛle ɛvi ye ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ ɔngakye ye Ɛvealeka Bodane ne, mɔɔ le ye ɛvealeka la. Zɔhane ati bɛdua mbaka ngɛnlɛma na bɛava nyɛvolɛ awozonle bɛaziezie nu bɛazonle bɛ.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Bɛbanlea bɛamaa bɛanyi kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la, na bɛamaa bɛazo kenle ko ne ala nwonlomɔ ne mɔɔ bɛkɛlua la, noko bɛnrɛnyia bɛyɔba. Nyane nee amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a bɛbanwu ye a. Bɛli kpɔvolɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo konim

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ne mɔ tea, bɛ ne kulu kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ zo la. Noko ɔbahwi bɛ nyunlu, na bɛbagua ndwɛlɛ aze, bɛanriandi kɛ awoka zo abonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye ahɔ, anzɛɛ munlutu mɔɔ ɛlɛdi akyima wɔ ahumuakyima nu la.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Aleɛ dwo a, nea, ɛzulolɛ ngome! Mɔɔ aleɛ kahye la ɛnee biala ɛnle ɛkɛ! Menli mɔɔ sɛkye yɛ, wua yɛ nwo ninyɛne la kyɛfoa ɛ.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Sudan azule ne mɔ anzi lɔ, azɛlɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ndɛbalɛ nu,

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: na bɛsoa ɛbɔfoɔma wɔ ndɔ ɛlɛne nu bɛmaa bɛkɔ Azule Naele ne nyiakɛ. Bɛmɛ soanvolɛma mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ a, bɛhɔ maanle bie mɔɔ nuhua menli ne le ndendenle, bɛ nwo yɛ fɛ na menli mɔɔ ewiade amra amuala sulo bɛ la anu; ɔle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ na ɔdi konim wɔ konle nu a, yɛɛ ye azɛlɛ ne, azule dɔɔnwo ɛgyigya nuhua.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewiade la amuala, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ye azo la, saa bɛmaa sɛkɛlɛneɛ bie zo wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ a, bɛnlea. Saa bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle nu a, bɛdie.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ɛleka mɔɔ mede la, mebado me nye meanlea bɛ koonwu kɛ ɛbuhenle nu wuluwulu ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ tɔ nɔɔzo, meavede me nye meanlea azɛlɛ ye.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Bɛbagyakyi bɛ bɛamaa awoka zo nloma nee azɛlɛ ye azo nane kɛ bɛli. Bɛbayɛ nloma aleɛ wɔ wawaa nu, na bɛayɛ azɛlɛ ye azo nane kɔsɔɔti aleɛ wɔ fɔsɛlɛ nu.”

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli ndendenle anwo fɛlɛko mɔɔ ewiade amra sulo bɛ, na bɛle maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ di konim wɔ konle nu, mɔɔ azule dɔɔnwo ɛgyigya bɛ azɛlɛ ne anu la bava ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne arɛlɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Zayɔn Boka, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Yigyibiti anwo la ɛne. Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma de amungu zo ɛlɛba waa zɛhae, ɔlɛba Yigyibiti. Awozonle mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la nwu ye a bɛ nwo bawozo bɛ, na Yigyibitima ahonle badu.

english_verse: “I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebamaa Yigyibitima angome adwazo atia bɛ nwo, adiema nee adiema baho, agɔnwolɛ badwazo agɔnwolɛ nwo zo, suakpole nee suakpole baho, na arelemgbunli adwazo arelemgbunli nwo zo.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛnwomenle mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la bawie, na mebazɛkye bɛ adwenle ngyehyɛleɛ biala. Bɛbahɔ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ, bɛ ngonyiama, menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo, yɛɛ bayivolɛma ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne abisa,

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: noko mebaye Yigyibitima ne meamaa menlenlɛ bie mɔɔ ati yɛ se la, na belemgbunli anwo ɛzulolɛ bie bazie bɛ. Medame Awulae, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ mese la ɛne.”

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Azule Naele ne basesa ayɛ resee, azɛlɛ ne akpakyekpakye;

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: ye ngane ne mɔ basesa na ye ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdukue ye bɛva la abɔ nvoanvoa, na nuhua ndɔ nee ndile akpɔlɔ.

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Naele ne anloa azɛlɛ ne mɔ badɔ mgbane; aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ ɛkɛ ne la amuala banwoso awu, na anwoma apia bɛ ahɔ.

english_verse: Those who fish in the Nile will be discouraged and mourn.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛhyelɛma mɔɔ to koba nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛto avonle wɔ Naele ne anu la anwo bavɔ, na bɛbazu bɛaye awolɛ.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ yɛ dwɛsɛ nwo gyima nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ndanlɛ la arɛle babɔ.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle mandimase wɔ maanle ne anu la, bɛbaha bɛ senle dwɛɛ, na alɔbɔlɛ bahu gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ di ɛkpa la.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Zowan mgbanyima le ahoasea kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne folɛtuvoma tu folɛ ɛtane. Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka bɛkile Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Mele nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ra, mele mɔmoane arelemgbunli ne mɔ bie ara nrenya” ɛ?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne wɔ nienwu? Bɛmaa bɛha na bɛye debie ko mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ mɔɔ ɔbava yeayɛ Yigyibitima la bɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zowan mgbanyima ɛyɛ ahoasea, yɛɛ bɛbɛlɛbɛla Mɛmefese mgbanyima. Yigyibiti titilema mɔɔ lɛ maanle ne la ɛmaa Yigyibitima anye zo ɛda bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye anyezota ɛdo Yigyibitima anwo, yemaa bɛbɔ atondo wɔ bɛ debie biala ɛyɛlɛ nu kɛ nzanli mɔɔ ɛbo ɛfefe ɛla nu la.

english_verse: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Debie biala ɛnle Yigyibiti mɔɔ tile o, dualɛ o, ɛrɛlakɛ anzɛɛ ndɔ kɛhola kɛyɛ a. Yigyibitima bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Yigyibitima bayɛ kɛ mralɛ. Sulosulo bamaa bɛ nwo awozo bɛ wɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa yeara bɛ nwo zo la abo.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Dwuda maanle ne anwo baha Yigyibitima ɛzulolɛ. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ duma ne bɛkɛhile Yigyibitima la, ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ wɔ mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔfa yeayɛ bɛ la ati.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu azuamgbole nnu mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la baha Keena anzɛɛ Hibulu aneɛ ne bie na bɛazonle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛbavɛlɛ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ anu ko “Sɛnzɛne Suakpole.”

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛbazi Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo na bɛakpɔnla Ɛdɛnkɛma mpila wɔ maanle ne ɛweɛne zo.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bayɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee daselɛ wɔ maanle ne anu, amaa mekɛ biala mɔɔ sisiravolɛma kɛdwazo bɛ nwo zo la, saa bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ ye a yearɛlɛ bɛ dievolɛ yeamaa yearaho yealie bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Yigyibitima anwu ye, na Yigyibitima banwu Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ mekɛ ne anu na bɛava azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛazonle ye; bɛbabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ na bɛaye.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yigyibitima na eza yeayɛ bɛ ayile; bɛbazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ, na ɔbadie bɛ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na yeayɛ bɛ ayile.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ademgbole bala Yigyibiti nee Aselea avinli. Aseleama bahɔ Yigyibiti, yɛɛ Yigyibitima bahɔ Aselea maanle nu, na Yigyibitima nee Aseleama babɔ nu azonle.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Yizilayɛ badɔ Aselea nee Yigyibiti anwo zo bɛayɛ maanle nsa, na bɛayɛ nyilalɛ bɛamaa ewiade amra amuala.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ yɛɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha me menli Yigyibitima, Aselea mɔɔ le me sa anloa gyima, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ, me agyadeɛ.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Aselea maanle maanle Belemgbunli Sagɔn zoanle ye Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea ye ɛlɔnema anwo zo la manle ɔvale ɛlɔnema ɔrale Ahyedɔdo ɔrahonle ɔvale suakpole ne.

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdendɛ ɛhile Emɔzo ara Ayezaya kɛ, “Kɔzianyi ɛrele ne mɔɔ hye ɛ nze zo la na yeye ɛ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa ne mɔ,” na yeyɛ ye zɔ, ɔlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ, ɔ gyakɛ gua aze na ɔzo ɔlua.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Me sonvolɛ Ayezaya ɛlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ, ɛgua ɔ gyakɛ aze yeluolua toonwo ɛvolɛ nsa. Ɛhye le sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile mɔɔ bazi Yigyibitima nee Sudanema anwo zo la.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli ne bahye Yigyibitima nuokɛ na yeazoa Sudanema yeahɔ nlɔnu. Ɔbahye ngakula nee mgbanyinli mɔɔ lɛ bɛ nwo zɔ, bɛ gyakɛ gua aze, na bɛ butua gua zo la yeahɔ, yeava yeagua Yigyibitima anyunlu aze.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛdo Sudanema anwo zo na bɛfa Yigyibiti bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la arɛle babɔ na bɛ adwenle aha abɔ nu.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ɛnweanloa nehae la baha kɛ, ‘Bɛnlea mɔɔ ɛzi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yɛvale yɛ rɛle yɛwulale bɛ nu, na yɛnriandile yɛhɔdanenle bɛ kɛ bɛboa yɛ na bɛlie yɛ bɛvi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu la anwo zo a! Na yɛmɛ, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Babelonia anwo la ɛne: Ɔle kɛ ahumuakyima mɔɔ vi nyiakɛ ɛlɛtu la, ɔvi ɛsɛlɛ zo a ɔlɛba a, ɔvi maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ bie anu a ɔlɛba a.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ a menwu ye la; ninyɛnevenlɛma mɔɔ fe ninyɛne nee ninyɛnezɛkyelɛma mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne. Yilam ɛlɔnema, bɛhɔho! Midea ɛlɔnema, bɛhɔbɛnra azuamgbole bɛyia! Nyamenle se, “Mebazi nyanehilelɛ ne mɔɔ Babelɔn ɛhile menli la kɔsɔɔti aze.”

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Yemɔti nyane ɛwolowolo me na me nwo fofo me kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. Me ti ɛzi aze, yemɔti mende ɛhwee, yɛɛ me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu, yemɔti mennwu ɛhwee.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: Me ti kpakye me, ɛzulolɛ ɛheda me nwo zo. Akee aledwolɛ ne mɔɔ me nwo lɔle ye la anu ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole bie ɛmaa me.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ bɛdo ɛkponle ne, bɛziezie mbia nwolɛ na bɛlɛdi bɛno. Arɛlevilɛ nu bɛdeanle nu, “Safohyenlema, bɛdwazo bɛvɔ bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ nwole!”

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae zele me kɛ, “Kɔ, kɔva awie maa ɔgyinla ɔzinza, na mɔɔ ɔkɛnwu ye la yeava yeado gua.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Saa ɔnwu kɛ menli dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na bɛlua ye nwiɔ nwiɔ, bie mɔ dede asoaso nee afunlumu zo a, maa ɔdie bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɛlɛsinza la nwunle bɛ na ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ, “O Awulae, megyi tawa ye azo mesinza dahuu. Aledwolɛ nu amuala megyi me gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Na kɛkala nea, bɛmɛ a bɛlɛba la! Menli ne dede mgbɔnwɔ zo na bɛlua ye nwiɔ nwiɔ!” Na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Yebɔ! Babelɔn ɛbɔ; bɛbubu ye awozonle ananze ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛgua.”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: O me menli mɔɔ bɛtietia bɛ nwo zo bɛwozo bɛ na bɛhegye bɛ kɛ ma a, mɔɔ mede mevi Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ ne la a mebɔ ye nolo mehile bɛ la. Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Yidɔm anwo la

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Yidɔm anwo la ɛne: Awie wɔ Yidɔm ɛlɛfɛlɛ me. Ɔse, “Sinzavolɛ, aledwolɛ ne anu ɛ? Sinzavolɛ, aledwolɛ ne anu ɛ?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Sinzavolɛ ne bua ye kɛ, “Aleɛ ɛlɛkye, na eza aledwolɛ bara. Saa ɛse ɛbiza a, biza; anrɛɛ sia bɛla bieko.” Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Areleebea anwo la

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Areleebea anwo la ɛne: Bɛmɛ Didanema mɔɔ bɛ ehwili a le bɛ azua mɔɔ bɛda nu la, Areleebea kpɔkɛ bo ala a bɛbadɛnla a.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ Timama, bɛva nzule bɛrɛlɛ menli mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la, bɛva aleɛ bɛyia menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi munzule la.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnriandi bɛvi konle nu, bɛnriandi bɛvi dadeɛ nee ɛda nloa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae zele me kɛ, “Ɛvolɛ ko pɛpɛ, kɛmɔ ɛkpabɔlɛ mekɛ ne kile la, Kida anyunlunyia badɔ aze,

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: na katakyiema mɔɔ ze ɛda to kpalɛ wɔ Kida la baha ekyi bie, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne a mese a.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ Bɔnza ne anwo la ɛne: Duzu a bɛlɛyɛ a, mɔɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛvo bɛhɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ ati zo,

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: na bɛlɛteɛdea nu, na suakpole ye azo ɛyɛ begyebegye, na bɛ nye ɛlie zɛhae ɛ? Bɛ menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la andɔ dadeɛ nloa yɛɛ bɛanwu konle nu.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛnriandi, noko bɛhye bɛ muala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ awie ando ɛda ko bɔbɔ la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandile bɛhɔle moa moa bɔbɔ la, bɛnwu bɛ bɛhye bɛ.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle kɛ, “Awie biala mmanea me; bɛmaa menzu mendwi monle kpalɛ; bɛmmapele kɛ bɛkyekye me rɛle wɔ me menli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la ati!”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne anyezota, ye konle nee ye menli ɛhunlɛ mekɛ wɔ Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ Bɔnza ɛdwu, na bɛbabubu suakpole ne bane ne mɔ bɛagua, na ɛdeɛdeanlɛ bara awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Yilam ɛlɔnema lɛ ɛda dede konle ehwili nu nee mgbɔnwɔ zo, yɛɛ Kɛɛ ɛlɔnema ɛye bɛ enyinlike ne mɔ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Bɛ mbɔnza kpalɛ ne mɔ anu ɛyɛ konle ehwili ngome, yɛɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dede mgbɔnwɔ zo la ɛva nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa Dwuda anwo ɛdanlɛ. Mekɛ ne anu bɛvale bɛ adwenle bɛzɔle konle ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ Kpɔkɛmile Sua ne anu la,

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: na bɛnwunle kɛ Devidi suakpole ne bane ne mɔ ɛgyigya dɔɔnwo. Bɛhɔsesale nzule wɔ nyiakɛ azule ne anu,

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: bɛdianle Gyɛlusalɛm azua ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bane ne mɔ anwo la na bɛbubule bie mɔ bɛvale bɛsosɔle bane ne mɔ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Bɛzile pike wɔ bane nwiɔ ne avinli bɛmanle azule dɛba ne zenzenle ragyinlanle nu. Noko bɛandwenle ahenle mɔɔ yɛle la anwo, yɛɛ bɛambu ahenle mɔɔ dwenlenle nwolɛ hyehyɛle dole ɛkɛ ne dɛba dɛba la bie.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne zele bɛ kɛ bɛzu na bɛli nyane, bɛkpa bɛ ti na bɛheda ɛrele;

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: na nea, bɛmanle bɛ nye liele, bɛlile fɛlɛko, bɛhunle nlankɛ nee mboane, bɛlile nane na bɛnlonle nwanye, na bɛhanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛli na yɛnlo, na ɛhyema ɛnee yɛwu.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛmaa mede ye me nzo nu kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, bɛnrɛva ɛtane ɛhye bɛnrɛhyɛ bɛ toonwo bɛkɛwu. Medame Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.” Hyɛbena kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle se, “Bɛla, kɔ Hyɛbena mɔɔ nea belemgbunli awuke ne azo la ɛkɛ na biza ye kɛ,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: ‘Duzu debie a ɛyɛ ye ɛke a, yɛɛ ɛ nee nwane a wɔ ɛke, mɔɔ yemɔti wɔbɔ nla wɔmaa ɛ nwo wɔ ɛke a? Wɔmɔ, ɛbɔ nla awoka zo na ɛtu bɔne wɔ bodane nu ɛyɛ wɔ tɛnlabelɛ.

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Nea, Ɛdɛnkɛma bavuandi wɔ ado kpole kpalɛ; ɛdawɔ ɛse ɛ nwo yɛ se! Ɔbazɔ wɔ mrɛlakɛ bo yeabili wɔ,

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: na yeavuandi wɔ kɛ bɔlo la yeade azɛlɛ tɛtɛlɛ bie azo; ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɛbawu na wɔ konle ehwili kɛnlɛma ne aha a. Anyiemgbanli, ɛ nwo yɛ nyiane wɔ ɛ menle sua nu bɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛaye wɔ gyima nu, na bɛaza wɔ bɛalie wɔ gyinlabelɛ ne.’ ”

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: na meava wɔ tɛladeɛ ne meawula ye, meava wɔ akyeso ne meahye ye, na meava wɔ tumi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ la meamaa ye. Na ɔbayɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ nee Dwuda amuala la bɛ ze.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Mebava Devidi awuke nu sanvɛ ne meamaa ye; ɔbabuke, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola nuhua to; ɔbado nu, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola ye buke.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Mebakpɔnla ye kɛ sika wɔ ɛleka kpalɛ, na ɔbayɛ anyunlunyia kpole yeamaa ɔ ze awuke nu amra.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: “Bɛbava debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɔ ze awuke nu ɛkɛ ne la bɛawula ɔ sa nu: mralɛ nee nlɔnra, ahɔpo mralɛ nee mgbole, nee debie biala bakpolo ɔ kɔme.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Na mekɛ ne anu medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Sika ne mɔɔ memkpɔnlanle la bakpɔlɔ na yeabu yeadɔ, na kpomgbolo ne mɔɔ kpolo ye la aye, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Taya anwo la ɛne: O Sepeen meli nu amra, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ Taya ɛbɔ, sua ɛnle zolɛ na yeayɛ ahonle mɔɔ meli gyinla ɛkɛ a ɔyɛ boɛ a. Nrɛlaleɛ ne vi Saepolɔso a rale a. Luk

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Bɛzie bɛ nwo diinyi, Saedɛn gualilɛma mɔɔ gua ɛnweanloa la, bɛ soanvolɛma ne pɛle nyevile ne

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: na bɛdwule tɛtɛlɛ nu lɔ. Bɛvale bɛ ezukoa ne bɛdɔle abɛlɛ wɔ Yigyibiti mɔɔ wɔ Azule Naele ne anloa la, na bɛ nee maanle maanle lile gua.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: O Saedɛn, wɔbɔ anyiemgba! Ɔluakɛ nyevile tandane ne ɛye wɔ. Ɔse, “Me ko ɛtɛkanle me yɛɛ metɛwole ɛlɛ. Metɛtetele ngakula mrenya anzɛɛ ngakula mraalɛ ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Saa edwɛkɛ ne dwu Yigyibiti a, ɛzulolɛ kpole baha bɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɛzi Taya la ati.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: O Fonehyeama mɔɔ de ɛnweanloa, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ! Bɛnriandi bɛhɔ Sepeen!

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Asoo bɛ anyelielɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛkyekyele mɔmoane ne la, yemɔ ɛne? Asoo bɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ zolɛ menli kɔ moa moa kɔbɔ nzeseɛ kyekye maanle la, yemɔ ɛne?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Nwane yɛɛ ɛhyehyɛ ɛhye ɛtia Taya a, arelemgbunli mgbole sua zo? Anrɛɛ ye gualilɛma le arelemgbunli; yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amra amuala bu ye gualilɛma.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛhyehyɛ a, kɛ ɔfa yeazɛkye adubɛnwoma anyunlunyia, na yeagua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ewiade amra di bɛ eni la anyunlu aze.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: O Sepeenema, bɛde bɛkponde bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo amuala kɛ Azule Naele bu aze la, na kɛkala awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola si bɛ aze a.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdende ɔ sa nyevile ne azo, yekpusu maanle maanle ne mɔ, na yeze kɛ bɛzɛkye Keena nee ye aranemgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Bɛmɛ Saedɛnema, bɛ anyelielɛ ɛwie. Bɛdwazo, bɛnriandi bɛhɔ Saepolɔso; ɛkɛ ne bɔbɔ, bɛ nzo nu ɛnrɛdwo bɛ.”

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: O Sepeen meli nu amra, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ bɛgua.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Fa wɔ getaa kpole ne, duolua suakpole ne azo, O tuutuunli mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi wɔ a! To edwɛne fɛlɛko, to edwɛne dɔɔnwo, amaa bɛava bɛahakye wɔ.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ye gualilɛ ninyɛne nee mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia bɛ wɔ ɛkpa ɛbɔlɛ nu la, bɛbadu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛzie yɛɛ bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛvea. Ye gualilɛ ninyɛne bamaa yeanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo nee ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɛkye ewiade amuala yeayɛ ye mgbane yeado ye ɛkɛ. Ɔbadu azɛlɛ ne anye yeafonyia na yeakponde menli mɔɔ de zo la amuala.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye amuala badɔ mgbane na zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azɛkye, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛha a.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye ɛwe, ɛhete, ewiade amuala ɛtuto, ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛnwoso, anwuma nee aze amuala ɛdo toboloo.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la ɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbulu Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo, bɛzɛkye ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ na bɛtulu ye damɛnlangoate ngyekyeleɛ ne.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati munzule ɛha azɛlɛ ye yɛɛ zolɛ menli ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne ati. Yemɔti azɛlɛ ye azo amra ɛlɛyela, menli ekyi bie a ɛha a.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Nwanye nwo ɛhyia, ɔluakɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ; menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ anye die bɛ nwo la adwenle ɛzɛkye.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Awie ɛnde getaa mgbole ne mɔ ane, sɔnwosɔnwo nee ahenle ne mɔ ane ɛgua, yɛɛ anyelielɛ alɛra ne ɛzi aze.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Bɛndɛnla nza bo bɛndo edwɛne bieko yɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ ɛyɛ ɛnwonle ɛmaa menli mɔɔ no la.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne azo begyebegye ne akee ɛbo zo, awie biala ɛdo ɔ nwo anlenkɛ nu, amaa awie gyɛne ambanwolo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛlɛsu kɛ nza ɛwie, anyelielɛ bo ɛdu, yɛɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛnle ewiade ne anu bieko.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne azo ɛyɛ kɛnlanana, nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛgolo ɛgua.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Zɛhae yɛɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu bayɛ a. Maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala anu bayɛ hilihelee kɛ ɔlivi baka mɔɔ bɛwie zolɛ ma kpolo, anzɛɛ vanye baka mɔɔ bɛwie zolɛ ma tete la.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ ne zo bɛto anyelielɛ edwɛne, yɛɛ adɔleɛ amra fa fɛlɛkolilɛ teɛdea nu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kpoleyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ aduduleɛ la, bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ɛnweanloa la ɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Wɔ ewiade muleɛ kɔsɔɔti azo yɛte kɛ bɛlɛto ayɛlɛyelɛ nee anyunlunyia edwɛne bɛamaa Tenlenenli Ko ne. Na mame, mese, “Nyane ngome ɛwie me kyekye, nyane ngome ɛwie me kyekye. Abule ɛbu me! Ngunzima tɛyɛ bɛ ngunzi ninyɛne ne mɔ, yɛɛ akee bɛ ngunziyɛlɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: O ewiade amra, ɛzulolɛ, ɛhane, yɛɛ ewule kuma ɛva bɛ aze.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛde ɛzulolɛ nganeɛ na ɔkɛnriandi la bahɔdɔ ewule kuma nu, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛvo file zo kɛvi ewule kuma nu la badɔ ɛhane nu. Ɔluakɛ bɛbukebuke anwuma nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ, na azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ ɛlɛkpusu.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye ɛkpuke kpole bie, nuhua ɛkpakye nwiɔ. Azɛlɛ ye ɛkpusu kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye ɛyɛ konikoni kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛbo nza la, na yehyea kɛ kpɔda. Ye ɛtane ɛbo ɔ nwo zo, na ɔbagolo yeagua mɔɔ ɔnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane Ɛdɛnkɛma badea anwuma tumivolɛma wɔ anwuma lɔ na yeadea azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli wɔ aze ɛke.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Bɛbaboɔboa bɛ muala bɛ nloa kɛ pilizama mɔɔ gua kuma nu la; bɛbagua bɛ efiade na mekɛ dɔɔnwo gua nu a bɛadea bɛ.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Akee siane ne balu kisii na sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛda bieko, ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bali belemgbunli wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm na yeahile ye anyunlunyia ne wɔ ye mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me Nyamenle; mebali wɔ eni kpole, mebaye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, tete yɛɛ ɛhyehyɛle bɛ a, yɛɛ nɔhalɛ nu wɔyɛ.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ suakpole ne ewula edukue, wɔyɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ la suadu; nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ suakunlu ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsisile la ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko, awie ɛnrɛkyekye ye bieko ɛlɛ.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ ɛvealeka kpundii wɔmaa ehyianvolɛma, ɛvealeka kpundii wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu; wɔyɛ enyinlike wɔwowa bɛ wɔ ahumu nee ewia samɛnlankɛ nu; ɔluakɛ atisesebɛma ɛtetalɛ ne le kɛ ahumu mɔɔ ɛlɛtia bane la;

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: ɔle kɛ anwoma wuluwulu mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ ɛsɛlɛ zo la. Ɛmaa nyɛvolɛ ne mɔ alɛrayɛlɛ gua; kɛ amungu si fa alubo wa ewia samɛnlankɛ nye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ wɔmaa atisesebɛma ɛgyakyi edwɛndolɛ a. Nyamenle to ɛkponle

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Zayɔn Boka ye azo yɛɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ nee nwanye mɔɔ ɛbe kpalɛ la ado ɛkponle amaa maanle maanle ne mɔ a.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Ɔbazɛkye debie biala mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ aguzo bɛheda maanle maanle ne mɔ azo la wɔ boka ɛhye azo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Ɔbame ewule bɔkɔɔ, na Awulae Nyamenle ne bakyikyi awie biala anye anwo monle, na yeakpa bɛ nwo nyiane kɔsɔɔti yeavi azɛlɛ ye azo. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔse a.

english_verse: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛbaha kɛ, “Bɛnlea, yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛne, yɛhendɛ ye, amaa yealie yɛ ngoane. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛne, yɛhendɛ ye; bɛmaa yɛ nye ɛlie na yɛli fɛlɛko wɔ ye ngoanelielɛ ne ati.” Nyamenle badea Mowabe

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne baheda Boka Zayɔn azo, na bɛbatietia Mowabe anwo zo kɛ bɛtietia ndɔ wulera zo wɔ ewula kuma nu la.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Ɔbatoto ɔ sa kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛweɛ azule la. Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma babɛlɛ ye mgbanyizonle ne nee ye azuleweɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne aze.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ɔbabubu ye bane ndendenle ne mɔ mɔɔ yelie yebɔ ɔ nwo bane la yeagua aze fɛɛnye.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛbado edwɛne ɛhye wɔ Dwuda azɛlɛ zo, Yɛlɛ suakpole bie mɔɔ yɛ se, ɔmaa ye ngoanelielɛ ne zo kɛ bane mgbole ndendenle.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Bɛbukebuke nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, amaa maanle tenlene ne mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la awolo nu.

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle gyi ɛ nwo zo la, ɛmaa ye anzonudwolɛ mɔɔ di munli, ɔboalekɛ ɔ rɛle wɔ wɔ nu.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu dahuu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne le damɛnlangoate bodane.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yeha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la aze; yezɛkye bɛ suakpole kɛnlɛma ne, yebubu bɛ bane ne mɔ yegua aze fɛɛnye.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Ehyianvolɛma tietia zolɛ, menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la tietia zolɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Tenlenenli adenle la aze fɛɛnye; ɛyɛ tenlenenli adenle ne tonlotonlo.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ adenle nu yɛɛ yɛlɛkendɛ wɔ a, O Ɛdɛnkɛma; mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la a le wɔ duma ne ɛhakyelɛ.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Nɔɔzo biala me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ, me sunsum mɔɔ wɔ me nu la kpondɛ wɔ. Ɔluakɛ saa wɔ ndeanlɛ ba ewiade a, ewiade amra sukoa pɛlepɛlelilɛ.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Saa ɛnwu amumuyɛnli anwunvɔne a, ɔnzukoa pɛlepɛlelilɛ; ɔyɛ amumuyɛ wɔ pɛlepɛlema maanle nu, ɔnnwu kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma si de bedevinli la.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔkpogya ɛ sa zo, noko bɛnnwu ye. Maa bɛnwu kɛ ɛsi ɛkulo wɔ menli ne la, na bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze. Maa wɔ senle ne ɛyela wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛhu bɛ.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbamaa yɛ nzo nu adwo yɛ, wɔyɛ yɛ gyima ne kɔsɔɔti wɔmaa yɛ.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, menlenlɛ bie mɔ ɛzie yɛ ɛlɛ, noko wɔmɔ ala yɛɛ yɛdie wɔ yɛto nu a.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Menlenlɛ zɔhane mɔ ɛwu, bɛnrɛdɛnla ngoane nu bieko; bɛle kɛ ɛlawolɛ, bɛnrɛdwazo ɛlɛ, zɔhane ati wɔzɛkye bɛ na wɔmaa menli arɛle ɛvi bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Wɔmaa yɛ maanle ye ɛyɛ kpole, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmaa yɛ maanle ye ɛyɛ kpole; anyunlunyia ɛha wɔ; wɔmaa yɛ azɛlɛ ye ɛdɛlɛ.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛkpondɛle wɔ wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, bɛvale bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛdole ɛ nyunlu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛtea bɛ la.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ ɛ ti, yɛyɛle kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛnrenzɛ, mɔɔ ye awolɛ mekɛ ɛdwu, na ɔ ko ɛha ye, na ɔlɛte nyane la.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛnee yɛ ko ɛha yɛ na yɛlɛnwu nyane kpalɛ, na yera kɛ, kɛ ɔsi ɔde la, yɛwo anwoma. Yɛtɛyɛle ngoanelielɛ nwo gyima yɛtɛmanle azɛlɛ ye, yemɔti ɛtane ewiade amra ɛtɛtule ɛtɛguale.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: Mɔwuamra bara ngoane nu, bɛbava bɛ nwonane ne bɛadwazo. O bɛmɛ mɔwuamra, bɛdunwue na bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ tɔ bɛ nwo zo la le wienyi, na ɔbada mɔwuamra anwo zo. Ndeanlɛ nee abozozielɛ

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Me menli, bɛrɛla, bɛwolo bɛ azua ne mɔ anu na bɛtoto bɛ nwo nlenkɛ nu. Bɛvea bɛ nwo ekyii kɔkpula kɛ ɛya ne kɛdwo la.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la ɔlɛba yearadea azɛlɛ ye azo amra wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne ati. Azɛlɛ ye baye mogya mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua ɔ nwo zo la amaa, yɛɛ ɔnrɛheda bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la anwo zo bieko.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ye dadeɛ ɛsesebɛ, kpole, nlane ne adua ɛwɔlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi la, Lɛveatan mɔɔ wuluwulu kakyihakyi ɔ nwo la kakɛ. Ɔbahu Lɛveatan na yeahu nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne mɔɔ la nyevile ne anu la.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma baha kɛ, “Bɛdo vanye egyinli kɛnlɛma ne anwo edwɛne!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a menea zolɛ a. Mekɛ biala megugua nzule zolɛ. Amaa awie anzɛkye ye la, mesinza ye nɔɔzo nee ewiazo.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Menva ɛya. Anrɛɛ ɛnee mbowule nee mbowunzaka wɔ nu mɔɔ me nee bɛ ko a, anrɛɛ menwɔteta bɛ na menwɔbɔ bɛ nu menwɔyela bɛ.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ saa bɛto bɛ nloa aze kɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ mefa bɛ mewula me kunlu a, ɛnee bɛ nee me ɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. Ɛhɛe, bɛ nee me ɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.”

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bara la anu Gyekɔbo abo zo amra abo bazɔ ndinli, Yizilayɛma bakpazi na bɛ nwo azo dɔɔnwo, na bɛ bo zo amra ava ewiade amuala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛtɛteanle Yizilayɛma, kɛmɔ ɔdeanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ bɛ la, yɛɛ ɔtɛkunle bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛhunle bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne la.

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Ngyikyi ngyikyi, ɛ nee bɛ lile na ɛmanle bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu, ɛvale wɔ aduduleɛ anwoma anloa ɛsesebɛ ne ɛvoanle bɛ.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Yemɔti debie mɔɔ Yizilayɛma yɛ a bɛkɛva bɛ ɛtane bɛkɛhyɛ bɛ la a le ɛhye: saa bɛbubu awozonle azukponle ne mɔ, bɛti bɛ motomoto kɛ munlutu, bɛbubu bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ anzɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛkpunlɛ azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne bieko la a, bɛkɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛkɛhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la ɛyɛ suadu; yeyɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkpo ye na bɛ rɛle ɛvi ye kɛ ɛsɛlɛ la. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ nlankɛ mralɛ didi na bɛda bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle a.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Saa suakpole ne azo mbaka ne bie mɔ ngane wu a bɛbubu bɛ bɛgua; mraalɛ basesa na bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛyɛne. Ɔluakɛ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo; yemɔti mɔɔ bɔle bɛ la ɛnrɛze bɛ anwunvɔne, yɛɛ ɔnrɛvavi bɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bawozo ma ne, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa yeahɔgua ye wɔ Azudenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo la anloa. O Yizilayɛma, bɛbadindi bɛ ngoko ngoko na bɛaboa bɛ nloa.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛbabɔ aweɛne tendenle kpole ne anu, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛminlinle bɛhɔle Aselea azɛlɛ zo, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvoanle bɛ bɛmanle bɛhɔle Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la bara na bɛarazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Boka Nwuanzanwuanza ne azo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha Yizilayɛ suakpole kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ nzabovoma ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la! Munzule ɛha ye, ye anyunlunyia ɛlɛkpa kɛ ndotolo abɔtile mɔɔ bobɔ menli mɔɔ nza ɛgya bɛ la ati wɔ anwonyia bɔnza nu la.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Awulae lɛ awie mɔɔ le katakyie na ɔ nwo yɛ se la; ahenle zɔhane le kɛ ahumu mɔɔ ɛlɛtu atete ezuawolɛ agua la, ahumu kpole mɔɔ sɛkye ninyɛne, ahumu anloa ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ maa azule yi bu aze la; ɔbava ɛzɛkyelɛ kpole yeara, yeadudu debie biala yeagua.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Bɛbali Yizilayɛ suakpole kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ nzabovoma ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la anwo zo konim;

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: na ye anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkpa kɛ ndotolo abɔtile mɔɔ bobɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ anwonyia bɔnza nu la ati la bayɛ kɛ wawaa nloa feege nzoleɛ mɔɔ kɛlumua kɛbolo la. Saa sonla nwu ye a, ɔte ɔdi ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ kɛ anyunlunyia abɔtile nee zolɛ kpɔba kɛnlɛma yeamaa ye menli ne mɔɔ hale la.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ɔbamaa mɔɔ bua ndɛne la pɛlepɛlelilɛ ahonle yeamaa yeabua ndɛne fɔɔnwo, na yeamaa mɔɔ ka konlema gua wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa la anwosesebɛ. Ayezaya nee Dwuda nzabovo Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma

english_verse: Priests and prophets stumble because they are drunk. Their minds are too confused to receive God's messages or give honest decisions.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ noko no nwanye bo yɛɛ bɛno nza ɛsesebɛ bɛtinda. Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma no nza ɛsesebɛ tinda. Nwanye maa bɛ adwenle ka bɔ nu yɛɛ nza ɛsesebɛ maa bɛtinda. Bɛfo wɔ bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛmbua ndɛne fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛkponle mɔɔ bɛde nwolɛ la azo le ɛveleɛ ngome, ɛleka ekyi bɔbɔ ɛnle zo mɔɔ le bɔkɔbɔkɔ a.

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔkilehile yɛ edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ, ɛhonlone ɛhonlone, ɛke ekyi, nehane ekyi.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma balua menli mɔɔ ka aneɛ gyɛne la anwo zo adendɛ ahile menli ɛhye mɔ

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnwomenlelielɛ a le ɛhye, bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛvɛ la ɛlie ye ɛnwomenle, ɛhye a le ɛnwomenlelielɛ a,” noko bɛandie la.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne bayɛ bɛ kɔme nu edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ agbɔkɛ, ɛhonlone, ɛhonlone, ɛke ekyi, nehane ekyi, amaa bɛahɔ na bɛadu bɛagua alɛnranyunlu, bɛabubu na bɛahye bɛ ɛhane nu bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ. Zayɔn mgbɛnezo bolɛ

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmɛ agolobɛnwoma mɔɔ bɛsie menli ɛhye mɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma!

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛha kɛ, “Yɛ nee ewule ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, yɛɛ yɛ nee ɛbolɔ ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ la, saa munzule kpole ne ba a ɔnrɛha yɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛmaa adalɛ ɛyɛ yɛ ɛvealeka, yɛɛ adalɛ nu a yɛnriandi yɛhɔvea a.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Bɛnlea, melɛfa bolɛ meado adiabo wɔ Zayɔn. Ɔbayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔ bɛnlea, mgbɛnezo bolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kpalɛ wɔ adiabo kpundii nu, na meahɛlɛ zolɛ kɛ, ‘Mɔɔ die di la ɛnrɛpele ndɛ.’

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Mebamaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ayɛ ɛzuzulɛ nyɛma ne na tenleneyɛlɛ ayɛ ɔ ti bolɛ ne. Ezuawolɛ ahumu bapia ɛvealeka ɛtane ne ahɔ na nzule ayi ava bodane ne.”

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbazɛkye ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee ewule kyekyɛle, yɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee Ɛbolɔ hyehyɛle la. Saa munzule kpole ne ba a, ɔbabu yeava bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Mekɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔse la, ɔbava bɛ, ɔluakɛ nwonlomɔ biala, alehyenlɛ biala nee aledwolɛ biala ɔbara, na nrɛlaleɛ biala mɔɔ bara la bayɛ ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛnrɛde ɔ bo a.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ɔ nwo zo, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Pɛleezem Boka, yɛɛ ye ɛya ne bayɛ kɛ mɔɔ ɔvale wɔ Gebɛyɔn Bɔnza la. Saa ye nyɛleɛ yɛ ɛzulolɛ bɔbɔ a, ɔbayɛ, yɛɛ saa ye gyimayɛlɛ yɛ nwanwane bɔbɔ a, ɔbali gyima ne yeawie.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmmasi amgbu na anrɛɛ bɛ ndeanlɛ kɛyɛ kpole, ɔluakɛ mede kɛ Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛli mɛla bie mɔɔ ɔbava yeazɛkye azɛlɛ ye amuala a. Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, bɛdie mɔɔ melɛka la; bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Asoo mɔɔ so ɛya dua la so ɛya dahuu? Asoo dahuu ɔtudu azɛlɛ nwo, ɔfunvu ahuma?

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Saa ɔsiezie azɛlɛ ne ɔwie a asoo ɔmkponde aledonlɛ nya nya evuanlɛ ma wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na ɔnlua hwiiti nee baale ɛhonlone ɛhonlone wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ fɛta la, na ɔngya bɛ ɛweɛne?

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ ne mɔ, bɛnva ɛnlankɛ nee ehwili bɛntietia zolɛ bɛnwozo. Bɛfa baka a bɛbolo a.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛwozo hwiiti ma a bɛgelegele nu? Kyɛkyɛ, bɛnyɛ ye zɔhane ɛlɛ. Saa ɔka ye ehwili ne yeawozo a, ɔyɛ ye bɛtɛɛ na yeangelegele ma ne anu.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɛhye noko vi Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ye folɛdulɛ yɛ nwanwane, yɛɛ ye nrɛlɛbɛ bo zolɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha Ɛlayɛle, Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ne mɔɔ belemgbunli Devidi dɛnlanle zolɛ la. Bɛva ɛvolɛ bɛdo ɛvolɛ zo na bɛmaa ɛkponledolɛ ɛhɔ zo mekɛ biala.

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: Noko mebamaa Ɛlayɛle anwu amaneɛ. Bɛbazu bɛaye awolɛ, na suakpole ne bayɛ kɛ azukponle Ɛlayɛle la.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Mebava ɛlɔne measisi tawa ndendenle meabɛnra meayia wɔ, na meahuohua anwea meazi wɔ bane ne.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Ɛbadendɛ ɛ bonyi nu kɛ nwomenle, na ɛ ne aminli ɛ nwo kɛ sonla mɔɔ vea ndɛtɛlɛ nu la.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ɛnelɛ kpole, ɛhululɛ nee azɛlɛkpusulɛ aralie wɔ. Ɔbara kɛ ahumuakyima nee ahumu kpole, yɛɛ sendɔlɔra senle la.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Na maanle maanle ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ ɛlɛko atia Ɛlayɛle, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛko bɛava ye aranemgbole ne na bɛahwe amaneɛnwunlɛ bɛamaa ye la bayɛ kɛ ɛlalɛ bie, anzɛɛ nɔɔzo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bie la.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zo bɛyɛ ahoasea gyibilito, bɛheda bɛ nye na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛzi! Bɛmmano nwanye, noko bɛbo, yɛɛ bɛmmano nza ɛsesebɛ, noko bɛdinda!

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva nafelɛ sunsum ɛwula bɛ na bɛbalafe botoo, na bɛmɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yeheda bɛ nye, yɛɛ yeheda ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛma ati zo.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛyɛ kɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ buluku mɔɔ bɛzɔ ɔ nloa la anu la. Saa menli fa maa sonla mɔɔ kola kenga la kɛ, “Kenga ɛhye” a, ɔka kɛ, “Menrɛhola, ɔboalekɛ bɛzɔ ɔ nloa.”

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Eza saa bɛfa buluku ne bɛmaa sonla mɔɔ ɛnze kenga la kɛ ɔgenga a, ɔbua bɛ kɛ, “Menze kenga.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Awulae zele kɛ, “Kɛmɔ menli ɛhye mɔ fa bɛ nloa mgbane a twe bikye me, bɛdi me eni na bɛ ahonle ɛmbikye me, yɛɛ bɛ ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo me la le menli mɛla mɔɔ ɛli la azolilɛ, na bɛzukoa bɛgua bɛ ti anu ala la,

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: bɛnlea, eza mebava menli ɛhye mɔ meayɛ ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane a. Bɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nrɛlɛbɛ baminli, yɛɛ bɛ menli mɔɔ nwu adwenle nu la deɛnwunlɛ baminli.” Kenlebie anyelazo

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ bɛfea Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛfa awozinli bɛwa bɛ nye bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ bie, na bɛka kɛ, “Nwane a nwu yɛ a? Nwane a ze yɛ a?” la.

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛkakyi ninyɛne ti aze! Asoo buakɛ nwovolɛ bahakyi ɔ nwo ɛva, yeamaa deɛ ne mɔɔ yenwo la aha kɛ, “Tɛ wɔ a ɛnwonle me a.” Anzɛɛ asoo deɛ ne mɔɔ yehyehyɛ la baha kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ hyehyɛle me la ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo?”

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee Lɛbanɔn ɛhakyi ɛya azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ na ɛya azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la ahakyi kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu anzondilirama bade buluku nu edwɛkɛ, na anyenzinlirama vi bɛ awozinli kabii ne anu anwu debie.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo la banyia anyelielɛ fofolɛ bie wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, na Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ati, ehyianvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ menli avinli la ali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ atisesebɛma ɛnrɛnyia ɛleka ɛnrɛgyinla yɛɛ agolobɛnwo bazi aze, na bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtetɛ bɛdi ɛtane la kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: Menli zɛhae mɔ fa bɛ nloa maa sonla yɛ ɛtane, bɛsua mɔɔ de anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa twi bɛ nyunlu la ɛhane, na bɛfa adalɛbɔlɛ mgbane mgbane bɛbua mɔɔ di benle la mgbɔvondɛne.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ liele Ebileham la ka mɔɔ fane Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne anwo la ɛne: “Gyekɔbo abo zo amra anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko, bɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛza bieko.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛnwu bɛ mra ne mɔ, medame me sa anloa gyima a, bɛbade me duma ne anwo; bɛbade medame Gyekɔbo Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne duma ne anwo, na bɛazulo Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ sunsum nu bɛfo la bade ɔ bo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtendɛ bɛ nzo abo la balie ngilehilelɛ ne ado nu.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Munzule ɛha ngakula mɔɔ te atua na bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkɛhyehyɛ na bɛnli me ngyehyɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne azo la. Bɛ nee awie mɔ yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me sunsum ɛmboka bɛ nwo la, na bɛfa ɛtane bɛbɔ ɛtane zo.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Bɛmbiza me ɛnee bɛzi nu kɛ bɛkɔ Yigyibiti bɛahɔbiza moalɛ bɛavi Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛkpondɛ ɛleka bɛavea na ɔlie bɛ ti.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ye maanle mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ Zowan yɛɛ ye ɛbɔfoɔma wɔ Heenɛze bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: But Egypt can't protect you, and to trust that nation is useless and foolish.”
translation_verse: noko bɛ nuhua ko biala anyunlu ɛgua aze kɛ bɛlie menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ na bɛnlɛ moalɛ biala bɛmmaa bɛ kɛ anyiemgba nee nyiane ala la bɛli.”

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane nane ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ la anwo la ɛne: “Bɛdua azɛlɛ mɔɔ nyane nee amaneɛnwunlɛ, awenade mbelɛ nee awenade nyinli, bɔna nee nwɔlɛ mɔɔ tu la wɔ zolɛ la avinli bɛfa anwonyia wɔ afunlumu nee asoaso zo bɛbɛlɛ menli mɔɔ bɛnnyia bɛ nwo zo nvasoɛ la.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Yigyibiti moalɛ le mgbane mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ a, yemɔti medo ye ‘Releehabe mɔɔ tɛnla diinyi’ la.” Menli anzosesebɛ

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Nyamenle zele me kɛ akee mengɔ na mengɛlɛ ye bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne wɔ bolɛ ɛdɛbaa zo nee buluku nu, amaa yeayɛ daselɛ yeatia bɛ dahuu.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma, alanema mɔɔ ɛndie Ɛdɛnkɛma ngilehilelɛ a.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Bɛka bɛkile ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛma kɛ “Bɛmmanwu debie,” na bɛaze Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛ, “Bɛmmaka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ biala mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la bɛkile yɛ. Bɛha mɔɔ le menlemenle nee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ la.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛvi nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu bɛye bɛ nwo, bɛmmamaa yɛte Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne nrɛlaleɛ biala.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se la ɛne, “Kɛmɔ bɛkpo me nloa edwɛkɛ ɛhye, na bɛ adwenle wɔ nzisi nee mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ zo, na bɛva bɛ adwenle bɛwula nu la,

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Ɔbabubu dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ kɛ buakɛ mɔɔ bɛde ye aze ɛsesebɛ la; bɛnrɛnyia ekyi bɔbɔ wɔ nu mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfa senle a ɔyɛ boɛ, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛfe angola nu nzule bɔbɔ la.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se, “Saa bɛsia bɛ nzi bɛba me ɛkɛ bɛbadie bɛ ɛnwomenle a, bɛkɛlie bɛ. Saa bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula me nu na bɛsie bɛ nwo diinyi a, bɛkɛnyia anwosesebɛ.” Noko bɛnrɛra!

english_verse: said, “No! We will safely escape on speedy horses.” But those who chase you will be even faster.
