translation_verse: Bɛ edwɛkɛ se, “Kyɛkyɛ! Yɛfo mgbɔnwɔ zo yɛahɔ waa.” Yemɔti waa ala yɛɛ bɛbahɔ a. Eza bɛse, “Yɛfo mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ kpalɛ la azo yeahɔ ndɛndɛ.” Yemɔti bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne noko anwo bayɛ ndɛ.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua apenle ko yia kpɔvolɛma ko a bɛbagua ɛbɔ nu, na saa kpɔvolɛma nnu nwunlonwunla bɛ a, bɛbanriandi; bɛ bie ɛnrɛha kɛ bɛ fɛlɛnra ne anzɛɛ bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpɔnla ye boka ne azo la ala.

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛkendɛ bɛ aze bɛ anwunvɔne. Yemɔti yeboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔnwu bɛ anwunvɔne. Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu la. Nyamenle bayila ye menli ne

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: O Zayɔnoma mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm, bɛnrɛzu bieko. Nɔhalɛ, saa bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ ye a, ɔbanwu bɛ anwunvɔne. Saa ɔte bɛ ne a, ɔbalie bɛ zo.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛlɛmaa bɛali nyane, bɛanwu amaneɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, bɛ Kilehilevolɛ ne ɛnrɛva ɔ nye ɛnrɛvea bɛ bieko. Bɛ nye banwu Kilehilevolɛ ne.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Bɛbade edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛ nzi kɛ ɔlɛka yeahile bɛ kɛ, “Adenle ne ɛne, bɛlua nuhua” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛminli bɛkɛva bɛne anzɛɛ fema zo la.

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbazɛkye bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee bɛ ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔ. Bɛbavuandi bɛ bɛagua kɛ bɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde a, na bɛaha ye kɛ, “Bɛhɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa ezule adɔ agua bɛ ma mɔɔ bɛlua la azo na bɛ bɛyɔba azo dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ ne anu bɛ nlankɛ bahɔ adidileka mɔɔ le mgbole la anu ahɔdidi.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlankɛ nyinli nee bɛ asoaso ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛso ɛya la banyia ndile mɔɔ bɛva ngyenle bɛfonla ye, na bɛva sofi nee faka bɛkpogya ye kpalɛ la ali.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Azudenle bazenze awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbahu bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne, bɛabubu bɛ tawa ne mɔ bɛagua la.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Siane ne ɛdalɛ ne bayɛ kpole kɛ sɛnzɛne ne ɛdalɛ la, yɛɛ sɛnzɛne ne ɛdalɛ bayɛ mɔnwo nsuu kɛ kenle nsuu ɛdalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛze kɛ ɔyɛ ye menli ne ayile na yeakyekye bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ yebɔ bɛ la azo la. Nyamenle badea Aselea

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia vi moa moa ɛlɛba, yeva ɛya na ɔlua esike kabii mɔɔ ɛdwazo bolonwonwo la anu. Ɛya wɔ ye ɛdendɛlɛ nu, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ yela kɛ sendɔlɔra.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Ɔ bonyi nu anwoma le kɛ azuyilɛ mɔɔ li bɛ kɔme nu la. Ɔlɛ ye ɛzɛkyelɛ akegyebɛ ne ɔbahegye maanle maanle ne mɔ, na yeava nyɛma yeasosɔ bɛ nloa yeaminli bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɛbado edwɛne, kɛmɔ bɛto ye nɔɔzo wɔ ɛvoyialilɛ nwuanzanwuanza nu la, na bɛali fɛlɛko kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ anyelielɛ bɛli fulutubɔlɛ nzi bɛlɛkɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Bodane ne ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛade ɔ ne ɛzulolɛ ne na bɛanwu ye tumi kpole ne wɔ ɛyavalɛ kpole nee sendɔlɔra kpole nu, ahumu nee ezuawolɛ ɛdɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Saa Aseleama te Ɛdɛnkɛma ane na ɔfa ye baka ne ɔbɔ bɛ avinli a bɛ ahonle badu.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛfa ye ndeanlɛ baka ne abɔ Aseleama la ɛnee ye menli ne lɛ akɛya nee getaa ɛlɛdielie zolɛ. Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbava tumi kpole yeaho yeamaa ye menli ne.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Bɛziezie ɛleka wɔ ɛkɛ ne dɛbadɛba mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayela Aselea belemgbunli ne a. Nuhua le kuma, ɔtɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛziezie ɛyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ nuhua. Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ye ɛnwomenle ne mɔɔ sɔ kɛ sɔlefe la yeamaa yeazɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ Yigyibiti kɛ bɛkabiza moalɛ, na bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛdo mgbɔnwɔ nwo zo la. Munzule ɛha bɛ kɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛdo konle ehwili dɔɔnwo nee mgbɔnwɔ kavolɛma mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la anwo zo na bɛnnea Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne anzɛɛ bɛmbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma la!

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ze nrɛlɛbɛ, ɔka a ɔndwe ɔnzia, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ nee amaneɛ lua. Ɔbadwazo yeatia amumuyɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛboa menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Yigyibitima le menli, bɛnle Nyamenle. Bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ lɛ nwonane, bɛnle sunsum. Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma tenrɛ ɔ sa a, boavolɛ ne nee mɔɔ bɛboa ye la amuala badu agua, na bɛ muala bɛ bo zo baminli.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɛmɔ awenade, saa ɔle ekyi bɔbɔ na ɔkye nane na ɔlɛdi a, mboaneneavolɛma ekpunli ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ɛmkputi ye ahonle la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mebaraho wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee ye awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo a.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛdu faa la na meazinza Gyɛlusalɛm. Mebazinza ye meaho mealie ye. Mebanwu ye anwunvɔne na mealie ye.”

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛhɔ ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛde ɔ nwo atua la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu awie biala bavuandi ye dwɛtɛ fufule nee ye ezukoa nvutuke mmonle ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ na ɔlua zolɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane la agua.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Aseleama badɔ dadeɛ mɔɔ tɛ sonla a to la anloa, na dadeɛ mɔɔ sonla ɛnlɛ nu la baha bɛ senle dwɛɛ. Bɛbanriandi dadeɛ ne, na bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bayɛ mialera nu gyima.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Bɛ bodane ne mɔɔ gyi bɛ nzi, belemgbunli ne bava ɛzulolɛ anriandi, yɛɛ ye safohyenlema ne mɔ anye zo bada bɛ na bɛanriandi bɛagyakyi bɛ konle fɛlɛnra ne mɔ. Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ye senle wɔ Zayɔn, na ye fonlomo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, se la ɛne.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua ko biala bayɛ kɛ ɛvealeka, bodane bɔne mɔɔ bɛfea nu wɔ anwoma anzɛɛ ahumudulɛ kpole nu la. Bɛbayɛ kɛ azudenle wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ le resee, bodane kpole bie alubo wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ mbaka ɛnle zo la azo.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Akee menli mɔɔ anye nwu debie la anye zo bade kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nzo te edwɛkɛ la badie.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ pele ndɛndɛ bua edwɛkɛ la babua ndɛne kpalɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ yi bɛlɛbɛlɛ la badendɛ kolokolo.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ koasea kɛ ɔle sonla mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni, yɛɛ bɛnrɛze twondwolondwo kɛ ɔfɛta enililɛ.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ koasea tendɛ ngoasea nu, yɛɛ ye adwenle le ɛtane; ɔsukoa ɔdi ɛtane, ɔka Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane, ɔmmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la aleɛ yɛɛ ɔmmaa mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la nzule ɔnno.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le twondwolondwo la koaseayɛlɛ le munzule; ɔfa amumuyɛ adwenle kɛ ɔfa adalɛ yeazɛkye ehyianvolɛma, saa bɛ edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ bɔbɔ a, ɔnvane ɔ nwo.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na sonla mɔɔ di ɔ nwo eni la dwenle ninyɛne kpalɛ nwo na ɔdi ninyɛne kpalɛ nzi. Ndeanlɛ nee abozozielɛ

english_verse: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛdɔ bɛ, bɛdwazo bɛdie me ne. Bɛmɛ mralɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ sa ɛdɔ bɛ kunlu, bɛdie mɔɔ melɛka la.

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Megye bɛ ɛvolɛ ko nee ekyi. Ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ, bɛmɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye sɔ bɛ nwo, bɛnlea, vanye ɛnrɛzo ma kpalɛ biala la ati, nwanyeyɛlɛ melahyinli ne ɛnrɛyɛ gyima.

english_verse: Shake and shudder, you women without a care! Strip off your clothes— put on sackcloth.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛdɔ bɛ, bɛ nwo bawozo bɛ. Bɛmɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ sa ɛdɔ bɛ kunlu, ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ. Bɛkpa bɛgua na bɛheda ɛrele.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Bɛpɛ bɛ kunlu adɛka bɛli nyane bɛmaa bɛ azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne, bɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ mɔɔ so kɛ debie la,

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ me menli ne azɛlɛ ne azo ɛfifi mbowule nee mbowunyɛma. Bɛzu bɛmaa awuke ne mɔ mɔɔ anyelielɛ wɔ nu, nee suakpole ne mɔɔ zolɛ yɛ fɛ la.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli gbudugbudu ɛhye bakpo suakpole ne, ye belemgbunli sua nu badɔ mgbane; ye awoka nee ye tawa ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgyinla zo bɛsinza la bayɛ awenade alaleɛ dahuu, ɔbayɛ anyelielɛ ɛleka yeamaa ɛbɔ nu asoaso, na yeayɛ nyɛmoa adidileka;

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ Nyamenle kɛwola ye Sunsum ne kɛgua yɛ nwo zo, na azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhwee ɛnle zolɛ la kɛyɛ azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ na azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la kɛyɛ kpɔkɛmile la.

english_verse: Honesty and justice will prosper there,
translation_verse: Akee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ bara azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka biala.

english_verse: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.
translation_verse: Ɔlua tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo, anzonudwolɛ bara; tenleneyɛlɛ ne bava anzonudwolɛ nee anwondɔlɛ ara dahuu.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Me menli ne badɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu, wɔ awuke mɔɔ nuhua le diinyi la anu, na bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua bɛ ma wɔ azule nloa na bɛmaa bɛ nlankɛ nee bɛ asoaso didi ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛ, bɛmɛ sɛkyevolɛma mɔɔ bɛtɛsɛkyele bɛmɛ a; bɛmɛ ngunzima, mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bɛmɛ bɛ nwo ngunzi a! Saa bɛwie bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ bɔ a, bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ noko; yɛɛ saa bɛwie bɛ ngunzi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ yɛ a, bɛ nee bɛ bali ye ngunzi nu.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu yɛ anwunvɔne; yɛlɛkendɛ wɔ. Die yɛ ti alehyenlɛ biala, saa ngyegyelɛ to yɛ a die yɛ.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: na menli wuluwulu maanle maanle ne mɔ anu kɛ abɛbɛ, na bɛfe zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti kɛ nyangomango di nya la.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le bedevinli, ɔde anwuma lɔ; ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ yeayi Zayɔn,

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: na yeamaa maanle ne agyinla bɛ mekɛ zo, na bɛanyia ngoanelielɛ molozo, nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenle. Ye anwonyia a le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛ katakyiema ɛlɛsu; bɛ anzonudwolɛ ɛbɔfoɔma ne ɛlɛsu alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Ademgbole ne mɔ azo ɛyɛ kɛnlanana, adendulɛma mɔɔ fa zolɛ la ɛgyakyi adenle ɛdulɛ. Bɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔ, daselɛlilɛ nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ, bɛmbu sonla biala.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne ɛdɔ mgbane, awie ɛnle zolɛ; Lɛbanɔn mbaka ɛgyengye. Hyɛlɔn mbɔnza azɛlɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ, yɛɛ mbaka mɔɔ wɔ Beehyan nee Kamɛle Boka la nya ɛwie kpolo gua. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ye kpɔvolɛma kɔkɔ

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Akee mebadwazo; kɛkala akee mebamaa me nwo zo; akee mebahile me tumi ne.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Bɛnrenzɛ abonle, bɛwo ewula; bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛnwomenle le senle mɔɔ bayela bɛ ahu bɛ a.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye la, bɛdie mɔɔ meyɛ la na bɛlie me tumi ne bɛdo nu.”

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Zayɔn la ahonle ɛdu, ɛzulolɛ kpole ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la, bɛ nwo ɛlɛwozo bɛ. Bɛse, “Nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ wɔ yɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛhola senle gbolamgbolam nu tɛnla a? Nwane a wɔ yɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛhola senle mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu tɛnla a?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ dua tenlene adenle nu na ɔtendɛ fɔɔnwo, mɔɔ kpo nzisima nvasoɛ, ɔkpɔlɔkpɔla ɔ sa anwo wɔ ndoloboalielɛ nwo, ɔtuodua ɔ nzo wɔ kɔdiawu ɛbɛla nwo, na ɔmuomua ɔ nye wɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo la,

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbadɛnla anwuma anwuma na yeava awolɛ mgbole yeayɛ aranemgbole yeabɔ ɔ nwo bane a. Ɔbanyia aleɛ yeali na yeanyia nzule yeanlo dahuu. Kenlebie anyunlunyia ne

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Eza bɛbanwu kɛ belemgbunli ne de ye ebia nu na bɛanwu kɛ ɔsie azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛlɛ kɔ moa la.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ bamaa bɛabizebiza bɛ ngome bɛ nwo wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne anwo kɛ, “Abɔlɔba ne mɔɔ tia menli, dielie adwule la wɔ nienwu? Sonla ne mɔɔ tia tawa ne mɔ la wɔ nienwu?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛnwu menli adubɛnwoma ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ le basabasa na bɛnde ɔ bo, na eza bɛyi bɛlɛbɛlɛ la bieko.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea Zayɔn, ɛleka ne mɔɔ yɛdi yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛvoyia ne mɔ la! Bɛ nye banwu Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ menli ne de ye anzonudwolɛ nu wɔ ndanlɛ azua mɔɔ bɛndudu la anu. Ndanlɛ azua zɔhane mɔ biala adakola ɛnrɛdu yɛɛ bie nyɛma ɛnrɛde.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla ye anyunlunyia nu yeamaa yɛ a. Ɔle ɛleka mɔɔ azule mgbole mɔɔ tɛlɛ nee azudenle wɔ a, noko ɛlɛne biala anzɛɛ meli biala ɛngola ɛngɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a le yɛ ndɛnebuavolɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma a sie yɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma a le yɛ belemgbunli a; ɔbalie yɛ ngoane.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛlɛne ne mɔ ɛtuto, bɛngola avela baka ne sɔ bɛmmaa ɔngyinla kpundii anzɛɛ ɔndɛlɛ avela ne mɔ anu. Akee bɛbahyɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ bɛnyia la bɛamaa abuburama bɔbɔ anyia bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Na awie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la ɛnrɛha kɛ, “Me nwo ɛdo me.” Bɛbava awie biala mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la ɛtane bɛahyɛ ye.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Bɛbavuandi bɛ menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la bɛagua, bɛnrɛzie bɛ; bɛ mogya bazonyi awoka ne mɔ azo na bɛ avunli ne mɔ abɔ nvoanvoa.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Anwumaneamra kɔsɔɔti bawodo na bɛabobɔ anwomanyunlu kɛ nwoma la. Bɛ muala bɛbakpolo bɛagua kɛ vanye baka anzɛɛ feege baka nya mɔɔ ɛlɛkpolo agua la.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ konle dadeɛ; mogya ɛbia ye takaa kɛ mboane nee mbɔnkye mogya, yɛɛ ɛnlome ɛyɛ nwolɛ sofuaa kɛ boane nyinli kelenzia nwo ɛnlome. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ azubɔlɛ wɔ Bɔzela, na ɔbahu menli dɔɔnwo wɔ Yidɔm azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Menli nee nlankɛ nyinli mgbole nee ndonrandonra badɔ. Bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo bayɛ mogya ngome na bɛ ɛnlome ayɛ anwea ne tɔfɔtɔfɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye nzenralɛlilɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbava yealie Zayɔn ati a.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Azule mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la amuala bahakyi bilewu na ye azɛlɛ ne ayɛ kɛ belesetɔn. Azɛlɛ ne balɔ kɛ bilewu mɔɔ senle la nu la.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Ye esike ne badwazo bolonwonwo dahuu, yɛɛ bɛnrɛhola ye nua alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ kɔsɔɔti. Azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane, ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo. Awie ɛnrɛpɛ nu ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Kyɛnyema nee fuke bava ɛkɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ kpadule nee kɔkɔsɛlɛ badɛnla ɛkɛ ne bie. Ɔbamaa menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la anye zo ada bɛ na ye mgbanyima abɔ atondo.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Bɛbavɛlɛ ye “Maanle mɔɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ,” yɛɛ ye mgbanyima bayɛ mgbane.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Mbowule bafifi ye aranemgbole ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ ɛhane la azo bafifi mbowule ndile. Ɛzonlɛ barakpɔsa ɛkɛ yɛɛ soholo bava ɛkɛ ayɛ bɛ tɛnlabelɛ.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Nanemgbole nee bedi bayia ɛkɛ, mɛnlamenlakɛ bavɛlɛvɛlɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ yɛɛ aledwolɛ nu bayivolɛma baralie bɛ ɛnwomenle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne a kpadule bayɛ ye sane, ado, abobɔ na yeali ɔ mra ne mɔ adane a. Ɛhɛe, ɛkɛ ne a sanzia baradɛnlɛdɛnla ye nyinli nee belɛ a.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Bɛnleɛnlea Ɛdɛnkɛma buluku ne anu na bɛkpondɛ ye kpalɛ. Ɛhye mɔ anu ko ɛnrɛminli; biala bahɔ ye nyinli nee belɛ. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛdo gua na ye Sunsum ne ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa ɛwie.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a yegua bɛ ti nzeleba yeye bɛ a. Yehyɛ azɛlɛ ne yemaa bɛ na yegya biala ɛweɛne. Bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ dahuu, na bɛbadɛnla ɛkɛ ne ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛlɛ nee azɛlɛ resee bali fɛlɛko, fienemgbole anye balie, zolɛ abɔ ndotolo;

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: zolɛ bawula kpole kɛ ndotolo baka, na yeava anyelielɛ yeado edwɛne. Zolɛ kɛnlɛma bayɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn Awoka zo, ye azɛlɛ bahye aleɛ kɛ Kamɛle Boka nee Hyɛlɔn azɛlɛ. Bɛbanwu Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne nee yɛ Nyamenle ne bedevinliyɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Bɛmaa mɔɔ asa anu ɛtuto la anwosesebɛ, na bɛmaa mɔɔ agyakɛ anzi ɛtuto la ɛgyinla kpundii.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛhile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle avoanvoanle la kɛ, “Bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se, bɛmmasulo! Bɛnlea, bɛ Nyamenle ne bara arali bɛ ti nzenralɛ. Nyamenle bara aralie bɛ ti. Ɔbara yearalie bɛ ngoane.”

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Abuburama bawuluwulu kɛ ahɛtɛboɛ, yɛɛ mumulema bava anyelielɛ ado edwɛne. Ɔluakɛ azule bavinde fienemgbole ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ azudenle baze ɛsɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Ɛnwea wuluwulu ne bahakyi azule bula, na nzubula bavinde azɛlɛ resee zo. Ɛzonlɛ ne mɔ alaleɛ bahakyi azia, ndile nee ndɔ bafifi ɛkɛ.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Bɛbakpakye ademgbole bɛado ɛkɛ, bɛbavɛlɛ ye “Nwuanzanwuanza Adenle.” Sonla mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la ɛnrɛva zolɛ, yɛɛ ahoasea ɛnrɛhola menli mɔɔ fa ɛkɛ la koasea yɛ.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Awenade ɛnrɛhɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ nane biala mɔɔ di nane la ɛnrɛhɔ ɛkɛ. Awie ɛnrɛnwu bie bɔbɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlie bɛ ngoane la baze ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne bɛ la bava edwɛndolɛ azia ara Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛbali fɛlɛko mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ; bɛ nye balie, bɛali fɛlɛko, na nyane nee alɔbɔlɛ baminliminli.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Bɛnlea na Hɛzikaya ambɛlɛbɛla bɛ anga kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma balie bɛ. Maanle maanle dɔɔnwo awozonle angola anlie bɛ anvi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu.

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Akee Safohyenle ne dwazole gyinlanle na ɔvale Hibulu aneɛ ne ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie mɔɔ belemgbunli kpole ne, Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛlɛka ahile bɛ la.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Heemate nee Aapade awozonle ne mɔ wɔ nienwu? Sifaveeyem awozonle hale nienwu? Asoo bɛholale bɛliele Samɛlea bɛvile ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Ɔse, ‘Bɛmmamaa Hɛzikaya bɛlɛbɛla bɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛlie bɛ.’

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Na Hɛzikaya suakunlu ɛkɛ ne mbɔlɔba nsa: Helekaya ara Yilayakem mɔɔ nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la, Hyɛbena mɔɔ le kɔɔto kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne, yɛɛ Esafe ara Dwowaa mɔɔ nea suakunlu ɛkɛ ne ngɛlata zo la rayiale bɛ.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Aselea Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛha bɛhile Hɛzikaya kɛ, ‘Aselea Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne ɛlɛbiza kɛ: Duzu debie yɛɛ bɛ kpundii ɛgyinlanlɛ ne gyi zo a?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa bɛ nloa tunli a bɛbɔ konle nwo mgbɔlɔka na bɛnyia tumi bɛko a? Nwane a bɛ nye la ɔ nwo zo mɔɔ yemɔti bɛde me nwo atua a?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛva bɛ adwenle bɛzɔ Yigyibiti. Ɔdaye mumua ne ɔle baka wulera. Awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ rɛle kɛwula ye nu la, saa ɔkomo zo a ɔbu ɔwɔ ye. Menli mɔɔ fa bɛ rɛle wula Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nu la kɛ wie ye la ɛne.’ ”

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Aselea kpanyinli ne vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛka bɛkile me kɛ, ‘Yɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne nu’ a, ɛnee mebiza bɛ kɛ: asoo tɛ ye azukponle a Hɛzikaya ɛzɛkye bɛ wɔ ɛleka ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle ye, na yeze Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ye wɔ azukponle kokye anwo la ɔ?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla, bɛ nee me menle Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛrayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ. Saa bɛkɛnyia menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la a anrɛɛ menwɔmaa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ apenle nwiɔ.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Na saa bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ rɛle wɔ Yigyibitima anu kɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛ konle ehwili nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la a ɛnee kɛ bɛsi bɛte me menle ne safohyenlema ne mɔ anu ekyi ko bɔbɔ anwo atua ɛ?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ bɛnze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa wɔ nu yɛɛ mera kɛ mebazɛkye maanle ɛhye a? Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, ‘Kɔteta maanle ɛhye na sɛkye ye.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Na Yilayakem, Hyɛbena, yɛɛ Dwowaa zele Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Yɛbodo wɔ, tendɛ Arelameeyeke nu kile wɔ sonvolɛma na yɛte. Mmatendɛ ɛkile yɛ wɔ Dwuda aneɛ nu ɛmaa menli mɔɔ gua bane ye ati zo ɛke la te bie.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Safohyenle ne buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ ngome nee bɛ belemgbunli ne ati a me menle ɛzoa me kɛ membanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ a, na menli mɔɔ gua bane ne ati zo la ɛmboka nwolɛ? Munzule ɛdo bɛ muala, bɛbali bɛ ebinli, bɛanlo bɛ miene.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa ɔdi bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu na Ɛdɛnkɛma balie bɛ, na Aseleama ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛho ɛnrɛva bɛ suakpole ne.

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛra ɔkɛrava bɛ ɔkɛhɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ne, na zolɛ le abɛlɛ, nwanye, aleɛ nee vanye egyinli ngome la azo la.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Awozonle ɛhye mɔ anu boni yɛɛ holale liele bɛ maanle ne mɔ vile Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu mɔɔ yemɔti bɛse Ɛdɛnkɛma bahola alie Gyɛlusalɛm avi ɔ sa nu a?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Akee Yilayakem, Hyɛbena, yɛɛ Dwowaa vale nyane suosuanle bɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwula la anu na bɛziale bɛhɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya ɛkɛ bɛhɔhanle mɔɔ Aselea Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne hanle la bɛhilele ye.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya dele edwɛkɛ ne la, nyane ngome manle ɔsuosuanle ye adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la anu, ɔvale ɛrele adɛladeɛ ɔwulale na ɔhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole Heemate, Aapade, Sifaveeyem, Hina, yɛɛ Ayeva la wɔ nienwu?”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye hɔle la a le kɛ, “Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya se yɛraze wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛnɛ le nyanelilɛ kenle; abule ɛbu yɛ, anyiemgba ɛha yɛ. Yɛyɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo na ɔ nwo ɛbɛlɛ ye, na ɔngola ɔ nwo twe la.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛzoa ye Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne yemaa yerabɔ tease Nyamenle ne aholoba. Medie medi kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la, na ɔbadea menli mɔɔ hanle la. Yemɔti sɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma maa ye menli ekyi ne mɔɔ ɛha la!’ ”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya soanvolɛma ne dwule Ayezaya anwo ɛkɛ ne la,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛha bɛhile bɛ menle kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Mmamaa edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔde la tu wɔ ahonle kɛ Aselea belemgbunli soanvolɛma ne ɛbɔ me aholoba a.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Nea, mebamaa belemgbunli ne sunsum bie meamaa yeade anzodwɛkɛ bie na yeazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu, na mebamaa yeadɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu.’ ” Aseleama nwunlonwunla Hɛzikaya bieko (

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Aselea Safohyenlema Kpanyinli ne dele kɛ ye belemgbunli ne ɛvi Leekehye, na ɔranwunle kɛ yeva ɛlɔnema ɔ nee Lebenama ɛlɛko.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Akee nrɛlaleɛ dole Aselea belemgbunli ne kɛ Yigyibiti ɛlɔnema mɔɔ Sudan Belemgbunli Tɛheeka a li bɛ ti la ɛlɛba aradoa ye nee ye aho. Aselea belemgbunli ne dele nrɛlaleɛ ne la ɔzoanle menli ɔmanle bɛhɔzele Hɛzikaya

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: kɛ, “Bɛze Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya kɛ: Mmamaa wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔva ɛ rɛle wɔwula ye nu la bɛlɛbɛla wɔ na ɔka kɛ bɛnrɛye Gyɛlusalɛm bɛnrɛmaa medame Aselea belemgbunli.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Nea, wɔde mɔɔ Aselea arelemgbunli ɛva ɛyɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo na bɛzɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ la. Ɛdwenle kɛ ɛkɛvi ɛsalɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Asoo maanle maanle ne mɔ awozonle holale liele bɛ vile egya mɔ asa anu? Me mgbanyima zɛkyele azuamgbole Gozan, Hɛlan, yɛɛ Rilezɛfe na bɛhunle Bɛtɛdɛn amra mɔɔ de Tɛlasaa la.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya liele kɛlata ne mɔɔ soanvolɛma ne nee ye rale la na ɔgengale. Akee ɔhɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na ɔvale kɛlata ne ɔdole Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ,

english_verse: Then he prayed:
translation_verse: na ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ,

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛde wɔ belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la azo anwuma a; ɛ ngomekye ala a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ sie arelemgbunli maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la a. Ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle azɛlɛ ye nee anwuma a.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ Aselea arelemgbunli ɛzɛkye maanle maanle dɔɔnwo, ɛbɔ bɛ bo zo,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Adenle ne mɔɔ ɔvale zolɛ ɔrale la, zɔhane adenle ne ala yɛɛ ɔbava zolɛ yeazia yeahɔ a. Ɔnrɛra suakpole ɛhye azo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Wɔzoa wɔ sonvolɛma wɔmaa bɛrazi me amgbu na wɔha kɛ wɔva wɔ konle ehwili dɔɔnwo wɔli Lɛbanɔn awoka mgbole nwo zo konim. Ɛdule ɛ nloa anu kɛ ɛbubule ɛkɛ ne sida mbaka mgbole mɔɔ le ndendenle, nee ɛkɛ ne sepelɛse mbaka ngɛnlɛma ɛguale, na ɛwolole ɛhɔle ye kpɔkɛmile nu, ɛvole ɛkɛ ne boka tendenle kpalɛ ne.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Ɛvale ɛdule ɛ nwo kɛ ɛbɔle bula dɔɔnwo na ɛnlonle nuhua nzule, yɛɛ wɔ ɛlɔnema vale bɛ gyakɛ venle Yigyibiti Azule Naele ne manle ɔsesanle.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: “Asoo ɛtɛtele kɛ mengyehyɛle ɛhye mendole ɛkɛ ne dɛba, yɛɛ memaa yeyɛ zɔhane a? Memanle wɔ anwosesebɛ kɛ ɛva ɛbutubutu azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la anye aze ɛyɛ bɛ azuadu.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Memanle menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ azua zɔhane mɔ azo la asa anu tutole, bɛ anwosesebɛ wiele na bɛ adwenle zɛkyele. Bɛyɛle kɛ ɛya nu ndile bɛtɛbɛtɛ bie anzɛɛ ndile mɔɔ ɛfifi sua ti zo la. Ɔkawie nyi la ɛnee yenwoso.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “Meze wɔ tɛnlabelɛ nu, wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nee wɔ ɛralɛ nu, nee me nwo ɛya mɔɔ wɔva, nee mgbane mgbane mɔɔ wɔdendɛ wɔtia me la.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔva me nwo ɛya kpole na wɔ mgbole ɛhehanlɛ ne ɛdwu me nzo nu la, mebava me koba ne meazɔ ɛ bonyi, meava kɔleɛ meatosa ɛ kɔmenzia na meaziane wɔ meamaa wɔava adenle ne mɔɔ ɛvale zolɛ ɛrale la azo wɔahɔ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Na Ayezaya hanle hilele Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya kɛ, “Mɔɔ bazi la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛne: ɛvolɛ ɛhye nee ɛvolɛ bieko, bɛbali ma mɔɔ bɛ ngome bɛfifi la, na ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la anu, bɛbazo ɛya bɛalua na bɛabu; bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli na bɛali zolɛ ma ne bie.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ Dwudama ekyi ne mɔɔ bɛbavi ɛsalɛ la abo bazɔ ndinli bieko na bɛazo ma.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Menli baha Gyɛlusalɛm nee Zayɔn Boka, ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ye zɔhane.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha mɔɔ fane Aselea belemgbunli ne anwo la ɛne: Ɔ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia suakpole ɛhye azo, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdo ɛda ko bɔbɔ wɔ zolɛ. Ɔnrɛva ɛlɔnema mɔɔ dedɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike la ɔnrɛbikye suakpole ne, yɛɛ ɔnrɛra kɛ ɔfa ɛlɔnema yearabɛnra suakpole ye yeayia.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Akee Aselea Belemgbunli Sɛnakɛlebe ziale hɔle ye sua zo na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Nenɛvɛ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɔwɔ ye bozonle Nezelɔko amonle sua ne anu ɔlɛsonle la, ɔdaye ɔ mra mrenya, Adelamɛlɛke nee Hyalizɛ vale dadeɛ rahunle ye na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle Arelalate maanle nu. Na ɔ ra nrenya Yisaahadɔn lile ye agya ziele maanle ne.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya hakyile ɔ nye bane nwo na ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma balie me ngoane; Yɛbabɔ agole yeado edwɛne, Wɔ yɛ ngoane mekɛ nu amuala, Wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu anwonyane bɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya manle ɔhale ye nee ewule. Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya, Emɔzo ara ne rakpɔlale ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se ɛtoto wɔ sua nu ɛke boɛ na ɛnrɛde kpɔkɛ, ɛbawu.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, menrɛnwu Ɛdɛnkɛma Wɔ teasema maanle nu; Menrɛnwu sonla bieko Wɔ ewiade amra anu.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebodo wɔ, kakye kɛ meyeye me ahonle nu mezonle wɔ nɔhalɛ nu, yɛɛ mebɔ mɔdenle meyɛ mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la.” Na ɔzunle alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Ayezaya.

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Kɔ na kɔze Hɛzikaya kɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nlenya Devidi Nyamenle ne, mede wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛɛ menwu wɔ monle mɔɔ wɔhwi la. Nea, mebava ɛvolɛ bulu nee nnu meaboka wɔ ngoane mekɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Na duzu edwɛkɛ a meka a? Ɔluakɛ yedendɛ yehile me, Yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne a yeyɛ a. Nyane ɛkyekye me, meda a menla.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Mebalie wɔ nee suakpole ɛhye meavi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa anu, na mealie suakpole ɛhye ati.”

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Ayezaya buale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔbali ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ la azo la ɛne:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Nea, memaa kpolike ne mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehaze ɛzi la ɛlawolɛ ne ɛhɔ ɔ nzi egyakɛ bulu.” Na ɛlawolɛ ne ziale ɔ nzi egyakɛ bulu.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya dele kpɔkɛ la, ɔhɛlɛle ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne ɛhye:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Mendwenlenle kɛ saa megyinla zo a, Mebavi ewiade ye anu meahɔ; Bɛye me kɛ menzinza Ɛbolɔ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ Wɔ me mekɛ mɔɔ ɛha la amuala.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Bɛdu me tɛnlabelɛ bɛhɔ Kɛ mboaneneavolɛ ndanlɛ sua; Me ngoane ɛyɛ kɛ ɛdanlɛ wɔ nwovolɛ sa nu; Ɔpɛ me ɔfi melahyinli ne anu, Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ Ɛpɛ me ngoane zo.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Aleɛ dwo a me nwo fofo me maa mesu toonwo alehyenlɛ, Kɛ asɛɛ awenade ɛlɛbubu me mbowule nu; Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ Mendwenlenle kɛ ɛbapɛ me ngoane zo.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mesu kɛ nyamenleakatiba, Mekulu kɛ abubule; Menlea anwuma toonwo me nye ɛha ɛkɛ. O Awulae, melɛnwu amaneɛ, die me.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: O Awulae, ɛhye mɔ amuala boka sonla ɛbɛla nwo, Yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ anu yɛɛ me ɛkɛla dua nyia ngoane a. Yɛ me ayile na maa menyia ngoane.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Nea, me kpalɛyɛlɛ ti Yɛɛ menwu amaneɛ kpole zɛhae a. Noko wɔye me wɔvi ewule nu, Ɔluakɛ wɔva me ɛtane kɔsɔɔti wɔhyɛ me.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ɛbolɔ amra ɛngola ɛnyɛ wɔ mo, Menli mɔɔ ɛwu la ɛngola ɛnye wɔ ayɛlɛ, Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewule kuma nu la Ɛngola ɛnva bɛ rɛle ɛnwula wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ nu.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ de aze la, yemɔ a kola yɛ wɔ mo a, Kɛmɔ ɛnɛ kenle ye melɛyɛ la. Selɛ a kilehile ɔ mra wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne a.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Ayezaya hanle hilele belemgbunli ne sonvolɛma ne kɛ bɛdi feege ma bɛdo ye nyila ne azo bɛmaa ɔkpuke na ɔde kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya bizale kɛ, “Duzu sɛkɛlɛneɛ yɛɛ bahile kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ me ayile na meahɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hɛzikaya liele menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la gyɛlɛɛnye na ɔvale ye anwonyia muala, ye dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, aledonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ, nwole evuanlɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛlɔne ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ye konle ninyɛne ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne la ɔhilele bɛ. Debie biala ɛnle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ anzɛɛ ye maanle ne anu mɔɔ yeanva yeangile bɛ a.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne ala anu, Babelonia Belemgbunli Mɛlodake Baladan, mɔɔ ɔ ze bɛfɛlɛ ye Baladan la dele kɛ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya anwo dole ye na yede kpɔkɛ la, ɔvale kɛlata nee ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔzoanle kɛ bɛva bɛhɔmaa ye.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hɔle Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya ɛkɛ ne hɔbizale ye kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ vi nienwu a rale a, yɛɛ bɛ amaneɛ se duzu?” Hɛzikaya buale kɛ, “Bɛvi maanle bie anu moa moa a bɛrale a; bɛvi Babelonia.”

english_verse: “What did you show them?” I asked. Hezekiah answered, “I showed them everything in my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ayezaya bizale ye kɛ, “Yɛɛ duzu debie a bɛnwunle ye wɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛke a?” Hɛzikaya buale kɛ, “Bɛnwu debie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛke la. Meanva ɛhwee meanvea bɛ.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na Ayezaya zele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Tie, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bara mɔɔ bɛbarahwe debie biala mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ mgbanyima ɛgyakyi wɔ la bɛahɔ Babelonia. Bɛnrɛgyakyi wɔ ɛhwee.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛ bo zo amra fɔɔnwo ne, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ bɛahɔ, bɛaza bɛ, na bɛamaa bɛazonle Babelonia belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya dele ɛhye abo kɛ ɔ nwo badɔ ye, ɔ nzo nu adwo ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la, yemɔti ɔbuale Ayezaya kɛ, “Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ ne ɛra la ɛnle ɛtane.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Bɛkyekye me menli ne arɛle, bɛkyekye bɛ rɛle.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Bɛdendɛ bɛtɛɛ bɛhile Gyɛlusalɛmma, na bɛdea nu bɛze bɛ kɛ bɛ ɛbɛla nu konle ne ɛwie; bɛva bɛ ɛtane bɛhyɛ bɛ. Na mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati bɛminlinle ye la Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛanyia ye mɔnwo.”

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ bie tea nu: “Bɛdu adenle wɔ fienemgbole nu lɔ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma! Bɛdenrɛ adenle ne mɔɔ la ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la bɛmaa yɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Bɛdua bɔnza biala na bɛze awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ; bɛduodua azɛlɛ nwo ahuma ne mɔ, na bɛyɛ ɛleka ahuhunduu ne mɔ sɛlɛsɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne bala ali, ɛnyelɛ kɔsɔɔti banwu ye. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔse a.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ bie se, “Tea nu bɔ nolo ne!” Membizale kɛ, “Duzu nolo a membɔ a?” Ɔzele kɛ, “Bɔ nolo kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti le kɛ ndile, bɛ kɛnlɛma kɔsɔɔti le kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndotolo.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Ndile nwoso, ndotolo kɛnlɛma kpa, mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛmaa ye anwoma ne kɛbɔ bɛ la. Nɔhalɛ, menli le kɛ ndile la.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, ndile nwoso, ndotolo kɛnlɛma kpa, noko Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne bagyinla ɛkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: O, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛ amaneɛ fɛlɛko ɛbabɔ Zayɔn a, fo kɔ boka tendenle ne azo; wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛ amaneɛ fɛlɛko ɛbabɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a, fa wɔ anwosesebɛ muala kpogya ɛ ne zo ka. Kpogya ɛ ne zo, mmasulo! Ka kile Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛne!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Awulae Nyamenle ne lɛ tumi ɛlɛba, Ɔbava ye tumi ne yeazie ye menli ne; bɛnlea, ɔlɛ ye ahatualɛ ɔ sa nu, yɛɛ ɔlɛ ye ndeanlɛ noko ɔlɛba.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Ɔbanlea ye menli ne boɛ kɛ mboaneneavolɛ yɛne nyɛmoa, ɔbaboɔboa mboane mralɛ ne anloa yeadedɛ bɛ ɔ sa zo. Ɔbavia bɛ ɔ kɛnra azo, na yeali mɔɔ lɛ mralɛ la anyunlu bɛtɛɛ. Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ye ɛsaso la

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛva ɔ sa akunlu ɛzuzu nzule, na yeva ɔ sa yezuzu anwomanyunlu a? Nwane a ɛhola ɛva debie ɛzuzu azɛlɛ ye azo munlutu, na yeva awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi yegua tone zo yezuzu a?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛhile Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne adenle, anzɛɛ ɛyɛ ɔ nwo Ɛdɛnkɛma folɛtuvo ɛhilehile ye a?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Nwane a Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye adwenle a, yɛɛ nwane a hilehilele ye pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle a? Nwane a bukele Ɛdɛnkɛma adwenle nu manle ɔnyianle ndelebɛbo a?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, maanle maanle ne mɔ le kɛ nzule kpɔnwo ko mɔɔ vi bokiti nu ɛpe la; bɛle kɛ munlutu wɔ tone zo; ɔfula mbɔra ne mɔ ɔ sa nu kɛ munlutu.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛnle ɛhwee wɔ ɔ nyunlu, ɔbu bɛ kɛ bɛndo ɛhwee.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Nwane anwo a bɛfa Nyamenle bɛto a, anzɛɛ duzu debie a zɔho ye a?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Amonle! Sonla a yɛ a, yɛɛ dwinvolɛ kolo ezukoa nvutuke gua nwolɛ, na ɔyɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ndweabane ɔmaa ye.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule la fa baka ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ la yɛ; ɔmaa dwinvolɛ kpalɛ se ananze mɔɔ ɔsie ye aze a ɔndu ɔndɔ la maa ye.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Bɛnze ɔ? Bɛtɛtele ɔ? Bɛanga bɛangile bɛ wɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔ? Tete mɔɔ aloa bɔle la bɛtɛtele ɔ bo ɔ?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔde ye ebia nu wɔ azɛlɛ ye ati zo anwuma lɔ. Ɔnea menli mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la a bɛ mgbole le kɛ abɛbɛ. Ɔdɛlɛle anwomanyunlu kɛ ɛdanlɛ, na ɔzieziele ye kɛ ndanlɛ sua ɔdɛnlanle nu.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔbɛlɛ arelemgbunli aze; ɔnva azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli ɔnyɛ ɛhwee.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛdua bɛ la, ɛkɛ ne ala ɛnee bɛfifi, kɛ bɛfifi ala la, ɛnee bɛzɔ ndinli; saa ɔbɔ ye anwoma wuluwulu ne a, bɛnwoso na ahumu pia bɛ kɔ kɛ ewula.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: “Ɛnee akee nwane anwo a bɛfa me bɛto a, amaa meazɔho ahenle,” Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛlɛbiza bɛ.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Bɛdo bɛ nye anwuma na bɛnlea, nwane a bɔle ɛhye mɔ a? Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɔle bɛ kɔsɔɔti a, yɛɛ ɔfa ko biala duma ɔfɛlɛ ye. Ye tumi kpole ne ati, yɛɛ ɔlɛ tumi na ɔ nwo yɛ se la ati, ko bɔbɔ ɛmminli.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ, duzu ati a ɛtendɛ ɛka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnze me adenle ne mɔɔ melua nu la, bɛsisi me a ɔnvane me Nyamenle ne anwo” ɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Bɛnze ɔ? Bɛtɛtele ɔ? Ɛdɛnkɛma le damɛnlangoate Nyamenle, ewiade amuala Bɔvolɛ. Ɔnvɛ yɛɛ ɔ nwo ɛmbɛlɛ ye, ye ndelebɛbo ɛnlɛ nvedenvedenu.

english_verse: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa mɔɔ anye zo ɛbulu la anwo gyinla ye, ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra bavɛ ayɛ bɛtɛɛ, mrenya kpukputilii bavɛ bɛadu bɛagua;

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la, bɛbanyia anwosesebɛ fofolɛ; bɛbanyia ndɛbalɛ mɔɔ le kɛ kɔleɛ ɛdeɛ ne. Bɛbanriandi na bɛnrɛvɛ, bɛbadia na bɛ nye zo ɛnrɛbulu.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Nyamenle se, “Bɛmɛ ɛnweanloa amra, bɛyɛ koonwu bɛdie me! Bɛmaa maanle maanle ɛmia bɛ anwosesebɛ ne anu bieko; bɛmaa bɛbikye, na bɛmaa bɛdendɛ; bɛmaa yɛhua yɛ nloa na yɛdie ndɛnebualɛ ne.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: “Nwane a hɔhanle konimnli ne mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ, mɔɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkɛtia la ɔdi konim a? Yeye maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti yemaa ye, yemɔti ɔdi arelemgbunli nwo zo konim; ɔfa ye konle dadeɛ ne ɔbɔ bɛ asande kɛ munlutu, ɔfa ye ɛda ne ɔpia bɛ ɔkɔ kɛ ewula.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Ɔfoa bɛ ndinlizo na ɔse bɛ nwo, wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɔtɛfale zolɛ ɛlɛ la azo.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Ɔvi tete, wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu, nwane a ɛyɛ ɛhye a? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔ, mele mɔlebɛbo, mele awieleɛ. Medame mumua ne ɛne.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: “Ɛnweanloa amra ɛnwu ye na bɛ ahonle ɛdu, azɛlɛ ye azo amra amuala anwo wozo bɛ; bɛhuohua bɛ nloa bɛra.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Awie biala boa ɔ gɔnwo, na ɔka ɔkile ɔ diema kɛ, ‘Gyinla ɛ nwo!’

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Dwinvolɛ mɔɔ se mbaka la si ezukoa dwinvolɛ ahonle, mɔɔ tenrɛdenrɛ ahyɛnze la si mɔɔ di mbulalɛ adwinli la ahonle; bɛse, ‘Ye ɛsosɔlɛ ne mɔ le kpalɛ;’ na bɛfa agbɛlɛko bɛbobɔ nu amaa yeandu.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: “Na bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ, me gɔnwo Ebileham nlɔnra,

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: bɛmɛ a menvale bɛ menvile ewiade ye amuala anu, na menvɛlɛle bɛ menvile ye muleɛ biala azo, na menzele bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛle me sonvolɛma’ a, menlea nu meye bɛ, metɛkpole bɛ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ lua; bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu, medame a mele bɛ Nyamenle a. Mebamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ, mebaboa bɛ, mebava me konimlilɛ tumi ɛsalɛ ne meazɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, menli mɔɔ ɛva bɛ nwo ɛya kpole la anyunlu bagua aze na bɛ adwenle aha abɔ nu. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛko bɛtia bɛ la ɛnrɛhola ɛhwee yɛ, yɛɛ bɛ bo zo baminli.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Bɛbakpondɛ menli mɔɔ nee bɛ dwudwu la, na bɛnrɛnwu bɛ. Menli mɔɔ zo konle doa bɛ la ɛnrɛhola ɛhwee yɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, melɛ bɛ sa fema ne anu. Medame yɛɛ melɛka meahile bɛ a: Bɛmmasulo na mebaboa bɛ.”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ le kɛ sone a, bɛmmasulo! Mebaboa bɛ, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ a le Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛayɛ kɛ ma ɛwozolɛ taboa mɔɔ le fofolɛ, na ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele mɔɔ yɛ nla; bɛbava bɛahili awoka mgbole ne mɔ bɛagua, na bɛapia awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ kɛ ma abonle.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Bɛbakpogya bɛ na anwoma ne abɔ bɛ ahɔ, na ahumu abɔ bɛ asande. Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, bɛ nye balie, na bɛaye Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: “Saa ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la kpondɛ nzule, na bie ɛnle ɛkɛ, na nzuhɔne maa bɛ kɔmenzia we resee a, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ; medame Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, menrɛkpo bɛ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Mebamaa azule aze awoka ne mɔ azo, na nzule feanvea adenrɛ mbɔnza ne mɔ anu. Mebamaa nzule agyinlegyinla ɛsɛlɛ zo, na meamaa nzubula agyinlegyinla azɛlɛ resee zo.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Mebamaa sida mbaka afifi fienemgbole nu, akasea, mɛtɛle nee ɔlivi mbaka kɔsɔɔti; mebamaa sepelɛse mbaka afifi ɛsɛlɛ zo, dwunipa nee bolonyia mbaka kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: amaa menli anwu ye na bɛanwu ye, bɛadwenle nwolɛ na bɛade ɔ bo kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛhye a; Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a bɔle bɛ a.” Awozonle nee Ɛdɛnkɛma dwudwu

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli ne se, “Bɛha bɛ edwɛkɛ ne, bɛhile nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla bɛraha mɔɔ bazi la, bɛha mɔɔ ɛzi dɛba la bɛhile yɛ, amaa yeadwenle nwolɛ, amaa yɛanwu kɛ bɛ awieleɛ zile wiele la; anzɛɛ bɛha mɔɔ bara la bɛhile yɛ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Bɛha mɔɔ bara ɛhye mɔ anzi la bɛhile yɛ, amaa yɛanwu kɛ bɛle nyamenle; bɛyɛ kpalɛ, anzɛɛ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ, amaa yɛ ahonle adu na yɛazulo.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛnle ɛhwee, yɛɛ bɛ gyima le mgbane; mɔɔ kɛva bɛ la ɛbɔ munzule.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: “Meye awie vi aduduleɛ lɔ memaa yera, ɔvi aduduleɛ lɔ ɔbarazonle me; ɔbatietia arelemgbunli nwo zo kɛ buakɛnwovolɛ ɛlɛtietia ndɛtɛlɛ zo la.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Nwane a alumua ne ɔhanle a, amaa yɛanwu ye, yɛɛ ɔhanle ye dɛba, amaa yeaha kɛ, ‘Ɔle nɔhalɛ’ a? Awie anga, yɛɛ awie ambɔ ye nolo, awie ande bɛ edwɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: None of these idols are able to give advice or answer questions.
translation_verse: Na meneanle la, awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ; awie ɛnle bɛ avinli mɔɔ tu folɛ, mɔɔ saa mebiza a ɔye ɔ nloa a.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛ muala bɛle mgbane, bɛ gyima ne mɔ ɛnle ɛhwee; bɛ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua la le kɛ anwoma.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea me sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ sɔ me nye la, yemɔ a mekpa nu meye ye a; me nye die ɔ nwo. Meva me Sunsum ne mewula ye, ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeara maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛmaa ɔ ne zo ɔnrɛdea nu, anzɛɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛde ɔ ne wɔ gua ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛpɛ ndɔ mɔɔ bɛkposo ye la, yɛɛ ɔnrɛnlua senle mɔɔ asɛɛ ɛnlu la; ɔbamaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ali gyima nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛkpo aze anzɛɛ ye ahonle ɛnrɛdu, kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ kɛra ewiade. Ɛnweanloa amra ɛlɛkendɛ ye mɛla ne.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma na ɔdɛlɛle ye, mɔɔ bɔle azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ debie biala, na ɔmaa menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛnwomenle nee sunsum la se,

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, tenleneyɛlɛ ti a mevɛlɛ wɔ a; mezɔ ɛ sa meva wɔ mezie gyɛlɛɛnye. Meva wɔ meyɛ kɛ ngyekyeleɛ memaa menli ne, ɛbayɛ kɛnlaneɛ wɔamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Ɛbadukuedukue mɔɔ anye ɛzi la anye, na wɔaye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ bɛgua efiade anu awozinli nu la.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, me duma ɛne! Menva me anyunlunyia memmaa awie, yɛɛ menva me ayɛlɛyelɛ memmaa ananze mɔɔ bɛgua.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, ninyɛne dɛba ne mɔɔ menganle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la ɛyɛ zɔ; kɛkala, melɛka ninyɛne fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ; melɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ kolaa na bɛasisi.” Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; ewiade amra amuala, bɛdo ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne! Nyevile zo amra, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ɛnweanloa la, bɛdo edwɛne.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tudu ɔ gyakɛ kɛ ɔle katakyie, ɔle kɛ ɛlɔnenli mɔɔ ɛva ɛya; ɔtea nu, ɔtea nu ɛsesebɛ, ɔkile ye katakyie tumi ne wɔ ye kpɔvolɛma anwo zo. Nyamenle bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔboa ye menli ne

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Nyamenle se, “Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la meyɛ koonwu, meyɛ koonwu, mehomo me nwo zo; na kɛkala mebadea kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo, mebalie ɛnwomenle mgbole kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛvɛ la.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Mebadwulu awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, na meamaa mbaka mɔɔ wɔ zo la anwoso; mebamaa azule ne mɔ apepɛ bula bula, na bula ne mɔ asesa ayɛ resee.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: “Mebahile anyenzinliravolɛma adenle, wɔ adenle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnze la anu, adenle mɔɔ bɛtɛfale zolɛ ɛlɛ la azo yɛɛ mebava bɛ mealua a. Mebamaa awozinli ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu la ayɛ wienyi, na ɛleka ahuhunduu ne mɔ ayɛ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ. Ninyɛne mɔɔ mebayɛ la ɛne, yɛɛ menrɛkpo bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula ananze mmonle nu, na bɛka bɛkile bɛ ananze mmonle ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛle yɛ nyamenle’ la bakpo aze na bɛ nyunlu agua aze.” Yizilayɛma kpo kɛ bɛnrɛzukoa

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛmɛ anzondiliravolɛma, bɛdie! Bɛmɛ anyenzinliravolɛma, bɛnlea, amaa bɛanwu debie!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Ɔnwu ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, noko ɔnvede ɔ nye ɔnnea, yebuke ɔ nzo, noko ɔnde edwɛkɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ye tenleneyɛlɛ ti, Ɛdɛnkɛma lile fɛlɛko, kɛ yekpogya Nyamenle mɛla ne zo yemaa bɛli ye eni.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Noko bɛwua ye menli ne bɛve bɛ nwo ninyɛne, bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ bɛgua bɛ azɛlɛ bo efiade. Bɛdɔ agye, bɛnlɛ awie mɔɔ die bɛ a, bɛyɛ afedeɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnga kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi!”

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Nwane a vale Gyekɔbo abo zo amra manle sɛkyevolɛ ne, yele Yizilayɛma manle nwule a? Asoo tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia ye, mɔɔ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛlua ye ndenle nu, na bɛse bɛnrɛli ye mɛla zo la ɔ?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔwolale ye ɛya wuluwulu ne ɔguale yɛ nwo zo, na yɛnwunle kɛ konle si yɛ ɛzulolɛ la; ɔmanle ye ɛya senle ne zɔle bɔle yiale Yizilayɛ, noko yeande ɔ bo; ɔyelale ye, noko yeandwenle nwolɛ bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle bɛ yɛle bɛ muala la se, “Bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ mekpɔne bɛ; meva bɛ duma mevɛlɛ bɛ, bɛle me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Saa bɛlua nzule buma nu a, me nee bɛ balua; bɛlua azule ne mɔ anu a, bɛnrɛmonla bɛ; saa bɛlua senle nu a, senle ne ɛnrɛyela bɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛzɔlɛ gbolamgbolam ne ɛnrɛyela bɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, bɛ Dievolɛ ne a. Mefa Yigyibiti meyɛ bɛ ɛkpɔnedeɛ, mefa Sudan nee Siba memaa na medie bɛ.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛsonle bolɛ wɔ me nye zo, medi bɛ eni, na mekulo bɛ la ati, mefa menli memaa na medie bɛmɛ bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ lua. “Mebava bɛ bo zo amra meavi aduduleɛ, meaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi adɔleɛ meara.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Mebaha meahile sɔlɔ amra kɛ, ‘Bɛgyakyi bɛ,’ na meaze nyiakɛ amra kɛ, ‘Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka bɛ;’ me mra mrenya ne mɔ vi moa moa, yɛɛ me mra mraalɛ ne mɔ vi ewiade ɛleka biala bara.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye, mɔɔ me anyunlunyia ti membɔle ye, na mengyehyɛle menyɛle la bara.” Yizilayɛma le Ɛdɛnkɛma alasevolɛ

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Nyamenle se, “Bɛva menli ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛ nye ɛzi, bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛ nzo ɛdi la bɛrɛla.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, na bɛmaa menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa. Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛhola kɛha ɛhye kɛdo gua, na ɔkɛhile yɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la a? Bɛmaa bɛva bɛ alasevolɛ bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛrali bɛmaa bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛdie na bɛha kɛ, ‘Ɔle nɔhalɛ.’ ”

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛle me alasevolɛ nee me sonvolɛma mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ, amaa bɛanwu ye na bɛalie me bɛali, na bɛade ɔ bo kɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a. Ɛye me a, nyamenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ li me nyunlu, yɛɛ bie vi me nzi ɛnrɛra.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: “Medame, medame ala a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ɛye me a dievolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Medame a menganle mɔɔ bazi la mendole gua a, medame a menliele bɛ ngoane a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee nyamenle gyɛne biala ɛnle bɛ avinli la; bɛdabɛ a bɛle me alasevolɛ a.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Medame a mele Nyamenle a, yɛɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la medame a mele Nyamenle a; awie ɛngola ɛnlie debie mɔɔ melɛ ye me sa nu la; yɛɛ melɛyɛ debie a awie ɛngola ɛnzi me aze.” Bɛnriandi bɛavi Babelɔn

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se, “Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti, mebazoa meamaa bɛahɔ Babelɔn anwo zo, meamaa bɛahɔbubu suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, na meamaa Babeloniama anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne ahakyi awolɛyelɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, Yizilayɛma Bɔvolɛ, bɛ Belemgbunli ne a.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
