translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ pɛ adenle to nyevile nu, na ɔye adenle ɔto azule mgbole nu,

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: yemɔ mɔɔ ɔka konle ehwili nee mgbɔnwɔ ɔgua, ɔbɛlɛ ɛlɔnema nee ɛlɔne nu katakyiema aze; ɔka bɛ ɔgua mɔɔ bɛngola dwazo bieko, ɔnua bɛ kɛ senle, ɔminli bɛ bo zo la se,

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmakakye ninyɛne dɛba ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛmmadwenle mɔmoane ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, melɛyɛ debie fofolɛ; kɛ ɔlɛba ɛ, asoo bɛnnwu ye? Mebakpakye adenle meado fienemgbole nu, na meaye azule meagua ɛsɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, Noko “Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛanzonle me, me nwo ɛvonle bɛ, O Yizilayɛma!

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛfale bɛ mboane bɛtɛbayɛle ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛtɛmanle me, yɛɛ bɛtɛfale azubɔlɛ bɛtɛdile me eni. Metɛfale azubɔlɛ metɛyɛle kpomgbolo metɛkpolole bɛ, yɛɛ metɛgyegyele bɛ wɔ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ nwo.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛfale bɛ ezukoa bɛtɛtɔle baka evuanlɛ bɛtɛmanle me, yɛɛ bɛtɛfale bɛ nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la bɛtɛbɔle azu bɛtɛmanle me. Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo, bɛva bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ bɛgyegye me.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Medame, medame a mele Nyamenle, mɔɔ medame me ti, mefa bɛ ɛtane mekyɛ bɛ a. Menrɛhakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bieko.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: “Bɛhakye me adwenle; bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛvedevede nu, bɛha bɛ tendile ne bɛhile kɛ bɛdi benle.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Bɛ ze ne mɔɔ lumua la yɛle ɛtane, yɛɛ bɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne yɛle ɛtane tiale me.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menguale bɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mgbanyima anyunlu aze; menyele Yizilayɛma memanle bɛzɛkyele bɛ, na memanle bɛgolole me menli ne anwo.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma, me sonvolɛma, bɛdie, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ a!

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ membɔle bɛ, mengyehyɛle bɛ bɛ nli mɔ akunlu la mese: Mebaboa bɛ; bɛmmasulo, me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra; bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ a.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: “Mebamaa ezule adɔ azɛlɛ resee zo, na azudenle aze azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule ɛnle zo la azo. Mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua bɛ bo zo amra anwo zo, na meayila bɛ mra.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Bɛbamaa bɛ nwo zo kɛ ndile mɔɔ fifi nzule nu la; bɛbayɛ kɛ mbaka mɔɔ fifi azule nloa la.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye baha kɛ, ‘Mele Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ;’ ko bava Gyekɔbo duma ado ɔ nwo zo, yɛɛ ko noko bahɛlɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ ɔ’ yeagua ɔ sa anwo, na yeava Yizilayɛ duma yeazɔ ye duma ne azo.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli nee Kpɔnevolɛ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a mele mɔlebɛbo ne, yɛɛ medame a mele awieleɛ ne; ɛye me a nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Nwane a le kɛ medame a? Bɛmaa ɔha ɔdo gua, bɛmaa ɔha ɔdo gua na ɔva ɔzi me nyunlu. Nwane a mɔmoane ɔholale ɔhanle mɔɔ bazi la a? Bɛmaa ɔha mɔɔ kenlebie bazi la ɔhile yɛ.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɛzulolɛ ka bɛ; meha mehile bɛ dɛba yɛɛ meva medo gua. Bɛmɛ a bɛle me alasevolɛ a! Asoo ɛye me a nyamenle bieko wɔ ɛkɛ ɔ? Pepɛdievolɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ medame; menze bie memboka me nwo.” Bɛgolo amonlezɔlɛ nwo

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mmonle la ɛnle ɛhwee, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la azo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa bɛ; bɛ alasevolɛ ne mɔ ɛnze, yɛɛ bɛnnwu kɛ bɛ nyunlu bagua aze.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua ananze bɛyɛ mmonle la ɛnnyia nvasoɛ biala wɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la amuala anyunlu bagua aze, yɛɛ dwinvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ la le menli ala; maa bɛ muala bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa bɛragyinla ɛke, na ɛkɛnwu kɛ bɛ ahonle badu, bɛ nyunlu agua aze.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Mbulalɛ dwinvolɛ ne wula bulalɛ senle nu na ɔyɛ nwolɛ gyima, ɔfa ɔ sa ɛnlomboɛ ne ɔsɔ hamenle nu ɔbolo ye ɔsiezie ye. Ye ɛyɛlɛ nu, nzuhɔne ku dwinvolɛ ne, ɛhɔne ku ye maa ɔ nwo bɛlɛ ye.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Saa kapenta noko a, ɔfa ye ɛzuzudeɛ ne ɔto nwolɛ, ɔfa ye pɛnsele ne ɔkɛlɛhɛlɛ taboa ne azo, na akee ɔfa bulalɛ ɔtwɛlɛhwɛlɛ nwolɛ, ɔsiezie ye ɔmaa ɔyɛ kɛ sonla, na ɔyɛ ɔmaa ɔsɔho sonla, na bɛfa bɛsie sua nu.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Sonla pɛ sida baka to; anzɛɛ yɛ baka ɛsesebɛ bie anyenle, ɔgyakyi ye ɔmaa ɔnyi ɔyɛ baka kpole ɛsesebɛ wɔ kpɔkɛ ne anu. Ɔdua sida baka na ɔgyakyi ye ɔmaa ezule tɔ gua zolɛ, ɔyɛ baka ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Akee ɔfa bie ɔyɛ ɛyɛne ɔwuda ɔmaa ɔbɔ ɔ nwo wuluwulu, ɔfa bie ɔwuda senle ɔto kpanwo ɔdi, na eza yeava bie yeayɛ ye nyamenle yeazonle ye. Ɔfa baka ne ɔyɛ ananze na yeabɔ ɔ ti aze yeamaa ye.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Na baka ne mɔɔ kɛha la yeava yeaze ananze, yeayɛ amonle, yeava yeayɛ ye nyamenle; ɔtu ɔtɔ ɔ nyunlu ɔsonle ye na yeazɛlɛ ye yeaha kɛ, “Die me ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɛle me nyamenle!”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Biala ɛndwenle, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle anzɛɛ bɛnnwu nrɛlɛbɛ bɛnga kɛ, “Baka ye foa ko a meyela ye senle nu, meva medo kpanwo, medondo fɛlɛ anzɛɛ nane meli la; na duzu ati a akee menwɔva sinli ne mɔɔ ɛha la menwɔyɛ bɛkyi debie ɛ? Asoo membɔ me ti aze memaa baka sinli?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔkɛli nzonle bɔbɔ; adwenle ɛtane ɛminli ye, yemɔti ɔngola ɔnlie ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɔnga kɛ amonle ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛnle nyamenle fee. Ɛdɛnkɛma, Bɔvolɛ nee Dievolɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛhakye ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ; Yizilayɛma, bɛle me sonvolɛma. Medame a membɔle bɛ a, bɛle me sonvolɛma. Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Mepia bɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ amuala kɛ amungu mehɔ, yɛɛ mepia bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ megua; bɛzia bɛrɛla, ɔluakɛ mekpɔne bɛ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: O anwumaneamra, bɛdo edwɛne, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛyɛ a; O azɛlɛ buma ne mɔ, bɛdea nu; O awoka, bɛdo edwɛne, O kpɔkɛ, nee nuhua mbaka kɔsɔɔti, bɛdo edwɛne! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, na bɛbawula ye anyunlunyia wɔ Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne mɔɔ bɔle bɛ guale bɛ wɔ bɛ nli mɔ akunlu la se, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti la, me ngome a membɔle anwuma a. Mɔɔ mebɔ azɛlɛ ye la, nwane a gyi me foa a?

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Medame a mesɛkye adalɛma mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ, memaa menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa zo la yɛ ahoasea, memaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nrɛlɛbɛ ka bɛ ti anu, na memaa bɛ adwenlenubukelɛ yɛ mgbane.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Medame a memaa me sonvolɛma edwɛkɛ di munli, na meyɛ mɔɔ me soanvolɛma kɛha la. Meka ye Gyɛlusalɛm anwo kɛ, ‘Menli baradɛnla zolɛ,’ na meka mekile Dwuda azuamgbole kɛ, ‘Bɛbakyekye bɛ fofolɛ, na mebakyekye bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛzɛkye la.’

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Medame a meka mekile buma kɛ ‘We resee, mebamaa wɔ azule ne mɔ asesa.’

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Medame a meka mekile Saelɛse kɛ, ‘Ɔle me mboaneneavolɛ, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ debie biala mɔɔ mekpondɛ la;’ meka mekile Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ, ‘Bɛbakyekye ye bieko,’ na meka wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo kɛ, ‘Bɛbawula wɔ adiabo ne aze.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Saelɛse, yemaa ye tumi kpole kɛ ɔli maanle maanle nwo zo konim, na ɔlie arelemgbunli tumi ɔvi bɛ sa nu; ɔbukebuke nlenkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu la, amaa bɛando nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu, na ɔzele ye kɛ:

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Mebalumua ɛ nyunlu, meahɔha awoka ne mɔ aze meamaa wɔ. Mebabubu bɛ kɔbele nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, na meapepɛ bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nzi mbulalɛ ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Mebava anwonyia mɔɔ vea awozinli nu la meamaa wɔ, meava anwoneɛ biala mɔɔ vea la meamaa wɔ, amaa wɔanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mefa wɔ duma mefɛlɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo ati, nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la ati, mefa wɔ duma mefɛlɛ wɔ, yɛɛ ɛnze me bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko me duma la ɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ, ɛye me a Nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ; memaa wɔ anwosesebɛ, noko ɛnze me,

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: amaa ɔvi aduduleɛ kɔdwu adɔleɛ, menli kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ ɛye me a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: O anwomanyunlu, tɔ tenleneyɛlɛ kɛ ezule fi anwuma gua azɛlɛ ye azo, maa azɛlɛ ye ɛmeme, amaa zolɛ afifi ngoanelielɛ, na tenleneyɛlɛ noko afifi zolɛ; Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a memaa ɛhye si a.” Ewiadebɔlɛ nee tetedwɛkɛ Awulae

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ nee ye Bɔvolɛ dwudwu la, ɔle kɛ buakɛ wɔ mɔɔ nwonle ye la asa anu. Asoo ndɛtɛlɛ bahola aha ahile mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ye anwo debie la kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛnwo la?’ anzɛɛ ‘Wɔ dwora ne ɛnlɛ ɔ sa?’

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛha kɛhile ɔ ze kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛwo bɛ la?’ anzɛɛ ɔ nli mɔɔ ako ɛha ye la kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛmaa wɔade awolɛ nyane la?’ ”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, Yizilayɛ Bɔvolɛ ne se, “Ɛbiza me kpuyia mɔɔ fane me menli ne anwo la, anzɛɛ ɛkile me mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mesi meyɛ me gyima la ɔ?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Medame a membɔle ewiade a, yɛɛ membɔle sonla mendole nu; menvale me tumi a membɔle anwuma a, yɛɛ medame a membɔle anwumaneamra a.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Memaa mɔɔ Saelɛse ɛyɛ la ɛyɛ tenlene, yɛɛ mebamaa ye ndenle ne mɔ ayɛ fɔɔnwo; ɔbakyekye me suakpole ne, na yeamaa bɛagyakyi me menli ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la, ɔnrɛlie bɛ ti ɛkpɔnedeɛ anzɛɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yigyibiti nee Sudan anwonyia ne amuala bapɛ ali bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ Sibama, menli kakanyinlima ne, barazonle bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbagua bɛ anga bɛara, na bɛarahoto bɛ. Bɛbabodo bɛazɛlɛ bɛ bɛaha kɛ, ‘Nyamenle nee bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma angome a lua a, nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ ɔ ngome ala.

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, Ngoanedievolɛ ne, Nɔhalɛ, ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛfea ɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛbɔ anyiemgba, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo mmonle la, bɛbɔ anyiemgba.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie Yizilayɛma ngoane, yemaa bɛ ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, bɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze anzɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛlɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle anwuma la, yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle a! Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle na ɔbɔle azɛlɛ ye la, ɔbɔle ɔmanle ɔlile munli, yeambɔ ye sesakaa biala yeanzie ɛkɛ; ɔbɔle ewiade, amaa sonla adɛnla nu. Ɔse, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Meanga ye fealera nu, wɔ awozinli azɛlɛ bie azo; meanga meangile Gyekɔbo abo zo amra kɛ, ‘Bɛva basabasayɛlɛ bɛkpondɛ me bo zo.’ Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka nɔhalɛ ne, meka mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la meto gua.” Ewiade Awulae nee Babelɔn mmonle ne mɔ

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛango bɛandɔ, mɔɔ bɛwɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la, bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛrɛla, bɛ muala bɛhwe bɛbikye. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsoa mbaka mmonle bɛkpɔsa, na dahuu bɛsonle nyamenle mɔɔ ɛngola ɛnlie ngoane la ɛnlɛ adwenle!

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛ tendile ne bɛdo gua; bɛ muala bɛva adwenle! Nwane a dɛbadɛba ne hanle ɛhye a? Nwane a vale dole gua wɔ mɔmoane a? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a menganle a, yɛɛ ɛye me a nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ. Mele Nyamenle tenlene yɛɛ medie ngoane, ɛye me a bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛrɛla na bɛnyia ngoane, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewiade amuala la! Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Meha medame me ngome me nwo mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ, me nloa ɛvula edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le tenlene, menrɛhwe menrɛzia: Awie biala bahoto me, awie biala babɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ me nyunlu.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: “Bɛbaha wɔ me nwo kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma anu yɛɛ yɛnwu tenleneyɛlɛ nee tumi a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva ɔ nwo ɛya la bara ye ɛkɛ na bɛ nyunlu agua aze.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ati Yizilayɛma abo zo amra bali konim na bɛ nyunlu ara anyia dahuu.

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: “Babelɔn awozonle Bɛle nee Nibo ɛwie ala ɛne, nane nee nlankɛ a soa bɛ mmonle ne mɔ a; ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛsoa bɛkpɔsa la le adesoa maa nane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛwie fɛ la.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ nu bɛkoto, bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze, bɛngola bɛnlie bɛ nwo, bɛhye bɛdabɛ mumua ne nuokɛ!

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: “O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie me, O Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛdie me! Ɔvi bɛ awolɛ nu menlea bɛ boɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Kɛkala bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛwie nyi la, medame ala yɛɛ mebazɔ bɛ toonwo bɛabɔ egyɛne a. Medame a mebɔ bɛ a, mebanlea bɛ nwo zo kpalɛ; mebaboa bɛ na mealie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: “Nwane a bɛkɛva ye bɛkɛdo me nwo, mɔɔ le kɛ medame na ɔ nee me sɛ a?

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Menli ye ezukoa nvutuke wɔ bɛ ahodoku nu; bɛsuzu bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔ; bɛbɔ ezukoa dwinvolɛ ɛkpa; ɔfa bɛ ezukoa ne ɔyɛ nyamenle, na bɛtu bɛgua ɔ nyunlu bɛsonle ye!

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Bɛkpogya ye zo bɛto bɛ kɔme zo, bɛsoa ye bɛkɔsie ye ɛleka ko, ɛnee ɔgyi ɛkɛ, ɔngola ɔndu ɔ bo ɔnvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyi la. Saa awie su fɛlɛ ye a ɔmbua ye anzɛɛ ɔnlie ye ɔnvi ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye alumua ninyɛne mɔɔ zile dɛba ne la; ɔluakɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ. Medame a mele Nyamenle a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ medame.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Medame a mɔlebɛbo ne menganle awieleɛ edwɛkɛ ne na mɔmoane menganle mɔɔ basisi la anwo bie menzele kɛ, ‘Mɔɔ meha la bagyinla ɛkɛ, yɛɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ mehyehyɛ la.’

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Mevɛlɛ awie vi aduduleɛ maanle bie anu moa moa, ɔbara kɛ anloma mɔɔ kyehye nyɛmoa di la. Meha, na mebamaa yeayɛ zɔ; mehyehyɛ medo ɛkɛ, yɛɛ mebayɛ.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsolo na bɛ ngoanelielɛ wɔ moa a, bɛdie me!

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Memaa bɛ ngoanelielɛ kenle ne ɛbikye, ɔnle moa fee, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ na me ngoanelielɛ ne ara. Mebalie Gyɛlusalɛm na meava anyunlunyia meamaa Yizilayɛ.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Babelɔn, dwu aze badɛnla ndɛtɛlɛ nu. Kalediama suakpole mɔɔ ɛnli kotɔ, ɛvi wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne azo dwu aze, ɔluakɛ ɛ nwo ɛngyia bieko.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Fa ɛdibolɛ ne na ti ɛdɔkɛ ne, ye ɛ ti zo aguzo ne; kpa gua maa ɛ gyakɛ anwo ɛla ɛkɛ, na wudwu azule ne mɔ.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Ɛ nwo bala zo, menli banwu kɛ wɔbɔ anyiemgba. Mebali nzenralɛ, yɛɛ menrɛvavi awie biala.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Yɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Yemɔ a ɔle Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Babelɔn, tɛnla koonwu maa awozinli ɛva wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ bɛnrɛvɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle belemgbunli raalɛ.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Menvale me menli ne anwo ɛya, menguale me agyadeɛ nwo evinli; menyele bɛ menwulale ɛ sa nu, wɔannwu bɛ anwunvɔne, na ɛmanle mrelera yɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Ɛzele me kɛ, ‘Medi belemgbunli meahyɛ.’ Yemɔti wɔandwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la anwo anzɛɛ kɛ bɛ awieleɛ bazi awie la.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛkulo anyelielɛ, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛdwenle kɛ ɛde, ɛ nwo tɔ wɔ, na ɛka ye ɛ ti anu kɛ, ‘Medame ɛne, awie ɛndɛla me; menrɛdɛnla kɛ kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ menrɛli abawuo’ la, tie ɛhye:

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: “Ɛdwenle kɛ wɔ amumuyɛ ne maa ɛ nwo tɔ wɔ, wɔ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Awie ɛnnwu me’; wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ne nee wɔ adwenle ne ɛmaa wɔminli. Eza wɔha ye ɛ ti anu kɛ, ‘Medame ɛne, awie biala nee me ɛnzɛ.’

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: Gyinla kpundii wɔ wɔ ngonyiayelɛ nee wɔ nyidane ɛdudulɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ sumunli wɔ mgbavolɛ nu wɔyɛ la anu; wɔannea a ɔbamaa wɔakpazi, wɔannea a ɛ nwo baha ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ tu wɔ folɛ la anwo ɛvonle wɔ, maa bɛgyinla bɛlie wɔ ngoane ɛ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛkyɛ anwumaneamra anu, bɛnea bɛsukoa nwɔlɔra ne mɔ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ siane fofolɛ biala bɛkola bɛka mɔɔ bazi ɛ nwo zo la bɛkile wɔ la.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, bɛle kɛ abɛlɛ gyakɛ, senle yela bɛ wee; bɛngola bɛnlie bɛ nwo bɛnvi senle ne asa anu. Ɛhye ɛnle samɛnlankɛ ɔmbɔ bɛ nwo wuluwulu, ɔnle senle bɛndɛnla nwo bɛnde!

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ ɛvɛ, na bɛ nee wɔ ɛli gua vi wɔ mgbavolɛ nu la, kɛ bɛ muala bɛle la ɛne; ko biala ɔdaye ɔlua ye ɛlualɛ, awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛlie wɔ a.”

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie ɛhye, bɛfa Yizilayɛ duma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ, yɛɛ bɛle Dwuda mogya ne bie; bɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma duma bɛka ndane, na bɛbɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne duma, noko bɛmbɔ ye nɔhalɛ nu nee fɔɔnwo zo.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛfa suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne duma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ nwo, na bɛfa bɛ ti bɛsɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne; ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ɔvi tete, menganle mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la, ɔvi me nloa anu ɔvindele na memanle bɛdele ɔ bo, akee arɛlevilɛ nu menyɛle na memanle ɔyɛle nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: yɛɛ dɛba dɛba ne menvale mendole gua a, menganle kolaa na bɛayɛ zɔ; anrɛɛ bɛkɛha kɛ, ‘Me bozonle ne a yɛle a, me ananze mɔɔ megua nee mɔɔ meze la yɛɛ hanle manle ɔyɛle zɔhane a.’

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: Bɛde, akee kɛkala, bɛnlea ɛhye mɔ, na bɛlie bɛdo nu kɛ mele nɔhalɛ. Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la bɛbade ninyɛne fofolɛ, ninyɛne mɔɔ vea mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Bɛnle ɛkɛ dɛba, kɛkala a mebɔ bɛ a; bɛtɛtele nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ kɛ ɛnɛ, anrɛɛ bɛkɛha kɛ, ‘Yɛdayɛ yɛze bɛ dɛba.’

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Bɛtɛtele ye ɛlɛ, bɛnze ye ɛlɛ, ɔvi tete, bɛtɛbukele bɛ nzo. Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ bɛbayɛ ngunzi, yɛɛ ɔvi bɛ awolɛ nu, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ atuadelɛma.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: “Me duma ne ati, megyakyi me ɛya ne, me ayɛlɛyelɛ ti, menrɛva menrɛgua bɛ nwo zo, amaa meambɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mede bɛ nwo, noko bɛ nee dwɛtɛ fufule ɛnzɛ; meva nyanenwunlɛ mokyea medu bɛ nuhua.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Medame mumua ne me ti yɛɛ meyɛ a, ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛgua me duma ne anwo evinli. Menrɛva me anyunlunyia menrɛmaa awie gyɛne.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Saelɛse kɛ ɔle kpanyinli

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie me! Yizilayɛma mɔɔ medame mevɛlɛ bɛ, bɛdie me! Medame a mele Nyamenle a, medame a mele mɔlebɛbo ne nee awieleɛ ne a.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Medame a menwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne aze a, menvale me tumi a membɔle anwuma a; saa mefɛlɛ bɛ a, bɛfinde me nyunlu.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: “Bɛ muala bɛrayia, na bɛdie! Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ ɛva ɛhye mɔ ɛdo gua a? Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la; ɔbali Babelɔn anwo gyima; ye tumi ne batia Babeloniama

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Medame, ɛhɛe, medame yɛɛ mevɛlɛ ye a, meva ye mera, na ɔbakpazi adenle biala anu.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: “Bɛhwe bɛbikye me na bɛdie ɛhye, ɔvi tete, metɛfeale metɛkanle edwɛkɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkara la, ɛnee mewɔ ɛkɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ ye menli ne anwo ngyehyɛlɛ

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ kilehile bɛ maa bɛyɛ kpalɛ, na ɔdi bɛ nyunlu ɔkilehile bɛ adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua nu la.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: “O anrɛɛ bɛdiele me mɛla ne mɔ! Anrɛɛ bɛ anzonudwolɛ kɛyɛ kɛ azule, na bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ayɛ kɛ nyevile azɛlɛkye;

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: anrɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra kɛzo kɛ ɛnwea, na bɛ mra azo kɛ abɛlɛ ma; bɛ duma ɛnrɛminli ɛlɛ, anzɛɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye wɔ me nyunlu ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Bɛvi Babelɔn bɛye bɛ nwo, bɛnriandi bɛvi Babelonia. Bɛbɔ ye nolo, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdeɛdea nu bɛha, bɛmaa ɔdwu azɛlɛ ye azo amuala; bɛha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne ye sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne!”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la, nzuhɔne angu bɛ ɛlɛ; ɔmanle nzule vi bodane nu vindele zenle manle bɛ, ɔkpukele bolɛ ne na nzule vi nu vindele.

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa, bɛdie me, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛde moa moa maanle nu, bɛdie. Mela ɛkolɛ nu la yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vɛlɛle me a, mɔɔ mela ɔmɔ akunlu la yɛɛ ɔdonle me duma a.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle me nloa edwɛkɛ yɛle nla kɛ konle dadeɛ, ɔvale me ɔveale ye tumi bo; ɔmanle menyɛle kɛ ɛda baka, ɔvale me ɔveale ye boa nu.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛle me sonvolɛ, Yizilayɛ, wɔmɔ ɛ ti, menli baye me ayɛlɛ.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “Medame, mevɛ mgbane, mezɛkye me anwosesebɛ mgbane, mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ a.” Noko me anwosesebɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ, yɛɛ me ahatualɛ wɔ me Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle me wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu kɛ menyɛ ye sonvolɛ, menva Yizilayɛma menzia membɛlɛ ye, ɔluakɛ mezɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye, yɛɛ me Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le me anwosesebɛ la se:

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: “Ɔnyɛ se kɛ ɛkɛyɛ me sonvolɛ, na ɛkɛva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɛkɛzie bɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne. Mebamaa wɔayɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛnlaneɛ, amaa me ngoanelielɛ ne adwu ewiade ɛleka biala.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛlɛka ahile sonla ne mɔɔ le arelemgbunli sonvolɛ, mɔɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛkpo ye, na bɛkyi ye kpole kpalɛ la kɛ, “Arelemgbunli banwu wɔ na bɛadwazo; arelemgbunli amra mrenya badu agua ɛ nyunlu, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, mɔɔ ɛkpa nu ɛye wɔ la di nɔhalɛ.” Gyɛlusalɛm boɛyɛlɛ

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ menwu bɛ anwunvɔne la, membuale bɛ, mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ medie bɛ ngoane la, memboale bɛ; mezinza bɛ, na mebɔ bɛ nwo bane, melua bɛ nwo zo me nee menli ne ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ, kɛ bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛahyɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la;

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: mebaha meahile pilizama kɛ, ‘Bɛraze bɛhɔ’ mebaze menli mɔɔ de awozinli nu la kɛ, ‘Bɛrɛla wienyi nu.’ Bɛbadidi adehane ne mɔ, yɛɛ awoka ne mɔ azo bayɛ bɛ adidileka.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne anzɛɛ nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ, sɛnzɛne anzɛɛ anwoma wuluwulu ɛnrɛbɔ bɛ, ɔluakɛ ahenle mɔɔ nwu bɛ anwunvɔne la bali bɛ ti, yɛɛ ɔbava bɛ yeahɔ nzubula nwo.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: “Mebakpakye adenle meado awoka ne mɔ anu, na meadu ademgbole meamaa bɛ.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, ɛhye mɔ vi moa bara, bɛvi sɔlɔ nee adɔleɛ afoa nu, yɛɛ bɛvi Asewan azɛlɛ zo bɛbara.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Anwuma amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne, O azɛlɛ ye azo amra, bɛli wulupe; O awoka, bɛdo edwɛne! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkyekye ye menli ne arɛle, na ɔbanwu ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane la anwunvɔne.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Noko Gyɛlusalɛmma se, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpo yɛ, yɛ Awulae arɛle ɛvi yɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Asoo ɛrɛladane arɛle bavi ɔ ra mɔɔ no nyɛfonlɛ, asoo ɔnrɛnwu ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ yewo ye la anwunvɔne? Ɔyɛ a bɛ rɛle kɛvi bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mame, me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mehɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ me sa akunlu; me nye wɔ bɛ suakpole ne bane ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: “Bɛ suazilɛma ɛbo suabɔlɛma ne anwo zo, menli mɔɔ razɛkyele bɛ la bahɔ.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ nye bɛbɔ bɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka bɛnlea, bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, bɛlɛba bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle la, bɛ nye balie bɛ menli ne anwo kɛ anwoneɛ, na bɛava bɛaziezie bɛ nwo kɛ atɔfolɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: “Nɔhalɛ, bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele ye, bɛ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛdole ye mgbane la bayɛ ekyi amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbadɛnla nu la; na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛmɛ la badu ahɔ moa moa.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ nu ngakula mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ la baha amaa bɛade bie kɛ: ‘Azɛlɛ ne le ekyi maa yɛ; bɛdɛlɛ nu bɛmaa yɛnyia ɛleka yɛdɛnla.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Akee bɛbaha ye bɛ ti akunlu kɛ, ‘Nwane a wole ngakula ɛhye mɔ manle yɛ a? Yɛ mra ne mɔ wule, yɛpɛle awolɛ, bɛhyele yɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu; na nwane a wole menli ɛhye mɔ a? Bɛnlea, ɔhale me ngomekye ala; nienwu a akee ɛhye mɔ vi ɛra a.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Bɛnlea, mebamaa me sa zo meahile maanle maanle. mebanwɔha ye meado bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ, na bɛbava bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bɛarɛlɛ bɛ, bɛbazoa bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛ bati bɛara.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli bayɛ bɛ dɔmagyama, na arelemgbunli mraalɛ ayɛ bɛ baviavolɛma. Bɛbazi bɛ ti aze, bɛabu ndwɛlɛ wɔ bɛ nyunlu, na bɛatafe bɛ gyakɛ anwo munlutu. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkendɛ me moalɛ la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze.”

english_verse: Is it possible to rescue victims from someone strong and cruel?
translation_verse: Asoo katakyie sɔ awie nu a bɛkola ye die? Asoo atisesebɛnli kye awie nuokɛ a bɛkola ye die?

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, “Sonla mɔɔ katakyie ɛhye ye nuokɛ la, bɛbalie ye, yɛɛ bɛbalie mɔɔ atisesebɛnli ne ɛhye ye la. Ɔluakɛ me nee menli mɔɔ nee bɛ ko la baho, yɛɛ mebalie bɛ mra ne mɔ ngoane.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Mebamaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ la ali bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwonane, na bɛanlo bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ mogya bɛabo kɛ bɛnlo nwanye. Akee menli kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Dievolɛ ne, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, Yizilayɛ Katakyie Ko ne a.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛ nli kɛlata ne mɔɔ mengɛlɛle membɔle ye ewole, menvoanle ye la wɔ nienwu? Anzɛɛ nwane a metua ye kakɛ, mɔɔ ɔlua zo medɔne bɛ memaa ye a? Bɛnlea, ɔlua bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛtane nee bɛ mɛladonlɛ ti yɛɛ bɛdɔne bɛ na bɛvoa bɛ nli a.

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔti ɛ, membale la ɛnee awie ɛnle ɛkɛ ɔ? Menvɛlɛle la, ɛnee awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ die zo ɔ? Asoo me sa ɛyɛ ezinraa mɔɔ yemɔti mengola memkpɔne bɛ a? Anzɛɛ menlɛ tumi mɔɔ mefa medie bɛ ngoane ɔ? Bɛnlea, metendɛ a nyevile sesa; memaa azule ne mɔ kakyi ɛsɛlɛ, fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛnnyia nzule, nzuhɔne maa bɛwu na bɛbɔ.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Memaa awozinli fa anwumaneamra, na memaa bɛkeda ɛrele.” Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ ne tieyɛ

english_verse: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ɛmaa me ɛnloanlɛ, amaa meahilehile, na meanwu edwɛkɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ meka a ɔkɛmaa mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la anwosesebɛ a. Nwonlomɔ biala ɔtunwue me, ɔbuke me nzo, amaa meade mɔɔ ɔkilehile me la.

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ɛbuke me nzo, yɛɛ meande ɔ nwo atua, meangakyi me nzi meanzi ye.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mengakyile me nzi memanle menli mɔɔ bo me la, menvale me kɛsa memanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdudule me kɛsa la; mɔɔ bɛtoto me nyunlu nyɛlɛ, bɛgua me nyunlu aze la, meanva me nyunlu meanvea.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne boa me, yemɔti me rɛle ɛtɛbɔle. Zɔhane ati meyɛ me nyunlu kɛ ɛtwɛlɛboɔ; meze kɛ me nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze;

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Awulae Nyamenle ne boa me; nwane a kɛbua me fɔlɛ a? Bɛnlea, bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ ɛdanlɛ, ɛlɛtɛba bali bɛ atete bɛ.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle, na ɔyɛ tieyɛ ɔmaa ye sonvolɛ ne, mɔɔ lua awozinli nu na ɔnlɛ kɛnlaneɛ, noko ɔ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, na ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔmaa ye Nyamenle ne la?

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwuda menli nzi senle, na bɛsɔ menli nwo tɛkɛ la, bɛnlea! Bɛlua bɛ senle ne mɔɔ bɛwuda, nee bɛ tɛkɛ ne mɔ wienyi ne anwo bɛhɔ! Debie mɔɔ bɛbanyia ye bɛavi me ɛkɛ ne la ɛne: nyane ala a baha bɛ a.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ngoane, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ la, bɛdie! Bɛnlea bodane ne mɔɔ bɛkpukele bɛyele bɛ nu, awolɛdulɛ kuma ne mɔɔ bɛdule bɛ nu la.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea bɛ nlenya Ebileham, nee bɛ nla Sɛla mɔɔ zole bɛ; ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Ebileham ɛtɛwole ralɛ la, yɛɛ menvɛlɛle ye a. Na menyilale ye memanle ɔ bo zo amra yɛle dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bakyekye Gyɛlusalɛmma arɛle, ɔbakyekye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azuadu nu la arɛle; ɔbamaa Gyɛlusalɛm fienemgbole ahakyi kɛ Yidɛn tola, yeamaa ɛsɛlɛ ne ayɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tola nu. Fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ bara ɛkɛ, na bɛado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛayɛ me mo.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: “Bɛdie me, me menli, me maanlema, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me, ɔluakɛ mebali mɛla, na me pɛlepɛlelilɛ bayɛ kɛnlaneɛ amaa maanle maanle ne mɔ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Me ngoanelielɛ ne ɛbikye kpalɛ, me ngoanelielɛ ne ɛdwu bɛ nwo zo dɛbadɛba, na medame mumua ne mebazie maanle maanle ne mɔ. Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa la ɛlɛkendɛ me, bɛ nye la kɛ menwɔlie bɛ.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Bɛdo bɛ nye anwuma bɛnlea, na bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea azɛlɛ ye, ɔluakɛ anwuma baminliminli kɛ esike; azɛlɛ ye batete kɛ ɛdanlɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ la bawu kɛ ngokowule. Me ngoanelielɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu, na me konimlilɛ ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ tenlenema, bɛdie me, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛdi me mɛla zo, bɛmmasulo menli ngehanleɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu bɛ ɛnwunlonwunlanlɛ nwo.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛlɛtɛba bali bɛ kɛ bɛdi ɛdanlɛ, yɛɛ sone bali bɛ kɛ bɛdi boane enrinli la; na me konimlilɛ ne badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, me ngoanelielɛ ne badwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: Dwazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa wɔ anwosesebɛ nee wɔ tumi ne dwazo boa yɛ. Dwazo, kɛmɔ mɔmoane ɛyɛle na ɛboale awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la. Asoo tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛpepɛle nyevizonle Releehabe anu azinli azinli, na ɛwɔle nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la atwɛ la?

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Asoo tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛmanle nyevile ne sesanle, ye buma ne nzule muala wele, na ɛmanle nyevile buma ne yɛle ademgbole, ɛmanle wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔkpɔne bɛ la luale nu la?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne bɛ la bazia ara, bɛbava edwɛndolɛ bɛara Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛ nye balie dahuu; bɛbali fɛlɛko na bɛ nye alie, na bɛnrɛnwu nyane, yɛɛ alɔbɔlɛ ɛnrɛhu bɛ bieko.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a mele Nyamenle mɔɔ kyekye bɛ rɛle a. Duzu ati a bɛsulo sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeawu, mɔɔ ye ngoane le kɛ ndile la ɛ?

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛ ne ɛwie ɛya fa, na yeva yezie ɔ nyunlu kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ la ati, dahuu bɛwɔ ɛzulolɛ nu. na bɛ rɛle ɛvi Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma, na ɔwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ aze la, Na kpɔvolɛ ne ɛyavalɛ ne dwu nienwu?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na mɔɔ bɛholo ɔ kɔme zo la anwo adɔ ye; ɔnrɛwu yɛɛ ɔnrɛnwu Ewule Kuma ne, yɛɛ ɔ nloa anu aleɛ ɛnrɛbɔ ye.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ maa nyevile azɛlɛkye kulu. Me duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Meva me edwɛkɛ mewula ɛ nloa, yɛɛ meva wɔ mevea me ndɛba abo. Medame a membɔle anwuma, na menwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze, na menzele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ, ‘Bɛle me menli’ a.” Gyɛlusalɛmma amaneɛnwunlɛ ne awieleɛ

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdwazo, bɛheha bɛ nwo, bɛheha bɛ nwo! Bɛmɛ, bɛnlo Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ kɔpo ne anu, ye ɛya kɔpo ne ɛra bɛ nwo zo ɛlɛ; bɛmɛ, bɛnlonle ye ɛya kɔpo ne anu bɛmanle ɔdɔle mgbane, na ɔmanle bɛyɛle sesɛsesɛ.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Mralɛ mrenya bebelebe ne mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ la, bɛnnyia nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnli bɛ ti. Mralɛ mrenya bebelebe ne mɔɔ bɛtete bɛ la, bɛnnyia nuhua ko ɛnzɔ bɛ avinli.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Bɛ mra mrenya anye zo ɛbulu, bɛgua ye takagyaa wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo kɛ kɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ ɛdo ɛhane, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo kpole, bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdea bɛ.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdi nyane a, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛanno nwanye na bɛbo a, bɛdie ɛhye:

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Awulae, bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ die ye menli ne ati la se, “Bɛnlea, melie kɔpo ne mɔɔ maa bɛyɛ sesɛsesɛ, me ɛya kɔpo ne mɔɔ maa bɛte nyane la mevi bɛ sa nu, bɛnrɛnlo nuhua bieko;

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Mebava meawula menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ, mɔɔ ɛha ɛhile bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Bɛbutu bɛmaa yɛtietia bɛ nwo zo,’ na bɛva bɛ nzi bɛyɛ ndɛtɛlɛ bɛtietia zo la, na bɛ nzi ɛyɛ guabile mɔɔ bɛdua zolɛ la asa anu.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdwazo! Bɛdwazo, bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se, bɛva bɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bɛwula, O Gyɛlusalɛm, suakpole nwuanzanwuanza azo amra, ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na ɔnzonle Nyamenle la ɛnrɛra suakpole ne azo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛmma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ, bɛdwazo bɛvi ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu; bɛye bɛ kɔme nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne mɔ, O Zayɔnoma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛandɔne bɛ bɛanlie debie, yemɔti bɛnrɛdua bɛ ti ezukoa biala wɔ bɛ ɛkpɔnelɛ nu.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Me menli ne hɔle Yigyibiti alumua ne kɛ bɛkakpɔsa lɔ ala, na Aseleama sisile bɛ mgbane gyɛne ne ala.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu a menwu ye ɛke a? Mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ bɛhye me menli ne bɛhɔ mgbane. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ su, yɛɛ dahuu bɛgua me duma ne anwo evinli.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Yemɔti me menli ne banwu me duma. Mekɛ ne anu bɛbanwu kɛ medame a melɛtendɛ la; medame ɛne.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Ahenle ne mɔɔ lua awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, mɔɔ lɛ nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ ɛlɛba la ɛralɛ nu le kɛnlɛma, ɔbɔ anzonudwolɛ nolo, na ɔlɛ nrɛlaleɛ kɛnlɛma kpalɛ, ɔbɔ ngoanelielɛ nolo, na ɔka ɔkile Zayɔn kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne di belemgbunli.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, bɛ sinzavolɛma ɛlɛtea nu, bɛbɔ nu bɛto edwɛne anyelielɛ nu, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛnwu ye bɛ nye amunwiɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzia ɛlɛba Zayɔn.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu bɛdo edwɛne, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede Gyɛlusalɛm awuke mɔɔ ɛbɔ la anu la, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnwu ye menli ne anwunvɔne, yekyekye ye menli ne arɛle.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye tumi nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛwa maanle maanle ne mɔ anye, na ewiade amra amuala bɛanwu yɛ Nyamenle ne ngoanelielɛ ne.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ, bɛhɔ, bɛvi Babelonia bɛdwazo bɛhɔ, bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka debie biala mɔɔ evinli ɛha ye la. Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔnlua bɛ nwo, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsoa Ɛdɛnkɛma dwora ne mɔ la.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛhɔ ye ndɛndɛ ndɛndɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnriandi, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbali bɛ nyunlu, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne bali bɛ nzi. Sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, me sonvolɛ ne bakpazi, bɛbali ye eni na bɛamaa ye zo. Ɔbayɛ sonlakpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la azibɛnwo, ɔhakyile bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔnzɔho sonla a, yeanzɔho sonla bɔbɔ.

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo banwu ye na bɛabɔ mgbatike, yemɔ ɔ ti arelemgbunli baha bɛ nloa ado nu, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛkanle bɛtɛkilele bɛ la, bɛbanwu ye, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ye ɛlɛ la, bɛbade ɔ bo.

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛlie mɔɔ yɛde la ɛli a? Nwane a bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne bɛhile ye a?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔfifile kɛ baka ekyi bie mɔɔ zɔle ndinli wɔ azɛlɛ resee zo; ɔnle kɛnlɛma anzɛɛ ɔnzɔho debie na yɛanlea, yɛɛ ɔnzɔ ɛnyelɛ na yɛ nye abolo ye.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Menli kpole ye yɛɛ bɛambu ye; ɔnwunle amaneɛ na ɔdele nyane; ɔyɛle sonla mɔɔ menli nwu ye a bɛye bɛ nye bɛto ɛbɔ nu, bɛkpole ye yɛɛ yɛambu ye bie.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, yezoa yɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ yezoa yɛ nyanenwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti; noko yɛ adwenle a le kɛ, ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne le Nyamenle ndeanlɛ.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Noko yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ ati bɛbodɛbodale ye, bɛbodɛbodale ye wɔ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati; bɛvale yɛ nwo ndeanlɛ bɛguale ɔ nwo zo, ye empele mɔɔ bɛbilale ye la ɛyɛ yɛ ayile.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛminli kɛ mboane la; yɛ nuhua biala ɔdaye yeva ye adenle ɛdeɛ zo; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala ɛgua ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Bɛsisile ye, na bɛhilele ye nyane, noko yeambuke ɔ nloa; ɔle kɛ boane ralɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ, yɛɛ ɔle kɛ boane mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛlɛpepɛ ɔ nwo enrinli la. Ɔdɔle mumule, yeambuke ɔ nloa.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Nzisilɛ nu, bɛbuale ye ewule fɔlɛ na bɛ nee ye hɔle; awolɛndoazo zɔhane amra, biala andwenle nwo kɛ bɛlɛye ye bɛavi anyewɔzoma azɛlɛ zo, bɛhunle ye wɔ me menli ne mɛladonlɛ ti.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle ye nla bɛbokale amumuyɛma anwo, bɛziele ye wɔ sukoavolɛma avinli. Yeanyɛ ɛtane biala, yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Noko ɔle me ɛhulolɛ kɛ bɛkɛbodɛboda ye, na ɔkɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo; na ɔkɛva ɔ nwo ɔkɛbɔ azu ɔkɛmaa ɛtane. Ɔbanyi yeahyɛ na yeanwu ɔ bo zo amra, na ɔlua ɔ nwo zo Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ ne ali munli.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Ɔbanwu ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne abo aleɛ na ɔ nye alie, na ɔlua me sonvolɛ tenlene ko ne anwo zo, bɛbava menli dɔɔnwo kɛ bɛle tenlenema; na ɔbazoa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebamaa ye ɛleka wɔ mgbolema avinli, na ɔ nee anwosesebɛma ahyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ konle nu la, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔmanle kɛ bɛhu ye, na bɛdianle ye bɛbokale mɛladonlɛma anwo. Ɔvale menli dɔɔnwo ɛtane ɔdole ɔ nwo zo, na ɔkpale mɛladonlɛma ati kyɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O motanli mɔɔ anwo ralɛ a, to edwɛne; to edwɛne na maa ɛ ne ɛhɔ anwuma, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛtɛtele awolɛ nyane ɛlɛ a! Ɔluakɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpo ye la amra bazo dɔɔnwo adɛla raalɛ ne mɔɔ de agyalɛ ne abo la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛbadɛlɛ wɔahɔ fema zo nee bɛne zo, na ɛ bo zo amra bava maanle ne amuala, na menli ayi azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Mmasulo, ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze; mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu, na awie ɛnrɛgua ɛ nyunlu aze, ɔluakɛ ɛ rɛle bavi wɔ mbɛlɛra nu anyiemgba ne, yɛɛ ɛnrɛhakye wɔ kunlanehyilɛ nyanenwunlɛ ne bieko.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛ hu a le wɔ Bɔvolɛ ne, ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma; Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a le wɔ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, bɛfɛlɛ ye ewiade amuala Nyamenle.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mevɛlɛ wɔ kɛ yelɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo ye na ɔlɛdi nyane, kɛ yelɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvoa ye ye mbɛlɛra nu la, medame wɔ Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ekyi bie memkpole wɔ, noko mebava anwunvɔnezelɛ kpole kpalɛ meazia meava wɔ.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Menvale ɛya kpole mendwenle me nwo mekɛ ekyi, mendole me nye ɛbɔ nu, noko mebava ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛnwie ɛlɛ la meanwu wɔ anwunvɔne, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ Kpɔnevolɛ ne a mese a.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ ɛhye kakye me Nowa mekɛ zo, mɔɔ menganle ndane kɛ menrɛmaa nzule mɔɔ le kɛ Nowa mekɛ zo ɛdeɛ ne la ɛnrɛyi ɛnrɛva azɛlɛ ye bieko la. Yemɔti meha ndane kɛ menrɛva ɛ nwo ɛya bieko, yɛɛ menrɛhwi ɛ nyunlu bieko.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Awoka mgbole badudu ahɔ, awoka ngyikyi bavi bɛ bo zo ne mɔ, na me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛnrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ, yɛɛ me anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛnrɛkpa nwo ɛlɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ menwu wɔ anwunvɔne la a mese a.” Kɛ kenlebie Gyɛlusalɛm bazi ayɛ la

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane, wɔ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu, na awie ɛnkyekye ɛ rɛle a, nea, mebayɛ wɔ awolɛ ne mɔ memeamemea, na meava awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la meawula wɔ adiabo ne.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma bahilehile ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ, na ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bakpazi kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Ɛbalua tenleneyɛlɛ zo wɔamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ se, awie ɛnrɛsisi wɔ, yɛɛ ɛnrɛzulo; yɛɛ ɛzulolɛ biala ɛnrɛbikye wɔ.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Saa awie fa konle ba a, ɛnee tɛ me ɔ; awie mɔɔ kɛva ye konle kɛdoa wɔ la, ɛdawɔ ti, ɔbali akoatɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, mebɔ dwinvolɛ mɔɔ wuda emunlike bɔ akodeɛ; eza mebɔ ɛlɔnenli mɔɔ ko sɛkye ninyɛne,

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: noko akodeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛatia wɔ la ɛnrɛyɛ kpalɛ ɛlɛ; yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛva edwɛkɛ kɛdo ɛ nwo zo la, ɛbaha wɔado ɔ nwo zo. Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma agyadeɛ, nee bɛ ti mɔɔ medie la a le ɛhye. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Awie biala mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la ɛrɛla ɛranlo nzule; yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ezukoa la ɛrɛla ɛradɔ aleɛ ɛli. Bɛrɛla, bɛradɔ nwanye nee meleke, bɛnlɛ bolɛ yɛɛ bɛnva ezukoa bɛndɔ.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛsɛkye bɛ ezukoa wɔ mɔɔ ɛnle aleɛ la anwo, na bɛsɛkye bɛ anwosesebɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɛmmaa ahunlundwolɛ la anwo ɛ? Bɛdie me kpalɛ, bɛli mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie aleɛ sosɔɔ nwo na bɛyɛ mbelane.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: “Bɛrɛla, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me; bɛdie, amaa bɛanyia ngoane, na me nee bɛ bakyekye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛntulu ɛlɛ, na bɛanyia me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ menvale mengulole Belemgbunli Devidi la.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, menyɛle ye maanle maanle ne mɔ dasevolɛ, maanle maanle ne mɔ safohyenlema kpanyinli mɔɔ li bɛ ti.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Akee ɛbavɛlɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze bɛ la, yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ la banriandi ara ɛ nwo, wɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ati, ɔluakɛ medame Nyamenle, mewula wɔ anyunlunyia.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛkɛnwu ye, bɛbodo bɛzɛlɛ ye na ɔbikye;

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: bɛmaa amumuyɛnli ne ɛgyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ, na mɔɔ ɛndwenle kpalɛ nwo la ɛgyakyi; bɛmaa ɔzia ɔrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma aze ye anwunvɔne, bɛmaa ɔzia ɔrɛla yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, na Nyamenle bava ye ɛtane ahyɛ ye.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Tɛ me adwenle a le bɛ adwenle, yɛɛ tɛ me ndenle a le bɛ ndenle.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, kɛmɔ anwumaneamra wɔ anwuma tɛla azɛlɛ ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ me ndenle le mgbole na me adwenle le kpole tɛla bɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ a.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ ezule nee ezukɔtweaba vi anwuma tɔ, na bɛnzia bɛngɔ, na bɛdoɔloa azɛlɛ ye, bɛmaa ndile nyenle, na aleɛ yɛ kpalɛ, bɛmaa mɔɔ dua la nyia ma, na sonla nyia bie di la,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: zɔhane ala yɛɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ vi me nloa anu kɛvinde la ɛnrɛzia ɛnrɛra me nwo ɛke mgbane a. Ɔbayɛ mɔɔ medwenle nwo kɛ ɔrayɛ la, na yeakpazi mɔɔ menzoanle ye nwolɛ la ɛyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ ɛbavi Babelɔn anyelielɛ nu, bɛbali ɛ nyunlu bɛ nee wɔ ahɔ anzonudwolɛ nu, awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ amuala babɔ nu ado edwɛne, na ɛbɔ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti babɔ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sepelɛse mbaka bafifi ɛleka mɔɔ mbowule wɔ la, mbaka mgbole bafifi ɛleka mɔɔ mbowunyɛma wɔ la; Ɛhye bayɛ ngakyedeɛ yeamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ bɛmpɛ bɛndo ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛli pɛlepɛle na bɛbɔ tenlene ɛbɛla, na ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na me ngoanelielɛ ne ara, na mealie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ ɛradɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne avinli la mmaka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma baye me avi ye menli ne avinli.” Nrenya mɔɔ bɛza ye noko la mmaka kɛ, “Bɛnlea, meyɛ baka wulera.”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mrenya mɔɔ bɛza bɛ, mɔɔ sie me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, yɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ sɔ me nye na bɛsɔ me ngyekyeleɛ ne anu ɛsesebɛ la,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: mebamaa bɛ duma ayɛ ngakyedeɛ mɔɔ tɛla mralɛ mraalɛ nee mralɛ mrenya wɔ me sua nu; mebamaa bɛ duma adɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu mɔɔ ɔnrɛkpa me sua nu ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: “Nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ kɛva bɛ nwo kɛbeta Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ bɛsonle ye, bɛkulo Ɛdɛnkɛma duma na bɛayɛ ye sonvolɛma, awie biala mɔɔ sie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, na ɔngua nwolɛ evinli, na ɔsɔ me ngyekyeleɛ ne anu ɛsesebɛ la,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: bɛmɛ yɛɛ mebava bɛ meahɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, na meamaa bɛ nye alie wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ sua ne anu a; mebalie bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ wɔ me azukponle ne azo. Ɔluakɛ bɛbavɛlɛ me sua ne, menli kɔsɔɔti nzɛlɛlɛ sua.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne mɔɔ boɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ bie la anloa la se, “Mebaboɔboa menli gyɛne noko anloa meaboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ meboɔboa bɛ nloa dɛba la anwo.” Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ɛnli munli

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ nanemgbole mɔɔ wɔ kpɔkɛ nu, nanemgbole mɔɔ wɔ kpɔkɛmile nu, bɛrali menli nane.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Me sinzavolɛma ne anye ɛzi, bɛ biala ɛnlɛ adwenle; bɛle ahwea mumule, bɛngola kpo bɔbɔ; mɔɔ bɛze ye yɛ la a le nafelɛ mgbole nee ɛlalɛ mgbole ɛhanlɛ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ahwea ne mɔ le adidikpoku kpole kpalɛ; bɛdi a bɛ ko ɛnyi ɛlɛ. Mboaneneavolɛma ne mɔ noko ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo; biala ɛva ɔdaye ye adenle ɛdeɛ zo. Biala dwenle ɔ ngome ye kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Bɛse, ‘Ayi mɔ, bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔkpondɛ nwanye bie yɛnlo. Bɛmaa yɛhɔnlo nza ɛsesebɛ yɛbo; ɛhyema noko bayɛ kɛ ɛnɛ la, ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ.’ ”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Tenlenenli wu a ɔnvane awie biala anwo; bɛfa menli titile bɛkɔ mɔɔ awie ɛnde ɔ bo a. Ɔluakɛ bɛye tenlenenli bɛfi munzule nu a, ɔ nzo nu dwo ye.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la da die bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ bɛ ɛkpa zo.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Bɛhwe bɛbikye, bɛmɛ nyɛne mraalɛ amra mrenya, bɛmɛ tuutuu nee agyalɛ mɛlatovoma abo zo amra.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Nwane a bɛgolo ɔ nwo a? Nwane a bɛbuke bɛ nloa wanaanwo bɛkeha ɛtane ɛtane bɛtietia ye a? Asoo bɛnle mɛladonlɛma amra? Alanema nlɔnra,

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: bɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ti bɛ nee bɛ da oku mbaka nee baka buzuu biala abo, na bɛkuhu bɛ mra wɔ mbɔnza ne mɔ anu nee bodane ahuma nu.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Bɛfa awolɛ azo tonlotonlo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anu la bie bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ na bɛsonle ye, bɛgua nza zolɛ na bɛfa bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛkɔmaa bɛ. Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛyɛ debie zɛhae a ɛnee ɔyɛ me ahunlundwolɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ɛkpa bɛkɔsie boka kpole zo yɛɛ bɛkɔ ɛkɛ bɛkɔbɔ azu na bɛfa bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɛ mmonle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ bɛsie bɛ nlenkɛ nzi nee bɛ nlenkɛ fɛlɛmo ne mɔ anwo. Kɛmɔ bɛkpo me la ati, bɛbɔ bɛ nwo anyiemgba wɔ bɛ ɛkpa ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mgbole, tɛtɛlɛ la azo, na bɛbɔ bɛ kulovolɛma ɛkpa bɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ da toonwo bɛdabɛ bɛ kunlu dwo nwolɛ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Bɛvale anatele evuanlɛ kpalɛ bɛguale bɛ nwo bɛhɔzonlenle bɛ bozonle Molɛke, bɛzoanle menli bɛmanle bɛhɔle moa moa, na bɛmanle bɛhɔle toonwo bɛhɔle Ɛbolɔ.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Bɛ adenle ne tendenle manle bɛ nwo yɛle bɛ bɛtɛɛ, noko bɛanga kɛ, “Ɔle debie mgbane.” Bɛnyianle ɛbɛla fofolɛ mɔɔ nee bɛ anwosesebɛ ne le ko la bɛbɔle, yemɔti bɛanvɛ.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛbiza bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, mɔɔ bɛsulo ye, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛbɔ adalɛ, na bɛngakye me, bɛndwenle me nwo nretee zɛhae ɛ? Asoo metɛsile bɛ nwo abotane bie ala, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛnzulo me a?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Nea, meka bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ne nee bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ meahile bɛ, na bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɔnrɛboa bɛ.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Saa bɛsu bɛakpondɛ moalɛ a, bɛmaa bɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa la ɛlie bɛ ɛ! Anwoma bapia bɛ ahɔ, ɛnwomenle kokye babɔ bɛ ahɔ. Na menli mɔɔ nriandi bafea me ɛkɛ ne la banyia azɛlɛ ne, na yeava me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne yeayɛ ye agyadeɛ.” Nyamenle moalɛ nee ayileyɛlɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ anwuma nee Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ de ɛkɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, mɔɔ ye duma a le Nwuanzanwuanza la se, “Mede anwuma lɔ nee ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ eza me nee mɔɔ nu ɔ nwo na ɔle bɛlɛvo la tɛnla, kɛ memaa mɔɔ ɛnlu ɔ nwo la anyia anyelazo.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame a memaa ngoane a, yɛɛ me nuhua a sunsum ne vi ba a; menrɛva bɛ nwo ɛya dahuu, yɛɛ dahuu menrɛbɔ bɛ somolɛ.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛtane nee bɛ anyebolo ti yɛɛ menvale bɛ nwo ɛya a. Menvale ɛya mendeanle bɛ na mendole me nye ɛbɔ nu, noko bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: “Menwu bɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛbɔ la, noko mebayɛ bɛ ayile. Mebali bɛ ti na meakyekye bɛ rɛle, na meamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdi nyane la arɛle akyekye.
