english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Anzonudwolɛ, anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa moa nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a; yɛɛ mebayɛ bɛ ayile.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma anzo nu ɛnrɛdwo bɛ ɛlɛ,” kɛ me Nyamenle ne se la ɛne.

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Tea nu, tea nu kpalɛ, maa ɛ ne ɛlielie kɛ aweɛne tendenle ne; ka me menli ne, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne mɛladonlɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kile bɛ.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Dahuu bɛkpondɛ me na bɛkulo kɛ bɛnwu me ndenle ne mɔ, kɛ asɛɛ bɛle maanle mɔɔ bɔ tenlene ɛbɛla na bɛtɛkpole medame, bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ la. Bɛsɛlɛ me kɛ membua ndɛne tenlene nu, bɛkulo kɛ bɛtwe bɛbikye me.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: “Bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a yɛhye ɛhɔne na ɛnnwu ye ɛ? Duzu ati a yɛbɛlɛ yɛ nwo aze na ɛndwenle nwolɛ fee ɛ?’ “Na mese: Bɛnlea, bɛdabɛ bɛ gyima nee anyelielɛ ti yɛɛ bɛkye ɛhɔne a, yɛɛ bɛsisi bɛ gyimayɛvoma.

english_verse: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛkye ɛhɔne, bɛdi butule na bɛko, na bɛwulowula awie mɔ kutuku atisesebɛ nu. Ɛnɛ mekɛ ye, ɛhɔnehyelɛ mɔɔ le kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ye la ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛde bɛ ne wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Asoo ɛhɔnehyelɛ mɔɔ medi ye edwɛkɛ la, yemɔ a le ɛhye, kɛ bɛkɛzie kenle, bɛkɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, bɛkɛsisi bɛ ti aze kɛ ɛhonle, na bɛkɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ nzonle nee ɛrele nu bɛkɛla zolɛ la ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ɛhye ɛhɔnehyelɛ, yɛɛ bɛnea a ɔle kenle mɔɔ kɛzɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nye ɔ?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: “Asoo ɛhɔnehyelɛ ne mɔɔ medi ye edwɛkɛ la, tɛ yemɔ a le ɛhye, kɛ bɛkɛgyakyi amumuyɛyɛlɛ, bɛkɛye kpomgbolo menli kɔme, bɛkɛgyakyi ndunlumililɛ, na bɛkɛgyakyi menli mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la bɛkɛmaa bɛkɛva bɛ nwo dwɔɔ?

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔnehyelɛ a le kɛ bɛkɛmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi la bie, na bɛkɛva ehyianli anwo anwunvɔne ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɛleka ɛnla la bɛkɛra sua nu. Saa bɛnwu awie mɔɔ ɛngeda bie la a bɛmaa ye ɛdanlɛ ɔheda na bɛmmafa bɛ nwo bɛfea bɛ nwo amra.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛyɛ ɛhye a bɛ wienyi ne bada kɛ nwonlomɔ ewia, na bɛ nwo aza ndɛndɛ; bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ne bala ali, na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me anyunlunyia ne azinza bɛ.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbavɛlɛ, na mebalie bɛ zo; bɛbazu bɛavɛlɛ me, na mebaha kɛ: Medame ɛne. “Saa bɛgyakyi nzisililɛ, butulelilɛ yɛɛ edwɛkɛ mgbane mgbane ɛhehanlɛ,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: saa bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye la aleɛ, na bɛboa mɔɔ nyane ɛha ye la bɛmaa ɔgyakyi nyanelilɛ a, bɛ wienyi ne bada awozinli nu na awozinli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la ade ayɛ kɛ ewiazo.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Na akee medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebazinza bɛ dahuu na meamaa bɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ meamaa bɛ kunlu adwo, na bɛ mbowule nu ayɛ se. Bɛbayɛ kɛ tola mɔɔ nzule dɔɔnwo wɔ nu, kɛ nzubula mɔɔ nuhua nzule ɛnsesa ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: yemɔ bɛ nye balie medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nwo, na mebamaa bɛali bɛ eni wɔ ewiade ye ɛleka biala. Mebava bɛ ze Gyekɔbo agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la meamaa bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma asa ɛtɛyɛle ezinraa mɔɔ ɔngola ɔnlie ngoane a, yɛɛ ɔ nzo ɛtɛtile, mɔɔ yemɔti ɔnde bɛ ɛzunlɛ a;

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: na bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛgya bɛ nee bɛ Nyamenle ne anyiane a, yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ a ɛwa ɔ nye mɔɔ yemɔti ɔnde bɛ ɛzunlɛ ne a.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛle ahɔdiawu, yɛɛ bɛle amumuyɛ. Bɛbɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nloa ka amumuyɛ edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua biala ɛndwe nɔhalɛ manzonle, yɛɛ bɛnga mɛla nɔhalɛ nu; adalɛ ala a bɛbɔ a, na bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛto kyɛlɛkpalɛ mgbane mgbane zo, bɛnrenzɛ amumuyɛ na bɛwo ɛkpɔlɛ.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Bɛbobɔ ɛwɔlɛ bɔna aholonvia, bɛnwo kɛdɛba ndendane; awie gelegele bɛ aholonvia ne mɔ bie anu a, ɛwɔlɛ ɛkyenlebenle a vi nu finde a yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛli bie la wu.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ munzuleyɛlɛ ɛleka, yɛɛ bɛngyɛne nwo na bɛaha sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya bɛagua. Atisesebɛ ɛyi bɛ adwenle ne mɔ, yɛɛ debie ɛzɛkyelɛ ala a wɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ anu a.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Bɛnze anzonudwolɛ adenle, yɛɛ bɛnli pɛlepɛle. Bɛyɛ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ ahyeɛhyealera, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛva zolɛ la anzo nu ɛndwo ye ɛlɛ. Menli ne ka bɛ ɛtane ado gua

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Menli ne hanle kɛ, “Ɛhye ati yɛ nee pɛlepɛle avinli ɛhwe, yɛɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ɛmbikye yɛ. Yɛkpondɛ wienyi, na nea, awozinli a yɛnyia ye a, yɛɛ yɛkpondɛ kɛ maanle nu te wienyi a ɛnee amungu kisii ɛva yɛ.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Yɛfuovua bane nwo kɛ anyenzinliravolɛma, na yɛdi nvuovua kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɛnyelɛ la. Yɛ gyakɛ kpulokpula ewia henlema kɛ asɛɛ aledwolɛ nu la, yɛɛ yɛlua menli mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la avinli a yɛle kɛ avunli la.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛkpo kɛ bɛdi, yɛkulu yɛ kɔmenzia kɛ abubule. Yɛkpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ, na yɛnnyia bie, yɛɛ yɛkpondɛ ngoanelielɛ, na ɔ nee yɛ yɛ avinli twe.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ akee ɛzo ɛ nyunlu, yɛɛ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ di daselɛ tia yɛ, ɔluakɛ yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ la ali wienyi, yɛɛ yɛze yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛyɛ la kɛ:

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: yɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛto ye mɛla ne mɔ na yɛkakyi yɛ nzi yɛsi yɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛte atua, yɛka nzisi edwɛkɛ, yɛbɔ adalɛ adwenle na yɛfa yɛto gua.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛhwe ɛhɔ moa, yɛɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ɛmbikye yɛ, ɔluakɛ nɔhalɛ ɛwie ɛleka kpatawienyi biala mɔɔ bɛdi edwɛkɛ la, yɛɛ fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ ɛngola ɛnzie ɔ ti ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ ɛnle ɛleka biala, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛhwe ɔ nwo kɛvi ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo la tɔ donvula.” Ɛdɛnkɛma boɔboa ɔ nwo alie ye menli ne Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle ye, na yeanyɛ ye fɛ kɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Ɔnwunle kɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ, na ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo kɛ awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔgyinla yealie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la a. Na ɔvale ye tumi ne ɔlile konim, na ye pɛlepɛleyɛlɛ ne liele bɛ.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔvale tenleneyɛlɛ ɔyɛle akɛnrazo enyinlike, na ɔvale ngoanelielɛ ɔyɛle kyɛlɛ ɔzoale, ɔvale nzenralɛlilɛ ɔyɛle ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale, na ɔvale ɛya kpole ɔyɛle aguzo ɔkyekyele ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ si de la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ndeanlɛ ne mɔ bayɛ a. Ɔbava ɛya yeali ye kpɔvolɛma ne nzenralɛ. Ɔbali maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa azɛlɛ zo la noko nzenralɛ.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔvi aduduleɛ mɔɔ kɔdwu adɔleɛ, awie biala bazulo Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye tumi ne, ɔluakɛ saa kpɔvolɛ ne ba yɛ nwo zo kɛ azuyilɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne bapia ye azia.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebara Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ Kpɔnevolɛ mearakpɔne Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne mɔɔ kɛhwe bɛ nwo kɛvi bɛ mɛladonlɛ nwo la.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Na mame, me ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ bayɛ la ɛne: Me Sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nwo zo, nee me edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meva medua bɛ nloa la ɛnrɛvi bɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra anloa, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ nee melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo, bɛda, ɔluakɛ bɛ wienyi ne ɛra, Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛlɛta.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, awozinli bava azɛlɛ ye, Awozinli kabii baheda maanle maanle ne mɔ azo, Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma wienyi ne bada bɛ nwo zo, Na bɛbanwu kɛ ye anyunlunyia ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Maanle maanle bara bɛ wienyi ne anu, Arelemgbunli bara bɛ ɛdwazolɛ ne wienyi ne anu.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ nye zo na bɛnlea, Bɛ muala bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa kɛ bɛsia bɛara; Bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ vi moa moa bara, Yɛɛ bɛbadedɛ bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛ sa zo bɛara.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbanwu bɛ na bɛali fɛlɛko, Bɛ ahonle nu bayɛ wuluwulu na bɛ nye alie, Ɔluakɛ nyevile nzi ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, Maanle maanle ne mɔ anwonyia bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛ maanle nu bayɛ afunlumu dɔɔnwo, Afunlumu ndonrandonra mɔɔ vi Medean nee Yifa; Dɔɔnwo noko vi Hyiba bara. Bɛbava ezukoa nvutuke nee ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛara, Na bɛbabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ ne nolo.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Bɛbava nyɛmoa bɛvi Kidaa bɛara, Bɛ nee Nɛbayo mboane nyinli kɔsɔɔti bara; Mebalie bɛ kɔsɔɔti me azukponle ne azo, Na mebawula me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlunyia.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Nwane mɔ a le ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ tu kɛ amungu, Na bɛtu kɛ abubule bɛkɔwolo bɛ nvɛnzɛlɛ nu la?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ moa moa maanle maanle bahendɛ me, Tahyehye meli ne mɔ a balumua Ava bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ avi moa moa ara a; Bɛbava dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛara. Bɛbava bɛarɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, Bɛbava bɛarɛlɛ Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, Ɔboalekɛ yemaa bɛ nyunlu ɛra anyia.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka ahile Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ, “Nyɛvolɛ a balie bɛ bane ne mɔ amaa bɛ a, Yɛɛ bɛ arelemgbunli bazonle bɛ. Ɔluakɛ menvale ɛya mendeanle bɛ, Na kɛkala menwu bɛ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ badeda nwolɛ dahuu, Bɛnrɛtoto nu aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ, Amaa menli vi maanle zo ava bɛ anwonyia arɛlɛ bɛ; Bɛ arelemgbunli bali bɛ nyunlu bɛado ɛlɔnwɔne bɛara.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnrɛzonle bɛ la Abo zo babɔ na bɛ maanle ne adɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: “Lɛbanɔn anyunlunyia ne bara wɔ ɛkɛ ne, Sepelɛse nee paanye mbaka nee mbaka ɛsesebɛ, Yɛɛ bɛbava bɛaziezie me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a; Mebamaa ɛleka mɔɔ metɛnla la ayɛ kɛnlɛma.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ sisile bɛ la amra mrenya ne mɔ Barabɔ bɛ ti aze amaa bɛ; Menli mɔɔ kpole bɛ la kɔsɔɔti Baradu agua bɛ gyakɛ anu. Bɛbavɛlɛ sua ne ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma Suakpole,’ ‘Zayɔn, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne Suakpole.’

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ bɛkpole wɔ na bɛkpɔle wɔ, Mɔɔ ɛnee awie ɛnva wɔ adenle zo la, Mebamaa wɔayɛ suakpole kɛnlɛma nee tɛtɛlɛ, Ɛleka mɔɔ anyelielɛ wɔ dahuu.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Bɛbanlo maanle maanle meleke; Arelemgbunli a bali bɛ adane a, Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, medame a mele bɛ Dievolɛ, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ, Yizilayɛ Katakyie Ko ne a.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: “Kɛ menwɔva kɔbele la, mebava ezukoa nvutuke, Kɛ menwɔva bulalɛ la, mebava dwɛtɛ fufule, Kɛ menwɔva mbaka la, mebava kɔbele, Yɛɛ kɛ menwɔva awolɛ la, mebava mbulalɛ mearɛlɛ bɛ. Mebamaa bɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ nea bɛ nwo zo la anzonudwolɛ, Na bɛ gyima zo neavolɛma ayɛ tenlenema.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛde konle nganeɛ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo bieko, Awie ɛnrɛzɛkye bɛ maanle ne bieko; Bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ bane ne mɔ Ngoanelielɛ, Na bɛavɛlɛ bɛ nlenkɛ ne mɔ Ayɛlɛyelɛ.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: “Sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛmaa bɛ wienyi bieko wɔ alehyenlɛ nu, Yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛmaa bɛ wienyi bieko aledwolɛ nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbayɛ bɛ wienyi mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ, Na bɛ Nyamenle ne bayɛ bɛ anyunlunyia.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Bɛ sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛdɔ ɛlɛ, Yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ, Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ bɛ wienyi mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ, Na bɛ nyanelilɛ muala abo bapɛ.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala bayɛ tenlenema; Bɛbava azɛlɛ ne bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ dahuu. Medame a menzole bɛ a, bɛle me sa anloa gyima, Amaa bɛawula me anyunlunyia.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua ekyi biala bayɛ abusua ekpulike, Na abusua ekyi biala bayɛ maanle mumua. Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a; Ye mekɛ dwu a mebamaa yeayɛ zɔ ndɛndɛ.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne Sunsum ne wɔ me nwo zo, Ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye me Kɛ menva amaneɛ fɛlɛko membambɔ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la; Yezoa me kɛ membankyekye menli mɔɔ arɛle ɛbɔ la arɛle, Membɔ nolo kɛ bɛgyakyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la, Na menye menli mɔɔ gua efiade la.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: Yezoa me kɛ membɔ nolo kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwunvɔnezelɛ mekɛ ne, Nee mekɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne fa ali nzenralɛ la ɛdwu; Na menkyekye menli mɔɔ di nyane la arɛle.

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: Yezoa me kɛ membankyekye Zayɔnoma arɛle Kɛ bɛgyakyi nyanelilɛ na bɛli fɛlɛko. Bɛgyakyi bɛ ti zo nzonle ɛbɔlɛ, Na bɛbɔ ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba abɔtile. Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne na bɛgyakyi nyanelilɛ; Amaa bɛavɛlɛ bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ mbaka ɛsesebɛ, Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua, amaa bɛawula ye anyunlunyia.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Bɛbakyekye azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛzɛkye bɛ la, Bɛbasisi azua mɔɔ bɛgologolo bɛ la fofolɛ; Azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛ mɔmoane mɔmoane la, Bɛbakyekye bɛ muala fofolɛ.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Nyɛvolɛ bagyinla ayɛne bɛ nyɛmoa, Nyɛvolɛ bazo bɛ ɛya ade bɛ vanye egyinli nu ma,

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sɛlɛvolɛma, Menli bavɛlɛ bɛ Nyamenle sonvolɛma. Maanle maanle bava bɛ anwonyia arɛlɛ bɛ, Na bɛali fɛlɛko kɛ anwonyia ne mɔ le bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Bɛ anyiemgba nee bɛ nyunlu aze ɛgualɛ ɛwie; Bɛbanyia mɔɔ bɛminli la mɔnwo na bɛali fɛlɛko; Yemɔti bɛbanyia bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔnwo bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ; Na bɛali fɛlɛko mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekulo pɛlepɛlelilɛ, Mekyi awule nee nwolɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ; Mebamaa me menli ne nɔhalɛ ahatualɛ, Me nee bɛ bakyekye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze la.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Bɛ bo zo amra bali bɛ ti wɔ maanle maanle avinli, Bɛ mra balie duma wɔ maanle maanle avinli. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛnwu bɛ la balie bɛ ado nu, Kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ a.”

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ati me nye balie kpole, Me ɛkɛla bali fɛlɛko wɔ me Nyamenle ne ati, Ɔluakɛ yeva ngoanelielɛ ɛdanlɛ yeheda me, Yeva pɛlepɛleyɛlɛ tɛladeɛ yewula me, Yeziezie me kɛ atɔfolɛ nrenya fa ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba siezie ɔ nwo, Anzɛɛ kɛ atɔfolɛ raalɛ fa anwoneɛ siezie ɔ nwo la.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛ azɛlɛ ye azo si fifi ndile, Na tola nu ninyɛne si fifi la, Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Awulae Nyamenle Bamaa tenleneyɛlɛ nee ayɛlɛyelɛ afifi Maanle maanle ne mɔ amuala anu a.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm ati menrɛyɛ koonwu, Gyɛlusalɛm ati menrɛlie me ɛnwomenle, Kɔdwu kɛ ye benlelilɛ kɛda wienyi, Na ye ngoanelielɛ kɛzɔ kɛ tɛkɛ.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu wɔ benlelilɛ ne, Arelemgbunli banwu wɔ anyunlunyia ne; Bɛbava duma fofolɛ bɛavɛlɛ wɔ, Duma fofolɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbado wɔ la.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛbayɛ belemgbunli kyɛlɛ kɛnlɛma wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu, Belemgbunli kyɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle asa anu.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ wɔ “Bɛkpo wɔ ” bieko, Yɛɛ bɛnrɛha kɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne “Ɛdɔ mgbane” bieko; Na bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ “Me anyelielɛ wɔ wɔ nuhua,” Na bɛavɛlɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne “Awuvolɛ.” Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die ɛ nwo, Yɛɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ awuvolɛ.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Kɛ kakula nrenya si gya belamunli raalɛ la, Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bagya wɔ a. Na kɛ atɔfolɛ nrenya anye si die ye atɔfolɛ raalɛ nwo la, Zɔhane ala yɛɛ wɔ Nyamenle ne anye balie ɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, meva sinzavolɛma Mezie wɔ bane ne mɔ azo; Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ muala, Bɛnrɛmua bɛ nloa, bɛnrɛyɛ koonwu. Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛkakye Ɛdɛnkɛma la, Bɛmmadie bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne anwo,

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɔdie ye ɛnwomenle Kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛkyekye Gyɛlusalɛm fofolɛ Na ɔkɛyɛ suakpole mɔɔ ewiade amuala kanvo ye la.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye tumi kpole ne, Nee ye anwosesebɛ ne ɛha ndane kɛ, “Menrɛva bɛ aleɛ ma Menrɛmaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛnrɛli bieko. Nyɛvolɛ ɛnrɛnlo bɛ nwanye Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛvɛ dedee bɛyɛ la ɛlɛ.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua na bɛbu la Yɛɛ bɛbali na bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ a, Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbua vanye ma bɛyɛ nwanye la Yɛɛ bɛbanlo ye wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ a.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Bɛwolo, bɛwolo nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu bɛvinde, Bɛziezie adenle ne bɛmaa menli ne; Bɛdu ademgbole, bɛyeye zolɛ awolɛ ne mɔ, Bɛva sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛmaa maanle maanle ɛnwu ye.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ nolo ɛmaa ewiade amuala ɛde kɛ, “Bɛha bɛhile Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ, Bɛnlea, bɛ ngoanelielɛ ɛlɛba, Bɛnlea, ɔlɛ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔ sa nu, Ɔ nee ye menli mɔɔ yelie bɛ la ɛlɛba.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ “Menli Nwuanzanwuanza,” “Menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛkpɔne Bɛ;” Na bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ, “ Nyamenle ɛkpondɛ bɛ ɛnwu bɛ;” “Suakpole Mɔɔ Nyamenle Amkpo Ye Ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Nwane a wula tɛladeɛ anye doaanye kɛ mogya, mɔɔ vi Bɔzela mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la ɛlɛba, mɔɔ ye tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula la kile kɛ yeli konim na ɔtia ye mrenyazo kɛ ɔlɛ tumi la? “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ melɛ tumi medie ngoane la ɔ. Melɛbɔ me konimlilɛ ne nolo.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Na duzu ati a wɔ tɛladeɛ ne anye le kɔkɔlɛ doaanye, kɛ sonla mɔɔ twihwi vanye ma nu nzule wɔ nwanyeyɛlɛ ɛleka la ɛ?

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mekpɔne me menli ne a, yɛɛ ɛnee nzenralɛlilɛ wɔ me ahonle nu kpalɛ.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Meneanle, na awie biala amba kɛ ɔbaboa me, na ɔyɛle me azibɛnwo kpole. Yemɔti medame me ngome me anwosesebɛ yɛɛ manle menlile konim a, yɛɛ me ɛya ne boale me.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Menvale ɛya kpole na memanle maanle maanle ne mɔ nlonle me ndeanlɛ ɛya kɔpo ne anu toonwo bɛbole, na mentietiale bɛ nwo zo, mendwinle bɛ ngoane mogya menguale azɛlɛ ne azo.” Ɛdɛnkɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔde ɔmaa Yizilayɛma la

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Mebaha Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛkɛ; mebaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ wɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ yemaa yɛ la amuala anwo, nee boɛ kpole mɔɔ yeyɛ yemaa Yizilayɛma la; ɔyɛle ɔmanle bɛ, kɛmɔ ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne nee kɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne kpole si de la.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, bɛle me menli; bɛle me mra mɔɔ ɛnrɛbɛlɛbɛla me a.” Na ɔyɛle bɛ dievolɛ.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Bɛ nyanelilɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛle ye nyanelilɛ, na ɔmanle ye soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee ye lua la liele bɛ ngoane. Ɔluale ye ɛhulolɛ nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ zo ɔkpɔnenle bɛ. Ɔvi mɔmoane, ɔdwule bɛ na ɔviale bɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Noko bɛdele ɔ nwo atua na bɛmanle ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne lile nyane. Yemɔti ɔhakyile ɔ nwo ɔyɛle bɛ kpɔvolɛ na ɔdaye mumua ne ɔhonle ɔtiale bɛ.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Na ɔhakyele mɔmoane, ɔhakyele ye sonvolɛ Mosisi. Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔdaye a ɔle Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɔyele ye menli ne ɔvile Ndɔ Nyevile ne anu a. Ɔdaye a ɔmanle ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee bɛ luale a.

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye a ɔmanle ye konimlilɛ tumi ne nee Mosisi luale na ɔkpakyele nyevile ne anu, ɔliele duma mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la ɔmanle ɔ nwo,

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: na ɔlile menli ne ati ɔvale bɛ ɔpɛle buma ne a.” Ɔmanle bɛyɛle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo mgbɔnwɔ, bɛandu koti.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne manle bɛyɛle kɛ nlankɛ mɔɔ lua bɔnza nu la, na ɔmanle bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle. Yemɔti ɛdawɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛlile wɔ menli ne ati na ɛliele duma kpole ɛmanle ɛ nwo a. Anwunvɔnezelɛ nee moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛwɔ anwuma lɔ, wɔ anyunlunyia ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne a to ɛ nye nea yɛ. Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpole ne nee wɔ tumi ne wɔ nienwu? Wɔye wɔ ahunluyelɛyelalɛ ne nee wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne wɔvi me nwo.

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ a ɛle yɛ ze a. Yɛ nlenya mɔ Ebileham nee Gyekɔbo ɛnze yɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ ɛle yɛ ze a. Ɔvi tete wɔ duma a le yɛ Kpɔnevolɛ.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu ati a ɛmaa yɛfo wɔ ndenle ne mɔ, yɛsolo na akee yɛnzulo wɔ a? Wɔ sonvolɛma ne mɔ ati, mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ le wɔ agyadeɛ la ati, sia bɛla.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Wɔ menli ne mɔɔ anwo te la lɛle wɔ ɛlɛka nwuanzanwuanza ne mekɛ ekyi bie; yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛragologolo ye ɛgua.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ kɛ menli bie mɔɔ ɛtɛsiele yɛ ɛlɛ la. Yɛnzɔho menli mɔɔ bɛva wɔ duma bɛvɛlɛ bɛ ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: O kpakye anwomanyunlu na dwu aze maa awoka ne mɔ ɛnwu wɔ, na bɛkpusu.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ɛ nyunlu a bɛle kɛ senle la ɛyɛne nu ɛlɛsɔ na ɔmaa nzule mɔɔ gyi zo la wu la. Ɛhye da wɔ duma ne ali kile wɔ kpɔvolɛma, yɛɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ nwu wɔ a bɛ nwo wozo bɛ.

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛyɛle ninyɛne ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ yɛ nye ɛnla la, ɛvi anwuma ɛdwule aze, awoka ne mɔ nwunle wɔ na bɛkpusule.

english_verse: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.
translation_verse: Ɔvi mɔmoane, awie ɛtɛtele anzɛɛ ɛtɛtele ye ɔ nzo nu, yɛɛ ɛnyelɛ biala ɛtɛnwunle Nyamenle biala kɛ wɔmɔ ala mɔɔ ɛdie menli mɔɔ sonle wɔ la ati la.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Ɛyia sonla mɔɔ fa anyelielɛ di pɛlepɛle la nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakye wɔ nee wɔ ndenle ne mɔ la. Nea, yɛyɛle ɛtane, yɛɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛhyɛ kpalɛ, yɛmaa wɔva ɛya; asoo ɛbalie yɛ ngoane?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛyɛ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a, yɛɛ yɛ ɛbɛla kpalɛ biala le kɛ tɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɛhu la. Yɛ muala yɛwu kɛ ɛyɛne, yɛɛ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛ kɛ anwoma la, bɛpia yɛ bɛkɔ.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Awie ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ sonle wɔ a, awie ɛngeha ɔ nwo bɔbɔ kɛ ɔtudu yeahisa wɔ, ɔluakɛ wɔye ɛ nye wɔvea yɛ na wɔye yɛ wɔwula yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ asa anu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Noko akee, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ a ɛle yɛ ze a; yɛmɛ, yɛle ndɛtɛlɛ, yɛɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle nwovolɛ ne a; yɛ muala yɛle ɛ sa anloa gyima.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmafa yɛ nwo ɛya kpole. Mmakakye yɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ dahuu. Nea na dwenle nwolɛ, yɛ muala yɛle wɔ menli.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɔ azuamgbole nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ azo ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ, awie fee ɛnle zolɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Bɛdo senle yɛ sua kɛnlɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ nuhua a yɛ nlenya mɔ yele wɔ ayɛlɛ la anu bɛyela ye, yɛɛ yɛ azua ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛbubu ɛyɛ ewula.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, asoo ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛndwe wɔ ahonle, ɛyɛ koonwu wɔamaa yɛanwu amaneɛ kpole ɛhye?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Memboɔboale me nwo kɛ memaa menli mɔɔ ambiza me bo zo la akpondɛ me. Menyɛle kɛ memaa menli mɔɔ amkpondɛ me la anwu me. Menzele maanle ne mɔɔ anzonle me la kɛ, ‘Mewɔ ɛke, mewɔ ɛke!’

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Mendɛlɛle me sa nu alehyenlɛ muala kɛ medie menli ne mɔɔ ɛde atua, na bɛdoa bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ ngyehyɛlɛ bɛdua adenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la anu la.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: Bɛle menli mɔɔ dahuu ka me ɛya kpole, bɛbɔ azu wɔ bɛ tola ne mɔ anu na bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ belekese zo.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛnla sɛka zo, yɛɛ aleɛ dwo a bɛfea bɛ nwo bɛdi kpolike nane, yɛɛ bɛ subue nu le bɛkyi ninyɛne ngome.

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: Bɛka bɛkile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛhwe bɛ nwo, bɛmmabikye yɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛdu yɛ bɛmaa; ɔnle kɛ bɛ nwo ka yɛ.’ Ɛhye mɔ le kɛ esike wɔ me bonyi nu; bɛle kɛ senle mɔɔ sɔ alehyenlɛ biala la.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo me nyunlu ɛke: Menrɛyɛ koonwu, mebadua bɛ nwolɛ kakɛ; ɛhɛe, mebamaa bɛ munzule abɔ bɛ ti.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ne babu azia bɛ kɛ bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ wɔ awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo, na bɛguale me nwo evinli wɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo la. Mebadua bɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ dɛba ne mɔ anwo kakɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ bɛnyia nwanye wɔ vanye ma nu, na bɛka kɛ, ‘Bɛmmasɛkye ye na debie kpalɛ wɔ nu’ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ me sonvolɛma ati menrɛzɛkye bɛ muala a.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Mebava Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne meara na meamaa Dwudama bie mɔ aradɛnla me awoka ne mɔ azo. Menli ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ, menli ne mɔɔ sonle me la badɛnla awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Hyɛlɔn fienemgbole ne bayɛ adidileka amaa me menli ne mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ me bo zo la mboane nee nlankɛ, yɛɛ Ekɔ Bɔnza bayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ nlankɛ balie bɛ ɛnwomenle a.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: “Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛ rɛle fi me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne, na bɛsie ɛkponle bɛsonle Saleɛ nee Ɛbolɔ Nrɛlaleɛ awozonle Gaade nee Mɛnae la,

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: mebaye bɛ meamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa, bɛbahu bɛ muala, ɔboalekɛ menvɛlɛle bɛ la bɛambua me, mendendɛle mengilele bɛ, na bɛandie. Bɛyɛle mɔɔ le ɛtane wɔ me nye zo la na bɛkpale nu bɛyɛle mɔɔ me nye ɛnlie nwolɛ la.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Bɛnlea, me sonvolɛma ne bali debie, na bɛmɛ, ɛhɔne bahu bɛ; bɛnlea, me sonvolɛma ne banlo nzule, na bɛmɛ, nzuhɔne bahu bɛ; bɛnlea, me sonvolɛma ne anye balie, na bɛmɛ, bɛ nyunlu bagua aze;

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: bɛnlea, me sonvolɛma ne bava fɛlɛkolilɛ ado edwɛne bɛ ahonle nu, na bɛmɛ, bɛbazu bɛali nyane bɛ ahonle nu na bɛaye awolɛ wɔ bɛ nwo mɔɔ yelɛyela bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Me menli ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la bava bɛ duma awa amonle, yɛɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne bahu bɛ; na me sonvolɛma ne ɛdeɛ, mebava duma fofolɛ meavɛlɛ bɛ.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la bava medame Nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne ayila ɔ nwo, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu mɔɔ ka ndane la bava medame, Nɔhalɛ Nyamenle me duma a aha ndane ne a, ɔboalekɛ bɛ alumua ngyegyelɛ ne ɛvi me ti anu, yɛɛ bɛ nzonlɛ ɛye me nye zo.” Ewiade fofolɛ ne ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebɔ anwuma fofolɛ nee azɛlɛ fofolɛ; ninyɛne dɛba ne mɔ abo zo baminli mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛhakye bɛ bieko a.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Me nye balie Gyɛlusalɛm anwo, na meali fɛlɛko wɔ me menli ne ati. Bɛnrɛde ɛzunlɛ bieko wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛde nyanenwunlɛ ɛnelɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Adɔma mɔɔ bɛwo ye a ɔngyɛ ɛnee yewu la, bie ɛnrɛzi suakpole ne azo, yɛɛ kpanyinli mɔɔ ɛtɛwiele ye mekɛ muala di la ɛnrɛwu. Ɔluakɛ kakula bali ɛvolɛ ɛya na yeawu, yɛɛ ɛtanenli bali ɛvolɛ ɛya, na munzule ngome.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Bɛbasisi azua bɛadɛnla nu, bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli na bɛali nuhua ma ne bie.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛsisi azua na awie mɔ gyɛne adɛnlɛdɛnla nu; bɛnrɛlua na awie mɔ gyɛne ali. Kɛ baka si kyɛ na yeawu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ me menli ne bahyɛ a, na me menli ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la badidi bɛ sa anloa gyima nwo bɛ nye alie ahyɛ.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛvɛ ɛvɛlɛ mgbane, anzɛɛ bɛnrɛwo mralɛ bɛnrɛmaa munzule ɛnrɛzi bɛ nwo zo, ɔluakɛ bɛbayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne mɔɔ yeyila bɛ la amra. Bɛ bo zo amra noko banyia nyilalɛ ne bie.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ bɔbɔ na mealie bɛ zo; mebade bɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nloa wɔ zo bɛlɛsɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Bedi nee boane ralɛ babɔ nu adidi, awenade bali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ la, yɛɛ ɛwɔlɛ bali ndɛtɛlɛ. Bɛnrɛboda awie yɛɛ bɛnrɛzɛkye debie wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Anwuma le me belemgbunli ebia, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye le me gyakɛ abo ebia. Duzu sua a bɛkɛzi bɛkɛmaa me a, yɛɛ nienwu a medie me ɛnwomenle a?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Medame a meva me sa mebɔ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, yemɔti debie biala le me ɛdeɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Noko sonla mɔɔ me nye balie ɔ nwo la a le sonla ne mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo, ɔnu ɔ nwo, ɔsulo me na ɔdi me edwɛkɛ zo la.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ ku ɛnlankɛ la le kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ ku sonla la; mɔɔ fa boane bɔ azu la le kɛ mɔɔ bu twea kɔme ku ye la; mɔɔ fa abɛlɛ ma yɛ azubɔdeɛ la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ fa kpolike mogya yɛ azubɔdeɛ la; mɔɔ fa ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ yɛ ngakyelɛ azubɔdeɛ la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ sɔ amonle la. Ɛhye mɔ ɛva bɛ ndenle ɛdeɛ zo, yɛɛ bɛ nye die bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛanwu amaneɛ, yɛɛ mebamaa amaneɛnwunlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la ara bɛ nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ menvɛlɛle la, awie anlie zolɛ, mendendɛle la, bɛandie; bɛyɛle mɔɔ le ɛtane wɔ me nye zo la, na bɛvale mɔɔ me nye ɛnlie nwolɛ la.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ zo la, bɛdie mɔɔ ɔlɛka la. Ɔse, “Bɛ mediema ne mɔ mɔɔ kyi bɛ, na medame ti bɛmbu bɛ bie la ɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile ye anyunlunyia ne na ɔlie bɛ, amaa yɛanwu bɛ anyelielɛ ne.’ Na bɛmɛ bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛ nyunlu bagua aze a.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛdie alɛra kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo lɔ la! Ɛnelɛ ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu! Ɛdɛnkɛma ane ɔ, na ɔlɛtea ye kpɔvolɛma ne!

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Me suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne le kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ako anga ye na yeawo anzɛɛ yeande awolɛ nyane wɔ ye ralɛ nrenya ɛwolɛ nu la.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛde edwɛkɛ zɛhae bie ɛlɛ a? Nwane a ɛnwu ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ bie ɛlɛ a? Asoo bɛkyekye maanle kenle kokye? Asoo bɛfa mekɛ ekyi bie bɛziezie maanle. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Zayɔn ako hanle ye ala la yɛɛ ɔwole ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ a.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebiza kɛ: Memaa ɔva ɛkolɛ na memmamaa ɔwo ɔ? Asoo medame, mɔɔ memaa bɛwo la, mendua ye awodeɛ ne adenle ɔ?”

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala bɛ nye ɛlie. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo Gyɛlusalɛm la, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu ye la, bɛli fɛlɛko wɔ ɔ ti,

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: amaa bɛanlo ɔ nyɛfo ne bie bɛ ko ayi, amaa bɛava anyelielɛ bɛahwihwi ye anyunlunyia nyɛfonzule ne mɔɔ ɛbu la bie bɛanlo.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛakpazi na maanle maanle ne mɔ anwonyia abu bɛ nwo zo kɛ azule mɔɔ bu aze la. Mebanloa bɛ nyɛfonlɛ, mebavia bɛ me nzi, na meadedɛ bɛ me gyakɛ azo meaha bɛ nwɔhoa.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Kɛ ninli si kyekye ɔ ra arɛle la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebakyekye bɛ rɛle a. Mebakyekye bɛ rɛle wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛbanwu ye, na bɛali fɛlɛko. Bɛ mbowule nu bamia na bɛade kpɔkɛ; na menli kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me sa wɔ me menli ne ɛkpazilɛ nu, na me ɛya ne wɔ me kpɔvolɛma anwo zo.”

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma balua senle nu a ara a, yɛɛ ye konle ehwili ne mɔ bara kɛ ahumu, bɛbava ɛya kpole bɛava senle bɛadea menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava senle a abua ndɛne a, na yeava ye dadeɛ ne yeado menli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo. Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bahu bɛ la zonle kpalɛ.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnua bɛ nwo, bɛte bɛ nwo bɛdi menli avinli bɛkɔ amonle nu bɛkɔdi kpolike nane, ahila nee bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ la amuala bagulu nu awu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze bɛ gyima nee bɛ adwenle ne mɔ. Na melɛba mearaboɔboa maanle maanle nee aneɛ aneɛ ne mɔ anloa, na bɛbara bɛaranwu me anyunlunyia ne,

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: na mebayɛ bɛ nzonlɛ. “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvi nuhua la, mebava bɛ meahɔ maanle maanle nu moa moa: Sepeen, Lebea anzɛɛ Pɛɛle, yɛɛ Ledea, mɔɔ bɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ze ɛda to kpalɛ kpalɛ la, akee Tubale yɛɛ Gyeevan nee maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa, mɔɔ ɛtɛtele me nganeɛ ɛlɛ anzɛɛ ɛtɛnwunle me anyunlunyia ne ɛlɛ la. Na bɛbaha me anyunlunyia nwo edwɛkɛ bɛahile maanle maanle ne mɔ.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ bava bɛ mediema ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la wɔ mgbɔnwɔ zo, konle ehwili nee bonrane nu, wɔ mgbɔnwɔndua nee afunlumu zo bɛarɛlɛ me wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, Gyɛlusalɛm, kɛ azubɔdeɛ; medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Bɛbava bɛ bɛara, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛma fa bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ wɔ debie anu bɔkɔbɔkɔ nu ba Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebaye bie mɔ meayɛ bɛ Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, kɛmɔ anwuma fofolɛ ne nee azɛlɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ mebabɔ la badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra nee bɛ duma baha ɛkɛ dahuu a.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia biala nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala, menli kɔsɔɔti barazonle me, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Na bɛbavinde bɛaranlea menli mɔɔ ɛde me nwo atua la avunli. Bɛ nwo azone ne mɔ ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ, senle mɔɔ ɛlɛyela bɛ la ɛnrɛnlu ɛlɛ, na bɛbayɛ kyibadeɛ bɛamaa menli kɔsɔɔti.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le sɛlɛvolɛ Helekaya mɔɔ boka sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Anato mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu la anwo la anloa edwɛkɛ ɛne:

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Emɔn ara Dwosaya mekɛ zo. Ɛnee Dwosaya ɛli ebia ne ɛvolɛ bulu nee nsa.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya bieko wɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem mɔɔ le Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara ne mekɛ zo. Ɔdendɛle ɔhilele ye toonwo Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya mɔɔ le Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara ne lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko wɔ ebia zo, na bɛhyele Gyɛlusalɛmma nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ siane nnu ne anu la. Gyɛlɛmaya ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse,

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Mekabɔ wɔ meado ɛ nli akunlu la ɛnee meze wɔ, yɛɛ bɛkawo wɔ la ɛnee mekpa nu meye wɔ, na meyɛ wɔ maanle maanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Membuale kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle, mele kakula, me nloa ɛtɛtele.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Mmaka kɛ ɛle kakula, ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ mebazoa wɔ bɛ avinli la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɔ, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔze wɔ la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛka.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Mmasulo bɛ, ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ lua; mebalie wɔ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendenle ɔ sa, ɔvale ɔhanle me nloa na ɔzele me kɛ, “Nea, meva me edwɛkɛ ne medua ɛ nloa.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛnɛ kenle ye, memaa wɔ tumi wɔ maanle maanle nee arelemgbunli nwo zo kɛ ɛdudu na ɛbubu bɛ ɛgua, ɛzɛkye bɛ na ɛvuandi bɛ ɛgua, kɛ ɛkyekye na ɛlua.” Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nwiɔ ne

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, duzu a ɛnwu ye a?” Membuale kɛ, “Menwu alemɔn baka.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ ɔ, wɔnwu ye kɔsɔɔ, ɔluakɛ melɛnea meamaa me edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ zɔhane.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko kɛ, “Duzu a ɛnwu ye a?” Membuale kɛ, “Menwu buakɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛwu kɛ ɔgyi senle zo wɔ sɔlɔ nehane, na ɔkyea ɔba me nwo ɛke.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma akee zele me kɛ, “Munzule vi sɔlɔ nehane bara menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la amuala anwo zo,

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ melɛfɛlɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ la amuala. Bɛ arelemgbunli bava bɛ arelemgbunli mbia araziezie Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa. Bɛbava bɛ mbia ne mɔ bɛabɛnra bɛayia Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti nee Dwuda azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛha la amuala.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Mebadea me menli ne wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛkpo me na bɛhɔkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, na bɛzonle bɛdabɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima la anwo.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, Gyɛlɛmaya, bɛza; dwazo na kɔha edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ melɛfa meazoa wɔ la kile bɛ. Mmasulo bɛ anrɛɛ menwɔmaa ɛkɛyɛ anwunvɔne wɔ bɛ nyunlu na ɛkɛzulo bɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Na nea, ɔvi ɛnɛ, meyɛ wɔ suakpole mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane, meyɛ wɔ bulalɛ mpila na meyɛ wɔ kɔbele bane mɔɔ mefa meatia maanle ye kɔsɔɔti, meatia Dwuda arelemgbunli, ye mgbanyima, ye sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Bɛbaho bɛatia wɔ, na bɛnrɛhola wɔ, ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ lua kɛ medie ɛ ti. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Kɔha kile Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Mekakye wɔ ngakula nu nɔhalɛlilɛ ne, ɛhulole me kɛ atɔfolɛ raalɛ la, ɛdoale me wɔ fienemgbole ne anu, azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛduale debie biala zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Yizilayɛ anwo te wɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nyunlu, Ɔle me bɛyɔba ma mɔɔ lumua a. Awie biala mɔɔ lile bie la lile fɔlɛ; munzule dole ye, Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’ ” Yizilayɛma bɛ nlenya mɔ ɛtane ne

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne: “Duzu ɛtane a bɛ ze mɔ nwunle ye me nwo, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛnriandile me, bɛhɔzonlenle mmonle mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nwo zo, na bɛdabɛ bɛyɛle mgbane a?

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Bɛambiza kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele yɛ vile Yigyibiti, Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ vale yɛ pɛle fienemgbole ne, azɛlɛ mɔɔ le ɛsɛlɛ nee ahuma ahuma, mɔɔ ezule ɛndɔ zo na awozinli kabii ɛva ye, mɔɔ awie ɛnva zo, yɛɛ awie ɛnde zo la wɔ nienwu?’

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Menvale bɛ membale azɛlɛ mɔɔ aleɛ ɛbu zo la azo kɛ bɛrali zolɛ aleɛ nee ninyɛne kpalɛ kɔsɔɔti. Na bɛrale la, bɛvale evinli bɛhanle me azɛlɛ ne, na bɛmanle me agyadeɛ ne yɛle kyibadeɛ.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ambiza kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ nienwu?’ Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnea mɛla ne azo la ɛnze me. Menli mɔɔ bu maanle ne la tietiale me mɛla ne mɔ azo; Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle bozonle Beeyale nrɛlaleɛ na bɛzonlenle ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ la. Ɛdɛnkɛma ka edwɛkɛ atia ye menli ne

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese me nee bɛ ɛnyia ye, yɛɛ me nee bɛ bo zo amra banyia ye.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ Saepelɛse ɛnweazo bɛhɔnlea, anzɛɛ bɛzoa awie Kidaa bɛmaa ɔhɔnlea ɛkɛ kpalɛ saa debie zɛhae bie ɛzi ɛkɛ ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Maanle biala ɛtɛkakyile ye nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnle nyamenle bɔbɔ la, noko me menli ne ɛva bɛ anyunlunyia ɛlie debie mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zo la.”

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me menli ne ɛyɛ ɛtane nwiɔ: bɛkpo me, bɛ ngoane nzubula ne, na bɛdabɛ bɛhɔbɔ bɛ bula ɛdeɛ, bula mɔɔ ɛbolo, mɔɔ ngoane nzule ɛngola ɛngyinla nu. Yizilayɛma nɔhalɛ mɔɔ anli la guabelɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛ ɛnle kanranli; bɛwole ye dehelɛ. Na duzu ati a bɛkyi ye a?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Awenade ne mɔ ɛkpo ye, bɛkpo ye kpole kpalɛ. Bɛmaa ye azɛlɛ ne ɛdɔ mgbane, ye azuamgbole ne mɔ ɛyɛ azuadu, menli ɛnde zo.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Yeanga ye zɔ, Mɛmefesema nee Tapanehizima ɛdu ye belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ, ɛdawɔ a wɔmaa ɛhye ɛdo wɔ a! Ɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkile wɔ adenle ne la.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wɔ amumuyɛ ne badua wɔ kakɛ, ɛkpolɛ mɔɔ wɔkpo me la babua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ. Nwu ye kɛ ɔle nyane nee munzule ɔmaa wɔ kɛ ɛkɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne; ɛnzulo me fee, Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle a se a. Yizilayɛma kpo kɛ bɛnrɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, bɛdele nyɛma, bɛdɛlale anhwe, na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Yɛnrɛzonle wɔ!’ Ɛhɛe, boka tendenle biala azo nee baka buzuu biala abo, bɛbutule kɛ tuutuu.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Noko memkpale nu menyele bɛ kɛ vanye ma mɔɔ anwo le kɔlɔnwo na menluale bɛ. Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ akee bɛwie ye zɛhae, na bɛyɛ vanye nyinli ɛ?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Kanza bɛbia saminla evuanlɛ, na bɛbia ye dɔɔnwo bɔbɔ a, bɛ nwo ɛnrɛvie me nye zo. Awulae Nyamenle a se a.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛhola bɛkɛha kɛ, ‘Evinli ɛtɛkanle yɛ, yɛtɛsonlenle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ’ ɛ? Bɛnlea bɛ ndenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu wɔ bɔnza ne anu, na bɛnwu mɔɔ bɛyɛ la. Bɛle kɛ afunlumu kokonyinli mɔɔ ɛde nyɛma, na ɔlɛdi ahyimango la,

english_verse: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
translation_verse: bɛle kɛ asoaso kokonyinli mɔɔ fienemgbole nee ɔ nwo ɛli, na yezɔ la ati ɔlɛfunvuafunvua anwoma nu. Nwane a kɛhola kɛgogo ye a? Mɔɔ kpondɛ ye la mmagyegye ɔ nwo. Saa ye ɛvolalɛ mekɛ dwu a bɛ sa baha ye.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Menzele bɛ kɛ: Bɛmmagua bɛ gyakɛ aze bɛtia, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ kɔmenzia we resee. Na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Anyelazo biala ɛnle nu, ɔluakɛ yɛhulo nyɛvolɛ, yɛɛ nyɛvolɛ ala a yɛbadoa bɛ a.’ ” Yizilayɛ fɛta ndeanlɛ

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ bɛkye awule a bɛbɔ ye anyiemgba la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbabɔ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anyiemgba a: bɛdabɛ, bɛ arelemgbunli, bɛ mgbanyima, bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma,

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ka kile baka kɛ, ‘Ɛle me ze,’ na bɛka bɛkile bolɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛdawɔ a ɛwole me a.’ Ɔluakɛ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi me, bɛnva bɛ nyunlu bɛmba. Na ngyegyelɛ to bɛ a ɛnee bɛse, ‘Dwazo na die yɛ.’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: “Na bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛle la wɔ nienwu? Saa bɛdabɛ bɛkɛhola bɛ die a, ɛnee saa ngyegyelɛ to bɛ a bɛmaa bɛdwazo. O Dwuda, kɛ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ dodo de la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ dodo de a.

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛtendɛ bɛtia me a? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Bɛ muala bɛde me nwo atua.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Bɛ mra ne mɔ ɛmaa mevɛ mgbane; medea bɛ, noko bɛande folɛ. Bɛdabɛ a bɛhu bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ awenade mɔɔ asa ɛha nane la.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ awolɛndoazo ɛhye, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne. Meyɛ fienemgbole memaa Yizilayɛ, anzɛɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ awozinli kabii ɛheda zo la ɔ? Duzu ati a me menli ne se, ‘Yɛlɛ fanwodi, yɛnrɛzia yɛnrɛra ɛ nwo ɛkɛ bieko’ a?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛlɛra arɛle fi ye anwoneɛ? Asoo atɔfolɛ raalɛ arɛle fi ye atɔfolɛ ndanlɛ? Noko me menli ne arɛle ɛvi me mekɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛngola ye tia a.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu adenle bɛkpondɛ bɛ kulovolɛma abo zo. Mraalɛ mɔɔ le amumuyɛ la bɔbɔ bɛhilehile bɛ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Bɛ ndanlɛ nu le ehyianvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya ngome, tɛ menli mɔɔ bubu nlenkɛ la mogya ɔ. “Bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala,

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: noko bɛse, ‘Menli fɔlɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlɛ me nwo ɛya bieko.’ Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛnlie bɛndo nu kɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛluolua ye ɔ nye ɔ nye, na bɛnzie bɛ ti ɛleka ko ɛ? Yigyibitima bagua bɛ nyunlu aze, kɛmɔ Aseleama guale bɛ nyunlu aze la.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Bɛbava bɛ sa bɛagua bɛ ti zo, bɛava ɛzunlɛ bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛara, ɔluakɛ mekpo menli ne mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula bɛ nu la. Bɛnrɛnyia nvasoɛ biala bɛnrɛvi bɛ ɛkɛ ne.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Saa ɛbɔ raalɛ ewole na ɔkɔ na nrenya fofolɛ gya ye a ɔ hu ne ɛngola ɛngya ye bieko. Saa ɔsia ɔgya ye bieko a ɛnee yeva evinli yeha azɛlɛ ne. Yizilayɛma, asoo mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ kulovolɛma ɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla la, bɛbahola bɛazia bɛara me nwo ɛkɛ ne bieko?

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ! Nienwu yɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛtɛdale a? Bɛdɛnlɛdɛnlanle adehane bɛhendɛle bɛ kulovolɛma, kɛ Arelabenli mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia wɔ fienemgbole nu la. Bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla atisesebɛ nu wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo bɛva evinli bɛha ye.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ezule ne ɛgyakyi ɛdɔlɛ, yɛɛ nyenyensuo ne ɛgyakyi ɛnyenyenlɛ. Bɛ ɛlualɛ nu kile kɛ bɛle tuutuuma, yɛɛ bɛnze nwolɛ nyiane.

english_verse: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;
translation_verse: “Tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛvɛlɛ me kɛkala kɛ, ‘Egya, sumunli yɛ ngakula nu ɛ gɔnwo a le yɛ.

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Asoo ɛbava ɛya dahuu, asoo wɔ ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo ɛlɛ?’ la. Yizilayɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛha la ɛne, noko bɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la.” Ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama nu bɛ nwo

english_verse: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Wɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya mekɛ zo, Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Wɔnwu debie mɔɔ Yizilayɛ, raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la ɛyɛ la? Yehɔ boka tendenle biala azo nee baka buzuu biala abo yehɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla.

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ anli nɔhalɛ na ɔdonle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la ati membɔle ye ewole na menvoanle ye. Ɔ diema raalɛ Dwuda adalɛ ne nwunle ye, noko yeanzulo, na ɔdaye ɔhɔbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla ne bie.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ tuutuu ɛlilɛ ɛnyɛ ye nyiane la ati, ɔzonlenle awolɛ nee mbaka na ɔdonle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne na ɔvale evinli ɔhanle azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: And worst of all, the people of Judah pretended to come back to me.
translation_verse: Ɛhye amuala zile, noko Yizilayɛ adiema raalɛ Dwuda ngunzi anva ye ahonle kɔsɔɔti ammaa me; ɔ nee me lile egyele zo amanie ala. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Yizilayɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ, noko ɔle kpalɛ ekyii ɔtɛla Dwuda alane.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Kɔ sɔlɔ nehane kɔha edwɛkɛ ɛhye kɛ, ‘Yizilayɛ mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ, sia bɛla na menrɛva ɛ nwo ɛya, ɔluakɛ mese anwunvɔne. Menrɛva ɛ nwo ɛya menrɛhɔ awieleɛ.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: “ ‘Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi a, bɛzia bɛrɛla me nwo ɛke na bɛ menle a le me. Mebaye bɛ nuhua ko meavi suakpole biala azo na meaye menli nwiɔ meavi abusua ekpulike biala anu, na meava bɛ meara Zayɔn.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ neavolɛma mɔɔ tie me la na bɛava nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo bɛazie bɛ.

english_verse: You will increase in numbers, and there will be no need to remember the sacred chest or to make a new one.
translation_verse: Na saa mekɛ ne anu bɛ nwo so na bɛyɛ mɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo a bɛanva Ɛdɛnkɛma Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne bɛanga edwɛkɛ bieko. Bɛnrɛdwenle nwolɛ anzɛɛ bɛnrɛhakye ye, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu ɛlɛka ne bɔbɔ na bɛaze kɛ bɛbobɔ ye bieko.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, bɛbavɛlɛ Gyɛlusalɛm “Ɛdɛnkɛma Belemgbunli Ebia.” Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bara me nyunlu arazonle me; bɛnrɛli bɛ ahonle ɛtane ne mɔ anzi bieko.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane Dwudama baboka Yizilayɛma, na bɛ muala bɛvi sɔlɔ bɛaradɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la azo kpɔkpɔ.’ ” Nyamenle menli ne awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ

english_verse: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛ, mendwenlenle kɛ mefa wɔ meaboka me mra ne mɔ anwo, na meamaa wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ le anyelielɛ, azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ tɛla ewiade ye azɛlɛ biala. Ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɛkɛvɛlɛ me ‘Egya’, na ɛnrɛhakyi ɛ nzi ɛnrɛzi me bieko.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, wɔyɛ kɛ yelɛ mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ɛmmaa kunli la; wɔanli nɔhalɛ wɔammaa me, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Yɛte ɛnelɛ bie boka ne azo lɔ, Yizilayɛma ɛlɛsu abodo, ɔboalekɛ bɛvo adenle ne, bɛ rɛle ɛvi Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Bɛzia bɛrɛla, me mra mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi a, mebayɛ bɛ ayile meamaa bɛali nɔhalɛ. Bɛmɛ bɛse, “Nea, yɛra wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, awoka ne mɔ le mɛlɛbɛla, awoka ne mɔ azo anyelielɛ mgbole ne mɔ amboa. Nɔhalɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anu yɛɛ Yizilayɛ ngoanelielɛ ne wɔ a.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Noko ɔvi yɛ ngakula nu bozonle Beeyale anwo nyiane ne ɛzonlenlɛ ɛmaa yɛ sa ɛvi nlankɛ, mboane, mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ egya mɔ hwinle bɛ ti anwo ɛhɛlɛnra kpondɛle la.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O Yizilayɛma, saa bɛkulo kɛ bɛsia bɛbatoa me a, ɛnee bɛzia bɛrɛla. Saa bɛfuandi ninyɛne mɔɔ le me kyibadeɛ la bɛgua, na bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛmaa me,

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
translation_verse: na bɛka ndane kɛ, ‘Meka Ɛdɛnkɛma’ nɔhalɛ nu, pɛlepɛle nu, nee tenlene nu a, ɛnee bɛhakye kɛ maanle maanle baze me kɛ menyila bɛ, na bɛbaye me ayɛlɛ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka ahile menli mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm la kɛ, “Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛzo bɛ ɛya ne, bɛmmadua ma ne wɔ mbowule nu.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛde bɛ ahonle nu, anrɛɛ bɛ ninyɛmunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati, me ɛya ne bazɔ kɛ senle, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola ye nua.” Bɛfa konle bɛanwunlonwunla Dwuda

english_verse: Head for Jerusalem or another walled town!’ “Jeremiah, tell them I'm sending disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Bɛva Zayɔn adenle zo! Bɛnriandi bɛlie bɛ ngoane, bɛmmasi aze, ɔluakɛ me nee munzule nee ɛzɛkyelɛ vi sɔlɔ ɛlɛba.

english_verse: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
translation_verse: Awenade vi kpɔkɛ ne abo ɛvinde, maanle maanle sɛkyevo ne ɛzi nu; ɔvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la yevinde kɛ ɔkayɛ yeamaa bɛ azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane; bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ babɔ, awie biala ɛnrɛha.

english_verse: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛheda ɛrele, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole ne ɛtɛfile yɛ nwo zo.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kenle zɔhane, belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ɛnrɛnyia akɛnrazilɛ; edwɛkɛ ne bayɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛzulolɛ na yeazi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo.”

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “Aa Awulae Nyamenle, wɔbɛlɛbɛla menli ɛhye mɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛmma bɔkɔɔ! Ɛse, ‘Ɔbayɛ boɛ’, noko kɛkala, dadeɛ deda bɛ kɔmenzia.”

english_verse: When disaster comes, the Lord will tell you people of Jerusalem, “I am sending a windstorm from the desert— not a welcome breeze. And it will sweep you away as punishment for your sins.
translation_verse: Anwoma mɔɔ mebamaa yeara la anu yɛ se kpole kpalɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mefa meadea me menli ne a.” Kpɔvolɛma ɛbɔ Dwudama ɛyia

english_verse: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind.” Then you will answer, “We are doomed!”
