translation_verse: Bɛnlea, kpɔvolɛ ne ɛlɛba kɛ amungu. Ye konle ehwili ne mɔ le kɛ ahumuakyima, yɛɛ ye mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ tɛla ahɔleɛ. Yɛminli ala ɛne! Yɛ bo zo ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ!

english_verse: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, ye ɛtane fi wɔ ahonle nu, amaa bɛalie wɔ ngoane. Bɛfa ɛtaneyɛlɛ adwenle bɛazie bɛ adwenle nu toonwo yeahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: before a message of disaster arrives from the hills of Ephraim and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ bie ɛlɛka ye wɔ Dan na ɔlɛbɔ munzule bie mɔɔ bara la nolo wɔ Yifelaem Boka.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Tell the nations that my people have rebelled against me. And so an army will come from far away to surround Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛbabɛnra bɛayia Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ sinzavoma mɔɔ ɛlɛsinza egyinli la, ɔboalekɛ bɛde me nwo atua. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: “People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.” Jeremiah's Vision of the Coming Punishment
translation_verse: Dwuda, wɔ ndenle mɔɔ ɛlua nu nee wɔ nyɛleɛ a ɛmaa ɛhye ɛra ɛ nwo zo a. Wɔ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne, wɔ awieleɛ ɛyɛ ɛnwonle, na yeha wɔ dedee yeha wɔ ahonle mɔɔ la ɛ kunlu la. Gyɛlɛmaya di ye menli ne anwo nyane

english_verse: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
translation_verse: Nyane ne! Mengola nyane ne anu sɔ! Me ɛbolɛ! Me ɛbolɛ ɛlɛte! Me ahonle ɛlɛnriandi me kunlu. Mengola koonwu yɛ. Mete aweɛne tendenle ne ane, ɔkile kɛ konle ɛlɛba.

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Anwubɛnyunlu doa anwubɛnyunlu, maanle ne ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ. Arɛlevilɛ nu, me ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ ɛzɛkye; me mgbɛnu ndanlɛ ne mɔ ɛtete nzokanzoka.

english_verse: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
translation_verse: Menea konle fɛlɛnra ne meahɔdwu kenlenzu, na mendie aweɛne tendenle ne ane ɔhɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me menli ne le ahɔnwɔne; bɛnze me. Bɛle ngakula ahoasea; bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo. Bɛbe ɛtaneyɛlɛ nu, na kpalɛ, bɛnze ye yɛ.” Gyɛlɛmaya ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ fane ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛba la anwo

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Meneanle azɛlɛ ye azo, na nea, ɛnee yedɔ mgbane, ɛhwee ɛnle zo; meneanle anwuma, na anwumaneamra anda.

english_verse: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
translation_verse: Meneanle, na nea, sonla ɛnle ɛkɛ, nloma kɔsɔɔti ɛdu ɛhɔ.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Meneanle, na nea, azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ; ye azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala ɛyɛ azuadu. ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole ne ati.

english_verse: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
translation_verse: Saa bɛte ɛlɔne ɛkpɔnwɔkavoma nee ɛdatovoma ane a, suakpole biala azo amra bagua ɛbɔ nu; bie mɔ bagua mbowule nu; bie mɔ bavo ahɔgua awolɛ zo. Azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti badɔ mgbane, awie biala ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ bieko.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔdɔ mgbane! Duzu ati a ɛheda arelemgbunli ɛdanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ ɛ? Duzu ati a ɛfa ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ ɛsiezie ɛ nwo, na ɛto ɛ nye anzi ɛ? Ɛlɛsiezie ɛ nwo mgbane! Wɔ kulovolɛma ɛkpo wɔ; bɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ bɛahu wɔ.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Mendele ɛdeanlɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo, mendele ɛkponlenlɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛwo ye belamunli ralɛ la. Gyɛlusalɛm a ɛzu ɛha nu la, yedɛlɛ ɔ sa nu, ɔse, “Mewu O! Medɔ kɔdiawuma asa anu.”

english_verse: “Search Jerusalem for honest people who try to be faithful. If you can find even one, I'll forgive the whole city.
translation_verse: Bɛnriandi bɛli akɔneaba wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kpalɛ ne mɔ azo! Bɛtoto bɛ nye! Bɛdabɛ bɛnlea ye bɛ nye zo! Bɛnlea gua ne mɔ azo saa bɛkɛnwu awie mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle na ɔka nɔhalɛ la a, na menva ye ɛtane mengyɛ ye.

english_verse: Everyone breaks promises made in my name.”
translation_verse: Bɛka ndane kɛ, “Meka Ɛdɛnkɛma” bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛka ndane ne adalɛ nu.

english_verse: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ ɛkulo nɔhalɛ. Ɛdeanle bɛ, na yɛanyɛ bɛ nyane; ɛhanle bɛ senle, noko bɛangakyi. Bɛsolo bɔkɔɔ; bɛtɛnunle bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ yɛ anwunvɔne, bɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma adenle ne, bɛnze bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne.”

english_verse: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebahɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ tumi ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la ɛkɛ me nee bɛ ahɔdendɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛze Ɛdɛnkɛma adenle ne, bɛze bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne. Noko bɛ muala bɛde nyɛma, bɛdɛla anhwe, bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛli ye mɛla zo.

english_verse: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yemɔti awenade vi kpɔkɛ nu barahu bɛ, bedi vi ɛsɛlɛ zo barazɛkye bɛ. Sobolɛ ɛhɔ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ anwo nzia, awie biala mɔɔ vi biala azo kɛvinde la bɛbatete ye nzokanzoka, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ zonle somaa, yɛɛ bɛkpo Nyamenle bɛhyɛ.

english_verse: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mefa bɛ ɛtane mekyɛ bɛ ɛ? Bɛ menli ne ɛkpo me, na bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la. Memanle bɛ aleɛ bɛlile bɛ ko yile la, bɛdonle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, na bɛdule bɛdoale tuutuuma.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ nyinli mɔɔ evunle ɛwie yi, na bɛ nwo ɛlɛmenlemenle bɛ la, ko biala atiakunlu ba ɔ gɔnwo aye anwo zo.

english_verse: Why shouldn't I punish the people of Judah?
translation_verse: Asoo ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo, na mesenra maanle zɛhae?

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔzɛkye ye vanye ɛya ne, na bɛmmasɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ; bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ bɛgua, ɔluakɛ bɛnle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama anli nɔhalɛ ammaa me. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛdɛnkɛma kpo Yizilayɛma

english_verse: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo adalɛ. Bɛse, “Ɔnrɛyɛ ɛhwee. Munzule biala ɛnrɛdo yɛ, konle ɛnrɛva yɛ aze, yɛɛ ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu yɛ.

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ le anwoma ala; bɛnlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ biala bɛnga. Kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛbayɛ ala la ɛne.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Gyɛlɛmaya, kɛmɔ bɛha edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, memaa me edwɛkɛ ne ahakyi senle wɔ ɛ nloa anu na menli ɛhye mɔ ahakyi ɛyɛne, na senle ne ayela bɛ wee.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma, memaa maanle bie anu amra arateta bɛ. Ɔle maanle dɛba yɛɛ ɔle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ se. Ɔle maanle mɔɔ bɛnde bɛ aneɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛka bɔbɔ la bɛnde ɔ bo.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛda mbaka boa le kɛ azie zo sɛka mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, yɛɛ menli ne le katakyiema.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛbali bɛ bɛyɔba ne nee bɛ aleɛ ne; bɛbahu bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ. Bɛbahu bɛ mboane nee bɛ nlankɛ, na bɛazɛkye bɛ vanye mbaka nee bɛ feege mbaka. Bɛbabubu bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane na bɛ ti zɔ bɛ la.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyɛlɛmaya, mekɛ ne anu menrɛzɛkye me menli ne menrɛdu bɛ bo.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Saa wɔ menli ne biza kɛ duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a, ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛkpole medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne na bɛzonlenle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu, yemɔti bɛbazonle nyɛvolɛ wɔ maanle mɔɔ ɛnle bɛ ɛdeɛ la anu.’ ” Nyamenle bɔ ye menli ne kɔkɔ

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ka kile Gyekɔbo abo zo amra nee Dwudama kɛ:

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: Bɛdie ɛhye, ahɔnwɔne mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ a, mɔɔ lɛ ɛnyelɛ na bɛnnwu debie a, mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ na bɛnde edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛnzulo me ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛgyi me nyunlu a bɛ nwo ɛnwozo bɛ a? Menvale ɛnwea mengyale nyevile ɛweɛne mɔɔ ɔngola ye bɔ tɛla ɛlɛ la. Azɛlɛkye ne mɔ bu na bɛngola bɛndɛla ɛweɛne ne, bɛkulu mgbole na bɛngola bɛnli ɛweɛne ne bɔtɛla.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛle menli anzosesebɛ na bɛte atua; bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi me.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: Bɛnga ye bɛ ahonle nu bɔbɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ tɔ ezule nee nyenyensuo wɔ bɛ ɛlobɔ nloa, na ɛbuhenle dwu a ɔmaa yɛ bɛyɔba la.’

english_verse: That's why I cannot bless you! *
translation_verse: Bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmaa ninyɛne kpalɛ ɛkpa bɛ ti.

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: “Amumuyɛma wɔ me menli ne avinli. Bɛkɔ nzia kɛ menli mɔɔ sua nlomangane la. Bɛsua ngane bɛkye menli.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Bɛ azua nu ɛyɛ nwule ninyɛne ngome kɛ tunli mɔɔ nloma ɛyi ye la. Yemɔti bɛ tumi ɛyɛ kpole yɛɛ bɛnyia bɛ nwo.

english_verse: and prosperous, but you refuse to help the poor get the justice they deserve.
translation_verse: Bɛdi aleɛ kpalɛ la ati bɛle mbelane tutoboo, bɛ nwo le mɛnlaanwo. Bɛ amumuyɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Bɛnze arisa ralɛ yɛɛ bɛnze sonla mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi ye la anwunvɔne.

english_verse: You need to be punished, and so I will take revenge.
translation_verse: “Asoo ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo, na mesenra maanle zɛhae ɔ?

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma yɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛze bɛ la. Me menli ne die mɔɔ bɛka la to nu; bɛmkpo kɛ bɛnrɛyɛ ye zɔhane, na saa awieleɛ ne ba a duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: O Bɛngyamanema, bɛnriandi bɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm! Bɛlie bɛ ngoane! Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Tɛkowa na bɛkpɔnla sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ Bɛte Hakɛlɛm, ɔluakɛ munzule ɛkpuke sɔlɔ ɛlɛba arazɛkye ninyɛne.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
translation_verse: Suakpole Zayɔn ɛfifi kɛnlɛma, noko bɛbabɔ ye.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli bava bɛ ɛlɔnema ara ɛkɛ. Bɛbasisi bɛ ndanlɛ azua bɛabɔ suakpole ne bɛayia. Awie biala badɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Bɛbaha kɛ “Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛhɔteta Gyɛlusalɛm; bɛteta ye ewiazo ketekete!” Menli ne babua kɛ, “Yekpa nwolɛ, aleɛ asɛɛ ɛdwo, sɛnzɛne ne ɛdɔ.

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔteta bɛ ɛnɛ nɔe, na yɛbubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ!”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne: “Bɛpepɛ ye mbaka ne mɔ na bɛhuohua anwea suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm anwo bɛbɛnra bɛyia. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtea suakpole ɛhye azo amra, ɔluakɛ ɛsisilɛ ala a bɛsisi menli a.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ dahuu nzule gyi bula nu la, zɔhane ala a Gyɛlusalɛm dahuu sie amumuyɛ a; konle konle nee ninyɛnezɛkyelɛ ala a mete a, anwondolɛ nee nganlɛ ɛbobɔlɛ ala a menwu bɛ a.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛva ɛhye mɔ bɛdu bɛ nwo folɛ, anrɛɛ menwɔkpo bɛ menwɔmaa bɛ suakpole ne kɛyɛ suadu.” Yizilayɛma le atuadelɛma

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛkpokpo Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ bɛwie ye ma kpolo la. Yemɔti kpɔla ye ngane ne mɔ azo bieko, kɛmɔ matevolɛ ɛlɛtete vanye ne a ɔyɛ la.”

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛya mɔɔ wɔva ye bɛ nwo la ɛwolowolo me, Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mengola ye me kunlu di.” Nzinlii Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Wola me ɛya ne gua ngakula mɔɔ wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo, nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ ɛyia la anwo zo. Bɛbahye kunli nee yelɛ, mgbanyinli nee mrelera bɛahɔ.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebadea menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ne azo la. Yemɔti bɛbava bɛ azua, bɛ egyinli yɛɛ bɛ ye mɔ bɛamaa awie mɔ gyɛne.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ngakula nee mgbanyinli kɔsɔɔti ɛva ɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkpondɛ ezukoa awule nu. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma amuala sisi menli ne.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛmia me menli ne nganlɛ ne mɔ a bɛdoɔloa bɛ ala. Bɛse, ‘Yehɔ, yehɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛtɛkɔle la.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Asoo bɛkyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ yɛle bɛ nyiane? Kyɛkyɛ, yeanyɛ bɛ nyiane fee, bɛnze nyiane deɛ holɛ. Yemɔti bɛbawu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ metea bɛ la ɛnee bɛ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Yizilayɛma kpo Nyamenle adenle ne

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye menli ne kɛ, “Bɛgyinlegyinla ndenle ne mɔ azo na bɛnlea. Bɛbizebiza mɔmoane ndenle ne mɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ adenle kpalɛ kpalɛ ne la la. Bɛlua nuhua na bɛkɛnyia anzonudwolɛ.” Na bɛbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, yɛnrɛlua nuhua fee.”

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Memanle bɛ sinzavolɛma na menganle kɛ, “Bɛdie aweɛne tendenle ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne!” Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛnrɛdie!”

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Bɛdie, bɛmɛ maanle maanle, maanlema mɔɔ ɛyia nu, na bɛnwu mɔɔ bara me menli ne anwo zo la.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Tie, O azɛlɛ! Adwenle ɛtane ɛtane mɔɔ me menli ne bɔ la ati, melɛmaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ bɛandie me ne, yɛɛ bɛkpo me mɛla ne.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Kɛ meyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee ye vi Hyiba ɛrɛlɛ me la ɛ? Anzɛɛ kɛ meyɛ aleɛdonlɛ ninyɛne evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle zo moa moa ɛrɛlɛ me la ɛ? Menrɛlie bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ɛnzɔ me nye.”

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebamaa menli ɛhye mɔ adu koti adu agua aze; selɛ o, mralɛ o, agɔnwolɛma anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ zuozua bane la o, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ bo zo baminli.” Sɔlɔ amra teta bɛ

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Menli vi sɔlɔ maanle nu ɛlɛba. Maanle anwosesebɛ kpalɛ bie ɛlɛboɔboa ɔ nwo nee konle vi moa moa ara.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Bɛdedɛ ɛda nee atwɛ mɔ; bɛ ti yɛ se yɛɛ bɛnze anwunvɔne. Saa bɛdede bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ azo a, bɛ nganeɛ kulu kɛ nyevile. Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛwie; bɛlɛba bɛ nee Gyɛlusalɛmma araho.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma se, “Yɛde nrɛlaleɛ ne, yɛ sa nu ɛtuto. Arɛlebɔlɛ nee nyane ɛkyekye yɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Bɛmmakɔ ɛbɔ nu yɛɛ bɛmmaduolua ademgbole ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛwie sia; ɛleka biala ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ.”

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye menli ne kɛ, “Bɛheda ɛrele na bɛva nzonle bɛbɔ bɛ nwo. Bɛzu bɛye awolɛ kpalɛ kɛ bɛsu ralɛ nrenya kokye mɔɔ ɛwu la, ɔboalekɛ sɛkyevolɛ ne mɔɔ bazɛkye bɛ la barateta bɛ arɛlevilɛ nu.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛte atua anzosesebɛ nu; bɛ nee alane asiayɛma a tu a. Bɛyɛ se kɛ kɔbele nee bulalɛ. Bɛ ɛbɛla ɛzɛkye.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: noko bɛandie me, anzɛɛ bɛangyea bɛ nzo bɔbɔ. Akee bɔbɔ bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ kpole kpalɛ bɛdɛlale bɛ ze mɔ.

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: saa bɛansisi nyɛvolɛ, bɛansisi menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ ze anzɛɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ, anzɛɛ bɛanga mogya mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la bɛangua ɛke, yɛɛ saa bɛangɔnzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛanzɛkye bɛ nwo a,

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadie mɛlɛbɛla edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ se, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛne, Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛne!’ la bɛdi.

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ saa nɔhalɛ nu bɛkakyi bɛ ndenle nee bɛ nyɛleɛ, saa nɔhalɛ nu bɛdi pɛlepɛle bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: menwɔmaa bɛkɛdɛnla ɛke, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ bɔkɔɔ la azo.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ, bɛdie mɛlɛbɛla edwɛkɛ bɛdi, noko bɛnnyia zolɛ nvasoɛ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Bɛwua, bɛku menli, bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, bɛdi amonle bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale, bɛsonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ la,

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: na bɛaragyinla me nyunlu wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la anu, na bɛaze kɛ, ‘Bɛlie yɛ ngoane’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛgua zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne la.

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la le awulema fealeka ɔ? Mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la, medame mumua ne menwu ye.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ Hyaelo, ɛleka mɔɔ menlumuale menyɛle kɛ bɛzonle me, na bɛhɔnlea kɛ menzile menyɛle ye wɔ me menli Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne ati la.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, medendɛ mehile bɛ fane dɔɔnwo na bɛandie, na menvɛlɛle bɛ la, bɛambua la ati, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese:

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ menvale menyɛle Hyaelo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebava meayɛ sua ye mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye, na bɛ ti zɔ ye nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la a.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Mebavoa bɛ, kɛmɔ menvoanle bɛ ze mɔ Yizilayɛma amuala la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Menli ne anyɛ tieyɛ

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people! I, the Lord, would refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, mmasɛlɛ ɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ anzɛɛ mmasu bɛ, yɛɛ mmakpa bɛ ti kyɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ menrɛdie.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Ɛnnwu nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo la ɔ?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Ngakula ne mɔ soa ɛyɛne, mrenya ne mɔ fa wuda senle, yɛɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ fɔtɔ ɛdɔkɛ fa yɛ keeki maa bozonle raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Anwuma Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne la. Eza bɛfa nza azubɔdeɛ bɛye ɛdɛne bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛfa bɛka me ɛya.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Ɛnee mame a bɛka me ɛya a? Kyɛkyɛ, bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome a bɛlɛsie bɛ nwo munzule bɛagua bɛ nyunlu aze a.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mebawola me ɛya ne meagua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye azo. Mebawola meagua menli nee nyɛmoa nwo zo, ɛbɔ nu mbaka nee azɛlɛ ye azo bɛyɔba zo. Me ɛya ne bazɔ kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua a.”

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti rale la, meanga ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee azubɔlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ biala meangile bɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menzele bɛ la ɛne, ‘Bɛdie me ne na mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛdabɛ bɛayɛ me menli. Eza bɛlua ndenle mɔɔ mehile bɛ la anu, amaa bɛ ɛbɛla awie bɛ boɛ.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Noko bɛanli me edwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ menganle la azo, yɛɛ bɛambu ye bie; bɛdabɛ bɛlile bɛ ahonle ɛtane nzi bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ kunlu dwo la, na bɛzɛkyele bɔbɔ bɛdɛlale dɛba ne.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Ɔvi kenle mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la, mezoa me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ alehyenlɛ biala,

english_verse: Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, Gyɛlɛmaya, ɛbaha edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔahile bɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, na bɛnrɛdie wɔ. Ɛbavɛlɛ bɛ, na bɛnrɛdɛne wɔ zo.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Na ɛbaha wɔahile bɛ kɛ: Ɛhye a le maanle ne mɔɔ anyɛ tieyɛ ammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne la. Bɛngulo kɛ bɛfo adenle a bɛtwi bɛ nyunlu. Nɔhalɛ ɛwie. Awie biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ. Nyɛleɛ ɛtane wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: “Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛye awolɛ; bɛkpa bɛ ti na bɛvuandi enrinli ne bɛgua. Bɛdo ɛzɛne edwɛne wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, ɔboalekɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, meva ɛya, na mekpo me menli ne.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ Dwudama ɛyɛ ɛtane ɛtia me. Bɛzie bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye la anu, bɛva evinli bɛha ye.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Wɔ Henɛm Bɔnza ne anu, bɛzi azukponle na bɛdo ye Tofɛte, amaa bɛayela bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛabɔ azu wɔ senle ne anu. Meanze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye, yɛɛ yeamba me adwenle nu bɔbɔ.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ bɛnrɛvɛlɛ ye Tofɛte anzɛɛ Henɛm Bɔnza bieko a. Bɛbavɛlɛ ye Ahunleɛ Bɔnza, ɔluakɛ bɛbazie avunli ɛkɛ. Bɛnrɛnyia ɛleka bɛnrɛzie avunli kɛ ɛkɛ ne ala.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Na menli ne avunli bayɛ anwomanyunlu nloma nee azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole aleɛ, bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛvoa bɛ.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne bahakyi ɛsɛlɛ. Wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo nee Gyɛlusalɛm gua ne mɔ azo, anyelielɛ, fɛlɛkolilɛ, yɛɛ atɔfolɛ o, awie ɛnrɛde bie ɛlɛ. Azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: “Mekɛ zɔhane bɛbaza Dwuda arelemgbunli, Dwuda mgbanyima, ye sɛlɛvolɛma, ye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm ezuavolɛ mbowule bɛagua zolɛ.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛkɛhuohua bɛ nloa bɛkɛzie bɛ la, bɛbado mbowule bɛazande azɛlɛ ne anwo. Bɛbagua ɛkɛ, amaa sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, yɛɛ anwumaneamra kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛhulole bɛ, bɛbɔle bɛ ti aze bɛmanle bɛ, bɛkpondɛle bɛ, bɛlile bɛ nzi na bɛzonlenle bɛ la anwu bɛ.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ baha munzule abusua ekpulike ɛhye anu, mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ mevoa bɛ mehɔgua la bahulo kɛ bɛkɛwu tɛla kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla ngoane nu. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛtane nee ndeanlɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Biza menli ne kɛ saa sonla tɔ aze a, ɔndwazo ɔ? Saa sonla fo adenle a ɔnzia ɔ nzi ɔ?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Na duzu ati a akee menli ɛhye mɔ agyakɛ ɛzia bɔkɔɔ na bɛnzia bɛmba ɛ? Bɛdi adalɛ nzi; bɛngulo kɛ bɛsia.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Megyele me nzo medie bɛ edwɛkɛhanlɛ, na biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ. Bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛtɛnunle ɔ nwo wɔ ye amumuyɛ ne anwo; mɔɔ ɔka la a le kɛ, ‘Duzu a meyɛ a?’ Awie biala ati ɛmi nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la anu kɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ konle la.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Akoso bɔbɔ mɔɔ lua anwomanyunlu la ze ye mekɛ; yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma, nyamenleakatiba, yɛɛ azuazuanloma ze bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛsia bɛba a, noko me menli ne ɛnze medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me mɛla ne.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛsi bɛkola bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ yɛze Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne’ ɛ? Bɛnlea, mɛla kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛma adalɛ ɛhakyi mɛla ne.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma anyunlu bagua aze. Bɛ adwenle baha abɔ nu na bɛahye bɛ. Nea, bɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nloa edwɛkɛ; na duzu nrɛlɛbɛ bɔbɔ a bɛze a?

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebava bɛ ye mɔ meamaa mrenya fofolɛ, na meava bɛ egyinli ne mɔ meamaa menli mɔɔ bali bɛ nwo zo konim la, ɔluakɛ bɛ mgbanyinli nee bɛ ngakula kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛkpondɛ ezukoa anyebolo nu. Ɔvi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo mɔɔ badwu sɛlɛvolɛma anwo zo la, biala ɛnli nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛmia me menli ne mɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ a bɛdoɔloa bɛ ala. Bɛse, ‘Yehɔ, yehɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛtɛkɔle la.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛkyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ yɛle bɛ nyiane? Kyɛkyɛ, yeanyɛ bɛ nyiane fee, ɔluakɛ bɛnze nyiane deɛ holɛ. Yemɔti bɛbawu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ metea bɛ la, ɛnee bɛ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mengulole kɛ menwɔboɔboa bɛ nloa, na menwunle kɛ bɛle kɛ vanye baka, anzɛɛ feege baka mɔɔ ma ɛnle zolɛ la, bɛ nya ne mɔ bɔbɔ ɛnwosonwoso, yɛɛ mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la ɛkpa bɛ ti.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Nyamenle menli ne bizale kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛtɛte ɛke a? Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la azo yɛhɔwu yɛgua ɛkɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛbua yɛ ewule fɔlɛ kɛ yɛwu; yemaa yɛ pɔezen nzule kɛ yɛnlo, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia ye.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Yɛ nye lale anzonudwolɛ adenle, na yeanyɛ boɛ; yɛ nye lale anwonzalɛ adenle, na bɛnlea, sulosulo a rale a.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Yɛte kpɔvolɛma mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ abonyi nu anwoma wɔ Dan. Saa bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nyinli ne mɔ su tea nu a azɛlɛ kpusu. Yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛra bazɛkye azɛlɛ ne nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la, bɛra bɛbabɔ suakpole ne, bɛabɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la abo zo.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, memaa nwɔlɛ bɔna mɔ mɔɔ awie ɛngola bɛ sili kye la arakeka bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Gyɛlɛmaya di ye menli ne anwo nyane

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Me nyanelilɛ ɛbo zo, yemaa menyia ahonle ewule.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Bɛdie, ɔvi maanle ti mɔɔ kɔdwu ɔ bo la, mete kɛ me menli ne ɛlɛsu kɛ, “Anzɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnle Zayɔn ɔ? Zayɔn belemgbunli ne ɛnle ɛkɛ ɔ?” Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛgua ananze mmonle bɛzonle bɛ bɛva bɛha me ɛya ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛva bɛha me ɛya ɛ?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Me menli ne su se kɛ, “Ɛlobɔ ne ɛze, bɛwie bɛyɔba ne bu, noko bɛtɛdiele yɛ ngoane.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Me ahonle ɛhwe, ɔboalekɛ bɛbodɛboda me menli ne; melɛdi nyane, me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Asoo ayile biala ɛnle Geleade? Asoo ninsinli biala ɛnle ɛkɛ? Duzu ati a akee bɛtɛyɛle me menli ne ayile a?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ me ti le nzubula na me nye monle le nzufeanvea, anrɛɛ menwɔzu me menli mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ la alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: O anrɛɛ meanyia nyɛvolɛ azokoɛleɛ fienemgbole nu lɔ, amaa meahwe me nwo meavi me menli ne anwo. Ɔluakɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛlatovoma, bɛle menli ngunzi.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Adalɛ ɛhu bɛ kuu; nɔhalɛ biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ne azo, adalɛ ngome ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me menli ne bɔ munzule la ɛnee bɛbɔ, yɛɛ bɛnze me.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnlea ɔ gɔnwo boɛ, ɔmmafa ɔ rɛle ɔwula ɔ diema biala nu, ɔluakɛ adiema biala le mɛlɛbɛla sonla, agɔnwolɛ biala yɛ ɔ gɔnwo anwo asiayɛ.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Awie biala bɛlɛbɛla ɔ gɔnwo, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnga nɔhalɛ; adalɛ ɛzɔ bɛ nloa anu, yɛɛ bɛngyakyi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Nzisi doa nzisi, yɛɛ adalɛ li adalɛ nzi. Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ye menli ne ɛkpo ye.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebadu bɛ nu evinli ne na meazɔ bɛ meanlea, ɔluakɛ duzu bieko a ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a? Bɛle me menli.

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Bɛ tafinlima yɛ nla kɛ ɛda baka; dahuu bɛbɔ adalɛ; bɛtendɛ agɔnwolɛ nu bɛkile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ, noko bɛ ahonle nu, bɛdi ye ɛhunlɛ busia.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebiza kɛ: Ɔnle kɛ metea bɛ wɔ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ anwo ɔ? Ɔnle kɛ mesenra maanle mɔɔ le zɛhae la ɔ?

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: “Bɛzu bɛye awoka ne mɔ awolɛ na bɛye fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ awolɛ; ɔboalekɛ bɛwe, yemɔti menli ɛngɔ nu. Ɛnɛ bɛnde nlankɛ ɛzunlɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, nloma nee ɛzonlɛ ɛnriandi ɛhɔ.

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Mebamaa Gyɛlusalɛm ahakyi ewula edukue, ɔbahakyi ɛzonlɛ dabelɛ. Mebamaa Dwuda azuamgbole adɔ mgbane, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: Nwane a ze nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛde ɛhye abo a? Nwane a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛwula ɔ nloa kɛ ɔbɔ ye nolo a? Duzu ati a azɛlɛ ne ɛzɛkye ɛdɔ mgbane kɛ fienemgbole, mɔɔ yemɔti awie ɛmpe zolɛ a?

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Ɛhye ɛzi, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo me mɛla mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la, yɛɛ bɛandie me ne, bɛanli zolɛ.

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Bɛli bɛ ahonle nzi anzosesebɛ nu bɛzonle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ hilele bɛ la.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdie mɔɔ medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne mebayɛ la: Mebamaa me menli ne mbaka ɛnwonle meamaa bɛali na meamaa bɛ nzule mɔɔ le pɔezen la bɛanlo.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Mebakponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ bɔbɔ ɛtɛtele bɛ aluma ɛlɛ la azo; mebamaa ɛlɔnema ara bɛ nwo zo toonwo kɔkpula kɛ menwɔwie bɛ bo zo bɔ la.” Gyɛlusalɛmma su abiza moalɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi la anwo! Bɛvɛlɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ su ye awolɛ la, mraalɛ mɔɔ to ɛzɛne edwɛne la.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Menli ne hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa bɛrɛla ndɛndɛ, bɛrazu bɛvua yɛ, bɛye awolɛ bɛmaa yɛhwi monle, na yɛ nye abo ɛyɛ monle monle.”

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛzunlɛ ɛde Zayɔn, na bɛlɛka kɛ, “Yɛwu o! Yɛbɔ anyiemgba bɔkɔɔ, ɔboalekɛ yɛvi azɛlɛ ne azo yɛdu, ɔboalekɛ bɛbubu yɛ azua ne mɔ.”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mraalɛ, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ. Bɛhilehile bɛ mra mraalɛ awolɛyelɛ, na bɛhilehile bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛzɛne edwɛne.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Ewule ɛlua yɛ nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu ɛra yɛ azua nu; yehu ngakula mɔɔ wɔ awɔdenle ne mɔ azo nee mgbavolɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ la.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Se bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se: “Azɛlɛ ne azo bayɛ avunli ngome kɛ nyɛmoa ebinli mɔɔ ɛyɛ totɔɔ wɔ ɛya avule ne mɔ anu la, kɛ ma mɔɔ bɛde bɛkyekye bɛ avile bɛgua, na menli ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ soa la.”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Saa awie ɛlɛtu ɔ nwo a, ɔdu ɔ nwo kɛ ɔze me na ɔte me edwɛkɛ bo, kɛ mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Me ɛhulolɛ ne gyi kpundii, yɛɛ meyɛ mɔɔ le pɛpɛ nee fɔɔnwo. Ɛhye mɔ a sɔ me nye a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ne ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebadea Yigyibitima, Dwudama, Yidɔmma, Amɔnoma, Mowabema, yɛɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo amra mɔɔ kpa bɛ nwoma azo enrinli la. Menli ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, noko bɛnli ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la azo. Maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ nee Yizilayɛma biala ɛnli me ngyekyeleɛ ne azo.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Bɛmmasukoa maanle maanle ne mɔ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ; maanle maanle ne mɔ ahonle tu anwomanyunlu sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ anwo, na bɛmɛ, bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu nwolɛ.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ le mgbane. Bɛpɛ baka ɛbɔ nu; na dwinvolɛ fa ye mbulalɛ ne se,

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: na bɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke bɛfɔle nwolɛ. Bɛfa pɛlɛko bɛbobɔ nu amaa bɛandudu bɛangua noko nea, bɛsonle abaaba ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Abaaba ɛhye mɔ le kɛ ahule nu ananze, bɛngola bɛndendɛ; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsoa bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛngola bɛndia. Bɛmmasulo bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛngola bɛnyɛ bɛ ɛhwee, yɛɛ bɛngola bɛnyɛ debie kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awie nee wɔ ɛnzɛ; ɛle bedevinli, wɔ duma ne le kpole, tumi wɔ nu.

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle Belemgbunli, nwane a ɛnzulo wɔ a? Enililɛ le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Maanle maanle ne mɔ anu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma o, bɛ nuhua arelemgbunli o, ko bɔbɔ nee wɔ ɛnzɛ.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Bɛle ahɔnwɔne, bɛle ahoasea. Abaaba ne mɔ ngilehilelɛ le mgbane.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛva dwɛtɛ fufule mɔɔ vi Sepeen la bɛfɔle abaaba ne mɔ anwo, bɛva ezukoa nvutuke mɔɔ vi Ɛfaze la bɛfɔle nwo, bɛle dwinvolɛ asa anloa gyima. Bɛva arelemgbunli ɛdanlɛ anye buluwu nee kɔkɔlɛ yɛɛ akɔlɛ ɛnlome nee kɔkɔlɛ bɛheda bɛ; menli mɔɔ ze adwinli la a nwonle ɛdanlɛ ne a.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle; wɔmɔ a ɛle tease Nyamenle nee Damɛnlangoate Belemgbunli ne a. Saa ɔfa ɛya a azɛlɛ kpusu. Maanle maanle ɛngola ye ɛya nloa gyinla.

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye tumi a bɔle azɛlɛ ye a, ɔvale ye nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔbɔle ewiade a, ɔvale ye ndelebɛbo a ɔbɔle anwomanyunlu a.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Saa ɔtea nu a anwomanyunlu nzule yɛ begyebegye; ɔmaa amungu kye ewiade ɛleka biala. Ɔmaa ezule fedevede na ɔmaa ahumu tu.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nvasoɛ ɛnle bɛ nwo zo, bɛfa bɛto agyiba; saa bɛ ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne dwu a bɛbazɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛnle kɛ nyamenle ɛhye mɔ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne le ye agyadeɛ: ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛahɔ nlɔnu

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛva bɛ aze a, bɛhuohua bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ye anu ala mefuandi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la kɔsɔɔti meagua. Mebamaa bɛanwu bɛ nyunlu meamaa yeade bɛ kpalɛ.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma zunle zele kɛ, “Abule ɛbu yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛboda! Yɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛlɛkile yɛ nyane, na ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdi ye yɛ kunlu.

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Membuale kɛ, “Yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ le ahɔnwɔne; bɛyɛ debie a bɛmbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ. Yemɔti a bɛamkpazi, na bɛbɔ yɛ menli ne asande la.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Bɛdie! Yɛde edwɛkɛ bie! Basabasa vi sɔlɔ maanle bie anu ɛlɛba arabɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ, yeamaa bɛayɛ azuadu; bɛbayɛ ɛzonlɛ dabelɛ.”

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, meze kɛ sonla ɔdaye ɔnlɛ ɔ nwo; sonla ɔdaye ɔnlɛ ye ngoane zo tumi.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tea me, noko anrɛɛ suzu, mmafa ɛya ɛtea me, anrɛɛ me awieleɛ ne ala ɛne.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ, nee menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la anwo zo; bɛhu wɔ menli ne; bɛbɔ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra abo zo tɔɔ; bɛmaa bɛ maanle ne ɛdɔ mgbane.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: Ɔle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti maanle ne mɔɔ le kɛ senle tandane la anu rale la. Menzele bɛ kɛ bɛdie me ne na bɛyɛ mɔɔ menwɔze bɛ la amuala. Saa bɛyɛ ɛhye a bɛbayɛ me menli, na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: Na mebali ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle bɛ ze mɔ kɛ mebava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ, mɔɔ kɛkala bɛde zolɛ la meamaa bɛ la azo.” Membuale kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɔyɛ zɔhane.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔbɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye nolo wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ amuala azo kɛ: Bɛdie ngyekyeleɛ ne anu edwɛkɛ na bɛli zolɛ.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti rale la, membɔle bɛ kɔkɔ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛdie me, na mehɔ zolɛ mehakye bɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Noko bɛandie, yɛɛ bɛanli zolɛ. Ko biala ɔdaye ɔyɛle ɛtane mɔɔ ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la. Yemɔti menvale ndeanlɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛhile wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne anu la mendeanle bɛ, noko bɛampili.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me bieko kɛ, “Nea, Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛde atua.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛyɛ bɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ kpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne la ɛtane ne mɔ bie; bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne. Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ kyekyele la.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Dwudama nyamenle ne mɔ ɛzo kɛ bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ala la, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma azukponle mɔɔ ɛsisi, mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale la ɛzo kɛ bɛ awɔdenle ne mɔ la. Bɛva bɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya, mmasɛlɛ ɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ anzɛɛ mmabodo ɛmaa bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ngyegyelɛ kɛdo bɛ la, ɔluakɛ menrɛdie bɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ mekulo bɛ la ɛlɛyɛ amumuyɛ ninyɛne. Duzu adenle a bɛlɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛba me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a? Bɛdwenle kɛ saa bɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo na bɛfa nane bɛbɔ azu a ɛnee munzule ɛndo bɛ ɔ? Ɛhye kɛmaa bɛ nye kɛlie ɔ?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma menvɛlɛle bɛ ‘ɔlivi baka buzuu mɔɔ lɛ ma ngɛnlɛma’ la. Na kɛkala, mekulu kokye meado senle nu meayela ye nya ne mɔ wee meamaa ye ngane ne mɔ abubu agua.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a menluale bɛ kɛ mbaka a. Noko melɛsɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama, bɛyɛ ɛtane. Bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale bɛva bɛha me ɛya.” Bɛbɔ adwenle bɛahu Gyɛlɛmaya

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma yele hilele me kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛlɛbɔ me nwo adwenle ahu me.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Ɛnee mele kɛ boane ralɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie na bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la. Menze kɛ mame a bɛlɛdwenle me nwo adwenle ɛtane la. Ɛnee bɛlɛka kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzɛkye baka ne nee ye ma ne mɔ amuala. Bɛmaa yɛpɛ ye yɛvi azɛlɛ ne azo, amaa awie angakye ye bieko.”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya zɛlɛle kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle ndɛnebuavolɛ mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle a; ɛneɛnlea menli ahonle nee bɛ adwenle nu. Me edwɛkɛ ye wɔ ɛ sa nu. Senra menli ɛhye mɔ maa me.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Anato ezuavolɛ ne kulo kɛ bɛku me. Bɛduale me kɛ memmabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo, anrɛɛ bɛkɛhu me.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadea bɛ! Bɛ mgbavolɛ badɔ konle nu; bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bawu ɛhɔne nu. Bɛ bo zo babɔ.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Mebamaa munzule ado Anatoma. Mekɛ ne dwu a, bɛ biala fee ɛnrɛha.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kanza mebɔ wɔ somolɛ bɔbɔ a, wɔmɔ, ɛdi benle. Noko mesɛlɛ wɔ meava me edwɛkɛ meado ɛ nyunlu. Duzu ati a amumuyɛma kpazi ɛ? Duzu ati a menli mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la wie boɛ ɛ?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Ɛdua bɛ, na bɛsɔ ndinli; bɛnyi na bɛso ma. Bɛ nloa anu a, ɛbikye bɛ kpalɛ, noko bɛ ahonle nu a, ɛmbikye bɛ.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛze me; ɛnwu me, yɛɛ ɛsɔ adwenle mɔɔ melɛ ye ɛ nwo la ɛnea. Twili amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛkahu bɛ la, fa bɛ sie kɔdwu kenle mɔɔ bɛku bɛ la.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Yɛ azɛlɛ ye ɛzɛkye ɛhyɛ; ndile mɔɔ wɔ zo la kɔsɔɔti ɛyela. Nyɛmoa nee nloma ɛlɛwu, wɔ menli mɔɔ de zo la amumuyɛ ti, ɔboalekɛ menli ka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛnwu mɔɔ yɛlɛyɛ la.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, saa ɛ nee menli ɛzu ɛnriandilɛ na wɔangola bɛ a, kɛ ɛsi ɛkola ɛ nee mgbɔnwɔ su ɛnriandilɛ ɛ? Na saa ɛlua azɛlɛ wienyi zo wɔdu wɔdɔ a, ɛnee saa ɛlua Dwɔdan kpɔkɛmile nu a, kɛ ɛkɛyɛ ɛ?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ mediema nee ɛ ze sua nu amra nee wɔ ɛli ye ngunzi nu, bɛboka menli mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ wɔ la. Bɛ nloa anu menlemenle, noko mmadie bɛ ɛdi.” Ɛdɛnkɛma di ye menli ne anwo nyane

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Megyakyi Yizilayɛma anzi ɛlilɛ; mekpo me agyadeɛ ne. Meye menli ne mɔɔ la me ahonle nwo la mewula bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔɔ le me agyadeɛ la ɛhakyi me nwo kpɔkɛmile nu awenade; ɛkpolɛ ala a bɛkpo me a, yemɔti mekyi bɛ.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔɔ le me agyadeɛ la ɛyɛ kɛ anloma ndeta mɔɔ sianza dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la. Bɛhɔ bɛhɔboɔboa nanemgbole kɔsɔɔti anloa kɛ bɛrali aleɛ.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Mboaneneavolɛma dɔɔnwo ɛzɛkye me vanye egyinli ne, bɛtietia me vanye mbaka ne mɔ azo, bɛmaa me azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Menli ɛra ɛsɛlɛ ne awoka ne mɔ azo, bɛzɛkye ɛkɛ kɔsɔɔti; ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me dadeɛ ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo kɔsɔɔti; awie biala ɛnlɛ anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Me menli ne ɛgua hwiiti, na bɛde mbowundile; bɛvɛ toonwo, na bɛvua asakpane. Ɔlua me ɛya kpole ne ati, bɛ bɛyɔba bayɛ anyiemgba.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Yizilayɛ la

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ nee ye menli Yizilayɛma bɔ ɛweɛne na bɛfa bɛ sa bɛka agyadeɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa ye menli Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ ɔ la anwo la ɛne: Ɔse, “Bɛnlea, mebadu bɛ meavi bɛ maanle ne mɔ anu, na meaye Dwudama meavi bɛ nu.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Saa metu bɛ zɔhane a, nzinlii mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, na mebava bɛ meazia meara bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ le bɛ agyadeɛ la azo.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Na ɔbara kɛ, saa bɛbafa me menli ne agyakɛ bɛbɔ me duma bɛdi amonle kɛ, ‘Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma de aze la.’ kɛmɔ bɛmanle Yizilayɛma vale bɛ bozonle Beeyale ne hanle ndane la a, bɛ nee me menli ne badɛnla na bɛakpazi.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na maanle biala mɔɔ andie me ne la, mebadu ye meabɔ ɔ bo zo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔdɔ lenen abɛlako na mo; anrɛɛ mmawula ye nzule nu.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mendɔle abɛlako ne na memonle, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me ala la.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me bieko kɛ,

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Ye abɛlako ne mɔɔ wɔdɔ wɔmo la kɔvea bolɛ tokule bie anu wɔ Azule Yufileti ne anloa.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ guale nu la Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Sia kɔ Yufileti ne anloa kɔye abɛlako ne mɔɔ memanle ɛvale ɛhɔveale lɔ la.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Mengɔle Yufileti ne anloa mengɔnvunle menyele abɛlako ne. Na nea, ɛnee yezɛkye bɔkɔɔ; ɛfa ye fee a ɔnva.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mebazi meazɛkye Dwudama adubɛnwo ne nee Gyɛlusalɛmma adubɛnwo ne la ɛne.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ ɛdu bɛ gye kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne. Bɛli bɛ ahonle ɛtane nzi na bɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ. Yemɔti bɛbayɛ kɛ abɛlako ne mɔɔ ɛfa ɛyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ la.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ abɛlako kyekye sonla bo kɛnlɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mekulo kɛ Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama amuala kɛbeta me kyengye a. Menyɛle bɛ zɔhane, amaa bɛayɛ me menli, mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ nwo zo bɛbabɔ me duma, bɛayeyɛ me, na bɛawula me anyunlunyia; noko bɛandie me ne.” Nwanye dwora ne

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile bɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Bɛgua nwanye wɔ nwanye dwora ko biala anu bɛmaa ɔyi. Bɛbaha bɛahile wɔ kɛ bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua nwanye wɔ dwora ko biala anu bɛmaa ɔyi;

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: na bua bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛnlea, mebaye nzabolɛ meado menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ye azo la kɔsɔɔti anwo: Arelemgbunli mɔɔ di Devidi ebia ne bie, sɛlɛvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala banlo nwanye abo.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Na mebava bɛ ti meafifi nwo ngoko, selɛ nee mralɛ mrenya amuala, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Menrɛze anwunvɔne yɛɛ menrɛvavi bie fee; yɛɛ menrɛnyia ahunluyelɛyelalɛ kɛ akee menrɛzɛkye bɛ.” Gyɛlɛmaya bɔ adubɛnwo nwo kɔkɔ

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, bɛdie na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdendɛ! Bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia kolaa na yeamaa awozinli ava bɛ, na bɛandu koti wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo, amaa saa bɛkpondɛ wienyi a yeangakyi awozinli kabii.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛnrɛdie me ne a, mebavea meazu wɔ bɛ adubɛnwo ne ati, mebaye awolɛ meahwi monle kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛhye Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne nuokɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile belemgbunli ne nee ɔ nli kɛ bɛvi bɛ mbia ne mɔ azo bɛdwu aze, na bɛ abɔtile ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ vi bɛ ti ɛdu ɛgua.

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Bɛtoto Dwuda nyiakɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu; awie ɛngola bɛ buke. Bɛvula Dwudama amuala, bɛva bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ nlɔnu.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛnlea! Kɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma vi sɔlɔ nehane ɛlɛba ɛ! Nienwu a mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ bɛwulale bɛ sa nu la wɔ a? Bɛ mboane ngɛnlɛma ne hale nienwu?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa menli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛvale bɛ kɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛma la bie bɛsie bɛ kpanyinli a, bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, duzu edwɛkɛ a bɛkɛha a? Asoo bɛ nwo ɛnrɛfofo bɛ, bɛnrɛde nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Saa bɛbiza bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Duzu ati a edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛsisi me nwo zo a,” anrɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛyɛ kpole, ɛye bɛ nwo zo ɛya, na bɛdua bɛ kakɛ.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Asoo sonla bile kola kakyi ye bile ne, anzɛɛ sobolɛ mɔɔ ɛtane ala a bɛdi la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛkola bɛdi boɛ.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ bɛ asande kɛ abonle mɔɔ ɛsɛlɛ zo anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye la.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mehyehyɛ kɛ mefa meayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo me na bɛhɔli adalɛ nzi.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Medame mumua ne mebaye bɛ nwo zo ɛya meamaa nyiane ahu bɛ.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Menwu bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ, bɛ awuvolɛvalɛ, nee bɛ huhunliyɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛ tuutuulilɛ wɔ ɛbɔ nu awoka zo. Gyɛlusalɛmma, abule ɛbu bɛ! Kenlenzu bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛ nwo kɛde a?

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ nzule ɛhɔne ne anwo hilele Gyɛlɛmaya la ɛne:

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ de boɛ la soa bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ kɛ bɛhɔ azule; bɛba azule ne mɔ azo a bɛnnyia nzule; bɛfa dwora ne mɔ mgbane bɛsia. Nyiane ku bɛ, bɛ adwenle ka bɔ nu na bɛkeda bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ezule ɛndɔ na azɛlɛ nwo ɛwe resee la, nyiane ɛlɛku ɛyazonlɛma na ɔmaa bɛkeda bɛ ti zo.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Ndile ɛnfifi, yemɔti weɛlɛ mɔɔ la kpɔkɛ nu la nriandi gyakyi ɔ ra adɔma.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ nu asoaso fo gyinla awoka ne mɔ azo, bɛdie ɛnwomenle ndɛndɛ kɛ ɛzonlɛ, bɛ nye zo yɛ kisii, ɔboalekɛ bɛnnyia ndile bɛnli.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: Akee me menli ne bazu avɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbu ɛzia yɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, keha ɛ nwo wɔ wɔ duma ne ati. Yɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛzi wɔ fane dɔɔnwo, yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ anyelazo a le wɔ, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɔkyele zo a ɛdie yɛ la, duzu ati a wɔyɛ ɛ nwo ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ adendulɛnli bie mɔɔ makyi ala kenle ko ahɔ a?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu, anzɛɛ wɔyɛ kɛ katakyie mɔɔ ɛngola ngoane die ɛ? Noko O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nee yɛ de, yɛɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ yɛ a; mmagyakyi yɛ.’ ”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ anwo la ɛne: “Bɛ kunlu dwo kɛ bɛkɛluolua nuhua zɔhane. Bɛtɛfule bɛ nwo, yemɔti medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, menrɛdɛne bɛ zo. Menea bɛ ɛtane nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo meadea bɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Anrɛɛ mmayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Saa bɛkye nwolɛ ɛhɔne bɔbɔ a, menrɛdie bɛ ɛzunlɛ, yɛɛ saa bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛba me nyunlu a, me nye ɛnrɛzɔ ye. Mebava mealua konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ anwonyane nu meayela bɛ wee.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, “Awulae Nyamenle, nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ka kile bɛ la a le kɛ, ‘Konle ɛnrɛdo bɛ; yɛɛ ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ; anzonudwolɛ ala a mebava meamaa bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ɛlɛbɔ me duma aha adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ. Meanzoa bɛ, yɛɛ me nee bɛ andendɛ bɔbɔ. Adalɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ, menli munzule ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ti anu a bɛbɔ bɛka ɛhye mɔ bɛkile bɛ a.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Yemɔti medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka meahile bɛdabɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ me duma ɛlɛka nrɛlaleɛ, noko tɛ medame a menzoanle bɛ, na bɛka kɛ, ‘Konle nee ɛhɔne ɛnrɛra azɛlɛ ɛhye azo ɛlɛ,’ la kɛ konle nee ɛhɔne nu yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma zɔhane badɔ a.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Bɛbahu menli ne mɔɔ bɛka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛkile bɛ la noko wɔ konle nu, yɛɛ bie mɔ bawu ɛhɔne nu: bɛdabɛ, bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mra mrenya, yɛɛ bɛ mra mraalɛ. Mebamaa bɛ munzule abɔ bɛ ti. Bɛbawu bɛagua Gyɛlusalɛm guabile zo. Bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛzie bɛ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ menga me nyane mengile menli ne mɔ kɛ: “Mesu meamaa monle abia me takaa alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ. Menrɛgyakyi ɛzunlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbodɛboda me menli ne, bɛanzuzu bɛamboda bɛ.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Saa mebɔ me ti ɛbɔkunlu a, konle nu avunli ngome; meba suakpole ne azo a, ɛhɔne ɛlɛku menli ne agua bɛ lɔ. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma ɛlɛyɛ bɛ gyima, noko bɛnze mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la.” Menli ne su abodo Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, yemɔti wɔye Dwudama bɔkɔɔ? Asoo ɛkyi Zayɔnoma? Duzu ati a wɔboda yɛ kpole zɛhae mɔɔ yɛyɛ ayile a yɛ nwo ɛnza ɛ? Yɛkpondɛle anzonudwolɛ, noko kpalɛ amba, yɛkpondɛle anwonzalɛ, na nea, ɛzulolɛ a rale a.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Ɔlua wɔ duma ne ati, mmakpo yɛ; mmasɛkye wɔ anyunlunyia belemgbunli ebia ne duma; kakye yɛ na mmatulu wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ kyekyele la.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Asoo maanle maanle ne mɔ nyamenle ne mɔ kola tɔ ezule? Asoo anwomanyunlu angome kola tɔ ezule? Tɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a tɔ ezule a? Yɛ anyelazo a le wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala a.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Saa Mosisi nee Samoɛle bɔbɔ bagyinla me nyunlu kpa kyɛlɛ a, menrɛva menli ɛhye mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ menrɛhyɛ bɛ ɛlɛ. Ye bɛ fi me nye zo,

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Saa bɛbiza wɔ kɛ nienwu ɛleka a bɛhɔ a, bua bɛ kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛ nuhua mɔɔ fɛta anwonyane la bawu anwonyane nu, bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ tɔ dadeɛ nloa la badɔ dadeɛ nloa; bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ wu ɛhɔne nu la bawu ɛhɔne nu, yɛɛ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ fɛta nuokɛhyelɛ la, bɛbahye ye nuokɛ bɛahɔ.

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ninyɛne mgbole nna asisi bɛ nwo zo azɛkye bɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Bɛbahu bɛ konle nu, ahwea batete bɛ avunli, nloma basuso bɛ nwonane, yɛɛ nanemgbole bali bɛ nwonane bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Mebamaa maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la kɔsɔɔti ahonle adu wɔ bɛ ti wɔ mɔɔ Hɛzikaya ara nrenya Manasɛ, Dwuda belemgbunli ne yɛle wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ati.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyɛlusalɛmma, nwane a banwu bɛ anwunvɔne a? Nwane a bazu bɛ a? Nwane bɔbɔ a bagyinla abiza bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
