translation_verse: Bɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, atua ala a bɛte a, yemɔti a medende me sa metia bɛ na mezɛkye bɛ a; akee mezi bɛ nwo abotane mevɛ.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Me menli ne anvi bɛ ninyɛndane nwo, yemɔti mehu bɛ, mezɛkye bɛ; meva me akegyebɛ ne mehegye bɛ wɔ suakpole biala azo wɔ maanle ye anu.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Memaa azɛlɛ ne azo ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛzo ɛdɛla ɛnweazo anwea. Mezɛkye mgbavolɛ ewia henlema memaa mrɛladane ɛyɛ anwunvɔne; memaa bɛ ɛbolɛ ɛde, ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ arɛlevilɛ nu.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole mralɛ nsuu la, nyane ngome ɛmaa ɔ nye zo ɛbulu. Ye sɛnzɛne lunle ewia henlema, bɛbɔ ye anyiemgba, bɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze. Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma ahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Gyɛlɛmaya ka ye nyane edwɛkɛ ahile Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Abule ɛbu me, ɔmɔ, kɛ ɛwole me ralɛ nrenya ɛdole azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ zolɛ le konle nee kpolerazulɛ ngome la azo a. Metɛbɔle awie bosea yɛɛ awie ɛtɛbizale me bie, noko awie biala bɔ me sasa.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa metɛkpale bɛ ti kyɛlɛ wɔ bɛ ɛkpazilɛ nwo, saa metɛbodole wɔ wɔ me kpɔvolɛma ati wɔ bɛ ɛmianlɛ nee ngyegyelɛ mekɛ nu a, ɛnee maa sasa mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ me la ɛha me.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛahɔzonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma wɔ maanle bie mɔɔ bɛnze nu la anu. Ɔluakɛ mame, saa mefa ɛya a ɔle senle; ɔsɔ a ɔnnu ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ, ɛze ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti. Kakye me na boa me. Die me ti na di menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la nzenralɛ. Mmasi bɛ nwo abotane toonwo ɛmaa bɛku me; nwu ye kɛ ɔlua wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ bɛlɛbɔ me aholoba a.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, ɛdendɛle ɛhilele me, na mendiele. Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne manle me nye liele na menlile fɛlɛko; ɔlua zolɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ me a.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Meandɛnla menli mɔɔ akunlu ɛdwo bɛ nwo na bɛdi fɛlɛko la avinli meanga meanzele. Mendɛnlanle koonwu, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɛ sa la me nwo zo, yɛɛ wɔmaa ɛya ɛwolo me.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Duzu ati a me anwofofolɛ ne ɛngyakyi ɛ? Duzu ati a me hanlɛ ye ɛyɛ kukulabi, mɔɔ meyɛ ye ayile a ɔngɔ a? Mmabɛlɛbɛla me kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na asesa la.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ, “Saa ɛsia ɛ nzi a, mebalie wɔ na wɔazia wɔayɛ me sonvolɛ. Saa wɔanva ɛ nloa wɔanga mgbane mgbane, na ɛfa ɛka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ a, mebayɛ wɔ me kpɔmanvolɛ. Menli ne bazia aradoa wɔ na tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbahɔdoa bɛ a.

english_verse: because I am making you strong, like a bronze wall. They are evil and violent, but when they attack,
translation_verse: Mebamaa wɔayɛ kɛ bane mɔɔ bɛva kɔbele bɛdo la wɔ menli ne akɔme nu. Bɛbava konle bɛadoa wɔ, na bɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, ɔluakɛ me nee wɔ lua kɛ medie wɔ na mealie wɔ ngoane. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebalie wɔ meavi amumuyɛma nee kɔdiawuma asa anu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me, ɔse,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Mmagya raalɛ, ɛwo mraalɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ ɛgua ɛke.

english_verse: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ melɛ edwɛkɛ meka mekile wɔ wɔ mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛwo bɛ ɛke nee bɛ awovolɛma ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Ewule ɛzulolɛ bie a bahu bɛ a. Bɛwu a bɛnrɛzu bɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛzie bɛ; bɛ avunli bagua azɛlɛ ye azo mgbane mgbane akpɔlɔ. Bɛbahu bie mɔ konle nu, yɛɛ ɛhɔne ngome bahu bie mɔ; bɛ avunli bayɛ nloma nee nanemgbole aleɛ.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Mmakɔ awuke mɔɔ ɛzɛne ɛdɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu. Mmakɔsu awie biala, ɔluakɛ meye me anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle menli ɛhye mɔ la. Melie me anwunvɔnezelɛ ne, me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee me anzonudwolɛ mevi menli ɛhye mɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ lɛ bie nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie, mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo la amuala bawu. Bɛnrɛzie bɛ yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛzu bɛ anzɛɛ ɛnrɛbodɛboda ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɛnrɛkpa ɔ ti ɛnrɛli nyane ɛnrɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnrɛva debie ɛnrɛdende sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛsu awie la anyunlu kɛ ɔfa yeakyekye ɔ rɛle, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛkyekye awie arɛle kɛ yeminli ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli la.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: “Mmawolo awuke mɔɔ bɛlɛdi, bɛanlo, bɛalie bɛ nye la anu, ɛkɔtɛnla aze ɛ nee bɛ di, no.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Nea, mebadu anyelielɛ anzɛɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ bo wɔ maanle ye anu wɔ ɛdawɔ ɛ nye zo wɔ wɔ mekɛ zo. Bɛbagyakyi atɔfolɛlielɛ nee nwolɛ ɛkponledolɛ nee anyelielɛ.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: “Saa ɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛkile menli ne mɔ na bɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua yɛ kakɛ kpole zɛhae ɛ? Duzu ɛtane a yɛyɛ a? Duzu ɛtane yɛɛ yɛyɛ yɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne a?’ a,

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: se bɛ kɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Ɔboalekɛ bɛ ze mɔ ɛkpo me na bɛhɔzonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Akee bɛmɛ bɔbɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa yebo bɛ ze mɔ ɛdeɛ ne azo. Ɔluakɛ nea, awie biala lua ɔdaye ye adenle ɛtane ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la azo, yɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati mebaye bɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo meahɔgua azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ ɛnze zolɛ la azo. Ɛkɛ ne, bɛbazonle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ: na menrɛze bɛ anwunvɔne fee.” Bɛvi nlɔnu bɛsia bɛara

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha kɛ, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti la de aze la.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile sɔlɔ maanle ne nee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, mɔɔ ɔkpondenle Yizilayɛma nu la rale la de aze la.’ Ɔluakɛ mebava bɛ meazia meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu, wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo.”

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, melɛto ɛsalɛ meavɛlɛ fɛlɛkyevoma dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛarahye menli ne. Ɛhye anzi mebavɛlɛ menli mɔɔ di ɛbɔlɛ la dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛahɔhwe menli ne bɛavi awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ awolɛ mgbole ne mɔ avinli bɛara.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Menye dua bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnvea, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛgua me sa nu.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ bɛkyi mmonle ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛzɛkye me azɛlɛ ne. Bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ngome a bɛyɛ ye azɛlɛ ne azo a, yemɔti mebadua bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ye ɛkɛ ne la anwo kakɛ mɔnwo.” Nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ kile diedi mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya lɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle me anwosesebɛ nee me aranemgbole, me ɛvealeka wɔ me anwongyelelɛ mekɛ nu. Maanle maanle vi maanle ti nee maanle bo bariandi araze wɔ kɛ, “Yɛ ze mɔ annyia agyadeɛ kpaziwɔkɛ biala kɛ adalɛ nee ninyɛne mgbane mgbane mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ la ala.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Yemɔti bɛnlea, mebamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu me. Mebayɛ ko ɛhye meamaa bɛanwu me tumi nee me anwosesebɛ na bɛanwu kɛ medame, me duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛva bulalɛ pɛne a bɛhɛlɛ Dwudama ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la a. Bɛva pɛne mɔɔ ati le daemɔn la bɛhɛlɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔ bɛ ahonle nwo na bɛhɛlɛ bɛgua bɛ azukponle ne mɔ abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Bɛ bo zo amra sonle bozonle raalɛ Ahyela wɔ azukponle mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ wɔ baka buzuu biala abo la azo,

english_verse: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.
translation_verse: wɔ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo wɔ kpɔkɛ nu. Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma arave bɛ ezukoa nee bɛ nwo ninyɛne wɔ bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye azɛlɛ ne azo la ati.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ la bavi bɛ sa, na meamaa bɛazonle bɛ kpɔvolɛma wɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛnze zolɛ fee la azo, ɔboalekɛ mame, saa mefa ɛya a ɔle senle; ɔsɔ a ɔnnu ɛlɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ka edwɛkɛ ɛdodo

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se: “Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula sonla nu, ɔkpo me na ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula sonla anwosesebɛ nu la.

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo aziakɛ mɔɔ fifi fienemgbole nu azɛlɛ resee mɔɔ ngyenle wɔ nu na sonla ɛnle zo la. Debie kpalɛ biala ɛnvinde ye.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛva ɔ rɛle kɛwula medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nu la.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Ɔle kɛ baka mɔɔ gyi azule nloa, ye ndinli dwu azule ne anu, ɔnzulo wawaa mekɛ, dahuu ye nya le duhuduhu, ezule ɛndɔ na azɛlɛ nwo we a ɔndwenle nwo, ɔluakɛ ɔso mekɛ biala.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: “Ahonle le mɛlɛbɛla tɛla debie biala, yezɛkye yebo zolɛ; nwane a kɛhola kɛde ɔ bo a?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meneɛnlea sonla adwenle nu na meneɛnlea ye ahonle nu a. Meboa awie biala, kɛmɔ ye ndenle ne mɔ de la, kɛmɔ ye nyɛleɛ ne si kɔ ye la.”

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kpondɛ ezukoa amile nu la le kɛ anloma mɔɔ bobɔ aholonvia mɔɔ tɛ ye a ɔdole la; ɔndwu mgbanyifoa ɛnee yevi ɔ sa, ye awieleɛ nu ɛnee yeyɛ koasea.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne le kɛ anyunlunyia belemgbunli ebia, ɔbɔ ɔ bo la ɔgyi boka kpole zo.

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛma anyelazo, awie biala mɔɔ kpo wɔ la anyunlu gua aze; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nzi bɛsi wɔ la abo zo baminli, kɛ asɛɛ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ munlutu nu, ɔluakɛ bɛkpo wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛle ngoane nzufeanvea la. Gyɛlɛmaya biza Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ me ayile, na me nwo baza; die me, na mebanyia ngoane. Wɔmɔ a ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ a.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Nea, menli ne ka kile me kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne wɔ nienwu? Ɔva ɔrɛla ɛ!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ ɛze kɛ metɛkpole kɛ menrɛyɛ mboaneneavolɛ wɔ wɔ gyima nu. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ vi me nloa anu vindele la vi wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Mmaka me ɛzulolɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛle me ɛvealeka wɔ me ngyegyelɛ mekɛ nu a.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Maa menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la anyunlu ɛgua aze, na mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze. Maa bɛ ahonle ɛdu, na mmamaa me ahonle tu. Maa munzule ɛdo bɛ na bɔ bɛ bo zo fane nwiɔ. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ɛzielɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ezuavolɛ, Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala mɔɔ dua nlenkɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ anu kɔ suakpole ne azo la, bɛdie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka la.

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: yemɔ menli ɛnrɛkpa suakpole ye azo ɛlɛ. Bɛ arelemgbunli badɛnla ehwili nu nee mgbɔnwɔ zo, bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛ mgbanyima banyia tumi, kɛmɔ Belemgbunli Devidi nyianle la.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Na menli bava ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee azubɔlɛ, ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ, yɛɛ moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ vi Dwuda maanzinli nu azuamgbole ne mɔ, nee azua mɔɔ ɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyia Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu, adɔleɛ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo yɛɛ Dwuda nyiakɛ arɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛandie me, bɛanzie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nwuanzanwuanza, na awie biala soa bɔlɛ ba Gyɛlusalɛm a, mebado senle wɔ suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu, ɔbayela Gyɛlusalɛm azua ne mɔ bɔkɔɔ, na bɛnrɛhola ye nua.”

english_verse: The Lord told me,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Gyɛlɛmaya, dwazo kɔ buakɛnwovolɛ ne sua nu, na ɛkɛ ne a ɛbade nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ mefa meazoa wɔ la a.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mendwazole mengɔle buakɛnwovolɛ ne sua nu. Ɛnee nwovolɛ ne ɛlɛfa ye ehwili ne ali adwinli.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Saa nwovolɛ ne nwo buakɛ ne bie na yeanyɛ kpalɛ a, ɛnee yezɛkye ye na yeva ndɛtɛlɛ ne yenwo debie fofolɛ, kɛmɔ ɔkpondɛ ye la.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.
translation_verse: “O Yizilayɛma, asoo mengola menyɛ bɛ kɛmɔ buakɛnwovolɛ yɛ ye ɛva ne la ɔ? Kɛ ɛva ne si de wɔ nwovolɛ ne asa anu la, zɔhane ala a bɛde wɔ me sa nu a.

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ mebadu maanle bie meahakyi ye, mebagologolo ye anzɛɛ mebabɔ ye la,

english_verse: and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.
translation_verse: saa maanle ne anu amra twe bɛ nwo fi bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo a, mebava bɛ ɛtane meahyɛ bɛ, menrɛzɛkye maanle zɔhane.

english_verse: If I promise to make a nation strong,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa mese kɛ meboa maanle bie meamaa yeakpazi, yeagyinla

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: na maanle ɛhye anu amra yɛ ɛtane na bɛandie me ne a, mebagyakyi kpalɛ biala mɔɔ mezuzu ye bɛ nwo la meagua ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ka kile Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Melɛdwenle nwolɛ mearazɛkye bɛ. Awie biala ɛhwe ɔ nwo ɛvi ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane nwo na ɔhakyi ye subane nee ye nyɛleɛ.

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Na bɛbabua wɔ kɛ, ‘Yɛndie wɔ edwɛkɛ biala. Yɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔ yɛ ahonle nu la; yɛɛ awie biala babɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.’ ” Menli ne kpo Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Biza maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛ nwane a ɛde edwɛkɛ zɛhae bie ɛlɛ a? Yizilayɛma ɛyɛ bɛkyi debie ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Asoo ezukɔtweaba ɛnle Lɛbanɔn awolɛ awoka ne mɔ azo? Asoo ye awoka ne mɔ azo nzule yɔlɔkɔkɔ ne mɔ we resee?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Noko me menli ne ɛkpo me, bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne. Bɛdu koti wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu, bɛanlua dɛba ne adenle ne anu. Bɛluolua ahane ahane, bɛanva ademgbole nu.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ maanle ne anu ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ, menli te ye duma a bɛkpobi ye. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɛkɛ ne la ahonle tu na ɔkpusu ɔ ti.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Mebakponde bɛ kɛ aduduleɛ anwoma wɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma anyunlu, saa bɛkɔ ɛmianlɛ nu a menrɛye me nyunlu, mebahakyi me nzi meazi bɛ.” Bɛkɔ Gyɛlɛmaya ati akpamo

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Akee menli ne hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛva Gyɛlɛmaya anwo adwenle, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ a kilehile mɛla ne anu a, na nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ tu folɛ, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne. Bɛmaa yɛdo ye ɛzonle na yɛduodua yɛ nzo wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati menyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ na tie me modolɛ.

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua kpalɛ kakɛ? Noko menli ne ɛvu me nwo kuma. Kakye kɛ menzile membale ɛ nyunlu membamkpale bɛ ti kyɛlɛ kɛ ɛye wɔ ɛya ne bɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɛhɔne ngome ɛhu bɛ mra; maa bɛwu dadeɛ nloa. Maa bɛ ye mɔ ɛyɛ mota na bɛyɛ ahunlanvolɛ. Maa anwonyane ɛbɔ mrenya ne mɔ ɛhu bɛ, na mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛwu konle nu.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Bɛvu kuma mɔɔ bɛmaa meadɔ nu a, yɛɛ bɛzuozua ngane mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahye me a. Yemɔti maa awie mɔ ɛrave bɛ nwo ninyɛne arɛlevilɛ nu, na maa ɛzunlɛ ɛdɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔdɔ dwora, na fa menli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ bie nee sɛlɛvolɛma mgbanyima ne mɔ bie,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: na ɛ nee bɛ ɛpe Foandɛkɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anu ɛhɔ Henɛm Bɔnza, na ka me nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, ‘Dwuda arelemgbunli nee Gyɛlusalɛm ezuavolɛ, bɛdie. Bɛnlea, melɛmaa munzule kpole bie arado bɛ mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛde la anwo babubu ye a.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: bɛzi azukponle bɛmaa bɛ bozonle Beeyale ne na bɛyela bɛ mra ɛke bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu bɛmaa ye. Nyɛleɛ zɛhae, tɛ me yɛɛ menzele bɛ anzɛɛ menlile ye mɛla memanle bɛ a, yɛɛ nwolɛ adwenle amba me ti anu bɔbɔ.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Bɛnrɛvɛlɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye Tofɛte anzɛɛ Henɛm Bɔnza bieko; bɛbavɛlɛ ye Ahunleɛ Bɔnza.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ɛke a mebazɛkye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ biala mɔɔ Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛhyehyɛ la. Mebamaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ kpondɛ bɛ la asa adɔ bɛ nwo zo ahu bɛ. Mebamaa anwomanyunlu nloma nee ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole ali bɛ avunli.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye suakpole ɛhye meamaa menli azulo ɛkɛ. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛze ɛke la akunlu badu na yeahɔsɔ ɔ ti, ɔluakɛ mebazɛkye ye meamaa yeayɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛma babɔ suakpole ne ayia na bɛateta ye ɛzulolɛ nu kpole bie. Ɛhɔne bamaa menli ne apɛ bɛ nwo ahu bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ ali; eza bɛbahu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɔbɔ bɛali.’ ”

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ membɔ dwora ne wɔ menli mɔɔ me nee bɛ hɔle la anyunlu,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: na menga mengile bɛ kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Kɛmɔ sonla gologolo nwovolɛ dwora na bɛfa ye bieko a ɔnva la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebagologolo menli ɛhye mɔ nee suakpole ɛhye a. Bɛbazie avunli wɔ Tofɛte, ɔboalekɛ bɛnrɛnyia azie bɛnrɛzie avunli ne mɔ zo.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Azua mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, Dwuda arelemgbunli azua, yɛɛ azua mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zolɛ bɛmaa anwumaneamra na bɛva nwanye bɛgua bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne la, evinli ɛha bɛ kɛ Tofɛte la.”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛlɛmaya vi Tofɛte, ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle ɔhɔbɔle ye nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo la rale na ɔragyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ na ɔhanle ɔhilele menli ne kɔsɔɔti kɛ,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Melɛfa munzule biala mɔɔ mezuzu kɛ mefa meadea suakpole ɛhye nee azua mɔɔ zuozua ye la amuala wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati la meara, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛnrɛdie me edwɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Yimɛ ara nrenya Sɛlɛvolɛ Pahyɛ mɔɔ le kpanyinli, mɔɔ nea Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la dele kɛ Gyɛlɛmaya ɛlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Na Pahyɛ manle bɛbole Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya na bɛbɔle ye kpanwu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Sɔlɔ Bɛngyaman Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle na Pahyɛ dule Gyɛlɛmaya kpanwu ne la, ɔhanle ɔhilele Pahyɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛnvɛlɛ wɔ Pahyɛ, na bɛfɛlɛ wɔ ‘Ɛzulolɛ wɔ ɛleka biala.’

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Mebamaa ɛ nwo aha ɛzulolɛ amaa ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala. Bɛ kpɔvolɛma bahu bɛ kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɛdawɔ ɛ nye zo. Mebaye Dwudama amuala meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne. Ɔbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ ahɔ Babelonia na yeahu bie mɔ.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛbahye ɛdawɔ Pahyɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra amuala nuokɛ bɛazoa bɛ bɛahɔ Babelonia. Nehane yɛɛ ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne ɛkile bɛ la bawu na bɛazie bɛ a.” Gyɛlɛmaya su ahile Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔbɛlɛbɛla me na meannwu ɔ nzi. Wɔbo me nwo zo, ɔluakɛ ɛtɛla me anwosesebɛ. Alehyenlɛ biala me nwo yɛ ɛzelekɛ; Awie biala si me amgbu.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ biala metendɛ a metea nu, metea meka kɛ, “Konle nee ɛzɛkyelɛ ɛlɛba o!” Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne ɛmaa meyɛ mgbane alehyenlɛ biala wɔ menli nye zo.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Saa meka kɛ, “Menrɛbɔ ye duma anzɛɛ menrɛbɔ ye duma menrɛdeɛdea” a; ɛnee ye edwɛkɛ ne sɔ kɛ senle yela me ahonle nu, ɔwolowolo me mbowule nu; akee meli ye me kunlu mevɛ, mengola.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mete menli azukuedulɛ ne; ɛzulolɛ ɛva ɛleka kɔsɔɔti. Agɔnwolɛma kpalɛ kpondɛ me azedɔlɛ, bɛse, “Tendɛ tia ye! Bɛmaa yɛdendɛ yɛtia ye! Wɔannea a ɔ nye zo bada ye, ɛnee yɛ sa ɛha ye na yɛali ye nzenralɛ.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi me nzi, ɔle konle nu katakyie, yemɔti menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la badu agua, bɛnrɛhola me nwo zo fo. Bɛ nzuzulɛ ɛnrɛyɛ ɛkɛ, bɛ nyunlu bagua aze kpole, na bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɔlɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ sɔ tenlenema nea, mɔɔ ɛnwu sonla biala ahonle nee ye adwenle nu, maa menwu kɛ wɔli me kpɔvolɛma nzenralɛ, ɔluakɛ meva me edwɛkɛ ne memaa wɔ.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma; bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ! Yelie anwunvɔnema ngoane yevi amumuyɛma asa anu.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha kenle ne mɔɔ bɛwole me la! Munzule ɛha kenle ne mɔɔ ɔmɔ wole me la!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Abule ɛbu sonla ne mɔɔ rabɔle egya amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛwo ralɛ nrenya bɛmaa wɔ” na ɔmanle ɔ nye liele la.

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Maa sonla zɔhane ɛyɛ kɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anze bɛ anwunvɔne, na ɔbutule bɛ nye aze la. Maa ɔde ɛzunlɛ nwonlomɔ na ɔde ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ewiazo,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ yeammaa meanga ɔmɔ akunlu meanwu. anrɛɛ ɔmɔ akunlu yɛle me azie, na ɔ ko kpole ne hale ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛwo me, kɛ membanwu ɛvɛlɛ nee nyane, na me awieleɛ ɛyɛ anyiemgba ɛ?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya zoanle Malekaya ara nrenya Pahyɛ nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Zɛfanaya, Meeyasaya ara nrenya ne wɔ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo ɛkɛ bɛhɔzele ye kɛ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛlɛfa konle aradoa yɛ. Yemɔti biza Ɛdɛnkɛma maa yɛ saa ɔkɛlua ye nwanwane adenle ne azo ɔkɛmaa ɔkɛgyakyi yɛ nwo zo ɛralɛ a.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile menli ne mɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Meva ngoane adenle nee ewule adenle mezie bɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdɛnla suakpole ne azo la bawu konle nu anzɛɛ ɛhɔne nu anzɛɛ ewulenzane nu. Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛhɔdane Babelonia ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛbɛnra ɛyia suakpole ye la, bɛnrɛhu ye. Bɛbava ye donvula ala.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meva me nye mezie suakpole ɛhye anwo kɛ memaa munzule ado bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ zolɛ la. Menrɛmaa kpalɛ ɛnrɛdo bɛ. Mebaye bɛ meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne na meamaa yeado senle zolɛ yeayela ye. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Dwuda suakunlu amra ndeanlɛ

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛdi mɔɔ meha la azo nɔhalɛ nu a, belemgbunlililɛ ne bayɛ bɛmɛ Devidi abo zo amra ɛdeɛ dahuu. Bɛ arelemgbunli, bɛ mgbanyima nee bɛ maanlema badɛnla ehwili nu nee mgbɔnwɔ zo dahuu.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛanli me edwɛkɛ zo a, meka medame me ngome me nwo kɛ awuke ɛhye babɔ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me nye zo, Dwuda maanle ne, Geleade maanle ne, yɛɛ Lɛbanɔn Boka, bɛ ngɛnlɛma sɛ, noko mebazɛkye Dwuda maanle ne meayɛ ye ɛsɛlɛ na meamaa maanle ne anu azuamgbole ayɛ azuadu.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Mebamaa menli ava konle ninyɛne arazɛkye maanle ne. Bɛbaha maanle ne anu sida mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bɛagua na bɛayela bɛ.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: “Ɛhye anzi nyɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo vi maanle maanle zo baraze ɛkɛ na bɛbaha bɛahile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdea suakpole ɛhye zɛhae ɛ?’

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpole Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ngyekyeleɛ ne na bɛzonlenle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.’ ” Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle wɔ Dwowahaze anwo la

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Dwudama, bɛmmasu mɔɔ ɛwu la, yɛɛ bɛmmadi ɔ nwo nyane; na bɛzu mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ la kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛzia ɔnrɛra bieko, ɔnrɛranwu ye maanle ye anu bieko.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ka kɛ, “Mesi me sua kpole ko mɔɔ lɛ anwuma ekpumgbunli mgbole”, na ɔkɛduodua ye nvɛnzɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛva sida adaboa bɛbobɔ, na ɔkɛha ye ayile kɔkɔlɛ la.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Ɛdwenle kɛ saa ɛfa sida mbaka ɛsisi azua a, ɛnee ɛle belemgbunli kpalɛ ɔ? Asoo ɛ ze lile, nlonle na ɔlile pɛlepɛle, ɔbɔle tenlene ɛbɛla? Ɛnee noko ye debie biala hɔle zolɛ manle ye.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Saa ɔlile pɛlepɛle ɔmanle ehyianvolɛma, yeambua menli mɔɔ ehyia la mgbɔvondɛne a ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, kɛ me ɛnwunlɛ de la ɛne.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ahonle mɔɔ ɛfa ɛwua menli ɛnyia ɛ nwo, ɛfa ɛka menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya ɛgua, na ɛfa ɛsisi wɔ menli ne, ɛyɛ bɛ amumuyɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha Dwosaya ara Gyɛhɔyakem, Dwuda belemgbunli ne anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Awie biala ɛnrɛzu ye kɛ, ‘ayi me diema nrenya,’ anzɛɛ ‘ayi me diema raalɛ.’ Awie biala ɛnrɛye awolɛ ɛnrɛze kɛ, ‘Me menle o,’ anzɛɛ ‘me belemgbunli o!’

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Bɛbahwenle ye aze bɛahɔvuandi ye bɛado Gyɛlusalɛm kandiba kɛmɔ bɛfuandi asoaso funli bɛto ala la.” Gyɛlɛmaya ka mɔɔ bara Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo la anwo nrɛlaleɛ

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛhɔ Lɛbanɔn bɛhɔzu, bɛhɔ Beehyan azɛlɛ zo bɛhɔzu kpalɛ; bɛhɔ Ebalem bɛhɔzu, ɔluakɛ bɛbɔ bɛ konle nu boavolɛma abo zo.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Bɛkpazile la mendendɛle mengilele bɛ, na bɛhanle kɛ bɛnrɛdie. Subane ɛhye a sumunli bɛ ngakula nu bɛhile a, kɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Anwoma ne bapia bɛ adekilevolɛma kɔsɔɔti ahɔ, na bɛahye bɛ konle nu boavolɛma nuokɛ bɛahɔ nlɔnu. Bɛ nyunlu bagua aze, nyiane ahu bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: O Lɛbanɔnoma, mɔɔ bɛde sida azua nu a, nyane to bɛ a ɛkponlenlɛ mɔɔ bɛbakponle la bayɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ ahonleɛ la. Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛhɔyakɛn anwo zo la

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakɛn le me sa fema kpɔdelera zo tumi kpɔba bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle la, mebakpolo wɔ meavi me sa,

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: na meaye wɔ meamaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ na ɛsulo bɛ la. Mebava wɔ meamaa Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza nee ye ɛlɔnema ne.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Mebavuandi wɔ nee ɛ nli ne mɔɔ wole wɔ la meahɔgua maanle bie mɔɔ tɛ ɛkɛ ne a bɛwole bɛ la anu. Ɛkɛ ne a bɛbawu a.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “Ɛnee Gyɛhɔyakɛn a ɛhakyi dwora ebule mɔɔ bɛkpo ye na awie ɛnva ye bieko la ɔ? Duzu ati a bɛvuandi ye nee ɔ mra bɛhɔgua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛnze la ɛ?”

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: O azɛlɛ, azɛlɛ, azɛlɛ! Tie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛlɛ nrenya ɛhye duma kɛ yeanwo ralɛ, ɔle sonla mɔɔ ɛnrɛyɛ kpalɛ wɔ ɛbɛla nu, ɔluakɛ ɔ mra ne mɔ biala ɛnrɛli ye agya, ɛnrɛdɛnla Devidi belemgbunli ebia ne azo, ɛnrɛzie Dwuda maanle ne bieko ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Munzule ɛha mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ sɛkye me mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ me adidileka ne, na bɛbɔ bɛ asande la.”

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ nea ye mboane ne mɔ la anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Bɛnnea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ, bɛvoa bɛ, bɛmaa bɛzande. Bɛnlea, mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Akee mebaboɔboa me mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti azo, ɛleka mɔɔ memanle bɛhɔguale la anloa mearagua ɛleka ko, wɔ tunli ko anu, na bɛbada, bɛ nwo azo.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ banlea bɛ kpalɛ la; bɛnrɛzulo bieko, bɛ ahonle ɛnrɛdu, yɛɛ kokye ɛnrɛminli. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebamaa tenlene Ɛhane akpakye Devidi sua nu. Ɔbali belemgbunli na ɔ nee ye menli ne adɛnla nrɛlɛbɛ nu, yeali edwɛkɛ pɛlepɛle nee tenlene nu wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Wɔ ye mekɛ zo, Dwudama banyia bɛ ti na Yizilayɛma anwo adɔ bɛ. Duma mɔɔ bɛbava bɛavɛlɛ ye la a le, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlenenli.’

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha kɛ, ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la ati.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛbaha la a le ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la vile sɔlɔ maanle ne nee maanle ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvoanle bɛ ɔhɔle la anu rale la ati.’ Na akee bɛbadɛnla bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ zo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Gyɛlɛmaya nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo la

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Me ahonle mɔɔ la me kunlu la ɛbɔndɔ, me mbowule kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛwozo. Meyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛbo nza la; ɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye edwɛkɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne ati, meyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ nza ɛgya ye la.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Awuvolɛvalɛma ɛyi azɛlɛ ye; bɛ nwo munzule ɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ fienemgbole nu adidileka ɛwe. Bɛ subane ɛnle kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛfa bɛ anwosesebɛ bɛsisi awie mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee sɛlɛvolɛma ɛnze Nyamenle; menwu kɛ bɛdi ɛtane wɔ me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɔbɔ anu.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛ ndenle ne mɔ anu bayɛ siselesisele, ayɛ awozinli; bɛbaheha bɛ bɛahɔ nuhua bɛamaa bɛadu bɛagua, ɔluakɛ mebamaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metea bɛ la.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Menwu ayahanlɛ debie bie wɔ Samɛlea Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo: bɛdendɛle bozonle Beeyale anloa azo, bɛvale bɛminlinle me menli Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Menwu debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma avinli: bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne, bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛsi amumuyɛma adua, yemɔti biala ɛngyakyi amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ; bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛyɛ kɛ Sodɔmma nee Gomɔlama wɔ me nye zo.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka ɛhye wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo: Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛali aleɛ ɛnwonle, meamaa bɛ nzule pɔezen bɛanlo, ɔboalekɛ Gyɛlusalɛm Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛmmaa menli ne ɛnzonle Nyamenle wɔ maanle ne anu.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛmmatie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka bɛkile bɛ la. Bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛkile bɛ, bɛmaa bɛnyia anyelazo mɔɔ kenle bie ɛlɛ ɔnrɛyɛ zɔhane, na tɛ mame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meva mezoa bɛ la.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Bɛka bɛkile menli mɔɔ ɛndie me ne la kɛ, ‘Debie biala bayɛ boɛ!’ yɛɛ bɛka bɛkile awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ kunlu dwo nwolɛ la kɛ, ‘Munzule biala ɛnrɛdo wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ anu boni a nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdu agyinla, ɛnwu ye na yede anzɛɛ yedie ye, na yeli ye edwɛkɛ zo a?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛlɛtu kpole kɛ ahumuakyima. Ɔbahɔgua ye wɔ amumuyɛma ati zo.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne ɛnrɛdwo, kyesɛ yeyɛ mɔɔ gyi ɔ nye zo la. Kenle bie bɛbade ɔ bo kpalɛ.”

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Meanzoa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, noko bɛhɔle. Meanga edwɛkɛ biala meangile bɛ, noko bɛhɔhanle nrɛlaleɛ.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee me dule agyinla a, anrɛɛ bɛhanle me nrɛlaleɛ ne bɛhilele me menli ne; anrɛɛ bɛmanle bɛvile ndenle ɛtane ne mɔ azo na bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Asoo sonla kola fea ɔ nwo mɔɔ mengola mennwu ye a? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese, mewɔ ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, anwuma o, aze o.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Mede adalɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma fa me duma bɔ, ka bɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne la. Bɛse, ‘Meha ɛlalɛ, meha ɛlalɛ’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Kenlenzu a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛhye mɔ kɛgyakyi adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ɛhanlɛ a? Bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka nrɛlaleɛ biala bɛfa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo.

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa bɛ ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka bɛkile bɛ nwo ngoko la bɛabɛlɛbɛla me menli ne bɛamaa bɛ rɛle avi me duma ne, kɛmɔ bɛ ze mɔ arɛle vile me duma ne na bɛzonlenle bozonle Beeyale ne la.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ ka ɛlalɛ la ɛha bɛ ɛlalɛ ne, na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ ka me nrɛlaleɛ ne la ɛha me nrɛlaleɛ ne nɔhalɛ nu.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛbiza kɛ, “Ɛhonle fa ye nienwu a nee awule sɛ a?”

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Me edwɛkɛ ne le senle, ɔle kɛ hamenle mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpukekpuke bodane la.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mekyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka ɛlalɛ adalɛ na bɛfa bɛ adalɛ nee bɛ nloa anu ɛyelɛ bɛdi me menli ne adwenle na bɛminli bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsoanle bɛ, anzɛɛ metɛkilele bɛ debie kɛ bɛyɛ la. Menli ne ɛnnyia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ nyɛleɛ ne azo nvasoɛ biala.” Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Saa menli ɛhye mɔ bie anzɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ anzɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ bie biza wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne a le duzu’ a, ka kile ye kɛ: Mese, bɛmɛ bɛdabɛ a bɛle adesoa bɛmaa me a, na mebavuandi bɛ meagua. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, sɛlɛvolɛ anzɛɛ menli ne mɔ bie fa ɔ nloa fula edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ a, mebadea ye nee ye sua nu amra.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛha bɛhile bɛ nwo ngoko nee bɛ mediema la a le, ‘Duzu mualɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa a?’ anzɛɛ ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha a?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ ne ɛdeɛ, bɛmmabɔ zolɛ bieko, ɔluakɛ adesoa ne a le bɛdabɛ bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ, bɛsi tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ Nyamenle ne la anloa edwɛkɛ ne ati aze.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbiza Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne la a le kɛ, ‘Duzu mualɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa a?’ anzɛɛ ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha a?’

english_verse: But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,”
translation_verse: Na saa bɛka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa ne’, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ meze bɛ kɛ bɛmmaka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma adesoa’ la a,

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: mebavuandi bɛ meagua meavi me nye zo. Mebazɛkye bɛ nee suakpole ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la.

english_verse: You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ nyunlu agua aze, bɛabɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛvi ye kenle bie ɛlɛ a.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza hyele Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakɛn, Dwuda belemgbunli ne, maanle mgbanyinli, yɛɛ dwinvolɛma vile Gyɛlusalɛm hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛ feege ahɛndɛne nwiɔ gyigyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Kɛndɛne ko anu feege ne mɔ le kpalɛ, eza bɛbolo ngɛnlɛma, na kɛndɛne ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la anu feege ɛdeɛ ne ɛnle kpalɛ fee, bɛdi a ɔnyɛ boɛ.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, duzu a ɛnwu ye la?” Membuale kɛ, “Feege ɔ; bie mɔ le kpalɛ, yɛɛ bie mɔ ɛnle kpalɛ fee mɔɔ bɛdi a.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse,

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: “Mebava Dwudama mɔɔ memaa bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la meado feege kpalɛ ne mɔ anwo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, meava bɛ meazia meara azɛlɛ ɛhye azo. Mebazɔ bɛ meamaa bɛagyinla, menrɛmaa bɛnrɛgolo bɛnrɛgua; mebalua bɛ, menrɛdudu bɛ menrɛgua.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ ahonle meamaa bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a; bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ bɛbava bɛ ahonle kɔsɔɔti bɛazia bɛara me ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ feege ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ le mgbane mgbane mɔɔ bɛdi a ɔnyɛ boɛ la, zɔhane ala a mebayɛ Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya, ye mgbanyima nee Gyɛlusalɛmma mɔɔ ɛha azɛlɛ ɛhye azo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la a.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ meamaa yeayɛ maanle maanle amuala ɛzulolɛ. Menli bazi bɛ amgbu, agolo bɛ nwo, agua bɛ nyunlu aze, ava bɛ duma apɛ ɛfenle wɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ menwɔmaa bɛkɛhɔgua bɛ la.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mebava konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewule meazi bɛ zo toonwo meamaa bɛ bo zo abɔ tɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la azo.”

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma soa ye kpɔmanvolɛma la ɛnee ɔsoa bɛ, noko bɛangyea bɛ nzo kɛ bɛtie.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne ka kile bɛ kɛ: Awie biala ɛgyakyi amumuyɛ nee ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ na ɔdɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ dɛbadɛba kɛ ɔle bɛ ɛdeɛ la azo dahuu.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadi nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne nzi, bɛyeyɛ bɛ, bɛsonle bɛ, yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ sa anloa adwinli bɛka me ɛya. Na saa bɛanyɛ ɛhye mɔ a, mebamaa bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: Noko bɛmɛ, bɛandie me ne; bɛva bɛ sa anloa adwinli bɛha me ɛya bɛmaa ngyegyelɛ ɛdo bɛ.

english_verse: You refused to listen to me,
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Kɛmɔ bɛandie me ne la,

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: bɛnlea, meto me sa meavɛlɛ sɔlɔ mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ amuala nee me sonvolɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza, meamaa bɛ nee azɛlɛ ɛhye azo amra nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la amuala anu amra araho. Mebazɛkye maanle ɛhye nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ awie dwu nu a ɔbɔ mgbatike, na meagua bɛ nyunlu aze mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Eza mebamaa bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ nee bɛ anyelielɛ abɔ bɛ, bɛnrɛlie atɔfolɛ bieko; bɛnrɛzɔ kɛnlaneɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛde ɛdibolɛ ne.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti bazɛkye ayɛ mgbane, na maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ azonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛvolɛ abulasuu.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ abulasuu ne anzi, mebadea Babeloniama nee bɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ bɛ ɛtane ti; Babelonia maanle ne bayɛ maanle mgbane mɔɔ ɛnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ a, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Munzule edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ melua me kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo meha, mɔɔ fane maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ anwo, na bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la bado bɛ.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Mebadua Babelonia kakɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nee bɛ sa anloa gyima ti; bɛbayɛ ngɛkɛlɛ bɛamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo nee arelemgbunli mgbole.” Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ bara maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo la

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, die nwanye dwora ɛhye, mɔɔ me ɛya ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la kɔmaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ menwɔzoa wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ la ɛnlo.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Bɛbanlo bɛabo, bɛayɛ tindaanwu ɔlua konle mɔɔ melɛmaa yearado bɛ la ati.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menliele dwora ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma asa anu menvale mengɔmanle maanle maanle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle me bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la na memanle bɛnlonle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda azuamgbole, bɛ arelemgbunli nee bɛ mgbanyima nlonle, amaa menli ne ayɛ mgbane, na azuamgbole ne mɔ ayɛ azuadu mɔɔ menli finde zolɛ a bɛbɔ mgbatike na bɛava bɛ duma bɛawa amonle, kɛmɔ ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɔde la.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Ka kile menli ne kɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Bɛnlo, bɛbo na bɛfefe bɛ nwo toonwo bɛdu bɛgua mɔɔ bɛndwazo bieko a, ɔboalekɛ melɛmaa konle arado bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛlie dwora ne bɛnrɛnlo me ɛya ne a, se bɛ kɛ: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛno!

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, mebɔ ɔ bo wɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ me duma la zolɛ la azo melɛsɛkye ninyɛne. Bɛdwenle kɛ bɛmɛ bɛbava bɛ nwo dwɔɔ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, mebadea bɛ, ɔluakɛ memaa konle adɔ ewiade amra amuala avinli. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: From my sacred temple I will roar like thunder, while I trample my people and everyone else as though they were grapes.
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti tia menli ne kɛ: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea nu wɔ anwuma, mebadendɛ meavi me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne; mebadea me menli ne nu kpole kpalɛ, kɛ sonla mɔɔ twihwi vanye ma nu nzule la meatia aleɛabo amra kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Me ne badwu ewiade ɛleka biala. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, melɛ edwɛkɛ metia ewiade amra kɔsɔɔti. Mebabua awie biala ndɛne, na meahu amumuyɛma. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se munzule ɛlɛkpɔsa vi maanle zo ahɔ maanle zo. Ahumu ɛsesebɛ bie ɛlɛtu vi azɛlɛ ye ati moa moa ara.

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhu bɛ la avunli bagua ye yɛlɛdɛdɛ, ɔvi maanle ti yeahɔdwu maanle bo. Bɛnrɛzu bɛ, bɛnrɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛnrɛzie bɛ. Bɛbagua ye kɛ nyɛmoa ebinli wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mboaneneavolɛma, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ. Bɛmɛ menli ne mgbanyima, bɛzu bɛva nzonle bɛbɔ bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛhunlɛ nee bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ mekɛ ɛdwu; yemɔti bɛbahu bɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la.

english_verse: You have nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. *
translation_verse: Mboaneneavolɛma ne ɛnrɛnyia ɛvealeka; menli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: yezɛkye anzonudwolɛ menli ne bɔkɔɔ, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya kpole.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Ɔlua nzisima konle konle ne mɔ ati Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ɛya kpole avinde kɛ awenade vi kpɔkɛ bo finde la yearabɔ bɛ maanle ne, na bɛ azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee menli ne amuala dele kɛ Gyɛlɛmaya ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara Gyɛhɔyakem bɔle ye belemgbunli ɛlilɛ bo la,

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na bɛhakye kɛ, saa bɛku me a, ɛnee bɛ nee bɛ menli ne amuala ɛva munzule bɛmaa bie ɛha suakpole ɛhye nee zolɛ menli ne amuala, kɛ bɛha sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la mogya bɛgua a. Ɔluakɛ mame, ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a zoanle me kɛ membanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti mengile bɛ a.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse; “Kɔgyinla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie ne anwo, na ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye mɔɔ meva memaa wɔ la amuala kile menli mɔɔ vi Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo basonle Ɛdɛnkɛma la amuala; mmagyakyi kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Wɔannea a ɔkɛyɛ kɛ menli ne badie na awie biala ahwe ɔ nwo avi ye ɛtane nwo. Saa bɛyɛ ɛhye a mebagyakyi ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati mevua kɛ mesɛkye bɛ la.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Saa bɛnrɛdie me ne, bɛnrɛli me mɛla mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: na bɛnrɛdie mɔɔ me sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ mezoa bɛ ndɛndɛ la ɛlɛka ahile bɛ la a,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: mebayɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye kɛ mɔɔ menyɛle Hyaelo la, na meayɛ suakpole ɛhye mgbane meamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ahyi ye.’ ”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔva Ɛdɛnkɛma duma wɔha nrɛlaleɛ kɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye bayɛ kɛ Hyaelo, na suakpole ɛhye ayɛ suadu, mɔɔ awie fee ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ a?” Menli ne kɔsɔɔti bɔle yiale Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ la, bɛvi suakunlu bɛrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛradɛnlanle aze wɔ Anlenkɛ Fofolɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ hanle hilele mgbanyima ne nee menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku nrenya ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ yeha Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ yetia suakpole ɛhye, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛde ye bɛ nzo nu la.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛhakyi bɛ ndenle nee bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ, na bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane, na ɔbava ndeanlɛ biala mɔɔ yeha kɛ ɔfa yeadea bɛ la yeahyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Na mame, bɛnlea, mewɔ bɛ sa nu. Mɔɔ bɛkulo la, bɛva bɛyɛ me.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Mgbanyima ne nee menli ne mɔ amuala hanle hilele sɛlɛvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Ɔnle kɛ bɛku nrenya ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ yelua Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne duma nu a yedendɛ yehile yɛ a.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Na mgbanyima ne bie mɔ dwazole hanle hilele menli mɔɔ ɛyia la amuala kɛ,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Maeka mɔɔ vi Molɛhyɛte la hanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ hilele menli ne kɔsɔɔti kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Bɛbazo Zayɔn kɛ ɛya la, Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ kɛ ewula edukue, na boka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la bayɛ kpɔkɛmile.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Noko Dwuda Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya nee ye ezuavolɛ ne angye ye angu ye. Mɔɔ Hɛzikaya yɛle la a le kɛ ɔkɛli Ɛdɛnkɛma eni ɔkɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛva ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛhyɛ ye. Na Ɛdɛnkɛma nwunle ye anwunvɔne, na ɔvale ɛzɛkyelɛ ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ la ɔhyɛle bɛ. Na yɛmɛ, yɛkpondɛ yɛahwe munzule kpole yɛamaa yɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Na dua soanvolɛma mɔɔ ɛra Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya anwo ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo fa nrɛlaleɛ kɔmaa Yidɔm, Mowabe, Amɔn, Taya, yɛɛ Saedɛn arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɛ,

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Bɛze bɛ menle mɔ kɛ

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: medame me tumi nee me anwosesebɛ zo a melua mebɔ ewiade ye nee menli nee nane mɔɔ wɔ nu la a, na mefa memaa awie biala mɔɔ mekulo la.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bazonle ye, bɛazonle ɔ ra, yɛɛ ye anlɔnra, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ye maanle ne kɛbɔ la. Mekɛ ne, maanle maanle nee arelemgbunli mgbole bava ye ayɛ bɛ akɛlɛ.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: “Maanle anzɛɛ belemgbunli biala mɔɔ anzonle Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛhye, anva ye gyɛnvayile ne ando ɔ kɔme zo la, mebalua Nɛbukadenɛza anwo zo meava konle, ɛhɔne yɛɛ ewulenzane meadea ye toonwo meabɔ ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmmatie bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, bɛ menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa azo, bɛ menli mɔɔ ka ɛlalɛ, bɛ menli mɔɔ bɔ munzule anzɛɛ bɛ menli mɔɔ bɔ bayivolɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɛlɛka ahile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmmasonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne’ la.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ adalɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ a bɛlɛka bɛahile bɛ la, na ye awieleɛ, mebadu bɛ na meavoa bɛ meavi bɛ azɛlɛ ye azo, na meabɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Na maanle biala mɔɔ kɛva Babelonia belemgbunli gyɛnvayile ne kɛdo ɔ kɔme zo, na ɔkɛzonle ye la, mebamaa yeadɛnla ye azɛlɛ ne azo yeadidi zolɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Menganle edwɛkɛ ko ne ala mengilele Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛva Babelonia belemgbunli ne gyɛnvayile ne bɛdo bɛ kɔme zo, na bɛzonle ye nee ye menli ne na bɛnyia ngoane.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a ɛtɛnla ɛkɛ ne wɔamaa konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewulenzane azɛkye wɔ nee wɔ menli ne, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha mɔɔ fane maanle mɔɔ anzonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne la anwo la ɛ?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Bɛmmatie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛka bɛahile bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛmmasonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne’ la, ɔluakɛ ɔle adalɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛsoanle bɛ, noko bɛlɛfa me duma bɛaha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ, yemɔti mebavoa bɛ nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ ahile bɛ la amuala na meabɔ bɛ bo zo.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Akee menganle mengilele sɛlɛvolɛma nee menli ne amuala kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛmmatie mɔɔ bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛlɛka kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala bɛbava Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛzonlenlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛvi Babelonia bɛazia bɛara la, ɔluakɛ ɔle adalɛ bɛlɛbɔ bɛahile bɛ.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
