translation_verse: Bɛmmatie bɛ; bɛzonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne na bɛnyia ngoane. Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ suakpole ɛhye bɔ a?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Saa amgba bɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, na bɛ sa ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ a, ɛnee bɛzɛlɛ bɛbiza medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ memmamaa bɛfa ɛzonlenlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la bɛkɔ Babelonia.”

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛbazoa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛahɔ Babelonia, na bɛbaha lɔ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ la kolaa na meamaa bɛava bɛ bɛazia bɛara ɛke. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi ebia la, ye ɛvolɛ nna ne ala anu, siane nnu ne anu, Azɛ ara nrenya Hananaya mɔɔ le Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ vi Gebɛyɔn la hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma nee menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ,

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ɔkadwu ɛvolɛ nwiɔ la ɛnee meva ɛzonlenlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale vi ɛke hɔle Babelonia la mezia mera Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Eza mebava Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakɛn, Dwuda belemgbunli ne, nee menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ Dwuda bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la amuala meazia meara, ɔluakɛ mebabubu Babelonia belemgbunli ne gyɛnvayile ne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle hilele Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Hananaya wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la kɔsɔɔti kɛ,

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: “Amen! Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɔyɛ zɔhane. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔha la ɛyɛ zɔhane, na ɔva ɛzonlenlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ nee menli mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la kɔsɔɔti ɔrɛla.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Noko tie edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ nee menli ne kɔsɔɔti la.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Ɔvi tete, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ lumua ɛdawɔ nee medame yɛ nyunlu la hanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewulenzane nwo la tiale maanle maanle dɔɔnwo nee arelemgbunli mgbole.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mɔɔ ka anzonudwolɛ nwo nrɛlaleɛ la, saa ye edwɛkɛ ne yɛ zɔhane a, menli ne balie ado nu kɛ amgba Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛzoa ye a.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Hananaya yele gyɛnvayile ne wɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya akɔme, na ɔbubule nuhua.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: Na Hananaya dendɛle wɔ menli ne amuala anyunlu ɛkɛ zele kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Ɛvolɛ nwiɔ mekɛ nu, kɛ mebazi meabubu Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza gyɛnvayile ne mɔɔ gua maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti akɔme la ɛne.” Na Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hɔle ye ɛleka bie.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Meva akɛlɛzonlenlɛ mbulalɛ gyɛnvayile megua maanle maanle ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti akɔme kɛ bɛzonle Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza, yɛɛ bɛbazonle ye noko, ɔluakɛ meva ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole kɔsɔɔti bɔbɔ memaa ye kɛ bɛzonle ye.’ ”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Nea, mebaye wɔ meavi azɛlɛ ye azo. Ɛvolɛ ɛhye anu ala, ɛbawu, ɔboalekɛ wɔbɔ adalɛ wɔmaa menli ne ɛde Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo atua.’ ”

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛhye Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakɛn, belemgbunli ne ɔ nli, suakunlu ɛkɛ ne mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli, Dwuda nee Gyɛlusalɛm maanle mgbanyima, dwinvolɛma nee mbulalɛ nee ezukoa dwinvolɛma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔ nlɔnu la yɛɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hɛlɛle kɛlata ne a.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Hyeefan ara nrenya Ɛleesa nee Helekaya ara nrenya Gɛmalaya a vale kɛlata ne hɔle a. Ɛnee Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya ɛzoa bɛ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Babelonia. Kɛlata ne se:

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛse menli mɔɔ ɔmanle bɛhyele bɛ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la kɛ

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: bɛsisi azua bɛdɛnla nu, bɛyɛ tola na bɛli nuhua bɛyɔba ne mɔ.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Bɛgya mraalɛ na bɛwo mralɛ mraalɛ nee mrenya. Bɛgya mraalɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra mrenya, na bɛva bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛmaa agyalɛ. Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛwo mralɛ mrenya nee mralɛ mraalɛ na bɛ nwo azo na bɛ nwo anga ekyi.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ suakpole ne mɔɔ memaa bɛhɔ zolɛ nlɔnu la boɛyɛlɛ na bɛzɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ bɛmaa ye, amaa bɛdabɛ noko kpalɛ adoa bɛ.

english_verse: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ medame a meze adwenle mɔɔ meva ye bɛ nwo a. Ɔnle adwenle ɛtane, ɔle adwenle kpalɛ mɔɔ bamaa bɛakpazi, bɛ tɛnlabelɛ nu ayɛ boɛ na bɛanyia anyelazo.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Akee bɛbazonle me, na bɛara ɛke bɛarayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, na mebadie bɛ.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛbanwu me. Saa bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala bɛkpondɛ me a, bɛbanwu me.

english_verse: and accept your worship. Then I will gather you from all the nations where I scattered you, and you will return to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mebaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ azo ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛwɔ, yɛɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ memkpondenle bɛ la meara Gyɛlusalɛm, na meava bɛ debie biala meazia meamaa bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ bɛha kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa yɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma wɔ Babelonia.’

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ memanle bɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma melɛka meahile bɛ la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Ka kile Hyɛmaya mɔɔ vi Nihɛlam la kɛ: Ɛdawɔ Hyɛmaya, wɔva wɔ duma wɔhɛlɛ ngɛlata wɔhɔmaa Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala, Sɛlɛvolɛ Meeyasaya ara nrenya Zɛfanaya yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma amuala kɛ,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ wɔ sɛlɛvolɛ kɛ ɛli Sɛlɛvolɛ Gyɛhɔyada agyakɛ anu, na ɛnlea ɛbɔ sɛnvolɛ biala mɔɔ kɛha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la kpanwu, na ɛva bulalɛ kɛba ɛgyela ɔ kɔme.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Na duzu ati a ɛtɛtwile Anatonli Gyɛlɛmaya anyunlu wɔ ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile bɛ la anwo ɛ?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yehɛlɛ yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ Babelonia la kɛ yɛbadɛnla nlɔnu yɛahyɛ na yɛsisi azua yɛdɛnla nu, yɛyɛ egyinli, na yɛli nuhua bɛyɔba.’ ”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Zɛfanaya gengale kɛlata ɛhye hilele Gyɛlɛmaya.

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, soa maa bɛhɔze menli mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la kɔsɔɔti kɛ, ‘Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ye wɔ Nihɛlamenli Hyɛmaya anwo la ɛne: Kɛmɔ meanzoa Hyɛmaya na yeva me duma yeha adalɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ yemaa bɛlie bɛli la ati,

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea Nihɛlamenli Hyɛmaya nee ɔ bo zo amra. Ɔ nwo sonla ɛnrɛdɛnla aze na ɔ nye anwu kɛ mebazi meamaa me menli ne akpazi la, ɔboalekɛ yeha yehile menli ne kɛ bɛde me nwo atua. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: ɔse, “Kɛlɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meha mehile wɔ la amuala wɔ buluku nu.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Akee biza, na nea. Asoo nrenya kola nrenzɛ wo ralɛ? Na duzu ati a menwu kɛ nrenya biala ɛva ɔ sa ɛzɔ ɔ nze kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la ɛ? Duzu ati a nrenya biala anyunlu ɛdo ɛ?

english_verse: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.
translation_verse: Bɛ gyakɔ! Ɔluakɛ kenle zɔhane yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole; kenle biala nee ye ɛnzɛ. Ɔle nyanenwunlɛ mekɛ ɔmaa Yizilayɛma, noko bɛbalie bɛ bɛavi nuhua.”

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ zɔhane mebabubu gyɛnvayile ne mɔ mɔɔ gua bɛ kɔme zo la, mebaye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo na bɛanyɛ ahanra bɛammaa nyɛvolɛ bieko.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Bɛbazonle medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee Devidi abo zo sonla ne mɔɔ mebaye ye meamaa bɛ kɛ ɔli belemgbunli la.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: “O me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛmmasulo, O Yizilayɛma, bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu; bɛnlea, mebalie bɛ meavi moa moa lɔ, mebalie bɛ bo zo amra meavi maanle ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ ahanra wɔ nu la anu. Yizilayɛma bazia ara sua nu, bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ, bɛ nzo nu adwo bɛ, na awie biala ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ lua kɛ medie bɛ ngoane; mebazɛkye maanle maanle mɔɔ memkpondenle bɛ zo la kɔsɔɔti, na bɛmɛ, menrɛbɔ bɛ bo zo; bɛnrɛva bɛ nwo dwɔɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mebazuzu meadea bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle zɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Bɛ ɛbodalɛ ne ɛnlɛ ayile, yɛɛ bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛdukue mgbole.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ nea bɛ a, bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛnlɛ ayile, bɛ nwo ɛnrɛza.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Bɛ kulovolɛma kɔsɔɔti arɛle ɛvi bɛ; bɛndwenle bɛ nwo ekyii bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ ɛli ye kɛ kpɔvolɛma. Medea bɛ kpole kpalɛ kɛ metea me kpɔvolɛ la, ɔboalekɛ bɛ fɔlɛlilɛ ɛyɛ kpole, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbo zolɛ.

english_verse: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli mɔɔ kɛzɛkye bɛ la, bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ, yɛɛ bɛbahye bɛ kpɔvolɛma amuala nuokɛ; menli mɔɔ kɛkpokpo bɛ la, bɛkɛkpokpo bɛdabɛ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ kɛve bɛ anwonyia la, mebamaa bɛave bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Mebayɛ bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile, na meamaa bɛ nwo aza. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, ɔboalekɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Zayɔn ɛyɛ mgbane, ɛnɛ awie ɛndwenle ɔ nwo.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebava Yizilayɛma azɛlɛ ne meazia meamaa bɛ, na meanwu bɛ anwunvɔne wɔ bɛ tɛnlabelɛ nu; bɛbakyekye Gyɛlusalɛm bieko wɔ ɔ bo zo ne, na bɛazi suakunlu ne wɔ ɔ bo zo dɛba ne ala.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde suakpole ne azo la bado moyɛlɛ edwɛne, bɛbadeɛdea nu anyelielɛ nu. Mebamaa bɛ nwo azo, bɛ nwo ɛnrɛha ekyi. Mebamaa bɛanyia bɛ nyunlu, bɛnrɛyɛ koahweabanema.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Bɛ mra bayɛ kɛ bɛ dɛba ne ala la, mebamaa bɛ maanle ne agyinla, na meadea menli mɔɔ sisi bɛ la amuala.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua bie a bali belemgbunli a, bɛ maanlebuvolɛ ne bavi bɛdabɛ bɛ avinli. Mebamaa yeabikye me, yɛɛ ɔbabikye me, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɔdaye ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛbikye me. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne le ahumu! Ɔlɛtu kɛ ahumuakyima, na ɔbaragua atisesebɛma ati zo.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole ne ɛnrɛdwo, kyesɛ yeyɛ mɔɔ yedwenle nwolɛ la amuala yewie. Kenle bie bɛbade ɛhye mɔ abo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ zɔhane, mebayɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛbayɛ me menli.

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: mevi moa moa menvindele bɛ. Mehulo bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la, yemɔti metɛdi nɔhalɛ metɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, mebatete bɛ, na bɛbanyi. Bɛbasesa bɛ ahenle ne mɔ bieko, yɛɛ bɛbazi agole bɛ nye alie.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: Eza bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli wɔ Samɛlea awoka ne mɔ azo; menli mɔɔ balua ma ne la bali ye nzoleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mekɛ badwu mɔɔ sinzavolɛma bagyinla Yifelaem adea nu avɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ wɔ Zayɔn.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea nu bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Yizilayɛ, bɛdeɛdea nu kɛ ɔde maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo; bɛbɔ nolo, bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛze kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie ye menli Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, me nee bie mɔ vi sɔlɔ maanle nu bara, me nee bie mɔ vi maanle ti nee maanle bo bara, anyenzinlirama nee abuburama bara bie, nrenzɛvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde awolɛ zo la amuala bara bie; bɛle maanle mumua a bɛbazia bɛara ɛke a.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma bava ɛzunlɛ ara, mebakyekye bɛ rɛle, meava bɛ meazia meara sua nu, mebava bɛ measianle azudenle nloa, bɛbalua ademgbole fɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnrɛdu koti nu la anu, ɔluakɛ mele selɛ memaa Yizilayɛ, yɛɛ me belamunli ralɛ nrenya a le Yifelaem.

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: O maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛdie me, na bɛbɔ me edwɛkɛ ne nolo wɔ moa moa maanle nu kɛ, ‘Sonla ne mɔɔ kpondenle Yizilayɛma la baboɔboa bɛ nloa, na ɔbanlea bɛ kɛ mboaneneavolɛ nea ye mboane la.’

english_verse: I will rescue them from enemies who could overpower them.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mekpɔne Yizilayɛma, na melie bɛ mevi menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la asa anu.

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Bɛbara bɛarado edwɛne anyelielɛ nu wɔ Zayɔn Boka, bɛ nye balie Ɛdɛnkɛma ahunlunyele ne anwo, bɛ nye balie abɛlɛ, nwanye nee nwole, yɛɛ mboane mralɛ nee nlankɛ mralɛ ne mɔ anwo. Bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ bayɛ kɛ tola nu ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛgugua zolɛ nzule la, bɛ nwo ɛnrɛhyele bɛ bieko.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Mbɛlɛra bazi agole na bɛ nye alie, mgbavolɛ nee mgbanyinli anye balie. Mebamaa bɛ ɛzunlɛ ahakyi anyelielɛ, mebakyekye bɛ rɛle, na bɛagyakyi nyanelilɛ bɛali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Mebamaa sɛlɛvolɛma ne anyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo, na me menli ne akunlu badwo me ahunlunyele ne anwo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛdɛnkɛma se Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mede ɛnelɛ bie wɔ Releema, ɔle awolɛyelɛ nee alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ, Relahyɛle ɛlɛsu ɔ mra, ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛwie wu, yemɔti bɛkpɔda ye a ɔndie.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Gyakyi ɛzunlɛ na kyikyi ɛ nye anwo. Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛvɛlɛ ɛnrɛyɛ gyɛne; bɛvi kpɔvolɛma maanle nu bɛbara. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: So don't lose hope. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛ anyelazo kenle bie, ɛ mra ne mɔ bazia ara sua nu. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: “Mede kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛdi nyane aha kɛ, ‘Ɛnee yɛle kɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ anye abo sɔ la, na wɔmɔ, ɛyɛle yɛ abɛbɛ, fa yɛ kɔ sua nu maa yɛkpazi, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle a.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Yɛkpole wɔ la, nzinlii yɛnlunle yɛ nwo, Ɛdeanle yɛ la, akee yɛnwunle adenle ne. Nyiane hunle yɛ, yɛ nyunlu guale aze, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛle ɛtane yɛ ngakula nu.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛ, ɛle me ra nrenya mɔɔ mekulo wɔ, ɛle ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ ɛla me ahonle nwo. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔva ɛ nwo ɛya la, ɛnee ɛ nwo adwenle gyi me adwenle nu. Yemɔti me nwo dɔ wɔ; nɔhalɛ, mebanwu wɔ anwunvɔne. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: Yɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ fa yɛ adenle ne nzonlɛ, yɛ ye mɔɔ ɛ nye ɛnvo ye la; nea ademgbole ne mɔɔ ɛluale nu ɛhɔle la boɛ. O Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛrɛla, bɛrɛla bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ bɛvi zolɛ bɛhɔle la azo.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi a, bɛsie kenlenzu? Memaa debie ngakyile ɛzi ewiade ye: raalɛ bawowa nrenya.” Kenlebie Nyamenle menli ne ɛkpazilɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Saa memaa me menli ne kpazi bieko a, bɛbaha wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu azuamgbole ne mɔ azo kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ, O Boka nwuanzanwuanza, tenleneyɛlɛ tɛnlabelɛ.’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ badɛnla Dwuda maanle ne anu azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la bayɛ ko. Bɛbayɛ ɛyazonlɛma nee mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ lɛ nyɛmoa a.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Mebamaa awie biala mɔɔ ɛvɛ la alie ye ɛnwomenle, na meamaa mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛhu ye ɛmaa ɔ nwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la aleɛ.”

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Ɔdwule ɛke la, mendunwuele na membukele me nye, na me nye liele me nafelɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ mebamaa Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ maanle nu ayɛ menli nee nane ngome a.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Na ɔbara kɛ, kɛmɔ menlea bɛ memaa bɛdudu bɛ na bɛbubu bɛ bɛgua, bɛbutu maanle ne anye aze, bɛzɛkyezɛkye ninyɛne, na munzule ɛdo bɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebanlea bɛ meamaa bɛasisi azua na bɛalua ninyɛne a.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli ɛnrɛha ye bieko kɛ, ‘Egya mɔ lile vanye ma nyinyianlera, na bɛ mra agye ɛnyia nwolɛ.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Awie biala bawu ɔ ti anwo ɛtane mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo ewule. Awie mɔɔ kɛli vanye ma nyinyianlera la, ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ gye a banyia a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ me nee Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ a.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: Ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ kɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ze mɔ vi Yigyibiti ba la me nee bɛ yɛle la. Ɛnee mele kɛ kunli memaa bɛ, noko bɛanli me ngyekyeleɛ zɔhane azo.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee Yizilayɛma bayɛ la ɛne: Mebava me mɛla ne meawula bɛ nuhua, mebahɛlɛ ye bɛ ahonle nu; mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛayɛ me menli.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛhilehile ɔ gɔnwo anzɛɛ ɛnrɛze adiema kɛ, ‘Maa mengile wɔ Nyamenle,’ ɔluakɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti, kpanyinli o, kakula o, bɛbanwu me. Mebava bɛ ɛtane meahyɛ bɛ, yɛɛ menrɛhakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la bieko. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ maa ewia fi alehyenlɛ nu, ɔmaa siane nee nwɔlɔra ta aledwolɛ nu, mɔɔ ɔka nyevile ne anu ɔmaa ye azɛlɛkye kulu, mɔɔ ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la se,

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Saa ewiade ɛhye mɔɔ mebɔ, mɔɔ gyi kpundii la kɔ awieleɛ, na ɔfi me nye zo bɔkɔɔ a, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma abo zo amra ɛnrɛyɛ maanle bieko me nye zo dahuu a.”

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Saa bɛkɛhola bɛkɛzuzu anwomanyunlu, bɛkɛdudu azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne bɛkɛnlea a, anrɛɛ mebazɛkye Yizilayɛma abo zo amra kɔsɔɔti wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ bara, na bɛbakyekye me suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm bieko, ɔvi Hananili Tawa ne anwo yeahɔkpula Muleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Ɛweɛne ne bala ɛkɛ ne fɔɔnwo toonwo yeahɔdwu boka Galɛbe na yeabele yeahɔdwu Gowa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɔnza ne anu amuala, ɔvi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsie avunli, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛgua ewula, nee azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la azudenle Kedelɔn ne anzi mɔɔ kɔdwu Ɛkpɔnwɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu la kɔsɔɔti bayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza amaa me. Bɛnrɛzɛkye suakpole ne bieko ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya lile ɛvolɛ bulu wɔ ebia zo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya. Ɛvolɛ zɔhane ala ɛnee Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɔdaye yeli ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ wɔ ebia zo.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, ɛnee Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ɛva konle ɛradoa Gyɛlusalɛmma, na bɛbɛnra bɛyia suakpole ne, na bɛha Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya bɛwula Dwuda belemgbunli ne sinzavolɛma sua nu wɔ belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya ɛhye ye ɛdo efiade. Ɔse, “Gyɛlɛmaya, duzu ati a wɔha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ wɔtia yɛ ɛ? Ɛse, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Bɛnlea, mebava suakpole ɛhye meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne, na ɔbava suakpole ne.

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ. Bɛbahye ye bɛahɔmaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne, na ɔ nee ye bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nye bayɛ nna na ɔ nee ye adendɛ.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Babelonia belemgbunli ne bava Zɛdikaya ahɔ Babelonia kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma menwɔhɔkpɔla ye la; saa ɔ nee Babelɔnoma ko biala a ɔnrɛhola bɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya hanle kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: ‘Gyɛlɛmaya, ɛ wuvuanyi Hyalɛm ara nrenya Hanamili baraha ahile wɔ kɛ: Tɔ me azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Anato la, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ nwolɛ adenle ɛtɔ a.’

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me ala la, me diema Hanamili rale me nwo ɛkɛ wɔ belemgbunli sinzavolɛma sua nu ɛkɛ, na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Tɔ me azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Anato mɔɔ wɔ Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ zo la, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ nwolɛ adenle kɛ ɛtɔ a. Zɔhane ati tɔ azɛlɛ ne maa ɔrali ɛ sa nu.’ Yemɔti menliele edwɛkɛ ne mendole nuhua kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛdendɛ ɛhile me a.

english_verse: from Hanamel, and so I did. The price was
translation_verse: Mendɔle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Anato la dwɛtɛ fufule bulu nee nsuu wɔ Hanamili asa anu.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔva wɔ tumi kpole ne nee wɔ anwosesebɛ wɔbɔ anwuma nee aze a!

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Akee menvale azɛlɛ ne anwo ngyehyɛlɛ kɛlata ne mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛsi bɛtɔ azɛlɛ, na bɛzɔ ɔ nloa, boka ngyehyɛlɛ kɛlata ko ne ala bie, mɔɔ bɛanzɔ ɔ nloa la

english_verse: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.
translation_verse: memanle Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke. Bɛlɛke le Masaya anlɔnra. Menvale ngɛlata ne mɔ memanle ye wɔ me diema Hanamili, dasevolɛma mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne ɛdɔlɛ nwo la, yɛɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ belemgbunli sinzavolɛma sua nu ɛkɛ ne bie la kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: ‘Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Fa ngyehyɛlɛ nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ, ko ɛhye mɔɔ bɛzɔ ɔ nloa, nee ɛhye mɔɔ bɛtɛsɔle ɔ nloa la amu nwiɔ gua ɛyɛba nu, amaa bɛahyɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha kɛ bɛbazia bɛadɔ azua, ɛya, yɛɛ vanye egyinli wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo.’ ” Gyɛlɛmaya nzɛlɛlɛ ne

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Debie biala ɛnyɛ se ɛmmaa wɔ, yɛɛ ɛkile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkile menli pemgbenleamgbe, na ɛtea menli wɔ bɛ ze mɔ ɛtane ti. O Nyamenle Bedevinli mɔɔ ɛle kpole, mɔɔ wɔ duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la,

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ le kpole yɛɛ ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole. Ɛnwu menli ndenle kɔsɔɔti anu na ɛnea bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛtua biala kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye ndenle ne mɔ de la.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: Wɔyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo ɛlɛ, yɛɛ ɛtɛyɛ ye ɛnɛ noko wɔ Yizilayɛma nee menli kɔsɔɔti avinli, na wɔlie duma wɔmaa ɛ nwo wɔ ewiade, kɛmɔ ɛnɛ ɔde la.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛluale sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne ɛyɛlɛ zo ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛsalɛ kpole ne ɛyele wɔ menli Yizilayɛma ɛvile Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Akee ɛvale azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ kye aleɛ la ɛmanle bɛ, kɛmɔ ɛvale ɛbɔle bɛ ze mɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛkɛva ɛkɛmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma radɛnlanle azɛlɛ ye azo, na bɛandie ɛ ne yɛɛ bɛanli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. Mɔɔ ɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la, bɛanyɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ. Yemɔti a wɔmaa anwubɛnyunlu ɛhye ɛdo bɛ la.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, Babeloniama ɛbɛnra suakpole ye ɛyia kɛ bɛko bɛava, na ɔlua konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewulenzane ti bɛbali suakpole ye anwo zo konim. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhanle ɛdole ɛkɛ ne la ɛyɛ zɔhane, kɛmɔ ɛ nye dua ye la.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: Noko, O Awulae Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛzele me kɛ, ‘Su ezukoa tɔ azɛlɛ ne maa menli ɛli nwolɛ daselɛ a. Noko akee bɛye suakpole ne bɛmaa Babeloniama kɛ bɛho bɛva.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord explained:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Nea, mame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ Nyamenle ne a; debie biala ɛmbo me nwo zo.

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Mefa suakpole ɛhye meamaa Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza meamaa yeaho yeava.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Babeloniama mɔɔ nee suakpole ye azo amra ɛlɛko la barado senle suakpole ye azo ayela ye, nee azua mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ wɔ zolɛ bɛmaa bozonle Beeyale ne, na bɛva nza bɛye ɛdɛne zolɛ bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne bɛva bɛha me ɛya la.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛziezie me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ me duma la zolɛ la anu bɛmaa evinli ɛha ye.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Bɛzile azukponle wɔ Henɔm Bɔnza bɛmanle bozonle Beeyale, bɛvale bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ bɛbɔle azu zolɛ bɛmanle bɛ bozonle Molɛke. Meanzoa bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye, yɛɛ meanga nwolɛ ɛlalɛ bɔbɔ ɛlɛ kɛ memaa bɛayɛ bɛkyi debie zɔhane na Dwudama alua zolɛ ayɛ ɛtane.” Anyelazo ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne hanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane suakpole ne anwo la hilele me na ɔzele me kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, ɛse melua konle, ɛhɔne, yɛɛ ewulenzane zo meye suakpole ye memaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Akee tie ɛ, nea, mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi maanle maanle mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menvale ɛya kpole la memkpondenle bɛ zolɛ la kɔsɔɔti anu. Mebava bɛ meazia meara maanle ɛhye anu bieko na meamaa bɛadɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ me menli, na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Kɛ mezi memaa munzule kpole ɛhye ɛdo menli ɛhye mɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛwɔkɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ bɛ la kɔsɔɔti bayɛ saleɛ amaa bɛ a.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Menli badɔ azɛlɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ kɛ yedɔ mgbane na menli nee nane ɛnle zolɛ, na bɛva bɛmaa Babeloniama la azo.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛbazu ezukoa bɛadɔ azɛlɛ, bɛbayɛ nwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ngɛlata bɛava bɛ sa bɛawula bɛ bo, bɛali nwolɛ daselɛ na bɛasosɔ bɛ nloa wɔ Bɛngyaman azɛlɛ zo. Ɛhye bara zolɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm afoa nu, wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu awoka ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ Dwuda, wɔ azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo nee azuamgbole mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne nyiakɛ la azo, ɔluakɛ mebamaa menli ne akpazi bieko. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ membɔle azɛlɛ ye, menzieziele ye gyɛlɛɛnye, na me duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma la, mese:

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: Bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ me, na mebalie zolɛ; mebaha ninyɛne mgbole nee mɔɔ vea mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle bɛ ɛlɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: Mebamaa Dwudama nee Yizilayɛma akpazi, na bɛayɛ kɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ dɛba ne bɛde la.

english_verse: They sinned and rebelled against me, but I will forgive them and take away their guilt.
translation_verse: Mebava bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ me nee me nwo atua mɔɔ bɛde la kɔsɔɔti meahyɛ bɛ, na meade bɛ nwo.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Na Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ anyelielɛ, ayɛlɛyelɛ, yɛɛ anyunlunyia ɛleka amaa me wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anye zo. Maanle biala mɔɔ bade kpalɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa suakpole ye la bazulo, ɔ nwo awozo ye wɔ nyele mɔɔ meyɛ memaa ye nee ɛkpazilɛ mɔɔ memaa suakpole ne ɛkpazi la ati.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Ɛke mɔɔ bɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Yezɛkye, sonla anzɛɛ nane ɛnle zolɛ,’ ɛhɛe, wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm kpalɛ ne mɔ azo mɔɔ ɛyɛ nyanyoo, mɔɔ bɛnnwu anloma nee akɔlɛ la, bɛbade kɛ

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: eza bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛlɛdi fɛlɛko; bɛbade atɔfolɛ nrenya ne nee atɔfolɛ raalɛ ne ane; yɛɛ bɛbade edwɛndolɛma ane kɛ bɛlɛfa moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Bɛbaha kɛ: ‘Bɛva moyɛlɛ bɛmaa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ, ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.’ Ɔluakɛ mebamaa maanle ne azia akpazi. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: Mboaneneavolɛma bazie mboane wɔ azua azua zo, Dwuda nyiakɛ, maanle ne anu awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, awoka ne mɔ abo, Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu, azua mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm afoa nu, yɛɛ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bayɛ mboane ngome. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama la.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu mebamaa tenlene ɛhane afifi Devidi sua nu, na ɔbabua ndɛne pɛlepɛle nu na yeamaa tenleneyɛlɛ ara maanle ne anu.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu Dwuda banyia ɔ ti na Gyɛlusalɛm anyia anzonudwolɛ. Na akee bɛbavɛlɛ suakpole ne ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma le Tenlenenli.’

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Dahuu Devidi abo zo sonla a badɛnla Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ebia ne azo a,

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ le Livae abo zo amra la a bazonle me, bɛava ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, bɛayela ma azubɔdeɛ, na bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa me dahuu a.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me: ɔse,

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, saa ɛkɛhola ɛkɛzɛkye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ wɔ me nee alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ avinli na mekɛ dwu a aleɛ ɛnrɛhye yɛɛ aleɛ ɛnrɛdwo a,

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: ɛnee noko awie kola sɛkye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ wɔ me nee me sonvolɛ Devidi avinli la, amaa yeannyia ɔ bo zo sonla andɛnla ye belemgbunli ebia ne azo. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛnee awie kɛhola kɛzɛkye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ wɔ me nee me sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ le Livae abo zo amra avinli la, na ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛzonle me a.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Mebamaa me akɛlɛ Devidi abo zo amra nee Livae abo zo amra sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ sonle me la anwo azo kɛ anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra anzɛɛ ɛnweazo anwea mɔɔ bɛtia a ɔnyɛ boɛ la.”

english_verse: The Lord also said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, asoo ɛtɛtele mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛka la? Bɛse, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpo mbusua ekpulike nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ɔkpale nu ɔyele bɛ la.’ Nea, ɔlua ɛhye ati bɛmbu me menli ne bie, yɛɛ bɛ nye zo a, bɛnzɔho maanle bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Saa tɛ medame yɛɛ me nee alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ, na menyɛle mɛla mɔɔ sie anwomanyunlu nee aze la a,

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: ɛnee mebakpo Gyekɔbo nee me sonvolɛ Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔ, yɛɛ menrɛmaa Devidi abo zo sonla ɛnrɛzie Ebileham, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra. Ɔluakɛ mebaze bɛ anwunvɔne na meamaa bɛakpazi.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza nee ye ɛlɔnema amuala, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ɔ bo la amuala ɛlɔnema ɛlɛko atia Gyɛlusalɛm nee azuamgbole mɔɔ zuozua ye la.

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, kɔha kile Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya kɛ mese: Mefa suakpole ɛhye meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne meamaa yeado senle zolɛ yeayela ye.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ Zɛdikaya, ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ; bɛbahye wɔ bɛahɔmaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne. Ɛ nee ye bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nye bayɛ nna na ɛ nee ye adendɛ; na ɔbava wɔ yeahɔ Babelonia.

english_verse: Zedekiah, I promise that you won't die in battle.
translation_verse: O Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya, tie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma melɛka ye ɛ nwo la. Ɛnrɛwu dadeɛ nloa.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: Ɛbawu anzonudwolɛ nu. Na bɛbakpumgbu wɔ ayile evuanlɛ kɛ mɔmoane bɛkpumgbunle ɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ lumuale lile ebia ne la na bɛazu bɛaye awolɛ kɛ, ‘Aa, yɛ menle!’ Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ meha a.”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti hilele Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema nee Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛha la azo amra gua konle zo. Azuamgbole ne mɔ a le Leekehye nee Azikaa mɔɔ bɛhye nwolɛ ɛhane la. Bɛbɛlɛbɛla ahanra ne mɔ

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Menli ne nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti liele ngyehyɛlɛ ne dole nu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala dwula ye ahanra mrenya anzɛɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ bɛ ahanra bieko ɛlɛ a. Yemɔti bɛdwulale bɛ.

english_verse: But those slave owners changed their minds and forced their former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Noko nzinlii bɛnyianle adwenle fofolɛ, bɛziale bɛ nzi bɛhyele mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛdwula bɛ la na bɛyɛle bɛ ahanra.

english_verse: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya. Ɔse,

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Mekɛ mɔɔ menyele bɛ nlenya mɔ menvile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la, me nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ na menzele kɛ,

english_verse: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me,
translation_verse: ɛvolɛ nsuu biala awie biala mɔɔ ɛdɔ ɔ diema Hibulunli kɛ ɔle kanra na yezonle ye ɛvolɛ nsia la, ɔwɔ kɛ gyakyi ye bɔkɔɔ maa ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔdi. Noko bɛ nlenya mɔ andie me ne anzɛɛ bɛampili me bɔbɔ.

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Nzinlii bɛnyianle adwenle ngakyile na bɛguale me duma ne anwo evinli. Bɛ nuhua ko biala ziale ɔ nzi hyele ye ahanra mrenya nee mraalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnyia bɛ ti kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ la ɔ nee bɛ rale na bɛrayɛle ye ahanra bieko.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛandie me edwɛkɛ. Mɔɔ bɛkyekyele bɛhyele ɔ bo kɛ bɛdwula bɛ mediema ahanra ne mɔ la, bɛtulu ye. Yemɔti bɛnlea, mame, medwula bɛmɛ kɛ bɛli bɛ ti; medwula bɛ kɛ bɛhɔwu konle nu, anwonyane nu, yɛɛ ɛhɔne nu. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Debie mɔɔ mebava meayɛ bɛ la, ewiade ye anu, maanle biala mɔɔ kɛde la, ɛzulolɛ baha ye.

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakem de ebia ne azo la. Ɔse,

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, kɔ Rilikabema ɛkɛ ne, ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔdendɛ, na fa bɛ bɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ ko anu, na maa bɛ nwanye bɛnlo.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menvale Habazenaya anlɔnra Gyeeyazanaya mɔɔ ɔ ze bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛlɛmaya la, ɔ mediema mrenya, ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ amuala, yɛɛ Rilikabema amuala membale.

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: Menvale bɛ mengɔle Yegedalaya ara nrenya, Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Heenan ekpumgbunli ne anu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Sua ɛhye zua suakunlu mgbanyima ne mɔ sua ɛdeɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔwɔ Hyalɛm ara nrenya Meeyasaya mɔɔ le anlenkɛ sinzavolɛ la sua ɛdeɛ ne anwuma.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
translation_verse: Akee menvale agbɔ mɔɔ nwanye ɛyiyi bɛ tetɛkɛɛ la nee nwolɛ ahɔpo menziele bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ, na menzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlo nwanye.”

english_verse: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, “Don't ever drink wine
translation_verse: Na bɛbuale kɛ, “Yɛnrɛnlo nwanye biala, ɔboalekɛ yɛ nlenya Rilikabe bɔle yɛ ze Dwɔnadabe kɔkɔ kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ o, bɛ bo zo amra o, biala mmafa nwanye ka ɔ nloa ɛlɛ;

english_verse: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.”
translation_verse: bɛmmasisi azua, bɛmmadua aleɛ, bɛmmadua vanye anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ vanye egyinli. Bɛdɛnla ndanlɛ azua nu dahuu, amaa bɛadɛnla azɛlɛ ye azo bɛahyɛ.’

english_verse: except now we have to live inside Jerusalem because Nebuchadnezzar has taken over the countryside with his army from Babylonia and Syria.
translation_verse: Na mekɛ mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ravale maanle ne la yɛzele kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na anrɛɛ Babelonia nee Selea ɛlɔnema kɛgyegye yɛ.’ Yemɔti a yɛde Gyɛlusalɛm ɛnɛ la.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, want you to learn a lesson
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Kɔbiza Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ bɛnrɛde folɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛdie me ne ɔ?

english_verse: from the Rechabite clan. Their ancestor Jonadab told his descendants never to drink wine, and to this very day they have obeyed him. But I have spoken to you over and over, and you haven't obeyed me!
translation_verse: Rilikabe ara nrenya Dwɔnadabe mɛla mɔɔ vale manle ɔ mra ne mɔ kɛ bɛmmano nza la, bɛli zolɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa bɛ ze. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, medendɛ mehile bɛ toonwo, na bɛanva.

english_verse: You refused to listen to my prophets, who kept telling you, “Stop doing evil and worshiping other gods! Start obeying the Lord, and he will let you live in this land he gave your ancestors.”
translation_verse: Mezoa me sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɛ nwo mekɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ bɛraze bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛgyakyi nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ; awie biala ɛhakyi ye subane. Bɛmmakɔdi nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne nzi bɛsonle bɛ, na bɛkɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la azo.’ Noko bɛandie me ne.

english_verse: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me,
translation_verse: Rilikabe ara Dwɔnadabe amra ne mɔ ɛli edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze hanle hilele bɛ la azo, na bɛmɛ, bɛandie me ne.

english_verse: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Makes a Promise to the Rechabites
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese, mebamaa munzule biala mɔɔ meha kɛ memaa yeado Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala la ado bɛ, ɔboalekɛ medendɛ mehile bɛ, na bɛandie, mevɛlɛ bɛ, na bɛanzulo.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: “I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab,
translation_verse: Na Gyɛlɛmaya zele Rilikabema kɛ, “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ bɛdie bɛ ze Dwɔnadabe ane, bɛli ye mɛla ne amuala azo, bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔzele bɛ la amuala la ati,

english_verse: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.”
translation_verse: medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Rilikabe ara Dwɔnadabe abo zo ralɛ nrenya bazonle me dahuu.’ ”

english_verse: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Dwosaya ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakem lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ ebia zo la Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye hilele Gyɛlɛmaya.

english_verse: since the time Josiah was king, I have been speaking to you about Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Now, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you,
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Fa nwoma na bɔ ye Belemgbunli Dwosaya mekɛ zo kɛlɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ meha mehile wɔ, mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ, Dwuda, yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti toonwo mɔɔ badwu ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.”
translation_verse: Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ saa Dwudama te kɛ mebazi meazɛkye bɛ la a, bɛ nuhua ko biala bagyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ, na meava bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ meahyɛ bɛ.”

english_verse: I sent for Baruch son of Neriah and asked him to help me. I repeated everything the Lord had told me, and Baruch wrote it all down on a scroll.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya vɛlɛle Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke, na ɔhanle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛhile ye la kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Bɛlɛke hɛlɛle bɛ nwoma zo.

english_verse: Then I said, Baruch, the officials refuse to let me go into the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛlɛmaya zele Bɛlɛke kɛ, “Bɛdua me kɛ memmakɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bieko.

english_verse: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɔ ɛkɛ ne kenle mɔɔ bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne la, ɛkɔkenga Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ meha memaa wɔhɛlɛ la ɛkile menli ne kɔsɔɔti. Eza kenga kile Dwudama mɔɔ vi bɛ azua zo kɛra la amuala.

english_verse: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma badie bɛ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne, na biala ahwe ɔ nwo avi ɛtane nwo, ɔluakɛ ɛya mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva wɔ menli ɛhye mɔ anwo la le kpole.”

english_verse: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king, the leaders set a day when everyone who lived in Jerusalem or who was visiting there had to pray and go without eating. So Baruch took the scroll to the upper courtyard of the temple. He went over to the side of the courtyard and stood in a covered area near New Gate, where he read the scroll aloud. This covered area belonged to Gemariah, one of the king's highest officials.
translation_verse: Na Bɛlɛke gengale Gyɛlɛmaya edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nwoma ne anu la hilele menli mɔɔ rayiale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la amuala. Ɔgengale ye wɔ kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Hyeefan ara nrenya Gɛmalaya ekpumgbunli ɛdeɛ ne anu a ɔhilele bɛ a. Sua ekpumgbunli zɔhane wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne Anlenkɛ Kpole Fofolɛ ne anwuma. Bɛgenga nwoma ne bɛhile mgbanyima ne mɔ

english_verse: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛgengale Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne amuala na Hyeefan anlɔnra Maekaya, Gɛmalaya ara nrenya ne dele la,

english_verse: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: ɔhɔle belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ, kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne ekpumgbunli ɛdeɛ ne anu. Ɛnee suakunlu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛyia ɛkɛ ne. Bɛmɛ a le Yilaehyama, kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne; Dɛlaya, ɔ ze a le Hyɛmaya; Ɛleneetan, ɔ ze a le Akebɔ; Gɛmalaya, ɔ ze a le Hyeefan; Zɛdikaya, ɔ ze a le Hananaya; yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.
translation_verse: Maekaya hanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔdele wɔ nwoma ne mɔɔ Bɛlɛke gengale hilele menli ne la anu la amuala hilele mgbanyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: the officials said, “Please sit down and read it to us,” which he did.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Tɛnla aze na kenga kile yɛ.” Yemɔti Bɛlɛke dɛnlanle aze na ɔgengale ɔhilele bɛ.

english_verse: After they heard what was written on the scroll, they were worried and said to each other, “The king needs to hear this!” Turning to Baruch, they asked,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ dele nwoma ne anu edwɛkɛ ne amuala la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ na bɛnleɛnleanle bɛ nyunlu. Na bɛhanle bɛhilele Bɛlɛke kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti kɔda belemgbunli anyunlu.”

english_verse: “Yes, Jeremiah did,” Baruch replied. “I wrote down just what he told me.”
translation_verse: Bɛlɛke buale bɛ kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko biala mɔɔ mehɛlɛ wɔ nwoma ye anu la vi Gyɛlɛmaya anloa anu.”

english_verse: The officials said, “You and Jeremiah must go into hiding, and don't tell anyone where you are going.”
translation_verse: Akee bɛzele ye kɛ, “Bɛlɛke, ɛ nee Gyɛlɛmaya bɛhɔkpondɛ ɛleka bɛvea. Bɛmmamaa awie nwu bɛ nzi adenle.” Belemgbunli ne yela nwoma ne

english_verse: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us. Jeremiah's Second Scroll
translation_verse: Akee belemgbunli ne manle ɔ ra nrenya Gyɛlamile, Azeleɛle ara nrenya Sɛlaya, yɛɛ Abedili ara nrenya Hyɛlimaya adenle kɛ bɛhye kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Bɛlɛke nee Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya, na Ɛdɛnkɛma vale bɛ veale. Gyɛlɛmaya kɛlɛ nwoma fofolɛ zo

english_verse: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem yelale nwoma ne mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle edwɛkɛ ne manle Bɛlɛke hɛlɛle zolɛ la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya.

english_verse: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Gyɛlɛmaya, fa nwoma fofolɛ kɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhɛlɛle ye alumua nwoma ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ne yelale ye la azo la kɔsɔɔti bieko wɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.
translation_verse: Ka kile Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem kɛ: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Wɔyela nwoma ɛhye na wɔbiza Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔhɛlɛ ye nuhua kɛ, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la, Babelonia belemgbunli ne barazɛkye azɛlɛ ye na yeahu menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala ɛ?”

english_verse: So I, the Lord, promise that you will be killed and your body thrown out on the ground. The sun will beat down on it during the day, and the frost will settle on it at night. And none of your descendants will ever be king of Judah.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Ɛdawɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem, ɛ bo zo sonla ɛnrɛdɛnla Devidi belemgbunli ebia ne azo ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛbavuandi wɔ funli ne bɛado ɛleka mɔɔ ewia bɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu na ɛbɔlɛ tɔ gua zolɛ aledwolɛ nu la.

english_verse: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!
translation_verse: Mebadea wɔ, ɛ bo zo amra, nee wɔ sonvolɛma amuala wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ti. Mebamaa munzule mɔɔ meha kɛ mebamaa yeado bɛdabɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma, yɛɛ Dwudama kɔsɔɔti la ado bɛ. Ɔboalekɛ mendendɛle mengilele bɛ, na bɛandie.’ ”

english_verse: After the Lord finished speaking to me, I got another scroll and gave it to Baruch. Then I told him what to write, so this second scroll would contain even more than was on the scroll Jehoiakim had burned.
translation_verse: Akee Gyɛlɛmaya vale nwoma bieko manle Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke, kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ ne, na ɔhanle alumua edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ nwoma ne mɔɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem yelale ye la anu la amuala ɔhilele ye. Bɛlɛke hɛlɛle ɔ muala; eza ɔhɛlɛle edwɛkɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhendeɛ ne la ɔbokale nwo.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had removed Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim from being the king of Judah and had made Josiah's son Zedekiah king instead.
translation_verse: Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ziele Gyɛhɔyakem ara nrenya Kɔnaya ahane na ɔvale Dwosaya ara nrenya Zɛdikaya ɔziele belemgbunli wɔ Dwuda.

english_verse: But Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Judah ignored everything the Lord had told me.
translation_verse: Na Zɛdikaya, ye sonvolɛma, yɛɛ Dwudama amuala, biala andie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ la.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to send them back to Zedekiah with this message: Zedekiah, you wanted Jeremiah to ask me, the Lord God of Israel, what is going to happen. So I will tell you. The king of Egypt and his army came to your rescue, but soon they will go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Ka kile Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya mɔɔ manle ɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ ne la kɛ, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne mɔɔ rale baboa bɛ la ɛlɛsia ahɔ Yigyibiti, bɛ maanle nu.

english_verse: Then the Babylonians will return and attack Jerusalem, and this time they will capture the city and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Babelonia ɛlɔnema ne bazia ara arateta suakpole ye bieko aho ava, na bɛado senle zolɛ bɛayela ye.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians will leave as they did before.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo bɛdwenle kɛ Babeloniama ne mɔ ɛnrɛra; bɛbara.

english_verse: Even if you could defeat their entire army, their wounded survivors would still be able to leave their tents and set Jerusalem on fire. Jeremiah Is Put in Prison
translation_verse: Saa kanza bɔbɔ bɛfo Babeloniama anwo zo, bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo, na ɔka menli mɔɔ ɛbodɛboda gua azua nu la a, bɛbadwazo bɛava senle bɛarayela suakpole ye. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Bɛhye Gyɛlɛmaya bɛdo efiade

english_verse: The Babylonian army had left because the Egyptian army was on its way to help us.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne ɛlɛba la, Babelonia ɛlɔnema ne vi Gyɛlusalɛm yele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: So I decided to leave Jerusalem and go to the territory of the Benjamin tribe to claim my share of my family's land.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya dule ɔ bo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ ɔkɔ Bɛngyaman maanzinli nu yeahɔlie ye afoa nu agyadeɛ ɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I was leaving Jerusalem through Benjamin Gate, when I was stopped by Irijah, the officer in charge of the soldiers at the gate. He said, “Jeremiah, you're under arrest for trying to join the Babylonians.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔdwule Bɛngyaman Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa la, Hananaya anlɔnra nrenya Ayelaegya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Hyɛlimaya la zɔle ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛlɛnriandi wɔava ɛ nwo wɔahɔmaa Babeloniama!”

english_verse: “I'm not trying to join them!” I answered. But Irijah wouldn't listen, and he took me to the king's officials.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya buale ye kɛ, “Ɔnle nɔhalɛ, menriandi menva me nwo mengɔmaa Babeloniama.” Noko Ayelaegya andie mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele ye la. Ɔzɔle ye nu ɔ nee ye hɔle mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: King Zedekiah secretly had me brought to his palace, where he asked, “Is there any message for us from the Lord?” “Yes, there is, Your Majesty,” I replied. “The Lord is going to let the king of Babylonia capture you.”
translation_verse: Nzinlii Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya zoanle manle bɛhɔvale ye. Ɔvale ye ɔhɔle ahane na ɔbizale ye saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha edwɛkɛ bie a. Gyɛlɛmaya buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, yeha edwɛkɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma se bɛbaye wɔ bɛamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne.”

english_verse: Then I continued, “Your Majesty, why have you put me in prison? Have I committed a crime against you or your officials or the nation?
translation_verse: Eza Gyɛlɛmaya bizale Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya kɛ, “Duzu ɛtane a meyɛ wɔ, wɔ mgbanyima anzɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛhye me bɛdo efiade a?

english_verse: Have you locked up the prophets who lied to you and said that the king of Babylonia would never attack Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Na wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ hanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ hilele wɔ la wɔ nienwu? Bɛmɛ a bɛzele wɔ kɛ Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛnrɛva konle ɛnrɛradoa wɔ anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo amra a.

english_verse: Please, don't send me back to that prison at Jonathan's house. If you do, I will die there.”
translation_verse: O Nana, mebodo wɔ, tie me. Tie me modolɛ, mmamaa bɛkɔto me efiade bieko wɔ kɛlɛhɛlɛvolɛ Dwɔnatan sua nu. Bɛto me efiade bieko a mebawu.”

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me taken to the prison cells in the courtyard of the palace guards. He told the soldiers to give me a loaf of bread from one of the bakeries every day until the city ran out of grain.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya manle bɛyele Gyɛlɛmaya bɛhɔdole suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne anwo ɛkɛ ne. Kenle ko biala bɛdie kpanwo kunguma ko wɔ menli mɔɔ to kpanwo la ɛkɛ ne bɛbɛlɛ ye. Bɛlɛ ye zɔhane toonwo ɔhɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ suakpole ne azo kpanwo kɔsɔɔti wiele la. Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya hale suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: One day, Shephatiah, Gedaliah, Jehucal, and Pashhur heard me tell the people of Judah
translation_verse: Matan ara Hyɛfataya, Pahyɛ ara Gɛdalaya, Hyɛlimaya ara Dwukale, yɛɛ Malekaya ara Pahyɛ dele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya ɛnee ɛlɛka ahile menli ne kɔsɔɔti la.

english_verse: So the four of them went to the king and said, “You should put Jeremiah to death, because he is making the soldiers and everyone else lose hope. He isn't trying to help our people; he's trying to harm them.”
translation_verse: Na mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle hilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Maa bɛhu nrenya ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ yeamaa ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛha suakpole ye azo nee menli ne amuala asa anu atuto. Nrenya ɛhye ɛnzuzu maanlema boɛ, ɔsuzu bɛ nee ɛtane.”

english_verse: Zedekiah replied, “Do what you want with him. I can't stop you.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya hanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, ɔwɔ bɛ sa nu, bɛyɛ ye kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la, ɔluakɛ belemgbunli ne ɛnrɛyɛ ɛhwee ɛnrɛtia bɛ.”

english_verse: Then they took me back to the courtyard of the palace guards and let me down with ropes into the well that belonged to Malchiah, the king's son. There was no water in the well, but I sank down in the mud.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛhyele Gyɛlɛmaya, bɛsosɔle ye nyɛma na bɛdwulale ye Belemgbunli ara nrenya Malekaya bula ne mɔɔ wɔ suakunlu alie ne anwo la anu. Ɛnee nzule ɛnle bula ne anu, ndɛtɛlɛ a wɔ nu a, na Gyɛlɛmaya minle ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Ebedmelech said, “Your Majesty, Jeremiah is a prophet, and those men were wrong to throw him into a well. And when Jerusalem runs out of food, Jeremiah will starve to death down there.”
translation_verse: “Nana, nea ɛtane kokye mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛ la. Bɛdwula Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya bula ne anu. Ɛhɔne bamaa yeawu ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ aleɛ fee ɛnle suakpole ye azo.”

english_verse: Ebedmelech and the soldiers went to the palace and got some rags from the room under the treasury. He used ropes to lower them into the well.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yibɛdemɛlɛke vale menli nsa bokale ɔ nwo na ɔ nee bɛ rale suakunlu ɛkɛ. Bɛhɔvale adɛladeɛ ndeteleka wɔ ɛlamoa bie mɔɔ wɔ sua ne mɔɔ bɛsie ninyɛne nu la anu, bɛvale nyɛma bɛzɔle bɛ na bɛdwulale bɛ bula ne anu bɛmanle Gyɛlɛmaya.

english_verse: Then he said, “Put these rags under your arms so the ropes won't hurt you.” After I did,
translation_verse: Akee sonvolɛ Yibɛdemɛlɛke hanle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Fa adɛladeɛ ndeteleka ne mɔ wulowula ɛ nvonlɔma anu, na fa nyɛma ne sosɔ wɔ awane bo.” Na Gyɛlɛmaya yɛle ye zɔhane.

english_verse: the men pulled me out. And from then on, I was kept in the courtyard of the palace guards. King Zedekiah Questions Jeremiah
translation_verse: Akee bɛhwenle Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ bula ne anu bɛvindele. Na ɔdɛnlanle sinzavolɛma ne sua nu ɛkɛ. Zɛdikaya biza Gyɛlɛmaya adwenle

english_verse: King Zedekiah had me brought to his private entrance to the temple, and he said, “I'm going to ask you something, and I want to know the truth.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya manle bɛvɛlɛle Gyɛlɛmaya, na ɔyiale ye wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la anloa. Ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Mebiza wɔ edwɛkɛ, na mmafa ɛhwee ɛfea me.”

english_verse: “Why?” I replied. “You won't listen, and you might even have me killed!”
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya buale kɛ, “Saa meka nɔhalɛ ne mekile wɔ a, ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛhu me ɔ? Yɛɛ saa metu wɔ folɛ bɔbɔ a, ɛnrɛva.”

english_verse: He said, “I swear in the name of the living Lord our Creator that I won't have you killed. No one else can hear what we say, and I won't let anyone kill you.”
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya hanle ndane fealera nu hilele Gyɛlɛmaya. Ɔse, “Meka tease Ɛdɛnkɛma ne mɔɔ bɔle yɛ la kɛ, menrɛmaa bɛnrɛhu wɔ anzɛɛ menrɛye wɔ menrɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ kpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ la.”

english_verse: Then I told him that the Lord had said: “Zedekiah, I am the Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I promise that if you surrender to King Nebuchadnezzar's officers, you and your family won't be killed, and Jerusalem won't be burned down.
translation_verse: Na Gyɛlɛmaya hanle hilele Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Saa ɛto ɛ nloa aze ɛmaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ a, bɛnrɛhu wɔ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛdo senle suakpole ye azo bɛnrɛyela ye. Ɛdawɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra banyia ngoane.

english_verse: But if you don't surrender, I will let the Babylonian army capture Jerusalem and burn it down, and you will be taken prisoner.”
translation_verse: Na saa wɔando ɛ nloa aze wɔammaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne mgbanyima ne mɔ a, bɛbava suakpole ɛhye bɛamaa Babeloniama; bɛbado senle zolɛ bɛayela ye, na wɔmɔ, ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ.”

english_verse: Zedekiah answered, “I can't surrender to the Babylonians. I'm too afraid of the people of Judah who have already joined them. The Babylonians might hand me over to them, and they would torture me.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya hanle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Mesulo Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛva bɛ nwo ɛmaa, na bɛpɛ bɛhɔli Babeloniama ɛkɛ la, kɛ bɛkɛye me bɛkɛmaa bɛ na bɛkɛbɔ me aholoba.”

english_verse: I said, “If you will just obey the Lord, the Babylonians won't hand you over to those Jews. You will be allowed to live, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya hanle kɛ, “Bɛnrɛye wɔ bɛnrɛmaa bɛ. Wɔmɔ tie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛzoa me, mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la na ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa wɔ, bɛnrɛhu wɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord has shown me that if you refuse to obey,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhile me, yehile debie mɔɔ saa wɔando ɛ nloa aze wɔammaa bɛ a ɔbara ɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: then the women of your palace will be taken prisoner by Nebuchadnezzar's officials. And those women will say to you: Friends you trusted led you astray. Now you're trapped in mud, and those friends you trusted have all turned away.
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɔle kɛ bɛlɛfa mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛha Dwuda belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ la amuala bɛahɔ Babelonia mgbanyima ne mɔ anyunlu, na bɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Agɔnwolɛma mɔɔ ɛdie bɛ ɛdi la ɛbɛlɛbɛla wɔ, ɛdo wɔ senle nu; kɛkala mɔɔ wɔmi ndɛtɛlɛ nu la, akee bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi wɔ.’

english_verse: The Babylonian army will take your wives and children captive, you will be taken as a prisoner to the King of Babylonia, and Jerusalem will be burned down.”
translation_verse: “Bɛbava ɛ ye mɔ nee ɛ mra mrenya kɔsɔɔti bɛamaa Babeloniama, na ɛdawɔ mumua ne, ɛnrɛva ɛ nwo dwɔɔ. Babelonia belemgbunli ne bahye wɔ nuokɛ, na yeado senle suakpole ye azo, yeayela ye.”

english_verse: Zedekiah said, “Jeremiah, if you tell anyone what we have talked about, you might lose your life.
translation_verse: Zɛdikaya buale Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Mmabɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo ɛkile awie biala na bɛnrɛhu wɔ.

english_verse: And I'm sure that if my officials hear about our meeting, they will ask you what we said to each other. They might even threaten to kill you if you don't tell them.
