translation_verse: Saa mgbanyima ne mɔ te kɛ me nee wɔ ɛrali adwelie na bɛbaka kɛ, ‘Ka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛhanle ɛhilele belemgbunli ne nee mɔɔ belemgbunli hanle hilele wɔ la kile yɛ, mmafa debie biala ɛfea yɛ na yɛnrɛhu wɔ’ a,

english_verse: So if they question you, tell them you were begging me not to send you back to the prison at Jonathan's house, because going back there would kill you.”
translation_verse: ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Membodole belemgbunli ne kɛ ɔmmamaa bɛkɔto me efiade bieko wɔ Dwɔnatan sua nu lɔ na anrɛɛ menwɔwu ɛkɛ ne.’ ”

english_verse: The officials did come and question me about my meeting with the king, and I told them exactly what he had ordered me to say. They never spoke to me about the meeting again, since no one had heard us talking.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima ne mɔ rabizale Gyɛlɛmaya, na ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne, kɛmɔ belemgbunli hanle hilele ye ala la. Yemɔti bɛgyakyile ye bɛhɔle, ɔboalekɛ awie ande adwelielilɛ ne ɔ nzo nu.

english_verse: I was held in the courtyard of the palace guards until the day Jerusalem was captured.
translation_verse: Na Gyɛlɛmaya dɛnlanle suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne ɛkɛ toonwo ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhonle bɛvale Gyɛlusalɛm la.

english_verse: When King Zedekiah and his troops saw that Jerusalem had been captured, they tried to escape from the city that same night. They went to the king's garden, where they slipped through the gate between the two city walls and headed toward the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya nee ye ɛlɔnema ne nwunle bɛ la, bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛnriandile bɛguale ɛbɔ nu. Bɛdule bɛ bo nɔe ne bɛluale belemgbunli tola ne anu. Bɛzenle anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ dua bane nwiɔ ne la anu, bɛluale bane ne avinli bɛvale bɛ ti bɛbɔle Dwɔdan Bɔnza ne anu lɔ.

english_verse: to Ebedmelech from Ethiopia: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I warned everyone that I would bring disaster, not prosperity, to this city. Now very soon I will do what I said, and you will see it happen.
translation_verse: “Kɔ, kɔha kile Yibɛdemɛlɛke mɔɔ vi Sudan la kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Kɛmɔ menzele ala la, mebamaa suakpole ɛhye abɔ, menrɛmaa ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ; kenle zɔhane, debie biala bawie ɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: “Find Jeremiah and keep him safe. Take good care of him and do whatever he asks.”
translation_verse: “Kpondɛ Gyɛlɛmaya abo zo, nea ye boɛ gyɛlɛɛnye, mmafa ɛ sa ɛka ye, na yɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛbiza wɔ la maa ye.”

english_verse: But the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah and took him to the town of Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial, then found him guilty,
translation_verse: Na Babelonia ɛlɔnema ne voanle bɛ na bɛhɔhyele Zɛdikaya wɔ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ ne mɔɔ zua Gyɛleko la azo. Bɛvale ye bɛrɛlɛle Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza wɔ suakpole Relebela mɔɔ wɔ Heemate azɛlɛ zo la azo. Nɛbukadenɛza buale Zɛdikaya ndɛne ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: and gave orders for him to be punished. Zedekiah's sons were killed there in front of him, and so were the leaders of Judah's ruling families.
translation_verse: Ɔhunle Zɛdikaya amra mrenya ne mɔ wɔ ɔdaye Zɛdikaya ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne; eza ɔhunle Dwuda menli titile ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Then his eyes were poked out, and he was put in chains, so he could be dragged off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Akee ɔdudule Zɛdikaya anye, ɔguale ye anga kɛ bɛva ye bɛhɔ Babelonia.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the Babylonian army had burned the houses in Jerusalem, including the royal palace, and they had broken down the city walls.
translation_verse: Babeloniama ne yelale belemgbunli ne awuke ne, bɛyelale ezuavolɛ ne mɔ azua ne mɔ na bɛbubule Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guards, led away everyone from the city as prisoners, even those who had deserted to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Na Babelonia ɛlɔnema kpanyinli Nɛbuzaladan vale menli mɔɔ hale suakpole ne azo, nee menli mɔɔ ɛva bɛ nwo ɛmaa ye dɛba la hɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia.

english_verse: Only the poorest people who owned no land were left behind in Judah, and Nebuzaradan gave them fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Ɔgyakyile Dwudama mɔɔ le ehyianvolɛma kpalɛ kpalɛ la bie mɔ wɔ maanle ne anu na ɔmanle bɛ vanye egyinli nee azɛlɛ. Bɛdwula Gyɛlɛmaya

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar had given the following orders to Nebuzaradan:
translation_verse: Na Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza zele sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan kɛ,

english_verse: Nebuzaradan, Nebushazban, Nergal Sharezer, and the other officers of King Nebuchadnezzar
translation_verse: Yemɔti sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan, Nɛbu Hyazeban, Nɛgale Salizɛ, yɛɛ Babelonia mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala

english_verse: sent some of their troops to bring me from the courtyard of the royal palace guards. They put me in the care of Gedaliah son of Ahikam and told him to take me to my home. And so I was allowed to stay with the people who remained in Judah. The Lord Promises To Protect Ebedmelech
translation_verse: zoanle manle bɛhɔvale Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Nɛbuzaladan, sinzavolɛma sua nu ɛkɛ bɛhɔmanle bɛ. Bɛvale ye bɛwulale Hyeefan anlɔnra Gɛdalaya, Ahaekam ara nrenya ne asa anu kɛ ɔva ye ɔhɔ sua nu, na ɔnlea ye. Yemɔti ɔ nee menli ne mɔ dɛnlanle. Yibɛdemɛlɛke anyelazo

english_verse: While I was a prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guard, the Lord told me to say
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔla efiade wɔ suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne ɛkɛ la. Ɔse,

english_verse: But because you trusted me, I will protect you from the officials of Judah, and when Judah is struck by disaster, I will rescue you and keep you alive. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ, nɔhalɛ, mebalie wɔ, bɛnrɛhu wɔ. Ɛbavi ɛsalɛ wɔ konle ne anu, ɔboalekɛ wɔva ɛ rɛle wɔwula me nu. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I was led away in chains along with the people of Judah and Jerusalem who were being taken to Babylonia. Nebuzaradan was the officer in charge of the guard, and while we were stopped at Ramah, the Lord caused him to set me free.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan dwulale Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Releema la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele ye. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛlɛmaya boka Gyɛlusalɛmma nee Dwudama mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ anga bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la anwo.

english_verse: But they continued to rebel against him, and now he has punished them just as he threatened.
translation_verse: amgba yemaa yeyɛ zɔhane na yeyɛ mɔɔ ɔzele la. Kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ɛtane bɛtiale Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛandie ɔ ne la yɛɛ yemaa ɛhye ɛzi bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: Today I am taking the chains off your wrists and setting you free! If you want to, you can come with me to Babylonia, and I will see that you are taken care of. Or if you decide to stay here, you can go wherever you wish.
translation_verse: Nea, melɛye anga ne mɔɔ gua ɛ sa la ɛnɛ kenle ye. Saa ɛnea na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ nee me kɛhɔ Babelonia a, ɛnee maa yɛhɔ na mebanlea wɔ gyɛlɛɛnye. Saa ɛnea noko na ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ ɛ nee me kɛhɔ Babelonia a, ɛnee mmaba. Nea, azɛlɛ ne amuala a la ɛkɛ ne tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ la, tɛnla ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ na ɔfɛta kɛ ɛtɛnla la.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar has chosen Gedaliah to rule Judah. You can live near Gedaliah, and he will provide for you, or you can live anywhere else you choose. Nebuzaradan gave me a supply of food, then let me leave.
translation_verse: Nɛbuzaladan hanle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Saa ɛkulo kɛ ɛtɛnla ɛke a ɛnee sia na ɛ nee Hyeefan anlɔnra Gɛdalaya, Ahaekam ara nrenya ne ɛhɔdɛnla. Gɛdalaya a Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛyɛ ye amɛnlado kɛ ɔnlea Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo a. Ɛ nee ye nee menli ne ɛhɔdɛnla, anzɛɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkulo kɛ ɛkɔtɛnla la, kɔdɛnla.” Akee ɔmanle Gyɛlɛmaya aleɛ nee ahyɛlɛdeɛ na ɔmanle ɔhɔle.

english_verse: I decided to stay with the people of Judah, and I went to live near Gedaliah in Mizpah. The Harvest Is Brought In
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlɛmaya hɔle Ahaekam ara nrenya Gɛdalaya anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Mezepa, na ɔ nee ye nee menli mɔɔ bɛgyakyi bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo la hɔdɛnlanle. Dwuda Amɛnlado Gɛdalaya (

english_verse: Gedaliah told them, “There's no need to be afraid of the Babylonians. Everything will be fine, if we live peacefully and obey King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Hyeefan anlɔnra Gɛdalaya, Ahaekam ara nrenya ne hakyele bɛ nee bɛ menli ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo kɛ bɛkɛzonle Babeloniama. Bɛdɛnla maanle ye anu, bɛzonle Babelonia belemgbunli ne na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: I will stay here at Mizpah and meet with the Babylonian officials on each of their visits. But you must go back to your towns and bring in the harvest, then store the wine, olive oil, and dried fruit.”
translation_verse: Na mame, mebadɛnla Mezepa na meagyinla bɛ ti wɔ yɛ nee Babeloniama mɔɔ kɛra yɛ ɛkɛ la avinli. Bɛdɛnla bɛ azua mɔɔ bɛwɔ zo la azo, bɛboɔboa nwanye, vanye ma, yɛɛ ɔlivi nwole nloa bɛzie ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: One day, Johanan got together with some of the other men who had been army officers, and they came to Mizpah and met with Gedaliah.
translation_verse: Akee Kalia ara nrenya Dwoheenan nee safohyenle mgbanyinli mɔɔ wɔ azua azua ne mɔ azo la

english_verse: They said, “Gedaliah, we came to warn you that King Baalis of Ammon hired Ishmael to murder you!” Gedaliah refused to believe them,
translation_verse: rale Gɛdalaya anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Mezepa. Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɛze kɛ Amɔle Belemgbunli Beeyalese ɛzoa Nɛtanaya ara nrenya Yehyemeeyɛle kɛ ɔrahu wɔ?” Noko Gɛdalaya anlie bɛ edwɛkɛ ne anli.

english_verse: so Johanan went to Gedaliah privately and said, “Let me kill Ishmael. No one will find out who did it. There are only a few people left in Judah, but they are depending on you. And if you are murdered, they will be scattered or killed.”
translation_verse: Akee Kalia ara nrenya Dwoheenan dule Gɛdalaya azukue wɔ Mezepa kɛ, “Maa me adenle maa mengɔngu Yehyemeeyɛle na awie ɛnrɛnwu ye. Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ Yehyemeeyɛle ku wɔ, na Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ de la kɔsɔɔti kɛbɔ asande, na bɛ bo zo kɛminli bɔkɔɔ ɛ?”

english_verse: Gedaliah answered, “Don't kill Ishmael! What you've said about him can't be true.”
translation_verse: Na Gɛdalaya buale Dwoheenan kɛ, “Mmakɔyɛ deɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛka ye wɔ Yehyemeeyɛle anwo la ɛnle nɔhalɛ.”

english_verse: But in the seventh month, Ishmael came to Mizpah with ten of his soldiers. He had been one of the king's officials and was a member of the royal family. Ishmael and his men were invited to eat with Gedaliah.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, siane nsuu ne anu, Nɛtanaya ara nrenya Yehyemeeyɛle nee menli bulu bie rale Gɛdalaya anwo ɛkɛ wɔ Mezepa. Yehyemeeyɛle ɔ nlenya a le Yilaehyama mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ne abusua nu, na ɔle belemgbunli mgbanyima ne mɔ bie la. Ɔrale ye kɛ, mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛlɛdi debie la,

english_verse: During the meal, Ishmael and his soldiers killed Gedaliah, the man chosen as ruler of Judah by the king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yehyemeeyɛle nee menli bulu ne dwazole Gɛdalaya anwo zo, bɛhwenle bɛ dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛhunle ye. Gɛdalaya a Babelonia belemgbunli ne ɛyɛ ye amɛnlado wɔ Dwuu maanle ne anu a.

english_verse: Then they killed the Jews who were with Gedaliah, and they also killed the Babylonian soldiers who were there.
translation_verse: Eza Yehyemeeyɛle hunle Dwuuma mɔɔ nee Gɛdalaya de Mezepa la, nee Babelonia ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ la amuala.

english_verse: The next day, the murders had still not been discovered,
translation_verse: Kɔdiawu edwɛkɛ ɛhye zile la, ye alehyenlɛ nu mɔɔ ɛnee awie ɛtɛtele kɛ bɛhu Gɛdalaya la,

english_verse: Ishmael went out the town gate to meet them. He pretended to be weeping, and he asked them to come into Mizpah to meet with Gedaliah, the ruler of Judah.
translation_verse: Yehyemeeyɛle vale ɛzunlɛ vi Mezepa rayiale bɛ adenle. Ɔradole bɛ la ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛranlea Ahaekam ara nrenya Gɛdalaya.”

english_verse: But after they were inside the town, Ishmael ordered his soldiers to kill them and throw their bodies into a well.
translation_verse: Bɛrale suakpole ne azo la, Nɛtanaya ara nrenya ne nee menli bulu ne mɔɔ boka ɔ nwo la zɔle bɛ hunle bɛ na bɛvuandinle bɛ bɛguale bula nu.

english_verse: He let ten of the men live, because they offered to give him supplies of wheat, barley, olive oil, and honey they had hidden in a field.
translation_verse: Na menli bulu mɔɔ boka abulatwɛ ne anwo la hanle hilele Yehyemeeyɛle kɛ, “Mmaku yɛ na yɛlɛ hwiiti, baale, ɔlivi nwole, yɛɛ wolɛ wɔ yɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu.” Yemɔti Yehyemeeyɛle angu bɛ amboka ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: The well that he filled with bodies had been dug by King Asa of Judah to store rainwater, because he was afraid that King Baasha of Israel might surround Mizpah and keep the people from getting to their water supply.
translation_verse: Yehyemeeyɛle zoale menli mɔɔ ɔhunle bɛ la avunli ne mɔ amuala guale Belemgbunli Esa bula kpole ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle la anu ɔmanle ɔyile. Belemgbunli Esa bɔle bula ɛhye kɛ ɔfa yeabɔ ɔ nwo bane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Beeyahya dwazole ɔ nwo zo kɛ ɔ nee ye ko la.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan, King Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guard, had left King Zedekiah's daughters and many other people at Mizpah, and he had put Gedaliah in charge of them. But now Ishmael took them all prisoner and led them toward Ammon, on the other side of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Akee Yehyemeeyɛle hyele menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛha Mezepa la amuala nee belemgbunli ne amra mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Babelonia sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan vale bɛ wulale Ahaekam ara nrenya Gɛdalaya asa anu kɛ ɔzie bɛ la nuokɛ na ɔvale bɛ ɔzile nu kɛ ɔ nee bɛ kɔ Amɔn azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Johanan and the other army officers heard what Ishmael had done.
translation_verse: Kalia ara nrenya Dwoheenan nee ɛlɔnema mgbanyinli ne mɔ dele ɛtane mɔɔ Yehyemeeyɛle ɛli kɔsɔɔti la.

english_verse: So they and their troops chased Ishmael and caught up with him at the large pit at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvale bɛ ɛlɔnema ne amuala bɛdoale ye kɛ bɛ nee ye kaho, na bɛhɔdole ye wɔ Gebɛyɔn azule kpole ne anloa.

english_verse: When Ishmael's prisoners saw Johanan and the officers, they were happy
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli mɔɔ nee Yehyemeeyɛle lua la nwunle Dwoheenan nee ɛlɔnema mgbanyinli ne mɔ kɛ bɛlɛba la, bɛlile fɛlɛko.

english_verse: But Ishmael and eight of his men escaped and went to Ammon. Johanan Decides To Take the People to Egypt
translation_verse: Na Yehyemeeyɛle wolole Dwoheenan asa abo na ɔ nee ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anu mɔtwɛ pɛle lile Amɔn azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Johanan and the officers had rescued the women, children, and royal officials that Ishmael had taken prisoner after killing Gedaliah. Johanan led the people from Gibeon
translation_verse: Akee Dwoheenan nee ɛlɔnema mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala vale menli mɔɔ Yehyemeeyɛle hunle Gɛdalaya wɔ Mezepa la ɔhyele bɛ nuokɛ la vi Gebɛyɔn ziale. Bɛle sogyama, mraalɛ, ngakula yɛɛ sonvolɛma.

english_verse: Johanan, Jezaniah, the other army officers, and everyone else in the group, came to me
translation_verse: Akee Dwuda ɛlɔnema mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala, Kalia ara nrenya Dwoheenan, Hɛhyaya ara nrenya Azalaya, yɛɛ menli ne amuala, mɔɔ lɛ bie nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la

english_verse: and said, “Please, Jeremiah, pray to the Lord your God for us. Judah used to have many people, but as you can see, only a few of us are left.
translation_verse: rahanle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, yɛbodo wɔ, yɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛbiza la maa yɛ. Sɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne maa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛha la, ɔluakɛ kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkola ɛnwu ye la, yɛdayɛ menli ɛwolaa ne, akee yɛwie, yɛha ekyi bie.

english_verse: Ask the Lord to tell us where he wants us to go and what he wants us to do.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti sɛlɛ maa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛhile yɛ adenle mɔɔ yɛva zo, nee debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la.”

english_verse: “All right,” I answered, “I will pray to the Lord your God, and I will tell you everything he says.”
translation_verse: Na Gyɛlɛmaya buale bɛ kɛ, “Mede, bɛnlea, mebazɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne meamaa bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛbiza la, na edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛze kɛ menga mengile bɛ la, mebamaa bɛade; menrɛvea bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛha la biala anu.”

english_verse: They answered, “The Lord himself will be our witness that we promise to do whatever he says,
translation_verse: Na bɛhanle bɛhilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ, “Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne dua ɛ nwo zo ka edwɛkɛ kile yɛ na yɛanva a, Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛli nɔhalɛ daselɛ fɔɔnwo ɛtia yɛ.

english_verse: even if it isn't what we want to do. We will obey the Lord so that all will go well for us.”
translation_verse: Saa ɔle kpalɛ o, ɔle ɛtane o, yɛbadie Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛlɛsoa wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ la ane, amaa saa yɛtie ɔ ne a yeayɛ boɛ yeamaa yɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Gyɛlɛmaya nzɛlɛlɛ ne anwo

english_verse: Ten days later, the Lord gave me an answer for
translation_verse: Ye kenle bulu ne azo Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya.

english_verse: and told them that the Lord God of Israel had said: You asked Jeremiah to pray and find out what you should do.
translation_verse: Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ bɛzoanle me kɛ menva bɛ modolɛ mengɔndo ɔ nyunlu la se la ɛne:

english_verse: I am sorry that I had to punish you, and so I now tell you to stay here in Judah, where I will plant you and build you up, instead of tearing you down and uprooting you.
translation_verse: Saa bɛkɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a, anrɛɛ mebalua bɛ na menrɛdu bɛ; mebamaa bɛ bo adila, na menrɛzɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ menlu me nwo kɛ medea bɛ memaa munzule ɛdo bɛ a.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of the King of Babylonia. I will protect you from him,
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo Babelonia belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la bieko. Bɛmmasulo ye, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nee bɛ lua yɛɛ mebalie bɛ meavi ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: and I will even force him to have mercy on you and give back your farms.
translation_verse: Mebaze bɛ anwunvɔne, amaa ɔdaye noko yeaze bɛ anwunvɔne na yeamaa bɛadɛnla bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ye azo. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: But you might keep on saying, “We won't stay here in Judah, and we won't obey the Lord our God.
translation_verse: “Na saa bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛnrɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ɛhye azo,’ na bɛtu Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anloa bɛto, bɛka kɛ,

english_verse: We are going to Egypt, where there is plenty of food and no danger of war.”
translation_verse: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, yɛkɔ Yigyibiti; ɛkɛ ne, yɛnrɛnwu konle, yɛnrɛde aweɛne ndendenle ne, yɛnrɛhyia aleɛ nwo, na ɛkɛ ne ala a yɛkadɛnla’ a,

english_verse: People of Judah, you survived when the Babylonian army attacked. Now you are planning to move to Egypt, and if you do go, this is what will happen.
translation_verse: ɛnee bɛmɛ Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma melɛka la. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Saa bɛtu bɛ gyakɛ bɛtia Yigyibiti kɛ bɛkadɛnla ɛkɛ ne a,

english_verse: You are afraid of war, starvation, and disease here in Judah, but they will follow you to Egypt and kill you there. None of you will survive the disasters I will send.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ kɛye bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɔ Yigyibiti bɛahɔdɛnla lɔ la kɔsɔɔti badɔ dadeɛ nloa anzɛɛ ɛhɔne nu anzɛɛ ewulenzane nu. Munzule mɔɔ mebamaa yeado bɛ la, bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha.

english_verse: I, the Lord, was angry with the people of Jerusalem and punished them. And if you go to Egypt, I will be angry and punish you the same way. You will never again see your homeland. People will be horrified at what I do to you, and they will use the name of your city as a curse word. Jeremiah Gives a Warning
translation_verse: “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Saa bɛkɔ Yigyibiti a mebakpokpo me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo kɛ mɔɔ memkpokpole menguale Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo la. Bɛbazɔho ewula wɔ menli nye zo, bɛ nwo baha ɛzulolɛ, yɛɛ bɛ duma bayɛ ɛfenle nee amowa ala menli nloa. Bɛnrɛnwu ɛke bieko.”

english_verse: I told the people: You escaped the disaster that struck Judah, but now the Lord warns you to stay away from Egypt.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze bɛdabɛ Dwudama mɔɔ bɛha la kɛ: ‘Bɛmmakɔ Yigyibiti.’ Bɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ mebɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ ɛnɛ kenle ye.

english_verse: You asked me to pray and find out what the Lord our God wants you to do, and you promised to obey him. But that was a terrible mistake,
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ ngoane bɛdo nzeleba na bɛminli, ɔluakɛ bɛzoanle me wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ kɛ menzɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne memaa bɛ, na edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛze bɛ la bɛkɛli zolɛ.

english_verse: because now that I have given you the Lord's answer, you refuse to obey him.
translation_verse: Na ɛnɛ, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle zoanle me kɛ menga mengile bɛ la meha mehile bɛ, noko bɛtɛtiele ɔ ne.

english_verse: And so, you will die in Egypt from war, hunger, and disease.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa, ɛhɔne nu anzɛɛ ewulenzane nu wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɔtɛnla zolɛ la azo.”

english_verse: But Azariah, Johanan and some other arrogant men said to me, “You're lying! The Lord didn't tell you to say that we shouldn't go to Egypt.
translation_verse: Hohyaya ara nrenya Azalaya, Kalia ara nrenya Dwoheenan yɛɛ mgbanyizonlema bie mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anzoa wɔ kɛ ɛraze yɛ kɛ yɛmmakɔ Yigyibiti yɛkɔtɛnla ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Baruch son of Neriah must have told you to say that. He wants the Babylonians to capture us, so they can take us away to Babylonia or even kill us.”
translation_verse: Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke ala a ɛli ɛwula wɔ a, amaa wɔaye yɛ wɔamaa Babeloniama wɔamaa bɛahu yɛ anzɛɛ bɛavula yɛ bɛahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia.”

english_verse: Johanan, the other army officers, and everyone else refused to stay in Judah in spite of the Lord's command.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Dwoheenan, ɛlɔnema mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala, yɛɛ menli ne kɔsɔɔti andie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla Dwuda maanle nu.

english_verse: So Johanan and the officers led us away toward Egypt. The group that left Judah included those who had been scattered in other countries and who had then come back to live in Judah.
translation_verse: Dwoheenan nee ɛlɔnema mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala vale Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha, na bɛvi maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛnriandile bɛhɔguale nu la anu bɛzia bɛra la amuala hɔle Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Baruch and I and others in the group had been staying with Gedaliah, because Nebuzaradan, the Babylonian officer in charge of the guard, had ordered him to take care of the king's daughters and quite a few men, women, and children.
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ ɛne: Mrenya, mraalɛ, ngakula, arelemgbunli amra mraalɛ, menli mɔɔ ɛlɔnema Kpanyinli Nɛbuzaladan vale bɛ gyakyile Ahaekam ara nrenya Gɛdalaya, Hyeefan anlɔnra ne kɛ ɔzie bɛ la, medame Gyɛlɛmaya, yɛɛ Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke.

english_verse: The people disobeyed the Lord and went to Egypt. The group had settled in Tahpanhes,
translation_verse: Bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane, na bɛradɛnlanle Yigyibiti wɔ suakpole Tapanehizi azo.

english_verse: when the Lord told me:
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Gyɛlɛmaya wɔ Tapanehizi kɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, carry some large stones to the entrance of the government building in Tahpanhes. Bury the stones underneath the brick pavement and be sure the Jews are watching.
translation_verse: “Sesa awolɛ mgbole wulowula belekese bama ne mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli suakunlu ne mɔɔ wɔ Tapanehizi la anuhɔlɛ ne la anu wɔ Dwudama anye zo.

english_verse: Then tell them that I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, have sent for my servant, Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. I will bring him here and have him set up his throne and his royal tent over these stones that I told you to bury.
translation_verse: Se bɛ kɛ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlea, mebazoa meamaa bɛahɔvɛlɛ Babelonia belemgbunli, me sonvolɛ Nɛbukadenɛza bɛara. Ɔbava ye belemgbunli ebia ne yearazie awolɛ ɛhye mɔ azo na yeazi ye belemgbunli ndanlɛ sua zolɛ.

english_verse: He will attack Egypt and kill many of its people; others will die of disease or be dragged away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ɔbaradua Yigyibitima kakɛ. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛta ewulenzane la, bɛbawu ewulenzane nu; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye bɛ nuokɛ la, bɛbahye bɛ nuokɛ, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwu dadeɛ nloa la, bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa.

english_verse: The Lord told me to speak with the Jews who were living in the towns of Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis in northern Egypt, and also to those living in southern Egypt. He told me to tell them:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele Gyɛlɛmaya, mɔɔ fane Dwuuma kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ de Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo wɔ Megedɔlo, Tapanehizi, Mɛmefese, yɛɛ Yigyibiti nyiakɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You saw how I destroyed Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. They lie empty and in ruins today,
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Bɛnwu munzule kpole mɔɔ memaa yedo Gyɛlusalɛmma nee Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ la. Bɛnlea, ɛnɛ bɛyɛ azuadu, yɛɛ awie ɛnde biala azo,

english_verse: because the people of Judah made me angry by worshiping gods that had never helped them or their ancestors.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛyɛle amumuyɛ na bɛhanle me ɛya. Bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ bɛmanle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ bɛmɛ o, bɛdabɛ o, bɛ ze mɔ o, biala ɛnze bɛ la na bɛzonlenle bɛ.

english_verse: Time after time I sent my servants the prophets to tell the people of Judah how much I hated their disgusting sins. The prophets warned them to stop sinning,
translation_verse: Menzoanle me sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma amuala bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne dahuu kɛ, ‘O, bɛmmayɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ na mekyi!’

english_verse: but they refused to listen and would not stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Noko bɛandie yɛɛ bɛangyakyi bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ; bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ bɛmanle nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.

english_verse: Finally, my anger struck like a raging flood, and today Jerusalem and the towns of Judah are nothing but empty ruins.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati memkpokpole me ɛya ne amuala menguale Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo, na bɛdɔ mgbane, bɛyɛ azuadu toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: Why do you now insist on heading for another disaster? A disaster that will destroy not only you, but also your children and babies.
translation_verse: “Na kɛkala, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mebiza bɛ kɛ: Duzu ati a bɛbɔ munzule bɛva na bɛkulo kɛ bɛminli mrenya nee mraalɛ, bɛ nlɔma nee bɛ ngakula mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda na bɛnrɛnyia bɛ bo zo amra ɛ?

english_verse: You have made me angry by worshiping idols and burning incense to other gods after you came here to Egypt. You will die such a disgusting death, that other nations will use the name of Judah as a curse word.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛfa bɛ sa anloa gyima bɛka me ɛya, bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa Yigyibiti ɛke mɔɔ bɛradɛnla la nyamenle ne mɔ na bɛsonle bɛ, amaa meazɛkye bɛ na bɛayɛ amowa nee agolobɛnwo menli wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la avinli ɛ?

english_verse: When you were living in Jerusalem and Judah, you followed the example of your ancestors in doing evil things, just like your kings and queens.
translation_verse: Bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ ze mɔ amumuyɛ ne, Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ye mɔ amumuyɛ ne yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne nee bɛ ye mɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle wɔ Dwuda azɛlɛ zo nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo la ɔ?

english_verse: Even now, your pride keeps you from respecting me and obeying the laws and teachings I gave you and your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛbɛlɛle bɛ nwo aze bɛtɛmanle me toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ kenle ye a, yɛɛ bɛtɛsulole me, bɛtɛdile me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ la azo.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have decided to wipe you out with disasters.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mese: Bɛ ɛtane ne ati mebava me nye meawula bɛ nyunlu na meabɔ Dwuda bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: There were only a few of you left in Judah, and you decided to go to Egypt. But you will die such horrible deaths in war or from starvation, that people of other countries will use the name of Judah as a curse word.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛazɛkye Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ ɛva ɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɔ bɛahɔdɛnla Yigyibiti la amuala. Bɛ muala bɛbawu bɛagua Yigyibiti. Bɛ muala bɛbawu konle nee ɛhɔne nu. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ bie nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bie la amuala bawu dadeɛ nloa nee ɛhɔne nu. Bɛbayɛ mgbane wɔ menli nye zo, bɛayɛ amowa wɔ menli nloa.

english_verse: I punished Jerusalem with war, hunger, and disease, and that's how I will punish you.
translation_verse: Mebadea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Yigyibiti la kɛmɔ medea Gyɛlusalɛm la. Mebava konle, ɛhɔne anzɛɛ ewulenzane a meadea bɛ a,

english_verse: None of you will survive. You may hope to return to Judah someday, but only a very few of you will escape death and be able to go back. The People Refuse To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: amaa Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha la anu bie mɔɔ de Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la anvi ɛsalɛ. Bɛ nye ɛnrɛnwu Dwuda ɛlɛ, kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ kɛ akee bɛsia bɛkɔ lɔ la, kyesɛ menli ekyi mɔɔ nriandile radanenle Dwuda la ala.”

english_verse: A large number of Jews from both northern and southern Egypt listened to me as I told them what the Lord had said. Most of the men in the crowd knew that their wives often burned incense to other gods. So they and their wives shouted:
translation_verse: Na mrenya mɔɔ ze kɛ bɛ ye mɔ ɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ ɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne, nee mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee gyigyi ɛkɛ ne la amuala, menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, boka Yizilayɛma mɔɔ de Yigyibiti nyiakɛ la hanle hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, what do we care if you speak in the Lord's name? We refuse to listen!
translation_verse: “Gyɛlɛmaya, edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔlua Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu wɔha wɔhile yɛ la, yɛnrɛdie.

english_verse: We have promised to worship the goddess Astarte, the Queen of Heaven, and that is exactly what we are going to do. We will burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to her, just as we, our ancestors, our kings, and our leaders did when we lived in Jerusalem and the other towns of Judah. We had plenty of food back then. We were well off, and nothing bad ever happened to us.
translation_verse: Yɛbayɛ debie biala mɔɔ yɛvua kɛ yɛyɛ la. Yɛbakpu ɛyɛlɛ yɛamaa Anwomanyunlu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne, na yɛagua nza yɛaye ɛdɛne yɛamaa ye, kɛmɔ yɛ nee yɛ ze mɔ, yɛ arelemgbunli nee maanle mgbanyima yɛyɛle ye wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole zo nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo la. Ɔluakɛ mekɛ zɔhane yɛnyianle aleɛ dɔɔnwo, yɛkpazile, yɛɛ munzule biala ando yɛ.

english_verse: But since the time we stopped burning incense and offering wine sacrifices to her, we have been dying from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Noko sumunli kɛ yɛduale kɛ yɛnrɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ yɛnrɛmaa Anwomanyunlu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne yɛɛ yɛnrɛgua nza yɛnrɛye ɛdɛne yɛnrɛmaa ye la, yɛhyia debie biala anwo yɛɛ yɛ menli ne ɛwie wu wɔ konle nee ɛhɔne nu.”

english_verse: Then the women said, “When we lived in Judah, we worshiped the Queen of Heaven and offered sacrifices of wine and special loaves of bread shaped like her. Our husbands knew what we were doing, and they approved of it.”
translation_verse: Mraalɛ ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ, yɛgua nza yɛye ɛdɛne yɛmaa Anwomanyunlu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne, na yɛto keeki mɔɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa ɔsɔho ye yɛmaa ye la, yɛ hu mɔ anye liele yɛ nyɛleɛ ne anwo.”

english_verse: Don't you think the Lord knew that you and your ancestors, your leaders and kings, and the rest of the people were burning incense to other gods in Jerusalem and everywhere else in Judah?
translation_verse: “Bɛdwenle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpunle ye wɔ Dwuda azuamgbole ne mɔ azo nee Gyɛlusalɛm guabile ne mɔ azo la ɔ? Bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ, bɛ arelemgbunli, bɛ mgbanyima, yɛɛ maanle ne anu amra a bɔle zɔhane ɛbɛla ne a. Ɛdɛnkɛma tɛkakye ye kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: And when he could no longer put up with your disgusting sins, he placed a curse on your land and turned it into a desert, as it is today.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛnrɛnlea bɛ ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ nee bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la bieko. Yemɔti a bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛdɔ mgbane, ɛyɛ ewula, ɛyɛ amowa, mɔɔ awie ɛnde zolɛ, kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔde la.

english_verse: This disaster happened because you worshiped other gods and rebelled against the Lord by refusing to obey him or follow his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle ɛtane kɛ bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ na bɛandie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane, bɛanli ye mɛla nee ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo yɛɛ bɛambu ye daselɛlilɛ ne mɔ la, yemɔti a munzule ɛhye ɛdo bɛ toonwo yeradwu ɛnɛ la.”

english_verse: Then I told the men and their wives, that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Here in Egypt you still keep your promises to burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to the so-called Queen of Heaven.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se: Bɛ nee bɛ ye mɔ bɛha kɛ bɛsonle Anwomanyunlu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne. Bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛbakpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛamaa ye, bɛagua nza bɛaye ɛdɛne bɛamaa ye. Bɛ mo. Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛli bɛ ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Keep these promises! But let me tell you what will happen. As surely as I am the Lord God, I swear that I will never again accept any promises you make in my name.
translation_verse: Akee bɛdabɛ Dwudama mɔɔ bɛde Yigyibiti la amuala, bɛdie. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka medame me ngome me duma kpole ne kɛ Dwudanli biala mɔɔ de Yigyibiti la ɛnrɛbɔ me duma ɛnrɛze kɛ, ‘Mekɛ ala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle de aze la’, ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Instead of watching over you, I will watch for chances to harm you. Some of you will die in war, and others will starve to death.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, bɛnrɛkpazi ɛlɛ, munzule ala a bado bɛ a. Bɛdabɛ Dwudama mɔɔ bɛpɛ bɛli Yigyibiti la amuala bawu konle nee ɛhɔne nu kɔkpula kɛ bɛ bo zo kɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ la.

english_verse: Only a few will escape and return to Judah. Then everyone who went to live in Egypt will know that when I say something will happen, it will—no matter what you say.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ ekyi bie a bɛbavi ɛsalɛ wɔ konle nu na bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛazia bɛara Dwuda a. Na akee Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ rale kɛ bɛbadɛnla Yigyibiti na bɛanyia ngoane la anwu bɛmɛ nee mame, nuhua ko mɔɔ ye edwɛkɛ le nɔhalɛ la.

english_verse: And here is how you will know that I will keep my threats to punish you in Egypt.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa ɛhye ayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ amaa bɛ, mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛke ala meamaa bɛanwu kɛ me edwɛkɛ gyi kpundii kɛ munzule ala a bado bɛ a.

english_verse: I will hand over King Hophra of Egypt to those who want to kill him, just as I handed Zedekiah over to Nebuchadnezzar, who wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Mebaye Yigyibiti Belemgbunli Hɔfela meamaa ye kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ kpondɛ ye ahu ye la. Mebayɛ ye kɛ menyɛle Dwuda Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya mɔɔ menyele ye memanle ye kpɔvolɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛkpondɛ ye ahu ye la.”

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, Baruch wrote down everything I had told him.
translation_verse: Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem, Dwosaya ara nrenya ne lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ ebia ne azo la, Gyɛlɛmaya hanle edwɛkɛ manle Nilaya ara nrenya Bɛlɛke hɛlɛle wɔ buluku nu.

english_verse: Then later, the Lord God of Israel told me to say to Baruch:
translation_verse: Ɔse, “O Bɛlɛke, Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se:

english_verse: You are moaning and blaming me, the Lord, for your troubles and sorrow, and for being so tired that you can't even rest.
translation_verse: Ɛhanle kɛ, ‘Medame Bɛlɛke, abule ɛbu me! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma akee ɛmaa me nyanelilɛ ɛyɛ kpole. Mekponle dedee akee mevɛ, mennwu ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me nwo a.’

english_verse: But all over the earth I am tearing down what I built and pulling up what I planted.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma se menga mengile wɔ kɛ, ‘Nea, melɛbubu mɔɔ mezi la meagua, yɛɛ mɔɔ melua la, melɛtudu meagua. Mebayɛ ɛhye wɔ aleɛabo ɛleka biala.

english_verse: I am bringing disaster everywhere, so don't even think about making any big plans for yourself. However, I promise that wherever you go, I will at least protect you from death. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, ɛkpondɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɔ? Mmakpondɛ bɛ bo zo, ɔluakɛ nea, melɛmaa munzule ado menli kɔsɔɔti, na wɔmɔ, ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɛhɔ la ɛlɛ ngoane. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’ ”

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia defeated King Neco of Egypt in a battle at the city of Carchemish near the Euphrates River. And here is what the Lord told me to say about the Egyptian army:
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle ɔ bo wɔ Yigyibiti anwo zo, ɔhanle Belemgbunli Niko ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛnee gua Azule Yufileti ne anloa wɔ Kaakimehye, na Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛli bɛ nwo zo konim wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosaya ara nrenya Gyɛhɔyakem ɛli ɛvolɛ nna wɔ Dwuda belemgbunli ebia ne azo la anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: It's time to go into battle! So grab your shields,
translation_verse: “Bɛsesa bɛ enyinlike ne mɔ na bɛhɔ konle nloa!

english_verse: saddle your horses, and polish your spears. Put on your helmets and armor, then take your positions.
translation_verse: Bɛziezie mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ, O mgbɔnwɔkavoma, bɛvo bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ azo! Bɛva bɛ mbulalɛ ahyɛlɛ na bɛrasolo! Bɛzi bɛ atwɛ ne mɔ, bɛva bɛ mbulahɛba ne mɔ bɛgyela!

english_verse: I can see the battle now— you are defeated and running away, never once looking back. Terror is all around.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Duzu a menwu ye a? Ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ, ɛmaa bɛzia bɛ nzi. Bɛ ɛlɔnema ne ɛli akoatɔ, bɛgua ndwɛlɛ aze, bɛndo bɛ nye bɛ nzi, ɛzulolɛ wɔ ɛleka biala.

english_verse: You are strong and run fast, but you can't escape. You fall in battle near the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la ɛngola nriandi; ɛlɔne nu katakyiema ɛnvi ɛsalɛ. Bɛdu koti na bɛdu bɛgua Azule Yufileti ne anloa wɔ sɔlɔ lɔ.

english_verse: What nation is this, that rises like the Nile River overflowing its banks?
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛlɛmaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ Azule Naele ne, kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛyi ɛbu aze la?

english_verse: It is Egypt, rising with a roar like a raging river and saying, “I'll flood the earth, destroying cities, and killing everyone in them.”
translation_verse: Yigyibiti dwazo kɛ azule Naele, ɔle kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛyi ɛbu aze la. Ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Mebayi meava ewiade; mebazɛkye azuamgbole nee zolɛ ezuavolɛ.’

english_verse: Go ahead, Egypt. Tell your chariots and cavalry to attack and fight hard. Order your troops to march out, with Ethiopians and Libyans carrying shields, and the Lydians armed with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: O mgbɔnwɔ, bɛluo, O konle ehwili, bɛbili! Bɛva ɛlɔnema ne bɛhɔ: Sudan nee Lebea mrenya mɔɔ dedɛ enyinlike, Ledea mrenya mɔɔ ze ɛda to la.”

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will win this battle and take revenge on his enemies. His sword will eat them and drink their blood until it is full. They will be killed in the north near the Euphrates River, as a sacrifice to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kenle ne le medame Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle me kenle, ɔle nzenralɛlilɛ kenle; mebali me kpɔvolɛma nzenralɛ. Dadeɛ bali bɛ antɛnlɛma; bɛ mogya bavɔ ye soonwu, ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle bɔ azu wɔ sɔlɔ maanle nu, wɔ Azule Yufileti ne anloa.

english_verse: Egypt, no medicine can heal you, not even the soothing lotion from Gilead.
translation_verse: O Yigyibitima, bɛhɔ Geleade bɛhɔkpondɛ ayile! Bɛyɛ ayile dɔɔnwo, noko bɛtɛtele kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: All nations have heard you weep; you are disgraced, and they know it. Your troops fall to the ground, stumbling over each other. A Warning for Egypt
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ɛde wɔ anyiemgbabɔlɛ, awie biala ɛde wɔ ɛzunlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛlɔnenli katakyie ɛfofo ɔ gɔnwo anwo zo; bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdu bɛgua. Nɛbukadenɛza ɛralɛ

english_verse: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia was on his way to attack Egypt, the Lord sent me with a warning for every Egyptian town, but especially for Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpanhes. He said to tell them: Prepare to defend yourselves! Everywhere in your nation, people are dying in war.
translation_verse: “Bɛha ye wɔ Yigyibiti, na bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Megedɔlo; bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Mɛmefese yɛɛ Tapanehizi, bɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛdwazo bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛbawu konle nu.’

english_verse: Your soldiers stumble over each other and say, “Get up! The enemy will kill us, unless we can escape to our own land.”
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo ne ɛdu koti, ɛdu ɛgua; bɛka bɛkile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Bɛdwazo, bɛmaa yɛzia yɛdoa yɛ menli ne, yehɔ maanle mɔɔ bɛwole yɛ nu la anu, yɛnriandi mɔɔ sisi yɛ la dadeɛ ne.’

english_verse: Give the king of Egypt this new name, “Talks-Big-Does-Nothing.”
translation_verse: “Bɛvɛlɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ‘Belemgbunli anwo alɛra mɔɔ maa ye mekɛ kpalɛ kpa ɔ ti a.’

english_verse: Egypt, I am the true king, the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as I live, those enemies who attack will tower over you like Mount Tabor among the hills or Mount Carmel by the sea.
translation_verse: Medame mɔɔ me duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la, mele Belemgbunli, na mese: Meka, meka kɛ, awie mɔɔ kɛzua wɔ la le kɛ yezua Boka Teebɔ wɔ awoka avinli anzɛɛ Boka Kamɛle wɔ nyevile nloa.

english_verse: You will be led away captive, so pack a few things to bring with you. Your capital, Memphis, will lie empty and in ruins.
translation_verse: O Yigyibitima, bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo na bɛ nee bɛ kɔ nlɔnu! Mɛmefese badɔ mgbane, ɔbabɔ, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zo.

english_verse: An enemy from the north will attack you, beautiful Egypt, like a fly biting a cow.
translation_verse: Yigyibiti le ɛnlankɛ belɛ kɛnlɛma, na tunli vi sɔlɔ ɛra banlo ye.

english_verse: The foreign soldiers you hired will turn and run. But they are doomed, like well-fed calves being led to the butcher. *
translation_verse: Ɛlɔnema bɔbɔ mɔɔ yebɔ bɛ ɛkpa la le kɛ nlankɛ mralɛ dɔlera. Ɛhɛe, bɛ muala bɛnriandi bɛzia bɛ nzi; bɛangyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu, ɔluakɛ bɛ awieleɛ mekɛ ɛdwu, bɛ ndeanlɛ mekɛ ɛdwu.

english_verse: The enemy army will go forward like a swarm of locusts. Your troops will feel helpless, like a snake in a forest
translation_verse: Yigyibiti twolo kɛ ɛwɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛtwenle ɔ nwo ahɔ la, ɔluakɛ ye kpɔvolɛma tia kilikili ba ɔ nwo zo; bɛfa akuma bɛba ɔ nwo zo kɛ menli mɔɔ bu mbaka la.

english_verse: when men with axes start chopping down trees. It can only hiss and try to escape.
translation_verse: Bɛbazɛkye ye kpɔkɛmile ne mɔɔ bɛwolo nu a ɔnwolo la, ɔboalekɛ bɛzonle bɛtɛla abɛbɛ, bɛtia bɛ a bɛnnwu bɛ nloa.

english_verse: Your people will be disgraced and captured by the enemy from the north.
translation_verse: Yigyibitima anyunlu bagua aze, bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa menli bie mɔɔ vi sɔlɔ la. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. Soon I will punish the god Amon of Thebes and the other Egyptian gods, the Egyptian kings, the people of Egypt, and everyone who trusts in the Egyptian power.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne zele kɛ, “Mebadea Tibise bozonle Amɔn ne, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne, Yigyibitima yɛɛ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ. Mebadea Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nee menli mɔɔ ɛva bɛ rɛle ɛwula ye nu la.

english_verse: I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army. But I also promise that Egypt will someday have people living here again, just as it had before. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Bring Israel Home The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mebaye bɛ meamaa menli mɔɔ kpondɛ bɛ ahu bɛ la. Mebava bɛ meamaa Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza nee ye safohyenlema ne. Nzinlii, menli badɛnla Yigyibiti bieko kɛ anrɛɛ mɔmoane ɔde la. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛdɛnkɛma balie ye menli ne ngoane

english_verse: Israel, don't be afraid. Someday I will bring you home from foreign lands. You and your descendants will live in peace and safety, with nothing to fear.
translation_verse: “O me akɛlɛ Gyekɔbo, mmasulo. O Yizilayɛ, mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu. Mebalie wɔ meavi moa moa lɔ meara. Mebalie ɛ bo zo amra meavi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle la meara. Gyekɔbo bazia ara na ɔ nzo nu adwo ye, ɔ nwo badɔ ye, awie ɛnrɛha ye ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid, even though now you deserve to be punished and have been scattered among other nations. But when I destroy them, I will protect you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: O me akɛlɛ Gyekɔbo, mmasulo, me nee wɔ lua. Mebazɛkye maanle maanle mɔɔ menvoanle wɔ memanle ɛhɔle nu la kɔsɔɔti, na wɔmɔ, menrɛzɛkye wɔ. Mebazuzu meadea wɔ, ɛnrɛva ɛ nwo dwɔɔ. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: Before the king of Egypt attacked the town of Gaza, the Lord told me to say to the Philistines:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ mɔɔ hanle ye wɔ Filisitiama anwo hilele Gyɛlɛmaya kolaa na Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne abɔ Gaza la ɛne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, tell you that your land will be flooded with an army from the north. It will destroy your towns and sweep you away, moaning and screaming.
translation_verse: Ɔse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛnlea! Azule ɛlɛmaa ɔ nwo zo wɔ sɔlɔ lɔ, na ɔbayɛ azule mɔɔ ye ɛzenlɛ yɛ ɛzulolɛ a. Ɔbayi yeabu azɛlɛ ye azo yeava debie biala, azuamgbole nee menli baha azule bo. Menli badea nu abiza moalɛ; aleɛabo sonla biala baye awolɛ.

english_verse: When you hear the thunder of horses and chariots, your courage will vanish, and parents will even abandon their own children.
translation_verse: Saa bɛte mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ agyakɛ abo, bɛte konle ehwili ne mɔ anwo alɛra ne nee bɛ gyakɛ ne mɔ ɛbililɛ ne ane a, selɛma ɛnrɛdo bɛ nye bɛ nzi ɛnrɛnlea bɛ mra, ɔboalekɛ bɛ sa nu ɛtuto bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: You refugees from Crete, your time has now come, and I will destroy you. None of you will be left to help the cities of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Filisitia ɛzɛkyelɛ mekɛ ɛdwu, bɛbade boavolɛ biala mɔɔ ɛha la bɛavi Taya nee Saedɛn anwo, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, melɛsɛkye Filisitiama mɔɔ vi Kiliti ɛnweanloa rale la amuala.

english_verse: The Anakim who survive in Gaza and Ashkelon will mourn for you by shaving their heads and sitting in silence.
translation_verse: Gazama ɛkpa bɛ ti, Ahyekɛlɔn abo zo ɛminli. O Anakema mɔɔ ɛha, bɛsu bɛabodɛboda bɛ nwo yeahɔdwu kenlenzu?

english_verse: You ask how long will I continue to attack you with my sword, then you tell me to put it away and leave you alone.
translation_verse: Aa, Ɛdɛnkɛma konle dadeɛ! Kenlenzu a ɛkɛgyakyi ɛbililɛ a? Kɔvea wɔ boa ne anu, die wɔ ɛnwomenle na yɛ koonwu.

english_verse: But how can my sword rest, when I have commanded it to attack Ashkelon and the seacoast?
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛla koonwu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzie ye gyima nwo la ɛ? Gyima ne tia Ahyekɛlɔn nee menli mɔɔ de ɛnweanloa la.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me to say to the nation of Moab: The town of Nebo is doomed; Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced, and even its fortress will be left in ruins.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ye wɔ Mowabe anwo la ɛne: “Bɛzu Niboma, ɔluakɛ bɛ sua ne ɛdɔ mgbane! Bɛho bɛva Keleateeyem, yebɔ anyiemgba, bɛgolo ye aranemgbole ne bɛgua ɔ nyunlu aze;

english_verse: No one honors you, Moab. In Heshbon, enemies make plans to end your life. My sword will leave only silence in your town named “Quiet.”
translation_verse: Mowabe anyunlunyia ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ. Bɛvale ɔ nwo adwenle ɛtane ne wɔ Hɛhyebɔn. Bɛse, ‘Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ ye bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ ɔnle maanle bieko a.’ O Mademɛn, ɛdawɔ noko, bɛbaha wɔ aze, bɛbava konle bɛadoa wɔ.

english_verse: The people of Horonaim will cry for help, as their town is attacked and destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɛdie! Bɛlɛtea Hɔloneeyem nehane kɛ, ‘Bɛlɛto maanle ye mgbane, bɛlɛsɛkye ninyɛne.’

english_verse: Moab will be shattered! Your children will sob
translation_verse: “Mowabe maanle ne ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ; yɛte ngakula ne kɛ bɛlɛsu,

english_verse: and cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they will tell of disasters.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛfo boka ne bɛahɔ Luhete la ɛnee bɛlɛ ɛzunlɛ, ɔboalekɛ Hɔloneeyem ndololeɛ nu yɛɛ bɛde ɛzɛkyelɛ ɛzunlɛ ne a.

english_verse: Run for your lives! Head into the desert like a wild donkey.
translation_verse: Bɛnriandi bɛlie bɛ nwo! Bɛnriandi kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo asoaso.

english_verse: You thought you could be saved by your power and wealth, but you will be captured along with your god Chemosh, his priests, and officials.
translation_verse: “Bɛvale bɛ rɛle bɛwulale bɛ anwosesebɛ nee bɛ anwonyia nu, yemɔti bɛbavo bɛ nwo zo; bɛbava bɛ bozonle Kimɔhye, ye ahɔmenle yɛɛ bɛ mgbanyima bɛahɔ nlɔnu.

english_verse: Not one of your towns will escape destruction. I have told your enemies, “Wipe out the valley and the flatlands of Moab.
translation_verse: Sɛkyevolɛ ne bavo suakpole biala azo, suakpole ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ; ɔbazɛkye bɔnza ne, ɔbazɛkye azɛlɛ sɛsɛ ne, kɛmɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meha la.

english_verse: Spread salt on the ground to kill the crops. Leave its towns in ruins, with no one living there.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Mowabe ndɛbalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔbadu yeahɔ; ye azuamgbole badɔ mgbane, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ.”

english_verse: Moab, you are like wine left to settle undisturbed, never poured from jar to jar. And so, your nation continues to prosper and improve.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Sumunli Mowabe ngakula nu, awie ɛtɛgyegyele ye, yɛɛ ɔle kɛ nza mɔɔ ɛdɔne ɔ bo la; bɛngakyi ye bɛngua dwora gyɛne gyɛne nu. Ɔtɛkɔle nlɔnu ɛlɛ, yemɔti ɔtɛyɛ fɛ, yɛɛ ɔtɛbɔ evuanlɛ.

english_verse: But now, I will send enemies to pour out the wine and smash the jars!
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, mekɛ bie badwu mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mebazoa menli meamaa bɛahɔhakyi Mowabe kɛ bɛkakyi nza bɛagua dwora gyɛne nu la. Bɛbawola nza ne na bɛabobɔ dwora ne mɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be ashamed, because your god Chemosh cannot save you, just as Bethel could not help the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na Mowabe anyunlu bagua aze, ɔlua ye bozonle Kimɔhye ati, kɛmɔ Yizilayɛma anyunlu guale aze wɔ Bɛtɛle mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ rɛle wɔ ye nu la.

english_verse: You claim that your soldiers are strong and brave.
translation_verse: Mowabema, duzu ati a bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛmɛ ɛne, yɛle katakyiema wɔ konle nu’ ɛ?

english_verse: But I am the Lord, the all-powerful King, and I promise that enemies will overpower your towns. Even your best warriors will die in the battle.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ babɔ Mowabe nee ye azuamgbole la ɛra; bɛhu bɛ mgbavolɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ. Medame Belemgbunli, mɔɔ me duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la a mese a.

english_verse: It won't be long now— disaster will hit Moab!
translation_verse: Munzule ɛlɛba arava Mowabe, ye nyanenwunlɛ ɛbikye.

english_verse: I will order the nearby nations to mourn for you and say, “Isn't it sad? Moab ruled others, but now its glorious power has been shattered.”
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Mowabe zua la, bɛzu ye, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze duma mɔɔ yelie la, bɛzu ye. Bɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛlie Mowabe belemgbunlililɛ tumi kpole ne, ye anyunlunyia tumi ne ɛbɔ aze.’

english_verse: People in the town of Dibon, you will be honored no more, so have a seat in the dust. Your walls will be torn down when the enemies attack.
translation_verse: Daebɔnoma, bɛvi bɛ anyunlunyia ɛleka ne bɛtolo bɛrakpofo azɛlɛ ketekete ye azo, ɔluakɛ sɛkyevolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛzɛkye Mowabe la ɛra bɛ nwo zo; yebubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: You people of Aroer, go wait beside the road, and when refugees run by, ask them, “What happened?”
translation_verse: O Alowɛma! Bɛgyinla adehane ne na bɛnlea! Bɛbiza nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛnriandi la kɛ, ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ ɔ?’

english_verse: They will answer, “Moab has been defeated! Weep with us in shame. Tell everyone at the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.”
translation_verse: Bɛbabua kɛ, ‘Mowabe ɛbɔ, ye anyunlunyia ɛdɔ aze; bɛzu ye, bɛye ye awolɛ. Bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ Azule Anɔn ne anloa kɛ Mowabe ɛdɔ mgbane!’

english_verse: I will punish every town that belongs to Moab, but especially Holon, Jahzah, Mephaath,
translation_verse: “Ndeanlɛ ɛra azɛlɛ sɛsɛ ne azo na yeha azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ: Hɔlɔn, Gyaza, Mɛfeeyate,

english_verse: Dibon, Nebo, Beth-Diblathaim,
translation_verse: Daebɔn, Nibo, Bɛte Debelateeyem,

english_verse: Kiriathaim, Beth-Gamul, Beth-Meon,
translation_verse: Keleateeyem, Bɛtegamɛle, Bɛtemiyɔn,

english_verse: My decision is final— your army will be crushed, and your power broken.
translation_verse: Bɛha Mowabe anwosesebɛ ne aze, yɛɛ bɛzɛkye ye tumi ne, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Bɛbabɛlɛ Mowabe aze

english_verse: People of Moab, you claim to be stronger than I am. Now I will tell other nations to make you drunk and to laugh while you collapse in your own vomit.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛmaa Mowabe ɛbo ɛyɛ tindaanwu, ɔboalekɛ yede me nwo atua. Mowabe bave ala nu, na menli agolo ɔ nwo.

english_verse: You made fun of my people and treated them like criminals caught in the act.
translation_verse: Mowabema, asoo tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛzelele Yizilayɛma la? Asoo Yizilayɛma wuale debie la ati a mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ Yizilayɛma duma la bɛkɔsɔ bɛ ti a?

english_verse: Now you must leave your towns and live like doves in the shelter of cliffs and canyons.
translation_verse: “O Mowabema, bɛdu bɛvi azuamgbole ne mɔ azo! Bɛhɔdɛnla bodane ne mɔ azo! Bɛyɛ kɛ abubule mɔɔ nwo ye sane wɔ bodane tokule nloa la.

english_verse: I know about your pride, and how you strut and boast.
translation_verse: Yɛde Mowabe adubɛnwo ne nganeɛ, ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo kpole, ɔbu ɔ nwo, ɔle mgbanyizonle yɛɛ ɔtu ɔ nloa anu.

english_verse: So I will cry and mourn for Moab and its town of Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Yemɔti meye Mowabe awolɛ; mesu Mowabe maanle ne amuala; mesu Kɛɛ Hilɛzema.

english_verse: People of Sibmah, you were like a vineyard heavy with grapes, and with branches reaching north to the town of Jazer and west to the Dead Sea. But you have been destroyed, and so I will weep for you, as the people of Jazer weep for the vineyards.
translation_verse: O Sebema vanye! Mesu wɔ metɛla Gyeezɛ. Wɔ vanye mbaka ngane ndendenle pɛle Nyevile Wulera ne dwule Gyeezɛ. Sɛkyevolɛ ne ɛzɛkye wɔ wawaa mbaka ma nee wɔ vanye ma mɔɔ ɛbolo la.

english_verse: Harvest celebrations are gone from the orchards and farms of Moab. I have silenced the shouts of people making wine.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ ɛvi Mowabe azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ kye aleɛ la azo. Memaa nwanye ne mɔɔ vi nwanye melahyinli ne mɔ anu twi la ɛgyakyi ɛhwinlɛ. Awie biala ɛnva anyelielɛ ɛndeɛdea nu ɛndwihwi vanye ma; ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne ɛnle anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ.

english_verse: Weeping from Heshbon can be heard as far as Elealeh and Jahaz; cries from Zoar are heard in Horonaim and Eglath-Shelishiyah. And Nimrim Creek has run dry.
translation_verse: “Hɛhyebɔnoma nee Ɛlɛyalima tea nu su; bɛsu bɛmaa bɛte bɛ ne moa moa wɔ Gyeehaze. Bɛ ne kɔ toonwo bɛte ye wɔ Zowaa, Hɔloneeyem, yɛɛ Ɛgelate Hyɛlehyaya lɔ. Nemelem azudenle bɔbɔ ɛsesa.

english_verse: I will get rid of anyone who burns incense to the gods of Moab or offers sacrifices at their shrines. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebadua Mowabema kpunli mɔɔ bɛmbɔ azu anzɛɛ bɛmkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmmaa bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ wɔ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: In my heart I moan for Moab, like a funeral song played on a flute. I mourn for the people of the town of Kir-Heres, because their wealth is gone. *
translation_verse: “Yemɔti medi nyane me ahonle nu memaa Mowabema yɛɛ medi nyane me ahonle nu memaa Kɛɛ Hilɛzema, ɔluakɛ anwonyia mɔɔ bɛnyianle la amuala ɛminli.

english_verse: The people of Moab mourn on the rooftops and in the streets. Men cut off their beards, people shave their heads; they make cuts on their hands and wear sackcloth. And it's all because I, the Lord, have shattered Moab like a jar that no one wants.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ bɛte ye wɔ Mowabe azua ne mɔ ati zo nee ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ la ala a le awolɛyelɛ, ɔluakɛ mebɔ Mowabe kɛ buakɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnrɛva ye ɛnrɛyɛ ɛhwee a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Moab lies broken! Listen to its people cry as they turn away in shame. Other nations are horrified at what happened, but still they mock her.
translation_verse: Mowabe ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ! Tie kɛ bɛlɛye awolɛ bie a! Mowabe anyunlu ɛgua aze! Mowabe ɛyɛ agolobɛnwo maanle. Maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la kɔsɔɔti golo ɔ nwo, si ye amgbu, yeyɛ debie ɛzulolɛ bie. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Mowabe ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ

english_verse: Moab, an enemy swoops down like an eagle spreading its wings over your land.
translation_verse: Kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne, “Bɛnlea, awie badu kɛ kɔleɛ, na yeava ɔ ndɛba yeabila Mowabe,

english_verse: Your cities and fortresses will be captured, and your warriors as fearful as women giving birth.
translation_verse: yeava ye azuamgbole ne mɔ nee ye aranemgbole ne mɔ. Kenle zɔhane Mowabe ɛlɔnema ahonle badu kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.

english_verse: You are finished as a nation, because you dared oppose me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbazɛkye Mowabe mɔɔ ɔnrɛyɛ maanle bieko a, ɔluakɛ yede medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nwo atua.

english_verse: Terror, pits, and traps are waiting for you.
translation_verse: O Mowabema, ɛzulolɛ, kuma, yɛɛ ɛhane wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛlɛkendɛ bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; and if you crawl out of the pit, you'll get caught in a trap. The time has come for you to be punished. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛkɛnriandi ɛzulolɛ ne la, ɛbahɔdɔ kuma ne anu, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛkɛvo kuma ne ɛkɛvinde file zo la, ɛbahɔdɔ ɛhane nu, ɔluakɛ medame, mebamaa ɛhye mɔ asisi Mowabema anwo zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mebadea bɛ la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Near the city of Heshbon, where Sihon once ruled, tired refugees stand in shadows cast by the flames of their burning city. Soon, the towns on other hilltops, where those warlike people live, will also go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Menli nriandi kɔtane Hɛhyebɔn, noko bɛnnyia gyinlagyakɛ, ɔboalekɛ senle ɛdɔ Hɛhyebɔn. Belemgbunli Saehɔn suakunlu ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛyela. Senle ɛzɛkye Mowabe anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ye ɛlɔnema fa tu bɛ nwo la.

english_verse: People of Moab, you worshiped Chemosh, your god, but now you are done for, and your children are prisoners in a foreign country.
translation_verse: O Mowabema, bɛ gyakɔ! Bɛzɛkye menli ne mɔɔ sonle bozonle Kimɔhye la, na bɛhye bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu.

english_verse: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Noko mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ mebamaa Mowabe akpazi bieko a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛnee kɛ bɛbazi bɛadea Mowabe la ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord has this to say about the nation of Ammon: The people of Israel have plenty of children to inherit their lands. So why have you worshipers of the god Milcom taken over towns and land belonging to the tribe of Gad?
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ye wɔ Amɔnoma anwo la ɛne: Ɔse, “Yizilayɛ ɛnlɛ mrenya ɔ? Ɔnlɛ mɔɔ ko die ɔ ti ɔ? Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Bozonle Melekɔm ɛzonlenlɛ ɛva Gaade maanzinli ne na ye menli ɛhɔdɛnla azuamgbole ne mɔ azo ɛ?

english_verse: Someday I will send an army to attack you in Rabbah, your capital city. It will be left in ruins, and the surrounding villages will lie in ashes. You took some of Israel's land, but on that day Israel will take yours!
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebamaa konle azi Amɔnoma suakpole Relaba azo abɔ ye, na ye namunamu ne mɔ ayela adɔ nzonle. Yizilayɛma baza menli mɔɔ liele bɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛ sa nu la alie bɛ debie, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Cry, people of Heshbon; your town will become a pile of rubble. You will turn here and there, but your path will be blocked. Put on sackcloth and mourn, you citizens of Rabbah, because the idol you worship will be taken to a foreign country, along with its priests and temple officials.
translation_verse: O Hɛhyebɔnoma, bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ Eyae ɛbɔ! Relaba mraalɛ, bɛzu! Bɛva ɛrele bɛheda, bɛzu bɛkpɔsa, ɔluakɛ bɛbava bɛ bozonle Melekɔm, ye ahɔmenle yɛɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ amuala bɛahɔ nlɔnu.

english_verse: You rebellious Ammonites trust your wealth and ask, “Who could attack us?” But I warn you not to boast when your strength is fading.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle, duzu ati a bɛfa bɛ mbɔnza ne mɔ bɛtu bɛ nwo ɛ? Bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula bɛ anwonyia nu na bɛka kɛ, ‘Nwane a kɛhola kɛva konle kɛradoa yɛ a?’

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send neighboring nations to strike you with terror. You will be scattered, with no one to care for your refugees.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛanwu ɛzulolɛ, medame Tumivolɛ, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Menli mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la bahile bɛ ɛzulolɛ, avoa bɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛboɔboa menli mɔɔ kɛnriandi la anloa a.

english_verse: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Edom
translation_verse: “Noko nzinlii mebamaa Amɔnoma akpazi bieko. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm anwo zo

english_verse: I will send disaster to punish you descendants of Esau, so anyone from Dedan had better turn around and run back home.
translation_verse: O Didanema, bɛnriandi bɛzia bɛhɔvea azɛlɛ bo, ɔluakɛ mekɛ mɔɔ mefa meadea Yisɔ abo zo amra la ɛdwu.

english_verse: People who harvest grapes leave some for the poor. Thieves who break in at night take only what they want.
translation_verse: Saa ɛdevolɛma radele ma wɔ bɛ avule nu a, anrɛɛ bɛnrɛgyakyi mgbɛpɛlɛ ɔ? Saa nwule ba ɛya nu nɔɔzo a, bɛnva mɔɔ saa bɛ di la ala ɔ?

english_verse: But I will take everything that belongs to you, people of Edom, and I will uncover every place where you try to hide. Then you will die, and so will your children, relatives, and neighbors.
translation_verse: Noko mekpa Yisɔ anwo ɛdanlɛ wienyi memaa ye feabelɛ ne mɔ ɛla ali; ɔngola ɔnvea ɔ nwo bieko. Bɛzɛkye ɔ mra, ɔ mediema mrenya, yɛɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ; ɔnlɛ awie bieko.

english_verse: But I can be trusted to care for your orphans and widows.
translation_verse: Gyakyi wɔ nrisa ne mɔ maa me na mebanlea bɛ; maa wɔ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ɛva bɛ ti ɛzɔ me.”

english_verse: Even those nations that don't deserve to be punished will have to drink from the cup of my anger. So how can you possibly hope to escape?
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Saa menli mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛno nyane kɔpo ne anu la ɛnlo nuhua a, ɛnee ɛdwenle kɛ wɔmɔ, ɔkɛkpa ɛ ti ɔ? Ɛnrɛva ɛ nwo dwɔɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛno nyane kɔpo ne anu bie.

english_verse: I, the Lord, swear in my own name that your city of Bozrah and all your towns will suffer a horrible fate. They will lie in ruins forever, and people will use the name “Bozrah” as a curse word.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka, meka kɛ, Bɔzela bayɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛleka, ndeanlɛ ɛleka, ɛleka mgbane bie, yɛɛ munzule ɛleka; ye azuamgbole ne mɔ amuala badɔ mgbane mɔɔ bɛnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ a.”

english_verse: I have sent a messenger to command the nations to prepare for war against you people of Edom.
translation_verse: Mede Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne. Yezoa sonla yemaa yeraha yehile maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛbɛza, bɛhɔteta Yidɔm! Bɛdwazo bɛhɔ konle.

english_verse: Your nation will be small, yet hated by other nations.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛayɛ ekyi wɔ maanle maanle avinli, na menli akpo bɛ.

english_verse: Pride tricks you into thinking that other nations look at you with fear. You live along the cliffs and high in the mountains like the eagles, but I am the Lord, and I will bring you down.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka nee bɛ adubɛnwo ne ɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ. Bɛde bodane adokule nu wɔ boka zo anwuma, noko saa bɛyɛ bɛ azua anwuma kɛ kɔleɛ bɔbɔ a, mebadwula bɛ aze. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: People passing by your country will be shocked and horrified to see a disaster
translation_verse: “Yidɔm bayɛ ɛleka ɛzulolɛ. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛze ɛkɛ ne la ahonle badu, yɛɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ yezɛkye la bamaa yeabɔ mgbatike.

english_verse: as bad as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and towns nearby. The towns of Edom will be empty.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele Sodɔm nee Gomɔla nee azuamgbole mɔɔ boka bɛ la, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛze ɛkɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ awenade vi Dwɔdan kpɔkɛ nu finde ba mboane kpolane nwo zo a bɛnriandi la, zɔhane ala a mebamaa bɛanriandi bɛavi Yidɔm a, na mebaye sonla mɔɔ mekulo la meamaa yeazie suakpole ne. Nwane a nee me sɛ a? Nwane a kɛhola nee me kɛdwudwu a? Belemgbunli boni a kɛhola me nyunlu gyinla a?

english_verse: Listen to my plans for you, people of Edom. Your children will be dragged off and your country destroyed.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdie ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meyɛ meatia Yidɔm, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ mevua kɛ mefa meayɛ suakpole Timan azo amra la. Bɛbahwenle bɛ ngakula ngyikyi ne mɔ bɔbɔ aze bɛahɔ. Nɔhalɛ, ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: The sounds of your destruction will reach the Red Sea and cause the earth to shake.
translation_verse: Bɛ azedɔlɛ ne bamaa azɛlɛ ye akpusu, yɛɛ bɛbade bɛ ɛzunlɛ wɔ Akaba Ebolo ne anu nehane.

english_verse: An enemy will swoop down to attack you, like an eagle spreading its wings and circling over Bozrah. Your warriors will be as fearful as women giving birth. What the Lord Says about Damascus
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, awie bamaa ɔ nwo zo na yeadu faa kɛ kɔleɛ, yearadɛlɛ ɔ ndɛba yeabila Bɔzela, na Yidɔm katakyiema ɛbolɛ bade kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse anwo zo

english_verse: The Lord says about Damascus: The towns of Hamath and Arpad have heard your bad news. They have lost hope, and worries roll over them like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane Dɛmasekɛse anwo la ɛne. Ɔse, “Heematema nee Aapadema adwenle ɛzɛkye, ɔboalekɛ bɛde amaneɛ ɛtane. Ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ ɛmaa bɛyɛ begyebegye kɛ nyevile mɔɔ ɛzɛkye na ɔngua la.

english_verse: You people of Damascus have lost your courage, and in panic you turn to run, gripped by fear and pain.
translation_verse: Dɛmasekɛse ɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ zɛhae. Ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnriandi na ɔ nye zo danle ye. Nyane nee alɔbɔlɛ ɛkyekye ye kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.

english_verse: Once I was pleased with your famous city. But now I warn you, “Escape while you still can!”
translation_verse: Suakpole mɔɔ ɛlie duma totohyia na anyelielɛ wɔ zo la, ɛnɛ menli arɛle ɛvi ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Soon, even your best soldiers will lie dead in your streets. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ye mgbavolɛ mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la badɔ amolɛ nu wɔ bɛ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema ne amuala kenle ko ne. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I will set fire to your city walls and burn down the fortresses King Benhadad built. Nebuchadnezzar and the People of the Desert
translation_verse: Mebado senle wɔ Dɛmasekɛse bane ne anu na ɔbazɔ yeava Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade suakunlu ɛkɛ, yeazɛkye ye aranemgbole ne mɔ.” Kidaa abusua ekpunli ne nee suakpole Heezɔ ndeanlɛ ne

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says about the Kedar tribe and the desert villages that were conquered by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia: Listen, you people of Kedar and the other tribes of the eastern desert. I have told Nebuchadnezzar to attack and destroy you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ fane Kidaa nee Heezɔ maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza honle vale bɛ la anwo la, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, “Bɛdwazo, bɛhɔ Kidaama anwo zo! Bɛzɛkye menli mɔɔ de aduduleɛ la!

english_verse: His fearsome army will surround you, taking your tents and possessions, your sheep and camels.
translation_verse: Bɛlie bɛ ndanlɛ azua nee bɛ nyɛmoa, bɛ mgbɛnu ndanlɛ, bɛ anwoneɛ yɛɛ bɛ afunlumu ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ. Menli baze bɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛzulolɛ ɛra ɛleka biala.’

english_verse: Run and hide, you people of the desert who live in villages! Nebuchadnezzar has big plans for you.
translation_verse: “O Heezɔma! Bɛnriandi bɛhɔ moa bɛhɔvea kuma bie anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Ɔluakɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛva bɛ nwo adwenle na yebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: You have no city walls and no neighbors to help, yet you think you're safe— so I told him to attack.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔlɛka yeahile ye ɛlɔnema ne kɛ, ‘Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔvo maanle ne mɔɔ de boɛ na awie ɛngola ye gyegye la anwo zo. Ɔnlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole yɛɛ mbulalɛ ɛngua ye nlenkɛ mgbole nzi. Bɛ ngome a bɛde a.’

english_verse: Then your camels and large herds will be yours no longer. People of the Arabian Desert, disaster will strike you from every side, and you will be scattered everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: “Bɛ afunlumu ne mɔ bayɛ afedeɛ, bɛbahyɛ bɛ nlankɛ bɛava. Mebakponde bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ ti enrinli ne azo la, na meamaa maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la agyegye bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Only jackals will live where your villages once stood. I, the Lord, have spoken. What the Lord Says about Elam
translation_verse: Heezɔ badɔ mgbane, ɔbayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛzonlɛ ɛnrɛkpa ɛkɛ ɛlɛ a. Awie ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ bieko ɛlɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yilam anwo zo la

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me to say: People of Elam, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will kill the archers who make your army strong.
translation_verse: Ɔzele kɛ, “Gyɛlɛmaya, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebabubu Yilamma ɛda ne mɔɔ maa bɛdwe kpole la anu.

english_verse: Your king and his officials will die, and I will rule in their place. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Akee mebahu Yilam belemgbunli ne nee ye mbganyima ne mɔ na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meali belemgbunli wɔ ɛkɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: But I promise that someday I will bring your people back to their land.
translation_verse: Noko nzinlii mebamaa Yilamma akpazi bieko. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: Announce what will happen and don't leave anything out.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle ye wɔ suakpole Babelɔn nee ye maanlema ne anwo hilele Gyɛlɛmaya la ɛne:

english_verse: Raise the signal flags; shout so all nations can hear— Babylon will be captured! Marduk, Babylon's god, will be ashamed and terrified, and his idols broken.
translation_verse: “Ka edwɛkɛ ne, bɔ ye nolo kile maanle maanle. Fola fɛlɛnra bɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo. Mmafea zolɛ; ka kɛ, ‘Bɛho bɛva Babelɔn bɔkɔɔ. Bɛgua ye bozonle Bɛle, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Maadɔko la anyunlu aze, ye ahonle ɛdu, bɛgua ye ananze ne mɔ anyunlu aze, ye mmonle ne mɔ ahonle ɛdu.’

english_verse: The attack on the Babylonians will come from the north; they and their animals will run, leaving the land empty. Israel and Judah Will Return to Their Land
translation_verse: “Maanle bie vi sɔlɔ ɛva konle ɛradoa Babeloniama, na ɔbamaa maanle ne adɔ mgbane, awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nu, sonla o, nane o, biala vi ɛkɛ ne banriandi.” Yizilayɛma sia ara sua nu

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel and Judah, when these things happen you will weep, and together you will return to your land and worship me, the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama babɔ nuhua ava ɛzunlɛ ara kɛ bɛkakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: You will ask the way to Zion and then come and join with me in making an agreement you won't break or forget.
translation_verse: Bɛbabiza Zayɔn adenle ne na bɛahakyi bɛ nye lɔ bɛaha kɛ, ‘Bɛrɛla, bɛmaa yɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ, mɔɔ awie biala arɛle ɛnrɛvi ye ɛlɛ la.’

english_verse: My people, you are lost sheep abandoned in the mountains by their shepherds. You don't even remember your resting place.
translation_verse: “Me menli ne ɛyɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛminli la, bɛ neavolɛma a ɛminli bɛ a. Bɛtulu bɛ bɛmaa bɛluolua awoka ne mɔ azo. Bɛkpɔsa awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi zo, bɛnnwu bɛ tunli ne adenle.

english_verse: I am your true pastureland, the one who gave hope to your ancestors. But you abandoned me, so when your enemies found you, they felt no guilt as they gobbled you up.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ nee mboane ne mɔ yiale la hunle bɛ lile, na bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ se, ‘Yɛnli fɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ lɛ bɛ, mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ vale bɛ ti zɔle ye la.’

english_verse: Escape from Babylonia, my people. Get out of that country! Don't wait for anyone else.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma, bɛnriandi bɛvi Babeloniama avinli, bɛyɛ kɛ mbɔnkye nyinli bɛnriandi bɛli mboane ne mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: In the north I am bringing great nations together. They will attack Babylon and capture it. The arrows they shoot are like the best soldiers, always finding their target.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, melɛboɔboa menli dɔɔnwo anloa meavi sɔlɔ maanle maanle mgbole nu kɛ bɛ nee Babeloniama ɛraho, na bɛva bɛ maanle ne. Bɛle menli mɔɔ ze ɛdadolɛ nye zo kpalɛ a, bɛto ɛda a ɔnvo fee.

english_verse: Babylonia will be conquered, and its enemies will carry off everything they want. Babylon Will Be Disgraced The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɛbave Babelonia ninyɛne bɛali. Menli mɔɔ bave ye ninyɛne ne la banyia debie biala mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Babelɔn ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: People of Babylonia, you were glad to rob my people. You had a good time, making more noise than horses and jumping around like calves threshing grain.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O bɛmɛ Babeloniama, bɛve me agyadeɛ bɛva, bɛ nye ɛlie kɛ ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ asa ɛha ndile na bɛsu kɛ ɛkpɔnwɔ la.

english_verse: The city of Babylon was like a mother to you. But it will be disgraced and become nothing but a barren desert.
translation_verse: Bɛbagua bɛ nli mɔɔ wole bɛ la anyunlu aze na bɛabɔ ye anyiemgba. Ɔnrɛnyia ɔ nyunlu wɔ maanle maanle avinli; ye azɛlɛ bahwie, zolɛ ayɛ resee, yeayɛ ɛsɛlɛ.

english_verse: My anger will destroy Babylon, and no one will live there. Everyone who passes by will be shocked to see what has happened.
translation_verse: Me ɛya ne ati awie ɛnrɛdɛnla Babelɔn, azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane, na awie biala mɔɔ kɛze zolɛ la bali nyane, adea nuhua na yeahɔsɔ ɔ ti wɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo.

english_verse: Babylon has rebelled against me. Archers, take your places. Shoot all your arrows at Babylon.
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛto ɛda la kɔsɔɔti, bɛdwazo bɛhɔbɔ bɛyia Babelɔn. Bɛdo ɛda biala mɔɔ bɛlɛ la bɛwɔ ye, bɛmmagyakyi bie, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ ɛtane yetia medame Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Attack from every side! Babylon surrenders! The enemy tears down its walls and towers. I am taking my revenge by doing to Babylon what it did to other cities.
translation_verse: Bɛdea nuhua, bɛha ye ɛleka biala kɛ Babelɔn ɛmaa ɔ sa zo; bɛgologolo ye bane ne mɔ bɛgua, ɔluakɛ, kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me nzenralɛlilɛ ne de la ɛne. Bɛli ye nzenralɛ, mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛyɛ ye bie bɛzie ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: There is no one in Babylonia to plant or harvest crops. Even foreigners who lived there have left for their homelands, afraid of the enemy armies.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa bɛdua ma wɔ Babelɔn, yɛɛ saa ɛbuhenle ne dwu a, bɛmmamaa bɛbu bie. Kɛmɔ bɛsulo kɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛma kɛhu bɛ la ati, awie biala banriandi ahɔ ye sua zo wɔ ye maanle nu. Yizilayɛma sia ara sua nu

english_verse: Israel is a flock of sheep scattered by hungry lions. The king of Assyria first gobbled Israel up. Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylonia, crunched on Israel's bones.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma le kɛ mboane mɔɔ awenade ɛvoa bɛ ɛmaa bɛbɔ asande la. Aselea belemgbunli ne lumuale hyele bɛ lile, yɛɛ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛfufo bɛ mbowule nu.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, punished the king of Assyria, and I will also punish the king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, mese: Mebadea Babelonia belemgbunli ne nee ye maanle ne, kɛmɔ mendeanle Aselea belemgbunli ne la.

english_verse: But I will bring Israel back to its own land. The people will be like sheep eating their fill on Mount Carmel and in Bashan, in the hill country of Ephraim and in Gilead.
translation_verse: Mebava Yizilayɛ meazia meahɔzie ye ye adidileka ne. Ɔbadidi Boka Kamɛle azo nee Beehyan maanzinli nu. Aleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la ɔbanyia bie wɔ Yifelaem awoka ne mɔ azo nee Geleade.

english_verse: I will rescue a few people from Israel and Judah. I will forgive them so completely that their sin and guilt will disappear, never to be found. The Lord's Commands to the Enemies of Babylonia
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a bɛnrɛde ɛtaneyɛlɛ nganeɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu ɛtaneyɛlɛ wɔ Dwuda, ɔluakɛ mebava menli mɔɔ baha mɔɔ mebagyakyi bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ meahyɛ bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia anwo zo la

english_verse: The Lord said: I have told the enemies of Babylonia, “Attack the people of Merathaim and Pekod. Kill them all! Destroy their possessions!”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛhɔteta Mɛlateeyemma nee Pikɔdoma bɛ nee bɛ ɛho. Bɛhu bɛ na bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ. Bɛyɛ mɔɔ meze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la amuala. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Sounds of war and the noise of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Konle ɛdɔ azɛlɛ ne azo ɛmaa bɛzɛkye menli dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Babylonia was a hammer pounding every country, but now it lies broken. What a shock to the nations of the world!
translation_verse: Babelonia ɛhakyi debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ maanle maanle avinli. Bɛzɔ ewiade hamenle kpole ne bɛbubu nuhua.

english_verse: Babylonia challenged me, the Lord God All-Powerful, but that nation doesn't know it is caught in a trap that I set.
translation_verse: O Babelonia, menzuale wɔ ɛhane, ɛdɔle nuhua, noko wɔannwu ye, ɛ nee me dwudwule, wɔmaa bɛhye wɔ ɛhane nu.

english_verse: I've brought out my weapons, and with them I will put a curse on Babylonia.
translation_verse: Medukue ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me konle ninyɛne ne mɔ la na meye me ɛya konle ninyɛne mevinde, ɔboalekɛ medame, Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle, melɛ gyima medi wɔ Babelonia azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Come from far away, you enemies of Babylon! Pile up the grain from its storehouses, and destroy it completely, along with everything else.
translation_verse: Bɛvi ewiade ɛleka biala bɛrɛla. Bɛrabu ye aleɛ ɛzielɛ azua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ. Bɛhwe ye ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛhuohua bɛ kɛ ma edukue edukue. Bɛzɛkye maanle ne bɔkɔɔ, bɛmmagyakyi debie biala.

english_verse: Kill the soldiers of Babylonia, because the time has come for them to be punished.
translation_verse: Bɛhu ye nlankɛ nyinli ne mɔ amuala, bɛhu bɛ kɔsɔɔti. Munzule ɛha bɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛadea bɛ la ɛdwu.”

english_verse: Attack Babylon, enemy archers; set up camp around the city, and don't let anyone escape. It challenged me, the holy God, so do to it what it did to other cities. Proud Babylon Will Fall
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, mese: Bɛvɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ze ɛda to la bɛmaa bɛhɔ Babeloniama anwo zo. Bɛbɛnra bɛyia bɛ, bɛmmamaa ko bɔbɔ fi ɛsalɛ. Bɛdua ye kakɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, ɔboalekɛ ɔ nye anzɔ me.

english_verse: People of Babylon, I, the Lord, promise that even your best soldiers will lie dead in the streets.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ye mgbavolɛ bawu agua ɛleka kpatawienyi ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ wɔ mekɛ zɔhane anu.

english_verse: Babylon, you should be named, “The Proud One.” But the time has come when I, the Lord All-Powerful, will punish you.
translation_verse: “O Babelonia adubɛnwo, mekyi wɔ. Wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mebava meadea wɔ la ɛdwu.

english_verse: You are proud, but you will stumble and fall, and no one will help you up. I will set your villages on fire, and everything around you will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Babelonia adubɛnwo badu koti, akpo aze, na ɔnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛdwazo ye. Mebado senle ye azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, na senle ne bayela debie biala mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la.
