english_verse: You Babylonians were cruel to Israel and Judah. You took them captive, and now you refuse to let them go.
translation_verse: “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛlɛsisi Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama kpalɛ. Menli mɔɔ hyele bɛ nuokɛ la lɛ bɛ kyengye zɛhae, bɛmmaa bɛndu bɛ gyakɛ fee.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, will rescue and protect them. I will bring peace to their land and trouble to yours.
translation_verse: Bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne anwo yɛ se, ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Mebali bɛ edwɛkɛ meamaa bɛ na meamaa anzonudwolɛ ara azɛlɛ ne azo, na Babeloniama ɛdeɛ, menrɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛnrɛdɔ bɛ.”

english_verse: I have declared war on you, your officials, and advisors.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛhu Babeloniama! Bɛhu Babelonia ezuavolɛ ne, bɛhu ye arelemgbunli nee ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma.

english_verse: This war will prove that your prophets are liars and fools. And it will frighten your warriors.
translation_verse: Bɛhu menli mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la, bɛle ahɔnwɔne! Bɛhu ye ɛlɔnema, na bɛzɛkye bɛ!

english_verse: Then your chariot horses and the foreigners in your army will refuse to go into battle, and the enemy will carry away everything you treasure.
translation_verse: Bɛhu ye mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ, bɛzɛkye ye konle ehwili ne mɔ! Bɛhu nyɛvolɛ ɛlɔnema mɔɔ boka ye la, bɛmaa bɛyɛ kɛ mraalɛ! Bɛzɛkye ye anwonyia ne mɔ na bɛve bɛli!

english_verse: Your rivers and canals will dry up. All of this will happen, because your land is full of idols, and they have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ewia ɛpe ye azɛlɛ ne azo, na ye azule ne mɔ ɛsesa, ɔluakɛ Babelonia le ananze maanle, menli ne anye die mmonle nwo kpalɛ!

english_verse: Never again will people live in your land— only desert animals, jackals, and unclean birds.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti nanemgbole, bedi, yɛɛ soholo bava Babelɔn ayɛ bɛ dabelɛ, menli ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ bieko ɛlɛ, awolɛndoazo biala anu awie ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns, and I will destroy Babylon just as completely. No one will live there again. Babylonia Is Invaded The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kɛ menyɛle Sodɔm nee Gomɔla nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la, zɔhane ala a mebava meayɛ Babelonia a. Awie agyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛkɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Far to the north, a nation and its allies have been awakened. They are powerful and ready for war.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, menli vi sɔlɔ ɛlɛba, maanle katakyie nee arelemgbunli dɔɔnwo vi ewiade ɛleka biala ɛlɛba.

english_verse: Bows and arrows and swords are in their hands. The soldiers are cruel and show no pity. The hoofbeats of their horses echo like ocean waves crashing against the shore. The army has lined up for battle and is coming to attack you, people of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Bɛdedɛ ɛda nee atwɛ, bɛ ti yɛ se, bɛnze anwunvɔne. Bɛdede mgbɔnwɔ zo, yɛɛ bɛ nwo soa kɛ nyevile. Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo kɛ bɛbaho, O Babeloniama, bɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo!

english_verse: Ever since your king heard about this army, he has been weak with fear; he twists and turns in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Babelonia belemgbunli ne dele bɛ nganeɛ, ɔ nwo golole ye na ɔ sa nu dole. Nyane wiele ye kyekye, ɔdele nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo.

english_verse: Babylonia, I will attack you like a lion from the forest, attacking sheep in a meadow along the Jordan. In a moment the flock runs, and the land is empty. Who will I choose to attack you? I will do it myself! No one can force me to fight or chase me away.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ awenade vi Dwɔdan kpɔkɛ nu finde ba mboane kpolane nwo zo a bɛnriandi la, zɔhane ala a mebamaa bɛanriandi bɛavi Babelonia a, na mebaye sonla mɔɔ mekulo la meamaa yeazie maanle ne. Nwane a nee me sɛ a? Nwane a kɛhola nee me kɛdwudwu a? Belemgbunli boni a kɛhola me nyunlu gyinla a?

english_verse: Listen to my plans for you, people of Babylonia. Your children will be dragged off, and your country destroyed.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdie ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma meyɛ metia Babelɔn nee debie mɔɔ mevua kɛ mefa meayɛ Babeloniama la. Bɛbahwenle bɛ ngakula ngyikyi ne mɔ aze bɛahɔ. Nɔhalɛ, ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: The sounds of your destruction will be heard among the nations, and the earth will shake.
translation_verse: Babelɔn azedɔlɛ ne bamaa azɛlɛ ye akpusu, yɛɛ bɛbade ye ɛzunlɛ ne wɔ maanle maanle zo.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, am sending a wind to destroy the people of Babylonia and Babylon, its capital.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebamaa sɛkyevolɛ bie anwosesebɛ meamaa yearaho yeatia Babelonia maanle ne nee menli mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la.

english_verse: Foreign soldiers will come from every direction, and when the disaster is over, Babylonia will be empty and worthless.
translation_verse: Mebazoa menli Babelonia meamaa bɛahɔhegye maanle ne. Saa munzule kenle ne dwu a, menli vi kodoka biala anu bara ɔ nwo zo, na Babelonia azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane.

english_verse: I will tell these soldiers, “Attack quickly, before the Babylonians can string their bows or put on their armor. Kill their best soldiers and destroy their army!”
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa kovolɛ ne kpo ye ɛda ne, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɔnyia adenle ɔgyela ye mbulahɛba ne. Bɛmmagyakyi ye mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bie; bɛhu ye ɛlɔnema ne bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Their troops will fall wounded in the streets of Babylon.
translation_verse: Bɛbodɛboda bɛ, bɛhu bɛ bɛgua Babelonia guabile ne mɔ azo,

english_verse: Everyone in Israel and Judah is guilty. But I, the Lord All-Powerful, their holy God, have not abandoned them.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda ɛyɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ɛtia Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, noko akee medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛkpole bɛ.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon! Run for your lives! If you stay, you will be killed when I take revenge on the city and punish it for its sins.
translation_verse: Bɛnriandi bɛvi Babelonia. Awie biala ɛnriandi ɛlie ye ngoane. Bɛmmadie Babeloniama ɛtane nwo ewule bɛwu, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛhye a mefa meadea bɛ wɔ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ me la anwo a.

english_verse: Babylon was my golden cup, filled with the wine of my anger. The nations of the world got drunk on this wine and went insane.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Babelonia le ezukoa nvutuke kɔpo mɔɔ melɛ ye me sa nu, mɔɔ ewiade maanle maanle muala no nuhua a. Maanle maanle nlonle nuhua na biala ati hanle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: But suddenly, Babylon will fall and be destroyed. I, the Lord, told the foreigners who lived there, “Weep for the city! Get medicine for its wounds; maybe they will heal.”
translation_verse: Babelonia ɛdu ɛdɔ arɛlevilɛ nu ɛbubu. Bɛzu ye ɛ! Bɛva ayile ɛnlome bɛkpuda ye, wɔannea a, ɔ nwo kɛza.

english_verse: The foreigners answered, “We have already tried to treat Babylon's wounds, but they would not heal. Come on, let's all go home to our own countries. Nothing is left in Babylonia; everything is destroyed.”
translation_verse: Na nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la hanle kɛ, ‘Ɛnee yɛkulo kɛ yɛyɛ Babelonia ayile; yɛyɛle biala na ɔ nwo anza. Bɛkpo ye, awie biala ɛhɔ ye maanle nu, ɔluakɛ Babelonia ndeanlɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord, want Babylon destroyed, because its army destroyed my temple. So, you kings of Media, sharpen your arrows and pick up your shields.
translation_verse: “Bɛzi atwɛ ne mɔ! Bɛgyela bɛ enyinlike ne mɔ!” Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛne. Yemaa Medea arelemgbunli anwosesebɛ, ɔluakɛ yeva yezie ɔ nyunlu kɛ ɔsɛkye Babelonia, yeava yeali mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛtiale ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la anwo nzenralɛ.

english_verse: People of Babylon, you live along the Euphrates River and are surrounded by canals. You are rich, but now the time has come for you to die.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛzua azule dɔɔnwo, mɔɔ nuhua le anwonyia ngome la, bɛ awieleɛ ɛra; bɛpɛ bɛ ɛbɛla nyɛma ne azo.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, swear by my own life that enemy soldiers will fill your streets like a swarm of locusts. They will shout and celebrate their victory. A Hymn of Praise (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma meha medame me ngome me nwo kɛ: Mebamaa menli abu Babelonia kɛ abɛbɛ kpolane, na bɛ ne babo ɛ nwo zo; bɛbayɛ alɛra mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛli konim la.” Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Saa ɔtendɛ a anwomanyunlu nzule di tufonyia, ɔmaa amungu dwazo aleɛabo ɛleka biala. Ezule tɔ a ɔmaa ɔfede, na ɔmaa anwoma vi ye anwomazielɛ ɛleka ne tu.

english_verse: God used his wisdom and power to create the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ye tumi bɔle azɛlɛ ye, ye nrɛlɛbɛ a ɔvale ɔbɔle ewiade a, yɛɛ ye ndelebɛbo a ɔvale ɔbɔle anwomanyunlu a.

english_verse: People who make idols are stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods cannot breathe.
translation_verse: Awie biala le koasea, ɔnlɛ adwenle. Ezukoa nvutuke dwinvolɛ biala mmonle ananze adwinli ne gua ɔ nyunlu aze, ye ananze ne mɔ le mɛlɛbɛla, ɛnwomenle fee ɛnle bɛ nu.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɛle ninyɛne avunli, gyima mgbane; bɛ ndeanlɛ mekɛ dwu a bɛ bo zo baminli bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord, Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own. God's Hammer The Lord said:
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ɛnle zɔ, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a. Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne le ye agyadeɛ, ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛdɛnkɛma hamenle ne

english_verse: Babylonia, you were my hammer; I used you to pound nations and break kingdoms,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Babelonia, ɛle me hamenle nee me akodeɛ, mefa wɔ mebubu maanle maanle, mefa wɔ mesɛkye arelemgbunli maanle,

english_verse: as well as men and women, young and old,
translation_verse: mefa wɔ meku mrenya nee mraalɛ, mefa wɔ meku mrelera nee ngakula, mefa wɔ meku mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra,

english_verse: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadua Babelonia nee menli mɔɔ de Babelonia la kakɛ wɔ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo.

english_verse: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.
translation_verse: O Boka sɛkyevo, mɔɔ sɛkye ewiade, mebava me sa meazie ɛ nwo, meahundo wɔ meado aze, na meamaa wɔayela wɔadɔ nzonle.

english_verse: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Nations Will Attack Babylon The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛva ɛ bo zo bolɛ ko bɔbɔ bɛnrɛzie sua mgbɛne zo, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva bie bɛnrɛwula sua adiabo, ɛbayɛ mgbane bɔkɔɔ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
translation_verse: “Bɛvola fɛlɛnra wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli, bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛhɔho bɛtia ye. Arelalate, Menae, yɛɛ Ahyikinaze, bɛbɛza na bɛ nee Babelonia ɛhɔho. Bɛye safohyenlema kpanyinli bɛmaa ɔli ɛlɔnema ne ati. Bɛmaa mgbɔnwɔ anwo ɛzo kɛ abɛbɛ kpolane.

english_verse: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Midea arelemgbunli, bɛ amɛnladoma, bɛ mgbanyima, yɛɛ maanle biala mɔɔ bɛsie la anu amra amuala ɛva bɛ ɛlɔnema nee ye ɛraho.

english_verse: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye te nyane na ɔkpusu, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma melɛdi Babelonia ɛbɔlɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo. Mehyehyɛ kɛ mebɔ Babelonia, meado azɛlɛ ne mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛndɛnla zolɛ a.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
translation_verse: Babelonia katakyiema ɛgyakyi konle na bɛhɔvea bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu. Bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie ɛmaa bɛyɛ kɛ mraalɛ. Senle la ye azua ne mɔ anu, bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nzi mbulalɛ ne mɔ anu ɛbubu.

english_verse: One messenger after another announces to the king, “Babylon has been captured!
translation_verse: Menli nriandi di akɔneaba kɛ bɛkabɔ Babelonia belemgbunli ne amaneɛ kɛ bɛva ye suakpole ne bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The enemy now controls the river crossings! The marshes are on fire! Your army has panicked!”
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ ɛlɔnema ne ɛva azupɛlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ na bɛdo senle wɔ suakpole ne aranemgbole ne mɔ anu. Babelonia ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anye zo ɛda bɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— “Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.” Babylonia Will Pay!
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, Babelonia le kɛ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛlɛwozo ma ɛkɛ la. Noko ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na ɔdaye ye ɛbuhenle ne adwu.”

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem say, “King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.
translation_verse: Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛhye Gyɛlusalɛm ɛli, yedi ye motomoto, yeyɛ ye mgbane; yeme ye kɛ nane anwo ɛzulolɛ me debie la, yeli ye yemaa ɔ ko ɛyi na yekpu ye yedo.

english_verse: The people of Babylonia harmed some of us and killed others. Now, Lord, make them pay!” The Lord Will Take Revenge on Babylon
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Gyɛlusalɛm ɛha kɛ, “Konle mɔɔ Babelonia ɛva ɛdoa me nee me nwo amra la ɛbu ɛzia ye. Me mogya mɔɔ yeha yegua la ɛgua ɔ ti zo.” Ɛdɛnkɛma baboa Yizilayɛma

english_verse: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛnlea, mebali bɛ edwɛkɛ meamaa bɛ na meali bɛ ti nzenralɛ. Mebamaa Babelonia nyevile asesa na meamaa ye azule asesa;

english_verse: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.
translation_verse: Babelonia bayɛ suadu na ɛkɛ ne ayɛ ɛzonlɛ dabelɛ. Ɔbayɛ ɛleka ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ a. Awie mɔɔ kɛhɔvinde zolɛ la babɔ mgbatike.

english_verse: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛbabɔ nu bɛadea kɛ awenade na bɛazu kɛ awenade mralɛ la.

english_verse: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye kɛbolo kpalɛ la, mebado bɛ ɛkponle na meamaa bɛanlo nza toonwo bɛ nye alie. Akee bɛbalafe na bɛnrɛdunwue ɛlɛ, bɛbaha nafelɛ nu. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ bara ahunleɛ kɛ mboane mralɛ, kɛ mboane nyinli nee mbɔnkye nyinli la.” Babelɔn awieleɛ

english_verse: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, kɛ bɛva Babelɔn mɔɔ anrɛɛ aleɛabo amra amuala bɔ ye duma la aze ɛ. Yeyɛ ɛleka ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ maanle maanle avinli.

english_verse: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
translation_verse: Nyevile ɛva Babelɔn, azɛlɛkye mgbole ɛbu ɛva ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
translation_verse: Ye azuamgbole ne mɔ ɛbɔ. Azɛlɛ ne azo nzule ɛsesa bɔkɔɔ ɛyɛ kɛ ɛsɛlɛ, awie ɛnde azɛlɛ ne azo, yɛɛ awie ɛnze ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Mebadea Babelonia Bozonle Bɛle na meamaa yeakpu mɔɔ yeme la. Maanle maanle ɛnrɛva ɛnriandilɛ ɛnrɛra Babelonia bieko. “Babelɔn bane ne mɔ ɛde ɛgua.

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: Me menli Yizilayɛma, bɛye bɛ nwo zo wɔ Babelɔn. Awie biala ɛnriandi ɛvi me ɛya kpole ne anu ɛlie ye ngoane!

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu, yɛɛ bɛmmasulo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛde ye azɛlɛ ne azo la anwo. Ɛvolɛ biala bɛte konle nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ belemgbunli nee ɔ gɔnwo belemgbunli ɛnyia konle.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebadea Babelonia awozonle ne mɔ a. Bɛbagua azɛlɛ ne amuala anyunlu aze na bɛahu ye menli ne mɔ amuala bɛagua zolɛ totɔɔ.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Anwuma nee aze nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ nu la kɔsɔɔti bado edwɛne anyelielɛ nu agua Babelonia ati zo, ɔluakɛ menli vi sɔlɔ maanle nu a bara arazɛkye Babelonia a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: Babelonia hunle ewiade menli muala, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔhunle Yizilayɛma.” Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔhɛlale Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia la

english_verse: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye menli mɔɔ wɔ Babelonia la kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi ɛsalɛ wɔ konle ne anu la, bɛhɔ, bɛmmagyinla ɛkɛ ne zɔhane! Kanza bɛwɔ moa bɔbɔ a, bɛhakye medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛhakye Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛka kɛ, ‘Bɛdea yɛ, bɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze, bɛbɔ yɛ anyiemgba. Bɛzɛkye yɛ anyunlunyia, ɔluakɛ nyɛvolɛ ɛrava Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.’

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛnlea, mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ me nee Babelonia awozonle ne mɔ bali a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛboda la kɔsɔɔti bagua azɛlɛ ne azo akponle.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Saa Babelonia fo kɔ anwuma kɔsi aranemgbole fa bɔ ɔ nwo bane bɔbɔ a, mebazoa menli meamaa bɛahɔzɛkye ye. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Babelɔn ɛzɛkyelɛ bieko

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdie! Bɛlɛtea nu Babelonia lɔ! Babelonia ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo alɛra ɔ!

english_verse: The shouts of the enemy, like crashing ocean waves, will drown out Babylon's cries as I level the city.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, melɛsɛkye Babelonia, meado ye mgbane, meamaa yeamua ɔ nloa katekate ne. Bɛ ɛlɔnema ane kɔ anwuma kpalɛ, na ɔdielie kɛ azule dɔɔnwo ane,

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ sɛkyevolɛ ɛra Babelɔn anwo zo. Bɛhye ye ɛlɔnema nuokɛ, bɛbubu bɛ ɛda ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele Nyamenle mɔɔ metua ɛtane nwo kakɛ a, mebadea Babelonia kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ye mgbanyima nee ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma, ye amɛnladoma, ye safohyenlema, yɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema anlo abo. Bɛbalafe mɔɔ bɛnrɛdunwue ɛlɛ a, medame Belemgbunli mɔɔ me duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la a mese a.”

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛbaha Babelɔn bane kpole ne bɛagua, bɛbado senle ye nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu. Menli ne ɛvɛlɛ muala bayɛ mgbane, senle bazɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛvɛlɛ biala. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Bɛva Gyɛlɛmaya nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔ Babelonia

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya lile Dwuda ebia ne la, ye ɛvolɛ nna ne anu, Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya hanle edwɛkɛ hilele Sɛlaya. Sɛlaya le Zɛdikaya abɔlɔba. Ɔle Masaya anlɔnra yɛɛ ɔ ze a le Nilaya. Ɛnee Sɛlaya nee Belemgbunli Zɛdikaya ɛlɛkɔ Babelonia.

english_verse: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
translation_verse: Gyɛlɛmaya hɛlɛle munzule mɔɔ bara Babelonia anwo zo la amuala wɔ buluku nu.

english_verse: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
translation_verse: Na ɔhanle ɔhilele Sɛlaya kɛ, “Saa ɛdwu Babelɔn a nea na kenga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala,

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: na ka kɛ, ‘O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔha ɛke anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ ɛbazɛkye ye mɔɔ sonla anzɛɛ nane ɛnrɛhola ɛkɛ ne tɛnla; ɔbabɔ bɔkɔɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Saa ɛwie buluku ɛhye kenga a, fa bolɛ boka nwo kyekye na fuandi to Azule Yufileti ne anu,

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: na ka kɛ, ‘Kɛ Babelonia bazi anloma la ɛne. Ɔnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ melɛmaa munzule ara ɔ nwo zo.’ ” Gyɛlɛmaya edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Kpanyinli Nɛbuzaladan hyele Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Sɛlaya nee ye boavolɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Zɛfanaya, yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu sonvolɛma nsa nuokɛ na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle.

english_verse: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
translation_verse: Akee Nɛbukadenɛza dudule Zɛdikaya anye, ɔguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ na ɔvale ye ɔhɔle Babelɔn ɔhɔdole ye efiade. Zɛdikaya lale efiade ne toonwo ɔwule. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzɛkyelɛ (

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, siane nna ne na ye kenle ngɔnla ne azo, ɛnee ɛhɔne mɔɔ ɛra suakpole ne azo la le kpole kpalɛ. Ɛnee menli ne ɛnnyia aleɛ fee wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɔnema ne bule bane ne nɔɔzo na bɛpenle ɛkɛ bɛnriandile. Bɛbɔle bɛ ti Dwɔdan Bɔnza afoa nu. Bɛvale anlenkɛ kpole bie mɔɔ la bane nwiɔ ne avinli la anu, bɛluale belemgbunli tola ne anu bɛhɔle.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: Bɛvale Zɛdikaya bɛrale Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza anyunlu, wɔ Relebela mɔɔ wɔ Heemate maanzinli nu la na ɔbuale ye ndɛne.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee ngɔnla wɔ ebia ne azo la, ye siane nnu ne, kenle mɔɔ tɔ zo bulu la azo, ye sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan vole Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: Ɔyelale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, belemgbunli suakunlu, yɛɛ Gyɛlusalɛm azua ne mɔ amuala; ɔyelale azua mgbole ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Babelɔn ɛlɔnema mɔɔ boka sinzavolɛma safohyenle ne anwo la gologolole bane ne mɔɔ bɛlie bɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm anwo bɛyia la guale aze.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Sinzavolɛma Safohyenle Nɛbuzaladan hyele ehyianvolɛma ne bie mɔ nuokɛ, nee menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛha la, yɛɛ ɔvale menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛva bɛ nwo ɛmaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne la ɔhɔle. Eza ɔhyele dwinvolɛma mɔɔ hale ɛkɛ ne la bɛdabɛ noko ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
translation_verse: Na Nɛbuzaladan gyakyile ehyianvolɛma ne bie mɔ ɛkɛ kɛ bɛyɛ vanye gyima na bɛzo ɛya.

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: manle Gyɛhɔyakɛn dɛlale arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ wɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelonia la amuala. Ɔyele Gyɛhɔyakɛn efiade, ɔvale ye ɔziele dibelɛ kpole mɔɔ tɛla arelemgbunli mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ wɔ Babelonia maanle ne anu la.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyɛhɔyakɛn kpolole ye efiadedolɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ guale. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la, ɔ nee Babelonia belemgbunli tɛnla ɛkponle ko anwo di debie.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne hilele ezukoa mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa Gyɛhɔyakɛn kenle ko biala la. Bɛyɛle ye zɔhane toonwo ɔhɔkpulale mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛhɔyakɛn wule la.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm a ɛyɛ kɛnlanana zɛhae la! Suakpole mɔɔ anrɛɛ zolɛ le gbudugbudu, nea kɛ akee yeyɛ kɛ kunlanvolɛ raalɛ a, anrɛɛ ɔle kpole wɔ maanle maanle avinli! Azuamgbole nu suakpole ɛnɛ ɛyɛ akɛlɛ maanle.

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Aledwolɛ nu ɔsu nyane nyane, ɔ nye abo monle monle; agɔnwolɛma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔlɛ la, ko bɔbɔ ɛmbikye ye ɛnkyekye ɔ rɛle. Ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nee ye lile egyele zo amanie, bɛ muala bɛyɛ ye kpɔvolɛma.

english_verse: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
translation_verse: Nyanehilelɛ nee akɛlɛzonlenlɛ ɛmaa Dwudama ɛhɔ nlɔnu; ɛnɛ bɛde maanle maanle avinli, bɛnnyia ɛleka bɛndo bɛ ti. Bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu bɛ kpɔvolɛma zi bɛ zo ɛhɔhye bɛ.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Zayɔn adenle zo ɛyɛ kɛnlanana, awie ɛmba ɛvoyia ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ la ɛlilɛ. Ye nlenkɛ mgbole kɔsɔɔti ɛbubu, ye sɛlɛvolɛma di nyane. Bɛpia ye mbɛlɛra muala bɛhɔ, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔde alɔbɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: Ye kpɔvolɛma ɛvo ɔ nwo zo, bɛkpazi bɛdɛla ye, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa yenwu amaneɛ wɔ ye ɛtane bebelebe ti; ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛgyakyi ye ɛhɔ, kpɔvolɛ ne ɛhye bɛ nuokɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm ɛminli ye anyunlunyia muala. Ye arelemgbunli ɛyɛ kɛ ahɛtɛboɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛnnyia adidileka la; anwosesebɛ ɛnle bɛ ɛnriandilɛ nu, wɔ mɔɔ doa bɛ kye bɛ la anyunlu.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm kakye ninyɛne ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ anrɛɛ mɔmoane le ye ɛdeɛ la. Mekɛ mɔɔ ye menli ne hɔdɔle kpɔvolɛma asa anu, na awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ boa ye la, kpɔvolɛma golole ɔ nwo, zile ye amgbu kɛ yedɔ aze la.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm yɛle ɛtane kpole, yemɔti ɔ nwo yɛle ɛtane; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbu ye la amuala kpole ye, ɔluakɛ bɛnwu kɛ ɔlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ, ɛhɛe, ɔdaye mumua ne ɔkponle, na ɔkakyi ɔ nye ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Ye ninyɛndane ne lale ali; yeandwenle ye azedɔlɛ nwo; yemɔti ye azedɔlɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole, ɔnlɛ awie ɛnkyekye ɔ rɛle. Ɔse, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne, na me kpɔvolɛ ne asa ɛha me!”

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ ne ɛva ɔ sa ɛbɔ ye ninyɛne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la anu; ɛhɛe, yenwu kɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛva ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne aze; menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi bɛ la wolo ɛzonlenlɛ ayia ne anu.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Ye ezuavolɛ ne kponle, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ aleɛ bɛali la; bɛfa bɛ anwoneɛ bɛdie aleɛ, amaa bɛ nwo agyinla bɛ. Sua bɔdenle ne ɛlɛtea, ɔse, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nea me, ɔluakɛ bɛkpo me.

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: “Asoo ɔnvane bɛ nwo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse ɛke la? Bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea saa nyane bie nee me ɛdeɛ ye mɔɔ ɛra me nwo zo la sɛ a. Ɛdɛnkɛma a manle anwubɛnyunlu ɛhye rale a wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɛya kpole la.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: “Ɔzoanle senle vi anwuma; ɔmanle ɔwolole me mbowule nu; ɔzuale me ɛhane; ɔdole me aze; yegyakyi me ɛkɛ, me nye zo bulu alehyenlɛ muala.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: “Bɛkyekyele me ɛtane ne mɔ bɔlɛ; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye a ɔkyekyele a; ɔvale ɔhendanle me kɔme; ye ɛnlomboɛ manle mengolole. Awulae yele me manle me kpɔvolɛma, mɔɔ mengola bɛ nyunlu gyinla la.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: “Awulae honle tiale me ɛlɔnema anu katakyiema; ɔmanle ɛlɔnema ratetale me hunle me mgbavolɛ ne mɔ; Awulae ɛdi Dwudama kɛmɔ bɛtwihwi vanye ma wɔ nwanyeyɛlɛ melahyinli nu la.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: “Ɛhye mɔ ati a melɛsu, monle ɛbia me takaa la; ɔluakɛ menlɛ awie mɔɔ kyekye me rɛle a, awie bɔbɔ mɔɔ si me ahonle la; me menli ne ɛdɔ agyie, ɔluakɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛva me aze.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: “Zayɔn tende ɔ sa, noko moalɛ biala ɛmba; Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdendɛ ɛtia Gyekɔbo, kɛ menli mɔɔ zuozua ye la ɛyɛ ye kpɔvolɛma. Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhakyi fovolɛ bie wɔ menli avinli.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: “Ɛdɛnkɛma di benle, ɔluakɛ medu ɔ nloa medo; maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛnlea nyane mɔɔ melɛnwu ye a; bɛhye me mbɛlɛra nee mgbavolɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔ.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: “Menvɛlɛle me kulovolɛma, na bɛbɛlɛbɛlale me; me sɛlɛvolɛma nee me mgbanyima wule suakpole ne azo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ aleɛ bɛali na bɛanyia ngoane la.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nea me na melɛnwu amaneɛ, me ɛkɛla ɛminli me nwo, me ahonle mɔɔ la me kunlu la ɛlɛte, ɔboalekɛ mede ɛ nwo atua kpole kpalɛ. Menli ɛhunlɛ ɛlɛsɔ yɔɔ wɔ guabile zo, sua nu bɔbɔ, ewule ɛlie ebia.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: “Bɛdele kɛ melɛkponle, noko awie ankyekye me rɛle. Me kpɔvolɛma amuala ɛde me amaneɛnwunlɛ nga; bɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ wɔdea me a. Maa kenle ne mɔɔ wɔhile la ɛrɛla na bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ kɛ medame la.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: “Maa bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu; ɛ nee bɛ ɛli, kɛmɔ ɛ nee me ɛli wɔ me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ anwo la, ɔluakɛ mekponle mehyɛ, yɛɛ me ɛnwomenle ɛwie.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Nea kɛ Awulae ɛzi ɛva ɛya, ɛmaa awozinli ɛva Zayɔn a. Yevuandi Yizilayɛ anyunlunyia ne yedo aze. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɛya la yeanvavi ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɔbɔ.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: Awulae anze anwunvɔne, yebɔ Yizilayɛ sua biala; yeva ɛya yegologolo Dwudama aranemgbole ne mɔ; yemaa maanle ne nee ye arelemgbunli anyunlu ɛgua aze.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Yeva ɛya kpole yehu Yizilayɛ katakyiema; kpɔvolɛma dwazole bɛ nwo zo, na Awualae amboa bɛ; ɔzɔle gbolamgbolam kɛ senle wɔ Yizilayɛ ɔyelale debie biala.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Yeva ye ɛda ne yezu yɛ, yeva ye tumi ne yetia yɛ kɛ kpɔvolɛ; yehu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yɛ nye die bɛ nwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kɔsɔɔti, yewola ye ɛya ne yegua kɛ senle.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛyɛ kɛ kpɔvolɛ, yebɔ Yizilayɛ bɔkɔɔ; yebubu ye suakunlu kɔsɔɔti, yegologolo ye aranemgbole ne mɔ; yemaa Dwudama nyanelilɛ nee awolɛyelɛ ɛyɛ kpole.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: Yegologolo ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne kɛ asɛɛ tola nu kpɔda, yezɛkye ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛvoyialilɛ nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛzielɛ ɛzi aze wɔ Zayɔn, yeva ɛya kpole yekpo ye arelemgbunli nee ye sɛlɛvolɛma.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛkpo ye azukponle ne, yekpo ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne; yemaa kpɔvolɛma ɛbubu ye suakunlu bane ne mɔ; bɛdeɛdeanle nu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne anu, kɛ asɛɛ bɛlɛdi ɛvoyia la.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma vuale kɛ ɔka Zayɔn bane ne mɔ yeagua; ɔvale ɛzuzudeɛ ɔzuzule bane ne; yeangakyi adwenle ne mɔɔ ɔvale kɛ ɔsɛkye ye la; ɔmanle bane nee aranemgbole bubule guale, bɛ muala bɛgulule nu bɛgolole bɛguale.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zayɔn nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛbubu ɛgua; bɛ nzi mbulalɛ ne mɔ ɛbubu; bɛhye ye belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima bɛhɔ nlɔnu; mɛla ne ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko, yɛɛ ye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛnnwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛnvi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Zayɔn mgbanyima dede ye ngungoonwu; bɛvula nzonle bɛgua bɛ ti zo na bɛheda ɛrele; Gyɛlusalɛm mbɛlɛra ɛsisi bɛ ti aze.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: Me nye la monle nu; me ɛkɛla anye zo ɛda ye; debie ɛlɛyɛ me ahonle, ɔlua Zayɔn ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ la ati, ɔboalekɛ mbɛda nee nlɔma anye zo ɛbulu wɔ Zayɔn guabile zo.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ bɛ nli mɔ kɛ, “Aleɛ nee nwanye wɔ nienwu?” Bɛ nye zo bulu wɔ Zayɔn guabile ne mɔ azo kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbodɛboda la; bɛ nli mɔ kɛdwu bɛ la ɛnee bɛhete bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛmma, duzu a menga a, duzu a menva bɛ mendo nwo a? Duzu a menva bɛ mendo nwolɛ, amaa meakyekye bɛ rɛle a, O Gyɛlusalɛm? Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛdo bɛ la le kpole tɛla nyevile tandane; awie ɛngola nwolɛ ɛhwee yɛ.

english_verse: Your prophets deceived you with false visions and lying messages— they should have warned you to leave your sins and be saved from disaster.
translation_verse: Bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha adalɛ nee mɛlɛbɛla ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhile bɛ; bɛamkpa bɛ ninyɛndane nwo ɛdanlɛ bɛanlie bɛ bɛanvi munzule nu; bɛhanle adalɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nee amaneɛ mɔɔ minli sonla la a bɛhilele bɛ a.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ se adenle ne azo la nea bɛ, bɔ bɛ sa nu, si bɛ amgbu; bɛkpusu bɛ ti na bɛsele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ, “Asoo suakpole kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ ye kɛnlɛma di munli na ewiade amra amuala anye sɔ ye la ɛ?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Bɛ kpɔmanvolɛma kɔsɔɔti tendɛ tia bɛ, bɛsele bɛ bɛkpobi bɛ nloa bɛse kɛ, “Aa, mekɛ ne mɔɔ yɛhendɛ dedee la ɛne; yɛ sa ɛha ye, yɛzɛkye ye, mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la ala ɛne!”

english_verse: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔzele la, yeyɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle bɛ nwolɛ kɔkɔ la, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ye dɛbadɛba la, yeanze anwunvɔne, yezɛkye debie biala, yemaa wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛzi ɛ nwo zo agole, na yemaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ne ɛyɛ kpole.

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: O Gyɛlusalɛm, tea nu fɛlɛ Awulae. Maa monle ɛbia wɔ kɛ nzule, wɔ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ. Mmadie wɔ ɛnwomenle fee, yɛɛ mmadafe.

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Dwazo, su aledwolɛ nu amuala, bɔ ɔ bo nɔsonɔso ne ala! Wola wɔ nyane gua Awulae anyunlu, kɛ ɛwola nzule wɔagua. Sɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛ mra ne mɔ ngoane ti; ɛhɔne ti bɛ nye zo bulu awɔdenle ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, to ɛ nye nea! Nwane mɔ a ɛ nee bɛ ɛli ye zɛhae a? Asoo mraalɛ ɛhu bɛ mra ɛli? Bɛ mra mɔɔ bɛ nye die bɛ nwo la. Bɛlɛku sɛlɛvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma wɔ Awulae Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Wɔ gua ne mɔ azo lɔ, mgbanyinli nee ngakula avunli ngome; me mbɛlɛra nee me mgbavolɛ ɛdɔ dadeɛ nloa; wɔ ɛya mekɛ ne ɛdwu, wɔhu bɛ, wɔanvavi bie.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: Ɛdole ɛsalɛ ɛvɛlɛle me kpɔvolɛma, bɛrale kɛ asɛɛ bɛba ɛvoyialilɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya la, awie biala anvi ɛsalɛ; menli mɔɔ menlile bɛ adane la, me kpɔvolɛma hunle bɛ kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: I have suffered much because God was angry.
translation_verse: Mame a mele sonla mɔɔ ɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ Nyamenle ɛyavalɛ bo a.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: Yehwili me, yeva me yera awozinli kabii mɔɔ wienyi ɛnle nu la anu;

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: ye ndeanlɛ ne kɛ gyi me nwo zo ala ɛne wɔ alehyenlɛ biala anu.

english_verse: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
translation_verse: yezie me nyane nee arɛlebɔlɛ kpole nu;

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: yemaa meha awozinli nu kɛ mɔwuamra ala la.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: Yedo me efiade, yegua me anga, mengola menriandi;

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: mesu mefɛlɛ kɛ ɔlie me, noko ɔndie me nzɛlɛlɛ;

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: yehundo awolɛ yedua me ndenle, yemaa me ndenle ɛhyeɛhyea.

english_verse: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
translation_verse: Yeyɛ me nwo bedi mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia, kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛwie tɛ la;

english_verse: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
translation_verse: ɔyele me ɔvile me adenle ne anu na ɔtetele me; yemaa meyɛ mgbane;

english_verse: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
translation_verse: ɔvale ye ɛda ne ɔzule me kɛ ɔto yeawɔ me.

english_verse: straight through my heart.
translation_verse: Ɔtotole ye ɛda ne mɔ ɔwowɔle me ahonle.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: Menli kɔsɔɔti sele me, alehyenlɛ biala bɛfa me bɛto edwɛne.

english_verse: God has turned my life sour.
translation_verse: Yemaa nyane ɛha me, me nloa anu ɛyɛ kɛ subo.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Yehwi me nyunlu aze, yemaa me gye ɛwie kpolo.

english_verse: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
translation_verse: Menlɛ anzonudwolɛ, menze anyelielɛ deɛ holɛ.

english_verse: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mese, “Me anyunlunyia ɛwie, yɛɛ menlɛ anyelazo bieko wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.”

english_verse: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
translation_verse: Kakye me nyanelilɛ nee me amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ me nloa anu kɛ subo nee bɔnyema la.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla dwenle nwo dahuu na ɔmaa medi nyane.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Mekakye edwɛkɛ ɛhye, zɔhane ati melɛ anyelazo.

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛmbɔ aze, ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne abo ɛndu ɛlɛ;

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: alehyenlɛ biala bɛle fofolɛ, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne le kpole.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Me ɛkɛla se, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le me afoa nu ɛdeɛ, yemɔti mebanyia anyelazo wɔ ye nu.”

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la, ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa ɛkɛla mɔɔ kpondɛ ye la.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛzie ɔ ti koonwu kɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ngoanelielɛ ne abo zo;

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛgyɛnva ye gyɛnvayile ne ye mgbavolɛ nu.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ɔva ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔzie ɔ nwo diinyi;

english_verse: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
translation_verse: bɛmaa ɔhwi ɔ nloa aze, ɔkɛyɛ kɛ anyelazo wɔ ɛkɛ;

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: ɔmaa bɛbo ye bɛdua ye ɛzunlɛ, na ɔli ye aholoba ne ɔ kunlu.

english_verse: The Lord won't always reject us!
translation_verse: Awulae ɛnrɛkpo sonla bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: ɔtea ye, noko ɔse anwunvɔne, kɛmɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne kpole de la,

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔnle ye ɛhulolɛ kɛ ɔkɛhile sonla nyane.

english_verse: Don't trample prisoners under your feet
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ bɛdo ye efiade la nyanelilɛ,

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: sonla ɛsisilɛ wɔ Anwuma Anwumanli ne anyunlu,

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: yɛɛ sonla mgbɔvodɛne ɛbualɛ, Awulae ɛnlie ɛndo nu.

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛha ɛmaa yeyɛ zɔ a? Kyesɛ Awulae ɔdaye yehyehyɛ ye zɔ.

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Asoo tɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne edwɛkɛ zo yɛɛ kpalɛ nee ɛtane dua ba a?

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a sonla mɔɔ de ngoane nu la kɛdendɛ ɔ nzo abo wɔ ye ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ nwo ɛ?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛnlea yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu boɛ, na yɛzia yɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛmaa yɛ sa nee yɛ ahonle zo yɛmaa Nyamenle wɔ anwuma

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: kɛ, “Yɛyɛ ɛtane, yɛde atua, na O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛtɛfale ɛtɛkyɛle yɛ.

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: “Wɔva ɛya wɔvoa yɛ ndinlizo, wɔanze anwunvɔne, ɛlɛku yɛ;

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: wɔva amungu wɔheda ɛ nwo, yemɔti ɛnde yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ biala.

english_verse: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
translation_verse: Wɔdo yɛ kɛ ewula wɔgua maanle maanle avinli.

english_verse: our enemies curse us.
translation_verse: “Yɛ kpɔvolɛma amuala bɔ yɛ aholoba;

english_verse: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
translation_verse: yɛ nye zo ɛda yɛ, yɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ ahuma, ɛzɛkyelɛ nee munzule ɛva yɛ aze.

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: Me nye la monle nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ me menli ne abo zo.

english_verse: and they won't stop
translation_verse: “Menrɛgyakyi monle ɛhwinlɛ,

english_verse: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛdo ɔ nye kɛnlea aze na ɔkɛnwu kɛ,

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛzi suakpole ne azo mbɛlɛra nwo zo la ɛmmaa mengola me nwo sɔ.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: “Me kpɔvolɛma ɛhye me kɛ anloma, bɛkpɔ me mgbane gyɛne ne ala;

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: bɛvuandinle me anyewɔzo bɛdole kuma nu, na bɛtotole awolɛ bɛbɔle me.

english_verse: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
translation_verse: Nzule bule me nwo zo, na menganle kɛ, ‘Mewu!’

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: “Menzunle menvɛlɛle wɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ kuma ne abo lɔ.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Ɛdele me modolɛ kɛ, ‘Mmatuodua ɛ nzo, mmakpo kɛ ɛnrɛdie me ɛzunlɛ, ɛnrɛlie me.’

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Menvɛlɛle wɔ la ɛbikyele me, ɛzele me kɛ, ‘Mmasulo!’

english_verse: You rescued me and saved my life.
translation_verse: “O Awulae, wɔlie me ti, wɔlie me ngoane.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔnwu mɔɔ amumuyɛma ɛyɛ me a; bua edwɛkɛ ne maa me.

english_verse: You know every plot they have made against me.
translation_verse: Wɔnwu bɛ nzenralɛ mɔɔ bɛli me la amuala, wɔnwu adwenle ɛtane mɔɔ bɛva ye me nwo la.

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ kɔsɔɔti me kpɔvolɛma kɔ me ti akpamo.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Nea bɛ azedɛnlanlɛ nee bɛ ɛdwazolɛ nu bɔbɔ, bɛfa me bɛto edwɛne.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tea bɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Maa bɛ ahonle ɛsolo, na maa munzule ɛdo bɛ.

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dua wɔ ɛya ne azo foa bɛ, na bɔ bɛ bo zo fi aleɛabo.”

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Ezukoa nvutuke ne ɛlu, ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ anye ɛhakyi. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne awolɛ ne mɔ ɛkponde suakpole ye awɔdenle ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Zayɔn mgbavolɛ mɔɔ di munli, mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke la ɛnɛ ɛzɔho mbuakɛ mɔɔ nwovolɛ ɛnwo bɛ ɔ sa nu la.

english_verse: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
translation_verse: Ɛzonlɛ bɔbɔ noa bɛ mra nyɛfonlɛ, na me menli ne ɛdeɛ, bɛ ti ɛyɛ se, bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo soholo.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne ku bɛ nlɔma, ngakula ne mɔ su kɛ bɛdie aleɛ, noko awie ɛnnea bɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ di aleɛ kpalɛ la, ɛnɛ ɛhɔne ku bɛ gua guabile zo; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛde arelemgbunli azua nu la ɛnɛ gua fovolɛ zo.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: Me menli ne ndeanlɛ ɛyɛ kpole ɛdɛla Sodɔm ɛdeɛ ne; yemɔ, bɛzɛkyele ye arɛlevilɛ nu, tɛ sonla a zɛkyele ye a.

english_verse: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
translation_verse: Ɛnee yɛ arelemgbunli anwo te tɛla ezukɔtweaba nee nyɛfonzule, bɛnyi ngɛnlɛma, bɛ nwo yɛ se; bɛ ngɛnlɛma le kɛ ezukoa bolɛ safaya.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Akee bɛ nyunlu ɛlu kisii ɛdɛla sisikpunlike, bɛnnwu bɛ menli holɛ; bɛnwa bɛhakyi mbowule, bɛhete kɛ ɛyɛne.

english_verse: Being killed with a sword is better than slowly starving to death.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ dɔle konle nu la anwo dwole dɛlale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔne hunle bɛ la; ɛhɔne manle bɛhetele, ɛbɔ nu nzoleɛ bɔbɔ, bɛannyia bie.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ se anwunvɔne la ɛdo bɛ kunlu mralɛ ɛli. Me menli ne ɛzɛkyelɛ manle bɛvale bɛ bɛhakyile aleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele ye ɛya kpole ne, na ɔwolale ye ɛya wuluwulu ne ɔguale; ɔdole senle wɔ Zayɔn, na ɔzɔle ɔyelale suakpole ne adiabo ne mɔ.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli anlie anli, azɛlɛ ye azo sonla biala anlie anli, kɛ kpɔvolɛma kɛhola kɛwolo Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛtane ne mɔ, nee sɛlɛvolɛma ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle, kɛ bɛhanle tenlenema mogya bɛguale la ati yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ zile a.

english_verse: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
translation_verse: Bɛhakyile anyenzinlirama bɛluoluale gua ne mɔ azo; mogya ɛbia bɛ takaa mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛnzɔ bɛ ndanlɛ nu a.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Menli deanle zele kɛ, “Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne! Bɛ nwo ɛnde! Awie mmamaa ɔ nwo ka bɛ.” Yemɔti bɛvoanle bɛ bɛmanle bɛluoluale nu. Maanle maanle zele kɛ, “Yɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdɛnla bieko.”

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne a ɛkponde bɛ a; ɔnrɛbu bɛ bieko; yeambu sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ, yeanze mgbanyima ne mɔ anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Our eyes became weary, hopelessly looking for help from a nation that could not save us.
translation_verse: Yɛ nye hale adenle zo, yɛhendɛle moalɛ mgbane; yɛzinzale yɛhendɛle maanle mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔnlɛ gyinlagyakɛ la.

english_verse: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
translation_verse: Menli vunvuanle yɛ gyakɛ abo zo mɔɔ ɛnee yɛngola finde a, yɛ awieleɛ bikyele, yɛ mekɛ dwule, ɔluakɛ yɛ awieleɛ ɛra.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ voanle yɛ la anwo yɛ ndɛ tɛla anloma ɛkpɔtɛ; bɛvoanle yɛ awoka zo lɔ; bɛhɔle yɛ nwo nzia wɔ fienemgbole nu.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛmaa yɛ, na ɔle yɛ ɛnwomenle la, bɛhye ye bɛ ɛhane nu. Yemɔ a yɛhanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, “Saa yɛwɔ ɔ bo a, yɛnzulo maanle maanle ne mɔ” a.

english_verse: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛli fɛlɛko, O Yidɔmma mɔɔ de Ɛɛze azɛlɛ zo, na bɛ nyane kɔpo ɛdeɛ ne bara bɛ nwo zo; bɛbanlo, bɛabo, na bɛayeye bɛ nwo bɛagua zo.

english_verse: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
translation_verse: Zayɔnoma, bɛwie bɛ tea wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati; ɔbaye bɛ yeavi nlɔnu; na bɛmɛ Yidɔmma, bɛbadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati, ɔbaza bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ yeagua zo.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nea mɔɔ ɛdo yɛ a; nea anyiemgba mɔɔ yɛbɔ a.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Yɛ gyadeɛ ɛpɛ ɛli nyɛvolɛ asa anu, nyɛvolɛ ɛva yɛ azua.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ nrisa, yɛnlɛ selɛ; yɛ nli mɔ ɛhakyi ahunlanvolɛ.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Yɛtua nzule mɔɔ yɛno la kakɛ, yɛtɔ ɛyɛne na yɛawuda.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Gyɛnvayile gua yɛ kɔme zo, yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ; bɛmmaa yɛnlie yɛ ɛnwomenle, yɛwie fɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Amaa yɛanyia aleɛ yɛali la, yɛsonle Yigyibiti nee Aselea.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Egya mɔ yɛle ɛtane, na bɛwu bɛhɔ; nwolɛ ɛzonle ɛzoa yɛmɛ.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Ahanra a sie yɛ a; yɛnnyia awie ɛnlie yɛ ɛnvi bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛ ngoane yɛtɔ aleɛ, ɔluakɛ ahɔdiawu ɛva ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Yɛ nwo ɛlɔ kɛ fonlomo, ɛhɔne ngome ɛwie yɛ yela.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Bɛkye yɛ mraalɛ bɛfa bɛ wɔ Zayɔn; bɛyɛ mbɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze mrenya la zɔhane wɔ Dwuda.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Bɛkyekye yɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ asa bɛkenda bɛ, bɛmbu yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ bie.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kyiba abɛlɛ melahyinli, yɛɛ ngakula mrenya soa ɛyɛne avile mgbole, na bɛ gyakɛ anzi wozo bɛ.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛvi suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛdua edwɛne ɛdolɛ.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Yɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛwie; yɛ agolezilɛ ɛhakyi yɛ nyanelilɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Yɛ nyunlu ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ; abule ɛbu yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane!

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati nyane ɛwie yɛ ku, ɛhye ati monle ɛmmaa yɛnnwu aze,

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Zayɔn Boka ɛdɔ mgbane, ɛzonlɛ a duolua ɛkɛ ne didi a.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle belemgbunli dahuu; wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Why have you forgotten us for so long?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a wɔkpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ? Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ?

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa yɛ bɔ wɔ ɛbolɛ. Maa yɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ kɛ dɛba ne la.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ wɔkpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɔ? Wɔva yɛ nwo ɛya bɔkɔɔ ɔ?

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo la, menwunle kɛ ahumu vi ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛlɛba. Ɛnee amungu ne le kpole kpalɛ na wienyi kpole bie ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye. Senle vi amungu ne anu ɛlɛtudu, na debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ ɛlɛta la wɔ senle ne anu.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Akee menwunle debie bie mɔɔ zɔho tease abɔdeɛ la nna. Na kɛ bɛde la ɛne: bɛle kɛ menli la,

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: noko ko biala anyunlu nna, yɛɛ ɔlɛ ndɛbalɛ nna.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Bɛ gyakɛ tenletenle, yɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ taboa ne mɔ le kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ndwɛlɛ la, na bɛta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛbolo nwolɛ la.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ kpulokpula zolɛ, yɛɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo zo na bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛkɔ fɔɔnwo; biala ɛmpɛne ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɛngakyi ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Bɛ nyunlu ne mɔ kɛ de la ɛne: ko biala anyunlu nna; ɔ nyunlu ko le sonla nyunlu, ye fema zo le awenade nyunlu, ye bɛne zo le ɛnlankɛ nyinli nyunlu, yɛɛ ɔ nzi le kɔleɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Bɛmemanle bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ nwiɔ nwiɔ zo mɔɔ ko biala ɛdeɛ ko ati kpula ɔ gɔnwo mɔɔ bikye ye la ɛdeɛ ne ati, yɛɛ ndɛbalɛ nwiɔ nwiɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la betɛbeta bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Ko biala tu ɔ bo a ɔkɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo; ɛleka biala mɔɔ sunsum ne kɛva bɛ kɛdu kɛdenrɛ la, biala ɛmpɛne ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ avinli, debie bie mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ guaanye kɛ senle samɛnlankɛ, na ɔle kɛ tɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ la wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔsɔ ɔkpɔsa tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anu. Ye senle ne ta kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye fi nuhua finde.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ noko tudu agyakɛ kɔ ba kɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye mɔɔ kɛkpakye la.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meneanle tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ la, menwunle kɛ ehwili nna gyigyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, ko biala ehwili ko.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Ehwili nna ne amuala zɔho bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ asɛɛ ehwili vea ehwili nu, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ta kɛ ezukoa bolɛ.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Ehwili nna ne mɔ amuala dedɛ bɛ gyakɛ ahutukpunli mɔɔ mbaka anzɛɛ mbulalɛ beɛbea nuhua, yɛɛ egyakɛ kutukpunli ko biala anwo le ɛnyelɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ tu bɛ bo, anzɛɛ gyinla, anzɛɛ maa bɛ nwo zo a, ehwili ne mɔ yɛ zɔhane ala. Ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ nwiɔ nwiɔ anu mɔɔ ko kpula ɔ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛva nwiɔ bɛhedɛheda bɛ nwo na bɛgyigyi ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛta la abo.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, mendele kɛ ɛnee bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ anu ɛlɛsu kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ nu, ɔle kɛ Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛkulu la, na ɔle kɛ ɛlɔne kpole bie ɛlɛyɛ alɛra la. Mɔɔ bɛkɛgyinla la, ɛnee bɛgua bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ aze.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Saa bɛgyinla na bɛgua bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ aze a, ɛnelɛ vi ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ hendɛhenda bɛ ti zo la azo ba.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Wɔ ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ hendɛhenda bɛ ti zo anwuma la azo, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ belemgbunli ebia, mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye safaya la a bɛyɛle la gyi zolɛ, na debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la de nuhua.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Deɛ ne mɔɔ de ebia ne anu la anwuma toonwo mɔɔ badwu ɔ nze zo la ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ ɛlɛta la, na yeyɛ kɛ asɛɛ debie mɔɔ senle ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la; akee menwunle kɛ ɔvi ɔ nze zo toonwo mɔɔ badwu ye aze la le kɛ senle na wienyi kpole kpalɛ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Wienyi ne le kɛ ezule mɔɔ ɛmunla la nyangondonle ne mɔɔ kɛdo la. Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne sɔhovolɛ de la ɛne. Nyamenle fɛlɛ Yizikeɛle ayɛ ye kpɔmanvolɛ Mɔɔ menwunle ɛhye la, membutule me nye aze, na mendele awie ane kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu, na me nee wɔ tendɛ.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔdendɛle ɔhilele me la, Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔmanle mendwazole mengyinlanle, na mendele kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mesoa wɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo ɛkɛ. Bɛle maanle mɔɔ te atua a, na bɛde me nwo atua. Bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ bɛtietia me mɛla zo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Eza bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛzua anyetele, yɛɛ bɛmbu me. Mesoa wɔ wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ na wɔahɔze bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne.’

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛtie wɔ anzɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie wɔ a, bɛbanwu kɛ amuanrɛɛ bɛlɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ wɔ bɛ avinli, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛle atuadelɛma.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, mmasulo bɛ, yɛɛ mmasulo mɔɔ bɛkeha la. Ɔbayɛ kɛ ɛla mbowule nu anzɛɛ ɛde nyamenleakɛlɛ avinli. Noko mmasulo bɛ ngehanleɛ yɛɛ mmamaa bɛ anyehoanlɛ ne mɔ tu wɔ ahonle, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛde atua a.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtie wɔ anzɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie wɔ bɔbɔ a, ka me edwɛkɛ ne kile bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛde atua a.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, tie mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la. Mmate atua kɛ menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. Buke ɛ nloa na di mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa wɔ la.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ bɛdende ɛsalɛ bie me nwo na ɔlɛ nwoma mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ nu la.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ɔdɛlɛle nwoma ne anu wɔ me nyunlu ɛkɛ, na ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ ɔ kunlu nee ɔ nzi amuala. Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle la le awolɛyelɛ, nyanelilɛ nee munzule edwɛkɛ ngome.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, di nwoma ɛhye mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa wɔ la maa ɛ ko ɛyi.” Menlile, na ɔyɛle me nloa anu menlemenle kɛ wolɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, kɔ Yizilayɛma ɛkɛ na ka me nloa edwɛkɛ ne kile bɛ.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Noko Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛnrɛdie wɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛtie me ne, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati anu le bile, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle ɛsolo.

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, mebamaa ɛdawɔ noko wɔayɛ se na meamaa wɔasolo kɛ bɛdabɛ la.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Kɔ wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔ nlɔnu la ɛkɛ ne, na saa bɛtie wɔ o, bɛandie wɔ o, ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese la ɛne.’ ”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle me zo, na mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛlɛkpogya ɔ nwo zo avi ɔ bo zo ne la, mendele azɛlɛkpusulɛ ɛnelɛ kpole bie wɔ me nzi nehane.

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ andɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ keha bɛ nwo, yɛɛ ehwili ne mɔ anwo alɛra ne a le kɛ azɛlɛkpusulɛ la.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔmanle me zo ɔhɔle. Ɛnee ɛya ɛhu me kpole. Na ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne tumi ne wɔ me nwo zo kpole.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Membale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la ɛkɛ wɔ Tɛle Abebe, wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la wɔ la. Me nee bɛ dɛnlanle kenle nsuu, na mɔɔ mendele nee mɔɔ menwunle ye la zinle me nwo. Ɛdɛnkɛma maa Yizikeɛle ayɛ sinzavolɛ (Yiz

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, meyɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma sinzavolɛ. Kenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛde edwɛkɛ ɛkɛvi me nloa anu la, ɛbaha wɔahile bɛ wɔabɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔamaa me.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Saa mese amumuyɛnli bie kɛ ɔbawu, na wɔanga wɔangile ye wɔamaa yeangakyi ye subane, yeanlie ye ɛkɛla ngoane a, ɔbawu kɛ ɔle ɛtanenli, na mebabiza wɔ ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Na saa ɛbɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ, na yeangakyi ye subane a, ɔbawu, na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ wɔ ngoane, ɛnli ɛzonle.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: “Saa tenlenenli bɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi ɛtane, ɔyɛ amumuyɛ a, mebamaa yeadu koti. Kɛmɔ ɛtɛbɔle ye kɔkɔ la ati, ɔbawu wɔ ye ɛtane ti, yɛɛ ye debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, menrɛhakye ye bieko; na ye ewule ne ɛdeɛ, mebabiza wɔ nwolɛ edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Noko akee, saa ɛbɔ tenlenenli zɔhane kɔkɔ kɛ ɔmmayɛ ɛtane ne na ɔgyakyi, yeannyia yeanyɛ ɛtane ne a, ɔbanyia ngoane kɛ ɔdiele wɔ kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne a, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ noko wɔlie wɔ ngoane.” Yizikeɛle ɛnrɛhola tendɛ

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne dwule me nwo zo kpole kpalɛ, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Dwazo kɔ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ wienyi ne azo lɔ. Ɛkɛ ne a mebadendɛ meahile wɔ a.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mendwazole mengɔle azɛlɛ sɛsɛ wienyi ne azo lɔ, na menwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔle kɛ anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ menwunle ye wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la, na membutule mutule nu.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na mendwazole mengyinlanle me gyakɛ anu, na ɔdendɛle ɔzele me kɛ, “Kɔ kɔdo ɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu wɔ ɛdawɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, bɛbava nyɛma bɛakyekye wɔ mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola menli nu finde a.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛ tafinlima abutu na wɔadɔ mumule mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola tendɛ na wɔabɔ bɛ kɔkɔ a, ɔboalekɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Na saa me nee wɔ tendɛ a, mebazianyi ɛ tafinlima na wɔaze bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne.’ Mɔɔ kɛdie la, maa ɔdie, mɔɔ kɛkpo noko kɛ ɔnrɛdie la, gyakyi ye, ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, sonla ra, fa belekese ko to ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ, na koɔhoa zolɛ maa ɔgyinla ɛkɛ ɔmaa suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Akee yɛ debie mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la. Fu kuma wɔ nwolɛ bɛnra yia, kuohua ɛnwea nwolɛ, yɛ azokoɛleɛ na siezie konle ninyɛne bɛnra yia ye.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Fa kyɛnze tɛtɛlɛ yɛ bane wa ɛdawɔ nee suakpole ne bɛ avinli. Akee yɛ kɛ ɛ nee suakpole ne ɛlɛko. Bɛva suakpole ne aze ala ɛne, na wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔva suakpole ne aze a. Ɛhye le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: “Akee maa ɛ nye ɛgyinla Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la anwo. Sua botokuma na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne tia ye.

english_verse: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
translation_verse: Nea, mebava nyɛma meakyekye wɔ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛ nwo kakyi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛwie suakpole ne fa la.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
