translation_verse: “Akee fa hwiiti, baale, aluba akpatala nee alubandenra , yɛɛ atoko; fa bɛ muala gua kyɛnze nu fete yɛ kpanwo. Aleɛ mɔɔ ɛbali, wɔ kenle ɛya nsa abulahɔnla ne anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛla ɛhyɛne zo la ɛne.

english_verse: and drink only two large cups of water.
translation_verse: Eza ɛbanlo nzule ekyi bie, kɛyɛ kɔpo nwiɔ kenle ko.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Ɛbava sonla ebinli welera wɔawuda senle wɔadondo wɔ kpanwo ne wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ wɔali.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma bali bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔbɔ bɛ asande menwɔhɔgua maanle gyɛne gyɛne zo la a.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Na membuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae Nyamenle! Nɔhalɛ, ɔvi me ngakula nu toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la metɛdile debie mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome yewu anzɛɛ nane kpole bie ɛtete ye nu la, yɛɛ debie nvoanle biala ɛtɛkpulale me nloa na evinli aha me.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Ɔle kpalɛ. Ɛnee mebamaa wɔava ɛnlankɛ ebinli na wɔagyakyi sonla ebinli ne, na wɔadondo wɔ kpanwo ne zolɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Sonla ra, memaa ɛhɔne azi Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛbava sulosulo bɛazuzu bɛ aleɛ na bɛali na bɛava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛazuzu bɛ nzule na bɛanlo.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Mebayɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ nzule asesa na bɛ aleɛ awie, bɛbava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛanleɛnlea bɛ nyunlu, na bɛ ndeanlɛ ne bamaa bɛanwa.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, o sonla ra, fa dadeɛ mɔɔ yɛ nla kpalɛ la kakyi dadeɛ dɛma, na fa kpa ɛ ti enrinli nee ɛ kɛsa amuala. Suzu enrinli ne mɔɔ ɛkɛkpa la wɔ tone zo na akee kyɛ nu nsa.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Gua ko senle nu yela ye wɔ suakpole ne avinli, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛva suakpole ne ɛkɛwie la; fa ko pepɛ nu ngyikyi ngyikyi kponde suakpole ne anwo yia, na kponde ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la anwoma ne anu, na medame, akee mebava me dadeɛ ne meazi mealɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Fa ɛkpɔ ɛhye mɔ biala anu ekyi kyekye ye wɔ wɔ tɛladeɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛbava ɛhye wɔagua senle nu wɔamaa yeazɔ. Ɛbanwu kɛ senle vi nuhua bazɔ ahɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: “Gyɛlusalɛm ɛne. Meva ye mezie ewiade avinli, memaa maanle maanle ɛbɔ ɛyia ye.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Noko yede atua amumuyɛ nu ala kɛ ɔnrɛli me mɛla ne mɔ nee me ngyehyɛlɛ zo, bɔbɔ yedɛla maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la amuala.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese la ɛne: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ ɛ nzo yɛ se tɛla maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ, na wɔanli me ngyehyɛlɛ nee me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na wɔva ɛ nwo wɔtolo maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ la,

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: medame Awulae Nyamenle, kɛ mese la ɛne: Nea, medame, ɛhɛe, medame mumua ne, meyɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ. Mebadea wɔ meamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu ye.

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Ɔlua bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ ati, mɔɔ mebava meahile bɛ la, metɛfale bie metɛkilele awie ɛlɛ, yɛɛ menrɛyɛ ye bieko ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Ye zɔhane ati, selɛma bahu bɛ mra mrenya ali na mralɛ mrenya ahu bɛ ze mɔ ali. Mebadea bɛ kpalɛ, na bɛ nuhua mɔɔ kɛha la, mebabɔ bɛ asande meahɔgua ɛleka muala.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati medame tease Awulae Nyamenle, mese, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ bɛva bɛ ninyɛmunli nee bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛgua me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne evinli la, mebabɔ bɛ bo zo. Menrɛvavi bie yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahyɛ bɛ nuhua nsa ahu ko; nwiɔ ne mɔɔ baha la, ko bawu konle nu; na meabɔ ko ne mɔɔ baha la asande na meava konle meazi bɛ zo.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: “Zɛhae yɛɛ bɛbanwu me ɛyavalɛ ne a; mebakpokpo ye kɔsɔɔti meagua bɛ ti zo na me kunlu adwo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meva ɛya kpole a melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ a.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: “Saa me ɛya ne fo me na me sa sɔ wɔ nu kɛ metea wɔ a, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ la bazi wɔ amgbu, na yeayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ yeamaa bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a!

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Mebamaa sane nee ɛhɔne ara bɛ nwo zo na bɛade ye nyane kɛ ɛda mɔɔ ɛlɛwowɔ bɛ azɛkye bɛ la.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛhɔne nee nanemgbole arahu bɛ mra, na meamaa ewulenzane, konle nee kpolera adɔ bɛ avinli ahu bɛ. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a!”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, fa ɛ nye su Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ na fa me nrɛlaleɛ kɔmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ: Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ awoka, bɛdie Awulae Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ ne. Awulae Nyamenle ne se, bɛmɛ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, mbɔnza nee ahuma, bɛnlea na medame, ɛhɛe, medame, mebava konle meadoa bɛ, na meazɛkye bɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle la.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Mebabubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛlɛ azukponle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, na meava bɛ avunli mearagua bɛ mmonle ne mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Mebava Yizilayɛma avunli meagua bɛ mmonle ne mɔ anyunlu, na meazande bɛ mbowule wɔ bɛ azukponle ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole kɔsɔɔti adɔ mgbane, na meabubu bɛ mmonle nee bɛ azukponle ne mɔ amuala, meazɛkye bɛ ɛyɛlɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na meaminli bɛ sa anloa gyima bo zo.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Bɛbahuhu menli sesakaa wɔ bɛ avinli na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Noko mebamaa bɛ bie mɔ avi ɛsalɛ na bɛade bɛakponde maanle maanle zo, amaa saa bɛte bɛkponde maanle maanle ne mɔ azo a,

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, na edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ menganle kɛ mebamaa munzule ɛhye ado bɛ la, meanga ye mgbane.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Bɔ ɛ sa nu! Si ɛ gyakɛ aze! Ka kɛ, ‘Egya e!’ wɔ Yizilayɛma munzule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati. Ɔluakɛ bɛbawuwu wɔ konle nee ewule mɔɔ bazi la anu.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua mɔɔ wɔ moa la ewulenzane bahu bɛ, bɛ nuhua mɔɔ wɔ sua nu la badɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ konle nu; yɛɛ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ baha la, ɛhɔne nee sane bahu bɛ. Ɛhye yɛɛ bɛbava bɛanwu kɛ me ɛyavalɛ ne ɛnlomboɛ si de la a.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛ avunli bayɛ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ avunli, bɛ azukponle ne mɔ azo, awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, bɛ egyane ne mɔ abo, bɛ oku mbaka bubuzuu ne mɔ abo, yɛɛ bɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛzonlenle la totɔɔ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Mebadenrɛ me sa na meazɛkye bɛ maanle ne. Mebamaa ɛleka biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma de la adɔ mgbane, ɔvi nyiakɛ fienemgbole ne anloa, yeahɔdwu sɔlɔ lɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Relebela la azo, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Wɔmɔ, o sonla ra, mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle melɛ ye meka meahile Yizilayɛma la ɛne: Yewie! Azɛlɛ ye muleɛ nna ne amuala ɛzɛkyelɛ ala ɛne!

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Menrɛvavi bie, yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mebadea bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlua nu la si de, na bɛtɛbɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ la, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Munzule ɛdoa munzule ɛrɛla bɛ nwo zo!

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, kɛ ɔlɛba ɛ! Yewie! Awieleɛ ne ɛra. Ye kɔsɔɔti gua bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amra, munzule ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ. Mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Bɛ anyezota mekɛ ne ɛbikye; bɛ anyelielɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo ɛwie.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: “Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meawola me ɛya ne amuala meagua bɛ nwo zo, na meabua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlua nu la si de la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Menrɛvavi bie, yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mebadea bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛ bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ la, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ mekola meku bɛ a.

english_verse: Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere,
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, kenle ne ɛdwu! Bɛnlea, ɔlɛba! Bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ ɛdwu. Nzisi ɛbɔ ndotolo, adubɛnwo ɛwula nya.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Basabasayɛlɛ ɛwie nyi ɛhakyi amumuyɛ baka. Bɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛha. Bɛ anyiabɛnwo nee bɛ anwonyia baminli, yɛɛ biala ɛnrɛnyia ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne ɛlɛba; asɛɛ yedwu bɔbɔ. Bɛmmamaa mɔɔ tɔ la anye die, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔne la mmadi nyane, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ tɔne la ɛnrɛzia ɛnrɛhɔkpondɛ mɔɔ yedɔne la abo zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati, biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ɔ nwo ngoane.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne anu kɛ awie biala ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo; noko awie biala ɛngɔ konle nloa, ɔluakɛ me ɛya ne wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo. Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Bɛbayia konle wɔ gua zo, yɛɛ ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahu bɛ wɔ sua nu. Mɔɔ ɛnriandi ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu la bawu dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua zo la.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Saa bie mɔ fi ɛsalɛ a, bɛbanriandi bɛahɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, bɛbayɛ kɛ mbɔnza nu abubule, na bɛazu bɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Bɛ sa bayɛ kpokpɔdwɔlɔɔ, na bɛ gyakɛ agbɔkɛ abili kɛ atɛ.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Bɛbaheda ɛrele, na ɛzulolɛ ava bɛ aze. Bɛ nyunlu bayɛ nyiane nyiane ngome na bɛ ti zo adudu.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Bɛbado bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule bɛagua mgbata zo, bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nwo ɛnrɛde, yɛɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ ɛnrɛvi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne anu. Bɛnrɛhola bɛ ezukoa ne mɔ di bɛnrɛmaa bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi. Ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔle ɛtane mɔɔ manle bɛdule koti a.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ bɛdule bɛ nwo, na bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ munzule ananze ne mɔ bɛbɔle bɛkyi ɛbɛla. Yemɔti mebamaa yeayɛ bɛkyi debie yeamaa bɛ.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Mebado me nye ɛbɔ nu meamaa bɛagua me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli. Nwule bahɔva ɛkɛ ne, bɛagua ɛkɛ ne evinli na bɛayɛ ɛkɛ ne suadu.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ suakpole ne azo ɛyɛ konle ngome na azɛlɛ ne azo ɛyɛ mogya ngome la,

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: mebamaa maanle mɔɔ ati yɛ se kpalɛ la arava bɛ azua ne mɔ. Mebamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo la aha aze, na evinli aha bɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Saa abodelɛ ba a, bɛbakpondɛ anzonudwolɛ, noko bɛnrɛnyia bie.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Munzule badoa munzule, yɛɛ huhuhuhu badoa huhuhuhu; bɛbakpondɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bɛavi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛkɛ, na Nyamenle mɛla ne baminli sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ati anu, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia folɛdulɛ bɛnrɛvi mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bali nyane, belemgbunli ara nrenya ne arɛle babɔ, na ɛzulolɛ bamaa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la asa adwɔlɔdwɔlɔ. Mebadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo, na adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛbuale awie mɔ ndɛne la anu yɛɛ mebalua meabua bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ndɛne a. Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ nsia, siane nsia ne anu, ye kenle nnu ne azo, ɛnee me nee Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne, na Awulae Nyamenle ne tumi ne rawolole me.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Memkpogyale me ti zo, na menwunle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla anwo ɛzulolɛ bie la kɛ ɔgyi ɛkɛ. Ɔvi ɔ nze zo mɔɔ pe ye aze la le senle, yɛɛ ɔvi ɔ nze zo mɔɔ kɔ ye anwuma la ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ la.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Ɔdenrɛle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛsalɛ la ɔzɔle me ti enrinli; na Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle me zo anwomanyunlu na ɔvale me wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ ɛbɔ nu la anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzie amonle bie, mɔɔ ka Nyamenle ɛya la.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne, menwunle wienyi kpole ne mɔɔ kile kɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne la bieko, kɛmɔ menwunle ye wɔ azɛlɛ wienyi ne azo la.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, maa ɛ nye zo nea ɛbɔ nu afoa nu.” Na nea, menwunle kɛ amonle ne gyi azukponle ne tɛbanu wɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la, bɛkyi ɛbɛla mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛbɔ adu me wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la ɔ? Na ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole kpalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle vale me vindele hɔle findezo alie nwo anuhɔlɛ ne, na meneanle la ɛnee tokule bie wɔ bane ne anu.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, fu bane ne anu.” Menvunle bane ne anu la menwunle kɛ anlenkɛ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Wolo kɔ nuhua na kɔnlea ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ye ɛke la.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menwolole mengɔle nu mengɔneanle. Na menwunle kɛ bɛdolɔdolɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze, nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ nee Yizilayɛma mmonle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ bane ne anwo.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ mgbanyima abulasuu gyigyi ɛkɛ ne, na Hyeefan ara Gyeeyazanaya boka bɛ. Ko biala lɛ ɛyɛlɛ siase ɔ sa nu, na ɛyɛlɛ ne esike ne ɛlɛkpu ahɔ anwuma.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle bizale me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu mɔɔ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ɛlɛyɛ ye feabo la ɔ? Sonla ko biala nee ye ekpumgbunli mɔɔ ɔsonle ye nvoninli wɔ nu la. Ɔluakɛ bɛse, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnnwu yɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi maanle ne.’ ”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Eza ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale me ɔrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la anwo, na menwunle kɛ mraalɛ bie gua ɛkɛ ɛlɛsu Tamɛze.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, asoo wɔnwu ɛhye. Ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu ɛhye ɔ? Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ Dwudama kɛbɔ munzule kpole ɛhye mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye ɛke la, na bɛkɛva kɔdiawu ɛbɛla bɛkɛkponde azɛlɛ ne azo amuala, na bɛkɛha me ɛya ɔ? Nea, bɛdabɛ bɛva baka bɛzinla bɛ bonyi.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebava ɛya me nee bɛ ali. Menrɛvavi bie yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne, bɛbazu ɛzunlɛ kpole bɔbɔ bɛavɛlɛ me, noko menrɛde bɛ ne.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Akee mendele kɛ Nyamenle deanle nu kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ suakpole ye sinzavolɛma, bɛrɛla ɛke. Biala ɛva ye konle ninyɛne ne mɔ.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na menli nsia vi anwuma lɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo rale, ko biala lɛ ye konle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbava yeahu menli ne la ɔ sa nu. Nrenya bie mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ la nee bɛ a lua a, na ngɛlata kodoku zia ye foa ko. Na bɛwolole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛhɔgyinlanle kɔbele azukponle ne anwo.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ dede Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la anu ɛhɔ. Ɔvɛlɛle nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la.

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ne azo amuala na fa sɛkɛlɛneɛ to awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane wɔ munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ zolɛ la anwo la anwoma azo.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Bɛhu mrenya mgbanyinli, mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, ngakula nee mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti, noko bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka awie biala mɔɔ lɛ nzonlɛ ne wɔ ɔ nwoma azo la. Bɛbɔ ɔ bo wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.” Yemɔti bɛbɔle ɔ bo wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu la anwo zo.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ! Bɛhɔsesa avunli ne mɔ bɛragua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu bɛgua nwolɛ evinli.” Yemɔti bɛhɔle suakpole ne azo na bɛhunle menli ne mɔ.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛlɛku menli ne mɔ na ɔhale me ngome la, mendule mendɔle mutule nu na mendeanle nu kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Ɛfa Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛya wɔahu Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛtane ne akee ɛbo zolɛ. Mogya ɛva azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ nzisi ɛva suakpole ye, ɔluakɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi maanle ne, yɛɛ ɔnnwu ɛhwee.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Mame medame, menrɛvavi yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, memaa yeabɔ bɛ ti tɔ.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Na nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne, na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la rale na ɔrahanle kɛ, “Meyɛ debie biala kɛmɔ ɛzele me la.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Nyamenle zele nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne la kɛ, “Kɔwolo ehwili ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ abo la avinli na fula samɛnlankɛ ne bie kɔzande ye wɔ suakpole ne azo.” Ɔkɔ la me nye gyi ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ nrenya ne kawolo ehwili ne anu la ɛnee tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ gyigyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nyiakɛ, na amungu ne rayile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ati zo hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Amungu ne rayile sua ne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne yile alie nwo ɛkɛ ne manle ɔyɛle wienyi.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Saa awie wɔ findezo alie nwo nehane na ɔte abɔdeɛ ne mɔ andɛba mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ nu la ane a, ɔle kɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ɛlɛtendɛ la.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Na tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ko vale ɔ sa bɔle senle ne mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ avinli la anu vulale bie guale nrenya ne asa anu. Nrenya ne liele na ɔhɔle.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ lɛ debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla sa la wɔ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ abo.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Meneanle la eza menwunle kɛ ehwili nna gyigyi abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ, abɔdeɛ ko biala ehwili ko. Ehwili ne mɔ ta kɛ ezukoa bolɛ.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛzɔho bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ ehwili ko de ko noko anu.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Saa bɛtu bɛ bo kɛ bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛkola bɛkɔ bɛ tɛbanu nna ne mɔ anu biala mɔɔ bɛngakyi anzɛɛ bɛmpɛne bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Ɛnyelɛ duodua ehwili kɛba ne mɔ nee nuhua mbulalɛ meɛbeanu ne mɔ amuala anwo, yɛɛ ehwili nna ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, biala anwo le ɛnyelɛ ngome.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Na mendele kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ehwili ne mɔ “Akyima Ehwili.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ko biala anyunlu nna. Mɔɔ lumua la zɔho ɛnlankɛ nyinli, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la le sonla, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la le awenade, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le kɔleɛ.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛgyinla a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛgyinla, yɛɛ saa bɛtu bɛ bo a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛdu bɛ bo. Ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne yele ɔ nwo hɔzinzele tease abɔdeɛ nna ne ati zo anwuma.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ dɛlɛle bɛ ndɛba anu na bɛdule, ehwili ne mɔ boka bɛ. Bɛhɔgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ɛheda bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a bɛle tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ menwunle bɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne abo wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Bɛ nyunlu kile kɛ bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a menwunle bɛ wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la. Ko biala maa ɔ nwo zo a, ɔkɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle membale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa. Na menwunle menli abulanwiɔ nee nnu wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne, Ezɛ ara Gyeeyazanaya nee Bɛnaya ara Pɛlataya, mɔɔ le maanle ne anu mgbanyinli la boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Na menganle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛhile me la amuala mengilele nlɔnuma ne.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, menli ɛhye mɔ a bɔ maamɔvo kpɔkɛ na bɛtu suakpole ne azo amra folɛ ɛtane la.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Bɛ edwɛkɛ se kɛ, ‘Ɔtɛdwule mekɛ mɔɔ yɛsisi azua a; suakpole ɛhye le kɛ danesɛne kpole bie, yɛɛ yɛmɛ yɛle fɛlɛ yɛwɔ nu.’

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔzele me kɛ menga kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, O, Yizilayɛma, kɛ bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ la ɛhye ɔ? Meze debie biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ adwenle nu la.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Bɛhu menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ suakpole ye azo, na ye kpalɛ ne mɔ amuala azo ɛyɛ avunli ngome.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: “Yemɔti kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ bɛgua kpalɛ ne mɔ azo la, bɛ avunli a le fɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ suakpole ye a le danesɛne kpole ne, na bɛmɛ, bɛbaye bɛ bɛavi suakpole ye azo bɛavinde.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Bɛzulo dadeɛ nloa ewule; na kɛkala, mebamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Mebaye bɛ kɔsɔɔti meavinde na meaye bɛ meamaa nyɛvolɛ adea bɛ.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Bɛbadɔ amolɛ nu wɔ konle nu; mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Suakpole ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ bɛ danesɛne kpole, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrɛyɛ nuhua fɛlɛ. Mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo,

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Ɔluakɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ zo, na bɛli maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la maamɛla zo.”

english_verse: The Lord replied:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛlɛka ɛdawɔ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nlɔnu la anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la wɔ moa; bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ avinli ɛde; kɛkala, azɛlɛ ye ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.’

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Medame yɛɛ menvale bɛ mengɔle maanle zo moa moa na membɔle bɛ memkpondenle maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli a; noko me nee bɛ lua maanle biala mɔɔ bɛhɔ nu la anu.’

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi menli ne mɔ anu, na meaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle mɔɔ me nee bɛ hɔle nu la anu, meazia meara, na meava Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ye meamaa bɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Saa bɛsia bɛba a, bɛbayeye ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane nee bɛkyi debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: “ ‘Mebamaa bɛanyia ahonle fofolɛ na meamaa bɛ sunsum fofolɛ. Mebaye bolɛ ahonle ne wɔ bɛ nuhua na meamaa bɛ tieyɛ ahonle.

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Bɛbazie me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ na bɛali zolɛ; bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane na bɛabɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla la, mebamaa bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ abɔ bɛ ti tɔ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle yɛɛ mese a.’ ” Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne fi Gyɛlusalɛm

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ akee bɔle bɛ ndɛba nu dule, ehwili ne mɔ li bɛ foa ko, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne zinzele bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi suakpole ne azo yele ɔ nwo na ɔhɔzinzele boka ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne aduduleɛ la azo.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle Sunsum ne vale me luale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu ziale rale Babelonia wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la avinli. Akee me nye zo tetele me.

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛde menli anzosesebɛma mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na ade atua la avinli. Bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie; bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, sonla ra, kyekye bɔlɛ na yɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Tɔ adenle zo alehyenlɛ nu mɔɔ awie biala anye dua wɔ kɛ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Yɛ ɛ nwo kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la na ɛvi ɛleka ko kɔ ɛleka fofolɛ. Bɛ nzo yɛ se, yɛɛ bɛde atua ɛdeɛ, noko wɔannea a bɛbade ɔ bo.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ ne anu, ɛbaboɔboa wɔ ninyɛne ne mɔ anloa wɔ bɛ nye zo, na ye nɔsolɛ nu wɔadɔ adenle zo wɔ bɛ nye zo, kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ kɔ nlɔnu la yɛ la.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Funvu bane ne anu fiti tɔ ɔ nzi wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne, na dua nuhua finde.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, maa wɔ bɔlɛ ne zo to ɛ kɔme zo na tɔ awozinli ne anu kɔ. Keda ɛ nyunlu, amaa wɔannwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la. Ɔluakɛ meva wɔ meyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ memaa Yizilayɛma.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Menyɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me la. Alehyenlɛ ne anu, menkyekyele me bɔlɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la; nɔsolɛ nu menvale me sa menvunvunle bane ne anu menfitile mendɔle ɔ nzi, na bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, menvale me bɔlɛ mendole me kɔme zo na mendɔle awozinli ne anu mengɔle.

english_verse: The next morning, the Lord
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, se Yizilayɛ atuadelɛma akee ɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se, nyɛleɛ ɛhye fane kpanyinli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbu Gyɛlusalɛm maanle ne nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala anwo.’

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ, mɔɔ wɔyɛ la le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa bɛ. Mɔɔ wɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ a. Bɛbahye bɛ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ nlɔnu.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne mɔɔ sie bɛ la bava ye bɔlɛ ado ɔ kɔme zo nɔɔzo, na yeanriandi yeahɔ. Ɔbavunvu bane ne anu yeafiti yeadɔ ɔ nzi, na yealua nu yeahɔ. Ɔbaheda ɔ ti zo, amaa yeannwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Na mebagua ye asawu meahye ye me ɛhane nu. Mebava ye meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ suakpole Babelɔn azo, wɔ Babelonia azɛlɛ zo, mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnrɛnwu ye a. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbawu a.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ menli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye wɔ ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ tu ye folɛ yɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti asande meahɔgua ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, na meamaa menli ahoto ahɔhu bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: “Saa mebɔ bɛ asande na mekponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle avinli a, yɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Noko mebamaa bɛ nuhua ekyi avi ɛsalɛ, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ ewulenzane nee ɛhɔne ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛwu, amaa bɛaha bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la bɛahile maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔdo bɛ la, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ anwo wozo ye la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, saa ɛdi aleɛ a fa anwowozolɛ di, yɛɛ ɛno nzule a fa anwowozolɛ nee sulosulo no.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Ka kile maanle ne anu amra kɛ, ‘Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye wɔ menli mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo la anwo la ɛne: Bɛbava sulosulo bɛali aleɛ, na bɛava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛanlo nzule, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la ahɔdiawu ɛbɛla ne ati, bɛ azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu la amuala bayɛ azuadu, na azɛlɛ ne azo ayɛ nyanyoo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a!’ ” Ɛrɛlɛ mɔɔ awie biala ze nee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnze

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ta bu la a le duzu? Bɛse, ‘Mekɛ ne ɛzenlɛ ala a se a, noko bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne ɛnyɛ zɔhane.’

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Metua zɛhae ɛrɛlɛ ne, na bɛnrɛbu ye bieko ɛlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo.’ Na ka kile bɛ kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ zɔhane a.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: “Akee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnrɛvinde Yizilayɛma avinli bieko.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mebadendɛ, na edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ mebaha la bayɛ zɔhane. Aze ɛzilɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ atuadelɛma, mebaha me nloa edwɛkɛ, na ɔbayɛ zɔhane, yɛɛ ɔbazi bɛ mekɛ zo. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, nea, Yizilayɛma se, ‘Debie mɔɔ bɛkɛye bɛkɛhile ye wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu kazi la, ɛnee yehyɛ, yɛɛ ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ ye la, kayɛ zɔhane la, ɛnee yehyɛ.’

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Me edwɛkɛ ɛnrɛzi aze bieko. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ medame menwɔha la bayɛ zɔhane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kile Yizilayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ bɔ bɛ ti anu keha mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Ka kile bɛ maa bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Munzule ɛha Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ahoasea ne mɔ, mɔɔ ɛnnwu ɛhwee na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la.

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛyɛ kɛ fovolɛ zo ɛzonlɛ.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛkɔneanle ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛgologolo ɛgua la, yɛɛ bɛtɛdiele Yizilayɛma anwo bane, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne dwu na konle ba a bɛahola gyinla.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ bɛha adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ; bɛse, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsoanle bɛ la. Noko bɛ nye la kɛ mebamaa bɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha la ayɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Asoo tɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ a bɛka mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha kɛ “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛkanle ɛhwee la?’

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ na bɛbɔ adalɛ la ati, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mekpo bɛ.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mebadea bɛdabɛ bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle debie a, ɛnee bɛse bɛnwu debie na bɛbɔ adalɛ la. Bɛnrɛdia bɛ bɛnrɛboka Yizilayɛma anwo, yɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdu agyinla bɔbɔ. Bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛhɔ bɛ maanle nu Yizilayɛ; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: “ ‘Kɛmɔ bɛbɛlɛbɛla me menli ne, na ɛleka mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ ɛnle la ɛnee bɛse anzonudwolɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, na menli ne die bane mgbane bie a ɛnee bɛmɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la;

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: ka kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi kalo ne la kɛ bane ne bagolo agua. Ezule kpole badɔ, ezuawolɛ mgbole bagua, na ahumu kpole adu,

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: na saa bane ne bu gua a, ɛnee bɛ kalo ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhwile nwolɛ la hale nienwu?’

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Mebava ɛya na meamaa ahumu kpole adu, ezule badɔ kpole bie, na ezuawolɛ adɔ abubu bane ne.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Mebabubu bɛ bane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la, na meagolo bɛ meagua, meamaa ye adiabo ne bɔbɔ anwenle zolɛ. Ye ɛbulɛ ne anu, ɔbahu bɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Zɛhae yɛɛ mebava meayɛ bane ne nee bɛdabɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛannwu ɛhwee na bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ bɛhilele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ bɛde anzonudwolɛ nu, na bɛhwile bane ne anwo kalo la. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a!” Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mraalɛ adalɛ la

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Sonla ra, akee nea mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ menli ne avinli, na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la. Ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kile bɛ na se bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkpomgba ngonyia sɛbɛ bɛgyelegyela menli sa, na bɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ duku, amaa bɛanyia tumi wɔ menli ngakyile nwo zo la. Asoo bɛfa bɛ ngonyia bɛahu me menli ne foa ko na bɛalie foa ko ngoane wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ezukoakpondɛlɛ ti?

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ adalɛ bɛhile me menli ne mɔ mɔɔ kulo adalɛ la, bɛgua me nyunlu aze wɔ me menli ne anyunlu, bɛlie baale nee kpanwo, bɛhu menli mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ wu la, na bɛlie menli mɔɔ fɛta ewule la ngoane.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mekyi ngonyia sɛbɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛnyia menli nwo zo tumi la. Mebatete bɛ meavi bɛ sa, na meazianyizianyi menli mɔɔ bɛkyekye bɛ la meamaa bɛahɔ kɛ nloma.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mebadudu bɛ ti duku ne mɔ meagua, na mealie me menli ne meavi bɛ sa nu, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnle bɛ tumi bo bieko a, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: “Bɛva bɛ adalɛ ne mɔ bɛbɔ menli mɔɔ di boɛ, na mengulo kɛ bɛ nwo bu ɛbonle la arɛle; bɛzi amumuyɛnli ne adua bɛammaa yeangakyi ye ɛbɛla ɛtane ne yeanlie ɔ nwo ngoane.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛnrɛnwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala yɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ adalɛ munzule biala. Mebalie me menli ne meavi bɛ sa nu, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlie bɛ mmonle ne mɔ ɛdo nu kpole kpalɛ na ɔlɛmaa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ azi bɛ nyunlu bile. Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔmaa adenle menwɔmaa bɛkɛbiza me edwɛkɛ?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti tendɛ kile bɛ na se bɛ kɛ: Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, Yizilayɛnli biala mɔɔ ɛva ye ahonle ɛmaa mmonle, yemaa ye ɛtane ɛzi ɔ nyunlu bile, na ɔkɛra Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɛkɛ ne la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne mebabua ye, ɔboalekɛ bɛ mmonle ne mɔ ɛzo somaa,

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: amaa meado me sa mealie Yizilayɛma mɔɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ ti bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo la.

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛ mmonle ne mɔ nee bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: “Mekɛ biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛnli anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la bie kɛde ɔ nwo kɛvi me nwo, ɔkɛhɔzonle awozonle, ɔkɛva ye ɛtane ɔkɛzi ɔ nyunlu bile, na akee ɔkɛhɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bie ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabiza ɔ nwo wɔ me ɛkɛ ne la, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne, mebabua ye.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Mebava me nye meawula sonla zɔhane anyunlu na meamaa yeayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee ɛfenle wɔ menli anloa anu, na meaye ye meavi me menli ne anu; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: “Na saa mɛlɛbɛla bie ba Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane afoa nu, na ɔbuke ɔ nloa ɔka adalɛ nrɛlaleɛ biala a, ɛnee medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a meyɛ a. Mebadea ye na meazɛkye ye meavi me menli Yizilayɛma avinli.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Ahenle ne mɔɔ rale babiza ɔ nwo nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne, bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ ndeanlɛ ne bayɛ ko, na bɛdabɛ bɛbali bɛ ndeanlɛ nwo ɛzonle,

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: amaa Yizilayɛma andwe bɛ nwo anvi me nwo, anluolua nu basabasa, na bɛanva mɛladonlɛ bɛanzɛkye bɛ nwo, amaa bɛayɛ me menli na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.” Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, saa maanle bie anu amra yɛ ɛtane tia me, bɛgyakyi me bɛkɔsonle nyamenle gyɛne, na meka kɛ metea maanle zɔhane, mefa ɛhɔne nee sane mebato maanle ne anu, na mɔɔ menli nee nane ɛlɛwu la,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: saa menli nsa ɛhye mɔ, Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu wɔ maanle ne anu bɔbɔ a, bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ kɛlie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome ala ngoane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: “Saa memaa nanemgbole ba azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ bɛzɛkye debie biala, memaa azɛlɛ ne tɔ mgbane, mɔɔ nanemgbole ne mɔ ati sonla biala ɛngola ɛngɔ zolɛ la a,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: meka, meka kɛ, saa menli nsa ɛhye mɔ bɔbɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛnrɛhola bɛ mra mrenya anzɛɛ bɛ mra mraalɛ ngoane die, kyesɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ala. Maanle ne ɛdeɛ, ɔbadɔ mgbane.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ saa metwe konle mebato maanle zɔhane anu, na memaa adenle kɛ bɛhu menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala a,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: meka, meka kɛ, saa menli nsa zɔhane wɔ maanle ne anu bɔbɔ a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛlie bɛ mra mrenya anzɛɛ mraalɛ, kyesɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ala.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ saa mefa ewulenzane mebato maanle zɔhane anu, na mefa ɛya kɛ meku menli nee nyɛmoa mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la a, meka, meka kɛ,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: saa bɔbɔ Nowa, Daneɛle, yɛɛ Dwobu wɔ maanle ne anu a, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese, bɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ raalɛ die. Bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ne bahola alie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome ala ngoane.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Na saa akee mefa me ndeanlɛ fane nna ɛhye mɔ: konle, ɛhɔne, nanemgbole mɔɔ di menli, yɛɛ ewulenzane megua Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo, kɛ mefa meaminli menli nee nyɛmoa abo zo ɛ!

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
