translation_verse: Ɛbawu anyiemgba ewule wɔ nyɛvolɛ asa anu; ɔluakɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle yɛɛ mese a.” Taya belemgbunli ne azedɔlɛ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, sing a funeral song for the king of Tyre and tell him I am saying: At one time, you were perfect, intelligent, and good-looking.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ye awolɛ gua Taya belemgbunli ne ati zo, na se ye kɛ, medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Ɛnee ɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ di munli, ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na wɔ anwofɛlɛko di munli.

english_verse: You lived in the garden of Eden and wore jewelry made of brightly colored gems and precious stones. They were all set in gold and were ready for you on the day you were born.
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɛwɔ Yidɛn, Nyamenle tola ne anu; ezukoa bolɛ biala mɔɔ anwo hyia la, menvale mengedale wɔ. Ezukoa awolɛ, kanɛlia, topaze, gyasepa, kelesɔlaete, bɛlele, ɔnekese, safaya, kɛbɛnkele, yɛɛ ɛmelade yɛɛ bɛvale bɛduoduale wɔ adɛladeɛ nu a. Kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ bɛbɔle wɔ la yɛɛ bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa bɛmanle wɔ a.

english_verse: I appointed a winged creature to guard your home on my holy mountain, where you walked among gems that dazzled like fire.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ, menyɛle wɔ tease abɔdeɛ mɔɔ mekpokpa wɔ nwole la menziele wɔ Nyamenle boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, na ɛluoluale awolɛ guaanye zo.

english_verse: You were truly good from the time of your birth, but later you started doing wicked things.
translation_verse: Ɔvi kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle wɔ la, ɛ nwo annyia nvonleɛ biala, hɔdwule kɛ ɛtane rale wɔ nu la.

english_verse: You traded with other nations and became more and more cruel and evil. So I forced you to leave my mountain, and the creature that had been your protector now chased you away from the jewels.
translation_verse: Wɔ gualilɛ ne yɛle kpole la ati, ɛbɔle kɔdiawu ɛbɛla na ɛyɛle ɛtane. Yemɔti ɛyɛle bɛkyi debie wɔ me sa nu, na menvuandinle wɔ wɔ Nyamenle boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo mendele aze, na tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ sinza wɔ la voanle wɔ vile awolɛ guaanye ne mɔ avinli.

english_verse: It was your good looks that made you arrogant, and you were so famous that you started acting like a fool. That's why I threw you to the ground and let other kings sneer at you.
translation_verse: Ɛlile wɔ kɛnlɛma nzi ɛdule ɛ nwo, ɛlile wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ nzi ɛzɛkyele wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ. Menvuandinle wɔ mendole aze, menyele ɛ nwo zo ɛdanlɛ mengilele arelemgbunli kɛ bɛnlea wɔ.

english_verse: You have cheated so many other merchants that your places of worship are corrupt. So I set your city on fire and burned it down. Now everyone sees only ashes where your city once stood,
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ne mɔ ati, ɛlile gua ɛtane ɛvale ɛzɛkyele wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ. Yemɔti memanle senle zɔle bɛ avinli na ɔyelale wɔ ɔhunle wɔ. Awie biala mɔɔ anye babɔ ɛ nwo zo la banwu kɛ wɔdɔ nzonle wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: and the people of other nations are shocked. Your punishment was horrible, and you are gone forever. Judgment on Sidon and Peace for Israel
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛze wɔ wɔ maanle maanle avinli la arɛle babɔ ɛ nwo, kɛ wɔ awieleɛ ɛwie ɛzulolɛ zɛhae, na ɛnrɛkpazi bieko ɛlɛ na aloa abɔ a.” Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia Saedɛn la

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the city of Sidon
translation_verse: “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye Saedɛn na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne tia ye kɛ,

english_verse: and tell its people: I, the Lord God, am your enemy! People will praise me when I punish you, and they will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Saedɛn, meyɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ, na mebamaa menli aye me ayɛlɛ wɔ wɔmɔ ɛ ti. Bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee wɔ kɛli, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta na menwɔlua ɛ nwo zo menwɔye me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne menwɔhile la.

english_verse: I will send deadly diseases to wipe you out, and I will send enemies to invade and surround you. Your people will be killed, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mebaye ewulenzane ɛzulolɛ bie meado ɛ nwo na mogya ava wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo. Bɛbava konle bɛadoa wɔ wɔ adenle biala azo, na bɛahu wɔ menli ne mɔ. Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a!’ ” Bɛbayila Yizilayɛ

english_verse: When that happens, the people of Israel will no longer have cruel neighbors that abuse them and make them feel as though they are in a field of thorns and briers. And the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. A Blessing for Israel
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Na Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, agbɔvolɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la anu biala ɛnrɛhakyi ɔ nwo mbowunzaka anzɛɛ mbowule ɛnrɛwowɔ anzɛɛ ɛnrɛbodɛboda bɛ. Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: The Lord God said: Someday I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are now scattered, and every nation will see that I am holy. The Israelites will once again live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Saa meboɔboa Yizilayɛma anloa mefi maanle maanle mɔɔ mebɔ bɛ asande mehɔgua nuhua la anu, na meye me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne mekile, wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anye zo a, bɛbadɛnla bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle ne mɔɔ menvale memanle me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo la anu.

english_verse: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ na bɛasisi azua, bɛayɛ bɛ vanye egyinli. Saa me nee maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ, mɔɔ ɛmbu bɛ la di, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la a, bɛbadɛnla, bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a.”

english_verse: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu, siane bulu ne, kenle bulu nee nwiɔ ne azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlea, mekpo Yigyibitima belemgbunli ne. Yeyɛ ɔ nwo nane kpole anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la yela azule Naele ne anu, na ɔka kɛ, ‘Medame a melɛ azule Naele ne a; medame a menyɛle a.’

english_verse: I will put a hook in your jaw and pull you out of the water, and all the fish in your river will stick to your scaly body.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ koba wɔ wɔ awudwɔlɛ nu, na meamaa fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ azule ne mɔ anu la abetɛbeta ɛ nwo abonle ne mɔ anu. Mebaye wɔ nee fɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ betɛbeta wɔ abonle ne mɔ anu la meavi azule ne mɔ anu,

english_verse: I'll throw you and the fish into the desert, and your body will fall on the hard ground. You will be left unburied, and wild animals and birds will eat your flesh.
translation_verse: na meavuandi bɛ meagua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ, na ɛdawɔ nee fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ azule ne mɔ anu la baha ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, na awie ɛnrɛsesa bɛ ɛnrɛzie bɛ. Mebava bɛ meamaa azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole nee nloma mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu la kɛ bɛli.

english_verse: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord. You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.
translation_verse: Na Yigyibitima kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a!” Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yigyibitima yɛle bɛ nwo ndɔ baka wulera.”

english_verse: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma zɔle nu dudule hisale bɛ la, bɛbubule, bɛbodɛbodale bɛ bati, bɛmanle bɛ nzi kpolokpolole na bɛ adwongu wozole.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock,
translation_verse: Yemɔti Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mebava konle meara bɛ nwo zo, na bɛahu menli nee nane kɔsɔɔti,

english_verse: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.
translation_verse: Yigyibiti maanle ne badɔ mgbane; awie biala ɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. “Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ɛhanle kɛ Azule Naele ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ, na ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛyɛle la ti,

english_verse: Now I am turning against you and your river. Your nation will be nothing but an empty wasteland all the way from the town of Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, and as far as the border of Ethiopia.
translation_verse: nea, mehakyi me nzi mezi wɔ nee wɔ azule ne mɔ amuala. Mebamaa Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane, ɔvi suakpole Megedɔlo mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne sɔlɔ lɔ la, yearadwu Asewan, toonwo yearadwu Sudanema ɛweɛne zo, wɔ maanle ne nyiakɛ.

english_verse: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for
translation_verse: Sonla anzɛɛ nane biala agyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia zolɛ. Awie ɛnrɛdɛnla zolɛ toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanla.

english_verse: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛazia bɛanyia bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ bieko, na meava bɛ meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu, wɔ Patolɔso azɛlɛ zo, na akee bɛayɛ maanle bɛlɛvo.

english_verse: and won't ever be strong enough to rule nations, as they did in the past.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ maanle bɛlɛvo kpalɛ kpalɛ, na ɔnrɛdu ɔ nwo bieko wɔ maanle maanle avinli. Mebaha bɛ aze fɛɛnye mɔɔ bɛnrɛzie maanle biala ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: My own people Israel will never again depend on your nation. In fact, when the Israelites remember what happened to you Egyptians, they will realize how wrong they were to turn to you for help. Then the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, did these things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia Will Conquer Egypt
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ɛnrɛva bɛ rɛle ɛnrɛwula bɛ nu bieko. Bɛbahakye amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhɔbizale bɛ moalɛ la. Na akee Yigyibitima banwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.” Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza bali Yigyibiti anwo zo konim

english_verse: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nsuu ne, siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked the city of Tyre. He forced his soldiers to carry so many heavy loads that their heads were rubbed bald, and their shoulders were red and sore. Nebuchadnezzar and his army still could not capture the city.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, Babelonia Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza manle ye ɛlɔnema yɛle ketekete kpalɛ tiale Taya. Ɔmanle bɛzoale awolɛ toonwo bɛ ti zo dule, bɛ bati kpolokpolole, noko ɔdaye o, ye ɛlɔnema o, biala annyia ɛhwee anvi Taya wɔ ɛvɛlɛ totohyia ne mɔɔ bɛvɛle la anwo.

english_verse: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Bɛnlea, mebava Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne meamaa Babelonia belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza. Ɔbazoa zolɛ anwonyia muala yeahɔ, na ye ɛlɔnema ave zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛava bɛadua bɛ nwo kakɛ.

english_verse: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Meva azɛlɛ ne memaa ye kɛ ye ɛvɛlɛ nwo ahatualɛ ɔ, ɔboalekɛ ɔyɛle gyima ne ɔmanle me. Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne.

english_verse: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu, mebamaa katakyiema adwazo Yizilayɛma avinli, na mebade ɛ nloa wɔ bɛ avinli. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Egypt that I am saying: Cry out in despair,
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne, ka kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne kɛ se la ɛne: Bɛzu kenle ne!

english_verse: because you will soon be punished! That will be a time of darkness and doom for all nations.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kenle ne ɛbikye, Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye. Amungu ngome bava kenle ne, ɔle munzule mekɛ ɔmaa maanle maanle ne mɔ.

english_verse: Your own nation of Egypt will be attacked, and Ethiopia will suffer. You will be killed in battle, and your land will be robbed and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Konle bava Yigyibiti aze, na abodelɛ kpole ado Sudanema, mekɛ mɔɔ Yigyibitima kɛho kɛdɔ, bɛkɛzoa ye anwonyia muala bɛkɛhɔ na bɛkɛgyakyi ye bɛkɛdo ye ɛkɛ ne kpoholokpo la.

english_verse: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.
translation_verse: “Sudanema, Lebeyama, Ledeama, Arelebiama amuala, yɛɛ Kɛɛbema mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ ɛkpa wɔ konle ne anu la amuala baho adɔ. Me menli ne bie mɔ noko baho adɔ.”

english_verse: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛboa Yigyibiti la amuala baho adɔ, yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ kpole ne baha aze, ɔvi Megedɔlo yeahɔdwu Asewan mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ la, bɛ muala bɛbawu dadeɛ nloa, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane adɛla azɛlɛ biala, yɛɛ ye azuamgbole bayɛ azuadu wɔ azuadu avinli.

english_verse: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔdo senle wɔ Yigyibiti, na ye boavolɛma amuala kɛwie wu la.

english_verse: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu, mebazoa menli meamaa bɛava meli bɛahɔnwunlonwunla Sudanema wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛnla la, na nyane mɔɔ bɛbade nee abodelɛ mɔɔ bɛbanwu ye la bayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Yigyibiti bɔle la, ɔluakɛ nea, mekɛ ne asɛɛ ɛdwu!”

english_verse: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mebamaa Babelonia belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza adua Yigyibiti anwonyia adenle.

english_verse: He and his cruel troops will invade and destroy your land and leave your dead bodies piled everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɛbava yemɔ yɛɛ ye menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi, mɔɔ le maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ tɛla maanle kɔsɔɔti la bɛara, bɛamaa bɛazɛkye azɛlɛ ne, na bɛ nee Yigyibitima aho, bɛahu menli ne bɛagua azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. Egypt's Proud Cities Will Lie in Ruins The Lord said to the people of Egypt:
translation_verse: Mebamaa azule Naele ne asesa, na meadɔne azɛlɛ ne meamaa amumuyɛma. Mebamaa nyɛvolɛ azɛkye azɛlɛ ne nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mebazɛkye mmonle ne mɔ nee ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Mɛmefese la. Belemgbunli ɛnrɛdwazo Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo bieko, yemɔti mebava sulosulo meado Yigyibitima anwo.

english_verse: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!
translation_verse: Mebamaa Yigyibiti nyiakɛ adɔ mgbane, na meado senle wɔ Zowan. Mebadea suakpole Tibɛse.

english_verse: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Mebadea Yigyibiti aranemgbole Pɛluseyɔm, na meahu menli mɔɔ wɔ Tibɛse la amuala.

english_verse: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.
translation_verse: Mebado senle wɔ Yigyibiti; Pɛluseyɔmma banwu nyane nee abodelɛ kpole. Bane mɔɔ bɛhye ye wɔ suakpole Tɛɛbe anwo la bagologolo agua, na nyane ayɛ kɛ azuyilɛ ava suakpole ne.

english_verse: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole Hɛleɔpɔlese nee Bubatese azo la badɔ dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛbahye mraalɛ ne mɔ nuokɛ.

english_verse: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.
translation_verse: Awozinli bava Tapanehizi wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔzɛkye Yigyibiti nee ye anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtu ɔ nloa anu la. Amungu bava ye na bɛahye ye mralɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ nuokɛ.

english_verse: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord. Egypt's King Is Powerless
translation_verse: Kɛ mebazi meadea Yigyibiti la ɛne. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.” Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne tumi ne mɔɔ ɛbɔ aze la

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the seventh day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko ne, siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la azo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord, have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mebu Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne asa. Bɛtɛbɔle ye bɔlɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ye ayile na nuhua ayɛ se, na yeahola yeava konle dadeɛ yeaho.

english_verse: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever,
translation_verse: Yemɔti medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mekpo Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne. Mebabubu ɔ sa, ɔ sa kpalɛ ne nee mɔɔ ɛbu dɛba la amuala, na meamaa konle dadeɛ ne avi ɔ sa nu adɔ aze.

english_verse: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ Yigyibitima asande meagua maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli na meakponde bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo amuala.

english_verse: I will strengthen the power of Babylonia's king and give him my sword to use against Egypt. I will also make the wounded king of Egypt powerless, and he will moan in pain and die in front of the Babylonian king. Then everyone on earth will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa Babelonia belemgbunli ne asa anu ayɛ se, na Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne asa anu ado, na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Saa mefa me konle dadeɛ ne mewula Babelonia belemgbunli ne asa anu a, ɔbava yeahɔ Yigyibitima anwo zo,

english_verse: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them.
translation_verse: na mebazande Yigyibitima wɔ maanle maanle avinli, na meakponde bɛ wɔ maanle zɔhane mɔ anu. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:
translation_verse: Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee ko, siane nsa ne, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Egypt and his people that I am saying: You are more powerful than anyone on earth. Now listen to this.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka kile Yigyibiti belemgbunli nee ye menli ne amuala kɛ: Nwane a ɛzɔho ye wɔ wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ nu a?

english_verse: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.
translation_verse: Nea, mefa wɔ meado Lɛbanɔn sida baka nwo, ɔlɛ ngane ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ maa alubo, yɛɛ ɔwale, ɔ ti dwu amungu ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.
translation_verse: Ɔnyia nzule ɔnyi ɔyɛ kpole; azɛlɛ bo nzule maa ɔnyi tendenle. Azule se dua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ la, na ɔdoɔloa kpɔkɛ ne anu mbaka bo.

english_verse: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔwa ɔyɛ tendenle ɔtɛla kpɔkɛ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti. Ye ngane kye yɛ mgbole, na ɔtoto ɔ sa ndendenle. Ɔluakɛ ye ndinli nyia nzule dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.
translation_verse: Anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti yɛ bɛ sane wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ anu; kpɔkɛ nu nane kɔsɔɔti wo bɛ mra wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ abo; maanle maanle tɛnla bɛ alubo nu.

english_verse: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.
translation_verse: Baka ne kpole le kɛnlɛma, ɔwale, ye ngane le ndendenle; ye ndinli dwu kɔ aze kpalɛ, ɔto azɛlɛ bo nzule.

english_verse: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.
translation_verse: Sida mbaka mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle tola ne anu la nee ye ɛnzu kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ bolonyia baka nee ye ngane mgbole ɛnzɛ. Baka biala ngane nee ye ɛdeɛ ne ɛnzɛ, yɛɛ baka biala ɛnle Nyamenle tola ne anu mɔɔ nee ye sɛ kɛnlɛma a.

english_verse: I, the Lord, gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.
translation_verse: Menyɛle ye kɛnlɛma memanle ɔdɛlɛdɛlɛle ye ngane, mbaka mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Yidɛn tola ne anu la anye bolole ye.

english_verse: King of Egypt, now listen to what I, the Lord God, am saying about that tree: The tree grew so tall that it reached the sky and became very proud and arrogant.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Kɛmɔ ɔnyinle ɔyɛle tendenle na ɔ ti dwule amungu ne mɔ anu, na ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo wɔ ye tendenle ne ati la,

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.
translation_verse: mebava ye meawula maanle ne mɔ anu katakyie ne asa anu, ɔ nee ye ali, kɛmɔ ye amumuyɛ ne mɔ fɛta la. Mevuandi ye medo ala ɛne.

english_verse: Cruel foreigners will chop it down and leave it wherever it falls. Branches and broken limbs will be scattered over the mountains and in the valleys. The people living in the shade of those branches will go somewhere else.
translation_verse: Nyɛvolɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ la bapɛ ye ado na bɛagyakyi ye ɛkɛ. Ye ngane ne mɔ babubu agua mbɔnza nu nee awoka ne mɔ azo, na ye baka mumua ne abubu agua azɛlɛ ne azo azudenle ne mɔ anu. Menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala banriandi avi ye alubo ne anu.

english_verse: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.
translation_verse: Anwomanyunlu nloma baradɛnlɛdɛnla baka wulera ne azo na ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole araluolua ye ngoloka ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: Never again will any tree dare to grow as tall as this tree, no matter how much water it has. Every tree must die, just as humans die and go down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, amaa baka biala mɔɔ gyi azule nloa la annyi angɔ anwuma somaa, anzɛɛ ɔ ti annyi andwu amungu ne mɔ anu, na mbaka mɔɔ no nzule la annyi ndendenle zɔhane, ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛ muala bɛmaa ewule, kɛmɔ menli wu la, bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ ewule kuma nu la anwo.”

english_verse: On the day this tree dies and goes to the world below, I, the Lord God, will command rivers and streams to mourn its death. Every underground spring of water and every river will stop flowing. The mountains in Lebanon will be covered with darkness as a sign of their sorrow, and all the trees in the forest will wither.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Saa baka ne wu kɔ ɛbolɔ a, mebamaa azɛlɛ bo nzule azu ye, na yeasisi ye azule ne mɔ, yeamaa azule dɔɔnwo azi. Mebamaa awozinli ava Lɛbanɔn, na ɔdaye ti kpɔkɛ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti agyengye.

english_verse: This tree will crash to the ground, and I will send it to the world below. Then the nations of the earth will tremble. The trees from Eden and the choice trees from Lebanon are now in the world of the dead, and they will be comforted when this tree falls.
translation_verse: Saa mefuandi ye meto ɛbolɔ meboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɔ ewule kuma nu la anwo a, ye azedɔlɛ ne bamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo awozo bɛ. Mbaka kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ Yidɛn tola nu, Lɛbanɔn mbaka kpalɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ nyia nzule la, arɛle bakyekye wɔ ɛbolɔ lɔ.

english_verse: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee ye bɛ muala bɛbahɔ ɛbolɔ sua zo, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdɔ dadeɛ nloa la wɔ la; ɛhɛe, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdɛnlanle ye alubo nu wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la abo zo baminli.

english_verse: King of Egypt, all these things will happen to you and your people! You were like this tree at one time—taller and stronger than anyone on earth. But now you will be chopped down, just as every tree in the garden of Eden must die. You will be sent down to the world of the dead, where you will join the godless and the other victims of violent death. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Ɛnee akee mbaka mɔɔ wɔ Yidɛn tola nu la, boni yɛɛ wɔ anyunlunyia nee ye sɛ a? Bɛbapɛ wɔ bɛado bɛaboka Yidɛn tola nu mbaka ne mɔ anwo bɛagua bɛ ɛbolɔ lɔ wɔahɔboka menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɛdɔ dadeɛ nloa la anwo. “Ɛhye fane Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nee ye menli ne amuala anwo.” Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne.

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:
translation_verse: Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ, siane bulu nee nwiɔ ne, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt and tell him I am saying: You act like a lion roaming the earth; but you are nothing more than a crocodile in a river, churning up muddy water with your feet.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ye awolɛ gua Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ati zo na se ye kɛ: Ɛdwenle kɛ ɛle awenade wɔ maanle maanle avinli, noko ɛle kɛ nane bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne mɔɔ la azukpole nu la. Ɛkpakye azule ne waa waa, ɛfa ɛ gyakɛ ɛbɔ azule ne anu na ɛkpoto ye.”

english_verse: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mebava maanle maanle meahakyi avonle meado wɔ, na meahwe wɔ meara file zo.

english_verse: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.
translation_verse: Mebavuandi wɔ meade ɛnweakpanye ne azo wɔ wienyi ne anu, na meamaa anwomanyunlu nloma nee ewiade nane kɔsɔɔti arali wɔ nane.

english_verse: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys,
translation_verse: Mebapepɛ wɔ nwonane ne azinli azinli meakponde awoka ne mɔ azo na meamaa mbɔnza ne mɔ anu ayɛ wɔ nwonane azinli kpɔlɔlera ngome.

english_verse: and your blood will flow throughout the land and fill up the streams.
translation_verse: Mebahwi wɔ mogya meagua azɛlɛ ne azo toonwo yeahɔdwu awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, nee azule ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.
translation_verse: Saa meminli ɛ bo zo a, mebaheda anwomanyunlu, na meamaa nwɔlɔra anlu. Mebava amungu meaheda sɛnzɛne ne anyunlu, yɛɛ siane ɛnrɛda.

english_verse: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mebamaa anwomanyunlu ngɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anlu, na meava awozinli meaheda azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛwɔ zolɛ la azo. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: Foreign nations you have never heard of will be shocked when I tell them how I destroyed you.
translation_verse: “Mebamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo mɔɔ kɛde kɛ mehye wɔ nuokɛ mehɔ maanle bie mɔɔ ɛtɛtele ye nganeɛ ɛlɛ la azo la ahonle adu.

english_verse: They will be horrified, and when I flash my sword in victory on the day of your death, their kings will tremble in the fear of what could happen to them.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ ati, mebamaa maanle maanle dɔɔnwo adwenle azɛkye, na saa menwɔha me konle dadeɛ ne bɛ nyunlu a, debie badɔ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ anwo zo. Kenle ne mɔɔ ɛbadɔ aze la, awie biala anwo bawozo ye na yeazu ɔdaye ɔ ngome ye ngoane.”

english_verse: The king of Babylonia is coming to attack you, king of Egypt!
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Babelonia belemgbunli ne dadeɛ ne bara ɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Your soldiers will be killed by the cruelest army in the world, and everything you take pride in will be crushed.
translation_verse: Wɔ menli ne dɔɔnwo badɔ katakyiema mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli la dadeɛ nloa. Bɛbazɛkye Yigyibiti debie biala mɔɔ hyia na ɔsonle bolɛ la, na bɛahu ye menli ne amuala.

english_verse: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ nane mɔɔ wɔ bɛ azule ne mɔ anloa la amuala. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛgyegye bɛ bieko, yɛɛ nane biala ɛnrɛhola ye mɛne fa gyegye bɛ bieko.

english_verse: The water will be clear, and streams will be calm. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Akee mebade bɛ azule ne mɔ anye na meamaa bɛ azule ne mɔ aze bɛtɛɛ kɛ nwole la. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: Egypt will become a barren wasteland, and no living thing will ever survive there. Then you and your people will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa memaa Yigyibiti azɛlɛ ne tɔ mgbane na mesɛkye debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la, na meku menli mɔɔ de zolɛ la amuala a, akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: This is your warning, and it will be used as a funeral song by foreign women to mourn the death of your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. A Sad Ending for Egypt
translation_verse: Ɛhye le awolɛyelɛ mɔɔ bɛbaye a; mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la baye zɛhae awolɛ ne agua Yigyibiti nee menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ati zo, medame, Awulae Nyamenle yɛɛ mese a.” Mɔwuamra maanle nu

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, su gua Yigyibitima amuala ati zo, na pia bɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɔdaye nee menli mɔɔ lɛ tumi wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la amuala kɔgua mɔwuamra ewiade ne anu, maa bɛhɔboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhɔ ɛbolɔ la anwo.

english_verse: Say to them: You may be more beautiful than the people of other nations, but you will also die and join the godless in the world below.
translation_verse: Se bɛ kɛ, ‘Nwane a bɛnea a bɛtɛla ye kɛnlɛma a? Bɛdwu bɛhɔ mɔwuamra anu, na bɛzie bɛ bɛboka menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anwo.’

english_verse: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.
translation_verse: “Bɛbawu bɛagua menli mɔɔ ɛdɔ dadeɛ nloa la avinli, na menli mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la amuala bahɔ ewule kuma nu.

english_verse: Brave military leaders killed in battle will gladly welcome you and your allies into the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli katakyiema baha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ. Bɛ nee bɛ boavolɛma mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛwɔ ɛbolɔ la baha kɛ, ‘Menli ne mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle, mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ konle ne anu la ɛra, na bɛmɛ a bɛgua ɛkɛ ne la?’

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Assyria are there. They once terrified people, but they were killed in battle and now lie deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Bɛ nla ne mɔ wɔ azie ne abo lɔ, yɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema nla ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye ɛdeɛ ne. Bɛhunle bɛ muala, bɛ muala bɛdɔle dadeɛ nloa. Bɛde aze la ɛnee bɛ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Elam are there. The very sight of those godless soldiers once terrified their enemies and made them panic. But now they are disgraced and ashamed as they lie in the world of the dead, alongside others who were killed in battle.
translation_verse: Yilam boka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ la anwo, ye ɛlɔnema ne sɛka ɛbɔ ɛyia ye. Bɛ muala bɛnze Nyamenle, yɛɛ bɛhunle bɛ muala wɔ konle nu. Bɛde aze la ɛnee bɛ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ, na kɛkala, bɛva anyiemgba bɛwu bɛhɔ ɛbolɔ bɛhɔboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ konle nu la anwo.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.
translation_verse: “Mihyɛke nee Tubale wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛ ɛlɔnema ɛwolaa ne nla ne mɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ. Bɛ muala bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle a, yɛɛ bɛhunle bɛ wɔ konle nu, ɔluakɛ bɛde aze la bɛ nwo hanle ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.
translation_verse: Bɛanzie bɛ kɛ bɛziele mɔmoane katakyiema mɔɔ vale bɛ konle ninyɛne hɔle ɛbolɔ la. Bɛvale bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ sa nu enyinlike ne mɔ a bɛziele bɛ a, ɔluakɛ bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ne tɛbɔ anyewɔzoamra anu.

english_verse: You Egyptians will be cruelly defeated, and you will be buried alongside these other godless soldiers who died in battle.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbahu bɛmɛ Yigyibitima na bɛ nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle na bɛhu bɛ wɔ konle nu la ahɔla a.

english_verse: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: “Yidɔm wɔ ɛkɛ, ye arelemgbunli nee ye maanle mgbanyima, bɛ anwosesebɛ kpole ne anzi, bɛ nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle na bɛhunle bɛ konle nu la a wɔ ɛbolɔ maanle nu a.

english_verse: The graves of the rulers of the north are there, as well as those of the Sidonians. Their powerful armies once terrified enemies. Now they lie buried in the world of the dead, where they are disgraced like other soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: “Arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ Sɔlɔ la wɔ ɛkɛ; bɛmɛ yɛɛ Saedɛnema amuala, bɛhunle bɛ anyiemgba nu wɔ konle nu. Bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛ anwosesebɛ kpole ne bɛhanle la anzi, bɛwu kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la bɛboka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ konle nu la anwo; bɛ anyiemgba doa bɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛbolɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.
translation_verse: “Saa Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nwu bɛ a, ɔdaye nee ye ɛlɔnema ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ ɛwu konle nu la arɛle bakyekye,” Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ, kɛmɔ Yigyibiti hanle anyewɔzoamra ɛzulolɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbahu ye belemgbunli ne nee ye ɛlɔnema amuala konle nu bɛaboka menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la anwo a.” Awulae Nyamenle a se a.

english_verse: and to sound a warning signal when the enemy is seen coming.
translation_verse: na ɔnwu kɛ konle asɛɛ ɛva maanle ne aze, na ɔwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu ɔkakye bɛ

english_verse: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛhakye ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la biala. Yeyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu na ɔle kpalɛ la, ɔbanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.
translation_verse: Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne, ye siane bulu ne, ye kenle nnu ne azo, nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛnriandi ɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm la rale me nwo ɛkɛ razele me kɛ, “Suakpole ne ɛbɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, warn your people by saying: Someday, I, the Lord, may send an enemy to invade a country. And suppose its people choose someone to stand watch
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka kile wɔ menli ne na se bɛ kɛ: Saa mefa konle meto maanle anzɛɛ azɛlɛ bie azo, na menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la ye bɛ sonla ko kɛ bɛ sinzavolɛ,

english_verse: If any of these people hear the signal and ignore it, they will be killed in battle. But it will be their own fault, because they could have escaped if they had paid attention.
translation_verse: Ɔdele aweɛne tendenle ne ane yɛɛ yeanla ɔ nwo zo a; ye mogya gua ɔ ti zo. Saa ɔlale ɔ nwo zo a, anrɛɛ ɔvile ɛsalɛ.

english_verse: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord, will hold that person responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Na saa sinzavolɛ ne nwu kɛ ɛlɔne ɛlɛba arava bɛ aze na yeanwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu, yeammaa menli ne anla bɛ nwo zo, na ɛlɔne ne ba na bɛku bɛ nuhua bie a, ɛnee sonla zɔhane, ye ɛtane ti yɛɛ bɛhu ye a, na mebalie ye mogya ne meavi sinzavolɛ ne ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti wɔmɔ, sonla ra, meyɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma sinzavolɛ. Mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛde me nloa anu edwɛkɛ la, kakye bɛ wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways. But if you refuse to warn them, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Saa meka mekile amumuyɛnli ne kɛ ɔbawu na wɔambɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ wɔammaa yeanvi ye ninyɛndane nwo a, amumuyɛnli zɔhane bawu ala ye ɛtane nu, noko mebalie ye mogya ne meavi wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent. The Lord Is Always Fair (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Na saa ɛbɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ kɛ ɔvi ye ninyɛndane nwo, na yeangyakyi ɔ sa anloa a, ɔbawu yeala ye ɛtane ne anu, na wɔmɔ, ɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo.” Sonla ko biala ɛzonlelilɛ

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Saa tenlenenli sia fi ye tenleneyɛlɛ nwo na ɔyɛ ɛtane a, ye ɛtane ne ati, ɔbawu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, “Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ sonla ra, wɔ menli ne mɔɔ kuohua bɛ nloa wɔ bane bo bane bo nee bɛ nlenkɛ nzi ka ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ la ka kile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Bɛrɛla bɛradie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye ɛra la.’

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, mɔɔ wɔha la ɛne: ‘Yɛ mɛladonlɛ nee yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbu ɛzia yɛ; na ɛhye ati a yɛmkpazi a. Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanyia ngoane ɛ?’

english_verse: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, menlɛ anyelielɛ biala wɔ amumuyɛnli ewule nu, kyesɛ amumuyɛnli ne kakyi fi ye ndenle ne mɔ anu na ɔnyia ngoane. Bɛzia bɛ nzi, bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛvi bɛ munzule ndenle ne mɔ anu; Yizilayɛma, duzu ati a bɛkulo kɛ bɛwu a?

english_verse: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka kile menli ne kɛ, saa tenlenenli yɛ ɛtane a, ye tenleneyɛlɛ ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye, yɛɛ saa amumuyɛnli sia fi ye ninyɛndane nwo a, ɔnrɛwu. Saa tenlenenli yɛ ɛtane a, ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛnyia ngoane.

english_verse: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Saa meka mekile tenlenenli kɛ ɔbanyia ngoane, na ɔmaa ɔ ti anu yɛ ye fɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane a, ye tenlene nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la abo zo baminli mɔɔ bɛnrɛhakye ye bieko a, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la yɛɛ ɔbawu yeala nu a.

english_verse: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.
translation_verse: Bieko, saa meka mekile amumuyɛnli kɛ, ‘ɛbawu’, na saa ɔsia ɔfi ye ninyɛndane nwo, ɔyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu na ɔle kpalɛ,

english_verse: For example, they need to return anything they have taken as security for a loan and anything they have stolen. Then if they stop doing evil and start obeying my Law, they will live.
translation_verse: na amumuyɛnli ne siane mɔɔ bɛvale bɛwulale ye ɛkɛ ne awoba la, ɔfa mɔɔ ɔwuale la ɔmaa ɔ menle mɔ, na ɔdi ngoane mɛla ne mɔ azo, mɔɔ ɔnyɛ ɛtane bieko la a, ɔbanyia ngoane, ɔnrɛwu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.
translation_verse: “Noko akee wɔ menli ne se, ‘Awulae adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛ adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ la.

english_verse: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Na saa amumuyɛnli sia fi ye amumuyɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na ɔyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu la na ɔdi boɛ a, ye boɛlilɛ ne ati, ɔbanyia ngoane.

english_verse: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done. The News of Jerusalem's Fall
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛse ‘Awulae adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ.’ Mebabua sonla ko biala ndɛne, kɛmɔ ye ndenle ne mɔ si de la.” Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ nwo nrɛlaleɛ

english_verse: The evening before this man arrived at my house, the Lord had taken control of me. So when the man came to me the next morning, I could once again speak. What Will Happen to Those Left in Israel?
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne dɔle me nwo zo, ɔvi kenle mɔɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu a ahenle ne mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la nriandile rale la nɔsolɛ nu. Kenle ko ne mɔɔ nrenya ne rale la nwonlomɔ ne, ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛde me nloa. Yemɔti mendendɛle, meanyɛ mumule bieko. Menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, “Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la azo la tɛka kɛ, ‘Ebileham ɛnee le sonla kokye, noko ɔholale ɔnyianle azɛlɛ ne, na akee yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛ nwo zonle la; bɛva azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa yɛ kɛ ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder
translation_verse: “Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Mɔɔ bɛdi nane mɔɔ ye mogya ne wɔ nu, bɛsonle bɛ mmonle ne mɔ, na bɛka mogya bɛgua la, asoo bɛkɛhola azɛlɛ ne fa yɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ?

english_verse: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!
translation_verse: Ɔngyɛ ɛnee bɛhwe dadeɛ, bɛbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla na bɛfa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mraalɛ la, ɛnee kɛ bɛsi bɛfa azɛlɛ ne bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, you people in the ruined cities will be killed in battle. Those of you living in the countryside will be eaten by wild animals, and those hiding in caves and on rocky cliffs will die from deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ mgbane ne azo la badɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ konle nu. Mɔɔ ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu la, mebaye ye meamaa nanemgbole ahye ye ali; yɛɛ ewulenzane bahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔvea aranemgbole nee awolɛ mbɔne nu la.

english_verse: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.
translation_verse: Mebamaa azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane, yeahwe, na ye anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la awie. Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo badɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛze zolɛ bieko a.

english_verse: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord. The People Listen, but Don't Change The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na saa meto azɛlɛ ne mgbane, mɔɔ awie ɛnle zolɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ninyɛndane ti a, akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.’ ” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne nrɛlaleɛ ne anzi edwɛkɛ

english_verse: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.
translation_verse: Bɛba ɛ nwo ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ awie biala ba la, bɛbatɛnla ɛ nwo ɛkɛ kɛ asɛɛ me menli la, na bɛtie mɔɔ ɛka la, noko bɛnrɛyɛ ye ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛfa bɛ nloa a bɛkile bɛ ɛhulolɛ a, na bɛ ahonle ɛdeɛ, yemɔ ɔgyi bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.
translation_verse: Na nea, ɛle bɛ nye zo kɛ sonla bie mɔɔ fa ɛnelɛ fɛlɛko to ɛhulolɛ edwɛne na ɔbɔ agole la, ɔluakɛ bɛte mɔɔ ɛka la, noko bɛnrɛyɛ ye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.
translation_verse: Saa ɛhye ba a, na ɔbara noko, yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ a ɛnee de bɛ avinli a.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, Israel's leaders are like shepherds taking care of my sheep, the people of Israel. But I want you to condemn these leaders and tell them: I, the Lord God, say you shepherds of Israel are doomed! You take care of yourselves while ignoring my sheep.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile Yizilayɛ mboaneneavolɛma ne. Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ kɛ, kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ yɛne bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo a, bɛwie! Asoo mboaneneavolɛ fa mboane kɔ adidi a, tɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔnea mboane ne mɔ ɔmaa bɛdidi a?

english_verse: You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock!
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛku mɔɔ ɛlɔ la bɛdi, bɛpepɛ bɛ nwo enrinli bɛnwo ndanlɛ bɛkeda; noko bɛmmaa mboane ne mɔ aleɛ.

english_verse: You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep.
translation_verse: Bɛannea mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la, bɛanyɛ mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la ayile, mɔɔ ɛboda la, bɛambɔ ye bɔlɛ, mɔɔ vonle adenle la, bɛanva ye bɛamba, bɛamkpondɛ mɔɔ ɛminli la, na bɛvale atisesebɛ nee amumuyɛ a bɛnleanle bɛ a.

english_verse: They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛbɔle asande, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛnlɛ mɔɔ nea bɛ a; na bɛyɛle aleɛ bɛmanle ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole.

english_verse: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
translation_verse: Me mboane ne mɔ bɔle asande, bɛluoluale awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo; me mboane ne mɔ bɔle asande wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala, na bɛannyia awie amkpondɛ bɛ anzɛɛ amkpo bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep.
translation_verse: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle mede aze la, kɛmɔ me mboane ne ɛdɔ agyie, na bɛyɛ aleɛ bɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, na bɛnlɛ mboaneneavolɛ biala, kɛmɔ me mboaneneavolɛma ne amkpo me mboane ne mɔ abo zo, na mboaneneavolɛma ne ɛli bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo adane, na bɛanyɛne me mboane ne la,

english_verse: So I, the Lord, will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛnlea, mekpo mboaneneavolɛma ne, na mebabiza bɛ mealie me mboane ne mɔ, na meamaa bɛagyakyi me mboane ne ɛyɛnelɛ. Bɛnrɛli bɛ ngome bɛ nwo adane bieko. Mebalie me mboane ne meavi bɛ nloa anu, amaa yeanyɛ aleɛ yeammaa bɛ. Mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord God then said: I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself,
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛnlea, medame, medame mumua ne mebakpondɛ me mboane ne toonwo meahɔnwu bɛ.

english_verse: just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ mboaneneavolɛ mɔɔ ye mboane mɔɔ ɛbɔ asande la si kpondɛ ye mboane ne mɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebakpondɛ me mboane ne mɔ a. Mebalie bɛ meavi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzande bɛ bɛhɔgua la wɔ amungu nee awozinli kenle ne.

english_verse: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.
translation_verse: Mebaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu; mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu, na meava bɛ meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. Mebayɛne bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, azudenle ne mɔ anloa, nee maanle ne anu ɛleka biala mɔɔ sonla tɛnla a ɔyɛ boɛ la.

english_verse: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe,
translation_verse: Medame mumua ne mebayɛ me mboane ne neavolɛ na meamaa bɛala bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right. Judgment on the Strong Sheep
translation_verse: “Mebakpondɛ mɔɔ ɛminli la, na me nee mɔɔ agyakɛ ɛvo adenle la azia ara sua nu; mebabɔ mɔɔ ɛbubu la bɔlɛ, meamaa mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la anyia anwosesebɛ, na mɔɔ ɛhye nee mɔɔ lɛ anwosesebɛ la, mebavede me nye meanlea bɛ boɛ. Mebamaa biala aleɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.
translation_verse: “Na bɛmɛ, me mboane ekpunli, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Bɛnlea, mebabua bɛ ndɛne na meaye kpalɛ ne meavi ɛtane ne mɔ avinli; meaye mbɔnkye ne mɔ meavi mboane ne avinli.

english_verse: Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy.
translation_verse: Bɛdi ndile kpalɛ ne bɛwie a, ɔnle kɛ bɛtietia mɔɔ kɛha la azo; na bɛno nzule kpalɛ anye komikomi bɛwie a, bɛatietia nu bɛakpoto ye.

english_verse: That means my other sheep have nothing fit to eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ɛnee bɛkpondɛ bɛaze kɛ me mboane ne ɛli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛtietia zolɛ la, na bɛnlo nzule ne mɔɔ bɛkpoto ye la ɔ?

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka meahile bɛ kɛ: Bɛnlea kɛ akee medame, medame mumua ne, mebabua mboane kyenlera ne mɔ nee mboane nwanlera ne mɔ ndɛne.

english_verse: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak,
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛfa bɛ nvenle nee bɛ bati bɛsuhuzuhu mboane nwanlera ne mɔ, na bɛfa bɛ mɛne bɛwowɔ bɛ bɛmaa bɛbɔ asande bɛkɔ maanle zo la ati,

english_verse: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
translation_verse: mebalie me mboane ekpunli ne ati. Bɛnrɛdɔ agyie bieko; na mebabua bɛ ndɛne meaye mboane kpalɛ ne meavi ɛtane ne avinli.

english_verse: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na me akɛlɛ Devidi ali bɛ belemgbunli, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ bayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ na meavoa nanemgbole ne mɔ meavi azɛlɛ ne azo, amaa bɛadɛnla fienemgbole ne anu anwondɔlɛ nu na bɛala kpɔkɛ nu mbaka ne mɔ abo bɛalafe.

english_verse: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain
translation_verse: “Mebayila bɛ na meayila ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne la amuala. Mebamaa ezule anyenye wɔ bɛ ɛlobɔ ne mɔ anloa ayɛ nyilalɛ amaa bɛ.

english_verse: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ nu mbaka bazo ma amaa bɛ, na azɛlɛ ne amaa bɛ aleɛ ahye, na bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ wɔ bɛ maanle ne anu. Saa meye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo, na medie bɛ mefi menli mɔɔ ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ bɛ ahanra la asa anu a, bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛdɔ agyie bɛnrɛmaa maanle maanle, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne azo nanemgbole biala ɛnrɛhye bie ɛnrɛli. Bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛmaa bɛ ahonle ɛnrɛdu.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ egyinli ne mɔ ahye, amaa ɛhɔne angu bɛ bieko wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na maanle maanle ne mɔ angolo bɛ nwo bieko.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Bɛbanwu kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, me nee bɛ lua, na bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma amuala, bɛle me menli. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: “Bɛle me mboane, me adidileka mboane, yɛɛ mele bɛ Nyamenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland,
translation_verse: Ka kile ye kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Nea, bɛmɛ Yidɔm awoka, meyɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛ! Mebadenrɛ me sa meatia bɛ, na meamaa bɛadɔ mgbane.

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ayɛ azuadu, na bɛ azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ ɛnee bɛle Yizilayɛma kpɔvolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, na bɛyele bɛ bɛmanle bɛhunle bɛ wɔ bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtea bɛ ndeanlɛ mɔɔ li amozi la ati,

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Awulae Nyamenle la, mebaha bɛ mogya meagua, na mogya adu bɛ mgbaliko, ɔboalekɛ bɛdi fɔlɛ kɛ bɛha mogya bɛgua, yemɔti mogya badu bɛ mgbaliko.

english_verse: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.
translation_verse: Mebamaa Yidɔm maanle ne adɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nu a; yɛɛ mebahu menli mɔɔ ba nu kɔ la amuala.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ maanle ne abɔ bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Maanle nwiɔ ɛhye, Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ bayɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ, na yɛbava yɛayɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mede bɛ avinli la.

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, me nee bɛ bali, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛya nee bɛ anyebolo ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛkpɔle me menli ne la si de la. Akee mebaye me nwo meahile bɛ wɔ bɛ ndɛnebualɛ nu.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mede aholoba mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne, na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Maanle ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane, bɛva bɛmaa yɛ kɛ yɛzɛkye bɛ’ la.

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: Bɛmemanle bɛ nwo zo, bɛhehanle mgbole bɛtietiale me, na bɛhehanle edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo bɛtietiale me. Mendele.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you,
translation_verse: “Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mebamaa bɛadɔ mgbane, amaa ewiade kɔsɔɔti anye alie.

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛzile bɛ nye liele Yizilayɛma azedɔlɛ nee bɛ mgbane mɔɔ bɛyɛle la anwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebayɛ bɛdabɛ noko a. Siyɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, Yidɔm maanle ne amuala badɔ mgbane. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Kɛmɔ kpɔvolɛ ne zelele bɛ na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Mɔmoane awoka ne mɔ ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ’ la ati,

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ awoka, bɛdie Awulae Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ. Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛlɛse bɛmɛ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, awoka avinli ahuma nee mbɔnza, azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane nee azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu, mɔɔ ɛdɔ agyie ɛmaa maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la kɛ,

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: ‘Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Melɛ ɛya kpole nee anyebolo melɛtendɛ meatia maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛha la, nee Yidɔmma kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ hyɛle me azɛlɛ ne manle bɛ nwo anyelielɛ nu, adubɛnwo nu kɛ bɛfa na bɛave zolɛ ninyɛne bɛali la.’

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Meka, meka kɛ, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la banwu zɔhane amaneɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ awoka, mbaka bafifi zolɛ, na bɛazo ma bɛamaa me menli Yizilayɛma, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛazia bɛara sua nu.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, bɛnlea, mele bɛ ɛdeɛ. Mebahakyi me nye bɛ nwo zo, na bɛbazo bɛ ɛya bɛalua.

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: Mebamaa menli dɔɔnwo aradɛnla ɛkɛ, meka Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti. Menli badɛnla azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na bɛaziezie ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa menli nee nane azo awoka ne mɔ azo; bɛ nwo bazo na bɛawo dɔɔnwo. Mebamaa bɛadɛnla, kɛmɔ alumua ne bɛde la, na meayɛ kpalɛ dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛ, meadɛla mɔɔ mɔmoane menyɛle la. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mebamaa me menli Yizilayɛma aradɛnla awoka ne mɔ azo na bɛava bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na bɛ mra ɛnrɛhye ɛhɔne bieko.

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: “Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ, menli ka kɛ, ‘Ɛdi menli, yɛɛ ɛkye maanle ne anu amra ɛhɔne ɛku bɛ.’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Menrɛmaa ɛnrɛde maanle maanle ne mɔ aholoba ɛbɔlɛ ne bieko, ɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛdu koti bieko. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.” Yizilayɛma ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma de bɛ maanle nu la, bɛvale bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee ninyɛndane bɛzɛkyele ye. Wɔ me nye zo a, bɛ nyɛleɛ ne ɛtane le kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Yemɔti menwolale me ɛya ne menguale bɛ ti zo wɔ mogya ne mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua azɛlɛ ne azo, nee bɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ne la ati.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ bɛhɔle maanle ne mɔ anu la, ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛhɔle la, bɛzɛkyele me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne. Yemɔti menli hanle ye bɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Ɛhye mɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye menli, noko akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfi ye azɛlɛ ne azo ala.’

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Tɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma ati yɛɛ mekeha me nwo a, na me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛhɔle nu la ati ɔ.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Mebakponde nzule mɔɔ anye te la bɛ nwo, na bɛ nwo bade avi bɛ ɛtane biala nee bɛ mmonle mɔɔ bɛzonlenle la anwo.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ ahonle fofolɛ, meava sunsum fofolɛ meawula bɛ nuhua, na meaye bolɛ ahonle ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la na meamaa bɛ ahonle bɛlɛvolɛ.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Mebava me sunsum ne meawula bɛ nuhua, na meamaa bɛali me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛanlea boɛ bɛali me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo, bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Mebaye bɛ meavi ninyɛndane biala anwo, na meamaa bɛanyia abɛlɛ dɔɔnwo; menrɛmaa ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ mbaka azo dɔɔnwo na bɛ ɛya nu aleɛ ahye, amaa ɛhɔne angu bɛ angua bɛ nyunlu aze bieko wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Tɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma ati yɛɛ mekeha me nwo a, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Bɛmaa ɔla bɛ ti anu. O Yizilayɛma, bɛmaa bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛyɛ bɛ nyiane ɛmaa bɛ ti ɛzi aze.”

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kenle mɔɔ mebanlua bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati la, mebamaa bɛahɔdɛnla bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, na bɛakyekye bɛ azua mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Bɛbazo ɛya wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo, wɔ menli mɔɔ zenle azɛlɛ ne azo la anye zo.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Na bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu kɛ Yidɛn Tola ne la, na azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛle azuadu la kɛkala azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu, na bɛlie nwolɛ bane.’

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Na akee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la banwu kɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mekyekye azua ne mɔ na memaa ɛleka mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la ɛfifi a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, yɛɛ mebayɛ noko.”

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Eza mebamaa Yizilayɛma abiza me bɛamaa meayɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ. Mebamaa bɛ nwo azo kɛ mboane ekpunli.

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛle azuadu la azo ayɛ menli gbudugbudu, kɛmɔ azubɔlɛ mekɛ dwu a Gyɛlusalɛm yɛ mboane ngome la. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne rahedale me nwo zo, na ye sunsum ne vale me rale bɔnza ne avinli, na menwunle mbowule dɔɔnwo wɔ bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Na ɔvale me ɔkpɔsale bɛ avinli, na menwunle kɛ ɛnee bɛzonle kpalɛ a bɛwɔ bɔnza ne anu a, na bɛwe bɛyɛ resee zɛhae.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbizale me kɛ, “Sonla ra, asoo mbowule ɛhye mɔ kola nyia ngoane?” Membuale kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛze a.”

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile mbowule ɛhye mɔ na se bɛ kɛ, O mbowule welera, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane.

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛlɛka ahile bɛmɛ mbowule kɛ: Mebamaa ɛnwomenle awolo bɛ nu na bɛbanyia ngoane.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛanyia ndinli, nwonane ara nwolɛ, nwoma arafɔle nwolɛ, na meava ɛnwomenle meawula bɛ nu na bɛanyia ngoane; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne, kɛmɔ bɛzele me la. Mɔɔ melɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, mendele ɛnelɛ bie kɛ ɔlɛsu kpoladada, na mbowule ne mɔ rasisiale zolɛ.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Me nye gyi bɛ nwo ala la, bɛnyianle ndinli, nwonane rale nwolɛ, na nwoma rafɔlele nwolɛ noko ɛnee ɛnwomenle ɛnle bɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile anwoma. Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se anwoma ne kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: O sunsum, ɛvi anwoma nna ne anu bɛla bagu ɛnwomenle gua menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ la nu maa bɛnyia ngoane.’ ”

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɔzele me la, na ɛnwomenle rale bɛ nu na bɛnyianle ngoane, bɛdwazole bɛgyinlanle, na ɛnee bɛ nwo zonle kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, mbowule ɛhye mɔ a le Yizilayɛma amuala. Nea, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Yɛ mbowule ɛwe, yɛnlɛ anyelazo biala; bɛpɛ yɛ bɛgua bɔkɔɔ ala ɛne.’

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se: O me menli, bɛnlea, mebabukebuke bɛ nla ne mɔ, meadwazo bɛ meavi bɛ nla ne mɔ anu, na me nee bɛ ahɔ sua nu wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Mebava me Sunsum ne meawula bɛ nuhua, na bɛanyia ngoane, na meava bɛ meahɔgua bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo; na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meha a, yɛɛ meyɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ mese la ɛne.” Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ yɛ belemgbunli maanle ko

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, fa baka na kɛlɛ nwolɛ, ‘Dwuda ɛdeɛ ɔ, na Yizilayɛma amuala nee ye le ko;’ eza fa baka ko noko na kɛlɛ nwolɛ, ‘Dwosefi ɛdeɛ ɔ na Yizilayɛma amuala nee ye le ko.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Akee fa mbaka nwiɔ ne bɔ nwolɛ yɛ bɛ baka ko wɔ ɛ sa nu.

english_verse: And when your people ask you what this means,
translation_verse: Na saa wɔ menli ne biza wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛnrɛhile yɛ deɛ mɔɔ ɛhye kile la abo?’ a,

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlea, meyɛ kɛ mefa Dwosefi baka ne nee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ nee ye ɛyɛ ko la, na meava ye nee Dwuda baka ɛdeɛ ne meabɔ bɛ nu meayɛ bɛ baka ko wɔ me sa nu.

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ akee bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɛlɛ mbaka nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔhɛlɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ la ɛ sa nu wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la,

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: se bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mebahɔva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ azo la, meaboɔboa bɛ nloa, na me nee bɛ ara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ bɛ maanle ko wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka maanle ne anu. Belemgbunli ko ala a bazie bɛ a. Bɛnrɛyɛ maanle nwiɔ bieko yɛɛ bɛnrɛyɛ arelemgbunli maanle nwiɔ.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Bɛnrɛzonle mmonle bɛnrɛgua bɛ nwo evinli; bɛnrɛyɛ bɛkyi debie biala, yɛɛ bɛnrɛtietia me mɛla ne mɔ azo. Mebalie bɛ meavi ninyɛne mɔɔ manle bɛyɛle ɛtane la asa anu na meade bɛ nwo. Bɛbayɛ me menli, na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ dɛnlanle zolɛ na menvale memanle me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo la azo. Bɛdabɛ, bɛ mra, yɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra kɔsɔɔti badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, na me sonvolɛ Devidi ali bɛ belemgbunli dahuu.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ bayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ; ɔbayɛ me nee bɛ yɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. Mebayila bɛ na meamaa bɛ nwo azo, na meazi me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛ avinli, mɔɔ bɛndu ye bieko ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Mebadɛnla bɛ avinli, na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Na akee maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mete Yizilayɛma anwo a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza wɔ bɛ avinli dahuu la.”

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ Meegɔɔgo azɛlɛ zo, wɔ Gɔɔgo mɔɔ sie Mihyɛke nee Tubale la,

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: Mebabɔ wɔ nzɛla na meava koba meabɔ wɔ awudwɔlɛ meava wɔ meara, ɛdawɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema amuala, wɔ mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ, mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛwulowula konle adɛladeɛ, bɛ nwo zonle kpalɛ na bɛdedɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike, bɛkola dadeɛ to;

english_verse: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
translation_verse: Goma nee ye ɛlɔnema, Bɛte Togama nee ye menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ li ɔ nzi mɔɔ bɛvi sɔlɔ nehane la amuala.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Mekɛ dɔɔnwo se a, bɛbaheha bɛ nwo; nzinlii bɛbava konle badoa maanle ne mɔɔ bɛlie ye bɛvi konle nu la. Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle maanle zo rale Yizilayɛ awoka maanle ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu la a wɔ ɛkɛ a; ɛnɛ bɛde ye anwondɔlɛ nu yɛɛ bɛndwenle konle nwo.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: Ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ li ɛ nzi la bara bɛ nwo zo kɛ ahumu, na wɔayɛ kɛ amungu wɔaheda maanle ne azo.”

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mekɛ zɔhane anu, ɛbanyia adwenle dɔɔnwo na wɔabɔ adwenle ɛtane wɔaha kɛ,

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: ‘Mefa konle meahɔdoa azua ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛdiele nwolɛ bane la. Mekɔ menli ne mɔɔ anzo nu ɛdwo bɛ na bɛde anwondɔlɛ nu, na bɛtɛdiele bɛ azua ne mɔ anwo bane, na bɛnlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ mbulalɛ gua bɛ nzi la anwo zo,

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: amaa yɛave bɛ ninyɛne, yɛazoa ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛkɛnyia la yɛahɔ, yɛahɔha menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ gbudugbudu de azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo la senle dwɛɛ. Bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle maanle zo a rale a, na bɛlɛ nlankɛ nee ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ bɛde ewiade ye avinli.’
