english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Hyiba nee Didan nee gualilɛma mɔɔ vi Tahyehye nee ye namunamu la babiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Wɔra kɛ ɛbave ninyɛne ɔ? Wɔboɔboa wɔ ɛlɔnema anloa kɛ ɛbazoa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke, nlankɛ nee ninyɛne wɔahɔ ɔ?’

english_verse: I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace,
translation_verse: “Yemɔti, sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se Gɔɔgo kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mekɛ ne anu mɔɔ ɛnee me menli ne de anwondɔlɛ nu la,

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: wɔara me menli Yizilayɛma anwo zo kɛ amungu la wɔaraheda maanle ne azo. Mekɛ ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu, mebamaa wɔara me azɛlɛ ne azo, na saa medua ɛdawɔ Gɔɔgo ɛ nwo zo meye me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne mekile a, maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu me.

english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mebiza wɔ kɛ: Wɔmɔ a ɛle sonla ne mɔɔ menluale me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo menganle ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ mɔmoane mɔmoane ne kɛ mebava wɔ meara Yizilayɛma anwo zo la ɔ?” Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gɔɔgo anwo zo

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ melɛ anyebolo nee ɛya kpole meka kɛ: Mekɛ ne anu, Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu bakpusu kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: Saa meye me nyunlu a, menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala, fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu, nloma mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu, nane, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ kɛnra aze la anwo bawozo ye, awoka badwulu agua, yɛɛ bodane boka senze bɔbɔ bagolo agua aze.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Mebamaa ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ aha Gɔɔgo, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Awie biala bahwe ɔ gɔnwo anwo dadeɛ.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Mebava ewulenzane nee mogya ɛhanlɛ a meadea ye a. Mebamaa ezuawolɛ, senle nee sɔlefe adɔ bilididi agua ye nee ye ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ yehwe bɛ yeli ɔ nzi la anwo zo.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Zɛhae yɛɛ mebahile me kpoleyɛlɛ nee me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ na meaye me nwo meahile bɛ wɔ maanle maanle anyunlu a. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia Gɔɔgo la na se ye kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Gɔɔgo, Mihyɛke nee Tubale belemgbunli, mekpo wɔ.

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: Mebahakyi ɛ nye na meahwe wɔ me nee wɔ vi sɔlɔ lɔ ara, na meamaa wɔahɔteta Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Akee mebabɔ wɔ ɛda ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye ɛ sa bɛne ne anu la meado, na meamaa wɔ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ vi ɛ sa fema ne anu agua aze.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔ ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ li ɛ nzi la amuala badɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo. Mebava bɛ nwonane meamaa nloma nee nanemgbole ali.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛbadɔ fienemgbole ne anu; medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebamaa senle adɔ agua Meegɔɔgo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde anwondɔlɛ nu wɔ ɛnweanloa la anwo zo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.

translation_verse: Kɛ azukponle ne kpole si de la ɛne, bɛva nzuzuleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzuzule Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la bɛzuzu: ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ bo ne anwumahɔlɛ yɛ waa nsa yɛɛ ɔ nloa kɛba ne ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ waa ko nee ekyi. Akee azukponle ne anwumahɔlɛ ɛne:

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, tie mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka meahile wɔ la. Ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ azukponle ne anwo la ɛne: Kenle mɔɔ bɛkɛwie ye si kɛ akee bɛbɔ ɛyelalɛ azu wɔ zolɛ, na bɛado mogya bɛagua nwolɛ la,

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,

translation_verse: Nrenya ne akee vale me rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ kɔne aduduleɛ la anloa. Ɛnee bɛdo nuhua.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Na Ɔzele me kɛ, “Anlenkɛ ɛhye, ɔnle kɛ bɛtukue; dahuu ɔwɔ kɛ ɔboa nyinlira nu, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ awie biala fa nu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛva nuhua. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ ɔboa nyinlira nu.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne ala a ɔwɔ kɛ kɔtɛnla nu di debie wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa anlenkɛ kpole ne sua kpandaanwo ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu la anu a ɔkɔ, na eza ɔsia ɔ nzi a.” Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛwololɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Akee nrenya ne vale me luale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu rale sua ne anyunlu. Memanle me nye zo la, menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛyi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne tɛkɛɛ. Membutule mutule nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, fa ɛ nye nea debie kpalɛ, na gyele ɛ nzo tie mɔɔ meka meahile wɔ, mɔɔ fane ngyehyɛlɛ nee mɛla mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anwo la amuala. Nea nwu menli mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ adenle bɛmaa bɛwolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛkɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: “Ka kile Yizilayɛma atuadelɛma kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: O Yizilayɛma, bɛgyakyi bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: My temple has been disgraced, because you have let godless, stubborn foreigners come here when sacrifices are being offered to me. You have sinned and have broken our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi kɛ bɛkɛmaa nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛsolo na bɛnze Nyamenle la kɛwolo me Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛkɛhɔgua ɛkɛ ne evinli wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa me aleɛ, nane ɛnlome nee mogya ne bɛarɛlɛ me la. Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne bɛboka bɛ ninyɛndane bebelebe ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: Bɛannea me ninyɛne nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ boɛ, na bɛva nyɛvolɛ kɛ bɛmɛ yɛɛ akee bɛnlea ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ me Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne la azo a.

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle na yesolo, ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu la, ɛnle kɛ kɔ me Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne.” Bɛye Livaema bɛvi sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne anu

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Livaema noko mɔɔ lile awozonlezonlenlɛ nzi, bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile me nwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma minlinle la, mebadea bɛ.

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: Bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛbayɛ wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la a le kɛ bɛkɛzinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ; bɛbahu nane mɔɔ menli ne kɛva kɛra kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu nee ɛyelalɛ azu la. Bɛbanlea na bɛaboa menli ne.

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛboale menli ne wɔ bɛ mmonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu, na bɛmanle Yizilayɛma dule koti bɛyɛle ɛtane la, medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka, meka kɛ, bɛ munzule doa bɛ.

english_verse: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Bɛnlɛ adenle bɛmbikye me, bɛnzonle me kɛ bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma, yɛɛ bɛnrɛbikye me ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ anwo te nee mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ la. Bɛ anyiemgba doa bɛ wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ati.

english_verse: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple. Rules for Priests The Lord said:
translation_verse: Noko mebava bɛ meamaa bɛazinza Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, bɛayɛ nwolɛ gyima biala nee gyima biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ nu la.” Sɛlɛvolɛma

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Livaema sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ le Zeedɔko abo zo amra la yɛɛ bara me nyunlu arazonle me a. Bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛbarazonle me na bɛava nane ɛnlome nee mogya bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa me a, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ a bɛgyinlanle bɛnleanle me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne azo, bɛlile nɔhalɛ bɛmanle me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hakyile bɛ nzi zile me la a.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛbawolo me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, na bɛahɔ me azukponle ne anwo bɛahɔbɔ azu, na bɛanlea me ɛzonlenlɛ zo wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Saa bɛkawolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛdwu ye anlenkɛ kpole ne anu a, bɛbawula lenen adɛladeɛ. Bɛnrɛwula mboane enrinli debie biala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsonle wɔ ɔ kunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, anzɛɛ alie ne anwo la.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Bɛbabɔ lenen ɛdanlɛ abɔtile na bɛawula lenen ɛdanlɛ ‘nikabuka’; ɔnle kɛ bɛwula debie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa ɛhɛnlɛnra kɛdu bɛ la.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛkɔ menli ne anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ ne a, bɛbaye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛwulale bɛzonlenle me la bɛagua ekpumgbunli nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anu. Bɛbava adɛladeɛ gyɛne bɛawula, amaa bɛanlua bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ azo bɛanva nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ bɛangɔmaa menli ne.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: “Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ biala kpa ɔ ti yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔmaa ɔ ti enrinli ne nyi yɛ ndendenle; bɛbafefa bɛ ti enrinli ne azo ala.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ biala no nza na yeahɔwolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ gya kunlanvolɛ anzɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ewole la. Ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ biala gya raalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya fee na ɔle Yizilayɛnli la anzɛɛ kunlanvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ hu le sɛlɛvolɛ la.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile me menli ne ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ debie mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza nee debie mɔɔ ɛnle nwuanzanwuanza la anu, na bɛkilehile bɛ bɛmaa bɛnwu debie mɔɔ anwo te nee debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la.

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Saa kpolera si a, sɛlɛvolɛma ne bayɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma na bɛabua edwɛkɛ ne, kɛmɔ me mɛla ne se la. Bɛbali me mɛla nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo, na bɛazie me ɛvoyia ne mɔ nee me Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ biala ɛngɔ funli nwo ɔmmaa evinli ɛnga ye; noko akee saa ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli, ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ ɔ ra raalɛ, ɔ diema nrenya anzɛɛ ɔ diema raalɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛkɔle agyalɛ la wu a, ɔkola ɔmaa evinli ka ye.

english_verse: If a priest touches a dead body, he is unclean and must go through a ceremony to make himself clean. Then seven days later,
translation_verse: Saa evinli ka ye a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia kenle nsuu na ɔ nwo evinli ne adu.

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Saa ɔtu evinli ne ɔwie, na kenle mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ yeahɔzonle la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ɔbɔ azu. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: “Sɛlɛvolɛ ne ɛnlɛ agyadeɛ biala, medame a mele bɛ agyadeɛ a. Ɔnle kɛ bɛnyia agyadeɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Bɛbali ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, nee abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ; debie biala noko mɔɔ bɛdu bɛmaa Nyamenle wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu la le bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. And whenever any of my people bake bread, they will give their first loaf as an offering to the priests, and I will bless the homes of the people when they do this.
translation_verse: Ma ngakyile mɔɔ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛde anzɛɛ bɛkɛbu, yɛɛ menli ne azubɔdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ amuala le sɛlɛvolɛma ne ɛdeɛ. Eza ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛ mɛtɛkɛ mɔɔ lumua la bɛbɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne, amaa nyilalɛ aha bɛ awuke ne mɔ.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne di debie biala, nane o, anloma o, mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔkɛwu anzɛɛ bɛkɛtete ye nu bɛkɛhu ye la.

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nzuzudeɛ ne mɔ amuala yɛ pɛpɛ:

english_verse: The Festival of Shelters will begin on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will continue for seven days. On each day of this festival, the ruler will provide the same number of animals that he did each day during Passover, as well as the same amount of grain and olive oil for the sacrifices.
translation_verse: “Siane nsuu ne, ye kenle bulu nee nnu ne azo mɔɔ bɛbɔ Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ bo la, ɔdaye noko ɔbayɛ zɔhane ala toonwo kenle nsuu ne adwu. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsesa ninyɛne zɔhane ala ɔmaa bɛbɔ ɛtane azu, ɛyelalɛ azu, yɛɛ ma azu ne mɔ, na ɔfa nwolɛ nwole noko ɔboka nwo.”

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli, yeyɛ boɛ! Bɛgyakyi konle nee nzisililɛ, na bɛli pɛlepɛle nee nɔhalɛ. Bɛmmatu me menli ne bɛfi bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo bieko. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: “Yifa ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsuzu ninyɛne anwo resee la, ɔwɔ kɛ nee ‘baate’ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsuzu nzule nee nwole la yɛ pɛpɛ. Bɛsuzu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ muala bɛgyinla nzuzuleɛ ‘homɛ’ azo. Yemɔti nzuzuleɛ ne bayɛ zɛ: Homɛ ko le yifa bulu anzɛɛ baate bulu.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Siane ne anu kenle nsuu ne azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔlua nvonleɛ zo ɔyɛle ɛtane anzɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnla nwolɛ na ɔyɛle ɛtane la. Ɛhye yɛɛ bɛbayɛ bɛayɛ mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛamaa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a.

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala bava azubɔdeɛ ɛhye mɔ amaa Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: But during New Moon Festivals, Sabbath celebrations, and other religious feasts, you leaders will be responsible for providing animals for the sacrifices, as well as the grain and wine. All these will be used for the sacrifices for sin, the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices to please me, and those to ask my blessing. I will be pleased and will forgive the sins of my people. The Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔle belemgbunli ne gyima kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee nza azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔmaa, wɔ ɛvoyia ne mɔ ɛlilɛ nu. Ɛvoyia ne mɔ a le Siane fofolɛ nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne mɔ, nee ɛvoyia mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ Yizilayɛma di la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɛtane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ ɔmaa na bɛfa bɛyɛ Yizilayɛma ati mgbɔdalɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.” Ɛvoyia ne mɔ (Ade

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Kenle nsuu ne amuala mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛdi ɛvoyia ne la, belemgbunli ne bava nlankɛ ndonrandonra nsuu, mboane nyinli nsuu mɔɔ biala anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la yeamaa bɛabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu. Eza kenle ko biala ɔbava abɔnkye nyinli ko yeayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la azo, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la bɛnua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ ne bava ɛtane azubɔdeɛ mogya ne bie apepe Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ felɛmo ne mɔ anwo, azukponle ne abati kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ ne anuhɔlɛ ne felɛmo ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, ye kenle bulu nee nna ne azo yɛɛ bɛbali Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne a. Bɛnrɛli kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la toonwo kenle nsuu.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Kenle ko zɔhane, belemgbunli ne babɔ ɔdaye nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati ava ɛnlankɛ nyinli edonraa ko ayɛ ɛtane azubɔdeɛ.

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Ɛnlankɛ ko nee boane ko biala mɔɔ bɛbahu ye la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia nwolɛ ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛsuzu a ɔndwu litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko yɛɛ nwole litili nsa.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ alie nwo anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la boa nyinlira nu wɔ kenle nsia ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima la anu. Bɛbuke ye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne yɛɛ Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia kenle ne.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bava Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ, alua anlenkɛ kpole ne anu aragyinla ye sua kpandaanwo ne anu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu lɔ alie ne anwo anlenkɛ felɛmo ne anwo, na yeanlea sɛlɛvolɛma ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ ye ɛyelalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ azu ne mɔ la. Ɔbayɛ ye nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne wɔ anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛkɛ. Ɔwie a, ɔbazia ɔ nzi yeavinde yeahɔ, noko ɔnle kɛ bɛto anlenkɛ ne anu toonwo nɔsolɛ.

english_verse: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.
translation_verse: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne nee Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ, menli ne amuala bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ɛhye anyunlu.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: “Ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne fa wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala la le mboane ndonrandonra nsia yɛɛ boane nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la,

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yeaboka boane nyinli ne anwo la le litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, yɛɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhola ye fa boka boane ralɛ ko biala anwo la. Ma azubɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ le zɛhae la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ɔlivi nwole litili nsa ɔboka nwolɛ.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Saa Siane Fofolɛ Ɛvoyia ne dwu a, ɔbava ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la, mboane ndonrandonra nsia, yɛɛ boane nyinli ko, mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne la;

english_verse: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: ɔbava ma azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɛsuzu a ɔdwu litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko la yeaboka ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko biala anwo, yɛɛ dodo biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkɛhola ye fa la yeaboka boane edonraa ko biala anwo, na yeava nwole litili nsa yeaboka azubɔdeɛ ko biala anwo.

english_verse: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.
translation_verse: Saa belemgbunli ne ɛlɛkɔ nuhua a, ɔbava anuhɔlɛ ne anu yeahɔ sua kpandaanwo ne anu, ɔlɛfinde noko a, ɛkɛ ne a ɔbava a.

english_verse: When my people come to worship me during any festival, they must always leave by the opposite gate from which they came: Those who come in the north gate must leave by the south gate, and those who come in the south gate must leave by the north gate.
translation_verse: “Saa menli ne ba ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ bie kɛ bɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma a, mɔɔ kɛlua sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu kɛwolo la, ɔsia ɔ nzi noko a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu a ɔfinde a, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛva nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu kɛwolo la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdua sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu a ɔfinde a. Ɔnle kɛ awie ko biala dua ɔ bo zo ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la finde. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua bɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo a bɛfinde a.

english_verse: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.
translation_verse: Saa bɛlɛkɔ ɛkɛ ne a, ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne nee bɛ a kɔ a, yɛɛ saa bɛlɛfinde a, ɔwɔ kɛ belemgbunli ne nee bɛ a finde a.

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram. The worshipers can offer as much grain as they want with each lamb. Three liters of olive oil must be offered with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛvoyia ne mɔ ɛlilɛ nu nee ɛlobɔ ne mɔ anloa ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ko biala, ma litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, boane nyinli ko biala, ma litili bulu nee nsuu nee foa ko, yɛɛ mboane ndonrandonra ne mɔ, yemɔ ma dodo biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhola ye fa la, yɛɛ ma azubɔdeɛ biala, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa nwole litili nsa bɛboka nwolɛ.

english_verse: If the ruler voluntarily offers a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing, the east gate of the inner courtyard will be opened for him. He will offer his sacrifices just as he does on each Sabbath; then he will leave, and the gate will be closed.
translation_verse: “Saa belemgbunli ɛlɛfa azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye yekpɔla ɔ kunlu yeva la arɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ o, saa anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ o, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbuke aduduleɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne bɛmaa ye. Ɔbava ye ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne anzɛɛ ye anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne yeamaa, kɛmɔ ɔyɛ ye wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la. Ɔwie a akee yeavinde na bɛado anlenkɛ kpole ne anu.” Dahudahu azubɔdeɛ ne

english_verse: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Nwonlomɔ biala belemgbunli ne bava boane edonraa ko yeamaa bɛayela ye bɛabɔ azu bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa ma azubɔdeɛ ɔboka nwolɛ, ɛsuzu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔto kilo nwiɔ. Eza ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nwole litili ko ɔmaa bɛfete esamo ne kɛ ma azubɔdeɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛhye le mɛla mɔɔ bɛngakyi ye ɛlɛ wɔ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nwo a.

english_verse: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Saa belemgbunli fa ye agyadeɛ bie kyɛ ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ bie a, ɔle ralɛ nrenya ne ɛdeɛ, ɔle ye agyadeɛ.

english_verse: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔfa ye agyadeɛ bie ɔmaa ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ bie a, agyadeɛ ne le ye ɛdeɛ kɔkpula Fanwodi Ɛvoyia ne kolaa na belemgbunli ne azia alie ye agyadeɛ ne. Mralɛ mrenya ne mɔ ala yɛɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ne agyadeɛ nu la le bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: The man who was showing me the temple then took me back to the inner courtyard. We walked to the south side of the courtyard and stopped at the door to the sacred rooms that belonged to the priests. He showed me more rooms at the western edge of the courtyard
translation_verse: Akee nrenya ne vale me luale anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne foa ko la anu, na yɛhɔle sɛlɛvolɛma ekpumgbunli nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ solo sɔlɔ afoa nu, la anwo. Menwunle ɛleka bie wɔ azua zɔhane mɔ adɔleɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ,

english_verse: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.
translation_verse: Bɛlie ko biala anwo bane na bɛsisi mokyea wɔ nuhua toonwo yeyia.

english_verse: The man said, “These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le egyaade ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bado menli ne azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the temple, where I saw a stream flowing from under the entrance. It began in the south part of the temple, where it ran past the altar and continued east through the courtyard.
translation_verse: Akee nrenya ne vale me ziale rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo. Na menwunle kɛ nzule vi anuhɔlɛ ne abo se kɔ aduduleɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anye kɔne aduduleɛ afoa nu. Nzule ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne abo, wɔ ye nyiakɛ afoa nu, wɔ azukponle ne nyiakɛ a senze a.

english_verse: We walked out of the temple area through the north gate and went around to the east gate. I saw the small stream of water flowing east from the south side of the gate.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale me ɔluale sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu ɔvindele, na ɔlile me nyunlu wɔ alie nwo nehane na yɛrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa, ɔ nye kɔne aduduleɛ yɛɛ azule ne senze vi ye nyiakɛ afoa nu.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen.” We walked to the riverbank,
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu ɛhye ɔ?” Akee ɔvale me ɔsianenle azule ne anloa na yɛziale yɛ nzi.

english_verse: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.
translation_verse: Menziale mɔɔ mekɔ la, menwunle kɛ mbaka dɔɔnwo wɔ azule ne anloa foa ko nee foa ko.

english_verse: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.
translation_verse: Na nrenya ne zele me kɛ, “Azule ɛhye se kɔ aduduleɛ maanzinli ne anu na ɔdwu Dwɔdan Bɔnza, ɔkɔgua Nyevile Wulera ne anu, ɔmaa nzule mɔɔ wɔ zɔhane azule ne anu la yɛ nzukpa.

english_verse: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Fɛlɛhyelɛma bagyinla nyevile ne anloa; ɔvi Ɛngidae mɔɔ kɔdwu Ɛnɛgeleeyem la bayɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛto avonle a. Nuhua fɛlɛ bayɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo kɛ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.
translation_verse: Noko ɔ nloa azia ne mɔ anu nzule ɛnrɛyɛ nzukpa. Bɛbaha ɛkɛ na bɛanyia ngyenle bɛavi nu.

english_verse: Fruit trees will grow all along this river and produce fresh fruit every month. The leaves will never dry out, because they will always have water from the stream that flows from the temple, and they will be used for healing people. The Borders of the Land
translation_verse: Mbaka ngakyile dɔɔnwo bafifi azule ne anloa foa ko nee foa ko mɔɔ bɛ nzoleɛ bayɛ aleɛ bɛdi a. Bɛ nya ɛnrɛnwoso yɛɛ bɛ nzoleɛ ɛnrɛpe. Siane biala bɛbazo ma fofolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ bo nzule ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a senze ba a. Bɛbali bɛ nzoleɛ na bɛava bɛ nya ne bɛayɛ ayile.” Azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne ne mɔ

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad,
translation_verse: “Azɛlɛ ne ɛweɛne ɛne: Ye ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne tenrɛ kɔ aduduleɛ, ɔvi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ɔlua suakpole Hɛtelɔn ɔfinde Heemate Ademgbole zo ɔdwu suakpole Zidade azo,

english_verse: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
translation_verse: Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne balua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ahɔ aduduleɛ, yeahɔdwu Yinɔn, ɛnee Dɛmasekɛse nee Heemate maanzinli ne mɔ wɔ ye anwuma. Ɛhye a le ye ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛweɛne ne a.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.
translation_verse: “Aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne wɔne ɔ ti nyiakɛ afoa nu, ɔvi Yinɔn mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse nee Hɔɔlan maanzinli ne mɔ avinli, ɔlua Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa, mɔɔ wɔ Geleade nee Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne avinli ɔkɔgua ye Teema mɔɔ wɔ Nyevile Wulera ne anloa la.

english_verse: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: “Nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne kɔ nyiakɛ-adɔleɛ afoa nu, ɔvi Teema ɔkɔdwu Keedɛhye mɛtɛlɛmɛtɛlɛ ne mɔ anu, na ɔwɔne ɔ ti adɔleɛ-ɛbɔnu, ɔlua Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa.

english_verse: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.
translation_verse: “Adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a le Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne ɔkɔdwu ɛleka bie mɔɔ nee Heemate Ademgbolezo bɛ nye bɔ zolɛ la. Ɛhye a le adɔleɛ ɛweɛne ne a.

english_verse: That is the land to be divided among the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: “Kyɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye maa mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ.

english_verse: It will belong to the Israelites and to any foreigners living among them whose children were born in Israel. These foreigners must be treated like any other Israelite citizen, and they will receive
translation_verse: Kyɛ maa bɛ maa ɔyɛ bɛdabɛ nee nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ de bɛ avinli na bɛwo mralɛ bɛgua bɛ avinli la agyadeɛ bɔkɔɔ. Menli zɔhane bayɛ kɛ Yizilayɛma amra mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ la. Bɛ nee bɛ nee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ amuala ɛhyɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛva ɛyɛ bɛ agyadeɛ.

english_verse: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛvolɛ biala mɔɔ de abusua ekpunli biala avinli la, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnyia ɔdaye ɔ ti anwo agyadeɛ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a, mese a.”

english_verse: Each tribe will receive a section of land that runs from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. The northern border of Israel will run along the towns of Hethlon and Lebo-Hamath, and will end at Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between the kingdoms of Damascus and Hamath. The tribes will receive their share of land in the following order, from north to south: Dan, Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, and Judah. The Special Section of Land The Lord said:
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne sɔlɔ ɛweɛne ne tenrɛ vi Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa kɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu, ɔkɔ suakpole Hɛtelɔn, ɔlua Heemate Ademgbolezo ɔdwu Yinɔn, ɔkɔkpula ɛweɛne ne mɔɔ la arelemgbunli maanle Dɛmasekɛse nee Heemate avinli la. Ɔwɔ kɛ abusua ekpunli biala nyia azɛlɛ ne bie, ɔvi aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne azo ɔkɔdwu adɔleɛ, wɔ Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsesa azɛlɛ ne, ɔvi ye sɔlɔ mɔɔ badwu ye nyiakɛ la ɛne. Dan Ahya Nafetalae Manasɛ Yifelaem Wulubɛn Dwuda Azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ la azɛlɛ ne avinli la

english_verse: South of Judah's territory will be a special section of land. Its length will be twelve and a half kilometers, and its width will run from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. My temple will be located in this section of land.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ bieko mɔɔ doa zolɛ la a le azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛpɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔwɔ kɛ ye tendenle nu mɔɔ vi ye sɔlɔ ba nyiakɛ la yɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ nu mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ kɔ adɔleɛ la noko yɛ zɔhane ala. Azɛlɛ ɛhye azo yɛɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bagyinla a.

english_verse: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ɛhye avinli, ɛbapɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita bulu la wɔazie ɛkɛ wɔamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Akee kɛ ɛbahyɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la ɛne: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne banyia azɛlɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ kɔ adɔleɛ na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nnu, ɔvi ye sɔlɔ mɔɔ ba ye nyiakɛ la. Ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ɛhye avinli yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyinla a.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ɛhye bayɛ Zeedɔko abo zo amra ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛwula bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ na bɛlile me mɛla zo bɛzonlenle me nɔhalɛ nu, na bɛamkpo me wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele atua, na Livaema kpole me la.

english_verse: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne avinli, yeayɛ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ yeazua Livaema azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide,
translation_verse: Livaema azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne bazua sɛlɛvolɛma ɛdeɛ ne. Ɔdaye ye tendenle bayɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ bayɛ kilomita nnu.

english_verse: and they must never sell or trade any of this land—it is the best land and belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛtɔne azɛlɛ ɛhye bie anzɛɛ bɛfa bie bɛbɔ agyinlanu bɛdie debie. Ɔnle kɛ bɛfa bie bɛmaa awie biala, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ baha, mɔɔ ye tendenle le kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, na ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nwiɔ nee foa ko la bala ɛkɛ, amaa maanlema akyekye bɛ suakpole ne, bɛabu bɛ namunamu na bɛadidi zolɛ. Suakpole ne bala azɛlɛ ne avinli.

english_verse: The city will be a square: Each side will be two kilometers long,
translation_verse: Suakpole ɛhye tendenle nee ye tɛtɛlɛ bazɛ. Ye tendenle bayɛ mita apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ noko bayɛ zɔhane ala.

english_verse: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ baha azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la bayɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la didi zolɛ a. Suakpole ne aduduleɛ afoa nu azɛlɛ ne tendenle le kilomita nnu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le kilomita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Ye adɔleɛ nu noko azɛlɛ ne kpole le kɛ aduduleɛ ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli biala anu na ɔwɔ suakpole ne azo la kola so zolɛ ɛya.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbaboɔboa wɔapɛ wɔado ɛkɛ ne la, ɔwɔ kɛ ye tendenle yɛ kilomita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ noko yɛ zɔhane ala. Azɛlɛ ɛhye le nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ zolɛ a bɛbakyekye suakpole ne a.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ mɔɔ kɛha aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ bɛboɔboa bɛpɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ, sɛlɛvolɛma nee Livaema azɛlɛ wɔ nu, na suakpole ne wɔ zolɛ la, le belemgbunli ne ɛdeɛ. Ɔtɛlɛ ɔkɔ adɔleɛ ɔkɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa, ye aduduleɛ kpula aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne, ye sɔlɔ, ɔ nee Dwuda a bɔ ɛweɛne a, yɛɛ ɔ nee Bɛngyaman a bɔ ɛweɛne wɔ nyiakɛ a. Mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ ɛha la azɛlɛ ne

english_verse: South of this special section will be the land that belongs to the rest of Israel's tribes. Each tribe will receive a section of land that runs from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. The tribes will receive their share of land in the following order, from north to south: Benjamin, Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, and Gad.
translation_verse: Mbusua ekpunli ekpunli mɔɔ ɛha la banyia bɛ azɛlɛ ɛdeɛ wɔ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne nyiakɛ. Ko biala ɛdeɛ tenrɛ vi aduduleɛ ɛweɛne ne anloa kɔ adɔleɛ kɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa. Kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsesa azɛlɛ ne, ɔvi sɔlɔ mɔɔ ba nyiakɛ la ɛne: Bɛngyaman Semɛyɔn Yesakaa Zɛbulɛn Gaade

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Gaade abusua ekpunli ne azɛlɛ ne nyiakɛ ɛweɛne ne wɔ nyiakɛ-adɔleɛ, ɔvi Teema ɔdwu Keedɛhye mɛtɛlɛmɛtɛlɛ ne anloa, na ɔtenrɛ ɔ nwo sɔlɔ-adɔleɛ, ɔlua Yigyibiti ɛweɛne zo ɔkɔgua ye Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anloa.

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdua nu bɛkyɛ azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ fa yɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ la ɛne.” Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem will have twelve gates, three on each of the four sides of the city wall. These gates will be named after the twelve tribes of Israel. The gates of Reuben, Judah, and Levi will be in the north; Joseph, Benjamin, and Dan will be in the east; Simeon, Issachar, and Zebulun will be in the south; Gad, Asher, and Naphtali will be in the west. Each side of the city wall will be two kilometers long,
translation_verse: Suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm lɛ nlenkɛ mgbole bulu nee nwiɔ. Suakpole ne bane nna ne mɔɔ bɛnra yia ye la ko biala tendenle le mita apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nwiɔ abulanlu, yɛɛ ko biala lɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nsa. Bɛva nlenkɛ ne mɔ bɛtoto Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ. Nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ la, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Wulubɛn, Dwuda, yɛɛ Livae; mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Dwosefi, Bɛngyaman, yɛɛ Dan. Nyiakɛ nlenkɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Semɛyɔn, Yesakaa, yɛɛ Zɛbulɛn, yɛɛ adɔleɛ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ a le Gaade, Ahya, yɛɛ Nafetalae.

english_verse: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be “The-Lord-Is-Here!”
translation_verse: Bane nna ne mɔɔ bɛnra suakpole ne yia la amuala tendenle le mita apenle ngɔnla. Suakpole ne duma, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la a le “Ɛdɛnkɛma Wɔ Ɛke.”

english_verse: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza mɔɔ vi Babelonia la vale ɛlɔne rabɔle yiale Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem ɛli ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia ne azo la.

english_verse: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar capture Jehoiakim and take away some of the things used in God's temple. And when the king returned to Babylonia, he put these things in the temple of his own god.
translation_verse: Na Awulae yele Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyakem manle Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɔ nwo zo konim na ɔsesale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ bie ɔhɔle. Ɔvale ninyɛne ne mɔ ɔhɔle Hyaenaa na ɔhɔguale bɛ ye bozonle ne abo.

english_verse: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza akee zele ye sonvolɛ kpanyinli Ahyepinaze kɛ ɔnlea na ɔye Yizilayɛ alehelɛ nee menli titile ne mɔ anu bie mɔ,

english_verse: The king said, “They must be healthy, handsome, smart, wise, educated, and fit to serve in the royal palace. Teach them how to speak and write our language
translation_verse: mgbavolɛ anwo fɛlɛko mɔɔ anye gyi bɛ ti anwo, bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛsukoa debie a bɛnvɛ nwolɛ, na bɛ nwo ɛnlɛ dɛne, mɔɔ bɛkola bɛsonle belemgbunli sua nu la, na ɔhile bɛ Babelonia aneɛ ne ɛgengalɛ nee ye ɛhɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne hanle kɛ dahuu bɛmaa ndetelɛ menli ɛhye mɔ alehelɛ aleɛ ne nee nza ne mɔɔ bɛdi bɛno ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la bie. Bɛtete menli ne ɛvolɛ nsa na akee bɛava bɛ bɛavinde belemgbunli ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ bɛyele bɛ la bie mɔ a le Daneɛle, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛvi Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne anu la.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne totonle bɛ aluma fofolɛ: ɔdonle Daneɛle, Bɛletihyazaa; ɔdonle Hananaya, Hyeedelake; ɔdonle Maehyeeyɛle, Mihyake, yɛɛ ɔdonle Azalaya, Abɛdenɛgo.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Na Daneɛle yɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔnrɛdoa alehelɛ aleɛ ne anzɛɛ nza ne ɔnrɛgua ɔ nwo evinli. Yemɔti ɔnwunle sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne kɛ ɔmaa ye adenle na ɔnrɛli aleɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔnrɛnlo nza ne ɔnrɛgua ɔ nwo evinli.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Nyamenle manle sonvolɛ kpanyinli Ahyepinaze anye zɔle Daneɛle, ɔnwunle ye anwunvɔne, na ɔkponlenle ye edwɛkɛ ne azo.

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: Noko ɛnee sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne sulo belemgbunli ne. Yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele Daneɛle kɛ, “Belemgbunli ɛhile aleɛ nee nza mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ la. Ɛhye ati saa ɔnwu kɛ wɔmɔ wɔnwa a, me gyakɔ! Me ti ne, tɛ me ɛdeɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Daneɛle hanle hilele neavolɛ ne mɔɔ sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne yele ye kɛ ɔnlea ɔdaye, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya bɛ nwo zo la kɛ,

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: “Sɔ wɔ sonvolɛma nea kenle bulu. Maa bɛmaa yɛ nya nya yɛli na bɛmaa yɛ nzule yɛnlo,

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: na fa yɛ to menli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi suakunlu aleɛ ne la anwo na nea, na mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu ye la akee wɔayɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ la.”

english_verse: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.
translation_verse: Sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne kponlenle nzuzulɛ ne azo na ɔzɔle bɛ ɔnleanle kenle bulu.

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Kenle bulu ne dwule la, ɛnee bɛyɛ mbelane, bɛ nwonane ɛyɛ ngɛnlɛma ɛdɛla mgbavolɛ mɔɔ lile belemgbunli ne aleɛ kpalɛ ne la.

english_verse: After this, the guard let them eat vegetables instead of the rich food and wine.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati neavolɛ ne ammaa bɛ aleɛ kpalɛ nee nza mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi na bɛno la, na ɔmanle bɛ nya nya.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ nna ɛhye, Nyamenle manle bɛnwunle nwoma na bɛnwunle nrɛlɛbɛ kpole. Nyamenle manle Daneɛle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nee ɛlalɛ bo ɛhilelɛ adwenle.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ nsa ne dwule la, Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza manle sonvolɛ kpanyinli ne vale menli ne mɔ rale ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bizebizale bɛ edwɛkɛ, na ɔnwunle kɛ mgbavolɛ nna ne, Daneɛle, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya ati ɛdi ɛdɛla awie biala.

english_verse: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.
translation_verse: Menli nna ne boale belemgbunli ne wɔ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ kye adwenle anzɛɛ hyia ndelebɛbo na ɔkɛbiza bɛ la anu kpole kpalɛ dɛlale ngonyiama nee silihyelɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala fane bulu.

english_verse: During the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had such horrible nightmares that he could not sleep.
translation_verse: Nɛbukadenɛza lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ ebia zo la ɔhanle ɛlalɛ na ɛzulolɛ hanle ye mɔɔ ɛnee ɔda a ɔnla a.

english_verse: and said, “I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Meha ɛlalɛ bie, na ɛlalɛ ne ɛha me ɛzulolɛ, yemɔti meda nwolɛ a ɔnla. Mekpondɛ kɛ mete ɔ bo.”

english_verse: They answered in Aramaic, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale belemgbunli ne wɔ Arelam aneɛ nu kɛ, “Nana, nyi kyɛ! Ka wɔ ɛlalɛ ne kile yɛ maa yɛhile ɔ bo.”

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Saa bɛangola bɛannwu ɛlalɛ ne bɛanga, bɛangile ɔ bo a, mebamaa bɛatete bɛ bɛahu bɛ, bɛabɔ bɛ awuke ne mɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Na saa bɛnwu ɛlalɛ ne bɛka na bɛkile ɔ bo a, mebahyɛ bɛ ninyɛne na meawula bɛ anyunlunyia. Zɔhane ati bɛha ɛlalɛ ne bɛhile me na bɛhile me ɔ bo.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” they said, “if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.”
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ eza buale belemgbunli kɛ, “Nana, ka wɔ ɛlalɛ ne kile yɛ, na yɛkɛhile ɔ bo.”

english_verse: because you know what's going to happen if you don't come up with the answer. You've decided to make up a bunch of lies, hoping I might change my mind. Now tell me the dream, and that will prove that you can interpret it.”
translation_verse: saa bɛannwu me ɛlalɛ ne bɛanga, bɛangile ɔ bo a, ɛza ko ala a mebava meahwi bɛ a. Bɛyɛ ko kɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ bɛahwenlehwenle bɛ bo aze bɛava bɛazɛkye mekɛ. Bɛha ɛlalɛ ne bɛhile me bɛmaa menwu kɛ bɛkɛhola ɔ bo kile.”

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ hanle hilele belemgbunli kɛ, “Awie ko ɛnle aleɛabo mɔɔ kɛhola debie mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛbiza la yɛ a, yɛɛ belemgbunli kpole biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛmaa ngonyiama, silihyelɛma, yɛɛ adunyipɛlɛma ɛyɛ debie zɛhae bie ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: It can't be done, except by the gods, and they don't live here on earth.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nana ɛbiza la, sonla ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ, kyesɛ awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnle nwonane la na ahola ye yɛ.”

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Nolo ne dwule maanle ne anu ɛleka biala kɛ bɛhu menli zɔhane mɔ kɔsɔɔti, na bɛkpondɛle Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ abo zo kɛ bɛku bɛ. Nyamenle kile Daneɛle ɛlalɛ ne abo

english_verse: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him
translation_verse: Na Daneɛle hɔbizale Aleɔko, belemgbunli sinzavolɛma kpanyinli ne, mɔɔ bɛva menli ɛhunlɛ ne bɛwula ɔ sa nu la nrɛlɛbɛ zo nee enililɛ nu

english_verse: and asked, “Why did the king give such cruel orders?” After Arioch explained what had happened,
translation_verse: kɛ, “Duzu ati a belemgbunli ɛli mɛla ɛzulolɛ ɛhye a?” Na Aleɔko yele edwɛkɛ ne dole ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, “If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Daneɛle hɔzɛlɛle belemgbunli ne kɛ ɔmaa ye mekɛ ɔmaa ɔrahile ye ɛlalɛ ne abo ɔhile ye.

english_verse: Daniel returned home and told his three friends.
translation_verse: Akee Daneɛle hɔle sua nu na ɔhɔbɔle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, Hananaya, Maehyeeyɛle, yɛɛ Azalaya amaneɛ.

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anwunvɔnezelɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo na bɛangu bɛ nee Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne nɔe ne Nyamenle luale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ zo yele ɛlalɛ ne hilele Daneɛle na ɔhilele ye ɔ bo. Na Daneɛle yele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ zele kɛ,

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Ɔkakyi mekɛ, ɔkakyi ɛlobɔ; ɔtu arelemgbunli, ɔsie arelemgbunli; ɔmaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ nwu nrɛlɛbɛ, na ɔmaa mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la adwenle;

english_verse: “You explain deep mysteries, because even the dark is light to you.
translation_verse: ɔye nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ vea la ɔkile; ɔze mɔɔ wɔ awozinli nu, yɛɛ ɔ nee wienyi a de a.

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: O, egya mɔ Nyamenle, meyɛ wɔ mo, na meye wɔ ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmaa me nrɛlɛbɛ, wɔmaa me anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ wɔye mɔɔ yɛbizale la wɔhile me; wɔmaa yɛnwu mɔɔ belemgbunli kpondɛ la.” Daneɛle ka ɛlalɛ ne ahile belemgbunli ne, na yeahile ɔ bo

english_verse: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, “Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.”
translation_verse: Akee Daneɛle hɔle sinzavolɛma kpanyinli Aleɔko mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛva nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ bɛku bɛ wɔ Babelɔn la ɛhunlɛ ne ɛwula ɔ sa nu la ɛkɛ na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ, “Mmaku Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne; wɔmɔ fa me kɔ belemgbunli anyunlu na mebahile ye ɛlalɛ ne abo.”

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ndɛndɛ ne ala Aleɔko vale Daneɛle hɔle belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Dwudama mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ bɛrale la anu ko se ɔbahola yeahile belemgbunli ɛlalɛ ne abo.”

english_verse: The king asked Daniel, “Can you tell me my dream and what it means?”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bizale Daneɛle mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛletihyazaa la kɛ, “Ɛkɛhola ɛkɛha ɛlalɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ menganle la na ɛkɛhile ɔ bo ɛkɛhile me ɔ?”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.
translation_verse: Daneɛle buale ye kɛ, “Nana, nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ, silikyevolɛ, ngonyiayelɛnli, anzɛɛ nwɔlɔra kengavolɛ biala ɛnle ewiade mɔɔ kɛhola kɛyɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ belemgbunli ɛbiza la.

english_verse: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.
translation_verse: “Nana, mɔɔ ɛwɔ nla nu la, ɛhanle ɛlalɛ wɔ mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo; na Nyamenle mɔɔ sa fealera nu ninyɛne gua zolɛ la hilele wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ basisi la.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mame meze nrɛlɛbɛ metɛla nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɔ, na bɛmaa wɔanwu wɔ ɛlalɛ ne abo la ati ɔ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: “Nana, ɛnwunle ananze totohyia anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ ta kpole kpalɛ, mɔɔ ɛnea ye a ɔnyɛ boɛ la kɛ ɔgyi ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Ananze ɛhye ati le ezukoa nvutuke, ɔ kɛnra nee ɔ sa ne mɔ le dwɛtɛ fufule, ɔ ko nee ye ɛzɔlɛ le kɔbele,

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: ɔ gyakɛ agbɔma ne mɔ le mbulalɛ, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ babonle ne mɔ ko biala foa ko le bulalɛ yɛɛ foa ko le ɛva.

english_verse: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ nye gyi nwolɛ ɛlɛnea la, ɛnwunle kɛ bolɛ mɔɔ tɛ awie a kpukele la angomekye vi ɛleka bie rafinle ananze ne agyakɛ babonle foa ko bulalɛ, foa ko ɛva ne azo na ɔbubule ye dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Akee bulalɛ ne, ɛva ne, kɔbele ne, dwɛtɛ fufule ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bubule na bɛdinle bɛyɛle motomoto kɛ munlutu; na anwoma ne bɔle ye hɔle mɔɔ bɛnnwu ɔ bo zo a. Bolɛ ne mɔɔ rabubule ananze ne la nyinle mindomindo kɛ boka la na ɔhedale azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: “Ɛlalɛ ne mɔɔ Nana hanle la ɛne, na akee mekile ɔ bo.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ a ɛle arelemgbunli nu belemgbunli a, yɛɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛyɛ wɔ maanle maanle belemgbunli, yemaa wɔ tumi, anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ anyunlunyia.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛ nwo zo, belemgbunli bieko badwazo, ye tumi ne ɛnrɛdwu wɔ ɛdeɛ ne. Belemgbunli mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la bara, na yemɔ a le kɔbele ne, na ɔdaye noko ɔbazie maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Eza kɛmɔ egyakɛ mrɛlɛsɛka ne foa ko le ɛva, foa ko le bulalɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ maanle ne foa ko bayɛ se na foa ko ado a.

english_verse: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.
translation_verse: Ɛnwunle kɛ bulalɛ ne nee ɛva ne ɛli afonla; ɛhye kile kɛ maanle ne anu amra balua agyalɛ zo ali ngamɔnu, noko ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ bulalɛ nee ɛva ɛngola ɛnfonla.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. It will be like the stone that was cut from the mountain, but not by human hands—the stone that crushed the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. Your Majesty, in your dream the great God has told you what is going to happen, and you can trust this interpretation. Daniel Is Promoted
translation_verse: kɛmɔ ɛnwunle bolɛ ne mɔɔ awie ɛnlɛ nu mɔɔ vi boka bie azo radinle bulalɛ ne, kɔbele ne, ɛva ne, dwɛtɛ fufule ne, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke ne la. Nana, Nyamenle bedevinli yɛɛ ɛha wɔ ɛlalɛ ɛhye a. Ɛlalɛ ne ala a meha mehile wɔ la, yɛɛ ɔ bo kɔsɔɔ a mehile la. Ɔnrɛkpa nwolɛ.” Belemgbunli yɛ Daneɛle mo

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza butule Daneɛle anyunlu mutule nu yɛle ye mo, na ɔzele kɛ bɛva azubɔdeɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Daneɛle.

english_verse: The king said, “Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Daneɛle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, wɔ Nyamenle ne le nyamenle kɔsɔɔti bɛ Nyamenle, yɛɛ ɔle arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti bɛ Awulae. Ɔle Nyamenle mɔɔ sa fealera nu ninyɛne gua zolɛ a. Ɔboalekɛ wɔhola wɔla me fealera nu edwɛkɛ ɛhye ali.”

english_verse: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.
translation_verse: Akee Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza lile Daneɛle eni kpole kpalɛ na ɔmanle ye gyinlabelɛ kpole, ɔhyɛle ye ninyɛne mgbole. Ɔyɛle Daneɛle Babelɔn maanle ne amɛnlado na ɔyɛle ye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la kɔsɔɔti kpanyinli.

english_verse: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.
translation_verse: Na Daneɛle zɛlɛle belemgbunli ne manle ɔvale Babelɔn maanle ne anwo amaamuo biala ɔwulale Hyeedelake, Mihyɛke, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo asa anu kɛ bɛnlea zolɛ; na yemɔ Daneɛle, ɔhale belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: and the king's high officials, governors, and advisors all crowded around them. The men were not burned, their hair wasn't scorched, and their clothes didn't even smell like smoke.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ne mɔ anu arelemgbunli, amɛnladoma, yɛɛ belemgbunli folɛtuvolɛma mɔɔ rayiale ɛkɛ la lile daselɛ kɛ menli nsa ne anwo ɛleka biala ambu ɛbonle; bɛ ti enrinli bɔbɔ, senle anga ye na yeayɛ bɛ adɛladeɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ambɔnle sisikpunlike bɔbɔ.

english_verse: and he commanded his governors, advisors, treasurers, judges, and his other officials to come from everywhere in his kingdom to the dedication of the statue.
translation_verse: Akee ɔmanle bɛhɔvale maanle ne anu mgbanyima: arelemgbunli, amɛnladoma, mgbanyima mɔɔ tu arane folɛ, gyazoneavolɛma, ndɛnebuavolɛma, edwɛkɛdivolɛma, yɛɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu mbɔlɔba mgbanyinli kɛ bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛvinde ananze ne mɔɔ ɔdaye Nɛbukadenɛza yemaa bɛzie la.

english_verse: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!
translation_verse: Akee nolobɔvo ne vale ɛnelɛ kpole bie bɔle nolo kɛ, “Maanlema mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile mɔɔ ɛrayia ɛke la,

english_verse: Trumpets, flutes, harps, and all other kinds of musical instruments will soon start playing. When you hear the music, you must bow down and worship the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
translation_verse: saa bɛte kɛ bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole, fulutu, ɛweɛne, yɛɛ agole ngakyile biala a, awie biala ɛdu ɛdɔ ɛzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza ɛzie la.

english_verse: Anyone who refuses will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛde, na yeangoto yeanzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne la, bɛhye ye bɛdo sendɔlɔra nu bɛyela ye.”

english_verse: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye anu, Babelɔnoma bie mɔ yele bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛtoɔdoa Dwuuma ne mɔ.

english_verse: They said, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Bɛhanle bɛhilele Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza kɛ, “Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ!

english_verse: And you said that anyone who did not bow down and worship it would be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛde na yeandu yeandɔ yeanzonle ananze ne la bɛhye ye bɛdo sendɔlɔra nu bɛyela ye.

english_verse: Sir, you appointed three men to high positions in Babylon Province, but they have disobeyed you. Those Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, refuse to worship your gods and the statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Wɔva Dwuuma bie wɔzie Babelɔn kɛ bɛzie maanle ne. Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛmbu wɔ; bɛnzonle wɔ awozonle ne mɔ yɛɛ bɛnzonle ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne noko mɔɔ wɔzie la. Bɛmɛ a le Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne ahonle futule kpole na ɔzele kɛ bɛva Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo bɛrɛla. Bɛhɔhyele menli ɛhye mɔ bɛrale.

english_verse: “I hear that you refuse to worship my gods and the gold statue I have set up.
translation_verse: Nɛbukadenɛza bizale bɛ kɛ, “Hyeedelake, Mihyake, Abɛdenɛgo, asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛnzonle me awozonle ne mɔ nee me ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ mezie la?

english_verse: Now I am going to give you one more chance. If you bow down and worship the statue when you hear the music, everything will be all right. But if you don't, you will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace. No god can save you from me.”
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ biala bɛte aweɛne ndendenle ne, fulutu, getaa ngyikyi nee mgbole, ɛweɛne, yɛɛ agole ngakyile ne mɔ ane na bɛkɛdu bɛkɛgua, bɛkɛzonle ananze ne mɔɔ memaa bɛzie la a, ɛnee bɛ kɔme doa zolɛ. Na saa bɛanli zolɛ a, bɛbavuandi bɛ bɛagua sendɔlɔra nu bɛayela bɛ. Ɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛbahile nyamenle holɛ ko mɔɔ balie bɛ la a.”

english_verse: The three men replied, “Your Majesty, we don't need to defend ourselves.
translation_verse: Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “O Nana, Nɛbukadenɛza, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛbua wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo bie.

english_verse: The God we worship can save us from you and your flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Saa ɔba ye zɔhane a, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛsonle ye la kola die yɛ fi sendɔlɔra ne anu, yɛɛ ɔbalie yɛ yeavi ɛ sa nu.

english_verse: But even if he doesn't, we still won't worship your gods and the gold statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Saa yeanlie yɛ bɔbɔ a yɛka ye wienyi kɛ yɛnrɛzonle wɔ awozonle ne mɔ, yɛɛ yɛnrɛdu yɛnrɛgua wɔ ezukoa nvutuke ananze ne mɔɔ wɔzie la anyunlu.” Bɛbu Daneɛle agɔnwo mɔ nsa ne ewule fɔlɛ

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.
translation_verse: Nɛbukadenɛza vale ɛya kpole, ɔmunlanle kpole kpalɛ wɔ Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo edwɛkɛ ne ati. Ɔmanle bɛhuanle sendɔlɔra kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ ye ɛzɔlɛ ne kpole tɛla dɛba ɛdeɛ ne mɔ fane nsuu la.

english_verse: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Akee ɔyele ye ɛlɔnema ne anu menli kekahilii ne bie mɔ kɛ bɛkyekye Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo na bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua sendɔlɔra ne anu bɛyela bɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, “Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire?” “Yes, Your Majesty,” his officers answered.
translation_verse: Arɛlevilɛ nu, Nɛbukadenɛza dwazole na azibɛnwo nu ɔbizale ye mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, na tɛ menli nsa a yɛkyekyele bɛ yɛvuandinle bɛ yɛguale senle ne anu a?” Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Nana, ɔle nɔhalɛ; yɛkyekyele menli nsa.”

english_verse: “But I see four men walking around in the fire,” the king replied. “None of them is tied up or harmed, and the fourth one looks like a god.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele kɛ, “Noko menwu menli nna mɔɔ bɛtɛkyekyele bɛ la kɛ bɛluolua senle ne anu. Bɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo. Ko ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la zɔho bozonle ralɛ nrenya.” Bɛye menli nsa ne bɛmaa bɛ dibilɛ

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar went closer to the flaming furnace and said to the three young men, “You servants of the Most High God, come out at once!” They came out,
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza dudule agyakɛ bikyele sendɔlɔra ne na ɔzele kɛ, “Hyeedelake, Mihyake, Abɛdenɛgo, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle sonvolɛma, bɛvinde bɛrɛla!” Yemɔti Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo vi sendɔlɔra ne anu vindele rale.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar said: Praise their God for sending an angel to rescue his servants! They trusted their God and refused to obey my commands. Yes, they chose to die rather than to worship or serve any god except their own.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza zele kɛ, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo Nyamenle ne. Ye sonvolɛma ne dule bɛ gye kɛ bɛnrɛli me mɛla ne azo, yɛɛ bɛnrɛdu bɛnrɛgua bɛnrɛzonle nyamenle biala kɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne ala. Bɛliele bɛ Nyamenle ne bɛlile na bɛvale bɛ nwonane bɛdole nzeleba, na amgba Nyamenle ɛzoa ye soanvolɛ yemaa yeralie bɛ.

english_verse: And I won't allow people of any nation or race to say anything against their God. Anyone who does will be chopped up and their houses will be torn down, because no other god has such great power to save.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti medi mɛla kɛ maanle anzɛɛ menli biala anzɛɛ aneɛ biala mɔɔ kɛdendɛ ɛtane kɛtia Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo Nyamenle ne la, bɛdudu bɛ abɛsa abɛsa na bɛyela bɛ azua ne mɔ. Ɔluakɛ nyamenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola die ngoane kɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne la.”

english_verse: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.
translation_verse: Na ɔmanle mgbavolɛ nsa ne, Hyeedelake, Mihyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo dibilɛ kpole wɔ Babelɔn maanzinli ne anu.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following letter to the people of all nations and races on the earth: Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle maanle maanle ne mɔ anu amra mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ kpole ɛha bɛ!

english_verse: I am glad to tell about the wonderful miracles God Most High has done for me.
translation_verse: Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne ɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, ɛye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhile me, na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔha menwɔhile bɛ.

english_verse: His miracles are mighty and marvelous. He will rule forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: “Ye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ le mgbole! Ye nwanwane ninyɛne ne mɔ yɛ ɛzulolɛ! Ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ye belemgbunlililɛ vi awolɛndoazo dwu awolɛndoazo.

english_verse: Then I commanded every wise man in Babylonia to appear in my court, so they could explain the meaning of my dream.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menlile mɛla kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn la amuala ɛrɛla ɛrahile me ɛlalɛ ne abo.

english_verse: After they arrived, I told them my dream, but they were not able to say what it meant.
translation_verse: Na ngonyiayevoma, silikyevoma, adunyipɛvoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra kengavoma rayiale; menganle me ɛlalɛ ne mengilele bɛ, na bɛangola ɛlalɛ ne abo kile.

english_verse: Finally, a young man named Daniel came in, and I told him the dream. The holy gods had given him special powers, and I had renamed him Belteshazzar after my own god.
translation_verse: Nzinlii Daneɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum ne wɔ ye nu, na menvale me bozonle Bɛletihyazaa duma mendonle ye la rale. Menganle ɛlalɛ ne mengilele ye. Mese:

english_verse: I said, “Belteshazzar, not only are you the wisest of all advisors and counselors, but the holy gods have given you special powers to solve the most difficult mysteries. So listen to what I dreamed and tell me what it means:
translation_verse: O Bɛletihyazaa, Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu. Wɔmɔ, ɛle ngonyiama amuala kpanyinli, yɛɛ fealera nu debie biala ɛmbo ɛ nwo zo. Ɛlalɛ mɔɔ meha la ɛ, na kile me ɔ bo.

english_verse: In my sleep I saw a very tall tree in the center of the world.
translation_verse: “Mewɔ nla nu la, menganle ɛlalɛ menwunle kɛ baka kpole tendenle bie gyi ɛkɛ.

english_verse: It grew stronger and higher, until it reached to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Baka ne nyinle toonwo ɔyɛle kpole kpalɛ, ɔ ti dwule Nyamenle ne ako abo lɔ mɔɔ aleɛabo amra amuala nwu ye la.

english_verse: It was covered with leaves and heavy with fruit— enough for all nations. Wild animals enjoyed its shade, birds nested in its branches, and all creatures on earth lived on its fruit.
translation_verse: Ye nya le kpukpotoloo yɛɛ ye ma zonle dɔɔnwo mɔɔ debie biala nyia bie di a. Ɛbɔ nu nane bada ye alubo ne anu yɛɛ nloma da ye ngane ne mɔ anu; nane nee menli kpokpoti di ye ma ne bie.

english_verse: “While I was in bed, having this vision, a holy angel came down from heaven
translation_verse: “Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo la, menwunle ye wɔ ɛlalɛ ne anu kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma ɛdwu aze.

english_verse: and shouted: ‘Chop down the tree and cut off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Make the animals leave its shade and send the birds flying from its branches.
translation_verse: Ɔdeanle nuhua kpole bie kɛ, ‘Bɛdu baka ne bɛdo aze, bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ, bɛkpolo ye nya ne mɔ na bɛdo ye ma ne mɔ bɛkponde. Bɛmaa nane ne mɔ ɛvi ɔ bo ɛnriandi ɛhɔ na nloma ne mɔ vi ye ngane ne mɔ anu ɛdu.

english_verse: But leave its stump and roots in the ground, surrounded by grass and held by chains of iron and bronze. ‘Make sure that this ruler lives like the animals out in the open fields, unprotected from the dew.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi ye dosinli ne nee ye ndinli ne mɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo na bɛva mbulalɛ nee kɔbele bɛnyinyi nwolɛ wɔ ndile ne anu. “ ‘Bɛmaa ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ ɛgua nrenya ɛhye anwo zo, na ɔ nee ɛbɔ nu nane nee mbaka ɛva adwenle.

english_verse: Give him the mind of a wild animal for seven long years.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ye sonla adwenle kpalɛ ne ɛminli, na ɔnyia nane adwenle toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu.

english_verse: This punishment is given at the command of the holy angels. It will show to all who live that God Most High controls all kingdoms and chooses for their rulers persons of humble birth.’
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ sinza la anloa edwɛkɛ ɛne. Ɔle kpɔkɛ mɔɔ nwuanzanwuanzama ne ɛbɔ, amaa menli kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne lɛ tumi wɔ ewiade belemgbunlililɛ zo, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la, ɔnvane nwolɛ kɛ ahenle le koahweabane bɔbɔ.’

english_verse: “Daniel, that was the dream that none of the wise men in my kingdom were able to understand. But I am sure that you will understand what it means, because the holy gods have given you some special powers.”
translation_verse: “Bɛletihyazaa, ɛlalɛ ɛhye a medame Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza menganle a, kile me ɔ bo, ɔboalekɛ Anwuma Nyamenle ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la amuala ɛyɛ biala na bɛangola bɛangile ɔ bo.” Daneɛle kile ɛlalɛ ne abo

english_verse: For a while, Daniel was terribly confused and worried by what he was thinking. But I said, “Don't be bothered either by the dream or by what it means.” Daniel replied: Your Majesty, I wish the dream had been against your enemies.
translation_verse: Akee Daneɛle, mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Bɛletihyazaa la, ahonle dule. Belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, “Bɛletihyazaa, mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu ɛlalɛ ne anzɛɛ ɔ bo ɛhilelɛ ne anwo.” Bɛletihyazaa buale kɛ, “Me menle, mesɛlɛ kɛ anrɛɛ ɛlalɛ ne ɛntia wɔ na ɔtia wɔ kpɔvolɛma nee menli mɔɔ kyi wɔ la!

english_verse: You saw a tree that grew so big and strong that it reached up to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nana, baka kpole tendenle ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle kɛ ɔgyi ɛkɛ, yenyi yekpula Nyamenle ne ako abo nehane, mɔɔ bɛnwu ye aleɛabo ɛleka biala, mɔɔ ye nya le kpukpotoloo,

english_verse: Its leaves were beautiful, and it produced enough fruit for all living creatures; animals lived in its shade, and birds nested in its branches.
translation_verse: ye ma le dɔɔnwo, na ɛbɔ nu nane bafea ye alubo nu, yɛɛ nloma banwo bɛ sane wɔ ye ngane ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ nane nee menli kɔsɔɔti di ye ma ne bie la, yemɔ a le ɛdawɔ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, that tree is you. Your glorious reputation has reached heaven, and your kingdom covers the earth.
translation_verse: “Nana, ɛdawɔ a wɔnyi na wɔnyia anwosesebɛ la. Wɔ anwosesebɛ ne kpole ɛkpula anwuma yɛɛ wɔ tumi ɛdende ɛdwu ewiade ɛleka biala.

english_verse: Then you saw a holy angel come down from heaven and say, “Chop down the tree and destroy it! But leave its stump and roots in the ground, fastened there by a chain of iron and bronze. Let it stay for seven years out in the field with the wild animals, unprotected from the dew.”
