translation_verse: Nana nwunle kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ vi anwuma ɛdwu na yearaze kɛ, ‘Bɛbu baka ne, bɛzɛkye ye na bɛgyakyi ye dosinli ne wɔ azɛlɛ ne anwo, na bɛva mbulalɛ nee kɔbele bɛnyinyi nwolɛ wɔ ndile ne anu. Bɛmaa ɛbɔlɛ ɛdɔ ɛgua ɔ nwo zo na ɔ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ɛhɔdɛnla ɛvolɛ nsuu.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, God Most High has sent you this message, and it means
translation_verse: “Nana, ɛlalɛ ne abo a le kɛ, Anwuma Anwumanli ne kpondɛ kɛ ɛnwu debie mɔɔ bazi ɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: that you will be forced to live with the wild animals, far away from humans. You will eat grass like a wild animal and live outdoors for seven years, until you learn that God Most High controls all earthly kingdoms and chooses their rulers.
translation_verse: Bɛbavoa wɔ bɛavi menli nu bɛamaa ɛ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ahɔdɛnla; ɛbali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli na ɛbɔlɛ adɔ ɛ nwo zo toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu. Ɛhye anzi ɛbanwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la.

english_verse: But he gave orders not to disturb the stump and roots. This is to show that you will be king once again, after you learn that the God who rules from heaven is in control.
translation_verse: Ɛdele kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle kɛ bɛgyakyi baka dosinli ne azɛlɛ ne anwo. Ɛhye kile kɛ saa ɛ nye zo tete wɔ na ɛdie ɛto nu kɛ Nyamenle a sie ewiade a, ɛbazia wɔazie wɔ maanle ne bieko.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please be willing to do what I say. Turn from your sins and start living right; have mercy on those who are mistreated. Then all will go well with you for a long time. The Rest of Nebuchadnezzar's Letter about His Second Dream
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Nana, die me folɛ mɔɔ melɛtu wɔ la to nu. Gyakyi ɛtanelilɛ nee ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɔ ɛbɛla tenlene, nwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la anwunvɔne, amaa wɔahɔ zolɛ wɔakpazi.”

english_verse: About twelve months later, I was walking on the flat roof of my royal palace and admiring the beautiful city of Babylon, when these things started happening to me. I was saying to myself, “Just look at this wonderful capital city that I have built by my own power and for my own glory!”
translation_verse: ɔhanle kɛ, “Babelɔn a ɛdɛlɛ kpole zɛhae la! Meva medame me tumi kpole ne a mekyekye a. Mekyekye kɛ mefa meayɛ me maanle ne suakpole, amaa menli anwu anyunlunyia mɔɔ wɔ me belemgbunlililɛ nu a.”

english_verse: But before I could finish speaking, a voice from heaven interrupted: King Nebuchadnezzar, this kingdom is no longer yours.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne anloa ampe yɛɛ ɛnelɛ bie dendɛle vi anwuma kɛ, “Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza, tie ɛ! Bɛlie wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛ sa nu.

english_verse: You will be forced to live with the wild animals, away from people. For seven years you will eat grass, as though you were an ox, until you learn that God Most High is in control of all earthly kingdoms and that he is the one who chooses their rulers.
translation_verse: Bɛbavoa wɔ bɛavi menli avinli na ɛ nee ɛbɔ nu nane ahɔdɛnla. Bɛbamaa wɔali ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu kɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la.”

english_verse: This was no sooner said than done—I was forced to live like a wild animal; I ate grass and was unprotected from the dew. As time went by, my hair grew longer than eagle feathers, and my fingernails looked like the claws of a bird.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala edwɛkɛ ne yɛle zɔhane wɔ Nɛbukadenɛza anwo zo. Bɛvoanle ye bɛvile menli avinli, ɔlile ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la, ɛbɔlɛ dɔle loale ye toonwo ɔ ti enrinli ndendenle yɛle kɛ kɔleɛ ndɛkɛ na ye bɔweɛlɛ vile yɛle kɛ kpolakɛ asa ati la. Nɛbukadenɛza yeyɛ Nyamenle

english_verse: Finally, I prayed to God in heaven, and my mind was healed. Then I said: “I praise and honor God Most High. God lives forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ nsuu ne dwule la, medame Nɛbukadenɛza, mendole me nye anwomanyunlu, na me nye rale me nwo zo. Menyele Anwuma Anwumanli ne ayɛlɛ na menyeyɛle teasenli ne menlile ye eni kɛ: “Ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ, ye belemgbunlililɛ vi awolɛndoazo dwu awolɛndoazo.

english_verse: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.”
translation_verse: Aleɛabo amra amuala ɛnzɔho ɛhwee ɔ nye zo; ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la wɔ anwuma amra nee aze amra avinli. Awie ɛngola ɛndua ye yɛɛ awie ɛngola ɛmbiza ye kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu ala me adwenle ziale rale sua nu; na me belemgbunlililɛ anyunlunyia ne, me belemgbunli tumi ne nee ye kɛnlɛma ne eza yɛle me ɛdeɛ. Menli mɔɔ tu me folɛ nee me mgbanyima kpondɛle me bo zo, na me belemgbunlililɛ ne lile munli. Eza menyɛle kpole, menyianle me nyunlu bɔbɔ mendɛlale alumua ne.

english_verse: That's why I say: “Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.”
translation_verse: “Akee kɛkala, medame Nɛbukadenɛza, mefa ayɛlɛyelɛ, enililɛ mewula Anwuma Belemgbunli ne anyunlunyia. Ɔluakɛ ye gyima kɔsɔɔti le kpalɛ, yɛɛ ye ndenle le fɔɔnwo, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la, ɔkola ɔbɛlɛ bɛ aze.”

english_verse: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza dole ye mgbanyima ne mɔ apenle ko ɛkponle kpole bie na ɔ nee bɛ muala nlonle nza.

english_verse: He got drunk and ordered his servants to bring in the gold and silver cups his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem. Belshazzar wanted the cups, so that he and all his wives and officials could drink from them.
translation_verse: Bɛlehyaza zɔle nza ne bie nleanle la, ɔhanle kɛ bɛhɔsesa ezukoa nvutuke ahɔpo nee dwɛtɛ fufule ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ ze Nɛbukadenɛza sesale bɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛrɛla bɛmaa belemgbunli nee ye maanle mgbanyima, ye mraalɛ nee ye mgbɔnla ne mɔ ɛnlo nu.

english_verse: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
translation_verse: Bɛnlonle nza ne na bɛyeyɛle ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔbele, bulalɛ, baka, yɛɛ bolɛ awozonle ne mɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛnwunle sonla ɛsalɛ kɛ yevinde na ɔlɛkɛlɛ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne bane ne mɔɔ nee kɛnlaneɛ baka ne anye bɔ zolɛ la anwo. Belemgbunli ne nwunle ɛsalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɛlɛ la;

english_verse: He was so frightened that his face turned pale, his knees started shaking, and his legs became weak.
translation_verse: na ɔ nyunlu hunle, ye adwenle zɛkyele, ɔ nwo wozole ye na ɔ gyakɛ bɔle nwolɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ.

english_verse: The king called in his advisors, who claimed they could talk with the spirits of the dead and understand the meanings found in the stars. He told them, “The man who can read this writing and tell me what it means will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. He will wear robes of royal purple and a gold chain around his neck.”
translation_verse: Ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ bɛvɛlɛ silikyevoma, ngonyiayevoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔrakengavoma bɛmaa bɛrɛla. Na belemgbunli ne hanle hilele Babelɔn nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛhola kɛgenga ngɛlɛlera ɛhye na ɔkɛhile me ɔ bo la, bɛbawula ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ, bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛado ɔ kɔme, na meayɛ ye maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa.”

english_verse: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant,
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ne abo la amuala rale ye ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne, na bɛangola bɛangenga ngɛlɛlera ne bɛangile ɔ bo bɛangile belemgbunli ne.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Akee ɛzulolɛ hanle Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza na ɔ rɛle bɔle kpole kpalɛ, ɛhye ati ye mgbanyima ne mɔ adwenle zɛkyele.

english_verse: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli raalɛ ne dele belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ ane la, ɔrale ɛkponledolɛ sua ne anu na ɔzele kɛ, “Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ! Mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛzulolɛ yɛɛ mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ.

english_verse: In your kingdom there is a man who has been given special powers by the holy gods. When your father Nebuchadnezzar was king, this man was known to be as smart, intelligent, and wise as the gods themselves. Your father put him in charge of all who claimed they could talk with the spirits or understand the meanings in the stars or tell about the future.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ wɔ maanle ye anu mɔɔ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ ye nu. Ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza mekɛ zo, bɛnwunle kɛ ɔlɛ wienyi bie li ɔ nyunlu, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ kɛ awozonle ne mɔ ala la. Ɔlua ɛhye ati Nɛbukadenɛza yɛle ye ngonyiayevoma, silikyevoma, adunyipɛvoma, yɛɛ nwɔlɔrakengavoma kpanyinli.

english_verse: He also changed the man's name from Daniel to Belteshazzar. Not only is he wise and intelligent, but he can explain dreams and riddles and solve difficult problems. Send for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.
translation_verse: Nrenya ɛhye a le Daneɛle mɔɔ ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza donle ye Bɛletihyazaa la. Bɛnwunle kɛ Daneɛle lɛ sunsum, ɔlɛ adwenle, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo ɔfa ɔkile ɛlalɛ bo, ɔkilehile agyiba nu, na ɔkola ɔye edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ biala anloa. Maa bɛhɔvɛlɛ ye na ɔkɛhile wɔ ngɛlɛlera ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anwo la abo.” Daneɛle kile ngɛlɛlera ne abo

english_verse: When Daniel was brought in, the king said: So you are Daniel, one of the captives my father brought back from Judah!
translation_verse: Bɛhɔvale Daneɛle bɛrale na belemgbunli ne zele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Daneɛle, se ɛle Dwudama mɔɔ egya hyele bɛ rale nlɔnu wɔ ɛke la anu ko?

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.
translation_verse: Mede kɛ Nyamenle Nwuanzanwuanza ne Sunsum wɔ wɔ nu, yɛɛ ɛlɛ wienyi bie li ɛ nyunlu, ɛlɛ ndelebɛbo, yɛɛ ɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.
translation_verse: Bɛva ngonyiayevoma nee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bɛra kɛ bɛgenga ngɛlɛlera ɛhye na bɛhile me ɔ bo, na bɛangola ɔ bo kile.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. Now then, if you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. You will wear royal purple robes and have a gold chain around your neck.
translation_verse: Na mede kɛ ɛkola ɛkile debie bo yɛɛ ɛkola ɛgyinla edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ nloa. Saa ɛkola ngɛlɛlera ne kenga ɛkile ɔ bo ɛkile me a, bɛbawula wɔ belemgbunli tɛladeɛ, bɛava ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛado ɛ kɔme, na wɔayɛ maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la.”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.
translation_verse: Daneɛle buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, maa wɔ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛwoa ɛkɛ; saa ɛkulo noko a fa kyɛ awie na mame, mekenga ngɛlɛlera ne meahile ɔ bo meahile wɔ.

english_verse: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.
translation_verse: “Nana, Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne yɛle ɛ ze Nɛbukadenɛza belemgbunli kpole na ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: God did such great things for him that people of all nations and races shook with fear. Your father had the power of life or death over everyone, and he could honor or ruin anyone he chose.
translation_verse: Ɔlua kpole mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛle ye la ati menli nee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la dwu ɔ nyunlu a, bɛsulo na bɛ nwo wozo bɛ. Saa ɔse kɛ bɛhu awie a, bɛku ye, yɛɛ saa ɔse kɛ bɛdwula awie a, bɛdwula ye. Ɔkola ɔmaa awie gyinlabelɛ; ɔkola ɔka awie aze.

english_verse: But when he became proud and stubborn, his glorious kingdom was taken from him.
translation_verse: Ɔ ti anu yɛle ye fɛ manle ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo, ɔyɛle anzosesebɛ, yemɔti bɛliele ye belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔ ɔ sa nu na bɛyele ye anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: His mind became like that of an animal, and he was forced to stay away from people and live with wild donkeys. Your father ate grass like an ox, and he slept outside where his body was soaked with dew. He was forced to do this until he learned that the Most High God rules all kingdoms on earth and chooses their kings.
translation_verse: Bɛvoanle ye bɛvile menli avinli, ye adwenle yɛle kɛ nane adwenle na ɔ nee nanemgbole hɔdɛnlanle. Ɔlile ndile kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli la, ɛbɔlɛ dɔle loale ye hɔdwule kɛ ɔnwunle kɛ Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne a sie ewiade a, yɛɛ ɔfa ɔmaa sonla mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la nea zolɛ.

english_verse: King Belshazzar, you knew all of this, but you still refused to honor the Lord who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: “Wɔmɔ Bɛlehyaza, Nɛbukadenɛza akunlu ralɛ nrenya a le wɔ, yɛɛ ɛze ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛsie, noko wɔanga ɛ nwo aze

english_verse: Instead, you turned against him and ordered the cups from his temple to be brought here, so that you and your wives and officials could drink wine from them. You praised idols made of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, even though they cannot see or hear or think. You refused to worship the God who gives you breath and controls everything you do.
translation_verse: na wɔhakyi ɛ nzi wɔzi Anwuma Nyamenle ne. Bɛva ahɔpo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bɛrɛlɛ wɔ na ɛ nee wɔ mgbanyima, wɔ mraalɛ, yɛɛ wɔ mgbɔnla ne mɔ ɛnlo nu. Wɔye dwɛtɛ fufule, ezukoa nvutuke, kɔbele, bulalɛ, baka, yɛɛ bolɛ awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnnwu debie, ɛnde edwɛkɛ, ɛnze ɛhwee la ayɛlɛ wɔgyakyi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ ngoane nee wɔ ndenle kɔsɔɔti wɔ ɔ sa nu la.

english_verse: That's why he sent the hand to write this message on the wall.
translation_verse: Yemɔti a yezoa ɛsalɛ ne yemaa yerahɛlɛ ngɛlɛlera ɛhye la.

english_verse: Belshazzar gave a command for Daniel to be made the third most powerful man in his kingdom and to be given a purple robe and a gold chain.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala Bɛlehyaza manle ye sonvolɛma wulale Daneɛle belemgbunli tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ, bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke ndweabane bɛdole ɔ kɔme, na bɛbɔle ye nolo kɛ bɛyɛ ye maanlebuvo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa.

english_verse: That same night, the king was killed.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne nɔe ne ala bɛhunle Babelonia Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza

english_verse: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.
translation_verse: Akee ɔyele Daneɛle nee menli nwiɔ bie noko kɛ bɛmɛ nsa bɛnlea amɛnladoma ɛya ko abulanwiɔ ne mɔ anwo zo, amaa belemgbunli ne amminli debie.

english_verse: And he did his work so much better than the other governors and officials that the king decided to let him govern the whole kingdom.
translation_verse: Daneɛle yɛle gyima dɛlale mgbanyima mɔɔ ɛha la nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ amuala, ɔboalekɛ sunsum kpalɛ wɔ ye nu. Yemɔti belemgbunli ne yɛle kɛ ɔmaa yeazie maanle ne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima ne nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛnea Daneɛle maamulɛ ne anu boɛ bɛakpondɛ nvonleɛ bie bɛatia ye, na bɛannyia ɛzonle biala bɛando Daneɛle anwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ; bɛannwu ɛtane anzɛɛ nvonleɛ wɔ ye maamulɛ nu.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: Akee menli ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Daneɛle ɛhye, saa yeanlua ye Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ zo yeamkpondɛ debie yɛantia ye a, yɛnrɛnyia ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Yemɔti mgbanyima ne nee amɛnladoma ne mɔ lile bɛ nloa rale belemgbunli ɛkɛ rahanle hilele ye kɛ, “Belemgbunli Dalayɛse, nyi kyɛ!

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: Nana, di mɛla ne fa ɛ sa wula ɔ bo kile kɛ bɛngakyi ye ɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Midiama, nee Pɛhyeama mɛla ne se la.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile mɛla ne na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔwulale ɔ bo.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Daneɛle nwunle kɛ bɛlie mɛla ne bɛdo nu na belemgbunli ɛva ɔ sa ɛwula ɔ bo la, ɔhɔle sua nu, ɔbukebukele ye nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ kɔne Gyɛlusalɛm afoa nu la ɔguale nwolɛ, na kenle ko biala ɔhotole ɔzɛlɛle na ɔyɛle ye Nyamenle ne mo fane nsa, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔyɛ ye dɛba ne la.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Daneɛle kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ radɛle ye nwunle kɛ ɔlɛsɛlɛ yeavɛlɛ ye Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Akee bɛhanle bɛhilele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Daneɛle, mɔɔ le Dwudama mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛrale nlɔnu wɔ ɛke la anu ko la ɛmbu wɔ, yɛɛ ɔmbu wɔ mɛla ne. Kenle ko biala ɔyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ fane nsa.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli dele edwɛkɛ ne la, ɔgyegyele ye adwenle dɔɔnwo. Ɛbɔ ye nwonlomɔ ne toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu nɔsolɛ nu la ɛnee ɔlɛkpondɛ adenle yealua nu yealie Daneɛle.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala ziale razele belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi kɛ, Midia nee Pɛhyea maanle nu, saa belemgbunli di mɛla fa ɔ sa wula ɔ bo a bɛntulu ye.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati belemgbunli ne manle bɛhɔvale Daneɛle bɛrale na bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole awenade ne mɔ tunli ne anu. Belemgbunli ne zele Daneɛle kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye dahuu la ɛlie wɔ ngoane!”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bolɛ bɛranyinle tunli ne. Akee belemgbunli vale ɔdaye mumua ne ye tumi sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ tumi sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ sosɔle bolɛ ne amaa awie angola anyɛ debie biala kɛ ɔdie Daneɛle.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne ziale hɔle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ. Yeanva debie fee yeanga ɔ nloa, yeanlie ɔ nye, yɛɛ aledwolɛ ne anu, nafelɛ angɔ ɔ nye zo.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Aleɛbahye ne, belemgbunli ne dwazole na ɔhanle ɔ nwo ɔhɔle awenade tunli ne anwo.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: Ɔbikyele tunli ne la ɔvale abodelɛ ɔdeanle nuhua kɛ, “Tease Nyamenle ne sonvolɛ Daneɛle! Asoo wɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye dahuu la ɛhola ɛlie wɔ ɛvi awenade ne mɔ asa anu?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Daneɛle buale belemgbunli ne kɛ, “Nana, nyi kyɛ!

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle ne zoanle ye soanvolɛ manle ɔratotole awenade ne mɔ anloa anu, yemɔti bɛanva bɛ nloa bɛanga me. Ɔluakɛ medi benle wɔ me Nyamenle ne anyunlu yɛɛ medi benle wɔ ɛdawɔ noko ɛ nyunlu. Nana, metɛyɛle ɛtane biala.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile fɛlɛko kpole na ɔzile ɔ gyakɛ aze kɛ bɛye Daneɛle wɔ tunli ne anu. Yemɔti bɛyele Daneɛle wɔ tunli ne anu, ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ ɔvale ɔ rɛle ɔwulale ye Nyamenle ne nu.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli manle bɛhɔhyele menli mɔɔ doanle Daneɛle la bɛrale, na bɛvuandinle bɛ nee bɛ mra nee bɛ mraalɛ bɛguale awenade tunli ne anu. Bɛandwu aze wɔ tunli ne anu bɔbɔ, awenade ne mɔ sosɔle bɛ anwuma tetele bɛ azinli lile.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Dalayɛse hɛlɛle hɔmanle maanle maanle nee menli ngakyile mɔɔ bɛ aneɛ le ngakyile la kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ dɔɔnwo ɛha bɛ!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Memaa bɛade kɛ meli mɛla kɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ me maanle ye anu la ɛzonle na ɔzulo Daneɛle Nyamenle ne. “Ɔluakɛ ɔle Tease Nyamenle, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu; na ɔbali belemgbunli dahuu.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: Ɔdie ngoane, ɔye menli ɔfi munzule nu; ɔyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ, ɔyɛ nwanwane gyima wɔ anwuma nee aze. Yelie Daneɛle yevi awenade ne mɔ asa anu.”

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Daneɛle nyianle ɔ nyunlu wɔ Belemgbunli Dalayɛse nee Pɛhyeanli Belemgbunli Saelɛse mekɛ zo.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Menwunle ye wɔ me ɛlalɛ ne anu wɔ nɔe ne kɛ anwoma vi aduduleɛ nee adɔleɛ, ɛbɔ nu nee nyiakɛ ɛlɛbɔ na yemaa nyevile kpole ne ɛlɛbegye.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Menwunle nane mgbole nna kɛ bɛvi nyevile ne anu bɛvinde, na asolo ko biala.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ lumua la zɔho awenade na ɔlɛ kɔleɛ ndɛbalɛ. Menwunle kɛ bɛdudule ɔ ndɛba ne mɔ, na bɛmanle ye zo bɛmanle ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle ɔ gyakɛ nwiɔ azo kɛ sonla la, na bɛmanle ye sonla adwenle.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: “Nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la zɔho ezizile. Bɛzɔle ye bɛdwazole ye. Ɛnee ɔlɛ sonla nvenle mbowule nsa ɔ gye nu, na bɛzele ye kɛ, ‘Dwazo, kɔ zolɛ di nane dɔɔnwo.’

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye anzi memanle me nye zo na menwunle kɛ nane bieko ɛvinde, yemɔ ɔzɔho sobolɛ, ɔlɛ anloma ndɛbalɛ nna gyigyi ɔ nzi, yɛɛ ɔ ti le nna; eza bɛmanle ye tumi.

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye anzi, wɔ ɛlalɛ ko ne ala anu, menwunle nane bieko. Ɛhye tɔ zolɛ nna, ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nwo yɛ se kpole kpalɛ. Ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtete nane nu ɔbubu ye mbowule nu, na yeava ɔ gyakɛ yeatietia mɔɔ kɛha la azo. Nane ɛhye le ngakyile bɔkɔɔ tɛla alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ; ɔlɛ mɛne bulu.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ melɛnea mɛne ne mɔ kpalɛ la, menwunle kɛ mɛne ekyi bie ɛlɛfinde alumua mɛne ɛdeɛ ne mɔ avinli. Ɔdudule alumua mɛne ne mɔ nsa ɔguale. Na nea, mɛne ɛhye lɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ɛnloanlɛ kɛ sonla la na ɔlɛka mgbole. Damɛnlangoate sonla ne anwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: “Meneanle la, menwunle kɛ bɛva arelemgbunli mbia bɛraziezie ɛkɛ. Sonla ne mɔɔ ɔvi tete ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la radɛnlanle aze. Ye tɛladeɛ ne le nwohyee kɛ ezukɔtweaba, yɛɛ ɔ ti enrinli le kɛ boane enrinli. Ye ebia ne le kɛ senle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ gbolamgbolam la, yɛɛ ebia ne agyakɛ ehwili ne mɔ le senle.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: Senle mɔɔ se kɛ azule la vi ebia ne anu finde. Menli apenle apenle zonlenle ye, yɛɛ menli apenle bulu mɔnwo apenle bulu gyigyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ. Akee bɛdɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi edwɛkɛ na bɛbukebukele mbuluku ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: “Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo la, mendele mgbole mɔɔ mɛne ne ɛlɛkeha la. Mekanlea la, menwunle kɛ bɛhu nane ne bɛzɛkye ye, na bɛvuandi ye bɛdo senle nu kɛ bɛyela ye.

english_verse: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
translation_verse: Bɛangu nane ne mɔ mɔɔ hale la, bɛliele bɛ belemgbunlililɛ tumi ne bɛ sa nu na bɛmanle bɛlile kenle ko nee ebule wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: “Wɔ nɔe ne ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle debie bie mɔɔ zɔho sonla ra la kɛ ɔlua amungu nu ɔlɛba, na ɔrale Tetenli ne anyunlu na bɛvale ye bɛhilele ye.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: Bɛmanle ye ebialilɛ tumi, anyunlunyia, yɛɛ enililɛ, amaa aleɛabo maanle maanle mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la azonle ye. Ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, ɔnrɛpɛ nu ɔnrɛze ɛlɛ yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ye sɛkye. Bɛhile Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ abo

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: “Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ yɛle me adwenleadwenle na menzulole.

english_verse: “The four beasts are four earthly kingdoms.
translation_verse: Ɔse, ‘Nane mgbole nna ɛhye gyi ɛkɛ maa arelemgbunli nna mɔɔ bara aleɛabo a.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Na Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne asa baha belemgbunlililɛ ne na yeayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.’

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: “Ɛnee mekulo kɛ menwu deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le ngakyile bɔkɔɔ tɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. Duzu ati a ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele nee kɔbele ɛweɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtete nane na yeava ɔ gyakɛ yeatia mɔɔ kɛha la azo a?

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: Eza mekulo kɛ mete mɛne bulu ne mɔɔ gyigyi ɔ ti zo, mɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ nsa dudule guale aze, mɛne ekyi ne mɔɔ vile na ɔlɛ ɛnyelɛ nee ɛnloanlɛ kɛ sonla, na ɔhanle mgbole la anwo edwɛkɛ. Duzu ati a yemɔ ɔlɛ tumi ɔtɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ a?

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: “Mekanwu ye la ɛnee nane mɛne ɛhye nee Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne ɛho na yeli bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: Akee Tetenli ne rale rabuale Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne benle; mekɛ ne dwule la maamulɛ ne zenle lile Nyamenle menli ne asa anu.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: “Ɔhanle kɛ, ‘Nane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la kile kɛ maanle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la badwazo, mɔɔ bayɛ ngakyile wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la anu a. Ɔbali maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo konim, na yeazɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Mɛne bulu ne kile kɛ arelemgbunli bulu a babu maanle ɛhye a. Nzinlii belemgbunli ko bie badwazo. Asolo belemgbunli ɛhye, na ɔbaha arelemgbunli nsa yeagua.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ɔbadendɛ ɛtane ɛtane yeatietia Anwuma Anwumanli ne na yeayɛ Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne mɔ kpɔdekpɔde. Ɔbamia ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkakyi nyamenlezonlenlɛ mɛla ne nee nuhua ɛvoyia mekɛ ne mɔ. Yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle menli ne bahɔ ɔ bo ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia a.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne baradɛnla aze, abua ndɛne alie ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɔ sa nu, na bɛabɔ ɔ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Ewiade belemgbunlililɛ ne nee tumi kɔsɔɔti bapɛ ali Anwuma Anwumanli ne menli ne asa anu. Bɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ, yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti barazonle bɛ ayɛ tieyɛ amaa bɛ.’

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: “Edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ ɛne. Na mame Daneɛle, ɔmanle ɛzulolɛ hanle me, na me adwenle zɛkyele, noko menvale edwɛkɛ ne menziele me ti anu.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Bɛlehyaza lile ɛvolɛ nsa wɔ ebia zo la, medame Daneɛle, menwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bieko.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo la, menwunle kɛ boane nyinli gyi azule ne anloa. Boane ne lɛ mɛne ndendenle nwiɔ, ko wale tɛla ko, na tendenle kpalɛ ne a nzinlii fifile a.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ boane ne tudu kɔ adɔleɛ, sɔlɔ, yɛɛ nyiakɛ, nane biala ɛngola ɔ nyunlu gyinla, yɛɛ bie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kola die debie fi ye tumi bo a; ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na ɔmemanle ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Me nye gyi ɛhye anwo melɛdwenle nwolɛ la, menwunle kɛ abɔnkye nyinli vi adɔleɛ ɛlɛba, na ɔ gyakɛ ɛnga aze; ɔlɛ mɛne ɛzulolɛ ko gyi ɔ ndo avinli.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ye anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti nee ɛya kpole ɔdule hyee ɔrale boane nyinli ne, mɔɔ lɛ mɛne nwiɔ ne, mɔɔ menwu kɛ ɔgyi azule ne anloa la anwo zo.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ yebikye boane nyinli ne na yeva ɛya kpole yezi ye yebubu ye mɛne nwiɔ ne. Boane nyinli ne angola abɔnkye nyinli ne anyunlu gyinla. Ɔzile ye ɔdole aze na ɔtietiale ɔ nwo zo. Nane biala angola anlie boane nyinli ne wɔ abɔnkye nyinli ne asa anu.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Abɔnkye nyinli ne dule ɔ nloa anu kpole kpalɛ; na mɔɔ ye anwosesebɛ ne dwule aze kpole kpalɛ la, ye mɛne kpole ko ne bule na mɛne nna fifile ɔ bo zo ne. Mɛne nna ne, ko anye kɔ ɛbɔ nu, ko kɔ nyiakɛ, ko kɔ aduduleɛ, yɛɛ ko kɔ adɔleɛ.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Mɛne ekyi bie vi mɛne ɛhye mɔ ko anu fifile; ɔfifile ɔyɛle kpole kpalɛ na ɔ nye kɔne nyiakɛ, aduduleɛ, yɛɛ anyunlunyia azɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Ɔnyinle tendenle kpalɛ ɔdwule anwumaneamra anu, na ɔhanle nwɔlɔra ne mɔ bie ɔguale aze ɔtietiale bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: Kɛ menli kɛbɔ tenlene azu ɛkɛ ne la, bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛyɛle ɛtane. Bɛgyakyile nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne bɛdole aze na nane ne lile konim wɔ debie biala anu.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Nzinlii mendele kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko ɛlɛtendɛ na ko ɛlɛbiza ye kɛ, “Kenlenzu, mekɛ ne boni yɛɛ dahuu ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne, mɛladonlɛ mɔɔ maa debie biala yɛ mgbane, yɛɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne nee nuhua menli ne anwo zo ɛtietialɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kɛgua a?”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee medame Daneɛle melɛdwenle kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na meade ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo la, mɔɔ arɛlevilɛ nu menwunle ye la a le kɛ, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la gyi me nyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Na mendele ɛnelɛ bie wɔ Azule Yuleeyae ne anloa, ɔse, “Geebeleɛle, kile nrenya ɛhye ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Geebeleɛle ragyinlanle me nwo ɛkɛ; ɔrale la me ahonle dule na membutule mutule nu. Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, te ɔ bo kɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kile kɛ ewiade bazi ara awieleɛ la.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mebutu ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne mutule nu na ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me la, meannwu ɛleka mɔɔ mengale ye bieko a. Na ɔzɔle me ɔdwazole me ɔgyinlanle.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: Ɔzele me kɛ, “Mekile wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ basisi awieleɛ mekɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne kile la.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: “Boane ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye kɛ ɔlɛ mɛne nwiɔ ne la gyi ɛkɛ maa Midia nee Pɛhyea arelemgbunli ne mɔ.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Abɔnkye nyinli ne gyi ɛkɛ maa Gilisi belemgbunli ne, yɛɛ mɛne totohyia ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ ndo avinli la kile maanle ne belemgbunli ne mɔɔ lumua la.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: “Saa arelemgbunli ɛhye mɔ di bɛ ebia ne toonwo na bɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛba awieleɛ, mɔɔ mɛladonlɛma kɔpo ne ɛwie yi la, belemgbunli bie badwazo, na yemɔ, ɔnzulo ɛhwee, yɛɛ ɔte agyiba biala abo.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ ye tumi le kpole yɛɛ ɔbazɛkye ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ye debie biala bayɛ boɛ amaa ye, yɛɛ ɔbazɛkye menli mgbole nee Nyamenle menli ne.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔ nwo yɛ ɛvɛlɛ la ati, ɔbamaa adalɛ alie ebia wɔ ye mekɛ zo. Ɔ ti akunlu bayɛ ye fɛ yeamaa yeamemaa ɔ nwo zo. Ɔnrɛbɔ menli kɔkɔ na yeava konle yeadoa bɛ. Ɔbamia ɔ nwo bɔbɔ yeava konle yeadoa arelemgbunli Belemgbunli ne. Noko awie ɛnrɛva ɔ sa ɛnrɛha ye bɔbɔ na yeakpo aze.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ wɔnwu ye la bayɛ zɔhane, noko mmabɔ ye nolo kɛkala na mekɛ tɛbɔ nu kpalɛ.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Na medame Daneɛle, debie dɔle me nwo zo, ɔyɛle me anwondolɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo. Nzinlii mendele kpɔkɛ na mendwazole mengɔle me gyima zo wɔ belemgbunli sua nu. Na ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne manle me nwo bubule me, meande ɔ bo.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: Ɔlile ebia ne la ye ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la ala anu, medame Daneɛle mɔɔ ɛnee melɛneɛnlea mbuluku nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anu na melɛdwenledwenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlua Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Gyɛlɛmaya anwo zo ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la, mendele ɔ bo kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm babɔ toonwo ɛvolɛ abulasuu.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: Menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne na menganle me nee me menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ mendole gua. Mese: “O Awulae, Nyamenle Bedevinli anwo ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ di wɔ ngyekyeleɛ zo na ɛkile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ, na bɛdi wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo la anwo zo a,

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ, yɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ la. Yɛyɛ amumuyɛ, yɛde atua na yɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛzi wɔ mɛla ne nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Yɛandie wɔ sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ ane. Bɛluale wɔ duma nu bɛbɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo bɛhilele yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ maanlebuvolɛma, yɛ ze mɔ, yɛɛ maanlema kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: and even our kings, our officials, and our ancestors.
translation_verse: O Awulae, yɛdayɛ, yɛ arelemgbunli, yɛ maanlebuvolɛma, yɛɛ yɛ ze mɔ ɛbɔ anyiemgba, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: O Awulae yɛ Nyamenle, yɛvo wɔ, yɛde ɛ nwo atua, noko wɔmɔ ala a ɛse anwunvɔne na ɛfa ɛtane ɛkyɛ a.

english_verse: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.
translation_verse: Yɛanli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛluale wɔ sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɛvale ɛmanle yɛ la azo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛdo wɔ mɛla ne, bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi wɔ, na bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie ɛ ne. Ɔlua zolɛ munzule ne nee ndane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ wɔ sonvolɛ Mosisi Mɛla ne anu la ɛha yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia wɔ.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛzele kɛ ɛbava wɔayɛ yɛ nee yɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ sie yɛ la ɛyɛ zɔhane ɛmaa munzule mɔɔ ɛdo yɛ la ɛyɛ totohyia, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛzi Gyɛlusalɛmma anwo zo la, bie ɛtɛsile ewiade ye anu ɛleka biala.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi Mɛla buluku ne anu la, munzule ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛra yɛ nwo zo, noko yɛtɛkpale Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne kyɛlɛ, yɛtɛgyakyile ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛtɛkpondɛle wɔ nɔhalɛ adenle ne.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔboɔboa wɔmaa munzule ne ɛdo yɛ, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle, ɛyɛ mɔɔ le tenlene la, na yɛmɛ, yɛndie ɛ ne.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: “O Awulae yɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne ɛyele wɔ menli ne ɛvile Yigyibiti, na wɔlie duma wɔmaa ɛ nwo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ la, yɛyɛ ɛtane, O Awulae, yɛyɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ a.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dua wɔ tenlene adenle ne azo ye wɔ ɛya ne wɔ suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, ɔluakɛ yɛ ɛtane ne nee yɛ ze mɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati, Gyɛlusalɛm nee wɔ menli ne ɛnɛ ɛyɛ ɛfenle mɔɔ la akɔlɛ nee anloma nloa a.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, O yɛ Nyamenle, tie wɔ sonvolɛ, me nzɛlɛlɛ nee me modolɛ, na ɔlua wɔ duma ne ati, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye la anwo.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: O Awulae, tie yɛ; O Awulae fa yɛ ɛtane kyɛ yɛ; O Awulae, tie yɛ na keha ɛ nwo. Wɔ duma ne ati, O me Nyamenle, mmasi aze, ɔboalekɛ bɛfa wɔ duma a bɛfɛlɛ wɔ suakpole ne nee wɔ menli ne a.” Geebeleɛle kile Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne abo

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ megua zolɛ melɛka me ɛtane nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ɛtane, na melɛbodo meazɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne wɔ me Nyamenle ne boka nwuanzanwuanza ne ati la,

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: Geebeleɛle mɔɔ alumua ne menwunle ye wɔ me ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu la, rale me nwo ɛkɛ ne ndɛndɛ wɔ nɔsolɛ nu azubɔlɛ mekɛ ne.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “O Daneɛle, mera kɛ mebɛlɛ wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɛyɛ wɔ modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne ala la yɛɛ Nyamenle diele wɔ a, na mera kɛ mebaha meahile wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɔkulo wɔ kpole. Yemɔti tie na te wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne abo.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee menli dɔɔnwo bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ ketekete ɛvolɛ nsuu, na ɛvolɛ nsuu ne foa ko, ɔbadua azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ ɛvalɛ. Bɛbava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ Maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛleka mɔɔ wɔ anwuma kpalɛ kpalɛ la. Ɔbawoa ɛkɛ yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ vale ziele ɛkɛ ne la anye kɛpe ɔ bo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa ye la.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane anu ɛnee medame, Daneɛle, melɛdi nyane dapɛne nsa.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: Aleɛ kpalɛ biala angɔ me kunlu. Meanli nane yɛɛ meanno nwanye. Meamkpokpa toonwo dapɛne nsa ne dwule.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Siane ne mɔɔ lumua la, ye kenle abulanwiɔ nee nna ne azo, ɛnee megyi Azule kpole Taegelese ne anloa.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo, na menwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ na ɔhye Yufaze ezukoa nvutuke akyeso la.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: Ye sonlabaka ne ta kɛ bɛlele ezukoa bolɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nyunlu maanle ne ta kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye, ɔ nye sɔ kɛ tɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ anwo ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛdu nu la; ɔ ne dielie kɛ menli ɛwolaa bie ane la.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Medame Daneɛle, me ngome ala a menwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne a. Menli mɔɔ nee me wɔ ɛkɛ ne la annwu ɛhwee. Ɛzulolɛ kpole bie hanle bɛ manle bɛnriandile bɛhɔveale.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Akee mendele ɔ ne, na mendɔle aze mutule nu na me nye zo bulule me.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “O Daneɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo wɔ a, dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu na tie mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la, ɔboalekɛ bɛzoa me ɛ nwo ɛke.” Mɔɔ ɔ nloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye yeahile me la, mendwazole mengyinlanle; ɛnee me nwo tɛwozo me.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔhilele me kɛ “Daneɛle, mmasulo, ɔluakɛ ɔvi kenle ko ne mɔɔ ɛnyianle adwenle kɛ ɛbɛlɛ ɛ nwo aze wɔamaa Nyamenle, wɔakpondɛ ndelebɛbo la yɛɛ wɔ ɛbizalɛdeɛ ne dwule Nyamenle anyunlu a, na mɔɔ wɔbiza la ati yɛɛ mera a.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: yɛɛ mera kɛ mebaha mɔɔ kenle bie bazi wɔ menli ne anwo zo la meahile wɔ a. Ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye kile wɔ mɔɔ kenle bie basisi la.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye ɔhilele me la, membutule me nye aze, na mendɔle mumule.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la vale ɔ sa hanle me nloa na membukele me nloa mendendɛle. Menganle mengilele ahenle ne mɔɔ gyi me nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Me menle, ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye ɛmaa me nwo amuala ɛlɛfofo me, menlɛ anwosesebɛ biala.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Kɛ menwɔzi menwɔyɛ na wɔ akɛlɛ, me nee me menle adendɛ ɛ? Menlɛ anwosesebɛ yɛɛ me ɛnwomenle ɛwie.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele me kɛ, “Ayi, Nyamenle kulo wɔ kpole, mmasulo. Anzonudwolɛ ɛha wɔ. Gyinla ɛ nwo na si ahonle.” Ɔhanle zɔhane la, akee menyianle anwosesebɛ na menganle kɛ, “Me menle, tendɛ, na kɛkala, wɔmaa menyia anwosesebɛ.”

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ Midianli Dalayɛse lile ebia ne la, ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, mengyinlanle ɔ nzi memanle ye anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ.” Yigyibiti nee Selea maanle ne mɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Arelemgbunli nsa bieko badwazo azie Pɛhyea maanle ne. Ko baradɔ zolɛ nna na yemɔ, ɔbanyia ezukoa yeadɛla alumua ɛdeɛ nsa ne. Kɛmɔ ɔbayɛ kpole, yeayɛ sukoavolɛ yeadɛla ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la ati ɔbaheha ɔ nwo yeatia Gilisi maanle ne.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: “Nzinlii belemgbunli kpole bie ɔdaye ɔbara; ɔbava tumi kpole a yeazie maanle ne a, na yeayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ye tumi ne kɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ la akee ye belemgbunlililɛ ne bagua na ye maanle ne anu ahyɛ nna. Awie mɔ gyɛne mɔɔ ɛmbikye ebia ne fee la a banlea maanzinli ne mɔ azo a, yɛɛ maanle ɛbulɛ ne ɛnrɛdwu ye ɛdeɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ maanle ne anu bagyigya.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: “Akee Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne banyia tumi, noko ye safohyenlema ne mɔ ko banyia tumi adɛla ye, yɛɛ ye maanle ne bayɛ maanle kpole.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Mekɛ bahɔ bie la Yigyibiti nee Selea arelemgbunli bayɛ konle nu agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na yeava ɔ ra raalɛ yeamaa Selea belemgbunli ne agya, amaa anzonudwolɛ arala bɛ avinli. Noko ɛhye ɛnrɛhyɛ; belemgbunli ne nee ɔ mra ne mɔ ɛnrɛli agyinla. Bɛbahu raalɛ ne, ye sonvolɛma, ɔ ra ne, yɛɛ ɔ hu.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala raalɛ ne anwo sonla barali ebia ne. Ɔbahɔ Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema ne anwo zo na yeabubu bɛ aranemgbole ne, yeadua bɛ kakɛ yeali bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: Ɔbazoa bɛ awozonle nee bɛ ananze ne mɔ yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bɛyɛ la yeazia yeahɔ Yigyibiti. Akee mekɛ dɔɔnwo baze mɔɔ ɔnrɛva konle ɔnrɛdoa Selea belemgbunli bieko a.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Nzinlii Selea belemgbunli bara Yigyibiti belemgbunli anwo zo, noko ɔnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, ɔbazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: “Selea belemgbunli ne amra baboɔboa ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo anloa kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kɔ konle. Ɛlɔnema ne anu ekpunli ko baho toonwo ahɔdwu Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne aranemgbole ne anwo.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bamaa ɛya ahu Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne na yeavinde yearadoa Selea belemgbunli ne ɔ nee ye bɛabɔ ye zo na yeali Selea belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe ne anwo zo konim.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Ɔbali fɛlɛko kɛ yeli Selea ɛlɔnema pemgbenleamgbe ne anwo zo konim na yehu menli apenle apenle bulu bulu a, noko ye konimlilɛ ne ɛnrɛhyɛ.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: “Selea belemgbunli ne bazia ahɔboɔboa ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ tɛla alumua ɛdeɛ ne la anloa, na mekɛ bie dwu a yeava bɛ nee konle ninyɛne yeara.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane mɔ anu menli dɔɔnwo badwazo atia Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne, na ɔlua ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ Daneɛle wɔ maanlema bie mɔ mɔɔ di mgbonde la banwu ye la ati, bɛbamia bɛ nwo kɛ bɛkile bɛ mrenya, noko bɛnrɛhola gyinla.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Akee Selea belemgbunli ne barateta suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la na yeava sua ne. Yigyibiti ɛlɔnema bagua adu aze; yɛɛ ye menli mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ bɔbɔ la ɛnrɛhola gyinla, ɔluakɛ bɛnrɛnyia anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Selea belemgbunli ne bayɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla. Ɔbava azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la kpokpoti yeayɛ ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: “Selea belemgbunli ne babɔ adwenle ava ye ɛlɔnema ne kɔsɔɔti apɛ adenle ahɔ ye kpɔvolɛ ne maanle nu na ɔ nee ye ayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛali zolɛ. Ɔbava ɔ ra raalɛ yeamaa ye kpɔvolɛ ne agya, amaa yeanyia adenle yeazɛkye ye kpɔvolɛ ne maanle ne, noko ye adwenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛli munli.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Nzinlii ɔbaluolua ɛnweanloa yeateta maanle maanle ɔ nee bɛ aho yeavo bie mɔ dɔɔnwo anwo zo. Na safohyenlema kpanyinli bie vi maanle gyɛne nu baraha ye aze. Nɔhalɛ, ɔbamaa Selea belemgbunli ne ninyɛmunli ne mɔ abu azia ye.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bazia ahɔ ye aranemgbole ne anu wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu, noko bɛbarali ɔ nwo zo konim wɔ ɛkɛ na ɔnrɛhola ɔ nwo zo ma bieko.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: “Belemgbunli ko noko badwazo ɔ nzi mɔɔ batete adwule wɔ maanle ne anu amuala a, noko ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛahu ye. Bɛnrɛhu ye konle nu anzɛɛ ɛyavalɛ nu.” Selea belemgbunli munzuvolɛ ne

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hɔle zolɛ hilele nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli bieko mɔɔ tɛ awie a bazɔ ɔ sa ava ye azie ebia zo la bavinde azie Selea maanle ne; ɔnrɛhakye bɛ ɔnrɛzie, ɔbalua mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo a yeazie ɔ nwo belemgbunli a.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: Ɛlɔne biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdo Nyamenle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bɔbɔ sɛbe.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Maanle mɔɔ ɔbazie la le ekyi bie, noko ɔbava mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo ɔ nee maanle maanle ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ yeahakyi ɔ nwo belemgbunli kpole.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: Ɔbadwazo maanle maanle mɔɔ gyigyi boɛ la anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu yeakpokpo bɛ, na yeayɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie maanle nu ɔ ze mɔ nee ɔ nlenya mɔ anyɛ bie fee la, na ɔ nee ɔ sa zo ahyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛwua la bɛali. Ɔbabɔ adwenle yeabɔ ɔ nwo bane mɔɔ kpɔvolɛ ɛngola ɛmbikye ye la, noko ɔnrɛli agyinla.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: “Ɔbazi ahonle yeava ɛlɔne kpole yeahɔteta Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne. Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ɔbava ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo la dɔɔnwo nee ye ahɔbɔ ye zo, na ɔnrɛhola Selea belemgbunli ne anyunlu gyinla, ɔluakɛ Selea belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla ye yeawie ye yɛ.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ nee ye di, nee ye no la a bado ye bie nu a. Bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema ne anu dɔɔnwo na mɔɔ kɛha la agua ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne badɛnla ɛkponle ko anwo ali adwelie, noko adalɛ ɔ, biala babɔ ye kpɔkɛ ɔ ti anu, yemɔti mɔɔ bɛbaha la biala bayɛ bɛ gye zo amanie, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ la ɛtɛdwule.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Selea belemgbunli ne bava ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ konle nu la azia ahɔ sua nu, yɛɛ ɔbava adwenle kɛ ɔsɛkye Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne. Ɔbayɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na yeazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: “Saa mekɛ ne dwu a ɔbadwazo Yigyibiti anwo zo bieko, na mekɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ kɛ alumua mekɛ ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ Wulomuma bava meli aradoa ye bɛ nee ye aho. Ye ahonle badu na yeagua ye ɔ nzi. “Ɔbava ɛya kpole yeazia ɔ nzi yeara Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne ɛzɛkyelɛ. Ɔsia ɔba a, ɔbali menli mɔɔ ɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la folɛdulɛ zo.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɔnema ne bie mɔ bagua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo evinli, bɛazɛkye aranemgbole ne, na bɛadua dahuu azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛvalɛ. Akee bɛbava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la yeamaa bɛali ɔ nzi, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze bɛ Nyamenle ne la bagyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu na bɛaheha bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Nyamenle menli ne anu la bayɛ toonwo bɛamaa menli dɔɔnwo anyia ndelebɛbo, noko bie mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa, bɛbayela bie mɔ, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ, bɛawua bie mɔ anwo ninyɛne mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle menli ne kpo aze a, moalɛ ekyi bie a bɛbanyia ye a. Menli dɔɔnwo bava mɛlɛbɛla araboka bɛ.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la bie mɔ badu koti, amaa bɛahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ na bɛ nwo ade saanwu ahɔkpula kɛ mekɛ ne kɛdwu la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la ɛtɛdwule.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: “Selea belemgbunli ne bayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la; ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeayɛ ɔ nwo kpole yeadɛla nyamenle biala, na yeaheha azibɛnwo edwɛkɛ yeatia nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne. Ɔbayɛ ɛhye yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛhwe ɔ nzo la, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ la yɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ne bakpo nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ zonlenle la, yɛɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ mraalɛ anye die nwolɛ la. Ɔbakpo nyamenle biala, ɔluakɛ ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeadɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Ɔbazonle aranemgbole nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne yeagyakyi ɛhye mɔ. Ɔbazonle nyamenle mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ ɛnze ye la; ɔbava ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule, awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ nee ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ awolɛ yɛ se la yeazonle ye.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala a ɔbava yeayɛ maanle zo nyamenle mɔɔ kɛzɔ ɔ nye la wɔ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlie ye bɛkɛdo nu kɛ ɔle bɛ belemgbunli la, ɔbali bɛ eni kpole kpalɛ, ɔbamaa bɛ gyinlabelɛ na yeamaa bɛ azɛlɛ kɛ bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: “Ɔka ekyii na mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhile la adwu a, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne bava konle ahɔdoa Selea belemgbunli ne. Selea belemgbunli ne bava ye anwosesebɛ muala, ye konle ehwili ne mɔ, ye mgbɔnwɔ nee ye meli dɔɔnwo ne ara ɔ nwo zo kɛ ahumuakyima. Ɔbahɔ maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo na yeali bɛ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Ɔbahɔvo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo. Menli apenle apenle badɔ, noko bɛbalie Yidɔmma nee Mowabema nee Amɔn maanle mumua ne bɛavi ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ɔbaho yeava maanle dɔɔnwo, na Yigyibiti ɛnrɛvi nu.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Yigyibiti anwonyia kpokpoti: ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bapɛ ali ye ɛkɛ. Ɔbaho yeava Lebea nee Sudan.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Noko nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔbade yeavi aduduleɛ nee sɔlɔ la bamaa ye ahonle adu na yeava ɛya kpole yeahɔ bɛ nwo zo yeahɔzɛkye menli dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Ɔbazi ye arelemgbunli ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ wɔ nyevile ne nee boka ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la avinli, noko ɔbawu; ɔnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛboa ye.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛwu la anu dɔɔnwo badwazo ara ngoane nu; bie mɔ banyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko babɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la bada kɛ sɛnzɛne, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhilehile menli kpalɛyɛlɛ adenle la bada kɛ nwɔlɔra la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, to buluku ne anu na sɔ ɔ nloa, yɛɛ mɔɔ wɔde la maa ɔha ɛ ti anu, kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne. Menli banriandi ahɔ ara, na ndelebɛbo bayɛ kpole.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Akee medame Daneɛle mendole me nye, na menwunle menli nwiɔ kɛ bɛgyigyi azule ne anloa, ko gyi azule ne foa ko yɛɛ ko ne ɔdaye ɔgyi ɔ nzi lɔ.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Na membizale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne gyi azule ne azo la kɛ, “Kenlenzu a nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti kɛyɛ zɔhane a?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kpogyale ɔ sa amu nwiɔ zo anwomanyunlu; na mendele kɛ ɔlɛfa Tease Nyamenle ne yeaha ndane kɛ, “Saa ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia ne dwu, na bɛwie Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde yɛ a, ɛhye mɔ amuala bayɛ zɔhane.”

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: Mendele edwɛkɛ ɛhye, na meande ɔ bo. Yemɔti membizale kɛ, “O me menle, kɛ ɛhye mɔ bazi awie ye ɛ?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Daneɛle, suzu ɛ nwo na bɛzɔ edwɛkɛ ne anloa, ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ zolɛ kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo bahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ, ade bɛ nwo saanwu na bɛayɛ menli fofolɛ. Na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛbahɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛndane; bɛ biala ɛnrɛde ɔ bo. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la ala a bade ɔ bo a.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, di nɔhalɛ kɔ awieleɛ. Ɛbawu, na awieleɛ mekɛ ne dwu a, ɛbagyinla ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa wɔ la.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Biyɛlae ara nrenya Hozia wɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli Ɛzaya, Dwotam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛhowahye ara nrenya Gyɛlɔbowam le Yizilayɛ belemgbunli. Hozia aye nee ɔ mra

english_verse: The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dumua alua Hozia anwo zo adendɛ ahile Yizilayɛma la, ɔzele Hozia kɛ, “Kɔgya tuutuu raalɛ na wo tuutuu mralɛ. Ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛlɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla.”

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Hozia gyale Debeleeyem ara raalɛ Gomɛ. Gomɛ nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Gyɛzelii’ ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meadea Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ mogya mɔɔ ɔ nlenya Gyɛhu hanle guale wɔ Gyɛzelii la anwo. Mefa Gyɛhu belemgbunlililɛ ne meara awieleɛ.

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane mebabubu Yizilayɛ ɛda ne anu wɔ Gyɛzelii Bɔnza.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Gomɛ nrenzɛle bieko na ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnzeyeanwunvɔne,’ ɔluakɛ menrɛze Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne bieko, yɛɛ menrɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ menrɛhyɛ bɛ fee.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Mebaze Dwudama anwunvɔne, medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mebalie bɛ ngoane, na tɛ konle nu ɔ, menrɛva konle dadeɛ anzɛɛ ɛda nee ɛda mbaka anzɛɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gomɛ pɛle ɔ ra ne nyɛfonlɛ la, ɔnrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya bieko.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnlememenli,’ ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma ɛnle me menli, yɛɛ menle bɛ Nyamenle.” Yizilayɛ banyia ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma bazo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu anzɛɛ bɛngola bɛndia la, na ɛleka ne mɔɔ bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnle me menli” la, ɛkɛ ne a bɛbaha bɛahile bɛ kɛ, “Bɛle tease Nyamenle ne amra” a,

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: na Dwudama nee Yizilayɛ bali ngamɔnu. Bɛbaye bɛ kpanyinli ko bɛamaa yeanlea bɛ nwo zo, bɛ nwo bazo na bɛakpazi wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔluakɛ Gyɛzelii kenle ne bayɛ kenle kpole!

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ “Me Menli” na bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ “Bɛnwubɛanwunvɔne.” Gomɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ, Yizilayɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Me mra, bɛ nee bɛ nli ɛdendɛ; kɛkala ɔnle me ye bieko, yɛɛ medame noko menle ɔ hu bieko, noko bɛ nee ye ɛdendɛ. Bɛzɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔgyakyi ye tuutuu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne nee ye awuvolɛvalɛ mɛladonlɛ ne.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Saa yeangyakyi a, mebakpa ɔ nwo meamaa yealɛ ɔ nwo zɔ kɛ kenle mɔɔ bɛwole ye la. Mebamaa yeayɛ kɛ fienemgbole nu azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛwe la, na meamaa nzuhɔne ngome ahu ye ado ye lɔ.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: Menrɛze ɔ mra ne mɔ anwunvɔne, ɔboalekɛ bɛle tuutuu mralɛ,

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛ nli le tuutuunli. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ nrenzɛle bɛ la ɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla. Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Metoa me kulovolɛma mɔɔ maa me aleɛ nee nzule, mboane enrinli nee lenen, ɔlivi nwole, yɛɛ nwanye la.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebava mbowumbaka meagya ye anyiane na mealie bane meawa ye, amaa yeannwu ye ndenle ne mɔ.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: Ɔbadu ye kulovolɛma ako na ɔnrɛdo bɛ. Ɔbakpondɛ bɛ na ɔnrɛnwu bɛ. Na akee ɔbaha kɛ, “Mesia meadoa me hu ne mɔɔ lumuale gyale me la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa me ɔtɛla kɛkala.”

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Ɔnze kɛ medame a menvale abɛlɛ, nwanye, ɔlivi nwole, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke memanle ye a, yɛɛ bɛvale bɛzonlenle bozonle Beeyale ne a.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛbuhenle ne dwu a mebalie me abɛlɛ, nwanye ne mɔ nee me mboane enrinli nee lenen ne mɔ mɔɔ menvale memanle ɔyɛle ndanlɛ ɔhedale la.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Mebakpa ɔ nwo wɔlɔnwo wɔ ye kulovolɛma anyunlu, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye ɛnrɛvi me tumi bo.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye ye vanye mbaka nee ye feege mbaka mɔɔ ɔse ɔle ye ɛkpabɔdeɛ mɔɔ ye kulovolɛma vale manle ye la. Mebamaa ye vanye nee ye feege egyinli ne mɔ ahakyi kpɔkɛ, nanemgbole arali.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: Mebadea ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ rɛle vile me na ɔhɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ ɔmanle ye awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, na ɔvale anwoneɛ ɔzieziele ɔ nwo ɔdoale ye kulovolɛma la; kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne. Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye menli ne anwo ɛhulolɛ

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti nea, mebali ye adwenle na meava ye meahɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na meadendɛ kɛnlɛma meahile ye.
