english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne, mebava ye vanye egyinli ne mɔ meamaa ye na meamaa Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ayɛ anyelazo anlenkɛ. Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mefɛlɛ ye a ɔbalie zo, kɛmɔ ye mbɛlɛra nu mɔɔ ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔrale la ɔyɛle la.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbavɛlɛ me “Me hu” na ɛnrɛvɛlɛ me, “Me Beeyale.”

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menrɛmaa ɔnrɛbɔ Beeyale ne mɔ duma bieko, yɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ bɛ duma bieko.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane me nee ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, anwomanyunlu nloma, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ kɛnra aze la bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ; mebaye ɛda, konle dadeɛ nee konle meavi azɛlɛ ne azo, na me menli ne adɛnla bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ, mebayia wɔ meava wɔ meayɛ me ye dahuu. Mebava tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ meagya wɔ, mebava ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee anwunvɔnezelɛ meagya wɔ.

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: Mebava wɔ meayɛ me ye nɔhalɛ nu, na ɛbanwu kɛ mele Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, mebadendɛ anwomanyunlu anwo na anwomanyunlu badendɛ azɛlɛ ye anwo.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: Na azɛlɛ ye bamaa abɛlɛ, nwanye nee nwole na aleɛ abu Gyɛzelii.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Mebalua ye azɛlɛ ne azo meamaa me nwo. Mebaze “Bɛnzebɛanwunvɔne” anwunvɔne, na meaze “Tɛmemenli ɔ” kɛ, “Bɛle me menli” na ɔdaye ɔbaha kɛ, “Ɛle me Nyamenle.”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔ bieko na kɔhulo awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne na ye kulovolɛ ne le nrenya mɔɔ gya raalɛ la. Kulo ye kɛmɔ kɛkala medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mesi mekulo Yizilayɛma mɔɔ kakyi bɛ nwo kɔ nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne anwo, na bɛkulo vanye mra la.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Menganle mengilele ye kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ me ye, ɛkyɛ me sa nu; mmabɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla bieko anzɛɛ mmakɔfa nrenya fofolɛ; na medame noko mebali nɔhalɛ ko ne ala meamaa wɔ.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma badɛnla ahyɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnrɛnyia belemgbunli anzɛɛ mgbanyima; bɛnrɛbɔ azu yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia awolɛ mpila, bɛnrɛnyia mmonle anzɛɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛazonle nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ Yifɔdo.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi Yizilayɛma bazia ara Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee bɛ belemgbunli Devidi ɛkɛ. Bɛbava ɛzulolɛ bɛazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ wɔ ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la. Ɔse, “Bɛnli nɔhalɛ anzɛɛ bɛnyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma yɛɛ bɛnlɛ Nyamenle anwo adwenle biala wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: Cursing, dishonesty, murder, robbery, unfaithfulness— these happen all the time. Violence is everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɛka ndane, bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛku menli, bɛwua, yɛɛ bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. Bɛdɛla anhwe yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne bayɛ resee yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bawu. Ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti, anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti, nyevile nu fɛlɛ bɔbɔ, bɛ muala bɛbawu.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ sɛlɛvolɛma somolɛ

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Awie biala mmasu ɛhye anwo kpolera, yɛɛ awie biala mmato menli ne ɛzonle; ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma bɔbɔ yɛɛ me nee bɛ lɛ edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Bɛbadu koti alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne noko nee bɛ badu koti aledwolɛ nu, na mebazɛkye bɛ nli ne.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Me menli ne ɛnlɛ adwenle la ati bɛzɛkye bɛ; kɛmɔ bɛkpo adwenlenubukelɛ la ati, medame noko mekpo bɛ kɛ bɛnle me sɛlɛvolɛma bieko, yɛɛ kɛmɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne la, medame noko me rɛle bavi bɛ mra.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛatia me la ɛne, yemɔti mebamaa bɛ enililɛ ahakyi anyiemgba.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Bɛdidi me menli ne ɛtane nwo, bɛyɛ adidikpoku wɔ me menli ne ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mebava meayɛ me menli ne la, zɔhane ala a mebava meayɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ a. Mebadea bɛ na meadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: Bɛbali, na bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi. Bɛbali awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuu kɛ bɛkɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛdoɔdoa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bua awozonlezonlenlɛma fɔlɛ

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ baka dosinli nwo abisa yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ kpɔma bɔbɔ bɔ bɛ munzule. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ɛva bɛ ɛminli, ɛmaa bɛgyakyi bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ na bɛlɛdi awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu. Bɛbɔ azu wɔ awoka mgbole zo na bɛfa bɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛkɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: mbaka ndendenle ɛsesebɛ bubuzuu bo, ɔboalekɛ bɛ alubo ne mɔ anu yɛ anyelielɛ. “Yemɔti bɛ mra mraalɛ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Noko saa bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne a, menrɛdea bɛ, ɔluakɛ mrenya ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛfa ahane bɛkɔfa tuutuuma yɛɛ bɛ nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuuma bɔ nu bɔ azu. Bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo a, na bɛbazɛkye bɛ noko.

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla a, Dwudama ɛnli nwolɛ fɔlɛ. Bɛmmakɔ Gelegale anzɛɛ Bɛteevɛn kɛ bɛkazonle, yɛɛ bɛmmafa ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma’ duma bɛka ndane.

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma anzo yɛ se kɛ mgbɔnwɔndua. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na meamaa bɛ aleɛ kɛ mboane mralɛ mɔɔ wɔ adidileka mɔɔ le tɛtɛlɛ la ɛ?

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Nzabovoma akpolane mɔɔ anye die tuutuulilɛ nwo a. Bɛkulo anyiemgba bɛtɛla anyunlunyia.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Anwonyia ɛpia bɛ ɛhɔ, na bɛ awozonle azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ati, anyiemgba baha bɛ.

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: “Bɛdie edwɛkɛ ɛhye, bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma! Bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma! Bɛdie, bɛmɛ arelemgbunli! Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne gyi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ngane wɔ Mezepa, bɛyɛ kɛ avonle mɔɔ bɛdo wɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo la,

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: bɛpɛ kuma kuloonwu wɔ suakpole Akasea azo, yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a; mebadea bɛ kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Meze Yifelaem, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ ɛnvea me nye zo. Na kɛkala, wɔmɔ Yifelaem, wɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.” Hozia bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nwo kɔkɔ

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmmaa bɛngola bɛnzia bɛngɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bamaa Yifelaem nee Yizilayɛ adu koti. Dwudama noko nee bɛ a badu koti ne a.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Bɛbava bɛ mboane nee bɛ nlankɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛnrɛnwu ye, ɔluakɛ yehwe ɔ nwo yevi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ bɛwo nyɛvolɛ mralɛ. Yemɔti siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne bazɛkye bɛ nee bɛ azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti. Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ konle ne

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Bɛwu konle aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu wɔ Gebɛya! Bɛbɔ nolo ne wɔ Releema! Bɛbɔ bubu wɔ Bɛteevɛn. Bɛli bɛ nzi, Bɛngyaman asa azo!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Kenle ne ɛlɛba, na bɛbazɛkye Yifelaem maanle ne. Yizilayɛma, nɔhalɛ nu, ɛhye bazi!

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwuda arelemgbunli ɛyɛ bɛ nwo menli mɔɔ di azɛlɛ zo ɛweɛne tukpɔnla a. Yemɔti mebawola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo kɛ nzule la.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Yifelaem ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ndeanlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ yebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ debie mgbane ala yɛɛ ɔdi ɔ nzi a.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebayɛ me nwo ɛlɛtɛba meazɛkye Yizilayɛ na meayɛ kɛ nrɛnlana meamaa Dwudama ayɛ mgbane.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ Yifelaem nwunle kɛ anwonyane ɛbɔ ye na Dwuda noko nwunle kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne yedudu nganlɛ la, Yifelaem hɔle Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabiza ye moalɛ, noko Aselea angola anyɛ bɛ nee bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Mebateta Yifelaem kɛ awenade na meateta Dwuda kɛ awenade ralɛ. Medame mumua ne mebatete bɛ nzokanzoka na meagyakyi bɛ meahɔ. Saa me nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ a, awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ die.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: “Mebahwe me nwo meavi menli ne anwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, na wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu, bɛkɛkpondɛ me bo zo la.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Menli ne baha kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzia yɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma! Yemaa yɛnwu amaneɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ ayile; yebodɛboda yɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Kenle nwiɔ ne azo ɔbamaa yɛabɔzɔbɔzɔ, na ye kenle nsa ne azo yeadwazo yɛ, na yɛadɛnla ngoane nu.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛnwu Ɛdɛnkɛma. Nɔhalɛ, ye ɛralɛ ɛnli mgbanwo, kɛmɔ alehyenlɛ ɛnli mgbanwo la. Ɔbara kɛ nyenyensuo nyenye doɔloa azɛlɛ ye la.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O Yifelaemma, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? O Dwudama, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? Me nwo ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la le kɛ nwonlomɔ amungu, ɔle kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ, ɔngyɛ na yeawe.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Yemɔti memaa me kpɔmanvolɛma ɛpɛ bɛ ɛgua. Meva me nloa edwɛkɛ mehu bɛ, yɛɛ me ndɛnebualɛ ne le wienyi;

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ mekpondɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii, na tɛ nane azubɔlɛ ɔ. Mekulo kɛ bɛnwu Nyamenle bɛtɛla ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: “Bɛle kɛ Adam la, bɛtulule ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la, bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Geleade le suakpole mɔɔ munzulema nee ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ na mogya ɛbu zolɛ a.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ le kɛ nwule ekpunli mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia kakpondɛ sonla akpokpo ye la. Bɛku menli wɔ Hyikɛm adenle zo yɛɛ bɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye amumuyɛ nu.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Menwu debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ Yizilayɛ: Yifelaem awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ; evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: “Na bɛmɛ Dwudama noko, mezie kenle mɔɔ mebava meadea bɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la anwo a.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli fa bɛ maamɔlɛ adwenle ne bɛlɛbɛla belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne di ye ɛvoyia ne la, ɔ nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nlonle nza na bɛyɛle tindaanwu na ɔbokale bɛ bɛzile amgbu.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Bɛ ninyɛndane nwo adwenlevalɛ maa bɛ adwenle nu dɔ kɛ fonlomo; aledwolɛ nu amuala bɛ ɛya ne wu gbodogbodo kɛ ɔgyi senle zo, alehyenlɛ nu ɔsɔ kɛ sendɔlɔra.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: “Bɛ muala bɛlɔle kɛ fonlomo na bɛhunle bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ amuala ɛwie wu yɛɛ bɛ biala anzɛlɛ ambiza me moalɛ.” Yizilayɛ nee maanle maanle ne mɔ

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem le kɛ kpanwo mɔɔ ɛtɛwiele be la. Bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anwo zo.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Bɛngola bɛnnwu ye kɛ nyɛvolɛ yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie a. Bɛbɔ egyɛne, na bɛnnwu ye.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Noko ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anzi, bɛnzia bɛndoa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ bɛmkpondɛ me bo zo.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Yifelaem di tɛnlatu kɛ abubule mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la. Bɛkɔ Yigyibiti bɛkɔbiza moalɛ, na bɛanriandi bɛahɔ Aselea bɛahɔbiza moalɛ.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, mebagua bɛ asawu meahye bɛ kɛ anwomanyunlu nloma la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo! Mebazɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde me nwo atua. Mekulo kɛ medie bɛ, noko bɛbɔ me nwo adalɛ.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛnvi bɛ ahonle nu, bɛda bɛ ɛkpa ne mɔ azo a bɛye awolɛ a. Abɛlɛ nee nza ti bɛbodɛboda bɛ nwo, bɛkpo me.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Medame a mentetele bɛ mengilele bɛ anwosesebɛ a, noko bɛfa me nwo maamɔvo adwenle.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi me na bɛtoa bozonle Beeyale ne. Bɛle kɛ ɛda kyealera. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ bawu dadeɛ nloa wɔ bɛ mgbanyizonle ɛdendɛlɛ ti. Yigyibitima bazi bɛ ti zo agole.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Agbɔvolɛ ɛlɛba arali me azɛlɛ ye mutule kɛ ahɔleɛ! Ɔluakɛ menli ne ɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la na bɛbulu me mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Me Nyamenle, yɛze wɔ.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ɛkpo mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Ɛhye ati bɛ kpɔvolɛma badu bɛ mgbaliko.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: “Bɛziele arelemgbunli, noko bɛanlua me nwo zo a bɛziele a. Bɛzieziele mgbanyima mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie. Bɛvale bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee bɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale ananze bɛzɛkyele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Mekyi nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne mɔɔ suakpole Samɛlea amra zonlenle ye la. Me ahonle ɛfutu bɛ nwo. Kenlenzu yɛɛ bɛkɛgyakyi bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ne a?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛnli dwinvolɛ a yɛle ananze ne a, ɔnle Nyamenle. Bɛbagelegele Samɛlea nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Bɛdua anwoma, na bɛbabu ahumu. Ɛya avule nu abɛlɛ ɛnrɛvievia mralɛ, bɛnrɛnyia aleɛ wɔ nu, yɛɛ saa bɛfievia mralɛ bɔbɔ a, nyɛvolɛ a bali a.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ ɛli akoatɔ; kɛkala bɛhyɛ bɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu na bɛyɛ kɛ buakɛ mgbane bie la.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma le kɛ asoaso ahohonyinli, bɛdabɛ bɛpɛ adenle bɛhɔ kɛ bɛkabiza Aseleama moalɛ. Yifelaem ɛbɔ maanle maanle gyɛne ɛkpa kɛ bɛraboa ye.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Saa kanza bɛluolua nu bɛbɔ maanle maanle ɛkpa a, akee mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa. Na bɛbagyakyi belemgbunli nee mgbanyima ɛzielɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔ Yifelaemma ɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo ɛva ɛyɛ ɛtane la, bɛmaa azukponle ɛyɛ debie ɛtane me nye zo.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Saa mekɛlɛ me mɛla apenle apenle bulu meamaa bɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛbabu bɛ debie ngakyile bie.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛkulo azubɔlɛ; bɛku nane bɛbɔ azu na bɛdi. Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye ɛnlie nwolɛ. Akee mebahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na meadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ, na meamaa bɛazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma ɛsisi arelemgbunli azua na bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne. Dwudama ɛsisi azuamgbole ɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane. Na mebakpomgbɔ senle meagua bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na ɔbayela bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, bɛgyakyi fɛlɛkolilɛ! Bɛmmadi wulupe kɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ la, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, na bɛkpo bɛ Nyamenle. Bɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛbɔ bɛ ɛkpa kɛ tuutuuma la wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ne azo; Yifelaemma bazia ahɔ Yigyibiti na bɛali aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la wɔ Aselea.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Wɔ maanle zɔhane mɔ anu, bɛnrɛgua nwanye aze bɛnrɛye ɛdɛne bɛnrɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ɛnrɛzɔ ɔ nye. Bɛ aleɛ bayɛ kɛ ɛzɛne aleɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛli bie la, evinli baha ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbali bɛava bɛakpɔda bɛ ko ala; bɛnrɛva bie bɛnrɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛnrɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na saa mekɛ ne dwu, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ne mɔ bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia a, duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, anwubɛnyunlu ɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ Aselea, Yigyibitima baboɔboa bɛ nloa; bɛbaboɔboa bɛ nloa bɛahɔgua bɛ Mɛmefese na ɛkɛ ne a bɛbawu bɛagua a. Ndile nee mbowule bafifi ava bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule gyazielɛ ɛleka nee bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu, nzenralɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Yizilayɛma banwu ye! Bɛlɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le koasea. Sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛva ye la ɛzɛ.” Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpɔ me kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne le kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le Yifelaemma, me Nyamenle ne menli ne sinzavolɛ. Noko ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔfa la, bɛsua ye ɛhane kɛ anloma la, yɛɛ ɛkpɔlɛ ɛyi ye Nyamenle ne sua ne tɔ.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ɛtane wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gebɛya la. Nyamenle bahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na yeadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ. Yizilayɛ ɛtane ne nee ɔ nzi edwɛkɛ

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mɔɔ mekanwu Yizilayɛ la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ vanye ma mɔɔ ɛfifi fienemgbole nu la. Mɔɔ mekanwu bɛ nlenya mɔ la, ɛnee bɛle kɛ feege mɔɔ ɛlɛdumua azo la ma mɔɔ ɛbolo la. Na mɔɔ bɛrale Piyɔ Boka la, bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle bozonle Beeyale ne, na mengyile bɛ bɔkɔɔ kɛ bɛ bozonle ne mɔɔ bɛhulole ye la.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Yifelaem anyunlunyia badu ahɔ kɛ anloma, bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, mraalɛ ɛnrɛnrenzɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva ɛkolɛ.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Saa bɛwo mralɛ bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ kɔsɔɔti; menrɛgyakyi ko bɔbɔ. Saa mefi bɛ avinli meye me nwo a, munzule baha bɛ!”

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, menwu kɛ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Yifelaem amra mrenya ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Yifelaem fa ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɔ maa bɛku bɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu a ɛfa wɔayɛ menli ɛhye mɔ a? Maa bɛ mraalɛ ko ɛkpɔnekpɔne na maa bɛ nyɛfo ne mɔ ɛbɔndɔbɔndɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yizilayɛma

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɔle ɔ bo wɔ Gelegale. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ membɔle ɔ bo kɛ mekyi bɛ a. Ɔlua bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati, mebadu bɛ me sua nu ɛkɛ. Menrɛhulo bɛ bieko ɛlɛ; bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛde me nwo atua.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Yifelaemma ɛyɛ kɛ baka mɔɔ ye ndinli ɛwu na ewule ɛha ye la, bɛnrɛzo ma. Saa bɛwo bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ la bɛ ahonle nwo la.” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ka Yizilayɛ anwo edwɛkɛ

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle ne bakpo ye menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛandie ɔ ne. Bɛbali ahyimango wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma le kɛ vanye mbaka mɔɔ so kposekpose la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ maanle ne ɛlɛkpazi la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi awolɛ mpila dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛsonle nwolɛ la.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Bɛnli nɔhalɛ, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ɛzonle. Ɛdɛnkɛma babubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na yeazɛkye bɛ mpila ne mɔ.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Akee menli ɛhye mɔ baha kɛ, “Yɛnlɛ belemgbunli, ɔluakɛ yɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na duzu yɛɛ belemgbunli kola yɛ maa yɛ a?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Bɛbuke bɛ nloa bɛkeha bie ala; bɛfa adalɛ ndane bɛkyekye ngyekyeleɛ, yemɔti ndeanlɛ fifi bɛ nwo kɛ ɛya nu ɛzezeane kuma nu ndile mɔɔ le pɔezen la.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ de suakpole Samɛlea azo la bazulo, bɛ nwo awozo bɛ, wɔ bɛ nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ananze ne mɔɔ ɛvi Bɛtɛle la ati. Menli ne bazu ye, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sonle ananze ne la bazu aye awolɛ wɔ ye anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ la ati.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, bɛbava ananze ne bɛayɛ adwule bɛahɔdua bɛamaa Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli kpole ne. Anyiemgba baha Yifelaemma na nyiane ahu Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ti.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samɛlea belemgbunli ne baminli kɛ taboa ebule nretee mɔɔ la azule nye la.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Bɛbazɛkye awoka zo ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Evɛn mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɔ ɛkɛ kɔsonle na bɛyɛ ɛtane la. Mbowule nee ndile bafifi bɛ azukponle ne mɔ azo. Na bɛbaha bɛahile awoka ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛheda yɛ nwo zo!” na bɛaha bɛahile awoka ngyikyi kɛ, “Bɛdu bɛgua yɛ nwo zo.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Yizilayɛ ndɛne

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Sumunli kɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale me wɔ Gebɛya la, bɛtɛgyakyile ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ ne. Yemɔti konle bava bɛ aze wɔ Gebɛya.

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mebara menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛde atua la anwo zo mearadea bɛ. Maanle maanle baha abɔ nu aho atia bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdua bɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anwo kakɛ la.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: “Ɛnee Yifelaem le kɛ ɛnlankɛ belɛ mɔɔ bɛtete ye, mɔɔ hulole kɛ ɔkɛwozo ma la. Noko mebava gyɛnvayile meagyɛnva ɔ kɔme kɛnlɛma ne meamaa yeayɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Dwuda funduvundu azɛlɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛ siezie azɛlɛ ne maa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, ‘Bɛlua tenleneyɛlɛ ma na bɛabu ɛhulolɛ kpundii. Bɛzo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la mgbane la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpondɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma me bo zo a, amaa meara na mearawola ngoanelielɛ meagua bɛ nwo zo.’

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Bɛlua amumuyɛ, bɛbu nzisi, bɛli adalɛ ma. “Kɛmɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anu la,

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: konle bava bɛ menli ne aze na bɛbabubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Ɔbayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hyaleman zɛkyele suakpole Bɛtabɛle la. Wɔ konle ne anu, bɛvale mrɛladane mraalɛ nee bɛ mra bɛfifinle debie bɛhunle bɛ.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Bɛtɛlema, bɛ amumuyɛ ne ati, debie mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Konle ne anu bɛbahu Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mɔɔ Yizilayɛ le kakula la, mengulole ye, na menvɛlɛle me ra nrenya ne menvile Yigyibiti.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Na fane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ menvɛlɛle ye la, fane dɔɔnwo ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔvile me nwo. Me menli ne bɔle azu manle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ na bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ bɛmanle mmonle.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Noko medame yɛɛ mengilele Yifelaemma ɛdialɛ a; mendedɛle bɛ me sa zo, noko bɛnze kɛ medame a meneanle bɛ a.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Menvale ahunlunyeleyɛlɛ nee ɛhulolɛ menlile bɛ ti, menyele bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo, na membutule memanle bɛ aleɛ.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: “Bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛra me nwo bieko, yemɔti bɛbazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti, na Aselea bazie bɛ.

english_verse: War will visit their cities, and their plans will fail.
translation_verse: Konle bava bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ aze, abubu bɛ azuamgbole nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Me menli ne gyi zolɛ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛte bɛ nwo bɛavi me nwo. Yemɔti bɛva kpomgbolo bɛgua bɛ kɔme, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛye ɛnrɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: “O Yifelaem, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ? O Yizilayɛ, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ? Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ mesɛkye wɔ kɛ menzɛkyele Adema la? Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ wɔ kɛ menyɛle Zɛboyem la ɛ? Me ahonle ɛndie me! Me kunlu yelɛyela me kpole wɔ ɛ nwo.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Menrɛva me ɛya kpole ne menrɛgua ɛ nwo zo, menrɛzɛkye Yifelaem, ɔluakɛ mele Nyamenle, menle sonla. Medame a mele Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ nee wɔ de la, menrɛra kɛ mebazɛkye wɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: “Saa metea me menli ne kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ nu kɛ awenade a, me menli ne akee badoa me bo zo. Saa metea nu a bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛvi adɔleɛ bɛara.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛara ndɛndɛ kɛ nloma la, yɛɛ bɛvi Aselea bɛbara kɛ abubule. Mebava bɛ meazia meahɔ bɛ azua nu. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Bɛbu Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda ewule fɔlɛ

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem ɛva adalɛ ngome ɛbɔ ɛyia me, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma noko le mɛlɛbɛla. Na Dwuda ɛdeɛ, Nyamenle ze ye, yɛɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: “Debie biala mɔɔ Yifelaem yɛ, ɔvi nwonlomɔ mɔɔ kɔdwu nɔsolɛ la le mgbane na ɔsɛkye ninyɛne. Bɛbɔ adalɛ mɔnwo na bɛka konle. Bɛ nee Aselea yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛfa nwole bɛkɔ Yigyibiti.”

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia Dwuda; ɔbadea Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. Ɔbadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nee ɔ diema Yisɔ pelele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nli akunlu la; na Gyekɔbo zɔle ɔ diema ne agyakɛ wɔ bɛ awolɛ nu; mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nyinle la, ɔ nee Nyamenle pelele.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne pelele na ɔlile konim. Ɔzunle na ɔbizale ye nyilalɛ. Ɔyiale Nyamenle wɔ Bɛtɛle na ɛkɛ ne, Nyamenle nee ye dendɛle.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gualilɛnli mɔɔ lɛ tone ɛtane ɔ sa nu la kulo kɛ ɔdi ye ɛdɔvolɛma nzisi.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Yifelaemma ɛha kɛ: Aa, yɛnyia yɛ nwo; yɛdu ahu! Noko bɛ anyiabɛnwo ne ɛnrɛhola ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo kakɛ tua ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la, mebamaa bɛadɛnlɛdɛnla ndanlɛ azua nu bieko, kɛmɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne dwu zo a bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: “Mendendɛle mengilele me kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, na memanle bɛnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ dɔɔnwo, na menluale me kpɔmanvolɛma ne anwo zo membule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Saa ninyɛndane bie tɛbɔ Geleade a, zolɛ ɛnrɛra nvasoɛ biala. Saa bɛfa nlankɛ nyinli bɛbɔ azu wɔ Gelegale a, azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ la bayɛ awolɛ edukue wɔ ɛya nu kofie ne mɔ avinli.”

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nriandile hɔle Mɛsɔpɔteemea, na ɔyɛle gyima, na raalɛ ti ɔnleanle mboane ɔvale ɔgyale raalɛ.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ manle ɔhɔyele Yizilayɛma ɔvile Yigyibiti na ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye.

english_verse: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.
translation_verse: Yifelaemma ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya kpole kpalɛ, yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne abɔ bɛ ti. Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye la abu azia bɛ.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Dɛba ne, saa Yifelaem tendɛ a, menli nwo wozo bɛ; bɛkpogyale ye zo wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli; na ɔluale bozonle Beeyale anwo zo ɔyɛle ɛtane na ɔwule.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Kɛkala bɛtɛkɔ zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ ɛtane; bɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua mmonle ananze mɔɔ dwinvolɛma a ɛyɛ la, na bɛse kɛ, “Bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ.” Menli ala, bɛdabɛ bɛfo nlankɛ ananze nloa anwo!

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo baminli kɛ nwonlomɔ nzulemungu anzɛɛ ɛbɔlɛ la. Bɛbayɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye avi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka, anzɛɛ esike mɔɔ lua nvɛnzɛlɛ nu la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la. Bɛnlɛ Nyamenle biala kɛ medame ala. Bɛye me a bɛnlɛ dievolɛ biala.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Medame a meneanle bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ nzule biala ɛnle nu la anu a.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ bɛdwule azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne azo na bɛlile bɛ ko yile la, bɛ mgbanyizonle yɛle kpole na bɛ rɛle vile me.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebayɛ bɛ kɔme nu kɛ awenade. Mebahakyi ɛrane meazia bɛ adenle nu.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Mebateta bɛ kɛ bedi mɔɔ bɛhye ɔ mra, na meatete bɛ nu, na ɛkɛ ne, mebali bɛ kɛ awenade di nane, na meatete bɛ nzokanzoka kɛ nanemgbole tete nane la.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma, mebazɛkye bɛ! Na nwane a kɛhola kɛboa bɛ a?

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Bɛbizale bɛliele belemgbunli nee mgbanyima. Bɛ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ balie bɛ la wɔ nienwu?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Menvale ɛya yɛɛ menvale arelemgbunli ne mɔ memanle bɛ a, yɛɛ meva ɛya meye bɛ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: “Bɛbɔ Yifelaem ninyɛndane ne mɔ kpɔkɛ, bɛva ye ɛtane ne mɔ bɛzie ɛkɛ.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɔ nli te awolɛ ne nyane, na ɔle koasea la ati, ɔmba. Ɔle kakula mɔɔ ye awolɛ mekɛ dwu a ɔnva ɔ ti ɔndua awodeɛ ne anloa a.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Memkpɔne bɛ menvi Ɛbolɔ tumi bo ɔ? Menlie bɛ menvi Ewule asa anu ɔ? O Ewule, wɔ bɔlɔ ne wɔ nienwu? O Ɛbolɔ, wɔ ɛzɛkyelɛ tumi ne wɔ nienwu? Anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛnle me nye zo bieko.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Yifelaem banyi bokoboko kɛ baka ndɔ, noko mebamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu ne adwazo ɛsɛlɛ ne azo abɔ asesa bɛ azɛlɛ bo nzule nee bɛ bula ne mɔ; ɔbaminli debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ wɔ ye gya nu la abo zo.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Mebadua Samɛlea kakɛ kɛ yede me nwo atua a. Ye menli ne bawu konle nu; bɛbava bɛ nlɔma ne mɔ bɛafifi debie bɛatete bɛ, na bɛatulutulu nrenzɛvolɛma ako.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ ninyɛndane ɛmaa bɛdu koti.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ na bɛva nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye bɛdo ɔ nyunlu: “Fa yɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti kyɛ yɛ; die mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Aselea ɛnrɛhola yɛ die, yɛɛ yɛnrɛvo konle mgbɔnwɔ zo bieko. Yɛnrɛha yɛnrɛhile yɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛyɛ la bieko kɛ bɛle ‘Yɛ Nyamenle.’ O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛse nrisa anwunvɔne.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ Yizilayɛma ɛbɛla fofolɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebava me menli ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ meahyɛ bɛ. Mebava me ahonle muala meahulo bɛ, ɔluakɛ meye me ɛya ne bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ meadɔ meagua Yizilayɛma anwo zo. Bɛbanyi bokoboko kɛ aloa, bɛbasosɔ ndinli kɛ Lɛbanɔn mbaka.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Bɛ ngane badɛlɛdɛlɛ, bɛbayɛ ngɛnlɛma kɛ ɔlivi mbaka, na bɛabɔ evuanlɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Bɛbazia bɛaradɛnla me alubo ne anu. Bɛbakpazi kɛ tola nu aleɛ; bɛbabua kɛ vanye mbaka, na bɛ evuanlɛ bayɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn nwanye evuanlɛ la.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: O Yifelaem, duzu a me nee mmonle lɛ yɛ a? Medame a mebua bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nwo, menea bɛ nwo zo a. Mele kɛ sepelɛse baka dokodoko, medame a memaa bɛso ma a.” Adwulaleɛ

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛde edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ abo; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ deɛnwunlɛ la, bɛnwu ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo, tenlenema fa bɔ bɛ ɛbɛla, yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma tu nwolɛ koti.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Pɛtuwɛle ara nrenya Dwowɛle la ɛne. Menli ne di nyane wɔ bɛ bɛyɔba ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Bɛdie, bɛmɛ mgbanyinli; bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Edwɛkɛ ɛhye, asoo bie ɛzi bɛ mekɛ zo, anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ mekɛ zo ɛlɛ?

english_verse: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛhile bɛ mra, na bɛ mra noko ɛha ɛhile bɛ mra, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛha bɛhile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo na bɛzu, bɛmɛ nzabovoma; nwanye ne fɛlɛko ti, bɛmɛ nwanyenovoma, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛvi bɛ nloa.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛteta azɛlɛ ye; bɛ nwo yɛ se yɛɛ bɛ nwo zonle kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛtia bɛ a ɔnyɛ boɛ a; bɛ gye nlane le kɛ awenade gye, yɛɛ bɛ gye ndendenle le kɛ awenade belɛ gye.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Bɛzu kɛ belamunli raalɛ mɔɔ ɛheda ɛrele ɛlɛsu nrenya mɔɔ gyale ye ye mbɛlɛra nu la.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ ɛwie Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Sɛlɛvolɛma, Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma ne su di nyane, .

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ ɛyazonlɛma, bɛli nyane; bɛzu, bɛmɛ vanye egyinli zo neavolɛma, ɔboalekɛ hwiiti ne, baale ne, ɛya ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne mɔ ɛzɛkye.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛwu, feege mbaka ne mɔ ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ. Ma mɔɔ le kɛ akutue, mrɛlɛ nee ampolo, ɛbɔ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti ɛwie wu. Menli anyelielɛ ɛwie.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: O sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛheda ɛrele na bɛzu, sonvolɛma mɔɔ sonle azukponle ne anwo, bɛzu. Bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, bɛheda ɛrele nɔe ne kɔsɔɔti, O me Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma! Ɔboalekɛ ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ ɛwie bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne; bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia. Bɛboɔboa mgbanyima ne mɔ nee menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la anloa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole wɔ kenle ne! Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye, ɔle kenle mɔɔ Tumivolɛ ne bava azɛkye ninyɛne a.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛsɛkye yɛ aleɛ ne mɔ, noko yɛ nye gyi nwolɛ mgbane. Anyelielɛ ɛnle yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ko.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Ma ne mɔ nwoso kofie ne mɔ anu, ninyɛne ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane; ma ɛzielɛleka ne mɔ ɛzɛkye, ɔboalekɛ aleɛ anyɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Nanemgbole ɛlɛkponle! Nlankɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ adidileka; mboane bɔbɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɔluakɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ, yɛɛ sendɔlɔra ɛyela kpɔkɛ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Nanemgbole bɔbɔ su fɛlɛ wɔ, ɔboalekɛ azudenle kɔsɔɔti ɛsesa, yɛɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn; bɛbɔ bubu wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo! Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la kɔsɔɔti anwo ɛwozo bɛ, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba, yedwu bɔbɔ asɛɛ.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ awozinli nee alɔbɔlɛ kenle, amungu nee awozinli kabii kenle. Abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛyɛ kɛ menli anwo ɛzulolɛ, ɛheda awoka ne mɔ azo kɛ awozinli. Ɛhye, ɔvi tete, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ, yɛɛ bieko ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bara la anu.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Ɛnwu bɛ a bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ, yɛɛ bɛnriandi kɛ konle mgbɔnwɔ.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Saa bɛlɛwuluwulu awoka ne mɔ azo a, bɛ nwo alɛra le kɛ konle ehwili; bɛ nwo tetɛ kɛ senle la ndile welera nu. Bɛsolo bɛ kɛ ɛlɔne kpole bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ konle la.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Bɛteta kɛ ɛlɔnema; bɛfo bane kɛ ɛlɔnema. Bɛ muala bɛkɔ bɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo. Bɛndɔ bɛngɔ fema zo yɛɛ bɛndɔ bɛngɔ bɛne zo.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Bɛnzuhuzuhu bɛ nwo, biala dua ye adenle ɛdeɛ ne anu. Bɛbɔ bɛfa adendualɛ biala anu, yɛɛ debie biala ɛngola ɛnzi bɛ aze.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Bɛtu twi bɛkɔ suakpole ne azo; bɛduolua bane ne mɔ anwo; bɛfo bɛkɔ azua ne mɔ anu, bɛdua nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu kɛ nwule.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Saa bɛlɛba a azɛlɛ kpusu, anwumaneamra anwo wozo bɛ. Sɛnzɛne ne nee siane ne du, na nwɔlɔra gyakyi ɛdalɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma tendɛ ɛsesebɛ zo kile ye ɛlɔne ne. Ɔluakɛ ye ɛlɔne ne le kpole; mɔɔ di ye mɛla zo la anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne le kpole, ɔyɛ ɛzulolɛ. Nwane a kɛhola gyinla a? Bɛnlu bɛ nwo

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛkala bɔbɔ, awie biala ɛva ɛhɔnehyelɛ, ɛzunlɛ nee nyanelilɛ, yɛɛ ye ahonle kɔsɔɔti ɛzia ɛrɛla me nwo ɛke.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Bɛtete bɛ ahonle nu na tɛ bɛ adɛladeɛ nu ɔ.” Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli; ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole, yɛɛ dahuu ɔfa ɛtane ɔkyɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Wɔannea Ɛdɛnkɛma bahakyi ye adwenle, yeagyakyi bɛ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛhye anzi, amaa bɛava ma nee nza azubɔdeɛ bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn; bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne; bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia.

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛsonle Nyamenle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne nee azukponle ne avinli la ɛzu ɛzɛlɛ kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu wɔ menli ne anwunvɔne. Mmamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ kpo yɛ, bɛsi yɛ amgbu bɛka kɛ, ‘Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?’ ” Nyamenle maa azɛlɛ ne ahye aleɛ bieko

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma hwenle ye azɛlɛ ne anwo nungule, na ɔnwunle ye menli ne anwunvɔne.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye menli ne kɛ, “Bɛnlea, melɛbɛlɛ bɛ ma, nwanye, nee nwole, na bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ; menrɛmaa maanle maanle ɛnrɛgolo bɛ nwo bieko.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Mebavoa abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ vi sɔlɔ rale la, mebavoa bie mɔ meahɔgua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ. Mebavoa bɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ lumua la meahɔgua Nyevile Wulera ne anu, na meavoa mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la meahɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu. Bɛ avunli ne mɔ babɔ, ɔluakɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la le kpole.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: “O azɛlɛ, mmasulo; di fɛlɛko na maa ɛ nye ɛlie, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole!

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo, bɛmɛ ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, ɔluakɛ fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ ɛbua; mbaka ne mɔ so ma, feege baka nee vanye ɛzo dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: “Bɛli fɛlɛko, O Zayɔnoma, na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo, ɔluakɛ yemaa ezule ɛdɔ ndɛ ɛbua bɛ benle, yemaa ezule ɛdɔ, nzule ɛbu bɛ nwo zo, alumua nee amozi ezule ɛdɔ kɛ dɛba ne ala la.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ma bayi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ, nwanye nee nwole bayi angola mgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ dodo ma mɔɔ abɛbɛ ne mɔ lile la mebava ɔ muala meamaa bɛ. Abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye, sɛkyera nee mɔɔ pɛ ma ne mɔ la, ɛlɔne kpole ne, medame a menzoanle ɛlɔne ɛhye bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Bɛbanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo bɛali, bɛ ko ayi, na bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ, yemɔ a yeyɛ ninyɛne mgbole yemaa bɛ a. Me menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na Yizilayɛma banwu kɛ mede bɛ avinli, na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mele bɛ Nyamenle a, awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ. Na menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko. Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Na ɔbara kɛ nzinlii, mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua awie biala anwo zo: bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ baha me nrɛlaleɛ ne; bɛ mgbanyinli baha ɛlalɛ, na bɛ mgbavolɛ anwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ anwo zo.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: “Mebahile kenle ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ anwomanyunlu nee azɛlɛ ye azo; bɛbaha mogya bɛagua, senle nee esike mungumungu bavinde.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne balu kisii, na siane ne ayɛ kɔkɔlɛ kɛ mogya kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle kpole anu ɛzulolɛ ne ara.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Na ɔbara kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la bɛbalie bɛ ngoane, ɔluakɛ wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm, bie mɔ bavi ɛsalɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbaha la anu yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bavɛlɛ bɛ la wɔ a.”

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Bɛguale me menli ne ati nzeleba kɛ nwane mɔ a me menli nuokɛma ne kɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a. Bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mrenya bɛvale ezukoa ne bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla, na bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mraalɛ bɛvale ezukoa ne bɛnlonle nwanye.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Bɛva me dwɛtɛ fufule nee me ezukoa nvutuke, na bɛzoa me anwonyia kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ bɛ mmonle azua nu.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Bɛva Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛvi bɛ maanle nu bɛhɔ moa moa, bɛdɔne bɛ bɛmaa Gilikima.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala meye bɛ meavi maanle mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle bɛ bɛhɔle nu la anu. Na mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ la, mebayɛ bɛ bie meadua.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Mebadɔne bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ meamaa Dwudama; bɛdabɛ noko bɛbadɔne bɛ bɛamaa Sabema mɔɔ wɔ moa moa lɔ la. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a medendɛ a.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Bɛbɔ nolo ɛhye wɔ maanle maanle avinli: Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo wɔ konle nu; Katakyiema, bɛkpusu bɛ nwo; bɛmaa ɛlɔnema ɛhwe ɛbikye.

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Bɛha bɛ nwo bɛrɛla, bɛmɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia, na bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ bɔnza ne anu.” O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛlɔnema ɛrateta bɛ.

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: “Bɛmaa maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nwo, na bɛrɛla Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadɛnla meabua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la ndɛne a.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Bɛkpogya ɛdedadeɛ ne zo, ɔluakɛ bɛyɔba ne ɛbolo. Bɛhɔ, bɛhwihwi nwanye ne, ɔluakɛ nwanye melahyinli ne ɛyi. Angola ne mɔ ɛyiyi ɛbulu zo, bɛ amumuyɛ le kpole.”

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Apenle apenle, apenle apenle wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mekɛ ne ɛbikye, ɔbazi Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne nee siane ne balu ayɛ awozinli, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra bagyakyi ɛdalɛ. Nyamenle bayila ye menli ne

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kulu wɔ Zayɔn Boka; ɔ ne kpusu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na anwuma nee azɛlɛ kpusu. Ɛdɛnkɛma le ye menli ne ɛvealeka, ɔle aranemgbole ɔmaa Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ mede Zayɔn, me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la. Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ nwuanzanwuanza, na nyɛvolɛ ɛnrɛze zolɛ bieko ɛlɛ.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: “Kenle zɔhane nwanye fɛlɛko vi awoka ne mɔ anu bazonyi, meleke baze awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, nzule bayi Dwuda azule kɔsɔɔti; nzufeanvea vi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bazenze aze kɛ azule wɔ Akasea Bɔnza.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: “Yigyibiti bahakyi ɛsɛlɛ, na Yidɔm adɔ mgbane, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale konle bɛdoale Dwuda maanle ne na bɛhunle menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la.

english_verse: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
translation_verse: Na Dwuda bayɛ menli gbudugbudu dahuu, Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ zɔhane yeahɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Mebali me menli ne mogya nwo nzenralɛ, menrɛva menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la ɛtane menrɛhyɛ bɛ, ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mede Zayɔn Boka.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dɛmasekɛsema yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛva atisesebɛ amaamuo bɛbu Geleadema.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle Belemgbunli Hazeeyɛle suakunlu ɛkɛ na senle ne bayela Belemgbunli Bɛneheedade aranemgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gazama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛhyele maanle mumua ko anu amra bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛdɔnenle bɛ bɛmanle Yidɔmma.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle Gaza bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Mebahu Ahyedɔdoma nee Ahyekɛlɔn belemgbunli ne. Mebadea suakpole Ɛkelɔn, na Filisitiama mɔɔ ɛha la amuala bawu.” Taya

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Tayama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛyele maanle mumua ko anu amra amuala bɛmanle Yidɔmma. Bɛangakye mediemayɛlɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ yɛle la. Luk

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Taya bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ.” Yidɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yidɔmma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛvale konle bɛyɛle bɛ mediema Yizilayɛma kpɔdekpɔde, bɛanze bɛ anwunvɔne. Bɛ ɛya ne andwo ɛlɛ. Oba

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Timan azo na ɔbayela Bɔzela aranemgbole ne mɔ.” Amɔn

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Amɔnoma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛko bɛakpondɛ azɛlɛ bɛaboka bɛ maanle ne anwo la, bɛhunle Geleade nrenzɛvolɛma.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle suakpole Relaba bane ne mɔ anu, na senle ne bayela ye aranemgbole ne mɔ. Akee bɛbadeɛdea nu wɔ konle kenle ne, na konle ne anu bayɛ se kɛ ahumuakyima la.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Bɛbahye bɛ belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛahɔ nlɔnu.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mowabema yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛyelale Yidɔm belemgbunli ne mbowule bɛmanle bɛdɔle nzonle.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle Mowabe azɛlɛ zo na ɔbazɔ yeayela Kɛleɔto aranemgbole ne mɔ. Mowabema bawu konle nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ne ɛlɛteɛdea nu na bɛlɛwu aweɛne ndendenle nu la.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Mebahu Mowabe belemgbunli ne nee ye mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala.” Dwuda

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwudama yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛkpo Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne, yɛɛ bɛanli ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. Bɛli nyamenle adalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima zonlenle bɛ la anzi toonwo bɛminli.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebado senle Dwuda azɛlɛ zo na ɔbazɔ yeayela Gyɛlusalɛm aranemgbole ne mɔ.” Nyamenle ndeanlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma yɛ ɛtane la ɛnee bɛyɛ, na mebadea bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛtɔne tenlenema bɛdie dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ bɛtɔne ehyianvolɛma bɛdie mgbɔlaboa.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Bɛtietia menli mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie nee menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la anwo zo, na bɛsuhu menli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane la bɛsie ahane. Ralɛ nrenya nee ɔ ze fa raalɛ ko na bɛgua me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Bɛkundohundo bɛ nwo aze wɔ azukponle biala anyunlu, wɔ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛwula bɛ lɔ awoba la azo, na bɛno nwanye mɔɔ bɛbɔ menli kakɛ bɛlie la wɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: “Noko bɛmɛ bɛ ti, menzɛkyele Amɔlema, mɔɔ bɛ ndendenle le kɛ sida mbaka na bɛ anwosesebɛ le kɛ oku mbaka la bɔkɔɔ membɔle bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Eza menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo, na menlile bɛ nyunlu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu toonwo ɛvolɛ abulanla, na menvale Amɔlema azɛlɛ ne memanle bɛ, memanle bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ ti anwo ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Menyele bɛ mra mrenya ne bie mɔ menyɛle bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, na memanle bɛ mgbavolɛ ne bie mɔ dule bɛ nwo ziele ahane manle Nyamenle na bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛnrɛnlo nwanye, bɛnrɛpepɛ bɛ ti, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva bɛ sa bɛnrɛha funli. O Yizilayɛma, asoo ɛhye ɛnle nɔhalɛ? Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mebiza bɛ a.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: “Noko bɛmanle menli mɔɔ dule bɛ nwo manle Nyamenle la nlonle nwanye, na bɛduale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɛ bɛmmaka me nrɛlaleɛ ne.

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Na bɛnlea, mebahomo bɛ nwo zo azɛlɛ ne anwo kɛ ehwili mɔɔ abɛlɛ ngyekyeleɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ na yemi la.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la ɛnrɛhola nriandi; anwosesebɛma agbɔkɛ nu batuto, yɛɛ katakyiema ɛnrɛhola bɛ nwo ngoane die.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ to ɛda la ɛnrɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ, menli mɔɔ agyakɛ anzi kola bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ la ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la ɛnrɛva bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane menli mɔɔ akɛnra yɛ se wɔ katakyiema avinli bɔbɔ la bagua bɛ adu aze alɛ bɛ sa mgbane agua ndwɛlɛ aze.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛtia bɛmɛ maanle mumua ko mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ ɔvile Yigyibiti la.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la kɔsɔɔti, ɛdawɔ ɛ ngomekye ala yɛɛ meze wɔ na menlea wɔ gyɛlɛɛnye a, yemɔti mebadea wɔ, wɔ wɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati.” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne gyima

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Menli nwiɔ ɛngola ɛmbɔ nu ɛndu adenle, kyesɛ bɛka bɛsie.

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Awenade ɛmkpo kpɔkɛ nu, kyesɛ yenwu nane mɔɔ ɔkye ye yeali la. Awenade ralɛ ɛnzu mgbane wɔ ye tunli ne anu, kyesɛ yenyia debie mɔɔ ɔdi la.

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Asoo anloma to ɛhane wɔ azɛlɛ nwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛsuale ye ɛhane la? Asoo ɛhane fuandi, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ debie ɛtɛkanle ye la?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Asoo bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ suakpole ne azo a menli ahonle ɛndu? Asoo munzule to suakpole, kyesɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ a?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ɛnyɛ debie wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtɛyele ɔtɛkilele ye sonvolɛma, Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma la.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Awenade ne ɛkpo, nwane a ɛzulolɛ ɛnga ye a? Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛdendɛ, nwane a kɛkpo kɛ ɔnrɛha ye nrɛlaleɛ ne a? Samɛlea ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ye nolo bɛhile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yigyibiti nee Ahyedɔdo aranemgbole ne mɔ anu la kɛ, “Bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ Samɛlea awoka ne mɔ azo, na bɛnlea ninyɛmunli mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ, nee nzisi mɔɔ bɛlɛdi wɔ zolɛ la.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛnze boɛlilɛ deɛ holɛ yɛɛ bɛva konle nee awule ninyɛne bɛyiyi bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Yemɔti medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Kpɔvolɛma babɔ ayia bɛ azɛlɛ ne, abubu bɛ nwo banebɔlɛ ne na bɛave bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ awenade kye boane na mboaneneavolɛ ne kɔ ye ɛlielɛ a debie mɔɔ ɔnwu ye ala la a le ye ndwɛlɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ ɔ nzo ko la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ de Samɛlea la ɛlielɛ bayɛ a; bɛbanwu ebia mɔɔ bɛda nu la ebule na bɛanwu ɛkpa sinli.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Bɛdie, na bɛbɔ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne kɔkɔ kɛ, kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne:

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ menwɔdea Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati la, mebazɛkye Bɛtɛle azukponle ne mɔ, na azukponle biala mgbɛne zo nna ne azo kpokpɔkoo ne mɔ babubu agua aze.
