english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mebabubu bɛ fɔsɛlɛ nee wawaa mekɛ azua ne mɔ. Azua mɔɔ bɛva ɛzɛlɛ bɛziezie nuhua la bagologolo agua; azua mgbole ne mɔ abo zo baminli. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Bɛdie edwɛkɛ ɛhye, bɛmɛ Beehyan nlankɛ mbelɛ mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea boka zo, mɔɔ sisi ehyianvolɛma, mɔɔ fa atisesebɛ amaamuo bu menli mɔɔ ehyia na bɛka bɛkile bɛ hu mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛnlo la.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ye nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne kɛ, “Bɛnlea na mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbabobɔ bɛ koba bɛahwe bɛ bɛahɔ la ɛlɛba. Ko biala bayɛ kɛ fɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛva koba la.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na bɛbalua bane adokule nu bɛavinde, awie biala bahɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo na bɛavuandi bɛ bɛagua Hɛmɔn.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne. Yizilayɛma anzukoa anyɛ

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle se, “Yizilayɛma, bɛhɔ Bɛtɛle ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne na bɛhɔdo mɛla ne mɔ. Bɛhɔ Gelegale bɛhɔtietia mɛla ne azo! Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛbɔ azu nwonlomɔ biala, na bɛva bɛ ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ne bɛrɛla kenle nsa nsa.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Bɛva kpanwo mɔɔ mgbɔvonle wɔ nu la bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu, na bɛbɔ ahonle fufule nu azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nolo, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, ɛhye a le nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ a.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a memanle ɛhɔne zile bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na aleɛ wiele bɛ azua nu a, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Eza memanle ezule gyakyile ɛdɔlɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yeha siane nsa na ɛbuhenle ne adwu la. Memaa suakpole ko nyia ezule, na suakpole ko ɛnnyia bie. Memaa ɛya avule ko nyia ezule a, avule ko ɛnnyia bie, yɛɛ ɛya mɔɔ ezule andɔ nu la anu ninyɛne sɛkye.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yemɔti azuamgbole nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa dule hɔle suakpole ko mɔɔ bɛ nye la kɛ bɛkɛnyia nzule bɛkɛnlua bɛ ahonle la azo, na bɛannyia nzule mɔɔ sa bɛ no la, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Memanle ewia katekate rayelale bɛ bɛyɔba ne mɔ. Memanle abɛbɛ ralile bɛ tola nee bɛ vanye avule ne mɔ anu ninyɛne, bɛ feege mbaka nee bɛ ɔlivi mbaka ne mɔ; noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Memanle ewulenzane ne mɔɔ rale Yigyibiti la bie rale bɛ nwo zo. Mengunle bɛ mgbavolɛ wɔ konle nu na mengyele bɛ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ nuokɛ. Memanle bɛ avunli kpɔlɔlera ne mɔ nvoanle bɔnlebɔnlenle bɛ bonyi nu wɔ bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Menzɛkyele bɛ bie mɔ, kɛmɔ menzɛkyele azuamgbole Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvile ɛsalɛ la le kɛ ɛyɛne mɔɔ bɛdu bɛvi senle nu la. Noko bɛanzia bɛamba me ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: Yemɔti O Yizilayɛma, mɔɔ mebava meayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Kɛmɔ mebayɛ ɛhye la ati, bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo bɛrayia medame, bɛ Nyamenle ne!”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle awoka ne mɔ, na ɔbɔle anwoma, ɔda ye adwenle ali ɔkile sonla; ɔkakyi alehyenlɛ ɔmaa ɔyɛ aledwolɛ, na ɔtietia azɛlɛ ye azo awoka zo la, ye duma ɛne, bɛfɛlɛ ye “Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle!”

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie awolɛyelɛ edwɛne ɛhye mɔɔ meto meagua bɛ ti zo la:

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Belamunli Yizilayɛ ɛdɔ aze, Ɔnrɛdwazo bieko ɛlɛ! Bɛkpo ye, wɔ ɔdaye ye azɛlɛ zo, Awie biala ɛnrɛkpogya ye zo.”

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Suakpole mɔɔ vale ɛlɔnema apenle ko hɔle la bava ɛya ko ala a azia ara a; yɛɛ suakpole mɔɔ vale ɛya ko hɔle la, bulu ala a bazia ara Yizilayɛ a.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛse Yizilayɛma kɛ, “Bɛkpondɛ me bo zo na bɛkɛnyia ngoane.

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Bɛmmakɔ Biyɛhyiba bɛkɔsonle. Bɛmmakpondɛ me wɔ Bɛtɛle, Bɛtɛle bayɛ mgbane. Bɛmmakɔ Gelegale noko, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti bɛahɔ nlɔnu.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo, na bɛnyia ngoane. Saa bɛamkpondɛ ɔ bo zo a, ɔbayɛ senle yeazɔ Dwosefi sua nu, yeayela Bɛtɛle, na awie ɛnrɛhola ye nua ɛlɛ.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ yɛ ɛnwonle, na bɛtietia tenleneyɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɔle nwɔlɔra Nsuu nee Apea Nsa, na ɔmaa awozinli kakyi alehyenlɛ, ɔmaa alehyenlɛ du yɛ aledwolɛ; yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtwe nyevile nu nzule ɔkɔ na ɔmaa ɔkakyi ezule ɔtɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔsɛkye anwosesebɛma na ɔbubu bɛ aranemgbole ɔgua a.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, kɛmɔ bɛsisi ehyianvolɛma na bɛwua bɛ hwiiti ne mɔ la ati bɛva awolɛ bɛsisi azua ngɛnlɛma, noko bɛnrɛla nuhua, yɛɛ bɛyɛ vanye egyinli ngɛnlɛma, noko bɛnrɛnlo bɛ ma ne mɔ anu nwanye.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze bɛ mɛladonlɛ mgbole ne mɔ nee kɛ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mgbole si de la. Bɛkile tenlenema nyane, bɛdie ndoloboa, na bɛdi bɛtia ehyianvolɛma.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la bayɛ koonwu wɔ mekɛ zɛhae anu, ɔluakɛ ɔle munzule mekɛ.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Yɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, mmayɛ mɔɔ le ɛtane la, amaa wɔadɛnla ngoane nu, na Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne nee wɔ alua, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔha la.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Kyi mɔɔ le ɛtane la, na kulo mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na nea maa nɔhalɛlilɛ ɛrɛla edwɛkɛlilɛ ɛleka ne mɔ; wɔannea a Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne kɛnwu Dwosefi abo zo amra ne mɔɔ ɛha la anwunvɔne.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne, Awulae se, “Menli bazu, aye awolɛ wɔ suakpole ne ɛleka kpatawienyi ne nee guabile ne mɔ azo. Bɛbavɛlɛ ɛyazonlɛma kɛ bɛboka menli mɔɔ ze awolɛ ye kpalɛ kpalɛ la anwo bɛmaa bɛzu mɔwuamra.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Ɛzunlɛ bade vanye egyinli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, ɔboalekɛ melɛba mearadea bɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛdendɛ la.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛdwu la! Duzu nvasoɛ a kenle zɔhane bayɛ amaa bɛ a? Ɔluakɛ ɔle awozinli kenle, ɔnle kenle mɔɔ anu te a.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnriandi awenade na yehɔyia bedi la! Anzɛɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ ye sua nu, ɔhisa bane ne na yeva ɔ sa yedo bane ne azo na ɛwɔlɛ ɛha ye la!

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne le awozinli, ɔnle wienyi; ɔle kabii, nuhua ɛnde.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekyi yɛɛ mekpo bɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛvoyia ne mɔ; yɛɛ me nye ɛnlie bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings or animal sacrifices— not even your very best.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee bɛ ma azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛba bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko menrɛlie, yɛɛ menrɛnlea bɛ nane dɔlera anzonudwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɔbɔ.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ alɛra edwɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛto la bɛhɔ nehane; mengulo kɛ mete bɛ getaa ne mɔ ane bɔbɔ.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ la, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛze kɛ azudenle, na tenleneyɛlɛ ɛze kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛnsesa ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma, ɛvolɛ abulanla ne mɔɔ menlile bɛ ti wɔ fienemgbole ne anu la, bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle me anzɛɛ bɛvale azubɔdeɛ bɛrɛlɛle me ɔ?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, kɛmɔ bɛsonle bɛ Bozonle Belemgbunli Sakɛte, nee bɛ Ɛwɔlɔra Bozonle Kaewan ne mɔ ananze ne mɔ, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ la,

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: mebava bɛ meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Dɛmasekɛse anzi lɔ,” kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Nyamenle la se la ɛne.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛdɔ bɛ wɔ Zayɔn, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛ nwo le kɔlɔnwo wɔ Samɛlea la, bɛmɛ mgbolema mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yizilayɛ, mɔɔ menli ba bɛ ɛkɛ babiza moalɛ la!

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Bɛhɔnlea suakpole Kaleni. Akee bɛhɔ suakpole Heemate maanzinli ne anu na bɛtele zolɛ bɛhɔ Filisitia suakpole Gate azo. Ɛnee bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ ɔ? Ɛnee bɛ maanzinli ne le kpalɛ tɛla bɛ maanzinli ɛdeɛ ne ɔ?

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Bɛnlie bɛndo nu kɛ munzule kenle ne ɛbikye, na konle ala a bɛtwe bɛba ɔ?

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛda ɛzɛlɛ ɛkpa zo na bɛtenrɛdenrɛ bɛ nwo wɔ mbia ndendenle nu bɛdi mboane nee nlankɛ la.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ edwɛne, kɛmɔ Devidi yɛle la, na bɛbɔ wɔ bɛ getaa ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Bɛno nwanye wɔ ahyɛnze bonkuma nu na bɛgua anatele evuanlɛ, na bɛnzu Yizilayɛ nee ye ɛzɛkyelɛ.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdabɛ a bɛbalumua bɛahye bɛ bɛahɔ nlɔnu a. Bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ nee bɛ ɛkponledolɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bara awieleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka me ngome me nwo kɛ: Mekyi Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonleyɛlɛ ne, mekpo bɛ azua mgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane la. Mebava bɛ suakpole ne nee zolɛ debie biala meamaa kpɔvolɛma!”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Saa menli bulu ka awuke ko anu a bɛbawu.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kɛwu la anwo sonla, ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛnea yeamaa bɛayela funli ne la baye funli ne wɔ sua ne anu avinde, na yeadea nu yeavɛlɛ awie mɔɔ wɔ sua ne anu la kɛ, “Awie bieko tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ɔ?” Ahenle babua kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ!” Akee funli ne anwo sonla ne baha kɛ, “Yɛ koonwu! Ɔnle kɛ yɛbɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma bɔbɔ.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye tumi edwɛkɛ ne a, azua mgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti badwulu agua.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Asoo mgbɔnwɔ kola wuluwulu bodane zo? Asoo menli kola fa nlankɛ nyinli so ɛya wɔ nyevile nye? Noko bɛmɛ, bɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛhakyi pɔezen, yɛɛ bɛmaa tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyɛ ɛnwonle.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛva sua Lodɛbaa aze. Bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo kɛ, “Yɛlua yɛdayɛ yɛ anwosesebɛ zo yɛva Kaaneeyem yɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Yizilayɛma, bɛnlea, mebamaa maanle gyɛne arava bɛ aze. Bɛbasisi bɛ, ɔvi Heemate Ademgbolezo mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ la toonwo yeahɔdwu Alaba Bɔnza wɔ nyiakɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne yele ninyɛne hilele me wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu. Wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ mɔɔ bɛpɛle belemgbunli ne ndile ne mɔɔ nyɛmoa di la bɛwiele la, Ɛdɛnkɛma yele abɛbɛ tɔka wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ ndile ne ɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔfifi bieko la.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Wɔ me ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu, menwunle kɛ abɛbɛ ne mɔ ɛli nya nee ndile amolɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, na menganle kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, mebodo wɔ, fa wɔ menli ne mɔ ɛtane kyɛ bɛ! Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Yizilayɛma adɛnla ngoane nu ɛ? Bɛ nwo anzo!”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle na ɔhanle kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye la ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane.” Senle nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Eza Awulae Nyamenle ne yele ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛboɔboa ɔ nwo ava senle adea ye menli ne. Senle ne yelale nyevile ne na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔyela azɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, mebodo wɔ, gyakyi! Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Yizilayɛma adɛnla ngoane nu ɛ? Bɛ nwo anzo!”

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma hakyile ye adwenle na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhye noko ɛnrɛyɛ zɔhane.” Ɛzuzunyɛma nwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Awulae yele debie bieko hilele me. Menwunle kɛ Awulae gyi bane bie mɔɔ bɛvale ɛzuzunyɛma bɛdole nwo a bɛdole la anwo, na ɔlɛ ɛzuzunyɛma ne ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Emɔso, duzu a ɛnwu ye a?” Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu ɛzuzunyɛma” Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Melɛfa ɛhye meahile kɛ me menli ne le kɛ bane mɔɔ ɛndenrɛ la. Me adwenle mɔɔ meva kɛ metea bɛ la, menrɛhakyi ye bieko.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ Ayezeke zonlenle la, mebazɛkye bɛ. Mebazɛkye Yizilayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ. Mebamaa belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam abo zo amra amuala awu dadeɛ nloa.” Emɔso nee Amazaya

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Amazaya, Bɛtɛle sɛlɛvolɛ ne hɔdoanle Emɔso hilele Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam kɛ, “Emɔso ɛlɛmaa menli ne ɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane. Ye ngehanleɛ ne mɔ ɛbo maanle ne anwo zo.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Ye edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔka la ɛne: ‘Gyɛlɔbowam bawu dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ bɛbahye Yizilayɛma bɛavi bɛ maanle nu bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ nlɔnu.’ ”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Akee Amazaya hanle hilele Emɔso kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, wɔha bie a yeyɛ boɛ! Sia kɔ Dwuda, kɔbɔ wɔ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo wɔ nehane na di nwolɛ aleɛ.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Mmaka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ bieko wɔ Bɛtɛle ɛke. Ɛke a le belemgbunli ne ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne a, yɛɛ ɔle maanle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Na Emɔso buale Amazaya kɛ, “Menle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, yɛɛ menle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ra. Meka mboane, yɛɛ feege mbaka ɛnleanlɛ gyima a meyɛ a.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle mengyakyile mboaneneavolɛ gyima ne, na ɔzoanle me kɛ mengɔnga mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo edwɛkɛ mengile ye menli Yizilayɛma.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, Amazaya, Ɛdɛnkɛma se menga mengile wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛ ye bayɛ tuutuu ala suakpole ye azo, yɛɛ ɛ mra mrenya nee ɛ mra mraalɛ badɔ dadeɛ nloa. Bɛbahyɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne bɛamaa awie mɔ, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛbawu menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la maanle nu. Na Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛbahye bɛ bɛ nee bɛ avi bɛ maanle ye anu ahɔ nlɔnu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Eza Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yele ɛhye hilele me. Menwunle kɛndɛne mɔɔ mbakama wɔ nu la.

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale me kɛ, “Emɔso, duzu a ɛnwu ye la?” Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu mbakama kɛndɛne ko.” Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Me menli Yizilayɛma awieleɛ kenle ne ɛdwu. Menrɛhakyi me adwenle, ɛdeanlɛ ne ala a metea bɛ a.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane edwɛne mɔɔ bɛto wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la amuala bahakyi awolɛyelɛ. Ɛleka biala bayɛ avunli ngome, bɛbayɛ koonwu bɛavuandi bɛ bɛagua.” Yizilayɛ ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu menli mɔɔ ɛhyia, na bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ye anu la anwo ɛwie bɛ kyele,

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: na bɛka kɛ, “Kenlenzu a siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne kɛwie na yɛanyia adenle yɛadɔne yɛ abɛlɛ a? Kenlenzu yɛɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne kɛze na yɛanyia adenle yɛadɔne yɛ hwiiti, yɛanyia adenle yɛazi yɛ ‘yifa’ ɛzuzudeɛ ne abo na yɛawodo yɛ ‘hyikɛle’ ɛzuzudeɛ ne anu, na yɛawua mɔɔ yɛfa tone yɛazuzu la anu,

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: amaa yɛava dwɛtɛ fufule yɛadɔ ehyianvolɛma, yɛava mgbɔlaboa yɛadɔ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛhyele bɛ, na yɛadɔne yɛ hwiiti mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la a?”

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ɛha ndane kɛ, “Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne bakpusu, na awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la banwu nyane. Maanle ne anu bapi na yeabɔ kɛ Yigyibiti Azule Naele ne di yitwe la.

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane mebamaa sɛnzɛne ne adɔ ewiazo ketekete, na aleɛ adwo na awozinli ava ewia henlema ne. Medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Mebamaa bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ ahakyi ɛzɛneyɛlɛ na meamaa bɛ edwɛne fɛlɛko ne mɔ ahakyi awolɛyelɛ. Mebamaa bɛakpa bɛ ti, bɛaheda ɛrele, na bɛayɛ kɛ awovolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsu bɛ ra nrenya kokye mɔɔ ɛwu la. Kenle zɔhane bayɛ ɛnwonle ɛnwonle toonwo ahɔ ye awieleɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ne ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebamaa ɛhɔne azi azɛlɛ ne azo a. Tɛ aleɛ ɛhɔne anzɛɛ nzule ɛhɔne ɔ. Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne anwo ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne a bahu bɛ a. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Menli bakpɔsa ɛnwea ɛnwea, bɛvi sɔlɔ bɛahɔ nyiakɛ na bɛvi aduduleɛ bɛahɔ adɔleɛ. Bɛbanriandi bɛahɔ bɛara ɛleka biala kɛ bɛkakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛnrɛnyia ye.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane nzuhɔne bamaa mgbavolɛ yɛɛ mbɛlɛra mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ na bɛnze nrenya fee la anye zo abulu bɛ.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa Samɛlea awozonle ananze ne mɔ bɛka ndane kɛ, ‘Meka Dan bozonle ne’, anzɛɛ ‘Meka Biyɛhyiba bozonle ne’ la amuala bagua aze, yɛɛ bɛnrɛdwazo bieko.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi azukponle ne anwo, na ɔzele me kɛ: “Si Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mpila ndendenle ne mɔ ati ne mɔ ɛsesebɛ maa nwolodo ne mɔ ɛkpusu. Bubu bɛ maa bɛha bɛgua menli ne amuala ati zo. Mebava dadeɛ meahu menli mɔɔ kɛha la; ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛhola nriandi; kokye bɔbɔ ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea Ɛbolɔ a, mebahwe bɛ meara. Saa bɛfo bɛkɔ anwuma a, mebadwula bɛ aze.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea Kamɛle Boka ne azo a, mebakpondɛ bɛ meahye bɛ. Saa bɛnriandi bɛkɔfea nyevile ne abo lɔ a, mebamaa ɛwɔlɛ akeka bɛ.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Saa bɛ kpɔvolɛma kye bɛ nuokɛ a, mebamaa bɛahu bɛ. Mezi pi kɛ mesɛkye bɛ, tɛ kɛ meboa bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Awulae, Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fa ɔ sa ka azɛlɛ ye a ɔkpusu, na menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ de zolɛ la di nyane, na maanle ne anu pi na ɔbɔ, kɛ Yigyibiti Azule Naele ne di yitwe la;

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: yemɔ mɔɔ ɔsi ye azua wɔ anwuma, na ɔsi ye ninyɛnezielɛ ɛleka wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo; yemɔ mɔɔ ɔtwe nyevile nu nzule, na ɔmaa ɔtɔ ezule ɔgua azɛlɛ ye azo la, ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yizilayɛma, kɛ mesi medwenle Sudanema anwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medwenle bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nwo a. Menyele Filisitiama menvile Kiliti na menyele Seleama menvile Kɛɛ, kɛmɔ menyele bɛdabɛ noko menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la.

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, melɛnea ɛtane belemgbunli maanle Yizilayɛ, na mebazɛkye ye, meaye ye meavi azɛlɛ ye azo. Noko menrɛzɛkye Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne amuala.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: “Mebaha tumi edwɛkɛ ne na meahegye Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛkɛgye ma la. Mebahegye bɛ meavi maanle maanle avinli na meaye mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la meavi nuhua.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ bɛwɔ me menli ne avinli mɔɔ bɛka kɛ, ‘Nyamenle ɛnrɛmaa munzule biala ɛnrɛdo yɛ’ la badɔ dadeɛ nloa.” Kenlebie Yizilayɛ banyia ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ mebava Devidi belemgbunli maanle ne mɔɔ ɛtete kɛ sua mɔɔ ɛyɛ kpasakpasa la gyinlabelɛ ne meamaa ye bieko. Mebalie ye bane ne mɔ fofolɛ meazie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ, na meakyekye maanle ne fofolɛ meayɛ ye kɛ ye dɛba ne ala la.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Yizilayɛma bava Yidɔm azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛha, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ le me ɛdeɛ la kɔsɔɔti ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.” Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bamaa ɛhye azi la se la ɛne.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea, mekɛ ne ɛlɛba, ” Ɛdɛnkɛma a se a, “abɛlɛ bavievia mralɛ dɔɔnwo abo menli mɔɔ bu la anwo zo, yɛɛ vanye ma bazo abo nwanyeyɛlɛ zo. Nwanye fɛlɛko bazonyi avi awoka ne mɔ azo, na yeaze awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Mebamaa me menli Yizilayɛma eza akpazi, bɛbakyekye bɛ azuadu ne mɔ na bɛadɛnla zolɛ; bɛbayɛ vanye egyinli na bɛanlo nuhua nwanye ne; bɛbayɛ tola na bɛali nuhua ninyɛne.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mebava me menli ne meazie bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛnrɛdu bɛ bieko ɛlɛ; bɛnrɛvi azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la azo.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a se a.

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛze Yidɔmma kɛ, “Nea, mebabɛlɛ bɛ aze wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu, awie biala bakpo bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: Bɛ adubɛnwo ne ɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ. Bɛ mgbole ne mɔɔ bɛlua a bɛka kɛ, kɛmɔ bɛkyekye bɛ suakpole ne bodane zo, na bɛwɔ awoka zo la ati, ‘Awie ɛnrɛhola yɛ ɛhwee yɛ’ la,

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: nea, saa bɛtu bɛkɔ anwuma kɛ kɔleɛ, na bɛyɛ bɛ sane wɔ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ azo bɔbɔ a, mebadwula bɛ aze.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: “Saa nwule ba bɛ nwo zo nɔɔzo a, bɛfa ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛkulo la. Saa menli tete vanye ma a, dahuu bɛgyakyi ekyi. Na bɛmɛ, bɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛkpokpo bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Bɛwie Yisɔ abo zo amra wua bɔkɔɔ, bɛve bɛ anwonyia ne amuala.

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛlɔne nu agɔnwolɛma ɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ, ɛdu bɛ ɛvi bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ nee bɛ le ko la ɛdwazo ɛtia bɛ ɛli bɛ nwo zo konim. Bɛdabɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ ɛvua bɛ ti, na bɛnrɛde ɔ bo ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kenle mɔɔ metea Yidɔmma la, mebazɛkye nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la na meaminliminli ndelebɛbo bo zo wɔ Yisɔ Boka.

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Katakyiema mɔɔ wɔ Timan la ahonle badu, na bɛbahu awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm la. Deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti bɛtea Yidɔmma la

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ mediema Gyekɔbo abo zo amra la ati, bɛbagua bɛdabɛ bɛ nyunlu aze na bɛabɔ bɛ bo zo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ kenle ko ne bɛgyinlanle ɛkɛ ne bɛmanle nyɛvolɛ vole Gyɛlusalɛm sesale zolɛ anwonyia hɔle, na bɛguale nwolɛ nzeleba bɛhyɛle la, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛboka menli ne anwo ala ɛne.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: Saa bɛ mediema ɛnwu bɛ nyunlu a, ɛnee ɔnle kɛ bɛsi bɛ amgbu. Saa bɛlɛsɛkye Dwudama bɛbɔ bɛ bo zo a, ɔnle kɛ bɛgyinla ahane bɛsele bɛ, anzɛɛ bɛtu bɛ nloa anu wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: Saa me menli ne ɛnwu bɛ nyunlu bɔbɔ a, anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛfa ɛlɔnema bɛfo suakpole ne azo, bɛsele bɛ na bɛgolo bɛ nwo, na bɛwua bɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛsia bɛ adenle nu, bɛtua menli mɔɔ nriandi la adenle. Anrɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛye bɛ bɛmaa na bɛmaa bɛnwu amaneɛ. Nyamenle badea maanle maanle ne mɔ

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne asɛɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadea maanle omaanle ne mɔ a. Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ Yidɔmma bɛyɛle la, bɛbayɛ bɛ bie bɛadua, bɛ munzule babɔ bɛ ti.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Bɛhilele me menli ne mɔ nyane wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo Zɔhane ati bɛbahile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti nyane ne bie; bɛbanwu amaneɛ kpalɛ na bɛ bo zo aminli. Yizilayɛma bali konim

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: “Noko Zayɔn Boka azo menli ne bie mɔ bavi ɛsalɛ na ɛkɛ ne bayɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza. Na Gyekɔbo abo zo amra bazia arava bɛ agyadeɛ.

english_verse: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: “Gyekɔbo abo zo amra badɔlɔ kɛ samɛnlakɛ, na Dwosefi abo zo amra azɔ kɛ senle tafinlima. Bɛbayela Yisɔ abo zo amra kɛ mbaka alosinli. Awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha Yisɔ sua nu. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: “Dwuda nyiakɛ amra barava Yisɔ Boka, na menli mɔɔ wɔ adɔleɛ la arava Filisitia maanle ne. Bɛbava Yifelaem nee Samɛlea azɛlɛ ne, na Bɛngyaman abo zo amra ava Geleade.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ nuokɛ wɔ maanle ye sɔlɔ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la bazia arava azɛlɛ ye, ɔvi Fonehyea ahɔkpula Zalɛfate. Nlɔnuma mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛwɔ Sadese la baraho ava azua mɔɔ wɔ Dwuda nyiakɛ la.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Katakyiema bahɔyia Zayɔn Boka, na bɛaho bɛava Yisɔ Boka. Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebali bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli.”

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Kenle ko Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Ametayi ara Dwona kɛ,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Dwona, kɔ suakpole Nenɛvɛ mɔɔ ɛlie duma kpole la azo na kɔbɔ nolo, bɔ bɛ ɛrele zo kɛ menwu bɛ amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Noko Dwona dwazole la ɔyɛle ye adwenle kɛ ɔnriandi Nyamenle yeahɔ Sepeen. Yemɔti ɔhɔle Dwɔpa na ɔnyianle meli bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Sepeen la. Ɔduale ye ɛlɛne kakɛ ne na ɔhɔvole meli ne anu kɛ ɔ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ meli ne anu la kɔ Sepeen, yeaye ɔ nwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle anwoma kpole bie dwazole nyevile ne anye. Ahumu ne dule kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee asɛɛ azudulɛ ne ɛbubu meli ne ɛwie a.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la ahonle dule kpalɛ na awie biala bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtea yeavɛlɛ ye nyamenle ne kɛ ɔlie ye. Bɛvuandinle meli ne anu ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛguale azule nu, amaa meli ne ayɛ felafela. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee Dwona ɛwolo ɛhɔ meli ne abo lɔ na yelafe.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea meli ne azo la hɔdunwuele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a wɔmɔ wɔlafe a? Dwazo na fɛlɛ wɔ nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛsonle ye la. Wɔannea a ɔkɛyɛ kɛ wɔmɔ wɔ nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne se anwunvɔne. Fɛlɛ ye maa ɔlie yɛ na yɛwie wu!”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛgua nzeleba yɛkpondɛ sonla holɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɔlua ɔ ti munzule kpole ɛhye ɛdo yɛ la.” Bɛguale nzeleba ne la, ɔbɔle Dwona.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Na bɛbizale Dwona kɛ, “Yemɔti, wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ munzule kpole ɛhye ɛdo yɛ a? Ka maa yɛdie! Duzu gyima a ɛyɛ a? Ɛvi nienwu? Ɛvi maanle boni anu? Menli boni a ɛvi bɛ nuhua a?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Dwona buale kɛ, “Mele Hibulunli. Mesonle Ɛdɛnkɛma, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la. Yemɔ a ɔbɔle nyevile nee azɛlɛ a.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Na Dwona vale zɔle zolɛ kɛ ɔlɛnriandi Ɛdɛnkɛma. Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Duzu debie a wɔyɛ la?”

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee akee ahumu ne ɛlɛtu kpole kpalɛ. Na bɛbizale Dwona kɛ, “Duzu debie a yɛva yɛyɛ wɔ na ahumu ye agua amaa yɛ a?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Dwona zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa me zo, bɛvuandi me bɛdo nyevile nu na nyevile ne bagua amaa bɛ, ɔluakɛ meze kɛ medame me ti yɛɛ ahumu kpole ɛhye ɛdwazo a.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Na menli ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛka meli ne bɛahɔ aze, noko yeanyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee akee ahumu ne anu ɛza na ɔtia bɛ.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛzele kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛsɛlɛ wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ, mmamaa yɛwu kɛ nrenya ɛhye kɛwu a, yɛɛ mmamaa ye mogya gua yɛ ti zo. Ɔluakɛ, wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ wɔhyehyɛ wɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛdawɔ ɛkulo la a.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Na bɛmanle Dwona zo bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole nyevile ne anu, na ɛkɛ ne ala nyevile ne guale diinyi.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ zulole Ɛdɛnkɛma kpole na bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle ye. Na bɛhanle ndane kɛ bɛkɛzonle Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle fɛlɛ kpole bie ramenle Dwona. Dwona lile kenle kɔkɔlɛ nsa wɔ fɛlɛ ne akunlu.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwona wɔ fɛlɛ ne akunlu la, ɔzunle ɔvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne; ɔzele kɛ,

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: “Munzule kpole dole me, na menzunle menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔdiele me. Mela ewule kuma nu la, menzunle menvɛlɛle wɔ na ɛdele me ne.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛvuandinle me ɛdole buma ne anu, wɔ nyevile kunlu nehane a; mengɔle azule bo na elonra nee azelɛkye mgbole bule vale me ti zo.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, ‘Akee meminli ɛ nye zo ala ɛne, na menrɛnwu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne bieko!’

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Azule ne monlanle me, meminlinle buma ne anu bɔkɔɔ, na nyevile bo ndile bɛkɛbɛkale me.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Menomanle azule kuma ne abo kpalɛ, wɔ awoka ne mɔ abo lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛto sonla anlenkɛ nu a bɛndukue ye ɛlɛ la. Noko wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, ɛyele me ɛvile Kuma ne anu ɛrale ngoane nu.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee me nye zo ɛbulu la, mengakyele, na menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma; me nzɛlɛlɛ dwule ɛ nyunlu wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ amonle ala a bɛsɔ la, bɛmbu wɔ yɛɛ bɛnzonle wɔ.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Na mame, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ, mebabɔ azu meamaa wɔ na meali me ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ mebɔ la azo. Wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a ɛdie ngoane a.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma manle fɛlɛ ne hɔkpule Dwona dole file zo.

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne dwule Dwona anwo zo bieko

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwona, dwazo kɔ Nenɛvɛ, suakpole ne mɔɔ ɛlie duma kpole la azo, na kɔbɔ me edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meva mewula ɛ nloa la nolo.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Na Dwona hɔle Nenɛvɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle hilele ye la. Nenɛvɛ le suakpole kpalɛ mɔɔ sonla fa kenle nsa a fi ɔ ti kɔ ɔ bo a.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Na Dwona bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkɔ sua bɔdenle ne azo. Ɔdiale kenle ko ala na ɔbɔle nolo kɛ, “Yeha kenle abulanla na bɛazɛkye Nenɛvɛ!”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Nenɛvɛ la liele Nyamenle lile. Bɛ muala bɛliele bɛdole nuhua kɛ bɛkeda ɛrele, bɛahye ɛhɔne, mgbolema nee ahoahweabane, bɛ muala bɛhyele ɛhɔne bɛvale bɛhilele kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ belemgbunli ne dele edwɛkɛ ne la, ɔvi ye belemgbunli ebia ne azo ɔdwazole, ɔkpale ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne ɔguale, ɔvale ɛrele ɔhedale, na ɔvale nzonle ɔbɔle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Nyamenle nwunle mɔɔ bɛyɛle la. Ɔnwunle kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛgyakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ. Yemɔti ɔhakyile ye adwenle, na yeammaa munzule kpole ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔmaa yeara bɛ nwo zo la amba.

english_verse: Jonah was really upset and angry.
translation_verse: Ɔrale ye zɛhae la, yeanyɛ Dwona fɛ fee na ɔvale ɛya.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Na ɔzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ mewɔ me sua zo lɔ mɔɔ menganle la, yemɔ a ɛyɛ zɔhane la. Na ɛhye ati noko yɛɛ anrɛɛ menriandi meahɔ Sepeen la. Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle ɛlolɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ se anwunvɔne a. Ɛlɛ abotane, ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpole, yɛɛ ɛ nye ɛnlie munzule nwo.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa menwu, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔwu tɛla kɛ menwɔdɛnla aze a.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma bizale ye kɛ, “Dwona, asoo ɛya kpalɛ a wɔva la?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Dwona hɔle suakpole ne kandiba mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la. Ɔyɛle kpato ɔdɛnlanle ɔ bo na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔnea mɔɔ bazi suakpole ne azo la.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle manle baka fifile hedale Dwona anwo zo, ɔmanle ye alubo, amaa ɔ nwo adɔ ye. Na Dwona anye liele baka ne anwo kpalɛ.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Na aleɛbahye ne, Nyamenle manle nvuba ralile baka ne, na baka ne nwosonle na ɔwule.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne kpogyale ɔ nwo zo la, Nyamenle manle aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu bie bɔle. Na ewia katekate bie vile bɔle Dwona ati mgbandanlama ne azo manle ɔ nwo yɛle ye bɛtɛɛ. Ɛnee akee Dwona akunlu a anrɛɛ yewu. Na ɔhanle kɛ, “Saa menwule bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔle kpalɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle bizale Dwona kɛ, “Asoo ɛya kpalɛ a baka ye mɔɔ ɛwu la ati wɔva la?” Dwona buale kɛ, “Saa menwule bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ mewu.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Dwona kɛ, “Baka ye, mɔɔ wɔmɔ wɔanyɛ nwolɛ ɛhwee biala, tɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛluale a; ɔfifile kenle ko nɔɔzo, na ye alehyenlɛ nu yewu la, yemɔ ɔyɛ wɔ nyane.

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Wɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli Dwɔtam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Maeka mɔɔ vi Molɛhyɛte la. Edwɛkɛ ne fane Samɛlea nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo. Samɛlea nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛzunlɛ nee awolɛyelɛ

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle, bɛ muala bɛdie; bɛdie, O azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti; Awulae Nyamenle badendɛ atia bɛ, Awulae badendɛ avi ye anwuma lɔ sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma vi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la ɔlɛba, ɔbara yearaluolua ewiade awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Awoka ne mɔ baholo ɔ gyakɛ abo, mbɔnza ne mɔ anu badudu ahuma mgbole; bɛbaholo kɛ ɛyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛha senle la, na bɛaze kɛ azule mɔɔ vi boka kyengye zo ɛlɛwola la.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɛladonlɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ bazi a. Yizilayɛma mɛladonlɛ ne a le boni? Asoo tɛ Samɛlea ɔ? Dwudama ɛtane ne mɔ a le boni? Asoo tɛ Gyɛlusalɛm ɔ?

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebazɛkye Samɛlea maanle ne amuala, meahakyi ye ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛ vanye egyinli la. Mebapiepia sua ne azo azua ne awolɛ ne mɔ meahɔgua bɔnza ne anu, na meaza bɛ adiabo ne mɔ meagua zolɛ.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Bɛbabubu ye mmonle ananze ne mɔ dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ, bɛayela mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ wɔ ɛkpabɔlɛ nu la amuala, na meazɛkye bɛ awozonle ananze ne mɔ meayɛ bɛ ewula edukue, ɔluakɛ ɔluale tuutuulilɛ zo a ɔnyianle ɛhye mɔ a, na bɛbava bɛazia bɛahɔmaa menli mɔɔ bɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla la.”

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Na Maeka hanle kɛ, “Ɔlua ɛhye ati mebazu meaye awolɛ, mebakpa me nwo, mealɛ me nwo zɔ, meaye awolɛ kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo ɛzonlɛ, na meali nyane kɛ anloma soholo,

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: Bɛmmaka ye wɔ Gate, bɛmmasu fee; bɛva nzonle bɛbɔ bɛ nwo wɔ Bɛte Lɛyafela.

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Hyeefɛma, bɛva nyiane bɛlɛ bɛ nwo zɔ bɛpɛ nuhua bɛhɔ. Zeeyanema mmaba fee; anrɛɛ Bɛte Yizɛlema ɛzunlɛ kpole ne kɛheda bɛ nwo zo na bɛkɛlie ye gyinlabelɛ ne bɛkɛvi ye ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Mɛlo la ɛlɛkendɛ anyebololɛ nu akpondɛ kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa munzule ɛdo Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Leekehyema, bɛhendɛhenda bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ. Bɛmɛ a bɛlumuale bɛyɛle ɛtane, bɛmanle mɛladonlɛ zanenle Yizilayɛ kɔsɔɔti na Gyɛlusalɛmma yɛle ɛtane a.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛbava ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛamaa Molɛhyɛte Gatema bɛ nee bɛ ali nrɛlaleɛ. Akezebe azua ne mɔ bayɛ mɛlɛbɛla debie amaa Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Malihyaama, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebamaa awie arali bɛ nwo zo konim. Yizilayɛ titilema banriandi ahɔvea Adɛlam.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma, bakpa bɛ ti, bɛbapepɛ bɛ nwo enrinli kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nye die bɛ nwo la ati. Bɛkpa bɛ ti koabekoabe kɛ ɛkpɔtɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye bɛ mra ne mɔ bɛahɔ nlɔnu.”

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ nwo na bɛda bɛ ɛkpa zo bɛbɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo adwenle la. Bɛlɛ tumi la ati, aleɛ kye a bɛyɛ awukade.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye bolo awie mɔ ɛya avule na bɛsa bɛ bɛdie; bɛ nye bolo awie mɔ azua na bɛdie bɛfi bɛ sa nu; bɛsisi awie mɔ bɛdie bɛ agyadeɛ nee bɛ sua nu amra.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebamaa munzule ado menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ kpomgbolo ɛkpolo bɛ kɔme na bɛngola ye ye la. Menli zɔhane ɛnrɛhola tia memaa bɛ bati zo, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne bayɛ munzule mekɛ amaa bɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli bado edwɛne agolo bɛ nwo, na bɛbazu bɛaye awolɛ nyane nyane kɛ, Munzule ɛdo yɛ! Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie yɛ agyadeɛ muala; yemaa yɛ azɛlɛ ne amuala ɛvi yɛ sa, yehyɛ yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye yɛ nuokɛ la.”

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ tendɛ me na bɛse me kɛ, “Mmabɔ zɔhane nolo ne! Ɔnle kɛ awie biala bɔ nolo mɔɔ le zɛhae la. Nyamenle ɛnrɛmaa yɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze.”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: O Yizilayɛma, asoo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka la ɛne? Asoo Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlɛ abotane? Asoo ɔdaye a yeyɛ ɛhye mɔ a? Asoo ye edwɛkɛ ne ɛnle kpalɛ ɛmmaa mɔɔ di boɛ la?

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Noko bɛmɛ bɛyɛ me menli ne kpɔvolɛma; bɛdwazo bɛtia me menli ne; bɛkpolo mɔɔ ɛngulo kpolera la adɛladeɛ, na bɛdie menli mɔɔ se bɛ adenle zo, mɔɔ ɛnlɛ konle adwenle biala la anwo ninyɛne.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛtu me menli ne mɔ mraalɛ wɔ bɛ azua ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ anu, bɛmaa bɛ mra nyilalɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ kenle bie menwɔmaa bɛ la bɔ bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo bɛhɔ, ɛke ɛnle ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle a, ɔboalekɛ bɛva bɛ nwo evinli bɛzɛkye ɛke bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Saa awie duolua nuhua aheha mgbane mgbane, abɔ adalɛ kɛ, “Mebabɔ nwanye nee nza ɛsesebɛ nwo nolo meahile bɛ” a, anrɛɛ yemɔ a ɔkɛyɛ nolobɔvo kpalɛ ɔkɛmaa menli ɛhye mɔ a.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebaboɔboa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nloa, O Yizilayɛma. Mebaboɔboa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la anloa. Mebayɛ bɛ menli ekpunli ko kɛ mboane mɔɔ wɔ tunli nu la. Mebamaa menli ayɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo gbudugbudu kɛ nyɛmoa mɔɔ ɛhɔ adidileka la.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
translation_verse: Na Maeka hanle kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli nee mgbanyima mɔɔ sie Yizilayɛma la, bɛdie! Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdwenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo.

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: Noko bɛmɛ, bɛkyi kpalɛ na bɛkulo ɛtane; bɛye me menli ne nwoma na bɛye bɛ nwonane bɛfi bɛ mbowule nwo.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Mekɛ badwu mɔɔ bɛbadea bɛavɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, na ɔnrɛdɛne bɛ zo. Ɔbava ɔ nye yeavea bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla ɛtane.”

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɛlɛbɛla Nyamenle menli ne minli bɛ. Saa bɛnyia ye bɛdi a ɛnee bɛse, “Anzonudwolɛ!” Awie mɔɔ annyia bie ammaa bɛ la ɛnee bɛzo konle bɛdoa ye. Yemɔti kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne,

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ kpɔmanvolɛma, aleɛ badwo bɛ, bɛnrɛnwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ; awozinli bava bɛ, na bɛnrɛde ɛbizalɛ edwɛkɛ biala. Sɛnzɛne ne badɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ati zo, yɛɛ alehyenlɛ ne bayɛ awozinli ava bɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Na mame, Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne ɛva tumi ɛyi me tɛkɛɛ, yemaa me pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee anwosesebɛ kɛ membɔ Gyɛkɔbo abo zo amra mɛladonlɛ ne nee Yizilayɛma ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la nolo mengile bɛ.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua mgbanyinli nee Yizilayɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ bɛkyi pɛlepɛlelilɛ na bɛdi mɔguazo la, bɛdie ɛhye.

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛfa menli ɛhunlɛ nee nzisi a bɛakyekye Nyamenle suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm a.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Zolɛ mgbanyima die ndoloboa na bɛabua ndɛne, zolɛ sɛlɛvolɛma maa bɛbɔ bɛ ɛkpa na bɛahilehile Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma pɛ bolɛ na bɛaha ɛbizalɛ edwɛkɛ ne. Noko bɛfa bɛ adwenle bɛto kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ lua na bɛka kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma de yɛ avinli. Munzule biala ɛnrɛra yɛ nwo zo.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmɛ ti, bɛbagologolo Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛgolo ɛya la bɛamaa yeayɛ suadu na boka ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zo la ahakyi kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Ɔbara ye kɛ, mekɛ ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu, boka ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la bayɛ boka tendenle adɛla ewiade boka biala. Maanle maanle bapia ara nwolɛ,

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: na menli dɔɔnwo baraha kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne azo, yɛhɔ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne sua nu, amaa yeahilehile yɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ, na yɛalua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu. Ɔluakɛ Zayɔn yɛɛ mɛla ne vi bara a, Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne vi Gyɛlusalɛm a bara a.”

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Ɔbabua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne, ɔbabua maanle mgbole mɔɔ wɔ moa la ndɛne. Bɛbabolo bɛ konle dadeɛ ne mɔ bɛava bɛazo ɛya, bɛbabolo bɛ atwɛ ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛdedadeɛ. Maanle biala ɛnrɛva konle ɛnrɛdoa maanle, yɛɛ bɛnrɛzukoa konle ɛhonlɛ bieko.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Awie biala badɛnla ye vanye egyinli nu, yɛɛ ye feege mbaka bo anzonudwolɛ nu; awie ɛnrɛha bɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔluakɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛdendɛ a.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti di bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ mɛla zo na bɛsonle bɛ, na yɛmɛ, yɛbazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne na yɛali ye mɛla zo dahuu. Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la bazia ara

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ne anu, mebaboɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ medea bɛ la amuala anloa, abuburama nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvoa bɛ bɛmaa bɛhɔ nlɔnu la.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Abuburama ne bayɛ Yizilayɛ abo zo amra mɔɔ ɛha la, na menli ne mɔɔ bɛambu bɛ bie la bayɛ maanle kpole, na Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla Boka Zayɔn na yeazie bɛ, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Na duzu ati a ɛsu kpole zɛhae a? Ɛnlɛ belemgbunli ɔ? Asoo wɔ folɛdulɛma ɛwie wu la ati a ɛlɛte nyane kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la ɔ?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛgyengye bɛ nwo bɛkponle kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la. Ɔluakɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ, bɛvi suakpole ye azo bɛbadu bɛahɔdɛnla namule nu wɔ kpɔkɛ nu. Bɛbahye bɛ bɛahɔ Babelɔn, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma baralie bɛ, yeakpɔne bɛ yeavi bɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu a.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Maanle maanle dɔɔnwo ɛli bɛ nloa ɛvua Gyɛlusalɛm ati; bɛse, “Bɛmaa yɛva yɛ nye yɛzie Gyɛlusalɛm anwo na yɛhɔzɛkye ye.”

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Noko bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma adwenle, bɛnde ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ abo. Bɛnze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa kɛ ma mɔɔ bɛkyekye bɛ avile avile mɔɔ bɛfa bɛahɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka la.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdwazo bɛwozo ma ne na mebamaa bɛ mɛne ne mɔ ayɛ mbulalɛ na bɛ ndwɛlɛ ndaboa ayɛ kɔbele. Bɛbatietia maanle maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo bɛazɛkye bɛ, na bɛadu anwonyia mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye la bɛamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ewiade amuala Awulae.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɔnema, bɛbɛza, na ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia yɛ. Bɛbava baka bɛabɔ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne anzo nu. Nyamenle bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ belemgbunli vi Bɛtelɛhɛm bara

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, O Bɛtelɛhɛm Ɛfelata, ɛle sua ekyi kpalɛ wɔ Dwuda maanle ne anu, noko wɔ nuhua yɛɛ awie vi bara, aragyinla me gyakɛ anu, na yeazie Yizilayɛma amuala a. Ye abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne abo vi tete.”

english_verse: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma baye bɛ amaa bɛ kpɔvolɛma kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la kɛwo la. Ɛhye anzi, ɔ mediema mɔɔ ɛha la bazia ara bɛ maanle nu Yizilayɛ.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Ɔbalua Ɛdɛnkɛma anwosesebɛ zo yeagyinla yeayɛne ye nyɛmoa wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ye Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia nu. Na ye menli ne badɛnla bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔbayɛ sonlakpole wɔ ewiade ɛleka biala.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Na ɛhye bava anzonudwolɛ ara. Ngoanelielɛ nee ndeanlɛ Saa Aseleama fa konle batoa yɛ wɔ yɛ maanle ye anu na bɛfa bɛ gyakɛ bɛtia yɛ azɛlɛ ye azo a, yɛbava mboaneneavolɛma kɛyɛ nsuu nee mgbanyima kɛyɛ mɔtwɛ a yɛaho yɛatia bɛ a.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Bɛbava tumi kpole bɛali Aseleama nee Nemelɔdoma anwo zo konim, na bɛalie yɛ bɛavi Aseleama asa anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva konle bɛkɛradoa yɛ wɔ yɛ maanle ye anu la.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Akee Gyekɔbo abo zo amra mɔɔ hale la bayɛ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛmaa yeadɔ, nee kyɛngyɛne mɔɔ ɛlɛgugua ndile zo la; bɛngendɛ sonla yɛɛ bɛngendɛ awie biala.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Gyekɔbo abo zo amra mɔɔ baha maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la bayɛ kɛ awenade mɔɔ la kpɔkɛ nu nane avinli la; ɔkɔ mboane ne anu, ɔtietia bɛ nwo zo na ɔtete bɛ azinli azinli, yɛɛ awie biala ɛngola bɛ die.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ, ɛ sa bahomo wɔ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo, na bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ wɔ la amuala.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ ne anu mebazɛkye bɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ maanle ne anu azuamgbole ne mɔ na meagologolo bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ amuala meagua.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ ngonyia ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛha ɛbizalɛ edwɛkɛ ɛnrɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye bɛ ananze ne mɔ nee bɛ mpila ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle nwolɛ la, na bɛnrɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛnrɛmaa bɛdabɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima bieko.

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: Mebadudu bɛ bozonle raalɛ Ahyela sɛkɛlɛneɛ mbaka ne mɔ na meazɛkye bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Mebava ɛya kpole kpalɛ meali maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛmbu me la nzenralɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne: Dwazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka wɔ edwɛkɛ ne maa awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ɛde ɛ ne.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ awoka mgbole nee azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ mɔɔ gyi kpundii, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne; Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye menli ne lɛ edwɛkɛ, ɔ nee Yizilayɛ baha ndɛne.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O me menli, duzu a meyɛ bɛ a? Duzu ngyegyelɛ a megyegye bɛ a? Bɛbua me!

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo a rale a, memkpɔnenle bɛ menvile akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu. Memanle Mosisi, Aalɔn, yɛɛ Meleam a lile bɛ ti a.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: O me menli, bɛhakye adwenle mɔɔ Mowabe Belemgbunli Beelake bɔle ye bɛ nwo, nee Biyɔ ara Beelam mualɛ mɔɔ vale manle ye la, na bɛhakye mɔɔ zile Akasea mɔɔ kɔ Gelegale adenle nu la, amaa bɛanwu nyɛleɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mefa medie menli la.” Debie mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Duzu a menva membɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, duzu a menva membanzonle Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la a? Asoo menva nlankɛ ndonrandonra mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ ko menyɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ membɛla ɔ nyunlu?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Asoo Ɛdɛnkɛma anye bazɔ mboane nyinli apenle apenle nee nwole mɔɔ se kɛ azule apenle bulu se la? Asoo menva me belamunli ralɛ mendua me ɛtane ne mɔ anwo kakɛ?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: O sonla, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhile wɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na duzu bieko yɛɛ akee Ɛdɛnkɛma kpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ a? Ɔkulo kɛ ɛdi pɛlepɛle, ɛkile ɛhulolɛ kpundii, na ɛfa mɛlɛbɛnwoaze ɛ nee Nyamenle dua.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Ɔle nrɛlɛbɛ debie bɔkɔɔ kɛ bɛkɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma. Tie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane kɛ ɔlɛfɛlɛ suakpole ne azo amra ɛ? Ɔse, “O abusua ekpunli nee menli mɔɔ ɛyia suakpole ye azo la, bɛdie!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ mebagyakyi sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ amumuyɛ tone ne nee adalɛ ɛzuzudeɛ kodoku ne la ɔ?

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mebɔ ɔ bo kɛ mesɛkye suakpole ne meamaa yeadɔ mgbane wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la ɛtane ne mɔ ati.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Bɛbali debie, na bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi, ɛhɔne bahu bɛ. Bɛnrɛhola ninyɛne fa sie, ɔ muala babɔ asande; yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛkɛva bɛkɛzie la mebamaa ɔ muala aminli konle nu.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Bɛbalua, na bɛnrɛbu; bɛbabua ɔlivi ma, na bɛnrɛva ye nwole ne bie bɛnrɛkpokpa; bɛbabua vanye ma, na bɛnrɛnlo nuhua nwanye ne bie.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Belemgbunli Ɔmelae nee ɔ ra Belemgbunli Ehabe amumuyɛ mɛla ne mɔ nee bɛ folɛdulɛ ne a bɛli zolɛ a, amaa meanyia adenle meayɛ suakpole ne suadu na zolɛ menli kɔsɔɔti anrese. Yemɔti ɛbazoa me menli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ndeanlɛ ne.”

english_verse: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
translation_verse: Abule ɛbu me! Ɔluakɛ meyɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku ye na bɛtete ye wawaa nzoleɛ muala la, vanye ma ɛwie vanye mbaka zo, yɛɛ feege ma mɔɔ ɛlielie la bie ɛnle ɛkɛ na meade bie meazɔ me ɛbolɛ.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle la ɛwie wu, sonlakpalɛ ko bɔbɔ anga menli ne anu. Menli mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti, biala kpondɛ kɛ ɔka mogya ɔgua, yɛɛ ko biala sua ɔ diema ɛhane.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Kpalɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la le kɛ mbowule nyɛma yɛɛ mɔɔ di boɛ la le kɛ mbowuzaka. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛadea bɛ la ɛdwu; kɛkala ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛ adwenle baha abɔ nu.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula mɔɔ ɛ nee ye zua la anu, yɛɛ mmafa wɔ adwenle ɛmaa ɛ gɔnwo. Sinza ɛ nloa wɔ ɛ ye bɔbɔ anwo,

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ralɛ nrenya ɛmbu selɛ bie, ralɛ raalɛ dwazo ninli anwo zo, yɛɛ raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ agyalɛ la dwazo ɔ hu ɔ nli anwo zo; sonla kpɔvolɛma a le ɔdaye ye sua nu amra.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Na mame, mebanlea mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛyɛ la, mebahendɛ me ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne; me Nyamenle ne badie me. Ɛdɛnkɛma die ye menli ne

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: O me kpɔvolɛ, mmadi me nwo zo wulupe. Saa metɔ aze a mebadwazo. Saa metɛnla awozinli nu a Ɛdɛnkɛma bayɛ me kɛnlaneɛ.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Mekponle Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ ne azo, ɔboalekɛ meyɛ ɛtane metia ye. Na nzinlii ɔbanwu me anwunvɔne na yeali me edwɛkɛ yeamaa me. Ɔbava me yeara wienyi nu; mebanwu ye ngoanelielɛ ne.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Akee me kpɔvolɛ ne banwu ye na nyiane bahu mɔɔ hanle hilele me kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” la. Me nye banwu kɛ bɛli bɛ nwo zo konim na bɛtietia bɛ nwo zo kɛ guabile zo ndɛtɛlɛ.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ bɛbalie Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ fofolɛ a. Mekɛ ne anu bɛbadɛlɛ bɛ ɛweɛne ne anu.

english_verse: People will flock to you from Assyria and Egypt, from Babylonia and everywhere else.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛvi Aselea, Yigyibiti nee Azule kpole ne anloa, yɛɛ ɛnwea nee awoka ne mɔ azo bɛbara.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Na azɛlɛ ye amuala badɔ mgbane wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati. Ɛdɛnkɛma banwu Yizilayɛ anwunvɔne

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa wɔ kpɔma ne na nea wɔ menli ne mɔɔ le wɔ agyadeɛ la anwo zo kɛ mboaneneavolɛ ka mboane la. Bɛ ngome bɛwɔ tola bie anu wɔ kpɔkɛ bie anu; maa bɛvinde bɛhɔdidi Beehyan nee Geleade fienemgbole nu, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle ye dɛba ne la.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne kile yɛ, kɛmɔ ɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛyele yɛ ɛvile Yigyibiti la.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu ye na bɛ anwosesebɛ kpole ne anzi, nyiane bahu bɛ. Bɛ nzo badi na bɛava bɛ sa bɛasosɔ bɛ nloa.
