english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Bɛbali ɛnwea kɛ ɛwɔlɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze la, bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛavi bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu bɛavinde, na bɛava sulosulo bɛahakyi bɛ nye Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anwo, na ɛdawɔ ɛ ti, ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Nwane a le Nyamenle kɛ ɛdawɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ɛfa ɛtane ɛkyɛ na ɛmbu wɔ menli Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la mɛladonlɛ nwo mgbonda a? Ɛnva ɛya ɛnga zo, ɔboalekɛ ɛ nye die ɛhulolɛ kpundii nwo.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Ɛbanwu yɛ anwunvɔne bieko, ɛbakpa yɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti wɔagua. Ɛbado yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔagua nyevile kunlu lɔ.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Ɛbahile wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne nee wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ, Gyekɔbo nee Ebileham anwo la wɔ bɛ bo zo amra anwo zo, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbɔle la de la.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye fane Nenɛvɛ anwo. Ɔle Nahum mɔɔ vi Ɛlekɔhye la ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ buluku. Ɛdɛnkɛma fa Nenɛvɛ anwo ɛya

english_verse: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle mɔɔ twe nungule, ɔdi nzenralɛ a; Ɛdɛnkɛma di nzenralɛ yɛɛ ɔfa ɛya; Ɛdɛnkɛma di ye kpɔvolɛma nzenralɛ, yɛɛ ye ɛya wɔ bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, noko ɔlɛ tumi kpole kpalɛ; ɔnrɛmaa mɔɔ di fɔlɛ la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ. Ye adenle la ahumu nee ahumuakyima nu, yɛɛ ɔ gyakɛ abo munlutu a le amungu.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Ɔtea nyevile ɔmaa ɔsesa, ɔmaa azule muala sesa; Beehyan nee Kamɛle azɛlɛ ne mɔ yɛ resee, na Lɛbanɔn ndotolo kpolo gua.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Ɔye ɔ nyunlu a awoka kpusu, awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ kolo. Azɛlɛ ye tɔ mgbane wɔ ɔ nyunlu, ewiade nee nuhua ninyɛne muala yɛ mgbane.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Ɔfa ɛya a, nwane a kɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla a? Nwane a kɛhola ye ɛya kpole ne anloa gyinla a? Ye ɛya sɔ kɛ senle; ɔka bodane a ɔkpukekpuke.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpalɛ, ɔle ɛvealeka wɔ ɛmianlɛ nu; ɔsɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnriandi bɛbatane ye la.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Ɔbava azuyilɛ kpole yeazɛkye ye kpɔvolɛma, yeavoa bɛ, yeaminli bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Duzu akpamo a bɛlɛkɔ ye Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo a? Ɔbamaa ɔ muala abo agua; ɔnli ye kpɔvolɛma nzenralɛ ɔndia nwiɔ.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Bɛyela kɛ mbowule mɔɔ ɛdo ɛsɛka nu, bɛyela kɛ abɛlɛ dosinli.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ, wɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ awie vi ɛra ɛrabɔ amumuyɛ kpɔkɛ ɛtia Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔtu amumuyɛ folɛ a.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛse ye menli Yizilayɛma la ɛne, “Aseleama anwo yɛ se yɛɛ bɛzonle bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbaha bɛ bɛagua na bɛazɛkye bɛ. Memaa nyane ɛha me menli ne, na menrɛmaa bɛnrɛnwu nyane bieko.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Mebaye Aseleama kpomgbolo ne me menli ne akɔme na meabubu Aseleama kpanwu ne mɔ anu.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛli Aseleama anwo mɛla, ɔse, “Bɛ duma ne ɛnrɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Mebazɛkye bɛ mmonle mɔɔ bɛgua nee mɔɔ bɛze mɔɔ wɔ bɛ awozonle azua ne mɔ anu la amuala.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Nea awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, awie nee amaneɛ fɛlɛko ɛlɛba; ɔbɔ anzonudwolɛ nwo nolo! Dwudama, bɛli bɛ ɛvoyia ne mɔ na bɛye bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ, ɔluakɛ amumuyɛma ɛnrɛra bɛ nwo zo bieko; bɛzɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ, kɛ mɔɔ bazɛkye wɔ la ɛra ɛ nwo zo ɛ! Sinza wɔ bane ne mɔ! Sinza wɔ ndenle ne mɔ! Fa wɔ anwosesebɛ muala, bɛza kpalɛ!

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Konle ehwili ne mɔ luolua gua ne mɔ azo, bɛtu bɛkɔ bɛba wɔ ɛleka kpatawienyi ne. Bɛsɔ kɛ tɛkɛ, bɛpɛ fɛlɛ kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Bɛvɛlɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ bɛrayia, bɛlɛkɔ a bɛ gyakɛ kpulokpula. Bɛtu twi bɛkɔ suakpole ne bane ne anwo, bɛhye bɛ nwo ɛhane.

english_verse: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
translation_verse: Bɛdukue azule ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ, alɔbɔlɛ ɛra belemgbunli sua nu.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Bɛhye belemgbunli raalɛ ne nuokɛ bɛhɔ; ye sonvolɛ mraalɛ ɛlɛsu kɛ abubule mralɛ, na bɛbila bɛ kɛnra azo.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ ɛyɛ kɛ nzubula, mɔɔ nuhua nzule se la. Bɛtea nu, “Bɛgyinla, bɛgyinla!” Noko awie ɛndo ɔ nye.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Bɛve dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔ! Bɛve ezukoa nvutuke ne mɔ! Ye anwonyia bo ɛndu ɛlɛ, ɔlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ.

english_verse: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.
translation_verse: Bɛdu Nenɛvɛ bɛfonyia! Bɛgologolo ye! Menli ne ahonle ɛdu; bɛngola gyinla; bɛ nwo wozo bɛ; bɛ nyunlu ɛza.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Na awenade tunli ne wɔ nienwu? Bolɛ bɔne ne mɔɔ awenade mralɛ ne mɔ wɔ nu, mɔɔ awenade ne fa mɔɔ ɔkɛhye ye la kɔ nu, na ɔ mra wɔ nu a bɛnzulo ɛhwee la, wɔ nienwu?

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Awenade ne hunle bie dɔɔnwo manle ɔ mra ne mɔ, ɔlofole bie ɔmanle awenade mbelɛ ne mɔ, ɔsesale mɔɔ yehu bɛ la ɔguale ye bɔne ne anu, ye tunli nu yɛle nane ngome.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nea, mekpo wɔ. Mebayela wɔ konle ehwili ne mɔ, na wɔ awenade ngyikyi ne mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa. Mebaye ɛ nloa anu aleɛ meavi ewiade, na awie ɛnrɛde wɔ soanvolɛma ane bieko.”

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha suakpole ne mɔɔ adalɛ nee ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ la! Anwonyia bɛfe ɛyi ye tɔ.

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Empele mɔɔ ɛlɛsu kpoladada, ehwili ne mɔ anwo alɛra, mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛwuluwulu, nee konle ehwili mɔɔ ɛlɛyieyia nu!

english_verse: cavalry attacking, swords and spears flashing; soldiers stumbling over piles of dead bodies.
translation_verse: Mgbɔnwɔ zo ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ɛbɔ ye zo, dadeɛ nee atwɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛbili fɛlɛfɛlɛ, avunli mɔɔ gua ye yɛlɛdɛdɛ, bɛtietia bɛ nwo zo bɛkɔ bɛba!

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ tuutuu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ bebelebe ne ati ɔ. Ɔfa ye kɛnlɛma, ye ngonyiayelɛ nee tuutuu ɛbɛla ɔkpokpo maanle, ɔfa ye sili ɔkyekye menli.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ, ɔse, “Metia wɔ. Mebakpali wɔ tɛladeɛ meagua ɛ ti zo, meamaa maanle maanle anwu kɛ ɛlɛ ɛ nwo zɔ, na arelemgbunli maanle anwu wɔ anyiemgba.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Mebado ɛ nwo nyɛlɛ, meabu wɔ mgbane, meamaa menli akpolo anlea wɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛnwu wɔ la babɔ mgbatike, na yeaha kɛ, ‘Nenɛvɛ ɛbɔ, nwane a kɛzu ye a? Nienwu yɛɛ mekanyia awie mɔ mɔɔ kɛkyekye ɔ rɛle a?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ, asoo ɛle kpalɛ ɛtɛla suakpole Tibise, Yigyibiti suakpole ne, mɔɔ la azule Naele ne anloa, na azule nee nyevile ɛbɔ ye ɛyia la?

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Sudan nee Yigyibiti le ye anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɛnga aze ɛlɛ a. Pɛɛte nee Lebeya boa ye wɔ konle nu.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Noko bɛhyele zolɛ menli nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu, bɛtetele ngakula mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la anu nzokanzoka wɔ guabile zo. Bɛguale mandimasema mɔɔ wɔ nu la ati nzeleba, na bɛguale ye menli mɔɔ yɛ se la nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Nenɛvɛ, ɛdawɔ noko ɛbabɔ, ɛbanriandi wɔakpondɛ ɛleka wɔavea, wɔavi wɔ kpɔvolɛma anye zo.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Wɔ aranemgbole kɔsɔɔti bayɛ kɛ feege mbaka mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ ɛzo na bɛbolo la; bɛkpusu bɛ a, bɛbakpolo bɛagua bɛamaa didiravolɛ ne.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Nea, wɔ ɛlɔnema ne, bɛ muala bɛle mraalɛ! Bɛbabukebuke wɔ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛamaa wɔ kpɔvolɛma; senle bali nuhua mbulalɛ ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Bɛhwe nzule bɛmaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɔne ɛva bɛ aze la, bɛmiemia bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu! Bɛfɔtɔ ndɛtɛlɛ, bɛtietia ɛva ne azo, bɛva bɛ belekese ɛgualɛ nlɛka ne mɔ!

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Senle ne bava bɛ aze wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛbayia dadeɛ na yeali bɛ kɛ abɛbɛ di nya. Bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛzo, bɛyɛ mɔnwo mɔnwo kɛ abɛbɛ nee kɛlatua!

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Ɛnyianle gualilɛma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ anwo zonle dɛlale anwomanyunlu nwɔlɔra. Bɛle kɛ abɛbɛ, bɛtɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba anu na bɛtu bɛkɔ.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ le kɛ kɛlatua, wɔ suakunlu mbɔlɔba le kɛ abɛbɛ kpolane, maanle nu dwo a, bɛtɛnlɛdɛnla bane ti; saa ewia finde a, ɛnee bɛdu bɛhɔ; awie ɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ bɛkɔ a.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Aselea belemgbunli, wɔ mboaneneavolɛma ɛlafe; wɔ mgbanyima ɛlɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ. Wɔ menli ɛbɔ asande wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔboɔboa bɛ nloa a.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Debie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛyɛ wɔ nganlɛ ayile a, wɔ ɛbodalɛ ne le kpole! Awie biala mɔɔ kɛde wɔ edwɛkɛ la bɔ ɔ sa nu kɛ wɔdɔ aze a, ɔluakɛ awie biala ze wɔ amumuyɛ mɔɔ ɛde la.

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ vale manle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Habakɛke manle ɔvale ɔdole gua la ɛne: Habakɛke bɔ pɛlepɛle mɔɔ menli ɛnli la anwo somolɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, menzu menvɛlɛ wɔ moalɛ ɔhɔdwu kenlenzu na wɔadie me? Anzɛɛ mendeɛdea nu kɛ, “Konle o! Konle o!” na wɔalie yɛ?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a ɛmaa me nye nwu nvonleɛ nee ngyegyelɛ ɛ? Ninyɛne ɛzɛkyelɛ ɛva yɛ aze, yɛɛ konle, mgbonde nee butule ɛlie ebia.

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Ɔlua zolɛ mɛla nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ yɛɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko. Ɔluakɛ amumuyɛma ɛbɔ tenlenema ɛnlo ɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛwie. Ɛdɛnkɛma mualɛ ne

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma buale kɛ “To ɛ nye nea maanle maanle ne mɔ na nea, ɔbayɛ wɔ nwanwane nee azibɛnwo. Ɔluakɛ melɛdi gyima bie wɔ wɔ mekɛ zo mɔɔ saa bɛka bɛkile wɔ a ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛli a.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nea, melɛmaa Babeloniama, maanle anwo ɛzulolɛ, atisesebɛ ne mɔɔ kpɔsa azɛlɛ ye ati nee ɔ bo la ava maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnle bɛ ɛdeɛ la ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ka ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ; bɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee bɛ kpoleyɛlɛ vi bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.
translation_verse: “Konle ala a bɛzo bɛlua a; bɛ ɛlɔnema anwo ka ɛzulolɛ. Menli mɔɔ bɛkye bɛ nuokɛ la zonle kɛ anwea la.

english_verse: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
translation_verse: Bɛmbu arelemgbunli, yɛɛ bɛgolo maamulɛma anwo. Aranemgbole biala ɛndu bɛ ahonle. Bɛkuohua anwea bɛsi ye na bɛgolo ye bɛgua.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Akee bɛtele zolɛ bɛkɔ bɛ nyunlu huu kɛ anwoma la; bɛle menli mɔɔ di fɔlɛ a; bɛ nyamenle a le bɛ anwosesebɛ.” Habakɛke bɔ somolɛ bieko ahile Ɛdɛnkɛma

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: Asoo ɛnle damɛnlangoate ɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, me Nwuanzanwuanza Ko? Yɛnrɛwu. O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Bodane, wɔye Babeloniama kɛ ɛdua bɛ nwo zo wɔadea yɛ, wɔahwe yɛ nzo.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ zolɛ te kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnva ɛnnea ninyɛndane nee ɛtane a. Duzu ati a ɛ nye gyi menli ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la anwo na wɔyɛ koonwu ɛlɛmaa amumuyɛma ye azɛkye tenlenema ɛ?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛyɛ menli kɛ fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu, anzɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze mɔɔ ɛnlɛ mɔɔ sie bɛ la;

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: yɛɛ Babeloniama to bɛ koba, bɛto bɛ avonle, bɛkye bɛ wɔ bɛ nwowie nu, na bɛdi nwolɛ fɛlɛko.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ avonle ne na bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwowie ne, ɔluakɛ bɛlua bɛ nwo zo bɛtɛnla ye anyelielɛ nu na bɛdi aleɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Asoo yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɔ zolɛ dahuu bɛyeye fɛlɛ ne bɛfi avonle ne anu na bɛsɛkye maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ anwunvɔne biala ɔ?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Mebahɔgyinla tawa ne azo meazinza, na meanlea mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛha kɛhile me la, na meanwu nyelebɛnloa mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mefa memaa ye wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ meva medo ɔ nyunlu la anwo.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me kɛ, “Kɛlɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne; kɛlɛ ye wɔ bolɛ ndɛbandɛba zo maa ɔ nye ɛvinde kpalɛ, amaa mɔɔ kɛgenga la adɔ ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛtɛdwule mɔɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne yɛ zɔhane a, noko mekɛ ne ɛlɛbikye, ɔnrɛyɛ adalɛ edwɛkɛ. Saa ɔkyɛ a kendɛ, ɔluakɛ nɔhalɛ nu, ɔbara, ɔnrɛhyɛ fee.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Nea, awie biala mɔɔ ɛnle tenlene la bakpo aze, noko tenlenenli ne balua ye diedi zo anyia ngoane.” Munzule ɛha menli mɔɔ ɛnle tenlene la

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Eza bɛnwu ye kɛ nwanye le ngunzi debie; adubɛnwonli ne ɛngyɛ; ye adidikpoku kpole le kɛ ɛbolɔ, ɔle kɛ ewule la, debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛnza ye. Ɔkuohua maanle maanle muala anloa, na ɔsesa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Asoo menli ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛnrɛhakyi bɛ nwo ɛnrɛbɔ ye aholoba, ɛnrɛzi ye amgbu, na bɛnrɛze kɛ, “Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kuohua mɔɔ ɛnle ye ɛdeɛ la anloa fa yɛ ye ɛdeɛ la. Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɔkɛgyakyi awoba ninyɛne ɛlielɛ a?”

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Asoo menli mɔɔ tua wɔ kakɛ la anye ɛnrɛra bɛ nwo zo ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛdwazo ɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu, ɛnrɛmaa ɛ nwo ɛnrɛwozo wɔ? Akee ɛbayɛ afedeɛ wɔamaa bɛ.

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔwua maanle maanle dɔɔnwo la, maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ anu abo zo amra bɛdabɛ bɛbawua wɔ wɔ mogya mɔɔ wɔha wɔgua nee konle mɔɔ wɔva wɔdoa menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade, wɔzɛkye azuamgbole nee zolɛ menli ne mɔ la ati.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ fa adenle ɛtane zo kpondɛ anyiabɛnwo ba ye awuke nu, maa ye awuke ne yɛ bedevinli na ɔbɔ ɔ nwo bane, amaa awie biala angyegye ye la.

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Wɔva anyiemgba kpole wɔra wɔ awuke nu kɛ wɔzɛkye maanle maanle dɔɔnwo a, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne wɔhwe munzule wɔmaa ɛ nwo.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anu la badea nu avɛlɛ, na aakɔ ne mɔ alie zolɛ.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dua menli ɛhunlɛ zo kyekye sua, na ɔdua ɛtanelilɛ zo ɔkyekye suakpole la.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, asoo tɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa adenle maa menli yɛ gyima maa senle sɛkye ye, na maanle maanle fonla bɛ nwo yɛ gyima mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ la?

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne anwo adwenle bayi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ kɛ nyevile tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ ne anu nzule la.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ noko anyiemgba babia wɔ takaa, ɛnrɛnyia ɛ nyunlu. Ɛdawɔ ɛbanlo, wɔabo na wɔahɔ ye gyigyilii. Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ kpole ne bara ɛ nwo zo, ɔbadea wɔ yeamaa anyiemgba aheda wɔ anyunlunyia zo.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Konle mɔɔ wɔva wɔzɛkye Lɛbanɔn la babu azia wɔ. Nanemgbole mɔɔ wɔhu bɛ la banwunlonwunla wɔ, wɔ menli mɔɔ wɔha bɛ mogya wɔgua, nee konle mɔɔ wɔva wɔdoa ewiade amra, wɔzɛkye azuamgbole nee zolɛ menli kɔsɔɔti la ati.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ ananze mɔɔ sonla ɔdaye yeyɛ la azo a? Ɔle ananze ala, ɔle kilehilevolɛ adalɛ. Dwinvolɛ biala die ananze mɔɔ ɔdaye yeyɛ, mɔɔ ɛndendɛ la di.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛha kɛhile debie mɔɔ bɛva baka bɛze la kɛ, “Dwazo!” na ɔkɛze bolɛ mɔɔ ɛndendɛ la kɛ, “Dwazo!” la. Asoo ɛhye kola ye yekile ɔ? Nea, bɛholo ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwolɛ, noko ɛnwomenle biala ɛnle ye nu.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Nwuanzanwuanza ne anu; bɛmaa aleɛabo amra amuala ɛyɛ koonwu wɔ ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mede wɔ nganeɛ, yɛɛ menwu wɔ gyima ne, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na mesulo. Yɛ ye bieko wɔ yɛ mekɛ zo, da ye ali wienyi wɔ yɛ mekɛ zo; ɛfa ɛya a kakye wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nyamenle vi Yidɔm rale, Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne vi Pɛlan Boka rale. Ye anyunlunyia hedale anwuma amuala, ye ayɛlɛyelɛ yile azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ye wienyi ne le kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye, ɔ sa akunlu ta kɛ sɛnzɛne, na ɛkɛ a ye tumi ne wɔ a.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Ewulenzane li ɔ nyunlu, ewulenzane li ɔ nzi.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Ɔgyinlanle ɔzuzule azɛlɛ ye, ɔnleanle, na maanle maanle ne mɔ kpusule; tete awoka ne mɔ amuala kpukekpukele, tete awoka ngyikyi nwonlonle, ye ndenle ne mɔ le kɛ dɛba ne ala la.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ Kuhyan sua nu amra ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ; Medeanema anwo wozole bɛ.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ɛyele wɔ ɛda mbaka ne ɛvile bɛ boa ne anu, na ɛkponle wɔ ɛda ne. Ɛvale azule ɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ye anu.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Awoka ne mɔ nwunle wɔ na bɛkpusule; azudulɛ ne anu yɛle se; buma hulule na ɔbule azɛlɛkye mgbole.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔle wɔ menli ne mɔ ngoane ɛlielɛ, ɛhɔle kɛ ɛkalie sonla ne mɔɔ wɔkpa nu wɔye ye la. Ɛgelegelele amumuyɛnli ne ati, ɛkpale ɔ nwo, ɔvi ye ɛzɔlɛ nwo ɔdwule ɔ kɔme anwo.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ ɛda mbaka ti ɛwowɔle ye ɛlɔnema kpanyinli ne mɔɔ rale me nwo zo kɛ ahumuakyima batete me la. Bɛvale anyelielɛ bɛrale kɛ bɛbazɛkye me kɛ ehyianli wɔ fealera nu.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Ɛvale wɔ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ɛtietiale nyevile ne anye, na azuamgbole ne mɔ anye yɛle awubue.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Mete na me nwo wozo me, ɔ ne maa me nloa babonle wozo; me nwo golo me, me gyakɛ to bɛka nu. Mebayɛ koonwu meahendɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ kenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle bava adea menli mɔɔ ko fa yɛ la.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Feege mbaka ɛnrɛzo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ma ɛnrɛra vanye mbaka zo, ɔlivi mbaka ɛnrɛzo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ aleɛ ɛnrɛvinde kpɔkɛ nu, mboane ne mɔ amuala bawu bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ nlankɛ adunli ne mɔ badɔ mgbane,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, mebali fɛlɛko, me ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne ati, me nye balie.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Awulae Nyamenle ne le me anwosesebɛ; ɔmaa me gyakɛ nyia anwosesebɛ kɛ weɛlɛ na ɔmaa me nwo yɛ kɔlɔnwo wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Emɔn ara Dwosaya di ebia wɔ Dwuda la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Zɛfanaya. Bɛfɛlɛ Zɛfanaya ɔ ze Kuhyae, Kuhyae ɔ ze a le Gɛdalaya, Gɛdalaya ɔ ze a le Amalaya, yɛɛ Amalaya ɔ ze a le Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya. Ɛdɛnkɛma ndɛnebualɛ kenle ne

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebazɛkye debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Mebazɛkye menli nee nane, nloma mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu nee nyevile nu fɛlɛ kɔsɔɔti. Mebavoa amumuyɛma; mebaye sonla dasanli meavi ewiade. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebahakyi me nzi meazi Dwuda nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala. Mebaminliminli bozonle Beeyale ne nee ye ahɔmenle ne mɔ amuala abo zo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla sua ti zo bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa anwumaneamra, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi amonle bɛkile Ɛdɛnkɛma na eza bɛali amonle bɛahile bozonle Molɛke noko,

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ bɛmkpondɛ ye, yɛɛ bɛmbiza ye ɛkɛ ne edwɛkɛ la, mebazɛkye bɛ muala.”

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ koonwu wɔ Awulae Nyamenle ne anyunlu, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye. Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛde menli mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ la anwo, yeboɔboa azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne anloa yezie ɛkɛ.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma babɔ ye azu ne la, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebadua belemgbunli mgbanyima ne, ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ keda maanle zo ndanlɛ la kakɛ.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane mebadua awie biala mɔɔ wulu ba nwolodo ne anu, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa konle nee nwule ninyɛne bɛyi bɛ menle sua ne tɛkɛɛ la kakɛ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kenle zɔhane, ɛzunlɛ bade Fɛlɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anloa, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua fofolɛ zo la baye awolɛ, yɛɛ konle kpole bazi awoka zo lɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde gua nu lɔ afoa nu la, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ nee bɛ di dwɛtɛ fufule gua la nee bɛ gualilɛma amuala ɛwie wu!

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu mebava kɛnlaneɛ meanleɛnlea Gyɛlusalɛm ahodoka ne mɔ anu kpalɛ, na meadea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ sa yi bɛ nwo a bɛka kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛyɛ debie kpalɛ anzɛɛ ɛtane biala’ la.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Bɛbawua bɛ nwo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ bɛ azua ne mɔ badɔ mgbane. Bɛbasisi azua, na bɛnrɛdɛnla nuhua; bɛbahye vanye tola, na bɛnrɛnlo nuhua nwanye.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle kpole ne ɛbikye. Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, yebikye kpalɛ. Ɛzunlɛ mɔɔ bade Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne la bayɛ alɔbɔlɛ, ɔluakɛ kenle zɔhane, katakyiema bazu alɔbɔlɛ ɛzunlɛ.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane le ɛya kenle, nyane nee abodelɛ kenle, ɛzɛkyelɛ nee ewule kenle, awozinli nee alɔbɔlɛ kenle, yɛɛ amungu nee awozinli kabii kenle.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebamaa nyane aha menli na bɛavuovua kɛ anyenzinlirama, ɔboalekɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia me. Bɛbahwi bɛ mogya bɛagua kɛ nzule, bɛ nwonane bakpɔlɔ.”

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kenle ne anu. Ewiade amuala bayela wee wɔ ye ɛya senle ne anu, ɔluakɛ ɔbazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la arɛlevilɛ nu.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: kolaa na bɛakpoa bɛ bɛagua kɛ ewula. Bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kpole ne ara bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛyɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛze bɛ la, bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛyɛ mɔɔ le tenlene na bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze kɛ wɔannea a bɛkɛheda bɛ nwo zo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya kenle ne anu. Maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua Yizilayɛ la ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Gaza bayɛ suadu yɛɛ Ahyekɛlɔn badɔ mgbane. Sɛnzɛnegyinla yɛɛ Ahyedɔdoma bagua ɛbɔ nu na Ɛkelɔn abɔ tɔɔ a. Emɔ

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Kɛlɛte maanle nu, mɔɔ bɛde nyevile ne anloa la, bɛ gyakɔ! Filisitiama mɔɔ de Keena azɛlɛ zo, Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne tia bɛ. Ɔse, “Mebazɛkye bɛ bɔkɔɔ; sonla ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha.”

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ Dwudama mɔɔ ɛha la ɛdeɛ; ɛkɛ ne a bɛ mboane badidi a. Aleɛ dwo a bɛbadeda Ahyekɛlɔnoma azua ne mɔ anu. Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne banlea bɛ nwo zo na yeamaa bɛakpazi bieko.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne se, “Menwu kɛ Mowabema ɛlɛsi agolo me menli ne anwo, nee Amɔnoma aholoba mɔɔ ɛlɛbɔ bɛ, yɛɛ ɛnwunlonwunlanlɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛnwunlonwunla bɛ wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne anwo la. Emɔ

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati meka meka kɛ, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Ɛdɛnkɛma la, Mowabe bayɛ kɛ Sodɔm na Amɔn ayɛ kɛ Gomɔla. Azɛlɛ ne azo bafifi ndile, ayɛ ngyenle ahuma, na yeadɔ mgbane mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Me menli ne mɔɔ ɛha la bahɔve bɛ ninyɛne, na me menli mɔɔ anwu la bava bɛ azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Bɛ mgbanyizonle ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle, mgbane mgbane mɔɔ bɛhanle, yɛɛ amgbu mɔɔ bɛzile Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma menli ne la anwo ahatualɛ mɔɔ bɛbanyia ye la ɛne.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ bali ye ɛsesebɛ. Ɔbazɛkye azɛlɛ ye azo awozonle ne mɔ amuala, na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bazonle ye wɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ Sudanema noko, bɛbadɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dadeɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma badende ɔ sa ɛbɔ nu afoa nu na yeazɛkye Aselea, na Nenɛvɛ adɔ mgbane, zolɛ awe kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Mboane, nlankɛ nee nane ngakyile, ɛkpɔtɛ nee ɛzonlɛ mɔ bava bɛ maanle ne azuamgbole ne mɔ ayɛ bɛ alaleɛ. Kpadule bavea azua ne mɔ anu, na bɛ ɛzunlɛ balielie nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ ye sida mbaka mgbunla ne mɔ anwo bala ɛkɛ.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne mɔɔ memanle ɔ nwo zo, dwenlenle kɛ ɔ nwo ɛdɔ ye na ɔhanle kɛ, “Medame ɛne, awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ” la, ɛyɛ suadu bɔkɔɔ, yehakyi ɛleka mɔɔ nanemgbole da die bɛ ɛnwomenle a. Awie biala mɔɔ pɛ nuhua ɛkɛ la tea nu na ɔkpusu ɔ ti.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha sua ne mɔɔ nzisima nee atuadelɛma mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la a wɔ zolɛ la.

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Bɛndie awie biala edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛkyi bɛ nyunlu ɛhwilɛ. Bɛnva bɛ rɛle bɛnwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu, yɛɛ bɛndwe bɛmbikye bɛ Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Bɛ mgbanyima le kɛ awenade mɔɔ ɛlɛkpo la; bɛ ndɛnebuavolɛma le kɛ nɔɔzo bedi; bɛdi a bɛtu ɔ bo, mɔɔ aleɛ kahye la, ɛnee bie ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma le menli mgbane; bɛnli nɔhalɛ. Bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma fa evinli ka ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne, na bɛtietia mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Noko Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ de bɛ avinli la di pɛlepɛle, ɔnli ɛtane. Nwonlomɔ biala ɔkile ye pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne, yɛɛ ɔmaa alehyenlɛ kpalɛ to bɛ dahuu; noko akee menli agbamgbanvolɛ ne ɛnze nyiane deɛ holɛ.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebɔ maanle maanle megua, mebubu bɛ konle ɛleka ɛsesebɛ ne mɔ amuala. Memaa bɛ gua ne mɔ azo ɛdɔ mgbane, awie biala ɛnva zolɛ. Bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ɛbɔ; awie ko anga, kyɛkyɛ, awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnde zolɛ.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Menganle kɛ, ‘Nɔhalɛ, ɔbazulo me na yealie me ndeanlɛ ne. Akee bɛnrɛzɛkye ye azua ne mɔ, nee mɔɔ meva memaa ye la amuala.’ Noko bɛmɛ, debie biala anu bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati bɛhendɛ me bɛmaa ɔhɔdwu kenle mɔɔ menwɔdwazo bɛ nwo zo la. Mebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ meboɔboa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti nee bɛ arelemgbunli anloa meawola me ɛya kpole ne meagua bɛ nwo zo. Ɔluakɛ me ɛya kpole ne senle ne bayela ewiade amuala yeamaa yeadɔ nzonle.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu mebade me menli ne anloa meamaa bɛadendɛ ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ anwo te la, amaa bɛ muala bɛadea bɛavɛlɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛabɔ nu bɛazonle me.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle me, me menli ne mɔɔ ɛzande la vi Sudan azule ne anzi lɔ bava bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne arɛlɛ me.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛnrɛgua bɛ nyunlu aze kɛ bɛyɛle ɛtane bɛtiale me a, ɔboalekɛ mebaye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die bɛ ngome bɛ kpoleyɛlɛ nwo la meavi bɛ avinli. Bɛnrɛha mgbole wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mebagyakyi menli mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze na bɛ nwo dwo la. Bɛbakpondɛ ɛvealeka wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne anu.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɛnrɛyɛ ɛtane; bɛnrɛbɔ adalɛ bɛnrɛbɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛbadidi na bɛala koonwu, awie ɛnrɛnwunlonwunla bɛ.” Anyelielɛ edwɛne

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: O Zayɔnoma, bɛdo edwɛne; O Yizilayɛma, bɛdea nu! Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛli fɛlɛko, O Gyɛlusalɛmma!

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye wɔ ndeanlɛ ne ɛvi ɛkɛ, yevoa wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne. Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli ne, nee bɛ de; bɛnrɛzulo munzule bieko.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛbaha bɛahile Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ, “Zayɔn, mmasulo; mmamaa ɛ sa nu to.

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ Nyamenle ne, nee wɔ de; ɔle katakyie mɔɔ maa ɛdi konim a. Ɔ nye balie ɛ nwo fɛlɛkolilɛ nu, ɔbava ye ɛhulolɛ yeakpɔda wɔ monle; yeava edwɛndolɛ yeamaa ɔ nye alie ɛ nwo,

english_verse: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
translation_verse: kɛ awie mɔɔ ɛlɛto ɛkponle la.” Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebakpa bɛ nwo munzule meagua, amaa awie andea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu me nee menli mɔɔ sisile bɛ la bali. Mebalie abuburama, na meaboɔboa menli mɔɔ bɛmbu bɛ bie la anloa; mebahakyi bɛ anyiemgba ne ayɛlɛyelɛ, nee enililɛ wɔ ewiade ye amuala anu.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa, me nee bɛ ara sua nu; mebamaa menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la ali bɛ eni aye bɛ ayɛlɛ, na bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma bɛanwu kɛ meva bɛ anwonyia ne amuala merɛlɛ bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Pɛhyea Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ ebia zo la, ye siane nsia ne azo, kenle ne mɔɔ lumua la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hagae. Hagae hanle nrɛlaleɛ ne hilele Dwuda amɛnlado ne, Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlubabɛle nee Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne, Gyɛhɔzeedake ara Dwɔhyua.

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Bɛlua ma dɔɔnwo, na bɛbu ekyi bie; bɛdi debie, noko bɛ ko ɛnyi; bɛno nwanye, noko bɛmbo; bɛkeda ndanlɛ, noko bɛ nwo ɛnyɛ wuluwulu, yɛɛ mɔɔ die ahatualɛ la die ezukoa ne gua kodoku mɔɔ abo le tokule la anu.

english_verse: Think about what I have said!
translation_verse: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛnlea kɛ bɛwie ye a.

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ bɛhɔva mbaka bɛrazi sua ne, amaa me nye alie nuhua, na meala me anyunlunyia ne ali wɔ nuhua. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: “Bɛ nye la kɛ bɛ bɛyɔba kɛzo dɔɔnwo, noko ekyi bie a bɛnyianle ye a; eza mɔɔ bɛ nee ye rale sua nu la, membɔle menguale. Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebiza bɛ kɛ duzu ati ɔ? Ɔboalekɛ bɛgyakyi me sua ne bɛmaa yeyɛ ewula na bɛmɛ, bɛ nuhua ko biala anye ɛbolo ɛlɛsi sua ala nuhua.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati a ezule ɛndɔ na azɛlɛ ɛngye aleɛ ɛmmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Eza meyɛ kɛ ezule mmatɔ mbɔnza ne mɔ anu nee awoka ne mɔ azo ɔmaa bɛnyia ma fofolɛ, nwanye, nwole, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ azɛlɛ ne maa bɛ la, menli nee nyɛmoa nee bɛ sa anloa gyima biala.” Menli ne tie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee Zɛlubabɛle nee Dwɔhyua nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ hale la amuala diele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane, na bɛlile ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Hagae, mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne zoanle ye manle ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ la azo. Na menli ne zulole Ɛdɛnkɛma.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔfoɔ ne, Hagae, hanle Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne hilele menli ne. Ɔse, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nee bɛ lua.”

english_verse: So the Lord God All-Powerful made everyone eager to work on his temple, especially Zerubbabel and Joshua.
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma hanle Dwuda Amɛnlado Zɛlubabɛle, Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Dwɔhyua, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti ahonle manle bɛrayɛle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nyamenle ne Sua ne anwo gyima.

english_verse: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle ɔ bo wɔ siane nsia ne anu, kenle abulanwiɔ nee nna ne azo.

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Akee tendɛ kile Hyialeteɛle ara Zɛlubabɛle, Dwuda amɛnlado ne, Gyɛhɔzeedake ara Dwɔhyua, Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la amuala na biza bɛ kɛ:

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: kɛmɔ menvale membɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvile Yigyibiti la. Me Sunsum ne nee bɛ de; bɛmmasulo.

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: “Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, mebamaa anwuma, azɛlɛ nee nyevile akpusu bieko, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: Eza mebakpusu maanle maanle ne mɔ meamaa bɛ anwonyia ne mɔ apɛ arali ɛke, na meamaa Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye anu ayɛ kɛnlɛma kpalɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Amozi sua ɛdeɛ ne bayɛ kɛnlɛma kpole kpalɛ adɛla alumua ɛdeɛ ne, na ɛke yɛɛ mebamaa me menli ne akpazi a, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne nee sɛlɛvolɛma fa adwenle

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Biza sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ maa bɛye kpuyia ɛhye anloa.

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: ‘Saa awie fa nane azinli mɔɔ le nwuanzanwuanza la gua ye tɛladeɛ nu, na ɔfa tɛladeɛ ne ɔka kpanwo, subue, nwanye anzɛɛ aleɛ ngakyile biala a, ɛnee aleɛ zɔhane anwo ɛde ɛyɛ nwuanzanwuanza ɔ?’ ” Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ buale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Na Hagae bizale bɛ kɛ, “Saa awie mɔɔ ɛva ɔ sa ɛha funli na ɔ nwo ɛnde la fa ɔ sa ka ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bie a, ɔmaa ɔyɛ aleɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la ɔ?” Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔyɛ aleɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la.”

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Na Hagae zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ nee maanle ɛhye de wɔ me nyunlu a, yɛɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima biala anwo ɛnde. Debie biala mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa kɛ bɛva bɛbɔ azu la anwo ɛnde.’ ” Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbayila menli ne

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne ala, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Hagae bieko.

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Menvale anwoma anu wuluwulu, adubue, yɛɛ ezuawolɛ menzɛkyele bɛ nee debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛle la, noko bɛanzia bɛamba me nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle nwolɛ bɛvi ɛnɛ kenle ye mɔɔ le siane ngɔnla ye kenle abulanwiɔ nee nna la azo. Bɛdwenle nwolɛ bɛvi kenle ne mɔɔ bɛwulale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adiabo ne aze la azo.

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: Asoo ma tɛbɔ bonwolo zo? Asoo bɛ vanye mbaka, feege mbaka, bɛ ma ne mɔɔ le kɛ akutue, yɛɛ bɛ ɔlivi mbaka ne mɔ ɛnzo ɔ? Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la mebayila bɛ.” Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ Zɛlubabɛle ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Ka kile Dwuda Amɛnlado Zɛlubabɛle kɛ, ɔnrɛhyɛ biala mebakpusu anwuma nee aze,

english_verse: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, mebava ɛdawɔ Zɛlubabɛle, me akɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛ ze a le Hyialeteɛle la, na meayɛ wɔ kɛ belemgbunli kpɔdelera, ɔluakɛ mekpa nu meye wɔ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse nyianle ɛvolɛ nwiɔ wɔ Pɛhyea ebia ne azo la, ye siane mɔtwɛ ne anu, Ɛdɛnkɛma rale Bɛlikaya ara Zɛkalaya, mɔɔ le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, na ɔ nlenya a le Yedo la anwo ɛkɛ

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Bɛzia bɛrɛla me nwo ɛke na medame mebazia meara bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ kɛ bɛ ze mɔ, mɔɔ alumua Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ bɔle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ ne nolo hilele bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛvi bɛ ninyɛndane nwo’ a bɛandie yɛɛ bɛanyɛ la.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ ze mɔ zɔhane, bɛwɔ nienwu? Yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma zɔhane mɔ, asoo bɛtɛte aze?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Noko me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ menvale menzoanle me sonvolɛma kpɔmanvolɛma la ɛhyɛ ɛdɛla bɛ ze mɔ. Yemɔti bɛnlunle bɛ nwo na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma zile hyehyɛle kɛ ɔ nee yɛ di wɔ yɛ ndenle nee yɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔ nee yɛ ɛli a.’ ” Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mgbɔnwɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: “Nɔe ne, menwunle kɛ nrenya bie de ɛkpɔnwɔ kɔkɔlɛ zo. Menwunle kɛ ɔgyi ‘mɛtele’ mbaka bie anu wɔ bɔnza bie anu, na ɔ nzi ɛkɛ ne, mgbɔnwɔ kɔkɔlɛ, ndetandeta, yɛɛ fufule gyigyi ɛkɛ.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Na membizale ye kɛ, ‘Me menle, na ɛhye mɔ noko ɛ?’ “Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne nee me dendɛle na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Mebahile wɔ deɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛde la.’

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Na nrenya ne mɔɔ gyi ‘mɛtele’ mbaka ne mɔ avinli la buale kɛ, ‘Ɛhye mɔ a Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzoa bɛ kɛ bɛrakpɔla azɛlɛ ye la.’

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: “Na bɛbuale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ gyi ‘mɛtele’ mbaka ne mɔ avinli la kɛ, ‘Yɛkpɔla aleɛabo amuala, na yɛnwu kɛ ewiade ye amuala ɛlɛdie ye ɛnwomenle.’

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee me dendɛle la hanle hilele me kɛ, ‘Tea nu ka kɛ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Metwe Gyɛlusalɛm nee Zayɔn anwo nungule kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: Meva maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo ɛya kpole kpalɛ kɛ bɛmɛ bɛ nwo ɛdɔ bɛ a. Ɔluakɛ saa mame meva me menli ne anwo ɛya ekyii bie a, akee bɛmɛ bɛmaa munzule ne ɛyɛ kpole.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, mezia mera Gyɛlusalɛm, na me nee anwunvɔnezelɛ a ɛra a. Bɛbazi me Sua ne wɔ zolɛ, na bɛbava ɛzuzudeɛ ne bɛado Gyɛlusalɛm anwo.’

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: “Eza Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele me kɛ, ‘Tea nuhua bieko ka kɛ: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, me azuamgbole ne mɔ azo bayɛ gbudugbudu bieko. Menli ne bakpazi, na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mebakyekye Zayɔn arɛle bieko na eza meakpa nu meaye Gyɛlusalɛm.’ ” Mɛne ne mɔ anwo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Akee memanle me nye zo na menwunle mɛne nna.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: Na membizale kɛ, “Na ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛba arayɛ duzu?” Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le mɛne ne mɔɔ bɔle Dwudama asande mɔɔ yemɔti awie angola ammaa ɔ ti zo la. Na dwinvolɛma ɛhye mɔ ɛra kɛ bɛbanwunlonwunla bɛ, na bɛazɛkye maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ dwazole Dwuda anwo zo kɛ bɛsɛkye ye la tumi ne.”

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo na menwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ lɛ ɛzuzulɛ nyɛma ɔ sa nu la.

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Na membizale ye kɛ, “Ɛkɔ nienwu?” Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Mekazuzu Gyɛlusalɛm, meanwu ye tendenle nee ye tɛtɛlɛ.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Na nea, Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ dendɛle hilele me la rale, na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko noko rayiale ye

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Nriandi, kɔha kile kpavolɛ ne kɛ, ‘Gyɛlusalɛm bayɛ gbudugbudu kɛ namunamu mɔɔ bɛanlie nwolɛ bane la, ɔboalekɛ zolɛ menli bazo, yɛɛ zolɛ nyɛmoa bazo.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Mebayɛ kɛ senle bane meabɔ ye mgbɔlɔka meayia, na meadɛnla ɛkɛ ne anyunlunyia nu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.’ ” Bɛvɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la kɛ bɛrɛla sua nu

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Hɛe! Hɛe! Bɛnriandi bɛvi sɔlɔ nehane. Membɔle bɛ asande menguale maanɔne, ɛleka biala mɔɔ anwuma anwoma fane nna ne kɛhola bɛ fa kɔ la.

english_verse: Leave Babylonia and hurry back to Zion.”
translation_verse: Hɛe! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Babelonia la, bɛnriandi bɛrɛla Gyɛlusalɛm.”

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye yɛɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale zoanle me wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ rawuale bɛ la anu a, ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ sa kɛha bɛ la ɛva ɔ nye kuduarizi ne ɛwɔ baka zo.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnlea, mebava me sa meanwɔha bɛ ti zo ala, na bɛbayɛ ɛvedeɛ bɛamaa menli mɔɔ zonlenle bɛ la.” Saa ɛhye si a yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛzoa me a.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: O bɛmɛ Gyɛlusalɛmma, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdo edwɛne na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie. Bɛnlea, melɛba na mearadɛnla bɛ avinli.”

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bava bɛ nwo amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛayɛ ye menli. Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla bɛ avinli na bɛanwu kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛzoa me a.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bava Dwuda ayɛ ye ɛdeɛ wɔ azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, na yeanlea nu yeaye Gyɛlusalɛm bieko kɛ ye ɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛyɛ koonwu wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, ɔluakɛ yemaa ɔ nwo zo wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma vale Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Dwɔhyua hilele me. Ɔgyi Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne anyunlu ɛkɛ na Seetan gyi ɔ sa fema zo kɛ ɔto ye ɛzonle.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne zele Seetan kɛ, “O Seetan! Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdua wɔ kakɛ! Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnlea nu ɛye Gyɛlusalɛm ɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ la ɛdua wɔ kakɛ! Asoo tɛ ɛyɛzinli a wɔdu wɔvi senle nu la?”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyigyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la kɛ, “Bɛyeye adɛladeɛ evinli ɛtane ne mɔ ɔ nwo.” Akee ɔhanle ɔhilele Dwɔhyua kɛ, “Nea, meye wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti mevi ɛ nwo, na mebava adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma meawula wɔ.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, “Maa bɛbɔ ye abɔtile kɛnlɛma.” Yemɔti bɛbɔle ye abɔtile kɛnlɛma na bɛwulale ye adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma; ɛnee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne gyi ɛkɛ ɛlɛnea yɛ.

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: “Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se: Saa ɛdua me ndenle ne mɔ anu na ɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ meva memaa wɔ la a, ɛbanlea me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu ɛke na wɔanlea me awuke ne mɔ azo, na meamaa wɔ adenle wɔ menli mɔɔ gyi ɛke la avinli.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Akee tie, Dwɔhyua, wɔmɔ a ɛle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli a, ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ dede ɛ nyunlu ɛke la amuala, bɛdie, ɔboalekɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ saleɛ doa bɛ a. Mebaye me sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Baka Ɛhane la meahile bɛ!

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, meva bolɛ mezie Dwɔhyua anyunlu ɛkɛ. Ɔle bolɛ kokye mɔɔ anye le nsuu a, na zolɛ yɛɛ mebahɛlɛ a, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Mebaye azɛlɛ ɛhye fɔlɛlilɛ ne amuala kenle kokye.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane, bɛ nuhua ko biala bado ɛsalɛ avɛlɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔɔ ɔ nee ye zua la wɔ ye vanye baka nee ye feege baka bo, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee me dendɛle la rale bieko, na ɔradunwuele me kɛ asɛɛ sonla bie mɔɔ wɔ nafelɛ nu la.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Na ɔbizale me kɛ, “Duzu a ɛnwu ye a?” Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛbaka, dwora gyi zolɛ, na ahɛnlaneɛ nsuu gyigyi zolɛ. Kɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ gyigyi kɛnlaneɛbaka ne azo la, ko biala anloa nsuu.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Ɔlivi mbaka nwiɔ noko gyigyi nwolɛ. Ko wɔ dwora ne fema zo yɛɛ ko wɔ ye bɛne zo.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlɛka ahile Zɛlubabɛle la ɛne: Tɛ anwosesebɛ anzɛɛ tumi, na me Sunsum ne yɛɛ ɛbava wɔali konim a, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: O awoka mgbole, bɛle duzu? Zɛlubabɛle badwulu bɛ yeamaa bɛayɛ kɛ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ; akee mɔɔ ɔkɛze kɛ ɔfa bolɛ ne mɔɔ la zolɛ anwuma la yeara la ɛnee bɛlɛtea nu kɛ, ‘Kɛnlɛmaleɛ! Ɔle kɛnlɛma somaa!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: ɔse, “Zɛlubabɛle ɛwula sua ɛhye adiabo ne aze; ɔbazi yeawie. Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛzoa wɔ bɛ nwo ɛke a.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛkpo mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ ninyɛne ngyikyi ngyikyi la bali fɛlɛko, na ɔbanwu kɛ Zɛlubabɛle gua zolɛ ɛlɛsi sua ne. “Ahɛnlaneɛ nsuu ɛhye mɔ a le Ɛdɛnkɛma anye ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔnea ewiade amuala la.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Membizale ye kɛ, “Na ɔlivi mbaka nwiɔ ɛhye mɔɔ ko gyi kɛnlaneɛbaka ne fema zo, ko gyi ye bɛne zo la abo a le duzu?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Eza membizale ye kɛ, “Na ɔlivi mbaka ngane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ gua ezukoa nvutuke paepe nwiɔ ne mɔɔ nwole dua nu finde gua la anwo la noko abo a le duzu.”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Na ɔbizale me kɛ, “Ɛnde ɛhye abo ɔ?” Membuale ye kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, me menle, mende ɔ bo.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le menli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛkpokpa bɛ nwole na bɛgyi ewiade amra amuala Awulae anwo ɛkɛ ne la.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Eza memanle me nye zo, na menwunle nwoma mɔɔ ɛdu faa la.

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne bizale me kɛ, “Duzu a ɛnwu ye a?” Membuale ye kɛ, “Menwu nwoma mɔɔ ɛdu faa la; ye tendenle le mita ngɔnla yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nna nee foa ko.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele me kɛ, “Munzule mɔɔ bahɔ ewiade amuala la wɔ nwoma ɛhye azo. Bɛhɛlɛ zolɛ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ awule la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu ye bɛfi azɛlɛ ne azo, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛha ndane adalɛ la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtu ye bɛfi azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se ɔbazoa ye yeamaa yeawolo awule awuke biala nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ye duma bɛka ndane adalɛ la biala awuke nu, na ɔbadɛnla ɛkɛ ne toonwo kɔkpula kɛ sua zɔhane kɛyɛ suadu, na nuhua mbaka nee awolɛ kɛgologolo kɛgua la.” Raalɛ ne mɔɔ de kɛndɛne ne anu la

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee me dendɛle la razele me kɛ, “Maa ɛ nye zo na nea debie mɔɔ ɛlɛse ahɔ la.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Membizale ye kɛ, “Duzu debie ɔ?” Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Kɛndɛne ne a ɛlɛse la.” Ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɔgyi ɛkɛ ne ɔmaa ewiade amra amuala ɛtane ne.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Kɛndɛne ne lɛ sumi nduazo; bɛdukuele zolɛ, na ɛnee raalɛ bie de nuhua.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Raalɛ ɛhye gyi ɛkɛ ne maa amumuyɛ.” Akee ɔzuhunle ye ɔdole kɛndɛne ne anu na ɔhanle sumi nduazo ne ɔdole zolɛ.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo bieko la menwunle kɛ mraalɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ kɛ anloma akoso ɛdeɛ ne la ɛdu faa ɛlɛba, na anwoma ne ɛlɛbɔ bɛ bo. Bɛramanle kɛndɛne ne zo bɛhɔle anwuma.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Membizale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kɛ, “Na bɛfa kɛndɛne ne bɛahɔ nienwu?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Bɛfa bɛahɔ Babelonia. Bɛbazi sua ɛkɛ bɛamaa ye. Bɛbava kɛndɛne ne bɛazie sua ne anu na bɛazonle ye.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Eza memanle me nye zo na menwunle kɛ konle ehwili nna vi awoka nwiɔ avinli ɛlɛba. Awoka ne mɔ le kɔbele awoka.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Konle ehwili ne mɔɔ lumua la, mgbɔnwɔ kɔkɔlɛ a ɛlɛtwe ye a. Mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ le bile,

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ le fufule, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ le nzonle anwo ndetandeta.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Na membizale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nee me dendɛle la kɛ, “Me menle, na ɛhye mɔ noko ɛ?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne buale kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ hɔvale bɛ nwo hilele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle azɛlɛ ye la, na kɛkala bɛlɛkɔ anwuma anwoma nna ne anu.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Konle ehwili ne mɔɔ mgbɔnwɔ bile ne mɔ ɛlɛtwe ye la kɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu maanle ne anu, wɔ Babelonia, mɔɔ mgbɔnwɔ fufule ne mɔ ɛlɛtwe ye la kɔ adɔleɛ afoa nu maanle ne anu, yɛɛ mɔɔ mgbɔnwɔ nzonle anwo ndetandeta ne mɔ ɛlɛtwe ye la kɔ nyiakɛ afoa nu maanle ne anu.”

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Mgbɔnwɔ nzonle anwo ndetandeta ne mɔ vindele rale la, ɛnee bɛngola gyinla fee; ɛhɔlɛ ala yɛɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɔ na bɛkɔkpɔla azɛlɛ ye a. Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ ɛ, bɛhɔkpɔla azɛlɛ ye.” Yemɔti bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkakpɔla azɛlɛ ye.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne deanle nu zele me kɛ, “Nea, mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la ɛmaa me Sunsum ne akunlu ɛdwo ɛbɔ nu afoa nu maanle ne anwo.” Nyamenle se bɛzoa Dwɔhyua belemgbunli kyɛlɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Die dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke fi Hɛledae, Tobaegya, yɛɛ Gyɛdaya mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu na bɛvi Babelonia bɛra la ɛkɛ ne, na kenle ko ne ala fa kɔ Zɛfanaya ara Dwosaya sua nu. Fa dwɛtɛ fufule ne nee ezukoa nvutuke ne yɛ belemgbunli kyɛlɛ na fa soa Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Dwɔhyua, Gyɛhɔzadake ara nrenya ne,

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a ɔbazi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a, na bɛbali ye eni kɛ belemgbunli. Ɔbadɛnla ye belemgbunli ebia nu na yeazie ye menli ne. Ɔbanyia sɛlɛvolɛ ko wɔ ye belemgbunli ebia ne anwo, na bɛdabɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nloa bazɛ bɛ nwo anzonudwolɛ nu.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli kyɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛkpa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ɛlɛ, na ɔbayɛ ngakyelɛdeɛ yeamaa Hɛledae, Tobaegya, Gyɛdaya, yɛɛ Zɛfanaya ara Dwosaya.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Menli mɔɔ wɔ moa moa la baraboa Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛzilɛ; na bɛbanwu kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛzoa me bɛ nwo a. Saa bɛtie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ane na bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa ye a, bɛbanwu kɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala bazi.”

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli Dalayɛse lile ɛvolɛ nna wɔ Pɛhyea ebia zo la, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele Zɛkalaya wɔ siane ngɔnla ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Kyeselɛve” la ye kenle nna ne azo.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: na bɛbiza sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Yɛli nyane na yɛhye ɛhɔne wɔ siane nnu ne anu, kɛmɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la yɛyɛ ye la ɔ?”

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdi, bɛanlo la, asoo mame me ti ɔ? Se bɛlile, bɛnlonle bɛmanle bɛ nwo!

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Gyɛlusalɛm le gbudugbudu na awie biala asa ɛyia ɔ nwo, mɔɔ ɛnee azuamgbole ɛbɔ ɛyia ye, na ye nyiakɛ nee ye adɔleɛ ndololeɛ nu kɔsɔɔti le menli ngome la, Ɛdɛnkɛma ammaa ye alumua kpɔmanvolɛma ambɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ nolo angile bɛ ɔ?” Anzosesebɛyɛlɛ ahatualɛ a le nlɔnuhɔlɛ

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mese: Bɛbua ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu, bɛyɛ ahunlunyele na bɛze bɛ nwo anwunvɔne ngoko ngoko;

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: bɛmmasisi ahunlanvolɛ, menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ ze mɔ, nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ ehyianvolɛma; yɛɛ bɛ biala mmafa ɔ diema anwo adwenle ɛtane.”

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Bɛboɔboale bɛsolole, amaa bɛandie Nyamenle mɛla ne nee edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛzoa ye Sunsum ne yemaa yelua ye alumua kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo yeha yehile bɛ la. Zɔhane ati Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale ɛya kpole,

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: na ɔhanle kɛ, “Kɛmɔ menvɛlɛle na bɛandie la, bɛdabɛ bɛvɛlɛle la, medame noko meandie.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
