translation_verse: Membɔle bɛ asande wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ la anu. Na azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgyakyile ye bɛ nzi la lale ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ awie ɛngɔ, ɛmba zolɛ a, na azɛlɛ kɛnlɛma ne dɔle mgbane.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me.

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, metwe Gyɛlusalɛm anwo nungule kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ mefa ɛya a metwe ɔ nwo nungule ne a.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Mebazia meahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, mebahɔ meahɔdɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm avinli, na bɛbavɛlɛ Gyɛlusalɛm nɔhalɛ suakpole, na bɛavɛlɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Boka ne Boka Nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Mrenya mrelera nee mraalɛ mrelera eza badɛnlɛdɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm gua ne mɔ azo, ko biala bava kpɔma a adia a, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ ɛrelera.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Na medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebiza kɛ: Saa ɔyɛ azibɛnwo ɔmaa bɛdabɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛha la bɛ nye zo wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ medame noko azibɛnwo ɔ?

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Bɛnlea, mebalie me menli ne meavi adɔleɛ nee aduduleɛ maanle ne mɔ anu,

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: na meava bɛ meara meamaa bɛaradɛnla Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ nee tenleneyɛlɛ nu.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ bɛavi me kpɔmanvolɛma anloa la, bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ, kɛmɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwula Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne aze la bɛnyianle la, amaa bɛahola bɛazi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnee mekɛ zɔhane ɛtɛdwule la, bɛmbɔ awie ɛkpa bɛndua ye kakɛ yɛɛ bɛmbɔ awie nane ɛkpa bɛndua ye kakɛ, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnva ɔ nwo kɔlɔnwo ɛngɔ ɛmba wɔ ye kpɔvolɛma asa anu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee meye ɛkpɔlɛ medo awie biala nee ɔ gɔnwo avinli.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala me nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la ɛnrɛli ye kɛ mɔɔ alumua ne me nee bɛ lile la, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Bɛbalua bɛ aleɛ anzonudwolɛ nu; vanye mbaka bazo, na azɛlɛ ne amaa bɛ aleɛ ahye, yɛɛ ɛbɔlɛ badɔ amaa bɛ. Mebamaa menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo amra mɔɔ ɛha la anyia ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ bɛyɛ amowa ɛfenle wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli la, zɔhane ala, O Dwuuma nee Yizilayɛma, yɛɛ mebalie bɛ na bɛayɛ nyilalɛ bɛamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ a. Yemɔti bɛmmasulo, na bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ hanle me ɛya la, menyianle adwenle kɛ me nee bɛ di ye ɛtane zo, na amgba noko menyɛle.

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, menyia adwenle bieko kɛ mekɛ ɛhye anu meyɛ boɛ meamaa Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwudama amuala. Yemɔti bɛmmasulo.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la ɛne: Bɛha nɔhalɛ bɛhile bɛ nwo ngoko, bɛyia nu a bɛbua ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu na bɛmaa anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo adwenle ɛtane, yɛɛ bɛmmadie ndane adalɛ biala bɛto nu, ɔluakɛ mekyi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me, ɔse,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mese: Ɛhɔne ne mɔɔ bɛkye ye siane nna ne, siane nnu ne, siane nsuu ne yɛɛ siane bulu ne mɔ anu la bayɛ anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ mekɛ amaa Dwudama na bɛado ɛkponle anyelielɛ nu. Yemɔti bɛhulo nɔhalɛ nee anzonudwolɛ.”

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli dɔɔnwo bara;

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: menli vi azuamgbole dɔɔnwo azo bahɔ azuamgbole zo ahɔze kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa yɛha yɛ nwo waa yɛhɔ yɛhɔzɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma na yɛzonle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma. Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛhɔ.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle mɔɔ anwo yɛ se nee menli ngakyile ngakyile barakpondɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo bɛazonle ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛazɛlɛ ye moalɛ.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu mrenya bulu vi maanle maanle ne mɔ nee aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ anu barazɔ Dwuunli tɛladeɛ nu na bɛaha kɛ, ‘Maa yɛ nee wɔ ɛhɔ, ɔluakɛ yɛde kɛ Nyamenle nee bɛ lua.’ ”

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tayama ɛzi aranemgbole na bɛboɔboa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke nloa edukue edukue kɛ gua zo ndɛtɛlɛ.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole Ahyekɛlɔn azo la banwu ɛhye, na ɛzulolɛ baha bɛ. Gazama banwu ye, na bɛ nwo bafofo bɛ. Ɛkelɔnoma noko banwu ye, na bɛanwu kɛ bɛ anyelazo muala ɛwie. Gaza belemgbunli ne bawu, yɛɛ Ahyekɛlɔn bayɛ kulofenle . Emɔ

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Menli ngakyile baradɛnla Ahyedɔdo; na Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa Filisitiama adubɛnwo ne abɔ aze.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛnrɛli nane mɔɔ mogya wɔ nu nee bɛkyi aleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdi la bieko. Menli mɔɔ baha la bayɛ me menli; bɛbayɛ kɛ abusua ekpulike wɔ Dwuda, yɛɛ Ɛkelɔnoma bayɛ kɛ Gyibɛsema la.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Akee mebadɛnla me sua ne anyunlu kɛ sinzavolɛ, amaa awie biala andia kilikili anze ɛkɛ. Awie ɛnrɛsisi bɛ bieko, ɔluakɛ medame me nye nwiɔ ɛnwu nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛnwu ye la.” Kenlebie belemgbunli ne

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: O Zayɔnoma, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie! O Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdea nu kpole kpalɛ! Bɛnlea, bɛ belemgbunli ne ɛlɛba bɛ ɛkɛ; ɔlɛba ye konimlilɛ nu. Ɔle bɛlɛvo yɛɛ ɔde asoaso zo, asoaso ralɛ zo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebabubu Yifelaem konle ehwili ne mɔ na meaye bɛ konle mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Mebabubu bɛ konle ɛda ne mɔ anu, na ɔbamaa anzonudwolɛ aha maanle maanle ne mɔ. Ye belemgbunlililɛ badwu ɛnwea ɛnwea, ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa yeahɔdwu ewiade awieleɛ.” Nyamenle menli ne sia ayɛ kɛ bɛ dɛba ne la

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛmɔ me nee wɔ ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛva azubɔlɛ mogya bɛzɔ ɔ nloa la ati, mebadwula wɔ menli ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la, mebaye bɛ meavi kuma ne mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nu la anu.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Bɛzia bɛrɛla bɛ ɛvealeka ne, O bɛmɛ pilizama mɔɔ bɛlɛ anyelazo a, ɛnɛ meka meahile bɛ kɛ, debie biala mɔɔ bɛminli ye la, mebamaa bɛanyia ye mɔnwo.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meva Dwuda meyɛ me ɛda mekpo. meva Yizilayɛ meyɛ me ɛda mbaka. O Zayɔn, mebado bɛ mra mrenya kɛ dadeɛ, meava meaha Gilikima senle, na meanwɔha bɛ kɛ kovolɛ dadeɛ.”

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bavinde bɛ ti zo anwuma; ɔbatoto ye ɛda ne kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye; Awulae Nyamenle ne babɔ aweɛne tendenle ne anu, na yealua nyiakɛ ahumuakyima ne anu yeara.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bawowa bɛ; bɛbahu totoabɔma ne bɛatietia bɛ nwo zo. Bɛbayɛ begyebegye kɛ asɛɛ bɛbo nza; bɛbaha bɛ kpɔvolɛma mogya bɛagua, yeazonyi kɛ asɛɛ ɔgyi kɔpo nu na bɛlɛwola bɛagua azukponle ne mgbɛne zo.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne balie bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle ye menli. Bɛle kɛ belemgbunli abɔtile zo mgbɔba, bɛbada ye azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, azɛlɛ ne bayɛ kpalɛ, ayɛ kɛnlɛma! Zolɛ abɛlɛ nee nwanye fofolɛ bamaa zolɛ mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra anyia anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Bɛbiza Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ ɔmaa ezule ɛdɔ wɔ nyenyensuo mekɛ nu. Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa anwomanyunlu yɛ dukuduku na ɔtɔ ezule ɔmaa menli, na ɔmaa awie biala egyinli kye a.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Mmonle ananze ne mɔ ka ngoaseasɛm, ngonyiama bɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ka ɛlalɛ la nwu adalɛ yekile, bɛfa bɛbɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛakyekye bɛ rɛle. Zɔhane ati menli ne duolua nuhua kɛ mboane; bɛnwu amaneɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ neavolɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Meva mboaneneavolɛma ne mɔ anwo ɛya kpole, na mebadea mgbanyima ne mɔ. Ɔluakɛ medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mebanlea me mboane ne, mɔɔ le Dwuda abo zo amra ne, na mebayɛ bɛ me konle mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ a.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua yɛɛ menli vi bara arabu maanle ne, arayɛ maanle mgbanyima nee safohyenlema na bɛazie me menli ne a.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ nuhua a, bɛbayɛ menli anwo ɛzulolɛ wɔ konle nu, bɛatietia bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo. Bɛbaho ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee bɛ lua, na bɛbali kpɔvolɛ konlema ne mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la anwo zo konim.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: “Mebamaa Dwudama anwo ayɛ se, yɛɛ mebalie Dwosefi sua nu amra. Mebanwu bɛ anwunvɔne, na me nee bɛ kɔsɔɔti azia ara sua nu. Bɛbayɛ kɛ asɛɛ metɛkpole bɛ, ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a, mebadie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Yifelaemma bayɛ kɛ katakyiema, na bɛali fɛlɛko kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlo nza la. Bɛ mra banwu ye na bɛ nye alie, na bɛali fɛlɛko wɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: “Mebavɛlɛ bɛ na meaboɔboa bɛ nloa, ɔluakɛ melie bɛ, na bɛ nwo bazo kɛ dɛba ne la.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Mendele bɛ memkpondenle maanle maanle avinli bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko wɔ moa moa maanle ne mɔ anu lɔ, bɛbahakye me, na bɛ nee bɛ mra bɛbadɛnla ngoane nu na bɛazia bɛara.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Me nee bɛ vi Yigyibiti nee Aselea bazia ara sua nu. Mebava bɛ meahɔgua Geleade nee Lɛbanɔn azɛlɛ zo, bɛbava azɛlɛ ne amuala, noko ɔnrɛza bɛ.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Bɛbalua ngyegyelɛ nyevile nu, na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebabɔ nyevile azɛlɛkye ne mɔ, na Azule Naele ne basesa, awe resee. Aselea adubɛnloanu ne baha aze, na Yigyibiti tumi ne bavi ɔ sa.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma me ti, mebamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se; bɛbazonle me na bɛadie me ne.” Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛdendɛ a.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: O Lɛbanɔnoma, bɛbukebuke bɛ nlenkɛ ne mɔ, amaa senle ne ayela bɛ sida mbaka ne mɔ!

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Sepelɛse mbaka, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, na sida mbaka ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ ɛzɛkye! Beehyan oku mbaka, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛzo kpɔkɛmile ne bɔkɔɔ!

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Bɛdie, mboaneneavolɛma ɛlɛsu ye awolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ anyunlunyia ɛdɔ aze! Bɛdie, awenade ne mɔ ɛlɛkpo, ɔluakɛ Dwɔdan kpɔkɛmile ne ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ! Mboaneneavolɛma nwiɔ ne

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle ne zele me kɛ, “Yɛ mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la neavolɛ.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ tɔ la ku bɛ fa bɛ nwo dwɔɔ kɔ, awie ɛnze bɛ ɛhwee, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ tɔne bɛ la ka kɛ, ‘Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, menyia me nwo;’ yɛɛ bɛ neavolɛma mumua ne ɛnze bɛ anwunvɔne.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti menyɛle mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ bɛamaa menli mɔɔ di mboane awule gua la neavolɛ. Menvale agbɔma nwiɔ; mendonle ko “Ɛlolɛ” yɛɛ ko ne noko mendonle ye “Koyɛlɛ”.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Akee menyɛnenle mboane ne mɔ. Siane ko anu, menzɛkyele mboaneneavolɛma nsa. Me kunlu andwo bɛ nwo fee, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛangulo me edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti menganle kɛ, “Menrɛyɛ bɛ neavolɛ. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwu la, bɛmaa ɔwu; mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsɛkye ye la, bɛzɛkye ye na bɛgyakyi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la bɛmaa bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛkeka bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko bɛli.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Akee menvale me kpɔma ne mɔɔ medo ye “Ɛlolɛ” la na membubule nu, menvale menzɛkyele ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛkyekye la.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mentulule ngyekyeleɛ ne kenle ko ne, na nwule ne mɔ mɔɔ di mboane gua, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛnea me la nwunle kɛ ɔle Ɛdɛnkɛma anloa edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Fa kɔgua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya ne anu.” Yemɔti menvale dwɛtɛ fufule ne, ezukoa kpole ne mɔɔ bɛdua bɛmaa me la mengɔnguale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gya ne anu.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Akee membubule me kpɔma ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ, mɔɔ medo ye “Koyɛlɛ” la anu mengilele kɛ mezɛkye mediemayɛlɛ mɔɔ la Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ avinli la.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Eza fa mboaneneavolɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnzonle bolɛ la.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nea, melɛmaa mboaneneavolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛndwenle mboane mɔɔ ɛlɛwu la anwo, ɔmkpondɛ mɔɔ ɛminli la, ɔnyɛ mɔɔ ɛboda la ayile, yɛɛ ɔmmaa mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ la aleɛ la ara. Ye ɛdeɛ ne a le kɛ, ɔbali mboane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɔ la, yeafufo bɛ mbowule nu.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Me mboaneneavolɛ mgbane zɔhane, mɔɔ kpo me mboane ne mɔ la, ye gyakɔ! Bɛbapepɛ ɔ sa wɔ konle nu na bɛadu ɔ nye fema ne. Ɔ sa badwe, yɛɛ ɔ nye fema ne bazi bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ fane Yizilayɛma anwo la ɛne: Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle anwuma, ɔbɔle azɛlɛ, na ɔbɔle sonla sunsum mɔɔ wɔ ye nu la se,

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Mebayɛ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ kɔpo mɔɔ nwanye ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la; maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua ye la baranlo bie na bɛabo kɛ tandi. Saa bɛfa ɛlɔnema bɛbabɛnra bɛyia Gyɛlusalɛm a, ɛnee bɛbɛnra bɛyia Dwuda azuamgbole kɔsɔɔti noko.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, mebamaa Gyɛlusalɛm ayɛ kɛ bolɛ ɛnlomboɛ yeamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ ɛhɔne kɛ bɛmaa ye zo la babodɛboda. Azɛlɛ ye azo maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti baboɔboa bɛ nloa atia ye.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, mebamaa ɛkpɔnwɔ biala anye zo ada ye na mɔɔ ka la agyibi. Na Dwudama ɛdeɛ, saa memaa maanle maanle ne mɔ mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ anye si a, mebabuke me nye na meanlea bɛ.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Na akee Dwuda mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ baha ahile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nyamenle ne ati, Gyɛlusalɛm lɛ anwosesebɛ.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu mebamaa Dwuda mbusua ekpulike ekpulike ne mɔ adɔlɔ woonwu kɛ siase mɔɔ gyi senle zo wɔ mbaka avinli, bɛayɛ kɛ tɛkɛ mɔɔ la nya avinli ɛlɛsɔ la. Bɛbazɛkye menli mɔɔ wɔ bɛ bɛne zo nee bɛ fema zo la amuala, na Gyɛlusalɛmma ɛdeɛ, bɛbadɛnla bɛ bo zo ne ala, wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebamaa Dwuda ɛlɔnema alumua ali konim, amaa Devidi abo zo amra nee Gyɛlusalɛmma annyia bɛ nyunlu andɛla Dwudama.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu mebawowa Gyɛlusalɛmma, amaa mɔɔ anwo ɛngyinla ye fee bɔbɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la anwo ayɛ se kɛ Devidi. Devidi abo zo amra bayɛ kɛ Nyamenle; bɛbayɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ bɛali menli ne ati.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Na mekɛ ne anu maanle biala mɔɔ kɛra Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo la, mebazɛkye ye.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “Mebamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne nee Gyɛlusalɛmma aze anwunvɔne dɔɔnwo, na bɛanyia sunsum mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, amaa bɛnea sonla mɔɔ bɛboda ye la a bɛali nyane bɛamaa ye, kɛmɔ sonla su ɔ ra nrenya kokye mɔɔ ɔlɛ na ɔkɛwu la; bɛbazu ye kɛ sonla mɔɔ ye belamunli ralɛ kɛwu na ɔlɛsu ye la.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu nyanelilɛ mɔɔ bara Gyɛlusalɛm la bayɛ kɛ nyane ne mɔɔ bɛlile wɔ Heedadelemɔn mɔɔ wɔ Mɛgedo fienemgbole nu la.

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ ne anu bɛbabuke nzufeanvea bɛava bɛanrinzi Devidi abo zo amra nee Gyɛlusalɛmma amuala ɛtane nee evinli biala bɛagua.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, mebaminliminli mmonle mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu nee bɛ aluma kɔsɔɔti abo zo, amaa bɛangakye bɛ bieko; eza mebadu kpɔmanvolɛma adalɛ nee sunsum ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti meavi azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Na saa awie biala finde kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ a, ɔ ze nee ɔ nli mɔɔ wole ye la baze ye kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku wɔ, ɔluakɛ ɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ɛbɔ adalɛ.’ Na ɔ ze nee ɔ nli bawɔ ye atwɛ ahu ye nee ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala mɔɔ baha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ, yeaha ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ edwɛkɛ la baze nwolɛ nyiane. Ɔnrɛva ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo ye futuu la ɔnrɛheda ɔ ti zo ɔnrɛbɛlɛbɛla menli.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Ɔbaha kɛ, ‘Menle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, mele ɛyazonlɛnli, ɔluakɛ sumunli me ngakula nu ɛbɔ nu egyinli ala a meyɛ a.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Na saa awie biza ye kɛ, ‘Na nganlɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛ nzi la noko ɛ?’ a, ɔbaha kɛ, ‘Bɛle nganlɛ mɔɔ me gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ mengɔle bɛ sua nu la bɔle me a.’ ” Nyamenle se bɛhu ye mboaneneavolɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwazo, konle dadeɛ, dwazo ku me mboaneneavolɛ ne, ku ahenle ne mɔɔ gyi me nwo ɛke la. Bɔ mboaneneavolɛ ne ku ye maa mboane ne mɔ ɛbɔ asande. Medame mebava me sa meazie ngyikyi ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, azɛlɛ ye amuala, mebahyɛ nu nsa na meazɛkye nwiɔ, meaminli bɛ bo zo. Nuhua ɛkpɔ ko ala a baha a.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Ekpunli ko ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa bɔbɔ la, mebagua bɛ senle nu meadu bɛ nuhua, kɛmɔ bɛtu dwɛtɛ fufule nu la, na meazɔ bɛ meanlea, kɛmɔ bɛsɔ ezukoa nvutuke bɛnea la. Bɛbabɔ me duma bɛavɛlɛ me, na mebalie bɛ zo. Mebaha kɛ, ‘Bɛle me menli’ na bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma le me Nyamenle.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Bɛdie, Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba, mɔɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛrawua wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la bɛbahyɛ wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛke ala.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Mebaboɔboa maanle maanle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anloa meamaa bɛ nee Gyɛlusalɛm aho na bɛava suakpole ne. Bɛbave bɛ ninyɛne na bɛafunlofunla bɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ. Bɛbahye suakpole ne azo amra foa ko bɛahɔ nlɔnu, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la, bɛbadɛnla ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bahɔ na ɔ nee maanle maanle ne mɔ ahɔho, kɛmɔ ɔyɛ a konle nu ɔyɛ la.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɔbava ɔ gyakɛ yeazie Ɔlivi Boka ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm aduduleɛ la azo, na boka ne bakpuke nwiɔ, ɔvi aduduleɛ yeahɔdɔ adɔleɛ, yeaye bɔnza tɛtɛlɛ kpalɛ yeado ɛkɛ; ɛhye bamaa boka ne foa ko ahɔli sɔlɔ na foa ko arali nyiakɛ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Bɛbanriandi bɛahɔ me awoka ne mɔ bɔnza ne anu, ɔluakɛ bɔnza ne anu badɛlɛ toonwo adwu Ezɛle. Bɛbanriandi, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ nriandile azɛlɛkpusulɛ mekɛ ne anu wɔ Dwuda Belemgbunli Ɛzaya mekɛ zo la. Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne bara, na ɔ nee Nyamenle menli ne mɔ amuala ara.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Kenle zɔhane, wuluwulu ɛnrɛra yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ ɛnrɛra.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Ɔbayɛ kenle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ala a ɔze a. Aleɛ ɛnrɛdwo na aleɛ ahye, ɔluakɛ aledwolɛ bayɛ wienyi kɛ alehyenlɛ la.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, ngoane nzule bazenze avi Gyɛlusalɛm, foa ko bazenze ahɔgua aduduleɛ nyevile ne anu na foa ko noko ahɔgua adɔleɛ nyevile ne anu. Fɔsɛlɛ nu o, wawaa nu o, kɛ ɔsi ɔsenze la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbazenze mekɛ biala a.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma bali azɛlɛ ye kɔsɔɔti azo belemgbunli; mekɛ ne anu awie biala bazonle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle kokye ne a yɛɛ ye duma ko.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Akee ewule mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bava ado maanle maanle mɔɔ kɛva konle kɛdoa Gyɛlusalɛm la anwo la ɛne: bɛ nwonane bakpɔlɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la, bɛ nye bakpɔlɔ bɛ nye mbɔne ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ bɛ tafinlima bakpɔlɔ bɛ nloa anu.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa sulosulo adɔ bɛ nwo na bɛ nye zo ada bɛ, amaa bɛadwazo bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo zo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Akee awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛra Gyɛlusalɛm anwo zo ɛlɛ la anu, mɔɔ kɛvi ɛsalɛ la bahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛvolɛ biala ahɔzonle Belemgbunli ne, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na yeali ye Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na saa azɛlɛ ye azo abusua ekpulike bie wɔ ɛkɛ na yeangɔ Gyɛlusalɛm yeangɔnzonle Belemgbunli ne, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a, ezule ɛnrɛdɔ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a bayɛ Yigyibitima nee maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ kɛkpo na bɛangɔnli Kpɔda Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne la ndeanlɛ a.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: yɛɛ siase biala mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Dwuda la, bɛbadu bɛazie ahane bɛamaa Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛra kɛ bɛbabɔ azu la ava ado bɛ azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne. Awie ɛnrɛli gua wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ mekɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mehulo bɛ.” Noko bɛmɛ bɛse, “Kɛ wɔzi wɔhulo yɛ ɛ?” Ɛdɛnkɛma biza bɛ kɛ, “Asoo tɛ Yisɔ adiema a le Gyekɔbo? Noko mehulo Gyekɔbo, Emɔ

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: na mekpɔ Yisɔ. Memaa ye awoka zo azɛlɛ ɛhakyi ɛsɛlɛ na meva ye agyadeɛ muala mewula ɛsɛlɛ zo boboduma ne mɔ asa anu.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Saa Yidɔmma ka kɛ, “Bɛzɛkye yɛ maanle ye bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko yɛbazia yɛakyekye ye fofolɛ” a, ɛnee kɛ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne, “Bɛbakyekye bɛ azua ne mɔ, na mebagologolo bɛ meagua. Bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne ‘Amumuyɛ Azɛlɛ’ na bɛavɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne ‘Menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva bɛ nwo ɛya mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.’ ”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛbanwu ye bɛ nye zo na bɛaha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ anzi lɔ!” Ɛdɛnkɛma twi sɛlɛvolɛma anyunlu

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma biza bɛ kɛ, “Ralɛ di ɔ ze eni yɛɛ akɛlɛ di ɔ menle eni. Na saa mele bɛ ze a, ɛnee eni mɔɔ bɛdi me la a le boni? Yɛɛ saa mele bɛ menle a, ɛnee ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo me la wɔ nienwu? Bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma bɔbɔ yɛɛ bɛsɛkye me duma a. Noko bɛmɛ bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛzi yɛzɛkye wɔ duma ɛ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Bɛfa aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la bɛgua me azukponle zo. Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Kɛ yɛzi yɛgua ɛ nwo evinli ɛ?’ Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne bɔbɔ, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi ye eni.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle bɛmaa ɔ nye ɛlie yɛ nwo na ɔlo yɛ. Asoo bɛnea a ɔkɛlie bɛ sa nu azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la?

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Anrɛɛ bɛ nuhua ko ahɔtoto Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu amaa bɛanzɔ senle wɔ me azukponle ne azo mgbane mgbane. Me kunlu ɛndwo bɛ nwo yɛɛ menrɛlie bɛ sa nu azubɔdeɛ biala.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Me duma le kpole wɔ maanle maanle avinli ɔvi sɛnzɛne aduduleɛ kɔdwu adɔleɛ. Ɛleka biala bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ na bɛfa azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ anwo te la bɛmaa me, ɔluakɛ me duma ne le kpole wɔ maanle maanle avinli.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛka kɛ ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne anwo ɛnde yɛɛ kpanwo ne ɛnle kpalɛ’ a ɛnee bɛgua azukponle ne anwo evinli.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Duzu ɛvɛlɛ a le ɛhye?’ Bɛka ɛhye na bɛakpobi bɛ nloa. “Saa bɛbabɔ azu a bɛfa nane mɔɔ bɛwuale, anzɛɛ ɛbubu anzɛɛ ewule ɛha ye la a bɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛbɛlɛ me a. Asoo medie ɛhye a ɔyɛ boɛ?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha nzisi sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ boane nyinli wɔ ye nyɛmoa nu, ɔkɛva ɔkɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ, na akee ɔkɛva ɛtane bie ɔkɛrabɔ azu ɔkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la, ɔluakɛ mele belemgbunli kpole, yɛɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti sulo me.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Akee bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛ mɛla a le ɛhye:

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Saa bɛnrɛdie me edwɛkɛ, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛzie bɛ ahonle nu kɛ bɛwula me duma ne anyunlunyia a, mebamaa munzule ara bɛ nwo zo na meamaa bɛ nyilalɛ ahakyi munzule. Nɔhalɛ, memaa bɛ nyilalɛ ɛhakyi munzule dɛbadɛba, ɔboalekɛ bɛambu me edwɛkɛ ne bie.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Mebahwi bɛ bo zo amra anyunlu, na meava bɛ azubɔlɛ nane ne mɔ ebinli meakpuda bɛ nyunlu, na meaye bɛ meavi me nye zo.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ɛhye yɛɛ bamaa bɛanwu kɛ medame yɛɛ meva mɛla ɛhye memaa bɛ a, amaa ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee Livae yɛkyekyele la anzɛkye.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: “Ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee ye yɛle la le ngoane nee anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ, yɛɛ menvale memanle ye amaa yeazulo, yɛɛ ɔzulole me noko. Ɔte me duma a, ɔ nwo wozo ye.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Ye ngilehilelɛ le fɔɔnwo yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ biala. Ɔ nee me luale anzonudwolɛ nu na ɔbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ la, na ɔmanle menli dɔɔnwo gyakyile ɛtaneyɛlɛ.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ndelebɛbo finde sɛlɛvolɛ biala anloa edwɛkɛ nu, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ menli fa ɛzukoalɛdeɛ wɔ ye ɛdendɛlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ ɔle Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: “Noko bɛmɛ, bɛvi adenle ɛhye azo bɛye bɛ nwo yɛɛ bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ bɛmaa menli dɔɔnwo ɛdu koti; bɛtulu ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee Livae kyekyele la.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese, meye bɛ nyunlu nwoma mɔɔ awie biala ɛmbu bɛ a, amaa bɛagua bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ menli nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlua me adenle ne anu bɛangilehile; bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛahilehile.” Menli ne anli nɔhalɛ ammaa Nyamenle

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛ ze ɛnle ko ɔ? Tɛ Nyamenle ko ne ala a bɔle yɛ muala ɔ? Duzu ati a yɛnli nɔhalɛ yɛmmaa yɛ nwo, na ɔlua zo yɛgua yɛ ze mɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee Nyamenle yɛle la anwo evinli a?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Dwudama anli nɔhalɛ, bɛbɔ munzule wɔ Yizilayɛ amuala nee Gyɛlusalɛm. Dwudama ɛva evinli ɛha Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye die ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛhɔgya mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle nyamenle gyɛne la.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ yɛ ɛhye mɔ la, saa yemɔ a ɔdi nwolɛ ɛzonle, anzɛɛ ɔdi daselɛ, anzɛɛ saa ɔfa nwolɛ azubɔdeɛ ɔba Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu bɔbɔ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛvi Gyɛkɔbo sua nu.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Debie bieko mɔɔ eza bɛyɛ la ɛne: Bɛtwi monle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma azukponle ne azo. Bɛsu na bɛdi nyane bɛ nuhua kɛ ɛnɛ ɔnlie bɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ, yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie nwolɛ.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Bɛbiza kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɔnlie ɛ?” Ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma di ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛgyale bɛ bɛ mgbavolɛ nu la yɛle la anwo daselɛ. Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa bɛ, noko bɛ mraalɛ ɔ, yɛɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne kile kɛ bɛle bɛ ye mɔ.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Asoo Ɛdɛnkɛma anga bɛ ambɔ nu anyɛ bɛ ko wɔ sunsum nee nwonane nu? Na duzu a ɛnee ɔkpondɛ a? Ɔkpondɛ Nyamenle nu mralɛ. Yemɔti bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ kpalɛ na bɛmmabɔ bɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛgya bɛ bɛ mgbavolɛ nu la ewole.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne se, “Mekyi ewolebɔlɛ, yɛɛ mekyi nrenya mɔɔ fa anyebolo bɔ ɔ ye ewole la. Medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. Yemɔti bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa bɛ ye mɔ.” Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne ɛbikye

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ bɛgyegye Ɛdɛnkɛma, na akee bɛbiza kɛ, “Kɛ yɛzi yɛgyegye ye ɛ?” Bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka la a le kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ di ɛtane la le kpalɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo, yɛɛ ɔ nye die bɛ nwo.” Eza bɛbiza kɛ, “Na Nyamenle ne mɔɔ di pɛlepɛle la wɔ nienwu?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nea, mebazoa me ɛbɔfoɔ meamaa yeahɔziezie adenle ne anu yeamaa me. Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala bɛbanwu Awulae ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkpondɛ ye la kɛ ɔlɛkɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo ɛbɔfoɔ ne mɔɔ bɛ nye la ye ade la ɛlɛba.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ ɔkɛra la, nwane a kɛhola gyinla a, yɛɛ saa ɔye ɔ nyunlu a, nwane a kɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ a? Ɔluakɛ ɔbayɛ kɛ dwinvolɛ senle mɔɔ ɔfa ɔtu ninyɛne nu anzɛɛ saminla anloa ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpo ninyɛne la.

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ɔbadɛnla aze kɛ dwinvolɛ mɔɔ tu dwɛtɛ fufule nu la. Ɔbadu Livaema anu na yeabolo bɛ nwo kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ yeahwi bɛ nwo kɛ dwɛtɛ fufule, kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva nɔhalɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne bɛkɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma la.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Ɛhye bamaa Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ayɛ anyenzɔlɛ amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mebahwe meabikye bɛ na meabua bɛ ndɛne. Mebadea ngonyiama, awuvolɛvalɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka ndane mgbane mgbane la ndɛndɛ zo. Mebadea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsisi gyimayɛvoma wɔ bɛ kakɛdualɛ nu, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsisi ahunlanvolɛ nee nrisa, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu nyɛvolɛ yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzulo me la.” Ngyɛnu bulu ɛkpɔ ko ɛdualɛ ne

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mengakyi ɛlɛ. Yemɔti bɛmɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛ bo zo ɛtɛbɔle bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Sumunli bɛ nlenya mɔ mekɛ zo yɛɛ bɛvale me mɛla zo ɛtietialɛ a, yɛɛ bɛnli zolɛ. Bɛzia bɛrɛla me ɛkɛ ne, na medame noko menwɔra bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛyɛ yɛzia yɛ nzi ɛ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Asoo sonla kola wua Nyamenle? Noko bɛmɛ, ɛwualɛ ala a bɛwua me a. Na bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Ɛnee kɛ yɛsi yɛwua wɔ ɛ?’ Bɛwua me wɔ bɛ azubɔlɛ nu nee ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛkyɛ nu bulu bɛtu ɛkpɔ ngoko bɛmaa me la anu.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ munzule, bɛdabɛ maanlema amuala, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛwua me.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Ɛkpɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ le me ɛdeɛ la, bɛva bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛrɛla bɛragua ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me ninyɛne ne la, amaa aleɛ ara me sua nu. Bɛzɔ me bɛnlea wɔ ɛhye anwo na bɛnlea saa menrɛbuke anwuma nlenkɛ menrɛgua nwolɛ menrɛmaa bɛnrɛnyia nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo a.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Menrɛmaa ngɛkɛba ɛnrɛli bɛ aleɛ, yɛɛ bɛ vanye mbaka ɛnrɛkpolo bɛ ndotolo nee ma ɛnrɛgua.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti baha kɛ Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ maanle nu bayɛ anyelielɛ.” Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne anwo ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛheha ɛtane ɛtane bɛtietia me! Noko bɛbiza kɛ, ‘Duzu edwɛkɛ a yɛha yɛtia wɔ a?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Bɛha kɛ, ‘Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ le debie mgbane. Duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ yɛnyia ye wɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo ɛlilɛ nwo, nee yɛ nwo alɔbɔlɛ alɔbɔlɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu, kɛ asɛɛ nyane bie ɛdo yɛ la anwo a?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Noko nea, ɛnɛ, yɛfa sonla mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la kɛ Nyamenle ɛyila ye. Menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la kpazi, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ ɛtane bɛsɔ Nyamenle bɛnea la anwo dwɔɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la dule bɛ nwo azukue. Ɛdɛnkɛma diele bie, yɛɛ ɔdele ɔ muala. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛdwenle ɔ nwo la, bɛhɛlɛle bɛ muala aluma wɔ ngakyelɛ buluku nu, ɔla Nyamenle anyunlu.

translation_verse: Ye nganeɛ dendenle hɔle Selea maanle ne anu amuala, na bɛvale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ewule ngakyile ɛha bɛ na bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ: mɔɔ ɛbubu, mɔɔ awozonle ɛva bɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ mgbutike la amuala bɛrɛlɛle ye, na ɔyɛle bɛ muala ayile.

translation_verse: “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nyane ɛha bɛ la; Nyamenle bakyekye bɛ rɛle!

translation_verse: “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle bɛlɛvo la; Azɛlɛ ye bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ!

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse anwunvɔne la; Nyamenle baze bɛdabɛ noko anwunvɔne!

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la; Bɛbanwu Nyamenle!

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ a bɛle ewiade ye kɛnlaneɛ a. Suakpole mɔɔ bɛhye ye boka zo la ɛnvea.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ a bɛle azɛlɛ ye azo ngyenle a. Ngyenle mɔɔ kɛda la bɛyɛ ye menlemenle bieko a ɔnyɛ boɛ. Bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ. Bɛto bɛgua na menli tietia zolɛ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.

translation_verse: “Bɛmmadwenle kɛ mera kɛ mebazɛkye Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ. Meamba bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ; mera kɛ meba meamaa bɛali munli.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Bɛde kɛ bɛhanle bɛhilele mɔmoane amra kɛ, ‘Bɛmmayɛ kɔdiawu na awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ kɔdiawu la bɛkɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Mame, mese: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛva ɔ diema anwo ɛya la bɛkɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ. Mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɔ diema aholoba la bɛ nee ye kɛhɔ nyianu sua nu mgbanyima ayia ne anyunlu; na mɔɔ kɛze ɔ diema kɛ, ‘Ɛle koasea!’ la, ɛva ɔ nwo ɛdo ɛbolɔ senle nu.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: gyakyi wɔ azubɔdeɛ ne wɔ azukponle ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne; dumua kɔ ɛ nee ɛ diema ne bɛbɔ bɛ avinli, na akee sia babɔ wɔ azu ne maa Nyamenle.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “Saa awie sɛma wɔ a, ɛ nee ye bɛziezie edwɛkɛ ne ndɛndɛ kolaa na bɛadwu ndɛnebualɛ ɛleka ne, amaa yeanye wɔ yeammaa ndɛnebuavolɛ ne na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ava wɔ amaa sinzavolɛma kɛ bɛdo wɔ efiade.

translation_verse: “Bɛha ye bieko kɛ, ‘Awie mɔɔ bɔ ɔ ye ewole la ɔhɛlɛ ewolebɔlɛ kɛlata ɔmaa ye.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Bɛde ye bieko kɛ bɛhanle bɛhilele mɔmoane amra kɛ, ‘Mmaka ndandɛla, na di ndane mɔɔ wɔha wɔ Awulae anyunlu la azo.’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ ko, ‘ɛhɛe’ a ‘ɛhɛe’; ‘kyɛkyɛ’ a ‘kyɛkyɛ’. Edwɛkɛ ngakyile biala vi abɔnsam ɛkɛ ne a ba a. Nzenralɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ (Luk

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Bɛde kɛ bɛha kɛ, ‘Bɛva ɛnyelɛ bɛzie ɛnyelɛ bo zo’, yɛɛ ‘bɛva egyele bɛzie egyele bo zo’.

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Noko mame, mese: Saa awie yɛ wɔ ɛtane a, mmasenra ye. Saa awie bɔ ɛ nzo fema ne anu a, kakyi bɛne ne ɔdaye maa ye.

translation_verse: Saa awie nee wɔ twe manzonle alie wɔ anwuma tɛladeɛ ne a, maa ɔva wɔ bubu ne ɔdaye,

translation_verse: Awie sɛlɛ wɔ debie a, maa ye bie, yɛɛ mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔfɛne debie wɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Kpɔvolɛma ɛhulolɛ (Luk

translation_verse: Saa bɛkulo menli mɔɔ kulo bɛ la angome a, ɛnee duzu ahatualɛ a bɛnyia ye wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ a? Anzɛɛ tɛ mɔɔ adwuledievolɛma yɛ la ala ɛne?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Na saa bɛbiza bɛ gɔnwo mɔ angome ahye a, ɛnee duzu debie ngakyile a bɛyɛ bɛmaa yebo zo a? Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle bɔbɔ la noko yɛ ye zɔhane ala.

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛanyɛ bɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne ɛnyelɛ zo. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔ a bɛnrɛnyia ahatualɛ wɔ bɛ anwuma Selɛ ne ɛkɛ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ nabalabama ne mɔ yɛ ye la. Menli zɔhane mɔ kulo kɛ bɛgyinla nyianu azua ne mɔ anu nee mgbata ne mɔ azo bɛyɛ bɛmaa menli kɔsɔɔti nwu bɛ kɛ bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnyia bɛ ahatualɛ bɛwie.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, bɛhɔvea bɛ sua kunlu ɛkɛ ne, bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu na bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛvɛlɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma mɔɔ bɛnnwu ye la, na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma na ɔnwu fealera nu edwɛkɛ la bayila bɛ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Wɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nu, bɛmmaka edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la yɛ ye la. Ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛdwenle kɛ saa bɛka edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo a yɛɛ Nyamenle kɛdie bɛ a.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ ye la, ɔluakɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ze mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la amuala kolaa na bɛabiza ye.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ saa bɛfa menli mɔɔ ɛvo bɛ la ɛtane bɛkyɛ bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛ anwuma Selɛ ne ɔdaye ɔkɛva bɛ ɛtane ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɔkɛhyɛ bɛ a.

translation_verse: Na saa bɛanva menli mɔɔ ɛvo bɛ la ɛtane ne mɔ bɛangyɛ bɛ a, bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɔdaye ɔnrɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔnrɛhyɛ bɛ. Ɛhɔnehyelɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ

translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, saa bɛkye ɛhɔne a anrɛɛ bɛnrinzi bɛ nwo, na bɛziezie bɛ nwo,

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: amaa awie mɔ annwu kɛ bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne. Na bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma na ɔze fealera nu debie biala la bayila bɛ. Anwonyia wɔ anwuma (Luk

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛdwenle Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la anwo kpalɛ, na ɔkɛva mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la ɔkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛmmadwenle ɛhyema anwo; ɛhyema ɔdaye ɔ nee ɔ ti anwo adwenleadwenle ɛdeɛ lua. Ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛva kenle ko anwo adwenleadwenle ɛdeɛ bɛkɛboka ko ɛdeɛ nwo.

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmakpondɛ bɛ anwonyia bɛsie azɛlɛ ye azo, anrɛɛ ɛlɛtɛba nee nrɛnlana kɛzɛkye ye, na nwule noko kola wua.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ bɛ anwonyia bɛzie anwuma maanle ne anu na ɛlɛtɛba nee nrɛnlana anzɛkye ye, na nwule noko angɔnwua.

translation_verse: Bɛnwu ye kɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛ anwonyia wɔ la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛ ahonle noko wɔ a. Sonlabaka ne kɛnlaneɛ (Luk

translation_verse: Na saa ɛ nye ɛnle kpalɛ a, wɔ sonlabaka ne anu le awozinli. Na saa wienyi ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ nu la le awozinli a, ɛnee noko ye awozinli ne kɛyɛ kabii kpalɛ. Nyamenle nee anwonyia (Luk

translation_verse: “Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzonle menlenlɛ nwiɔ, ɔluakɛ saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbahulo ko na yeakpɔ ko, anzɛɛ ɔbali ko eni na yeakpo ko. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛnrɛhola Nyamenle nee ezukoa sonle a.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛmmadwenle kɛ, ‘Duzu yɛɛ yɛbali a’, anzɛɛ ‘Duzu a yɛbanlo a’, anzɛɛ ‘Duzu a yɛbaheda a’,

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse vi ɛkɛ ne na ɔkɔ la, ɔnwunle adwuledievolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mateyu la kɛ ɔde adwulelielɛ sua ne anu. Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ.” Mateyu dwazole na ɔdoale ye.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse kpula ɔ sa wɔ Mateyu sua nu ɛkɛ ne la, adwuledievolɛma dɔɔnwo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la rabokale Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ na bɛ muala bɛkpulale bɛ sa.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Falasiima bie mɔ nwunle ye na bɛzele Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛ menle nee adwuledievolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ awie ɛmbu bɛ la to bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu ɛ?”

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse anloa wɔ zo ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile bɛ la, nyianu sua ne neavolɛ kpanyinli ne rale na ɔrahotole Gyisɛse anyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Me ra raalɛ ɛwu kɛkala; noko bɛla bava ɛ sa to ɔ nwo zo maa ɔnyia ngoane.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nye na ɔnwunle ye la, ɔzele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Ralɛ raalɛ, maa ɛ rɛle ɛdɔ wɔ azule nu. Wɔ diedi ɛmaa ɛ nwo ɛza.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala raalɛ ne anwo zale.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ɔdule sunsum ɛtane ne la, mumule ne dendɛle. Na ɔyɛle menli dɔɔnwo ne nwanwane na bɛzele kɛ, “Yɛtɛnwunle ɛhye bie ɛlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ!”

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne ɛdoavolɛma ne rale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne rabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a yɛmɛ yɛɛ Falasiima yɛkye ɛhɔne dahudahu na wɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛngye bie fee ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdwenle kɛ saa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne wɔ ɛkɛ a, ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛra atɔfolɛlielɛ ne abo la kɛli nyane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Noko saa mekɛ dwu na bɛbaye atɔfolɛ nrenya ne wɔ bɛ avinli bɛkɔ a, ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ yedwu mɔɔ bɛkye ɛhɔne a.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: “Awie ɛnva ɛdanlɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwulale ye nzule nu ɛlɛ la ɛnda ɛdanlɛ dɛba nu; saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛdanlɛ fofolɛ ne kɛde dɛba ne na ɔkɛmaa tokule ne akee kɛyɛ kpole.”

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ, “Saa mefa me sa meka ye tɛladeɛ ne bɔbɔ a, me nwo kɛza.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyisɛse dwazole na ɔ nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne nee nrenya ne hɔle.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Raalɛ bie mɔɔ mogya ɛdudu ye toonwo ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ la ralile Gyisɛse anzi na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhanle ye tɛladeɛ ne anloa.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Gyisɛse dwule nyianu sua ne kpanyinli ne sua nu la, ɔnwunle agolehanlɛma, nee menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛra bayɛ ɛzɛne ne la.

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhwe bɛ nwo! Bɛlɛra ne ɛtɛwule; ɔlɛdafe ala!” Na bɛzelele ye bɛzile ye amgbu.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛyele menli ne mɔ bɛvindele la, Gyisɛse wolole sua ne anu na ɔzɔle bɛlɛra ne asa, na bɛlɛra ne dwazole.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Nzinlii mɔɔ Gyisɛse hɔle sua nu la, bɛrale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. Na Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie bɛdi kɛ menwɔhola bɛ ayile yɛ ɔ?” Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Yɛmenle!”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyisɛse vale ɔ sa hehanle bɛ nye ne mɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔyɛ zɔ ɔmaa bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ diedi ne de la.”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nye ne mɔ dukuedukuele. Gyisɛse bɔle bɛ nloa kɛ, “Bɛmmabɔ zo bɛmaa awie biala te.”

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: Noko bɛvile ɛkɛ ne la, bɛvale Gyisɛse gyima kpalɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛhɔle maanzinli ne anu amuala. Gyisɛse yɛ mumule ayile

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Noko Falasiima ne mɔ zele kɛ, “Ɔdua mbɔnsam kpanyinli ne tumi zo a ɔtu mbɔnsam ne mɔ a.” Gyisɛse se menli anwunvɔne

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hɔkpɔsale maanzinli ne anu azua nee namunamu ne mɔ amuala azo, ɔhilehilele wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la ɔhilele menli ne. Ɔmanle menli mɔɔ ewule ngakyile ɛha bɛ nee mɔɔ anwonyane ɛbɔ bɛ la amuala anwo zale.

english_verse: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ɔnwunle menli somaa ne la, alɔbɔlɛ hunle ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbɔ asande na bɛluolua nu mgbane mgbane kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle bɛyɔba ne ɛbolo kpole, na menli mɔɔ bu la le ekyi.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛzɛlɛ egyinli menle ne kɛ ɔkɛva gyimayɛvoma dɔɔnwo ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛhɔbu bɛyɔba ne.”

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Felepe nee Baatɔlomiyu; Tɔmase nee Mateyu mɔɔ le adwuledievolɛ ne; Afeɛse ara Gyemise nee Tadease;

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ kɛ bɛli bɛ edwɛkɛ a, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbaha la anwo anzɛɛ kɛ bɛbazi bɛaha ye la anwo; saa mekɛ ne dwu a, bɛbava mɔɔ bɛbaha la bɛamaa bɛ.

english_verse: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translation_verse: “Bɛdie! Melɛsoa bɛ kɛ mboane la wɔ bedi avinli. Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla bɛ nwo zo kɛ nwɔlɛ, noko bɛyɛ bɛlɛvo kɛ abubule.

translation_verse: Saemɔn mɔɔ le Keenanli ne, nee Dwudase Yesekaleɔto mɔɔ yele Gyisɛse manle la. Bulu nee nwiɔ ne gyima (Mak

translation_verse: Gyisɛse zoanle bɛdabɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ɛhye na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmakɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu anzɛɛ Samɛlea azua ne mɔ azo;

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: bɛmmafa aleɛ kodoku wɔ bɛ adendulɛ nu. Bɛmmafa anwuma adɛladeɛ nwiɔ, mgbɔlaboa anzɛɛ kpɔma, ɔluakɛ soamɛlɛkɛ didi mgbane.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkɔ sua bie anzɛɛ namule bie azo a, bɛbiza bɛnwu sonla mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ la na bɛhɔzokoɛ ye, na bɛdɛnla ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne ɔhɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvi sua ne anzɛɛ namule ne azo la.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Na nɔhalɛ, mese, wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nyamenle baze Sodɔm nee Gomɔla amra anwunvɔne dɔɔnwo adɛla menli mɔɔ wɔ zɔhane sua ne azo la. Bɛbayɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde (Mak

translation_verse: “Adiema baye adiema amaa kɛ bɛhu ye. Selɛ baye ralɛ amaa, mralɛ badwazo bɛ awovolɛma anwo zo na bɛaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛahu bɛ.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ menli sa nu, ɔluakɛ bɛbahye bɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ kɔɔto; bɛbabila bɛ empele wɔ bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu,

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: yɛɛ eza bɛbahwe bɛ bɛahɔ maanle mgbanyima nee arelemgbunli nyunlu wɔ me ti, na bɛabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo bɛahile bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛbadendɛ a; bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la Sunsum ne balua bɛ nwo zo adendɛ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Me ti, menli kɔsɔɔti bakpɔ bɛ. Noko mɔɔ kɛgyinla kpundii kɛhɔ awieleɛ la, Nyamenle kɛlie ye ngoane.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde wɔ sua ko azo a, bɛnriandi bɛhɔ mɔɔ doa ye la azo. Na meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnrɛwie Yizilayɛ azua ne mɔ amuala azo kɔ na Sonla Ra ne ara.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Ɛdoavolɛ biala ɛndɛla ye kilehilevolɛ, yɛɛ akɛlɛ ɛndɛla ɔ menle.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdoavolɛ biala yɛ kɛ ɔ menle la, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ akɛlɛ yɛ kɛ ɔ menle la. Saa bɛvɛlɛ sua menle ne Biyɛlezɛbɛle a, ɛnee ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne amra ɛdeɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ bɛ aluma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye la (Luk

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛku nwonane ne na bɛngola ɛkɛla ne ku la; bɛzulo Nyamenle mɔɔ kola nwonane ne nee ɛkɛla ne amuala ku, na ɔsɛkye bɛ wɔ ɛbolɔ senle nu la.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Bɛtɔ nyamenleakatiba nwiɔ ɛkpɔsɛba ko, noko akee ko bɔbɔ ɛndɔ aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnze nu a.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ti zo enrinli bɔbɔ bɛdia.

translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛsonle bolɛ kpole bɛtɛla nyamenleakatiba dɔɔnwo. Kelaese ɛlielɛ nee ye ɛkpolɛ (Luk

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛha ye baguase kɛ ɔle me ɛdeɛ la, medame menwɔyɛ ye zɔhane ala menwɔmaa ye wɔ Egya mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anyunlu.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Na awie biala mɔɔ kɛkpo me wɔ bagua nu la, medame noko menwɔkpo ye wɔ Egya mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anyunlu. Tɛ anzonudwolɛ ɔ, konle ɔ (Luk

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Bɛmmadwenle kɛ me nee anzonudwolɛ a rale ewiade a; kyɛkyɛ, meanva anzonudwolɛ meamba. Me nee konle a rale a.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: Membale kɛ mebamaa mralɛ mrenya adwazo atia bɛ ze mɔ, mralɛ mraalɛ adwazo atia bɛ nli mɔ, nwuvolɛ mraalɛ adwazo atia bɛ hu mɔ bɛ nli mɔ;

translation_verse: sonla biala kpɔvolɛma kpalɛ vi ɔdaye ye sua nu.

translation_verse: “Mɔɔ kulo ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli tɛla me la ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kulo ɔ ra nrenya anzɛɛ ɔ ra raalɛ tɛla me la ɛnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ me ɛdoavolɛ.

translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛlie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ la, kɛnyia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ nwo ahyɛlɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛlie sonlakpalɛ wɔ sonlakpalɛ duma nu la, kɛnyia sonlakpalɛ nwo ahatualɛ.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Awie mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ la ɛlie medame; mɔɔ kɛlie me noko la ɛlie mɔɔ zoanle me la.

translation_verse: Na bɛhakye ɛhye: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa ngakula ngyikyi ɛhye mɔ anu ko nzule fɔlɔdɔdɔ kanrɛlɛ ko bɔbɔ kɛnlo, kɛ ɔle me ɛdoavolɛ la, kɛnyia nwolɛ ahatualɛ somaa!”

translation_verse: Gyisɛse gyima mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛdi la nganeɛ dwule Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne anzo nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔla efiade la. Yemɔti ɔzoanle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ wɔ Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne;
