english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Na ɔ nli hanle kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, ye duma a le Dwɔn.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Awie ɛnle wɔ abusua ne anu mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye zɔhane a!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛyɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛhilele ɔ ze bɛbizale ye duma holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔkulo kɛ bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ kakula ne la.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Zɛkalaya bizale bɛ liele taboa mɔɔ bɛkɛlɛ zolɛ la, na ɔhɛlɛle zo kɛ, “Ye duma a le Dwɔn.” Ɛhye yɛle bɛ muala azibɛnwo.

english_verse: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala Zɛkalaya holale dendɛle bieko na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ hanle ye kpalɛzo amra amuala, na bɛhɔhanle mɔɔ ɛzi la wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli ne anu amuala.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ dele la dwenlenle nwolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee yela ɛkɛ ne wienyi kɛ Awulae tumi ne wɔ kakula ne anwo zo. Yemɔti bɛhanle kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, kakula ɛhye bayɛ sonlakpole!” Zɛkalaya ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wolole Dwɔn ɔ ze Zɛkalaya na ɔbɔle Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nolo kɛ,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Bɛmaa yɛye Awulae, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ! Yeraboa ye menli na yekpɔne bɛ.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: Yemaa yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ kpole bie mɔɔ vi ye sonvolɛ Devidi abusua nu a.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Ɔluale ye kpɔmanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo zo ɔbɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ dɛba kɛ,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ɔbalie yɛ yeavi yɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi yɛ la tumi bo.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle kɛ ɔbaze yɛ nlenya mɔ anwunvɔne, na ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi ye ngyekyeleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: Ɔvuale ɔhilele yɛ nlenya Ebileham, na ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔkɛlie yɛ ɔkɛvi yɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu, amaa yɛazonle ye, mɔɔ ɛzulolɛ biala ɛnle nu,

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: wɔ anwondelɛ nee fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ nu wɔ ɔ nyunlu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: “Na wɔmɔ, me awolɛ, bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne kpɔmanvolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛbalumua Awulae anyunlu wɔahɔziezie ye ndenle ne mɔ,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: na wɔamaa ye menli ne anwu kɛ bɛbava bɛ ɛtane bɛahyɛ bɛ na bɛalie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔlua yɛ Nyamenle ne ahunlunyele kpole ti, ɔbamaa ngoanelielɛ kenle ne ado yɛ;

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: ye wienyi ne bada bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde awozinli nu nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ ewule nu la anwo zo, na yealie yɛ yeava anzonudwolɛ adenle ne azo.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na kakula ne nyinle na ɔyɛle se wɔ sunsum nu. Ɔdɛnlanle fienemgbole ne anu toonwo ɔhɔkpulale kenle mɔɔ ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele Yizilayɛma wɔ bagua nu la.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Wulomu Maanle Maanle Kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɔgɛsetɛse la lile mɛla kɛ bɛdia menli mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Semɛyɔn la wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Nrenya ɛhye le sonlakpalɛ. Nyamenle nwo ɛzulolɛ wɔ ye nu na ɔlɛkendɛ Yizilayɛma ngoanelielɛ ne. Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ ye nu,

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a le menli ɛdianlɛ mɔɔ lumua a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Koyeleneɛse a di amɛnlado wɔ Selea maanzinli nu a.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Na awie biala hɔle ɔ nzi kɛ ɔkɔ yeamaa bɛadia ye wɔ ɔdaye ye abusua sua zo.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Dwosefi vi Nazalɛte mɔɔ wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu la hɔle Belemgbunli Devidi sua zo Bɛtelɛhɛm mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli nu la. Ɔhɔle ɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ ɔvi Devidi abusua nu.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkɔ yeamaa bɛadia ye nee Mɛle, mɔɔ ɛnee yeyia ye la. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Mɛle ɛva ɛkolɛ,

english_verse: and while they were there,
translation_verse: yemɔti Bɛtelɛhɛm yɛɛ ɔ ko hanle ye a.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Ɔwole ye belamunli ralɛ ne nrenya na ɔvale avuazinli ɔkyekyele ɔ nwo na ɔdole ye mboane adidi ɛlɛka nu wɔ mboane tunli bie anu, ɔluakɛ bɛannyia ɛleka wɔ nyɛvolɛ sua ne anu. Mboaneneavolɛma nee Nyamenle soanvolɛma

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Mboaneneavolɛma bie wɔ maanle ne anu na bɛlɛsi epe bɛanlea bɛ mboane wɔ fiene ne azo.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ vindele bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne, na Awulae anyunlunyia ne dale bɛ nwo zo manle ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmasulo! Melɛ amaneɛ kpalɛ melɛbɛlɛ bɛ, mɔɔ bamaa fɛlɛkolilɛ kpole aha menli kɔsɔɔti a.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kenle ye bɛwo bɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Awulae Kelaese ne wɔ Devidi sua zo.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Bɛlua sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye azo a bɛbanwu ye a: bɛbanwu kɛ bɛva avuazinli bɛkyekye adɔma ne anwo na bɛva ye bɛdo mboane adidi ɛlɛka nu.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Arɛlevilɛ nu ala anwuma soanvolɛma dɔɔnwo rabokale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko ne anwo na bɛdole edwɛne bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle wɔ anwuma anwuma, anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔ nye die bɛ nwo wɔ ewiade ye la.”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne vi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne ziale hɔle anwuma la, mboaneneavolɛma ne hanle hilele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm yɛhɔnlea mɔɔ ɛzi, mɔɔ Awulae ɛraha ɛhile yɛ la.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ndɛndɛ ne ala mboaneneavolɛma ne hɔle na bɛhɔnwunle Mɛle nee Dwosefi nee adɔma ne kɛ ɔla mboane adidi ɛlɛka nu.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mboaneneavolɛma ne nwunle adɔma ne la, bɛhanle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle ye kakula ne anwo hilele bɛ la bɛhilele menli ne.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Mɛle vale edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ziele ɔ ti anu na ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Mboaneneavolɛma ne ziale hɔle, bɛdole edwɛne bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛde nee mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la anwo; mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la amgba le kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hanle hilele bɛ ala la. Bɛdo Gyisɛse duma

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔlile kenle mɔtwɛ la, bɛyɛle kakula ne mrenyanu nzonlɛ na bɛdonle ye duma Gyisɛse. Duma ɛhye a Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne vale manle ye kolaa na bɛanrenzɛ ye a. Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Mekɛ dwule kɛ akee Dwosefi nee Mɛle yɛ mɔɔ Mosisi mɛla ne kile, mɔɔ fane kakula ne nee ɔ nli ɛnluanlɛ nwo la, bɛvale ye bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkava ye bɛahile Awulae,

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”
translation_verse: kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Awulae Mɛla ne anu la. Ɔse, “Bɛdu belamunli ralɛ nrenya biala bɛmaa Awulae.”

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Eza bɛvale abubule anzɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ngyikyi nwiɔ bɛhɔbɔle azu, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Awulae Mɛla ne anu la.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: na yeye yehile ye kɛ ɔnrɛwu ɛlɛ kyesɛ ɔnwu Awulae Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Sunsum ne vale Semɛyɔn hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na mɔɔ Gyisɛse awovolɛ ne vale ye rale ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛbayɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Mɛla ne se la,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Semɛyɔn liele kakula ne dole ɔ sa zo na ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo ɔhanle kɛ:

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Awulae, wɔli wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. Akee gyakyi wɔ akɛlɛ adenle anzonudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: mɔɔ ɛvale ɛbɔle menli kɔsɔɔti ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Ɔle wienyi mɔɔ baye wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne yeahile menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la, na yeava anyunlunyia yearɛlɛ wɔ menli Yizilayɛma.”

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ Semɛyɔn hanle wɔ Gyisɛse anwo la zinle ɔ ze nee ɔ nli anwo.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Semɛyɔn yilale bɛ na ɔzele ɔ nli Mɛle kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛye kakula ɛhye ɛzie ɛkɛ. Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo balua ɔ nwo zo adu koti, na dɔɔnwo noko alua ɔ nwo zo anyia ngoane; ɔbayɛ Nyamenle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ menli dɔɔnwo ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛdo nu,

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: noko ɔlua ɔ nwo zo, menli dɔɔnwo awozinli nu adwenle kpɔkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ la bala ali wienyi. Na ɛhye anwo nyane bayɛ kɛ dadeɛ mɔɔ yɛ nla la awɔ wɔ ahonle ne anu.”

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Ɔdaye noko ɔrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu dɔnehwele ne ala anu ɔrayɛle Awulae mo na ɔhanle kakula ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye la kɛ Nyamenle barakpɔne Gyɛlusalɛm la. Gyisɛse awovolɛ sia ara Nazalɛte

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛwiele debie biala yɛ, kɛmɔ Awulae Mɛla ne se la, Mɛle nee Dwosefi ziale rale bɛ sua zo Nazalɛte mɔɔ wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu la.

english_verse: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him. The Boy Jesus in the Temple
translation_verse: Kakula ne nyinle na ɔ nwo yɛle se; nrɛlɛbɛ yile ye tɛkɛɛ, na Nyamenle yilale ye dɔɔnwo. Kakula Gyisɛse wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu

english_verse: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ biala Gyisɛse awovolɛ kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɔdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bie.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse lile ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ la, bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkali ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele ɛvoyia ne di na bɛsia bɛara la, kakula Gyisɛse hale Gyɛlusalɛm, na ye awovolɛ ne annwu ye zɔhane.

english_verse: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenlenle kɛ yebɔ menli dɔɔnwo ne anu, yemɔti bɛdiale kenle ko adenle na bɛhɔkpondɛle ye wɔ bɛ mbusua nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ avinli,

english_verse: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nsa ne azo, bɛnwunle ye wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ ɔde Dwuu kilehilevolɛma avinli, ɔlɛtie bɛ edwɛkɛ ne bie na ɔbizebiza bɛ kpuyia.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye nyelebɛnloa nee ye ndelebɛbo nu la zinle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛtie ye la anwo.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Ye awovolɛ ne nwunle ye la ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo, na ɔ nli zele ye kɛ, “Me ra, duzu ati a wɔyɛ yɛ zɛhae ɛ? Nea, me nee ɛ ze yɛvɛ kpalɛ wɔ wɔ ɛkpondɛlɛ nu.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛkpondɛ me ɛ? Bɛnze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ metɛnla Egya sua nu ɔ?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: Noko bɛande edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhanle la abo.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyisɛse nee bɛ ziale rale Nazalɛte, na ɔyɛle tieyɛ ɔmanle bɛ. Ɔ nli vale edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ziele ɔ ti akunlu.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse nyinle nwonane nu nee nrɛlɛbɛ nu, na ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu wɔ Nyamenle nee menli nyunlu.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Adwuledievolɛma bie rale kɛ bɛba bɛamaa bɛazɔne bɛ, na bɛbizale Dwɔn kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, duzu a yɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: Do something to show that you really have given up your sins. Don't start saying you belong to Abraham's family. God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ɔ bo bɛyɛ debie mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo, na bɛmmakɔ zo bɛka kɛ, ‘Yɛle Ebileham amra.’ Meka meahile bɛ kɛ Nyamenle kola maa awolɛ ɛhye mɔ yɛ Ebileham abo zo amra!

english_verse: But to Herod the ruler, he said, “It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife.” John also said Herod had done many other bad things.
translation_verse: Na Dwɔn hwile Hɛlɔdo mɔɔ le Galeli maanzinli zo neavolɛ la anyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Hɛlɔdo ɛgya ɔ diema aye. Raalɛ ne bɛfɛlɛ ye Hɛlɔdease; eza ɛnee Hɛlɔdo ɛyɛ ninyɛndane dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Everyone became excited and wondered, “Could John be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo anye la Mɛzaya ne ɛralɛ zo la, bɛdwenlenle kɛ bekezɛ yemɔ a le Dwɔn.

english_verse: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Anase nee Kayafase a le sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli wɔ Yizilayɛ a, na Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne razile Zɛkalaya ara Dwɔn anwo zo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.

english_verse: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, “In the desert someone is shouting, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya buluku ne anu la: “Awie ɛlɛtea nu wɔ fienemgbole ne anu kɛ: ‘Bɛziezie Awulae adenle ne; bɛdenrɛdenrɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ!

english_verse: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.

translation_verse: Na duzu ati a ɛse ɛ diema kɛ, ‘Me diema, mebodo wɔ, maa menye mumunli ne mɔɔ la ɛ nye zo la,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ dubinli la ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛ nye zo la ɛ? english_verse: Jesus told them: I saw Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Menwunle kɛ Seetan vi anwuma kɛ ɛsɛlɛmanye la ɛrade aze.

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Na bɛdie! Memaa bɛ tumi wɔ Kpɔvolɛ ne anwo zo. Eza memaa bɛ tumi kɛ bɛtietia nwɔlɛ nee nyamenleakɛlɛ nwo zo na debie biala ɛnrɛyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Mɛla kilehilevolɛ bie rale kɛ ɔbazɔ Gyisɛse yeanlea, na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, duzu a menyɛ na meanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a?”

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Nrenya ne buale kɛ “Mɛla ne se, ‘Fa wɔ ahonle muala, wɔ ɛkɛla muala, wɔ anwosesebɛ muala, yɛɛ wɔ adwenle muala kulo Awulae wɔ Nyamenle ne’; na akee ‘Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo.’ ”

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne manle fɛlɛko yile Gyisɛse ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya, anwuma nee aze Awulae, meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔva wɔvea nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nee nwomama la wɔye wɔhile menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la. Ɛhɛe, Egya, ɛnee kɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɔba ye la ɛne.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: “Egya ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwula me sa nu. Awie biala ɛnze Ralɛ ne sonla holɛ kɛ Selɛ ne ala, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnze Selɛ ne sonla holɛ kɛ Ralɛ ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ralɛ ne kulo kɛ ɔye ye ɔkile bɛ la ala.”

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse hakyile ɔ nwo wɔ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo na ɔhanle ye ahane ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nwo ɛyɛ moavolɛ kɛ bɛmɛ bɛnwu ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnwu bɛ kɛkala la!

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Duzu a bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ mɛla ne anu a? Kɛ ɛsi ɛkile ɔ bo ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔbua ye boɛ; yɛ ye zɔhane ala na ɛkɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ mɛla kilehilevolɛ ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔbua ɔ nwo benle la ati, ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Na me gɔnwo a le nwane?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Nrenya bie vi Gyɛlusalɛm ɛlɛtolo ahɔ Gyɛleko na ɔhɔdɔle nwule avinli. Bɛkpokpole ye, na bɛbole ye bɛmanle asɛɛ ɔwule bɔkɔɔ, na bɛgyakyile ye ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔle.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Na ɔrale kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ bie vale adenle ne azo, na mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la, ɔbule ahane ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ nrenya bie mɔɔ vi Livae abusua ne anu la ɔdaye ɔvale adenle ne azo a, na ɔhɔvindele nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbodɛboda ye la anwo zo. Ɔdaye noko ɔdole ɔ nye ɔnleanle ye na ɔbule foa ko ɔhɔle.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Akee Samɛleanli bie ɔdaye ɔvale adenle ne azo na ɔradole ye. Mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la, alɔbɔlɛ hunle ye.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne, ɔvale nwanye ɔnrinzinle ye nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu, ɔtotole nwole nu na ɔkyekyele; akee ɔvale ye ɔdɛnlanle ɔdaye ye ɛkpɔnwɔ ne azo na ɔ nee ye hɔle nyɛvolɛ sua bie anu na ɔnleanle ye gyɛlɛɛnye.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la ɔyele dwɛtɛ fufule nwiɔ ɔmanle nyɛvolɛ sua menle ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Nea ye gyɛlɛɛnye maa me, na kakɛ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛbɔ ye wɔ dwɛtɛ ɛhye anzi la, saa mesia meba a, mebadua meamaa wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse dwulale ye edwɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛnee menli nsa ye, ɛdawɔ ɛnea a bɛ nuhua boni a yɛle agɔnwolɛ manle nrenya ne mɔɔ dɔle nwule avinli la?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Mɛla kilehilevolɛ ne buale kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ hilele ahunlunyele manle ye la ɔ.” Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ noko kɔ na kɔyɛ zɔhane ala.” Gyisɛse kpɔla Maata nee Mɛle

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne tu adenle la, bɛrale namule bie azo, na raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Maata la liele ye hɔle ye sua nu.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Maata lɛ ɔ diema raalɛ ko, bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɛle. Mɛle dɛnlanle Awulae agyakɛ abo ɛkɛ ne na ɔdiele ye ngilehilelɛ ne.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Gyima ne mɔɔ ɛnee Maata angome gyi nwo la somaa ti, ɔmanle ye adwenle bɔle nu. Yemɔti ɔhɔle Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ, “Awulae, wɔnwu kɛ me diema raalɛ ye ɛgyakyi gyima ye ɛkpolo me ngome la? Ka kile ye maa ɔrazɔ me nu.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Awulae buale ye kɛ, “Maata, Maata! Ninyɛne dɔɔnwo gyegye wɔ sɛkye wɔ adwenle.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Debie ko ala a hyia a, na Mɛle ɛkpa nu ɛva mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na bɛnrɛlie ye ɔ sa nu ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti meka meahile bɛ: Bɛbiza, na bɛ sa kɛha ye; bɛkpondɛ, na bɛkɛnwu ye; bɛbɔ nu, na bɛkɛbuke anlenkɛ ne bɛkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Na saa bɛmɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛle ɛtanevolɛma la, bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa ninyɛne kpalɛ bɛmaa bɛ mra a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnrɛva Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛnrɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye la ɛ?” Gyisɛse nee Biyɛlezɛbɛle (Mat

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: na ɔ gɔnwo ne fea ye sua ne anu bua ye kɛ, ‘Mmagyegye me! Bɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu dɛbadɛba, yɛɛ me nee me mra yɛla; menrɛhola dwazo na meamaa wɔ debie biala.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua boni yɛɛ saa ɔ ra biza ye fɛlɛ a, ɔkɛmaa ye ɛwɔlɛ a?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛha ɛhye: ‘Egya, Wɔ duma ne anwo ɛde; wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛrɛla.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Na fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ, ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ fo yɛ la, yɛfa yɛkyɛ ye. Na mmamaa yɛkɔ sɔnea nu.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ biza la asa ka ye, mɔɔ kpondɛ la nwu ye, yɛɛ bɛkɛdukue anlenkɛ ne bɛkɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ nu la.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwona yɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ manle Nenɛvɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame Sonla Ra, mebayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ meamaa adwuleso amra noko a.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, raalɛ bie manle ɔ ne zo wɔ menli ne anu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole wɔ na ɔlile wɔ adane la!”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛtu sunsum ɛtane bie mɔɔ le mumule la avi nrenya bie anwo. Ɔdule sunsum ɛtane ne la nrenya ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtendɛ, na ɛhye zinle menli ɛwolaa ne anwo kpole,

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Menli ne bie mɔ noko mɔɔ ɛnee kpondɛ kɛ bɛsɔ Gyisɛse bɛnea la hanle kɛ ɔyɛ nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle die ye to nu la ɔhile bɛ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse nwunle bɛ adwenle, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Maanle biala mɔɔ anu kɛhyɛ nwiɔ la bɔ.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa Seetan ɔdaye noko ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anu gyigya na bɛko bɛtia bɛ nwo a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeagyinla ɛ? Bɛse medua Biyɛlezɛbɛle anwo zo a metu mbɔnsam a;

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: na saa adenle ɛhye azo a medua metu mbɔnsam a, ɛnee bɛmɛ, kɛ bɛ mra si tu bɛ mbɔnsam ɛ? Bɛdabɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ kile kɛ bɛvo!

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: “Saa katakyie siezie ɔ nwo kɛ ɔsinza ye sua a, ɛnee ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la amuala anwo le kɔlɔnwo.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ Falasiima! Bɛmɛ, bɛkulo nyianu azua ne mɔ anu mbia ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu la azo ɛdɛnlanlɛ nee gua zo ahyebizalɛ mɔɔ menli bɔ bɛ ti aze abiza bɛ ahye la.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ anu ko zele ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, saa ɛka ɛhye a, ɛnee wɔtia yɛ o!”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zɔle zolɛ hanle kɛ, “Saa sunsum ɛtane fi sonla nwo tu a, ɔduolua ɛleka reresee kɛ ɔkpondɛ ɛleka yealie ye ɛnwomenle, na saa yeannyia bie a, ɔka ɔkile ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Mesia meahɔ me sua ne mɔɔ mevi nu menvindele la anu.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Ɔsia ɔba na ɔbanwu kɛ bɛkpoɔkpoa nuhua bɛziezie nuhua, noko awie ɛnle nu a,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: akee ɔfinde ɔkɔ na ɔkɔfa sunsum ɛtane nsuu mɔɔ le amumuyɛ tɛla ɔdaye mumua ne la ɔba na bɛbatɛnla ɛkɛ ne, na nzinlii sonla zɔhane gyinlabelɛ sɛkye kpalɛ tɛla alumua ne.” Nyilalɛ kpalɛ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɔbɔ, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne na bɛdi zolɛ la!” Menli ne biza nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ (Mat

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Falasiinli ne nwunle kɛ Gyisɛse annrinzi ɔ sa anwo, kɛmɔ bɛ mɛla ne kile la na yeabɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi debie, yemɔti ɔzinle ɔ nwo.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ Falasiima, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛkyɛ aledonlɛ nya nya evuanlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ kabɛle nee nya nya evuanlɛ mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ bɛfa bɛto aleɛ la anu bulu bɛtu ko bɛmaa Nyamenle, na bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee Nyamenle anwo ɛhulolɛ zo. Ninyɛne nwiɔ ɛhye yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ a, yɛɛ eza ɔnle kɛ bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Akee mɔɔ menli ne rabɔle yiale Gyisɛse la, ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Adwuleso amra ye le ɛtanevolɛma! Bɛkpondɛ nyamenlezo sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛanlea, na bɛnrɛnyia bie kyesɛ Dwona sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛdeɛ ne ala.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne Hyiba maanle nu Belemgbunli Raalɛ ne badwazo adoɔdoa adwuleso amra, ɔboalekɛ ɔvi ye maanle nu moa moa lɔ ɔdiale asɛɛ azɛlɛ ye foa ko na ɔradiele Sɔlɔmɔn nrɛlɛbɛ ngilehilelɛ ne; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Sɔlɔmɔn la wɔ ɛke.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, Nenɛvɛma badwazo adoɔdoa bɛmɛ adwuleso amra, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Dwona ɛlɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo la, bɛnlunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo; noko meka meahile bɛ, awie mɔɔ le kpole tɛla Dwona la wɔ ɛke! Nwonane ne anu wienyi ne (Mat

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Awie biala ɛnzɔ kɛnlaneɛ na ɔnva bondo ɔmbutu zolɛ; ɔfa ɔsie kɛnlaneɛbaka zo anwuma, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛba sua ne anu la bɛanwu aze.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Ɛnyelɛ le sonlabaka ne kɛnlaneɛ. Saa zolɛ te nwaanye a, sonlabaka ne anu le wienyi, yɛɛ saa zolɛ le kisii a, sonlabaka ne anu le awozinli.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Ahɔnwɔne! Asoo tɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛle nwolɛ ne la a yɛle ɔ kunlu ne noko a?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛ! Bɛmɛ, bɛyɛ sɛka ngɛnlɛma bɛmaa Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ hunle bɛ la.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse wiele tendɛ la, Falasiima bie dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔrɛla ɔmaa bɛkpula bɛ sa. Yemɔti Gyisɛse hɔle na ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛkponle ne anwo kɛ ɔdi debie.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Bɛmɛ Falasiima, bɛkpuda bɛ kanrɛlɛ nee bɛ ɛyɛba nwo, noko bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu, atisesebɛ nee ɛtane ngome ɛyi bɛ tetɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Bɛva mɔɔ ɛyi bɛ kanrɛlɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛba ne mɔ la bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma na debie biala anwo kɛde kɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Munzule ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle kɛ aziezo sɛka mɔɔ bɛanyɛ ye nzonlɛ la, menli ɛnze la ati bɛtietia zolɛ na bɛmaa evinli ka bɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma noko! Bɛmɛ, bɛkyekye adesoa ɛnlomboɛ mɔɔ bɛngola bɛ la bɛsoa menli, noko bɛndenrɛ bɛ sa ɛrɛlɛsɛka ko bɔbɔ bɛnzɔ nu bɛmmaa menli ne ɛnzoa adesoa zɔhane mɔ.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdi daselɛ, yɛɛ bɛ kunlu dwo mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ hunle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛdole bɛ nla ne mɔ.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati a Nyamenle Nrɛlɛbɛ ne hanle la, ɔse: ‘Bɛbayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mebazoa bɛ wɔ bɛ nwo la kpɔdekpɔde na bɛahu bie mɔ.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛbadea adwuleso amra noko wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ sumunli kɛ bɛbɔle ewiade la bɛhu bɛ la anwo,

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle Ebulu, bakpula Zɛkalaya, mɔɔ bɛhunle ye wɔ azukponle ne nee Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne avinli la anwo zo. Ɛhɛe, mese, bɛbadea adwuleso amra wɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala anwo.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: “Munzule ɛha bɛdabɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma! Bɛmɛ, bɛdo nrɛlɛbɛ sua ne anlenkɛ ne anu, bɛva ye sanvɛ ne bɛvea; bɛmɛ a bɛnrɛwolo nu, yɛɛ bɛnrɛmaa awie noko ɛnrɛwolo nu!”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse vile ɛkɛ ne la, mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee Falasiima ne mɔ vale edwɛkɛbizalɛ zɔle ye na bɛgyegyele ye dɔɔnwo,

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: kɛ saa ɔ nloa kɛhoati a bɛazɔ ye nu.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo rabɔle yiale ye, mɔɔ ɛnee akee asɛɛ bɛlɛtietia bɛ nwo zo la, Gyisɛse lumuale dendɛle hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ Falasiima mgbɔvonle ne anwo, meka bɛ adalɛ nabalaba ngilehilelɛ ne

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Nyamenle a keda ndile mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu, mɔɔ ɛnɛ fifi a, ɛhyema ɛnee bɛyela bɛ wɔ fonlomo nu la ndanlɛ a. Ɛnee bɛnea a ɔnrɛhola ɔnrɛheda bɛ ndanlɛ ɔ? Bɛ diedi le ekyi somaa!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛhyia bɛ, na ɔdaye noko ɔkɛva ɛhye mɔ ɔkɛmaa bɛ. Anwonyia wɔ anwuma (Mat

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me gɔnwo mɔ, meka meahile bɛ, bɛmmasulo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛku nwonane ye ala, na bɛngola bɛnzɛkye ɛkɛla ne la.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ti enrinli bɔbɔ bɛdia ɔ muala. Yemɔti bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ, bɛsonle bolɛ kpole bɛtɛla nyamenleakatiba kpolane! Kelaese ɛlielɛ nee ye ɛkpolɛ (Mat

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: “Me mboane ekpunli ekyi, bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la kulo kɛ bɛnyia Belemgbunlililɛ ne.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Bɛdɔne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la amuala na bɛva ezukoa ne bɛmaa ehyianvolɛma. Bɛyɛ gya ahodoku mɔɔ ɛnzɛkye ɛlɛ la bɛmaa bɛ nwo, na bɛva bɛ anwonyia bɛzie ɛleka mɔɔ ɔnrɛminli ɛlɛ la, ɔboalekɛ awule asa ɛnrɛha ye, yɛɛ ɛlɛtɛba ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzɛkye ye.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bahilehile bɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka la.” Sukoavolɛ koasea ne anwo ɛrɛlɛ

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛle kɔnwɔne! Ɛnɛ nɔe ala bɛbaye wɔ ngoane ne bɛavi wɔ nuhua; na nwane a bava ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala mɔɔ wɔva wɔzie wɔmaa ɛ nwo la a?’ ”

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Meka meahile bɛ, awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ ye te wɔ bagua nu kɛ ɔle me ɛdeɛ la, medame Sonla Ra, mebayɛ ye zɔhane ala meamaa ye wɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma anyunlu.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ kɛ bɛkali bɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu anzɛɛ amɛnladoma nee arelemgbunli nyunlu a, bɛmmadwenle mɔɔ bɛbaha anzɛɛ kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie bɛ nwo la anwo.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Nrenya ko mɔɔ wɔ menli dɔɔnwo ne anu la hanle hilele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ka kile me diema ne maa ɔ nee me ɛhyɛ agya ninyɛne ne mɔɔ yɛ ze gyakyile yɛ la.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Me gɔnwo, nwane a manle me tumi kɛ membua ndɛne anzɛɛ mengyɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ agya ninyɛne memaa bɛ a?”

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: Na ɔzɔle zolɛ ɔzele menli ne amuala kɛ, “Bɛmmayɛ anyebolo wɔ adenle biala anu, ɔboalekɛ sonla ngoane ɛnle ye anwonyia anzɛɛ ye ezukoa kpole mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anu.”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔdwenlenle nwolɛ kɛ, ‘Menlɛ ɛleka mɔɔ mesie me aleɛ ɛwolaa ɛhye a. Duzu a menyɛ a?’

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Ɛhye yɛɛ meyɛ a; megolo me bonwolo dɛba ne mɔ na measisi bie mgbole, na meava me aleɛ nee me ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala meagugua zolɛ.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɛhye ati meka meahile bɛ, bɛmmadwenle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛanyia ngoane anzɛɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛheda la anwo.

english_verse: Life is more than food or clothing.
translation_verse: Ngoane hyia kpole kpalɛ tɛla aleɛ, yɛɛ sonlabaka hyia kpole kpalɛ tɛla ndanlɛ.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu aloa si nyi la: bɛnyɛ gyima yɛɛ bɛnnwo ndanlɛ. Noko meka meahile bɛ kɛ Belemgbunli Sɔlɔmɔn, wɔ ye anyunlunyia mekɛ ne amuala anu, yeannyia ndanlɛ mɔɔ le ngɛnlɛma kɛ ndotolo ɛhye mɔ la anu ko bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Don't keep worrying about having something to eat or drink.
translation_verse: “Yemɔti bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle sɛkye wɔ mɔɔ bɛkɛli nee mɔɔ bɛkɛnlo la anwo.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Bɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ze kɛ bɛhyia ɛhye mɔ anwo.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Na saa sonvolɛ zɔhane ka kɛ, ‘Me menle bahyɛ na yeara,’ na ɔbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔbo sonvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, mrenya nee mraalɛ, na ɔdi, ɔno na ɔbo a,

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle kɛ menvale anzonudwolɛ membale ewiade ɔ? Meka meahile bɛ, tɛ anzonudwolɛ ɔ, na mgbakyemgbakye ɔ.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonvolɛma mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ menle kɛra la ɔkɛrado bɛ kɛ bɛ nye gyi zo na bɛlɛkendɛ ye la. Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛdɛnlɛdɛnla aze, ɔkɛkpa ɔkɛgua, na ɔkɛmaa bɛ debie.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔsia ɔba alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli o, anzɛɛ akɔlɛmɔleɛ o, na ɔbato bɛ zɔhane ala a, bɛ nyilalɛ le kpole.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Na bɛhakye ɛhye! Saa awuke menle ze mekɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ awule ne kɛva kɛra la a, anrɛɛ ɔnrɛmaa ye adenle ɔnrɛmaa ɔnrɛbu ɔnrɛra ye sua ne anu.

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Pita bizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, ɛbu ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye wɔamaa yɛdayɛ yɛ ngome anzɛɛ awie biala ɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Awulae buale kɛ, “Ɛnee nwane a le sonvolɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ la? Yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ ɔ menle kɛyɛ ye kpanyinli wɔ ye awuke ne anu kɛ ɔmaa sonvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la aleɛ wɔ mekɛ ne anloa la.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kɛra sua nu la ɔkɛrado ye kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ɛhye la.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, meka meahile bɛ kɛ, ɔ menle ne kɛmaa ɔkɛnlea ye ninyɛne kpokpoti azo.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: ɔ menle ne bara wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnze na ɔ nye ɛnla la. Na ɔ menle ne kɛye ye ali kɛmaa ɔkɛhɔboka anzosesebɛma anwo.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: “Sonvolɛ mɔɔ ze deɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ, noko ɔnziezie ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ la, bɛkɛbila ye empele kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Na sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnze mɔɔ ɔ menle kpondɛ, na ɔyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbila ye empele a, yemɔ bɛkɛbila ye ekyii bie ala. Sonla mɔɔ bɛkɛmaa ye ninyɛne dɔɔnwo la, bɛkɛlie ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ye ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛva dɔɔnwo kpalɛ bɛkɛwula ɔ sa nu la, bɛkɛbiza ye bɛkɛlie dɔɔnwo kpalɛ bɛkɛvi ye ɛkɛ. Gyisɛse maa mgbakyemgbakye ba (Mat

english_verse: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!
translation_verse: “Membale kɛ mebado senle wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛɛ me kunlu a anrɛɛ yezɔ dɛbadɛba.

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Noko akee ɔwɔ kɛ mesɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ sa, na saa ɛhye ɛtɛsenle a me ti akunlu ɛtɛgyale!

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la abusua ko mɔɔ menli nnu a wɔ nu la anu babu nwiɔ, na nwiɔ ne atia nsa ne.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Selɛma batia bɛ mra mrenya, yɛɛ mralɛ mrenya batia bɛ ze mɔ; ninlima batia bɛ mra mraalɛ, yɛɛ mralɛ mraalɛ batia bɛ nli mɔ; azebɛla batia ahileni na ahileni atia azebɛla.” Mekɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo (Mat

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse eza zele menli ne kɛ, “Saa bɛnwu kɛ maanle nu ɛmunla sɛnzɛne adɔleɛ na ɔlɛfo yeara a, ɛnee bɛse, ‘Ezule badɔ’, na ɔyɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ nyiakɛ anwoma ne kɛze kɛ ɔbɔ noko la, ɛnee bɛse, ‘Wuluwulu bara’, na ɔyɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Adalɛ nabalabama! Bɛkola bɛnwu azɛlɛ ye azo nee anwomanyunlu sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ abo bɛkile, na kɛmɔti a bɛngola bɛngile mekɛ ɛhye mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la abo ɛ? Ɛ nee wɔ kpɔvolɛ bɛbɔ nu (Mat

english_verse: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?
translation_verse: “Kɛmɔti a bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛngola bɛmbua bɛ nwo ndɛne fɔɔnwo ɛ?

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Saa sonla nee wɔ lɛ edwɛkɛ na ɔfa wɔ ɔkɔ suakunlu a, bɔ mɔdenle kɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnyianle bɛtɛkɔle edwɛkɛ ne azo la, ɛ nee ye bɛkɛziezie edwɛkɛ ne wɔ adenle nu kolaa na bɛadwu lɔ, amaa yeanva wɔ yeangɔmaa ndɛnebuavolɛ ne, na ndɛnebuavolɛ ne aye wɔ awula kpolisima asa anu, na kpolisima ahɔdo wɔ efiade.

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu menli bie rahanle Galelima bie mɔɔ Paelɛte ɛmaa bɛhu bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛbɔ azu bɛamaa Nyamenle la anwo edwɛkɛ hilele Gyisɛse.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛmɔ bɛhunle Galelima zɔhane mɔ wɔ adenle zɔhane anu la, ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔkile kɛ bɛle ɛtanevolɛma kpole bɛtɛla Galelima mɔɔ ɛha la amuala ɔ?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Ɔnle zɔhane. Meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanzia bɛanvi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo a, bɛ muala bɛbawu kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ ala la.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Gyisɛse bizale kɛ, “Kɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne si de ɛ? Duzu a menva mendo nwolɛ a?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Ɔnle zɔhane. Na meka meahile bɛ, saa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanzia bɛanvi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo a, bɛ muala bɛbawu kɛ menli zɔhane mɔ ala la.” Feege baka ne mɔɔ ɛnzo ma la anwo ɛrɛlɛ

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse bule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye. Ɔse, “Ɛnee nrenya bie lɛ feege baka wɔ ye vanye tola bie anu. Na ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpondɛ ma wɔ zolɛ na yeannyia bie.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Na tola neavolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, ‘Yɛmenle, maa ɔgyinla ɛkɛ ne na yɛnlea ye ɛvolɛ ye noko; mebavuduvudu ɔ bo na meagugua ewula ɔ bo.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Na saa ɛvolɛ ne kadwu na ɔso a, ɔle kpalɛ; yeanzo noko a, yɛkɛpɛ ye yɛkɛdo.’ ” Gyisɛse yɛ raalɛ abubura bie ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne

english_verse: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue,

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: A rich man once had a manager to take care of his business. But he was told that his manager was wasting money.

translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ twehwe sonla kɔ ɛtane nu la sisi, na mɔɔ ɔkɛlua ɔ nwo zo ɔkɛzi la, ye gyakɔ.

translation_verse: Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo bizebizale Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo, na Gyisɛse ambua ye.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses stood up and accused him of all kinds of bad things.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ zile gyinlanle, bɔle bɛ nyunlu bile, totonle Gyisɛse ɛzonle mgbole.

english_verse: That same day Herod and Pilate became friends, even though they had been enemies before this. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɔvi kenle ko ne ala Paelɛte nee Hɛlɔdo yɛle agɔnwolɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnga. Bɛbu Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ (Mat

english_verse: As Jesus was being led away, some soldiers grabbed hold of a man named Simon who was from Cyrene. He was coming in from the fields, but they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
translation_verse: Sogyama ne vale Gyisɛse hɔle. Mɔɔ bɛkɔ la, bɛ nee nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn mɔɔ vi Saelin la yiale kɛ ɔvi ye namule zo ɔlɛba suakpole ne azo. Bɛhyele ye nuokɛ na bɛvale meanubaka ne bɛzoale ye kɛ ɔli Gyisɛse anzi.

english_verse: One of the criminals hanging there also insulted Jesus by saying, “Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and save us!”
translation_verse: Maamɔvoma ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛbɔ bɛ meanubaka nu la anu ko dendɛle tiale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Kelaese ne la ɔ? Die ɛ nwo na die yɛdayɛ noko ɛ!”

english_verse: Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people.
translation_verse: Paelɛte vɛlɛle sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne, mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛɛ ɛlɔne ne amuala manle bɛyiale,

english_verse: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Paelɛte kpondɛ kɛ ɔgyakyi Gyisɛse, yemɔti ɔdendɛle ɔhilele menli ne bieko.

english_verse: Pilate spoke to them a third time, “But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte hanle ye fane nsa ne azo hilele bɛ kɛ, “Na duzu ɛtane a nrenya ye ɛyɛ a? Mennwu debie biala mɔɔ yeyɛ mɔɔ fɛta ewule a. Yemɔti memaa bɛabila ye mbaka na meagyakyi ye.”

english_verse: The people kept on shouting as loud as they could for Jesus to be put to death.
translation_verse: Na bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua ɛsesebɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu, na nzinlii bɛlile konim.

english_verse: Finally, Pilate gave in.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Paelɛte buale Gyisɛse ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ la.

translation_verse: Ɔyele sonla ne mɔɔ ɔlua ye kɔdiawu nee ye maamɔlɛ nzakadolɛ zo bɛdole ye efiade na bɛse bɛkpondɛ ye la ɔmanle bɛ, na ɔvale Gyisɛse ɔmanle bɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la, bɛyɛ. Bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu (Mat

english_verse: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ baka ne le amolɛ la a, ɛnee saa baka ne wu a, duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛvale menli nwiɔ mɔɔ le maamɔvoma la bɛbokale Gyisɛse anwo bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkahu bɛ.

english_verse: Someday people will say, “Women who never had children are really fortunate!”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛlɛba mɔɔ menli baze kɛ, ‘Mraalɛ mɔɔ le mota, mɔɔ anwo mralɛ, yɛɛ bɛtɛnoanle ngakula nyɛfolɛ ɛlɛ la ati ɛyɛ boɛ!’

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne gyi ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛnea la ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛlɛsi ye amgbu kɛ, “Se ɔliele awie mɔ ngoane o; saa yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye ye la amgba a, bɛmaa ɔlie ɔ nwo ngoane ɔmaa yɛnlea!”

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Sogyama ne bɛdabɛ bɛzile ye amgbu; bɛhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛvale nwanye ɛnwonle bie bɛmanle ye,

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: na bɛzele kɛ, “Saa wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne a ɛnee die ɛ nwo ɛ!”

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Na ko ne hwile ɔ nyunlu zele kɛ, “Wɔmɔ ɛnzulo Nyamenle? Bɛbua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ kɛ ɔdaye ala la.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ, ɛnɛ kenle ye, me nee wɔ bahɔ Paladaese.” Gyisɛse ewule (Mat

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: Kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla yɛɛ ewia ne nlunle a, na awozinli hedale maanle ne amuala azo toonwo ewiazo dɔne nsa. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne dele sinli nwiɔ.

english_verse: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_verse: Akee bɛziale bɛhɔle sua nu bɛhɔkpondɛle alufuanlɛ nee sakyeɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛakpokpa funli ne la. Akee bɛliele bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne, kɛmɔ mɛla ne se la.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Father, I put myself in your hands!” Then he died.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse deanle nu kpole kɛ, “Egya! Me ɛkɛla wɔ ɛ sa nu!” Ɔhanle ɛhye na ɔwule.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ rale ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛbanlea bie la nwunle mɔɔ zile la, bɛbɔle bɛ sa ati na bɛziale bɛhɔle.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Manivolɛma mɔɔ ze Gyisɛse, nee mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ doale ye vi Galeli rale la gyinlanle ahane moa moa nleanle mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la. Gyisɛse ɛzielɛ (Mat

english_verse: There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwosefi. Ɔvi Arelematia mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli nu la. Nrenya ne le sonlakpalɛ, ɔdi nɔhalɛ na ɔlɛkendɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛralɛ. Ɔboka Ayiama ne anwo, noko yeanlie bɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ ne nee mɔɔ bɛyɛle la yeando nu.

english_verse: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle Paelɛte ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔzɛlɛle ye Gyisɛse funli ne.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Ɔdwulale funli ne aze, ɔvale lenen ɛdanlɛ ɔkyekyele funli ne na ɔvale ye ɔdole nla bie mɔɔ bɛpɛ ye wɔ bolɛ bie anu na bɛtɛsiele awie biala nu la anu.

english_verse: It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
translation_verse: Kenle ne le Yalɛ, na Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne ɛbikye.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ nee Gyisɛse vi Galeli rale la nee Dwosefi hɔle hɔnwunle sɛka ne nee kɛ bɛzile bɛziele ye la.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ ne mɔ a le Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la, Dwowana, yɛɛ Gyemise ɔ nli Mɛle. Bɛmɛ yɛɛ mraalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ nee bɛ lua la a hanle edwɛkɛ ne hilele ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ a.

english_verse: When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance,
translation_verse: Bɛnwunle kɛ bɛhundo bolɛ ne bɛvi nla ne anloa,

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: yemɔti bɛwolole nuhua, na bɛannwu Awulae Gyisɛse funli ne.

english_verse: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.
translation_verse: Bɛ adwenle yɛle bɛ kpomgbondee, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ nwohyee la ragyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ la ati, bɛbutubutule bɛ nye aze, na menli ne mɔ bizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛlɛkpondɛ mɔɔ de aze la wɔ mɔwuamra anu ɛ?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye Sonla Ra ne bɛwula ɛtanevolɛma asa anu, na bɛbɔ ye meanubaka nu bɛku ye; na ye kenle nsa ne anzi ɔdwazo ɔba ngoane nu.’ ”

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ne ala ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ bie ɛlɛkɔ sua bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛmeeyɛse la azo; ɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm bɛ avinli kɛyɛ kilomita bulu nee ko,

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu a bɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ adenle ye anu la?” Alɔbɔlɛ ngome manle bɛgyinlanle,

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: Ɛnee yɛ nye la kɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbarakpɔne Yizilayɛma a! Yeanga ɛhye angome, edwɛkɛ ne zile la ɛnɛ le kenle nsa.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Mraalɛ bie noko mɔɔ wɔ yɛ avinli la yɛɛ akee dule yɛ kunlu bɔbɔ a. Bɛhɔle sɛka ne azo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne,

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Yɛ bie mɔ noko hɔle sɛka ne azo la bɛhɔnwunle ye, kɛmɔ mraalɛ ne mɔ hanle la, na ɔdaye mumua ne ɛdeɛ, bɛannwu ye.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, bɛle ahɔnwɔne kpalɛ. Duzu ati a bɛngola bɛnlie mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la amuala bɛnli ɛ?

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Asoo bɛnnwu ye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala na yeahɔ ye anyunlunyia ne anu?”

english_verse: Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse bɔle ɔ bo vile Mosisi mbuluku ne mɔ nee mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha na bɛhɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu wɔ ɔ nwo la azo na ɔhilehilele nu ɔhilele bɛ.

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Maa yɛhɔla na mekɛ ne ɛhɔ, aleɛ ɛlɛdwo.” Yemɔti Gyisɛse nee bɛ hɔle sua nu.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee bɛ dɛnlanle aze kɛ bɛdi debie la, ɔvale kpanwo ne, ɔyilale zolɛ, ɔbubule nuhua na ɔvale ɔmanle bɛ.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛtendɛ wɔ adenle ne anu na ɔlɛkilehile yɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu la ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ bɛwuda senle yɛ ahonle nu la.”

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛdwazole na bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛhɔdwule la ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee ko ne nee menli mɔɔ nee bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛyia nu

english_verse: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛ nloa wɔ zolɛ bɛlɛka ɛhye mɔ anwo bie la, Awulae mumua ne ragyinlanle bɛ avinli [na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.”]

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛdwenlenle kɛ bɛnwu nwomenle.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛzulolɛ ɛha bɛ a? Duzu ati a bɛ ti akunlu ɛyɛ bɛ kesee ɛ?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Bɛnlea me sa nee me gyakɛ, na bɛnwu ye kɛ medame mumua ne ɛne. Bɛsosɔ me na bɛnlea, ɔluakɛ nwomenle ɛnlɛ nwonane nee mbowule, kɛmɔ bɛnwu me kɛ melɛ la.” [

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhanle ɛhye ɔwiele la, ɔvale ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ ɔhilele bɛ.]

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Noko fɛlɛko kpole nee azibɛnwo ammaa bɛanlie bɛanli. Yemɔti ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛlɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛke ɔ?”

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Na bɛmanle ye fɛlɛ sinli mɔɔ bɛze la,

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: na ɔlile ye bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛhye mɔ a le ninyɛne mɔɔ menganle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mengilele bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la: debie biala mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu, nee mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, nee Edwɛndolɛ mbuluku ne mɔ anu mɔɔ fane me nwo la kpokpoti ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nɔhalɛ.”

english_verse: Then he helped them understand the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Akee ɔbukele bɛ adwenle ɔmanle bɛdele Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne abo,

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la ɛne: Ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na ye kenle nsa ne anzi bɛdwazo ye bɛfi mɔwuamra anu.

english_verse: They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Akee bɛbɔ ɔ bo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke bɛva me duma bɛbɔ anlubɛnwo nolo bɛhile maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, na saa bɛdie bɛdi a, Nyamenle ava bɛ ɛtane ahyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: you must tell everything that has happened.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛdi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo daselɛ a.
