translation_verse: Medame mumua ne mebazoa deɛ mɔɔ Egya vale bɔle ɛwɔkɛ la wɔ bɛ nwo. Bɛdɛnla suakpole ɛhye azo ɛke kɔkpula kɛ tumi vi anwuma kɛra bɛ nwo zo la.” Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ anwuma (Mak

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse nee bɛ vi suakpole ne azo hɔle mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛdwu Bɛtani la, na ɔmanle ɔ sa zo ɔyilale bɛ.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔyila bɛ la, ɔdele ɔ nwo ɔvile bɛ nwo [na bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma.]

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ zonlenle ye na bɛvale fɛlɛkolilɛ kpole bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm,

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: na bɛhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu dahuu bɛhɔyɛle Nyamenle mo.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: Mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɛnee Edwɛkɛ ne nee Nyamenle a wɔ ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Ngoane kɔsɔɔti vi Edwɛkɛ ne anu a ba a, na ngoane ɛhye a le menli wienyi ne a.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Wienyi ne ta awozinli nu, na awozinli ɛngola ɛngye ye.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Nyamenle zoanle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔn la,

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: manle ɔrahanle wienyi ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele menli, amaa bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛade nrɛlaleɛ ne na bɛalie bɛali.

english_verse: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne a le nɔhalɛ wienyi ne mɔɔ ta menli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo na ɔba ewiade la.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ewiade ye. Nyamenle luale ɔ nwo zo a bɔle ewiade a, noko ewiade amra ɛnze ye.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: Ɔrale ɔdaye ye maanle nu, na ye menli ne anlie ye.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: mɔɔ bɛanlua nwonane nee mogya ngyehyɛlɛ zo a bɛwole bɛ na bɛarayɛ Nyamenle amra a, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔle bɛ ze a.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne rayɛle sonla mɔɔ ɛlolɛ nee nɔhalɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a, na ɔ nee yɛ dɛnlanle. Yɛnwunle ye anyunlunyia mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye kɛ ɔle Selɛ ne Ara kokye la.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlolɛ bebelebe ne ati, yeyila yɛ muala kɔsɔɔti, na ɔyila yɛ dahuu.

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Dwɔn anva anvea bɛ na ɔkpale nwolɛ ɛdanlɛ wienyi kɛ, “Tɛ mame a mele Mɛzaya ne a.”

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee wɔmɔ a le nwane? Wɔmɔ a ɛle Yilaegya ɔ?” Dwɔn buale bɛ kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, tɛ yemɔ a le me.” Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɔ?” Ɔbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee kile yɛ wɔ sonlazule. Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa mualɛ yɛkɔmaa menli mɔɔ zoanle yɛ la. Duzu a ɛka ye wɔ ɛ nwo a?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Dwɔn buale kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya hanle la: “Mame a mele ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛtea nu wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne anu, ‘Bɛdenrɛdenrɛ adenle ne bɛmaa Awulae ɛlua nu!’ la.”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ rale la, Falasiima a zoanle bɛ a.

english_verse: They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
translation_verse: Bɛbizale Dwɔn kɛ, “Saa tɛ wɔ a ɛle Mɛzaya ne, Yilaegya anzɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɛsɔne menli a?”

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Dwɔn buale kɛ, “Mame mefa nzule a mesɔne a, na ko bie gyi bɛ avinli ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnze ye a.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Yemɔ, ɔli me nzi ɔlɛba, na menfɛta kɛ menwɔzianyi ye mgbɔlaboa zo nyɛma bɔbɔ.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala zile Bɛtani, Azule Dwɔdan ne anloa mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ, ɛleka mɔɔ Dwɔn ɛlɛsɔne menli la. Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Dwɔn nwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛba ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeabɔ azu yeaye ewiade amra ɛtane yeahɔ la ɛne!

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye a ɛnee melɛka ye edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menganle kɛ ‘Nrenya bie li me nzi ɛlɛba na ɔle sonlakpole ɔtɛla me la, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ bɛkawo me la ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ.’

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Ɛnee menze ye sonlazule, noko membale kɛ mebava nzule meazɔne menli amaa Yizilayɛma anwu ye.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Daselɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn lile la ɛne. Ɔse, “Menwunle kɛ Sunsum ne vi anwuma ɛlɛdwu ɔ nwo zo kɛ abubule la, na ɔrazinzele ɔ nwo zo.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ɛnee menze kɛ yemɔ ɔ; noko Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zoanle me kɛ menva nzule menzɔne la zele me kɛ, ‘Ɛbanwu kɛ Sunsum ne ɛrazinze nrenya bie anwo zo; sonla zɔhane a le sonla ne mɔɔ ɔbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne yeazɔne la.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Na mese, menwu ye, na meka meahile bɛ kɛ, nrenya ɛhye, yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle Ara ne a.” Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ lumua

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Ye alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee Dwɔn nee ye ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne ko ne ala,

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: na bɛnwunle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛse. Na Dwɔn hanle kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Nyamenle Boaneralɛ ne ɛne!”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɛdoavolɛma nwiɔ ne dele la bɛgyakyile ye ɛkɛ bɛdoale Gyisɛse.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse dole ɔ nye na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛdoa ye la, ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛkpondɛ duzu?” Bɛbuale kɛ, “Relabae, nienwu ɛleka yɛɛ ɛde a?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛranlea.” Yemɔti bɛ nee ye hɔle sua nu na bɛhɔnwunle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde la, na bɛ nee ye dɛnlanle kenle ko ne.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Bɛ mu nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛdele Dwɔn edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛdoale Gyisɛse la anu ko a le Andelu, mɔɔ le Saemɔn Pita adiema ne.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Na ndɛndɛ ne ala Andelu hɔkpondɛle ɔ diema Saemɔn na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu Mɛzaya ne.”

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Na ɔ nee Saemɔn bɛrale Gyisɛse ɛkɛ. Gyisɛse nleanle Pita koonwu na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Saemɔn, mɔɔ le Dwɔn ara ne. Bɛbavɛlɛ wɔ Sifase.” Gyisɛse fɛlɛ Felepe nee Natanayɛle

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Felepe hɔkpondɛle Natanayɛle na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu sonla ne mɔɔ Mosisi hɛlɛle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ mɛla ne anu, na Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma noko hɛlɛle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ la. Yemɔ a le Gyisɛse, Dwosefi mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la ara ne.”

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Natanayɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Asoo debie kpalɛ bie kola fi Nazalɛte finde?” Felepe buale kɛ, “Bɛla banlea.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ Natanayɛle ɛlɛba la, ɔzele kɛ, “Bɛnlea, Yizilayɛnli kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnze adalɛ bɔ la ɛne!”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanayɛle bizale ye kɛ, “Na ɛze me nienwu?” Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Menwunle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛde feege baka ne abo la kolaa na Felepe aravɛlɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanayɛle hanle kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle Ara ne. Wɔmɔ a ɛle Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli ne a!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Kɛmɔ meha kɛ menwunle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛde feege baka ne abo la ati yɛɛ wɔlie wɔli a. Ɛbanwu nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye a!”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ muala kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: bɛbanwu kɛ anwuma ɛbuke na Sonla Ra ne ati, Nyamenle soanvolɛma ɛlɛfo dwu.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nwiɔ ne anzi bɛliele atɔfolɛ bie wɔ Kana sua zo, wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu. Gyisɛse ɔ nli wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie,

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛdole ɛsalɛ bɛvɛlɛle Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ noko.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛnlonle nwanye ne na ɔwiele la, Gyisɛse ɔ nli zele ye kɛ, “Bɛ nwanye ɛwie.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, mmaka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ la ɛkile me, me mekɛ ɛtɛdwule.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse ɔ nli zele sonvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile bɛ biala la, bɛyɛ.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Dwuuma lɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu ngyehyɛlɛ bie mɔɔ fane ɛnluanlɛ nwo. Debie zɛhae ati bolɛ dwora nsia wɔ awuke ne anu, ko biala kola di nzule litili ɛya ko.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele soanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛsesa nzule bɛgua dwora ne mɔ anu bɛmaa bɛyi tetɛkɛɛ.” Na bɛyɛle ye zɔhane.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Akee bɛza nzule ne bie bɛhɔmaa mɔɔ ɛlɛnea atɔfolɛlielɛ ne azo la.” Bɛzale bie bɛhɔle,

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: na ɔzɔle nzule ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛhakyi nwanye la bie ɔnleanle la, ɛnee ɔngola ɔnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ nwanye ne vi a ; yemɔti ɔvɛlɛle atɔfolɛ nrenya ne

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Awie biala die atɔfolɛ a, ɔdumua ɔye ye nwanye kpalɛ ne ɔfinde, na mɔɔ bɛkɛbo ekyii la akee yeava nwanye mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la yeara. Na wɔ ɛdeɛ ne, yeanyɛ zɔhane. Wɔva kpalɛ ne wɔzie dedee yeradwu bekezɛ!”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Na Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la a le ɔdaye mumua ne ye sonlabaka ne.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Dwuuma Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne asɛɛ ɛdwu, yemɔti Gyisɛse hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse vale nyɛma yɛle empele na ɔvale ɔvoanle nane ne mɔ, mboane nee nlankɛ kɔsɔɔti, ɔvile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu; akee ɔbutubutule ɛkponle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛfa bɛazenza ezukoa la ɔmanle ezukoa ne zandele sua ne anu,

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hakyele kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Nyamenle, wɔ sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ sɔ kɛ senle la wɔ me nu.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛbubu Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ɛhye bɛgua na mebava kenle nsa meazi ye bieko.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔdole kɛ menli ɛlɛdi nlankɛ, mboane, yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma gua wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na eza menli dede ɛkponle nwo ɛlɛsenza ezukoa.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔne mɔlɔnoma ne la kɛ, “Bɛva bɛ bɛvinde! Bɛmmafa Egya sua ne bɛyɛ gua nu!”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ziale rale na bɛrabizale ye kɛ, “Duzu nwanwane nyɛleɛ yɛɛ ɛkɛhola ɛkɛyɛ ɛkɛhile kɛ ɛlɛ adenle ɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ a?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hakyele kɛ yeha ɛhye ɛlɛ, na bɛliele Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle la noko bɛlile. Gyisɛse ze sonla deɛ holɛ

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne anu ɛnee Gyisɛse wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnwunle gyima mgbole mɔɔ ɔlile la liele ye lile.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse anva ɔ nwo ando awie biala anwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɔze bɛ kɔsɔɔti kpalɛ.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: Yeangyia kɛ awie kɛha sonla nwo edwɛkɛ kɛhile ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔze mɔɔ wɔ sonla biala ahonle nu la.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Nekɔdimɛse. Ɔle Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ko yɛɛ ɔboka fane ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Falasii la anwo.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔhɔle Gyisɛse ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Relabae, yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle kilehilevolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa wɔ a. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la bie yɛ kyesɛ Nyamenle nee ye lua.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ meahile wɔ: awie biala ɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne kyesɛ bɛwo ye fofolɛ.”

english_verse: Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
translation_verse: Nekɔdimɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na sonla mɔɔ ɛwie nyi la bɛawo ye fofolɛ ɛ? Ɔnrɛhola ɔ nli akunlu wolo ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛwo ye fofolɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ: kyesɛ bɛfa nzule nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛsɔne sonla anrɛɛ ɔnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛkɛlua nwonane ne azo bɛkɛwo ye la le nwonane, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlua Sunsum ne azo bɛkɛwo ye la le sunsum.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Mmamaa ɔyɛ wɔ ɛzulolɛ kɛ meha kɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwo wɔ fofolɛ’ a.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Anwoma ne bɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkulo la; ɛte ɔ ne, na ɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi ɔba a, yɛɛ ɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkɔ a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛwo ye Sunsum nu la de a.”

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Nekɔdimɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na ɛhye ayɛ zɔhane ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛle Yizilayɛ kilehilevolɛ kpole zɛhae, noko ɛnze ɛhye?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ meahile wɔ: yɛka mɔɔ yɛnwu ye na yɛbɔ mɔɔ yɛde la nolo, noko bɛ biala ɛnlie yɛ edwɛkɛ ne ɛndo nuhua.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Saa meka ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la anwo edwɛkɛ mekile bɛ na bɛnlie bɛnli a, ɛnee saa meka anwuma lɔ edwɛkɛ mekile bɛ a kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie bɛali ɛ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Awie biala noko ɛtɛkɔle anwuma lɔ kɛ Sonla Ra ne mɔɔ vi anwuma lɔ rale la ala.”

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Mosisi manle kɔbele ɛwɔlɛ ne zo wɔ baka zo wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne anu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbamaa Sonla Ra ne zo a,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: amaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anwu na yeanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle hulole ewiade amra kpole kpalɛ la ati yɛɛ ɔvale Ɔ Ra kokye ne ɔmanle a, amaa awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anwu na yeanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anzoa Ɔ Ra ne wɔ ewiade ye kɛ ɔrabua menli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ndɛne, na ɔralie ewiade amra ngoane.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛlie Ralɛ ne kɛli la bɛnrɛbua ye ndɛne, na mɔɔ anlie ye anli la, bɛbua ye ndɛne dɛbadɛba, ɔboalekɛ yeanlie Nyamenle Ara kokye ne yeanli.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Kɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne de la ɛne: wienyi ne ɛra ewiade ye na bɛ ninyɛndane ti, menli kulo awozinli tɛla wienyi ne.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛndane la kyi wienyi ne yɛɛ ɔnrɛlua nu ɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛye ye nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɔkɛhile.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la kɔ wienyi ne anu, amaa wienyi ne ada agua ye gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔlile la azo ahile kɛ ɔbɛlɛle ɔ nwo aze ɔmanle Nyamenle. Gyisɛse nee Dwɔn

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse nee ye ɛdoavolɛma ne hɔle Dwudiya maanzinli nu. Ɔlile kenle ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne na ɔzɔnenle menli.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Dwɔn ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee Dwuuma bie mɔ su kpolera wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu ɛnluanlɛ nwo.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛhɔle Dwɔn ɛkɛ ne na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, ɛkakye nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnee nee wɔ wɔ azule Dwɔdan ne anzi lɔ, mɔɔ ɛhanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ la ɔ? Kɛkala ɔlɛsɔne menli, na awie biala asɛɛ ɛlɛkɔ ye ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Dwɔn buale kɛ, “Awie biala ɛnrɛnyia ɛhwee kyesɛ Nyamenle fa maa ye.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛdi daselɛ kɛ menganle kɛ, ‘Tɛ me a mele Mɛzaya ne, na bɛzoanle me kɛ menlumua ɔ nyunlu.’

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Atɔfolɛ nrenya ne a le mɔɔ gya atɔfolɛ ne la, saa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne agɔnwo ne mɔɔ gyi ahane la te atɔfolɛ nrenya ne ane a, ɔ nye die. Me fɛlɛkolilɛ ne, ye munlililɛ kɛ de la ɛne.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonlakpole ɔtɛla me, na meyɛ ekyi.” Mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la le sonlakpole tɛla bɛ muala; mɔɔ vi ewiade ye anu la le ewiade ɛdeɛ yɛɛ ɔka ewiade edwɛkɛ, na sonla mɔɔ vi anwuma la bo ɔ muala azo.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Ɔka mɔɔ yenwu ye nee mɔɔ yede la, noko awie biala ɛndie ye edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ die ye edwɛkɛ ne to nu la kile maa bɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa ye la ka Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle maa ye Sunsum ne yi ye tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Selɛ ne kulo Ɔ Ra ne, na yeva ninyɛne muala yewula ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ die Ralɛ ne di la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na mɔɔ kɛkpo kɛ ɔnrɛlie Ralɛ ne ɔnrɛli la ɛnrɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɛlɛ, Nyamenle ndeanlɛ ne wɔ ɔ nwo zo dahuu.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Gyisɛse dele mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha la, ɔvile Dwudiya ɔziale ɔhɔle Galeli.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ la ɔvale Samɛlea maanzinli nu.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne zele kɛ, “Yɛmenle, na ɛnlɛ bokiti, yɛɛ bula ye noko anu kɔ. Na ɛnee nienwu yɛɛ ɛnyia ngoane nzule ne a?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo a manle yɛ bula ɛhye a, yɛɛ yemɔ, ɔ mra yɛɛ ye nyɛmoa nlonle nuhua nzule. Na ɛkpondɛ wɔaha kɛ wɔmɔ ɛle sonlakpole ɛtɛla Gyekɔbo ɔ?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: na mɔɔ kɛnlo nzule ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa ye la bie la, nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ. Nzule ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa ye la bahakyi nzubula wɔ ye nu mɔɔ bamaa ye ngoane nzule nee ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, maa me nzule ɛhye bie maa meno na nzuhɔne angu me bieko na eza meara ɛke kɛ mebaza nzule.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔvɛlɛ ɛ hu na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne wɔhɔ agyalɛ nnu, yɛɛ nrenya ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye de kɛkala la, tɛ ɛ hu ɔ. Wɔha nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne zele kɛ, “Yɛmenle, menea wɔ a ɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Me nlenya mɔ Samɛleama zonlenle Nyamenle wɔ boka ye azo, na bɛmɛ Dwuuma bɛse Gyɛlusalɛm ala a le ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle Nyamenle a.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, die me di, mekɛ bara mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛzonle Selɛ ne wɔ boka ye azo anzɛɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm a.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, bɛmɛ Samɛleama, bɛnze mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la, na yɛmɛ Dwuuma, yɛze mɔɔ yɛsonle ye la. Ɔboalekɛ ngoanelielɛ kɛra a ɔvi Dwuuma.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Na mekɛ ne ɛlɛba, yɛɛ yedwu bɔbɔ, mɔɔ ɛzonlenlɛma kpalɛ ne bazonle Selɛ ne wɔ sunsum nu nee nɔhalɛ nu a. Ɔluakɛ kɛ Selɛ ne kpondɛ kɛ bɛsonle ye la ɛne.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Nyamenle le Sunsum, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la bɛsonle ye wɔ sunsum nu nee nɔhalɛ nu.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Meze kɛ Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kelaese ne la bara. Saa ɔba a, ɔbaha mɔɔ ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala yeahile yɛ.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Medame a me nee wɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne ziale rale a, na ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo kpole kɛ ɔ nee raalɛ ɛlɛtendɛ a. Na bɛ nuhua biala angola ambiza raalɛ ne kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ ɛkpondɛ a?” na bɛabiza Gyisɛse kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ nee raalɛ ne ɛlɛtendɛ a?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Na raalɛ ne gyakyile ye nzule buakɛ ne ɛkɛ, ɔziale ɔhɔle na ɔhɔhanle ɔhilele sua ne azo amra kɛ,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Bɛrɛla bɛranlea awie bie mɔɔ ɛha debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ la ɛhile me a. Asoo tɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli dule twi, bɛvi sua ne azo bɛrale ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ la.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma ne gua zo ɛlɛkpa Gyisɛse kyɛlɛ kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, bakpula ɛ sa!”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Melɛ aleɛ medi mɔɔ bɛnze a.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbizebiza bɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɛnee awie ɛrɛlɛ ye aleɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me aleɛ a le kɛ menwɔli mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo na menwɔwie gyima mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle me kɛ menyɛ la yɛ.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ bɛse, ‘Yeha siane nna na ɛbuhenle ne adwu.’ Na meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea ɛya nu lɔ boɛ; nzoleɛ ɛbolo, na yedwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu a.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bu bɛyɔba ne la bɛtua ye kakɛ na ɔsoa nzoleɛ ne ɔkɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu, amaa mɔɔ dua nee mɔɔ bu la abɔ nu ali fɛlɛko.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Ɛrɛlɛ ne le nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, ‘Ko dua na ko bu.’

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Mezoa bɛ kɛ bɛhɔva bɛyɔba wɔ ɛya mɔɔ bɛanyɛ nuhua gyima la anu; awie mɔ gyɛne a yɛle nuhua gyima a, na bɛmɛ, bɛnyia menli zɔhane mɔ anwo nvasoɛ.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samɛleama dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la liele Gyisɛse lile, ɔboalekɛ raalɛ ne lile daselɛ kɛ, “Yeha debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ la yehile me.”

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Samɛleama rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔ nee bɛ ɛradɛnla, na ɔ nee bɛ dɛnlanle kenle nwiɔ.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko liele ye lile wɔ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ti,

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: na bɛhanle bɛhilele raalɛ ne kɛ, “Kɛkala, tɛ mɔɔ ɛhanle la ati yɛɛ ɛmaa yɛlie ye yɛli a. Yɛlie ye yɛli, ɔluakɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ yɛ nzo nu na yɛnwu kɛ amgba yemɔ a ɔle ewiade Ngoanedievolɛ ne a.” Gyisɛse yɛ arane abɔlɔba ko ara nrenya ayile

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne yeha ye ɛlɛ kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ biala ɛnlɛ ɔ nyunlu wɔ ɔdaye ye maanle nu.”

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɔdwule Galeli la, menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la liele ye gyɛlɛɛnye, ɔluakɛ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne mɔɔ bɛlile wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛhɔle bie na bɛnwunle debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ ɛvoyia ne abo la.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse ziale hɔle Galeli sua ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kana la azo bieko, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔhakyile nzule ne nwanye la. Arane abɔlɔba bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔ ra wɔ Kapɛnayɛm na ɔnde kpɔkɛ a.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Ɔdele kɛ Gyisɛse vi Dwudiya ɛra Galeli la ɔhɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔmaa bɛhɔ Kapɛnayɛm na ɔhɔyɛ ɔ ra ne ayile, ɔluakɛ asɛɛ yewu.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Bɛmɛ, bɛ biala ɛnrɛlie ɛnrɛli ɛlɛ kyesɛ bɛnwu nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mgbole bie.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Abɔlɔba ne hanle kɛ, “Yɛmenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, maa yɛhɔ na me ra ne kɛwu.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ na ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ.” Nrenya ne liele Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ ne lile, na ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Ɔlua adenle zo mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la, ye sonvolɛma nee ye yiale na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ.”

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Ɔbizale bɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ra ne dele kpɔkɛ la, na bɛhanle kɛ, “Anoma ewiazo dɔne ko yɛɛ ɛyɛlɛyɛlɛ ne dule a.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Nrenya ne hakyele kɛ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ” a. Yemɔti ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala liele lile.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a le nwanwane gyima kpole mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ Gyisɛse vi Dwudiya rale Galeli la ɔyɛle a.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi Gyisɛse hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Dwuuma ɛlɛdi bɛ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛvoyia bie la.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm “Mboane Anuhɔlɛ” ne anloa, nzubula bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔlɛ kpɔda nnu wɔ nwolɛ, bɛfɛlɛ nzubula ne wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Bɛtezata.”

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ nzubula ne anloa mɔɔ ye ewule ne hanle ye la ye ɛvolɛ abulasa nee mɔtwɛ ɛ.

translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Bɛlile kpanwo ne na bɛ ko yile la ati yɛɛ bɛlɛkpondɛ me bo zo a, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛdele me nwanwane gyima mgbole mɔɔ menyɛle la abo la ati ɔ.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Duzu yɛɛ yɛyɛ na yɛahola yɛayɛ gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la a?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛlie mɔɔ ɔzoanle ye la bɛkɛli.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya mɔ lile aleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye mana la wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, ‘Ɔmanle bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ vi anwuma la bɛlile.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: tɛ Mosisi a vale aleɛ ne mɔɔ vi anwuma la manle bɛ a; Egya a maa bɛ aleɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ vi anwuma la a.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ aleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle fa maa bɛ la a le sonla ne mɔɔ vi anwuma ɛdwu aze na ɔmaa ewiade amra ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, maa yɛ aleɛ ɛhye bie kenle biala.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne a. Mɔɔ kɛra me nwo la, ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la, nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu ye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, meka meahile bɛ kɛ bɛnwu me, noko bɛnrɛlie bɛnrɛli.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ Egya bava ye amaa me la bara me nwo. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛra me nwo la menrɛvoa ye,

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ mevi anwuma membale kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛhulolɛdeɛ, na meamba kɛ mebali me ti anwo.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ zoanle me la kpondɛ kɛ meyɛ ɛhye, amaa meamminli mɔɔ yeva yemaa me la bie, na meava bɛ muala meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li awieleɛ la.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Egya kpondɛ la a le kɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu Ralɛ ne na bɛkɛlie ye bɛkɛli la kɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ; na mebadwazo bɛ meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Dwuuma ne mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtendɛ Gyisɛse bɛ nzo abo, ɔboalekɛ yeha kɛ, “Mame a mele kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la.”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Na bɛhanle kɛ, “Tɛ Dwosefi ara Gyisɛse ɛhye ɔ? Yɛze ɔ ze nee ɔ nli. Adenle boni azo a ɔlua mɔɔ ɔka kɛ ɔvi anwuma a yera a?”

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi bɛ nzo abo ɛdendɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ɛngile kɛ awie biala ɛnwu Selɛ ne; mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne rale la a le sonla mɔɔ ɛnwu Selɛ ne a.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ kɛlie kɛli la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne a.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlenya mɔ lile mana wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, na bɛwule.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma ba la le aleɛ mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛli bie la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Mame a mele ngoane kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la. Mɔɔ kɛli kpanwo ɛhye bie la badɛnla ngoane nu dahuu. Kpanwo ne mɔɔ mefa meamaa ye la a le me nwonane ye mɔɔ meva memaa la, amaa ewiade anyia ngoane.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Saa bɛanli medame Sonla Ra me nwonane, bɛanno me mogya a bɛnrɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛli me nwonane ne bie na ɔkɛnlo me mogya ne bie la lɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na mebadwazo ye meara ngoane nu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ me nwonane ne a le aleɛ kpalɛ ne a, yɛɛ me mogya ne a le nzule kpalɛ ne a.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di me nwonane na ɔno me mogya la de me nu, yɛɛ medame mede ye nu.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Egya mɔɔ zoanle me la de aze, yɛɛ ɔdaye ɔ ti melɛ ngoane. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛva me kɛli la, medame me ti ɔkɛnyia ngoane a.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a le kpanwo ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la; ɔnle kɛ mana ne mɔɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ lile a nzinlii bɛwule la. Mɔɔ kɛli kpanwo ɛhye bie la kenyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkilehile wɔ Kapɛnayɛm nyianu sua ne anu la. Ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ edwɛkɛ

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔɔ doa ye la anu dɔɔnwo dele ɛhye mɔɔ ɔhanle la na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ngilehilelɛ ɛhye yɛ se. Nwane a kɛhola ɛhye azo di a?”

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Na saa akee bɛnwu Sonla Ra ne kɛ ɔlɛkɔ anwuma, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi ɔrale la ɛ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ maa ngoane la a le Nyamenle Sunsum ne; sonla anwosesebɛ ɛngola ɛnyɛ ɛhwee. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la a le Nyamenle Sunsum mɔɔ maa ngoane la.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Ɛhye ati a menganle mengilele bɛ kɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛra me nwo kyesɛ Selɛ ne ɛva ye ɛrɛlɛ me la.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, menli mɔɔ doa ye la anu dɔɔnwo ziale bɛ nzi na bɛangola bɛ nee ye anlua bieko.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Gyisɛse bizale ye ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne kɛ, “Na bɛdabɛ noko ɛ, bɛkɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛhɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Saemɔn Pita buale ye kɛ, “Awulae, nwane ɛkɛ a yɛkɔ a? Wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ maa ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Kɛkala yɛlie yɛli, na yɛze kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ɛra a.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛmɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ye, se memkpale nu menyele bɛ o? Noko bɛ nuhua ko le musuɔfoɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɔlɛka Dwudase mɔɔ le Saemɔn Yesekaleɔto ara ne edwɛkɛ. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwudase le bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔdaye ala a ɔbaye ye yeamaa a.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse hɔle akpɔsa wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu. Yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛhɔ Dwudiya, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛtɛ ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne ahu ye.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwuuma Belandane Bo Ɛdɛnlanlɛ Ɛvoyia ne bikyele la,

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse amediema mrenya ne mɔ zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ Dwudiya ɛ, amaa menli mɔɔ doa wɔ la anwu wɔ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛdi la.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ menli nwu ye kpalɛ la ɛnvea ye ninyɛne ɛyɛlɛ nwo. Kɛmɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ la, ɛnee ɛbɔneko ɛngɔ ɛmaa ewiade amra amuala ɛnwu wɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me mekɛ kpalɛ ne ɛtɛdwule. Bɛmɛ, mekɛ biala le kpalɛ maa bɛ.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Ɛtane ewiade ye ɛmkpɔ bɛ, na mame, ɔkpɔ me, ɔluakɛ meka mekile ye dahuu kɛ ye ndenle ne mɔ ɛnle kpalɛ.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ bɛhɔ bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne. Na mame, menrɛhɔ, ɔboalekɛ me mekɛ kpalɛ ne ɛtɛdwule.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye na ɔdɛnlanle Galeli. Gyisɛse hɔle ɛvoyialilɛ ne

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse amediema ne mɔ hɔle ɛvoyialilɛ ne la, nzinlii ɔdaye noko ɔhɔle, noko yeanye ɔ nwo yeangile, ɔveale ɔ nwo.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛlɛkpondɛ ye ɛsesebɛ wɔ ɛvoyia ne abo, na bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɔwɔ nienwu?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ rale ɛvoyialilɛ ne bie la hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ huhuhuhu dɔɔnwo. Bie mɔ se, “Ɔle sonla kpalɛ.” Bie mɔ noko se, “Ɔnle sonlakpalɛ, ɔlɛyɛ menli ne koasea.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Noko biala angola anye ɔ nyunlu anga ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ baguase, ɔboalekɛ bɛsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛlile ɛvoyia ne dedee na ɔhɔdwule ye avinli bie la, Gyisɛse hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkilehile.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Ye ngilehilelɛ ne zinle Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anwo kpole manle bɛhanle kɛ, “Na kenlenzu a sonla ɛhye zukoale ye nwoma ye, mɔɔ ɔtɛkɔle sukulu ɛlɛ, noko ɔze debie kpole zɛhae a?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ melɛkilehile la ɛnle me ti anwo ngilehilelɛ. Ɔvi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la banwu kɛ mɔɔ melɛkilehile la vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ anzɛɛ medame me ti anwo ngilehilelɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ di ɔ ti anwo kilehile la kpondɛ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ nyunlu. Mɔɔ kpondɛ anyunlunyia maa mɔɔ zoanle ye la ka nɔhalɛ ne, yɛɛ nvonleɛ biala ɛnle ye nu.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Tɛ Mosisi a vale mɛla ne rɛlɛle bɛ la ɔ? Noko bɛ nuhua ko biala ɛnli mɛla ne azo. Duzu ati a bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛku me ɛ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ɛlɔne ne buale kɛ, “Ɛnlɛ ɛ sa! Nwane a ɛlɛkpondɛ wɔ ahu wɔ a?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Nwanwane gyima kpole ko pɛ mɔɔ menyɛle la ɛzi bɛ muala bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Se Mosisi hanle kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mra mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ati, saa ɔdwu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bɔbɔ a, bɛyɛ.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Na saa bɛyɛ kakula nrenya mrenyanu nzonlɛ wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle na bɛndo Mosisi mɛla ne a, ɛnee duzu ati yɛɛ bɛva me nwo ɛya kɛ meyɛ sonla ayile memaa ɔ nwo ɛza wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ vi Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkɛ ne la bie mɔ hanle kɛ, “Asoo tɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkpondɛ ye bɛahu ye la ɛne?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Nea! ɔlɛtendɛ bagua nu, noko awie biala ɛngola ɛnga edwɛkɛ biala ɛntia ye! Ɛnee mgbanyima ne mɔ akee ɛlie ɛdo nu kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne ɔ?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Saa Mɛzaya ne ba a, awie biala ɛnrɛnwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi a. Noko nrenya ɛhye, yɛze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi la.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛlɛkilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Asoo amgba bɛze me yɛɛ bɛze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi la? Meamba me ti anwo adenle. Mɔɔ zoanle me la le nɔhalɛ. Bɛmɛ bɛnze ye,

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: na mame meze ye, ɔboalekɛ mevi ɔ nwo lɔ a membale a yɛɛ ɔdaye a ɔzoanle me a.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛyɛle kɛ bɛkye ye, noko awie angola anzɔ ye nu, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ye mekɛ ne ɛtɛdwule.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɔne ne anu la liele ye lile na bɛhanle kɛ, “Asoo Mɛzaya ne ba a, ɔbayɛ nwanwane gyima mgbole yeadɛla mɔɔ nrenya ɛhye ɛyɛ la?” Bɛzoa kɛ behɔhye Gyisɛse

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Falasiima dele mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛka ye huhuhuhu wɔ Gyisɛse anwo la, yemɔti bɛ nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ yɛle adwenle na bɛzoanle kɛ bɛhɔhye ye bɛrɛla.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Me nee bɛ badɛnla mekɛ ekyi bie ala na akee meahɔ mɔɔ zoanle me la anwo lɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛnrɛnwu me, ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ mekɔ la bɛnrɛhola ɛkɛ ne kɔ.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Dwuu mgbanyima ne hanle ye wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛnee nienwu ɛleka a ɔkɔ mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ ye a yɛnrɛnwu ye a? Ɛnee ɔkɔ Giliki azuamgbole ne mɔ bie azo ɛleka mɔɔ Dwuuma bie mɔ wɔ la yeahɔhilehile Gilikima ɔ?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Ɔse, ‘Bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛnrɛnwu me’, yɛɛ eza ɔse, ‘Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.’ Ɛnee duzu edwɛkɛ a ɔkpondɛ yeaha a?” Ngoane azudenle

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ li awieleɛ wɔ ɛvoyia ne ɛlilɛ nu la hyia kpole. Kenle ko zɔhane Gyisɛse dwazole na ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la ɛrɛla me ɛkɛ ɛranlo nzule.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, ‘Mɔɔ die me di la, ngoane azudenle vi ye ahonle nu baze.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye wɔ Sunsum ne mɔɔ menli mɔɔ die ye di la banyia ye la anwo. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛtɛfale Sunsum ne bɛtɛmanle, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛtɛdwazole Gyisɛse bɛtɛbale ye anyunlunyia ne anu. Menli ne avinli ɛkpakye

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɔne ne anu la anu dɔɔnwo dele mɔɔ ɔhanle la, na bɛzele kɛ, “Amgba, nrenya ɛhye a le Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛ ne!”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Bie mɔ noko se, “Yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne.” Eza bie mɔ noko se, “Mɛzaya ne vi Galeli ɛnrɛra.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se Mɛzaya ne bayɛ Belemgbunli Devidi dehelɛ, yɛɛ bɛbawo ye wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm, ɛleka mɔɔ Devidi dɛnlanle la.”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati mgbakyelɛ ralale menli ne avinli wɔ Gyisɛse ati.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Bie mɔ yɛle kɛ bɛkye ye, noko awie biala angola anzɔ ye nu. Dwuu mgbanyima ne ɛnlie ɛnli

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee Falasiima ne mɔ zoanle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔhye Gyisɛse la ziale rale, na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ati a bɛangye ye bɛamba ɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale bɛ kɛ, “Awie biala ɛtɛtendɛle kɛ nrenya ɛhye tendɛ la.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Falasiima ne bizale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmaa yeyɛ bɛdabɛ noko koasea ɔ?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛnwu kɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ bie anzɛɛ Falasiima bie bɔbɔ ɛlie ye ɛli?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔne ne die ye di, ɔboalekɛ bɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnze Mosisi mɛla ne, yemɔti abule kpalɛ a ɛbu bɛ a!”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nekɔdimɛse ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne bie, ɔle sonla mɔɔ ɛhɔ Gyisɛse anwo ɛlɛ a. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Yɛ mɛla ne kile kɛ saa yɛtɛtele sonla anloa anu edwɛkɛ, yɛtɛnwunle mɔɔ yeyɛ la a, yɛmbu ye ewule fɔlɛ.”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛdawɔ noko ɛvi Galeli ɔ? Kɔvedevede Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kpalɛ nea kɛ saa ɛkɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko bɔbɔ vi Galeli ɛvinde a!”

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Akee awie biala hɔle sua nu, na Gyisɛse hɔle Ɔlivi Boka ne azo.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, ɔziale ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Menli ne amuala rabɔle yiale ye na ɔdɛnlanle aze kɛ ɔkilehile bɛ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne nee Falasiima vale raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛhɔhye ye kɛ ɔlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la rale na bɛvale ye bɛziele bɛ avinli ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Bɛzele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Kilehilevolɛ, raalɛ ɛhye, yɛhyele ye kɛ nrenya ɛlɛfa ye awuvolɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Wɔ yɛ mɛla ne anu, Mosisi ɛhile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsi raalɛ zɔhane awolɛ dedee bɛmaa ɔwu. Na kɛ ɛse ɛ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Bɛhanle ɛhye bɛdole ye abɛla, amaa bɛanyia bie bɛagyinla zolɛ bɛahɔdoa ye. Na Gyisɛse hanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛbizebizale Gyisɛse kpuyia, na ɔdenrɛle ɔ nwo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ ɔnea a ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane ɛlɛ la ɛlumua ɛdo bolɛ ɛbɔ raalɛ ye.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye la eza ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔhɛlɛhɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Menli ne dele ɛhye la, bɛbɔle ɔ bo, ɔvi bɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ anwo zo, bɛhɔle ngoko ngoko dedee bɛwiele kɔ bɔkɔɔ. Ɔhale Gyisɛse nee raalɛ ne angome wɔ ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse denrɛle ɔ nwo na ɔbizale raalɛ ne kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, na menli ne mɔ wɔ nienwu? Ko bɔbɔ anga ambua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne buale kɛ, “Yɛmenle, ko bɔbɔ anga o!” Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnee medame noko membua wɔ ewule fɔlɛ. Kɔ, na mmayɛ ɛtane bieko.”] Gyisɛse a le ewiade wienyi ne a

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse dendɛle hilele Falasiima ne bieko kɛ, “Mame a mele ewiade wienyi ne a. Awie biala mɔɔ kɛdoa me bo zo la kɛnyia ngoane nu wienyi ne, ɔnrɛlua awozinli nu ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Falasiima ne zele ye kɛ, “Kɛkala, akee ɛlɛdi ɛ nwo daselɛ, mɔɔ wɔha la ɛndo ɛhwee.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa medi me nwo daselɛ bɔbɔ a, mɔɔ meka la le nɔhalɛ, ɔboalekɛ meze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi membale a, yɛɛ meze ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la. Bɛmɛ, bɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ mevi membale a yɛɛ bɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ a.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛabua ye ndɛne, na mame membua ndɛne.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Na saa mebua ndɛne bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ me ndɛnebualɛ bayɛ fɔɔnwo, ɔluakɛ tɛ me ngome a melua a; Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la boka me nwo.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ mɛla ne anu kɛ saa dasevolɛma nwiɔ anloa yɛ ko a, ɛnee mɔɔ bɛkɛha la le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Medi me nwo daselɛ yɛɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la di me nwo daselɛ.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛ ze ne wɔ nienwu?” Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnze me, yemɔti bɛnze Egya. Saa bɛze me a anrɛɛ bɛze Egya noko.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkilehile wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ azubɔlɛ nlɛka ne mɔ gyigyi la. Na awie biala angola ye kye, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ye mekɛ ɛtɛdwule. Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ bieko kɛ, “Mebahɔ; bɛbakpondɛ me, na bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu. Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ hanle kɛ, “Ɔse, ‘Bɛnrɛhola ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la kɔ.’ Ɛnee ɔkpondɛ yeaze kɛ ɔkahu ɔ nwo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Bɛmɛ bɛvi azɛlɛ ye azo, na mame mevi anwuma. Bɛvi ewiade ɛhye anu, na mame menvi ewiade ye anu.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ meha mehile bɛ kɛ bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu la. Saa bɛanlie bɛanli kɛ, ‘Medame a le Medame’ a bɛbawu bɛala bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ a le nwane?” Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Kɛmɔ melumua meha mehile bɛ ala la.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka ye bɛ nwo, yɛɛ melɛ dɔɔnwo mebua bɛ nwolɛ ndɛne. Mɔɔ zoanle me la le nɔhalɛ yɛɛ mɔɔ menwɔde menwɔvi ye ɛkɛ ne la a meka mekile ewiade a.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Bɛande ɔ bo kɛ Selɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ a Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ahile bɛ a.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛmaa medame Sonla Ra zo wɔ meanubaka ne azo anwuma a yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ ‘Medame a le Medame’ a; na bɛanwu kɛ menva me ngome me tumi menyɛ debie, na meka mɔɔ Selɛ ne kɛhilehile me la ala.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Eza mɔɔ zoanle me la nee me lua. Ɔtɛgyakyile me, ɔluakɛ dahuu meyɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ɛhye mɔ la liele ye lile. Alehelɛ nee ngɛkɛlɛ

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyisɛse zele Dwuuma mɔɔ liele ye lile la kɛ, “Saa bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma amgba;

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: bɛbanwu nɔhalɛ ne, na nɔhalɛ ne bamaa bɛanyia bɛ ti.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛle Ebileham abo zo amra, yɛɛ yɛtɛyɛle awie biala ngɛkɛlɛ ɛlɛ. Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɛse yɛkɛnyia yɛ ti ɛ? Duzu edwɛkɛ a ɛkpondɛ wɔaha a?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane la le ɛtane akɛlɛ.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Akɛlɛ ɛmbɔ abusua ne bie dahuu, na dehelɛ boka abusua ne anwo dahuu.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Saa Ralɛ ne yɛ bɛ alehelɛ a, ɛnee bɛle alehelɛ amgba.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ bɛle Ebileham abo zo amra. Noko kɛmɔ bɛnlie me ngilehilelɛ ne bɛndo nu la ati, bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛku me.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Meka mɔɔ Egya ɛhilehile me la, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze ɛha ɛhile bɛ la.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛ ze a le Ebileham.” Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa amgba ala bɛ ze a le Ebileham a, anrɛɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze yɛle la bie.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meyɛ la amuala a le kɛ menwɔha nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ mede mevi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la menwɔhile bɛ. Noko bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me. Ebileham anyɛ ɛhye!

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze kpalɛ ne yɛle la bie!” Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛnle arelazinli mralɛ; yɛ ze ala a le Nyamenle. Yɛle ɔ mra kpalɛ kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa amgba bɛ ze a le Nyamenle a, anrɛɛ bɛkulo me, ɔboalekɛ mevi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a membale a. Meamba me ti anwo adenle. Ɔdaye a ɔzoanle me a.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛnde mɔɔ melɛka la abo ɛ? Ɔboalekɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛtie me nrɛlaleɛ ne la ati ɔ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Bɛ ze kpalɛ ne a le Abɔnsam. Ɔ mra a le bɛ, yɛɛ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛ ze kpalɛ ne kulo la. Ɔbɔ ɔ bo amuala la ɛnee ɔle kɔdiawu. Yeanli nɔhalɛ ɛlɛ, ɔboalekɛ nɔhalɛ nretee zɛhae ɛnle ye nu. Saa ɔbɔ adalɛ a ɛnee ɔlɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la, ɔboalekɛ ɔle alane, yɛɛ ɔle adalɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ze.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Mame meka nɔhalɛ ne, na ɛhye ati noko yɛɛ bɛnlie me bɛnli a.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua boni a kɛzi ɔ kɛnra kɛha kɛ medi ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ a?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la tie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne. Bɛmɛ, bɛnvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, na ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛduodua bɛ nzo kɛ bɛnrɛdie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne a.” Gyisɛse nee Ebileham

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Dwuuma ne zele Gyisɛse kɛ, “Saa yɛka kɛ ɛle Samɛleanli na ɛlɛ ayɛne a ɛnee yɛbɔ adalɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ “Menlɛ ayɛne. Medi Egya eni, na bɛmɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛdi me eni.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Mɔɔ kɛli me edwɛkɛ zo la ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?

translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa me ngome mewula me nwo anyunlunyia a, ɛnee me anyunlunyia ɛndo ɛhwee. Ahenle mɔɔ wula me anyunlunyia la a le Egya, mɔɔ yemɔ a bɛse ɔle bɛ Nyamenle la.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,

translation_verse: Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ anlie ando nu kɛ ɛnee ɔle anyenzinliravolɛ yɛɛ bɛdukue ɔ nye a. Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle ye awovolɛ

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse dele kɛ bɛvoa nrenya ne bɛvi nyianu sua ne anu la, ɔkpondɛle ye ɔnwunle ye na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɛdie Sonla Ra ne ɛdi?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, na yemɔ a le nwane, amaa mealie ye meali?”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnwu ye dɛbadɛba, na yemɔ ala a nee wɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la.”

translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Membale ewiade kɛ mebabua ndɛne, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛzi la anwu debie, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwu debie la anye azi.”

translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Saa bɛ nye ɛzi a, anrɛɛ bɛnli fɔlɛ, na kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛse bɛnwu debie la, bɛ fɔlɛlilɛ doa bɛ.”

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
