english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ na bɛdi nyane. Bɛlie Nyamenle bɛli na bɛlie medame noko bɛli.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Egya awuke nu ɛkɛ ne, azua ngome; mekɔ meahɔziezie ɛleka meamaa bɛ. Saa ɔnle zɔhane a anrɛɛ menrɛha menrɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Saa mekɔ na mesiezie ɛleka memaa bɛ a, mebara bieko na mearava bɛ meahɔ me nwo lɔ, amaa bɛadɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ ɛleka mɔɔ melɛkɔ la.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Tɔmase bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, yɛnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la; na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanwu adenle ne mɔɔ kɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛ?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Mame a mele adenle ne, nɔhalɛ ne, nee ngoane ne a; awie biala ɛnrɛhola Selɛ ne ɛkɛ ne kɔ kyesɛ ɔdua me nwo zo.”

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔzɔle zo kɛ, “Saa bɛze me a anrɛɛ bɛze Egya noko, yɛɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, bɛnwu ye yɛɛ bɛze ye.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Felepe hanle kɛ, “Awulae, kile yɛ Selɛ ne; mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ la ala ɛne.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Felepe, yemɔti mekɛ tendenle ye mɔɔ me nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla la bɛnze me? Awie mɔɔ ɛnwu me la ɛnwu Selɛ ne. Duzu ati a akee ɛbiza me kɛ, ‘Kile yɛ Selɛ ne ɛ?’

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Felepe, na ɛnlie ɛnli kɛ mede Selɛ ne nu yɛɛ Selɛ ne de me nu ɔ?” Gyisɛse akee hanle hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la ɛnle me ti anwo edwɛkɛ. Selɛ ne mɔɔ de me nu la a yɛ ye gyima a.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Bɛlie me bɛli kɛ mede Selɛ ne nu yɛɛ Selɛ ne de me nu. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee gyima mɔɔ meyɛ la ati, bɛlie me bɛli.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Awie mɔɔ kɛlie me kɛli la kɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ meyɛ la bie, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la bɔbɔ, ɔluakɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ,

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye biala wɔ me duma nu la, mebayɛ, amaa bɛalua Ralɛ ne anwo zo bɛaye Selɛ ne anyunlunyia bɛahile.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Saa bɛbiza debie biala wɔ me duma nu a, mebayɛ. Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo ɛwɔkɛ

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Saa bɛkulo me a, bɛbali me mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Mebabiza Selɛ ne meamaa yeamaa bɛ Boavolɛ fofolɛ, na ɔ nee bɛ aradɛnla dahuu.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Boavolɛ zɔhane, yemɔ a le Sunsum ne mɔɔ baye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la ahile bɛ la. Ewiade ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye, ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛnwu ye yɛɛ ɔnze ye. Na bɛmɛ bɛze ye, ɔluakɛ ɔ nee bɛ a de a yɛɛ ɔde bɛ nu.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “Saa mekɔ a, menrɛgyakyi bɛ nrisa; mebara bɛ nwo bieko.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee ewiade ɛnnwu me bieko, na bɛmɛ, bɛbanwu me, na kɛmɔ mede ngoane nu la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛbadɛnla ngoane nu.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a bɛkɛnwu kɛ mede Egya nu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛde me nu, na medame mede bɛ nu la.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie me mɛla ne mɔ na ɔkɛli zolɛ la, yemɔ a kulo me a. Egya bahulo awie biala mɔɔ kulo me la, na medame noko mebahulo ye na meaye me nwo meahile ye.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Dwudase bizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, duzu ati a ɛye ɛ nwo wɔahile yɛ na ɛnrɛye ɛ nwo ɛnrɛhile ewiade ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Awie biala mɔɔ kulo me la bali me ngilehilelɛ zo. Egya bahulo ye, na me nee Egya yɛbara ɔ nwo ɛkɛ yɛ nee ye aradɛnla.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛngulo me la ɛnli me ngilehilelɛ zo. Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde la ɛnvi me ɛkɛ ne, ɔvi Selɛ ne mɔɔ zoanle me la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ de ala ye yɛɛ meha ɛhye mehile bɛ la o!

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Boavolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ Selɛ ne bazoa ye wɔ me duma nu la, barahilehile bɛ debie biala, na yeamaa bɛahakye mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la amuala.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “Anzonudwolɛ a mefa megyakyi bɛ a; medame me anzonudwolɛ a mefa megyakyi bɛ a. Menva memmaa bɛ kɛmɔ ewiade fa maa la. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ na bɛdi nyane; bɛmmasulo noko.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Bɛdele kɛ meha kɛ, ‘Melɛkɔ na mebara bieko.’ Saa bɛhulole me a, anrɛɛ bɛ nye ɛlie kɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ a, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ, ɔle kpole ɔtɛla me.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Kɛkala meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, kolaa na yeazi, amaa saa ɔsi a, bɛalie bɛali.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Menrɛhola me nee bɛ ɛnrɛdendɛ ɛnrɛhyɛ dɔɔnwo biala, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ sie ɛtane ewiade ɛhye la ɛlɛba. Ɔnlɛ me nwo zo tumi ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: noko ɔwɔ kɛ ewiade nwu kɛ mekulo Selɛ ne; yemɔti meyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔkɛze me la. “Bɛdwazo bɛmaa yɛhɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Mame a mele vanye baka kpalɛ ne a, yɛɛ Egya a le tola ne amenle a.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Me sa ngane biala mɔɔ ɛnzo ma la, ɔkpane ye ɔto, na ɔsiezie ngane ne mɔ mɔɔ so ma la, amaa bɛazo ma dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ meva memaa bɛ la ɛziezie bɛ ɛwie.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛdɛnla me nu, na medame mendɛnla bɛ nu. Baka ɛhane ngome ɛngola ɛnzo ma; saa ɔwɔ vanye baka ne anwo a yɛɛ ɔso ma a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne a, kyesɛ bɛmeta me nwo kɛ baka ngane la.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Mame a mele vanye baka ne a, yɛɛ bɛmɛ a bɛle ye ngane ne mɔ a. Mɔɔ kɛdɛnla me nu na menwɔdɛnla ye nu la bazo ma dɔɔnwo; ɔluakɛ saa menle nu a bɛ ngome bɛnrɛhola ɛhwee yɛ.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ andɛnla me nu la bɛfuandi ye bɛto kɛ baka ɛhane mɔɔ bɛpɛ la; ɔwe na ɔkyengye. Mbaka ngane mɔɔ le zɛhae la, bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛfuandi bɛ bɛgua senle nu bɛyela bɛ.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Saa bɛde me nu na me edwɛkɛ ne de bɛ nu a, ɛnee bɛbiza debie biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la, na bɛ sa kɛha ye.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛlɛye Egya anyunlunyia bɛahile; na ye zɛhae azo a bɛlua a bɛkɛhile kɛ bɛle me ɛdoavolɛma a.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Mekulo bɛ kɛ mɔɔ Selɛ ne kulo me la; bɛdɛnla me ɛhulolɛ ne anu.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi me mɛla ne mɔ azo a ɛnee bɛde me ɛhulolɛ ne anu, kɛmɔ meli Selɛ ne mɛla zo na mede ye ɛhulolɛ ne anu la.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, amaa me fɛlɛkolilɛ adɛnla bɛ nu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ali munli.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Me mɛla ne a le ɛhye: Bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, kɛmɔ mehulo bɛ la.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛnyia ye wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo la a le kɛ ɔkɛva ye ngoane ɔkɛdo aze ɔkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la a, ɛnee bɛle me gɔnwo mɔ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Menvɛlɛ bɛ sonvolɛma bieko, ɔboalekɛ sonvolɛ biala ɛnze mɔɔ ɔ menle ne ɛlɛyɛ la. Mefɛlɛ bɛ me gɔnwo mɔ, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ mendele ye wɔ Egya ɛkɛ ne la meha ye kpokpoti mehile bɛ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛnleanle bɛyele me a; medame a memkpale nu menyele bɛ a, yɛɛ mezoa bɛ kɛ bɛhɔlua Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne bɛmaa ɔzo ma dɔɔnwo kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ ɛlɛ la a. Yemɔti Selɛ ne bava debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza ye wɔ me duma nu la amaa bɛ.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ la a le kɛ; bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. Ewiade ɛkpɔlɛ

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Bɛhakye kɛ saa ɛtane ewiade ye kpɔ bɛ a, ɛnee bɛnwu ye kɛ yelumua yekpɔ me.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Saa bɛle ewiade ɛdeɛ a ɛnee ewiade bahulo bɛ kɛ ɔ ti anwo ɛdeɛ la. Na mekpa nu meye bɛ mevi ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anu amra avinli, yemɔti bɛnle ɛtane ewiade ɛdeɛ. Ɛhye ati ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anu amra kpɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la; ‘Akɛlɛ ɛnle kpole ɛndɛla ɔ menle.’ Saa bɛyɛle me kpɔdekpɔde a ɛnee bɛbayɛ bɛdabɛ noko kpɔdekpɔde; saa bɛlile me ngilehilelɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛbali bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ngilehilelɛ zo.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ bɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɔboalekɛ bɛmɛ, bɛle me ɛdeɛ, na ɛtane ewiade ɛnze mɔɔ zoanle me la.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Saa meamba meammanga edwɛkɛ ne meangile bɛ a anrɛɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ; kɛkala, bɛnlɛ bɛ ɛtane nwo nyelebɛnloa biala.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kpɔ me la kpɔ Egya.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Saa meambanyɛ nwanwane gyima ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ awie ɛtɛyɛle bie ɛlɛ la wɔ bɛ avinli a, anrɛɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ; na kɛkala, bɛnwu mɔɔ menyɛle la yɛɛ bɛkpɔ me nee Egya a.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔba ye noko ala la ɛne, amaa mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ mɛla ne anu la ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, ‘Mgbane gyɛne ne ala yɛɛ bɛkpɔle me a.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Boavolɛ ne mɔɔ le Sunsum ne, mɔɔ ye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la finde, na ɔvi Selɛ ne ɛkɛ ne la bara. Mebazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo meamaa ɔvi Selɛ ne ɛkɛ yearaha me nwo edwɛkɛ yeahile bɛ.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ noko bɛbaha me nwo edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne amuala, bɛ nee me a lua a.

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ, amaa bɛangyakyi bɛ diedi ne anu.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Bɛbaye bɛ ali bɛavi bɛ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu. Mekɛ bara mɔɔ awie biala mɔɔ kɛhu bɛ nuhua bie la badwenle kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ye Nyamenle gyima.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Bɛbayɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, ɔluakɛ bɛnze Selɛ ne yɛɛ bɛnze me.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Na meha ɛhye mɔ mehile bɛ, amaa saa mekɛ ne dwu na bɛlɛfa bɛayɛ bɛ a, bɛahakye kɛ menganle mengilele bɛ. Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne gyima “Meanga ɛhye mɔ meangile bɛ alumua ne, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee me nee bɛ a de a.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, melɛkɔ mɔɔ zoanle me la anwo lɔ, noko bɛ biala ɛmbiza me kɛ, ‘Ɛkɔ nienwu?’

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Kɛkala mɔɔ meha ɛhye mehile bɛ la, nyane ɛyi bɛ ahonle tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Na meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛ kɛ melɛkɔ a, ɔboalekɛ saa meangɔ a Boavolɛ ne ɛnrɛra bɛ nwo. Na saa mekɔ a, mebazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Na ɔba a, ɔbahile yeamaa ewiade amra anwu kɛ bɛvo kpole wɔ bɛ adwenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛtane nwo nee mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ kpalɛ nwo, nee Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anwo la anwo.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Bɛvo wɔ bɛ adwenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo la, ɔboalekɛ bɛnlie me bɛnli;

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: bɛvo wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo, ɔboalekɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ, na bɛnrɛnwu me bieko;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛvo wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anwo, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ sie ɛtane ewiade ɛhye la bɛbua ye ndɛne dɛbadɛba.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka mekile bɛ, noko kɛkala, bɛnrɛhola ɔ muala anu sɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Na saa Sunsum ne mɔɔ baye nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la ba a, ɔbamaa bɛanwu nɔhalɛ ne amuala. Ɔnrɛva ɔdaye ye tumi ɔnrɛdendɛ, na ɔbaha mɔɔ ɔkɛde, na yeaha ninyɛne mɔɔ bara la anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile bɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Ɔbawula me anyunlunyia, ɔboalekɛ ɔbaha mɔɔ meka la yeahile bɛ.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Egya lɛ bɛ la amuala le me ɛdeɛ; ɛhye ati yɛɛ meha kɛ Sunsum ne baha mɔɔ menwɔva menwɔmaa ye la ahile bɛ a. Nyanelilɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee bɛnnwu me bieko, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbanwu me.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ bizebizale bɛ nwo kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛhye abo a le duzu? Ɔse, ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee bɛnnwu me bieko, yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala bɛbanwu me’; eza ɔse, ‘ɔboalekɛ melɛkɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ.’

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Ɛnee ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala’ ɛhye abo a le duzu? Yɛnnwu mɔɔ ɔlɛka la anu.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse nwunle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛabiza ye la, yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Menganle kɛ, ‘Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛnrɛnwu me, yɛɛ eza ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbanwu me.’ Se mɔɔ bɛlɛbizebiza bɛ nwo la ɛne?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Bɛbazu bɛayi, na ɛtane ewiade ye bali fɛlɛko; bɛbali nyane, na bɛ nyanelilɛ ne bahakyi fɛlɛkolilɛ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Saa raalɛ fo awolɛ zo a, ye adwenle sɛkye, ɔboalekɛ ye nyanedelɛ mekɛ ɛdwu; na saa ɔwo a, ɔ rɛle fi ye nyane ne, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee ɔlɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ yewo ralɛ yedo ewiade a.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔle ɔmaa bɛ a; kɛkala alɔbɔlɛ ɛha bɛ, na mebaranwu bɛ bieko na fɛlɛkolilɛ bayi bɛ ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ, fɛlɛkolilɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ sa die ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: “Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, bɛnrɛbiza me bɛnrɛlie debie biala. Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile bɛ: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛbiza Selɛ ne wɔ me duma nu la, ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu bekezɛ la, bɛtɛbizale debie biala wɔ me duma nu; bɛbiza na bɛ sa kɛha ye, amaa bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ali munli. Ewiade anwo zo konimlilɛ

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Mebubu ɛhye mɔ mrɛlɛ nu mehile bɛ. Na mekɛ bara mɔɔ menrɛbu bɛ mrɛlɛ nu bieko a, mebaha Selɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ wienyi meahile bɛ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Saa mekɛ zɔhane dwu a, bɛbabiza ye wɔ me duma nu; menga kɛ mebabiza meamaa bɛ,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Selɛ ne ɔdaye ɔkulo bɛ. Ɔkulo bɛ ɔluakɛ bɛkulo me na bɛlie bɛli kɛ mevi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a membale a.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Mevi Selɛ ne anwo lɔ a membale ewiade a; yɛɛ kɛkala melɛfi ewiade meahɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne zele ye kɛ, “Awulae, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne akee ɛkpa nwolɛ ɛdanlɛ wienyi, ɛmbu ye mrɛlɛ nu bieko.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Kɛkala yɛnwu kɛ ɛkola ɛnwu debie biala; ɔngyia kɛ awie kɛbiza wɔ kpuyia bɔbɔ. Ɛhye maa yɛdie yɛdi kɛ ɛvi Nyamenle anwo lɔ a ɛrale a.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale kɛ, “Akee bɛlie bɛli ɔ?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛlɛba, na yedwu bɔbɔ, bɛbabɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti asande, na awie biala ahɔ ɔdaye ye sua nu, na yeaha me ngomekye. Noko ɔnrɛha me ngome, ɔboalekɛ Selɛ ne nee me lua.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Meha ɛhye mehile bɛ amaa saa bɛmeta me nwo a bɛanyia anzonudwolɛ. Ɛtane ewiade ɛhye bamaa bɛali nyane, noko bɛgyinla kpundii. Meli ɛtane ewiade ɛhye anwo zo konim!”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse wiele ɛhye ka la, ɔnleanle anwuma na ɔhanle kɛ, “Egya, mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Wula Ɛ Ra anyunlunyia na maa Ralɛ ne ɛwula wɔ anyunlunyia.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmaa ye menli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo tumi, amaa yeava ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la yeamaa menli mɔɔ wɔva bɛ wɔmaa ye la.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle kokye ne a, na bɛkɛnwu Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ wɔzoa ye la.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Mehile wɔ anyunlunyia ne wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo; mewie gyima mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la di.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Egya, fa me anyunlunyia maa me, anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ bɛkabɔ ewiade ye la ɛnee melɛ ye la, fa maa me wɔ ɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛkala.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Mela wɔ ali mehile menli mɔɔ ɛvale bɛ ɛvile ɛtane ewiade ye anu ɛmanle me la. Ɛnee bɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ɛvale bɛ ɛmanle me a. Bɛli wɔ edwɛkɛ ne azo,

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: na kɛkala bɛnwu kɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la vi wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la, meva memaa bɛ, yɛɛ bɛzɔ nu noko; bɛze kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ mevi ɛ nwo lɔ a membale a, yɛɛ bɛdie bɛdi kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: “Mesɛlɛ meamaa bɛ. Menzɛlɛ memmaa ɛtane ewiade ye. Mesɛlɛ meamaa menli mɔɔ ɛvale bɛ ɛmanle me la, ɔboalekɛ bɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ melɛ la le wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ la amuala le me ɛdeɛ; na bɛ nwo zo yɛɛ me anyunlunyia dua da ali a.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Kɛkala melɛba ɛ nwo lɔ; menle ewiade ye anu bieko, na bɛmɛ bɛwɔ ewiade ye anu. Selɛ Nwuanzanwuanza, wɔ duma ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la tumi nu ti, fa bɛ sie gyɛlɛɛnye, amaa bɛayɛ ko kɛ ɛdawɔ nee medame yɛle la.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la, menziele bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ wɔ duma ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la tumi nu. Membɔle bɛ nwo bane, na ko bɔbɔ amminli, kyesɛ kokye ne, Dwudase musuofoɔ ala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ minli la, amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Kɛkala melɛba ɛ nwo lɔ, yɛɛ melɛka ɛhye mɔ noko wɔ ewiade ye anu, amaa bɛ nye alie me nwo kpole wɔ bɛ ahonle nu.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Meha wɔ nrɛlaleɛ ne mehile bɛ, yemɔti ɛtane ewiade ɛhye kpɔ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛnle ɛtane ewiade ye ɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ menle ɛtane ewiade ye ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Membiza kɛ ɛye bɛ ɛvi ewiade ye anu, mesɛlɛ kɛ ɛkɛzie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye ɛkɛvi amumuyɛnli Seetan asa anu.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menle ɛtane ewiade ɛdeɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛnle ye ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Dua nɔhalɛ ne azo te bɛ nwo na fa bɛ yɛ wɔ ɛdeɛ; wɔ edwɛkɛ ne a le nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Mezoa bɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu, kɛmɔ ɛzoanle me wɔ ewiade ye anu la;

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɔlua bɛ ti medu me nwo memaa wɔ, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛadu bɛ nwo nɔhalɛ nu bɛamaa wɔ.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Menzɛlɛ memmaa bɛ ngome. Mesɛlɛ meamaa bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati bɛdie me bɛdi la.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛyɛ ko. Egya! Maa bɛdɛnla yɛ nu, kɛmɔ ɛde me nu na medame mede wɔ nu la. Maa bɛyɛ ko, amaa ewiade amra alie ali kɛ amgba ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la meva zɔhane ala bie memaa bɛ, amaa bɛayɛ ko, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ nee medame yɛle ko la;

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: maa mendɛnla bɛ nu, na ɛdawɔ noko tɛnla me nu, amaa bɛayɛ ko kpalɛ kpalɛ, na ewiade amra anwu kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a, na ɛkulo bɛ kɛmɔ ɛkulo me la.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Egya! Wɔva bɛ wɔmaa me, na mekpondɛ kɛ bɛ nee me tɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ mewɔ la, amaa bɛanwu me anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛvale ɛmanle me la, ɔluakɛ ɛhulole me kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade ye.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Pɛlepɛlelilɛ Egya! Ɛtane ewiade ye ɛnze wɔ, na mame meze wɔ, yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ ze kɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛzoanle me a.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Mela wɔ ali mehile bɛ na mebahɔ zo meayɛ ye zɔhane, amaa ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye me nwo la adɛnla bɛ nu, na medame noko meadɛnla bɛ nu.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse eza bizale bɛ kɛ, “Nwane a bɛkpondɛ ye a?” Bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛkpondɛ Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Se meha mehile bɛ kɛ medame ɛne. Saa medame yɛɛ bɛkpondɛ me a, ɛnee bɛmaa ɛhye mɔ ɛhɔ.”

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Paelɛte vindele rabizale bɛ kɛ, “Duzu ɛtane a sonla ɛhye ɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Saa ɔtɛtonle mɛla a anrɛɛ yɛnrɛva ye yɛnrɛrɛlɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Paelɛte ziale hɔle ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ la na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ a ɛle Dwuuma belemgbunli ne la ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛnee kpuyia ɛhye vi ɛdawɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne anzɛɛ awie mɔ yɛɛ ɛha ye me nwo ɛhile wɔ a?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Paelɛte buale ye kɛ, “Ɛdwenle kɛ mele Dwuunli ɔ? Ɛdawɔ wɔ menli ne nee bɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli yɛɛ ɛva wɔ ɛrɛlɛ me a. Duzu debie a wɔyɛ a?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Me belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnle ewiade ɛhye anu; saa me belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔ ewiade ye anu a, anrɛɛ me ɛlɔnema kɛho kɛmaa me na bɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛva me bɛnrɛmaa Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Kyɛkyɛ, me belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛnle ɛke.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte zele ye kɛ, “Se ɛnee ɛle belemgbunli o!” Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛdawɔ ɛse mele belemgbunli. Na ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ bɛwole me bɛmanle membale ewiade ye anu a, kɛ membanli nɔhalɛ ne anwo daselɛ. Mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ne ɛdeɛ la tie mɔɔ meka la.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Paelɛte bizale kɛ, “Duzu a le nɔhalɛ ne?” Bɛbua Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ (Mat

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Na bɛ amaamuo ne kile kɛ, saa bɛbali bɛ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne a ɔwɔ kɛ medwula pilizanli ko memaa bɛ. Bɛkɛhulo kɛ menwɔdwula Dwuuma Belemgbunli ne menwɔmaa bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛbuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ! Yɛmkpondɛ ye! Yɛkpondɛ Balabase.”

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Sogyama ne vale evileni nwonle abɔtile na bɛvale bɛkpolole Gyisɛse ati; bɛwulale ye tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ bie mɔɔ arelemgbunli ala a wula la

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: na bɛrahotole ye bɛgolole ɔ nwo bɛzele kɛ, “Dwuuma Belemgbunli, nyi kyɛ!” Bɛka ye zɛhae a ɛnee bɛhɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne bɛhɔbɔ ɔ nzo nu.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte eza ziale doale Dwuuma ne wɔ gua ne azo lɔ na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdie, me nee ye ba ɛke meamaa bɛanwu kɛ mennwu nvonleɛ biala wɔ ɔ nwo mɔɔ medua zolɛ mebu ye ewule fɔlɛ a.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛvindele, ɔbɔ ye evileni abɔtile ne na ɔwula ye arelemgbunli tɛladeɛ kɔkɔlɛ ne. Paelɛte zele kɛ, “Bɛnlea! Sonla ne ɛne!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne nee sinzavolɛma ne mɔ nwunle ye la bɛdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Bɔ ye meanubaka nu! Bɔ ye meanubaka nu!” Paelɛte zele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛrava ye bɛhɔbɔ ye meanubaka nu. Mennwu debie mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ mebu ye ewule fɔlɛ a!”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Dwuuma ne buale ye kɛ, “Yɛlɛ mɛla, na mɛla ne kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔwu, ɔboalekɛ ɔyɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Nyamenle Ara.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Paelɛte dele ɛhye la, ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle ye.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Ɔwolole ɔhɔle ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Ɛvi nienwu?” Na Gyisɛse andɛ ɔ nloa anu.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Paelɛte zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnrɛdɛne me zo? Kakye kɛ melɛ tumi mekola megyakyi wɔ anzɛɛ memaa bɛbɔ wɔ meanubaka nu bɛku wɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Ɛlɛ me nwo zo tumi, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛva ɛmaa wɔ a. Yemɔti sonla ne mɔɔ vale me rawulale ɛ sa nu la a di ɛzonle kpole kpalɛ a.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte dele ɛhye la, akee ɔbɔle nwolɛ mɔdenle biala kɛ ɔkpondɛ adenle yealua zolɛ yeagyakyi Gyisɛse. Na Dwuuma ne hanle ye anyebolo zo kɛ, “Saa ɛgyakyi ye a ɛnee ɛnle Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne agɔnwo! Awie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔfɛlɛ ɔ nwo belemgbunli la le Wulomu Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne kpɔvolɛ!”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔvale Gyisɛse ɔvindele na ɔradɛnlanle ndɛnebualɛ ebia ne anu wɔ ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hibulu aneɛ nu Gabata la.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee asɛɛ yedwu sɛnzɛngyinla, wɔ Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia kenle ne anu. Paelɛte hanle hilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛ Belemgbunli ne ɛne!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Na Paelɛte yele Gyisɛse manle bɛ kɛ bɛhɔbɔ ye meanubaka nu. Bɛbɔ Gyisɛse meanubaka nu (Mat

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati sogyama ne hɔle na bɛhɔbubule sonla ne mɔɔ lumua nee ko ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la agyakɛ.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Dwuuma sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ zele Paelɛte kɛ, “Mmakɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Ɔle Dwuuma Belemgbunli’, na kɛlɛ kɛ, ‘Nrenya ɛhye se: Mele Dwuuma Belemgbunli!’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ ɔ nli nee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkulo ye edwɛkɛ la gyi ɛkɛ ne la ɔhanle ɔhilele ɔ nli kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, nea, ɛ ra nrenya ɛne.”

english_verse: ) Jesus was taken away,
translation_verse: ) Bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛhɔle.

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Bɛmanle ɔzoale ye meanubaka ne na ɔrale ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Gɔlogɔta” la.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu a; bɛbɔle menli nwiɔ noko meanubaka nu wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ko wɔ Gyisɛse fema zo yɛɛ ko wɔ ye bɛne zo na Gyisɛse wɔ avinli.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Paelɛte hɛlɛle edwɛkɛ bɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka ne ati zo kɛ, “Nazalɛtenli Gyisɛse, Dwuuma Belemgbunli.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Dwuuma dɔɔnwo gengale, ɔboalekɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu la nee sua zo anwa biala. Edwɛkɛ ne, bɛhɛlɛle ye wɔ Hibulu, Laten, yɛɛ Giliki aneɛ ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Paelɛte buale kɛ, “Mɔɔ mehɛlɛ la a mehɛlɛ a!”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: sogyama ne zele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Bɛmmamaa yɛsuosua nu; bɛmaa yɛgua nwolɛ nzeleba yɛnlea ahenle mɔɔ ɔkɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ la.” Ɛhye zile amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Bɛhyɛle me adɛladeɛ ne mɔ bɛvale, na me bubu ne, bɛguale nwolɛ nzeleba.” Mɔɔ sogyama ne mɔ yɛle la ɛne.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛnee gyigyi Gyisɛse meanubaka ne anwo la a le Gyisɛse ɔ nli nee ɔ nli adiema Mɛle, Kulopase aye ne, yɛɛ Mɛle ne mɔɔ vi Magedala la.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Bɛdwule Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛnwunle kɛ yewu dɛbadɛba; yemɔti bɛambubu ɔ gyakɛ.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Tola bie zua ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbɔle Gyisɛse meanubaka nu la, nla fofolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛtɛtole sonla nu ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse nwunle kɛ akee debie biala ɛli munli ɛwie. Yemɔti amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Nzuhɔne ɛlɛku me.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Buakɛ bie mɔɔ nwanye bisii bie wɔ nu la gyi ɛkɛ: bɛvale emiane bɛbɔle nu, bɛvale bɛzianle nyinlanyinla baka ti, na bɛmanle ye zo bɛkpulale Gyisɛse anloa.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse liele nwanye ne na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yewie!” Akee ɔbɔle ɔ ti aze na ɔwule. Bɛwɔ Gyisɛse anvenle atwɛ

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Akee Dwuu mgbanyima ne zɛlɛle Paelɛte kɛ ɔmaa bɛ adenle ɔmaa bɛhɔbubu menli mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛ meanubaka nu la agyakɛ bɛmaa bɛwu ndɛndɛ na bɛdwula bɛ aze bɛvi meanubaka ne mɔ azo. Bɛzɛlɛle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɛnee kenle ne le Yalɛ na aleɛ kye a ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ɛhye le kenle nwuanzanwuanza kpalɛ kpalɛ maa bɛ la ati, bɛangulo kɛ avunli ne mɔ kɛhendɛhenda meanubaka ne mɔ azo zɔhane kenle ne.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Na sogyama ne mɔ anu ko wɔle Gyisɛse anvenle atwɛ, na ɛkɛ ne ala mogyanzule hwinle guale.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle ɛhye amaa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Bɛambu ye bowule ko bɔbɔ.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Eza Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ko noko se, “Menli anye banwu mɔɔ bɛwɔle ɔ nvenle atwɛ la.” Gyisɛse ɛzielɛ (Mat

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ aleɛ kye a ɔle Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle, na eza nla ne bikye la ati, bɛdole Gyisɛse nu.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Dwosefi, mɔɔ vi Arelematia la hɔzɛlɛle Paelɛte kɛ ɔva Gyisɛse funli ne ɔmaa ye. Paelɛte kponlenle zolɛ manle ye, yemɔti Dwosefi hɔvale Gyisɛse funli ne.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mu nwiɔ bɛvale ayile evuanlɛ ne bɛyɛle Gyisɛse anwo na bɛkyekyele ye wɔ kisane nu, ɔluakɛ kɛ Dwuuma yɛ bɛ funli la ɛne.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Tɔmase buale kɛ, “Me Awulae nee me Nyamenle!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Molɛ nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala mɔɔ maanle nu ɛtɛwiele tete la, Mɛle mɔɔ vi Magedala la hɔle sɛka ne azo na ɔnwunle kɛ bɛye bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛnyinle nla ne anloa la.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Akee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ lumuale dwule sɛka ne azo la ɔdaye ɔdwule nla ne anu; ɔnwunle ɛhye mɔ na ɔliele ɔlile.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Ɛdoavolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne anu ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Tɔmase la, ɛnle ɛkɛ ne a Gyisɛse rale a.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: Na ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛma nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule la kɛ bɛde ɛleka mɔɔ anrɛɛ Gyisɛse funli ne la la, ko de ɔ ti sɔlɔ yɛɛ ko de ɔ gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ɔnriandile ɔhɔbɔle Saemɔn Pita nee ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛye Awulae wɔ nla ne anu bɛhɔ, na yɛnnwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔdo ye a.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Pita nee ɛdoavolɛ ko ne hɔle hɔnleanle nla ne.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛlɛkɔ la bɛlɛ ɛnriandilɛ, na ɛdoavolɛ ɛhendeɛ ne nriandile ndɛndɛ dɛlale Pita na ɔhɔdwule sɛka ne azo.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze ɔnleanle nla ne anu la ɔnwunle kɛ kisane ne mɔ gua nu, na yeandwu nu.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Saemɔn Pita vi amozi rale, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdwule nla ne anu. Ɔnwunle kɛ kisane ne

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɛdanlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzɔle Gyisɛse ada la gua ɛkɛ. Bɛ muala bɛngua ɛleka ko. Bɛbubu ɛdanlɛ ne bɛgua ɔ ngome.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Mɛle hale sɛka ne azo zunle. Mɔɔ ɔsu la, ɔnleanle nla ne anu.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a?” Ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrava me Awulae bɛhɔ, na mennwu ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔdo ye a.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ, “Ɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛlɛsu a? Nwane a ɛkpondɛ ye a?” Ɛnee Mɛle dwenle kɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la a le sonla ne mɔɔ nea tola ne azo la ati, ɔzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, saa ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛrayele ye ɛhɔle a, ka na kile me ɛleka mɔɔ ɛhɔdole ye la maa mengɔnva.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Mmasɔ me, ɔboalekɛ metɛkɔle Selɛ ne anwo lɔ. Na wɔmɔ kɔ na kɔze me mediema ne mɔ kɛ, ‘Melɛkɔ Egya nee bɛ Ze ne, me Nyamenle nee bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo lɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɔvale ɔ sa nee ɔ nvenle ɔhilele bɛ. Ɛdoavolɛma ne anye liele kpole kɛ bɛnwu Awulae a.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Molɛ kenle ko ne ala mɔɔ ɛnee aleɛ ɛdwo kpalɛ la, ɛnee ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛhuohua bɛ nloa na bɛdo bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ bɛsulo Dwuu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Gyisɛse ragyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele bɛ bieko kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ. Kɛmɔ Selɛ ne zoanle me la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ medame noko mesoa bɛ a.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Akee ɔliele ɛnwomenle ɔguale bɛ nwo zo na ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛlie Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa awie ɛtane bɛkyɛ ye a, ɛnee bɛva bɛhyɛ ye; saa bɛanva bɛangyɛ ahenle a, bɛnrɛva bɛnrɛhyɛ ye.” Gyisɛse nee Tɔmase

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ hale la hanle hilele ye kɛ, “Yɛnwu Awulae!” Tɔmase zele bɛ kɛ, “Saa metɛnwunle ɔ sa nu pɛlɛko ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye la abo zo kapenle ne, metɛfale me sa metɛfuale kapenle ne, na metɛfale me sa metɛkanle ɔ nvenle kapenle ne a, menrɛlie menrɛli.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Ɔlile dapɛne ko la ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ eza huohuanle bɛ nloa na bɛdole bɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu bieko, mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Tɔmase boka bɛ nwo. Bɛtotole nlenkɛ ne mɔ anu ɛdeɛ, noko Gyisɛse ragyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛ.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Akee ɔzele Tɔmase kɛ, “Tɔmase, fa ɛ sa bɛla ɛke na nea me sa nu; tenrɛ ɛ sa fua me nvenle. Gyakyi wɔ kpolerazulɛ ne na die di!”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Wɔnwu me la ati yɛɛ wɔlie wɔli a? Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle me na bɛlie bɛli la!” Kpɔkɛ mɔɔ Buluku ɛhye gyi zolɛ la

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ nwunle bɛ, mɔɔ bɛangɛlɛ bɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu a.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛke la, bɛhɛlɛ amaa bɛalie bɛali kɛ Gyisɛse a le Mɛzaya ne mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne la, na ɔlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ ye nu la azo bɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Gyisɛse eza yele ɔ nwo hilele ɛdoavolɛma ne wɔ Taebilease Tandane ne anloa. Kɛ ɔyɛle la ɛne:

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Saemɔn Pita, Tɔmase, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Nda, Natanayɛle, mɔɔ vi Kana mɔɔ wɔ Galeli maanzinli nu la, Zɛbɛdi amra ne mɔ, yɛɛ Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma gyɛne nwiɔ, bɛ muala bɛwɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Saemɔn Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Mekɔ azule zo.” Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛ nee wɔ kɔ.” Zɔhane ati bɛ muala bɛhɔvale ɛlɛne na bɛhɔle, na nɔe ne amuala bɛyɛle biala na bɛangye fɛlɛ.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛba aradudu la, Gyisɛse ragyinlanle tandane ne anloa, noko ɛdoavolɛma ne annwu kɛ ɔdaye ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus shouted, “Friends, have you caught anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: Na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Mgbavolɛ ye mɔ, bɛhyele fɛlɛ ɔ?” Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Yɛannyia debie!”

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdo bɛ avonle ne wɔ bɛ sa fema zo ɛkɛ ne, na bɛkɛhye bie.” Amgba bɛdole avonle ne bɛ fema zo, na fɛlɛ ngome mɔɔ bɛhyele la ammaa bɛangola avonle ne twehwe gua ɛlɛne ne anu.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la hanle hilele Pita kɛ, “Awulae ɔ.” Saemɔn Pita dele kɛ Awulae la, ɔvale ye anwuma tɛladeɛ ne ɔwulale na ɔwulule ɔdɔle azule ne anu ɔweɛle ɔrale file zo.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdwule aze la, bɛnwunle kɛ bɛva emunlike bɛwuda senle na fɛlɛ gua zo yɛɛ kpanwo noko wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛva fɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ kɛkala la bie bɛrɛla.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛrɛla bɛrali debie.” Ɛdoavolɛma ne anu biala angola ambiza ye kɛ, “Na ɛdawɔ a le nwane?” Ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse hɔvale kpanwo ne, na ɔbubule ɔmanle bɛ; eza ɔhɔvale fɛlɛ ne, na ɔyɛle ye zɔhane ala.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Ɛhye a tɔ zolɛ nsa mɔɔ Gyisɛse yele ɔ nwo hilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazole ye bɛvile ewule nu la a. Gyisɛse nee Pita

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele debie di la, Gyisɛse zele Saemɔn Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me kpalɛ ɛtɛla ɛhye mɔ?” Pita buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Awulae, ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.” Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane mralɛ ne mɔ boɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse eza bizale Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me?” Pita buale kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, Awulae, ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.” Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Fane nsa ne azo eza Gyisɛse bizale Pita kɛ, “Dwɔn ara Saemɔn, asoo ɛkulo me?” Nyane hanle Pita kɛ Gyisɛse ɛbiza ye fane nsa kɛ, “Asoo ɛkulo me?” a, na ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Awulae ɛze debie biala; ɛze kɛ mekulo wɔ.” Gyisɛse zele ye kɛ, “Nea me mboane ne mɔ boɛ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Meka nɔhalɛ ne meahile wɔ: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛle kpavolɛ la, ɛnee ɛdawɔ ɛkola ɛmaa ɛ nwo zo ɛkɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkulo la, na saa ɛyɛ kpanyinli a, ɛbadenrɛ ɛ sa na awie akyekye bɛ na yeava wɔ yeahɔ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ ɛkɔ la.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ, “Bɛla maa yɛhɔ!” Gyisɛse nee ɛdoavolɛ ko ne

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Pita hakyile ɔ nwo na ɔnwunle kɛ ɛdoavolɛ ko ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse kulo ye edwɛkɛ la doa bɛ. Ɛdoavolɛ ɛhye ala a mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdi aleɛ ne la, ɔhwenle ɔbikyele Gyisɛse na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, nwane a baye wɔ amaa?” la.

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Pita nwunle ye la ɔbizale Gyisɛse kɛ, “Awulae, na nrenya ɛhye ɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale ye kɛ, “Saa mekulo kɛ ɔtɛnla aze kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la a, ɔle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɔ? Wɔmɔ baze maa yɛhɔ!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Yemɔti edwɛkɛ ne dendenle dwule Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne mɔ amuala anzo nu kɛ ɛdoavolɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛwu ɛlɛ. Noko Gyisɛse anga ye zɔhane. Ɔse, “Saa mekulo kɛ ɔtɛnla aze kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la a, ɔle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛdoavolɛ zɔhane a le ɛdoavolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ la, yemɔ noko ala a eza hɛlɛle a, na yɛze kɛ mɔɔ yeha la le nɔhalɛ. Adwulaleɛ

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Akee ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle a. Saa bɛhɛlɛle bɛ muala ngoko ngoko a anrɛɛ menea a nwolɛ mbuluku ɛnrɛzo ewiade ye amuala anu.

english_verse: Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first
translation_verse: Nana Tiyɔfelɛse: Wɔ me alumua buluku ne anu, menganle ninyɛne mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle nee mɔɔ ɔhilehilele la anwo edwɛkɛ

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: ɔhɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma la. Mɔɔ bɛbava ye bɛahɔ anwuma la, ɔluale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne azo ɔhilehilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la amuala.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ yiale la ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmatu bɛ bo bɛfi Gyɛlusalɛm, na bɛhendɛ Egya ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yebɔ bɛ ɛwɔkɛ na meha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mehile bɛ la.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Dwɔn vale nzule a zɔnenle a, na bɛmɛ, ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, bɛbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a bɛazɔne bɛ a.” Bɛva Gyisɛse bɛhɔ Anwuma

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee Gyisɛse yiale nu la bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Awulae, akee mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛbava Belemgbunlililɛ ne wɔamaa Yizilayɛma bieko ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ, “Egya a kyehyɛ mekɛ nee ɛlobɔ muala a, yemɔti ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛnwu kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛzi la.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Na saa Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ba bɛ nwo zo a bɛbanyia tumi, na bɛali me nwo daselɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, nee Dwudiya amuala nee Samɛlea bɛahɔdwu aleɛabo ɛleka biala.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhanle ɛhye la, bɛmanle ye zo anwuma, na mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi ɔ nwo ala la amungu liele ye vile bɛ nye zo.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye hale anwomanyunlu, na arɛlevilɛ nu ala mrenya nwiɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule la ragyinlanle bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne na bɛzele ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ,

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: “Galelima, duzu ati a bɛgyi ɛke na bɛ nye ɛha anwuma ɛ? Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ bɛrava ye wɔ bɛ avinli ɛke bɛhɔ anwuma la bazia alua adenle zɔhane ala azo ara bieko, kɛmɔ bɛnwu ye kɛ ɔlɛkɔ la.” Dwudase kɔliagya

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Bɛdwule la, bɛhɔle anwuma sua ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ nu la anu. Bɛmɛ a le: Pita, Dwɔn, Gyemise yɛɛ Andelu; Saemɔn mɔɔ le Maanle Kulovolɛ ne yɛɛ Felepe nee Tɔmase; Baatɔlomiyu, Mateyu, Afeɛse ara Gyemise, yɛɛ Dwudase mɔɔ le Gyemise ara ne.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛyia nu dahuu na bɛfa koyɛlɛ bɛ nee mraalɛ ne mɔ yɛɛ Mɛle mɔɔ le Gyisɛse ɔ nli ne nee ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: (Ezukoa ne mɔɔ Dwudase luale ye ninyɛndane zo liele la, ɔvale ɔdɔle azɛlɛ, na ɛkɛ ne a ɔvuandinle ɔ nwo ɔdele, ɔ ko kpukele na ɔ kunlu anyalɛ muala tulule guale na ɔwule a.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm la dele ɛhye. Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle azɛlɛ ne wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu “Akɛledɛma.” Ɔ bo a le “Mogya azɛlɛ.”)

english_verse: In the book of Psalms it says, “Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there.” It also says, “Let someone else have his job.”
translation_verse: “Ɔluakɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Edwɛndolɛ Buluku ne anu kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa ye awuke ɛbɔ; awie mmatɛnla nu ɛlɛ.’ Eza bɛhɛlɛ ye kɛ, ‘Bɛmaa awie fofolɛ ɛli ɔ gyakɛ anu.’

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛboka yɛ nwo, ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsɔne menli nee mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛ ye gyima ne, bakpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Awulae bɛhɔle anwuma la amuala, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nuhua ko baboka yɛ nwo maa yɛdi Awulae ewudwazo ne anwo daselɛ.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛzuzule menli nwiɔ, Dwosefi mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Baasabase nee Matayase.

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ bɛzele kɛ, “Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛze menli kɔsɔɔti ahonle nu a. Zɔhane ati Awulae, ɛdawɔ kilehile yɛ maa yɛye menli nwiɔ ye anu ko mɔɔ wɔvɛlɛ ye la,

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: maa ɔrayɛ wɔ ɛzoanvolɛ, ɔli gyima ne mɔɔ Dwudase gyakyile ziele ahane hɔle ye ɛdeɛ nu la.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Na bɛguale menli nwiɔ ne ati nzeleba la ɔbɔle Matayase. Yemɔti bɛvale ye bɛbokale ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee ko ne anwo.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɛntekɔso kenle ne dwule la, ɛnee diedima ne amuala ɛboa bɛ nloa ɛleka ko.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala alɛra bie vi anwuma kɛ ahumu kpole bie la rayile sua ne mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rayile bɛ tɛkɛɛ na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛka aneɛ ngakyile, kɛmɔ Sunsum ne vale manle bɛ kɛ bɛha la.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dwuuma mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ti bɛvi maanle gyɛne gyɛne nu bɛrale la tɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdele ɛnelɛ ɛhye la, bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo kpalɛ rale ɛkɛ, na ɔyɛle bɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole; ɔluakɛ bɛ nuhua ko biala dele kɛ diedima ne ɛlɛka ye sua zo aneɛ ne bie.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwane ɔmanle bɛhanle kɛ, “Na menli ɛhye mɔ, se bɛ muala bɛle Galelima o?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ akee yɛte kɛ bɛlɛka yɛdayɛ yɛ maanle nu aneɛ ɛ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛvi Patea, Medea, yɛɛ Yilam, Mɛsɔpɔteemea, Dwudiya, yɛɛ Kapadosea, Pɔntɛse, yɛɛ Ehyea,

english_verse: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome,
translation_verse: Felegyea, Pamefelea, Yigyibiti nee Lebea maanzinli ne mɔɔ bikye Saelin. Yɛ bie mɔ noko vi Wulomu,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛhakyi bɛsonle Dwuuma Nyamenle ne la, Kilitima nee Areleebeama, noko yɛ muala yɛte kɛ bɛlɛfa yɛ maanle nu aneɛ bɛaha ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Na azibɛnwo nu ala, bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛhye abo a le duzu?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Na bie mɔ golole bɛ nwo na bɛzele kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛbo nza.” Pita tendɛ ahile menli ne

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Na Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee ko ne mɔɔ hale la dwazole na ɔmanle ɔ ne zo ɔzele ɛlɔne ne kɛ, “Ebiamɔ Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la amuala, bɛdie bɛmaa mengile bɛ ɛhye mɔ abo.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛtɛbole nza, kɛmɔ bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ la, ɔluakɛ aleɛ hyenle la bɔ zo mɔɔ dɔne ngɔnla ɛbɔ a.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Na ɛhye a le mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Dwowɛle hanle dole ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔse,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Nyamenle se, mɔɔ mebayɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la ɛne. Mebamaa me Sunsum ne ara menli muala anwo zo. Na bɛ mra mrenya nee mraalɛ baha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ. Bɛ mgbavolɛ banwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ, na bɛ mrenya mgbanyinli aha ɛlalɛ.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, mebamaa me Sunsum ne ara me ngɛkɛlɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ anwo zo, na bɛaha Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Mebayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne wɔ anwomanyunlu na meayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo. Bɛbanwu mogya, senle, yɛɛ esike mungumungu.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne bayɛ awozinli, na siane ne ayɛ yɔɔnwo kɛ mogya, kolaa na Awulae anyunlunyia kenle kpole ne adwu.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Na ɔbara kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ Awulae duma la bɛkɛlie ye ngoane.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Yizilayɛma, bɛdie! Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la le sonla mɔɔ Nyamenle yele ye manle bɛ a; ɔluale ɔ nwo zo ɔlile gyima mgbole, ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nye zo, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛze a.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo, ɔliele ɔdole nu kɛ bɛkɛye Gyisɛse bɛkɛmaa bɛ; yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛmanle menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la bɔle ye meanubaka nu hunle ye a.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu na ɔyele ye ɔvile ewule asa nu; ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ ewule di ɔ nwo zo konim.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Devidi ɛha ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Menwu Awulae dahuu kɛ ɔgyi me sa fema zo, yemɔti menzulo.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati medi fɛlɛko me ahonle nu, na me nwo sande me wɔ me ɛdendɛlɛ nu, kɛ medame zɛhae ala, mɔɔ ewule a fɛta me la mede anyelazo nu;

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Nyamenle, ɛnrɛgyakyi me ɛkɛla wɔ mɔwuamra anu, yɛɛ ɛnrɛmaa wɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne nwonane ɛnrɛkpɔlɔ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Wɔhile me ngoane adenle ne, na medi fɛlɛko kɛ ɛ nee me lua.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Mediema, bɛmaa menga ye wienyi mengile bɛ kɛ yɛ ze Devidi wule na bɛziele ye, na ye sɛka wɔ ɛkɛ kɛkala.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ yɛɛ ɔze ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye a: Nyamenle hanle ndane dole zolɛ kɛ ɔbamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne bie ali belemgbunli kɛ ɔdaye Devidi la.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Devidi noko nwunle mɔɔ Nyamenle bayɛ la, yemɔti a ɔhanle Mɛzaya ne ewudwazo ne anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛangyakyi ye wɔ mɔwuamra anu, yɛɛ ye nwonane amkpɔlɔ.’

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛdwazo Gyisɛse ɛhye ɛvi mɔwuamra anu, kɛmɔ yɛ muala yɛdi nwolɛ daselɛ la.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ye zo bɛzie Nyamenle asa fema zo, na yenyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ ɔze vale bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la; na mɔɔ bɛnwu ye nee mɔɔ kɛkala bɛte la a le ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa yɛ la a.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Devidi ɔdaye mumua ne yeangɔ anwuma, noko ɔhanle ɔdole ɛkɛ ne kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne zele me Awulae kɛ, tɛnla me sa fema zo ɛke,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ agbɔvolɛ muala menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa Yizilayɛma amuala ɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ, Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye Awulae nee Mɛzaya a.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne dele ɛhye la, ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛ na bɛbizale Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ a?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛgyakyi ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ, na bɛmaa bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, amaa bɛava bɛ ɛtane bɛahyɛ bɛ na bɛanyia Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne, mɔɔ le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne le bɛ nee bɛ mra nee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka muala, mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne kɛvɛlɛ bɛ la ɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Na Pita hɔle zolɛ hanle edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo hilele bɛ na ɔdule bɛ folɛ kɛ, “Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi amaneɛ mɔɔ amumuyɛma ɛhye mɔ banwu ye la anu.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Na bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne ngilehilelɛ ne, bɛ nee bɛ zonlenle, na bɛbɔle nu bɛlile debie wɔ mediema ɛyɛlɛ nu. Diedima ne ɛdɛnlalɛ

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo manle ɔyɛle awie biala ɛzulolɛ nee azibɛnwo.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛliele Gyisɛse bɛlile la lile ahua na bɛhyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la bɛmanle bɛ nwo.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Bɛdɔnedɔnenle bɛ nwo ninyɛne nee bɛ agyadeɛ ne mɔ na bɛhyɛle ezukoa ne bɛmanle bɛ muala, kɛmɔ biala ɛhyianlɛ de la.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Kenle biala bɛyia nu wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, bɛbɔ nu bɛdi debie wɔ koyɛlɛ nu,

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
