translation_verse: na bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. Bɛnyianle bɛ nyunlu wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti avinli, na dahuu Awulae fa menli mɔɔ bɛlɛdie bɛ ngoane la baboka bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Kenle ko Pita nee Dwɔn kɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu wɔ ewiazo dɔne nsa nzɛlɛlɛ mekɛ ne anu la,

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: bɛhɔdole nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛwole ye abubura la. Dahuu bɛsoa ye bɛba Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Anlenkɛ Kɛnlɛma” la anloa bɛmaa ɔsɛlɛzɛlɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nu la ninyɛne.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Ɔnwunle Pita nee Dwɔn kɛ bɛlɛkɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la, ɔzɛlɛle bɛ kɛ bɛhyɛ ye debie.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Bɛnleanle ye koonwu, na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Nea yɛ!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Ɔnleanle bɛ, na ɔdwenlenle kɛ bɛbahyɛ ye debie.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Menlɛ ezukoa fee, na mɔɔ melɛ ye la a mefa meamaa wɔ la. Ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la duma nu, mese wɔ kɛ, dwazo tia!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ɔzɔle ɔ sa fema ne ɔdwazole ye, na ɛkɛ ne ala ɔ gyakɛ nee ye adwongu ne mɔ anu mianle,

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: ɔwulule ɔpenle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia. Ɔ nee bɛ hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, na ɔwuluwulule ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Menli ne amuala nwunle kɛ ɔlɛwuluwulu ɔye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ,

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: na nzinlii mɔɔ akee bɛnwunle kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ tɛnla sɛlɛzɛlɛ ninyɛne wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Anlenkɛ Kɛnlɛma” la anloa la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo, na mobolɛ kpole bole bɛ wɔ mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo. Pita tendɛ ahile menli mɔɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ nrenya ne doa Pita nee Dwɔn la, ɔyɛle menli ne nwanwane ɔmanle dɔɔnwo nriandile hɔyiale bɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne “Sɔlɔmɔn Kpɔda” ne abo.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Pita nwunle bɛ la ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Yizilayɛma, duzu ati a ɛhye ɛyɛ bɛ azibɛnwo na bɛ nye ɛha yɛ nwo ɛ? Anzɛɛ bɛdwenle kɛ yɛdayɛ yɛ anwosesebɛ nee yɛ ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ zo, yɛɛ yɛlua mɔɔ yɛmaa nrenya ɛhye ɛdia a?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Ebileham, Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne yɛɛ ɛwula ye Sonvolɛ Gyisɛse anyunlunyia a. Bɛyele ye bɛmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛkpole ye wɔ Paelɛte anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Paelɛte mumua ne kulo kɛ ɔgyakyi ye la.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Ɔle sonlakpalɛ mɔɔ anwo te a, noko bɛkpole ye, na bɛkpale Paelɛte kyɛlɛ kɛ ɔdwula kɔdiawu ne ɔmaa bɛ.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Bɛhunle sonla ne mɔɔ maa ngoane la, na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu; yɛ muala yɛdi ɛhye anwo daselɛ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse ɛhye duma nu nee ye tumi zo nee diedi wɔ ye duma ne anu yɛɛ nrenya ɛhye ɛnɛ gyi bɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛ yede kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Na mediema, meze kɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ yɛle Gyisɛse la, tɛ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo hanle dole ɛkɛ ne dɛba, kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ, yemɔti a ɔmanle ɔrale ye zɔhane a.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛzia bɛrɛla Nyamenle ɛkɛ, amaa yeava bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala yeahyɛ bɛ,

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: na mekɛ dwu a Awulae arɛlɛ bɛ Sunsum nu anwosesebɛ, na yeava Mɛzaya ne, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse, mɔɔ yeye ye dɛba yemaa bɛ la yɛarɛlɛ bɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtɛnla anwuma lɔ kɔkpula kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti fofolɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛlua ye kpɔmanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anwo zo ɛha ye dɛba la.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Mosisi hanle kɛ, ‘Awulae bɛ Nyamenle ne baye kpɔmanvolɛ avi bɛ avinli na yeazoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ yezoa me la, na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie ye na bɛdi mɔɔ ɔkɛha ɔkɛhile bɛ la amuala azo.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ andie kpɔmanvolɛ zɔhane la, bɛbaye ye bɛavi Nyamenle menli ne avinli na bɛazɛkye ye.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Eza Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, Samoɛle nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli ɔ nzi la amuala, biala hanle mekɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔluale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo ɔbɔle la le bɛ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele la, bɛwɔ nu bie, ɔluakɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele Ebileham kɛ, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra anwo zo yɛɛ mebalua meayila maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti a.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Nyamenle yele ye Sonvolɛ ne na ɔzoanle ye ɔmanle ɔlumuale ɔrale bɛ ɛkɛ kɛ ɔmaa awie biala ɛhwe ɔ nwo ɛvi ɛtane nwo na ɔyila bɛ.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pita nee Dwɔn anloa wɔ zolɛ bɛlɛtendɛ bɛahile menli ne mɔ la, sɛlɛvolɛma bie nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne neavolɛ kpanyinli ne nee Sadusiima fane ne anu amra bie mɔ ravindele bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ɛya kpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛzoanvolɛma ne ɛlɛkilehile menli ne mɔ kɛ Gyisɛse ɛdwazo ɛvi ewule nu, na ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ mɔwuamra badwazo ara ngoane nu bieko a.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔguale efiade kɛ aleɛ kye a bɛ nee bɛ kɛli, ɔluakɛ ɛnee aleɛ ɛdwo.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la anu dɔɔnwo liele lile na bɛkɛyɛ mrenya apenle nnu.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la Dwuu mgbanyima ne nee asɔne ne anu adile adile ne mɔ nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne yiale Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne bie la a le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Anase nee Kayafase, Dwɔn, Alɛzanda, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne abusua nu la.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma nwiɔ ne ragyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛbizale bɛ kɛ, “Kɛ bɛzile bɛyɛle nrenya ye ayile ɛ? Tumi boni azo anzɛɛ duma boni anu a bɛluale bɛyɛle zɛhae gyima a?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne vale Pita nyinle, na ɔbuale bɛ kɛ, “Nana mɔ nee egya mɔ,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: saa ɛnɛ kenle ye bɛlɛbiza yɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa nrenya abubura ye nee kɛ yɛzile yɛyɛle ye ayile la a,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: ɛnee bɛdie bɛmaa ɔdo Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti kɛ, ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte, mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye, na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile ewule nu la duma nu a ɛnɛ nrenya ɛhye gyi bɛ nyunlu ɛke kɛ yede kpɔkɛ bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse a le mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye ɔ nwo kɛ, ‘Bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛmɛ suasivoma bɛkpole la ɛrayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpole kpalɛ kɛ sua mgbɛnezo sika la.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ yɛlua a yɛkɛnyia ngoane a, ɔluakɛ awie bieko ɛnle aleɛabo mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ye duma ɛmaa mɔɔ yɛdua ɔ nwo zo a yɛkɛnyia ngoane a.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ayiama ne azibɛnwo kɛ Pita nee Dwɔn ɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae a, ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwoma a, na bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ bɛ nee Gyisɛse a anrɛɛ lua a.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Eza noko bɛnnwu mɔɔ bɛka a, ɔluakɛ nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye ayile la gyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛvale bɛ bɛziele ahane ekyii, na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛdwenledwenle nwolɛ.

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: Bɛbizale bɛ nwo kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ yɛyɛ bɛ ɛ? Awie biala mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke la ze kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛyɛ nwanwane gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae a, yɛɛ yɛngola yɛnga kɛ ɔnle zɔhane.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Na amaa edwɛkɛ ne andende la bɛmaa yɛdua bɛ kɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bɛka edwɛkɛ bɛkile awie biala bieko.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛle bɛ na bɛduale bɛ kɛ bɛmmatendɛ menli nu anzɛɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bɛkilehile menli.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Na Pita nee Dwɔn buale bɛ kɛ, “Saa ɔle kpalɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ yɛkɛdie bɛmɛ na yɛkɛgyakyi Nyamenle a ɛnee bɛdabɛ bɛbua;

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: na yɛmɛ, mɔɔ yɛde nee mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la, yɛnrɛhola yɛnrɛgyakyi ye ɛhanlɛ!”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔlua ɔ nwo zo bɛyɛle nwanwane gyima kpole zɛhae la ɛnee ɛli ɛvolɛ mɔɔ bo abulanla. Diedima ne sɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ avi Nyamenle ɛkɛ

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛgyakyile bɛ la, Pita nee Dwɔn ziale hɔle bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo ɛkɛ na bɛhanle mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli nee maanle mgbanyinli ne mɔ hanle la amuala bɛhilele bɛ.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la, bɛ muala bɛbɔle nu bɛzɛlɛle, “O Tumivolɛ Awulae mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee azɛlɛ, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala,

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: ɛluale wɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo zo ɛmanle yɛ nlenya Devidi, wɔ akɛlɛ ne dendɛle zele kɛ, ‘Duzu ati a maanle maanle ɛva ɛya kpole zɛhae a na menli dwenle adwenle ɛtane zɛhae ɛ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, maanle mgbanyinli ɛva adwenle ko na bɛtia Nyamenle nee ye Mɛzaya ne.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Hɛlɔdo nee Pɔnteɛse Paelɛte, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la amuala yiale nu wɔ suakpole ɛhye azo na bɛvale adwenle bɛtiale wɔ Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Gyisɛse mɔɔ wɔyɛ ye Mɛzaya la.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Bɛyiale nu bɛvale adwenle bɛyɛle debie biala, kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ wɔ tumi ɛhulolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne de la.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Na Awulae, akee nea kɛ bɛlɛsi bɛanwunlonwunla yɛ a. Maa yɛ, wɔ ɛzoanvolɛma, akɛnrasesebɛ maa yɛhola yɛha wɔ Edwɛkpa ne.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Kile wɔ tumi wɔ ayileyɛlɛ nu, na boa maa yɛlua wɔ Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Gyisɛse duma nu yɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛwiele nzɛlɛlɛ ne yɛ la, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyiale nu la kpusule. Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole bɛ na bɛnyianle akɛnrasesebɛ kɛ akee bɛka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ. Diedima ne kyɛ bɛ nwo ninyɛne

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Diedima ne amuala lile ahua wɔ ahonle nee adwenle nu. Bɛ nuhua biala anva ye debie biala ambɔ ye ɛbolɛ na bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ hyɛle debie biala mɔɔ ko lɛ ye la.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Na ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale tumi kpole lile Awulae Gyisɛse ewudwazo ne anwo daselɛ, na Nyamenle lole bɛ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua biala angyia, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ azɛlɛ anzɛɛ azua la dɔnedɔnenle bɛ, bɛvale ezukoa mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ nu la

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: bɛrɛlɛle ɛzoanvolɛma ne na bɛhyɛle bɛmanle awie biala nyianle bie, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛhyianlɛ ngakyile ne mɔ de la.

english_verse: Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means “one who encourages others.”
translation_verse: Dwosefi hɔdɔnenle ye azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la na ɔvale ezukoa mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ nu la amuala ɔrɛlɛle ɛzoanvolɛma ne.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Nrenya ko wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase. Ɔ ye bɛfɛlɛ ye Safaela. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛdɔnenle bɛ agyadeɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la;

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: ɔ nee ɔ ye yɛle adwenle ko, ɔdele ezukoa mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la bie ɔziele, na ɔvale mɔɔ hale la ɔradole ɛzoanvolɛma ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Pita zele ye kɛ, “Ananayase, duzu ati a wɔmaa Seetan ɛvo ɛ nwo zo na yemaa wɔbɛlɛbɛla Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne na wɔde ezukoa mɔɔ ɛnyianle ye la bie wɔvea ɛ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛtɛtɔnenle wɔ agyadeɛ ne la, ɛnee ɔle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔnenle wɔ agyadeɛ ne la, ɛnee ɔle wɔ ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔnenle ye la, ɛnee ezukoa ne noko le wɔ ɛdeɛ. Na duzu yɛɛ hanle wɔ manle ɛvale adwenle ɛhye a? Adalɛ ɛhye wɔambɔ wɔangile sonla; wɔbɔ wɔhile Nyamenle!”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananayase dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔpɛle ɔfinle na ɔwule ɛkɛ ne ala; na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne la amuala.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Mgbavolɛ ne mɔ dwazole, bɛyɛle ɔ nwo boɛ na bɛhɔziele ye.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Nzinlii, kɛyɛ dɔnehwele nsa anzi, ɔ ye noko rale; na ɛnee ɔtɛtele mɔɔ ɛzi la anwo bie fee.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Pita bizale ye kɛ, “Ka nɔhalɛ kile me, ɛ nee ɛ hu bɛ agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle ye la mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la amuala a le ɛhye ɔ?” Raalɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɔ muala ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛ nee ɛ hu bɛyɛ adwenle ko kɛ bɛbazɔ Awulae Sunsum ne bɛanlea ɛ? Nea, menli mɔɔ hɔziele ɛ hu la agyakɛ abo a ɛte ye wɔ anuhɔlɛ lɔ la, na bɛ nee ɛdawɔ noko bahɔ.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala ɔdaye noko ɔpɛle ɔfinle Pita anyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔwule. Mɔɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ziale rale la, bɛranwunle kɛ ɔdaye noko yewu, na bɛvale ye bɛhɔziele ye ɔ hu anwo ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle diedima ne nee menli mɔɔ dele edwɛkɛ ne la amuala. Nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ ngakyile

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne yɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ngakyile nee nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo wɔ menli ne avinli. Ɛleka mɔɔ diedima ne amuala bɔ nu yia la a le Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne kpɔda ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Sɔlɔmɔn Kpɔda” la abo.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ ɛmboka diedima ne anwo la ɛnwolo bɛ nu, noko menli kɔsɔɔti hanle bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ, mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ liele Awulae lile la rabokale bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Na ɔlua ɛzoanvolɛma ne gyima zo, nzinlii ɛnee akee bɛsoa wuleravolɛma bɛbagua ɛkpa zo wɔ awɔdenle ne mɔ azo, amaa ngyengyene nu bie ala Pita se ɛkɛ a ye ɛlawolɛ adɔ bie anwo zo na ɔ nwo aza.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Na menli mɔɔ wɔ azua mɔɔ bikye Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala vale bɛ awuleravolɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ sunsum ɛtane gyegye bɛ la amuala rale manle bɛyɛle bɛ ayile. Bɛyɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne kpɔdekpɔde

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdwazole ɛzoanvolɛma ne anwo zo na bɛhyele bɛ bɛguale efiade.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Na kenle ko ne nɔe ne, Awulae soanvolɛ rabukele efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ na ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele na ɔzele bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛhɔha ngoane fofolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ bɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle nwonlomɔ mangyee ne la, ɛzoanvolɛma ne hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkilehile. Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee ɔ sa zo ne mɔ manle bɛvɛlɛle mgbanyima ayia, na bɛdule menli kɛ bɛhɔye ɛzoanvolɛma ne wɔ efiade ne bɛrɛla.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ menli ne mɔ hɔle la bɛannwu ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ na bɛziale bɛrabɔle amaneɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Yɛhɔle la ɛnee efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ wɔ nyinlira nu, yɛɛ sinzavolɛma ne noko amuala gyigyi nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa; noko yɛbukele nlenkɛ ne mɔ la, yɛannwu awie biala wɔ ɛkɛ.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Ɛhye yɛle kpanyinli ne mɔɔ nea Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne sinzavolɛma ne anwo zo, nee sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ naa ekyii, na bɛdwenlenle nwo kɛ kabezɛ edwɛkɛ bie ɛzi ɛzoanvolɛma ne anwo zo.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Na yeangyɛ yɛɛ nrenya ko rabɔle bɛ amaneɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, menli ne mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade la wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu lɔ ɛlɛkilehile menli.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti sinzavolɛ kpanyinli ne vale ye ɛlɔnema ne na bɛhɔvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ bɛrale, noko bɛanyɛ bɛ mgbane mgbane biala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛsulo kɛ saa bɛyɛ ye kikilikikili a ɛlɔne ne kɛzi bɛ awolɛ.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye bɛragyinlanle ayiama ne anyunlu, na Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizale bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Bɛmɛ, yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɛmmabɔ sonla zɔhane duma bɛkilehile menli wɔ ɛleka biala, noko nea mɔɔ akee bɛlɛyɛ a. Bɛva bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne bɛkponde Gyɛlusalɛm amuala; bɛyɛ bɛamaa yɛmɛ yɛali ɛzonle wɔ sonla ne ewule nwo!”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Na Pita nee ɛzoanvolɛma ne buale kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtie Nyamenle yɛtɛla sonla.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne dwazole Gyisɛse mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye la vile ewule nu.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa ye zo ɛzie ye ye fema zo ɛyɛ ye Adenlekilevolɛ nee Dievolɛ kɛ ɔhile Yizilayɛma adenle ɔmaa bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛanyia ɛtanefakyɛ a.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ yɛɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ le Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie ye la, yɛdi ɛhye anwo daselɛ.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Ɛhye yelale ayiama ne kpole manle bɛyɛle kɛ bɛku ɛzoanvolɛma ne.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nuhua ko dwazole. Ɔle Falasiinli, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gameeleɛle. Ɔle mɛla kilehilevolɛ yɛɛ maanlema bu ye kpole kpalɛ. Ɔmanle bɛvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ bɛvindele,

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: na ɔzele ayiama ne kɛ, “Yizilayɛ mgbanyima, bɛnlea boɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛayɛ menli ɛhye mɔ la anwo.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, wɔ menli ɛdianlɛ mekɛ ne anu, Dwudase mɔɔ vi Galeli la ɔdaye ɔdwazole. Ɔdaye ɔhwenle menli dɔɔnwo ɔlile ɔ nzi. Na ɔdaye bɛhunle ye na menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la amuala zandele.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo la a le kɛ, bɛgyakyi bɛ, bɛmmayɛ bɛ ɛhwee. Na saa mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la le sonla ngyehyɛlɛ a, ɔbazɛkye.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Saa ɔvi Nyamenle noko a, yemɔ ɔyɛ se kɛ bɛkɛhola ye sɛkye, yɛɛ eza noko bɛannea boɛ a, bɛbaho bɛatia Nyamenle.” Ayiama ne vale Gameeleɛle folɛdulɛ ne.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ɛzoanvolɛma ne bɛrale ayiama ne anyunlu bieko, bɛbilale bɛ empele, na bɛduale bɛ kɛ bɛmmabɔ Gyisɛse duma bieko ɛlɛ ɛleka biala; na bɛgyakyile bɛ.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale fɛlɛkolilɛ vile ayia sua ne anu hɔle, kɛ bɛdabɛ bɔbɔ Nyamenle ɛbu bɛ bie, na ɔlua Gyisɛse duma ne ati bɛnwu amaneɛ a.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Yemɔti dahuu bɛhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu nee azua nu bɛhilehilele na bɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la nolo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Mɛzaya ne a.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Nzinlii, mɔɔ ɛnee akee ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo ɛlɛso la, ɛdendɛlɛ radɔle Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki nee Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la avinli. Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki la se bɛbu bɛ nye bɛgua bɛ ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ anwo zo wɔ dahuu ndɔnielilɛ nu.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne vɛlɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne amuala na bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ ndɔnielilɛ ti yɛkɛbu yɛ nye yɛkɛgua Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ zo.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, ayi mɔ, bɛnlea na bɛye bɛ nuhua nsuu mɔɔ menli bu bɛ, mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo na bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la bɛmaa yɛ, na yɛva bɛ yɛzie zɛhae gyima ye anloa,

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: amaa yɛdayɛ noko yɛanyia mekɛ yɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee Edwɛkpa ne ɛhanlɛ gyima ne.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ nzuzulɛ ne zɔle bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nye, na bɛyele Sitivin, mɔɔ lɛ diedi ne anu kpundii na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la, Felepe, Polɔkɔlɛse, Nekanɔ, Taemɔn, Paamɛnase, yɛɛ Nekɔlɔso mɔɔ vi Anteɔko, mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli na yehakyi ɔsonle Dwuuma Nyamenle ne la.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ bɛmanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne, ɛzoanvolɛma ne vale bɛ sa guale bɛ ti zo na bɛyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmanle bɛ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne akee nyinle kpole manle menli somaa rabokale bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛle dɔɔnwo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛɛ eza sɛlɛvolɛma dɔɔnwo liele Edwɛkpa ne lile. Sitivin ɛhyelɛ

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Nyamenle lole Sitivin dɔɔnwo na ɔmanle ye tumi kpole ɔmanle ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole ɔhilele menli.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menli bie mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ nwo “Fanwodi Sukuluma” na bɛvi Saelin nee Alɛzandelea, nee bie mɔ mɔɔ vi Selesea nee Ehyea la bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛ nee Sitivin su kpolera.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Na Sunsum ne manle Sitivin nrɛlɛbɛ dɔɔnwo, yemɔti bɛangola ye fee.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛwulowulale menli bie abo bɛmanle bɛhanle kɛ, “Yɛdele kɛ ɔlɛka munzule edwɛkɛ yeatia Mosisi nee Nyamenle.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Na bɛluale adenle ɛhye azo bɛmanle maanlema nee asɔne mgbanyima ne nee mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ vale ɛya na bɛhyele Sitivin bɛ nee ye hɔle ayiama ne anyunlu.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛmanle menli ralile dasewia kɛ, “Nrenya ɛhye, dahuu ɔtendɛ ɔtia yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ye nee Mosisi mɛla ne.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Yɛdele kɛ ɔlɛka kɛ Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la barazɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye, na yeahakyi maamɛla biala mɔɔ Mosisi hyehyɛle manle yɛ la!”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ayia ne abo la amuala anye hale Sitivin anwo, na bɛnwunle kɛ ɛnee ɔ nyunlu ɛyɛ kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ nyunlu la.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bizale Sitivin kɛ, “Asoo ɛhye mɔ le zɔhane?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Sitivin buale kɛ, “Mediema mrenya nee egya mɔ, bɛdie me! Anyunlunyia Nyamenle ne yele ɔ nwo hilele yɛ nlenya Ebileham wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ Mɛsɔpɔteemea la, kolaa na yeadu yeahɔdɛnla Hɛlan.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Ɛvi wɔ abusua nee wɔ maanle ye anu tu na kɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ mebahile wɔ la azo.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ ɔvi Kaledea mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye maanle nu la ɔdule ɔhɔdɛnlanle Hɛlan a. Nzinlii mɔɔ Ebileham ɔ ze wule la, Nyamenle manle ɔradɛnlanle azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛnɛ bɛmɛ bɛde zolɛ la azo.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Nyamenle ɛtɛfale azɛlɛ ne ɛleka biala ɛtɛmanle Ebileham kɛ ɔle ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ. Azɛlɛ waa ko bɔbɔ bɔle ye, noko ɛnee Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava yeamaa ye nee ɔ bo zo amra, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Ebileham mumua ne ɛnlɛ ralɛ la.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Kɛ Nyamenle zele ye la ɛne, ‘Ɛ bo zo amra bahɔ maanɔne ahɔyɛ ahanra, bɛahile bɛ nyane toonwo ɛvolɛ ɛya nna.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Nzinlii mebadea menli zɔhane mɔɔ bɛbahɔzonle bɛ la, na bɛvi maanle zɔhane anu bɛbaye bɛ nwo na bɛarazonle me wɔ ɛke ala.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle manle Ebileham ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ, yemɔ a le mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ. Yemɔti Ebileham wole Ayezeke la ye kenle mɔtwɛ ne azo ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Ayezeke wole Gyekɔbo na ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo wole mralɛ mrenya bulu nee nwiɔ ne, mɔɔ le yɛ nlenya mɔ titile ne, na ɔyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: “Dwosefi anwo yɛle ɔ mediema ne mɔ ɛya na ɔlua zolɛ bɛdɔnenle ye kɛ kanra bɛmanle bɛ nee ye hɔle Yigyibiti, na Nyamenle lile ɔ nzi,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: na ɔyele ye ɔvile ye amaneɛnwunlɛ muala anu. Mɔɔ Dwosefi dwule Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne anyunlu la, Nyamenle manle ye nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔlua zo ɔnyianle ɔ nyunlu. Na Yigyibiti belemgbunli yɛle ye amɛnlado wɔ ye maanle ne anu nee ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne neavolɛ.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu, sane nee ɛhɔne rale Yigyibiti nee Keena maanle ne mɔ anu, manle ɔyɛle abodelɛ kpalɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛnnyia aleɛ wɔ ɛleka biala a.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Gyekɔbo dele kɛ aleɛ wɔ Yigyibiti la, ɔzoanle ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ, mɔɔ le yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ ne la, Dwosefi yele ɔ nwo hilele ɔ mediema ne mɔ, na ɔlua zolɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne nwunle Dwosefi abusua ne.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Dwosefi vale nrɛlaleɛ hɔmanle ɔ ze Gyekɔbo kɛ ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala ɛrɛla Yigyibiti. Bɛle menli abulasuu nee nnu.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Gyekɔbo hɔle Yigyibiti, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwule na yɛ nlenya mɔ noko wule a.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Bɛdule bɛ avunli ne mɔ bɛrale Hyikɛm na bɛziele bɛ wɔ sɛka ne mɔɔ Ebileham dɔle vile Heemɔ abusua ne lɔ la anu.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Mɔɔ mekɛ ne bikyele mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle akee ye ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya Ebileham la, ɛnee yɛ nlenya mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la anwo ɛzo kpalɛ.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Nzinlii belemgbunli fofolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnze Dwosefi anwo edwɛkɛ biala la rale ebia ne azo.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ adenle zo ɔbɔle yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ abolɛ ɔmanle bɛvuandinle bɛ nlɔma bɛguale bɛmanle bɛwule.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala yɛɛ bɛwole Mosisi a, ɔle kakula kɛnlɛma kpalɛ! Na bɛvale ye bɛveale sua nu bɛnleanle ye toonwo ɔlile siane nsa.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛyele ye bɛdole ye lɔ la, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ hɔvale ye yɛle ɔ ra na ɔhɔtetele ye wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Bɛhilehilele ye Yigyibiti nrɛlɛbɛ nee ye amaamuo ne amuala. Na ɔnyinle ɔyɛle sonlakpole wɔ edwɛkɛhanlɛ nee nyɛleɛ nu.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Ɔnwunle bɛ nuhua ko kɛ Yigyibitinli bie ɛlɛyɛ ye asa, na ɔhɔliele ɔ ti na ɔbɔle Yigyibitinli ne ɔmanle ɔwule.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Ye alehyenlɛ nu ɔnwunle kɛ Yizilayɛma nwiɔ ɛlɛko, ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkakpɔda, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, ‘O, ebiamɔ! Bɛle mediema; duzu ati a bɛlɛko bɛayɛ bɛ nwo asa ɛ?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Na ko ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛyɛ ɔ gɔnwo asa la zuhunle Mosisi ziele ahane na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Nwane a dule wɔ kɛ ɛrali yɛ nwo zo belemgbunli na ɛyɛ yɛ ndɛnebuavolɛ a?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ ɛku medame noko, kɛmɔ anoma ɛhunle Yigyibitinli ne la ɔ?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi dele ɛhye la, ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔnriandile ɔhɔle Medea azɛlɛ zo. Ɔwole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Ɛvolɛ abulanla pɛle nu la, Nyamenle soanvolɛ yele ɔ nwo hilele Mosisi wɔ sendɔlɔra nu wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ zua Boka Saenae la anu.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mosisi nwunle ɛhye la ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo na ɔbikyele nwolɛ kɛ ɔkanlea ye boɛ. Na ɔdele Awulae ane, ɔse,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Mame a mele ɛ nlenya mɔ Nyamenle ne, Ebileham, Ayezeke, yɛɛ Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne a.’ Mosisi ahonle dule kpole na yeangulo kɛ ɔkɛmaa ɔ nye zo ɔkɛnlea deɛ ne bieko.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, ‘Yeye ɛ gyakɛ mgbɔlaboa ne, ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛgyi la azɛlɛ ne le nwuanzanwuanza.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Menwu kɛ bɛlɛsi bɛayɛ me menli mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibiti la amumuyɛ la, yɛɛ mede bɛ ɛzunlɛ noko, na mera kɛ mebalie bɛ. Yemɔti bɛla na mesoa wɔ wɔ Yigyibiti.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Mosisi ɛhye mɔɔ bɛkpole ye, na bɛzele ye kɛ, ‘Nwane a yɛle wɔ belemgbunli nee ndɛnebuavolɛ wɔ yɛ nwo zo’ la, yemɔ ala a Nyamenle luale soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ vindele sendɔlɔra ne anu wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la anwo zo zoanle ye kɛ ɔli bɛ nwo zo belemgbunli na ɔlie bɛ a.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɛvolɛ abulanla ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ Yigyibiti nee Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anloa, yɛɛ fienemgbole ne anu na ɔyele menli ne ɔvile Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mosisi ɛhye ala a zele Yizilayɛma kɛ, ‘Nyamenle baye ye kpɔmanvolɛ avi bɛ avinli yeazoa ye bɛ nwo, kɛmɔ ɔzoanle me la.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛyiale ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la ɔ nee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne dendɛle wɔ Boka Saenae azo, na ɔliele Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ ɛradwu yɛ nwo zo la ɔrɛlɛle yɛ nlenya mɔ a.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Na yɛ nlenya mɔ kpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie ye; bɛvale ye bɛziele ahane na bɛhulole kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛzia bɛkɛhɔ Yigyibiti.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛyɛle ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze na bɛvale bɛyɛle amonle bɛzɔle, bɛlile nwolɛ nwɔhoa na bɛyeyɛle deɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛva bɛ sa bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Yemɔti Nyamenle hwenle ɔ nwo vile bɛ nwo na ɔyele bɛ ɔmanle kɛ bɛzonle anwomanyunlu ninyɛne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mbuluku ne mɔ anu la. Ɔse, ‘Yizilayɛma, ɛvolɛ abulanla ne mɔɔ bɛlile wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la, bɛhunle nane bɛbɔle azu bɛmanle me ɔ?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Bɛzoale bɛ bozonle Molɛke ɛdanlɛ sua ne, yɛɛ bɛzoale bɛ ɛwɔlɔra bozonle Relɛfaa ɛdanlɛ sua ne noko; bɛdabɛ a bɛnwonle bɛ yɛɛ bɛzonlenle bɛ a. Yemɔti mebava bɛ meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ Babelɔn anzi lɔ.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Ɛsɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ yɛ nlenya mɔ nyianle Ɛdanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle de bɛ avinli la a. Bɛyɛle ye kɛmɔ Nyamenle zele Mosisi ala la, nzonlɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle vale hilele Mosisi la azo a ɔnleanle ɔzile a.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Nzinlii yɛ nlenya mɔ vale Ɛdanlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ bɛliele ye bɛ ze mɔ ɛkɛ ne la lile bɛ nyunlu na bɛ nee Dwɔhyua hɔle bɛhɔhonle bɛvale maanle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle manle bɛlile bɛ nwo zo konim la. Na ɔwoale bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne toonwo ɔradwule Devidi mekɛ zo.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anye zɔle Devidi na Devidi zɛlɛle Nyamenle kɛ ɔmaa ye adenle ɔmaa ɔzi sua ɔmaa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Noko Sɔlɔmɔn a zile sua ne a.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: “Noko akee Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne ɛndɛnla sua mɔɔ menli ɛzi la anu. Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha kɛ,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Awulae se, Anwuma le me belemgbunli ebia, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye le me gyakɛ abo ebia. Duzu sua a bɛsi bɛamaa me a? Nienwu ɛleka a metɛnla mealie me ɛnwomenle a?

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: Sitivin hɔle zolɛ zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, bɛ nzo yɛ se kpalɛ! Bɛnlie Nyamenle bɛnli fee; bɛkpɔla bɛ nzo anzi wɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo! Bɛva bɛ nlenya mɔ agyakɛ, dahuu bɛko bɛtia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne!

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ mgbanyima andwazo ɔ nwo zo a. Bɛhunle menli mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle bɛ kɛ bɛrabɔ ye Sonvolɛ Nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo nolo la amuala, na eza bɛye ɔdaye mumua ne bɛmaa bɛhu ye.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛliele Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔɔ ye soanvolɛma nee ye rale la a; noko bɛanli zolɛ!” Sitivin awolɛ ɛzilɛ

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ayiama ne ɛlɛtie Sitivin la ɛnee ɛya ɛwie bɛ wolowolo na bɛ nwo ndinli ɛlɛtwehwe bɛ kikilikikili zɛhae.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Na ɛnee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi Sitivin tɛkɛɛ la ati, ɔdole ɔ nye anwuma na ɔnwunle Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne na Gyisɛse gyi Nyamenle asa fema zo.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnlea, menwu kɛ anwuma ɛbuke, na menwu kɛ Sonla Ra ne gyi Nyamenle asa fema zo.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala bɛduoduale bɛ nzo, na bɛdeanle nu kokye la ɛnee bɛwɔ Sitivin anwo zo, nwee!

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Bɛhwenle ye bɛ nee ye hɔle suakpole ne kandiba, na bɛzile ye awolɛ. Dasevolɛma ne mɔ yeyele bɛ adɛladeɛ manle kpavolɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la lɛle.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛlɛsi Sitivin awolɛ la ɛnee ɔ ne la nu ɔlɛtea ɔfɛlɛ Awulae kɛ, “Awulae Gyisɛse, die me ɛkɛla!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Akee ɔhotole na ɔdeanle nu kpole kɛ, “Awulae, fa ɛtane ɛhye kyɛ bɛ!” Ɔhanle ɛhye la, ɔwule.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo bɔle mɔdenle ala kɛ ɔkɛzɛkye Asɔne ne. Ɔwolowolole azua nu ɔhɔhwenle mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ ɛzɔ diedi ne anu la na ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele ɔmanle bɛguale bɛ efiade. Bɛka Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Samɛlea

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Diedima ne bɔle asande la bɛnriandile bɛhɔle azua azua zo na bɛhɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Felepe hɔle Samɛlea suakpole bie azo hɔhanle Mɛzaya ne anwo edwɛkɛ hilele menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne diele na bɛnwunle nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, bɛ muala bɛliele bɛlile,

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ ɔmanle sunsum ɛtane dɔɔnwo deɛdeanle nu na bɛvile menli somaa ne ala anwo. Menli mɔɔ ɛdwidwe nee abuburama dele kpɔkɛ,

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: na suakpole ne azo amra lile fɛlɛko kpole.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ suakpole ne azo; bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn. Nrenya ɛhye ɛva ngonyiayelɛ ɛha Samɛlea maanlema ne ɛzulolɛ, na ɔka kɛ ɔdaye ɔle sonlakpole.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu, mgbanyinli nee ngakula muala tie ye. Bɛse, “Sonla ɛhye a le Nyamenle tumi ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Tumi Bedevinli’ la.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ngonyia ɔdanle bɛ nye zo na ɔmanle bɛzulole ye kpalɛ na bɛliele ye bɛlile.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo nee Gyisɛse Kelaese duma ne mɔɔ Felepe hanle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la, mraalɛ nee mrenya kɔsɔɔti liele lile na bɛmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Saemɔn ɔdaye ɔliele ɔlile na bɛzɔnenle ye. Nzinlii ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔbɔnenle Felepe, na ɔ nee ye luale. Mɔɔ ɔnwunle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Felepe yɛle la, ɔyɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne dele wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Samɛlea la ɛzɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anu la bɛzoanle Pita nee Dwɔn wɔ lɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle la bɛzɛlɛle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bɛmanle diedima ne mɔ.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu ɛdeɛ, noko Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛtɛbale bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Pita nee Dwɔn vale bɛ sa guale menli ne mɔ ati zo zɛlɛle, na bɛnyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Saemɔn nwunle kɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne fa bɛ sa gua menli ti zo a bɛnyia Nyamenle Sunsum ne la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛlie ezukoa na bɛmaa medame noko tumi ɛhye bie, amaa awie biala mɔɔ menwɔva me sa menwɔgua ɔ ti zo la anyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Na Pita buale ye kɛ, “Abule ɛbu wɔ nee wɔ ezukoa ne amuala, kɛ ɛkɛdwenle kɛ bɛfa ezukoa a bɛtɔ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ a!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ yɛ gyima ɛhye bie a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menwu kɛ ɛle anyebolo kpole kpalɛ na ɛtane ɛbɔ wɔ kpanwu.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Saemɔn zele Pita nee Dwɔn kɛ, “Mekpa bɛ kyɛlɛ, bɛzɛlɛ Awulae bɛmaa me, amaa mɔɔ bɛha la biala anzi me nwo zo.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Nzinlii Pita nee Dwɔn hanle Edwɛkpa ne, lile Awulae anwo daselɛ, na bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛkɔ la bɛvale Samɛlea namunamu ne mɔ dɔɔnwo azo bɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne. Felepe nee Yiteyopeanli kpanyinli ne

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Awulae soanvolɛ dendɛle zele Felepe kɛ, “Kɔ nyiakɛ nehane, wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee Gaza adenle ne azo.”

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Sunsum ne zele Felepe kɛ, “Twe bikye ehwili ne.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Felepe nriandile hɔle ehwili ne anwo, na ɔdele kɛ ɔlɛkenga Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya nwoma ne, na ɔbizale ye kɛ, “Asoo ɛte mɔɔ ɛlɛkenga la abo?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Nrenya ne buale ye kɛ, “Na kɛ mesi meyɛ mete ɔ bo ɛ? Kyesɛ awie kilehile nu kile me.” Na ɔmanle Felepe radɛnlanle ehwili ne anu wɔ ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛkenga la se, “Ɔle kɛ boane mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛhɔ ahunleɛ, anzɛɛ boaneralɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛpepɛ ye enrinli la, yeambuke ɔ nloa.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Bɛgolole ɔ nwo, bɛbuale ye mgbɔvondɛne, awie ɛnrɛhola ɔ bo zo amra kile, ɔluakɛ bɛpɛle ye ɛbɛla ne sinli wɔ ewiade ye anu.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Na abɔlɔba ne bizale Felepe kɛ, “Kile ɛhye anu kile me. Nwane anwo edwɛkɛ a Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɛlɛka a, ɔdaye ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ yɛɛ ɔlɛka a anzɛɛ awie gyɛne ɔ?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Na Felepe bɔle ɔ bo wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo, na ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Gyisɛse anwo la ɔhilele ye.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Felepe zele ye kɛ, “Saa ɛdie ɛdi bɔkɔɔ wɔ wɔ ahonle nu a, bɛsɔne wɔ a ɔyɛ boɛ.” Ɔbuale ye kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, medie medi kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese a le Nyamenle Ara ne a.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Nrenya ne manle ehwili ne gyinlanle, ɔ nee Felepe bɛhɔle azule ne anu na ɔmanle Felepe zɔnenle ye.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛvi azule ne anu bɛvole file zo la, Sunsum ne vale Felepe minliminlinle. Nrenya ne annwu ye bieko, na ɔvale fɛlɛko ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Felepe hɔvindele Azotɛse na ɔhɔkpɔsale namunamu ne mɔ anu ɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne toonwo ɔradwule Sizalia.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo nyianle anwosesebɛ kpalɛ wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nu na ɔholale ɔhilehilele nu kɛ Gyisɛse a le Mɛzaya ne, ɔmanle ɔrale kɛ Dwuuma bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la dɔle mumule wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Dwazo kɔ suakpole ne azo na bɛbahile wɔ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Na medame mebahile ye amaneɛ mɔɔ ɔbanwu ye wɔ me duma nu la.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔlɛ ɔ nwo ɔkabɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne anwo la bɛanlie ye bɛanli, na bɛzulole ye.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: na wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu yenwu nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase la kɛ yera ɔ nwo ɛkɛ yerava ɔ sa yegua ɔ ti zo yemaa yenwu debie bieko.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ fɛlɛ nwo abonle la vi Sɔɔlo anye zo guale aze, na ɔnwunle debie bieko; na ɔdwazole ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Sɔɔlo lɛ ye kɔdiawu adwenle ne tɛgyegye Awulae ɛdoavolɛma ne. Ɔhɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: na ɔhɔliele tumi ngɛlɛta kɛ ɔkɔ Dɛmasekɛse nyianu azua ne mɔ anu yeahɔhye bɛdabɛ mraalɛ nee mrenya mɔɔ bɛlua Awulae Adenle ne azo la, yeakyekye bɛ, ɔ nee bɛ ara Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔlua adenle zo na ɔka ekyii ɔdwu Dɛmasekɛse la, wienyi kpole bie vi anwomanyunlu rabɔle yiale ye.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Ɔpɛle ɔfinle na ɔdele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie se, “Sɔɔlo! Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde zɛhae ɛ?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Na ɔbizale kɛ, “Awulae, ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?” Ɛnelɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Medame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ nee Sɔɔlo lua la dɔle mumule, bɛandɛ bɛ nloa anu, ɔluakɛ bɛdele ɛnelɛ ne, na bɛannwu awie biala.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo vi azɛlɛ ne anwo dwazole la ɛnee ɔ nye ɛzi. Yemɔti bɛsosɔle ɔ sa bɛ nee ye hɔle Dɛmasekɛse.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Kenle nsa, ɛnee ɔnnwu debie, yɛɛ ɔnli debie na yeanlo nzule.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ bie wɔ Dɛmasekɛse, bɛfɛlɛ ye Ananayase. Wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu, ɔdele kɛ Awulae se, “Ananayase!” Ɔliele zolɛ kɛ, “Awulae, medame ɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Na Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘Fɔɔnwo’ la azo, na kɔ Dwudase sua nu, na biza awie bie mɔɔ vi Taasɛse na bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɔɔlo la. Ɔgua zolɛ ɔlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ananayase zele kɛ, “Awulae, menli dɔɔnwo ɛha sonla ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ nee debie mɔɔ yeva yehile wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛhile me.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Na yera ɛke kɛ ɔlɛ tumi ngɛlɛta vi sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛkɛ kɛ ɔbahye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle wɔ la amuala.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Awulae zele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ kɔ, na meye ye kɛ ɔrayɛ me sonvolɛ, ɔva me duma ɔhɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu nee arelemgbunli nee Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti Ananayase hɔle sua nu ɛkɛ, ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale Sɔɔlo ati zo na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Adiema Sɔɔlo, Awulae Gyisɛse, mɔɔ ɛlua adenle zo ɛlɛba ɛke mɔɔ ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele wɔ la ɛzoa me ɛ nwo ɛke, amaa wɔanwu debie bieko na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ara ɛ nwo zo.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Akee ɔlile debie na ɔ nwo gyinlanle ye. Sɔɔlo bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Dɛmasekɛse Sɔɔlo nee ɛdoavolɛma ne dɛnlanle mekɛ ekyi wɔ Dɛmasekɛse,

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: na ɔhɔle nyianu azua ne mɔ anu ɔhɔbɔle nolo kɛ Gyisɛse, “Yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle Ara ne a.”

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdele ye edwɛkɛ ne la azibɛnwo kpole na bɛbizale kɛ, “Na tɛ sonla ɛhye a ɛlɛkuhu menli mɔɔ bɔ Gyisɛse duma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɔ? Anzɛɛ yeamba ɛke kɛ ɔbahye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ Gyisɛse duma la yeahɔmaa sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Kenle guale nu ekyii la, Dwuuma ne hɔle akpamo kɛ bɛku ye,

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: na Sɔɔlo dele. Dwuuma ne dɛle ye wɔ sua ne azo nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kɛ bɛ sa kɛha ye bɛkɛhu ye.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Baanabase raboale ye na ɔ nee ye hɔle ɛzoanvolɛma ne ɛkɛ. Ɔhilehilele kɛ Sɔɔlo zile nwunle Awulae wɔ adevinli ne na Awulae dendɛle hilele ye, nee Sɔɔlo ahonle mɔɔ zile na ɔvale Gyisɛse duma ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Dɛmasekɛse la amuala ɔhilele bɛ.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Yemɔti akee bɛmanle Sɔɔlo nee bɛ luale, na ɔyele ɔ nyunlu wienyi ɔvale Awulae duma ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm amuala.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Eza ɔ nee Dwuuma mɔɔ ka Giliki la zule kpolera ɔmanle bɛnyianle adwenle kɛ bɛku ye.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ diedima ne bie mɔ dele ɛhye la, bɛvale Sɔɔlo bɛhɔle Sizalia na bɛmanle ɔhɔle Taasɛse.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Ɔlua Sɔɔlo ɛhakyilɛ zo akee Asɔne ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya, Galeli, yɛɛ Samɛlea la nyianle anzonudwolɛ na ɔnyinle. Na ɔlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne moalɛ zo Asɔne ne nyianle anwosesebɛ, menli dɔɔnwo rale nu na bɛvale Nyamenlezulolɛ bɛluale. Pita wɔ Leda nee Dwɔpa

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Pita hɔle ɛleka dɔɔnwo, na kenle ko ɔhɔkpɔlale Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Leda la.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔhɔnwunle nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yiniase la kɛ yedwidwe na yela ɛleka ko toonwo ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Na Pita zele ye kɛ, “Yiniase, Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛyɛ wɔ ayile. Dwazo na nyenya wɔ ɛkpa ne.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala Yiniase dwazole.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Leda nee Hyɛlɔn la nwunle nrenya ne na bɛhakyile bɛdoale Awulae.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Dwɔpa noko, raalɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Tabeta. Ɔle ɛdoavolɛ. Raalɛ ɛhye vale ye mekɛ yɛle ahunlunyele gyima na ɔboale ehyianvolɛma.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɔ nwo dole ye na ɔwule. Bɛbiale ye na bɛdedale ye wɔ ɛbolɔnsane zo ekpumgbunli ne mɔ bie anu.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Dwɔpa nee Leda anwa biala. Yemɔti mɔɔ diedima ne mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔpa la dele kɛ Pita wɔ Leda la, bɛzoanle menli nwiɔ bɛmanle bɛhɔvale nrɛlaleɛ bɛhɔmanle ye kɛ. “Yɛsɛlɛ wɔ, bɔ mɔdenle ka ɛ nwo bɛla.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Pita noko anzi aze na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle. Ɔhɔdwule la, bɛ nee ye hɔle ɛbolɔnsane ne azo ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdeda ye la. Ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ Dɔkase ɛyɛ bɛ nyele ɛlɛ la vale ɛzunlɛ rabɔle yiale Pita na bɛvale adɛladeɛ mɔɔ Dɔkase kpomgbale hyɛle bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la bɛhilele ye.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Pita vindele bɛ, na ɔhotole ɔzɛlɛle; ɔhakyile ɔ nye funli ne anwo na ɔzele kɛ, “Tabeta, dwazo!” Raalɛ ne bukele ɔ nye na ɔnwunle Pita la, ɔmanle ɔ nwo zo ɔdɛnlanle aze.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Pita zɔle ye manle ɔdwazole ɔgyinlanle. Akee ɔvɛlɛle diedima ne nee ahunlanvolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ na ɔvale ye ɔmanle bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ɛhye kpondenle Dwɔpa amuala, na menli somaa ne ala liele Awulae lile.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Pita dɛnlanle Dwɔpa hyɛle dɔɔnwo wɔ nrenya bie mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn la sua nu.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ Sizalia, bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɔnileɛse. Ɔle Wulomu Ɛlɔne ekpunli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Yetalea” la safohyenle.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Ɔle sonla mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle a, yɛɛ ɔ nee ye sua nu amra amuala bɛsonle Nyamenle. Ɔ sa do Dwuuma ehyianvolɛma anwo zo, yɛɛ ɔnva ye nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɔndo aze.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Kenle ko ewiazo kɛyɛ dɔne nsa ɔhɔle nzɛlɛlɛ ɛyɛlɛ la ɔnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ. Nyamenle soanvolɛ ragyinlanle ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ na ɔvɛlɛle ye kɛ, “Kɔnileɛse!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne la, ɛzulolɛ hanle ye na ɔhanle kɛ, “Yɛmenle, duzu edwɛkɛ ɔ?” Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne buale ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛde wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ na yenwu wɔ ahunlunyele gyima ne amuala.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Yemɔti soa maa bɛhɔ Dwɔpa bɛhɔva nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: Ɔde nrenya bie mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn la sua nu, wɔ nyevile ne anloa ɛkɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne wiele la ɔhɔle. Kɔnileɛse vɛlɛle ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ nwiɔ yɛɛ sogyanli ko mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle na ɔboka menli mɔɔ sinza ɔdaye Kɔnileɛse la anwo la,

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: ɔhanle mɔɔ ɛzi la amuala ɔhilele bɛ na ɔzoanle bɛ wɔ Dwɔpa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle, na mɔɔ bɛlua adenle zo na ɔka ekyii bɛdwu Dwɔpa la, ɛnee Pita ɔdaye yevo yehɔ sua ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la ati zo anwuma kɛ ɔkayɛ ewiazo nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne hunle ye na mɔɔ ɔlɛkendɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛto bɛamaa ye la, ɔ nye hɔle dɔɔnwo na ɔnwunle

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: kɛ anwuma ɛbuke, na bɛlɛdwula debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛsosɔ ɔ nloa nna ne amuala anu la aze.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Wɔ deɛ ne anu, ɔnwunle nane, nwɔlɛ, yɛɛ nloma ngakyile dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Na ɛnelɛ bie zele ye kɛ, “Pita, dwazo na ku bie di!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na Pita zele kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae, debie mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde na ɔle kyibadeɛ la, metɛdile bie ɛlɛ.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ ne eza zele ye kɛ, “Debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛde nwolɛ la, mmaka kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ɛhye zile fane nsa, na bɛhwenle deɛ ne bɛhɔle anwuma.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pita ɛlɛdwenle mɔɔ yenwu ye la anwo la, ɛnee menli mɔɔ Kɔnileɛse zoanle bɛ la noko ɛbizebiza dedee bɛnwu Saemɔn sua nu na bɛra, bɛwɔ anuhɔlɛ ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Bɛvɛlɛle na bɛbizale kɛ, “Ɛyɛvolɛ bie wɔ ɛke mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita ɔ?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pita gua zolɛ tɛdwenle mɔɔ yenwu ye la anwo na ɔkulo kɛ ɔte ɔ bo la, Nyamenle Sunsum ne zele ye kɛ, “Nea, menli nsa ɛra ɛke bakpondɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti dwu aze kɔyia bɛ; mmadwenle nwolɛ, ɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ. Ɔluakɛ medame a mezoa bɛ a.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Pita dwule aze na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ahenle mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la a le medame. Na bɛ ɛdialɛ nu ɛ?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Bɛbuale ye kɛ, “Safohyenle Kɔnileɛse a ɛzoa yɛ a. Ɔle sonlakpalɛ somaa, ɔsulo Nyamenle, yɛɛ Dwuuma amuala bu ye bie kpalɛ. Ɛkenle Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie zele ye kɛ ɔrava wɔ ɔhɔ ye sua nu, na ɔdie mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye ɛka wɔahile ye la.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Na Pita vale bɛ hɔle sua nu na ɔmanle bɛ ɛleka bɛlale. Aleɛ hyenle la ɔboɔboale ɔ nwo na ɔ nee bɛ hɔle; diedima bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Dwɔpa la nee ye hɔle.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Bɛzile nu la ye alehyenlɛ nu yɛɛ bɛdwule Sizalia a, na bɛhɔdole kɛ Kɔnileɛse nee ye sua nu amra, nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ yedo ɛsalɛ yevɛlɛ bɛ la ɛwie yia na bɛlɛkendɛ ye.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Kɔnileɛse yiale Pita wɔ anlenkɛ ne anloa, ɔdule ɔdɔle ɔ gyakɛ anu na ɔzonlenle ye.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Na Pita manle ɔdwazole na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo na medame mele sonla.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pita anloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile Kɔnileɛse la, bɛhɔwolole sua ne anu, na ɔnwunle kɛ menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ ɛrayia.
