english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ wɔ Dwuu ɛzonlenlɛ ne anu, bɛmmaa adenle bɛmmaa yɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnfonla. Noko Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me kɛ memmabu awie biala kɛ ɔ nwo ɛnde.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛzoanle kɛ bɛrava me la meandwenlehwenle me bo aze na mera a. Yemɔti mebiza bɛ kɛ duzu ati a bɛravale me a?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kɔnileɛse zele ye kɛ, “Ɛnɛ le kenle nna, kɛyɛ bekezɛ ala, ɛnee melɛyɛ ewiazo dɔne nsa nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ me sua ye anu, na nrenya bie mɔɔ wula tɛladeɛ fufule la ragyinlanle me nyunlu ɛkɛ

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Kɔnileɛse! Wɔ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛdwu Nyamenle anyunlu na yenwu wɔ ahunlunyele gyima ne amuala.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti soa awie wɔ Dwɔpa maa ɔhɔva nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la. Ɔ nee Saemɔn mɔɔ yɛ nwoma nwo gyima la a de a, wɔ nyevilenloa ɛkɛ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati a menzoanle kɛ bɛrava wɔ a, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ noko wɔandwenlehwenle ɛ bo aze na wɔra a. Yemɔti yɛ muala yɛyia wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɛke kɛ yɛtie mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa wɔ kɛ ɛraha ɛhile yɛ la.” Pita tendɛ ahile menli ne

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Na Pita zele bɛ kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, menwu ye wienyi kɛ Nyamenle bu menli kɔsɔɔti kɛ bɛsɛ.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ sulo ye na ɔdi boɛ la ɔdie ye ɔto nu, yɛɛ ɔnnea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔvi nee maanle holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔvi nu la.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ ɔzile mɔɔ ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti Awulae la anwo zo Nyamenle vale anzonudwolɛ nwo Edwɛkpa ne rɛlɛle Yizilayɛma la.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ɛhye nolobɔlɛ bo wɔ Galeli, na bɛbɔle ye Dwudiya amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Dwɔn bɔle ɛzɔnenlɛ nwo nolo wiele la.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Bɛze Gyisɛse mɔɔ vi Nazalɛte la anwo edwɛkɛ nee kɛ Nyamenle zile vale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne wulale ye na ɔmanle ye tumi la amuala. Gyisɛse kpɔsale ɛleka dɔɔnwo yɛle ahunlunyele gyima, na ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Abɔnsam ɛlɛfa ye tumi ne agyegye bɛ la ayile, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nee ye lua.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Yɛdi mɔɔ ɔyɛle ye wɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu nee Gyɛlusalɛm la amuala anwo daselɛ. Bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛhunle ye.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Na ye kenle nsa ne azo Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu na ɔmanle ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: yɛmɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye yɛ kɛ yɛli daselɛ la. Yɛ nee ye lile, nlonle, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdwazole ɔvile ewule nu la,

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: na ɔzele yɛ kɛ yɛha ɔ nwo Edwɛkpa ne yɛhile menli kɔsɔɔti, na yɛli ɔ nwo daselɛ kɛ yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye mɔwuamra nee anyewɔzoamra ndɛnebuavolɛ a.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma amuala ka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la, ɔlua ye duma ne tumi zo bɛkɛva ye ɛtane bɛkɛhyɛ ye.” Menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la nyianle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pita anloa wɔ zolɛ ɛlɛtendɛ la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie edwɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɛhye yɛle Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛlie Edwɛkpa ne ɛli na bɛ nee Pita vi Dwɔpa rale la azibɛnwo kpole kɛ Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛra menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la noko anwo zo a.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛdele kɛ ɛnee bɛlɛka ɛdendɛlɛ ngakyile bɛahanvo Nyamenle ye bedevinli mɔɔ ɔde la. Na Pita manle ɔ ne zo zele kɛ,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Menli ɛhye mɔ ɛnyia Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, kɛmɔ yɛnyianle ye ala la. Anzɛɛ awie kɛhola kɛze kɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛfa nzule yɛsɔne bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle bɛ wɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu. Na bɛzɛlɛle ye bɛ nee ye dɛnlanle mekɛ ekyi.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee diedima mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la dele kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la noko ɛlie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛli.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ Pita hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ adwenle wɔ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ zo la dendɛle ye nwolɛ,

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: na bɛbizale ye kɛ, “Kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ ɛhɔle menli mɔɔ ɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la sua nu na ɛ nee bɛ dole bɛ sa ɛyɛba ko anu ɛ?”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Na Pita bɔle ɔ bo hanle edwɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ zile la amuala hilele bɛ.

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Ɛnee mewɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔpa la azo melɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ, na me nye hɔle dɔɔnwo, na menwunle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ bɛdedɛ ɔ nloa nna ne amuala anu la kɛ ɔvi anwuma na bɛlɛdwula ye aze, na ɔradwule me nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, ɔgyinlanle.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meneanle nuhua la menwunle nane, nwɔlɛ, yɛɛ nloma ngakyile wɔ nuhua.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Na mendele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie se, ‘Pita, dwazo na ku bie di!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na menganle kɛ, ‘Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae, debie mɔɔ le kyibadeɛ anzɛɛ nwolɛ ɛnde la metɛdile bie ɛlɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na ɛnelɛ ne vi anwuma rale bieko kɛ, ‘Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛde nwolɛ la mmabu ye kɛ nwolɛ ɛnde!’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Ɛhye zile fane nsa, na nzinlii bɛhwenle ye bɛhɔle anwuma.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ menli nsa mɔɔ ɛnee bɛzoa bɛ vi Sizalia wɔ me nwo ɛkɛ ne la rale sua nu ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne zele me kɛ me nee bɛ ɛhɔ, memmasi aze. Mediema nsia ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ vi Dwɔpa la bokale me nwo manle yɛ muala yɛhɔle Sizalia wɔ Kɔnileɛse sua nu.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Kɔnileɛse hanle kɛ ɔzile ɔnwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ bie wɔ sua ne anu na ɔzele ye kɛ, ‘Soa maa bɛhɔ Dwɔpa bɛhɔva nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn Pita la,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: na ɔbaha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛmaa ɛ nee wɔ sua nu amra kɛnyia ngoane la.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Na membɔle ɔ bo kɛ metendɛ ala la yɛɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rale bɛ nwo zo, kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔrale yɛ nwo zo la a.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Na mengakyele mɔɔ Awulae hanle la, ɔse, ‘Dwɔn vale nzule a zɔnenle a, na bɛmɛ, bɛbava Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a bɛazɔne bɛ a.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Na saa Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ahyɛlɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɔvale ɔhyɛle yɛ kɛ yɛlie Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛli la a, ɛnee mame a le nwane, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ metua Nyamenle adenle a!”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Bɛdele ɛhye la, bɛgyakyile bɛ nvefenu ne na bɛyeyɛle Nyamenle bɛzele kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko adenle kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.” Anteɔko asɔne ne

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Sitivin ɛhunlɛ ne anzi, kpɔdekpɔde mɔɔ bɛyɛle diedima ne la manle bɛbɔle asande, bie mɔ hɔvindele Fonehyea, Saepelɛse nee Anteɔko bɛhɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne bɛhilele Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ lɔ la ala.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Diedima ne bie mɔ mɔɔ vi Saepelɛse nee Saelin la noko hɔhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Anteɔko hilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Awulae lile bɛ nzi manle menli dɔɔnwo liele lile na bɛhakyile bɛrale Awulae ɛkɛ.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Gyɛlusalɛm asɔne ne dele ɛhye, na bɛzoanle Baanabase wɔ Anteɔko.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔhɔdwule na ɔnwunle kɛ Nyamenle ɛzi ɛlo menli ne la, ɔlile fɛlɛko na ɔzile bɛ kɛnra kɛ bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛzɔ diedi ne anu kpalɛ na bɛli nɔhalɛ bɛmaa Awulae.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Baanabase mumua ne le sonlakpalɛ mɔɔ diedi nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la ati, ɔhwenle menli dɔɔnwo ɔrale Awulae ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Baanabase akee hɔle Taasɛse kɛ ɔkakpondɛ Sɔɔlo.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la ɔ nee ye rale Anteɔko. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ nee asɔnema ne dɛnlanle ɛvolɛ ko na bɛhilehilele bɛ. Na Anteɔko ɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛlumuale bɛvɛlɛle ɛdoavolɛma ne Keleseɛnema a.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ala Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bie vi Gyɛlusalɛm rale Anteɔko.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Agabɛse la dwazole luale Sunsum ne tumi ne azo hanle dole ɛkɛ kɛ ɛhɔne kpole bie bara ewiade amuala.

english_verse: The followers in Antioch decided to send whatever help they could to the followers in Judea.
translation_verse: Yemɔti diedima ne bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛkeha bɛ sa aze na mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye la bɛava bɛahɔboa mediema mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle ɛhye na bɛvale mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la bɛmanle Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo hɔmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ɛhye anu ala Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo vale ɔ nye wulale diedima ne bie mɔ anyunlu.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɔnwunle kɛ ɛhye ɛyɛ Dwuuma fɛ la, ɔdoale zo na ɔhyele Pita ɔdaye.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛhyele Pita la, ɔdole ye efiade na ɔyele sogyama nna-nna ekpunli nna kɛ bɛzinza ye. Hɛlɔdo yɛle kɛ saa bɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne bɛwie a yɛɛ ɔkɛli ye edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Yemɔti Pita lale efiade ne, na diedima ne noko anye bolole yɛle nzɛlɛlɛ ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ manle ye. Bɛye Pita efiade ne

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Nɔe ne mɔɔ ɛnee aleɛ kye a Hɛlɔdo kɛye Pita kɛmaa menli ne la, ɛnee Pita la sogyama nwiɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛsinza ye la avinli, na bɛva nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ nwiɔ bɛgua ye, na bɛva bɛsosɔ sogyama nwiɔ ne, yɛɛ eza sogyama bie mɔ noko gyigyi anlenkɛ ne anloa ɛlɛsinza.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Arɛlevilɛ nu ala Nyamenle soanvolɛ rale ɛkɛ na wienyi kpole bie dale efiade ne. Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne bɔle Pita abati dunwuele ye na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Maa ɔyɛ ndɛ dwazo!” Na ɛkɛ ne ala nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne vi ɔ sa wɔlɔle guale.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ, “Fa wɔ tɛladeɛ ne nee wɔ mgbɔlaboa ne wula.” Pita yɛle ye zɔhane na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne eza zele ye kɛ, “Akee fa wɔ tabule ne kye na toa me.”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Bɛdɛlale sinzavolɛma ekpunli ne mɔɔ lumua nee mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ, na bɛdwule mbulalɛ anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛfinde suakpole ne azo la anwo la, anlenkɛ ne angome bukele manle bɛ, na bɛvindele. Bɛhɔle ekyii la, Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne gyakyile Pita na ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Pita anye zo tetele ye la ɔzele kɛ, “Akee bɔ zo mɔɔ menwu kɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la le nɔhalɛ a. Awulae ɛzoa ɛmaa bɛraye me bɛvi Hɛlɔdo asa anu, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ Dwuuma anye la kɛ bɛkɛyɛ me la amuala anu.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye zɛhae la, Pita luale zolɛ hɔle Dwɔn Maake ɔ nli Mɛle sua nu, ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo ɛyia ɛkɛ na bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Pita bɔle anuhɔlɛ lɔ anlenkɛ ne anu, na sonvolɛ bɛlɛra bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Wuloda la rale kɛ ɔbanlea ahenle holɛ.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔdele Pita ane kɛ yemɔ a ɔlɛfɛlɛ la, fɛlɛko ngome ti, kɛ ɔkɛdukue anlenkɛ ne la, ɔziale ɔhɔbɔle amaneɛ kɛ Pita ɛra na ɔgyi anlenkɛ ne anzi lɔ.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Debie ɛlɛyɛ wɔ.” Na ɔtinlinle zolɛ ɔhanle ye anyebololɛ nu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ, yemɔti bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɛnee noko ye nwomenle ɔ.”

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Pita bɔle anlenkɛ ne anu ndinlizo; nzinlii bɛrabukele ye, na bɛnwunle ye la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Ɔmanle ɔ sa zo kɛ bɛyɛ koonwu, na ɔhanle kɛ Awulae zile yele ye wɔ efiade ne la ɔhilele bɛ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛha bɛhile Gyemise nee mediema mɔɔ ɛha la amuala,” na ɔvindele ɔhɔle.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ aleɛ hyenle la, sinzavolɛma ne adwenle zɛkyele kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛngola bɛnnwu mɔɔ ɛzi Pita anwo zo a.

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Hɛlɔdo manle bɛkpondɛle ye biala, na bɛannwu ye. Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛhyele sinzavolɛma ne nuokɛ na ɔzele kɛ bɛhu bɛ bɛdua. Ɛhye anzi, Hɛlɔdo vi Dwudiya hɔle Sizalia hɔlile mekɛ ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ. Hɛlɔdo ewule nu

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Hɛlɔdo vale menli mɔɔ wɔ Taya nee Saedɛn la anwo ɛya, ɛhye ati bɛdule menli kɛ bɛhɔnwu ye. Bɛlumuale bɛ sa hanle Belasetɛse mɔɔ nea belemgbunli suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la moalɛ, na akee bɛhɔle Hɛlɔdo anyunlu bɛhɔkpɔdale ye. Ɔluakɛ bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la amuala vi belemgbunli ne maanle nu.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Kenle mɔɔ bɛhilele la dwule la, Hɛlɔdo wulale ye belemgbunli tɛladeɛ ne na ɔhɔdɛnlanle ye ebia nu na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele menli ne mɔ.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Menli ne mɔ bɔle ɔse zele kɛ, “Ɛhye, yemɔ nyamenle bie ane ɔ, na tɛ sonla ne ɔ.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Na arɛlevilɛ nu ala Awulae soanvolɛ rabɔle Hɛlɔdo dole aze manle ɔ nwo dole ye, ɔlɔle azonlɛ na ɔwule, ɔluakɛ yeanva anyunlunyia yeammaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: God's message kept spreading.
translation_verse: Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne hɔle zolɛ dɛlɛle.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo wiele bɛ gyima ne di la, bɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔle, na bɛvale Dwɔn Maake bɛbokale bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee kilehilevolɛma wɔ Anteɔko asɔne ne anu, bɛmɛ a le Baanabase, Semɛyɔn , Luseɛse , Maneeyen , yɛɛ Sɔɔlo.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛlɛkye ɛhɔne la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛdu Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo bɛzie ahane bɛmaa me na memaa bɛhɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ yemɔti menvɛlɛle bɛ la.”

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne vale Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo hɔle Sɛlusea na bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛhɔle bɔra ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Saepelɛse la azo.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdwule Salamese la, bɛhanle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu. Bɛ nee Dwɔn Maake a hɔle a na ɔboale bɛ wɔ gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Bɛkpɔsale bɔra ne azo na bɛrale Peefɔso bɛradole Dwuunli bie mɔɔ ye ngonyia la. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Baa-Gyisɛse, yɛɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔfɛlɛ ɔ nwo Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Ɔle bɔra ne azo amɛnlado ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sɛgyeɛse Pɔɔlɛse la agɔnwo. Amɛnlado ɛhye ze nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ ɔ nye ɛde. Ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvɛlɛle Baanabase nee Sɔɔlo kɛ bɛrɛla na ɔkulo kɛ ɔtie Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Ɛlemase ammaa bɛ adenle, na ɔyɛle kɛ ɔkakyi Amɛnlado ne adwenle, amaa yeanlie ɛzonlenlɛ fofolɛ ɛhye yeanli.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne rawolole Sɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɛnee akee bɛfɛlɛ ye Pɔɔlo la, ɔnleanle Ɛlemase koonwu

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: na ɔzele ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ Abɔnsam ara, ɛle debie kpalɛ biala kpɔvolɛ. Amumuyɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ, yɛɛ dahuu ɛbɔ adalɛ wɔ Awulae adenle kpalɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛdua wɔ kakɛ, ɔmaa ɛ nye ɛzi ɔhɔkpula mekɛ ekyi bie mɔɔ ɛnnwu debie biala a.” Na ɛkɛ ne ala awozinli vale Ɛlemase manle ɔlile nvuovua na ɔzɛlɛle kɛ awie ɛzɔ ɔ sa ɛhile ye adenle.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Amɛnlado ne nwunle mɔɔ ɛzi la, ɔliele ɔlile na Awulae anwo ngilehilelɛ ne yɛle ye azibɛnwo kpole. Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ wɔ Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu la

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ vi Peefɔso la bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛrale Pɛga, wɔ Pamefelea maanzinli nu, na Dwɔn Maake gyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne ziale hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Bɛvi Pɛga la bɛbɔle hwii bɛhɔle Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea la. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dwule la, bɛhɔle nyianu sua ne anu na bɛhɔdɛnlanle aze.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Bɛwiele Mosisi mɛla ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne kenga la, nyianu sua ne mgbanyima ne dole ɛsalɛ vɛlɛle bɛ kɛ, “Mediema, saa bɛlɛ edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko bie mɔɔ maa anwosesebɛ la a ɛnee bɛha bɛmaa menli ne ɛdie bie.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo dwazole manle ɔ sa zo na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ Yizilayɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke na bɛsulo Nyamenle la, bɛdie me!

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne kpale nu yele yɛ nlenya mɔ na ɔyɛle bɛ ɛlɔne kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛle nyɛvolɛ bɔbɔ wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. Nyamenle vale ye tumi kpole ne yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo,

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, bɛnlea boɛ na mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle la anzi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔse,

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Wɔ Keena noko, Nyamenle zɛkyele maanle maanle nsuu na ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle ye menli ne mɔ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle yele ye ɛkɛ ne la, ɔyɛle Devidi bɛ belemgbunli. Na Nyamenle hanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Menwu Gyɛsi ara Devidi kɛ yemɔ a ɔle sonla mɔɔ sɔ me nye a, na yemɔ a ɔbali gyima mɔɔ mekpondɛ la amuala a.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Devidi ɛhye alɔnra a le Gyisɛse mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ ye Yizilayɛma Ngoanedievolɛ, kɛmɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne se la.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse babɔ ye gyimalilɛ ne abo la, Dwɔn lumuale rabɔle nolo zele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo na bɛmaa bɛzɔne bɛ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Dwɔn bawie ye gyima ne la, ɔbizale menli ne kɛ, ‘Bɛdwenle kɛ mame a le nwane? Tɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ ye la a le me. Na nea, ɔli me nzi ɔlɛba, na ye mgbɔlaboa bɔbɔ menfɛta kɛ menwɔyeye.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: “Me mediema, Ebileham nlɔnra nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛsulo Nyamenle mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛke la amuala, yɛmɛ yɛ ti yɛɛ bɛvale ngoanelielɛ nwo Edwɛkpa ɛhye bɛzoanle a!

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm nee bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ annwu kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Ngoanedievolɛ ne a, yɛɛ bɛande Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkenga ye dahuu wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne la abo. Noko bɛbule Gyisɛse ewule fɔlɛ bɛmanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ hanle la yɛle nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Bɛwiele debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kile ye wɔ ɔ nwo la amuala yɛ la, bɛyele ye wɔ meanubaka ne azo na bɛziele ye.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu,

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: na ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye vi Galeli rale Gyɛlusalɛm la, na ɔmanle bɛnwunle ye fane dɔɔnwo. Na bɛmɛ yɛɛ kɛkala bɛdi ɔ nwo daselɛ bɛkile Yizilayɛma a.

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: Na yɛdayɛ noko yɛra ɛke kɛ yɛfa Edwɛkpa ne yɛarɛlɛ bɛ kɛ, Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya mɔ la, yelua Gyisɛse mɔɔ yedwazo ye yera ngoane nu la anwo zo yeyɛ yemaa yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛle bɛ nlɔnra la. Edwɛndolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la se, ‘Wɔmɔ, ɛle me ra; ɛnɛ merayɛ ɛ ze.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ fane ye mɔwuamra anu ɛdwazolɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔnrɛkpɔlɔ ɛlɛ la, kɛ Nyamenle se la ɛne, ‘Mebava me nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ mɔɔ menvale membɔle Devidi ɛwɔkɛ la meamaa wɔ.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Eza yeha ye wɔ ɛleka fofolɛ kɛ, ‘Ɛnrɛmaa wɔ sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa wɔ la ɛnrɛkpɔlɔ.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Devidi zonlenle ye Nyamenle wɔ ye mekɛ zo na ɔwule, bɛziele ye wɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ avinli, na ɔkpɔlɔle.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Na sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu la amkpɔlɔ.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Bɛnlea, bɛmɛ agolobɛnwoma! Akpule ku bɛ agua bɛ lɔ! Ɔluakɛ, gyima mɔɔ melɛdi wɔ bɛ mekɛ zo la ɛnle debie mɔɔ awie kile nu kile bɛ bɔbɔ a bɛkɛlie bɛkɛli a!’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase vi nyianu sua ne anu finde ahɔ la menli ne zɛlɛle bɛ kɛ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bieko bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛraha edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ bɛhile bɛ.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛkpɔnenle la, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ boka Dwuuma Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anwo la dɔɔnwo doale Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase, na ɛzoanvolɛma ne zile bɛ ahonle kɛ bɛzɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne anu kpundii.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle bieko dwule la, asɛɛ suakpole ne azo amra amuala dule rale kɛ bɛbadie Awulae edwɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Dwuuma ne nwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne la, anyebolo dɔle bɛ nwo; bɛdendɛle bɛtiale mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la, na bɛbɔle bɛ aholoba.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Noko Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase dendɛle akɛnrasesebɛ zo zele bɛ kɛ, “Anrɛɛ ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛlumua bɛkɛha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne bɛkɛhile bɛmɛ Dwuuma. Na saa bɛnyia bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie na bɛhile kɛ bɛ nwo ɛnfɛta ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ yɛgyakyi bɛ na yɛkɔka edwɛkɛ ne yɛkile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae zele yɛ kɛ, ‘Meyɛ bɛ kɛ kɛnlaneɛ memaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amaa aleɛabo amra amuala anyia ngoane.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la dele ɛhye la, bɛlile fɛlɛko na bɛyeyɛle Nyamenle wɔ ye edwɛkɛ ne anwo, na bɛ nuhua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle maa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la liele lile.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Awulae edwɛkɛ ne dɛlɛle hɔle maanzinli ne anu amuala.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Na Dwuuma ne lile mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo nee mraalɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ gyi boɛ na bɛsulo Nyamenle na bɛnle Dwuuma la anzo. Bɛmanle bɛbɔle ɔ bo bɛyɛle Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase kpɔdekpɔde toonwo bɛdule bɛ maanzinli ne anu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne kpɔlɔkpɔlale bɛ gyakɛ abo munlutu guale sua ne azo amra ati zo na bɛzile nu bɛhɔle Ayekoneɛm.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Na diedima mɔɔ wɔ Anteɔko la lile fɛlɛko kpole na Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne yile bɛ tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔ Ayekoneɛm noko, edwɛkɛ ko ne ala bie zile. Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase hɔle Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu hɔdendɛle manle Dwuuma nee Gilikima dɔɔnwo liele lile.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Na Dwuuma bie mɔ mɔɔ anlie anli la lile wulale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bie mɔ manle bɛvale diedima ne mɔ ɛkpɔlɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Noko ɛzoanvolɛma ne dɛnlanle ɛkɛ hyɛle, bɛhanle Awulae anwo edwɛkɛ ne akɛnrasesebɛ zo na Awulae hilele nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye ɛlolɛ nwo nolo ne mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ la anu na ɔmanle bɛ tumi ɔmanle bɛyɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Na menli mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne azo la anloa anzɛ bɛ nwo; foa ko hɔle Dwuuma anzi, yɛɛ foa ko hɔle ɛzoanvolɛma ne anzi.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Nzinlii bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bie mɔ nee Dwuuma bɔle nu bɛ nee bɛ mgbanyima yɛle adwenle kɛ bɛkɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo zo bɛahɔzi bɛ awolɛ.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nrenya bie wɔ Lesetela, bɛwole ye abubura, yemɔti ɔtɛtiale ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Ɛnee nrenya ɛhye ɛlɛtie Pɔɔlo kpalɛ. Na Pɔɔlo nwunle kɛ nrenya ne ɛnyia diedi mɔɔ kola yɛ ye ayile la, ɔnleanle ye koonwu

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele ye kɛ, “Dwazo gyinla!” Nrenya ne wulule gyinlanle na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ menli ne mɔ nwunle mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛyɛ la, bɛdeɛdeanle nu wɔ Laekewonea aneɛ ne anu kɛ, “Awozonle ne mɔ ɛhakyi bɛ nwo menli ɛra yɛ avinli!”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Na bɛvɛlɛle Baanabase, Ziyɛse, na bɛvɛlɛle Pɔɔlo, Hɛmɛse, ɔluakɛ bɛse Pɔɔlo a tendɛ maa bɛ a.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Na kɔmenle ne mɔɔ tendɛ Ziyɛse anloa azo, na ye amonle sua ne gyi sua ne kandiba ɛkɛ ne ala la vale nlankɛ nee ndotolo kɔtɔlɔba rale suakpole ne bane ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa kɛ ɔ nee menli ne mɔ bɛbabɔ azu bɛamaa ɛzoanvolɛma ne.

english_verse: When the two apostles found out about this, they tore their clothes in horror and ran to the crowd, shouting:
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Baanabase nee Pɔɔlo dele mɔɔ menli ne mɔ kpondɛ ayɛ la, ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo. Yemɔti bɛsuosuanle bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle menli ne avinli na bɛzele bɛ kɛ,

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: “Ayi mɔ, duzu ati a bɛlɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛ? Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle menli kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Yɛrale kɛ yɛbabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo yeahile bɛ, amaa bɛahwe bɛ nwo bɛavi ninyɛne mgbane mgbane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ la anwo, na bɛazonle tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma, azɛlɛ, nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la amuala la.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Mɔmoane ɔmanle menli muala adenle ɔmanle bɛyɛle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Noko dahuu ɔdua ye ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ la azo ɔkile ɔ nwo ɔkile bɛ: ɔmaa bɛ ezule, yɛɛ ɛbuhenle ne dwu a ɔmaa bɛ aleɛ na ɔmaa bɛ nye die.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛngola bɛnzi menli ne mɔ aze wɔ bɛ azu ɛbɔlɛ ne anwo a.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Nzinlii Dwuuma bie vi Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu nee Ayekoneɛm la rale, bɛralile menli ne anzo bɛhɔle bɛ afoa na bɛzile Pɔɔlo awolɛ bɛmanle ɔ nye zo bulule; bɛhwenle ye bɛhɔdole sua ne kandiba, ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ yewu.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ diedima ne rabɔle yiale ye la, ɔ nye rale zolɛ na ɔdwazole ɔ nee bɛ hɔle sua nu. Aleɛ hyenle la ɔ nee Baanabase bɛhɔle Dɛbi. Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase ziale rale Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Selea la

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase hanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Dɛbi la, bɛnyianle ɛdoavolɛma gyɛlɛɛnye. Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne bɛziale bɛhɔle Lesetela nee Ayekoneɛm, yɛɛ Anteɔko mɔɔ wɔ Paesedea maanzinli nu la.

english_verse: They encouraged the followers and begged them to remain faithful. They told them, “We have to suffer a lot before we can get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Bɛmanle diedima ne mɔ anwosesebɛ na bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛzɔ diedi ne anu kpundii. Bɛhilehilele bɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo na yɛanwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛzieziele mgbanyima bɛmanle bɛ, na bɛvale ɛhɔnehyelɛ nee nzɛlɛlɛ bɛdule bɛ bɛwulale Awulae ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwule ye nu la asa anu.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Akee bɛhɔkpɔsale Paesedea maanzinli ne anu na bɛrale Pamefelea maanzinli nu.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Bɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Pɛga na bɛhɔle Ateelea.

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne la bɛvale ɛlɛne bɛziale bɛrale Anteɔko. Ɛke a bɛdule bɛ bɛwulale Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo kolaa na bɛabɔ bɛ gyima ɛhye mɔɔ bɛwie ye di la abo a.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛradwule Anteɔko la, bɛyiale asɔnema ne amuala na bɛhanle mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ la amuala bɛhilele bɛ, nee kɛ yezi yebuke diedi adenle yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nee diedima ne dɛnlanle ɛkɛ ne hyɛle dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Menli bie vi Dwudiya rale Anteɔko na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛkilehile diedima ne kɛ, “Saa bɛanyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, kɛmɔ Mosisi mɛla ne kile la a bɛnrɛnyia ngoane.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase nee bɛ zule ɛhye anwo kpolera kpole kpalɛ. Zɔhane ati bɛdule menli kɛ bɛboka Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase anwo bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɛhɔnwu ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Asɔnema ne guale bɛ adenle, na bɛkɔ la bɛvale Fonehyea nee Samɛlea, na bɛhanle kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛzi ɛhakyi, na bɛlie Nyamenle bɛli la anwo edwɛkɛ bɛhilele bɛ. Na diedima ne lile nwolɛ fɛlɛko somaa.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛvale mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ la amuala bɛbɔle amaneɛ bɛhilele bɛ, na asɔnema ne, ɛzoanvolɛma ne, yɛɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ liele bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Na diedima ne bie mɔ mɔɔ boka Falasii fane ne anwo la dwazole na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na eza bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɛdoavolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ yiale nu vale edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo adwenle.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Na bɛhehanle nwolɛ bie dedee la, Pita dwazole na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ayi mɔ, bɛze kɛ mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, Nyamenle yele me bɛ avinli manle mengɔmbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛade edwɛkɛ ne na bɛalie bɛali.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle mɔɔ ze sonla ahonle nu la hilele kɛ yelie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko, na ɔmanle bɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne bie, kɛmɔ ɔvale ɔmanle yɛdayɛ ala la.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: Yeangile kɛ asolo yɛmɛ nee bɛmɛ. Ɔluale bɛ diedi zo yɛɛ ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ɔhyɛle bɛ a.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Duzu ati yɛɛ akee bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle bɛkɛnlea, na bɛkɛva kpomgbolo kpole bɛkɛgyela diedima ne akɔme, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛangola ye soa la ɛ?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ! Kɛmɔ yɛdie yɛdi na ɔlua Awulae Gyisɛse ɛlolɛ zo bɛbalie yɛ ngoane la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ɛdeɛ ne de a.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle ɛhye la bɛ muala bɛyɛle koonwu na akee bɛdiele Baanabase nee Pɔɔlo kolakola ne, nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlua bɛ nwo zo ɛyɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli la amuala.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛ nloa penle la, Gyemise dendɛle na ɔzele kɛ, “Mediema, bɛdie me.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Saemɔn ɛha ɛhile nu kɛkala kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle anye hɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anwo zo na ɔyele menli wɔ bɛ avinli ɔrayɛle ye ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ la.

english_verse: This agrees with what the prophets wrote,
translation_verse: Ɛhye nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne le ko. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se,

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Awulae se, ɛhye anzi mebazia meara, na meamaa Devidi belemgbunlililɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle aze la zo. Mebayɛ ye fofolɛ na meamaa ye zo meazie ɔ gyakɛ anu,

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: amaa ewiade amra mɔɔ ɛha la ara me ɛkɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na mevɛlɛ bɛ la arayɛ me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: I promised it long ago.”
translation_verse: Awulae a vale ɛhye dole gua dɛbadɛba ne a.’ ”

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Gyemise hɔle zolɛ zele kɛ, “Me adwenle a le kɛ, ɔnle kɛ yɛta bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛhakyi bɛlɛba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la anye zo.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛhɛlɛ kɛlata yehɔmaa bɛ kɛ bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, mɔɔ le kɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛkpa munzule anzɛɛ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la anwo, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nee nane mɔɔ bɛlofo ye bɛhu ye na bɛampɛ ɔ kɔme la ɛlilɛ nee mogya nwo.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Mosisi mɛla ne, bɛkenga ye Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ noko bɛbɔ ye nolo wɔ sua biala azo.” Kɛlata mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle bɛhɔmanle diedima mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ɛzoanvolɛma ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ, nee asɔnema ne mɔ amuala akee bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛsoa menli bɛamaa bɛ nee Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase ahɔ Anteɔko. Bɛdule menli nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛbu bɛ kpalɛ la bɛmanle bɛ nee bɛ hɔle. Bɛmɛ a le Dwudase mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Baasabase la, yɛɛ Saelase.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Na bɛvale kɛlata ɛhye bɛmanle bɛ kɛ bɛva bɛhɔ: “Yɛdayɛ bɛ mediema ɛzoanvolɛma nee asɔne mgbanyima, yɛlɛ mediema ɛhulolɛ yɛbiza mediema mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Anteɔko, Selesea, yɛɛ Selea la amuala ahye.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Yɛde kɛ yɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ yɛanzoa bɛ la ɛra bagyegye bɛ aha edwɛkɛ azɛkye bɛ adwenle.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a le Dwudase nee Saelase, bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ bamoa mɔɔ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ kɛlata ye anu la azo.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee yɛdayɛ yɛdie yɛto nu kɛ yɛnrɛva kpomgbolo kpole biala yɛnrɛkpolo bɛ kɔme kɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ hyia la ala.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadi aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛkpa munzule anzɛɛ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la; bɛmmadi mogya; bɛmmadi nane mɔɔ bɛlofo ye na bɛampɛ ɔ kɔme la, na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nwo. Saa bɛtwe bɛ nwo bɛfi ɛhye mɔ anwo a ɛnee bɛlua adenle fɔɔnwo ne anu. Yɛbiza bɛ ahye.”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ la hɔdwule Anteɔko la, bɛboɔboale diedima ne kɔsɔɔti anloa na bɛyele kɛlata ne bɛmanle bɛ.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ diedima ne gengale kɛlata ne la, bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole wɔ akɛnrazilɛ mɔɔ kɛlata ne ɛva ɛrɛlɛ bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Dwudase nee Saelase, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma la dendɛle dɔɔnwo hilele bɛ manle bɛnyianle anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Bɛlile kenle ekyi wɔ ɛkɛ ne la, diedima ne akee gyakyile bɛ adenle kɛ bɛzia bɛhɔ menli mɔɔ zoanle bɛ la anwo lɔ. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase dɛnlanle Anteɔko hyɛle ekyii; bɛ nee diedima ne bie mɔ hilehilele na bɛbɔle Awulae edwɛkɛ ne nolo. Pɔɔlo nee Baanabase avinli ɛtetelɛ

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Mekɛ guale nu la Pɔɔlo zele Baanabase kɛ, “Maa yɛzia yɛhɔkpɔla azua mɔɔ yɛha Awulae edwɛkɛ ne wɔ zo la, na yɛhɔnlea kɛ mediema ne mɔ si kɔ la.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Baanabase hulole kɛ bɛkɛva Dwɔn Maake bɛkɛboka bɛ nwo,

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: noko Pɔɔlo adwenle a le kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ Maake kpole bɛ wɔ Pamefelea, ɔgyakyile bɛ ɛkɛ ne na ɔ nee bɛ anyɛ gyima ne anwie la, ɔngyia kɛ bɛ nee ye kɛhɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ɛhye anwo kpolerazulɛ yɛle kyengye kpalɛ manle bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛ avinli tetele. Baanabase vale Maake na ɔ nee ye pɛle azule hɔle Saepelɛse.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo noko vale Saelɛse hɔle, na mediema ne mɔ vale Pɔɔlo wulale Awulae ɛlolɛ ne abo.

english_verse: They traveled through Syria and Cilicia, encouraging the churches.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle Selea nee Selesea ɔhɔmanle diedima mɔɔ wɔ asɔne ne mɔ anu la anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo eza rale Dɛbi nee Lesetela noko. Ɛdoavolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Temɔte. Ɔ nli le Dwuunli mɔɔ ɛlie Edwɛkpa ne ɛli a, yɛɛ ɔ ze le Gilikinli.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Mediema mɔɔ wɔ Lesetela nee Ayekoneɛm la kanvo Temɔte kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zolɛ Pɔɔlo hulole kɛ ɔkɛva Temɔte ɔkɛhɔ. Ɛhye ati ɔmanle bɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ. Pɔɔlo yɛle ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la amuala ze kɛ Temɔte ɔ ze le Gilikinli.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɛ akpɔsa ne anu, sua biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdwu zo la bɛye ɛzoanvolɛma nee mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ngyehyɛlɛ ne bɛto diedima ne anyunlu, na bɛse bɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Ɛhye manle asɔne ne mɔ anwo yɛle se wɔ diedi nu na menli dɔɔnwo rabokale bɛ nwo dahuu. Pɔɔlo ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ wɔ Tulowase

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle Felegyea nee Galeehyea maanzinli ne mɔ anu, ɔluakɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ammaa adenle ammaa bɛanga Edwɛkpa ne wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdwule Mesea maanzinli ne ɛweɛne zo la bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛhɔ Baetenea maanzinli nu, na Gyisɛse Sunsum ne ammaa bɛ adenle.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛpɛle nu bɛhɔluale Mesea maanzinli nu na bɛhɔle Tulowase.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Nɔe ne Pɔɔlo nwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ kɛ nrenya bie vi Masidonea ɛragyinla ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na ɔlɛkpa ye kyɛlɛ kɛ, “Bɛla Masidonea maanzinli nu na baboa yɛ!”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle zɛhae debie la, yɛbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ Nyamenle yɛɛ ɛvɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛhɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo yɛhile menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la a, ɛhye ati yɛhuohuanle yɛ nwo na yɛhɔle Masidonea maanzinli nu. Ledea yɛ diedinli

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Yɛvale ɛlɛne yɛvile Tulowase yɛdole ye zo yɛhɔle Samotelase, ye alehyenlɛ nu ɛnee yɛwɔ Niapɔlese.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la yɛhɔle Felepae, mɔɔ le suakpole wɔ Masidonea maanzinli nu la. Suakpole ɛhye Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a bɔle ye nzeseɛ a. Yɛlile kenle dɔɔnwo wɔ sua ne azo.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle ne dwule la, yɛhɔle bɛ azule ne anloa wɔ suakpole ne kandiba. Yɛ adwenle a le kɛ kabezɛ ɛkɛ ne a Dwuuma ɔyɛ a yia yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ mɔɔ diele yɛ edwɛkɛ ne la ko a le Ledea mɔɔ vi Tayataela na ɔtɔnedɔne arelemgbunli ndanlɛ la. Ɔle raalɛ mɔɔ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ wɔ ye nu a. Na Awulae bukele ye adwenle nu manle ɔdiele mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la kpalɛ.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: Na ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye nee ye sua nu amra amuala, na ɔzele yɛ kɛ, “Saa bɛbu me kɛ melɛ diedi wɔ Awulae anu a, ɛnee bɛ nee me ɛradɛnla me sua nu.” Ɔtinlinle zolɛ na ɔ nee yɛ hɔle. Bɛgua Pɔɔlo nee Saelɛse efiade wɔ Felepae

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Kenle ko yɛlɛkɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la, yɛyiale kanranli bɛlɛra bie mɔɔ di ahɔne na ɔlua ye munzule ɛbɔlɛ zo ɔ menle mɔ ɛnyia bɛ nwo ninyɛne nee ezukoa la.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: Ɔdoale yɛ nee Pɔɔlo na ɔlile yɛ nzi ɔdeɛdeanle nu kɛ, “Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma, mɔɔ bɔ ngoanelielɛ adenle ne anwo nolo la ɛne!”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛhye alehyenlɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmanle akee ɔyɛle Pɔɔlo abodelɛ, na ɔhakyile ɔ nye ɔzele sunsum ɛtane ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛlɛra ne anwo la kɛ, “Ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, mese wɔ kɛ, ɛvi ɔ nwo tu!” Na sunsum ɛtane ne vi bɛlɛra ne anwo dule ɛkɛ ne ala.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ne amenle mɔ nwunle kɛ bɛ ezukoa ɛnyialɛ adenle ne ɛdua la, bɛhɔhyele Pɔɔlo nee Saelase bɛhwenlenle bɛ aze bɛ nee bɛ hɔle mgbanyinli nyunlu wɔ bɛ gua ne anu.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Bɛlɛfa amaamuo mɔɔ nee yɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɛnle ko la bɛarahilehile yɛ. Yɛmɛ yɛle Wulomuma mɔɔ yɛdie bɛ ngilehilelɛ ne yɛto nu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Na menli ne mɔ amuala bokale menli mɔɔ hɔdoanle ɛzoanvolɛma ne la anwo. Na edwɛkɛdivolɛma ne tetele Pɔɔlo nee Saelase adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwula la na bɛmanle bɛbilale bɛ empele.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛbole bɛ bɛwiele la, bɛguale bɛ efiade, na bɛzele mɔɔ nea efiade ne azo la kɛ ɔzɔ bɛ nu boɛ.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zo ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔle efiade ne akunlu lɔ na ɔbɔle bɛ kpanwu.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Nɔe ne, kɛyɛ alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli, ɛnee Pɔɔlo nee Saelase ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛlɛto edwɛne bɛaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ, na menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛgua efiade ne bie la ɛlɛtie bɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Arɛlevilɛ nu ala azɛlɛ kpusule kpole bie na efiade ne adiabo ne kpusule. Na ɛkɛ ne ala efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ amuala bukebukele na nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ mɔɔ dedɛ bɛ la amuala kpolokpolole guale.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ pilizama sinzavolɛ ne vi nafelɛ nu dunwuele na ɔnwunle kɛ efiade ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ deda nwolɛ la, ɔdwenlenle kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade ne la ɛwie nriandi kɔ, ɛhye ati ɔhwenle ye dadeɛ ne kɛ ɔku ɔ nwo.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo deanle nu kɛ, “Mmaku ɛ nwo! Yɛ muala yɛwɔ ɛke!”

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Pilizama sinzavolɛ ne manle bɛvale kɛnlaneɛ bɛrale, na ɔvale sulosulo ɔhɔdule ɔdɔle Pɔɔlo nee Saelase agyakɛ anu.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: Ɔvale bɛ ɔvindele na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ, “Yɛmenle mɔ, duzu yɛɛ menyɛ na meanyia ngoane a?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Die Awulae Gyisɛse di, na ɛdawɔ nee wɔ sua nu amra kɛnyia ngoane.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Akee bɛhanle Awulae anwo Edwɛkpa ne bɛhilele ye nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la amuala.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Dɔnehwele ne anu ala, pilizama sinzavolɛ ne miemianle bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ, na ɔvale nwole ɔtotole nu, na ɔmanle bɛzɔnenle ye nee ye sua nu amra amuala.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale bɛ ɔhɔle sua nu na ɔmanle bɛ debie bɛlile, na ɔ nee ye sua nu amra lile fɛlɛko kɛ bɛnyia diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu a.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la, Wulomu arane mgbanyima ne mɔ zoanle kpolisi mgbanyinli manle bɛhɔzele pilizama sinzavolɛ ne kɛ, “Gyakyi menli ne mɔ maa bɛhɔ.”

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Pilizama sinzavolɛ ne hanle hilele Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛzoa kɛ bɛgyakyi ɛdawɔ nee Saelase. Yemɔti bɛhɔ anzonudwolɛ nu.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo zele kpolisi mgbanyinli mɔɔ rale la kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ, mgbane gyɛne ne ala, bɛbo yɛ bagua nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛle Wulomuma la, bɛgua yɛ efiade na akee bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛye yɛ ahane nyaa bɛmaa yɛkɔ? Yɛnrɛhɔ! Maa Wulomu mgbanyima ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛraye yɛ.”

english_verse: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.
translation_verse: Kpolisi mgbanyinli ne mɔ hɔhanle edwɛkɛ ɛhye hilele Wulomu mgbanyima ne mɔ. Na mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Pɔɔlo nee Saelase le Wulomuma la, bɛ ahonle dule.

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛrale bɛrakpale bɛ kyɛlɛ; bɛyele bɛ efiade ne na bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛvi suakpole ne azo bɛhɔ.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee Saelase vi efiade ɛkɛ ne la, bɛhɔle Ledea sua nu. Bɛhɔdole mediema ne bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛdendɛle bɛhilele bɛ, bɛzile bɛ ahonle, na akee bɛhɔle.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo nee Saelase kpɔsale hɔle Amfepɔlese nee Apɔlonea na bɛrale Tɛsalonaeka. Dwuuma lɛ nyianu sua wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Pɔɔlo yɛ ye ala la, ɔhɔle nyianu sua ne anu na ɔ nee bɛ lile Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anwo adwelie Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle fane nsa.

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: Ɔhilehilele nu ɔmanle bɛnwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na bɛdwazo ye bɛfi ewule nu, na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Gyisɛse ɛhye mɔɔ melɛka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ la, yemɔ a le Mɛzaya ne.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ liele lile na bɛhakyile bɛdoale Pɔɔlo nee Saelase; zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gilikima mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle nee mraalɛ mgbanyinli dɔɔnwo ne ala yɛle a.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anwo akpule hunle Dwuuma ne mɔ. Yemɔti bɛsesale kpamgbanvolɛma bie bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa. Bɛmanle bɛdole nzaka wɔ suakpole ne azo toonwo bɛrale Gyeesen sua nu ɛkɛ kɛ bɛbakpondɛ Pɔɔlo nee Saelase bɛahwe bɛ bɛavinde bagua nu.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Bɛannwu bɛ la, bɛhwenlenle Gyeesen nee mediema ne bie mɔ bɛvale bɛ bɛhɔmanle mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛbutu ewiade amuala anye aze la ɛra yɛ sua ye azo noko,

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: na Gyeesen ɛlie bɛ azie. Bɛ muala bɛlɛbulu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne mɛla zo, na bɛkile kɛ belemgbunli bieko eza wɔ ɛkɛ, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyisɛse.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Bɛvale edwɛkɛ ɛhye bɛmanle menli ne nyakanle bɛmanle ɔhanle mgbanyima ne mɔ noko.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Na nzinlii mgbanyima ne mɔ manle Gyeesen nee mediema ne mɔ duale ezukoa lile bɛ nwo agyinlanu, na bɛgyakyile bɛ bɛmanle bɛhɔle. Pɔɔlo nee Saelase wɔ Bɛlia

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ maanle nu muanle la, mediema ne mɔ manle Pɔɔlo nee Saelase hɔle Bɛlia. Bɛhɔdwule la, bɛhɔle Dwuuma nyianu sua ne anu.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la adwenle nu ɛbuke ɛdɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Tɛsalonaeka la. Zɔhane ati bɛliele Edwɛkpa ne na dahuu bɛnleɛnleanle Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kpalɛ kɛ saa mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka la le nɔhalɛ a.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Bɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala liele lile, yɛɛ Giliki mraalɛ nee mrenya dɔɔnwo mɔɔ lɛ duma la noko liele lile.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la dele kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛhɔha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne wɔ Bɛlia la, bɛrale ɛkɛ ne na bɛrafutule menli ne mɔ ahonle.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Na ndɛndɛ ne ala mediema ne mɔ manle Pɔɔlo adenle bɛmanle ɔhɔle; na Saelase nee Temɔte hale Bɛlia.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ hɔle Pɔɔlo ɛzɔhonlɛ la vale ye toonwo bɛ nee ye hɔdwule Atɛnse na bɛazia. Na Pɔɔlo vale nrɛlaleɛ manle bɛhɔmanle Saelase nee Temɔte kɛ bɛrɛla waa bɛraboa ye. Pɔɔlo wɔ Atɛnse

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛkendɛ Saelase nee Temɔte wɔ Atɛnse la, ɔnwunle kɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ ɛva sua ne, yemɔti ɔlile nyane dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔhɔle nyianu sua ne anu ɔ nee Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛsulo Nyamenle la hɔdendɛle. Dahuu ɔkɔgyinla mgbata ne mɔ azo na ɔ nee menli mɔɔ se la tendɛ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Eku nwiɔ bie mɔɔ Ɛpekulɛse nee Zɛno a dele la anu kilehilevolɛma rale na bɛ nee Pɔɔlo razule kpolera na bɛzele kɛ, “Na sonlamgbane ɛhye, duzu edwɛkɛ yɛɛ ɔkpondɛ yeaha a?” Bie mɔ noko se, “Ɔzɔho kɛ ɔlɛbɔ ɛzonlenlɛ fofolɛ bie anwo nolo.” Bɛhanle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ Pɔɔlo hanle Gyisɛse nee ewudwazo nwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvale Pɔɔlo bɛrale Alɛyɔpagɛse azo bagua ne anu na bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛkulo kɛ ɛmaa yɛnwu ngilehilelɛ fofolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la anu kpalɛ.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne bie mɔ yɛ yɛ nzo nu ngakyile, na yɛkulo kɛ yɛte ɔ bo.”

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo dwazole gyinlanle ayiama ne anyunlu na ɔhanle kɛ, “Atɛnsema, menwu kɛ adenle biala anu, bɛkulo nyamenlezonlenlɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Mekpɔsa suakpole ye azo dɔɔnwo, na mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛsonle la ɛdɛneyelɛ ninyɛne wɔ ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ eza bɛlɛ azubɔlɛ mokyea ko mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ ‘Ɛhye le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yɛnze ye la ɛdeɛ’ la wɔ ɛkɛ. Na mɔɔ bɛsonle ye, noko bɛnze ye la, yemɔ yɛɛ mebaha ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ kɛkala la.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ bɔle ewiade nee mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la amuala la le anwuma nee aze Awulae, na ɔndɛnla sua mɔɔ menli ɛva bɛ sa ɛzi la anu.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: Eza ɔngyia debie biala anwo na sonla ava ɔ sa anloa gyima akpondɛ debie amaa ye, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye a ɔmaa sonla biala ngoane nee ɛnwomenle nee debie biala a.

english_verse: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bɔle sonla na ɔluale ɔ nwo zo ɔmanle menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala rale. Ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtɛnla nee maanle biala ɛkpazilɛ nee ye azedɔlɛ a.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa bɛakpondɛ ye kɛ bɛ sa kɛha ye na bɛanwu ye. Noko Nyamenle nee yɛ nuhua biala avinli ande biala,

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ, ‘Ye nuhua yɛɛ yɛde na yɛkɔ, yɛba, na yɛnyia ngoane a.’ Ɔle kɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛma bie mɔ hanle la. ‘Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle ɔ mra.’

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: Saa yɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee ɔnle kɛ yɛdwenle kɛ Nyamenle le abɔdeɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule anzɛɛ bolɛ ananze bie mɔɔ sonla ɔdaye yeva ye adwenle yehyehyɛ na yeyɛ la.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bule ɔ nye guale zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee menli ɛnze la. Kɛkala, ɔlɛka yeahile menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala la kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane nwo.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yehile kenle mɔɔ ɔbalua sonla ne mɔɔ yedu ye yezie ɛkɛ ne la anwo zo yeabua aleɛabo amra kɔsɔɔti ndɛne a. Ɔdwazole sonla zɔhane ɔvile ewule nu ɔvale ɔzile edwɛkɛ ɛhye dawua ɔmanle awie biala.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ Pɔɔlo ɛlɛka ewudwazo nwo edwɛkɛ la, bie mɔ golole ɔ nwo, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko zele kɛ, “Yɛkulo kɛ ɛsi edwɛkɛ ɛhye azo na ɛka ye bieko ɛkile yɛ wɔ kenle fofolɛ.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo vi ayiama ne anyunlu hɔle.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Noko menli ne bie mɔ liele lile na bɛhɔbokale ɔ nwo. Bie mɔ a le Dayoneseɛse, mɔɔ boka Alɛyɔpagɛse ayiama ne anwo, nee raalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Damalese la, yɛɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth,
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, Pɔɔlo vile Atɛnse hɔle Kɔlente.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: Ɔhɔdole Dwuunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Akoyela na bɛwole ye wɔ Pɔntɛse maanzinli nu la kɛ bɔ zo mɔɔ ɔ nee ɔ ye Pelesela bɛvi Yetale bɛra a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Belemgbunli Kolɔdeɛse ɛha kɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la amuala vi maanle ne anu ɛdu. Pɔɔlo hɔle bɛ nwo,

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: na kɛmɔ bɛ muala bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛdi aleɛ la a le ɛdanlɛ sua ɛyɛlɛ la ati, ɔ nee ye dɛnlanle na ɔ nee bɛ yɛle gyima.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle biala ɔkɔ nyianu sua ne anu ɔ nee bɛ kɔtendɛ, kɛ ɔbɔ mɔdenle yeali Dwuuma nee Gilikima ne mɔ adwenle.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
