translation_verse: yɛɛ mɔɔ menyɛle ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛne. Menliele tumi wɔ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛkɛ ne na menguale Nyamenle menli ne dɔɔnwo efiade. Eza saa bɛbua bɛ ewule fɔlɛ a, meto me ɛma mefua zolɛ.

english_verse: I often had them punished in our synagogues, and I tried to make them give up their faith. In fact, I was so angry with them, that I went looking for them in foreign cities.
translation_verse: Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala memanle bɛdeanle bɛ wɔ nyianu azua ne mɔ anu, na membɔle mɔdenle kɛ memaa bɛ ngome bɛaha ɛtane bɛatia bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ne. Me nye bolole bɛ nwo kpalɛ manle ɔrale kɛ akee mekɔ azuamgbole zo wɔ maanle maanle zo yɛɛ mekɔkye bɛ meba a. Pɔɔlo ka kɛ ɔzile ɔrayɛle diedinli la (Gyi

english_verse: King Agrippa, one day I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and permission of the chief priests.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye ala anwo bie yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ manle me tumi kɛlata manle mengɔle Dɛmasekɛse a.

english_verse: About noon I saw a light brighter than the sun. It flashed from heaven on me and on everyone traveling with me.
translation_verse: Na wɔ adevinli ne, kɛyɛ sɛnzɛngyinla, Nana, yɛɛ menwunle kɛ wienyi mɔɔ ta tɛla sɛnzɛne la, vi anwuma ɛrabɛnra ɛyia me nee menli mɔɔ me nee bɛ lua la a.

english_verse: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice say to me in Aramaic, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me? It's foolish to fight against me!”
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛpɛle yɛfinle, na mendele ɛnelɛ bie kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me wɔ Hibulu aneɛ nu kɛ, ‘Sɔɔlo, Sɔɔlo! Duzu ati a ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde ɛ? Ɛto ɛ gyakɛ ɛwɔ evileni bowule a, ɛboda ɛ nwo o!’

english_verse: “Who are you?” I asked. Then the Lord answered, “I am Jesus! I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Na membizale ye kɛ, ‘Awulae, na ɛdawɔ nwane ɔ?’ Na Awulae zele kɛ, ‘Mame a mele Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la.

english_verse: Now stand up. I have appeared to you, because I have chosen you to be my servant. You are to tell others what you have learned about me and what I will show you later.”
translation_verse: Na dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu. Meye me nwo mehile wɔ, amaa meayɛ wɔ me sonvolɛ na wɔali me nwo daselɛ wɔ mɔɔ wɔnwu ye ɛnɛ, nee mɔɔ nzinlii mebaye meahile wɔ la amuala anwo.

english_verse: The Lord also said, “I will protect you from the Jews and from the Gentiles that I am sending you to.
translation_verse: Mebalie wɔ meavi Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ mebazoa wɔ bɛ avinli la asa anu.

english_verse: I want you to open their eyes, so they will turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God. Then their sins will be forgiven, and by faith in me they will become part of God's holy people.”
translation_verse: Mesoa wɔ, amaa wɔahɔbuke bɛ nye na wɔahwe bɛ wɔavi awozinli nu nee Seetan tumi ne abo wɔara wienyi nu nee Nyamenle ɛkɛ, amaa ɔlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ me nu la azo bɛanyia ɛtanefakyɛ na bɛanyia ɛleka wɔ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la avinli.’ Pɔɔlo ka ye gyimayɛlɛ nwo edwɛkɛ

english_verse: King Agrippa, I obeyed this vision from heaven.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye ati, Belemgbunli Agelepa, meanyɛ anzosesebɛ wɔ anwuma ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: First I preached to the people in Damascus, and then I went to Jerusalem and all over Judea. Finally, I went to the Gentiles and said, “Stop sinning and turn to God! Then prove what you have done by the way you live.”
translation_verse: Na menlumuale menganle ye wɔ Dɛmasekɛse nee Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Dwudiya maanle ne mɔ amuala anu, nee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛmboka Dwuuma anwo la anu, kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo na bɛzia bɛrɛla Nyamenle ɛkɛ, na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛnlu bɛ nwo la.

english_verse: That is why some men grabbed me in the temple and tried to kill me.
translation_verse: Na ɔlua ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ Dwuuma rahyele me wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛku me a.

english_verse: But all this time God has helped me, and I have preached both to the rich and to the poor. I have told them only what the prophets and Moses said would happen.
translation_verse: Noko Nyamenle moalɛ ti, ɛnɛ megyi ɛke metɛdi daselɛ metɛkile bɛ mgbanyinli nee bɛ ngakula muala. Mɔɔ Mosisi nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle dole ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔbazi la, yemɔ ala a le mɔɔ melɛka la.

english_verse: I told them how the Messiah would suffer and be the first to be raised from death, so he could bring light to his own people and to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ Mɛzaya ne nwu amaneɛ na ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ badwazo avi mɔwuamra anu, na yeabɔ wienyi nwo nolo yeahile Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala.”

english_verse: Before Paul finished defending himself, Festus shouted, “Paul, you're crazy! Too much learning has driven you out of your mind.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo anloa wɔ zolɛ ɔlɛka edwɛkɛ ne la, Fɛsetɛse deanle ye nu zele kɛ, “Pɔɔlo, wɔzɛ! Ɛdoa nwomazukoalɛ dedee ɛlɛbɔ ɛlane.”

english_verse: But Paul replied, “Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true, and it makes sense.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Nana Fɛsetɛse, metɛsɛle. Nɔhalɛ komii ne a melɛka la.

english_verse: None of these things happened off in a corner somewhere. I am sure that King Agrippa knows what I am talking about. That's why I can speak so plainly to him.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Agelepa, mekpa edwɛkɛ ne anwo ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ menzulo ɔ nzi a, ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ ɛze ɛhye mɔ amuala. Meze noko kɛ ɛyɛle bɛ nzonlɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ biala anzi fealera nu.

english_verse: Then Paul said to Agrippa, “Do you believe what the prophets said? I know you do.”
translation_verse: Belemgbunli Agelepa, asoo ɛdie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne ɛdi? Meze kɛ ɛdie ɛdi somaa!”

english_verse: Agrippa asked Paul, “In such a short time do you think you can talk me into being a Christian?”
translation_verse: Agelepa bizale Pɔɔlo kɛ, “Ɛnee ɛdwenle kɛ mekɛ ekyi ɛhye ala anu ɛmaa meayɛ Keleseɛnenli ɔ?”

english_verse: Paul answered, “Whether it takes a short time or a long time, I wish you and everyone else who hears me today would become just like me! Except, of course, for these chains.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo buale ye kɛ, “Saa mekɛ ekyi nu o, saa mekɛ tendenle nu o, me nzɛlɛlɛ a le kɛ anrɛɛ Nyamenle amaa ɛdawɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie me ɛnɛ la amuala ayɛ ye sonvolɛma kɛ medame la, mɔɔ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ye ɛmboka nwolɛ a.”

english_verse: Then King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and everyone who was with them got up.
translation_verse: Na belemgbunli ne, amɛnlado ne, yɛɛ Bɛnaesi nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la amuala dwazole.

english_verse: But before they left, they said, “This man isn't guilty of anything. He doesn't deserve to die or to be put in jail.”
translation_verse: Bɛvindele la, bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo kɛ, “Sonla ɛhye ɛtɛyɛle debie mɔɔ fɛta kɛ bɛku ye anzɛɛ bɛto ye efiade bɔbɔ a.”

english_verse: Agrippa told Festus, “Paul could have been set free, if he had not asked to be tried by the Roman Emperor.”
translation_verse: Na Agelepa zele Fɛsetɛse kɛ, “Saa sonla ye ambɔ ye edwɛkɛ ne atua ammaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne a anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi ye bɛmaa ɔkɔ.”

english_verse: When it was time for us to sail to Rome, Captain Julius from the Emperor's special troops was put in charge of Paul and the other prisoners.
translation_verse: Nzinlii mɔɔ bɛyɛle adwenle kɛ akee ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkɔ Yetale la, bɛvale Pɔɔlo nee pilizama bie mɔ mɔɔ boka nwolɛ la bɛwulale Dwuleɛse mɔɔ le sogya kpanyinli wɔ Wulomu Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne sogyama ne anu la asa anu.

english_verse: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail to some ports along the coast of Asia. Aristarchus from Thessalonica in Macedonia sailed on the ship with us.
translation_verse: Yɛhɔvole ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Adelameteɛm, mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ Ehyea maanzinli nu la anu na yɛdule. Alesetaakɛse, mɔɔ le Masidoneanli na ɔvi Tɛsalonaeka la boka yɛ nwo.

english_verse: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la yɛradwule Saedɛn. Dwuleɛse hilele ye ahunlunyele wɔ Pɔɔlo anwo. Ɔmanle ye adenle ɔmanle ɔhɔle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ anwo kɛ ɔhɔkpondɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbahyia nwolɛ la.

english_verse: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.
translation_verse: Yɛvi Saedɛn yɛdule la ɛnee anwoma ne ɛlɛbɔ atia yɛ. Yemɔti yɛwɔle yɛ ti aze yɛsianenle Saepelɛse aze.

english_verse: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.
translation_verse: Yɛluale Selesea nee Pamefelea anwuma yɛrale Maela mɔɔ wɔ Lesea maanzinli nu la.

english_verse: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ yɛɛ sogya kpanyinli ne nyianle ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Alɛzandelea ɛlɛkɔ Yetale la, na ɔvale yɛ ɔhɔvole nuhua.

english_verse: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.
translation_verse: Yɛdule la ɛnee yɛngola kɔ kpalɛ biala, yemɔti yɛlile kenle dɔɔnwo wɔ adenle nu. Yɛ nwo hyelele yɛ kpalɛ na yɛaradwu Kenaedɛse. Kɛmɔ ɛnee anwoma ne tɛtu tɛtia yɛ la ati, yɛdɛlale bɔra ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Salemoni ala la yɛɛ yɛsianenle Kiliti bɔra ne aze a.

english_verse: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.
translation_verse: Yɛsianenle aze kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛvɛle dedee na yɛrale ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Ahonle Kɛnlɛmazo” mɔɔ ɔ nee Lasia sua zo anwa biala la.

english_verse: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.
translation_verse: Yɛhyɛle ɛkɛ kpalɛ na ɔrale kɛ akee yɛkɔ a ɔngɔ, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu ɛnee azule nye ɛvalɛ akee ɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ na eza Buada Ɛvoyia ne ɛpɛ nu. Ɛhye ati, Pɔɔlo dule folɛ ɛhye:

english_verse: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, “Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.”
translation_verse: “Yɛmenle mɔ, menwu kɛ yɛ adendulɛ ye ɛlɛba arayɛ ɛzulolɛ amaa yɛ. Yɛbaminli ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ɛlɛne ye bazɛkye, yɛ ninyɛne bahɔ, yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛbawu.”

english_verse: But Julius listened to the captain of the ship and its owner, rather than to Paul.
translation_verse: Na sogya kpanyinli ne adwenle hɔle ɛlɛne menle ne nee mɔɔ nea zo la ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle la anu, na ɔgyakyile mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hanle la.

english_verse: The harbor at Fair Havens wasn't a good place to spend the winter. Because of this, almost everyone agreed that we should at least try to sail along the coast of Crete as far as Phoenix. It had a harbor that opened toward the southwest and northwest, and we could spend the winter there. The Storm at Sea
translation_verse: Eza ahonle ne azo bɔbɔ ɛnle kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛdi fɔsɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne a ɔyɛ boɛ a. Ɛhye ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la anu somaa ne ala hulole kɛ bɛkɛdu bɛkɛdɔ azule nye bieko na bɛkɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛkɛdwu Fonekese mɔɔ lɛ ahonle kpalɛ wɔ Kiliti na ɔ nye wɔ nyiakɛ adɔleɛ nee ɛbɔ nu adɔleɛ la, na bɛkɔdi fɔsɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ. Nyevile nye ahumu ne

english_verse: When a gentle wind from the south started blowing, the men thought it was a good time to do what they had planned. So they pulled up the anchor, and we sailed along the coast of Crete.
translation_verse: Nyiakɛ anwoma bɛtɛɛ bie vɛlɛle, na menli ne dwenlenle kɛ akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ, kɛmɔ bɛzuzule ala la. Bɛdule sɛkɛ na bɛsianenle Kiliti bɔra ne aze kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: days you have been so worried that you haven't eaten a thing.
translation_verse: Noko bɛandwu ɛleka biala yɛɛ anwoma ɛsesebɛ bie mɔɔ vi ɛbɔ nu la dwazole a.

english_verse: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.
translation_verse: Ɔkpale yɛ ɛlɛne ne kpalɛ, na kɛmɔ ɛnee yɛyɛ nwolɛ biala a ɔnyɛ boɛ la, yɛgyakyile nu yɛmanle ye kɛ ɔkpa yɛ ɔhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔbɔ yɛ yeahɔ la.

english_verse: We went along the island of Cauda on the side that was protected from the wind. We had a hard time holding the lifeboat in place,
translation_verse: Ɔkpale yɛ ɔhɔluale bɔra ekyi bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Kɔda la aze, na yɛbɔle mɔdenle yɛziele ɛlɛne ekyi ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛnemgbole ne anu la boɛ.

english_verse: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.
translation_verse: Bɛkpogyale ye na bɛsosɔle ye nyɛma. Bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛhɔnwe Lebea ese ne azo la ati, bɛdwulale avela ne mɔ na bɛgyakyile nu kɛ anwoma ne ɛkpa ye ɛhɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la.

english_verse: The storm was so fierce that the next day they threw some of the ship's cargo overboard.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee kɛ maanle nu ɛzi ɛmunla, na ahumu ne tɛsa la ati, bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛyeye ɛlɛne ne anu ninyɛne ne bie bɛagua nyevile nu.

english_verse: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.
translation_verse: Ye kenle nsa ne azo bɛvuandinle ɛlɛne ne anwo ninyɛne ne bie noko bɛguale nyevile nu.

english_verse: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Kenle dɔɔnwo pɛle nu mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nye ɛnnwu sɛnzɛne na yeayɛ ɛwɔlɔra a, yɛɛ kɛ ahumu ne noko gyi zo ala ɛne. Yemɔti yɛ nwo vɔle bɔkɔɔ kɛ yeannyia yɛanyɛ boɛ, yɛbawu.

english_verse: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.
translation_verse: Menli ne anloa nu dole, yemɔti mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ɛnee bɛnli debie. Na kenle ko Pɔɔlo dwazole gyinlanle bɛ avinli na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ebiamɔ, anrɛɛ bɛvale mɔɔ menganle la, na yɛvi Kiliti yɛandu; anrɛɛ munzule kpole ɛhye kpale yɛ ti na yɛamminli ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ɛhye mɔ.

english_verse: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.
translation_verse: Noko kɛkala, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛzi ahonle na awie biala ɛnrɛminli ye ngoane; ɛlɛne ye ala a bazɛkye a.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Nɔe, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mele ye ɛdeɛ na mesonle ye la soanvolɛ rale me nwo ɛke,

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: na ɔzele me kɛ, ‘Pɔɔlo, mmasulo, na ɔwɔ kɛ ɛgyinla Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne anyunlu. Ɔlua zo Nyamenle ɛva bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ lua nyevile ye anye la amuala ngoane ɛhyɛ wɔ.’

english_verse: Cheer up! I am sure that God will do exactly what he promised.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati ayi mɔ, bɛzi ahonle. Medie Nyamenle medi kɛ mɔɔ bɛha bɛhile me la bayɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: But we will first be shipwrecked on some island.
translation_verse: Noko akee ahumu ne bakpa yɛ ahɔnwe bɔra bie ɛnweanloa.”

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛpɛle sɛkɛ ne mɔ amuala anu na bɛzianyinle nyɛma ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛlɛne ne kotogyampa ne anu la. Bɛvolale avela ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne ati la bɛmanle anwoma ne vale ye hɔle aze.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Ɛnee gyimayɛvoma ne kpondɛ avi ɛlɛne ne anu anriandi la ati, bɛdwulale ɛlɛne ekyi ne na bɛyɛle kɛ asɛɛ bɛkado sɛkɛ ne bie wɔ ɛlɛnemgbole ne anyunlu lɔ la.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Bɛzulole kɛ yɛ ɛlɛne ne kɛhɔfofo bolɛ bie azo la ati, bɛdwulale sɛkɛ nna azule nu na yɛzɛlɛle alehyenlɛ.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo hanle hilele sogya kpanyinli ne kɛ, “Saa gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ andɛnla ɛlɛne ye anu a yɛ nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛha.”

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati sogyama ne pɛle nyɛma ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛlɛne ekyi ne la anu na bɛmanle ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Just before daylight Paul begged the people to eat something. He told them, “For
translation_verse: Aleɛbahye ne, Pɔɔlo bodole bɛ kɛ bɛ muala bɛli debie. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Ɛnɛ le kenle bulu nee nna ɛne, ahunlundetelɛ ɛmaa bɛlɛ bɛ ko mgbane.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛli debie ekyi bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛgyinla bɛ, na bɛ biala ati enrinli ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛminli.”

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo hanle ɛhye la, ɔvale kpanwo, ɔyɛle nzɛlɛlɛ, ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔbubu yeali wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala akee bɛzile ahonle, na awie biala lile debie.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Akee mɔɔ awie biala ako yile la bɛdule abɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la bie bɛguale nyevile nu, amaa ɛlɛne ne ayɛ felafela. Ɛlɛne ne ɛzialɛ

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ aleɛ hyenle la ɛnee bɛnnwu azɛlɛ holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛra zolɛ la ɛdeɛ, noko bɛnwunle ɛnwea wɔ ye ebolo bie anu, na bɛyɛle kɛ bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛahɔnwe ɛlɛne ne wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɛne ne hɔdɔle ɛsa nu; ɔ ti ne minle ɛnwea ne anu mɔɔ bɛtu ye a ɔnyɛ boɛ fee a, na nyevile azɛlɛkye ne bule zile ɔ bo ne bubule ye.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Sogyama ne yɛle kɛ bɛku pilizama mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la amuala, amaa bie anweɛ anvo file zo na yeanriandi.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ ɛnee sogya kpanyinli ne kulo kɛ ɔdie Pɔɔlo ngoane la ati, yeamkponle zolɛ. Ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze weɛ la ɛweɛ ɛhɔ file zo.

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: Menli noko mɔɔ hale la bie mɔ sesale ndaboa mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu, mɔɔ ɛlɛtudu ahɔ la bie, bie mɔ noko sosɔle ɛlɛne ne abɛta abɛta ne mɔɔ ɛdudu la anu bɛvole bɛbutubutule zolɛ. Ɛnee kɛ yɛyɛle mɔɔ yɛ muala yɛholale aze dwu la ɛne.

english_verse: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛradwule aze la yɛdele kɛ bɔra ne mɔɔ yɛra zo la bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɔleta.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Bɔra ne azo amra lɛ ahunlunyele kpalɛ. Ɛnee ezule ne ɛlɛtɔ na ɛyɛlɛ wɔ nu la ati, bɛhuanle senle bɛmanle yɛ muala yɛdɛnlanle nwolɛ.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo sesale ngeleka bie guale senle ne anu. Na senle ne wuluwulu ne hanle ɛyɛne ne la, ɛwɔlɛ bɔna vi nu vindele na ɔbebale Pɔɔlo asa.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɔra ne azo amra nwunle kɛ ɛwɔlɛ ne beba Pɔɔlo asa la, bɛdule bɛ nwo azukue kɛ, “Sonla ɛhye kɛyɛ kɔdiawu. Yemɔti yevi nyevile ye anu kɔlɔnwo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔyɛ biala a ɔbawu.”

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo kpondenle ɛwɔlɛ ne guale senle ne anu na ɛhwee anyɛ ɔdaye mumua ne.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔyɛle zɔhane la ɛnee menli ne mɔ anye la kɛ Pɔɔlo asa banwu anzɛɛ ɔbapɛ yeafi yeawu. Na bɛnleanle dedee mɔɔ ɛhwee anyɛ ye la, bɛhakyile bɛ adwenle na bɛhanle kɛ, “Ɔle bozonle!”

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Bɔra ne azo kpanyinli ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Pɛbeleɛse la ɛleka mɔɔ de la nee ɛleka mɔɔ yɛwɔ la anwa. Ɔ nee yɛ hɔle ye sua nu na ɔliele yɛ kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye, ɔlieliele yɛ nye kenle nsa.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee ebunlu ɛhye Pɛbeleɛse ɔ ze na eza ɔkɔ baka zo, yemɔti ɔla sua nu. Pɔɔlo hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, ɔzɛlɛle ɔmanle ye na ɔvale ɔ sa ɔguale ɔ nwo zo ɔmanle ɔdele kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛhye zile la, awuleravolɛ mɔɔ wɔ bɔra ne azo la amuala rale manle ɔyɛle bɛ ayile.

english_verse: The people were very respectful to us, and when we sailed, they gave us everything we needed. From Malta to Rome
translation_verse: Bɛlile yɛ eni dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ kenle mɔɔ yɛbahɔ la, bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛbahyia nwolɛ wɔ yɛ adendulɛ ne anu la bɛhɔguale ɛlɛne ne anu bɛmanle yɛ. Yɛvi Mɔleta yɛkɔ Wulomu

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: Siane nsa pɛle nu la yɛvale ɛlɛne bie mɔɔ vi Alɛzandelea mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “Bozonle Ndalɛ,” mɔɔ ralile fɔsɛlɛ ne wɔ bɔra ne azo la yɛzɔle yɛ adendulɛ ne azo.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: Yɛradwule aze wɔ Saelekusu na yɛlile kenle nsa wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: Yɛvi ɛkɛ ne la yɛrale Riligeɛm. Aleɛ hyenle la nyevile nu anwoma ne dwazole. Yemɔti yɛlile kenle nwiɔ yɛɛ yɛdwule Putiyɔle sua zo a.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: Yɛnwunle diedima ne bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, na bɛzɛlɛle yɛ bɛmanle yɛlile dapɛne wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Nzinlii yɛradwule Wulomu.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: Ɛnee diedima mɔɔ wɔ Wulomu la ɛde yɛ nganeɛ dɛbadɛba, yemɔti bɛvi ɛkɛ ne toonwo bɛrayiale yɛ wɔ Apeɛse Gua nu nee “Dabelɛ Nsa.” Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo nwunle bɛ la, ye ahonle gyinlanle na ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo. Wɔ Wulomu

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛdwule Wulomu la, bɛmanle Pɔɔlo adenle kɛ ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔhɔdɛnla, na bɛyele sogyanli ko kɛ ɔ nee ye ɛhɔdɛnla na ɔzinza ye.

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Ɔlile kenle nsa la Pɔɔlo vɛlɛle Dwuu mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la, ɔ nee bɛ yiale nu na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Me mediema Yizilayɛma, meanyɛ ɛtane biala meantia me menli anzɛɛ yɛ amaamuo ne mɔɔ yɛnyianle yɛvile yɛ nlenya mɔ lɔ la, noko bɛhyele me piliza bɛyele me bɛmanle Wulomuma wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Bɛnleɛnleanle me edwɛkɛ ne anu la ɛnee bɛnnwu debie biala mɔɔ meyɛ mɔɔ fɛta ɛhunlɛ a.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ Dwuuma amkponle la ati, ɛnee ɔhyia kɛ mebɔ me edwɛkɛ ne atua memaa Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne. Menlɛ bɛ nwo adwenle ɛtane biala, yɛɛ meamba kɛ mebadoa bɛ.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ me nee bɛ badendɛ a. Ɔluakɛ, ɔlua sonla ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma lɛ anyelazo wɔ ye nu la ati yɛɛ bɛgua me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ a.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Bɛzele ye kɛ, “Yɛmɛ yɛtɛnyianle ɛ nwo kɛlata biala vi Dwudiya, yɛɛ mediema ne mɔ biala ɛtɛbale ɛtɛbabɔle yɛ nehane amaneɛ biala mɔɔ le ɛtane wɔ ɛ nwo a.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Na yɛkulo kɛ yɛtie wɔ adwenle. Mɔɔ yɛze ye ɛke la a le kɛ, zɛhae fane ye mɔɔ ɛwɔ nu la, awie biala tendɛ tia ye.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nee Pɔɔlo hilele kenle. Kenle ne dwule la, menli dɔɔnwo rayiale ɛleka mɔɔ Pɔɔlo de la. Na ɔhanle Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilehilele nu ɔhilele bɛ, na ɔbɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔmaa bɛalie Gyisɛse anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nee Mosisi mɛla ne ka la bɛali. Ɔdendɛle ɛhye anwo ɔvi nwonlomɔ mangyee ne toonwo aledwolɛ.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ liele lile, na bie mɔ anlie anli.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Na bɛ adwenle anzɛ yɛɛ bɛzandele a. Na mɔɔ bɛbahɔ la Pɔɔlo hanle edwɛkɛ ko ɛhye kɛ, “Mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne luale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ Ayezaya anwo zo hanle hilele yɛ nlenya mɔ la le nɔhalɛ somaa!

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔzele kɛ, ‘Kɔze menli ɛhye mɔ kɛ, bɛbadie, bɛadie, na bɛnrɛde ɔ bo; bɛbanlea, bɛanlea, na bɛnrɛnwu debie,

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle se, menli ɛhye mɔ ɛsolo, bɛduodua bɛ nzo yɛɛ bɛmuomua bɛ nye. Anrɛɛ bɛ nye kɛnwu debie, bɛ nzo kɛde edwɛkɛ, bɛkɛnyia ndelebɛbo, na bɛkɛzia bɛkɛra me ɛkɛ, na meayɛ bɛ ayile.’ ”

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Pɔɔlo hanle ɛhye la, Dwuuma ne vale kpolerazulɛ kpole kpalɛ dwazole hɔle.]

english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo dɛnlanle sua mɔɔ ɔde nu na ɔdaye a ɔtua ye kakɛ la anu toonwo ɛvolɛ nwiɔ. Ɔliele menli mɔɔ rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne la amuala.

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: Ɔhanle Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ na ɔhilehilele menli ninyɛne mɔɔ fane Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo la, na awie biala andenda ɔ gyakɛ anu.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ mele Kelaese Gyisɛse akɛlɛ, na Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ me kɛ membanyɛ ɛzoanvolɛ na yeze me kɛ membɔ ye Edwɛkpa ne nolo la a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.

english_verse: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.
translation_verse: Nyamenle luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo vale Edwɛkpa ɛhye bɔle ɛwɔkɛ wɔ mɔmoane kpalɛ ne, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anu la.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: noko wɔ Nyamenle nu nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ nu a, bɛva tumi kpole bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu bɛhile kɛ ɔle Nyamenle Ara la anwo.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlo yɛ ɛmaa merayɛ ɛzoanvolɛ a, amaa menli kɔsɔɔti alie ye duma ne ali na bɛadie ye.

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛwɔ Wulomu la boka ɛhye anwo, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrayɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye mearɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo bɛ na yevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrayɛ ye menli na bɛwɔ Wulomu la amuala. Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Medumua mealua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo meayɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ti, ɔluakɛ bɛ diedi nganeɛ ɛdwu ewiade amra amuala anzo nu.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ medua ɔ Ra ne anwo Edwɛkɛ Kpalɛ ne nolobɔlɛ zo mefa me ahonle muala mesonle ye la di me daselɛ kɛ mɔɔ melɛka la le nɔhalɛ. Nyamenle ze kɛ dahuu mekakye bɛ

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu. Mesɛlɛ kɛ ɔlua ɔdaye Nyamenle ye ɛhulolɛ zo ɔmaa adenle ɔmaa membamkpɔla bɛ.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekulo kɛ mebakpɔla bɛ, amaa yɛanyia Nyamenle Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne na bɛ nwo ayɛ se.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ, saa yɛ muala yɛyia nu a bɛ diedi bamaa me anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ me diedi bamaa bɛ diedi anyi.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mekpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu mehyehyɛ kɛ anrɛɛ menwɔrakpɔla bɛ, amaa meahola meahakyi bɛ bie mɔ dɔɔnwo, kɛmɔ meyɛ ye wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo zo la, noko ɔyɛ a ɛnee debie fofolɛ ɛzi me aze.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mekulo kɛ meka Edwɛkpa ne mekile bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛwɔ Wulomu la a. Tumi wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anu

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Menze Edwɛkpa ne anwo nyiane. Ɔle Nyamenle tumi mɔɔ ɔfa ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la amuala a, mɔɔ lumua la a le bɛdabɛ Dwuuma yɛɛ akee bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne kɔdwu awieleɛ ne amuala, Nyamenle dua diedi zo a maa menli sɔ ɔ nye a. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mɔɔ bɛkɛlua ye diedi zo bɛkɛmaa ɔkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la banyia ngoane.” Sonla azedɔlɛ

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛhile bɛmaa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne vi anwuma bara bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmbu Nyamenle na bɛfa bɛ ngunziyɛlɛ bɛkeda nɔhalɛ ne azo la anwo zo.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Nyamenle badea bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛze mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonla nwu ye wɔ Nyamenle anwo la. Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔyele ɔhilele bɛ a.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Sumunli kɛ Nyamenle bɔle ewiade la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔye ye su kpalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nye ɛnnwu ye la wienyi yeahile sonla a. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ a le ye damɛnlangoate tumi ne nee ye nyamenleyɛlɛ ne. Menli nwu ɛhye wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ la anu. Yemɔti bɛnlɛ nyelebɛnloa fee!

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Bɛze Nyamenle, noko bɛnva enililɛ mɔɔ fɛta la bɛmmaa ye kɛ ɔle Nyamenle, yɛɛ bɛnva moyɛlɛ bɛmmaa ye. Adwenle mgbane mgbane yɛɛ bɛfa a, yɛɛ awozinli ɛyi bɛ adwenle ne mɔ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu la tetɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Bɛse bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ, noko bɛle ahɔnwɔne;

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: kɛ bɛkɛzonle damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne la, bɛsonle ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnwo, mɔɔ le kɛ sonla, nloma, nane anzɛɛ nwɔlɛ la.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menli ɛyɛ bɛ nwo ahɔnwɔne zɛhae la ati, Nyamenle ɛye bɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane ne mɔ, na ɔlua zolɛ mraalɛ fa mraalɛ na mrenya fa mrenya.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyile kɛ bɛkɛlie nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle anwo la bɛkɛli. Zɔhane ati bɛdie adalɛ ne bɛdi na bɛsonle ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ bɛ la, na bɛgyakyi Bɔvolɛ Nyamenle mumua ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha ye dahuu a. Amen.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menli yɛ nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ la ati, Nyamenle ɛgyakyi bɛ ɛmaa bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɛla ne. Bɔbɔ mraalɛ fa bɛ nwo gyakyi mrenya.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mrenya noko gyakyi mraalɛ na bɛmaa bɛ ti akunlu ba bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mrenya nwo zo na bɛfa bɛ a. Nzinlii bɛnyia bɛ ninyɛndane ɛhye mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ, bɛte ye bɛ nwonane nu kpalɛ kpalɛ kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menli kpole kɛ bɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle la ati, ɔgyakyile bɛ ɔmanle bɛ adwenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛkpɔlɔ la, amaa ɔlua zolɛ bɛyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ amumuyɛ, asiayɛ, anyebolo, ngunzi, nungule, kɔdiawu, konle, adalɛ nee nwondomgbɔ la ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ. Bɛye ndɛne,

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: bɛka bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane, bɛkyi Nyamenle, bɛtu bɛ nwo, bɛyɛ mgbanyizonle, bɛkile bɛ nwo, bɛboɔboa bɛdwenle ɛtane nwo bɛyɛ, yɛɛ bɛndie bɛ awovolɛma;

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: bɛle ahɔnwɔne, bɛnlɛ diedi, bɛnze ahunlunyele yɛɛ bɛ ti yɛ se kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Bɛze noko kɛ Nyamenle mɛla ne kile kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla zɛhae mɔ la fɛta ewule, noko bɛyɛ, yɛɛ bɛsi awie mɔ adua bɛmaa bɛyɛ bie.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ayi, wɔmɔ a ɛle nwane bɔbɔ a, ɛnlɛ adenle ɛmbua awie mɔ ndɛne hweledede. Saa ɛbua awie ndɛne wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo a, ɛnee ɛlɛbua ɛ nwo fɔlɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbua ndɛne ne la ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛbua ye ndɛne la yɛ la bie.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ saa Nyamenle tea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ zezɛhae ɛbɛla la a ɛnee ɔfɛta.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Na ayi, ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛyɛ nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɛbua awie mɔ nwolɛ fɔlɛ la bie. Ɛnee ɛdwenle kɛ ɛkɛvi nu wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anu ɔ?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ ɛmbu ye kpalɛyɛlɛ totohyia ne nee ye abotane ne bie ɔ? Ɛnze kɛ Nyamenle atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne, ɔlɛkile wɔ yeamaa wɔanlu ɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Noko bɛmɛ bɛ nzo yɛ se kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛsolo. Zɔhane ati bɛlɛmaa bɛ ndeanlɛ ayɛ kpole wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛya ne nee ye ndɛnebualɛ fɔɔnwo ne kɛdwu la.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle badua awie biala kakɛ, kɛmɔ ye gyima de la.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ, abotane nee kpalɛyɛlɛ ala a bɛli ɔ nzi a, na bɛkpondɛ anyunlunyia, enililɛ nee ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. Na bɛmɛ noko ala yɛɛ Nyamenle bamaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Bie mɔ noko le angomedi, bɛkpo mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la na bɛdi ɛtane nzi. Bɛ nwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle bawola ye ɛya kpole ne agua a.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ la amuala banwu amaneɛ nee abodelɛ, Dwuuma lumua yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la doa bɛ.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bava anyunlunyia, enililɛ nee anzonudwolɛ amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la, Dwuuma lumua yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la doa bɛ.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnlɛ Mosisi mɛla ne; yemɔti bɛyɛ ɛtane a bɛminli bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko tɛ mɛla ne abo ɔ. Dwuuma a lɛ mɛla ne a, yemɔti bɛyɛ ɛtane a bɛnea mɛla ne azo a bɛbua bɛ ndɛne a.

english_verse: God accepts those who obey his Law, but not those who simply hear it.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ tɛ mɛla ne ɛdielɛ a maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye a, kyesɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne se la.

english_verse: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned,
translation_verse: Bɛ nyɛleɛ ne kile kɛ mɔɔ Mosisi mɛla ne kpondɛ la, bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ ahonle nu, yɛɛ bɛ adwenle die to nu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ a bɛ adwenle nu yɛ bɛ kesee kɛ bɛbali fɔlɛ anzɛɛ bɛbali benle wɔ Kenle ne anu,

english_verse: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says. The Jews and the Law
translation_verse: kɛmɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la kile la. Na yemɔ a le kɛ, Nyamenle dua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne wɔ adwenle biala mɔɔ bɛfa ye fealera nu la anwo. Dwuuma nee Mosisi mɛla ne

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Na saa ɛfɛlɛ ɛ nwo Dwuunli, ɛgyi Mosisi mɛla ne azo, ɛfa Nyamenle ɛtu ɛ nwo,

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: ɛze mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ ɛyɛ la, yɛɛ wɔzukoa mɛla ne la ati, ɛze mɔɔ le kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la,

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: ɛze ye wienyi kɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle anyenzinliravolɛma adekilevolɛ a, ɛle kɛnlaneɛ ɛmaa menli mɔɔ lua awozinli nu la,

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: ɛle fotuvo ɛmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ la, ɛle ngakula kilehilevolɛ, ɛze ye wienyi kɛ mɛla ne ɛbuke wɔ adwenle nu ɛmaa wɔnwu nɔhalɛ ne,

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: ɛkilehile ɛ gɔnwo mɔ a, ɛnee duzu ati a ɛngilehile ɛ nwo ɛ? Ɛka kɛ, “Bɛmmawua”, na asoo ɛnle awule?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Ɛse, “Bɛmmato awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne”, na asoo ɛnva awuvolɛ? Ɛkyi amonle anzɛɛ bozonle, na asoo ɛngɔ amonle nu anzɛɛ bozonle zo ɛngɔnwua?

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Ɛtu ɛ nwo kɛ ɛlɛ mɛla ne, na asoo ɛntietia zolɛ, ɛngua Nyamenle anyunlu aze?

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛmɛ Dwuuma bɛ ti, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la tendɛ tia Nyamenle.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ ne le nvasoɛ, na saa bɛnli mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee noko anrɛɛ bɛanyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ bɔbɔ.

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati menli mɔɔ nwonane nu bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, noko bɛdi mɛla ne azo la babua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na bɛlɛ mɛla ne bɛ sa nu, na bɛtietia zolɛ la ndɛne.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Dwuunli kpalɛ ne a le sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum nu yeyɛ ye ahonle nu mrenyanu nzonlɛ na ɔnyɛ ye nwonane nu debie la. Sonla ɛhye nyia ye nganvolɛ fi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, ɔnnyia ye ɔnvi menli lɔ.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Asoo Dwuuma gyi boɛ tɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la? Anzɛɛ nvasoɛ bie wɔ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ zo ɔ?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, wɔ adenle biala azo! Ɔboalekɛ alumua ne, bɛmɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle vale ye ngilehilelɛ ne wulale bɛ sa nu a.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Na saa yera kɛ menli ne bie mɔ anli nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔnrɛli nɔhalɛ ɔ?

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Saa menli ɛnli nɔhalɛ bɔbɔ a Nyamenle bahɔ zolɛ ali nɔhalɛ dahuu. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkile wɔ bɛmaa ɛka nɔhalɛ; na bɛdi wɔ edwɛkɛ a wɔali benle.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Saa yɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ maa yɛnwu Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne wienyi a, ɛnee kɛ yɛse ɛ? Saa yɛyɛ ɛtane na Nyamenle tea yɛ a, ɛnee Nyamenle ɔdaye yeyɛ ɛtane ɔ?

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Ɔnle nɔhalɛ! Saa Nyamenle ɛnli pɛlepɛle a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛbua ewiade ndɛne ɛ?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Saa me adalɛ mɔɔ mele la kile maa Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne nee ye nɔhalɛ ne da ali wienyi a, ɛnee duzu ati yɛɛ bɛbua me fɔlɛ kɛ mele ɛtanenli ɛ?

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Duzu ati yɛɛ bɛnga kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛli ɛtane amaa kpalɛ ara ɛ?” Nɔhalɛ, ɛzonle mɔɔ menli ne bie mɔ ɛva ɛdo yɛ nwo zo la ɛne. Na bɛdabɛ bɛ munzule doa bɛ! Sonla biala ɛnle tenlenenli

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Saa ye zɛhae a, ɛnee yɛdayɛ Dwuuma yɛgyi boɛ yɛtɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Mehile nuhua dɛba kɛ Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala zo ɛtane.

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le tenlenenli a, Kyɛkyɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Biala ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo, biala ɛmkpondɛ Nyamenle abo zo.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛde Nyamenle anwo atua; biala ɛvo, yɛɛ biala ɛnli boɛ, kyɛkyɛ, ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Bɛ nloa deda nwolɛ kɛ sɛka mɔɔ ɛbubu, adalɛ yɛɛ vi bɛ nloa anu finde a. Bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ yɛ nla tɛla ɛwɔlɛ gye.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Amowa nee nzɛnvunli wɔ bɛ nloa anu.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔ la bɛtwehwe amaneɛnwunlɛ nee nyanelilɛ bɛmaa.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Bɛnze anzonudwolɛ adenle ne

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nu.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ, debie biala mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne anu la wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ mɛla ne abo la, amaa menli muala aha bɛ nloa ado nuhua kɛ bɛdi fɔlɛ wɔ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne anu.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ di Mosisi mɛla ne azo la ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle anye. Mɛla ne gyima a le kɛ, ɔmaa sonla nwu ye ɛtane mɔɔ yeyɛ la. Kɛ Nyamenle si maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, adenle mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zo maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la ɛrala ɛkɛ wienyi, yɛɛ ɔnvane mɛla ne anwo hweledede. Mɛla mumua ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma di ɛhye anwo daselɛ.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛnfɛta Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Ɔlua mgbɔdalɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛva ɔ nwo ɛli la azo, Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔkyɛ mgbane la maa menli muala sɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: na kɛkala ɔ nee menli di wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo, ɔfa ɔkile ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne. Nyamenle dua adenle ɛhye azo kile kɛ ɔle tenlenenli na ɔmaa awie biala mɔɔ die Gyisɛse di la sɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee duzu a yɛfa yɛtu yɛ nwo a? Yɛnlɛ ɛhwee! Na ɛnee akee duzu ati ɔ? Ɛnee yɛ gyima kpalɛ nwo anzɛɛ? Kyɛkyɛ. Na yɛdie yɛdi la ati ɔ.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛnwu kɛ sonla mɔɔ die Nyamenle di la yɛɛ Nyamenle maa ɔsɔ ɔ nye a, na tɛ mɔɔ di mɛla ne azo la ɔ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle le Dwuuma angome Nyamenle ɔ? Anzɛɛ ɔnle bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la Nyamenle ɔ? Kɛmɔti ɛ, ɔle bɛdabɛ noko bɛ Nyamenle!

english_verse: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.
translation_verse: Nyamenle le kokye yɛɛ ɔbalua diedi zo a yeamaa Dwuuma azɔ ɔ nye a; zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔbalua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko diedi zo yeamaa bɛazɔ ɔ nye a.

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: Na ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ yɛdua diedi zo yɛavuandi mɛla ne yɛagua ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Ɔnle zɔhane fee. Yɛdua yɛ diedi zo yɛkpogya mɛla ne zo.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Saa ye nyɛleɛ a manle ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye a, anrɛɛ ɛnee ɔlɛ debie ɔfa ɔtu ɔ nwo wɔ nwolɛ. Noko ɔngola ɔndu ɔ nwo wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ye diedi ne ati Nyamenle liele ye dole nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ yɛ gyima la bɛtua ye nwolɛ kakɛ, ye ahatualɛ ne ɛnle ahyɛlɛdeɛ, ɔle debie mɔɔ yehwi ɔ ti anwo a yenyia ye a.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɛnyɛ gyima na ɔdie Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bua ɛtanevolɛma benle la di la, ye diedi zo yɛɛ Nyamenle nea na ɔmaa ɔsɔ ɔ nye a.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Belemgbunli Devidi ka ye wɔ sonla ne mɔɔ saa ɛye ye gyimayɛlɛ ɛsie ahane a ɛnee Nyamenle die ye to nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli la anwo a. Ɔse:

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ Awulae ɛmbu ye ɛtane nwo mgbonda la!”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Devidi ka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la angome ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ. Ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ye diedi ti, Nyamenle liele ye dole nu kɛ ɔle tenlenenli.”

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Mekɛ boni anu a ɛhye zile a? Ɔzile na Ebileham ayɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ anzɛɛ ɔyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ kolaa na yeazi? Ɔzile kolaa na yeayɛ.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Nzinlii a Ebileham manle bɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ, ɔvale ɔyɛle sɛkɛlɛneɛ anzɛɛ nzonlɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛlua ye diedi zo ɛmaa yezɔ ɔ nye a. Yemɔti Sunsum nu a, ɛnee Ebileham le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi na yelie bɛ kɛ bɛsɔ ɔ nye, noko bɛtɛyɛle bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la bɛ ze.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Eza ɔle bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la ati ɔ, na bɛva ɔ gyakɛ na bɛ diedi le kɛ ɔdaye Ebileham ɛdeɛ ne kolaa na yeayɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ la bɛ ze. Bɛdua diedi zo a bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne a

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ kɛ azɛlɛ ne bayɛ ye nee ɔ bo zo amra ɛdeɛ. Nyamenle bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ɛhye, tɛ kɛ Ebileham lile mɛla ne azo la ati ɔ, na ɔliele Nyamenle ɔlile, na ɔlua zolɛ Nyamenle manle ɔzɔle ɔ nye.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ fane agyalilɛ nwo la wɔ ɛkɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo la angome a, ɛnee noko sonla diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anu la le mgbane, yɛɛ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne azo.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ bɔbɔ, yɛka Nyamenle ɛya; na ɛleka noko mɔɔ mɛla ɛnle la, menli ɛndo mɛla.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔkɛ ne gyi diedi zo, amaa yɛanyɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ yeammaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi Mosisi mɛla ne azo la angome, na yeayɛ ɛlolɛ mɔɔ ka Ebileham abo zo amra amuala mɔɔ lɛ diedi kɛ ɔdaye Ebileham la. Ɔluakɛ Ebileham le yɛ muala yɛ ze wɔ sunsum nu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Meyɛ wɔ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo bɛ ze.” Nyamenle ɛhye mɔɔ Ebileham liele ye lile la a bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ ne a. Nyamenle ɛhye a maa mɔɔ ɛwu la dwazo ba ngoane nu na ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ maa mɔɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ la ba a.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Ebileham liele Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne lile na ɔmanle ɔ nye lale zo ɛsesebɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee anyelazo ɛwie la, kɛ ɔbayɛ “maanle maanle bɛ ze.”

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: Ye diedi ne anga aze wɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo, na ye diedi ne manle ye anwosesebɛ na ɔyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Ɔliele ɔlile bɔkɔɔ kɛ Nyamenle kola yɛ mɔɔ yeha la maa ɔbo zolɛ.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ “bɛliele ye kɛ ɔle tenlenenli” ne, bɛangɛlɛ bɛammaa ɔ ngome kye.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛle bɛmanle yɛdayɛ noko mɔɔ yɛdie mɔɔ dwazole yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse vile ewule nu la yɛdi la.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Bɛyele Gyisɛse bɛmanle ɔwule wɔ yɛ ɛtane ti na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu, amaa bɛalie yɛ kɛ yɛsɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔlua diedi zo yɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la, yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛnyia yɛ ti wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse lua yɛ diedi zo ɛva yɛ ɛra Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnɛ yɛde nu la abo. Yemɔti yɛdi fɛlɛko anyelazo nu kɛ yɛbanyia Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Bɔbɔ wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu yɛbali fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ yɛze kɛ nyanelilɛ maa sonla nyia abotane,

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Anyelazo ɛhye ɛnye yɛ anrinli ɛndo yɛ sa nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ le Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne azo ɛva ye ɛhulolɛ ɛyi yɛ ahonle ne mɔ tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee moalɛ ɛwie bɔkɔɔ la, Kelaese wule manle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔhyehyɛle la anu.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ se kɛ awie kɛwu kɛmaa tenlenenli. Ɔyɛ a bie kɛhulo kɛ ɔkɛwu ɔkɛmaa sonlakpalɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: noko Nyamenle ɛhile kɛ ɔsi ɔkulo yɛ la, na yemɔ a le kɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee yɛtɛda nwo yɛtɛde ɛtaneyɛlɛma la, Kelaese wule manle yɛ!

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlua Kelaese ewule zo ɛmaa yɛzɔ ɔ nye; fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛlua Kelaese anwo zo ɔnrɛlie yɛ ɔnrɛvi ye ɛya ne anu ɛ?

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle Nyamenle kpɔvolɛma la, yelua ɔ Ra ne ewule zo ɔ nee yɛ ɛli ngamɔnu na yeyɛ yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛlua tease Kelaese ne ati ɔnrɛlie yɛ ngoane ɛ?

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Noko tɛ ɔ muala ɛ. Yɛdua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ Nyamenle anu, ɔluakɛ yeyɛ yɛ Nyamenle agɔnwo mɔ. Adam nee Kelaese

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛmɔ ɛtane luale sonla ko anwo zo a rale ewiade, na sonla ko ne ɛtane ne vale ewule rale la, yɛɛ ewule dele kpondenle aleɛabo amra anwo zo a, ɔluakɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Ɛtane rale ewiade kolaa na bɛava mɛla ne bɛamaa, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnee mɛla ɛnle ɛkɛ la, bɛmbu ɛtane nwo mgbonda bɛntia awie biala.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Noko ɔvi Adam anwo zo toonwo mɔɔ radwule Mosisi anwo zo la, ewule nyianle sonla nwo zo tumi, bɔbɔ menli mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛnle kɛ Adam mɛladonlɛ ɛdeɛ ne la. Adam le sonla ko ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔba la sɔhovolɛ.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Noko bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnle ko, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛnle kɛ Adam ɛtane ne la. Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ sonla ko ne ɛtane ti menli dɔɔnwo wule ɛdeɛ, noko Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua sonla ko ne, mɔɔ le Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ zo ɔfa ɔkyɛ mgbane la wɔ ɛkɛ maa menli somaa.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Ngakyile wɔ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne nee mɔɔ sonla ko ne ɛtane ne kola yɛ la anu. Ɔluakɛ sonla ko ne ɛtane ti yɛɛ Nyamenle buale sonla fɔlɛ a; na ɛtaneyɛlɛ somaa ne anzi, ye ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛbua yɛ benle.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Sonla ko ne, Adam ɛtane ti yɛɛ ɛtane luale ranyianle sonla nwo zo tumi a. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbalua sonla ko ne, Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bɛanyia ɛlolɛ ne molozo nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa mgbane la anwo bazo kpalɛ, na bɛalua ɔ nwo zo bɛali arelemgbunli wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ sonla ko mɛladonlɛ hwenle menli kɔsɔɔti hɔle ewule nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ sonla ko tenleneyɛlɛ babua menli kɔsɔɔti benle na yeamaa bɛ ngoane a.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ sonla ko anzosesebɛ ti menli muala yɛle ɛtanevolɛma la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔlua sonla ko anzomɛlɛkɛ zo menli somaa bazɔ Nyamenle anye a.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Bɛvale mɛla ne bɛrale ala la yɛɛ mɛladonlɛ liele ebia a; noko ɛleka mɔɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ ne zonle la, Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne yɛle dɔɔnwo bole zolɛ.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ ɛtane vale ewule a lile belemgbunli la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne fa kpalɛyɛlɛ di belemgbunli na ɔfa yɛ ɔdua Gyisɛse Kelaese, yɛ Awulae ne anwo zo ɔkɔ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu a.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Yɛhɔ zo yɛyɛ ɛtane amaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne azo ɔ?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ! Saa ɛtane maa yɛwu a, ɛnee kɛ yɛsi yɛtɛnla ɛtane nu bieko ɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔnenle yɛ bɛmanle Kelaese Gyisɛse la, ɛnee bɛzɔne yɛ bɛmaa ye ewule ne.

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛlua ɛzɔnenlɛ ne azo bɛziele yɛ bɛbokale ɔ nwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwule la, amaa kɛmɔ Selɛ ne vale anyunlunyia tumi ne dwazole ye vile ewule nu la, yɛdayɛ noko yɛabɔ yɛ ɛbɛla ne fofolɛ.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese a hɔle ewule nu a, ɛnee bɛbadwazo yɛdayɛ noko bɛavi ewule nu bɛara ngoane nu, kɛmɔ bɛdwazole ye la.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ yɛ su dɛba ne bɛhunle ye bɛbokale Kelaese anwo wɔ meanubaka ne azo, amaa bɛazɛkye yɛ su ɛtane ne tumi ne na yɛanyɛ ɛtane ngɛkɛlɛ bieko.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla wu a, ɛnee ɔnle ɛtane tumi bo bieko.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Saa yɛ nee Kelaese ɛwu a, ɛnee yɛdie yɛdi kɛ yɛ nee ye badɛnla ngoane nu.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ bɛdwazo Kelaese bɛvi ewule nu na ɔnrɛwu bieko; ewule ɛnlɛ ɔ nwo zo tumi bieko.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Ye ewule ne mɔɔ ɔwule la, ɔwule kokye ala ɔyele ɔ nwo wɔ ɛtane asa anu, na ngoane nu mɔɔ kɛkala ɔde la, ɔde ɔmaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛdwenle bɛmaa bɛ nwo kɛ bɛwu bɛvi ɛtane tumi ne abo, na ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛde aze bɛmaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔnle kɛ ɛtane nyia bɛ nwo zo tumi bieko na ɔmaa bɛdi ye atiakunluwɔzo nzi.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Eza ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ sonlabaka ne ɛleka biala bɛmaa ɛtane kɛ bɛva bɛyɛ ninyɛndane biala. Bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛye bɛ bɛvi ewule nu bɛra ngoane nu, na bɛdu bɛ nwo ɛleka biala bɛmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔva ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛtane yɛ bɛ menle bieko; bɛnle mɛla ne abo, bɛwɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo. Tenleneyɛlɛ nwo ngɛkɛlɛ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Duzu bieko? Ɛnee kɛmɔ yɛwɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne abo na yɛnle mɛla ne abo la ati, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ saa bɛbu bɛ nwo bɛmaa awie kɛ bɛsonle ye kɛ bɛle ahanra a, ɛnee bɛle ahanra bɛmaa ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la. Saa ɛtane a le bɛ menle a, bɛbanyia nwolɛ ewule, saa bɛtie Nyamenle noko a, bɛbalie bɛ bɛamaa bɛazɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo, ɔluakɛ mekɛ bie, ɛnee bɛle ahanra bɛmaa ɛtane, na kɛmɔ bɛvale bɛ ahonle muala bɛyɛle tieyɛ bɛmanle nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye wɔ ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye la anu la ati

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: bɛliele bɛ bɛvile ɛtane nu na bɛrayɛle ahanra bɛmanle tenleneyɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa menga edwɛkɛ ne sikalɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle so nu la. Kɛmɔ mekɛ bie bɛyɛle bɛ nwo ahanra bɛmanle ɛtane nee amumuyɛ na bɛyɛle ninyɛndane la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ahanra bɔkɔɔ bɛmaa tenleneyɛlɛ a, amaa bɛ nwo ade nwuanzaanwu.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛle ɛtane ahanra la, ɛnee bɛnle tenlenema.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Na duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ bɛnyianle ye wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛle na ɛnɛ bɛse nwolɛ nyiane la anwo a? Nyɛleɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ awieleɛ a le ewule!

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, bɛye bɛ bɛvi ɛtane nu na bɛrayɛ Nyamenle ahanra, bɛ nvasoɛ a le bɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛte nwolɛ na bɛadu bɛ nwo bɔkɔɔ bɛamaa ye, na ɔlua zo bɛanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛtane ahatualɛ a le ewule, na Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa mgbane la a le ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ wɔ yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ati.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Me mediema, melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ze mɛla deɛ holɛ a. Se bɛze kɛ mɛla kyekye sonla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde aze la?

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ, raalɛ mɔɔ wɔ agyalɛ la, mɛla kyekye ye beta ɔ hu anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu de ngoane nu la; na saa ɔ hu wu a, mɛla ɛnkyekye ye bieko.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu de aze la saa ɔkɔ nrenya gyɛne nwo a, ɛnee yedo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne; noko saa ɔ hu wu a, zɔhane mɛla ne ɛnkyekye ye bieko, yemɔti saa ɔkɔ agyalɛ fofolɛ a ɔndo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Mediema, kɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ ne de la ɛne. Kɛmɔ ɔlua Kelaese anwo zo yɛwu la, Mosisi mɛla ne ɛnlɛ yɛ nwo zo tumi bieko, na yɛle Kelaese mɔɔ bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu la ɛdeɛ, amaa yɛ nwo ara nvasoɛ amaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛde yɛmaa yɛ nwo la, yɛ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne mɔ manle mɛla ne dwazole yɛle gyima wɔ yɛ nu, na ɔlua zolɛ yɛ nwo rale nvasoɛ manle ewule.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Na kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnle mɛla ne tumi bo, na yɛwu yɛvi mɔɔ bɔle yɛ kpanwu la asa anu la, yɛnzonle kɛmɔ ɛnee yɛwɔ mɛla ne abo la. Yɛsonle wɔ adenle fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne kile la anu. Mɛla nee ɛtane

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Ɛnee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Kɛ mɛla ne le ɛtane ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane. Mɛla ne a manle menwunle kɛ ɛtane si de la a. Saa mɛla ne anga kɛ “Mmayɛ anyebolo” a, anrɛɛ menze kɛ bɛsi bɛyɛ anyebolo la.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Ɛtane nyianle adenle wɔ mɛla ne anu na ɔvale anyebolo ngakyile muala ɔluale ndenle ngakyile nu ɔwulale me nu. Ɛtane mumua ne, saa ɛye mɛla ne ɛsie ahane a, ɔle debie wulera.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛnee menze mɛla deɛ holɛ la ɛnee melɛ ngoane, na mɔɔ mɛla rale la, ɛtane dwazole gyinlanle,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: na menwule. Na mɛla ko ne ala mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛlɛ me ngoane la, rayɛle ewule manle me.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ɛtane nyianle adenle vale mɛla bɛlɛbɛlale me, na ɔluale zolɛ ɔhunle me.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Mosisi mɛla mumua ne le nwuanzanwuanza, yɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne le nwuanzanwuanza, ɔle kpalɛ, ɔtenrɛ.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Na ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ debie kpalɛ a hunle me la ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Ɛtane a hunle me a. Ɔvale kpalɛ ɔlile ɔ nyunlu ɔhunle me, amaa ye su dɛba ne avinde kɛ ɔle ɛtane. Yemɔti, bɛlua mɛla ne azo bɛhile kɛ ɛtane le kakadane kpalɛ kpalɛ. Sonla nu mgbeleralilɛ

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ mɛla ne le sunsum nu debie; mame, mele nwonane nu debie mɔɔ bɛdɔne me kɛ kanranli bɛmaa ɛtane a.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ meyɛ la mende ɔ bo, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ kɛ meyɛ la, mengola menyɛ, na meyɛ deɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Na saa meyɛ mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ meyɛ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ medie meto nu kɛ mɛla ne le kpalɛ.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Yemɔti tɛ me nye fuu yɛɛ meyɛ a, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ de me nu la a maa meyɛ a.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ kpalɛ biala ɛnle me sonlabaka ye anu. Ɔluakɛ me kunlu a anrɛɛ meyɛ kpalɛ, noko mengola menyɛ.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Mengola menyɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ mekulo kɛ meyɛ la, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la yɛɛ meyɛ a.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Na saa meyɛ mɔɔ mengulo kɛ meyɛ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ tɛ me nye fuu ɔ, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ de me nu la ɔ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛnee menwu kɛ mɛla ɛhye ɛlɛyɛ gyima wɔ me nu. Mɔɔ mekulo kɛ meyɛ kpalɛ la, ɛnee ɛtane ala a gyi me nye zo a.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Wɔ me nuhua a ɛnee me nye die Nyamenle mɛla ne anwo kpalɛ.
