english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Na menwu mɛla fofolɛ bie wɔ me sonlabaka ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ amuala anu. Mɛla ɛhye ko tia mɔɔ me adwenle kulo kɛ ɔyɛ la, na ɔmaa meyɛ kanranli memaa ɛtane mɛla ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ me sonlabaka ne anu la.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Me nwo yɛ anwunvɔne kpole! Na nwane a kɛlie me kɛvi nwonane ɛhye asa nu, mɔɔ ɔ nee me ɛlɛkɔ ewule nu a?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Melua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo meyɛ Nyamenle mo. Ɛhye yɛɛ megyi nwo a; mefa me adwenle muala medi Nyamenle mɛla ne azo mesonle ye, na me sonlabaka ye anu a, ɛnee meli ɛtane mɛla nzi.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse le ko la ɛnlɛ ndeanlɛ biala.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne mɛla ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔmaa yɛ ngoane la ɛye me ɛvi ɛtane nee ewule mɛla ne abo.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ nwonane ne bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ ti mɛla ne angola anyɛ la, Nyamenle ɛyɛ. Yemɔ a le kɛ, ɔzoanle ɔdaye ɔ Ra ne ɔmanle ɔvale sonla nwonane ɛtane ɛhye bie ɔrale na ɔradeanle ɛtane ne mɔɔ de sonla nu la.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye, amaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛde Nyamenle Sunsum ne anu na yɛnde nwonane nu la, mɛla ne ngyehyɛlɛ fɔɔnwo ne ali munli wɔ yɛ nu.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde nwonane nu la adwenle wɔ nwonane nu ninyɛne ɛyɛlɛ zo. Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛtɛnla kɛmɔ Sunsum ne kile bɛ la adwenle wɔ Sunsum nu nyɛleɛ zo.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Saa ɛmaa nwonane nu adwenleadwenle keda ɛ nwo zo a, ɔwie ewule; yɛɛ saa ɛmaa Sunsum nu adwenleadwenle keda ɛ nwo zo a, ɔwie ngoane nee anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mɔɔ maa nwonane nu adwenleadwenle keda ɔ nwo zo la le Nyamenle kpɔvolɛ; ɔluakɛ ɔnli Nyamenle mɛla ne azo, yɛɛ ɔdi zo bɔbɔ a ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ;

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛ sonlabaka ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi la ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛnde bɛmmaa bɛ sonlabaka ne, na saa Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu a, ɛnee noko bɛde bɛmaa Sunsum ne. Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ Kelaese Sunsum ne bie wɔ ye nu la ɛnle Kelaese ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Na saa Kelaese de bɛ nu a, ɛnee saa ɛtane ti bɛwu nwonane nu bɔbɔ a, Sunsum ne anu bɛlɛ ngoane, ɔboalekɛ bɛlie bɛ bɛmaa bɛzɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, me mediema, ɛzonle la yɛ nwo zo kɛ ɔnle kɛ yɛtɛnla yɛmaa yɛ sonlabaka ne.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛtɛnla bɛmaa bɛ sonlabaka ne a, bɛbawu; na saa bɛtɛnla bɛmaa Sunsum ne a, bɛbahu nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la, na bɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne yɛ bɛ tataa la le Nyamenle amra.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ɛnyɛ bɛ ahanra, na ɔmmaa bɛnyɛ avoanvoanle. Sunsum ne maa bɛyɛ Nyamenle amra, na ɔlua Sunsum ne tumi zo yɛkola yɛfɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ, “Egya! Me Papa.”

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee yɛ ɛdeɛ ne bɔ nu maa yɛkola yɛka kɛ yɛle Nyamenle amra.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Na saa yɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee yɛdi agya, yɛɛ ye ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛkɛ yemaa ɔ mra la yɛbanyia bie, na yɛ nee Kelaese ava mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa ye la, ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese di nyane a yɛ nee ye kɛnyia ye anyunlunyia ne. Kenlebie anyunlunyia

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Menea a amaneɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛnwu ye ɛke la kpole ɛnrɛdo kenlebie anyunlunyia mɔɔ yɛbanyia ye la.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ muala ɛlɛkendɛ anwolɔlɛ kpole nu kɛ Nyamenle kɛye ɔ mra kɛhile.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ abɔdeɛ muala mgbane mɔɔ ɛyɛ la, tɛ ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo ɔ, na Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ɔ. Noko anyelazo ɛhye wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛ

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: kenle ko dedee bɛbaye abɔdeɛ muala bɛavi ɛkpɔlɔlɛ akɛlɛzonlenlɛ nu na yeanyia anyunlunyia fanwodi ne mɔɔ Nyamenle amra lɛ ye la.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛze kɛ toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la abɔdeɛ muala ɛlɛte nyane kɛ asɛɛ yevo awolɛ zo.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Na tɛ abɔdeɛ ngome; yɛdayɛ noko mɔɔ yɛnyia Sunsum ne kɛ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ lumua la, yɛte nyane wɔ yɛ nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛkendɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛyɛ yɛ ɔ mra na ɔkɛlie yɛ sonlabaka ne la.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Anyelazo ɛhye azo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ bɛlie yɛ ngoane a. Na yemɔ a le kɛ, awie ɛmmaa ɔ nye ɛnla debie mɔɔ ɔ nye gyi nwolɛ la azo. Na nwane bɔbɔ yɛɛ kɛmaa ɔ nye kɛla debie mɔɔ ɔ nye gyi nwolɛ la azo a?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Saa yɛmaa yɛ nye da debie mɔɔ yɛ nye ɛngyi nwolɛ la azo a, yɛɛ yɛfa abotane yɛkendɛ ye ɛnyianlɛ a.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛmɔ yɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne baboa yɛ a. Ɔluakɛ yɛnze nzɛlɛlɛ yɛ, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la. Sunsum ne ɔdaye a ɔsɛlɛ Nyamenle ɔmaa yɛ wɔ nyanedelɛ nee ɛkponlenlɛ mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ ɛnrɛhola ye ka la anu a.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ neɛnlea menli kɔsɔɔti ahonle nu la ze sunsum nu adwenleadwenle biala kɛ si de la, ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne kpa ye menli ti kyɛlɛ, ɔsɛlɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne de la.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ wɔ debie biala anu, Nyamenle maa debie biala yɛ kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la, meka bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne de la.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la, yeva bɛ yezie ahane kɛ bɛbayɛ kɛ ɔ Ra ne la, amaa Ralɛ ne ayɛ mediema dɔɔnwo adiema kpanyinli.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la yɛɛ ɔfɛlɛ bɛ na ɔdielie bɛ ɔmaa bɛsɔ ɔ nye, na ɔ nee bɛ tɛnla anyunlunyia nu a. Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Saa ɔle zɛhae ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee akee kɛ yɛzi yɛha ye ɛ? Saa Nyamenle gyi yɛ nzi a nwane a kɛhola yɛ a?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Nea, yeanva ɔ Ra ne yeanyɛ yɛ abokɛ na yeva ye yebɔ azu wɔ yɛ muala yɛ ti! Na saa yeva ɔ Ra ne yemaa wɔ yɛ ti a, ɛnee fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee ɔnrɛva ninyɛne muala ɔnrɛboka ɔ Ra ne anwo ɔnrɛmaa yɛ a?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛdo Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ɛzonle a? Nyamenle ɔdaye yebua bɛ benle!

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛbua bɛ fɔlɛ a? Asoo Kelaese Gyisɛse, mɔɔ wule, na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu, na ɔde Nyamenle asa fema zo ɛlɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle amaa yɛ la ɔ?

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Nwane a kɛhola kɛhwe yɛ kɛvi Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne anwo a? Amaneɛnwunlɛ anzɛɛ anwongyelelɛ, kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛ anzɛɛ ɛhɔne, ehyia, anwubɛnyunlu anzɛɛ ewule?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti yɛgyi ewule avinli alehyenlɛ muala; na bɛyɛ yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Kyɛkyɛ, wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, yɛlua mɔɔ hulole yɛ la anwo zo yɛdi konim!

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze ye wienyi kɛ debie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛkpɔkye yɛ ɛnrɛvi Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne anwo; ewule o, ngoane o, Nyamenle soanvolɛma o, anzɛɛ awozinli nu tumivolɛma biala, wɔ ɛnɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bazi anzɛɛ kenlebie ɛdeɛ mɔɔ bara la anu,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: yɛɛ tumi anzɛɛ debie biala ɛnle ewiade ye anu, anwuma anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ti anu, anzɛɛ ewiade ye anu debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛkpɔkye yɛ kɛvi Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛnyia ye la anwo.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Kelaese ati nɔhalɛ kpalɛ a melɛka meahile bɛ la, membɔ adalɛ. Me adwenle nu wienyi, Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɔdaye ɔze kɛ membɔ adalɛ,

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɔze nyane mɔɔ melɛdi wɔ me ahonle nu

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: meamaa medame me mbusuafo Dwuuma la. Bɛ ti me kunlu a anrɛɛ Nyamenle ɛdua me kakɛ na yekpɔkye me yevi Kelaese anwo.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Bɛle Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le Nyamenle ɔdaye ye menli mɔɔ yeyɛ bɛ ɔ mra, yeye ye anyunlunyia yehile bɛ, ɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛ ngyekyeleɛ, na yeva ye mɛla yemaa bɛ a; bɛlɛ nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ ne; bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛ bo vi Hibulu abusua mgbole ne mɔ anu, yɛɛ Kelaese ne bayɛ sonla la, ɔvi bɛ nu. Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle mɔɔ di ɔ muala azo belemgbunli la dahuu. Amen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Na menga kɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛkpo aze, ɔboalekɛ tɛ Yizilayɛma amuala a Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ kɛ bɛle ye menli a;

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ tɛ ngakula mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ wɔ nwonane nu ngyehyɛlɛ zo la amuala a le Nyamenle amra a, na ngakula mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne ati bɛwole bɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ kɛ bɛle nlɔnra kpalɛ kpalɛ ne a.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne kɛ ɔbɔle ye la ɛne, “Saa mekɛ ne dwu a mebazia meara na Sɛla bawo ralɛ nrenya.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Tɛ ɔ muala noko ɛne. Ɔluakɛ Relebɛka amra mrenya nwiɔ ne bɛ ze a le yɛ nlenya Ayezeke.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Na amaa bɛ nuhua ko ɛvɛlɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne ali munli, kɛmɔ Nyamenle hyehyɛle la, Nyamenle zele Relebɛka kɛ, “Kpanyinli ne bazonle kakula ne.” Ɔhanle ɛhye kolaa na bɛawo bɛ, na bɛanwu kpalɛ anzɛɛ ɛtane; ɛhye kile kɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne gyi ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo na tɛ nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛle la ati ɔ.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mengulole Gyekɔbo, na memkpɔle Yisɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle ɔhilele Mosisi kɛ, “Mɔɔ mekulo kɛ mese ye anwunvɔne la yɛɛ mebaze ye anwunvɔne a, yɛɛ mɔɔ mekulo kɛ medi ɔ nwo nyane la, mebali ɔ nwo nyane.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛngyi mɔɔ sonla kpondɛ la, anzɛɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛyele ɔ nwo kɛ ɔyɛ la azo.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne zele Yigyibiti belemgbunli kɛ, “Menyɛle wɔ belemgbunli kɛ mefa wɔ meahile me tumi mɔɔ melɛ ye, na meamaa me duma adɛlɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Yemɔti, Nyamenle ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo ɔse bie anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔmaa bie noko yɛ anzosesebɛ. Nyamenle ɛya nee ye anwunvɔnezelɛ

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Bie babiza me kɛ, “Saa ɔle zɛhae a, ɛnee kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle tɛnwu nvonleɛ wɔ sonla nwo ɛ? Nwane yɛɛ kɛhola kɛzi Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne aze a?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Na ayi, ɛdawɔ bɔbɔ a le nwane na wɔayeye Nyamenle anloa azo? Buakɛ ɛngola ɛmbiza mɔɔ nwonle ye la kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛnwonle me zɛhae ɛ?”

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ a. Ɔkpondɛ kɛ ye ɛya ne nee ye tumi ne da ali wienyi. Yemɔti ɔsi abotane kpole kpalɛ ɔnea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ye ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo na ɔbazɛkye bɛ la.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Eza noko ɔkulo kɛ ye anyunlunyia ne da ɛkɛ, na ɔwola ɔgua yɛdayɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnwu yɛ anwunvɔne, na yeziezie yɛ kɛ yɛnyia ye anyunlunyia ne la anwo zo.

english_verse: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛmɛ yɛɛ yevɛlɛ yɛ yevi Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli a.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Hozia buluku ne anu la se: “Menli ne mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɛnle me menli la, mebavɛlɛ bɛ ‘Me menli’. Maanle ne mɔɔ meangulo ye la mebavɛlɛ ye ‘Me ɛhulolɛ maanle’.

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Na ɛleka mɔɔ bɛwɔ a bɛzele bɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛnle me menli’ la, ɛkɛ ne ko ne ala yɛɛ bɛbavɛlɛ bɛ tease Nyamenle ne amra a.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Ayezaya hanle ye wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo kɛ, “Saa Yizilayɛma zonle kɛ ɛnweazo anwea bɔbɔ a, ekyi bie yɛɛ bɛbalie bɛ ngoane a,

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Awulae babu ɔdaye nee ewiade ye bɛ avinli mgbonda ne fenlefenle ndɛndɛ.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Ayezaya hanle dole ɛkɛ ne bieko kɛ, “Saa Tumivolɛ Awulae angyakyi menli wɔ yɛ nzi a, yɛbayɛ kɛ Sodɔm nee Gomɔla la.” Pɔɔlo sɛlɛ amaa Yizilayɛma

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee kɛ yɛha yɛze ɛ? Yɛka ɛhye, kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, na bɛandwenle nwolɛ ɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la, ɛlua diedi zo ɛzɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nea, melɛfa bolɛ meado Zayɔn mɔɔ bamaa menli akpulokpula a, ɔbayɛ bodane mɔɔ bamaa bɛadu bɛagua a. Na mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la arɛle ɛnrɛbɔ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Me mediema, me kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛlie me menli ne kɔsɔɔti ngoane. Na ɛhye ati mefa me ahonle muala mesɛlɛ Nyamenle wɔ nwolɛ dahuu.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛgyakyi fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zolɛ maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la, na bɛpele bɛva bɛ ngome bɛ fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ɛdeɛ zo; bɛanva nɔhalɛ fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ adenle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle dua zolɛ maa menli sɔ ɔ nye la azo.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese rale la yɛɛ mɛla ne tumi bɔle aze a, amaa mɔɔ kɛlie kɛli la azɔ Nyamenle anye. Ngoanelielɛ wɔ ɛkɛ maa awie biala

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Wɔ mɛla ne azolilɛ nu, Mosisi hanle kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛyɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne kpondɛ la balua zolɛ anyia ngoane.

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua diedi zo bɛsɔ Nyamenle anye la, kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la ɛne, “Ɔnle kɛ ɛka ɛkile ɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhɔ nyamenlezo a?’ ”

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: “Anzɛɛ ɔnle kɛ ɛbiza kɛ, ‘Nwane a kɛdwu kɛhɔ ɛbolɔ maanle nu a?’ ”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔka la a le ɛhye, “Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛbikye bɛ, ɔla bɛ nloa na ɔwɔ bɛ ahonle nu,” na yemɔ a le diedi nwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ ye nolo yɛkile bɛ la.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ, saa bɛdie bɛto nu na bɛka ye bɛ nloa kɛ, “Gyisɛse le Awulae” na bɛdie bɛdi wɔ bɛ ahonle nu kɛ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile mɔwuamra anu a, bɛbanyia ngoane.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa sonla fa ye ahonle die di a yɛɛ ɔka ye diedi ne ɔ nloa na ɔnyia ngoane a.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Awie biala boka ɛhye anwo, ɔboalekɛ ngakyile biala ɛnle Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli. Nyamenle le bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ Awulae ko ne ala, na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ ye la.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ Awulae duma kɛzu kɛvɛlɛ ye la kɛnyia ngoane.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Na kɛ menli kɛyɛ na bɛazu bɛavɛlɛ ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie ye bɛnli la ɛ? Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛalie mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ la bɛali ɛ? Saa bɛannyia mɔɔ ka maa bɛtie noko la a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛade ɛ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛabɔ nolo ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛsoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔbɔ nolo la ɛ? Mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka ye wɔ nwolɛ la ɛne, “Soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ fa edwɛkɛ kpalɛ ne ara la ɛralɛ nu le kɛnlɛma na ɔyɛ nwanwane!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Noko tɛ bɛ muala a bɛlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛli a, ɔluakɛ Ayezaya hanle ye bɛ nwo kɛ, “Awulae, edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdele bɛvile yɛ ɛkɛ ne la, nwane a liele lile a?”

english_verse: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, saa yɛte edwɛkɛ ne a yɛɛ yɛnyia diedi a, yɛɛ edwɛkɛ ne a le Kelaese ne anwo Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ ne.

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Na mebiza kɛ, asoo ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛtɛtele Edwɛkpa ne? Bɛde ye bɔkɔɔ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛ ne ɛdwu ewiade muleɛ muala azo; bɛ edwɛkɛ ɛdwu azɛlɛ ye kodoka biala anu.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Eza mebiza bieko kɛ, ɛnee Yizilayɛma ande ɔ bo ɔ? Dumua tie mɔɔ Mosisi hanle la; ɔse, “Mebamaa bɛ nye abolo menli bie mɔɔ ɛnfɛta maanle bɔbɔ la; na mebalua kɔnwɔnema bie maanle zo meamaa bɛava ɛya.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ayezaya noko si ɔ kɛnra ka kɛ, “Menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛmkpondɛ me la ɛnwu me; meye me nwo mehile menli mɔɔ ɛmbiza me bo zo la.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ fane Yizilayɛma anwo la Ayezaya hanle kɛ, “Mendenrɛle me sa alehyenlɛ muala kɛ medie menli ne mɔɔ ɛde atua na bɛ nzo yɛ se la, na ɔyɛle mgbane.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee mebiza kɛ, se ɛnee Nyamenle ɛkpo ye menli ne o? Ɔnle zɔhane fee! Medame, mele Yizilayɛnli, Ebileham anlɔnra mɔɔ vi Bɛngyaman abusua nu.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛtɛkpole ye menli ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne amuala ɔkpale nu ɔyele bɛ la. Se bɛze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛleka mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛnee Yelaegya ɛlɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle atia Yizilayɛma la?

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Awulae, bɛhu wɔ kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala, na bɛbubu wɔ azukponle ne mɔ amuala; me ngomekye ala yɛɛ meha a, yɛɛ bɛ nye ɛbolo noko kɛ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Duzu bieko? Yizilayɛma annyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la. Menli ekyi bie mɔɔ Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ la a nyianle ye a. Mɔɔ hale la yɛle anzosesebɛ.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala noko ɔde a; ye ɛlolɛ ne ati, Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye menli ekyi bie ɛzie ɛkɛ.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Saa ɛlolɛ zo ala yɛɛ ɔlua a, ɛnee tɛ nyɛleɛ ti ɔ. Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle kpa nu aye sonla amaa ɔ nwo wɔ ahenle ne mɔdenlebɔ ti a, ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛnle ɛlolɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle manle bɛsolole ɔmanle ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala bɛ nye ɛnnwu debie, yɛɛ bɛ nzo ɛnde edwɛkɛ.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Devidi noko hanle kɛ, “Bɛ ɛkponledolɛ kɛbɔ bɛ ti tɔɔ, ɔkɛyɛ kuma nee ndeanlɛ ɔkɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee mebiza kɛ, mɔɔ Dwuuma dule koti la, se ɛnee bɛminli bɔkɔɔ? Ɔnle zɔ. Ɔlua bɛ ɛtane ti, ngoanelielɛ vi bɛ ɛkɛ ɛhɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛkɛ, amaa Dwuuma anye abolo bɛ.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Dwuuma ɛtane mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɛva nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo ɛra ewiade, na bɛ sunsum nu ehyia ɛlilɛ ɛva nyilalɛ ɛrɛlɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la. Yemɔti saa Dwuuma amuala baraboka nwo a anrɛɛ nyilalɛ ne bayɛ kpole kpalɛ! Menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la ngoanelielɛ

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Akee metendɛ meahile bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ mele ɛzoanvolɛ memaa bɛ la, me nye die me gyima nwo kpalɛ,

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: amaa meawula me gɔnwo mɔ Dwuuma anyebolo, na ɔlua zo bɛalie bie mɔ ngoane.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛkpole bɛ la ati dasanli rayɛle Nyamenle agɔnwo, na saa akee bɛdie bɛ bɛto nu a bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ bayɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛvi ewule nu bɛdwazo bɛra ngoane nu la.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa alumua kpanwo ebule ekyi ne bɛmaa Nyamenle a, ɛnee noko kpanwo kunguma ko ne amuala le ye ɛdeɛ; yɛɛ saa baka bie ndinli anwo te na bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle a ɔyɛ boɛ a, ɛnee ye ngane ne mɔ amuala noko anwo te.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Kɛkala ɛdeɛ Dwuuma le kɛ baka belɛ mɔɔ bɛpepɛ ye ngane ne mɔ bie bɛgua na bɛva bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle kɛ baka nyinli la ngane bɛrasisa zolɛ, kɛ bɛnyia nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ vi baka ne anu ba la bie.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, ɔnle kɛ bɛtu bɛ nwo bɛkile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛpɛ bɛ bɛgua kɛ baka ngane la. Duzu ati a bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo ɛ? Bɛle ngane ala; tɛ bɛmɛ a bɛsɔ ndinli ne a, ndinli ne a sɔ bɛ a.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Ɛbaha kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, noko bɛpepɛle ngane zɔhane mɔ bɛguale na bɛvale yɛ bɛsisiale zolɛ.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Ɔle nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ. Bɛpepɛle bɛ bɛguale, ɔluakɛ bɛanlie bɛanli, na bɛmɛ bɛlie bɛli yemɔti bɛgyi ye kpundii. Noko akee bɛmmafa bɛtu bɛ nwo; anrɛɛ bɛzulo Nyamenle.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle anvavi Dwuuma ne mɔɔ le kɛ baka ne ɔdaye ye ngane ne mɔ la a, ɛnee ɔnrɛvavi bɛdabɛ noko.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Ɛhye maa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle si se anwunvɔne na eza ɔ sa yɛ ɛnlomboɛ la. Ɔ sa yɛ ɛnlomboɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo aze la, noko saa bɛtɛnla ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne abo dahuu a, anrɛɛ ɔkɛze bɛ anwunvɔne. Na saa bɛanyɛ ye zɔhane a ɔbakpanekpane bɛdabɛ noko yeagua.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Saa Dwuuma gyakyi bɛ anzosesebɛyɛlɛ ne, na bɛdie bɛdi a bɛbava bɛ bɛazia bɛarazie bɛ bo zo ne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle lɛ tumi, ɔkola ɔyɛ ye zɔhane bieko.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛle kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu baka nyinli ngane mɔɔ bɛpepɛ bɛ na bɛva bɛ bɛsisia egyinli nu baka belɛ zo la. Dwuuma le kɛ egyinli nu baka belɛ; yemɔti ɔnyɛ se ɔmmaa Nyamenle kɛ ɔkɛva ngane ne mɔ mɔɔ yepepɛ yevi ɛkɛ ne la ɔkɛziezie bɛ bo zo ne mɔ. Nyamenle se awie biala anwunvɔne

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Me mediema, nɔhalɛ bie vea ɛkɛ mɔɔ mekulo kɛ bɛnwu ye a, amaa bɛagyakyi kɛ bɛkɛdwenle kɛ asɛɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ somaa. Yemɔ a le kɛ Yizilayɛma anzosesebɛ ne ɛnrɛhɔ zolɛ dahuu; saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la dodo mɔɔ ba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la nyia ba a, anzosesebɛ ne babɔ aze.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Na ɛhye bamaa Yizilayɛma amuala anyia ngoane, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la. Ɔse, “Ngoanedievolɛ ne vi Zayɔn bara, na yearaye amumuyɛ muala yeavi Gyekɔbo nlɔnra ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye a saa mefa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ mekyɛ bɛ a me nee bɛ bayɛ a.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Dwuuma kpole Edwɛkpa ne la ati, Nyamenle ɛyɛ kpɔvolɛ wɔ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ati. Noko kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la ati, bɛle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ wɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ ati.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛngakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ wɔ menli mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ na yeyila bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛkpole Nyamenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la, na ɛnɛ bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Dwuuma ɛyɛ anzosesebɛ.

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Dwuuma ɛyɛ Nyamenle anwo anzosesebɛ, amaa ɔlua bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anwunvɔne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛze bɛ la azo, yeaze bɛdabɛ Dwuuma anwunvɔne ne bie.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛyɛ anzosesebɛ, amaa yeanwu bɛ muala anwunvɔne. Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Nyamenle anwonyia le kpole. Ye nrɛlɛbɛ nee ye adwenle le kpole bo zolɛ. Nwane a kɛhola kɛde ye kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛbɔ la abo a?

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nwane a ze Awulae adwenle a? Nwane a kɛhola kɛdu ye folɛ a?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Nwane a ɛhola ɛhyɛ ye debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsie ɔ bo zo a?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye a ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, debie biala lua ɔ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa ye. Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle dahuu! Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati me mediema, Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ bebelebe ne mɔɔ ɔse yɛ la ati, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛva bɛ sonlabaka ne mɔ bɛbɔ azu mɔɔ anwo te na ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ la bɛmaa Nyamenle. Ɛhye a le sunsum nu ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛsonle ye a.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa ewiade amaamuo di bɛ adwenle. Bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛhakyi bɛ adwenle bɔkɔɔ, na bɛahola bɛanwu Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ le kpalɛ, ɔsɔ ɛnyelɛ, na ɔdi munli la.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Melua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yemaa me la azo mese bɛ muala kɛ bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo. Bɛdwenle kpalɛ na bɛbua bɛ nwo ndɛne ngoko wɔ diedi dodo mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la anu.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ sonlabaka lɛ ye nvɛyeba dɔɔnwo na nvɛyeba ko biala lɛ ye gyima mɔɔ ɔdi la,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa yɛzonle bɔbɔ a yɛ muala yɛbɔ nu a yɛle sonlabaka ko wɔ Kelaese anu, na yɛsosɔ yɛ nwo ngoko kɛ sonlabaka nvɛyeba ne mɔ sosɔ bɛ nwo la a.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa yɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo yɛnyia bɛ la yɛyɛ gyima. Saa yɛ bie mɔ ahyɛlɛdeɛ a le Nyamenle anloa azo ɛdendɛlɛ a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ ye zɔhane, kɛmɔ yɛ diedi ne de la.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Saa ɛzonlenlɛ nu noko a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsonle. Saa ngilehilelɛ nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkilehile.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Mɔɔ lɛ folɛdulɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ la ɛva ɛdu ɔ gɔnwo mɔ folɛ. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ asa dwu awie mɔ anwo zo la, ɛyeye ɔ kunlu ɛyɛ. Mɔɔ yɛ ahunlunyele gyima la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ ye anyelielɛ nu; yɛɛ mɔɔ lɛ moalɛ la ɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛboa.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ; bɛhyi mɔɔ le ɛtane la na bɛzɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la anu.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma, na bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛpele bɛbu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, bɛmmayɛ mgbovonle, na bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛzonle Nyamenle.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ anyelazo ɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie, bɛzi abotane wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu, na bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ sa ɛdwu mediema Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ ɛhyia la anwo zo, na bɛlie nyɛvolɛ wɔ bɛ azua nu.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle nyilalɛ bɛmaa menli mɔɔ yɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde la; ɛhɛe, bɛzɛlɛ nyilalɛ bɛmaa bɛ, bɛmmasɛlɛ ndeanlɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee mɔɔ di fɛlɛko la ɛli fɛlɛko na bɛ nee mɔ su la ɛzu.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ muala bɛ adwenle ɛyɛ ko. Bɛmmayɛ mgbanyizonle, bɛ nee ahoahweabane ɛdu. Bɛmmabu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Saa awie yɛ bɛ ɛtane a, bɛmmadi ye nzenralɛ. Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛyɛ mɔɔ awie biala nea a ɛnee nwolɛ te la.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, bɛmmafa ɛtane bɛtua ɛtane kakɛ ɛlɛ, bɛgyakyi debie biala anu bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛya ne. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nzenralɛ le me ɛdeɛ, mebadua ɛtane kakɛ, Awulae a se a.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, “Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku wɔ kpɔvolɛ a, maa ye aleɛ ɔli; saa nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye a, maa ye nzule ɔnlo; ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛnee ɛlɛkuohua senle samɛnlakɛ ɔ ti zo.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa ɛtane fo bɛ nwo zo; bɛva kpalɛyɛlɛ bɛli ɛtane nwo zo konim.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala bu mgbanyima mɔɔ ɛlɛbu maanle ne la, ɔboalekɛ tumi biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛnze nu a, yɛɛ mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ zo kɛkala la, Nyamenle a ɛva bɛ ɛzie ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ awie biala mɔɔ di boɛ la sulo menli mɔɔ maanlebulɛ ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la kyesɛ menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la ala. Bɛmkpondɛ kɛ bɛsulo sonla mɔɔ tumi wɔ ɔ sa nu la ɔ? Ɛnee bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ, na ɔkɛhanvo bɛ.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔle Nyamenle sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ye gyima wɔ bɛ kpalɛ ti a. Noko saa ɛdi ɛtane ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee sulo ye, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛ tumi, yɛɛ kɛmɔ ɔle sonvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ye Nyamenle gyima la, ɔkola ɔtea menli mɔɔ di ɛtane la.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtie na bɛyɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ tumi anzɛɛ maanlebulɛ ne wɔ bɛ sa nu la kɛze bɛ la, tɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛdea bɛ la ati ɔ, na bɛ adwenle nu te wienyi la ati ɔ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtua bɛ maanle adwule noko a, ɔluakɛ saa mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ di zɛhae gyima la yɛ bɛ gyima ne adenle kpalɛ zo a, ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ bɛ Nyamenle gyima.

english_verse: Pay all that you owe, whether it is taxes and fees or respect and honor. Love
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtua la, bɛdua; bɛdua bɛ maanle adwule ngakyile ne mɔ amuala, bɛbu mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛli bɛ muala eni. Gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa yɛ nwo ngoko la

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadi awie biala anwo ɛzonle, ɛzonle mɔɔ yɛdi la a le kɛ yɛkɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. Mɔɔ kulo ɔ gɔnwo dasanli la ɛli Mosisi mɛla ne azo ɛwie.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Mɛla ne mɔɔ se, “Mmafa awuvolɛ, mmayɛ kɔdiawu, mmawua, mmayɛ anyebolo” nee mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, bɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo la.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Saa ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ a, ɛnrɛyɛ ɛ gɔnwo ɛtane. Yemɔti ɛhulolɛ a sɔ Mosisi mɛla ne amuala anloa a.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfi nafelɛ nu bɛdwazo a. Ɔluakɛ ngoanelielɛ mekɛ ne ɛbikye ɛdɛla kɛmɔ yɛzuzule ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛlumuale yɛnyianle diedi ne la.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Aledwolɛ ne asɛɛ ɛze, alehyenlɛ ɛbikye; zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛgyakyi awozinli nu nyɛleɛ ne mɔ, na yɛva wienyi nu konle tɛladeɛ mɔɔ bamaa yɛahola ko la yɛwula.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛli yɛ nwo eni, na yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla kpalɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ alehyenlɛ nu la, mɔɔ anwondɛlɛ mgbane mgbane, nzabolɛ, adwɔmanebɔlɛ, anzɛɛ huhunli ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ, konle anzɛɛ nungule ɛhwenlɛ biala ɛnle nu a.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Na bɛva Awulae Kelaese bɛyɛ konle tɛladeɛ bɛwula, na bɛzi nwonane nu adwenle ɛvalɛ nee ye atiakunluwɔzo aze.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ye diedi le ekyi la, bɛlie ye wɔ bɛ avinli, noko bɛ nee ye mmasu ye adwenle nu nzuzulɛ biala anwo kpolera.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Bie diedi maa ɔdi debie biala, na mɔɔ ye diedi le ekyi la di nya nya nee mbakama ala.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ di debie biala la mmakpo mɔɔ ɛnli debie biala la, yɛɛ mɔɔ di nya nya nee mbakama ala la mmabua mɔɔ di debie biala la ndɛne, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlie ye ɛdo nu.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Na ɛdawɔ a le nwane mɔɔ ɛbua awie akɛlɛ ndɛne a? Saa ɔyɛ ye boɛ o, ɔnyɛ ye boɛ o, ɔ menle ala a kola ka a, yɛɛ ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa ye noko, ɔboalekɛ Awulae kola maa ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa ye.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Sonla ne bie adwenle a le kɛ kenle ne bie hyia tɛla kenle mɔɔ ɛha la amuala. Bie noko dwenle nwolɛ kɛ kenle ne amuala sɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ biala dwenle nwolɛ kpalɛ na ɔmaa ye adwenle si pi wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ dwenle nwolɛ sie kenle ko kɛ ɔhyia ɔtɛla kenle mɔɔ ɛha la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti; mɔɔ di debie biala la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti, ɔboalekɛ ɔyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ aleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔbali la anwo. Mɔɔ kpo kɛ ɔnrɛli debie biala la yɛ ye zɔhane wɔ Awulae anyunlunyia ti, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye noko ɔyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Yɛ nuhua ko biala ɛnde aze ɛmmaa ɔ nwo, yɛɛ yɛ biala ɛnwu ɛmmaa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa yɛde aze a, yɛde yɛmaa Awulae, yɛɛ saa yɛwu a, yɛwu yɛmaa Awulae. Yemɔti saa yɛde aze o, yɛwu o, yɛle Awulae ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛhye ati a Kelaese wule na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu a, amaa yeayɛ anyewɔzo amra nee mɔwuamra Awulae.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Saa ye zɔhane a ɛnee wɔmɔ, duzu ati a ɛkɛbua ɛ gɔnwo ndɛne a? Ɛdawɔ noko, duzu ati a ɛkɛtoto ɛ gɔnwo anwo nyɛlɛ ɛ? Yɛ muala yɛbagyinla Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ebia ne anyunlu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awulae se, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ mame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, awie biala babu ndwɛlɛ wɔ me nyunlu, yɛɛ menli muala bayeyɛ me kɛ mele Nyamenle.”

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛ nuhua ko biala babu ye mgbonda ahile Nyamenle. Mmamaa ɛ diema kpo aze

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛgyakyi yɛ gɔnwo mɔ ndɛne ɛbualɛ, na yɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ yɛnrɛyɛ debie biala mɔɔ kɛmaa adiema bie kɛhɔ ɛtane nu anzɛɛ kɛkpo aze a.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Sumunli kɛ me nee Awulae Gyisɛse lile ngamɔnu la menwu ye kɔsɔɔ kɛ aleɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnde a. Na saa awie dwenle kɛ bie anwo ɛnde a, ɛnee nwolɛ ɛnde ɛmmaa ɔdaye ɔ ngome,

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: yɛɛ saa ɛmaa aleɛ mɔɔ ɛdi la amaa ɛ gɔnwo ali nyane a ɛnee ɛngulo ye. Mmamaa wɔ aleɛ mɔɔ ɛdi la sɛkye sonla mɔɔ Kelaese ɛwu ɛlie ye ngoane la.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Mmamaa debie mɔɔ ɛdwenle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa wɔ la nyia duma ɛtane.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, tɛ yemɔ a le nlidi nlidi anzɛɛ nono nono, na yemɔ a le pɛlepɛlelilɛ, anzonudwolɛ nee anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne fa maa la.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ sonle Kelaese wɔ zɛhae adenle zo la yɛɛ Nyamenle anye die ɔ nwo na ɔsɔ menli nye a.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ɔwɔ kɛ kenle biala yɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ fa anzonudwolɛ ba na ɔboa yɛ nee yɛ gɔnwo mɔ na ɔmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ la.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Bɛmmatoa aleɛlilɛ bɛsɛkye Nyamenle gyima ne. Debie biala anwo te, noko ɔle ɛtane kɛ ɛkɛli debie mɔɔ kɛmaa ɛ gɔnwo kɛhɔ ɛtane nu la.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛgyakyi nane ɛlilɛ, nza ɛnlonlɛ, anzɛɛ debie mɔɔ bɛyɛ a ɔkɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo kɛkpo aze la ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Diedi biala mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛhye anwo la, maa ɔli ɛdawɔ nee wɔ Nyamenle bɛ avinli. Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔnea a ye adenle zo ɔ na nzinlii ɔnrɛli nwolɛ nyane la.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Na saa wɔ adwenle yɛ wɔ kesee wɔ debie mɔɔ ɛdi la anwo na ɛdi a, ɛbali fɔlɛ kɛ ɛlile a, ɔluakɛ wɔanlua diedi zo a ɛlile a. Debie biala mɔɔ ye ɛyɛlɛ ɛngyi diedi zo la le ɛtaneyɛlɛ.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛ diedi nu yɛ se la yɛboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ diedi nu ɛnyɛ se la wɔ bɛ debie biala anu. Ɔnle kɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye die yɛ ngome yɛ nwo ala.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ la a le kɛ yɛkɛmaa yɛ gɔnwo mɔ anye kɛlie bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ boɛlilɛ ti, amaa bɛ diedi anyi.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese andwenle ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Aholoba mɔɔ menli bɔle wɔ la ɛragua me nwo zo.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ maa yɛgyinla kpundii na ɔmaa yɛ akɛnrazilɛ la, ɛboa bɛ ɛmaa bɛ muala bɛdɛnla anloanzɛlɛ nu, na bɛva Kelaese Gyisɛse agyakɛ,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: amaa bɛ muala kɔsɔɔti bɛava ɛnelɛ ko bɛaye yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ ze Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛnyia Edwɛkpa ne

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛlie bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko wɔ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ti, kɛmɔ Kelaese liele bɛ la.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meka meahile bɛ kɛ Kelaese yɛle ɔ nwo sonvolɛ wɔ Dwuuma ati, vale hilele kɛ Nyamenle di nɔhalɛ, kɛ ɔkɛmaa ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle yɛ nlenya mɔ la kɛyɛ zɔhane,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: na yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la aye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ati. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Zɔhane ati mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la avinli. Mebado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne meayeyɛ wɔ”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Bieko, ɔse, “Maanle maanlema mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛ nee Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ɛli fɛlɛko.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Eza ɔse, “Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛye Awulae ayɛlɛ; menli kɔsɔɔti, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Ayezaya noko se, “Gyɛsi anlɔnra bie bavinde; ɔbara yearazie maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la kɔsɔɔti, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bava bɛ rɛle awula ye nu.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ le yɛ nzuzuguazo la ɛmaa bɛ anyelielɛ nee anzonudwolɛ wɔ bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ ye nu la ati, amaa bɛalua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne tumi zo bɛ anyelazo anyi. Pɔɔlo anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye ɔhɛlɛle la

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Me mediema, medame mumua ne medie meto nu kɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, yɛɛ bɛlɛ adwenle ne na bɛkola bɛkilehile bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Noko wɔ kɛlata ɛhye anu, mezi me kɛnra meha ninyɛne bie anwo edwɛkɛ mehakye bɛ adwenle wɔ nwolɛ. Menyɛle ye zɔhane, ɔlua gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva me ɛzie la ati,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: kɛ mele Kelaese Gyisɛse akɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ gyima wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la avinli. Mesonle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mebɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la nolo, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ayɛ azubɔdeɛ mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a ɛde nwolɛ na ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye la.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, Kelaese Gyisɛse ati, mekola mefa gyima mɔɔ meyɛ memaa me Nyamenle la metu me nwo.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menrɛha edwɛkɛ ngakyile biala kɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ Kelaese ɛlua me nwo zo ɛyɛ la ala, amaa mealie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la meamaa bɛayɛ tieyɛ bɛamaa Nyamenle. Mebaha mɔɔ Kelaese yɛle la wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ nee nyɛleɛ nu,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔyɛle, nee mɔɔ ɔvale Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi ɔyɛle la. Yemɔti wɔ me adendulɛ nu, ɔvi Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ badwu Yelelekɛm, meha na meva Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne amuala medo gua.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati mɔɔ mekpondɛ la a le kɛ menwɔva Edwɛkpa ne menwɔdo gua wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛtɛtele Kelaese nganeɛ ɛlɛ la, amaa meangɔnzɔ mɔɔ awie gyɛne ɛbɔ ɔ bo la azo.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanga ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛangile bɛ la banwu ye, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ la banyia ndelebɛbo.” Pɔɔlo bahɔ Wulomu

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati a mekɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la meannyia adenle meambamkpɔla bɛ la.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala mɔɔ akee mewie me gyima di wɔ maanzinli ɛhye mɔ anu, na eza ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la mehulo kɛ menwɔra bɛ nwo lɔ la ati,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: me nye la kɛ akee mebara. Saa mese meahɔ Sepeen a mebava bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne, amaa medi mekɛ ekyi wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ a, bɛaboa me bɛamaa meazɔ me adendulɛ ne azo.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea nee Akaya la ɛdwenle nwo ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛkeha bɛ sa aze bɛahɔboa ehyianvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle menli ne anu, wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔle bɛdabɛ bɛ ti anwo adwenle mɔɔ bɛvale ɛdeɛ, noko nɔhalɛ nu, bɛdi ɛzonle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛboa bɛ. Kɛmɔ Dwuuma ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la sunsum nu nyilalɛ ne bie la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la noko fa bɛ ɛbɛla nu nyilalɛ ne bie boa Dwuuma.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Saa mewie gyima ɛhye di na mefa mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la mekɔmaa bɛ mewie a, mebaraze meahɔ Sepeen, na mebava bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne mearakpɔla bɛ.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ saa menyia mebadwu bɛ nwo lɔ a, Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ ne bava Kelaese anu nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo arɛlɛ bɛ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Mediema, mesɛlɛ bɛ, ɔlua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ati, ɔ nee ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne la ati, bɛboa me wɔ me gyima ye ɛyɛlɛ nu na bɛzɛlɛ Nyamenle bɛmaa me.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛlie me kɛvi Dwudiyama ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la asa anu, na eza me gyima mɔɔ mekali ye wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la kɛzɔ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anye,

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: amaa saa ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a, meava anyelielɛ mearakpɔla bɛ. Medie medi kɛ meba a me nye balie.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla. Amen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Mekanvo adiema Fobi, mɔɔ le sonvolɛ raalɛ wɔ Sɛnkilia asɔne ne anu la meahile bɛ.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Bɛlie ye wɔ Awulae duma nu, kɛ bɛkɛlie Nyamenle menli ne mɔ bie ala la, na bɛmaa ye moalɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛhyia nwolɛ la, ɔluakɛ ɔle sonla mɔɔ yeboa menli dɔɔnwo nee medame noko a.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Mebiza Pelesela nee Akoyela mɔɔ le me mediema gyimayɛvoma wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzonlenlɛ ye anu la ahye.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Bɛvale bɛ ngoane bɛdole me ti nzeleba na bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo. Meyɛ bɛ mo somaa; na tɛ me ngome bɔbɔ o, menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma la asɔne ne mɔ amuala yɛ bɛ mo somaa.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Mebiza asɔnema mɔɔ dahuu yia nu wɔ bɛ sua nu ɛkɛ yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la noko ahye. Mebiza me gɔnwo kpalɛ Ɛpaenɛtɛse mɔɔ yemɔ a le sonla mɔɔ lumuale liele Kelaese lile wɔ Ehyea maanle ne anu la ahye.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Mebiza Mɛle mɔɔ ɔdaye noko yeyɛ gyima kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ nu wɔ lɔ la ahye.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo mɔ Dwuuma nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛguale yɛ muala efiade, mɔɔ le Andulonaekɛse nee Dwuniase, mebiza bɛ ahye, ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ ze bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛdoale Kelaese abo zo kolaa na meahakyi mearayɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebiza Ampeleatɛse ahye. Ɔle me gɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ Awulae ɛzonlenlɛ ye anu.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Mebiza Ɛbeenɛse mɔɔ yɛ muala a yɛyɛ Kelaese gyima ye la, nee Setakese mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔle me gɔnwo la ahye.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Mebiza Apɛlizi. Ye nɔhalɛlilɛ sɔ Kelaese anye. Mebiza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Alesetobulɛse abusua nu la amuala ahye.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebiza me busuanli Dwuunli Hilodeɔn nee mediema mɔɔ doa Kelaese abo zo na bɛwɔ Naasesɛse abusua nu la amuala ahye.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mebiza Telaefina nee Telaefosa mɔɔ boka Awulae gyima ye anwo la, yɛɛ me gɔnwo kpalɛ Pɛsese ahye. Pɛsese ɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ wɔ Awulae gyima ne anwo.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Mebiza Wulufɛse ahye. Ɔle sonla mɔɔ anwo ɛnla aze wɔ Awulae gyima ye anu a. Mebiza ɔ nli noko; ɔyɛle me kɛ ɔ ra la.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Mebiza Asenkeletɛse, Felɛgɔn, Hɛmɛse, Patulobase, Hɛmase, yɛɛ mediema Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ nee bɛ de la amuala ahye.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Mebiza Felɔlɔgɛse nee Dwulia, Niliyuso nee ɔ diema raalɛ ne, Ɔlempase yɛɛ Nyamenle menli mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la amuala ahye.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo atuu dahuu. Kelaese asɔnema ne amuala biza bɛ ahye somaa. Awieleɛ folɛdulɛ

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ bɛ, me mediema, bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ wɔ amaantoma mɔɔ sɛkye awie mɔ diedi na bɛtia ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛnyia ye la asa anu. Bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi menli zɔhane mɔ anwo.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ di zɛhae gyima la ɛnzonle yɛ Awulae Kelaese. Bɛsonle bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ala. Bɛfa bɛ nloa anu fɛlɛko nee ɛsoabɔlɛ bɛsɛkye menli mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la adwenle.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛde bɛ nganeɛ wɔ bɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anwo, yemɔti me nye die bɛ nwo kpole kpalɛ. Mekpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu nrɛlɛbɛ wɔ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la anwo na bɛkpɔlɔkpɔla bɛ sa anwo bɔkɔɔ bɛfi ɛtane nwo.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle, anzonudwolɛ maavolɛ ne, ɛnrɛhyɛ biala na yeabɛtɛ Seetan wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ gyakɛ abo. [Yɛ Awulae ɛlolɛ ne nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.]

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo gyimayɛvolɛ Temɔte biza bɛ muala ahye. Luseɛse, Gyeesen, yɛɛ Sosepatɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛle Dwuuma la se bɛbiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Medame Tɛhyeɛse, mɔɔ hɛlɛle kɛlata ɛhye la, melua Awulae duma nu mebiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlua ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ zo ɛvɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔrayɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ, nee yɛ diema Sɔsetinɛse a

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a. Yɛlɛ yɛkamaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlente, mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛdu bɛ bɛzie ɛkɛ ne, na bɛvɛlɛ bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ɛleka muala, mɔɔ bɛbɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma la, kɛ bɛrayɛ Nyamenle menli la.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Yɛ Ze Nyamenle nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ! Kelaese anu nyilalɛ

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Dahuu meyɛ me Nyamenle ne mo memaa bɛ kɛ yelua Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo yelo bɛ a.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ ne ɛwie nyi wɔ bɛ nu dɛba,

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: yemɔti bɛngyia ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala anwo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛralɛ bieko mɔɔ ɔbara la.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Kelaese ɔdaye ɔbamaa bɛagyinla kpundii bɛahɔ awieleɛ, amaa bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ debie biala anu wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese Kenle ne.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula Nyamenle ne mɔɔ vɛlɛle bɛ kɛ bɛ nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse Kelaese, yɛ Awulae ɛradila agɔnwolɛ la anu. Mgbakyemgbakye wɔ Asɔne ne anu

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Mediema, melɛ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma ne mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ muala bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo; bɛmmamaa mgbakyemgbakye biala bada bɛ avinli. Bɛhye bɛ nwo file wɔ adwenle nu nee bɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Melɛka ɛhye, ɔluakɛ me mediema Kuloyi sua nu amra bie mɔ ɛraha ɛhile me kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛpɛ bɛ nwo bɛdi butule.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ asolo bɛ nuhua ko biala nee ye edwɛkɛ. Mɔɔ ko se “Mewɔ Pɔɔlo afoa la”, ɛnee bie se, “Mewɔ Apɔlɔso afoa.” Bie se, “Mewɔ Pita afoa,” ɛnee bie noko se, “Mewɔ Kelaese afoa.”

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛ Kelaese anu ekpunli ekpunli ɔ? Na mebiza bɛ kɛ, Pɔɔlo a bɛbɔle ye meanubaka nu bɛmanle bɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛzɔnenle bɛ kɛ bɛle Pɔɔlo ɛdoavolɛma ɔ?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Meyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ meanzɔne bɛ nuhua biala kyesɛ Kelesepɛse nee Gayɛse ala.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Yemɔti awie biala ɛnga kɛ bɛzɔnenle ye kɛ ɔle me ɛdoavolɛ.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Mekakye noko kɛ medame a menzɔnenle Setɛfanase nee ye sua nu amra a, na mengola mengakye kɛ menzɔnenle awie bieko.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kelaese anzoa me kɛ membanzɔne menli. Ɔzoanle me kɛ memambɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, na memmafa sonla nrɛlɛbɛ meka, anrɛɛ tumi ne mɔɔ wɔ Kelaese meanubaka ne anwo edwɛkɛ ne anu la kɛyɛ mgbane. Kelaese a le Nyamenle tumi nee nrɛlɛbɛ ne a

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese meanubaka ne azo ewule ne anwo edwɛkɛ le debie funli maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛminli la; noko ɔle Nyamenle tumi ɔmaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlɛdie yɛ ngoane la.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mebaminliminli nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nrɛlɛbɛ ne abo zo, na meamaa adwenlema ndelebɛbo ayɛ mgbane.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma hale nienwu? Nienwu a mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne hale a? Anzɛɛ mekɛ ɛhye anu kpolerazulɛ benlerama ne mɔ hale nienwu? Asoo Nyamenle ɛtɛkilele kɛ ewiade anu nrɛlɛbɛ le debie mgbane?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle luale ye nrɛlɛbɛ zo zile menli adenle, yeammaa bɛanlua bɛdabɛ bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ zo bɛannwu ye. Mɔɔ ɔyɛle la a le kɛ, Nyamenle luale mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛse ɔle “koasea” edwɛkɛ yɛɛ yɛlɛbɔ ye nolo la azo bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la ngoane.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Dwuuma kpondɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ si edwɛkɛ ne dawua la, yɛɛ Gilikima kpondɛ nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ, yɛbɔ Kelaese meanubaka ne azo ewule ne mɔɔ maa Dwuuma tu koti na ɔle ɛzɛlɛ edwɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nolo;

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la, Dwuuma o, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la o, Kelaese a le Nyamenle tumi ne yɛɛ ɔdaye ko ne ala a ɔle Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne a.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nu koasea edwɛkɛ tɛla menli nrɛlɛbɛ, yɛɛ Nyamenle nu bɛtɛɛ ɛyɛlɛ yɛ se tɛla sonla anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Mediema, akee bɛhakye kɛ anrɛɛ bɛsi bɛde mɔɔ Nyamenle vɛlɛle bɛ la. Saa sonla afoa nu a anrɛɛ bɛ nuhua ekyi bie ala a ze nrɛlɛbɛ, lɛ tumi anzɛɛ le mandimase a.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anye la nwo yɛɛ ɔkpale nu ɔyele deɛ mɔɔ ewiade bu ye ɛzɛlɛ debie la kɛ ɔfa yeamaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma anyunlu agua aze a, yɛɛ ɔkpale nu ɔyele deɛ mɔɔ ewiade bu ye kɛ ɔle bɛtɛɛ na bɛmbu ye bie la kɛ ɔfa yeagua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ tumi la anyunlu aze a.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpale nu yele deɛ mɔɔ ewiade nea a ɔmbu ye bie na ɔfa ye kɛ ɔnle debie biala la kɛ ɔfa yeazɛkye deɛ mɔɔ ewiade dwenle kɛ ɔ nwo hyia la.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye amaa dasanli biala angola ammemaa ɔ nwo zo wɔ ɔ nyunlu.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛva bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛbɔ nu, na yemaa Kelaese ɛrayɛ yɛ nrɛlɛbɛ. Ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ yɛlua a yɛsɔ Nyamenle anye, yɛ nwo te na yɛyɛ alehelɛ a.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la, “Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo la ɛva mɔɔ Awulae ɛyɛ la ɛmemaa ɔ nwo zo.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mekɛ mɔɔ membale bɛ nwo lɔ kɛ mebabɔ Nyamenle nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vea la nolo meahile bɛ la, meanga ye kɛ mele sonla mɔɔ me nloa ɛde na meze nrɛlɛbɛ kpole la.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ membɔle me ti anu kpɔkɛ kɛ me rɛle kɛvi debie biala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ de la na ɔkɛha Gyisɛse Kelaese angome nee ye meanubaka ne azo ewule ne ala,

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menvale bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ, ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ kpalɛ a me nee bɛ dɛnlanle a;

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: yɛɛ meanva sonla nrɛlɛbɛ nee anloanu kolokolo a mengilehilele bɛ, membɔle edwɛkɛ ne nolo a; menluale Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi zo,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: amaa bɛ diedi ne agyinla Nyamenle tumi ne azo na yeangyinla sonla nrɛlɛbɛ zo. Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
