translation_verse: Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ yɛbɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nwo nolo yɛkile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyi sunsum nu la. Tɛ ewiade ɛhye anu nrɛlɛbɛ ɛdeɛ ne anwo nolo ɔ, yɛɛ tɛ ewiade tumivolɛma mɔɔ bɛ tumililɛ ne ɛnrɛhyɛ na yeavi bɛ sa la nrɛlɛbɛ ɛdeɛ ne anwo nolo ɔ.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ ye nolo la le Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ vea na menli ɛnze a. Nyamenle vale ziele yɛ ɛkɛ dɛba kolaa na yeabɔ ewiade ye kɛ ɔbava yeade yɛ nyunlu.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ ɛhye, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ewiade la annwu ye, ɔluakɛ saa bɛnwunle ye a, anrɛɛ bɛambɔ anyunlunyia Awulae ne meanubaka nu.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Debie mɔɔ sonla ɛtɛnwunle ye anzɛɛ ɛtɛtele ɛlɛ, debie mɔɔ sonla andwenle kɛ ɔkɛzi ɛlɛ la, yemɔ a le deɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛziezie ɛdo ɛkɛ ne ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la a.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Yɛmɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛlua ye Sunsum ne azo ɛye fealeranu debie zɛhae ɛhile yɛ a, ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne fedevede ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti anu, bɔbɔ kɛ Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne kuma ne kuloonwu si de la.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛnze sonla adwenle kyesɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ye sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ ye nu la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne angome ala a ze Nyamenle adwenle nu a.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Tɛ ewiade ɛhye anu sunsum a yɛnyia ye a. Sunsum ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la a yɛnyia ye a, amaa yɛanwu ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo yɛ la amuala.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mɔɔ yɛka la ɛnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sonla nrɛlɛbɛ a kilehile yɛ a. Nyamenle Sunsum ne kilehile yɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛha kɛ yɛkilehile sunsum nu nɔhalɛ ne yɛahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu la.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛnle ye nu la ɛngola ɛnnyia Nyamenle Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ. Sonla zɛhae ɛnde ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ abo; bɛle ɔ nye zo ɛzɛlɛ edwɛkɛ, ɔboalekɛ kyesɛ sunsum nu ala na bɛade ɔ bo.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ ye nu la kola neɛnlea debie biala anu, na yemɔ awie biala ɛngola ɛnneɛnlea ye nu.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nwane a ze Nyamenle ati anu a? Nwane a kola tu ye folɛ a?” Noko yɛmɛ, yɛlɛ Kelaese adwenle ne bie.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Mediema, edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ, meangola meandendɛ meangile bɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnyia Nyamenle Sunsum ne la; mendendɛle mengilele bɛ kɛ ewiade ɛhye anu amra, kɛ bɛle mbɛda wɔ Kelaese diedi ne anu.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Menvale nyɛfonzule a menlile bɛ adane a, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛtɛdwule mɔɔ bɛkposa aleɛ a; yɛɛ kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛtɛdwule,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛtɛgua zolɛ bɛtɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ ewiade ɛhye anu amra la. Asoo mɔɔ nungule ɛhwenlɛ nee butulelilɛ ɛnzea bɛ adenle la, ɛnee ɛhye ɛngile kɛ bɛ nee ewiade ɛhye anu amra bɔ bɛ ɛbɛla ko?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nuhua ko ɛlɛka kɛ, “Mewɔ Pɔɔlo afoa,” na bie noko se, “Mewɔ Apɔlɔso afoa” la, ɛnee bɛmbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ ewiade amra la ɔ?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Na Apɔlɔso bɔbɔ a le nwane? Pɔɔlo noko a le nwane? Yɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma ala mɔɔ bɛluale yɛ nwo zo bɛliele Edwɛkpa ne bɛlile a. Yɛ nuhua ko biala yɛ ye gyima mɔɔ Awulae vale manle ye kɛ ɔyɛ la.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Menluale ma ne yɛɛ Apɔlɔso guguale zolɛ nzule, na Nyamenle a manle ɔnyinle a.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ dua nee mɔɔ gugua zolɛ nzule la anwo ɛngyia dɔɔnwo. Nyamenle a anwo hyia a, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔmaa baka ne nyi a.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Ngakyile ɛnle mɔɔ dua nee mɔɔ gugua zolɛ nzule la avinli. Nyamenle badua ko biala kakɛ wɔ ye gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛle Nyamenle egyinli nu gyimayɛvoma yɛɛ bɛmɛ a bɛle egyinli ne a. Eza bɛle Nyamenle sua.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Menvale ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo me la mendole sua ne abo kɛ suasivolɛ kpalɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛlɛto zolɛ a. Na ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala nea kɛ ɔsi ɔto zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Na kɛ awie biala gyima si de la bala ali wienyi wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Kelaese bara la. Kenle zɔhane senle ne bamaa awie biala gyima ala ali; senle ne bazɔ awie biala gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la anlea na yeaye ye kɛ ɔde la yeahile.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Na saa senle ne yela sua ne a, ɛnee ahenle mɔɔ zile la ɛminli debie, noko Nyamenle balie ɔdaye mumua ne ngoane kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛlie ye bɛvi senle nu la.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Bɛnze kɛ bɛle Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua na Nyamenle Sunsum ne de bɛ nu ɔ?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Saa awie sɛkye Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne a, Nyamenle bazɛkye ɔdaye noko, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo te, na sua zɔhane, yemɔ a le ɛdawɔ.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Awie biala mmabɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo. Saa bɛ nuhua bie dwenle kɛ ɔle ewiade ɛhye anu nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ a, ɛnee ɔyɛ ɔ nwo kɔnwɔne na yeanwu nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ewiade ye anu nrɛlɛbɛ le ɛzɛlɛ debie wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle dua nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma agyibadolɛ zo kye bɛ;”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: yɛɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne bieko ka kɛ, “Awulae ze kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma adwenle ɛvalɛ biala le mgbane.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo o, Apɔlɔso o, Sifase o, ewiade ye o, ngoane o, ewule o, ɛnɛ mekɛ ye o, kenlebie o, ɔ muala le bɛ ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ Kelaese le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu yɛ kɛ Kelaese sonvolɛma mɔɔ nea Nyamenle gyima ne mɔɔ vea la azo a.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Debie ko mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ sonvolɛ zɛhae yɛ la a le kɛ ɔkɛli nɔhalɛ ɔkɛmaa ɔ menle ne.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Mame, ɔnvane me nwo kɛ saa bɛmɛ o, anzɛɛ awie biala kɛbua me ndɛne. Medame bɔbɔ membua me nwo ndɛne.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Me ti anu wienyi; debie biala ɛntia me, noko ɛhye ɛngile kɛ amgba medi benle. Awulae angome a bua me ndɛne a.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmmabua awie biala ndɛne kɔkpula Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae kɛra bieko la. Awieleɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne wɔ Awulae asa anu, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaraye ninyɛne mɔɔ vea awozinli nu nee ahonle nu nzuzulɛ muala yeavinde wienyi nu a. Zɔhane mekɛ ne awie biala asa baha ye moyɛlɛ mɔɔ fɛta la avi Nyamenle ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Me mediema, ɔlua bɛ ti yɛɛ meva Apɔlɔso nee medame mumua ne medo edwɛkɛ nwo meha a, amaa bɛazukoa yɛ na bɛanyɛ bɛammaa yeandɛla mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛ nuhua biala mmafa awie ko pɛ ɔ gɔnwo anye zo.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Nwane a zele bɛ kɛ bɛle kpalɛ bɛtɛla bɛ gɔnwo mɔ a? Tɛ Nyamenle a manle bɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la amuala ɔ? Saa ɔle zɔhane a, ɛnee duzu ati a bie kɛmemaa ɔ nwo zo kɛ asɛɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛnle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛ?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Bɛ sa ɛdɔ bɛ kunlu! Bɛnyia bɛ nwo bɛwie! Bɛhoane yɛ nwo bɛyɛ arelemgbunli! Me kunlu bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ bɛle arelemgbunli amgba, amaa yɛ nee bɛ ali bɛ mbia ne mɔ.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ me kɛ Nyamenle ɛva yɛmɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ɛzie ɛkɛ, kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛbu bɛ ewule fɔlɛ na nzinlii bɛbahu bɛ bagua nu bɛahile ɛtane ewiade ye, anwuma soanvolɛma nee menli muala la.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Kelaese ati yɛyɛ ahɔnwɔne; na bɛmɛ, bɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma. Yɛle bɛtɛɛ na bɛmɛ, bɛ nwo yɛ se. Menli ɛmbu yɛ, noko bɛdi bɛmɛ eni.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne tɛku yɛ; yɛ adɛladeɛ ɛtete yɛ nwo, bɛbila yɛ mbaka, yɛnlɛ awuke, mgbɔsa mgbɔsa a ɛdɔ yɛ nwo a;

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, yɛɛ yɛpe na yɛali. Bɛwa yɛ amonle a, yɛyila bɛ; bɛyɛ yɛ kpɔdekpɔde a, yɛkponle zolɛ.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ yɛ aholoba a, yɛtendɛ kpalɛ yɛkile bɛ. Yɛyɛ ewula wɔ ewiade ye anu; ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala yɛle ewiade amra fovolɛ.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Mengɛlɛ ɛhye kɛ megua bɛ nyunlu aze; mefa meadu bɛ folɛ kɛ bɛle me mra mɔɔ mekulo bɛ edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Saa Kelaese ati bɛlɛ adanedivolɛma apenle bulu bɔbɔ a, bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛ ze kokye. Ɔlua Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ menvale membɛlɛle bɛ la ati, merayɛ bɛ ze wɔ Kelaese ati.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛva me gyakɛ.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ala ati a melɛsoa Temɔte, mɔɔ le me ra mɔɔ mekulo ye, na Awulae ati ɔdi nɔhalɛ la wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a. Ɔbahakyehakye bɛ ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ fofolɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ Kelaese ati melua nu melɛkilehile asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka biala la.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua bie mɔ ɛlɛtu bɛ nloa anu na bɛdwenle kɛ menrɛra lɔ bieko.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Saa ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a ɔnrɛhyɛ, mebara bɛ nwo lɔ na mearavedevede nu meanlea tumi mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtu bɛ nloa anu la lɛ la, na tɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkeha la ɔ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛngyi ɛdendɛlɛ zo, ɔgyi tumi zo.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Boni a bɛkulo a? Saa melɛba a menva empele membɛla anzɛɛ menva sunsum nu ɛhulolɛ nee bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ membɛla?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Kɛkala menli ɛraha kɛ bɛlɛbɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla bie mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle bɔbɔ la ɛnrɛbɔ a. Mede kɛ kpavolɛ bie ɛva ɔ ze aye.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ɛnyɛ bɛ nyiane bɔbɔ? Bɛli nwolɛ nyane na bɛye sonla zɔhane mɔɔ ɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye la wɔ bɛ avinli.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: bɛye sonla ɛhye bɛwula Seetan asa anu amaa ye nwonane ne azɛkye na ye ɛkɛla anyia ngoane wɔ Awulae Kenle ne.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Bɛ adubɛnwo ye ka bie! Bɛnze kɛ, “Fɛlɛ ko dɔ sonlɛ na ɔla fɛlɛ dɔɔnwo avinli a ɔsɛkye bɛ muala.”

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Bɛye fɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɔ azonlɛ la wɔ bɛ avinli na bɛ nwo ade saanwu, amaa bɛayɛ menli fofolɛ mɔɔ evinli biala ɛnle bɛ nwo a, kɛmɔ meze ye wienyi kɛ amgba bɛde la. Ɔluakɛ kɛkala mɔɔ bɛhu Kelaese, yɛ Akpabɛnwo boaneralɛ ne bɛbɔ azu la,

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: bɛmmamaa yɛfa yɛ ɛtane nee yɛ amumuyɛ subane nvinli ne yɛdi Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia ne, na yɛva atiakunlu wienyi nee nɔhalɛlilɛ yɛli.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Menganle ye wɔ me kɛlata ne anu kɛ bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane la mmatu.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Meanga meammaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane mɔɔ le kɛ anyebolo anzɛɛ awule na eza bɛsonle awozonle la; ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛkahola bɛade bɛ nwo bɛavi ewiade amra ɛhye mɔ anwo bɔkɔɔ la ɛnee kyesɛ bɛfi ewiade ye anu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ, bɛ nee awie biala mɔɔ fɛlɛ ɔ nwo Keleseɛnenli na ɔbɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane, ɔle anyebolo, ɔsonle awozonle, ɔ nloa ɛdendɛlɛ ɛnyɛ fɛ, ɔle nzanli anzɛɛ ɔle awule la mmatu. Bɛ nee sonla zɛhae mmatɛnla ɛkponle nwo bɔbɔ di debie.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Duzu ati bɔbɔ yɛɛ saa bɛ nuhua bie nee ɔ diema nyia edwɛkɛ a ɛnee ɔkɛva ye ɔkɛhɔ kɔɔto ɔkɛhɔmaa ewiade ndɛnebuavolɛma, na ɔmmaa Nyamenle menli ne ɛnziezie ɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Bɛnze kɛ Nyamenle menli ye ala a babua ewiade amra ndɛne a? Na saa bɛmɛ a bɛbabua ewiade amra ndɛne a, ɛnee duzu ati a bɛngola edwɛkɛ ngyikyi ɛhye mɔ siezie ɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛnze kɛ yɛmɛ a yɛbabua anwuma soanvolɛma bɔbɔ ndɛne a? Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ akee azɛlɛ ye azo edwɛkɛ yɛngola yɛnli a?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Saa ɔle zɛhae a ɛnee edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ bie si a, duzu ati a bɛfa bɛkɔmaa menli mɔɔ asɔne ye ɛmbu bɛ bie la siezie ɛ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ anyiemgba bɔbɔ! Asoo amgba ala nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ ko bɔbɔ ɛnle bɛ asɔne ne anu, mɔɔ kola siezie mediema avinli,

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: mɔɔ yemɔti adiema fa adiema kɔ kɔɔto kɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛnli la bua bɛ ndɛne a?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ twe manzonle bɔbɔ a ɛnee noko bɛha aze. Duzu ati a bɛngulo kɛ awie kɛvo bɛ ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛngulo kɛ awie kɛsisi bɛ ekyii ɛ?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, bɛze kɛ amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne. Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo; menli mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle awozonle, bɛfa nwuvolɛ, mrenya mɔɔ fa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ fa mraalɛ,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle nwule, bɛle anyebolo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nza ɛgya bɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nloa ɛdendɛlɛ ɛnyɛ fɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ahɔdiawu la, biala ɛnrɛnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Kɛ ɛnee bɛ bie mɔ de la ɛne. Na Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma ne ati nee Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ati, bɛbia bɛ; bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi ɛtane nwo, na bɛmaa bɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. Bɛva bɛ sonlabaka ne bɛde Nyamenle anyunlu

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Wɔannea a awie baha kɛ, “Melɛ adenle meyɛ debie biala.” Ɔle zɔhane, noko tɛ nyɛleɛ ne amuala a le kpalɛ a. Mekola meka kɛ, “Melɛ adenle meyɛ debie biala,” noko menrɛmaa debie biala adenle menrɛmaa ɔnrɛva me ɔnrɛyɛ ye akɛlɛ.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Awie noko bahola aha kɛ, “Bɛbɔle aleɛ bɛmanle ɛkolɛ, yɛɛ bɛbɔle ɛkolɛ bɛmanle aleɛ.” Ɔle zɔhane, noko Nyamenle bazɛkye bɛ mu nwiɔ. Bɛmmafa bɛ sonlabaka ne bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane biala; bɛva bɛzonle Awulae. Awulae a maa sonlabaka ne mɔɔ ɔhyia nwo la a.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a dwazole Awulae vile ewule nu a, na ɔlua ye tumi ne azo ɔbadwazo yɛdayɛ noko yeavi ewule nu.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Bɛnze kɛ bɛ sonlabaka ne mɔ le Kelaese ɛdeɛ ne nvɛyeba nvɛyeba mɔɔ bɔ nu yɛ Awulae sonlabaka ne la ɔ? Asoo menva Kelaese sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba membɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla? Nyamenle ɛkpa ɛgua!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ bɛnze kɛ awie mɔɔ kɛva ɔ nwo kɛha tuutuunli la nee ye bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛ nwonane ko ɔ? Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kpakye nu ka ye wienyi kɛ, “Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛkɛyɛ nwonane ko.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ fa ɔ nwo beta Awulae la nee ye yɛ ko wɔ Sunsum nu.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ. Ɛtane biala mɔɔ sonla yɛ la ɛnga ye sonlabaka ne; na awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla la yɛ ɛtane tia ɔdaye ye sonlabaka ne.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Asoo bɛnze kɛ bɛ sonlabaka ne le Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ na ɔde bɛ nu la ɛzonlenlɛ sua? Bɛdabɛ bɛnlɛ bɛ nwo; bɛle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔle bɛ bolɛ ɛsesebɛ. Yemɔti, bɛva bɛ sonlabaka ne bɛde Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Akee mɔɔ fane edwɛkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle me nwolɛ la, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ nrenya ɛnrɛva ɔ sa ɛnrɛha raalɛ bɔbɔ.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Yelɛ ɛnlɛ tumi wɔ ɔdaye ye nwonane ne azo, ɔ hu a lɛ nwolɛ tumi a; yɛɛ kunli ɛnlɛ tumi wɔ ɔdaye ye nwonane ne azo, ɔ ye a lɛ zolɛ tumi a.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɔ bɛ nwo abolɛ, kyesɛ bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛdumua bɛkponle zolɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛanyia alagye bɛazɛlɛ; nzinlii bɛzia bɛyia nu bieko, amaa yeamba ye kɛ bɛangola bɛ nwo sɔ la ati Seetan azɔ bɛ anlea.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛ muala bɛle kɛ mɔɔ mede la; noko Nyamenle ɛmaa awie biala ɔ ti anwo ahyɛlɛdeɛ, asolo biala ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngya bie nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ahunlanvolɛ la, meka meahile bɛ kɛ ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛ kɛ bɛ ngome bɛkɛhɔ zo bɛkɛdɛnla, kɛmɔ meyɛ ye la.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛnea na bɛnrɛhola bɛ nwo sɔ a, ɛnee bɛgya bie; ɔle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛgya bie tɛla kɛ bɛ nwo kɛhyele bɛ na bɛnrɛhola bɛ nwo sɔ a.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Melɛ ɛhye, kɛ ɔle mɛla mɔɔ vi Awulae ɛkɛ memaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle nwuvolɛ la kɛ yelɛ mmagyakyi ɔ hu;

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: yɛɛ saa ɔgyakyi ye a ɔmmakɔ agyalɛ fofolɛ; anzɛɛ ɔzia ɔ nee ɔ hu dɛba ne ɛhɔbɔ nu. Kunli biala noko mmabɔ ɔ ye ewole.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Akee mɔɔ medame noko meka meahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la a le ɛhye: saa Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ nrenya bie aye ɛnle diedinli na yelɛ ne kponle zolɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye kɛdɛnla a, ɔmmabɔ ye ewole.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ saa Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ raalɛ bie ɔ hu ɛnle diedinli na kunli ne kponle zolɛ kɛ ɔ nee ye kɛdɛnla a, ɔmmabɔ ewole a.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ diedinli yelɛ ne te kunli ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la anwo maa ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye, yɛɛ diedinli nrenya ne te ɔ ye ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la anwo maa ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye. Saa yeamba ye zɔhane a bɛ mra ne mɔ anwo ɛnrɛde, na ɔnle zɔ, bɛ nwo te.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Na saa awie mɔɔ ɛnle diedinli la kulo kɛ ɔbɔ ewole a, bɛmaa ye adenle. Saa ɔba ye zɔhane a, Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ nrenya ne anzɛɛ raalɛ ne lɛ adenle kɛ ɔbɔ ewole ne. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ raalɛ, saa wɔmɔ a ɛbalie ɛ hu ngoane a, asoo ɛze? Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ nrenya, saa wɔmɔ a ɛbalie ɛ ye ngoane a, asoo ɛze? Bɛdɛnla kɛmɔ Nyamenle vɛlɛle bɛ la

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛlua ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo ye la azo ɛdɛnla kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde mɔɔ Nyamenle vɛlɛle ye la. Ɛhye yɛɛ mehyehyɛ memaa asɔne ne mɔ amuala a.

english_verse: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle fɛlɛ awie la ɛnee yeyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ a, ɔmmapele kɛ ɔminliminli nzonlɛ ne abo zo; saa ɔfɛlɛ ye la ɛnee bɛtɛyɛle ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ a, ɔmmayɛ.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ wɔ mrenyanu nzonlɛ o, bɛanyɛ o, ɔngyia. Debie mɔɔ hyia la a le Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo ɛlilɛ.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛdɛnla, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde mɔɔ Nyamenle vɛlɛle ye la.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Nyamenle vɛlɛle wɔ la ɛnee ɛle akɛlɛ ɔ? Ɔnle debie, mmadwenle nwolɛ; noko saa adenle bie azo ɛkɛhola ɛkɛkpɔne ɛ nwo a, yɛ ye zɔhane.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ akɛlɛ mɔɔ Awulae ɛvɛlɛ ye la ɛyɛ dehelɛ wɔ Awulae anu; zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ le dehelɛ na bɛvɛlɛ ye la, le akɛlɛ maa Kelaese a.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Nyamenle dɔle bɛ bolɛ ɛsesebɛ; zɔhane ati bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo ngɛkɛlɛ bɛmaa menli.

english_verse: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛ nuhua ko biala nee Nyamenle ɛlua, kɛmɔ ɔde mɔɔ Nyamenle vɛlɛle ye la. Mɔɔ ɛngya bie nee ahunlanvolɛ

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ le edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngya bie la anwo la, menlɛ Awulae ɛkɛ ne mɛla biala memmaa bɛ, medame me adwenle a meka a, kɛ sonla mɔɔ Awulae ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne na menli kola die ye di la.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Saa menea kɛkala mekɛ ye anu anwongyelelɛ mɔɔ ɛra la a, ɛnee medwenle kɛ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla biala kɛdɛnla, kɛmɔ ɔde ye ala la.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ɛgya raalɛ ɔ? Ɛnee mmabɔ ye ewole. Ɛngya bie ɔ? Ɛnee mmadwenle bie ɛgyalɛ nwo.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Na saa ɛgya bie noko a, ɛnee ɛtɛyɛle ɛtane, yɛɛ saa raalɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛgyale ye la kɔ agyalɛ a, ɛnee ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane. Ewiade ye anu edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo maa nwuvolɛ nwo kyele bɛ kpalɛ, na ɛhye yɛɛ mekulo kɛ ɔkpa bɛ ti a.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Mediema, mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le ɛhye: mekɛ ne ɛwie, na ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, kunlima ɛdɛnla kɛ bɛngya mraalɛ;

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu la ɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛnli nyane; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye ɛlie la ɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛnli fɛlɛko; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔ ninyɛne la ɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ mɔɔ bɛtɔ la ɛnle bɛ ɛdeɛ;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli ewiade ninyɛne nzi la ɛyɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛngyia ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo la. Ɔluakɛ ewiade ɛhye, kɛ ɔde ye kɛkala la, ɔnrɛhyɛ na yeapɛ nu.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Mekpondɛ kɛ bɛye adwenleadwenle muala bɛfi ɛkɛ. Nrenya mɔɔ ɛngya raalɛ la dwenle Awulae gyima ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔkɛzɔ Awulae anye;

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: na nrenya mɔɔ gya raalɛ la dwenledwenle ewiade ninyɛne nwo, ɔluakɛ ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔmaa ɔ ye anye die.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ye adwenle ne ɛhyɛ nwiɔ. Raalɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛgyale ye la dwenledwenle Awulae gyima ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔtu ye sonlabaka ne nee ye ɛkɛla ne ɔmaa Nyamenle; na awuvolɛ raalɛ dwenledwenle ewiade ninyɛne nwo, ɔluakɛ ɔkpondɛ kɛ ɔmaa ɔ hu anye die.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Melɛka ɛhye wɔ bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ ti. Mensisi bɛ nwo zo. Mekpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ na ɔfa adenle nu la, na bɛfa bɛ nwo amuala bɛsonle Awulae wɔ adenle biala anu.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Saa nrenya bie yia bɛlɛra bie na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛnrɛgya bɛ nwo, na nzinlii nrenya ne nwu kɛ debie mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ bɛlɛra ne la ɛnle kpalɛ, na ɔdaye mumua ne ɔngola ɔ nwo sɔ na ɔnwu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgya bɛ nwo a, bɛgya bɛ nwo, kɛmɔ bɛkpondɛ la. Ɔnle ɛtane.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mɔɔ gya raalɛ ne mɔɔ yeyia ye la, yɛ ye boɛ; noko mɔɔ ɛngya bie la yɛ ye boɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ raalɛ te ɔ nwo fi ɔ hu anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ hu de ngoane nu la. Na saa ɔ hu wu a, ɔlɛ adenle kɛ ɔgya nrenya biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la, noko ɔwɔ kɛ nrenya ne yɛ Keleseɛnenli.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Saa raalɛ ne kɛdɛnla mɔɔ ɔngɔ agyalɛ a anrɛɛ mese ɔ nye balie. Kɛ me adwenle se me la ɛne, yɛɛ medie medi kɛ medame noko Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ me nu.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Akee meka aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la anwo edwɛkɛ. “Yɛ muala yɛlɛ adwenle, yɛze deɛ,” ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛmɔ bɛka la; noko akee bɛ deɛnwunlɛ zɛhae sɛkye bɛ; ɛhulolɛ a maa ngɔzo a.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ dwenle kɛ ɔze deɛ la, ɛnze mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnwu ye la.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kulo Nyamenle la, Nyamenle ze ye.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mɔɔ fane aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la ɛlilɛ nwo, yɛze kɛ amonle ɛnle debie biala, yɛɛ nyamenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne kɛ Nyamenle kokye ne ala.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Na saa bɔbɔ nyamenle bie mɔ wɔ anwuma anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo, kɛmɔ nɔhalɛ “nyamenle nee awulae mɔ” bie dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ ne la,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: yɛmɛ yɛze Nyamenle kokye ne ala, yemɔ a le Selɛ ne mɔɔ bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na yɛde aze yɛmaa ye la; yɛɛ Awulae ko, Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ ɔlua ɔ nwo zo a bɛbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛde aze la.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Noko tɛ menli ne amuala a lɛ nɔhalɛ deɛnwunlɛ ɛhye a. Amonlezɔlɛ ɛli menli bie mɔ adwenle ɛmaa ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala saa bɛdi aleɛ zɛhae mɔ bie a ɛnee bɛdwenle nwolɛ kɛ asɛɛ amgba ɔle aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ “nɔhalɛ” amonle a. Ɔba ye zɛhae a ɛnee kɛmɔ bɛ adwenle ɛtɛtinle la ati, bɛfa ye kɛ aleɛ ne gua bɛ nwo evinli.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, aleɛ ɛnrɛva yɛ ɛnrɛdwu Nyamenle anyunlu. Yemɔti saa yɛanli a yɛnrɛminli debie biala, yɛɛ saa yɛdi noko a yɛnrɛnyia nvasoɛ biala.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Noko bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ fanwodi nyɛleɛ ɛhye ammaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ diedi ɛtɛtinle la andu koti.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa awie mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ anu la nwu wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛze deɛ la kɛ ɛlɛdi aleɛ wɔ amonle sua bo a, asoo ɛhye ɛnrɛzuhu ɔ kɔme anzi ɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛli aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Nwu ye kɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛtane zɛhae wɔatia ɛ mediema ne mɔ, na ɛlɛsɛkye bɛ adwenle la, ɛnee ɛlɛyɛ ɛtane wɔatia Kelaese.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, saa aleɛ zɛhae kɛmaa me diema bie kɛkpo aze a, ɛnee menrɛli aleɛ zɔhane bieko na aloa abɔ, amaa me diema bie anyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Menle dehelɛ ɔ? Menle ɛzoanvolɛ ɔ? Metɛnwunle yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse ɔ? Na tɛ bɛmɛ a Awulae ati bɛle me sa anloa gyima a?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Saa bɔbɔ awie mɔ ɛnlie me ɛndo nu kɛ mele ɛzoanvolɛ a ɛnee tɛ bɛmɛ ɔ! Bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ mɔɔ Awulae ati bɛbɔ la kile kɛ mele ɛzoanvolɛ.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Me ne mɔɔ mesa meahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfedevede me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la ɛne!

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Yɛnlɛ adenle kɛ yɛdi na yɛno ɔ?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Yɛnlɛ adenle kɛ yɛgya Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ bie na yɛ nee ye tu adenle kɔyɛ gyima, kɛmɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ nee Awulae amediema ne mɔ nee Pita yɛ ye la ɔ?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ me nee Banabase yɛ mu nwiɔ ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛpele na yɛali a?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Sogyanli boni a wɔ konle nloa na ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔdi ɔ nloa anu ndɔnie a? Nwane a ɛyɛ vanye egyinli na ɔnli vanye ma ne bie a? Nwane a nea nyɛmoa na ɔnno bɛ nyɛfonzule ne bie a?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Mosisi mɛla ne anu kɛ, “Mmakyekye ɛnlankɛ ne mɔɔ wozo awule ne la anloa.” Asoo ɛnlankɛ nwo hyia Nyamenle tɛla yɛ la ati a ɔhanle ɛhye a?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ tɛ yɛmɛ yɛ ti a ɔhanle ɛhye a? Nɔhalɛ, bɛhɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ sonla ti. Bɛmaa mɔɔ so ɛya nee mɔɔ fa nu aleɛ la ɛyɛ bɛ gyima ne anyelazo nu kɛ bɛbanyia bɛ afoa nu aleɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Yɛlua sunsum nu ma wɔ bɛ nu, na saa yɛnyia nvasoɛ wɔ ninyɛne nu yɛfi bɛ ɛkɛ ne a, ɛnee ɔnle ɛtane.

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Saa awie mɔ bɔbɔ lɛ adenle kɛ bɛdie ɛhye wɔ bɛ lɔ a, ɛnee akee yɛmɛ ɛ? Noko yɛtɛyɛle debie zɛhae mɔ bie. Yɛkponle ninyɛne muala azo, amaa yɛandua Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne ɛhanlɛ adenle.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, bɛze kɛ menli mɔɔ yɛ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu gyima la nyia bɛ aleɛ fi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛboa azubɔlɛ nu wɔ azukponle ne anyunlu la nyia ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu ne la bie.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Awulae ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo la nyia bɛ aleɛ fi bɛ gyima nu a.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Noko metɛbizale debie biala metɛfile bɛ lɔ, yɛɛ mengɛlɛ ɛhye kɛ akee bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bɛmaa me. Menwɔhulo kɛ menwɔwu kɛdɛla kɛ awie kɛmaa me nloa anu mɔɔ metu kɛ menga Edwɛkpa ne menlie ahatualɛ la kɛyɛ mgbane.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Menlɛ adenle kɛ mememaa me nwo zo kɛ mebɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo a, ɔluakɛ ɔle me gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a. Saa meambɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo a, me gyakɔ!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Saa melɛ medame me ɛhulolɛ yɛɛ melɛyɛ gyima ne a, anrɛɛ me nye bala ahatualɛ zo, na meyɛ ye kɛ ɔle ɛzonle ɔla me nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle a ɛva ɛwula me sa nu a.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee duzu ahatualɛ a menyia ye a? Me ahatualɛ a le kɛ menwɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la nolo mɔɔ menlie ɛhwee, na eza menva adenle mɔɔ melɛ ye wɔ Edwɛkpa ne ɛhanlɛ nwo la menyɛ me nwo boɛ.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Mele dehelɛ, menle awie biala akɛlɛ; noko meyɛ me nwo akɛlɛ memaa awie biala, amaa me sa aha bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo ne ala.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: Wɔ Dwuuma anu, membɔle me ɛbɛla kɛ mele Dwuunli, amaa me sa aha bɛ; na saa medame Pɔɔlo menle Mosisi mɛla ne abo bɔbɔ a, membɔle me ɛbɛla kɛ mewɔ mɛla ne abo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛwɔ mɛla ne abo la de la, amaa me sa aha bɛ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ meyɛ ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mewɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la avinli a; meyɛ me nwo kɛ asɛɛ menle mɛla ne abo, amaa me sa aha bɛdabɛ noko. Ɛhye ɛngile kɛ menli Nyamenle mɛla ne azo; nɔhalɛ ne a le kɛ mewɔ Kelaese mɛla bo.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Saa mewɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ diedi ɛnli munli la anu noko a, meyɛ me nwo kɛ bɛ nuhua bie la, amaa me sa aha bɛ. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ me nee menli muala yɛ ko a, amaa adenle biala azo mealua mealie bie mɔ ngoane meamaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Meyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala wɔ Edwɛkpa ne ati, amaa meanyia nwolɛ nyilalɛ ne bie.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Bɛze ye wienyi kɛ menli dɔɔnwo a su ɛnriandilɛ a, noko bɛ nuhua ko ala yɛɛ asa ka nwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne a. Ɛhye ati bɛnriandi kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛnyia nwolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kazu ɛnriandilɛ la siezie ɔ nwo kpalɛ wɔ adenle biala anu. Ɔyɛ ye zɔhane, amaa bɛabɔ ye nwolɛ abɔtile, abɔtile ɛhye bɔbɔ ɛngyɛ na yeazɛkye. Na yɛmɛ Keleseɛnema, yɛsu ɛnriandilɛ yɛdie abɔtile mɔɔ ɛnzɛkye ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, kɛmɔ me ɛnriandilɛ ne gyi kpɔkɛ zo la, dahuu menriandi fɔɔnwo; mele kɛ sonla mɔɔ ko la. Mentoto me abotokuma ne mɔ mgbane mgbane.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Mebɔ mɔdenle mesɔ me nwo na megyinla me ti koonwu medie abotokuma kpalɛ, amaa mame mɔɔ mebɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo la meandɔ sinli wɔ sɔnea ne anu.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Mediema, mekpondɛ kɛ bɛkakye mɔɔ zile yɛ nlenya mɔ mɔɔ doale Mosisi la anwo zo la. Bɛ muala yɛɛ amungu ne wowale bɛ a, yɛɛ bɛ muala a bɛluale Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne anu bɛpɛle a.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛzɔnenle bɛ muala kɛ Mosisi ɛdoavolɛma wɔ amungu ne nee nyevile ne anu.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛlile sunsum nu aleɛ ko ne ala bie,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: bɛnlonle sunsum nu nzule ko ne ala. Ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛnlonle nzule ne mɔɔ vi sunsum nu bodane ne anu vindele zenle lile bɛ nzi la bie; bodane zɔhane a le Kelaese mumua ne.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Noko akee Nyamenle anye anlie bɛ muala bɛ nwo, yemɔti bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo totɔle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ le kɔkɔbɔlɛ maa yɛ, na bɛbɔ yɛ kɔkɔ amaa yɛ ti akunlu amba ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ zo, kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ yɛle la,

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: anzɛɛ yɛanzonle awozonle, kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ yɛle la. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Menli ne mɔ dɛnlanle aze lile na bɛnlonle na bɛdwazole bɛzile agole.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ yɛbɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla biala kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ bɔle a bɛ nuhua apenle ngoko abulanwiɔ nee nsa dɔle kenle ko la.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Bɛte kɛ bɛka kɛ, “Yɛlɛ adenle yɛyɛ debie biala.” Ɔle zɔhane, noko tɛ ninyɛne ne amuala a boa a. “Yɛlɛ adenle yɛyɛ debie biala,” noko tɛ ninyɛne ne amuala a maa ngɔzo a.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ yɛsɔ Awulae yɛnea, kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ yɛle a nwɔlɛ kekale bɛ hunle bɛ la.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Eza ɔnle kɛ yɛtendɛ yɛ nzo abo, kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ yɛle na Ewule soanvolɛ zɛkyele bɛ la.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ sisile bɛ nwo zo, amaa yeayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ yeamaa awie mɔ, yɛɛ bɛhɛlɛle kɛ bɛfa bɛahilehile yɛ, ɔluakɛ ewiade ne awieleɛ mekɛ a yɛwɔ nu la.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa mɔɔ dwenle kɛ ɔgyi boɛ la ɛnlea boɛ na yeandɔ aze.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Sɔnea biala mɔɔ ɛdo bɛ la le kɛ mɔɔ to awie biala la. Nyamenle le nɔhalɛ, bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu kɛ ɔnrɛmaa sɔnea mɔɔ bɛnrɛhola ɔ nloa gyinla la ɛnrɛdo bɛ ɛlɛ. Bɛ sɔnea mekɛ nu bɔbɔ, ɔbamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ yeamaa bɛagyinla ɔ nloa, na yeahile bɛ adenle yeamaa bɛavi nu.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati ayi mɔ, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nwo.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ kɛ bɛle nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma. Bɛdabɛ bɛdwenle mɔɔ melɛka la anwo.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ dwora ne mɔɔ yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ nwolɛ la, Kelaese mogya ne a yɛkyɛ yɛno ye nu a, yɛɛ kpanwo ne mɔɔ yɛdie yɛdi la, Kelaese nwonane ne a yɛdi a.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ kpanwo ne mɔɔ yɛbubu la le ko la, saa yɛle dɔɔnwo bɔbɔ a yɛle sonlabaka ko, ɔluakɛ yɛ muala yɛkyɛ kpanwo ko ne ala.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Bɛnlea mɔɔ Yizilayɛma yɛ la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi azubɔlɛ aleɛ ne la a le menli mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ azukponle ne anwo la.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Duzu edwɛkɛ a mekpondɛ meaha a? Kɛ bozonle ɛzonlenlɛ anzɛɛ aleɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛmaa bozonle la amgba le debie ɔ?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Menga ye zɔhane. Mɔɔ melɛka la a le kɛ ewiade amra fa ninyɛne bɔ azu maa mbɔnsam, bɛmbɔ bɛmmaa Nyamenle. Memkpondɛ kɛ bɛ nee mbɔnsam nyia debie yɛ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ bɛno Awulae dwora ne anu na eza bɛanlo mbɔnsam dwora nu; yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛtɛnla Awulae ɛkponle nwo na eza bɛahɔdɛnla mbɔnsam ɛkponle nwo.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Yɛkulo kɛ yɛka Nyamenle ɛya ɔ? Yɛdwenle kɛ yɛ nwo yɛ se tɛla ye ɔ?

english_verse: We should think about others and not about ourselves.
translation_verse: Awie biala mmadwenle ɔ ngome ye boɛyɛlɛ nwo. Bɛdwenle bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛdeɛ nwo.

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Bɛli nane biala mɔɔ bɛtɔne ye wɔ gua nu la, bɛmmadwenle nwolɛ bɛbizebiza nwolɛ edwɛkɛ,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la bie to ɛsalɛ fɛlɛ bɛ wɔ ye ɛkponledolɛ bo na bɛkɔ a, bɛli debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛva bɛkɛzie bɛ nyunlu la, na bɛmmadwenle nwolɛ bɛbizebiza nwolɛ edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: tɛ kɛ bɛmɛ bɛ adwenle nu kɛyɛ bɛ kesee la ati ɔ, na ahenle ne ɛdeɛ ne ati, bɛmmadi. Awie kɛbiza kɛ, “Duzu ati a awie yemɔ ye adwenle mɔɔ kɛzɛkye la ati me ti anwo ɛlilɛ kɛbɔ me ɛ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Saa meyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ mɔɔ medi la anwo a, ɛnee kɛmɔti a awie kɛdendɛ me wɔ aleɛ mɔɔ meyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ nwolɛ la anwo a?”

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Bɛdie ɛ. Debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, saa aleɛ a bɛdi o, saa nzule a bɛno o, bɛyɛ bɛde Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔɔ bɛndenda Dwuuma anzɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nee Nyamenle menli ne agyakɛ anu a.

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ye kɛmɔ meyɛ ye ala la. Mendwenle me ngome me kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo; mebɔ mɔdenle kɛ menwɔyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ maa awie biala la, amaa bɛalie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, bɛva me gyakɛ, kɛmɔ meva Kelaese agyakɛ la. Bɛ ti zo ɛhedalɛ wɔ asɔne sua nu

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Mekanvo bɛ, ɔluakɛ dahuu bɛkakye me na bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ zo.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Noko mekpondɛ kɛ bɛte ɔ bo kɛ nrenya biala amenle a le Kelaese, raalɛ biala amenle a le ɔ hu, yɛɛ Kelaese amenle a le Nyamenle.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Yemɔti nrenya biala mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ anzɛɛ ɛlɛka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne na ɔkɛheda ɔ ti zo la gua Kelaese anyunlu aze.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Raalɛ biala noko mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ anzɛɛ ɛlɛka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ na yeangeda ɔ ti zo la gua ɔ hu anyunlu aze; ngakyile biala ɛnle ye nee raalɛ mɔɔ bɛkpa ɔ ti la avinli.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Saa raalɛ ne ɛnrɛheda ɔ ti zo a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɔpepɛ anzɛɛ ɔkpa ɔ ti enrinli ne. Na saa ɔyɛ ye zɔhane na ɔyɛ ye anyiemgba a, ɛnee noko ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkeda zo.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ nrenya keda ɔ ti zo, ɔluakɛ nrenya da Nyamenle su ne nee ye anyunlunyia ne ali,

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ambɔ nrenya anvi raalɛ nu. Ɔbɔle raalɛ ɔvile nrenya nu;

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: yɛɛ tɛ raalɛ ti a bɛbɔle nrenya a. Nrenya ti a bɛbɔle raalɛ a.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ɔlua anwuma soanvolɛma ne mɔ ati, ɔwɔ kɛ raalɛ biala keda ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Noko akee, Awulae ati nrenya ɛngɔ ɛngyakyi raalɛ, yɛɛ raalɛ ɛngɔ ɛngyakyi nrenya.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛmɔ bɛbɔle raalɛ bɛvile nrenya nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ raalɛ wo nrenya a, yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti vi Nyamenle.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛbua: asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ angeda ɔ ti zo la kɛzɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu?

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: yɛɛ raalɛ fa ye ɛdeɛ ne bɔ abɔfo; ɔluakɛ bɛva enrinli ndendenle bɛmaa ye kɛ ɔva ɔheda ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Saa awie kulo kɛ ɔsu ɛhye anwo kpolera a, mɔɔ melɛ ye meka la a le kɛ yɛmɛ anzɛɛ Nyamenle asɔnema ne mɔ, yɛnlɛ amaamuo fofolɛ bieko wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu kɛ ɛhye ala. Awulae aleɛ ne (Mat

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔɔ melɛka la ɛnle bɛ ɛhanvolɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nyianu ne mɔ ɛnwie kɛnlɛma yɛ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ lumua, mede kɛ bɛyia nu a ɛnee bɛ avinli ɛkpakyekpakye. Na ɔyɛ medame noko kɛ ɛhye foa ko bie le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa bɛlɛdi a, bɛ nuhua biala di ye aleɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee ye kɛhɔ la, amaa ɔlua zo, mɔɔ ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bie mɔ la ɛnee bie mɔɔ ɛbo.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kenle biala mɔɔ bɛlɛdi kpanwo ɛhye, na bɛlɛno dwora ye anu la, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane bɛfa bɛbɔ Awulae ewule ne nolo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛra bieko la.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa awie ambu Awulae nwonane ne bie wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛdi kpanwo ne, na ɔlɛno dwora ne anu la a, ɔtwehwe ndeanlɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛwiele aleɛ ne di la, ɔvale dwora ne, na ɔzele kɛ, “Dwora ɛhye a le Nyamenle Ngyekyeleɛ Fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva me mogya ne bɛhye ɔ bo la. Kenle biala mɔɔ bɛlɛno nu la, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane bɛva bɛhakye me.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ menyianle ye menvile Awulae lɔ la a menvale memanle bɛ a, yemɔ a le kɛ, nɔe ne mɔɔ bɛyele Awulae Gyisɛse bɛmanle la, ɔvale kpanwo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo, ɔbule nu, na ɔzele kɛ, “Ɛhye a le me nwonane ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa bɛ la. Bɛyɛ ɛhye bɛva bɛhakye me.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ kɛli Awulae kpanwo ne anzɛɛ kɛnlo ye dwora ne anu wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɛnfɛta la anu la kɛli Awulae nwonane ne nee ye mogya ne anwo fɔlɛ.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala dumua neɛnlea ye ahonle nu kpalɛ na yeali kpanwo ne, yeanlo dwora ne anu.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo anwo ɛyɛ bɛ bɛtɛɛ, bɛ nwo ɛtoto bɛ, na bie mɔ ɛwu la.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Na saa yɛdumua yɛneɛnlea yɛ ahonle nu kpalɛ a Nyamenle ɛnrɛdea yɛ.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Na Awulae tea yɛ, ɔtwe yɛ nzo amaa bɛanva yɛ bɛamboka ewiade amra anwo bɛambua yɛ ewule fɔlɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, me mediema, saa bɛyia nuhua kɛ bɛdi Awulae aleɛ ne a, anrɛɛ bɛhendɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Saa ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bie a, ɔlumua ɔli debie wɔ sua nu, amaa bɛbayia nu a Nyamenle andea bɛ. Mɔɔ fane edwɛkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la anwo, meba a mebaha nwolɛ bie.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Bɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnze Nyamenle la, awie mɔ vale adenle bie azo manle bɛzɔle mmonle mɔɔ ɛndendɛ la.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ awie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ ye nu la ɛngola ɛnga kɛ “Munzule ɛha Gyisɛse!” Yɛɛ awie biala noko ɛngola ɛnga kɛ “Gyisɛse le Awulae”, kyesɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne de ye nu.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ le ngakyile dɔɔnwo, noko Nyamenle Sunsum ko ne ala a fa maa a.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Ɛzonlenlɛ ndenle ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ, noko yɛsonle Awulae kokye ne ala.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Anwosesebɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ gyima ngakyile dɔɔnwo la wɔ ɛkɛ, noko Nyamenle ko ne ala a maa awie biala anwosesebɛ maa ɔfa ɔsonle a.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne da ɔ nwo ali wɔ adenle bie anu wɔ yɛ nuhua ko biala nu wɔ yɛ muala yɛ kpalɛ ti.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne maa bie ka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔmaa bie adwenle nu buke.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ko ne ala maa bie diedi nyi yɛɛ ɔmaa bie tumi ɔfa ɔyɛ ayile.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne maa bie tumi maa ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne yɛɛ ɔmaa bie ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo a; ɔmaa bie ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ ɔkola ɔfa ɔnwu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ vi Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ ɛnvi ye ɛkɛ ne la. Nyamenle Sunsum ne maa bie tendɛ aneɛ ngakyile, yɛɛ ɔmaa bie noko tumi mɔɔ ɔkola ɔkile mɔɔ bɛka la abo.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ko ne ala a yɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala a; Sunsum ko ne ala a maa awie biala ahyɛlɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la a. Sonlabaka ne lɛ nvɛyeba nvɛyeba

english_verse: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ sonlabaka ne le ko na ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ zonle, na biala le ngakyile la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Kelaese de a.

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛlua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo bɛzɔne yɛ muala, bɛyɛ yɛ sonlabaka ko, na bɛmaa yɛ muala, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, ahanra nee alehelɛ, Nyamenle Sunsum ko ne ala a.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ne mɔ zonle. Ɔnle kokye.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Na saa egyakɛ ka kɛ, “Menle ɛsalɛ, yemɔti memboka sonlabaka ne anwo” a, ɛnee ɛhye ɛngile kɛ amgba ɔmboka sonlabaka ne anwo,

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: yɛɛ saa ɛnzolɛ ka kɛ, “Menle ɛnyelɛ, yemɔti memboka sonlabaka ne anwo” a, ɛnee ɛhye ɛngile kɛ amgba ɔmboka sonlabaka ne anwo.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Saa sonlabaka ne kpokpoti le ɛnyelɛ a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeade edwɛkɛ ɛ? Saa sonlabaka ne kpokpoti le ɛnzolɛ a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeade nvoanle ɛ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔde la a le kɛ Nyamenle hulole yɛɛ ɔvale nvɛyeba ngakyile dɔɔnwo ɔbɔle sonla a.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ muala bɛle debie ko ala a, anrɛɛ bɛnvɛlɛ ye sonlabaka.

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔde la a le kɛ sonlabaka ne lɛ nvɛyeba dɔɔnwo, noko ɔle sonlabaka kokye.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, ɛnyelɛ ɛngola ɛnga ɛngile ɛsalɛ kɛ, “Ɛ nwo ɛngyia me!” Anzɛɛ etile ɛngola ɛnga ɛngile egyakɛ kɛ, “Ɛ nwo ɛngyia me!”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, saa yɛye sonlabaka nvɛyeba bɛtɛbɛtɛ ne mɔ nu a, yɛngola debie biala yɛ;

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: yɛɛ sonlabaka ne ɛleka mɔɔ yɛdwenle kɛ bɛ nwo ɛngyia biala la yɛɛ yɛnea bɛ boɛ kpalɛ a; nuhua ne mɔɔ ɛnle ngɛnlɛma la yɛɛ yɛdɛ alagye yɛyɛ bɛ kpalɛ a.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nvɛyeba ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ ɛngyia kɛ bɛkɛziezie bɛ dɔɔnwo. Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔvale nvɛyeba ne mɔ ɔbɔle nu ɔyɛle sonlabaka ne a, amaa bɛali mɔɔ anwo ɛngyia la eni kpalɛ.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati mgbakyemgbakye biala ɛnle sonlabaka ne anu, yɛɛ nvɛyeba ngakyile ne mɔ amuala dwenle maa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Saa sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ko nwu nyane a, ɔka mɔɔ ɛha la amuala; yɛɛ saa bɛye ko ayɛlɛ a, mɔɔ ɛha la amuala nee ye di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Kelaese sonlabaka ne a le bɛ muala, yɛɛ bɛ nuhua ko biala le ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ bie.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhile awie biala gyinlabelɛ wɔ asɔne ne anu; mɔɔ lumua la a le ɛzoanvolɛma, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la a le Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la a le kilehilevolɛma; akee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne, mɔɔ doa bɛ la a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmaa bɛ tumi kɛ bɛyɛ ayile la; yɛɛ akee boavolɛma, amaamuoma, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtendɛ aneɛ ngakyile la.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛnle ɛzoanvolɛma, anzɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma, anzɛɛ kilehilevolɛma. Bɛ muala bɛnlɛ tumi mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne a,

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ ayile, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛka aneɛ ngakyile, anzɛɛ bɛfa bɛkile aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛka la abo a.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛbolo bɛkpondɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ na bɛ nwo hyia kpalɛ la. Akee bɛmaa mengile bɛ adenle kpalɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ hyia la.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Saa mekola menli nee anwuma soanvolɛma aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ ka, na menlɛ ɛhulolɛ a, me ɛdendɛlɛ le kɛ ɛlawule anzɛɛ awa mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ alɛra la.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Saa melɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ mefa metendɛ Nyamenle anloa azo, na saa mebe nwoma nu kpole, mete fealeranu edwɛkɛ muala abo, na melɛ diedi mɔɔ maa mekola metudu awoka, na menlɛ ɛhulolɛ a, menzɔho sonla.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Saa mefa me nwo ninyɛne muala mekyɛ ehyianvolɛma na mefa me sonlabaka ye memaa kɛ bɛyela ye, na menlɛ ɛhulolɛ a, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ.

english_verse: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ lɛ abotane, ɔ ti akunlu le kɛnlɛma; ɛhulolɛ ɛnle anyebolo, ɔmbu ɔ nwo, yɛɛ ɔmmemaa ɔ nwo zo;

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: ɛhulolɛ ɛnyɛ ninyɛne mgbane mgbane, yɛɛ ɔndendɛ ɛtane ɔntia awie; ɔnle angomedi, ɔnva ɛya yɛɛ ɔmbu ɛtane nwo mgbonda;

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: ɛhulolɛ anye ɛnlie ninyɛndane nwo, ɔdi fɛlɛko wɔ mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ. Nyamenle anloa azo ɛdendɛlɛ ɛdeɛ, ɔbakpa nwo. Ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtendɛ aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ la bazi aze, yɛɛ nwoma ɛnwunlɛ mgbole bapɛ nu aze.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛ nwoma mɔɔ yɛze nee yɛ Nyamenle anloa azo ɛdendɛlɛ le afoa afoa.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Na saa nuhua ne mɔɔ di munli la ba a, ɔbaminliminli ninyɛne mɔɔ le afoa afoa la abo zo.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ mele kakula la, mendendɛle kɛ kakula, mendwenlenle kɛ kakula, yɛɛ menzuzule edwɛkɛ nwo kɛ kakula. Kɛkala mɔɔ meyɛ kpanyinli la, megyakyi ngakula ninyɛne ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la le kɛ nvoninli monzomonzo bie wɔ neanleɛ nu, na kenle bie yɛ nye bayia zo. Kɛkala, mɔɔ meze la ɛnli munli, na kenle bie ɔbali munli, kɛmɔ Nyamenle si ze me la.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ ɛhulolɛ bo zo na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛbolo bɛkpondɛ sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ, titile, Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la ɛndendɛ ɛngile menli; ɔtendɛ ɔkile Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ awie biala ɛnde mɔɔ ɔka la abo. Mɔɔ ɔyɛ la a le kɛ ɔdua Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi zo ɔka fealeranu ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ bɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo la tendɛ kile menli, ɔboa bɛ, ɔmaa bɛ akɛnrazilɛ na ɔkyekye bɛ rɛle.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la boa ɔ ngomekye ɔ nwo na mɔɔ bɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo la boa asɔnema amuala.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Mekulo kɛ anrɛɛ bɛ muala bɛkɛha aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ bie, noko me kunlu a anrɛɛ eza bɛ muala bɛkola bɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo kpalɛ. Ɔluakɛ sonla mɔɔ bɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo la anwo hyia kpalɛ tɛla sonla mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la, kyesɛ awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ kola kile mɔɔ ɔka la abo a, amaa yeayɛ moalɛ yeamaa asɔnema amuala.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Mediema, saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ na mebaka aneɛ ngakyile mekile bɛ a, duzu nvasoɛ a bɛkɛnyia ye bɛkɛvi me ɛkɛ ne a? Bɛnrɛnyia ɛhwee, kyesɛ melɛ yekile bie vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ anzɛɛ deɛnwunlɛ bie anzɛɛ nrɛlaleɛ bie vi Nyamenle lɔ, anzɛɛ ngilehilelɛ bie mebɛlɛ bɛ.

english_verse: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
translation_verse: Saa bɛlɛbɔ ninyɛne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ngoane wɔ bɛ nu, mɔɔ le kɛ fulutu anzɛɛ getaa la na ɛnelɛ ne mɔ ɛnvinde kpalɛ a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na bɛanwu edwɛne holɛ ko mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ la ɛ?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Saa bɛbɔ mangɛta na ɔ ne anvɛlɛ boɛ a, nwane a kɛboɔboa ɔ nwo kɛ ɔkɔ konle a?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ɛdeɛ ne de a. Saa bɛ bie ka aneɛ ngakyile mɔɔ awie ɛnde ɔ bo la a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na awie anwu mɔɔ bɛha la ɛ? Ɔba ye zɛhae a ɛnee ɔle kɛ bɛlɛtendɛ bɛahile anwoma la.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Na saa mende aneɛ ne a, ɛnee ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛka la le me nye zo ɛyɛvolɛ, yɛɛ medame noko mele ɔ nye zo ɛyɛvolɛ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, awie mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile la ɛzɛlɛ kɛ ɔkɛnyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkile mɔɔ ɔka la abo la.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa mesɛlɛ adenle zɛhae anu a, ɛnee me sunsum amgba ɛlɛsɛlɛ, noko me adwenle ɛnle nu.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Ɛnee duzu a ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a? Mebava me sunsum meazɛlɛ, yɛɛ mebava me adwenle noko meazɛlɛ; mebava me sunsum meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne, yɛɛ mebava me adwenle noko meado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Na saa bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ sunsum nu ala a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na awie gyɛne mɔɔ wɔ nyianu ne anu la alie bɛ moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne azo “Amen” ɛ? Ɔngola ɔnyɛ ye zɔhane, ɔluakɛ ɔnde mɔɔ bɛlɛka la abo.

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Bɛ moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne le kpalɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko sonla zɔhane ɛnnyia moalɛ biala wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Meyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ meka aneɛ ngakyile metɛla bɛ nuhua biala a.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Noko akee saa yɛyia nuhua kɛ yɛsonle a, menwɔhulo kɛ menwɔha edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ nnu mɔɔ menli te ɔ bo la, amaa meava meahilehile awie mɔ, tɛla kɛ menwɔha edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ apenle ngoko bulu wɔ aneɛ ngakyile nu mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛde ɔ bo la.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛmmadwenle ngakula adwenle. Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ mbɔdɔma mɔɔ ɛnze ɛtaneyɛlɛ deɛ holɛ la, na bɛva mgbanyinli adwenle.
