english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kɛ, “Awulae se, Mebalua menli bie mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile nee nyɛvolɛ anloa ɛdendɛlɛ zo meadendɛ meahile menli ɛhye mɔ; noko bɛnrɛdie me edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, aneɛ ngakyile ɛhanlɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ɛnle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛmmaa diedima. Ɔle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie bɛnli la, yɛɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa diedima. Ɔnle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɔmmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie bɛnli la.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Yemɔti, saa asɔnema kɔsɔɔti yia nu na awie biala bɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔka aneɛ ngakyile, na saa menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle anzɛɛ bɛnlie bɛnli la bie mɔ ba ayia ne abo a, asoo bɛnrɛha kɛ bɛ muala bɛbɔ ɛlane ɔ?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛ muala bɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo na awie mɔɔ ɛnlie ɛnli, anzɛɛ ɛnze Nyamenle la ba ayia ne bie a, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛde la kɛmaa ɔkɛnwu ye ɛtane, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɔbade la babua ye ndɛne

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: aye ɔ ti anu edwɛkɛ ahile ye, na yeamaa yeabɔ ɔ ti aze yeazonle Nyamenle, na yeaha yeado gua kɛ, “Amgba Nyamenle nee bɛ de!” Asɔne nu ngyehyɛlɛ

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ, saa bɛyia nu kɛ bɛsɛlɛ a, mɔɔ lɛ edwɛne la ɛdo, mɔɔ lɛ ngilehilelɛ la ɛhilehile, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye debie ɛhile ye la ɛla ye ali, mɔɔ lɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ wɔ aneɛ ngakyile nu la ɛha, na mɔɔ lɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ fa kile aneɛ ngakyile bo la ɛhile edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha la abo. Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala bɛva bɛboa asɔne ne anyunluhɔlɛ.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛyia nu la saa awie mɔ baha aneɛ ngakyile a, bɛmaa menli nwiɔ anzɛɛ yebo zolɛ la, menli nsa ɛdendɛ. Bɛha ye ngoko ngoko, na sonla ko ɛhile mɔɔ bɛlɛka la abo.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Na saa awie ɛnle asɔne ne anu mɔɔ kɛhola kɛhile mɔɔ bɛlɛka la abo a ɛnee ahenle mɔɔ ka aneɛ ngakyile ne la ɛyɛ koonwu na ɔdendɛ ɔhile ɔ nwo nee Nyamenle.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la anu nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa ɛdendɛ, na mɔɔ ɛha la ɛdie ɛvedevede mɔɔ bɛha la anu.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Saa awie mɔɔ wɔ ayia ne anu la kulo kɛ ɔda mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile ye la ali a, bɛmaa ahenle mɔɔ gyi gua nu ɛlɛtendɛ la ɛmua ɔ nloa.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ muala bɛlɛ adenle bɛtendɛ bɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo ngoko ngoko, amaa bɛ muala bɛazukoa na bɛ nwo ayɛ se.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la ɛzɔ ɔ nwo,

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛnle basabasa Nyamenle. Ɔle anzonudwolɛ Nyamenle. Kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle asɔnema ne mɔ amuala anu la,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: mraalɛ ɛmua bɛ nloa wɔ asɔne nyianu ne mɔ anu. Bɛnlɛ adenle kɛ bɛkɛdendɛ, kɛmɔ Dwuuma mɛla ne se la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛboa mrenya ne mɔ abo.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Saa edwɛkɛ bie a, bɛbiza bɛ hu mɔ wɔ sua nu, ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ anyiemgba bɔbɔ kɛ raalɛ kɛdendɛ asɔne sua nu a.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Na duzu ati ɔ? Bɛ nuhua yɛɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne vi rale ɔ? Anzɛɛ bɛ ngome yɛɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ɛra bɛ ɛkɛ a?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nuhua bie bu ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ, anzɛɛ ɔlɛ sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ a ɛnee ɔlie ɔdo nu kɛ mɔɔ melɛkɛlɛ la vi Awulae ɛkɛ.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔnlie ɔndo nu a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛmmadie ye bɛto nu.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, me mediema, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛbolo kɛ bɛkɛbɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo, yɛɛ bɛmmatua aneɛ ngakyile ɛhanlɛ.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Bɛlua ndenle kpalɛ nee ngɛnlɛma zo bɛyɛ debie biala pɛpɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Mediema, akee metwe bɛ adwenle meara Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ membɔle ye nolo mengilele bɛ a bɛliele bɛdole nu na bɛ diedi gyi zo la azo.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Saa bɛsɔ nu ɛsesebɛ a bɛkɛnyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ; kyesɛ bɛanlie bɛanli.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ menvale membɛlɛle bɛ la le edwɛkɛ mɔɔ hyia kpalɛ. Yɛ ɛtane ti yɛɛ Kelaese wule a, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kile la.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Bɛziele ye na ye kenle nsa ne azo, Nyamenle dwazole ye rale ngoane nu, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: Ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele Pita, na nzinlii ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Eza kenle ko bie ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ bo ɛya nnu mɔɔ bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo ne ala tɛte aze la, bie mɔ ɛwu bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Akee ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele Gyemise yɛɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ne, ɔyele ɔ nwo ɔhilele medame noko, medame zɛhae ala, mɔɔ mele kɛ kyɛkyɛ ralɛ la.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ medame a mele ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ anu ekyi kpalɛ kpalɛ, mɔɔ menfɛta kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ me ɛzoanvolɛ a, ɔboalekɛ menyɛle Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Noko ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ati, merayɛ kɛmɔ mede la. Ye ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔlole me la anyɛ gyɛne, ɔluakɛ meyɛ gyima kpalɛ medɛla ɛzoanvolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, noko tɛ medame me mɔdenlebɔ ɔ, Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ me nwo zo la ɔ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, saa mame o anzɛɛ bɛmɛ o, edwɛkɛ ko ne ala a yɛ muala yɛbɔ ye nolo a, yɛɛ yemɔ noko ala a bɛlie bɛli la. Yɛ ewudwazo ne

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Saa kɛkala yɛ nolobɔlɛ a le kɛ Nyamenle ɛdwazo Kelaese ɛvi ewule nu a, ɛnee kɛ ɔsi mɔɔ bɛ bie mɔ kola ka kɛ bɛnrɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛnrɛra ngoane nu ɛ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔle zɔhane kɛ ewudwazo ɛnle ɛkɛ ne a, ɛnee Nyamenle ɛtɛdwazole Kelaese;

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: yɛɛ saa Nyamenle ɛtɛdwazole Kelaese ɛtɛfile ewule nu a, ɛnee yɛ nolobɔlɛ ne le mgbane, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ diedi ne le mgbane.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Yeanga ye zɔ, saa ɔnle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛba ngoane nu a, ɛnee yɛdo Nyamenle ɛzonle, ɔluakɛ yɛli daselɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛdwazo Kelaese ɛvi ewule nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yeanyɛ ye zɔhane la.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle ɛndwazo mɔwuamra a, ɛnee ɔtɛdwazole Kelaese.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Na saa Nyamenle ɛtɛdwazole Kelaese a, ɛnee bɛ diedi ne le mgbane na bɛtɛte bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu;

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi na bɛwu la ɛminli.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Saa ngoane ɛhye anu ala yɛɛ yɛlɛ anyelazo wɔ Kelaese anu a, ɛnee noko yɛyɛ anwunvɔne kpole kpalɛ yɛtɛla menli kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Na nɔhalɛ ne a le kɛ Nyamenle ɛdwazo Kelaese ɛvi ewule nu, na ɛhye maa yɛsi pi kɛ Nyamenle badwazo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la amuala.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛmɔ ewule luale sonla ko anwo zo a rale la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ewudwazo ne lua sonla ko anwo zo ɛra a.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ menli kɔsɔɔti dua Adam anwo zo wu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle balua Kelaese anwo zo adwazo bɛ muala ara ngoane nu a.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo awie biala wɔ ye mekɛ nloa: Kelaese a lumua a, na akee saa ɔdwu ye ɛralɛ bieko a bɛadwazo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Akee awieleɛ mekɛ ne bara na Kelaese bali mgbolema, tumivolɛma nee arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti anwo zo konim, na yeava Belemgbunlililɛ ne yeawula Nyamenle Selɛ ne asa anu.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese di belemgbunli kɔkpula kɛ Nyamenle kɛli ye agbɔvolɛ amuala anwo zo konim na ɔkɛva bɛ ɔkɛwula ɔ gyakɛ abo la.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Kpɔvolɛ mɔɔ li amozi mɔɔ bɛbazɛkye ye la a le ewule.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwula ɔ gyakɛ abo.” Ɔle nɔhalɛ wienyi kɛ saa bɛka kɛ “bɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛwula ɔ gyakɛ abo” a, ɛnee ɔngile kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ yemɔ a ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwula Kelaese agyakɛ abo la noko boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛwula Kelaese belemgbunlililɛ ne abo a, akee ɔdaye Ralɛ mumua ne, ɔbava ɔ nwo yeawula Nyamenle mɔɔ vale ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti wulale ɔ bo la abo, amaa Nyamenle ali ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azo belemgbunli.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Saa mɔɔ bɛka la le nɔhalɛ, kɛ bɛndwazo mɔwuamra bɛmba ngoane nu a, ɛnee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla mɔwuamra agyakɛ anu bɛmaa bɛzɔne bɛ la, duzu a bɛ nye la zolɛ a?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: Saa bɛndwazo mɔwuamra a, ɛnee duzu ati a menwɔva me ngoane menwɔdo nzeleba dɔnehwele biala ɛ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Meka ko ɛhye, mediema! Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ati, ewule sianle me dahuu wɔ me nwo mɔɔ metu ye wɔ bɛ nwo la anwo.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Saa mele sonla ala, mɔɔ menlɛ anyelazo biala wɔ ewule nzi, yɛɛ me nee “ɛhoayelɛ nu nanemgbole” honle wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse a, ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ a menyia ye a? Saa Nyamenle ɛndwazo mɔwuamra ɛmba ngoane nu a, ɛnee kɛmɔ ɔyɛ a bie mɔ ka la, “Bɛmaa yɛli na yɛnlo, ɔluakɛ ɛhyema ɛnee yɛwu.”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ, “Agɔnwolɛ ɛtane sɛkye ɛbɛla kpalɛ.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛva adwenle kpalɛ na bɛgyakyi ɛtaneyɛlɛ. Ɔyɛ anyiemgba bɔbɔ kɛ menwɔha kɛ bɛ bie mɔ ɛnze Nyamenle a. Ewudwazo ne sonlabaka

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Awie babiza kɛ, “Kɛ Nyamenle si dwazo mɔwuamra ba ngoane nu ɛ? Na duzu nwonane a bɛbava bɛadwazo a?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Kɔnwɔne! Ɛdua ma na ɔtɛkpɔlɔle a ɔnfifi.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a maa ma ne baka holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔkulo la a; ɔmaa ma ko biala ati anwo baka kpalɛ.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Nwonane kɔsɔɔti ɛnle ko. Asolo sonla nwonane, asolo nane nwonane, asolo nloma nwonane, yɛɛ asolo fɛlɛ nwonane.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Anwomanyunlu abɔdeɛ wɔ ɛkɛ yɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo abɔdeɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. Asolo anwomanyunlu abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ngɛnlɛma yɛɛ asolo azɛlɛ ye azo abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ngɛnlɛma.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Asolo sɛnzɛne ne kɛnlɛma, asolo siane ne kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ asolo nwɔlɔra noko ngɛnlɛma; eza asolo ɛwɔlɔra ko biala bɔbɔ nee ye kɛnlɛma.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdwazo mɔwuamra bɛba ngoane nu a kɛ ɔbayɛ la ɛne. Mɔɔ bɛlua la kpɔlɔ, mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazo ye ba ngoane nu la ɛmkpɔlɔ.

english_verse: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.
translation_verse: Bɛdua ye anyiemgba nu; Nyamenle dwazo ye anyunlunyia nu. Bɛdua ye anwobɛlɛlɛ nu; Nyamenle dwazo ye tumi nu.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Bɛsie ye nwonane nu sonlabaka; Nyamenle dwazo ye sunsum nu sonlabaka. Saa nwonane nu sonlabaka wɔ ɛkɛ a, ɛnee sunsum nu sonlabaka wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle bɔle sonla mɔɔ lumua, mɔɔ le Adam, manle ɔrayɛle ɛkɛla mɔɔ de aze a.” Na Adam ne mɔɔ li amozi la le Nyamenle Sunsum mɔɔ maa ngoane a.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Tɛ sunsum nu sonlabaka ne a dumua ba a. Nwonane nu sonlabaka ne dumua ba, na akee sunsum nu sonlabaka ne adoa ye.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Ndɛtɛlɛ a Nyamenle vale bɔle sonla ne mɔɔ lumua la a, na sonla ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la vi anwuma a rale a.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle azɛlɛ ye azo amra la le kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale ndɛtɛlɛ bɔle ye la, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle anwuma amra la le kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛle kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale ndɛtɛlɛ bɔle ye la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛbayɛ kɛ sonla ne mɔɔ vi anwuma rale la a.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Mediema, mɔɔ mekpondɛ meaha la a le kɛ, nwonane nee mogya ɛngola ɛnnyia Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, yɛɛ debie mɔɔ kpɔlɔ la ɛngola ɛnnyia mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ la.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Bɛdie fealeranu edwɛkɛ ɛhye: yɛ muala yɛnrɛwu. Saa bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu a, yɛ nye zo katete yɛ la ɛnee Nyamenle ɛhakyi yɛ ɛwie. Ɔluakɛ bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne anu a, Nyamenle badwazo mɔwuamra, mɔɔ bɛnwu bieko ɛlɛ a, na bɛahakyi yɛ muala mɔɔ yɛha la.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa nwonane mɔɔ kpɔlɔ la kakyi yɛ mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ ɛlɛ la, na nwonane mɔɔ wu la kakyi yɛ mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ la a, ɛnee Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne bayɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Bɛzɛkye ewule! Bɛli ɔ nwo zo konim bɔkɔɔ!

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: Ewule, wɔ konimlilɛ ne wɔ ni? O, Ewule, wɔ bɔlɔ ne wɔ ni?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ewule bɔlɔ a le ɛtane, yɛɛ ɛtane tumi ne vi mɛla ne anu.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Na yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ ɔdua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo ɔmaa yɛdi konim a!

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, me mediema kulovolɛma, bɛgyinla kpundii kpalɛ. Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛbolo Awulae gyima ne ɛyɛlɛ nwo, na bɛnwu ye kɛ Awulae ati bɛ ɛvɛlɛ ɛnrɛyɛ gyɛne.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ fane ezukoa ne mɔɔ bɛwowɔ bɛahɔboa Nyamenle menli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya maanzinli nu la anwo la, bɛyɛ ye kɛ mɔɔ mengyehyɛle memanle asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Galeehyea maanzinli nu la.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Molɛ biala, bɛ nuhua ko biala ɛde ezukoa mɔɔ yenyia ye dapɛne ne anu la bie ɛdo ahane, na bɛva bɛzie, amaa saa meba a yeangyia kɛ bɛkɛwowɔ ezukoa.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Meba a mebahɛlɛ kɛlata meamaa bɛdabɛ bɛ menli mɔɔ bɛkɛdu bɛ la, na bɛava bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne bɛahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Na saa ɔhyia kɛ mekɔ bie noko a ɛnee bɛ nee me ahɔ. Pɔɔlo ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Saa mevi Masidonea a mebara bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ mekakpɔsa Masidonea maanzinli ne anu.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Wɔannea a mebali mekɛ ekyi anzɛɛ fɔsɛlɛ ne bɔbɔ wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, na akee bɛaboa me bɛamaa meazɔ me adendulɛ ne azo meahɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mekɔ la.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Mengulo kɛ menwu bɛ ala a ɛnee me gyakɛ gyi nu. Saa Awulae maa adenle a, me nye la kɛ me nee bɛ badɛnla ahyɛ ekyii.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Mebadɛnla Ɛfɛsɛse ɛke kɔkpula Pɛntekɔso Ɛvoyia ne.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Agbɔvolɛ zonle ɛke bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko gyima bedevinli bie mɔɔ anwo hyia la anye ɛrala ɛkɛ ne ɛmaa me kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ medi.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Saa Temɔte ba bɛ nwo lɔ a, bɛlie ye gyɛlɛɛnye bɛmaa ɔ nye ɛlie, ɔluakɛ ɔlɛyɛ Awulae gyima ne kɛmɔ melɛyɛ la.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa awie biala bu ye kɛ ɔle kakula na ye adwenle ɛtɛtinle, bɛboa ye bɛmaa ɔzɔ ye adendulɛ ne azo anzonudwolɛ nu, amaa yeanyia adenle yeazia yeara me nwo ɛke, ɔluakɛ me nye la ye nee mediema mɔɔ ɛha la ade.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Akee mɔɔ fane adiema Apɔlɔso anwo la, mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala mezuzu mehile ye kɛ ɔ nee mediema ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ bɛrakpɔla bɛ, noko ɔngulo kɛ ɔba kɛkala. Ɔnyia adenle a ɔbarakpɔla bɛ. Nrɛlaleɛlilɛ

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ diedi ne anu, bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ, bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Bɛva ɛhulolɛ bɛyɛ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛze kɛ Setɛfanase nee ye sua nu amra a lumuale liele Kelaese lile wɔ Akaya a, yɛɛ bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa kɛ bɛkɛzonle Nyamenle menli ne.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mebodo mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛli menli mɔɔ le zɛhae, nee awie biala mɔɔ nee bɛ yɛ gyima nee bɛ sonle la ngilehilelɛ zo.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Me nye ɛlie Setɛfanase nee Fɔtunatɛse nee Akeeyaekɛse ɛralɛ ne anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛdi gyima mɔɔ saa bɛdabɛ a bɛwɔ ɛke a anrɛɛ bɛkɛli la;

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛmaa me nye ɛlie, kɛmɔ bɛ nye liele la. Menli mɔɔ le zɛhae la anwo hyia, anrɛɛ bɛnlea bɛ boɛ.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea maanle ye anu la biza bɛ ahye. Mediema Akoyela nee Pelesela, nee asɔnema mɔɔ yia bɛ sua nu ɛkɛ ne la lɛ Awulae duma ne biza bɛ ahye kpalɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Mediema mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la biza bɛ ahye. Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo atuu.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo me sa anloa ɛne. Mebiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛngulo Awulae la, munzule ɛha ye. Yɛ Awulae, bɛla!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Awulae Gyisɛse ɛlolɛ ne nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Kelaese Gyisɛse ati me ɛhulolɛ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhulo ɛyɛ ye Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ la, nee yɛ diema Temɔte a ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye ahɔmaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole Kɔlente azo, nee Nyamenle menli ne amuala mɔɔ wɔ Akaya maanle ne kpokpoti anu la a.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Pɔɔlo yɛ Nyamenle mo

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛyɛ Nyamenle, yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ɔ Ze ne, anwunvɔnezelɛ Selɛ ne nee arɛlekyekyelɛ Nyamenle ne mo.

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔkyekye yɛ rɛle wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti anu na yɛdua ye arɛlekyekyelɛ ne azo yɛkyekye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛhyele bɛ wɔ ndenle ngakyile dɔɔnwo anu la arɛle.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛ nee Kelaese nwu ye amaneɛ ne mɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛ nee ye nyia ye arɛlekyekyelɛ ne mɔ a.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Saa yɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɛnee bɛ ngoanelielɛ nee bɛ arɛlekyekyelɛ ti ɔ; yɛɛ saa bɛkyekye yɛ rɛle a, ɛnee bɛkyekye bɛdabɛ noko bɛ rɛle, na bɛmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ, amaa bɛava abotane bɛagyinla amaneɛnwunlɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛgyi bie anwo la anloa.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Yemɔti yɛ nye la bɛ nwo zo ɛsesebɛ; yɛze kɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nee yɛ nwu yɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ nee yɛ nyia yɛ arɛlekyekyelɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ sa ka ye noko la a.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu kɛ yɛ nwo zile hyelele yɛ wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu la. Yɛ nwo hyelele yɛ kpole manle ɔbole yɛ nwo zo mɔɔ ɔhale yɛ nee ewule ala.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Yɛvale ye kɛ bɛbua yɛ ewule fɔlɛ bɛwie ala ɛne. Ɛhye zile amaa yɛdayɛ yɛanzi yɛ kɛnra, na yɛava yɛ nwo amuala yɛado Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazo mɔwuamra la anwo zo.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Ewule ɛzulolɛ zɛhae anu yɛɛ ɔyele yɛ ɔvile a, yɛɛ ɔkɛye yɛ nu somaa; yɛɛ eza yɛ rɛle wɔ ye nu kɛ ɔkɛye yɛ nu bieko,

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: ɔlua bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ti. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli dɔɔnwo bayɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ yɛ ti, kɛ ɔlua menli somaa nzɛlɛlɛ zo yelo yɛ ɛlolɛ kpole zɛhae a. Pɔɔlo kakyi ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛfa yɛtu yɛ nwo la a le ɛhye: yɛ ti kanrɛlɛ ne di daselɛ kɛ yɛlua Nyamenle nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ, nee Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne tumi zo yɛɛ yɛfa yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla wɔ ewiade ye anu a, bɔbɔ wɔ bɛ avinli, na tɛ ewiade nrɛlɛbɛ zo a yɛlua a.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Adwenle ɛhye a wɔ me ti anu ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ manle menlumuale mengyehyɛle kɛ mebarakpɔla bɛ, amaa bɛanyia nyilalɛ mɔnwo la.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menyɛle kɛ saa mese meahɔ Masidonea a mebamakyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, yɛɛ eza saa mevi Masidonea mesia meara a meamakyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne bieko, amaa bɛagua me adenle bɛamaa meahɔ Dwudiya.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Yemɔti ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ menyɛle la kile kɛ mele sonla mɔɔ meka a menyɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ meyɛ me ngyehyɛlɛ kɛ adalɛ sonla bie mɔɔ meka kɛ “ɛhɛe” a ɛnee mekile “kyɛkyɛ” ɔ?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Nyamenle le nɔhalɛ, na yɛkola yɛfa yɛ rɛle yɛwula ye nu la, me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ membɔle bɛ la ɛnle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ meka “ɛhɛe” a ɛnee mekile “kyɛkyɛ” a.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne, mɔɔ me nee Seleveenɛse nee Temɔte yɛbɔle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ ne nolo yɛhilele bɛ la, ɛnle “Ɛhɛe” nee “Kyɛkyɛ” sonla. Ɔle Nyamenle nu “Ɛhɛe”;

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ anu “Ɛhɛe” ne a. Ɛhye ati a yɛdua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛka “Amen” ne yɛwula Nyamenle anyunlunyia a.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɔdaye a ɔsi yɛ nee bɛdabɛ pi wɔ Kelaese ati a; Nyamenle ɔdaye mumua ne a yeye yɛ yezie ɛkɛ,

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: yeyɛ yɛ nzonlɛ yemaa ɔ nwo, na yeva ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne yewula yɛ ahonle nu kɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie ɔbava yeamaa yɛ la amuala anwo awoba a.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Nyamenle di daselɛ, yɛɛ ɔze me ti anu! Memkpondɛ kɛ mebɔ bɛ rɛle la ati yɛɛ menyɛle me adwenle kɛ menrɛra Kɔlente a.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ yɛkile bɛ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛdi la ɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛlɛ diedi ne anu kpundii. Yɛ nee bɛ a ɛlɛyɛ gyima ne a wɔ bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ ti.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Yemɔti menyɛle me adwenle kɛ menrɛra bɛ nwo lɔ bieko na meabɔ bɛ rɛle.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa mebɔ bɛ rɛle a, nwane a kɛlielie me nye a? Kyesɛ menli ko ne ala mɔɔ membɔle bɛ rɛle la ala.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ mengɛlɛle bɛ kɛlata ɛhendeɛ ne a, meangulo kɛ menwɔra na menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ kɛlielie me nye la abɔ me rɛle. Ɔluakɛ meze ye wienyi kɛ me nye die a, ɛnee bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nye ɛlie.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Menvale nyanelilɛ, arɛlebɔlɛ nee monle a mengɛlɛle bɛ a, amaa bɛanwu kɛ mesi mekulo bɛ la, na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mekulo kɛ mebɔ bɛ rɛle la ati ɔ. Sonla ne mɔɔ ɛvo la hyia fakyɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Saa awie ɛmaa arɛlebɔlɛ bie ɛra a, menwudu ye ɛdeɛ, noko tɛ me ngome a yebɔ me rɛle a, bɛ muala yɛɛ yebɔ bɛ rɛle a.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ bɔkɔɔ ɔmaa sonla zɔhane kɛ bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo ne ala ɛhwi ɔ nyunlu a.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛva ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛhyɛ ye na bɛkyekye ɔ rɛle, amaa yeanli nyane somasoma yeangyakyi diedi ne anu.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛmaa ɔnwu ye kɛ amgba bɛkulo ye.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Mengɛlɛle bɛ kɛlata ɛhendeɛ ne, amaa ɔlua zo meanwu kɛ bɛzile bɛgyinlanle sɔnea ne anloa la, na eza meanlea kɛ saa dahuu bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ azo a.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa awie anwo edwɛkɛ bɛkyɛ ye a, ɛnee medame noko meva mehyɛ ye. Saa ɔhyia kɛ mefa awie anwo edwɛkɛ mekyɛ ye a, meyɛ ye zɔhane wɔ bɛ ti wɔ Kelaese anyunlu,

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: amaa Seetan anli yɛ nwo zo konim, ɔluakɛ yɛze ye ndenle ne mɔ amuala. Pɔɔlo anwo andɛ ye wɔ Tulowase

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mendwule Tulowase kɛ mekabɔ Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne nolo la, menwunle kɛ Awulae ɛbuke adenle ɛmaa me kɛ menli gyima wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Noko me nwo andɛ me kpalɛ biala, ɔluakɛ meannwu me diema Taetɛse wɔ ɛkɛ. Yemɔti me nee ɛkɛ ne amra lile nrɛlaleɛ na mendoale zolɛ mengɔle Masidonea. Kelaese maa yɛdi konim

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ dahuu ɔfa yɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ Kelaese ɛhye yɛ nuokɛ na ɔfa yɛ ɔto Kelaese konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔne, na ɔdua yɛ nwo zo ɔmaa Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ ne wolowolo ɛleka biala kɛ debie evuanlɛ la.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ evuanlɛ mɔɔ maa ngoane la ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdie bɛ ngoane la, yɛɛ ɔbɔ nvoanle mɔɔ maa ewule la ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛminli la. Na nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhola gyima zɛhae yɛ a?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Yɛmɛ, yɛnle kɛ menli mɔɔ fa Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne si kongo la, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle a ɛzoa yɛ a, yɛɛ yɛgyinla ɔ nyunlu yɛtendɛ kɛ Kelaese sonvolɛma.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Asoo mɔɔ meha la eza kile kɛ yɛlɛtu yɛ nloa anu? Anzɛɛ ɔhyia kɛ yɛfa nganvolɛ kɛlata yɛbakile bɛ, anzɛɛ yɛdie bie wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ ne, kɛmɔ bie mɔ yɛ la ɔ?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛle yɛ nganvolɛ kɛlata mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu mɔɔ awie biala nwu ye na ɔkenga a.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Ɔla ali wienyi kɛ Kelaese ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔhɛlɛle kɛlata ɛhye na ɔvale ɔzoanle yɛ a. Yeanva “ɛnke” a ɔhɛlɛle a, yɛɛ yeangɛlɛ ye wɔ bolɛ zo, ɔhɛlɛle ye wɔ menli ahonle zo.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛka ɛhye, ɔluakɛ ɔlua Kelaese anwo zo yɛlɛ diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Yɛnlɛ debie biala wɔ yɛ nu mɔɔ maa yɛka kɛ yɛkola yɛyɛ gyima ɛhye a. Yɛ munlililɛ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ;

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: yemɔ yɛɛ yeyɛ yɛ Ngyekyeleɛ Fofolɛ ne sonvolɛma a. Ngyekyeleɛ Fofolɛ ɛhye ɛnle mɛla mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle a, ɔle Nyamenle Sunsum. Mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle la fa ewule ba, na Nyamenle Sunsum ne maa ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne lale ali wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle ye bolɛ zo la ɔlɛmaa Mosisi la. Na saa ɛnee Mosisi anyunlu ne mɔɔ dale la ɛlɛnu bɔbɔ a, mekɛ ne anu ɔdale kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ɛngola ɔ nyunlu nea a. Na saa mɛla ne mɔɔ zolɛ ɛlilɛ fa ewule ba la luale anyunlunyia zɛhae anu a rale a,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛzonlenlɛ ɛnrɛnyia anyunlunyia kpole kpalɛ ɛnrɛdɛla ɛhye ɛ?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Saa ɛzonlenlɛ mɔɔ maa bɛbu menli ewule fɔlɛ la yɛle anyunlunyia a, ɛnee Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛzonlenlɛ mɔɔ maa bɛbu menli benle la le anyunlunyia kpole kpalɛ mɔɔ bo zolɛ a!

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Yɛkola yɛka kɛ kɛmɔ kɛkala anyunlunyia ne le kpole kpalɛ la ati, yeheda dɛba ne anyunlunyia ɛdeɛ ne azo.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeanlu la lɛ anyunlunyia a, ɛnee mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu na ɔnnu ɛlɛ la anyunlunyia ɛdeɛ ne bo zolɛ.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛlɛ anyelazo ɛhye la ati, yɛtendɛ a yɛnzulo.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Yɛnle kɛ Mosisi mɔɔ vale ɛdanlɛ hedale ɔ nyunlu amaa Yizilayɛma annwu kɛ ɔ nyunlu ɛdalɛ ne ɛlɛnu la.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Bɛhedale bɛ adwenle zo amgba; ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ nee ɛnɛ ala, saa bɛlɛkenga Ngyekyeleɛ Dɛba ne a, ɔle kɛ asɛɛ ɛdanlɛ ko ne ala tɛkeda zolɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlua Kelaese angome anwo zo ala yɛɛ bɛkola bɛye ɛdanlɛ ne a.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Ɛhɛe, ɛnɛ bɔbɔ, saa bɛka kɛ bɛkenga Mosisi mɛla ne mɔ a, ɛnee ɔle kɛ ɛdanlɛ ne tɛkeda bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtie la adwenle zo.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na saa sonla twe bikye Awulae a, bɛkɛye ɛdanlɛ ne ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Awulae ne a le Nyamenle Sunsum ne, yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ Awulae Sunsum ne wɔ la, fanwodi wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛye yɛ muala yɛ nyunlu ndanlɛ ne mɔ a Awulae anyunlunyia ne bada alielie yɛ nyunlu. Anyunlunyia ɛhye mɔɔ vi Awulae, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛkɛ la ɛlɛkakyihakyi yɛ yeamaa yɛayɛ ye sɔhovolɛ wɔ anyunlunyia mɔɔ bo zolɛ la anu.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlolɛ nu ala yɛɛ yeva gyima ɛhye yewula yɛ sa nu a, zɔhane ati yɛ rɛle ɛmbɔ.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Yɛkpo awozinli nu nee anyiemgba nyɛleɛ muala; yɛmbɔ alane ɛbɛla, yɛɛ yɛmbɔ adalɛ wɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛhanlɛ nu yɛngakyi ye. Yɛlua nɔhalɛ wienyi ne anu yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ awie biala kɛnyia yɛ nwo adwenle kpalɛ.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Na saa edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ ye nolo la bɛheda zolɛ a, ɛnee bɛheda zolɛ bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛminli la ala.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Bɛnlie bɛnli, ɔluakɛ ɛtane ewiade ɛhye nyamenle ne ɛzi bɛ adwenle ne anye. Ɔmmaa bɛnnwu wienyi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛta fi Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese, mɔɔ le Nyamenle sɔhovolɛ kpalɛ ne anyunlunyia ne anwo la.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Yɛmbɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ ngome yɛ nwo nolo; yɛbɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo nolo kɛ ɔle Awulae, yɛɛ Gyisɛse ati yɛmɛ yɛle bɛmɛ bɛ sonvolɛma.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ zele kɛ, “Wienyi vi awozinli nu ɛda” la a le Nyamenle ko ne ala mɔɔ manle ye wienyi ne dale yɛ ahonle nu la, amaa yɛanwu Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛlɛta Kelaese anyunlu la.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Noko yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ Sunsum nu anwonyia ɛhye la yɛle kɛ mbuakɛ ala, amaa yeala ali kɛ tumi bedevinli ne le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, na ɔnle yɛ ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Ndenle dɔɔnwo anu bɛgyegye yɛ, na bɛngola bɛnzɛkye yɛ; bɛmaa yɛ adwenle nu yɛ kpomgbondee, noko yɛ agbɔkɛ nu ɛntuto;

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: bɛyɛ yɛ kpɔdekpɔde, noko yɛtɛkyianle agɔnwolɛ nwo ɛlɛ; yɛɛ ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie bɔbɔ a bɛbobɔ yɛ, noko yɛtɛwule.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Yɛ ngoane mekɛ nu amuala ewule sianle yɛ wɔ Kelaese ati, amaa menli anwu ye ngoane ne wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ɛhye ala anu.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ ewule di gyima wɔ yɛ nu, noko ngoane di gyima wɔ bɛmɛ bɛ nu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛ diedi ne le kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ se, “Mendendɛle, ɔluakɛ menliele menlile” la, yɛdayɛ noko yɛtendɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛdie yɛdi.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ dwazole Awulae Gyisɛse rale ngoane nu la badwazo yɛ aboka Gyisɛse anwo, na yeava yɛ nee bɛ yeahɔ ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala lua bɛmɛ bɛ ti, amaa mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛlɛtɛlɛ ahɔ menli dɔɔnwo anwo zo la, bɛava moyɛlɛ bɛawula Nyamenle anyunlunyia. Yɛde aze wɔ diedi nu

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati yɛmkpo aze. Saa yɛ nwonane ɛlɛwie bɔbɔ a, Nyamenle kakyi yɛ sunsum nu nwonane ne alehyenlɛ biala.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Nyane sikalɛ ekyi ɛhye mɔɔ yɛlɛnwu ye la bava anyunlunyia mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ na ɔle kpole kpalɛ ɔtɛla nyane ɛhye la arɛlɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛ nye ɛnla ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu bɛ la azo; yɛ nye la ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ la azo. Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu bɛ la ɛngyɛ na apɛ nu aze, na mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ saa bɛgolo yɛ nwonane sua ye mɔɔ yɛde nu la bɛgua aze kɛ ndanlɛ sua wɔ ewiade ye anu a, Nyamenle bamaa yɛ sua mɔɔ bɛanva ɛsalɛ bɛanzi, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu la wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Yɛsu yɛ kunlu, ɔluakɛ yɛkulo kɛ bɛfa yɛ anwuma nwonane sua ne bɛkpolo yɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ aze ɛke la,

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: amaa saa yɛfa yɛkpolo a bɛanwu kɛ yɛnlɛ yɛ nwo zɔ.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ yɛde ndanlɛ sua ɛhye anu la, yɛsu yɛ kunlu kpalɛ wɔ anwongyelelɛ nu; tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛkpa yɛ azɛlɛ ye azo ndanlɛ sua bɛvi yɛ nwo ɔ, na yemɔ a le kɛ, yɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛfa anwuma ndanlɛ sua ɛdeɛ fofolɛ ne bɛkpolo yɛ, amaa ngoane aheda mɔɔ wu la azo.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a ɛziezie yɛ ɛmaa ngakyile ɛhye a, na yeva ye Sunsum ne yeli ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbava yeamaa yɛ la anwo agyinlanu.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ dahuu. Yɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛde nwonane sua ɛhye anu ala la, ɛnee yɛ nee Awulae yɛ avinli twe.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛfa diedi a yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla a, na tɛ deɛ mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ nwu ye la ɔ.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛ akɛnrasesebɛ na yɛkɛhulo ye kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛvi nwonane sua ɛhye anu na yɛ nee Awulae kɛhɔdɛnla.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ hyia kpalɛ la a le kɛ, saa yɛwɔ yɛ sua nu ɛke o, anzɛɛ nehane o, yɛkɛzɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ muala yɛfinde Kelaese anyunlu na ɔbua yɛ ndɛne, amaa yɛ nuhua ko biala asa aha ahatualɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o, kɛmɔ ye ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔlua ye sonlabaka ye azo yebɔ la de la. Yɛdua Kelaese anwo zo yɛfa Nyamenle agɔnwolɛ

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛze kɛ Nyamenlezulolɛ si de la ati, yɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkɛmaa menli kɛzulo Nyamenle; na kɛ yɛmɛ yɛde la, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔze, yɛɛ meze kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wɔ bɛ adwenle nu.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ yɛkulo kɛ yɛkanvo yɛ nwo yɛkile bɛ bieko ɔ, na yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛva yɛ bɛkɛdu bɛ nwo, na bɛahola bɛanyia edwɛkɛ bɛaha bɛahile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa menli gyinlabelɛ a bɛtu bɛ nloa anu na bɛnva bɛ subane a bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Asoo yɛzɛ? Saa yɛzɛ a, ɛnee Nyamenle ati ɔ, yɛɛ saa yɛ adwenle la ɛkɛ ne a, ɛnee ɔla ɛkɛ ɔmaa bɛmɛ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne a sie yɛ a, ɔboalekɛ yɛdie yɛto nu kɛ sonla ko wule manle menli kɔsɔɔti, na ye zɔhane ati menli kɔsɔɔti ɛwu.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Ɔwule ɔmanle menli muala, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la andɛnla ammaa bɛ ngome bɛ nwo, na bɛadɛnla bɛamaa sonla ne mɔɔ bɛ ti a ɔwule na bɛdwazole ye bɛrale ngoane nu la.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la, yɛnnea awie biala anyunlu yɛmbua ndɛne. Saa mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la yɛbuale Kelaese ndɛne wɔ zɔhane adenle zo bɔbɔ a, ɛnɛ yɛnyɛ ye zɔhane bieko.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ le Kelaese ɛdeɛ la le abɔdeɛ fofolɛ; dɛba ne ɛpɛ nu ɛhɔ, fofolɛ ɛra.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a ɛyɛ ɛhye amuala a, na yelua Kelaese anwo zo yeyɛ yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ, yɛɛ yemaa yɛ gyima kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛhwe menli yɛrayɛ bɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a le kɛ, Nyamenle lua Kelaese anwo zo ɛlɛtwe menli muala ayɛ bɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ. Nyamenle ambu bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbonda antia bɛ na yeva edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ fane kɛ menli si yɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ la yewula yɛ sa nu.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Yɛle Kelaese agyakɛ anu gyinlavolɛma, na ɔlua yɛ nwo zo Nyamenle ɛlɛtu folɛ. Zɔhane ati yɛgyi Kelaese agyakɛ anu yɛbodo yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle adenle bɛmaa ɔhakyi bɛ kɛ bɛnle agbɔvolɛ na bɛle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kelaese anyɛ ɛtane, noko ɔlua yɛmɛ yɛ ti Nyamenle vale ye yɛle ɛtane mumua ne, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛanyia Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛ nee Kelaese bɔ nu yɛ gyima la, yɛbodo yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ sa ɛha ye la yɛ mgbane.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛdie mɔɔ Nyamenle se la; ɔse, “Mekɛ ne dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mese bɛ anwunvɔne la, mendiele bɛ. Mekɛ ne dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ medie bɛ ngoane la, memboale bɛ.” Bɛdie ɛ! Nyamenle ɛlolɛ mekɛ ne a le ɛnɛ. Ɛnɛ a le ngoanelielɛ kenle ne a.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Yɛmkpondɛ kɛ yɛtenda awie agyakɛ anu na awie anyia yɛ gyima ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane aha.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Wɔ yɛ nyɛleɛ biala anu yɛfa abotane yɛgyinla ngyegyelɛ, anwongyelelɛ nee abodelɛ biala anloa, yɛkile kɛ yɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Bɛbila yɛ mbaka, bɛgua yɛ efiade na bɛwudo yɛ bagua nu; bɛmaa yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ, yɛsi epe, yɛɛ bɛkye yɛ ɛhɔne.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Noko ɔlua yɛ anwondelɛ, nrɛlɛbɛ, abotane, atiakunlukpalɛ nee Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee yɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: yɛ nɔhalɛ nrɛlaleɛ ne, nee Nyamenle tumi ne azo yɛla yɛ nwo ali yɛhile kɛ yɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma. Pɛlepɛlelilɛ a le yɛ konle dadeɛ mɔɔ yɛfa yɛko na yɛfa yɛpepɛ yɛdie yɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Bɛdi yɛ eni yɛɛ bɛgua yɛ nyunlu aze; bɛbɔ yɛ aholoba yɛɛ bɛye yɛ ayɛlɛ. Bɛbu yɛ alanema, noko yɛdi nɔhalɛ;

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: bɛyɛ kɛ bɛnze yɛ, noko bɛ muala bɛze yɛ; bɛfa yɛ kɛ yɛwu bɔbɔ a, bɛnlea, yɛtɛte aze. Saa bɛtwi yɛ nyunlu a, bɛtɛkunle yɛ.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Saa bɛbɔ yɛ rɛle a, yɛ nye die yɛ nwo dahuu; ɔzɔho kɛ yɛle ehyianvolɛma, noko yɛyɛ menli dɔɔnwo sukoavolɛma; ɔzɔho kɛ yɛnlɛ bie, noko nɔhalɛ, yɛlɛ debie biala.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Me gɔnwo mɔ Kɔlentema! Yɛbuke yɛ munli nu a yɛlɛtendɛ yɛahile bɛ a.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Yɛnzi bɛ aze; saa azezilɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ a ɛnee ɔvi bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ kɛ metendɛ mekile me mra la. Yemɔti bɛbuke bɛ munli nu, kɛmɔ yɛyɛ yɛmaa bɛ la. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ wɔ bozonle ɛzonlenlɛma anwo

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Bɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie Kelaese bɛnli la mmatu. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na kpalɛ nee ɛtane adila agɔnwolɛ ɛ? Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na wienyi nee awozinli abɔ nu adɛnla ɛ?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Kelaese nee Abɔnsam anloa azɛ bɛ nwo ɛ? Duzu a diedinli nee bozonle ɛzonlenlɛnli lɛ ye yɛ a?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Duzu ngitanwo a wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ sua avinli a? Yɛle tease Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ sua! Kɛ ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne yeha la ɛne. Ɔse, “Mebabu me awuke wɔ me maanlema avinli na me nee bɛ adɛnla; Mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle na bɛayɛ me menli.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛ Awulae se la ɛne, “Bɛgyakyi bɛ na bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi bɛ nwo. Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka debie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la, na menwɔlie bɛ.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Mebayɛ bɛ ze, na bɛayɛ me mra mrenya nee mraalɛ, kɛ Tumivolɛ Awulae se la ɛne!”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ yɛ la ɛne. Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛwowo debie biala mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nwo mɔɔ gua yɛ sonlabaka ye anzɛɛ yɛ ɛkɛla ne mɔ anwo evinli la yɛgua, yɛzulo Nyamenle, na yɛmaa yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo ɛde bɔkɔɔ. Pɔɔlo di fɛlɛko

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Bɛbuke bɛ munli nu bɛmaa yɛ; yɛtɛyɛle awie biala ɛtane, yɛtɛsɛkyele awie biala, yɛɛ yɛtɛdile awie biala amile.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Menga ɛhye membu bɛ fɔlɛ, na kɛmɔ meha ye dɛba la, saa yɛde ngoane nu o, yɛwu o, yɛlɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ dahuu yɛle ko a.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Medie bɛ medi, mefa bɛ metu me nwo! Me nwo tɔ me, yɛɛ wɔ yɛ anwongyelelɛ muala anu medi fɛlɛko kpole.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛrale Masidonea la, yɛ nwo andɔ yɛ kpalɛ biala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkɛhɔ la yɛyia ngyegyelɛ; gua zo a, konle; sua nu a, ɛzulolɛ ngome.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Noko Nyamenle mɔɔ kyekye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ la arɛle la, luale Taetɛse ɛralɛ ne azo kyekyele yɛ rɛle,

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: yɛɛ tɛ ye ɛralɛ ne angome, na ye amaneɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔrabɔle mɔɔ fane kɛ bɛzile bɛkyekyele ɔ rɛle, bɛ nwo mɔɔ dɔ me, me nwo nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛdi, nee bɛ nye mɔɔ ɛbolo kɛ bɛpepɛ bɛalie me la ɛmaa kɛkala me nye ɛlie kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Na saa me kɛlata ne manle bɛ rɛle bɔle bɔbɔ a, menli nwolɛ nyane kɛ mengɛlɛle a. Noko akee menlile nyane wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwunle kɛ kɛlata ne ɛbɔ bɛ rɛle mekɛ ekyi bie la.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Kɛkala ɛdeɛ, medi fɛlɛko, tɛ kɛ membɔle bɛ rɛle la ati ɔ, na kɛ bɛ rɛle ɛbɔlɛ ne manle bɛnlunle bɛ nwo. Nyamenle luale bɛ rɛle ɛbɔlɛ ne azo lile gyima, yemɔti yɛanyɛ bɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ nyanelilɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ze nuhua la maa sonla nu ɔ nwo na ɔnyia ngoane, ɔmmaa ɔnvu ɔ nwo; ewiade ye anu nyanelilɛ maa ewule.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɛ rɛle ne mɔɔ bɔle la lile a: bɛ nye bolole edwɛkɛ ne anwo manle bɛhilele kɛ bɛ nwo ɛnle nu! Nea bɛ ɛya mɔɔ bɛvale, ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛ nu, bɛ nwo mɔɔ dɔ me kɛ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ mewɔ lɔ, bɛ nwo mɔɔ bɛyelele kɛ bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ, nee kɛ bɛzile bɛdeanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile ɛtane la. Adenle biala anu bɛyɛle bɛhilele kɛ bɛnli fɔlɛ fee wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, saa mengɛlɛle bɛ kɛlata ne a, ɛnee tɛ ahenle mɔɔ yɛle ɛtane ne la ati ɔ, anzɛɛ ahenle mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye ɛtane ne la ati ɔ; mengɛlɛle, amaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ me nwo la ala ali amaa bɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛ rɛle ɛkyekye. Tɛ yɛ rɛle mɔɔ ɛkyekye la angome, na yɛ nye liele kpole wɔ Taetɛse anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye, nee ɔ rɛle mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛboale bɛkyekyele la anwo.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Saa mendule me nloa anu mengilele ye wɔ bɛ nwo a, bɛangua me nyunlu aze. Debie biala anu yɛka nɔhalɛ ne yɛkile bɛ, na ɛhye ati yɛɛ yɛ nloa anu mɔɔ yɛdule yɛhilele Taetɛse la ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ a.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔlɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ kpole, na ɔkakye bɛ muala bɛ tieyɛ nee kɛ bɛzile bɛvale ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛyɛle ye akɔaba la.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Medi fɛlɛko kɛ mekola medie bɛ medi bɔkɔɔ a.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne ɛli wɔ asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea la anu la.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle sɔnea nu kpole wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo anu, noko bɛlile fɛlɛko kpole. Ɛnee bɛnlɛ bie suzuamgba ɛdeɛ, noko bɛluale bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu bɛvale ninyɛne bɛhyɛle, bɛhilele bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Medi daselɛ kɛ bɛmanle ahyɛlɛdeɛ, kɛmɔ bɛkɛhola ala la, na bɛboale bɔbɔ bɛmanle ɔbole zolɛ. Bɛvale ɛhulolɛ

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: bɛtinlinle zo bɛkpale yɛ kyɛlɛ kɛ yɛmaa bɛ adenle yɛmaa bɛboa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛhyianlɛ nu la.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Yɛ nye anla fee. Bɛlumuale bɛvale bɛ nwo bɛmanle Awulae, na akee ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo bɛava bɛ nwo bɛamaa yɛdayɛ noko.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛzɛlɛ Taetɛse mɔɔ lumuale bɔle gyima ɛhye abo la kɛ ɔrazɔ zolɛ wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ na ɔboa bɛ ɔmaa bɛwie ɛhulolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ɛhye.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ debie biala anu bɛdi munli, wɔ diedi nu, ɛdendɛlɛ nu, adwenlenubukelɛ nu, bɛ nye mɔɔ ɛkpota bɛ ti anwo kɛ bɛboa, nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ nwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛ nye la kɛ bɛkɛhile bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma noko wɔ ɛlolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ ɛhye anu bɛkɛmaa ɔkɛbo zolɛ a.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Mengyehyɛ mɛla memmaa bɛ. Melɛ moalɛ mɔɔ awie mɔ anye ɛbolo ɛlɛboa la menea kɛ bɛ ɛhulolɛ si to kɔ la.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ ne si de la; ɔle sukoavolɛ, noko ɔlua bɛ ti ɔyɛle ɔ nwo ehyianli, amaa yealua ye ehyia ne azo yeayɛ bɛ sukoavolɛma.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zo bɛli gyima ne bɛhɔ awieleɛ, amaa mɔdenle mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛhyehyɛle la awie kɛnlɛma kɛ bɛvale mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la bɛwiele gyima ne.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa ɔwɔ bɛ nuhua kɛ bɛkɛmaa debie a, ɛnee mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la azo a Nyamenle balua alie bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne a. Ɔnrɛnlea mɔɔ bɛnlɛ ye la azo ɔnrɛlie.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Menzoa bɛ adesoa kpole memmaa awie mɔ anwo ɛndɔ bɛ; na ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛnɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye dɔɔnwo la, bɛkɛboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ bie la, amaa mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛkɛhyia la menli mɔɔ lɛ bie dɔɔnwo la aboa bɛ. Ɔba ye zɛhae a ɛnee moalɛ ne ɛyɛ sɛsɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Sonla mɔɔ sesale bɛ dɔɔnwo la annyia bɛ molozo, yɛɛ sonla mɔɔ sesale ekyi la angyia.” Taetɛse nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo somaa kɛ yemaa Taetɛse noko ɛnyia ɛhulolɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ la, kɛ ɔba yearaboa bɛ a.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ yekponle mɔɔ yɛbizale ye la azo angome ɔ, na ɔlɛba bɛ nwo lɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔlɛtu ɔ ti anwo adenle la.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛsoa ye nee adiema ne mɔɔ asɔne ne mɔ amuala di ye eni wɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ nwo la.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Yeanga ye zɔhane, asɔnema ne ɛnlea nu ɛye ye na bɛyɛ ye kɛ ɔ nee yɛ ɛkpɔsa ɛyɛ ɛhulolɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye, yɛva yɛde Awulae anyunlu, na yɛhile kɛ yɛkulo kɛ yɛboa.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ awie ɛnrɛnyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane biala ɛnrɛha wɔ kɛ yɛsi yɛnea ahyɛlɛdeɛ kɛnlɛma ye azo la.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Debie titile mɔɔ gyi yɛ nye zo la a le kɛ yɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ tenrɛ wɔ Nyamenle nee menli nyunlu la.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Yemɔti yɛlɛsoa bɛ nee yɛ muala yɛ diema ne mɔɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala yɛzɔ ye yɛnlea na yɛnwu kɛ ɔkulo kɛ dahuu ɔboa la bɛ nwo lɔ. Kɛkala yelie bɛ yeli, yɛɛ yenyia ɛhulolɛ kpole kɛ ɔboa.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Taetɛse ɛdeɛ, ɔle me gɔnwo mɔɔ yɛbɔ nu yɛyɛ gyima yɛboa bɛ a; mediema mɔɔ nee ye ɛlɛba la gyigyi asɔne ne mɔ agyakɛ anu, yɛɛ bɛte Kelaese anyunlu.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛhile bɛ ɛhulolɛ, amaa asɔne ne mɔ ali nwolɛ daselɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ yɛanva bɛ yɛandu yɛ nwo mgbane.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔngyia biala kɛ menwɔhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ moalɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛkamaa Nyamenle menli ne la anwo.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa, yɛɛ meva bɛ medu me nloa anu mehile Masidoneama. Menganle kɛ, “Sumunli ɛkenle ɛvolɛ ne yɛɛ mediema mɔɔ wɔ Akaya maanzinli nu la boɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛboa a.” Zɛhae mɔdenlebɔlɛ ne ɛmaa menli dɔɔnwo ne ala akee anye ɛbolo.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Kɛkala melɛsoa mediema ɛhye mɔ, amaa yɛ nloa anu mɔɔ yɛvale bɛ yɛdule wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo la anyɛ mgbane, na kɛmɔ menganle la bɛaboɔboa bɛ nwo pɛneko.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Yeamba ye zɔ na saa Masidoneama bie mɔ nee me ba na bɛbanwu kɛ bɛtɛboɔboale bɛ nwo a, yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛ nyunlu bagua aze kpole kɛ yɛvale yɛ nye yɛdole bɛ nwo zo a.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati medwenle nwolɛ kɛ ɔhyia kɛ metu mediema ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛlumua me nyunlu wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, na bɛaboɔboa ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la anloa bɛado ɛkɛ, amaa saa meba a yeanyɛ kɛ asɛɛ awie yɛɛ ɛhye bɛ mialeranu kɛ bɛyɛ a, na bɛdabɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa la ati ɔ.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Bɛhakye ɛhye: sonla mɔɔ dua ma ekyi la bu ekyi, yɛɛ mɔɔ dua dɔɔnwo la bu dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛva mɔɔ yezuzu nwo wɔ ye ahonle nu la ɛmaa. Ɔmmatwenlehwenle ɔ bo aze anzɛɛ ɔyɛ ye kɛ asɛɛ yemia la ati ɔ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle kulo sonla mɔɔ te ɔ nyunlu kyɛ debie la.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kola maa bɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la maa ɔbo zolɛ, amaa dahuu bɛanyia mɔɔ sa bɛ la na bɛava bie bɛayɛ nyele.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔ sa dwu ehyianvolɛma anwo zo, ye atiakunlukpalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ maa ɛyazonlɛnli ma maa ɔdua na ɔmaa ye aleɛ ɔdi la, kɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu ma mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la dɔɔnwo bɛkɛlua, na bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ bɛyɔba ne azo dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Wɔ debie biala anu, Nyamenle bamaa bɛanyia bie, amaa bɛ ti akunlu ayɛ kɛnlɛma na menli dɔɔnwo ayɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ ɔlua yɛ nwo zo bɛnyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ bɛvi bɛ ɛkɛ ne a.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye ɛmmaa Nyamenle menli ne ɛnnyia mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la angome, na eza ɔmaa menli buke bɛ ahonle nu yɛ Nyamenle mo.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ɛhye kile bɛ diedi mɔɔ bɛlɛ la. Ɔlua zo menli dɔɔnwo ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ bɛdi Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛlie bɛdo bɛ nwo zo la azo, na bɛ nee awie biala kyɛ nyilalɛ mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛbava anwolɔlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ bɛazɛlɛ bɛamaa bɛ wɔ ɛlolɛ molozo ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo bɛ la ati.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ ye nwanwane ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛse mewɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a menle awie, na saa menle bɛ nwo lɔ a, ɛnee me nloa yɛ se wɔ bɛ nwo. Kelaese ati, melɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma mebodo bɛ,

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: bɛmmayɛ bɛmaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ a me nee bɛ bie badi ye ɛsesebɛ, ɔboalekɛ medie me nwo medi kɛ mekola mekile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse yɛfa ewiade adwenle a yɛbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla la kɛ meyɛ se.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ yɛde ewiade ye anu ɛdeɛ, noko tɛ ewiade ye konle a yɛlɛko a.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Tɛ ewiade konle ninyɛne a yɛfa yɛko a; Nyamenle konle ninyɛne mɔɔ tumi wɔ nu la a yɛfa yɛbubu aranemgbole ne mɔ a. Yɛsɛkye kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane;

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: yɛgologolo debie biala mɔɔ bɛkɛmaa ye zo adubɛnwo nu bɛkɛtia Nyamenle anwo adwenlenubukelɛ la, yɛɛ yɛkye adwenle biala nuokɛ yɛbele ye yɛmaa ɔtie Kelaese.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Na saa akee bɛkile kɛ bɛva bɛ nwo bɛmaa Kelaese bɔkɔɔ a, yɛadua awie biala mɔɔ anwo yɛ se la kakɛ wɔ ye nyɛleɛ nwo.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ bɛnlea ye boɛ na bɛabua. Awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbu ɔ nwo kɛ ɔle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛmaa ɔdwenle nwolɛ ɔhakye kɛ saa ɔle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee yɛdayɛ noko yɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Ɔnyɛ me nyiane kɛ metu me nwo somaa wɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa yɛ la anwo a, ɔluakɛ Awulae anva ammaa yɛ kɛ yɛva yɛzɛkye bɛ, ɔse yɛva yɛnlea yɛmaa bɛkpazi.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
