translation_verse: Mengulo kɛ ɔyɛ kɛ asɛɛ mefa me ngɛlata ne mɔ meanwunlonwunla bɛ.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bie baha kɛ, “Pɔɔlo yɛ se wɔ ngɛlata zo, na saa ɔwɔ ɛke a, ɔnle awie, yɛɛ ye edwɛkɛ ɛngyinla kpɔkɛ zo!”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa menli zɔhane mɔ ɛde ɔ bo kɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ ye wɔ ngɛlata ne mɔ anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛnle bɛ nwo lɔ la, yemɔ ala yɛɛ anrɛɛ yɛkɛha wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la a.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Yɛnzi yɛ kɛnra yɛmbu yɛ nwo bie anzɛɛ yɛnva yɛ nwo yɛndo menli mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛkanvo bɛ nwo la anwo. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto awie mɔ anwo, na bɛnea awie mɔ bɛfa bɛ bɛto bɛ nwo la ɛnze nrɛlɛbɛ.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ, yɛnrɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo yɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛbo zolɛ. Yɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo a, yɛmemaa ye wɔ gyima ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie yɛ nyunlu la anwo, kɛ yɛrali ye gyima wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Yɛdayɛ a yɛlumuale yɛvale Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ a, yemɔti saa yɛfa bɛ yɛtu yɛ nwo a, ɛnee yɛtɛyɛle yɛtɛmanle ɔtɛbole zolɛ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Yɛnva awie mɔ gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ Nyamenle anva ammaa yɛ la yɛndu yɛ nwo. Yɛ nye la kɛ saa bɛ diedi nyi a yɛɛ yɛ gyimayɛlɛ ne badɛlɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ bɛ avinli a,

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: amaa yɛahola yɛahɔbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo wɔ maanle maanle fofolɛ zo na yɛanva awie gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ ye dɛba la yɛandu yɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo la ɛyɛ ye zɔ wɔ debie mɔɔ Awulae ɛyɛ la anwo.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ tɛ sonla mɔɔ kanvo ɔ ngome ɔ nwo la a sɔ Nyamenle anye a, na sonla mɔɔ Awulae kanvo ye la a sɔ Nyamenle anye a.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ saa mele kɔnwɔne bɔbɔ a, bɛkɛva me zɔ. Mebodo bɛ, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane.

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Metwe bɛ nwo nungule, kɛmɔ Nyamenle yɛ ye ala la. Bɛle kɛ bɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze nrenya mɔɔ meyia ye kɛ megya ye meamaa nrenya kokye, Kelaese mumua ne.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Noko mesulo kɛ, kɛmɔ ɛwɔlɛ ne vale adalɛ nrɛlɛbɛ bɛlɛbɛlale Yivi la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbazɛkye bɛ adwenle a, amaa bɛahwe bɛ nwo bɛavi Kelaese ɛzonlenlɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ di munli la anwo.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ nye die awie biala mɔɔ ba bɛ nwo nehane na ɔbabɔ Gyisɛse fofolɛ bie, mɔɔ tɛ yemɔ a ɔle Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ yɛbɔle ye nolo yɛhilele bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ la anwo. Eza bɛdie sunsum nee edwɛkpa bie mɔɔ asolo bɛ na tɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛvile yɛ lɔ la bɛto nu.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Menlie menli kɛ bɛ “ɛzoanvolɛma kpalɛ” ne mɔ tɛla me.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Saa me nloa yɛɛ ɛtɛtele bɔbɔ a, tɛ nwoma nu ɔ; yɛɛ yɛla ɛhye ali wienyi yɛhile bɛ wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo nee debie biala anu.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Yemɔti kɛmɔ membɔle Nyamenle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛ mɔɔ meanlie bɛ ɛhwee, na menganle me nwo aze, amaa meamaa bɛ zo la, se ɛnee me ɛtane mɔɔ meyɛ la ɛne?

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ de la, saa mekyia a mengyegye bɛ kɛ bɛboa me; mediema mɔɔ vi Masidonea rale la a rɛlɛle me debie biala mɔɔ mengyianle nwolɛ la a. Na kɛmɔ meanyɛ ye dɛba la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ menrɛva kpomgbolo biala menrɛkpolo bɛ kɔme a.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Meka Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ me nu la kɛ, me nwo ɛdulɛ ɛhye awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛdua me wɔ ɛleka biala wɔ Akaya maanzinli ye anu!

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Duzu ati a melɛka ɛhye a? Mengulo bɛ edwɛkɛ ɔ? Nyamenle ze kɛ mekulo bɛ.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Mebahɔ zolɛ meayɛ mɔɔ melɛyɛ ye kɛkala la, amaa ɛzoanvolɛma zɔhane mɔ annyia kpɔkɛ angyinla zolɛ andu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima, kɛmɔ yɛyɛ ye la.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ le ɛzoanvolɛma alane mɔɔ adalɛ gyima a bɛyɛ a; bɛhakyi bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma!

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyɛ nwanwane. Seetan bɔbɔ kola kakyi ɔ nwo yɛ kɛ ɔle wienyi nu soanvolɛ.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔnyɛ ɛzulolɛ kɛ Seetan sonvolɛma kɛhakyi bɛ nwo kɛ bɛle Nyamenle sonvolɛma kpalɛ a. Bɛbanyia ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo ahatualɛ mɔɔ fɛta la wɔ awieleɛ ne. Ɛzoanvolɛ Pɔɔlo anwubɛnyunlu

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Mesi zolɛ bieko: bɛ nuhua biala mmadwenle kɛ mele kɔnwɔne; na saa bɛbu me zɔhane bɔbɔ a, ɛnee eza noko bɛlie me kɛ kɔnwɔne, amaa meanyia bie meadu me nwo ekyii.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ melɛka ye kɛkala la ɛnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ melua Awulae Tumi zo a melɛka a, ɔluakɛ melɛtendɛ adubɛnwo nu kɛ mele kɔnwɔne.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ dɔɔnwo ne ala fa ewiade ye anu ninyɛne tu bɛ nwo la, medame noko metu me nwo bie.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ bɛdabɛ, bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ somasoma ti, bɛ nye die kɔnwɔnema anwo.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye die awie biala mɔɔ yɛ bɛ kɛ ahanra, awie mɔɔ sisi bɛ, awie mɔɔ tu ɔ nloa anu na ɔkpakyekpakye bɛ nye zo la anwo.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me nyiane kɛ melɛka kɛ yɛyɛle foanvoanle na yɛangola ɛhye mɔ bie yɛ a. Na saa awie kola fa debie tu ɔ nwo a ɛnee kɛmɔ melɛtendɛ kɛ kɔnwɔne la, medame noko mekola bie yɛ.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Saa bɛle Hibuluma a, medame mele Hibulunli. Saa bɛle Yizilayɛma a, medame mele Yizilayɛnli. Saa bɛle Ebileham nlɔnra a, medame mele Ebileham anlɔnra.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Saa bɛle Kelaese sonvolɛma a, ɛnee ɔkɛyɛ kɛ mezɛ bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko mele sonvolɛ kpalɛ metɛla bɛ. Meyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ, mela efiade fane dɔɔnwo medɛla bɛ, bɛbila me empele fane kɛyɛ nyɛ, yɛɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, ɔhale me nee ewule.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Dwuuma ɛbila me mbaka abulasa nee ngɔnla ne fane nnu.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Wulomuma ɛbila me empele fane nsa; bɛzi me awolɛ ko, mebutu nyevile nu fane nsa, yɛɛ meminli nyevile nye ko dɔnehwele abulanwiɔ nee nna.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Wɔ me adendulɛ dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anu, meyia esiane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ azuyilɛ, ahɔdiawu, yɛɛ medame me gɔnwo mɔ Dwuuma, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la asa anu esiane; meyia azua mgbole zo esiane, esiane wɔ fienemgbole nu, yɛɛ meyia agɔnwolɛma adalɛ asa anu esiane.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Meli gyima nee mgbelera dɔɔnwo; aleɛ dwo a nafelɛ ɛngɔ me nye zo; ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne ku me; mekye ɛhɔne, ɛyɛlɛ ku me yɛɛ melɛ me nwo zɔ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Yeanga ɛhye mɔ angome, asɔne asɔne ne mɔ anwo adwenleadwenle le adesoa kpole mɔɔ mezo ye dahuu a.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Saa awie yɛ bɛtɛɛ a, ɛnee medame me nwo ɛgolo me; yɛɛ saa bɛtwe awie bɛkɔ ɛtane nu a, ɛnee me kunlu yelɛyela me.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Saa ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo a, menwɔyɛ ye zɔhane wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele bɛtɛɛ la anwo.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Nyamenle mɔɔ le Awulae Gyisɛse ɔ Ze ne, yemɔ yɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛha ye duma ne dahuu a, ɔluakɛ ɔze kɛ membɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ mewɔ Dɛmasekɛse la, Belemgbunli Alɛtase amɛnlado ne vale sinzavolɛma gyinlegyinlanle suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa kɛ bɛhye me.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Na bɛdɛnlanle me kɛndɛne nu bɛwulale me suakpole ne bane ne tokule ne mɔ bie anu bɛdwulale me aze, na menvile ɔ sa.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo, saa nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ bɔbɔ a, ɔwɔ kɛ metu me nwo. Noko meka ninyɛne mɔɔ Awulae ɛlolɛ zo yemaa menwu bɛ nee mɔɔ yeye yehile me la.

english_verse: I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven
translation_verse: Meze Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ bie mɔɔ ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma wɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ la;

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Ye fane nsa mɔɔ meboɔboa me nwo kɛ mebakpɔla bɛ la ɛne; saa meba a menrɛrakpolo bɛ kɔme, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne a mekpondɛ bɛ a, na tɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la ɔ. Tɛ mralɛ a kpondɛ sie awovolɛma a, awovolɛma a kpondɛ sie mralɛ a.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meze la a le kɛ bɛvale nrenya ɛhye bɛhɔle Paladaese,

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔdele edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka a ɔnga, yɛɛ dasanli biala ɛnlɛ nwolɛ adenle kɛ ɔkɛha a.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Sonla zɛhae ati yɛɛ metu me nwo a, na ɔhale medame me ngome a, anrɛɛ menrɛdu me nwo ɛlɛ, kyesɛ wɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele bɛtɛɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Saa mekulo kɛ metu me nwo a anrɛɛ menle kɔnwɔne wɔ nwolɛ, ɔluakɛ menwɔha nɔhalɛ ne. Noko menrɛdu me nwo, ɔboalekɛ memkpondɛ kɛ awie bu me bie maa ɔtɛla mɔɔ yenwu kɛ meyɛ nee mɔɔ yede kɛ meka la, anwo.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Amaa me ti anu anyɛ me fɛ na meadu me nwo wɔ nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me la anwo la, bɛwulale debie me nwonane ye anu, Seetan soanvolɛ bie ɔ, ɔgyegye me na ɔbɛlɛ me aze, amaa meandu me nwo.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati menzɛlɛle Nyamenle fane nsa wɔ ɛhye anwo kɛ ɔye zɔhane ewule ne me nwo.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Na ɔbuale me kɛ, “Me ɛlolɛ ne le kpalɛ maa wɔ, ɔluakɛ me tumi ne anu yɛ se maa wɔ kpalɛ kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ la.” Yemɔti medi fɛlɛko kpole kpalɛ na metu me nwo wɔ me bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nwo, amaa Kelaese tumi ne aheda me nwo zo.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Kelaese ati, me kunlu dwo me nwo wɔ me bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ, ngyegyelɛ, kpɔdekpɔdeyɛlɛ, yɛɛ munzule nu, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ menwɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ la ɛnee me nwo ɛyɛ se kpalɛ. Kɔlentema anwo hyia Pɔɔlo

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Se bɛnwu kɛ meyɛ kɔnwɔne, noko bɛdabɛ a bɛmaa meyɛ a. Bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie me bɛto nuhua a, ɔluakɛ saa mendo awie biala bɔbɔ a, bɛ “ɛzoanvolɛma zɔhane mɔ” ɛndɛla me wɔ adenle biala anu.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Menvale abotane kpole a menyɛle ninyɛne mɔɔ kile kɛ mele ɛzoanvolɛ la wɔ bɛ nu a; bɛnwunle sɛkɛlɛneɛ nee nwanwane ninyɛne nee gyima mɔɔ kile Nyamenle tumi ne la amuala.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Saa ɛye kɛ meangakyi kpomgbolo meamkpolo bɛ kɔme la ɛsie ahane a, ɛnee duzu debie kpalɛ a bɛyɛle bɛmanle asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ bɛanyɛ bɛammaa bɛmɛ a? Saa mevo bɛ wɔ ɛhye anu a, ɛnee bɛva bɛhyɛ me.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Ɔkɛyɛ me kɛnlɛma kɛ menwɔva mɔɔ melɛ la amuala, nee medame me sonlabaka ne menwɔboa bɛ. Na saa mekulo bɛ edwɛkɛ kpole zɛhae a, ɛnee kɛmɔti yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛngulo me edwɛkɛ fee ɛ?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ meanyɛ kpomgbolo meamkpolo bɛ kɔme, noko bɛmɛ bɛse mele kɛdɛba, na menvale mɛlɛbɛla a mengyele bɛ a.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Asoo menluale menli mɔɔ menzoanle bɛ la bie anwo zo mensisile bɛ?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Menzɛlɛle Taetɛse, na menzoanle ye nee adiema nrenya ko wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, na ɛnee Taetɛse a rasisile bɛ a? Asoo ɔ nee me yɛ adwenle anyɛ ko, yɛɛ yɛmbɔ yɛ ɛbɛla ko?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Wɔannea a bɛkɛdwenle kɛ yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛaza yɛ ne wɔ bɛ nyunlu. Ɔnle zɔhane fee! Yɛtendɛ, kɛmɔ Kelaese kulo kɛ yɛtendɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu la. Ayi mɔ, debie biala mɔɔ yɛyɛ la, bɛdabɛ bɛ kpalɛ ti ɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Mesulo ɔ nzi kɛ meba a menwɔrado bɛ wɔ adenle bie anu mɔɔ menrɛhulo a, anzɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛkɛnwu me wɔ adenle bie anu mɔɔ bɛnrɛhulo a. Mesulo kɛ mebarado bɛ nee butulelilɛ, nungule ɛhwenlɛ, ɛya mgbole ɛvalɛ, angomedi, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ, nzekuebɔlɛ, mgbanyizonle ɛyɛlɛ, yɛɛ basabasayɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me kɛ meba bieko a me Nyamenle ne baha me aze wɔ bɛ nyunlu, na meazu meagua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle ɛtane na bɛtɛnunle bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane mɔɔ anwo ɛnde, nee adwɔmanebɔlɛ nwo la ati zo.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye a tɔ zolɛ fane nsa mɔɔ melɛba mearakpɔla bɛ a. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ menli nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa foa ɛzonle biala mɔɔ bɛkɛdo awie la azo di daselɛ.”

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Mekakye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛtane dɛba, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la amuala kɛ, meha ye dɛba wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ membamkpɔlale bɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, yɛɛ melɛka ye bieko kɛkala mɔɔ menle bɛ nwo lɔ la kɛ, saa meba a bɛ nuhua biala mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɛtane la ɛnrɛva ɔ nwo dwɔɔ.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Bɛkɛnwu kɛ amgba Kelaese dua me nwo zo tendɛ. Ɔ nee bɛ bali ye ɛsesebɛ na bɛanwu kɛ ɔnle bɛtɛɛ na ɔlɛ tumi.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Na saa ɔyɛle bɛtɛɛ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo bɔbɔ a, ɔlua Nyamenle tumi zo ɔde ngoane nu. Yɛdayɛ noko yɛle bɛtɛɛ wɔ Kelaese ati, na ɔlua Nyamenle tumi ne azo yɛ nee ye badɛnla na yɛ nee bɛ ali.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Bɛnleɛnlea bɛ ahonle nu, na bɛnlea kɛ bɛtɛdɛ bɛ diedi ne anu. Bɛzɔ bɛ nwo bɛnlea; asoo bɛnnwu kɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse wɔ bɛ nu? Ɛnee kyesɛ bɛangola sɔnea ne anloa gyinla.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Me nye la kɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛnle menli mɔɔ ɛkpo aze a.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ bɛnrɛyɛ ɛtane, tɛ kɛ amaa bɛanwu kɛ yɛho yɛdɔ zolɛ ɔ, na amaa yɛmɛ, saa ɔzɔho kɛ yɛkpo aze bɔbɔ a, bɛmɛ bɛayɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Yɛngola yɛnyɛ debie biala yɛntia nɔhalɛ ne. Mɔɔ yɛkola ye yɛ la, yɛyɛ yɛboa nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Yɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ bɛkɛyɛ se na yɛmɛ yɛkɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛli munli.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ kɛmɔ menle bɛ nwo lɔ la, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ kɛlata ɛhye a, amaa saa meba a me nee bɛ anli ye ɛsesebɛ, kɛmɔ tumi ne mɔɔ Awulae ɛva ɛmaa me la de la. Bɛ boɛyɛlɛ ti yɛɛ bɛvale tumi ne bɛmanle me a, na tɛ bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ ti ɔ.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Mediema, akee mewie, mebiza bɛ ahye. Bɛhakyi bɛ subane; bɛli me folɛdulɛ ne mɔ azo, bɛmaa bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo na bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. Na ɛhulolɛ nee anzonudwolɛ Nyamenle ne nee bɛ badɛnla.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Bɛva mediema ɛhulolɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo atuu. Nyamenle menli ne kɔsɔɔti biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ ne, Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne, nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ ne nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse Kelaese wule manle yɛ, ɔliele yɛ ɔvile yɛ ɛtane nu, amaa yeaye yɛ yeavi munzule mekɛ ɛhye anu; ɔyɛle ɛhye, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Anyunlunyia ɛha Nyamenle dahuu! Amen. Edwɛkpa ne le kokye

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me azibɛnwo kɛ kɛkala angome bɛlɛnriandi bɛavi Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese ati yelo bɛ na yevɛlɛ bɛ la anwo bɛahɔli edwɛkpa fofolɛ nzi a.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, Edwɛkpa fofolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, kɛ mɔɔ meha mehile bɛ la ala. Menwu kɛ awie mɔ ɛlɛgyegye bɛ azɛkye bɛ adwenle, na bɛahakyi Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Noko awie biala, saa yɛdayɛ o anzɛɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma o, mɔɔ bɔ edwɛkpa gyɛne bie nolo ahile bɛ atia mɔɔ yɛha yɛhile bɛ dɛba la, munzule ɛha ye.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Yɛha, na eza mesi zolɛ bieko kɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛbɔ edwɛkpa gyɛne bie nolo kɛhile bɛ kɛtia mɔɔ bɛde na bɛlie bɛli la, munzule ɛha ye.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɔyɛ bɛ kɛ kɛkala akee mekpondɛ menli nganvolɛ, anzɛɛ Nyamenle nganvolɛ ɔ? Anzɛɛ mekpondɛ me nyunlu wɔ menli nu ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ! Saa mekpondɛ me nyunlu wɔ menli nu a, ɛnee menle Kelaese akɛlɛ. Kɛ Pɔɔlo zile yɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, mekakye bɛ adwenle kɛ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la ɛnvi sonla ɛkɛ.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Meanlie meanvi awie lɔ, yɛɛ tɛ awie a hilehilele me a. Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne a yele hilele me a.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛde mɔɔ menyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee meli Dwuuma Nyamenlezonlenlɛ maamɛla ne anzi la. Menyɛle Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde memanle ɔbole zolɛ na membɔle mɔdenle kɛ megu asɔne ne.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Wɔ me tipɛne ne mɔ anu, biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ nee me sɛ wɔ Dwuuma maamɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ nu a, yɛɛ eza me nye bolo yɛ nlenya mɔ ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgyakyile yɛ la anwo ɛsesebɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: ɔyele ɔ ra ne ɔhilele me kɛ akee menga Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala mɔɔ ɛtɛtele la, meangɔmbiza sonla biala adwenle,

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: yɛɛ meangɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔbɔ kɛ mekanwu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma mɔɔ bɛli me nyunlu la. Ɛleka mɔɔ mengɔle la a le Areleebea, yɛɛ nzinlii menziale membale Dɛmasekɛse a.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ nsa anzi yɛɛ akee mengɔle Gyɛlusalɛm mengɔnlile dapɛne nwiɔ mengɔmkpɔlale Pita a.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Meangɔnwu ɛzoanvolɛ gyɛne bieko kɛ Gyemise mɔɔ le Awulae adiema nrenya ne ala.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Nzinlii mengɔle akpɔsa wɔ Selea nee Selesea maanzinli ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Dwudiya la biala ɛnze me.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛze la a le mɔɔ awie mɔ ɛha na bɛde wɔ me nwo la kɛ, “Sonla ne mɔɔ yɛle yɛ kpɔdekpɔde kɛ ɔsɛkye Keleseɛn ɛzonlenlɛ ne la a ɛnɛ ɛlɛbɔ diedi ko ne ala nolo yeahile maanlema kɛ bɛlie Gyisɛse bɛli la!”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Na ɔlua me ti bɛyele Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna pɛle nu la me nee Banabase yɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm bieko. Menvale Taetɛse membokale yɛ nwo yɛhɔle.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Mengɔle, ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛye ɛhile me kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mekɔ. Mengɔndwule la me nee mgbanyima ne mɔ yiale nu ahane na mengilehilele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo mekile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu mengilele bɛ, amaa gyima ɛhye mɔɔ melɛyɛ nee mɔɔ meyɛ ye dɛba la anyɛ gyɛne.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Na Taetɛse bɔbɔ mɔɔ le Gilikinli na ɔ nee yɛ a hɔle la, bɛanga kɛ ɔyɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Ɛnee adalɛma bie mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi la ɛpele ɛpe adenle bie azo ɛra ayia ne bie. Menli ɛhye mɔ rale kɛ bɛbanlea kɛ yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛdi la yɛ nwo ɛzi ɛdɔ yɛ la. Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛmaa yɛazia yɛayɛ ahanra wɔ Dwuuma mɛla ne abo,

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: na yɛammaa bɛ adenle fee, amaa yɛazie nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Edwɛkpa ne anwo, kɛmɔ kɛkala ɔde la gyɛlɛɛnye yɛamaa bɛ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Mengilehilele Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la anu menwiele la, menli zɛhae mɔ, mɔɔ bɛse bɛle mgbanyima la anga kɛ debie bieko wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ a. Bɛle duzu menli bɔbɔ a, ɔnvane me nwo, ɔboalekɛ menli kɔsɔɔti sɛ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la a le kɛ amgba Nyamenle ɛva ye Edwɛkpa ne ɛwula me nloa na yezoa me kɛ membɔ ye nolo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, kɛmɔ yeva yewula Pita anloa kɛ ɔbɔ ye nolo ɔhile Dwuuma la.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bɛnwunle ye wienyi kɛ Nyamenle ko ne ala mɔɔ manle Pita rayɛle ɛzoanvolɛ wɔ Dwuuma ati la, ye ko ne ala yɛɛ ɛyɛ me ye ɛzoanvolɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la a.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Gyemise, Pita, yɛɛ Dwɔn mɔɔ diedima ne bu bɛ kɛ bɛle mgbanyima la liele dole nu kɛ, nɔhalɛ, mame a Nyamenle ɛva ɛlolɛ gyima ɛhye ɛwula me sa nu a. Yemɔti bɛzomanle me nee Banabase, bɛyɛle yɛ mo nee yɛ, bɛhilele kɛ bɛlie yɛ bɛdo nu. Akee yɛ muala yɛliele yɛdole nu kɛ yɛmɛ yɛhɔbɔ nolo ne wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la anu na bɛdabɛ noko bɛhɔ Dwuuma anu.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛzele yɛ la a le kɛ anrɛɛ yɛhakye na yɛboa mediema mɔɔ le ehyianvolɛma la, na ɛhye a le debie titile mɔɔ me nye bolole nwolɛ kɛ meyɛ a. Pɔɔlo hwile Pita anyunlu wɔ Anteɔko

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ Pita rale Anteɔko la, ɔmanle mendwile ɔ nyunlu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee mɔɔ ɔlɛyɛ la ɛnle kpalɛ.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Mediema Dwuuma mɔɔ ɔradole bɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛle bɛ nwo avoanvoanle kɛ Pita la, bɛmanle Banabase bɔbɔ ɔdaye ɔbɔle bɛ foanvoanle ɛbɛla ɛhye bie.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ bɛnlua nɔhalɛ adenle ne azo, kɛmɔ Edwɛkpa ne kile la, menzele Pita wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ, “Ɛle Dwuunli, noko wɔ ɛbɛla ne ɛngile kɛ ɛle Dwuunli. Na duzu ati a akee ɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛkakyi bɛyɛ Dwuuma mgbemgbene nu ɛ?” Diedi a die Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ngoane a

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bɛwole yɛ Dwuuma, na yɛnle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ, tɛ mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ yɛɛ maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye a, kyesɛ yɛdie Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛdi kolaa na yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye. Yɛdayɛ bɔbɔ, yɛliele Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛlile kolaa na Nyamenle alua zolɛ yeamaa yɛazɔ ɔ nye, na tɛ mɛla ne mɔɔ yɛlile zolɛ la ati ɔ. Ɔluakɛ sonla biala mɔɔ di mɛla ne azo la ɛnrɛzɔ Nyamenle anye ɛlɛ.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Saa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛali na yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye la eza yɛdi fɔlɛ a, se ɛnee Kelaese a twehwe yɛ kɔ ɛtane nu a? Egya ɛkpa ɛgua!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Saa mekpo mɛla adenle ne na eza mesia me nzi kɛ akee medi mɛla ne azo a, ɛnee mehile kɛ medi fɔlɛ na medo mɛla ne.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Mame, mɛla ne anyunlu a, mewu; mɛla ne a hunle me a, amaa meadɛnla ngoane nu meamaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlo me kpole, yemɔti menrɛkpo ye amunli. Ɔluakɛ saa sonla di mɛla ne azo kolaa na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye a, ɛnee noko Kelaese wule ewule mgbane.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: O Galeehyeama ahɔnwɔne! Nwane a ɛhye bɛ sili a? Asoo bɛngakye mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ, mɔɔ fane kɛ ɔzile ɔyɛle mɔɔ bɛhunle Gyisɛse Kelaese wɔ meanubaka ne azo la?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Bɛha ko ɛhye bɛmaa mendie, asoo mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛlile zo la ati a Nyamenle vale ye Sunsum ne manle bɛ a, anzɛɛ bɛdiele Edwɛkpa ne na bɛliele bɛlile la ati ɔ?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Duzu ati a bɛde bɛ nwo bɛdo zɛhae ɛ? Bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛnlɛma wɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne anu, na kɛ ɔyɛle mɔɔ bɛlɛwie ye nwonane nu ɛ?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ bɛkpondɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛnwu ye nee mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la amuala yɛ mgbane ɔ? Ɔnle kɛ ɔba ye zɔhane fee!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdwenle kɛ Nyamenle fa ye Sunsum ne amaa bɛ, yeava bɛ yeayɛ nwanwane ninyɛne yeahile kɛ bɛlile mɛla ne azo, anzɛɛ bɛdie Edwɛkpa ne na bɛlie bɛli la ati ɔ?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu kɛ, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ɔlua ye diedi ti ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye.”

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ Ebileham nlɔnra kpalɛ ne a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi la.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle balua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la diedi zo yeamaa bɛazɔ ɔ nye.” Ɛhye kile kɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne lumuale nwunle ye, na ɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo ɔhilele Ebileham kɛ, “Ɛ nwo zo yɛɛ Nyamenle balua ayila maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti a.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Ebileham liele lile na bɛyilale ye. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la amuala nyia nyilalɛ a.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛdi mɛla ne azo na bɛazɔ Nyamenle anye la ɛnwu amaneɛ. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie biala mɔɔ anli mɛla ne ngyehyɛlɛ ne amuala azo, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle Mɛla buluku ne anu la, munzule ɛha ye.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Kɛkala, yɛnwu ye wienyi kɛ awie ko biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛli mɛla ne amuala azo na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Sonla ne mɔɔ kɛlie Nyamenle kɛli na ɔkɛzɔ ɔ nye la a banyia ngoane a.”

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Noko mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ nee Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛdie ye wɔali la ɛnle ko. Ɔluakɛ, Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie mɔɔ di mɛla ne amuala azo la a banyia ngoane a.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kelaese ɛralie ndeanlɛ muala, na yelie yɛ yevi munzule mɔɔ anrɛɛ mɛla ne fa yɛ ahɔ nu la anu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mɔɔ bɛkɛhenda ye wɔ baka zo la munzule ɛha ye.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Bɛhendanle Kelaese wɔ baka zo wɔ yɛmɛ yɛ ti, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛanyia nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ la bie, na kɛmɔ yɛdie Kelaese yɛdi la ati yɛ muala yɛ sa aha ye Sunsum ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ la. Mɛla ne nee ɛwɔkɛ ne

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Mediema, memaa bɛ ndonwo ko na bɛnlea: Saa menli nwiɔ kponle ngyehyɛlɛ bie azo na bɛkye ɔ bo a, awie ɛngola ɛnzɛkye ye anzɛɛ ɛnva bie ɛmboka nwolɛ.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne manle Ebileham nee ye anlɔnra. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛnga kɛ “ye nlɔnra,” mɔɔ kile kɛ nlɔnra ne mɔ zonle a. Ɔse “ye anlɔnra,” mɔɔ kile anlɔnra kokye, na anlɔnra ɛhye, yemɔ a le Kelaese.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne gyi mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ zo a ɛnee noko ɔnle ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ gyi ye ɛwɔkɛ ne azo a. Na ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle Ebileham la ati a Nyamenle ɛmaa ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ le zɛhae la a.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Saa ɔle zɛhae a ɛnee mɛla ne kpɔkɛ mɔɔ gyi zolɛ la a le boni? Nyamenle vale mɛla ne manle, amaa sonla anwu ɛtane deɛ holɛ. Mɛla ne hilehilele yɛ ekyii hɔdwule kɛ Ebileham anlɔnra ne mɔɔ yemɔti bɛbɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la rale la. Nyamenle manle ye soanvolɛma a vale mɛla ne luale sonla nwo zo rale a.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛdeɛ, ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne yɛɛ ɔbɔle a, yeanva yeanlua awie anwo zo. Mɛla ne gyima

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɛhye kile kɛ mɛla ne tia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔnle zɔhane fee. Saa mɛla bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ zolɛ ɛlilɛ maa menli ngoane a, anrɛɛ awie mɔɔ kɛli zolɛ la kɛzɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se ɛtane gyale ewiade amuala; ɛhye ati bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Gyisɛse Kelaese bɛdi la angome a Nyamenle bava ye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle la yeamaa bɛ a.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛbukele diedi adenle ne la, mɛla ne bɔle yɛ kpanwu hɔdwule kɛ bɛbukele diedi adenle ne la.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Mɛla ne dɛnlanle yɛ nwo zo kpalɛ hɔdwule mekɛ mɔɔ Kelaese rale la, amaa saa yɛdie ye yɛdi a, yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Kɛkala mɔɔ diedi mekɛ ne ɛra la, saa yɛdie Kelaese yɛdi a mɛla ne ɛnrɛdɛnla yɛ nwo zo bieko.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye ɛhye: Bɛlie Gyisɛse bɛli la ati bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛbɔ nu ɛyɛ Nyamenle amra.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔne bɛ wɔ Kelaese duma nu la ɛva Kelaese agyakɛ.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ngakyile biala ɛnle Dwuuma nee sonla mɔɔ ɛnle Dwuunli la avinli, akɛlɛ nee dehelɛ, anzɛɛ nrenya nee raalɛ avinli. Ɔluakɛ Kelaese ati bɛ muala bɛle menli ko.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Saa bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee bɛle Ebileham nlɔnra mɔɔ asa baha Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ ne la a.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Na bɛmaa mengile ɛhye anu bieko; ɔle kɛ kakula mɔɔ ɛli agya la. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔle kakula la, ɔde ye kɛ asɛɛ ɔle akɛlɛ la wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ, noko ɔdaye a ɔlɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ awuke ne anu la a.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Ye ngakula nu, ɔlɛ sonla mɔɔ nea ye nee ye ninyɛne ne mɔ azo a, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze ne mɔɔ ɔlile ye agya la hilele la.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde a; mɔɔ ɛnee yɛle ngakula wɔ sunsum nu la yɛyɛle ngakula yɛmanle ewiade ye anu tumi muala.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ mekɛ ne dwule la, Nyamenle zoanle ɔ Ra ne manle ɔrale ewiade. Raalɛ a nrenzɛle Ralɛ ɛhye a, na ɔwole ye ɔdole Dwuuma maamɛla ne anu,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔralie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mɛla ne ɛlɛbu bɛ kɔme la, amaa bɛarayɛ Nyamenle amra.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛle ɔ mra la, Nyamenle ɛzoa ɔ Ra ne Sunsum ne yemaa yerayi yɛ ahonle ne mɔ tɛkɛɛ, yemɔti yɛkola yɛka kɛ, “Egya! Me Papa!”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛnle ngɛkɛlɛ bieko, na bɛle Selɛ ne amra. Na saa bɛle ɔ mra a, ɛnee bɛdi agya. Pɔɔlo dwenle Galeehyeama anwo

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Dɛba ne mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la, ɛnee bɛle ngɛkɛlɛ bɛmaa ninyɛne mgbane mgbane mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛsonle bɛ la.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Kɛkala mɔɔ bɛnwu Nyamenle la anzɛɛ bɛmaa menga kɛ, kɛkala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpondɛ bɛ bo zo la, duzu ati a eza bɛkulo kɛ bɛsia bɛkɔsonle sunsum ɛtane ɛtane, anwo anwunvɔne ɛhye mɔ bieko ɛ? Duzu ati a eza bɛkulo kɛ bɛsia bɛyɛ bɛ nwo ngɛkɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ ɛ?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Bɛsie kenle, siane, ɛlobɔ, yɛɛ ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ko biala ɛvoyia dwu a bɛdi na bɛkyi ɔ nloa a.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me kɛ bɛmaa mevɛ mgbane!

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Me mediema, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛva me gyakɛ, ɔluakɛ mele kɛ bɛdabɛ la. Bɛtɛyɛle me ɛtane biala.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ me nwo mɔɔ dole me la ati a menyianle adenle membɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo mengilele bɛ a.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Noko mekɛ ne anu bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee me anwondolɛ ne kpondɛ ayɛ dwɛwɔlɛ amaa bɛ la, bɛamkpo me. Bɛliele me kɛmɔ bɛkɛlie Nyamenle soanvolɛ anzɛɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɔdaye mumua ne la.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, bɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma ne wɔ nienwu? Ɛnee medi daselɛ kɛ saa bɛyɛ na ɔkɛyɛ boɛ bɔbɔ a, anrɛɛ bɛdudule bɛ nye bɛmanle me.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ kɛkala angome bɛmaa meyɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛ kɛ meha nɔhalɛ ne mehile bɛ la ɛ?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ yɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛ nye die bɛ nwo, noko tɛ adenle kpalɛ zo a bɛ nee bɛ lua la! Mɔɔ menli zɔhane mɔ kpondɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛhwe bɛ bɛkɛvi me nwo, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nye alie bɛmɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛnyia bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ, noko bɛmaa ɔyɛ zɔhane wɔ adenle kpalɛ nu, na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane dahuu, bɔbɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛnde la.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ me nee bɛ a wɔ lɔ a, na meanwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meka la. Medwenle bɛ nwo somaa! Heega nee Sɛla

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Bɛmaa membiza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛboa mɛla ne abo la kɛ, asoo bɛnde mɔɔ mɛla mumua ne se la?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se Ebileham wole mralɛ mrenya nwiɔ. Ko ɔ nli le akɛlɛ yɛɛ ko ɔ nli le dehelɛ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Ebileham nee ɔ ye akɛlɛ ne bɛ ra ne, bɛwole ye kɛ bɛwo ralɛ biala la, na ɔ nee dehelɛ ne bɛ ra ne, yemɔ bɛluale Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ zo a bɛwole ye a.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Debie zɛhae ka yɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ndelebɛbo wɔ nu a: mraalɛ nwiɔ ne gyi ɛkɛ maa ngyekyeleɛ nwiɔ. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole ɔ mra ɛdeɛ ne wɔ akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nu la a le Heega; ɔgyi ɛkɛ ɔmaa ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ Boka Saenae azo la.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Heega gyi ɛkɛ maa Boka Saenae mɔɔ wɔ Areleebea la, na yemɔ a le ɛnɛ mekɛ ye suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɔ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala wɔ akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bo.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Na suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm kpalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la ɛnle akɛlɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bo. Yemɔ ɔle dehelɛ, na ɔle yɛ sua zo kpalɛ nee yɛ nli.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Wɔmɔ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛtɛwole ɛlɛ a, wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛtɛtele awolɛ nyane ɛlɛ a, di fɛlɛko, maa ɛ nye ɛlie, ɔluakɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpole ye la, lɛ mralɛ dɔɔnwo tɛla raalɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ agyalɛ mumua ne la.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Mediema, ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham la ati, yɛle ɔdaye Nyamenle ɔ mra, kɛmɔ Ayezeke de la.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛwole ye kɛ bɛwo ralɛ biala la yɛle mɔɔ bɛluale Nyamenle Sunsum ne tumi zo bɛwole ye la kpɔdekpɔde. Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ kɛkala ɔde a.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se duzu? Ɔse, “To akɛlɛ ne nee ɔ ra ne adenle zo, ɔluakɛ akɛlɛ ralɛ nee dehelɛ ralɛ ɛmbɔ nu ɛnli agya.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mediema, bɛnwu ye kɛ yɛnle akɛlɛ ne amra na yɛle dehelɛ ne amra.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛ fanwodi; Kelaese ɛraye yɛ kɔme kpomgbolo. Yemɔti, bɛgyinla kpundii kɛ bɛdi bɛ ti anwo, na bɛmmamaa adenle bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ bieko.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Bɛdie! Medame Pɔɔlo yɛɛ melɛka meahile bɛ a. Saa bɛmaa adenle bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ a, ɛnee bɛhile kɛ Kelaese anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa bɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenle kɛ bɛdi mɛla ne azo a bɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la ɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛvi Kelaese anwo, na bɛnrɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne bie.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Yɛmɛ, ɔlua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo, kɛmɔ yɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛdi la ati, yɛ nye la kɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbamaa yɛazɔ ɔ nye.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ ko a, yɛyɛ yɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ o, yɛanyɛ o, ɔngyia. Mɔɔ hyia la a le kɛ yɛkɛnyia diedi mɔɔ fa ɛhulolɛ yɛ gyima la.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Alumua ne ɛnee bɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ! Na nwane a ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛmmadie nɔhalɛ ne bɛdi a?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Tɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la a eza ɛze bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ɛhye a.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Amgba, ɔle kɛ mɔɔ bɛka la, “Fɛlɛ ko dɔ sonlɛ na ɔla fɛlɛ dɔɔnwo avinli a, ɔsɛkye bɛ muala.”

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Melɛ diedi wɔ Awulae anu kɛ bɛnrɛnyia adwenle fofolɛ biala kɛ me ɛdeɛ ne ala. Na ahenle holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔse ɔkɛgyegye bɛ la, Nyamenle badua ye kakɛ!

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Na mediema, asoo medame, saa mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ yɛɛ mebɔ nwolɛ nolo a anrɛɛ ɛnee duzu ati a bɛlɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde ɛ? Anrɛɛ Kelaese meanubaka ne mɔɔ mebɔ nwolɛ nolo la ɛnyɛ ngyegyelɛ biala ɛmmaa awie biala.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Me kunlu a anrɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛgyegye bɛ la kɛhɔ zo zɛhae ala na bɛkɛza bɛ nwo bɔbɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ me mediema, Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ, ɛye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo. Yemɔti bɛmmadi bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi na bɛfa bɛ fanwodi ne bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Bɛva ɛhulolɛ bɛzonle bɛ nwo ngoko.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɛla ne amuala, bɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko bɛmaa yɛ kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛ nwo.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Na saa bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ɛbɔ nu nane, bɛkeka bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛ bɛ nwo anwula a, ɛnee noko bɛnlea boɛ na bɛanguhu bɛ nwo. Nyamenle Sunsum ne nee sonla su ne

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ la a le kɛ, bɛmaa Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛhilehile bɛ adenle na bɛmmadi bɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla atiakunluwɔzo ne ko tia Nyamenle Sunsum ne, yɛɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne ko tia sonla atiakunluwɔzo ne. Bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛnga fee, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Saa bɛmaa Nyamenle Sunsum ne kile bɛ adenle a, mɛla ne ɛngola ɛnkyekye bɛ bieko.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Sonla su ne gyima mɔɔ di la da ali wienyi. Bɛmɛ a le adwɔmane, ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la ɛbɔlɛ,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: anyebolo, kɔdiawuyɛlɛ, nza ɛbolɛ, anyelielɛ mgbane mgbane nee ninyɛne mɔɔ le zɛhae mɔ la. Meha mehile bɛ dɛba, na eza mekakye bɛ bieko kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la ɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne ma a le ɛhye mɔ: ɛhulolɛ, anyelielɛ, anzonudwolɛ, abotane, atiakunlukɛnlɛmayɛlɛ, kpalɛyɛlɛ, nɔhalɛlilɛ,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: mɛlɛbɛnwoaze, yɛɛ bɛ nwo zo ɛhomolɛ. Ɛhye mɔ, mɛla biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ tia bɛ a.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdeɛ la, ɛbɔ bɛ su dɛba ne nee bɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane ne mɔ amuala meanubaka nu.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle Sunsum ne ɛmaa yɛ ngoane a, ɛnee bɛmaa Sunsum ne ɛli yɛ nyunlu wɔ yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ yɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo, yɛka yɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛya, na yɛ nye bolo bɛ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Mediema, saa bɛnwu awie mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ ɛtane a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu la ɛdenrɛ ye, noko anrɛɛ bɛyɛ ye bɛtɛɛ wɔ adenle kɛnlɛma nu. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛanyɛ mɔɔ ahenle yɛle la bie.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo ngoko, na bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a ɛnee bɛlɛdi Kelaese mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Saa awie bu ɔ nwo noko ɔndo ɛhwee a, ɛnee ɔlɛbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɔdaye ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbua ye nyɛleɛ nwo ndɛne, na saa ɔle kpalɛ a yeava mɔɔ yeyɛ la yeadu ɔ nwo; ɔmmafa awie ɛdeɛ mɔɔ ɛyɛ la ɔto ye ɛdeɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala ɔdaye ɔbazoa ye adesoa.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa awie mɔɔ bɛlɛmaa ye Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ nwo ngilehilelɛ la ɛmaa ye kilehilevolɛ ne debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia ye la bie.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo; bɛnzi Nyamenle amgbu, ɔluakɛ mɔɔ sonla kɛlua la yɛɛ ɔbu a;

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ, mɔɔ kɛli ye nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nzi la banyia ewule. Na mɔɔ di Nyamenle Sunsum ne anzi la balua Sunsum ne azo anyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛhɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ kpalɛ; ɔluakɛ saa yɛangyakyi nyele ɛyɛlɛ a, kenle bie yɛbanwu ɔ bo aleɛ.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kenle biala mɔɔ mekɛ kɛra kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ nyele la, bɛmaa yɛyɛ yɛmaa awie biala, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛlɛ diedi ko la. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ mezi meva me sa anloa mgbole ye melɛkɛlɛ bɛ la.

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛka ye ndinlizo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ la kulo kɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo ala kɛ bɛze amaamuo. Bɛyɛ bie zɔhane ala, amaa awie anyɛ bɛ kpɔdekpɔde kɛ bɛlɛka Kelaese ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Na mame, ɔkɛbɔ me tɔ kɛ menwɔdu me nloa anu a kyesɛ debie ko anwo ala, yemɔ a le Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse meanubaka ne. Ɔluakɛ ye meanubaka ne ati, ewiade le debie funli maa me, yɛɛ medame mumua ne mewu memaa ewiade.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Saa ɔwɔ kɛ awie yɛ ye mrenyanu nzonlɛ o, saa ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ o, ɔle debie mɔɔ ɛngyia fee a. Mɔɔ hyia la a le kɛ yɛkɛyɛ menli fofolɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi zɛhae ngyehyɛlɛ fofolɛ ne azo la, bɛmɛ nee Nyamenle menli kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ yɛsɛlɛ kɛ ɔdaye Nyamenle ɔnwu bɛ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu a.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la awie biala mmagyegye me bieko, ɔboalekɛ ahapenle mɔɔ wɔ me nwo la kile kɛ mele Kelaese Gyisɛse akɛlɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Me mediema, yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo yeyɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ la yɛɛ ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a. Ɔlɛ ɔkamaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Yɛ Ze Nyamenle nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Sunsum nu nyilalɛ mɔɔ Kelaese ati sonla nyia ye la

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ le yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze ne mo. Ɔluakɛ yelua yɛ koyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ la azo yeyila yɛ na yeva anwuma Sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ muala yemaa yɛ.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpale nu yele yɛ ziele ɛkɛ manle Kelaese kolaa na yeabɔ ewiade, amaa yɛ nwo ade nwuanzaanwu mɔɔ fɔlɛlilɛ biala ɛnle yɛ nu wɔ ɔ nyunlu a. Ɔlua ye ɛhulolɛ ne ati

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Nyamenle bɔle kpɔkɛ dɛba kɛ, ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo, ɔbamaa yɛayɛ ɔ mra, kɛmɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ gyi ɔ nyunlu la de la.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye nwanwane ɛlolɛ kpole nee ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yelua ɔ Ra ne mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la anwo zo yeva yemaa yɛ la ati.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yɛle mɔɔ yehyehyɛ la, na yelua Kelaese anwo zo yemaa yɛnwu ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yedwenle nwolɛ dɛba yedo ɛkɛ ne na ɔvea la.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye, mɔɔ ye mekɛ dwu a Nyamenle bamaa yeali munli la a le kɛ, ɔkuohua abɔdeɛ muala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la anloa, na yeava Kelaese yeazie bɛ ti.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛlumuale yɛnyianle anyelazo wɔ Kelaese anu la yɛye Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ayɛlɛ.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko, kɛmɔ bɛdele nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ le Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vale ngoanelielɛ rɛlɛle bɛ, na bɛliele Kelaese bɛlile la ati, Nyamenle vale ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne, mɔɔ ɔvale ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ la ɔmanle bɛ, ɔvale ɔyɛle bɛ nzonlɛ kɛ bɛle ye menli.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Sunsum ne di agyinlanu kɛ yɛbanyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ye menli ɛwɔkɛ la; eza ɔmaa yɛsi pi kɛ Nyamenle bamaa menli mɔɔ le ye ɛdeɛ la anyia bɛ ti bɔkɔɔ. Bɛmaa yɛye ye anyunlunyia ne ayɛlɛ! Pɔɔlo nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati sumunli kɛ mendele bɛ nganeɛ kɛ bɛlie Awulae Gyisɛse bɛli, nee bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle menli muala anwo la,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: dahuu meyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Mekakye bɛ wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: na mesɛlɛ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le anyunlunyia Selɛ ne kɛ ɔmaa bɛ Sunsum nu nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛnwu ɔdaye Nyamenle kpalɛ la.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛ adwenle nu kɛbuke, amaa bɛanwu anyelazo ne mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ wɔ nu, ye nwanwane nyilalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɔ ye menli ɛwɔkɛ la anu anwonyia ne

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: nee kɛ ye tumi ne kpole si de la. Tumi ɛhye mɔɔ ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛdie ye yɛdi la anu la, yemɔ ala a le anwosesebɛ bedevinli ne

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: mɔɔ Nyamenle vale dwazole Kelaese vile ewule nu, na ɔvale ye ɔdɛnlanle ɔ sa fema zo wɔ anwuma la.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Kelaese di belemgbunli wɔ arelemgbunli, tumivolɛma, mgbolema nee awulae mɔ anwo zo a. Ɔbo duma biala mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ɛhye nee ewiade fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bara la azo.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛva ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwula Kelaese agyakɛ abo, na yeva Kelaese yemaa asɔne ne kɛ ye Awulae mɔɔ bo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti azo.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Dɛba ne, bɛ mɛladonlɛ nee bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ manle bɛwule sunsum nu.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu bɛlile ewiade ye ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ne mɔ anzi; bɛdiele anwomanyunlu tumivolɛma mɔɔ kɛkala sie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle la edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ɛnee yɛdayɛ noko yɛle kɛ bɛdabɛ ala la; yɛbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛkulo la, yɛyɛle mɔɔ yɛ nwonane ne atiakunluwɔzo nee yɛ adwenle zele yɛ la, na ɔlua zo yɛhanle Nyamenle ɛya kɛ awie biala la.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛwu sunsum nu wɔ yɛ mɛladonlɛ ti la, ɔvale yɛ nee Kelaese ɔrale ngoane nu. Ɔlua Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ti yɛɛ bɛlie bɛ ngoane a.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ko la ati, Nyamenle ɛdwazo yɛ nee Kelaese kɛ yɛ nee ye ɛhɔli belemgbunli wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛhye amuala ɔhilele ye ɛlolɛ totohyia ne mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu la nee atiakunlukɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati dahuu ɔlɛ ye wɔ yɛ nwo la.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Tɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo ɔ. Ɔle Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ala, amaa awie biala andu ɔ nwo wɔ nwolɛ.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Yɛle Nyamenle asa anloa gyima, yɛɛ yelua yɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ koyɛlɛ ne azo yebɔ yɛ yemaa ɛbɛla kpalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle ɔdole yɛ ɛkɛ ne dɛba kɛ yɛbɔ la. Bɛ nee Kelaese le ko

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, bɛhakye kɛ dɛba ne ɛnee Dwuuma fɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle a. Ɔluakɛ Dwuuma yɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ na bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛnyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ mekɛ ne anu ɛnee bɛ nee Kelaese avinli twe, ɛnee bɛle nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ bɛmboka Yizilayɛ maanlema ne anwo a, ɛnee bɛnze ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔlua zo a Nyamenle bɔle ye menli ne ɛwɔkɛ la anwo bie. Bɛdɛnlanle ewiade ye anu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anyelazo na bɛnze Nyamenle la.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛyɛ ko, amaa ɔlua zo bɛmɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛwɔ moa moa la, bɛlua Kelaese mogya ne mɔɔ ɔhwinle ɔguale la azo bɛhwe bɛ bɛbikye Nyamenle.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Kelaese a le yɛ anzonudwolɛmaavolɛ a. Ɔluakɛ yeva Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yebɔ nu yeyɛ bɛ menli ko, na yegologolo bane ne mɔɔ gya bɛ ɛweɛne mɔɔ maa bɛyɛ bɛ nwo agbɔvolɛ la yegua.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: Ɔluale ye sonlabaka ne azo ɔpɛle Dwuuma mɛla ne nee nwolɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anu na ɔlua Kelaese ati ɔmanle menli ekpunli nwiɔ ɛhye yɛle menli fofolɛ ko na yɛnyianle anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Kelaese luale ye ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la yele ɛkpɔlɛ wɔ bɛ avinli na ɔhanle Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ɔbɔle nu ɔmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Yemɔti Kelaese rabɔle anzonudwolɛ nwo Edwɛkpa nolo ne hilele menli kɔsɔɔti; ɔbɔle ɔhilele bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma, mɔɔ bɛwɔ moa moa la yɛɛ Dwuuma mɔɔ bikye ye la.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔlua Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛɛ yɛ muala, Dwuuma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la yɛkola yɛdua Sunsum ko ne ala azo yɛkɔ Selɛ ne anyunlu a.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la bɛnle nyɛvolɛ anzɛɛ maanle zo amra bieko; kɛkala bɛle mandimase wɔ Nyamenle menli ne avinli na bɛbɔ Nyamenle abusua eku ne bie.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko a bɛle sua mɔɔ bɛlɛsi ye wɔ ɛzoanvolɛma nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma adiabo ne mɔɔ bɛwula la azo a, na Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔle sua ne mgbɛnezo sika ne mɔɔ hyia kpole kpalɛ la a.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Kelaese a sɔ sua mumua ne maa ɔgyinla ɔyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ sua nwuanzanwuanza ɔmaa Awulae a.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ ko la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛlua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo bɛlɛsi bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛ sua la na Nyamenle adɛnla nu.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la ati bɛhye me nuokɛ bɛmaa Kelaese Gyisɛse la, mesɛlɛ dahuu memaa bɛ.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Medie medi kɛ bɛde kɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ zo ala yɛɛ yeva gyima ɛhye yemaa me kɛ menyɛ a, wɔ bɛ kpalɛ ti.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yele ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vea la hilele me. (Mehɛlɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ sikalɛ,

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: na saa bɛkenga mɔɔ mehɛlɛ la a anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu me ndelebɛbo ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vea la anu.)

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Dɛba dɛba ne bɛanga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ vea la bɛangile sonla biala, noko kɛkala, Nyamenle lua Sunsum ne azo ɛye ɛhile ye ɛzoanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne nee Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛnee vea ɛkɛ ne la a le kɛ, ɔlua Edwɛkpa ne azo, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma nee Dwuuma bɔ nu nyia Nyamenle nyilalɛ ne mɔ; bɛyɛ menli ko na bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔbɔle la.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlua ye tumi ne gyimalilɛ zo ɛmaa me ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, kɛ menyɛ Edwɛkpa ne anwo sonvolɛ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Mele Nyamenle menli ne anu kakula bɔkɔɔ, noko Nyamenle ɛmaa me adenle ɛhye kɛ membɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwonyia ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neɛnleanu la anwo nolo mengile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la,

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: na memaa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛnwu kɛ nwanwane ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vea la bazi ahɔ zolɛ la. Nyamenle mɔɔ yemɔ a ɔbɔle ninyɛne muala la vale ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye veale mekɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la,

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: amaa mekɛ ɛhye anu ala ɔlua Asɔne ne azo anwuma tumivolɛma nee mgbolema anwu Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ kpole ne.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yɛle ɛhye kɛmɔ ye damɛnlangoate ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ Awulae ne anwo zo ɔmanle ɔlile munli la de la.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Yɛ nee Kelaese yɛ koyɛlɛ ne, nee diedi mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye wɔ ye nuhua la ati, yɛkola yɛbɔ kpɔkɛ na yɛsi yɛ kɛnra yɛfinde Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛmmamaa amaneɛ mɔɔ melɛnwu ye wɔ bɛ ti la bɔ bɛ rɛle; ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛ. Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛnee melɛka la, ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ mekoto mesɛlɛ Selɛ ne

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
