translation_verse: mɔɔ ye nehane a abusua biala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la nyia ye nɔhalɛ duma la,

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: kɛ ye anyunlunyia ne kpole ti, ɔlua ye Sunsum ne azo ɔmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ɔmaa bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ adwenle nu,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: na ɔlua bɛ diedi zo ɔmaa Kelaese ɛdɛnla bɛ ahonle nu. Mesɛlɛ kɛ bɛkɛgyinla kpundii wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: amaa bɛahola bɛ nee Nyamenle menli ne anyia anwosesebɛ ade kɛ Kelaese ɛhulolɛ ne tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle, ye anwumahɔlɛ nee ye kuma si de la abo.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛanwu ye ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ bo sonla adwenle zo la, na Nyamenle su ne mɔɔ maa sonla sɔ Nyamenle anye la ayi bɛ tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Anyunlunyia ɛlua asɔne ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo ɛha Nyamenle mɔɔ dua tumi ne mɔɔ yɛ gyima yɛ nu la azo maa ɔbo mɔɔ yɛbiza nee mɔɔ yɛdwenle nwo la azo la, wɔ ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ! Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mesɛlɛ bɛ, meze kɛ Awulae ɛzonlenlɛ ne ati mela efiade bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ fɛta Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne mɔɔ yemɔti yevɛlɛ bɛ la.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Dahuu bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, bɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ na bɛnyia abotane. Bɛde bɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ngoko ngoko wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu na bɛmaa koyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la ɛwoa ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Asɔne ko yɛɛ Sunsum ko a wɔ ɛkɛ a, yɛɛ anyelazo ko anu a Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a;

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Awulae ko, diedi ko, yɛɛ ɛzɔnenlɛ kokye ala a wɔ ɛkɛ a.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kokye mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti yɛ Ze na ɔle abɔdeɛ muala bɛ Awulae na ɔyɛ gyima wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nu la a de bɛ muala bɛ nu a.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvole ɔhɔle anwuma la, ɔhyele menli dɔɔnwo nuokɛ ɔ nee bɛ hɔle; na ɔvale ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔmanle aleɛabo amra.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Akee “ɔhɔle anwuma” ne abo a le duzu? Yemɔ a le kɛ saa ɔvole a ɛnee noko alumua ne ɔdwule ɔhɔle azɛlɛ ti anu.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ahenle mɔɔ dwule la ɔdaye ko ne ala a ɔhɔle anwuma wɔ anwumaneamra anzi lɔ a, amaa ewiade kpokpoti anwu ye.

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛhye ɔvale ɔzieziele Nyamenle menli kɔsɔɔti ɔmanle Keleseɛn ɛzonlenlɛ gyima ne, amaa bɛayɛ Kelaese asɔnema

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: kɔdwu kɛ awieleɛ ne, kɛmɔ yɛdie yɛdi na yɛze Nyamenle Ara ne la ati, yɛkɛbɔ nu yɛkɛyɛ ko na yɛayɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛdi na bɛ nee Kelaese ɛzɛ atipɛne la.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee yɛnle ngakula bieko mɔɔ adalɛma fa bɛ ngilehilelɛ nee agyiba ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtwe menli bɛkɔ ɛtane nu la bɔ yɛ kɔ ba kɛ selɛkye nee anwoma la.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Saa yɛfa ɛhulolɛ yɛka nɔhalɛ ne a, Kelaese ati yɛbanyi wɔ adenle biala anu. Kelaese a gyi yɛ ti

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: mɔɔ yɛ nwonane ye nvɛyeba ne mɔ amuala sosɔ ye na ɔmaa biala yɛ ye gyima kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la, na nwonane ne nyi ɛhulolɛ nu a. Ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ fofolɛ wɔ Kelaese ati

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Mekakye bɛ wɔ Awulae duma nu; bɛmmabɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ awozonle ɛzonlenlɛma la bieko mɔɔ bɛndwenle adwenle kpalɛ a.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ adwenle nu le awozinli, bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo yɛɛ bɛmboka ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle fa maa la anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛnze ɛhwee yɛɛ eza bɛ nzo yɛ se.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Nyiane ɛnle bɛ nye zo, bɛyɛ ninyɛndane yɛɛ bɛkulo ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, bɛde ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ yɛɛ bɛhilehile bɛ nɔhalɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ Gyisɛse anu la.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛdu bɛ su dɛba ne mɔɔ manle bɛbɔle ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo na ɔvale ye atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne ɔzɛkyele bɛ la bɛgua.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ su fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso na ɔkile ɔ nwo wɔ nɔhalɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ na ɔle nwuanzaanwu la anu la bɛwula.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bieko; awie biala ɛha nɔhalɛ ɛhile ɔ gɔnwo, ɔboalekɛ yɛ muala yɛle menli ko.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Saa ɛfa ɛya a, mmamaa ɔfa wɔ ɔkɔ ɛtane nu; eza mmamaa sɛnzɛne ne tɔ wɔ ɛya zo.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ le awule la ɛgyakyi ye awule ne na ɔyɛ gyima, amaa yeanyia bie yeanlea ɔ nwo na eza yeanyia bie yeaboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa edwɛkɛ ɛtane fi bɛ nloa anu finde; bɛdendɛ kɛnlɛma mɔɔ maa sonla nyia ngɔzo na ɔnyia mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la, amaa mɔɔ bɛkɛha la biala azo ara nvasoɛ amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie la.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɔ Nyamenle Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne arɛle, ɔluakɛ Sunsum ne a le Nyamenle nzonlɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ ye bɛ nwo mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ a; sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛhye kile kɛ Kenle ne dwu a Nyamenle bakpɔne bɛ.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Bɛye sipe nee ɛkpɔlɛ nee ɛya biala bɛgua. Bɛmmadi butule anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ aholoba. Bɛye atiakunlu ɛtane biala bɛgua.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma na bɛze anwunvɔne, bɛva bɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛtane bɛhyɛ bɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛlua Kelaese anwo zo ɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛhyɛ bɛ la.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Bɛle Nyamenle amra mɔɔ ɔkulo bɛ a, yemɔti bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kɛ ɔdaye ala la.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa ɛhulolɛ ɛvinde bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu, kɛmɔ Kelaese hulole yɛ na ɔdole ye ngoane aze ɔmanle yɛ ɔvale ɔyɛle azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Bɛle Nyamenle menli, zɔhane ati bɛye adwɔmanebɔlɛ anzɛɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane anzɛɛ anyebolo wɔ bɛ nu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Bɛmmaka anyiemgba edwɛkɛ biala, bɛmmatendɛ ɛdendɛlɛ ɛtane yɛɛ bɛmmabɔ ngoayɛ mgbane mgbane. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ la a le kɛ bɛkɛyɛ Nyamenle mo.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Bɛde ɛhye abo kpalɛ, awie biala mɔɔ bɔ adwɔmane anzɛɛ ye ɛbɛla nwo ɛnde anzɛɛ ɔle anyebolo la ɛnrɛnyia agyadeɛ wɔ Kelaese nee Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa awie fa adubɛnloanu bɛlɛbɛla bɛ; ɔboalekɛ ɔlua ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne ba menli mɔɔ ɛndie ye edwɛkɛ la anwo zo a.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛ nee menli zɔhane mɔ mmatu wɔ adenle biala anu.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Dɛba ne ɛnee bɛwɔ awozinli nu, na ɛnɛ bɛyɛ Awulae menli; ɛhye ati bɛwɔ wienyi nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ wienyi nu la.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wienyi nu yɛɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ, pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee nɔhalɛlilɛ dɔɔnwo vi ba a.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛzukoa mɔɔ bɛyɛ a ɔsɔ Awulae anye la.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ awozinli nu nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ menli yɛ na nvasoɛ ɛnle zolɛ la bie. Bɛnwu bie a anrɛɛ bɛha bɛdo gua.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ nyiane kpole bɔbɔ kɛ bɛkɛha bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye fealera nu la anwo edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Na saa ninyɛne muala finde wienyi nu a, ɛnee bɛ nɔhalɛ ɛsaso ne ɛla ɛkɛ ne wienyi;

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ debie biala mɔɔ kɛla ali la, ɛnee yeyɛ wienyi. Yemɔti a bɛha ye kɛ, “Wɔmɔ mɔɔ wɔlafe a, tunwue na ɛvi mɔwuamra anu dwazo! Na Kelaese wienyi ne kɛda ɛ nwo.”

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ wɔ adenle biala anu, ɔboalekɛ mekɛ ye mɔɔ yɛwɔ nu la le ɛtanelilɛ mekɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo ahɔnwɔne, na bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnwu mɔɔ Awulae kpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi nza ɛbolɛ na ɔsɛkye bɛ; bɛmaa Sunsum ne ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Bɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne, anyelielɛ edwɛne nee sunsum nu edwɛne bɛli bɛ nwo adwelie; na bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ bɛ ahonle nu bɛmaa Awulae.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Bɛlua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu bɛyɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne mo dahuu wɔ debie biala anu. Yelɛma nee kunlima

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Yelɛma, bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ bɛmaa Awulae la.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kunli ne a lɛ tumi wɔ ɔ ye anwo zo a, kɛmɔ Kelaese lɛ Asɔne ne azo tumi la; asɔne ne a le Kelaese sonlabaka ne yɛɛ Kelaese a le asɔne ne Ngoanedievolɛ a.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yelɛma ɛha bɛ nwo aze bɔkɔɔ ɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, kɛmɔ asɔne ne yɛ maa Kelaese la.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Kunlima, bɛhulo bɛ ye mɔ kɛmɔ Kelaese hulole Asɔne ne na ɔdole ye ngoane aze wɔ ɔ ti la.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛhye na ɔvale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ nee nzule ɔnrinzinle nwolɛ bɔkɔɔ na ɔdele nwolɛ;

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: amaa yeava asɔne ne kɛnlɛma gyɛlɛɛnye yeamaa ɔ nwo, mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛtɛkpɔdele, evinli biala ɛnle nwolɛ, yɛɛ nvonleɛ biala ɛnle nwolɛ na nwolɛ te nwuanzaanwu a.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ kunlima kulo bɛ ye mɔ kɛ bɛ nwo la. Nrenya mɔɔ kulo ɔ ye la kulo ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nwo.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Awie ɛnrɛkpɔ ɔdaye ɔ nwo ɛlɛ; mɔɔ ɔyɛ la a le kɛ ɔdi ɔ nwo adane na ɔnea ye sonlabaka ne boɛ, kɛmɔ Kelaese noko yɛ Asɔne ne la,

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ yɛle ye sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ne mɔ bie.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɛhye ati nrenya bagyakyi ɔ ze nee ɔ nli na yeava ɔ nwo yeabeta ɔ ye anwo, na bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛayɛ menli nwiɔ mɔɔ le nwonane ko a.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ kpole bie mɔɔ vea la wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ɛhye anu, na mete ɔ bo kɛ ɔfane Kelaese nee asɔne ne anwo.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Noko ɔwɔ kɛ kunli biala kulo ɔ ye kɛ ɔdaye ɔ nwo, na yelɛ biala noko di ɔ hu eni.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Ngakula, bɛdie bɛ awovolɛma wɔ Awulae ati, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a le debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ a.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: Ɛwɔkɛ ne a le “amaa wɔayɛ kpalɛ na wɔahyɛ azɛlɛ ye azo.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Selɛma, bɛmmaka bɛ mra ɛya; bɛtete bɛ na bɛhilehile bɛ, kɛmɔ Awulae kpondɛ la. Ngɛkɛlɛ nee menlenlɛma

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛva ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛdie bɛ menle mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu la kɛ asɛɛ bɛlɛsonle Awulae la.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Tɛ ɛnyelɛ zo yɛkile nu ɔ, na bɛva ahonle kpalɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la; bɛyɛ ye kɛ bɛle Kelaese ngɛkɛlɛ,

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: na bɛva adwenle kpalɛ bɛzonle kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛamaa Awulae na tɛ menli ɔ.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ awie biala kɛyɛ la, saa akɛlɛ o, saa dehelɛ o, Awulae bamaa ye nwolɛ ahatualɛ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Menlenlɛma, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ, na bɛmmanwunlonwunla bɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmasisi bɛ. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛ nee bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ amuala wɔ Menlenlɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la abo. Yemɔ, ɔnli mɔguazo wɔ ye ndɛnebualɛ nu. Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ne, bɛlua Awulae tumi bedevinli ne azo bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Bɛwula Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne mɔ amuala na bɛahola bɛagyinla Abɔnsam agyiba ne mɔ anloa.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, tɛ menli a yɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛko a; sunsum nu tumivolɛma, ewiade arelemgbunli anzɛɛ maanlebuvoma, ewiade amra mɔɔ sie ɛnɛ mekɛ ye awozinli nu amra, yɛɛ sunsum nu anwuma ɛlɔnema amumuyɛ yɛɛ yɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛko a.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛwula Nyamenle konle tɛladeɛ ne amuala, amaa saa kenle ɛtane ne ba a, bɛahola bɛagyinla kpɔvolɛ ne anyunlu, amaa mɔɔ konle ne kawie la ɛnee bɛgyi bɛ gyakɛ anu kpundii.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛziezie bɛ nwo bɛzie, bɛva nɔhalɛ bɛyɛ akyeso bɛhye; bɛva pɛlepɛlelilɛ bɛyɛ bulalɛ enyinlike bɛbutu bɛ kɛnra azo

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: na bɛva anzonudwolɛ Edwɛkpa ne bɛyɛ mgbɔlaboa bɛwula.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Mekɛ biala bɛva diedi bɛyɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a bɛbava bɛalie Abɔnsam senle ɛda ne mɔɔ ɔkɛdo la amuala bɛanlua bɛ a.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Bɛva ngoanelielɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne bɛyɛ bulalɛ kyɛlɛ bɛzoa na bɛva Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kɛ konle dadeɛ mɔɔ Sunsum ne fa maa la.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa medame noko kɛ saa menyia nwo mebadendɛ a, Nyamenle kɛmaa me edwɛkɛ mɔɔ mebaha la, amaa meahola meadendɛ akɛnrasesebɛ zo meabɔ mɔɔ vea Edwɛkpa ne anu la nolo.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Edwɛkpa ne ati a mela efiade a, noko mele nwolɛ ɛbɔfoɔ. Bɛzɛlɛ kɛ menwɔva akɛnrasesebɛ menwɔha Edwɛkpa ne kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la. Adwulaleɛ nee moyɛlɛ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Nyamenle Selɛ ne, nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛmaa mediema ne mɔ amuala anzonudwolɛ nee diedi nu ɛhulolɛ.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo nee Temɔte, mɔɔ yɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse ngɛkɛlɛ la, yɛɛ yɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye yɛahɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛyɛ Nyamenle menli nee asɔne neavolɛma nee asɔne boavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ Felepae suakpole ne azo la amuala a.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Pɔɔlo sɛlɛ amaa diedima

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Meyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ dahuu mekakye bɛ a.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Eza kenle biala mefa fɛlɛkolilɛ mesɛlɛ memaa bɛ muala,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: wɔ moalɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛboa me wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anwo gyimalilɛ nu, ɔvi mɔlebɛbo ne amuala toonwo mɔɔ ɛradwu ɛnɛ la.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati medie medi kɛ Nyamenle mɔɔ bɔle gyima kpalɛ ɛhye abo wɔ bɛ nu la kɛzɔ zolɛ kɛmaa ɔkɛli munli wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse kɛra la.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Medwenle bɛ nwo somaa! Na ɔle kpalɛ noko kɛ melɛ bɛ nwo adwenle zɛhae a, ɔluakɛ wɔ me efiadenla nu nee Edwɛkpa ne nolobɔlɛ nee ye ɛgyinlalɛ nu, me nee bɛ yɛ muala a yɛnyia Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne a.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Nyamenle di me daselɛ kɛ me nwo mɔɔ dɔ bɛ la amuala vi Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne ahonle nu.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛdo bɛ ɛhulolɛ nu, ɔmaa bɛ nɔhalɛ adwenle nee ndelebɛbo mɔɔ di munli la,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: amaa bɛnwu mɔɔ le kpalɛ la a bɛanwu ye, na bɛ nwo ade saanwu na bɛanli fɔlɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Bɛzo nɔhalɛ ma kpalɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese ala a fa maa la na bɛmaa anyunlunyia nee ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle. Sonla ngoane vi Kelaese

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mekulo kɛ bɛnwu kɛ, mɔɔ ɛzi me nwo zo biala la ɛboa ɛmaa Edwɛkpa ne ɛhɔ zo,

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: ɛmaa ɔlua zo suakunlu sinzavolɛma ne mɔ amuala nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛha la amuala ɛnwu ye kɛ Kelaese ati a mela efiade a.

english_verse: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
translation_verse: Na me efiadenla ɛhye ɛmaa mediema ne mɔ dɔɔnwo ɛzi pi wɔ Awulae anu na bɛlɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo mɔɔ bɛnzulo ɛhwee a.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Ɔle nɔhalɛ kɛ bie mɔ fa akpule nee aholazilɛ a bɔ Kelaese anwo nolo ne a, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko lɛ adwenle kpalɛ.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la, bɛmbɔ Kelaese anwo nolo ne nɔhalɛ nu, bɛbɔ ye manzonlehwenlɛ nu, na bɛdwenle kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛamaa me nwo ahyele me wɔ efiade ɛke.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Ɔnle debie! Medi nwolɛ fɛlɛko, ɔluakɛ saa bɛlɛ adwenle kpalɛ o, saa ɛtane o, Kelaese anwo nolo ala a bɛbɔ a. Ɛhɛe, yɛɛ eza mebahɔ zolɛ meali fɛlɛko,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ meze kɛ ɔlua bɛmɛ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese Sunsum ne moalɛ zo mebavi efiade ɛke.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ hyia me ɛsesebɛ na me nye la la a le kɛ menrɛze me gyima ne anwo nyiane ɛlɛ, na wɔ ewule nu o, ngoane nu o, menwɔnyia akɛnrasesebɛ menwɔva me nwo amuala menwɔli gyima menwɔwula Kelaese anyunlunyia.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Na mame, mese ngoane a le Kelaese, yɛɛ ewule le nvasoɛ.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Saa metɛnla ewiade ye anu a anrɛɛ mebali gyima kpalɛ bie. Noko mennwu mɔɔ memkpa nu menva a.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Megyi ninyɛne nwiɔ avinli. Me kunlu a anrɛɛ mevi ewiade ɛhye anu na me nee Kelaese ɛhɔdɛnla, ɛhye le debie kpalɛ totohyia.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Mesi pi wɔ ɛhye anwo, na meze kɛ metɛnyianle metɛwule. Meze kɛ me nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛbadɛnla, na bɛanyia ngɔzo na bɛ nye alie wɔ diedi nu,

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: amaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ bieko a bɛanyia anwosesebɛ bɛava me bɛadu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ ɛbɛla mɔɔ Kelaese ati bɛlɛbɔ la anwo.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ wɔ menli nu ɛfɛta mɔɔ Kelaese anwo Edwɛkpa ne kilehile la, amaa saa meba bɛ nwo lɔ o, menle lɔ o, meade kɛ bɛlɛ koyɛlɛ nee adwenle ko bɛgyi kpundii kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ afoa na bɛlɛko kɛ menli kɛzɔ diedi ne anu.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Bɛmmasulo bɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ; bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ, na ɛhye bahile amaa bɛanwu kɛ bɛmɛ bɛli konim na bɛ agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ ɛho ɛdɔ. Ɔluakɛ bɛ ngoane a le Nyamenle.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Nyamenle a ɛmaa adenle kɛ bɛlie Kelaese bɛli na bɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ɔ ti a.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ mekɛ bie bɛnwunle kɛ ɛnee melɛko wɔ diedi nu la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ kɛkala noko bɛte kɛ megua zolɛ a. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛrazɔ konle ko ne ala anu.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi la ati bɛ nwo yɛ se. Ye ɛhulolɛ ne kyekye bɛ rɛle. Sunsum ne maa bɛdi ahua, ɔmaa bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛse bɛ nwo anwunvɔne.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Akee mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛhye bɛ nwo file, bɛnyia adwenle ko, bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko na bɛmaa me fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ɛli munli.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ debie biala angomedi nu anzɛɛ adubɛnwo nu; dahuu bɛva anwoazehanlɛ bɛbu bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛdɛla bɛ nwo bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Awie biala mmadwenle ɔ ngomekye ye boɛyɛlɛ nwo, na ɔdwenle ɔ gɔnwo mɔ noko ɛdeɛ nwo.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Bɛmaa zɛhae subane ne mɔɔ ɛnee Kelaese Gyisɛse lɛ la ɛvinde bɛ ɛbɛla nu.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Yemɔ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔ nee Nyamenle bɛ su le ko la, yeandwenle nwo yeampele kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle kɛzɛ.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: Ɔkpɔlale ɔ kunlu ɔyɛle ɔ nwo akɛlɛ na bɛwole ye kɛ sonla biala la, Ɔrale kɛ ɔle sonla,

english_verse: Christ was humble. He obeyed God and even died on a cross.
translation_verse: ɔbɛlɛle ɔ nwo aze ɔyɛle tieyɛ ɔhɔle ewule nu, na ɔwule meanubaka zo bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zo Nyamenle ɛkpogya ye zo na yemaa ye duma fofolɛ mɔɔ tɛla aluma muala.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, anwuma nee aze nee ɛbolɔ amra amuala bahoto Gyisɛse na bɛali ye duma ne eni,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: na awie biala aha ye baguase kɛ, Gyisɛse Kelaese le Awulae, bɛava bɛawula Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlunyia. Bɛda kɛ bɛle ewiade ahɛnlaneɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ayi mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛlile me edwɛkɛ zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee me nee bɛ de la, ɔhyia ɛsesebɛ kɛ akee bɛkɛyɛ ye zɔhane kɛkala mɔɔ me nee bɛ ɛnde la. Bɛva ɛzulolɛ nee anwowozolɛ bɛli bɛ ngoanelielɛ ne anwo gyima bɛhɔ awieleɛ,

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛdi gyima wɔ bɛ nu dahuu, amaa bɛanyia ɛhulolɛ na bɛahola bɛayɛ mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: amaa awie annwu nvonleɛ biala wɔ bɛ nwo anzɛɛ anzu bɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ nwo kpolera kɛ bɛle Nyamenle amra mɔɔ evinli fee ɛnle bɛ nwo, wɔ adalɛ nee ɛtane ewiade ye anu a. Saa bɛwɔ bɛ avinli a bɛda kɛ bɛmɛ a bɛle ewiade ahɛnlaneɛ a,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: na bɛzɔ ngoane edwɛkɛ ne anu boɛ, amaa Kenle mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la meanyia bie meadu me nwo kɛ meanzu ɛnriandilɛ ne mgbane anzɛɛ meanyɛ me gyima ne mgbane.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Saa bɔbɔ ɔba ye kɛ bɛfa me mogya bɛaye ɛdɛne bɛagua bɛ diedi azubɔlɛ zo bɛamaa Nyamenle a, anrɛɛ me nye die nwolɛ kpole na me nee bɛ di fɛlɛko.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nye die na bɛ nee me di fɛlɛko a. Temɔte nee Ɛpafulodaetɛse

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Me nye la kɛ saa ɔyɛ Awulae Gyisɛse ɛhulolɛ a ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meazoa Temɔte wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ, amaa meade bɛ nganeɛ na me nye alie.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Menlɛ awie mɔɔ kɛdwenle bɛ nwo kpalɛ kɛ medame la, kyesɛ Temɔte ala, yɛɛ yemɔ noko ala a kɛdwenle bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛha la biala ɛlɛbɔ ye ɛbɛla mɔɔ hyia ye la, na yegyakyi mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ la.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze Temɔte bolɛ mɔɔ sonle a. Bɛze gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ ralɛ na ɔ nee me yɛlile wɔ Edwɛkpa ne anwo a.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ me nye la kɛ saa menyia menwu kɛ ninyɛne ɛlɛsi ahɔ ye wɔ ɛke la a ɛnee menwɔzoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Me rɛle wɔ Awulae anu kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na medame mumua ne meara bɛ nwo lɔ.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Medwenle nwo kɛ eza ɔwɔ kɛ mesoa adiema Ɛpafulodaetɛse noko wɔ bɛ nwo nehane, ɔ nee me a yɛdi gyima ye a, yɛɛ yegyinla me nzi yeho kpalɛ kɛ me gɔnwo sogyanli, eza yezonle na yeboa me kɛ ɔle bɛ soanvolɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mengɔle ɛhyianlɛ nu la.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo ɛlɛdɔ bɛ muala, na ɔlɛdi nyane kɛ bɛdele ye anwonyane nganeɛ a.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ɔwule ɔwiele. Na Nyamenle a ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne a, na tɛ yemɔ a yenwu ye anwunvɔne a na mame bɔbɔ ɔ, anrɛɛ me nyanelilɛ ne kɛbo zolɛ.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, memaa yeazia yeara bɛ nwo lɔ bieko ndɛndɛ, amaa bɛnwu ye a bɛ nye alie na medame noko meapɛ me adwenleadwenle ne azo.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Bɛva fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛlie ye kɛ bɛ diema wɔ Awulae ati. Bɛli menli mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la eni,

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ Kelaese gyima ne yɛɛ bɛ moalɛ mɔɔ ɔlua me ti ɔliele kɛ ɔfa yearɛlɛ me la ati a ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole nzeleba a.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ne, mediema, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie kɛ bɛra Awulae ɛkɛ a. Ɔnyɛ me ɛvɛlɛ kɛ mesi mɔɔ mehɛlɛ ye dɛba la azo wɔ bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ ti a.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ wɔ nindavoma anwo; menli ɛhye mɔ ɛhakyi ahwea mɔɔ nganlɛ ala a bɛkulo kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Yɛmɛ a yɛnyia nɔhalɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛyɛlɛ ne a, na tɛ bɛmɛ ɔ, ɔluakɛ yɛdua Nyamenle Sunsum ne azo a yɛsonle a, na yɛdi fɛlɛko kɛ yɛnyia Kelaese Gyisɛse wɔ yɛ ɛbɛla nu. Yɛnva yɛ rɛle yɛnwula ewiade amaamuo nu.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Menlile dapɛne ko ala la yɛɛ bɛyɛle me mrenyanu nzonlɛ a. Bɛwole me Yizilayɛnli, mevi Bɛngyaman abusua nu yɛɛ mele Hibulunli tɛnyetɛnye, egya nee ɔmɔ le Hibuluma, yɛɛ ɔba mɛla ne anwo edwɛkɛ a, mele Falasiinli.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Mɔdenlebɔlɛ nu a menyɛle diedima ne kpɔdekpɔde, yɛɛ saa ɔhale kɛ sonla di mɛla ne azo na yeazɔ Nyamenle anye a, anrɛɛ menli fɔlɛ hweledede.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Noko ɔlua Kelaese ati, ninyɛne mɔɔ anrɛɛ anwo lɛ nvasoɛ maa me la ɛnɛ ɛnzɔ me nye bieko.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Tɛ ɛhye mɔ angome, na ɛnwunlɛ mumua ne mɔɔ menwu Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese la sonle bolɛ maa me tɛla debie biala. Ɔlua ɔ ti mevuandi debie biala megua; mebu bɛ kɛ fovolɛ zo ewula la, amaa Kelaese ayɛ me ɛdeɛ,

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: na bɛanwu kɛ me nee ye lua. Medame mumua ne menlɛ tenleneyɛlɛ biala menyɛ kɛ medi mɛla ne azo la ati ɔ. Me tenleneyɛlɛ lua kɛ medie Kelaese medi la ati ɔ. Tenleneyɛlɛ ɛhye vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ na ɔdua yɛ diedi zo a ɔfa ɔmaa a.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Mɔɔ mekpondɛ la a le kɛ menwɔnwu Kelaese na menwɔde ye ewudwazo tumi ne me nu, na me nee ye yɛkɛnwu amaneɛ na menwɔyɛ kɛ ɔdaye wɔ ye ewule nu,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: amaa me nye ala kɛ Nyamenle badwazo medame noko avi ewule nu ara ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anu. Ɛnriandilɛ kpalɛ ne

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Menga kɛ meho medɔ zo anzɛɛ meli munli. Metɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ me sa kɛha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ yemɔti Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛva ɔ sa ɛdo me nwo zo la.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Mediema, nɔhalɛ, menva ye kɛ me sa ɛha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne; debie ko yɛɛ meyɛ a, na yemɔ a le kɛ me rɛle kɛvi mɔɔ ɛze me nzi la na menwɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ menwɔdwu mɔɔ wɔ me nyunlu la anwo.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Yemɔti memia me nwo kɛ menriandi meahɔ awieleɛ, amaa me sa aha ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ le anwuma ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle lua Kelaese anwo zo ɛlɛfɛlɛ yɛ ahɔ nu la.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛnyi sunsum nu la yɛnyia subane zɛhae, na saa bɛ bie mɔ noko lɛ subane ngakyile bie a, Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔbahilehile bɛ yeamaa bɛade ɔ bo.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Noko kɛ ɔde biala la, bɛmaa yɛhɔ yɛ nyunlu yɛzɔ mɔɔ yɛlɛ la anu boɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Me mediema, bɛ muala bɛva me gyakɛ. Yɛmaa bɛ ndonwo kpalɛ, yemɔti bɛnlea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ la boɛ.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ dahuu meka, yɛɛ ɛnɛ noko melɛ nyanelilɛ melɛsi zolɛ a: menli dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne ɛmaa bɛyɛ Kelaese meanubaka ne azo ewule ne anwo agbɔvolɛ a.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ, bɛ awieleɛ a le kɛ Nyamenle bazɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ nyamenle a le bɛ ko. Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛse nwolɛ nyiane la bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo, yɛɛ bɛ adwenle muala gyi ewiade ninyɛne zo.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Yɛmɛ, yɛ nzi maanle wɔ anwuma. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ yɛ nye la kɛ yɛ Dievolɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese vi bara a.

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: Na ɔbalua tumi ne mɔɔ maa ɔkola ɔfa ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔbawula ɔ bo la azo yeahakyi yɛ nwonane wulera ɛhye yeayɛ ye kɛ ye anyunlunyia nwonane ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, me mediema kulovolɛma, mɔɔ me nwo dɔ bɛ a, me ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ me nye die bɛ nwo, na mefa bɛ metu me nwo a! Mediema kpalɛ, bɛgyinla kpundii kɛ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mebodo mesɛlɛ Yiwodea nee Senteki kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo kɛ mediema mraalɛ mɔɔ nee Awulae a lua a.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Akee wɔmɔ noko, me boavolɛ kpalɛ, mekpondɛ kɛ ɛboa mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ; ɔluakɛ bɛ nee me nee Kelɛmɛnte nee me gɔnwo mɔ gyimayɛvoma mɔɔ ɛha la amuala, mɔɔ bɛ aluma wɔ Nyamenle ngoane buluku ne anu la a lile Edwɛkpa ne ɛkpondenlɛ nwo gyima a.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie dahuu kɛ bɛle Awulae ɛdeɛ a; mesi zo bieko: bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa awie biala ɛnwu kɛ bɛlɛ abotane molozo. Awulae ɛbikye.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Bɛmmadwenle debie biala anwo. Wɔ debie biala anu bɛyɛ moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ na bɛva mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la bɛdo Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ bo sonla ndelebɛbo muala azo la bazie bɛ ahonle nee bɛ adwenle gyɛlɛɛnye wɔ Kelaese ati.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mɔɔ meka meadwula me edwɛkɛ ne la a le kɛ, bɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ, mɔɔ lɛ duma, ninyɛne mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo, mɔɔ anwo te, mɔɔ le kɛnlɛma, mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ, nee mɔɔ di munli na ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ nwolɛ la anwo.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛzukoa na bɛlie bɛdo nu bɛvi me ɛdendɛlɛ nee me nyɛleɛ nu la, na Nyamenle ne mɔɔ maa yɛ anzonudwolɛ la nee bɛ badɛnla. Moyɛlɛ

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Medi fɛlɛko kpole wɔ Awulae ati kɛ mekɛ tendenle ye anzi, eza bɛnyia adenle bɛlɛkile kɛ bɛdwenle me nwo a. Menga kɛ bɛgyakyi me nwo ɛdwenlenlɛ, na ɛnee bɛnnyia adenle.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ melɛka la ɛngile kɛ me nwo ɛhyele me, ɔluakɛ mezukoa kɛ me kunlu kɛdwo me nwo mekɛ biala wɔ gyinlabelɛ biala mɔɔ mewɔ nu la anu.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Meze ehyia di, meze ezukoa di. Mezukoa ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ, amaa ɛleka biala nee mekɛ biala anu, saa menyia ye medi o, meannyia ye meanli o, saa melɛ bie o, menlɛ bie o, me kunlu adwo me nwo.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Ɔlua anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese fa maa me la ati, mekola megyinla ninyɛne muala anloa.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Noko bɛyɛle ye boɛ kɛ bɛboale me wɔ me anwongyelelɛ ne anu a.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ Felepaema, bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ mɔɔ medumua meabɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, mɔɔ menvile Masidonea la, bɛmɛ ala a bɛle asɔnema mɔɔ boale me, nleɛnleanle me nvasoɛ nee me kakɛ nu a.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Fane dɔɔnwo ne ala bɛnwanle me wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ me nwo kɛhyele me wɔ Tɛsalonaeka la.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ mekpondɛ nwanle la ati ɔ, na mekpondɛ kɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo ba nvasoɛ dɔɔnwo.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛva bɛnwa me la me sa ɛha ye, ɔzonle somaa! Kɛkala mɔɔ me sa ɛha bɛ nwanle mɔɔ Ɛpafulodaetɛse ɛva ɛrɛlɛ me la, mengyia debie biala anwo bieko. Bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne le kɛ azubɔlɛ evuanlɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo na ɔ nye sɔ ye la.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Me Nyamenle ne balua Kelaese Gyisɛse anyunlunyia nu anwonyia kpole ne azo ayɛ bɛ ɛhyianlɛdeɛ amaa bɛ.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Anyunlunyia ɛha yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne dahuu! Amen. Ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Yɛbiza Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ le Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdeɛ la kɔsɔɔti ahye. Mediema mɔɔ nee me wɔ ɛke la biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la amuala, bɔbɔ Maanle Maanle belemgbunli ne suakunlu amra ne mɔ biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo yeyɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ la nee yɛ diema Temɔte ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ wɔ Kɔlɔsae na bɛle yɛ mediema nɔhavoma kpalɛ mɔɔ die Kelaese di nɔhalɛ nu la. Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ, yɛyɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze Nyamenle ne mo.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛde kɛ bɛliele Kelaese Gyisɛse bɛlile la, bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ wɔ Nyamenle menli ne anwo,

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛlɛ anyelazo bie mɔɔ bɛ sa baha ye wɔ anwuma a. Anyelazo ɛhye a bɛdele nwolɛ edwɛkɛ alumua ne, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale Edwɛkpa ne bɛrɛlɛle bɛ la.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: Edwɛkpa ne ɛlɛso ma yɛɛ ɔlɛnyi wɔ ewiade ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, kɛmɔ ɔzile la pɛpɛ wɔ bɛ nuhua wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛdele Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ ne na bɛdele ɔ bo bɛnwunle ye deɛ holɛ la.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Ɛpafelase a hilehilele bɛ Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ɛhye anwo edwɛkɛ a. Ɔle yɛ diema sonvolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ sonle Kelaese nɔhalɛ nu a; ɔgyi yɛ gyakɛ anu wɔ lɔ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Ɔdaye yɛɛ eza yeha ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum ne ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ yehile yɛ a.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati, sumunli kɛ yɛdele bɛ nganeɛ la, dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ. Yɛsɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔva sunsum nu nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo muala ɔyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, amaa bɛanyia Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo,

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: bɛabɔ bɛ ɛbɛla ne bɛamaa yeafɛta Awulae, dahuu bɛayɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo la, na bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne anwo ara nvasoɛ wɔ gyima kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, na bɛade Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne abo kpalɛ.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye anyunlunyia tumi ne ɛwula bɛ anwosesebɛ, amaa bɛava abotane nee anyelielɛ bɛagyinla debie biala anloa,

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: na bɛava fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛayɛ Selɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmaa bɛfɛta kɛ bɛ nee ye menli ne kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla ye wienyi ne anu la mo.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlie yɛ ɛvi awozinli nu tumi ne mɔ abo, yeva yɛ yera ɔ Ra kulovolɛ ne belemgbunlililɛ ne abo,

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Kelaese le Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu ye la sɔhovolɛ. Yemɔ a ɔle abɔdeɛ muala anu belamunli Ralɛ a.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ɔ nwo zo a Nyamenle luale bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a: mɔɔ wɔ anwuma o nee mɔɔ wɔ aze o, mɔɔ bɛnwu bɛ nee mɔɔ bɛnnwu bɛ la amuala, ewiade ye anu tumima nee arelemgbunli nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsie ɛnɛ mekɛ ye anu awozinli ewiade ye nee sunsum nu ɛlɔnema; Nyamenle luale Kelaese anwo zo a bɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a, yɛɛ Kelaese ati a ɔbɔle bɛ a.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Kelaese wɔ ɛkɛ ne kolaa na ɛhye mɔ amuala ara, na yemɔ a ɔsɔ ewiade ye ɔmaa ɔyɛ ewiade a.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Yemɔ a ɔle ye sonlabaka ne, mɔɔ le Asɔne ne ati a, yemɔ a ɔle debie biala mɔlebɛbo a, yɛɛ yemɔ a ɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdwazole bɛ bɛvile ewule nu la kpanyinli a, amaa debie biala anu yealumua.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔhulole yɛɛ ɔvale ye su ne amuala ɔwulale Ralɛ ne nu a.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, ɔlua Ralɛ ne anwo zo, Nyamenle ɛbɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔdie aleɛabo ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze la yeamaa ɔ nwo na yealua ɔ Ra ne ewule mɔɔ ɔwule meanubaka ne azo la azo ɔ nee bɛ ayɛ ko.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Dɛba ne ɔlua bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle nee bɛ adwenle ɛtane mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la ati, ɛnee bɛ nee Nyamenle bɛ avinli twe, na bɛle ye agbɔvolɛ.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala, ɔlua Kelaese ewule ne azo bɛyɛ Nyamenle agɔnwo mɔ, amaa yeava bɛ yeara ɔ nyunlu kɛ bɛ nwo te nwuanzaanwu mɔɔ fɔlɛlilɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nu a.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛsɔ bɛ diedi ne anu ɛsesebɛ, bɛgyinla bɛ ti na bɛgyinla kpundii. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛzɛkye bɛ anyelazo ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne la a. Edwɛkpa ɛhye, bɛbɔ ye nolo bɛhile abɔdeɛ muala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la, yɛɛ medame, Pɔɔlo a bɛyɛ me nwolɛ sonvolɛ a. Pɔɔlo gyima kɛ ɔle Asɔne ne sonvolɛ

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, bɛdabɛ bɛ ti ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɔluakɛ melua me nwonane nu amaneɛnwunlɛ ye azo melɛboa meamaa Kelaese amaneɛnwunlɛ wɔ ye Asɔne ne ati ali munli.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ me asɔne ne sonvolɛ, na yeva gyima ɛhye yemaa me kɛ menyɛ wɔ bɛ ti a. Gyima ne a le Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔle fealera nu debie mɔɔ Nyamenle vale veale aleɛabo amra ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la, na kɛkala yeye yehile ye menli ne a.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne a le kɛ ɔkɛye ye fealera nu kpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔbɔle, mɔɔ anyunlunyia nee anwonyia ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ɔmaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti la ɔkɛhile ye menli ne. Fealera nu kpɔkɛ ɛhye a le kɛ Kelaese ne de bɛ nu, na ɔbamaa bɛanyia anyelazo kɛ kenle bie bɛbanyia Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne bie.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Yemɔti yɛbɔ Kelaese ɛhye anwo nolo yɛkile awie biala, yɛkilehile bɛ na yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nu, amaa yɛava ko biala yɛara Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ sonla mɔɔ di munli, na ɔ nee Kelaese a lua a.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Na ɛhye yɛɛ melɛ anwosesebɛ kpole ne mɔɔ Kelaese fa maa na ɔyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ wɔ me nu la mepele meyɛ a.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa menga gyima ɛsesebɛ mɔɔ meyɛ memaa bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle me nyunlu ɛlɛ la mengile bɛ.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Meka ɛhye meamaa bɛ akɛnrazilɛ na bɛali ahua wɔ ɛhulolɛ nu, amaa bɛanyia diedi nu anwonyia ne mɔɔ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ fa maa la. Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ bɛlua a bɛkɛnwu deɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛvea la a; deɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛvea la a le Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Kelaese anu a Nyamenle nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ anwonyia ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ nee adwenlenubukelɛ vea a.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Meka ɛhye meahile bɛ: bɛmmamaa awie fa ɔ nloa anu menlemenle yɛ bɛ koasea.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menle bɛ nwo lɔ ɛdeɛ, noko me nee bɛ de wɔ sunsum nu, na ɔyɛ me fɛ kɛ menwu kɛ bɛsi bɛdi bɛ nwo eni nee kɛ bɛ diedi wɔ Kelaese anu si de kpundii la. Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ munli wɔ Kelaese anu

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛlie Kelaese Gyisɛse bɛdo nu kɛ ɔle Awulae la, bɛ nee ye ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛsosɔ ndinli kpalɛ wɔ Kelaese anu la, bɛlua ɔ nwo zo bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla, bɛmaa bɛ diedi ɛgyinla kpundii, kɛmɔ bɛhilehilele bɛ la, na bɛyɛ ye mo dahuu.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na awie anva mɛlɛbɛla nee adalɛ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛlua ewiade amaamuo zo bɛhyehyɛ, nee mɔɔ vi awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima ɛkɛ ne na ɔnvi Kelaese ɛkɛ ne la anyɛ bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ.

english_verse: God lives fully in Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle su ne de Kelaese sonlabaka ne nu,

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: na kɛmɔ yemɔ a ɔbo sunsum nu arelemgbunli nee tumivolɛma anwo zo la, bɛ nee ye ɛyɛ ko na bɛli munli.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛzɔnenle bɛ ala la, ɛnee bɛzie bɛ su ɛtane ne nee Kelaese. Eza wɔ ɛzɔnenlɛ ne anu ala bɛluale bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle tumi ne mɔɔ dwazole Kelaese vile ewule nu la azo bɛdwazole bɛdabɛ noko.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee ɔlua bɛ ɛtane ti, nee kɛmɔ bɛnle Dwuuma na bɛnle Mosisi mɛla ne abo la ati, ɛnee bɛwu sunsum nu, na kɛkala Nyamenle ɛva bɛ nee Kelaese ɛra ngoane nu, na yeva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala yehyɛ yɛ.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Ɔpɛle yɛ ɛtane nwo kakɛ biala mɔɔ maa mɛla ne kyekye yɛ la anu, ɔyele ye ɛkɛ ne na ɔvale ɔbɔle meanubaka ne azo.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Kelaese liele ɔ nwo wɔ meanubaka ne azo wɔ awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima asa anu, ɔguale bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ bagua nu na ɔzinlanle bɛ nyɛma zo wɔ ye konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔnedolɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛmmamaa awie bua bɛ ndɛne wɔ mɔɔ bɛdi nee mɔɔ bɛno, anzɛɛ ɛvoyialilɛ nwo, anzɛɛ Siane Fofolɛ nee Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle nwo.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala le ninyɛne mɔɔ bara la ɛlawolɛ; bɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ ne a le Kelaese.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo bɛdi, bɛdwenle anwoazehanlɛ nee anwuma soanvolɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nwo, na bɛfa ye kɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ le debie mɔɔ hyia tɛla zolɛ; menli zɛhae mɔ fa bɛ ewiade adwenle ne tu bɛ nwo mɔɔ ndelebɛbo biala ɛnle nu a. Bɛmmamaa menli zɛhae mɔ adenle bɛmaa bɛsɛkye bɛ adwenle, kɛ asɛɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛlɛyɛ la bɛnyɛ ye boɛ.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ ɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdoa Kelaese mɔɔ le Asɔne ne ati la. Kelaese a le Asɔne ne, mɔɔ le ye sonlabaka ne. Ɔdi ye adane, ɔkuohua ye ɔmaa ɔnyi, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ ye ala la. Yɛ nee Kelaese wu, yɛ nee ye tɛnla ngoane nu

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nee Kelaese ɛwu na bɛnyia bɛ ti wɔ awozinli ewiade ye sunsum nu tumima ne mɔ asa anu a, ɛnee akee duzu ati a bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ asɛɛ bɛde aze bɛmaa ewiade ɛ? Duzu ati a bɛdi mɛla anzɛɛ ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka ɛhye”, “Mmafa ɛhendeɛ ne ɛka ɛ nloa”, “Mmasɔ ɛhendeɛ ne anu” azo ɛ?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti fane ninyɛne mɔɔ saa ɛnyia bɛfa bɛyɛ debie ko a, bɛfa bɛyɛ debie bieko a ɔnyɛ boɛ la anwo. Bɛle menli ngilehilelɛ nee ngyehyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Ngyehyɛlɛ zɛhae mɔ ɔyɛ a zɔho kɛ gyi nrɛlɛbɛ zo wɔ bɛ anwuma soanvolɛma ɛzonlenlɛ nu, bɛ adalɛ anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnyia ye wɔ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo, nee nwonane ne nyanehilelɛ nwo la anu; na ɔmboa sonla ɔmmaa ɔngomo ɔ nwo zo. Bɛ nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ne bɔbɔ akee yɛ kpole.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Bɛdwazo bɛ nee Kelaese bɛra ngoane nu. Yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ ahonle ɛdoa ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ Kelaese de ye belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ Nyamenle asa fema zo la abo zo.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ la anwo na bɛgyakyi mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛwu na bɛva bɛ ngoane bɛboka Kelaese ɛdeɛ ne bɛvea Nyamenle anu.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Yɛ ngoane a le Kelaese, yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ Kelaese kɛra la bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nee ye kɛra anyunlunyia nu. Ɛbɛla dɛba ne nee fofolɛ ne ɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu, mɔɔ le kɛ adwɔmane, ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ, ɛhulolɛ ɛtane, atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane, yɛɛ anyebolo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛyɛlɛ le awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ati Nyamenle ɛya ne bara bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛandie ɔ ne la anwo zo.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko, mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee bɛ atiakunluwɔzo kɛ de la ɛne.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Na kɛkala ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgua ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala lɔ: ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛya ɛvalɛ, ahonle kpole, ɛkpɔlɛ, yɛɛ dumanzɛkyelɛ. Bɛmmamaa aholoba anzɛɛ edwɛkɛ ɛtane fi bɛ nloa anu finde.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɔ adalɛ bɛkile bɛ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛ su dɛba ne nee ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nu bɛgua.

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: Bɛva su fofolɛ ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle ye la nea ye ɛsaso zo kakyihakyi ye dahuu la bɛwula, amaa bɛanwu kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔsi ɔde la.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ansolo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nee Dwuuma, ansolo menli mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛ mrenyanu nzonlɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛle bɛ bie la, ansolo nyɛvolɛ, ansolo menli mɔɔ anye ɛtɛtele, ansolo ahanra, yɛɛ ansolo alehelɛ. Kelaese a le ninyɛne kpokpoti a. Kelaese wɔ ye kpokpoti anu.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Bɛle Nyamenle menli mɔɔ yehulo bɛ na yekpa nu yeye bɛ kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛdeɛ na bɛ nwo te a. Yemɔti bɛze anwunvɔne, bɛyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze, bɛyɛ bɛtɛɛ na bɛzi abotane wɔ debie biala anu.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Bɛsosɔ bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na saa bie lɛ ɔ gɔnwo anwo ɛya a ɔva ɔhyɛ ye. Bɛva ɛtane bɛhyɛ, kɛmɔ Awulae ɛva bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛhyɛ bɛ la.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Na bɛva ɛhulolɛ bɛboka ɛhye mɔ anwo, na yemɔ yɛɛ kɛmaa bɛkɛli munli a.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Kelaese anzonudwolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔmaa bɛ la ɛvinde bɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ nu, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ muala wɔ asɔne ye anu kɛ bɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu. Bɛnwu nyele.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa Kelaese edwɛkɛ ne nee nwolɛ nvasoɛ muala ɛdɛnla bɛ nu kpalɛ. Bɛva nrɛlɛbɛ bɛhilehile bɛ nwo na bɛdu bɛ nwo folɛ. Bɛdo edwɛne, anyelielɛ edwɛne, na bɛdo sunsum nu edwɛne bɛboka moyɛlɛ mɔɔ vi ahonle nu la bɛmaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ, edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛka, nyɛleɛ biala anu, bɛyɛ ye wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu, na bɛlua ɔ nwo zo bɛyɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne mo. Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ ne

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yelɛma, bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, na mɔɔ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Kunlima, bɛhulo bɛ ye mɔ, bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo zo kengɛndɛɛnye.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngakula, bɛdie bɛ awovolɛma edwɛkɛ wɔ debie biala anu, ɔboalekɛ yemɔ a Nyamenle anye die nwolɛ a.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Awovolɛma, bɛmmatu bɛ mra anwo mɔra, anrɛɛ bɛ rɛle kɛbɔ.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛdie bɛ ewiade ye anu menlenlɛma edwɛkɛ wɔ debie biala anu, bɛmmayɛ ye wɔ ɛnyelɛ zo kɛ bɛyɛ bɛahile ala na bɛayɛ bɛ mo; bɛva Nyamenle ɛzulolɛ bɛyeye bɛ ahonle nu bɛyɛ.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la bɛva ahonle kpalɛ bɛyɛ, kɛ asɛɛ bɛyɛ bɛamaa Awulae, na bɛnyɛ bɛmmaa sonla.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ Awulae a bamaa bɛ nwolɛ ahatualɛ ne mɔɔ yeva yezie ɛkɛ yemaa ye menli la a. Ɔluakɛ Awulae Kelaese a le Menlenlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ɛtanevolɛ biala noko banyia ye ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ahatualɛ, Nyamenle bua sonla ko biala ndɛne, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la, ɔnli mɔguazo. mɔguazo.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Menlenlɛma, bɛnlea bɛ ngɛkɛlɛ ne mɔ boɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. Bɛhakye kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛlɛ bɛ Menle wɔ anwuma. Folɛdulɛ

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu, bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu wɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nu, na bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Eza bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛdayɛ noko kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa yɛ mekɛ kpalɛ ɔmaa yɛbɔ fealera nu Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la nolo. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye ala ati yɛɛ kɛkala mela efiade a.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛzɛlɛ kɛ menwɔdendɛ menwɔhile nu wienyi, kɛmɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ ye ala la.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la, bɛ nee bɛ ɛzia nrɛlɛbɛ nu, na bɛdendɛ bɛhile bɛ wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia nuhua adenle la.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na ɔyɛ anyelielɛ, na bɛnwu nyelebɛnloa kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa bɛye awie biala edwɛkɛ nloa la. Awieleɛ nrɛlaleɛ

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Adiema kulovolɛ Tekekɛse, mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ gyimayɛvolɛ nee sonvolɛ wɔ Awulae gyima nu la babɔ me nwo edwɛkɛ ahile bɛ.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati a melɛsoa ye wɔ bɛ nwo lɔ a, amaa yeaha kɛ yɛ agbɔkɛ nu si de la yeahile bɛ na bɛ nye alie.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Ɔ nee Onɛsemɛse mɔɔ le yɛ diema kulovolɛ nɔhalɛ ne, mɔɔ le bɛdabɛ bɛ nuhua bie la a bara a. Bɛbaha debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ wɔ ɛke la bɛahile bɛ.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Alesetaakɛse mɔɔ nee me a la efiade ye la yɛɛ Maake mɔɔ le Baanabase adiema ne biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛsetɛse la biza bɛ ahye. Menli nsa ɛhye a le Dwuuma mɔɔ ɛlie ɛli na bɛ nee me yɛlɛdi Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo gyima a, yɛɛ bɛboa me kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Ɛpafelase, mɔɔ le bɛdabɛ bɛ bie, na eza ɔle Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ la biza bɛ ahye. Dahuu ɔkakye bɛ wɔ ye nzɛlɛlɛ nu, kɛ Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛgyinla kpundii, bɛyɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ ati ɛdi, na bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Mekola medi daselɛ kɛ yeyɛ gyima kpole yemaa bɛ nee menli mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia nee Hayɛleepɔlese la.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luku mɔɔ le yɛ ninsinli kulovolɛ ne, nee Dimase biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Yɛbiza mediema mɔɔ wɔ Lawɔdesia la ahye, eza yɛbiza Nemefa nee asɔnema ne mɔɔ yia nu wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ahye.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛkenga kɛlata ɛhye bɛwie a, bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛgenga ye wɔ Lawɔdesiama asɔne ne anu noko. Eza anrɛɛ bɛgenga kɛlata mɔɔ vi Lawɔdesia kɛra la.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Na bɛha bɛhile Aakepɛse kɛ ɔnlea ɔmaa Awulae gyima ne mɔɔ yezɔ nu la ɛli munli.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, me sa anloa ɛne: Mebiza bɛ ahye. Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi kɛ mela kpanwu nu! Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo, Saelase, yɛɛ Temɔte ɛkɛ. Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Tɛsalonaeka asɔne ne anu amra mɔɔ le Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ la. Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Tɛsalonaekama ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee diedi

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Dahuu yɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a, yɛbɔ bɛ duma yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ muala bɛ ti.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa yɛkɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne nee yɛ Ze ne anyunlu a, yɛkakye kɛ bɛzile bɛhilele bɛ diedi na bɛ ɛhulolɛ manle bɛyɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ, nee kɛ bɛ anyelazo mɔɔ wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anu la si gyi kpundii la.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛze kɛ Nyamenle lɛ bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ na yekpa nu yeye bɛ yemaa ɔ nwo.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛanva yɛ nloa mgbane a yɛvale Edwɛkpa ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ a, yɛvale tumi nee Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne nee ye nɔhalɛ ne anwo adwenle mɔɔ si pi la a yɛrale a. Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ yɛzile yɛbɔle yɛ ɛbɛla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ de la; yɛyɛle ɛhye wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ kpalɛ ti.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Bɛzukoale yɛ nee Awulae; yemɔti bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo, na bɛvale anyelielɛ ne mɔɔ vi Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne anu ba la bɛliele nrɛlaleɛ ne.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati bɛyɛle ndonwo kpalɛ bɛmanle diedima mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea nee Giliki maanzinli ne mɔ anu la.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
