translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ tɛ Awulae anwo nrɛlaleɛ ne angome yɛɛ vi bɛ ɛkɛ ne dwule Masidonea nee Akaya a, na eza bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anu la noko ɛdwu menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛleka muala la anzo nu. Ɛhye ati, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Menli zɔhane mɔ ka kɛ bɛzile bɛliele yɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛrale bɛ nwo lɔ la. Bɛka kɛ bɛzile bɛhwenle bɛ nwo bɛvile bɛ mmonle ngakyile ne mɔ anwo, bɛhɔle Nyamenle ɛkɛ na bɛzonlenle nɔhalɛ nee tease Nyamenle ne la.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: Bɛkile kɛ kɛkala bɛlɛkendɛ ɔ Ra Gyisɛse kɛ ɔvi anwuma ɔbara. Yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle dwazole ye vile ewule nu, na ɔdie yɛ ɔfi Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne mɔɔ bara la anu a.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛdabɛ bɛnwu kɛ yɛ ɛralɛ mɔɔ yɛrale bɛ nwo lɔ la anyɛ mgbane.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze amaneɛ mɔɔ yɛnwunle ye nee aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔle yɛ wɔ Felepae kolaa na yɛara Tɛsalonaeka la. Noko yɛ Nyamenle ne manle yɛ akɛnrasesebɛ manle yɛhanle Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi ye ɛkɛ ne la yɛhilele bɛ wɔ mekɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo tia yɛ la.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛvale yɛdole bɛ nyunlu la ɛngyi nvonleɛ bie anzɛɛ adwenle ɛtane biala azo, yɛɛ yɛando awie biala abɛla.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ yɛanva huhudi ɛdendɛlɛ kɛnlɛma yɛangeda anyebolo zo, Nyamenle di yɛ daselɛ wɔ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Yɛambɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkpondɛ menli nganvolɛ, saa ɔvi bɛ ɛkɛ ne anzɛɛ ɔvi awie mɔ lɔ o,

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: noko kɛmɔ yɛle Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma la, anrɛɛ yɛkola yɛka kɛ bɛyɛ ye zɔhane. Noko yɛbɛlɛle yɛ nwo aze, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yɛ nee bɛ de la, na yɛdɛfɛdɛfɛle bɛ kɛ ɛrɛladane mɔɔ ɛlɛdi ɔ mra adane la.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Ɔlua bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ la ati yɛanga Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la angome ala yɛangile bɛ; yɛvale yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ noko yɛbokale nwo. Bɛ nwo hyia yɛ somaa!

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, mediema, bɛkakye kɛ yɛzile yɛyɛle gyima yɛvɛle la. Yɛyɛle gyima nɔɔzo nee ewiazo, amaa yɛanyɛ kpomgbolo yɛamkpolo bɛ kɔme wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛka Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la yɛahile bɛ la.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee Nyamenle bɛdi yɛ daselɛ kɛ yɛ subane mɔɔ yɛhilele yɛhilele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛliele bɛlile la le bɔkɔbɔkɔ, ɔle fɔɔnwo mɔɔ evinli biala ɛnle nwo a.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛnwunle kɛ yɛyɛle bɛ nuhua ko biala kɛ selɛ kɛyɛ ɔ ra la.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Yɛzile yɛ ahonle, yɛkyekyele bɛ rɛle, na yɛhɔle zolɛ yɛmanle bɛ anwosesebɛ kɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ fɛta Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛrɛla ye anyunlunyia Belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Debie bieko mɔɔ yemɔti dahuu yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo la a le kɛ, mɔɔ yɛvale Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne yɛrɛlɛle bɛ la, bɛdiele na bɛzɔle nu kɛ ɔnle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ vi sonla ɛkɛ a, na ɔvi Nyamenle ɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɔle zɔhane noko. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛlɛyɛ ye gyima wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la anu.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, mɔɔ zile asɔnema mɔɔ le Kelaese ɛdeɛ la anwo zo wɔ Dwudiya la, yemɔ ala a zile bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nwo zo a. Bɛnwunle amaneɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ menli asa anu, kɛmɔ Dwuuma yɛle ala la.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Dwuuma hunle Awulae Gyisɛse nee kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, bɛyɛle yɛ kpɔdekpɔde bɛmanle yɛnriandile. Bɛha Nyamenle ɛya kpole! Bɛkyi awie biala.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛtua yɛ mɔɔ yɛnga Edwɛkpa ne yɛngile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la, amaa bɛtie a bɛanyia ngoane. Bɛyɛle ɛhye bɛmanle bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ akee yɛle kpole. Na kɛkala, Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo. Pɔɔlo anwo dɔ Tɛsalonaekama

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛmɛ, yɛvile bɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne mekɛ ekyi bie wɔ nwonane nu na tɛ sunsum nu ɔ, yemɔti yɛ nwo dɔ bɛ kpole, na yɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ yɛnwu bɛ nyunlu bieko.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛsia yɛba bɛ nwo lɔ bieko la ati, medame Pɔɔlo, menyɛle biala kɛ anrɛɛ menwɔzia menwɔra, noko Seetan ammaa yɛ adenle.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Na ɛnee yɛ anyelazo, yɛ anyelielɛ anzɛɛ abɔtile mɔɔ yɛfa yɛtu yɛ nloa anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ Awulae kɛra la a le boni? Tɛ yemɔ a le bɛdabɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, bɛmɛ a bɛle yɛ anyunlunyia nee yɛ anyelielɛ a.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Nzinlii ɛnee akee yɛngola nu sɔ. Yemɔti yɛyɛle kɛ yɛmɛ yɛkɛha Atɛnse

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: na yɛazoa adiema Temɔte mɔɔ nee yɛ yɛ Nyamenle gyima ye, yɛka Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Kelaese anwo la. Yɛzoanle ye kɛ ɔramaa bɛ anwosesebɛ na ɔboa bɛ wɔ bɛ diedi nu,

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: amaa bɛ biala andoa nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛkile bɛ la ati yeamkpo aze. Bɛdabɛ bɛze ye wienyi kɛ ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ kɛ bɛkɛhile yɛ abodelɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ kɛ bɛbahile yɛ nyane, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛzi la ɛmaa bɛnwu mɔɔ yɛhanle la nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Ɛnee akee mengola ye me kunlu di bieko, ɛhye ati menzoanle Temɔte kɛ ɔranlea kɛ bɛ diedi ne si gyi la. Ɔnrɛyɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ Abɔnsam kɛhola kɛzɔ bɛ muala kɛnlea dedee kɛmaa yɛ gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛle la amuala kɛyɛ mgbane!

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, Temɔte vi bɛ nwo lɔ ɛzia ɛra yɛ nwo ɛke, na yeva amaneɛ fɛlɛko mɔɔ fane bɛ diedi nee ɛhulolɛ nwo la yerabɔ yɛ. Yeha yehile yɛ kɛ dahuu bɛdwenle yɛ nwo adwenle kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ nwo dɔ yɛ, kɛmɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nwo dɔ bɛ la.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mediema, wɔ yɛ anwongyelelɛ nee amaneɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ anu, bɛmɛ a bɛzi yɛ ahonle a. Bɛ diedi yɛɛ ɛmaa yɛ anwosesebɛ a,

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ saa bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ Awulae anu a, ɛnee yɛlɛ ngoane.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Kɛkala yɛkola yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ anyelielɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti yɛlɛ ye wɔ ɔ nyunlu la.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ kɔsɔɔti yɛfa yɛ ahonle muala yɛsɛlɛ kɛ yɛkɛnwu bɛ nyunlu na mɔɔ bɛhyia nwo wɔ bɛ diedi nu la yɛayɛ yɛamaa bɛ.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ yɛ Nyamenle Selɛ mumua ne nee yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse kɛ ɔbuke adenle ɔmaa yɛnyia mekɛ yɛrɛla bɛ nwo lɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛmaa bɛnyia bɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ ngoko na ɔmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye wɔ menli nwo la ɛnyi ɛyɛ kpole kpalɛ kɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ nwo la.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ ɔbamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se, na bɛali munli, bɛ nwo ade wɔ yɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la kɛra la a. ɛra la a.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ne, mediema, kɛmɔ bɛzukoale kɛ bɛkɛzi bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la bɛvile yɛ ɛkɛ ne la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛyɛ a. Na kɛkala yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse duma nu yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ ye molozo.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ ɔlua Awulae Gyisɛse tumi zo yɛvale yɛmanle bɛ la.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ a le kɛ bɛ nwo kɛde na bɛkɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛkɛvi adwɔmane ɛbɔlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: tɛ wɔ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane nu, kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la yɛ ye la.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhye ɛyɛlɛ nu, ɔnle kɛ awie biala yɛ ɔ diema bie ɛtane anzɛɛ sisi ye. Yɛha ɛhye yɛhile bɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yɛbɔ bɛ nwolɛ kɔkɔ, kɛ Nyamenle badea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ zɔhane ɛtane ne la.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anvɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛrabɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane, ɔvɛlɛle yɛ kɛ yɛrayɛ menli mɔɔ anwo te a.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mɔɔ kɛkpo ngilehilelɛ ɛhye la ɛmkpo sonla, na yekpo Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛva ye Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Ɔngyia kɛ awie kɛhɛlɛ bɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ diedima, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye yehilehile bɛ kɛ bɛzi bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko la.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, zɛhae subane ne ala a bɛhile bɛmaa mediema mɔɔ wɔ Masidonea maanzinli nu la amuala a. Yemɔti yɛsɛlɛ bɛ, mediema, bɛyɛ ye zɔhane kpalɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛzie bɛ nyunlu kɛ bɛkɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ le bɛtɛɛ a, bɛdwenle bɛ nwo na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛhola bɛ nwo nea a, kɛmɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane na bɛanva bɛ rɛle bɛanzɔ awie a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ amozi na bɛnle diedima la kɛbu bɛ bie. Awulae ɛralɛ ne

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛkulo kɛ bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la anwo la, amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanli nyane kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anyelazo la.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Yɛdie yɛdi kɛ Gyisɛse wule na eza ɔdwazole ɔrale ngoane nu, zɔhane ala yɛɛ Nyamenle balua Gyisɛse anwo zo ava bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ye bɛdi na bɛwu la azia ara ngoane nu a.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛhye anwo, yɛka mɔɔ Awulae ɔdaye ye ngilehilelɛ ne se la: yɛdayɛ mɔɔ saa ɔdwu Awulae ɛralɛ ne a ɛnee yɛtɛte ngoane nu la ɛnrɛlumua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwu la anyunlu.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Yɛbade kɛ bɛha tumi edwɛkɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ, yɛbade Nyamenle soanvolɛ kpanyinli ne ane, bɛbabɔ Nyamenle aweɛne tendenle ne anu, na Awulae ɔdaye mumua ne ɔvi anwuma lɔ ɔbadwu aze. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Kelaese bɛdi na bɛwu la balumua adwazo avi ewule nu;

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: na akee yɛdayɛ mɔɔ mekɛ ne anu yɛtɛte aze anzɛɛ yɛtɛwule la bɛakpogya yɛ zo anwuma na yɛ nee bɛ yɛ muala yɛahuohua yɛ nloa wɔ amungu ne anu, na yɛahɔyia Awulae wɔ anwomanyunlu. Na akee yɛ nee Awulae adɛnla dahuu.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛva ɛhye mɔ bɛkyekye bɛ rɛle ng bɛkyekye bɛ rɛle ng

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Mediema, ɔngyia kɛ yɛkɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ mekɛ nee ɛlobɔ holɛ ko mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ bazi la anwo.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ Awulae Kenle ne bara kɛ awule ba bawua nɔɔzo la.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ menli kɛdwenle kɛ akee “Debie biala ɛla boɛ” la, mekɛ ne anu ala yɛɛ munzule ne bazi a. Biala ɛnrɛvi ɛsalɛ, ɔbayɛ arɛlevilɛ nu kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ako ɛha ye la.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Noko ayi mɔ, bɛmɛ bɛnde awozinli nu na Kenle ne ali bɛ nvunu kɛ awule la.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛle wienyi nu menli, mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle alehyenlɛ nu menli.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛmmamaa yɛdafe kɛ ebia mɔ la; ɔwɔ kɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye gyinla zolɛ na yɛyɛ yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli mɔɔ dafe la da nɔɔzo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛno nza bɛbo la tinda nɔɔzo.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ, yɛle alehyenlɛ nu amra, yemɔti bɛmaa yɛzie yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na yɛva diedi nee ɛhulolɛ yɛyɛ bulalɛ enyinlike yɛbutu yɛ kɛnra azo, na yɛva yɛ ngoane ɛnyianlɛ nwo anyelazo yɛhakyi bulalɛ kyɛlɛ yɛzoa.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle angyehyɛ kɛ yɛranwu amaneɛ wɔ ye ɛya ne anu. Yevɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛralua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo yɛnyia ngoane.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse wule manle yɛ amaa ɔba a, saa yɛwu o, yɛde ngoane nu o, yɛ nee ye adɛnla.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko, kɛmɔ kɛkala bɛlɛyɛ ye la na bɛmaa bɛ nwo anwosesebɛ. Folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi nee ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛsɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛli menli mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ sonle na bɛyɛ bɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ tu bɛ folɛ, na bɛkilehile bɛ Awulae adenle ne la eni.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Bɛli bɛ eni kpole kpalɛ na bɛhulo bɛ wɔ bɛ gyima ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati. Bɛmaa bɛ muala bɛ nloa ɛzɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Yɛkakye bɛ, bɛbɔ mɔɔ le mgbovonle la kɔkɔ, bɛzi mɔɔ le foanvoanle la ahonle, bɛboa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la, na bɛnyia biala anwo abotane.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ awie ɛnrɛva ɛtane ɛnrɛdua ɛtane kakɛ. Dahuu bɛyɛ bɛ adwenle kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ bɛkɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko nee awie mɔ gyɛne.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Dahuu bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie,

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu,

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: na bɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ gyinlabelɛ biala anu. Mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse lua la yɛ la ɛne.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Bɛmmanua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne,

english_verse: or ignore prophecies.
translation_verse: bɛmmakpo Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ biala.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Bɛzɔ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti bɛnlea, bɛva mɔɔ le kpalɛ la bɛzie,

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: na bɛhyi ɛtane ngakyile biala.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la ɛde bɛ nwo wɔ adenle biala anu, na ɔva bɛ sonla mumua ne ɔzie: bɛ ɛkɛla, bɛ sunsum, yɛɛ bɛ sonlabaka ne amuala, ɔye bɛ ɔvi nvonleɛ biala anu, ɔde bɛ nwo wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese bara la.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fɛlɛ bɛ la anu, ɔluakɛ ɔkola ɔyɛ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Mediema, anrɛɛ bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Bɛva atuu ɛyɛlɛ kpalɛ bɛbizebiza mediema ne mɔ ahye.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Mese bɛ wɔ Awulae duma nu kɛ bɛgenga kɛlata ɛhye bɛhile mediema ne mɔ amuala.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi Pɔɔlo, Saelase, yɛɛ Temɔte ɛkɛ. Yɛfa yɛahɔmaa Tɛsalonaeka asɔnema mɔɔ le yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Kelaese ɛralɛ nee ndɛnebualɛ ne

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Mediema, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo dahuu wɔ bɛ ti. Ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa yɛ kɛ yɛkɛyɛ ye zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ bɛ diedi ɛlɛnyi, yɛɛ bɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nuhua ko biala lɛ ye wɔ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ diedima anwo la ɛlɛyɛ kpole.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛfa bɛ yɛpɛ Nyamenle menli mɔɔ ɛha la anye zo. Yɛfa bɛ diedi nu kpundii mɔɔ bɛgyi wɔ nyanenwunlɛ nee abodelɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛnwu ye la anu la yɛtu yɛ nloa anu kpole.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Ɛhye mɔ amuala kile kɛ Nyamenle ndɛnebualɛ ne le fɔɔnwo, amaa bɛafɛta Nyamenle Belemgbunlililɛ ne, mɔɔ yemɔti bɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Nyamenle badua menli mɔɔ ɛlɛmaa bɛanwu nyane la amuala kakɛ,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: yeaye nyane mɔɔ bɛlɛnwu ye la bɛ kɔme zo, na nwolɛ nyilalɛ ne bie aha yɛdayɛ noko. Ɔbayɛ ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Awulae Gyisɛse vi anwuma, ɔ nee ye soanvolɛma mɔɔ lɛ tumi la lua sendɔlɔra nu kɛra

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: kɛ ɔbadua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnli Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse anwo la azo la kakɛ la.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Bɛbadea menli zɔhane mɔ na bɛaye bɛ bɛavi Awulae anye zo nee ye anyunlunyia tumi ne abo, na bɛazɛkye bɛ ɛzɛkyelɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Ɛhye bazi mekɛ mɔɔ Kenle ne kɛdwu na Kelaese kɛra kɛ ɔbalie ye anyunlunyia nee enililɛ yeavi ye menli ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ye bɛdi la ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛdabɛ noko bɛbaboka Nyamenle menli ne anwo, ɔboalekɛ bɛlie ye edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la bɛli.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati dahuu yɛsɛlɛ yɛmaa bɛ, yɛbiza yɛ Nyamenle ne kɛ ɔmaa bɛ nwo ɛfɛta ye ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne. Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ ɔlua ye tumi ne azo ɔmaa bɛhola bɛyɛ kpalɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ la na ɔmaa bɛ diedi nu gyima muala ɛli munli,

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: amaa ɔlua zo bɛali yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse duma ne eni, na bɛdabɛ noko ɔlua yɛ Nyamenle ne nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlolɛ zo bɛali bɛ eni.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Mediema, mɔɔ fane yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛralɛ ne nee yɛ nloa mɔɔ bɛbahuohua na yɛ nee ye ahɔyia la anwo, mesɛlɛ bɛ,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: bɛmmamaa bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ kpomgbondee anzɛɛ bɛmmadi nyane wɔ nwolɛ na bɛdwenle kɛ asɛɛ Awulae Kenle zɔhane ɛraze dɛbadɛba. Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ bekezɛ ɔvindele Sunsum nu edwɛkɛ bie anu anzɛɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne nolobɔlɛ nu, anzɛɛ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ yɛ ngɛlata mɔɔ yɛva yɛrɛlɛ bɛ la bie anu.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa awie biala bɛlɛbɛla bɛ wɔ adenle biala anu. Ɔluakɛ Kenle ne ɛnrɛra kyesɛ “Atuadelɛ” ɛra zolɛ kpalɛ na mɛladonlɛ ɛhakyi ɔ nwo “Amumuyɛnli” ne mɔɔ bɛbabua ye ewule fɔlɛ la ɛra.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Saa ɔba a ɔbatia debie biala nee nyamenle biala mɔɔ menli sonle la. Ɔbavo yeagyinlegyinla bɛ bati, yeahɔdɛnla aze wɔ Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu na yeavɛlɛ ɔ nwo kɛ ɔdaye a ɔle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Bɛngakye ɔ? Mɔɔ mewɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la menganle ɛhye mengilele bɛ.

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Debie ti yɛɛ kɛkala ɛhye ɛtɛsile a, yɛɛ bɛze deɛ holɛ ko ne noko. Saa mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwu a, Amumuyɛnli ne bara.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, menli somaa ɛlɛyɛ ninyɛndane atia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ la, noko mɔɔ bazi la ɛnrɛzi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛye ahenle ne mɔɔ si ye aze la ɛkɛ ne la,

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: kolaa na akee Amumuyɛnli ne ara. Na saa Awulae Gyisɛse ba a, ɔbava ɔ nloa anu anwoma mgbane yeahu ye na yeava ɔ nyunlu ɛdalɛ wienyi kpole ne yeazɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛnli ne bava Seetan tumi a ara a, na yearayɛ adalɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole, yeaye ngonyia,

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: na yeava adalɛ nee amumuyɛ adenle zo yeahwe bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛminli la. Menli ɛhye mɔ baminli, ɔluakɛ bɛangulo nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ kɛlie bɛ ngoane la.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati, Nyamenle bazoa nvonleɛ tumi ne yeamaa yearayɛ gyima wɔ bɛ nu, amaa bɛalie mɔɔ le adalɛ la bɛali.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Ye awieleɛ a le kɛ, bɛbazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanlie nɔhalɛ ne bɛanli na bɛ nye die ɛtane nwo la amuala. Bɛkpa nu bɛye bɛ kɛ bɛnyia ngoane

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kulo bɛ, yemɔti mediema, ɔwɔ kɛ dahuu yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ bɛ ti. Ɔluakɛ mɔlebɛbo ne ala yɛɛ Nyamenle kpale nu yele bɛ kɛ bɛlie bɛ ngoane a, wɔ bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anu nee Sunsum ne tumi ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ Nyamenle menli mɔɔ anwo te la ati.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyamenle luale Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la azo a vɛlɛle bɛ a, amaa bɛanyia Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anyunlunyia ne bie.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Yemɔti mediema, bɛgyinla kpundii na bɛzɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ yɛ nolobɔlɛ nu nee ngɛlata zo yɛhile bɛ la anu ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese mumua ne nee yɛ Ze Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ hulole yɛ na ye ɛlolɛ ti yemaa yɛ anwosesebɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ nee anyelazo kpalɛ la,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: ɛmaa bɛ akɛnrasesebɛ na ɔmaa bɛyɛ se, bɛyɛ nla, bɛha na bɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la amuala. la amuala.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Mediema, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ li amozi la a le kɛ, bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ kɛ Awulae edwɛkɛ ne kɛdɛlɛ ndɛndɛ na ɔkɛli konim, kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ye wɔ bɛ nu la.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛlie yɛ kɛvi menli munzule atisesebɛma asa anu; ɔluakɛ tɛ menli ne amuala a die edwɛkɛ ne di a.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Bɛkola bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula Awulae anu. Ɔbamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ se na yealie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye yeavi Ɛtanenli ne asa anu.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛmaa yɛ adwenle ɛzi pi wɔ bɛ nwo, yemɔti yɛze kɛ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ yɛhanle yɛhilele bɛ la, na eza bɛbahɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ye zɔhane dahuu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Awulae ɛha bɛ ahonle ɛmaa bɛnyia Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne anwo ndelebɛbo kpalɛ na bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ Kelaese anwo ngilehilelɛ ne anu. Gyimayɛlɛ nwo ɛzonlelilɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Mediema, yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, yɛka yɛahile bɛ kɛ bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi mediema mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ mgbovonle na bɛngulo kɛ bɛdi folɛ mɔɔ yɛdule bɛ la azo la anwo.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ kɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛle la. Yɛanyɛ mgbovonle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee bɛ de la.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Yɛanli awie biala debie mɔɔ yɛandua a. Yɛyɛle gyima, yɛhwinle yɛ ti anwo alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ, amaa yɛanyɛ kpomgbolo yɛamkpolo awie biala akɔme.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ yɛnlɛ adenle kɛ yɛbiza awie debie ɔ, na yɛyɛle ye zɔhane amaa bɛdabɛ noko bɛanlea zolɛ bɛayɛ bie.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛwɔ bɛ nwo lɔ la, ɛnee yɛta yɛka yɛkile bɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ ɛngulo kɛ ɔyɛ gyima la, ɔnle kɛ ɔdi aleɛ.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Yɛka ɛhye ɔboalekɛ yɛde kɛ bɛ bie mɔ ɛlɛbɔ mgbovonle ɛbɛla, mɔɔ bɛnyɛ ɛhwee kɛ awie mɔ edwɛkɛ nu yɛɛ bɛyɛ ye nwotonlonwotonlo a.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Yɛka yɛahile menli mɔɔ le zɛhae la kɛ yɛlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese duma nu, yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ anzɛɛ yɛkakye bɛ kɛ, bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ maa anzonudwolɛ la na bɛyɛ gyima mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ sa kɛhɔ bɛ nloa dahuu la.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Saa awie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔnrɛli mɔɔ yɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ kɛlata ɛhye anu la azo a, bɛmɛ bɛyɛ ahenle zɔhane nzonlɛ, bɛmmayɛ ye ɛhwee, na ɔdaye ɔ ngome ɔ nyunlu bagua aze.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ ye kɛ ɔle kpɔvolɛ; bɛbɔ ye kɔkɔ kɛ adiema. Folɛdulɛ mɔɔ li amozi

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Yɛsɛlɛ kɛ Awulae mumua ne, mɔɔ le anzonudwolɛ maavolɛ la ɛmaa bɛ nzo nu ɛdwo bɛ mekɛ biala nee adenle biala anu. Awulae nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ anyelazo ne manle bɛyɛle me Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Mefa meahɔmaa Temɔte, mɔɔ le me ra kpalɛ wɔ diedi ne anu la. Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Kelaese Gyisɛse yɛ Awulae ne ɛlo wɔ, ɛnwu wɔ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ. Ngilehilelɛ adalɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛtɛnla Ɛfɛsɛse, kɛmɔ mesia meahɔ Masidonea mɔɔ menganle mengilele wɔ la. Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛkilehile ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ a, na tua bɛ.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ maa bɛgyakyi bɛ nla mɔ anwo nwɔra ɛdolɛ ne nee mbusua nu ɛhilehilelɛ somasoma ne. Ɛhye mɔ wie kpolerazulɛ ala, na ɔnvane Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdua diedi zo bɛnwu ye la anwo.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Bodane mɔɔ yɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛdeɛ ne gyi zolɛ la a le ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vi ahonle mɔɔ ɛtane ɛnle nu, adwenle mɔɔ nuhua te wienyi, nee diedi mɔɔ di munli la.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Menli bie ɛhwe bɛ nwo ɛvi ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo na bɛhɔdoa ngoasea edwɛkɛ ngehanleɛ bo zo bɛminli.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛkilehile Nyamenle mɛla ne anu, noko bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka la bɛnde ɔ bo na bɛade ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛka nwolɛ mgbole la abo.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ Mɛla ne le kpalɛ, saa menli di zolɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la a.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnwu kɛ tɛ menli mɔɔ di boɛ la ati a mɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ a, mɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa atuadelɛma, anzosesebɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle nee ɛtanevolɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛnde, menli mɔɔ ku bɛ ze mɔ anzɛɛ bɛ nli mɔ, ahɔdiawu,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: menli mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla funli, mrenya mɔɔ fa mrenya anzɛɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ fa mraalɛ, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwua menli, adalɛma, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi dasewia anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ngilehilelɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ wɔ Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ anyunlunyia nee saleɛ Nyamenle ne ɛva ɛwula me sa nu kɛ membɔ ye nolo la anu. Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne anwo moyɛlɛ

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Meyɛ yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ ɛmaa me anwosesebɛ wɔ me gyima ne anwo la mo. Meyɛ ye mo kɛ yebu me bie na yeva me wɔ ye gyima nu a.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la menganle munzule edwɛkɛ mentiale ye, menyɛle ye kpɔdekpɔde na menguale ɔ nyunlu aze. Na Nyamenle nwunle me anwunvɔne, ɔluakɛ ɛnee menlɛ diedi, yemɔti ɛnee menze mɔɔ melɛyɛ la.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Awulae noko lole me totohyia, na ɔmanle me diedi nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ le yɛ ɛdeɛ la wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Ɛhye le nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdie bɛto nu na bɛdie bɛdi a; Kelaese Gyisɛse rale ewiade ye anu kɛ ɔbalie ɛtanevolɛma, mɔɔ medame a mele bɛ nuhua kpanyinli la ngoane.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle nwunle me anwunvɔne a, amaa Kelaese Gyisɛse abotane kpole ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ medame, ɛtanevolɛma kpanyinli me nwo la, ala ali na yeayɛ ndonwo yeamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nzinlii bɛbalie ye bɛali na bɛanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Na tete Belemgbunli ne, Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle kokye ne, mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu ye la, yemɔ yɛɛ enililɛ nee anyunlunyia ɛha ye dahuu a. Amen

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Me ra Temɔte, melɛ mɛla ɛhye, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle ye wɔ ɛ nwo dɛbadɛba la se la, mewula ɛ sa nu. Maa edwɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ wɔ konle ninyɛne na fa ko konle kpalɛ ne,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: na nyia diedi nee adwenle kpalɛ mɔɔ anu te la. Menli ne bie mɔ ɛminli bɛ diedi, ɔluakɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle kpalɛ mɔɔ anu te a.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Menli zɛhae bie mɔ a le Haemɛneeyɛse nee Alɛzanda, mɔɔ meva bɛ mewula Seetan tumi ne abo la, amaa bɛahile bɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛgyakyi Nyamenle anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛhanlɛ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ lumua la a le kɛ, anrɛɛ bodo, sɛlɛ maa ɛ nwo nee awie mɔ na yɛ Nyamenle mo wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti ati.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne bie maa arelemgbunli nee menli mɔɔ tumi wɔ bɛ sa nu la amuala, amaa yɛ nwo adɔ yɛ na yɛanyia anzonudwolɛ yɛabɔ yɛ ɛbɛla, na yɛanyia adenle yɛazonle yɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛali ye eni, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Zɛhae nzɛlɛlɛ le kpalɛ na ɔsɔ Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne anye.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛkpondɛ kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nwu nɔhalɛ ne na bɛnyia ngoane.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kokye a wɔ ɛkɛ a, yɛɛ pepɛdievolɛ kpɔdavolɛ ko a gyi Nyamenle nee sonla avinli a, yemɔ a le Kelaese Gyisɛse

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ ɔyɛle me ɛzoanvolɛ kɛ menga na mengilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la nɔhalɛ diedi ne a. Membɔ adalɛ, nɔhalɛ ne a melɛka la!

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Eza mekpondɛ kɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ noko siezie bɛ nwo kɛnlɛma wɔ adenle mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛze deɛ na nyiane wɔ bɛ nye zo la azo; tɛ tileyɛlɛ mɔɔ bie ɛtɛbale ewiade ɛlɛ anzɛɛ avikpa nee mgbɔba mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ bɛ nwo sɔɔnwo, bɛawula adɛladeɛ anzɛɛ bɛaheda ndanlɛ awolɛ ɛsesebɛ la yɛɛ melɛka a.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Meka ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ fɛta mraalɛ mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ ɛyɛ koonwu, ɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze ɛzukoa.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Memmaa adenle kɛ mraalɛ ɛhilehile anzɛɛ ɛnyia mrenya nwo zo tumi; ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka bɛ nloa bɛto nu.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛlumuale bɛbɔle Adam kolaa na bɛabɔ Yivi;

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: yɛɛ tɛ Adam a ɛwɔlɛ ne bɛlɛbɛlale ye a. Raalɛ ne a ɛwɔlɛ ne bɛlɛbɛlale ye mɔɔ ɔdonle Nyamenle mɛla ne a.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Noko saa raalɛ ka ɔ nwo aze, ɔbɔ mɔdenle ɔtɛnla diedi, ɛhulolɛ nee anwondelɛ nu a, ɔlua mralɛ ɛwolɛ ti bɛkɛlie ye ngoane.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Ɛhye le nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ: Saa awie anye bolo kɛ ɔyɛ asɔne kpanyinli a, ɛnee yeva gyima kpalɛ.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne kpanyinli biala yɛ sonla mɔɔ ngehanleɛ biala ɛnle ɔ nwo, ɔ ye kokye, ɔ nye gyi ɔ ti anwo, ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo, ɔ nye ka aze, ɔdie nyɛvolɛ na ɔkola ɔkilehile;

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ nzanli anzɛɛ ɔdi mgbonde; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla bɛtɛɛ mɔɔ kyi manzonle; ɔnle kɛ ɔ nye bolo ezukoa.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ kola bu ɔdaye ye awuke ne kpalɛ na ɔ mra fa enililɛ tie ye edwɛkɛ a.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ ɛngola ɛmbu ɔdaye ye awuke la, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yeahola yeanlea Nyamenle asɔne ne azo ɛ?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ rale asɔne ne anu la ɛtɛkyɛle a, anrɛɛ ɔkɛmemaa ɔ nwo zo ɔkɛmaa bɛkɛbua ye fɔlɛ kɛ bɛbua Abɔnsam la.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngɔ asɔne la di ye eni, amaa yeangua ɔ nyunlu aze, yeangɔndɔ Abɔnsam ɛhane nu. Asɔne nu boavolɛma

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ asɔne nu boavolɛma yɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ subane kpalɛ na bɛdi nɔhalɛ a; ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ nzama anzɛɛ bɛyɛ ezukoa nwo anyebolo.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa adwenle mɔɔ anu te la bɛsɔ diedi ne mɔɔ bɛye bɛhile bɛ la anu nɔhalɛ nu.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Bɛzɔ menli zɛhae mɔ bɛnlea kolaa na saa edwɛkɛ ɛnle bɛ nwo a, bɛazonle asɔne ne kɛ bɛle boavolɛma.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛ ye mɔ noko ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye gyi bɛ ti anwo na bɛdi nɔhalɛ wɔ debie biala anu a.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le asɔne nu boavolɛ la ɔwɔ kɛ gya raalɛ ko, na ɔkola ɔ mra nwo zo nee ye awuke zo nea kpalɛ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ boavolɛma mɔɔ bɛkɛyɛ bɛ gyima kpalɛ la nyia bɛ nyunlu na bɛkola bɛka bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse anu la anwo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛnzulo a. Fealera nu edwɛkɛ kpole ne

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Melɛkɛlɛ wɔ kɛlata ɛhye, noko me nye la kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara lɔ.

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: Na saa mekyɛ ɛralɛ nu a, kɛlata ɛhye bamaa wɔanwu kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsi ɛbɔ wɔ ɛbɛla wɔ Nyamenle sua nu la, meka tease Nyamenle ne asɔne ne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ne sika nee ye bodane la.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Yɛka yɛto gua kɛ nɔhalɛ, awozinli nu debie mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anu la yɛ nwanwane: Ɔrale ewiade kɛ sonla, noko Sunsum nu a ɔle saanwu. Nyamenle soanvolɛma nwunle ye, bɛbɔle ɔ nwo nolo wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anu. Ewiade amra amuala liele ye lile, na bɛvale ye bɛhɔle anwuma anyu

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Sunsum ne ka ye wienyi kɛ menli ne bie mɔ bakpo bɛ diedi ne kenle bie; bɛbadie sunsum adalɛma edwɛkɛ na bɛali mbɔnsam ngilehilelɛ ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Menli alane bie mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛwu kɛ asɛɛ bɛva bulalɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu la bɛwula nu la a yɛ ngilehilelɛ ɛhye a.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Zɛhae menli ne kilehile kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ menli kɛgya bɛ nwo, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdi aleɛ bie mɔ. Noko Nyamenle bɔle aleɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi na bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne la ɛva moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛli.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ la le kpalɛ. Ɔnle kɛ yɛkpo biala. Ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa moyɛlɛ yɛdie ɔ muala,

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nee nzɛlɛlɛ ne te nwolɛ. Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ kpalɛ ne

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Saa ɛfa ngilehilelɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛkilehile mediema ne mɔ a, ɛbayɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse sonvolɛ kpalɛ, na diedi nu ngilehilelɛ ne nee ngilehilelɛ kpalɛ ne mɔɔ dahuu ɛli ɔ nzi la aboa amaa wɔanyi sunsum nu.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Twe ɛ nwo fi yɛ nlenya mɔ anwo koasea nwɔra mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnle nyamenlezonlenlɛ la anwo, na mia ɛ nwo sonle Nyamenle kpalɛ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ yɛpele yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ a, ɔluakɛ yɛva yɛ nye yɛdo tease Nyamenle ne anwo zo. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔle menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ Ngoanedievolɛ a, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Fa ɛhye mɔ tu bɛ folɛ na kilehile bɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Mmamaa awie bu wɔ kakula; maa wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ nee wɔ nyɛleɛ, wɔ ɛhulolɛ, wɔ diedi nee wɔ anwondelɛ ɛyɛ ndonwo ɛmaa diedima ne amuala.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Maa ɛ nye ɛbolo Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛgengalɛ wɔ bagua nu, ye nolobɔlɛ nee ye ngilehilelɛ nwo kɔkpula kɛ menwɔra la.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Mmakpo sunsum nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma hanle a ɛ sa hanle ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ vale bɛ sa guale ɛ ti zo la.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle yɛ ɛhye mɔ na tu ɛ nwo maa bɔkɔɔ, amaa wɔ anyunluhɔlɛ ne ala ali wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Nea ɛ nwo boɛ na nea wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne boɛ. Kɔ zolɛ yɛ ɛhye mɔ, ɔluakɛ saa ɛyɛ ye zɔhane a, ɛkɛlie ɛ nwo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie wɔ la ngoane.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Mmatwi kpanyinli biala anyunlu. Dielie bɛ kɛ ɛ ze mɔ la. Yɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kɛ ɛ mediema mrenya;

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: mraalɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ, tendɛ kile bɛ kɛ ɛ nli mɔ, yɛɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ noko, yɛ bɛ kɛ ɛ mediema mraalɛ, wɔ adenle mɔɔ nuhua te la anu.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Di ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ neavolɛ la eni.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Na saa kunlanvolɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ mralɛ anzɛɛ nlɔnra a, maa ngakula zɔhane mɔ ɛzukoa bɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ gyima ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi bɛmaa bɛ awovolɛ la, bɛva bɛdua bɛ awovolɛ kakɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye a sɔ Nyamenle anye a.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Kunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awie ɛnnea ye la, ɛva ɔ nye ɛdo Nyamenle anwo zo, na ɔhɔ zolɛ ɔbodo ɔzɛlɛ na ɔbiza moalɛ aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Na kunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛdi ɔ ti la, kanzɛ ɔde ngoane nu bɔbɔ a yewu dɛbadɛba.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Fa folɛdulɛ ɛhye maa bɛ, amaa awie annyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane biala anga wɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Saa awie ɛngola ye mbusua nea, bɔbɔ ɔngola ye awovolɛ boɛ nea a, ɛnee yekpo diedi ne na yezɛkye yedɛla sonla mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Mmakɛlɛ kunlanvolɛ biala duma ɛboka ahunlanvolɛ ne mɔ anwo kyesɛ yeli ɛvolɛ abulasia nee ɔ nzi, na eza ɔhɔle agyalɛ ko ala,

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ye nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ti bɛbɔ ye duma kpalɛ kɛ ɔle raalɛ mɔɔ tetele ɔ mra kpalɛ, ɔliele nyɛvolɛ, ɔwowole anwondelɛma agyakɛ anwo, ɔboale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo hyelele bɛ, na ɔdule ɔ nwo ɔmanle gyima kpalɛ biala ɛyɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Mmafa kunlanvolɛ bɛlɛra biala ɛboka kunlanvolɛma aluma ne anwo, ɔluakɛ saa bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne dwazo a, ɛnee bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɔ agyalɛ na bɛtwe bɛ nwo bɛfi Kelaese anwo,

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: na bɛdi bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛbɔle la anwo fɔlɛ.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Eza bɛsɛkye mekɛ bɛduolua ye mgbovonle nu bɛwolowolo azua nu, yɛɛ tɛ ɛhye angome, bɛbɔ nzekue, bɛfa bɛ nloa bɛwulowula awie mɔ edwɛkɛ nu, na bɛkeha edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛka la.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati menwɔhulo kɛ ahunlanvolɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ kɛhɔ agyalɛ, bɛkɛwo mralɛ, na bɛkɛbu bɛ awuke, amaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma annyia adenle anga edwɛkɛ ɛtane antia yɛ.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ahunlanvolɛ ne bie mɔ kɛkala angome ɛpɛ bɛ nwo ɛhɔ kali Seetan anzi.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Saa diedinli raalɛ bie lɛ ahunlanvolɛ wɔ ye abusua nu a, ɔboa bɛ, na ɔmmafa bɛ nwo ɛzonle ɔsoa asɔne ne, amaa asɔne ne ahola aboa ahunlanvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bɛ awie mɔ la.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Nwu ye kɛ mgbanyinli mɔɔ yɛ gyima kpalɛ la fɛta ahatualɛ mɔnwo, titile, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo na eza bɛkilehile la;

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛmmakyekye ɛnlankɛ ne mɔɔ wozo awule la anloa,” yɛɛ “Sonla yɛ gyima die ahatualɛ.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Saa awie toa asɔne kpanyinli bie kile wɔ a, mmadie ɛto nu ɛkɛ ne ala kyesɛ wɔde ye wɔ alasevolɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa anloa.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Twi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛtane ala a bɛyɛ la anyunlu wɔ bagua nu, amaa menli mɔɔ ɛha la azulo.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Megyi Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse nee anwuma soanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ anyunlu meka meahile wɔ kɛ, di ngyehyɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ azo, na mmanea menli nyunlu anzɛɛ ɛdi mɔguazo wɔ debie biala anu.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Mmapele ndɛ ɛfa ɛ sa ɛgua awie biala ati zo kɛ ɔrayɛ Awulae gyima. Mmafa ɛ nwo ɛdielie awie mɔ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane nu; nea maa ɛ nwo ɛde.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Mmano nzule ngome ala, ɛ ko ne nee ɛ nwo ne mɔɔ toto wɔ wazowazo la ati, anrɛɛ no nwanye ekyi.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Menli ne bie mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ la ali wienyi, na ɔdi bɛ nyunlu ɔ nee bɛ kɔ ndɛnebualɛ nu, na bie mɔ ɛtane ɛdeɛ kyɛ na yeavinde.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ biala la ali wienyi a, yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnla ali bɔbɔ la, bɛngola bɛnvea zolɛ.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ngɛkɛlɛ la ɛbu bɛ menle mɔ kɛ bɛfɛta enililɛ wɔ adenle biala anu, amaa awie biala annyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane anga wɔ Nyamenle duma ne nee yɛ ngilehilelɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Ahanra mɔɔ bɛ menle mɔ le diedima la mmakpo kɛ bɛnrɛli bɛ menle mɔ eni, kɛmɔ bɛle bɛ mediema la ati. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle bɛ kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ gyimayɛlɛ nwo nvasoɛ ne kɔ diedima mɔɔ bɛkulo bɛ edwɛkɛ la lɔ. Ngilehilelɛ adalɛ nee anwonyia kpalɛ Kilehile na bɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ nolo.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kilehile ngilehilelɛ fofolɛ bie na ɔnlie yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne nee yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ngilehilelɛ ne ɔndo nu la

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: memaa ɔ nwo zo ala na ɔnze debie biala. Kpolerazulɛ nee edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ nwo butulelilɛ ɛyɛ ye subane; na ɛhye noko nee nungunlehwenlɛ, manzonle, aholoba ɛbɔlɛ nee menli nwo adwenle ɛtane ɛvalɛ a lua a.

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: Eza bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛzɛkye na nɔhalɛ ne ɛvi bɛ sa la su kpolera dahuu. Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛdua nyamenlezonlenlɛ zo bɛanyia bɛ nwo.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Saa sonla maa ɔ kunlu adwo mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anwo a, anrɛɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ le anwonyia kpole.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛanva ɛhwee yɛamba ewiade ye, yɛɛ yɛnrɛva bie yɛnrɛhɔ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, saa yɛlɛ mɔɔ yɛdi nee mɔɔ yɛkeda la a, bɛmaa yɛ nye ɛzɔ yɛ nwo.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ bɛ nwo bɛanyia la tɔ ngyegyelɛ nu, na munzule atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane mɔɔ sɛkye menli, minli bɛ bo zo la kye bɛ wɔ ye ɛhane nu.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ezukoa nwo anyebolo le munzule muala abo ndinli; bie mɔ anye ɛbolo ye ɛkpondɛlɛ somaa yemaa bɛvi diedi ne anwo mɔɔ akee nyane ala a bɛdi a. Pɔɔlo tu folɛ

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, Nyamenle sonla, twe ɛ nwo fi ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo, na pele kpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ, anwondelɛ, diedi, ɛhulolɛ, abotane yɛɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle ko diedi nu konle kpalɛ ne na ɛ sa aha ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la, ɔluakɛ ngoane ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle vɛlɛle wɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛlale wɔ diedi ne ali wɔ dasevolɛma dɔɔnwo ne anyunlu la a.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Megyi Nyamenle mɔɔ maa ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ngoane, nee Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ gyinlanle Pɔntɛse Paelɛte anyunlu lile ye diedi nwo daselɛ la anyunlu, meka meahile wɔ kɛ

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: di ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo na maa nwolɛ ɛde bɔkɔɔ ɔhɔkpula Kenle mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛra bieko la.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Ye ɛralɛ bieko mekɛ kpalɛ ne wɔ Nyamenle Tumivolɛ Saleɛnli Kokye ne mɔɔ le arelemgbunli Belemgbunli nee awulae mɔ Awulae la asa anu.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Ɔdaye ala a ɔle damɛnlangoate na ɔde wienyi ne mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛmbikye ye la anu a. Awie biala ɛtɛnwunle ye ɛlɛ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛnwu ye ɛlɛ. Enililɛ nee belemgbunlililɛ mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la le ye ɛdeɛ dahuu! Amen.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Tendɛ kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ngoane ɛhye anu anwonyia la kɛ bɛmmamemaa bɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛmmafa bɛ nye bɛto ninyɛne mɔɔ pɛ nu se kɛ anwonyia la azo, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla Nyamenle mɔɔ maa yɛ debie biala molozo mɔɔ yɛfa yɛdie yɛ nye la anwo zo.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ nyele, bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ, bɛfa atiakunlukɛnlɛma nee ɛhulolɛ bɛkyɛ debie.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Ye zɛhae ɛnee bɛlɛkuohua bɛ agyadeɛ nloa mɔɔ bayɛ sua bo ɛdolɛ amaa bɛ wɔ kenle bie, amaa bɛ sa aha ngoane ne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ ngoane ne la.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Temɔte, nea mɔɔ bɛva bɛwula ɛ sa nu la boɛ. Twe ɛ nwo fi munzule edwɛkɛ ɛhehanlɛ nee kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ mɔɔ bie mɔ fo fɛlɛ ye “Adwenlenubukelɛ” la anwo.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bie mɔ ɛha kɛ bɛlɛ ɛhye na ɔlua ɔ ti bɛminli diedi adenle ne. Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ muala.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ zo merayɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛzoanvolɛ, na yezoa me kɛ membɔ ngoane ne mɔɔ Kelaese ati bɛvale bɛbɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ la nolo la, yɛɛ melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Mefa meahɔmaa me ra Temɔte mɔɔ la me ahonle nwo la. Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee yɛ Awulae Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛlo wɔ, ɔnwu wɔ anwunvɔne na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ. Moyɛlɛ nee akɛnrazilɛ

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Meyɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ mesonle ye nɔhalɛ nu, kɛmɔ me nlenya mɔ yɛle la mo kɛ mekakye wɔ wɔ me nzɛlɛlɛ nu alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ biala a.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ mekakye monle mɔɔ ɛhwinle la ati, me nwo dɔ wɔ nɔɔzo nee ewiazo amuala, na me kunlu a anrɛɛ menwu wɔ, amaa me nye alie.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Mekakye nɔhalɛ diedi ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye, diedi ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛ nla Loyese nee ɛ nli Yunaesi lɛ ye la bie, na medie medi kɛ ɛdawɔ noko ɛlɛ zɔhane diedi ne.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati meka meahile wɔ kɛ fa ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle manle wɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menvale me sa menguale ɛ ti zo la yɛ gyima.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ammaa yɛ sunsum mɔɔ le foanvoanle a; Nyamenle manle yɛ Sunsum mɔɔ lɛ tumi nee ɛhulolɛ na ɔmaa yɛkola yɛkomo yɛ nwo zo la.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Mmamaa Awulae anwo daselɛlilɛ yɛ wɔ nyiane; yɛɛ mmamaa medame noko mɔɔ Kelaese ati mela efiade la me nwo yɛ wɔ nyiane. Ɛdawɔ dua anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa wɔ la azo nwu Edwɛkpa ne anwo amaneɛ ne bie.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Ɔliele yɛ ngoane na ɔvɛlɛle yɛ kɛ yɛrayɛ ye menli, tɛ yɛ gyima mɔɔ yɛyɛ la ati ɔ, na ɔlua ɔdaye ye bodane nee ye ɛlolɛ ti. Ɔluale Kelaese Gyisɛse anwo zo ɔvale ɛlolɛ ɛhye ɔmanle yɛ ɔvi aloamɔleɛ,

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɛnɛ bɛlua yɛ ngoanedievolɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛralɛ ne ati bɛla ye ali a. Ɔpɛle ewule tumi ne anu na ɔluale Edwɛkpa ne azo ɔlale ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ali ɔhilele yɛ.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Edwɛkpa ɛhye yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛyɛ kɛ membɔ ye nolo, menyɛ ɛzoanvolɛ na mengilehile a.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati yɛɛ menwu amaneɛ ɛhye mɔ a. Noko ɔnyɛ me nyiane, ɔluakɛ meze mɔɔ meva me rɛle mewula ye nu la, na medie medi kɛ ɔkɛhola ɔkɛzie mɔɔ meva mewula ɔ sa nu la gyɛlɛɛnye ɔkɛhɔkpula Awulae Kenle ne.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdele ɛvile me ɛkɛ ne la anu boɛ, fa yɛ ndonwo di zo, na tɛnla diedi nee ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la anu.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlua Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nu la tumi zo bɛva bɛwula ɛ sa nu la anu boɛ.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Ɛze kɛ awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea maanzinli ne anu la ɛnriandi me; Fegyɛlɛse nee Hɛmɔgyɛnize bɛdabɛ bɛboka bɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛnwu Onɛsefɔlɛse awuke nu amra anwunvɔne, ɔboalekɛ ɔkyekyele me rɛle mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala. Yeanyɛ ye nyiane kɛ mela efiade a.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Ɔdwule Wulomu ala la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ me a, na ɔkpondɛle me toonwo ɔnwunle me.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Awulae ɛnwu ye anwunvɔne wɔ Awulae Kenle ne anu! Ɛdawɔ ɛze dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔyɛle ɔmanle me wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse a.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Me ra, wɔmɔ maa ɛ nwo ɛyɛ se wɔ ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la anu.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Fa ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdele ɛvile me ɛkɛ ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee melɛkilehile menli dɔɔnwo la wula bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛdie bɛ ɛdi kɛ bɛkɛhola ye kilehile la asa anu.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ noko nwu wɔ afoa nu amaneɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɛle Kelaese Gyisɛse sogyanli kpalɛ mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ a.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Sogyanli mɔɔ gyi konle nloa la kpondɛ kɛ ɔsɔ ye safohyenle ne anye. Yemɔti ɔnva ɔ nwo ɔnwulowula maanlema ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ su ɛnriandilɛ la ɛngola ɛnnyia ahyɛlɛdeɛ kyesɛ ɔdi nwolɛ mɛla ne mɔ azo.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Ɛyazonlɛnli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ la yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ dumua di avule ne anu aleɛ ne bie a.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Dwenle mɔɔ melɛka la anwo, ɔluakɛ Awulae baboa wɔ yeamaa wɔade ɔ muala abo.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Kakye Gyisɛse Kelaese, kakye ye ewudwazo ne na kakye kɛ ɔle Devidi anlɔnra. Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ mebɔ ye nolo la ɛne.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Na Edwɛkpa ɛhye ati yɛɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ na bɛgua me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ kɛ asɛɛ medo mɛla bie la. Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ɛdeɛ bɛtɛguale ye nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati medi debie biala me kunlu wɔ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la ati, amaa bɛdabɛ noko Kelaese Gyisɛse ati bɛanyia ngoanelielɛ ne nee anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la bie.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne le nɔhalɛ, ɔse: “Saa yɛ nee ye ɛwu a, ɛnee yɛ nee ye badɛnla ngoane nu.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Saa yɛgyinla kpundii a, yɛ nee ye bali belemgbunli. Saa yɛkpo ye a, ɔdaye ɔkɛkpo yɛ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Saa yɛnli nɔhalɛ a, yemɔ, ɔdi nɔhalɛ dahuu. Ɔluakɛ ɔngola ɔmbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo.” Gyimayɛvolɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye la

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Kakyehakye wɔ menli ne mɔ wɔ ɛhye anwo, na bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu kɛ bɛmmadi edwɛkɛ agbɔkɛ nwo butule. Ɔnle kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɔsɛkye menli mɔɔ tie la adwenle.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle ɛsesebɛ kɛ ɛkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye, kɛ gyimayɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnze ye gyima nwo nyiane na ɔkilehile Nyamenle nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne kpalɛ la.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Twe ɛ nwo fi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsu zɛhae munzule nee koasea kpolera la anwo. Ɛhye te menli fi Nyamenle anwo.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Zɛhae ngilehilelɛ le kɛ hanlɛ mɔɔ ɛdidi nwonane ne abo la. Kilehilevolɛma zɛhae anu nwiɔ a le Haemɛneeyɛse nee Faelitɛse;

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: bɛgyakyi nɔhalɛ adenle ne na bɛlɛsɛkye diedima ne mɔ adwenle kɛ ewudwazo mekɛ ne ɛpɛ nu ɛze dɛbadɛba.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Noko adiabo ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛwula la gyi kpundii, na bɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ kɛ, “Awulae ze bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la,” yɛɛ “Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ bɔ Awulae duma kɛ ɔle Awulae la twe ɔ nwo fi ɛtane nwo.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Wɔ awuke kpole biala anu, nyɛba nee dwora ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ: bie mɔ wɔ nu mɔɔ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule a bɛyɛle a, yɛɛ bie mɔ noko bɛvale baka anzɛɛ ɛva a bɛyɛle a; bie mɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ yɛɛ bie mɔ noko anwo ɛngyia biala.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Saa awie twe ɔ nwo fi ninyɛne evinli nwo a, ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɛyɛba mɔɔ anwo hyia na bɛde nwolɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle, na ɔ nwo ɛra nvasoɛ ɛmaa ɔ menle na bɛziezie ye kɛ bɛfa bɛayɛ gyima kpalɛ la.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Yemɔti kpo wɔ mgbavolɛ nu atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ na ɛ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ahonle mɔɔ nuhua te bɛfɛlɛ Awulae la ɛpele ɛkpondɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ, diedi, ɛhulolɛ, nee anzonudwolɛ bo zo.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Twe ɛ nwo fi koasea kpolerazulɛ mgbane mgbane ne mɔ anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛze kɛ bɛwie butulelilɛ.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ Awulae sonvolɛ biala di butule. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma ɔmaa awie biala, na ɔyɛ kilehilevolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ lɛ abotane a.
