english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔto ɔ rɛle azule nu ɔkilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛnga la, ɔluakɛ saa ɔyɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a ɔbamaa bɛ mekɛ kpalɛ yeamaa bɛanlu bɛ nwo na bɛaranwu nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛ nye zo tete bɛ a bɛanriandi bɛavi Abɔnsam mɔɔ hyele bɛ manle bɛkpole Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne la ɛhane ne anu.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Mekpondɛ kɛ ɛnwu ye kɛ, awieleɛ mekɛ ne anu, anwongyelelɛ dɔɔnwo bara.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Menli bayɛ angomedi nee ezukoa nwo anyebolo, bɛbamemaa bɛ nwo zo na bɛazua anyetele; bɛbabɔ aholoba, bɛnrɛdie bɛ awovolɛma, bɛbakpo amunli, bɛnrɛzonle Nyamenle;

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: bɛ ti bayɛ se, bɛnrɛze anwunvɔne, bɛbabɔ nzekue, bɛbali mgbonde, bɛbava ɛya mgbane mgbane na bɛahyi kpalɛ,

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: bɛbaye bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛamaa, bɛbayɛ mgbaha na bɛ ti anu ayɛ bɛ fɛ; bɛbahulo anyelielɛ bɛadɛla Nyamenle,

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: bɛbazɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu, na bɛnrɛlie ye tumi kpalɛ ne bɛnrɛdo nu. Twe ɛ nwo fi menli zɛhae mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye bie mɔ luolua nu wolowolo azua di mraalɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛhyele bɛ na bɛ nwo yɛ anwunvɔne, na bɛ ɛtane nwo fɔlɛlilɛ ɛyɛ adesoa ɛlɛbu bɛ kɔme, na nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo ngakyile ɛndie bɛ la anzo.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Mraalɛ zɛhae mɔ dahuu bɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛzukoa noko bɛngola bɛnnwu nɔhalɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ Gyanize nee Gyambilize dwazole tiale Mosisi la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ tia nɔhalɛ ne a. Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛnli munli na bɛ diedi tɔ sinli a.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Na bɛnrɛdwu moa biala, ɔluakɛ awie biala banwu kɛ bɛle agbamgbanvolɛ. Gyanize nee Gyambilize kɛ hɔwiele ye la ɛne. Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, wɔli me ngilehilelɛ, me nyɛleɛ nee me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu bodane ne anzi; wɔnwu me diedi, me abotane, me ɛhulolɛ, nee me kpundii mɔɔ megyi,

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: me amaneɛnwunlɛ nee kpɔdekpɔde mɔɔ bɛyɛ me, ɛze mɔɔ zile me nwo zo wɔ Anteɔko, Ayekoneɛm yɛɛ Lesetela la amuala, ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ menwunle ye la le kpole. Noko Awulae yele me vile ɔ muala anu.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, awie biala mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ na ɔ nee Kelaese Gyisɛse dua la, bɛbayɛ ye kpɔdekpɔde.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛma nee adalɛma bahɔ zolɛ amaa bɛ ti ayɛ se kpalɛ, bɛbabɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ na bɛabɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, kɔ zolɛ sɔ nɔhalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhilehile wɔ na ɛdie ɛdi ɛsesebɛ la anu. Ɛze wɔ kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ,

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: yɛɛ ɛkakye kɛ sumunli wɔ ngakula nu yɛɛ ɛzukoale Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ maa wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ saa ɛdie Kelaese Gyisɛse ɛdi a, ɔkola ɔmaa wɔ ngoanelielɛ la.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Bɛfa Nyamenle Sunsum a bɛkɛlɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne a, na ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa nɔhalɛ ne ɛhilehilelɛ, sonla nyunlu ɛhwilɛ, folɛdulɛ, yɛɛ menli ɛtetelɛ wɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ nu,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: amaa sonla ne mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la ali munli na bɛaziezie ye bɛamaa yeayɛ gyima kpalɛ.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Megyi Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse mɔɔ babua anyewɔzo amra nee mɔwuamra ndɛne la anyunlu, meka ye ɛralɛ bieko nee ye belemgbunlililɛ ne na mese wɔ kɛ:

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Bɔ edwɛkɛ ne nolo na si zolɛ mɔɔ ɛndwenle mɔɔ kɛzi ɔ nzi a, kpalɛ o, ɛtane o! Di menli ne adwenle maa bɛlie Edwɛkpa ne bɛdo nu, twi bɛ nyunlu, tu bɛ folɛ na fa abotane kilehile bɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛdie ngilehilelɛ kpalɛ a. Bɛbali bɛdabɛ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi, na bɛaboɔboa kilehilevolɛma dɔɔnwo mɔɔ kɛha mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛte la anloa bɛamaa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Bɛbaduodua bɛ nzo wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anwo, na bɛadie nwɔra.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, sie ɛ ti koonwu, mia ɛ nye te nyane, kpɔsa bɔ Edwɛkpa ne nolo, na yɛ Nyamenle gyima ne kɛ ɛle sonvolɛ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Mame, mekɛ ne ɛdwu mɔɔ bɛfa me bɛabɔ azu a, mekɛ mɔɔ mefa meavi ewiade ɛhye anu la ɛbikye.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Meho konle kpalɛ ne, mewie ɛnriandilɛ ne su, meli me ɛwɔkɛ zo.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Na kɛkala konimlilɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne, mɔɔ le fɔɔnwoma abɔtile ne, mɔɔ Awulae, Pɛlepɛle Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne bava amaa me wɔ Awulae Kenle ne la, wɔ ɛkɛ ne maa me, yɛɛ ɔnle ɛkɛ ɔmmaa me ngome, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ bɛlɛkendɛ ye ɛralɛ bieko la amuala. Nrɛlaleɛ

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle bakpɔla me ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Dimase ɛhulo kɛkala ewiade ye na yekpo me, yehɔ Tɛsalonaeka. Kelɛsɛnze ɛhɔ Galeehyea, yɛɛ Taetɛse ɛhɔ Dalemeehyea.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Yeha Luku angomekye ala wɔ me nwo ɛke. Nea kɛ ɛ sa kɛha Maake na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla, ɔluakɛ ɔkɛhola ɔkɛboa me.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Mezoa Tekekɛse wɔ Ɛfɛsɛse.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Saa ɛba a fa me anwuma tɛladeɛ ne mɔɔ mengyakyile ye wɔ Kaapɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Tulowase la bɛla; anrɛɛ fa mbuluku ne mɔ noko, bɔbɔ me nwoma mbuluku mralɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ mekɛlɛ nu la bɛla.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Alɛzanda mɔɔ le kɔbele dwinvolɛ ne ɛyɛ me ɛtane kpole, na Awulae badua ye nwolɛ kakɛ noko, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ nea ɛ nwo boɛ wɔ ɔ nwo, ɔluakɛ ɔtia yɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛzo yɛlua la kpole.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Awie biala angyinla me nzi wɔ alumua ne mɔɔ mekaza me ne wɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ ne anu la. Bɛ muala bɛkpole me. Mesɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle ɛva ɛhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Awulae gyinlanle me nzi, na ɔmanle me anwosesebɛ. Zɔhane ati mengolale membɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo memanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Dwuuma la amuala dele bie; na Nyamenle yele me vile awenade ne anloa anu.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Na Awulae balie me gyɛlɛɛnye avi munzule muala anu na ɔ nee me ahɔ ye anwuma Belemgbunlililɛ ne abo. Anyunlunyia ɛha ye dahuu! Amen. Ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Mebiza Pelesela nee Akoyela, yɛɛ Onɛsefɔlɛse awuke nu amra ahye.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Yilasetɛse hale Kɔlente yɛɛ mengyakyile Tulofemɛse wɔ Maelitɛse, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔnde kpɔkɛ.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle bɛla na fɔsɛlɛ ne ara. Yubulɛse, Pudɛnse, Laenɛse, yɛɛ Kolɔdea nee mediema mɔɔ ɛha la amuala biza wɔ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Awulae nee wɔ sunsum ɛdɛnla. Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ muala.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ mele Nyamenle sonvolɛ nee Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la yɛɛ melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a. Bɛyele me na bɛzoanle me kɛ mengɔmboa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la wɔ bɛ diedi nu, na mengilehile bɛ memaa bɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anu la.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: Yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne gyi anyelazo zo kɛ kenle bie yɛbanyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la. Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔmbɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ la, vale ngoane ɛhye bɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ kolaa na yeabɔ ewiade.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne dwule la ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ne ɔdole gua, na ɛhye yɛɛ yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛva ɛwula me sa nu kɛ membɔ ye nolo a.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Melɛkɛlɛ wɔ, Taetɛse, mɔɔ ɛle me ra kpalɛ la wɔ diedi ne mɔɔ yɛlɛ nu la ati. Egya Nyamenle nee Kelaese Gyisɛse, yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne ɛlo wɔ na ɔmaa wɔ anzonudwolɛ. Taetɛse gyimalilɛ wɔ Kiliti

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Mengyakyile wɔ wɔ Kiliti kɛ ɛnlea ɛmaa debie biala mɔɔ tɔ sinli la ɛyɛ boɛ, na ɛye mgbanyima ɛmaa bɛnlea asɔne ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua biala azo la azo, kɛmɔ mengilehilele wɔ la.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ asɔne neavolɛ biala di ɛzonle; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔgya raalɛ ko ala; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔ mra nyia diedi yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛdie duma kɛ bɛle wowawowa anzɛɛ anzosesebɛ.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ, kɛmɔ asɔne neavolɛ ne gyi Nyamenle gyima ne ati la, ɔnle kɛ ɔ nwo nyia ngehanleɛ, ɔnle kɛ ɔmemaa ɔ nwo zo anzɛɛ ɔnyia ahonle kpole. Ɔnle kɛ ɔyɛ nzanli anzɛɛ ɔ sa yɛ kpokpo, ɔnle kɛ ɔ nye bolo ezukoa.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala kola wolo ye na ɔkulo kpalɛyɛlɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo, ɔyɛ sonla mɔɔ ye subane le kpalɛ, ɔ nwo te na ɔdi ɔ nwo eni.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ anzo yɛ se la dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ko tia ngilehilelɛ ɛhye a. Bɛ nuhua titile a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛli Dwuuma nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne anzi na bɛhakyi bɛrayɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma la. Bɛka mgbole na bɛbɛlɛbɛla awie mɔ.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtua bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlua ezukoakpondɛlɛ ti bɛlɛkilehile mɔɔ ɔnle kɛ bɛkilehile la, na bɛlɛsɛkye mbusua dɔɔnwo bɛabɔ bɛ awuke.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Kilitinli bie mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛse ɔle bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ la ɛha kɛ, “Kilitima dahuu bɔ adalɛ, bɛle nane amumuyɛ, bɛle mgbovonle adidikpokuma.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ ɔhanle la le nɔhalɛ. Ɔlua ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ ɛtwi bɛ nyunlu kpalɛ, amaa bɛanyia diedi mɔɔ yɛ nla la,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: na bɛandoa Dwuuma amaamuo dɛba ne nee bɛ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ vi menli mɔɔ ɛkpo nɔhalɛ ne la ɛkɛ ne la abo zo.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Debie biala anwo te maa menli mɔɔ anwo te la, na ɛtanevolɛma nee menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la, debie biala anwo ɛnde, ɔboalekɛ bɛ adwenle nee bɛ ti anu kɛkɛba ne ɛkpɔlɔ.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛse bɛze Nyamenle, noko bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛngile zɔhane. Ɛkpɔlɛ nee anzosesebɛ ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ, yɛɛ bɛnze debie kpalɛ biala yɛ.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Na wɔmɔ, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkilehile diedi ne mɔɔ le saanwu la.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Kilehile mrenya mgbanyinli ne mɔ maa bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, bɛdwenle, bɛzie bɛ nwo diinyi, bɛmaa bɛ diedi ɛyɛ nla, na bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ nee abotane.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala noko yɛɛ maa mraalɛ mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛnwu ye na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛze Nyamenle la a. Bɛmmayɛ ngunzi anzɛɛ bɛmmayɛ bɛ nwo akɛlɛ bɛmaa nza. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkilehile mɔɔ le kpalɛ la,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: amaa bɛahola bɛatete mbɛlɛra ne mɔ bɛamaa bɛahulo bɛ hu mɔ nee bɛ mra.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: amaa bɛanwu nrɛlɛbɛ, bɛazie bɛ nwo diinyi, bɛayɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma, bɛ nwo ade saanwu, na bɛayɛ yelɛma kpalɛ mɔɔ tie bɛ hu mɔ ane a, amaa awie anga Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ka kile mgbavolɛ ne mɔ maa bɛzɔ bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Wɔ ninyɛne muala anu, ɛdawɔ mumua ne pɛ kelemunli kpalɛ wɔ gyima kpalɛ ɛyɛlɛ nu to ɛkɛ. Maa ɛ nye ɛbolo wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne anwo na di nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Fa ɛdendɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ menli ɛnrɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la kilehile, amaa wɔ agbɔvolɛ asa aha bɛ gye nu, na bɛannyia edwɛkɛ ɛtane bɛanga wɔ yɛ nwo.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Kilehile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ahanra la maa bɛdie bɛ menle mɔ edwɛkɛ na bɛmaa bɛ menle mɔ akunlu ɛdwo bɛ nwo wɔ ninyɛne muala anu. Saa bɛ menle mɔ tendɛ bɛ nyunlu a, bɛmmayeye bɛ nloa azo.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Bɛmmayɛ awule ndɛbandɛba biala. Ɔwɔ kɛ dahuu bɛkile kɛ bɛle kpalɛ, bɛdi nɔhalɛ, amaa ngilehilelɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne anwo la ayɛ nvasoɛ wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛye ye ɛlolɛ ne ɛhile wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ ngoanelielɛ ti.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ɛlolɛ ne kilehile yɛ kɛ yɛvuandi ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane nee ewiade atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ yɛgua, na yɛyɛ yɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, yɛnlea boɛ na yɛbɔ Nyamenlezulolɛ ɛbɛla fɔɔnwo ne wɔ ewiade ye anu,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: yɛva yɛhendɛ saleɛ Kenle ne mɔɔ yɛ nye la ye adenle wɔ melɛ mɔɔ yɛ Nyamenle bedevinli ne nee Ngoanedievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese bɛ anyunlunyia ne kɛra la.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse Kelaese vale ɔ nwo manle wɔ yɛ ti kɛ ɔbaye yɛ yeavi amumuyɛ muala anu, na yeayɛ yɛ ye menli mɔɔ anwo te na yɛle ɔ ngomekye ye ɛdeɛ la, amaa yɛ nye abolo kɛ yɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Kilehile ɛhye mɔ amuala na fa wɔ tumi ne kpokpoti wula wɔ ngilehilelɛ nee bɛ nyunlu ɛhwilɛ nu. Mmamaa awie biala fa ɛ nyunlu kyikyi aze.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Kakye wɔ menli ne kɛ bɛha bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa arelemgbunli nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ tumi wɔ bɛ sa nu la, bɛdie bɛ edwɛkɛ na bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ wɔ adenle biala anu.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Ka kile bɛ kɛ bɛmmaka awie anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane anzɛɛ bɛmmadi butule, na bɛva anzonudwolɛ nee agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ bɛdɛnla na bɛli awie biala eni.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee anrɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛle ahɔnwɔne, tufoande, yɛɛ yɛminlinle. Yɛyɛle ngɛkɛlɛ yɛmanle nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo nee anyelielɛ ngakyile kɔsɔɔti; yɛbɔle yɛ ɛbɛla ne atiakunlutane nee anyebolo nu; menli kpɔle yɛ yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛkpɔle yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ yɛ Ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle ne lale ye atiakunlukɛnlɛma nee ye ɛhulolɛ ne ali la,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: ɔliele yɛ ngoane. Tɛ gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛle la ati ɔ, na ɔse anwunvɔne la ati ɔ. Ɔluale nzule awolɛ fofolɛ ne, mɔɔ le ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne fa maa la azo a ɔwole yɛ bieko a.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle luale yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo wolale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne guale yɛ nwo zo,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: amaa ɔlua ye ɛlolɛ zo yɛazɔ Nyamenle anye na yɛanyia ngoane ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ yɛ nye la zolɛ la.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ɛhye le nɔhalɛ. Mekulo kɛ ɛka edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ na ɛsi zo ɛsesebɛ, amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle bɛdi la anlea zolɛ abɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ dahuu. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ le kpalɛ na eza ɔhyia ɔmaa sonla biala.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Tua ɛhye mɔ: kpolerazulɛ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu, yɛ nlenya mɔ aluma ngilehilenu, butulelilɛ nee mɛla nwo kpolerazulɛ. Ɛhye mɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ yɛɛ eza bɛle debie mgbane.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ fa mgbakyemgbakye ara la, bɔ ye kɔkɔ fane kɛyɛ nwiɔ, na gyakyi ye maa ɔva ɔ nwo.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Ɛkola ɛnwu ye kɛ sonla zɛhae ɛzɛkye, na ye ɛtane ne bua ye fɔlɛ. Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Saa mesoa Aatɛmase anzɛɛ Tekekɛse wɔ ɛ nwo lɔ a, bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛra me nwo wɔ Nekɔpɔlese, ɔboalekɛ meyɛ me adwenle kɛ ɛkɛ ne a mekali fɔsɛlɛ ne a.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛmaa Zinase mɔɔ le lɔyanli ne nee Apolɔso kɛbɔ bɛ adendulɛ ne abo, na nea kɛ bɛnyia debie biala mɔɔ bɛhyia nwolɛ la.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me wɔ ɛke la amuala biza wɔ ahye. Yɛbiza yɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ yɛ muala yɛlɛ diedi ko la ahye. Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Pɔɔlo, mɔɔ ɔlua Kelaese Gyisɛse ati mela efiade nee adiema Temɔte ɛkɛ. Ɔdwu yɛ gɔnwo Faelimɔn, mɔɔ le yɛ diema gyimayɛvolɛ wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ ye anu la ɛkɛ;

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: ɔdwu asɔnema mɔɔ yia wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne, yɛɛ adiema raalɛ Afea nee Aakepɛse mɔɔ le yɛ gɔnwo sogyanli ne la ɛkɛ:

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Egya Nyamenle nee yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Faelimɔn ɛhulolɛ nee ye diedi

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Adiema Faelimɔn, mekɛ biala mesɛlɛ a, mebɔ wɔ duma na meyɛ Nyamenle mo.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mete wɔ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle menli ne anwo nee diedi mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ Awulae Gyisɛse anu la nganeɛ.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Me nzɛlɛlɛ a le kɛ, wɔ diedi nu mediemayɛlɛ ne kɛva ndelebɛbo mɔɔ nuhua pi wɔ debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ Kelaese ati ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ la kɛra.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Adiema kulovolɛ, medi fɛlɛko kpole wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye la anwo, na yemaa me akɛnrazilɛ! Wɔmaa Nyamenle menli muala anye ɛlie. Onɛsemɛse ati kyɛlɛkpalɛ

english_verse: Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati kɛmɔ Kelaese ati ɛle adiema la anrɛɛ mekola mese wɔ memaa ɛyɛ debie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ la,

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: na ɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ ti, mebazɛlɛ wɔ. Mame a mele Pɔɔlo mɔɔ megyi Kelaese Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu, na kɛkala ɔlua ɔ ti mela efiade la, noko akee mebiza ɛhye.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ wɔ meamaa me ra Onɛsemɛse. Ɔlua Kelaese ati, Onɛsemɛse ɛrayɛ me ra wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mela efiade ye ala la.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛraze ɛhɔ la ɛnee ɔ nwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa wɔ; na kɛkala, ɔ nwo lɛ nvasoɛ maa wɔ nee medame.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Melɛsiane ye meamaa yeara ɛ nwo lɔ bieko, na fa ye kɛ medame ɔ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ menwɔhulo kɛ ɔkɛdɛnla me nwo ɛke, na yeagyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu yeaboa me wɔ Edwɛkpa ne ɛkpondenlɛ nu, kɛmɔ mela efiade la.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Noko menrɛhulo kɛ menwɔyɛ debie mɔɔ ɛnze nu la wɔ ɛhye anwo, amaa yeanyɛ kɛ asɛɛ wɔ moalɛ ne ɛyɛ mialeranu debie; mekulo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛfa wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛyɛ.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ɔkɛyɛ kɛ ɛhye ati a Onɛsemɛse vile ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne mekɛ ekyi a, amaa saa ɔsia ɔba a yeaha ɛkɛ bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: tɛ kɛ ɔle wɔ kanranli angome ɔ, na kɛ Kelaese ati ɔle adiema kulovolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia me kpole a. Na wɔ wɔ afoa nu, kɛmɔ ɔle kanranli nee adiema wɔ Kelaese ati la, wɔ ɛhulolɛ ɛdeɛ ne bo zolɛ.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Yemɔti saa ɛdie ɛto nu kɛ ɛ nee me a lua ɛdeɛ a, ɛnee die ye kɛ ɛkɛlie me ala la.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Saa yeyɛ ɛtane yetia wɔ anzɛɛ ɔtua wɔ kakɛ a, nea me ti na fa kyɛ ye.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Medame Pɔɔlo, me sa anloa a melɛ melɛkɛlɛ ɛhye a. MEDAME PƆƆLO, MEBADUA KAKƐ NE MEAMAA WƆ. Mengulo kɛ mekakye wɔ kɛ ɛdawɔ mumua ne ɛwɔ me sa nu.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, me diema, ɔlua Awulae ati, gyakyi ɛhye anu maa me, kɛmɔ Kelaese ati ɛle me diema la, na maa me nye ɛlie.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye, ɔluakɛ medie medi kɛ ɛkɛyɛ mɔɔ melɛbiza la. Nɔhalɛ, meze kɛ ɛkola ɛyɛ ɛmaa ɔbo zolɛ.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Eza kpondɛ dabelɛ sie me, ɔboalekɛ melɛ anyelazo kɛ Nyamenle badie bɛ muala bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ amaa meazia me nee bɛ aradɛnla. Ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Ɛpafelase mɔɔ nee me yɛla efiade ɛke wɔ Kelaese Gyisɛse ati la biza wɔ ahye.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ me gɔnwo mɔ gyimayɛvoma Maake, Alesetaakɛse, Dimase, yɛɛ Luku bɛdabɛ bɛbiza wɔ ahye a.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛlo wɔ na ɔ nee wɔ ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Mɔmoane ne, Nyamenle vale ndenle dɔɔnwo azo luale ye kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo dendɛle hilele yɛ nlenya mɔ wɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala,

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: na kenle nsa ye ɛdeɛ, yelua ɔ Ra ne anwo zo a yedendɛ yehile yɛ a. Ɔ Ra ne anwo zo a ɔluale ɔbɔle ewiade a, na yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye ye kɛ awieleɛ ne debie biala le ye ɛdeɛ a.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse kile kɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne wienyi kpole si de la. Ɔle Nyamenle ɛsaso bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ ɔfa ye tumi edwɛkɛ ne a ɔsɔ ewiade a. Ɔliele ɛtanefakyɛ ɔmanle sonla na ɔwiele la, ɔhɔle anwuma ɔhɔdɛnlanle Tumivolɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne asa fema zo. Nyamenle Ara ne le kpole

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Nyamenle manle Ralɛ ne yɛle kpole dɛlale Nyamenle soanvolɛma amuala, yɛɛ duma mɔɔ ɔvale ɔmanle ye la tɛla bɛ ɛdeɛ ne amuala.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anga angile ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ bie kɛ, “Ɛle Me Ra; ɛnɛ a mewo wɔ a.” Nyamenle anga wɔ ye soanvolɛma ne bie anwo kɛ, “Mebayɛ ɛ Ze, na wɔayɛ me Ra.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ Nyamenle bazoa ye belamunli Ralɛ ne wɔ ewiade la, ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma amuala sonle ye.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Wɔ ye soanvolɛma ne anwo, Nyamenle hanle kɛ, “Nyamenle yɛ ye soanvolɛma kɛ anwoma, na ɔyɛ ye sonvolɛma kɛ senle tafinlima.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Wɔ Ralɛ ne anwo, Nyamenle hanle kɛ, “O Nyamenle, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ! Ɛfa nɔhalɛlilɛ a ɛsie wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnea bɛ nwo zo la a.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Ɛkulo mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la na ɛkyi mɔɔ ɛnli mɛla zo la. Ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne, ɛkpa nu ɛye wɔ na yemaa wɔ nidi nu anyelielɛ kpole mɔɔ tɛla mɔɔ yeva yemaa ɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala la a.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Eza ɔhanle kɛ, “Awulae, wɔmɔ yɛɛ mɔlebɛbo ne ɛbɔle ewiade a, yɛɛ ɛ sa anloa gyima a le anwumaneamra.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ muala bɛbaminli, ɛnee wɔmɔ ɛwɔ ɛkɛ; bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ ɛdanlɛ.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Ɛbanyenya bɛ kɛ ɛkpa, na wɔali bɛ kedayegua kɛ ɛdanlɛ. Na wɔmɔ dahuu kɛ ɛde ala la yɛɛ ɛde a, yɛɛ wɔ ngoane ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Nyamenle anga angile ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ bie kɛ, “Tɛnla me sa fema zo ɛke kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ agbɔvolɛ menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Ɛnee Nyamenle soanvolɛma a le nwane mɔ? Bɛmɛ a le sunsum bie mɔ mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle na ɔsoɔzoa bɛ ɔmaa bɛkɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia ngoane la.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛsɔ nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yɛde la anu ɛsesebɛ, amaa yɛamminli.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma vale rɛlɛle yɛ nlenya mɔ la ɛrayɛ nɔhalɛ, yemɔti mɔɔ anli zo la banyia nwolɛ ndeanlɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Na saa yɛanzɔ ngoanelielɛ kpole mɔɔ le zɛhae la anu a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ? Awulae mumua ne lumuale bɔle ngoanelielɛ ɛhye anwo nolo, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdiele ye la ɛhile ɛmaa yɛnwu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Mekɛ ko ne ala Nyamenle ɔdaye ɔlile daselɛ ɔvoale bɛ ɛdeɛ ne azo, na ɔvale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔmanle bɛ, ɔmanle bɛyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne, kɛmɔ ye ɛhulolɛdeɛ ne de la. Sonla mɔɔ die yɛ kɔ ngoane nu la

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛtɛfale ye soanvolɛma kɛ bɛzie ewiade fofolɛ ne mɔɔ yɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ kɛ ɔbara la.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Bɛha ye wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu ɛleka bie kɛ, “Sonla le duzu, mɔɔ ɛdwenle ɔ nwo zɛhae a? Anzɛɛ sonla ra mɔɔ ɛ nye wɔ ɔ nwo zo zɛhae a?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔle ye ɛmanle wɔ soanvolɛma dɛlale ye mekɛ ekyi bie ala anu, ɛwulale ye anyunlunyia na ɛmanle bɛlile ye eni,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: na ɛvale ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛwulale ɔ bo.” Saa ɔvale “ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɔwulale ɔ bo” a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ debie biala boka nwolɛ. Noko mɔɔ kɛkala yɛnwu ye la a le kɛ sonla ɛnzie ninyɛne muala.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Na yɛnwu Gyisɛse mɔɔ mekɛ ekyi bie anu ɔdaye noko bɛyɛle ye ekyi bɛdɛlale Nyamenle soanvolɛma la, kɛ bɛwula ye anyunlunyia na bɛdi ye eni wɔ nyane ewule mɔɔ ɔwule la ati. Nyamenle luale ɔdaye ye ɛlolɛ zo yɛɛ ɔmanle ɔwule wɔ awie biala ati a.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔdaye yɛɛ ɔbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti na bɛle ye ɛdeɛ la, kɛmaa Gyisɛse kɛnwu amaneɛ kolaa na yeali munli, amaa yeahola yeava mralɛ somaa yeahɔ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne anu.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ɔte menli nwo ɔfi bɛ ɛtane nwo na ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yede bɛ nwo la nyia Selɛ ko. Ɛhye ati Gyisɛse ɛnze nyiane kɛ ɔkɛvɛlɛ bɛ ɔ mediema.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mebabɔ wɔ duma meahile me mediema ne mɔ; mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ biala mɔɔ yɛkɛyia la.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Eza ɔse, “Mebava me rɛle meawula Nyamenle anu.” Eza ɔhanle ye bieko kɛ, “Me nee ngakula mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛmaa me la ɛra.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati kɛmɔ ngakula ne mɔ le nwonane nee mogya la, Gyisɛse ɔdaye ɔyɛle ɔ nwo kɛ bɛdabɛ la na ɔnyianle bɛ nwonane ne bie, amaa yealua ye ewule zo yeazɛkye Abɔnsam, mɔɔ ɛnee lɛ tumi wɔ ewule nwo zo la,

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: na yealie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua kɛ bɛsulo ewule la ati bɛyɛle ahanra wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛde ngoane nu la.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔla ɛkɛ wienyi kɛ tɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma yɛɛ ɔrale bɛ ɛboalɛ a na ɔrale ɔbaboa Ebileham abo zo amra.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ kɛ ɔ mediema ne mɔ la wɔ adenle biala anu, amaa yeayɛ bɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ na ɔse anwunvɔne wɔ ye Nyamenle gyimayɛlɛ nu, na yeali bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ, amaa bɛava menli ɛtane bɛahyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Kɛkala ɔkola ɔboa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sɔnea nu la, ɔboalekɛ bɛzɔ ɔdaye bɛnlea ɛlɛ, yɛɛ yenwu amaneɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Me mediema Keleseɛnema, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a! Bɛdwenle Gyisɛse, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛzoa ye kɛ ɔrayɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli wɔ diedi ye mɔɔ yɛlɛ nu la anwo.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Ɔlile nɔhalɛ ɔmanle Nyamenle mɔɔ zoanle ye la, kɛmɔ Mosisi lile nɔhalɛ wɔ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu wɔ Nyamenle sua nu la.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ si sua la lɛ ɔ nyunlu tɛla sua ne mɔɔ ɔkɛzi la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse lɛ ɔ nyunlu tɛla Mosisi a.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Sonla ala a si sua a, yɛɛ Nyamenle noko a ɛyɛ ninyɛne muala a.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mosisi lile nɔhalɛ kɛ ɔle akɛlɛ wɔ Nyamenle sua nu, na ɔlile ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle baha nwolɛ bie wɔ kenle bie la anwo daselɛ.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Na Kelaese ɛdeɛ ɔlile nɔhalɛ kɛ ɔle Ralɛ mɔɔ nea Nyamenle sua nu ɛkɛ a. Saa yɛgyinla akɛnrasesebɛ zo na yɛsi pi wɔ anyelazo nu a, yɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛle ye sua. Nyamenle menli ne ɛnwomenlelielɛ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Yemɔti, kɛ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne se la ɛne, “Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle na bɛdele Nyamenle anwo atua, na mekɛ ne anu bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Bɛ nlenya mɔ nwunle gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ menlile memanle bɛ ɛvolɛ abulanla anu la, noko bɛgyegyele me na bɛzɔle me bɛnleanle.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati menvale menli zɔhane mɔ anwo ɛya na menganle kɛ, ‘Bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛsolo na bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛli me mɛla zo a.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ, ‘Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Me mediema diedima, bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie mɔ ansolo, na bɛande bɛ nwo bɛanvi tease Nyamenle ne anwo.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, amaa ɛtane ambɛlɛbɛla bɛ biala na yeakpunli ye ahonle la, bɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko alehyenlɛ biala, kɛmɔ “Ɛnɛ” gyi ɛkɛ ne maa yɛ alehyenlɛ biala mɔɔ kɛhye yɛ nyunlu la.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ alumua diedi ne mɔɔ yɛnyianle la, saa yɛsɔ nu ɛsesebɛ yɛkɔ awieleɛ a yɛɛ yɛ nee Kelaese kɛli agya a.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a, bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle na bɛdele Nyamenle anwo atua la.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Nwane mɔ a dele Nyamenle ane noko bɛdele atua la? Bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ Mosisi hɔyele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la ɔ.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Nyamenle ka ye ndane ne kɛ, “Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la” ɛnee ɔ nee nwane mɔ? Ɔ nee menli mɔɔ dele atua la.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ɛhye maa yɛnwu kɛ bɛandwu ɛleka ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlie bɛanli.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Kɛkala mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ fane ɛnwomenlelielɛ nwo la tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne la, bɛmaa yɛnlea boɛ na bɛanze yɛ bie mɔ kɛ bɛdɔ sinli na bɛnrɛdwu ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɛleka ne.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛde Edwɛkpa ne, kɛmɔ bɛdele la. Bɛdele edwɛkɛ ne, na kɛmɔ bɛanlie bɛanli la ati, yeanyɛ nvasoɛ yeammaa bɛ.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛdie yɛdi la angome a banyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la a. Ɔle kɛmɔ ɔhanle la. Ɔse, “Menvale ɛya na menganle ndane kɛ, ‘Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la.’ ” Ɔhanle ɛhye, noko ɛnee yewie ye gyima yɛ dɛba, ɔvi ewiade mɔlebɛbo ne amuala.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Wɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne anu, bɛka ɛhye wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsuu la anwo kɛ, “Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ye gyima nwo wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la azo.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ɛhye ala noko a bɛha nwolɛ bie bieko kɛ, “Bɛ gyakɛ ba ɛnrɛtia ɛleka mɔɔ meyɛ kɛ memaa bɛaralie bɛ ɛnwomenle la.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛdele Edwɛkpa ne la bie mɔ yɛle anzosesebɛ la, bɛannyia Nyamenle ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛanlie bɛanli. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee bie mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛbanyia ɛwɔkɛ ne a.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Nyamenle ɛzie kenle fofolɛ mɔɔ le “Ɛnɛ”. Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu la, ɔluale Devidi anwo zo ɔhanle, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la: “Saa ɛnɛ bɛte Nyamenle ane a, bɛmmayɛ anzosesebɛ.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Dwɔhyua holale manle menli ne liele bɛ ɛnwomenle a, anrɛɛ Nyamenle eza ɛnrɛha kenle fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bieko.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Kenle tɛbɔ ɛkɛ ne tɛmaa Nyamenle menli ne, kɛmɔ Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la azo la.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ kɛnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la die ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ɔdaye ye gyima nwo, kɛmɔ Nyamenle liele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ ye gyima nwo la.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ yɛkɛnyia ɛnwomenlelielɛ ne, amaa yɛanlea boɛ na yɛ nuhua biala anyɛ anzosesebɛ, kɛmɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ yɛle la.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne gyi zo na ɔyɛ se, ɔyɛ nla ɔtɛla dadeɛ anye nwiɔ biala. Ɔpɛ to, ɔdua ɛkɛla nee sunsum ayia zo, ɔgya mbowule agbɔkɛ nee mbowule ɛnlome ɛweɛne na ɔfede adwenle nee ahonle nu ɔnwu bɛ nzuzulɛ muala.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu, debie biala ɛnvea; debie biala mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la la ɔ nyunlu wienyi, na yemɔ yɛɛ yɛbabu yɛ mgbonda yɛahile ye a. Gyisɛse le Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli kpole kpalɛ

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛzɔ diedi ne mɔɔ yɛnyia ye la anu ɛsesebɛ. Ɔluakɛ yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli Kpole Kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ toonwo ɛhɔdwu Nyamenle anyunlu a; yemɔ a le Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Ara ne.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Yɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ɛhye le sonla mɔɔ se yɛ anwunvɔne wɔ yɛ sinlidɔlɛ nwo a. Yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle kɛ yɛdayɛ la, noko yeanyɛ ɛtane biala.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmaa yɛzi ahonle na yɛbikye Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia ne mɔɔ ɛlolɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la anwo. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbanwu yɛ anwunvɔne na ye ɛlolɛ ti yɛanyia moalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛhyia la a.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli biala, bɛye ye bɛfi menli avinli na bɛtu ye kɛ ɔgyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu na ɔva bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ ɔbɔ azu ɔzɛlɛ ɛtanefakyɛ ɔmaa bɛ.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔtɔ sinli wɔ ndenle dɔɔnwo anu la ati, ɔmaa ɔ nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze nwolɛ bie na bɛvo la di ye bɛtɛɛ.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Eza kɛmɔ ɔtɔ sinli la ati, saa ɔbɔ azu a ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdumua ɔbɔ ye ɛtane nwo azu kolaa na akee yeabɔ bie yeamaa menli kɔsɔɔti wɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Awie ko ɔdaye ɔngola ɔnyɛ ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli. Bɛdua Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ zo a bɛyɛ sonla sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli a, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle Aalɔn la.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Kelaese ɔdaye yeanyɛ ɔ nwo sɛlɛvolɛ kpanyinli a. Nyamenle ɔdaye mumua ne a ɔzele ye kɛ, “Ɛle me Ra; ɛnɛ merayɛ ɛ Ze.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Eza yeha ye wɔ ɛleka gyɛne kɛ, “Ɛbayɛ sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu, kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ ewiade ye anu la, ɔvale ɛzunlɛ nee nyane ɔdeɛdeanle nu ɔvale ye nzɛlɛlɛ ɔdole Nyamenle mɔɔ yemɔ ala a kɛhola kɛye ye kɛvi ewule nu la anyunlu. Kɛmɔ ɔhanle ɔ nwo aze na ɔvale ɔ nwo amuala ɔmanle la ati, Nyamenle diele ye.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Ɔle Nyamenle Ara bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔluale ye amaneɛnwunlɛ zo ɔzukoale ɔyɛle tieyɛ.

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ bɛmanle ɔlile munli la, akee ɔrayɛle ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtie ye la,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: na Nyamenle yɛle ye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la. Azekpolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛ dɔɔnwo yɛka wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo, noko nuhua ngilenu bayɛ se amaa bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛ ndelebɛbo le ekyi.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ saa bɛle kilehilevolɛma bɔbɔ a anrɛɛ ɔmbɔ nzonle a, noko kɛkala bɛtɛkpondɛ awie mɔɔ bɔ ɔ bo yeahilehile bɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la. Bɛngola aleɛ mɔɔ anu yɛ se la di. Ɛhye ati bɛkpondɛ nyɛfonzule bɛanlo.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ no nyɛfonzule la tɛde adɔma; ɔnlɛ adwenle biala wɔ ɛtane nee kpalɛ nwo.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Aleɛ mɔɔ anu yɛ ɛnlomboɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ maa mgbanyinli, ɔluakɛ bɛzukoa na bɛkola bɛnwu ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ kpalɛ nee ɛtane nu la.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛhɔ zolɛ yɛzukoa yɛyɛ mgbanyinli na yɛgyakyi Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ nwo ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la. Tɛ bɔ zo mɔɔ eza yɛbɔ ɔ bo yɛazukoa kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfi ninyɛndane nwo na yɛdie Nyamenle yɛdi ɔ, anzɛɛ ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ fane ɛzɔnenlɛ ngakyile nwo,

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: ɛsalɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛgua bɛ nwo zo, ewudwazo ne nee ndɛnebualɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la anwo ɔ. Bɛmaa yɛzukoa yɛhɔ yɛ nyunlu,

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: na ɛhye yɛɛ saa Nyamenle maa adenle a ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ a.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Nyamenle yila azɛlɛ mɔɔ meme nzule mɔɔ kɛdɔ zo la na ɔmaa zolɛ aleɛ yɛ kpalɛ maa menli mɔɔ yɛ zolɛ egyinli la.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Na saa azɛlɛ zɛhae azo fifi mbowule nee ndile a, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zo; ɔle kɛ asɛɛ Nyamenle ɛwa ye amonle ɛwie na bɛbava senle bɛazɛkye ye la.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Noko ayi mɔ, saa yɛtendɛ zɛhae bɔbɔ a, yɛ adwenle si pi wɔ bɛ nwo. Yɛze kɛ nyilalɛ kpalɛ bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ beta ngoanelielɛ nwo a.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛnli nzisi. Ɔ rɛle ɛnrɛvi gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛle nee ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛhile wɔ ɔ nwo nee nyele mɔɔ kɛkala bɛtɛbɔ nwo bɛtɛkile bɛtɛmaa bɛ mediema mɔɔ doa Kelaese abo zo la.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Yɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛ nuhua ko biala bagyinla kpundii ahɔ awieleɛ, amaa mɔɔ bɛ nye la zolɛ la bɛ sa aha ye.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Yɛngulo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ mgbovonle. Yɛkulo kɛ bɛsukoa menli mɔɔ bɛlua bɛ diedi nee abotane zo bɛnyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la. Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne gyi pi

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle Ebileham ɛwɔkɛ ne la, ɔvuale ɔhilele ye kɛ ɔbali ɛwɔkɛ ne azo. Kɛmɔ awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le kpole tɛla ye la ati, Nyamenle vale ɔdaye ɔ ngome ye duma a vuale a.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebayila wɔ na meamaa ɛ bo zo amra ayɛ dɔɔnwo.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ebileham zile abotane, na ɔnyianle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle ye la.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Saa sonla ka ndane a, ɔfa awie mɔɔ tɛla ye la duma a ɔka ndane ne a, yɛɛ ndane ne pɛ kpolerazulɛ biala azo.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia ɛwɔkɛ ne bie la nwu kɛ ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ; ɛhye ati ɔvale ndane ɔbokale ye ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, ninyɛne nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ a wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛngakyi na ɔkile kɛ Nyamenle ɛnrɛbɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ a, amaa yɛdayɛ mɔɔ yɛnriandi yɛahɔvea ye nu la yɛanyia akɛnrasesebɛ yɛazɔ anyelazo ɛhye mɔɔ bɛva bɛzie yɛ nyunlu la anu kpalɛ.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Anyelazo ɛhye le kɛ sɛkɛ maa yɛ ɛkɛla. Ɔgyi pi, na ɔgyi ye kpundii ɔkɔpe anwuma lɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anu na ɔkɔdua ɔ nwo wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ɛleka ɛhye yɛɛ Gyisɛse, ɔlua yɛdayɛ yɛ ti, yelumua lɔ, yehɔyɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli, kɛmɔ Mɛlekezidɛke la a.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Mɛlekezidɛke ɛhye, anrɛɛ ɔle belemgbunli wɔ Salɛm, eza ɔle Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne Sɛlɛvolɛ. Mɔɔ Ebileham vi konle ne mɔɔ ɔlile arelemgbunli nna bie anwo zo konim la anloa ɛlɛba la, Mɛlekezidɛke yiale ye na ɔyilale ye,

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: na Ebileham hyɛle mɔɔ ɔnyianle ye wɔ konle ne anu la amuala anu bulu na ɔdule ɛkpɔ ko ɔmanle ye.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Mɛlekezidɛke ɛhye, debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kile yɛ ɔ ze anzɛɛ ɔ nli a, na yeayɛ ye abusua. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ debie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kile yɛ ye awolɛ kenle anzɛɛ ye ewule kenle a. Ɔle kɛ Nyamenle Ara ne ala la; ɔle Sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ ɛnee ɔle sonlakpole kpalɛ. Ebileham, yɛ nlenya kpanyinli ne, hyɛle ye ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ konle nu la anu bulu na ɔdule ɛkpɔ ko ɔmanle ye.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Livae abo zo amra noko mɔɔ le sɛlɛvolɛma la, mɛla ne kile kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛhyɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnyia ye biala la anu bulu na bɛdu ɛkpɔ ko bɛmaa bɛ. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne die zɛhae debie fi bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu amra lɔ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛle Ebileham abo zo amra la.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Mɛlekezidɛke ɛnle Livae anlɔnra, noko ɔliele Ebileham, mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ye ɛwɔkɛ la ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɔhyɛle nu bulu na ɔdule ko ɔmanle ye la na ɔyilale ye.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Kpolerazulɛ biala ɛnle nwo kɛ mɔɔ maa nyilalɛ la le kpole tɛla mɔɔ die nyilalɛ ne la.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Ewiade ye anu, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko la le menli mɔɔ wu a, na anwuma lɔ, sonla mɔɔ die ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko ne la de aze dahuu.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Eza saa yɛka ye kpalɛ a, yɛkɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Ebileham duale ye ngyɛnu bulu ne anu ɛkpɔ ko ne la, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ Livae, ɔdaye yedua.

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɔbɔ bɛtɛwole Livae a, ɛnee ɔwɔ ɔ nlenya Ebileham akunlu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Mɛlekezidɛke yiale ye la.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Ɔlua Livae abusua ne sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ gyima ngyehyɛlɛ ne azo yɛɛ bɛvale mɛla ne bɛrɛlɛle Yizilayɛma a. Na saa Livae abusua ne sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ gyima ne lile munli a, anrɛɛ Aalɔn yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsie ɔ gyakɛ anu a, na ɔnrɛhyia kɛ eza bɛkɛva sɛlɛvolɛ ngakyile bie bɛkɛzie Mɛlekezidɛke agyakɛ anu.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛkakyi sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ne a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ eza bɛkakyi mɛla ne noko.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Yɛ Awulae ne mɔɔ ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ a bɛka la, vi abusua gyɛne nu; ye busuanli bie ɛtɛdile sɛlɛvolɛ ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ bɛwole ye wɔ Dwuda abusua nu, yɛɛ Mosisi noko ambɔ abusua ɛhye duma wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne la. Sɛlɛvolɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ le kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ ne anye la ɛkɛ ne wienyi, kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ le kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la ɛvinde.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu kɛ Mɛlekezidɛke la.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee bɛzie ngyehyɛlɛ dɛba ne ahane, ɔboalekɛ ɔnli munli yɛɛ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Mosisi Mɛla ne angola ammaa ɛhwee anli munli. Na kɛkala, bɛva anyelazo kpalɛ bie bɛra, mɔɔ yɛlua zo a yɛbikye Nyamenle a.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse sɛlɛvolɛlilɛ ɛdeɛ ne ndane wɔ nwolɛ. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awulae ɛha ndane na ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ: ‘Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu.’ ”

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Ngakyile ɛhye maa Gyisɛse yɛ ngyekyeleɛ kpalɛ bie agyinlanudivolɛ.

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Ngakyile bieko wɔ ɛkɛ: sɛlɛvolɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ zonle, ɔluakɛ bɛwule na bɛangola bɛanyɛ bɛ gyima ne.

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Noko Gyisɛse de aze dahuu, yɛɛ ye sɛlɛvolɛ gyima ne ɛngakyi ɛngɔ awie lɔ.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati ɔkola kɛkala nee mekɛ biala ɔdie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua ɔ nwo zo bɛba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɔde aze na ɔdi bɛ ti mgbɔdalɛ wɔ Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ le zɛhae la yɛɛ kola sɔ yɛ wɔ yɛ ɛhyianlɛ biala anu a, ɔluakɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza; ɛtane biala ɛnle ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ye nu. Bɛye ye bɛzie ahane bɛvi ɛtanevolɛma anu na bɛmaa ye zo bɛhɔ anwuma.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ kɔ azukponle nwo kenle biala, kɛ bɛkabɔ bɛ ɛtane nwo azu na bɛabɔ bie bɛamaa awie mɔ la. Ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔbɔle azu ne kokye ala.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Mosisi Mɛla ne maa adenle maa bɛyɛ menli mɔɔ ɛndenrɛ la sɛlɛvolɛ mgbanyinli. Na Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ ndane ne wɔ nu, na ɔrale nzinlii la, yɛɛ ɛye Ralɛ ne mɔɔ di munli dahuu la kɛ ɔyɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli a.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛlɛka la amuala, saa yɛbɔ ye kpɔkɛ ko a, yemɔ a le ɛhye: yɛlɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli zɛhae, mɔɔ de Nyamenle Bedevinli ne Belemgbunli Ebia ne fema zo wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli gyima ne wɔ anwuma lɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Ɛleka ne, wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ tɛ sonla a zile na Nyamenle ɔdaye a yezi la anu.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli biala mɔɔ bɛkɛye ye la fa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne nee nane bɔ azu maa Nyamenle. Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ɔdaye ɔnyia debie ɔbɔ azu.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Saa ɔwɔ ewiade ye anu a anrɛɛ ɔnrɛyɛ sɛlɛvolɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ dua Mosisi mɛla ne azo fa ninyɛne bɔ azu la zonle.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ bɛyɛ la le gyima mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ anwuma lɔ la sɔhovolɛ. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ Mosisi bazi ndanlɛ sua ne la, Nyamenle zele ye kɛ, “Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛkɛyɛ debie biala ɛkɛmaa ɔkɛzɔho mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhilele wɔ wɔ boka ne azo lɔ la.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Na kɛ ɔde la a le kɛ bɛmaa Gyisɛse sɛlɛvolɛ gyima mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kpole tɛla dɛba ne la. Ɔboalekɛ ɔgyi ninyɛne kpalɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ zo.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Saa alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne lile munli a, anrɛɛ yeangyia kɛ eza bɛkɛkyekye fofolɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle nwu nvonleɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ye menli nwo, yemɔti ɔse, “Medame Awulae mese, mekɛ bara mɔɔ me nee Yizilayɛma nee Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne bakyekye ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ a.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛyɛ kɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ nlenya mɔ kyekyele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la. Bɛanli nɔhalɛ wɔ zɔhane ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la anwo, yemɔti meandɛne bɛ zo, Medame Awulae a mese a.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Akee ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ me nee Yizilayɛma bakyekye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bara la ɛne: Mebava me mɛla meawula bɛ adwenle nu, na meahɛlɛ ye bɛ ahonle zo. Mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛ nuhua biala kɛhilehile ɔ gɔnwo, anzɛɛ kɛze ɔ diema kɛ ‘Nwu Awulae.’ Ɔluakɛ ngakula nee mgbanyinli banwu me.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Mebava bɛ ɛtane meahyɛ bɛ na menrɛhakye bɛ nvonleɛ ne mɔ bieko.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle ɛlɛka ngyekyeleɛ fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ yemaa alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛyɛ mgbane. Debie biala mɔɔ kɛkpa nwolɛ la ɛngyɛ biala na yeaminli.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛnee alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne lɛ ɛzonlenlɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ yɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔle nwuanzanwuanza na ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsonle ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Bɛzile ndanlɛ sua ko, ye findezo mgbɛnu ne bɛfɛlɛ ye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza. Ɛkɛ a kɛnlaneɛ baka ne, ɛkponle ne nee kpanwo ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle la wɔ a.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Ɛke yɛɛ ezukoa azukponle ne mɔɔ bɛkpu ɛyɛlɛ zo yɛɛ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke bɛyɛ ye sɔɔnwo la wɔ a. Ezukoa dwora ne mɔɔ mana wɔ nu la gyi Ɛlɛka ne anu. Aalɔn baka ne mɔɔ kpakyele nya, nee awolɛ ndɛbandɛba nwiɔ ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ mɛla ne zolɛ la wɔ Ɛlɛka ne anu.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Akee anyunlunyia abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la zinze Ɛlɛka ne azo anwuma na bɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba anu wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ebia ne azo, bɛlɛkile kɛ Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ. Na kɛkala, mekɛ ɛtɛdwule mɔɔ yɛkilehile debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anu ngoko ngoko a.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Kɛ bɛhyehyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la ɛne. Alehyenlɛ biala sɛlɛvolɛma kɔ ndanlɛ sua ne findezo mgbɛnu ne anu kɔyɛ bɛ gyima;

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: noko Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne ala yɛɛ kɔ ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne mgbɛnu ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la anzi la anu a, yɛɛ ɔkɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ. Ɔlɛkɔ ɛkɛ a ɔfa mogya ɔkɔbɔ azu ɔmaa Nyamenle wɔ ɔdaye Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne nee menli kɔsɔɔti bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ɛhye anwo la kile kɛ suzuamgba ala mɔɔ findezo ndanlɛ sua ne ɛtɛyele ɛkɛ ne la, adenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛfa nu bɛkɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne a.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛhye le ɛzukoalɛdeɛ maa yɛ ɛnɛ mekɛ ye. Ɔkile kɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ nee nane azubɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ bɛmaa Nyamenle la ɛngola ɛmmaa sonvolɛma ahonle nu ɛnde.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Aleɛ nee nza nee bɛ nwo ɛnluanlɛ ngakyile nwo nyɛleɛ yɛɛ bɛyɛ a. Na ɛhye noko le ɛnyelɛ zo debie mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ a, kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛhakyi ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti fofolɛ la.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Na Kelaese ɛra kɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ kɔsɔɔti anwo Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli. Ndanlɛ sua ne mɔɔ ɔyɛ gyima nu la le kpole, ɔdi munli ɔtɛla biala; tɛ sonla a zile a, yɛɛ ɔmboka ewiade ɛhye anwo a bɛbɔle a.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Kelaese wolole ndanlɛ sua ɛhye anu kokye ne ala na ɔhɔle Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne la, yeanva mbɔnkye nee nlankɛ mogya a ɔbɔle azu ne a; ɔvale ɔdaye mumua ne ye mogya a ɔbɔle azu ɔvale ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la ɔrɛlɛle yɛ a.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Bɛkponde nlankɛ nee mbɔnkye mogya nee ɛnlankɛ ralɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛyela ye la nzonle wɔ menli nwo na bɛfa ye kɛ ɔkola ɔnrinzi bɛ nwo evinli muala.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ ɛhye le nɔhalɛ la, ɛnee ɛnea a ɛkɛnwu kɛ Kelaese mogya ne kola di gyima kpole maa ɔbo zolɛ. Yelua Sunsum ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ la azo yeva ɔ nwo yebɔ azu mɔɔ di munli la yemaa Nyamenle. Ye mogya ne bade yɛ adwenle nu avi nyɛleɛ mgbane mgbane mɔɔ fa yɛ kɔ ewule nu la anwo na yɛazonle tease Nyamenle ne.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Saa awie yɛ “wele” na saa ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtulu nu a, kyesɛ bɛkile kɛ ahenle mɔɔ yɛle zɔhane kɛlata ne la ɛwu.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa ahenle mɔɔ yɛle “wele” ne la de aze a, nvasoɛ biala ɛnle mɔɔ yeyɛ la azo; saa ɔwu a yɛɛ ɛnee nvasoɛ ɛra zolɛ a.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati alumua ngyekyeleɛ ne bɛvale mogya a bɛhyele ɔ bo a.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Mosisi gengale mɛla ne amuala hilele menli ne na ɔwiele la, akee ɔvale ɛnlankɛ nee abɔnkye mogya ɔkpotole nzule nu, ɔvale nyinlanyinla nee boane kɔkɔlɛ ndɛkɛ ɔkyekyele na ɔvale ɔbɔle mogya ne anu ɔkpondenle Mɛla Buluku ne nee menli ne amuala anwo,

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: na ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛhye a le mogya ne mɔɔ sɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ kɛ bɛli zolɛ la anloa a”.

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Mosisi eza kpondenle mogya ne wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ la anwo a.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, mɛla ne kile kɛ mogya ala a bɛfa bɛte debie biala anwo a, yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtwi mogya na bɛava bɛali ɛtane nwo mgbɔdalɛ. Kelaese azubɔlɛ ne nunu ɛtane muala

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne zɛhae mɔ, mɔɔ le anwuma lɔ ɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne sɔhovolɛ la, yɛɛ bɛte nwolɛ wɔ adenle zɛhae anu a. Anwuma lɔ ninyɛne ɛdeɛ kpalɛ ne hyia azubɔlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye a.
