english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese angɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mɔɔ menli a ɛzi na ɔle anwuma lɔ ɛdeɛ ne sɔhovolɛ la anu. Yehɔ anwuma lɔ, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔfinde Nyamenle anyunlu dahuu ɔkpa yɛ ti kyɛlɛ a.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Dwuuma Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne fa mogya kɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne ɛvolɛ ɛvolɛ. Na Kelaese ɛdeɛ yeangɔ fane dɔɔnwo kɛ ɔfa ɔ nwo yeahɔbɔ azu ne,

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ saa ɔle zɔhane a, anrɛɛ ɔkile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese nwu amaneɛ fane dɔɔnwo, ɔvi ewiade mɔlebɛbo ne. Noko ɔrale kokye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti ɛlɛkɔ awieleɛ la, na ɔvale ye mogya ɔbɔle azu ne ɔnununle ɛtane muala.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa sonla biala kɛ ɔwu kokye, na ewule ne anzi Nyamenle abua ye ndɛne.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛvale Kelaese ɔdaye noko bɛbɔle azu kokye ala kɛ ɔranunu menli dɔɔnwo ɛtane ne mɔ a. Ɔbara bieko, na tɛ kɛ ɔ nee ɛtane bali ɔ, na ɔbalie menli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkendɛ ye la ngoane.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Dwuuma mɛla ne ɛnle ninyɛne fɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la nɔhalɛ sɔhovolɛ. Ɔle ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ bara la sɔhovolɛ ekyi bie. Azu ko ne ala yɛɛ ɛvolɛ biala bɛbɔ a. Ɛhye ati bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛlua mɛla ne azo bɛnrɛmaa menli mɔɔ kpondɛ Nyamenle la ɛnrɛlua dahuu azubɔlɛ ko ne ala azo ɛnrɛzɔ Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Saa azubɔlɛ ne te menli mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle la anwo bɔkɔɔ a, anrɛɛ bɛ adwenle ɛnyɛ bɛ kesee kɛ bɛnli ɛtane nwo fɔlɛ bieko, yɛɛ eza anrɛɛ bɛgyakyi azu ne ɛbɔlɛ.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɔyɛ se kɛ mbɔnkye nee nlankɛ mogya kɛhola kɛnunu ɛtane mɔɔ mekɛ biala bɛyɛ la abo zo.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ati mɔɔ Kelaese bara ewiade la, ɔzele Nyamenle kɛ, “Ɛmkpondɛ azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ noko wɔmaa me nwolɛ nwonane.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Ɛ nye ɛnlie nane mumua ɛyelalɛ anzɛɛ ɛtanefakyɛ azubɔlɛ nwo.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati menganle kɛ, ‘O Nyamenle, mera kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la, kɛmɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ me nwo wɔ mɛla buluku ne anu la.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Alumua ne ɔhanle kɛ, “Ɛmkpondɛ, yɛɛ ɛ nye ɛnlie azubɔdeɛ anzɛɛ nane ɛyelalɛ nee ɛtanefakyɛ azubɔlɛ nwo.” Ɔhanle ɛhye, noko mɛla ne maa adenle maa bɛbɔ azu mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la amuala.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Eza ɔhanle kɛ, “O Nyamenle, mera kɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la.” Yemɔti Nyamenle kpole dɛba ne azubɔlɛ ne na ɔvale Kelaese azubɔlɛ ɛdeɛ ne ɔziele ɔ bo zo.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Dwuuma sɛlɛvolɛ biala bɔ azu dahuu yɛɛ ɔbɔ zɔhane azu ne ala wɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo, noko azubɔlɛ ɛhye mɔ ɛngola ɛnye yɛ ɛnvi yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Kelaese bɔle ɛtanefakyɛ nwo azu kpalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛ nla la kokye, na ɔhɔdɛnlanle Nyamenle asa fema zo.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔlɛkendɛ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛva ye kpɔvolɛma kɛwula ɔ gyakɛ abo la.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yeva azubɔlɛ kokye yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yede bɛ nwo la ɛli munli dahuu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne di daselɛ kile yɛ, ɔluakɛ alumua ne ɔhanle kɛ,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Awulae se, Saa kenle zɔhane pɛ nu a ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ me nee bɛ bakyekye la ɛne: Mebava me mɛla meawula bɛ ahonle nu, na meahɛlɛ ye wɔ bɛ adwenle nu.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Akee ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Menrɛhakye bɛ ɛtane ne nee bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ bieko.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛleka mɔɔ fakyɛ wɔ la, ɛtanefakyɛ nwo azubɔlɛ ɛngyia bieko. Bɛmaa yɛhwe yɛbikye Nyamenle

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mediema, yɛlɛ adenle bɔkɔɔ kɛ yɛdua Gyisɛse ewule ne azo yɛfa mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne anu yɛkɔ Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse ɛlua mgbɛnu ɛdanlɛ ne, mɔɔ le ɔdaye ye nwonane ne anu ɛkpakye ngoane adenle fofolɛ ɛmaa yɛ.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ yɛlɛ sɛlɛvolɛ kpole mɔɔ nea Nyamenle sua ne azo la,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: bɛmaa yɛva ahonle kpalɛ nee diedi mɔɔ si pi, ahonle mɔɔ bɛde nwolɛ bɛvi adwenle nu fɔlɛlilɛ nwo, nee sonlabaka mɔɔ bɛva nzule anye komikomi bɛbia ye la yɛhwe yɛbikye Nyamenle.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛzɔ anyelazo ne mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye la anu kpalɛ, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle yɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la le nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛdwenle yɛkpondɛ adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zolɛ a yɛkɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na yɛkɛyɛ gyima kpalɛ la.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa yɛgyakyi kɛ yɛkɛhɔ yɛ nyianu ne, kɛmɔ bie mɔ yɛ la. Bɛdabɛ bɛkola bɛnwu kɛ Awulae Kenle ne ɛbikye, yemɔti bɛmaa yɛsosɔ yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnwu nɔhalɛ ne la, saa yɛ nye fuu yɛkɔ zolɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane a, azubɔlɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛhola kɛye yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ a.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Ɛnee mɔɔ ɛha la a le kɛ yɛkɛva anwowozolɛ yɛkɛhendɛ Nyamenle Ndɛnebualɛ ne nee ye ɛya ne mɔɔ sɔ hulenyi kɛ senle mɔɔ bazɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtia Nyamenle la.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ kɛdo Mosisi Mɛla ne la, saa bɛnyia alasevolɛ nwiɔ anzɛɛ nsa di daselɛ tia ye na ɔdi fɔlɛ a, bɛku ye mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ biala ɛnle nu a.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Ɛnee ɛdawɔ fa ɛ nye to na nea sonla mɔɔ kɛkpo Nyamenle Ara ne, na yeambu mogya ne mɔɔ bɛlua zo a bɛ nwo te na Nyamenle vale zɔle ngyekyeleɛ ne anloa, na ɔkɛva Nyamenle ɛlolɛ Sunsum ne anyunlu ɔkɛkyikyi aze la ɛ? Ye ndeanlɛ mɔɔ ɔbanyia ye la le kpole kpalɛ.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ yɛze ahenle mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Nzenralɛlilɛ le me ɛdeɛ, mebadua ɛtane kakɛ” la; yɛɛ eza yɛze Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ se, “Nyamenle babua ye menli ndɛne” la.

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Ɔkɛyɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛdeɛ, kɛ ɛkɛdɔ tease Nyamenle ne ɛhane nu a!

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye mɔɔ zile bɛ nwo zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle wienyi ne dale bɛ nwo zo la. Bɛnwunle amaneɛ dɔɔnwo, noko abodelɛ ne ambo bɛ nwo zo ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Ɔdwule mekɛ ne bie la, bɛguale bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ bagua nu, bɛhilele bɛ nyane, yɛɛ ɔdwule mekɛ ne bie noko la, ɛnee akee bɛ nuhua ko biala bɔbɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔdaye ɔnwu amaneɛ ne bie.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee menli mɔɔ bɛguale bɛ efiade la lile nyane, yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛzale bɛ bɛliele bɛ nwo ninyɛne bɔbɔ la, yeanvane bɛ nwo fee, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛze kɛ bɛlɛ ninyɛne kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnzɛkye ɛlɛ la wɔ ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmmakpo aze fee, ɔluakɛ ɛhye mɔ amuala, ahatualɛ kpole bie li ɔ nzi.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia abotane, amaa bɛahola bɛayɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ na bɛanyia ye ɛwɔkɛ ne.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na sonla ne mɔɔ ba la ara, ɔnrɛzi aze fee.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ sonla ne mɔɔ sɔ me nye la balua anyia ngoane a. Saa ɔsia ɔ nzi a, me nye ɛnrɛlie ɔ nwo.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Yɛnle menli mɔɔ yɛsia yɛ nzi na yɛminli a. Yɛlɛ diedi, yemɔti yɛlɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ɔlua diedi zo yɛɛ yɛnyia ndelebɛbo kɛ Nyamenle vale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ala a bɔle ewiade a, na mɔɔ ɛnɛ yɛnwu ye la vi mɔɔ yɛnnwu ye la anu a rale a.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Diedi yɛɛ manle Ebulu bɔle azu kpalɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la manle Nyamenle dɛlale Keen a. Ɔlua ye diedi ti Ebulu zɔle Nyamenle anye kɛ ɔle sonla tenlene, ɔluakɛ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne zɔle ɔ nye. Ebulu ɛwu bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko kɛkala ɔlua ye diedi zo ɔtendɛ ɔkile yɛ.

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ye diedi ti Yinɔko anwu; bɛvale ye anyewɔzo bɛhɔle anwuma wɔ Nyamenle anwo lɔ. Awie kpondɛle ye a, yeannwu ye, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛva ye ɛhɔ anwuma lɔ. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne kile kɛ Yinɔko zɔle Nyamenle anye kolaa na bɛava ye bɛahɔ.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ se kɛ awie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi la kɛhola kɛzɔ Nyamenle anye. Ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ awie mɔɔ ba Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la die di kɛ Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo la.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ Nowa luale mɔɔ ɔdele Nyamenle kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne mɔɔ fane ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la anwo a. Ɔdiele Nyamenle ane na ɔbobɔle ɛlɛnemgbole ɔvale ɔliele ɔ nwo nee ye sua nu amra ngoane. Ɔluale zɛhae adenle zo ɔbule ewiade ye kɛ ɔle debie mgbane, na ɔ sa hanle Nyamenle nu fɔɔnwoyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdua diedi zo bɛ sa ka ye la.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ebileham diele Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ ne na ɔdule ɔhɔle maanle mɔɔ Nyamenle hilele ye kɛ ɔle ye ɛdeɛ la anu a. Ɔvi ye maanle ne anu ɔdule la, ɛnee ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnze ɛleka mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Ye diedi ti, ɔdɛnlanle maanle ne mɔɔ Nyamenle vale bɔle ye ɛwɔkɛ la anu kɛ ɛyɛvolɛ. Ɔdɛnlanle ndanlɛ sua nu, kɛmɔ Ayezeke nee Gyekɔbo, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛboka nwo a Nyamenle bɔle bɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne la yɛle la.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ɛnee Ebileham ɛlɛkendɛ Nyamenle ɔdaye ye Suakpole ne mɔɔ yehyehyɛ, yewula ye aze na yekyekye la.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɔlua sonla ko mɔɔ le Ebileham, mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle kɛ asɛɛ yewu, noko ɔtɛwole ralɛ ɛlɛ la anwo zo yɛɛ ɛnɛ nlɔnra dɔɔnwo mɔɔ le kɛ anwuma nwɔlɔra nee ɛnweazo anwea la ɛra a.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Diedi nu yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ amuala wule a. Bɛ sa anga ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle bɛ la, noko bɛnwunle ye bɛ adwenle nu wɔ moa moa na bɛliele bɛdole nu kɛ bɛle nyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛra nlɔnu wɔ azɛlɛ ɛhye azo a.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ ka zɛhae edwɛkɛ la kile kɛ bɛlɛkpondɛ bɛ sua zo kpalɛ ne.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Bɛandwenle maanle ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛgyakyi ye bɛ nzi bɛahɔ la anwo. Saa bɛdwenlenle nwolɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛziale bɛrale.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ ɛnee bɛ nwo ɛlɛdɔ ye la a le anwuma maanle kpalɛ ne. Yemɔti noko yeanyɛ Nyamenle nyiane kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ ye bɛ Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ yekyekye suakpole yezie ɛkɛ ne yemaa bɛ.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Ɛnee Nyamenle ɛha ɛhile Ebileham kɛ, “Ɔlua Ayezeke anwo zo a ɛbanyia wɔ nlɔnra dɔɔnwo ne, kɛmɔ menvale membɔle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ la a.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Ebileham nyianle adwenle kɛ Nyamenle kola dwazo mɔwuamra fi ewule nu, na amgba noko, Ebileham asa hanle Ayezeke vile ewule nu.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ayezeke yileyilale Gyekɔbo nee Yisɔ a.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Ayezeke yileyilale Dwosefi amra ne mɔ kolaa na yeawu a. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yeyɛ ɛrelera kondokondo na ɔlɛ kpɔma nu yɛɛ ɔzɛlɛle Nyamenle a.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Diedi yɛɛ manle Dwosefi, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔla ewule ɛkpa zo la, hanle kɛ Nyamenle baye Yizilayɛma avi Yigyibiti, na ɔhilele kɛ bɛzi bɛyɛ ye mbowule ne mɔ la a.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua, mɔɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwole Mosisi la, ye awovolɛ vale ye veale toonwo siane nsa a. Bɛnwunle kɛ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ, ɛhye ati bɛanzulo na bɛbulule belemgbunli ne mɛla ne azo.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Mosisi dule zo la, ɔkpole kɛ bɛkɛvɛlɛ ye Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ ne ara a.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Ɔdwenlenle nwo kɛ saa sonla doa Kelaese ne abo zo na ɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɔle kpalɛ ɔtɛla kɛ ɔkɛnyia Yigyibiti anwonyia kɔsɔɔti a, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔ nye la ahyɛlɛdeɛ mɔɔ kenle bie Nyamenle bava amaa ye la azo.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ Mosisi anzulo belemgbunli ne ɛya mɔɔ ɔkɛva la na ɔdule ɔvile Yigyibiti a. Yeanzia ɔ nzi, ɔgyinlanle kpundii kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnwu Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɛnnwu ye la.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔluale ɔhyehyɛle Akpabɛnwo ne na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma vale mogya kpondenle bɛ nlenkɛ nloa a, amaa saa Nyamenle Ewule Soanvolɛ ne ba a yeangu Yizilayɛma belamunli mralɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma luale mɔɔ bɛpɛle Ndɔ Nyevile ne kɛ asɛɛ bɛlua azɛlɛ resee zo la a; mɔɔ Yigyibitima yɛle kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛpɛ la, azule ne vale bɛ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma luale bɔle suakpole Gyɛleko bane ne mgbɔlɔka dedee kenle nsuu manle ɔgolole ɔguale a.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ bɛangu tuutuunli Releehabe kɛ menli anzosesebɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ kpole Nyamenle la a, ɔluakɛ ɔliele Yizilayɛma mɔɔ rale banleɛnlea maanle ne anu na bɛahɔha la azie, na ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Boni bieko a menga a? Ɔluakɛ saa meka kɛ mekɔ zolɛ meaha menli mɔɔ le kɛ Gedɛyɔn, Bɛlake, Samesɛn, Gyɛfeta, Devidi, Samoɛle, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ a mekɛ kɛbɔ me.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Bɛluale diedi zo bɛhonle na bɛlile maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo konim. Bɛnleanle bɛmanle pɛlepɛlelilɛ yɛle gyima na bɛnyianle Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ. Bɛluale diedi zo bɛhanle awenade nloa bɛdole nu,

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: bɛnluanle sendɔlɔra, yɛɛ bɛango bɛandɔ. Ɛnee bɛle bɛtɛɛ, noko bɛ nwo yɛle se; bɛ nwo yɛle ɛzulolɛ wɔ konle nu na bɛmanle nyɛvolɛ ɛlɔnema guale ndwɛlɛ aze.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Diedi zo yɛɛ ɔlua mɔɔ mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ mra wule la bɛdwazole bɛ bɛrale ngoane nu a. Bie mɔ noko mɔɔ kpole ewiade ye anu fanwodi biala la, bɛyɛle bɛ asa na bɛwule, amaa Nyamenle adwazo bɛ ahɔ ngoane kpalɛ nu.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Bɛzile bie mɔ amgbu, bɛbole bɛ, yɛɛ bɛguale bie mɔ anga na bɛguale bɛ efiade.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Bɛzile bie mɔ awolɛ, bɛvale sɛlada bɛkpakyekpakyele bie mɔ anu nwiɔ nwiɔ, [bɛzɔle dɔɔnwo bɛnleanle,] bɛvale dadeɛ bɛpepɛle bie mɔ akɔme. Bɛhedale mboane nee mbɔnkye nwoma, bɛlile ehyia, bɛlile nyane, yɛɛ bɛyɛle bɛ amumuyɛ.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Ewiade anyɛ fɛ fee ammaa bɛ! Bɛluoluale nuhua kɛ nyɛvolɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ nee awoka zo na bɛdɛnlanle awolɛ mbɔne nee adokule nu wɔ azɛlɛ bo.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Nea duma mɔɔ menli zɛhae mɔ lua diedi zo ɛnyia ye a! Noko bɛannyia mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la,

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ɛbɔ gyinlabelɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔfa yeamaa yɛ la anwo kpɔkɛ. Ye ngyehyɛlɛ ne titile a le kɛ saa yɛboka bɛ nwo a yɛɛ bɛkɛli munli a.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛmɔ yɛlɛ dasevolɛma pemgbenleamgbe ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛbɔ yɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka ɛyia la, bɛmaa yɛye debie biala mɔɔ si yɛ aze, nee ɛtane mɔɔ ɛgya yɛ la ali, na yɛmia yɛ nwo kpalɛ yɛnlea ɛnriandilɛ ne mɔɔ gyi yɛ nyunlu la.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Bɛmaa yɛnlea Gyisɛse angome ala, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔli yɛ nyunlu wɔ diedi nu na ɔmaa yɛ diedi di munli a. Ɔlua anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnee la ɔ nyunlu la ati, yeandwenle anyiemgba ewule ne mɔɔ ɔbawu meanubaka ne azo la anwo, na kɛkala ɔde Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia ne fema zo.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenle ɛkpɔlɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse nyianle ye, nee kɛ ɔzile ɔgyinlanle kpundii wɔ ɛkpɔlɛ bebelebe ne anloa, wɔ ɛtanevolɛma asa nu la anwo, na bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle bɔ anzɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ anzi tuto.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee ɛtane bɛ konle ye anu, bɛtɛdwule ye kpɔmgbɔse ne mɔɔ ɛhunlɛ bɔbɔ finde nu a.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Anzɛɛ bɛ rɛle ɛvi akɛnrazilɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ka kile bɛ kɛ bɛle ɔ mra la ɔ? Ɔse, “Me ra, saa Awulae tea wɔ a die ye fɛlɛko nu, yɛɛ saa ɔtwi ɛ nyunlu a mmamaa ɛ rɛle bɔ.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Awulae tea mɔɔ ɔkulo ye la, na ɔtwi ɔ ra biala mɔɔ ɔdie ye la anyunlu.”

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Saa bɛandea bɛ kɛ mralɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ bɛnle mralɛ kpalɛ, na bɛle arelazinli mralɛ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Saa yɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ wole yɛ la tea yɛ a, yɛdi bɛ eni. Fane nyɛ yɛɛ akee yɛnrɛli yɛ sunsum nu Selɛ ne eni na yɛnrɛnyia ngoane a?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Yɛ ze mɔ mɔɔ wole yɛ la tea yɛ mekɛ ekyi bie ala, kɛmɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnea a ɔle kpalɛ la, na Nyamenle tea yɛ wɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ kpalɛ ti, amaa kenle bie yɛanyia ye nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne bie.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Kɛkala, ndeanlɛ biala ɛnyɛ fɛ, ɔyɛ nyane, noko nzinlii bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛzɔ bɛ ndeanlɛ nu na bɛkɛva nu ma la sɔ ɛnyelɛ na bɛnyia anzonudwolɛ wɔ bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu. Folɛdulɛ nee kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Bɛlua ndenle kpalɛ nu, amaa bɛ agbɔkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛtuto la andwɔlɔdwɔlɔ, na bɛazianyizianyi.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛ nee menli kɔsɔɔti kɛdɛnla anzonudwolɛ nu na bɛmaa bɛ ɛbɛla nwo ɛde nwuanzaanwu, ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ anyɛ ye zɔhane la ɔyɛ se kɛ ɔkɛnwu Nyamenle.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie ande anvi Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne anwo. Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie angakyi ɔ nwo “baka gyangoyi” ambɛkɛbɛka mbaka gyɛne nwo anguhu ɔ gɔnwo mɔ.

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea boɛ na bɛ bie annyia subane ɛtane anzɛɛ anyɛ kɛ Yisɔ mɔɔ nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛnle ye nu la ati, yeangola ɔ nwo sɔ na aleɛ ti ɔdɔnenle ye kpanyinli la.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze kɛ nzinlii, ɛnee akee ɔkpondɛ ɔ ze nyilalɛ, na ɔzunle ɔhwinle monle, noko ɔ sa anga ye, ɔluakɛ yeannwu adenle mɔɔ ɔfa zolɛ a mɔɔ yeyɛ la ɔkɛhola ɔkɛhakyi ye a.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛtɛbadwule Boka Saenae azo, ɛleka mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dwule la, na bɛanwu sendɔlɔra ne, awozinli kabikabi ne nee ye kumɔɔnwo ne, nee ahumu ne,

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: na bɛade aweɛne tendenle ne ane yɛɛ ɛnelɛ totohyia ne, mɔɔ Yizilayɛma dele a bɛzele kɛ akee yebo zo, na bɛzɛlɛle kɛ edwɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ boɛ la.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ ɛnee mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛmanle bɛ kɛ, “Saa nane bɔbɔ agyakɛ tia boka ne anwo a, bɛzi ye awolɛ bɛhu ye” la, bɛngola nu sɔ.

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ɛkɛ ne yɛle ɛzulolɛ kpalɛ, manle Mosisi bɔbɔ hanle kɛ, “Mesulo, megyinla a ɔngyinla!”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ bɛra Boka Zayɔn, wɔ tease Nyamenle ne suakpole ne mɔɔ le anwuma lɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma apenle apenle mɔɔ bɛnze bɛ nloa la ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ la azo.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Bɛra anyelielɛ ayia ne mɔɔ Nyamenle amra mgbanyinli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ anwuma lɔ la a kɔ la bie. Bɛra Nyamenle mɔɔ le menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛnebuavolɛ la ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛra fɔɔnwoma mɔɔ bɛmaa bɛ sunsum ɛli munli la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Bɛra Gyisɛse, mɔɔ kyekyele Ngyekyeleɛ Fofolɛ ne abo, nee mogya ne mɔɔ bɛhwinle bɛguale na ɔtendɛ kpalɛ ɔkile yɛ ɔtɛla Ebulu ɛdeɛ ne la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛnlea boɛ, na bɛamkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie mɔɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛdie mɔɔ hanle Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ ne hilele bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la, anvi ɛsalɛ. Na saa akee yɛmɛ yɛkpo kɛ yɛnrɛdie mɔɔ tendɛ fi anwuma lɔ kile yɛ la a, kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛavi ɛsalɛ ɛ?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ɔ ne manle azɛlɛ kpusule, na ɛnɛ noko yevua kɛ, “Eza mebakpusu ye bieko. Tɛ azɛlɛ ye angome, na mebakpusu anwuma noko.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ɛhye, “eza bieko” ne kile kɛ abɔdeɛ muala bakpusu na bɛadudu bɛ bɛavi ɛkɛ, na mɔɔ kɛhola kɛgyinla na ɔ bo andu la baha ɛkɛ.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ yemaa yɛ belemgbunlililɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ abo ɛmkpusu ɛlɛ, na yɛva ɛzulolɛ, enililɛ yɛɛ moyɛlɛ yɛzonle ye yɛmaa ɔzɔ ɔ nye,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne le sendɔlɔra.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zo bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ mediema mɔɔ nee Kelaese a lua la.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ bɛkɛlie nyɛvolɛ wɔ bɛ azua nu. Bie mɔ ɛyɛ bie zɔhane na bɛlie Nyamenle soanvolɛma wɔ bɛ azua nu mɔɔ bɛnze a.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ efiade la, na bɛdwenle bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ a gua efiade ne a. Bɛhakye menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la, na bɛdwenle bɛ nwo kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛlɛnwu nyane ne bie.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbu agyalɛ bie kpalɛ kpalɛ, na kunli nee yelɛ di nɔhalɛ maa bɛ nwo. Nyamenle badea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle adwɔmane nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdo awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Bɛye ezukoa nwo anyebolo bɛvi bɛ ɛbɛla nu, na bɛmaa bɛ kunlu ɛdwo mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la anwo. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛha ye kɛ, “Menrɛgyakyi bɛ ɛlɛ, yɛɛ me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ fee.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, yɛkola yɛsi yɛ kɛnra yɛka kɛ, “Awulae le me boavolɛ, menrɛzulo ɛhwee. Duzu yɛɛ sonla kola yɛ me a?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ, mɔɔ hanle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne hilele bɛ la. Bɛdwenle bɛnwu kɛ bɛzile bɛbɔle bɛ ɛbɛla ne la, nee bɛ ewule nu, na bɛzukoa bɛ diedi ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛ la.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese si de anoma la, ɔle zɔhane ɛnɛ nee kenle biala.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa ngilehilelɛ ngakyile biala twe bɛ fi adenle kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlua zo la azo. Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ yɛkɛmaa Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne kɛmaa yɛ ɛkɛla nwo kɛyɛ se tɛla kɛ yɛkɛli aleɛ nwo ngyehyɛlɛ zo la, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile ngyehyɛlɛ zɛhae mɔ anzi la, yeamboa bɛ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛ azukponle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ gyima wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne anu la ɛnlɛ adenle kɛ bɛkɛli zolɛ a.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne fa nane ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ ɛtanefakyɛ azu ne la mogya ba Nwuanzanwuanza nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne baye ɛdɛne a, nane mumua ne, bɛyela ye wɔ nzeseɛ ne anzi lɔ.

english_verse: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Gyisɛse wule suakpole ne kandiba lɔ, amaa yeava ye mogya ne yeanrinzi menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa yɛvinde yɛdoa ye wɔ kandiba lɔ, na ye nyiane ne ɛha yɛ muala.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, yɛnlɛ suakpole biala mɔɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne kpɔkpɔ a; yɛ nye la suakpole kpalɛ bie mɔɔ bara la ade.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛmaa yɛva ayɛlɛyelɛ yɛlua Gyisɛse anwo zo yɛmaa Nyamenle. Ɛhye a le azubɔlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ mɔɔ bɔ ye duma kɛ ɔle Awulae la kola bɔ a.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Bɛmmamaa bɛ rɛle fi kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpalɛ na bɛkɛboa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, ɔboalekɛ ɛhye a le azubɔlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye a.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Bɛdie bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛli bɛ mɛla zo. Mgbanyima zɛhae mɔ a dahuu nea bɛ ɛkɛla zo a, ɔboalekɛ bɛbabu bɛ gyima nwo mgbonda bɛahile Nyamenle. Saa bɛtie bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛbava fɛlɛkolilɛ bɛayɛ bɛ gyima. Saa tɛ ye zɔhane ɛdeɛ a, bɛbava nyanelilɛ a bɛayɛ a, na ɛhye noko ɛnrɛboa bɛ kpalɛ biala.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa yɛ. Yɛsi pi kɛ yɛ adwenle nu le wienyi, ɔboalekɛ yɛkpondɛ kɛ dahuu yɛyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Mesɛlɛ bɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ kɛ Nyamenle kɛmaa menwɔzia menwɔra bɛ nwo lɔ bieko ndɛndɛ. Nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Anzonudwolɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le Mboaneneavolɛ Kpole ne, mɔɔ luale ye ewule azubɔlɛ zo zɔle ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ la anloa la vile ewule nu la,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ɛmaa bɛ sa ɛha debie biala mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Nyamenle ɛmaa bɛhola bɛyɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo la, na ɔlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo ɔva bɛ ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la. Anyunlunyia ɛha Kelaese dahuu! Amen. Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ li amozi

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Mebodo bɛ, me mediema, bɛzi abotane bɛdie akɛnrazilɛ nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ kɛlata ɛhye mɔɔ mehɛlɛ bɛ la anwa biala.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Memaa bɛade kɛ bɛye adiema nrenya Temɔte bɛvi efiade. Saa ɔba ɛke ndɛndɛ a, me nee ye yɛbarakpɔla bɛ.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Yɛbiza bɛ mgbanyima ne nee Nyamenle menli ne mɔ amuala ahye. Mediema mɔɔ vi Yetale ɛra ɛke la se bɛbiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔ nee bɛ muala ɛdɛnla! Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi Gyemise, Nyamenle nee Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese akɛlɛ ne ɛkɛ. Mebiza Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ ɛde ɛkponde aleɛabo la amuala kɔsɔɔti ahye. Diedi nee nrɛlɛbɛ

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Me mediema, saa sɔnea ngakyile dɔɔnwo ba bɛ nwo zo a bɛli nwolɛ fɛlɛko;

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ saa bɛ diedi maa bɛkola sɔnea ɛhye mɔ anloa gyinla a ɛnee ɔkile kɛ bɛlɛ diedi nu anwosesebɛ.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Bɛzi pi wɔ anwosesebɛ ɛhye anu na bɛgyinla kpundii mɔɔ bɛmkpo aze ɛlɛ, amaa bɛali munli bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ bɛngyia debie biala anwo a.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Saa bɛ nuhua bie hyia nrɛlɛbɛ a, ɔzɛlɛ Nyamenle na ɔkɛva ɔkɛmaa ye; ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle ati akunlu le kɛnlɛma na ɔyila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbiza ye debie la.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Noko anrɛɛ bɛva diedi mɔɔ bɛ ti anu keseeyɛlɛ anzɛɛ kpolerazulɛ biala ɛnle nu la bɛbiza. Mɔɔ ye adwenle ɛngyinla la le kɛ nyevile sɛlɛkye mɔɔ anwoma bɔ ye kɔ ba la.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ le zɛhae, mɔɔ ɛngola ɛnzi ye adwenle pi wɔ debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛ la anwo la mmadwenle kɛ ɔkɛnyia debie ɔkɛvi Awulae ɛkɛ. Ehyea nee anwonyia

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Keleseɛnenli biala mɔɔ anrɛɛ di ehyia na Nyamenle ɛmaa ye zo la ɛli fɛlɛko,

english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: yɛɛ Keleseɛnenli biala mɔɔ le sukoavolɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛha ye aze la ɛmaa ɔ nye ɛlie. Ɔluakɛ sukoavolɛma bakpolo agua kɛ ɛhoayelɛ nu ndotolo.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Sɛnzɛne ne tudu a ɔfi ye ewia wuluwulu ne ɔbɔ ndile ɔmaa ɔkyengye, ye ndotolo ne kpolo gua, na ɔminle ye kɛnlɛma ne. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ sukoavolɛ mɔɔ anye wɔ ye gyima nwo ala la baminli a. Sɔnea nee ngyegyelɛ

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛgyinla kpundii wɔ sɔnea nu la, ɔboalekɛ saa ɔko ɔtɔ zolɛ a ye ahatualɛ a le ngoane ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ menli mɔɔ kulo ye la ɛwɔkɛ la.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Saa awie kɔ ngyegyelɛ nu a ɔmmaka kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛlɛsɔ me anlea.” Ɔluakɛ ɛtane ɛngola ɛnzɔ Nyamenle ɛnnea yɛɛ Nyamenle mumua ne ɛnzɔ awie biala ɛnnea.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Sonla ɔdaye ye atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne a sɔ ye nea na ɔtwe ye ɔfi Nyamenle anwo a.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Saa ye munzule atiakunluwɔzo ne nrenzɛ a ɔwo ɛtane, yɛɛ ɛtane wie nyi a ɔwie ewule.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Me mediema kulovolɛma, bɛmmamaa bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ!

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Ɛlolɛdeɛ kpalɛ biala nee ahyɛlɛdeɛ biala mɔɔ di munli la vi anwuma; ɔvi Nyamenle Selɛ ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma ahɛnlaneɛ ne mɔ la ɛkɛ a ɔba a. Nyamenle ɛnli ngakyile, anzɛɛ ɔmboa ɔngakyi wienyi awozinli.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Ɔdaye ye ɛhulolɛ zo yɛɛ ɔluale nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne azo ɔwole yɛ a, amaa yɛayɛ ye abɔdeɛ nu alumuama. Ɛdielɛ nee ɛyɛlɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Mediema kulovolɛma, bɛhakye ɛhye. Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala tie ɔ nzo anwo, ɔmmatendɛ dɔɔnwo yɛɛ ɔmmafa ɛya.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛvuandi subane ɛtane nee nyɛleɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti bɛgua na bɛdo bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa Nyamenle, bɛlie edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ yelua ye wɔ bɛ ahonle nu la bɛdo nu, na yemɔ yɛɛ ɔkola ɔdie bɛ ngoane a.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Bɛmmabɛlɛbɛla bɛ nwo bɛyɛ mɔɔ asɛɛ bɛtie ye edwɛkɛ ne ala a; bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛde la.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛdie edwɛkɛ ne na yeanva yeambɔ ye ɛbɛla la le kɛ sonla mɔɔ nea ɔ nyunlu wɔ neanleɛ nu la.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: Ɔnea ɔ nyunlu ɔwie na ɔkɔ a ɛkɛ ne ala ɔ rɛle fi ɔdaye ye sonla holɛ mɔɔ ɔzɔho ye la.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Na awie mɔɔ neɛnlea fanwodi mɛla ne mɔɔ di munli la anu, na ɔsɔ nu dwaa ɔfa ɔbɔ ye ɛbɛla, na ɔndie ye mgbane ala ɔmmaa ɔ rɛle ɛnvi, na ɔyɛ gyima mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ la, yemɔ yɛɛ Nyamenle kɛyila ye wɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Saa awie dwenle kɛ ɔsonle Nyamenle na ɔmmua ɔ nloa azo a, ye Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne le mgbane, na ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔdaye ye ɛkɛla.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Nyamenlezonlenlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ evinli biala ɛnle nwolɛ wɔ Nyamenle Selɛ ne anyunlu la a le kɛ ɛkɛkpɔla nrisa nee ahunlanvolɛ wɔ bɛ anwongyelelɛ nu, ɛkɛboa bɛ na ɛkɛzie ɛ nwo gyɛlɛɛnye mɔɔ ewiade amra ɛnnyia ɛ nwo ngehanleɛ biala la.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Me mediema, kɛmɔ bɛlɛ diedi wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ le anyunlunyia Awulae ne la anu la ati, bɛmmanea sonla nyunlu na bɛabu ye bie.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Saa ngyengyene nu bie sukoavolɛ mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke mgbɔdelera gua ɔ sa na ɔheda ɛdakpa la ba bɛ nyianu ne bie, na ehyianli mɔɔ heda ɛdanlɛ mgbane bie la ɔdaye noko ɔba bie, na

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: saa bɛkile anyenzɔlɛ bɛmaa mɔɔ heda ɛdanlɛ kɛnlɛma ne la, na bɛse ye kɛ, “Mesɛlɛ wɔ, tɛnla ebia kpalɛ ɛhye azo.” na bɛse ehyianli ne kɛ, “Gyinla nehane, anzɛɛ tɛnla aze wɔ me gyakɛ abo ɛke” a,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: ɛnee bɛdi ngilehilenu nwo fɔlɛ na bɛlua adwenle ɛtane zo bɛbua ndɛne mɔɔ ɛngɔ adenle nu a.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Me mediema kulovolɛma, bɛdie! Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle ehyianvolɛma wɔ aleɛabo la, bɛmɛ a Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ, ɛyɛ bɛ diedi nu sukoavolɛma na bɛnyia Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne, mɔɔ yeva yebɔ ɛwɔkɛ yemaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye la a.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ bɛmbu ehyianvolɛma bie. Asoo tɛ sukoavolɛma a sisi bɛ na bɛtwili bɛ bɛkɔ ndɛnebuavolɛma anyunlu la?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Asoo tɛ sukoavolɛma a ka duma kpalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane la?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Saa bɛdi Belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo mɛla ne, mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se la kɛ, “Kulo ɛ gɔnwo kɛ ɛdawɔ ɛ nwo” la azo a, ɛnee bɛlua nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛnea sonla nyunlu na bɛabu ye bie a, ɛnee bɛyɛ ɛtane, na mɛla ne bu bɛ fɔlɛ.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ se ɔdi mɛla ne amuala azo na ɔkɛvo nuhua edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko la ɛdo mɛla ne amuala.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sonla ko ne ala mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Mmafa awuvolɛ” la yɛɛ hanle kɛ, “Mmaku sonla” a. Yemɔti saa wɔanva awuvolɛ na ɛku sonla a ɛnee wɔdo mɛla.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Bɛdendɛ na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛbava fanwodi mɛla ne bɛabua bɛ ndɛne la.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ ɛnze anwunvɔne la, Nyamenle ɛnrɛze ye anwunvɔne wɔ ye ndɛnebualɛ nu; anwunvɔnezelɛ fo keda ndɛnebualɛ zo. Diedi nee nyɛleɛ

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Me mediema, saa awie ka ye kɛ, “Melɛ diedi” na ye nyɛleɛ ɛngile zɔhane a, ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ ɔnyia a? Asoo ye diedi zɔhane kɛhola kɛlie ye ngoane?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Saa adiema nrenya bie anzɛɛ adiema raalɛ bie ɛnlɛ ɛdanlɛ ɛngeda yɛɛ ɔhyia aleɛ nwo,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: na ɛse ye kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛyila wɔ. Ɛ nwo ɛyɛ wɔ wuluwulu na di aleɛ maa ɛ ko ɛyi” na saa wɔammaa ye ninyɛne mɔɔ hyia maa ngoane la a ɛnee duzu nvasoɛ a wɔ mɔɔ ɛka la azo a?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la le wulera.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Awie baze kɛ, “Sonla ne bie lɛ diedi yɛɛ ko noko kola yɛ gyima.” Me mualɛ a le kɛ, kile me kɛ sonla si nyia diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la, na medame noko menwɔva me gyimayɛlɛ menwɔhile wɔ me diedi.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Bɛdie bɛdi kɛ Nyamenle kokye a wɔ ɛkɛ a. Ɔdaye ne ala ɛne! Mbɔnsam noko die di, na ɛzulolɛ maa bɛ nwo wozo bɛ.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Kɔnwɔne! Ɛkulo kɛ bɛkile wɔ kɛ diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwo la ɛnzo ma ɔ?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Kɛ Ebileham zile zɔle Nyamenle anye ɛ? Ɔluale gyimayɛlɛ zo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔ ra Ayezeke ɔhɔle kɛ ɔlɛ ye ɔkabɔ azu yeamaa Nyamenle la.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Ɛkola ɛnwu kɛ ye diedi nee ye gyimayɛlɛ bɔle nuhua yɛle gyima; ye gyimayɛlɛ ne manle ye diedi ne lile munli.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Ɛhye maa Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne yɛ nɔhalɛ kɛ, “Ebileham liele Nyamenle lile, na ɔlua ye diedi ti Nyamenle liele ye kɛ ɔle sonla tenlene.” Na ɔlua zolɛ bɛvɛlɛle Ebileham Nyamenle agɔnwo.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Yemɔti ɛkola ɛnwu ye kɛ sonla gyimayɛlɛ a maa ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye a, na tɛ ye diedi ngome ɔ.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Kɛ tuutuunli Releehabe ɔdaye ɔyɛle ala la ɛne. Ɔliele Dwuu soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ rale banleɛnlea maanle ne anu ahɔ la azie na ɔboale bɛ ɔmanle bɛluale adenle fofolɛ nu bɛhɔle. Ye gyima ɛhye manle ɔzɔle Nyamenle anye.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Yemɔti, kɛmɔ nwonane mɔɔ sunsum ɛnle nu la le funli la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ diedi mɔɔ gyimayɛlɛ ɛmboka nwolɛ la le wulera a.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Me mediema! Ɔnle kɛ bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo yɛ kilehilevolɛma, ɔboalekɛ bɛze kɛ yɛmɛ kilehilevolɛma bɛbabua yɛ ndɛne fenlefenle bɛadɛla menli mɔɔ ɛha la.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Yɛ muala yɛfo wɔ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo anu. Sonla mɔɔ ɛnvo wɔ ye edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ nu la di munli na ɔkola ɔsɔ ɔ nwo.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Yɛfa bulalɛ yɛwula ɛkpɔnwɔ nloa anu, amaa yeadie yɛ ne, na yɛahola yɛamaa ɔ nee yɛ ahɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ yɛkulo la.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea amɛle: ɔle kpole yɛɛ anwoma mɔɔ anu yɛ se la a pia ye a; noko bulalɛ ekyi bie a maa ahenle mɔɔ ka amɛle ne la kakyihakyi ɔ nye na ɔmaa ɔkɔ ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔkulo la a.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɛtafinlimalɛ de a: ɔle sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ekyi bie, noko ɔkola ɔfa ninyɛne mgbole ɔtu ɔ nwo. Bɛdabɛ bɛnlea kɛ senle ekyi si yela, sɛkye ɛbɔ nu mbaka la.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Ɛtafinlimalɛ le senle. Ɔboa ɔle munzule ewiade ekyi kpalɛ wɔ yɛ sonlabaka ne nvɛyeba ne mɔ avinli na ɔfa ɛtane ɔsalo yɛ sonlabaka ne kpokpoti. Ɔle ɛbolɔ senle kpalɛ mɔɔ fa senle to yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Sonla kola tete nyɛmoa mɔɔ le kɛ nane, nloma, nwɔlɛ yɛɛ nyevile nu fɛlɛ ɔmaa bɛtie ye.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Noko ɛtanfinlimalɛ ɛdeɛ sonla biala ɛngola ɛmbele ye. Ɔle munzule debie mɔɔ ewule bɔlɔ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ a.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Ɛnloanlɛ ko ye ala anu yɛɛ nyilalɛ nee amowa vi ba a. Me mediema! Ɔnle kɛ ɔba ye zɔhane.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Nzule fɛlɛko nee nzule tondɔtondɔ ɛnvi nzubula ko anu ɛmba.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Me mediema! Feege baka ɛngola ɛnzo ɔlivi ma, yɛɛ vanye baka ɛnzo feege ma. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ nzule tondɔtondɔ ɛngola ɛngakyi nzukpa a. Anwuma nrɛlɛbɛ

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua boni a ze nrɛlɛbɛ na ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo a? Bɛmaa ɔva ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ kpalɛ ɔpɛ kilemunli ɔhile nyɛleɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛfa mɛlɛbɛnwoaze nee nrɛlɛbɛ bɛyɛ la.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛ ahonle nu bɛle anyebolo, bɛle angomedi a, ɛnee bɛmmatu bɛ nloa anu kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ na bɛyɛ ɛtane bɛtia nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ zɛhae ɛnvi anwuma lɔ a ba a; ɔle ewiade nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ɛnle sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ye la nu; sonla zɔhane le abɔnsam.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Ɛleka mɔɔ anyebolo nee angomedi wɔ la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mgbonde nee munzule ngakyile biala wɔ a.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Nrɛlɛbɛ ne mɔɔ vi anwuma lɔ la anwo te, mɔɔ lumua la ɛne. Eza ɔle anzonudwolɛ, ɔka ɔ nwo aze, ɔlɛ ndelebɛbo; anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ yɛɛ ɔso nyɛleɛ kpalɛ biala ma. Ɔndwenle adwenle ɛtane, yɛɛ ɔmbɔ adalɛ.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ kpondɛ anzonudwolɛ na bɛdua anzonudwolɛ nu la bu tenleneyɛlɛ bɛyɔba.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Duzu a twehwe konle ba a, yɛɛ duzu a fa butule ba bɛ avinli a? Asoo tɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ angomedi atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ a dahuu nee bɛ ko bɛ nuhua la?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Bɛkpondɛ ninyɛne bie, noko bɛnnyia bie, yemɔti bɛkuhu bɛ nwo; bɛ nye bolo ninyɛne nwo ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ, noko bɛnnyia bɛ ɛlɛ, yemɔti bɛdi butule na bɛko. Bɛ sa ɛnga deɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyia nwo la, ɔluakɛ bɛmbiza Nyamenle.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Bɛbiza noko a bɛ sa ɛnga ye, ɔboalekɛ bɛnva adwenle kpalɛ bɛmbiza; bɛbiza ninyɛne mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛ ngome bɛ nye kɛlie la.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Boniayɛma! Bɛnze kɛ saa bɛ nee ewiade tila agɔnwolɛ a ɛnee bɛyɛ Nyamenle agbɔvolɛ ɔ? Sonla mɔɔ fa ewiade ye agɔnwolɛ la kile kɛ ɔle Nyamenle kpɔvolɛ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Bɛmmadwenle kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ka la le mgbane. Ɔse, “Nyamenle twe ye Sunsum ne mɔɔ yeva yewula yɛ nu la anwo nungule.”

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Noko Nyamenle ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔfa ɔmaa la le kpole. Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Nyamenle bɛlɛ mɔɔ le mgbanyizonle la aze, na ɔmaa mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la zo.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Yemɔti bɛdu bɛ nwo bɛmaa Nyamenle. Bɛmmamaa Abɔnsam adenle, na ɔvi bɛ nwo ɔbanriandi.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Bɛhwe bɛbikye Nyamenle, na ɔdaye noko ɔkɛbikye bɛ. Bɛmɛ ɛtanevolɛma, bɛhakyi bɛ subane! Bɛde bɛ ahonle nu, bɛmɛ nabalabama!

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Bɛli nyane na bɛzu; bɛmaa bɛ ɛzelekɛ ɛyɛ ɛzunlɛ na bɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛyɛ alɔbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze wɔ Awulae anyunlu, na ɔkɛmaa bɛ zo. Adiema Keleseɛnenli ndɛnebualɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Mediema Keleseɛnema, bɛmmakeha bɛ gɔnwo mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane. Mɔɔ ka ɔ diema anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane anzɛɛ bua ye ndɛne la tia mɛla ne na eza ɔbua mɛla ne ndɛne. Na saa ɛbua mɛla ne ndɛne a, ɛnee ɔkile kɛ ɛnli mɛla ne azo bieko, na ɛle ye ndɛnebuavolɛ.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Nyamenle angomekye a kola die ngoane na ɔkola ɔsɛkye ye a. Yemɔ ala a ɔmaa mɛla na ɔle ndɛnebuavolɛ a. Na wɔmɔ, ɛdawɔ a le nwane, mɔɔ ɛbua ɛ gɔnwo ndɛne a? Adubɛnwo nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛka kɛ, “Ɛnɛ anzɛɛ ɛhyema yɛbahɔ suakpole ɛhye anzɛɛ ɛhendeɛ ne azo, yeahɔli ɛvolɛ ko, yɛayɛ gyima yeakpondɛ ezukoa dɔɔnwo” la, bɛdie!

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Bɛnze mɔɔ bazi bɛ nwo zo ɛhyema a. Bɛdabɛ mumua ne, bɛ ngoane tendenle le nyɛ? Bɛ ngoane le kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ la, ɔngyɛ na yeawe na ɔ bo zo aminli.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka la a le kɛ, “Saa ɔyɛ Awulae ɛhulolɛ na yɛde ngoane nu a, yɛbayɛ ɛhye anzɛɛ ɛhendeɛ ne.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo, bɛtu bɛ nloa anu; na adubɛnwo ɛhye mɔ amuala le ɛtaneyɛlɛ.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, sonla ne mɔɔ ze debie kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ na yeanyɛ la, ɔle ɛtane ɔmaa ye.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ sukoavolɛma, bɛdie! Bɛbɔ ɔ bo kɛkala bɛzu bɛye awolɛ wɔ munzule mɔɔ ɛlɛba bɛ nwo zo la ati.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛ anwonyia ne ɛkpɔlɔ, yɛɛ nvɔlekɛ ɛli bɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule muala ɛlɔ nrɛnlana, na bɛ nrɛnlana mɔɔ bɛlɔ la bayɛ daselɛ atia bɛ na yeali bɛ nwonane ne kɛ senle. Bɛboɔboa anwonyia nloa wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ewiade ye ɛlɛba awieleɛ la.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Bɛtɛtuale bɛ gyimayɛvoma ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ bɛ ɛya ne mɔ anu la kakɛ. Bɛdie, bɛ ahatualɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nye fuu bɛanva bɛammaa bɛ la ati, bɛlɛsu, yɛɛ menli mɔɔ boɔboale aleɛ nloa manle bɛ la ɛzunlɛ ne ɛdwu Tumivolɛ Awulae ne anzo nu.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ wɔ ewiade ye anu ɛyɛ anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ ngome; bɛli bɛ nwo adane, bɛyɛ mbelane kɛ nlankɛ mɔɔ bɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ la.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Bɛbua sonla mɔɔ ɛnli fɔlɛ la ewule fɔlɛ bɛku ye; noko ɔndɛ ɔ nloa anu! Abotane nee nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, mediema, bɛzi abotane bɛhɔkpula Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae kɛra la. Bɛnlea ɛyazonlɛnli ne, ɔkendɛ ɔmaa azɛlɛ ye maa ye nzoleɛ ngɛnlɛma, ɔsi abotane ɔkendɛ ɔmaa fɔsɛlɛ ne nee bokile ne tɔ zolɛ.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ noko ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsi abotane. Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla, ɔluakɛ Awulae ɛralɛ ne ɛbikye.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛmmatendɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ bɛ nzo abo, amaa bɛambua bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ndɛne. Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne ɛbikye, ɔgyi bɛ nlenkɛ ne mɔ anloa.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Mediema, bɛhakye Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ luale Awulae duma nu dendɛle la. Bɛva bɛ abotane ne mɔɔ bɛnyianle ye bɛgyinlanle kpundii wɔ nyane nu la bɛyɛ ndonwo.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinlanle kpundii, bɛvale abotane bɛzɔle nyane bɛhɔle awieleɛ la yɛɛ yɛka kɛ Nyamenle ɛyila bɛ a. Se bɛde Dwobu ɔdaye ye abotane ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle ɔvale ɔgyinlanle kpundii ɔzɔle ye nyane ne la anwo bie, yɛɛ eza bɛze kɛ awieleɛ ne Nyamenle zile lole ye la. Nyamenle se anwunvɔne yɛɛ ɔ kunlu yelɛyela ye.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Me mediema, mɔɔ hyia kpole kpalɛ la a le kɛ, bɛmmaka ndane hweledede; bɛmmaka anwuma anzɛɛ aze anzɛɛ debie gyɛne biala bɔbɔ. Bɛmaa bɛ “Ɛhɛe” ɛyɛ ɛhɛe, bɛ “Kyɛkyɛ” ɛyɛ kyɛkyɛ, amaa Nyamenle andea bɛ.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua bie wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔzɛlɛ. Bie ɛlɛdi fɛlɛko ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛ nuhua bie ɛnde kpɔkɛ ɔ? Bɛmaa ɔvɛlɛ asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa ye, na bɛkpokpa ye nwole wɔ Awulae duma nu.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa diedi bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye a, wuleravolɛ ne anwo baza; Awulae badwazo ye, na saa yeyɛ ɛtane a yeava ye ɛtane yeahyɛ ye.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, bɛha bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhile bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛzɛlɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, na bɛkɛde kpɔkɛ. Sonla tenlene biala nzɛlɛlɛ yɛ nla eza tumi wɔ nu.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Yilaegya le sonla kɛ yɛdayɛ ala la; noko ɔzɛlɛle kɛ ezule mmatɔ la, ezule andɔ azɛlɛ ye azo dedee ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Na eza ɔzɛlɛle bieko, na ezule dɔle kpole manle aleɛ bule.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Mediema, saa bɛ nuhua bie kpɔkye fi nɔhalɛ ne anwo na ɔlɛminli, na bɛ nuhua bie kɔfa ye ba a,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: bɛmaa ɔhakye kɛ: sonla mɔɔ kɛlie ɛtanevolɛ kɛvi ye ɛtane nu la ɛlie ɛtanevolɛ ne ɛkɛla ɛvi ewule nu na yeheda ɛtane dɔɔnwo azo.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Pita, mɔɔ mele Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛ la ɛkɛ. Melɛ mekamaa Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ na bɛha maanɔne wɔ Pɔntɛse, Galeehyea, Kapɛdosea, Ehyea, yɛɛ Baetenea maanzinli ne mɔ anu la amuala.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Nyamenle Selɛ ne luale ye bodane ne azo kpale nu yele bɛ na ɔluale ye Sunsum ne azo ɔyɛle bɛ menli mɔɔ anwo te la, kɛ bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Gyisɛse Kelaese na ye mogya ne ade bɛ nwo. Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ molozo. Anyelazo mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle, yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɔ Ze ne! Yelua ye ɛlolɛ kpole ne azo yedwazo Gyisɛse Kelaese yevi ewule nu na yemaa yɛnyia ngoane fofolɛ nwo anyelazo mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ a.

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zolɛ yɛ nye la nyilalɛ bebelebe ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛzie ye menli ne la azo. Bɛmɛ bɛ ti, yeva nyilalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ ɛmkpɔlɔ, ɔnzɛkye, yɛɛ ɔndu anzɛɛ ɔmkpa la yezie anwuma lɔ yemaa bɛ.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Zɛhae nyilalɛ ne le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ diedi ti Nyamenle tumi ne dielie bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye na bɛbaye ngoanelielɛ ne bɛahile bɛ wɔ mekɛ ne mɔɔ li amozi la ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati saa yera kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi nyane wɔ mekɛ ekyi ye anu wɔ sɔnea nee amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile nu a, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ kɛ bɛfa bɛazɔ bɛ diedi bɛanlea saa ɔgyi kpundii a. Ezukoa nvutuke bɔbɔ mɔɔ sɛkye la, bɛfa senle a bɛnea kɛ ɔle kpalɛ a; zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ diedi ne mɔɔ hyia tɛla ezukoa nvutuke la bɛsɔ ye bɛnea a, amaa yeava ayɛlɛyelɛ, anyunlunyia, yɛɛ enililɛ yearɛlɛ bɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse bara la.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Bɛtɛnwunle Gyisɛse ɛlɛ, noko bɛkulo ye. Kɛkala bɔbɔ bɛnnwu ye, noko bɛdie ye bɛdi, na ɔlua zo bɛ nye die na bɛdi fɛlɛko kpole mɔɔ ɛnloanlɛ ɛngola ɛnga a,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛlua bɛ diedi mɔɔ wɔ ye nu la azo bɛlɛdie bɛ ɛkɛla ngoane.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ hanle ɛlolɛ ɛhye mɔɔ le bɛ ɛdeɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ dole ɛkɛ ne la nleɛnleanle nu, na bɛkpondɛle ngoanelielɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Nyamenle bava amaa bɛ la anu.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnwu sonla holɛ ko ne mɔɔ bara nee mekɛ holɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɔbava yeara la. Ɛhye a le mɔɔ ɛnee Kelaese Sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛlɛkilehile bɛ na ɔka nyane mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Kelaese nwu ye nee anyunlunyia mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la anwo bie ɔkile bɛ a.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Nyamenle yele hilele ye kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ luale Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛzoanle ye vi anwuma rale la azo bɔle Edwɛkpa ɛhye nolo hilele bɛ, kɛ tɛ bɛdabɛ kpɔmanvolɛma bɛ ti yɛɛ bɛyɛle zɔhane gyima ne a, na bɛmɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma bɛ ti ɔ. Ɛhye mɔ le ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma akunlu a anrɛɛ bɛde ɔ bo a. Bɛdɛnla nwuanzanwuanza nu

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛzie bɛ adwenle koonwu, bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla nyilalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛbanyia ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese kɛra la azo.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ tieyɛ bɛmaa Nyamenle na bɛmmamaa bɛ atiakunluwɔzo sie bɛ kɛ dɛba ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnze nwolɛ bie la.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ bɛ la anwo te, yemɔti bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛde wɔ nyɛleɛ biala anu.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo te, ɔboalekɛ mele nwuanzanwuanza.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛfɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɔnnea sonla nyunlu na ɔbua menli kɔsɔɔti ndɛne, kɛmɔ biala nyɛleɛ si de la bɛ Ze. Zɔhane ati, bɛva Nyamenlezulolɛ bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛze mɔɔ bɛduale ye wɔ bɛ ti na bɛahola bɛakpɔne bɛ bɛavi bɛ nlenya mɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛbɔlɛ ne anu la. Bɛanva debie mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeazɛkye, mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa nvutuke anzɛɛ dwɛtɛ fufule,

english_verse: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
translation_verse: bɛvale Gyisɛse, mɔɔ le boaneralɛ mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ dɛne biala la mogya ne mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la a bɛkpɔnenle bɛ a.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Nyamenle vale ye ziele ɛkɛ dɛba kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade, yɛɛ bɛmɛ bɛ ti bɛye ye bɛhile wɔ mekɛ ye mɔɔ li amozi la anu a.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛɛ bɛlie Nyamenle ne mɔɔ dwazole ye vile ewule nu na ɔmanle ye anyunlunyia la bɛli, na kɛkala bɛ diedi nee bɛ anyelazo ɛragyinla Nyamenle anwo zo a.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Kɛkala mɔɔ ɔlua bɛ tieyɛ wɔ nɔhalɛ ne anwo bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi ninyɛndane nwo na bɛnyia ɛhulolɛ bɛmaa bɛ mediema diedima la, bɛmaa bɛ ɛhulolɛ ne ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ vi bɛ ahonle nu a.

english_verse: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛlua tease Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ zo bɛwo bɛ fofolɛ kɛ bɛle mralɛ mɔɔ ɛnwu ɛlɛ la na bɛnle menli mɔɔ wu la amra.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Menli kɔsɔɔti le kɛ ndile, bɛ anyunlunyia le kɛ ndotolo. Ndile ne nwoso na ndotolo ne kpolo,

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: noko Awulae edwɛkɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.” Edwɛkɛ ɛhye a le Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye nolo bɛhilele bɛ la.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi ɛtane muala anwo; bɛmmabɔ adalɛ, bɛmmayɛ ngunzi, bɛmmatwe nungule, bɛmmayɛ aholoba.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ nlɔma mɔɔ sunsum nu nyɛfonzule ɛhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la, amaa saa bɛnyia ye bɛno a bɛanyi na bɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bɛdabɛ bɛhola bɛnwu kɛ Awulae atiakunlu le kɛnlɛma.”

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla Awulae ɛkɛ. Yemɔ a ɔle Tease Bolɛ ne mɔɔ ewiade amra kpole ye kɛ ɔle debie mgbane na Nyamenle noko ɛkpa nu ɛye ye kɛ ɔle bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia la a.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Bɛrɛla kɛ bɛle tease awolɛ na bɛmaa bɛva bɛ bɛzi sunsum nu ɛzonlenlɛ sua mɔɔ bɛsonle nu, kɛ bɛle sɛlɛvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza na bɛlua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo bɛbɔ sunsum nu azu mɔɔ sɔ ɛnyelɛ la bɛmaa Nyamenle.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Mekpa nu meye bolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, kɛ mefa meayɛ bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia wɔ Zayɔn; mɔɔ kɛlie ye kɛli la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ɛlɛ.”
