english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Bolɛ ɛhye sonle bolɛ kpole kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛdi la, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlie bɛnli la, Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Bolɛ ko ne ala mɔɔ suatovoma ne kpole kɛ ɔle debie mgbane la, yemɔ ala a ɔrayɛle bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la a.”

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ a. Bɛle Belemgbunli ne sɛlɛvolɛma, maanle nwuanzanwuanza, Nyamenle ɔdaye ye menli mɔɔ yeboɔboa yekpondɛ bɛ bo zo na yevɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛvi awozinli nu bɛrɛla ye wienyi ne anu na bɛbɔ ye nwanwane gyima ne nolo a.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie ɛnee bɛnzɔho menli bɔbɔ, na ɛnɛ bɛle Nyamenle menli. Mekɛ bie ɛnee bɛnze Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne deɛ holɛ, na ɛnɛ bɛ sa ɛha ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne. Nyamenle ngɛkɛlɛ

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, mesɛlɛ bɛ, bɛle nyɛvolɛ nee adendulɛma wɔ ewiade! Bɛmmadi nwonane atiakunluwɔzo ne mɔ mɔɔ dahuu nee bɛ ɛkɛla ko la anzi fee.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛmaa bɛ nyɛleɛ wɔ maanlema avinli yɛ kɛnlɛma, amaa saa bɛsi bɛ amgbu kɛ bɛnle kpalɛ bɔbɔ a, ɛnee kɛmɔ bɛnwu bɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ne la ati bɛaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ Kenle ne mɔɔ Awulae bara la.

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: nee amɛnladoma, mɔɔ le kɛ ɛzoanlɛ bie a bɛzoa bɛ kɛ bɛradea maamɔvoma, na bɛhanvo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi boɛ la.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ a le kɛ bɛkɛva bɛ nyɛleɛ kpalɛ ne mɔ bɛkɛmaa ahɔnwɔne kɛgyakyi mgbane mgbane ɛhehanlɛ.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Bɛdɛnla kɛ bɛdi bɛ ti anwo, noko bɛmmafa bɛ ti anwo ɛlilɛ ne bɛkedɛheda ɛtane zo. Bɛdɛnla kɛ bɛle Nyamenle ngɛkɛlɛ.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Bɛli menli kɔsɔɔti eni. Bɛhulo bɛ gɔnwo mɔ diedima. Bɛzulo Nyamenle na bɛli Maanle Maanle Belemgbunli ne eni. Kelaese amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo ndonwo

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ ngɛkɛlɛ, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ menle mɔ; bɛmmabu mɔɔ atiakunlu le kɛnlɛma la angome, na bɛbu mɔɔ ati yɛ se la noko.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Saa bɛfa Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ bɛsie bɛ nyunlu, na ɔlua yemɔti bɛnwu amaneɛ mɔɔ ɛnfɛta la, na bɛsi nwolɛ abotane a, ɔbayila bɛ.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ duzu nvasoɛ yɛɛ bɛkɛnyia ye kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛtane na bɛkɛnyia nwolɛ ndeanlɛ a? Na saa bɛdi boɛ la ati bɛnwu nwolɛ amaneɛ na bɛsi nwolɛ abotane a, Nyamenle bayila bɛ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti Kelaese mumua ne nwunle amaneɛ vale yɛle ndonwo manle bɛ. Na ɛhye noko ala ati yɛɛ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ a, amaa bɛava ɔ gyakɛ.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Yeanyɛ ɛtane biala, yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ yeangile awie biala.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Noko mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye aholoba la, yeambɔ bɛ bie, bɛgolo ɔ nwo la, yeandɛ ɔ nloa anu; mɔɔ ɔnwu amaneɛ bɔbɔ la, yeanwunlonwunla awie, na ɔvale ye anyelazo kɔsɔɔti ɔdole Nyamenle anwo zo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle pɛlepɛle Ndɛnebuavolɛ ne a.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Kelaese ɔdaye mumua ne ɔliele yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ wɔ ye sonlabaka ne anu ɔhɔle meanubaka ne azo, amaa yɛawu yɛamaa ɛtane na yɛadɛnla yɛamaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ. Bɛlua ye ɛbodalɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ azo a bɛyɛ bɛ ayile a.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ɛnee bɛle kɛ mboane mɔɔ ɛminli la, na kɛkala bɛva bɛ bɛzia bɛra kɛ bɛrali Mboaneneavolɛ ne nee bɛ ɛkɛla sinzavolɛ ne anzi.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ nwuvolɛ mraalɛ, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ hu mɔ, amaa nuhua mɔɔ ɔ hu ɛnlie Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne ɛnli la, bɛalua bɛ nyɛleɛ zo bɛahwe ye bɛarɛlɛ Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛha edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko bɔbɔ a,

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: ɔboalekɛ bɛbanwu bɛ nwo enililɛ nee bɛ anwondelɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ bɛ ti ɛyɛlɛ, mgbɔba, agudeɛ anzɛɛ ndanlɛ ngɛnlɛma ɛhedalɛ bɛsiezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛfa bɛamaa bɛ nwo ayɛ fɛ.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa bɛ nyamenlezo anwofɛlɛko ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la ɛvinde. Nyamenlezo anwofɛlɛko ɛhye vea bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu, na yemɔ a le bɛ bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ nee bɛ koonwuyɛlɛ subane ne. Ɛhye a le kɛnlɛma na ɔsɔ Nyamenle anye a.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ mraalɛ mɔɔ dule bɛ nwo manle Nyamenle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ na bɛnyianle anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu la adenle mɔɔ luale zolɛ zieziele bɛ nwo la a le kɛ bɛhanle bɛ nwo aze bɛmanle bɛ hu mɔ.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Ɛnee kɛ Sɛla de la ɛne; ɔyɛle tieyɛ ɔmanle ɔ hu Ebileham na ɔvɛlɛle ye ɔ menle. Kɛkala, saa bɛbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ na bɛammaa debie biala anwunlonwunla bɛ a, bɛle ɔ mra mraalɛ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛmɛ mrenya noko, saa bɛ nee bɛ ye mɔ de a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛle mraalɛ na bɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ a. Yemɔti bɛli bɛ eni, ɔboalekɛ bɛ nee bɛ bɛ muala a bɛbanyia Nyamenle ngoane ɛlolɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne a. Bɛyɛ ɛhye, amaa debie biala andenda bɛ gyakɛ anu wɔ bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nu. Kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo amaneɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Awieleɛ ne, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ muala bɛ adwenle yɛ ko; bɛde bɛ gɔnwo mɔ nyane bo na bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko kɛ bɛle mediema. Bɛnyia ahonle kpalɛ na bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Bɛmmafa ɛtane bɛtua ɛtane kakɛ anzɛɛ bɛmmafa butule bɛyia butule. Bɛva nyilalɛ nee kosoɛ ɛyɛlɛ bɛdua ɛtane kakɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye ati yɛɛ Nyamenle vɛlɛle bɛ a, amaa bɛanyia nyilalɛ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Awie mɔɔ kulo ngoane na ɔkpondɛ anyelielɛ la ɛgyakyi adalɛ ɛbɔlɛ nee munzule edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi ɛtane nwo na ɔyɛ kpalɛ; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkpondɛ anzonudwolɛ bo zo na ɔdi ɔ nzi.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anye wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛma anwo zo, na ɔbuke ɔ nzo ɔtie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ dahuu. Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ɛtane la, Awulae kakyi ɔ nzi si bɛ.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Saa bɛpele bɛdi boɛ a, nwane yɛɛ kɛhola kɛyɛ bɛ debie a?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ bɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti bɔbɔ a, bɛbanyia nyilalɛ. Bɛmmasulo awie biala, yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Bɛzulo Kelaese wɔ bɛ ahonle nu kɛ ɔle bɛ Awulae. Dahuu bɛziezie bɛ nwo, amaa saa awie biza bɛ bɛ anyelazo ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la anwo edwɛkɛ a bɛahola bɛaye ɔ nloa,

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: noko anrɛɛ bɛva bɛtɛɛyɛlɛ amaa saa awie mɔ keha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane a, bɛ subane kpalɛ ne, kɛmɔ bɛle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma na bɛdi boɛ la agua menli zɔhane mɔ anyunlu aze.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la a le kɛ yɛkɛli boɛ na yɛkɛnwu amaneɛ a, ɛnee ye zɔhane le kpalɛ, tɛla kɛ yɛkɛli ɛtane a.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Kelaese mumua ne wule kokye wɔ awie biala ɛtane ti. Ɔle sonlakpalɛ, noko ɔwule ɔmanle ɛtanevolɛma, amaa yealie yɛ yeahɔmaa Nyamenle. Bɛhunle ye wɔ nwonane nu, noko bɛdwazole ye wɔ sunsum nu,

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: na wɔ sunsum ne anu yɛɛ ɔhɔle ɔhɔbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo ɔhilele sunsum nu amra mɔɔ bɛgua bɛ anga la a.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Sunsum ɛhye mɔ a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛle Nyamenle anwo anzosesebɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlɛkendɛ abotane nu ala yeamaa Nowa abobɔ ɛlɛne ne la. Bɛdabɛ ekyi ne ala, bɛle mɔtwɛ, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu wɔ azule ne anye la yɛɛ bɛliele bɛ ngoane a.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Ɛzɔnenlɛ le sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ gyi ɛkɛ maa nzule ne a. Ɔnle sonlabaka nwo evinli ɛnrinzinlɛ, ɔle Nyamenle nyunlu modolɛ kɛ ɔmaa bɛ adwenle mɔɔ anu la ɛkɛ ne wienyi la, amaa ɔlua Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ewudwazo ne azo bɛalie bɛ ngoane.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Yemɔ yɛɛ yehɔ anwuma na ɔde Nyamenle asa fema zo na Nyamenle soanvolɛma nee anwuma tumivolɛma nee mgbolema amuala sonle ye a.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛmɛ bɛ ti Kelaese nwunle amaneɛ wɔ nwonane nu la, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛbanwu amaneɛ; ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ kɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ nwonane nu la ɛnyɛ ɛtane bieko.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Na ɔvi mekɛ ne anu mɔɔ kɔ la, ɔmaa Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne dielie ye wɔ ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛha amozi la anu na ɔgyakyi ye atiakunluwɔzo nzi ɛlilɛ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Bɛzɛkye bɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo bɛyɛ mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle Nyamenle la yɛ la bie. Bɛbɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla, bɛli bɛ atiakunluwɔzo mgbane mgbane nzi, nza ɛgya bɛ, bɛmaa bɛ nye die mgbane mgbane, bɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla, na bɛsonle awozonle.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Kɛkala ɔsi bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle la anwo kɛ saa ɛnɛ bɛbɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane ɛhye mɔ a bɛmɛ Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma ɛmbamboka bɛ nwo a, na ɔlua zo bɛkeha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛbabu bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo mgbonda bɛahile Nyamenle mɔɔ babua anyewɔzoamra nee mɔwuamra ndɛne la.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛbɔle Edwɛkpa ne nolo bɛhilele mɔwuamra a, amaa saa bɛlua bɛ nwonane ɛhye azo bɛbua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛbua awie biala la a, sunsum nu bɛadɛnla, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la. Menli mɔɔ nea Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne mɔ boɛ la

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti awieleɛ ɛbikye. Ɛhye ati bɛzɔ bɛ nwo kpalɛ na bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye, na bɛahola bɛayɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ hyia kpalɛ la, bɛva bɛ ahonle muala bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, ɔboalekɛ ɛhulolɛ maa bɛfa ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa adenle bɛmaa bɛ mediema Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma ɛwolo bɛ mɔɔ adendɛbɛnzoabo biala ɛnle nu a.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ bɛ muala bɛnea bɛ Nyamenle ahyɛlɛdeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ boɛ la, ko biala ɛva ye ɛdeɛ mɔɔ yenyia ye la ɛkpondɛ ɔ gɔnwo mɔ kpalɛ ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ ka Nyamenle edwɛkɛ la ɛnlea ɛha Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne; mɔɔ sonle noko la ɛva ye anwosesebɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye la amuala ɛzonle, amaa debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu menli ava ayɛlɛyelɛ alua Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo amaa Nyamenle. Yemɔ yɛɛ anyunlunyia nee tumi le ye ɛdeɛ dahuu a. Amen. Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, bɛmmamaa amaneɛnwunlɛ kpole mɔɔ bara bɛ nwo zo arazɔ bɛ anlea la yɛ bɛ azibɛnwo kɛ asɛɛ debie ɛzulolɛ bie ɛrado bɛ.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Bɛli fɛlɛko kɛ bɛ nee Kelaese ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ a, amaa saa bɛye ye bɛkile anyunlunyia nu a bɛali fɛlɛko kpole.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Saa Kelaese duma nu ti bɛkile bɛ nyane a, nyilalɛ ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ ɛhye kile kɛ anyunlunyia sunsum ne mɔɔ le Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Noko akee bɛmmamaa bɛ biala nwu amaneɛ kɛ ɔle kɔdiawu, awule anzɛɛ yedo mɛla anzɛɛ yeva ɔ nloa yedo awie edwɛkɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Na saa awie le Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ la ati ɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɔmmamaa ɔyɛ ye nyiane, na ɔyɛ Nyamenle mo kɛ ɔlɛ Kelaese duma ne anu a.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne abo a, na Nyamenle menli ne yɛɛ bɛbalumua bɛabua bɛ ndɛne a. Na saa ndɛnebualɛ ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ yɛ nwo zo a, ɛnee kɛ ɔkɛzi ɔkɛwie ye wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnlie Edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la ɛnli la anwo zo ɛ?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne se, “Saa ɔyɛ se ɔmaa kpalɛma kɛ bɛkɛvi ɛsalɛ a ɛnee kɛ ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ ɛnzonle Nyamenle la kɛwie ye ɛ?”

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ti bɛnwu amaneɛ la bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ na bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne anwo zo, ɔluakɛ ɔdi ye ɛwɔkɛ zo dahuu.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Medame, mele asɔne mgbanyima ne mɔ bie. Mele Kelaese amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anwo dasevolɛ, yɛɛ mebanyia anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ bara la bie. Yemɔti mesɛlɛ bɛdabɛ asɔne mgbanyima mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la kɛ,

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: bɛnlea mboane ekpunli ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛwula bɛ sa nu la boɛ, bɛva ahunlundwolɛ bɛnlea bɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ la, na bɛmmatwenlehwenle bɛ bo aze. Bɛyɛ gyima kɛ bɛkulo kɛ bɛsonle la ati ɔ na tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛkpondɛ ɔ nzi ahatualɛ la ati ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Bɛmmapele kɛ bɛkile bɛ tumi wɔ menli mɔɔ bɛva bɛ bɛwula bɛ bo la anwo zo, na bɛpɛ kilemunli kpalɛ bɛmaa mboane ne ɛlua zo,

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: amaa saa Mboaneneavolɛ Kpanyinli ne ba a bɛanyia anyunlunyia abɔtile ne mɔɔ ye kɛnlɛma ɛmkpa anzɛɛ ɛndu ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdabɛ ngakula mɔɔ bɛwɔ asɔne ne anu la noko bu mgbanyima ne mɔ na bɛka bɛ nwo aze bɛmaa bɛ a. Bɛ muala bɛva fɛlɛko nee ɛzelekɛ bɛzonle bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, ɔluakɛ “Nyamenle kyi mɔɔ memaa ɔ nwo zo la, na ɔyila mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze la.”

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛbɛlɛ bɛ nwo aze wɔ Nyamenle tumi kpole ne abo, amaa saa ɔdaye ye mekɛ ne mɔɔ yehile la dwu a yeamaa bɛ zo.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Bɛva bɛ adwenleadwenle muala bɛgua ɔ nwo zo, ɔboalekɛ ɔdwenle bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ bɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye na bɛzinza! Na bɛ kpɔvolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Abɔnsam, lua nu ɛlɛkpo kɛ awenade, ɔlɛkpondɛ awie yeahye ye yeali.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Bɛzɔ bɛ diedi ne anu kpundii, bɛho bɛtia ye na bɛnwu kɛ bɛ mediema diedima mɔɔ wɔ ewiade ye anu ɛleka biala la ɛlɛnwu zɛhae amaneɛ ne bie.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Na saa bɛte nyane ne ekyii bɛwie a ɛlolɛ kɔsɔɔti Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ bɛ kɛ bɛ nee Kelaese ɛradɛnla ye anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu la anu la, ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbaziezie bɛ yeamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ nee akɛnrasesebɛ, na yeamaa bɛagyinla kpundii.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛhye yɛɛ tumi ne le ye ɛdeɛ dahuu a! Amen. Ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Saelase mɔɔ kɛkala Kelaese ati meva ye kɛ me diema kpalɛ kpalɛ la yɛɛ ɛboa ɛmaa mehɛlɛ bɛ kɛlata ezinraa ɛhye a. Mekulo kɛ mesi bɛ ahonle, na medi daselɛ kɛ ɛhye a le Nyamenle ɛlolɛ kpalɛ ne a. Bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ nuhua.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Bɛ mediema asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn, mɔɔ bɛdabɛ Nyamenle ɛkpa nu ɛye bɛ la biza bɛ ahye. Me ra Maake noko ɔdaye ɔbiza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛva Kelaese ɛdoavolɛ ɛhulolɛ ne bɛyɛ bɛ nwo atuu, bɛbizebiza bɛ nwo ahye. Anzonudwolɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bɛle Kelaese ɛdeɛ la.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Saemɔn Pita, mɔɔ mele Gyisɛse Kelaese akɛlɛ nee ye ɛzoanvolɛ la ɛkɛ. Melɛ mekamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔlua Nyamenle nee Dievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti bɛnyia diedi mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kɛ yɛdayɛ la.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛlo bɛ dɔɔnwo na ɔmaa bɛ nzo nu ɛdwo bɛ molozo kɛ bɛnwu ye nee yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse a. Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Nyamenle tumi kpole ne ɛmaa yɛ debie biala mɔɔ yɛhyia nwo wɔ yɛ ɛbɛla kpalɛ ɛbɔlɛ nee yɛ nyamenlezonlenlɛ nu la, ɔluakɛ yɛze mɔɔ ɛvɛlɛ yɛ kɛ yɛ nee ye ɛradɛnla ye anyunlunyia ne nee ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne anu la.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Ɔlua zo yebɔ yɛ ɛwɔkɛ mgbole dɔɔnwo mɔɔ sonle bolɛ, amaa ɔlua ɛwɔkɛ ɛhye mɔ azo bɛavi ɛtane nu wɔ ewiade ye anu, na bɛanyia ye Nyamenle su ne bie.

english_verse: Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding,
translation_verse: Ɔlua ɛhye ala ati ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛfa kpalɛyɛlɛ bɛboka bɛ diedi nwo na bɛfa deɛnwunlɛ bɛboka bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa bɛlɛ subane kpalɛ zɛhae molozo a, ɔmaa bɛ nwo kpundi bɛ na bɛyɛ nla wɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo deɛnwunlɛ nu.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɛhye mɔ la anye ɛyɛ na ɔngola ɔnnwu moa, na ɔ rɛle ɛvi kɛ bɛde ɔ nwo bɛvi ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle bɛ dɛba la anwo.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mediema, bɛbɔ mɔdenle kpalɛ kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛmaa Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ yevɛlɛ bɛ nee ɛkpalɛ mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye bɛ la kɛgyinla bɛ nyunlu dahuu. Saa bɛyɛ ye zɔhane a bɛnrɛdɔ aze ɛlɛ.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Zɛhae nyɛleɛ zo ala yɛɛ bɛlua a bɛkɛnyia yɛ Awulae nee Dievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese belemgbunlililɛ ne mɔɔ ɛmbɔ aze ɛlɛ la a.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati meyɛ me adwenle kɛ dahuu mebahakyehakye bɛ wɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo, noko meze kɛ bɛze bɛ dɛba na bɛ ti ɛmi nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la anu kpalɛ.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Menea a ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mekakyehakye bɛ adwenle wɔ edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mede ngoane ɛhye anu la.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meado nwonane ɛhye aze, kɛmɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese hanle hilele me la.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, mebabɔ mɔdenle meanlea kɛ adenle biala anu, saa mewu mekɔ bɔbɔ a bɛkɛhakye ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ. Kelaese anyunlunyia nwo alasevolɛ

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Yɛangyinla ngehanleɛ zo anzɛɛ sonla adwenle nzuzulɛ zo a yɛkpale yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese tumi ne nee ye ɛralɛ bieko nwo edwɛkɛ ne anwo ɛdanlɛ yɛhilele bɛ a. Yɛdayɛ yɛnwunle ye anyunlunyia kpole ne yɛ nye zo yɛɛ yɛdi nwolɛ daselɛ.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Yɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Nyamenle Selɛ ne dele ɔ nyunlu, wulale ye anyunlunyia a. Yɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɛnelɛ ne vi Anyunlunyia Bedevinli ne ɛkɛ ne hanle kɛ, “Me Ra mɔɔ mekulo ye la ɛne, me nye die ɔ nwo kpole!”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Yɛdayɛ yɛdele ɛnelɛ ɛhye yɛ nzo nu kɛ ɔvi anwuma a ɔrale a, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne anu ɛnee yɛ nee ye a wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo a.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ɛhye maa yɛ adwenle si pi kpalɛ wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle Kpɔmanvolɛma hanle la anwo. Ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛdie ye boɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kɛ kɛnlaneɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛta ɛleka mɔɔ le awozinli la, kɔkpula kɛ Alehyenlɛ ne kɛra na aleɛbahye edole ne kɛdu bɛ ahonle ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛte ɔ bo la a le kɛ sonla ko biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛva ɔdaye ɔ ngome ye adwenle ɛnrɛhilehile Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la abo.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma edwɛkɛ kpɔkɛ ko biala mɔɔ bɛhanle la ɛnvi sonla. Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne a wolole bɛ manle bɛhanle zɔhane edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la a.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Mekɛ bie Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma alane bie vindele menli ne avinli. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ kilehilevolɛma alane bavinde bɛdabɛ noko bɛ avinli a. Bɛbava adalɛ ngilehilelɛ nee awozinli nu ngehanleɛ mɔɔ sɛkye adwenle la bɛara. Yemɔti bɛbakpo Menlenlɛ ne mɔɔ liele bɛ ngoane la na bɛahwe arɛlevilɛ nu munzule bɛamaa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Menli dɔɔnwo badoa bɛ alua bɛ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane adenle ɛhye anu, na ɔlua bɛ nyɛleɛ ti menli adendɛ ɛtane atia nɔhalɛ Adenle ne.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Bɛ anyebolo ti, kilehilevolɛma alane ɛhye mɔ bava adalɛ edwɛkɛ abɛlɛbɛla bɛ anyia bɛ nwo zo nvasoɛ. Bɛbua bɛ ndɛne dɛbadɛba, na ɔla ɛkɛ ɔlɛkendɛ bɛ. Ahenle mɔɔ bazɛkye bɛ la ɛtɛdafele.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle anvavi ye soanvolɛma ne mɔɔ vonle ye, na ɔvuandinle bɛ ɔguale hɛɛle, yemaa bɛgua bɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ wɔ awozinli kabii ne anu, kɛ bɛhendɛ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne;

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: saa Nyamenle anvavi ewiade dɛba ne na ɔvale azuyilɛ ɔzɛkyele ɛtane ewiade ne, na ɔgyakyile Nowa, mɔɔ bɔle Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ nwo nolo, nee menli nsuu bie;

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: saa Nyamenle anvavi na ɔdeanle azuamgbole Sodɔm nee Gomɔla, ɔvale senle ɔzɛkyele bɛ, ɔhilele kɛ kenle bie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛngulo Nyamenle la kɛzi kɛwie ye la,

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: ɛnee nɔhalɛ, saa ɛnea mɔɔ sonlakpalɛ zɛhae nwunle ye na ɔdele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔde menli zɔhane mɔ avinli, nee alehyenlɛ biala ye ɛbolɛ mɔɔ te wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo a,

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: ɛnee Awulae ze kɛ ɔsi ɔdie menli kpalɛ ɔfi bɛ sɔnea nu na ɔsie amumuyɛma wɔ ndeanlɛ bo kɔkpula Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne a.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛli bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane nzi na bɛkpo Nyamenle la kɛ bɛbawie ye la ɛne. Kilehilevolɛma alane ɛhye mɔ si bɛ kɛnra, bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛmbu anyunlunyiama mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la na bɛtendɛ bɛtia bɛ.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Noko, Nyamenle soanvolɛma bɔbɔ, mɔɔ yɛ se, lɛ tumi tɛla kilehilevolɛma alane ɛhye mɔ la ɛnva ɛya ɛndoɔdoa bɛ ɛngile Awulae.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ yɛ bɛ ninyɛne kɛ ɛbɔ nu nane mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ kɛ bɛhye bɛ bɛhu bɛ la. Bɛtendɛ ɛtane bɛtia debie biala mɔɔ bɛnze la, na bɛbazɛkye bɛ kɛ ɛbɔ nu nane.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ awie mɔ la, bɛbadua bɛ nwolɛ kakɛ. Bɛ anyelielɛ ala a le ewia henlema nza ɛbolɛ nee adwɔmanebɔlɛ mgbole; bɛ nwo yɛ nyiane yɛɛ ɔyɛ anyiemgba bɔbɔ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kɛdu a. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ de ɛkponle ko anwo bɛlɛkpula bɛ sa la ɛnee bɛlɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛ.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Adwɔmanebɔlɛ ɛnzea bɛ adenle yɛɛ bɛnze ɛtane nwo nyiane nretee zɛhae. Bɛbɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛtinle sunsum nu la. Anyebolo ɛwie bɛ ku! Abule ɛbu bɛ!

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Bɛgyakyi adenle kpalɛ ne na bɛminli nwɔnda; bɛva Biyɔ ara Beelam mɔɔ doale ezukoa anyebolo na ɔlile ɛtane

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: na bɛdeanle ye wɔ ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo la agyakɛ. Asoaso bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔde zolɛ la vale sonla ɛnelɛ dendɛle ye na ɔduale Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ɔmanle ɔgyakyile ye ɛzɛlɛ ninyɛne ne.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ le kɛ nzubula mɔɔ ɛsesa la, bɛle kɛ nzulemungu mɔɔ ahumu ɛlɛbɔ ye ahɔ la. Nyamenle ɛzie bɛ ɛleka wɔ awozinli kabikabi ne anu.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Bɛtu bɛ nloa anu, bɛka edwɛkɛ mɔɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu la na bɛfa adwɔmanebɔlɛ atiakunluwɔzo bɛsɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛanriandi bɛavi menli mɔɔ de ɛtane nu la avinli la.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Bɛfa fanwodi bɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛle subane ɛtane nwo ahanra la. Sonla biala mɔɔ kɛmaa debie kɛvo ɔ nwo zo la le kanranli maa deɛ zɔhane.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa menli nwu yɛ Awulae nee Dievolɛ Kelaese Gyisɛse, na ɔlua ɔ ti bɛfi ewiade ninyɛndane nu na eza bɛsia bɛ nzi bɛmaa ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ fo bɛ nwo zo a, ɛnee noko bɛ gyakɔ; bɛbazɛkye kpalɛ wɔ awieleɛ ne bɛadɛla alumua ne.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ɛnee noko bɔbɔ ɔle kpalɛ kɛ anrɛɛ bɛannwu pɛlepɛlelilɛ adenle ne fee, tɛla kɛ bɛkɛnwu ye na bɛkɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛkɛzi mɛla nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa bɛ la.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ si bɛ nwo zo la kile kɛ ɛrɛlɛ ne le nɔhalɛ bɔkɔɔ, “Twea fe a ɔsia ɔkɔdi”, yɛɛ “ɛbia kpolike a ɔsia ɔkɔboto ndɛtɛlɛ.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: amaa bɛadwenle edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ ɛha ɛdo ɛkɛ ne nee Awulae Dievolɛ ne ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛzoanvolɛma ne mɔ ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Mɔɔ lumua la a le kɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnyia ndelebɛbo kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la amgbuzilɛma bie mɔɔ di bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi la badwazo na bɛarazi bɛ amgbu. Bɛbagolo bɛ nwo,

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: na bɛabiza kɛ, “Se ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbara, na ɔwɔ nienwu? Sumunli mɔmoane mɔɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ wule la, kɛ debie biala de, ɔvi aloamɔleɛ la yɛɛ ɔde a.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Menli zɛhae mɔ anye fuu yɛɛ bɛyɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛnze kɛ aloa kabɔ la Nyamenle vale ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ ala a manle anwuma rale, na azɛlɛ resee ye noko yele ɔ nwo vile nzule nu rale dɛbadɛba ne, na nzule ɛbɔ ye ɛyia a,

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: yɛɛ eza noko nzule ye ala a yile zɛkyele ewiade dɛba ne la.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anloa edwɛkɛ ko ye ala azo a bɛlua bɛhua anwuma nee aze mɔɔ kɛkala wɔ ɛkɛ ne la anwo senle bɛzie ɛkɛ bɛlɛfa bɛahendɛ ndɛnebualɛ kenle ne nee menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la ɛzɛkyelɛ a.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ Awulae ɛngola ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ yebɔ la azo di, kɛmɔ bɛ bie mɔ dwenle kɛ ɔde la, na yemɔ a le kɛ Awulae lɛ bɛ nwo abotane, ɔluakɛ ɔngulo kɛ bɛsɛkye awie biala. Ɔkpondɛ kɛ awie biala nu ɔ nwo na ɔtwe ɔ nwo ɔfi ye ɛtane ne mɔ anwo.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Awulae Kenle ne bara kɛ awule la. Kenle ne, anwuma bava ɛnelɛ kpole bie aminliminli anwomanyunlu na anwumaneamra ayela aholo; na azɛlɛ ye nee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bayela adɔ nzonle.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkendɛ na bɛ nye la kɛ Nyamenle Kenle ne bara ndɛndɛ la. Kenle zɔhane anwuma bayela adɔ nzonle na ye wuluwulu ne aholo anwumaneamra amuala.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ, kɛmɔ Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ ne kile la, yɛkendɛ anwuma fofolɛ ne nee ewiade fofolɛ ne mɔɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ wɔ nu la.

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ayi mɔ, kɛmɔ bɛlɛkendɛ ɛhye mɔ la, bɛbɔ mɔdenle, amaa Awulae ba a yeanwu kɛ bɛ nwo te mɔɔ nvonleɛ biala ɛnle bɛ nu na bɛ nee ye bɛ nloa sɛ bɛ nwo a.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Bɛde ɔ bo kɛ yɛ Awulae abotane ne le ngoanelielɛ maa bɛ, kɛmɔ adiema Pɔɔlo ɛlua nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye la azo ɛhɛlɛ ɛrɛlɛ bɛ la.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Nɔhalɛ, ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ala a ɔhɛlɛle bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ ye ngɛlata ne mɔ anu a. Ninyɛne bie noko mɔɔ bɛ bo ɛdelɛ ɛnla aze la wɔ ye ngɛlata ne mɔ anu. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛngyinla ɛleka ko na bɛnze ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo bie la kyibehyiba bɛ ɛtane ɛtane bie, kɛmɔ bɛva bɛyɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne bie mɔ la. Bɛlua ɛhye azo bɛlɛsɛkye bɛ ngome bɛ nwo.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Na ayi mɔ, bɛmɛ bɛhakye bɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo bie dɛba. Yemɔti bɛnlea boɛ na kpamgbanvolɛma anva bɛ amumuyɛ andwe bɛ angɔ nvonleɛ nu, na bɛavi ɛleka kɛnlɛma ɛhye mɔɔ bɛgyi la bɛagua aze.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛnyi wɔ yɛ Awulae nee Dievolɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo nrɛlɛbɛ nee ɛlolɛ ne anu. Yemɔ yɛɛ anyunlunyia ɛha ye kɛkala nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a! Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Yɛlɛkɛlɛ bɛ wɔ ngoane Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne na yɛde, yɛnwu ye yɛ nye zo, yɛnlea ye kpalɛ, na yɛva yɛ sa yɛha ye la anwo.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Ngoane Edwɛkɛ ɛhye lale ɔ nwo ali na yɛnwunle ye; zɔhane ati yɛdi nwolɛ daselɛ na yɛka ngoane ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ mɔɔ nee Selɛ ne a wɔ ɛkɛ na ɔyele ɔhilele yɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ yɛnwu ye nee mɔɔ yɛde la yɛɛ yɛka yɛahile bɛdabɛ noko a, amaa bɛ nee yɛ adila agɔnwolɛ. Yɛ nee Selɛ ne nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse Kelaese a ɛdila agɔnwolɛ ɛhye a.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Yɛlɛkɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ amaa yɛ anyelielɛ ne ali munli. Nyamenle le wienyi

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ yɛde yɛvi ye ɛkɛ ne na yɛka yɛahile bɛ la a le ɛhye: Nyamenle le wienyi, awozinli fee ɛnle ye nu.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, saa yɛka kɛ yɛ nee Nyamenle le agɔnwolɛ, noko yɛbɔ awozinli nu ɛbɛla a, ɛnee yɛle adalɛ na yɛnli nɔhalɛ wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ nee nyɛleɛ nu.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Na saa yɛdua wienyi nu, kɛmɔ Nyamenle de wienyi nu la a, ɛnee yɛle agɔnwolɛma, na ɔ Ra Gyisɛse mogya ne mɔɔ ɔhwinle ɔguale la te yɛ nwo fi ɛtane biala anwo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Saa yɛka kɛ yɛnyɛ ɛtane a, ɛnee yɛbɛlɛbɛla yɛ nwo, yɛɛ yɛnga nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Nyamenle di ye ɛwɔkɛ zo, ɔdi pɛlepɛle. Saa yɛka yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ yɛkile ye a, ɔkɛva ɔkɛhyɛ yɛ na ɔkɛde yɛ nwo ɔkɛvi nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɛndenrɛ la amuala anwo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Saa yɛka kɛ yɛtɛyɛle ɛtane a, ɛnee yɛmaa Nyamenle ɛbɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ ye edwɛkɛ ne ɛnle yɛ nu.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ kɛlata ɛhye, amaa bɛanyɛ ɛtane, na saa bɛ nuhua bie yɛ ɛtane a, yɛlɛ kamaavolɛ wɔ Selɛ ne anwo lɔ mɔɔ kpa yɛ ti kyɛlɛ a, yemɔ a le Gyisɛse Kelaese, mɔɔ le fɔɔnwonli ko ne.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Kelaese a le sonla mɔɔ yɛlua ɔ nwo zo mɔɔ bɛva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛhyɛ yɛ a, yɛɛ tɛ yɛ ngome, na menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala boka nwolɛ.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Saa yɛdi ye mɛla ne mɔ azo a, ɛnee amgba yɛze ye.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Saa awie ka kɛ, “Meze Nyamenle” na ɔnli Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo a, ɛnee ɔle adalɛ, yɛɛ nɔhalɛ biala ɛnle ye nu.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ di Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne azo la, yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne di munli wɔ ye nu la. Adenle ɛhye azo a yɛdua yɛnwu ye kpalɛ kɛ yɛ nee Nyamenle le agɔnwolɛ a.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ kɛ awie biala mɔɔ nee Nyamenle le agɔnwolɛ la bɔ ye ɛbɛla kɛ Kelaese ɛdeɛ ne la. Mɛla fofolɛ ne

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, mengɛlɛ mɛla fofolɛ biala membɛlɛ bɛ; dɛba ko ne ala mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne bɛnyianle ye la a melɛ melɛbɛlɛ bɛ a. Mɛla dɛba ne a le nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛde ye dɛba la.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Noko akee melɛkɛlɛ mɛla fofolɛ mearɛlɛ bɛ mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ wɔ Kelaese nee bɛdabɛ noko bɛ nu a, ɔboalekɛ awozinli ne ɛlɛse, na nɔhalɛ wienyi ne ɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛlɛta.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ se ɔde wienyi ne anu, noko ɔkpɔ ɔ diema la, tɛte awozinli nu.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kulo ɔ diema la de wienyi ne anu, yɛɛ debie biala ɛnle ye nu mɔɔ kɛmaa awie kɛdu koti a.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kpɔ ɔ diema la de awozinli ne anu, na kɛmɔ ɔlua awozinli ne anu la ati, ɔnnwu ɛleka holɛ ko mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ la, ɔluakɛ awozinli ne ɛzi ɔ nye.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ ɔlua Kelaese ati, Nyamenle ɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Egya mɔ, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛze sonla ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Mgbavolɛ, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛli Abɔnsam anwo zo konim. Me mra ngakula, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛze Selɛ ne.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Egya mɔ, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛze sonla ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Mgbavolɛ, melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛlɛ anwosesebɛ, yɛɛ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne de bɛ nu, na bɛli Abɔnsam anwo zo konim.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Bɛmmakulo ewiade anzɛɛ ewiade debie biala. Awie biala mɔɔ kulo ewiade la ɛnlɛ Selɛ ne anwo ɛhulolɛ.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ ewiade ye anu debie biala mɔɔ le kɛ, nwonane nu atiakunluwɔzo, anyebolo, nee ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu adubɛnwo la ɛnvi Selɛ ne ɛkɛ ne na ɔvi ewiade ye.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Ewiade nee nuhua atiakunluwɔzo ninyɛne ne mɔ amuala bapɛ nu aze, na sonla ne mɔɔ yɛ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛdeɛ la de aze dahuu. Kelaese kpɔvolɛ ne

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, awieleɛ mekɛ ne ɛbikye! Bɛde ye dɛba kɛ Kelaese Kpɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ bayɛ ɔ nwo kɛ yemɔ a ɔle Kelaese ne la bara, na kɛkala bɔbɔ, Kelaese kpɔvolɛma dɔɔnwo ɛye bɛ nyunlu, yemɔti yɛnwu kɛ awieleɛ mekɛ ne ala ɛne.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ vi yɛ nu a hɔle a, na bɛmboka yɛ nwo. Saa bɛboka yɛ nwo a, anrɛɛ bɛ nee yɛ dɛnlanle. Bɛgyakyile yɛ bɛhɔle, amaa yeala ali wienyi kɛ bɛ biala ɛmboka yɛ nwo.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Na bɛmɛ, Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛmaa bɛ ye Sunsum ne bie, bɛdabɛ bɛze debie biala.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ bɛnze nɔhalɛ ne la ati a melɛkɛlɛ bɛ a. Melɛkɛlɛ bɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛze nɔhalɛ ne la ati ɔ, yɛɛ bɛze noko kɛ adalɛ biala vi nɔhalɛ ne anu ɛnvinde.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Nwane a le adalɛ ne a? Yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ ka kɛ tɛ Kelaese a le Mɛzaya ne la. Sonla zɔhane a le Kelaese Kpɔvolɛ ne a. Ɔluakɛ yemɔ ɔnlie Selɛ ne nee Ralɛ ne ɔndo nu.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnlie Ralɛ ne ɛndo nu la ɛnlie Selɛ ne ɛndo nu, na awie biala mɔɔ die Ralɛ ne to nu la, ɛlie Selɛ ne noko ɛdo nu.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, bɛmaa mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne bɛdele la ɛdɛnla bɛ nu. Saa bɛmaa mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne bɛdele la tɛnla bɛ nu a, bɛ nee Ralɛ ne nee Selɛ ne kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Melɛkɛlɛ bɛ ɛhye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle bɛabɛlɛbɛla bɛ la anwo.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ, Sunsum ne mɔɔ Kelaese ɛwola ɛgua bɛ nwo zo la tɛbɔ bɛ nwo, yemɔti bɛngyia kilehilevolɛ bieko, ɔluakɛ ye Sunsum ne bahilehile bɛ debie biala, yɛɛ ɔnle adalɛ, ɔka nɔhalɛ. Ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ yeva yemaa bɛ la bɛli zo na bɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ ko ɛdɛnla.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Akee me mra ngakula, bɛ nee Kelaese ɛyɛ ko ɛdɛnla, amaa saa Kenle ne dwu na ɔye ɔ nyunlu a yɛazi pi na yɛanva nyiane yɛangɔnwenwe ɛleka bie.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Bɛze kɛ Kelaese le tenlenenli, yemɔti bɛnwu ye kɛ awie biala mɔɔ yɛ debie mɔɔ tenrɛ la le ɔ ra.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea kɛ Selɛ ne ɛzi ɛhulo yɛ a! Ye ɛhulolɛ kpole ne ati, bɛfɛlɛ yɛ Nyamenle amra, yɛɛ nɔhalɛ nu, yɛle ɔ mra. Debie mɔɔ yemɔti ɛtane ewiade ye ɛnze yɛ la a le kɛ yeannwu Nyamenle.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, kɛkala yɛle Nyamenle amra, noko akee kɛ kenle bie yɛbazi yɛayɛ la ɛtɛdale ali. Noko yɛze kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Kelaese bara bieko la, yɛbayɛ kɛ ɔdaye ala la, ɔluakɛ yɛbanwu ye kɛmɔ ɔde ala la.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ lɛ anyelazo ɛhye wɔ Kelaese anu kɛ yɛbayɛ kɛ Kelaese ala la maa ɔ nwo te kɛ Kelaese la.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ɛtane la di fɔlɛ kɛ ɔto Nyamenle mɛla ne, ɔluakɛ ɛtane le mɛladonlɛ.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Bɛze kɛ Kelaese rale amaa yeaye ɛtane ne mɔ yeavi ɛkɛ. Yemɔ, ɛtane biala ɛnle ye nu.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati awie mɔɔ nee Kelaese lua la ɛnyɛ ɛtane; awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ɛtane la ɛtɛnwunle Kelaese yɛɛ ɔnze ye.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, bɛmmamaa awie bɛlɛbɛla bɛ! Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ tenrɛ la le tenlenenli, kɛmɔ Kelaese le tenlenenli la.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Na awie biala mɔɔ yɛ ɛtane la le Abɔnsam ɛdeɛ, ɔluakɛ mɔlebɛbo ne Abɔnsam a lumuale yɛle ɛtane a. Deɛ mɔɔ yemɔti Nyamenle Ara ne rale la a le kɛ ɔbazɛkye Abɔnsam gyima biala mɔɔ yeli la.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ le Nyamenle ara la ɛnyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle su ne wɔ ye nu, na kɛmɔ ɔ Ze a le Nyamenle la, ɔngola ɔnyɛ ɛtane.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle Nyamenle amra nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle Abɔnsam amra la avinli la ɛne: awie biala mɔɔ ɛmbɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ anzɛɛ ɛngulo ɔ diema la ɛnle Nyamenle ara. Bɛhulo bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ala bɛdele la a le ɛhye: ɔwɔ kɛ yɛkulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Ɔnle kɛ yɛyɛ kɛ Keen mɔɔ le Abɔnsam ara, mɔɔ hunle ɔ diema ne la. Na duzu ati a ɔhunle ye a? Ɔhunle ɔ diema ne, ɔluakɛ ɔdaye Keen ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ɛnle kpalɛ, na ɔ diema ne nyɛleɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati me mediema, saa ɛtane ewiade ye ɛngulo bɛ edwɛkɛ a bɛmmamaa ɔyɛ bɛ ɛzulolɛ.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ yɛvi ewule nu yɛra ngoane nu; yɛze ɛhye, ɔluakɛ yɛkulo yɛ mediema ne mɔ. Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɛhulolɛ la de ewule nu.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kpɔ ɔ diema la le kɔdiawu, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛze kɛ kɔdiawu biala ɛnlɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la wɔ ye nu.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Kɛ ɛhulolɛ de la ɛne: Kelaese dole ye ngoane aze manle yɛ, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛto yɛ ngoane aze yɛmaa yɛ mediema.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Saa awie mɔɔ lɛ ewiade ye anu ninyɛne la nwu ɔ diema mɔɔ ɛhyia, na ɔye ɔ nye ɔto ɛbɔ nu a, ɛnee kɛ ɔsi ɔka kɛ ɔkulo Nyamenle ɛ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, bɛmmamaa yɛfa edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ anzɛɛ yɛ nloa mgbane yɛkulo menli; ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ nɔhalɛ ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ, na eza ɔfinde yɛ nyɛleɛ nu. Nyamenle anyunlu ɛhɔlɛ

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ɛhye a kɛmaa yɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛlɛ nɔhalɛ ne wɔ yɛ nu, na yɛkɛzi pi wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: mekɛ biala mɔɔ yɛ adwenle kɛbu yɛ fɔlɛ la a, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle le kpole tɛla yɛ adwenle, yɛɛ ɔze debie biala.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, saa yɛ adwenle ɛmbu yɛ fɔlɛ a, ɛnee yɛsi pi wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ yɛkɛbiza ye la, yɛ sa ka ye, ɔluakɛ yɛdi ye mɛla ne mɔ azo na yɛyɛ mɔɔ sɔ ɔ nye la.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Ye mɛla ne a le kɛ yɛlie ɔ Ra Gyisɛse Kelaese yɛli na yɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, kɛmɔ Kelaese ɔdaye ɔzele yɛ la.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ di Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo la nee Nyamenle a lua a yɛɛ Nyamenle nee ye lua. Mɔɔ maa yɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle nee yɛ lua la a le Nyamenle Sunsum ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa yɛ la.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, bɛmmadie sunsum ne mɔ amuala bɛdi, bɛzɔ bɛ bɛnlea na bɛnwu sunsum ne mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma adalɛ dɔɔnwo ɛdwazo ewiade ye anu.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ kɛmaa bɛkɛhola bɛkɛnwu kɛ sunsum ne vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la a le ɛhye: sunsum biala mɔɔ ka to gua kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese rale kɛ sonla la le Nyamenle Sunsum,

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: yɛɛ sunsum biala mɔɔ ɛnlie Gyisɛse ɛndo nu la ɛnle Nyamenle Sunsum. Sunsum ɛhye le Kelaese Kpɔvolɛ ne sunsum ne mɔɔ bɛdele kɛ ɔbara, na kɛkala ɔwɔ ewiade ye anu dɛbadɛba la.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, bɛmɛ bɛle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, na bɛli Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma adalɛ ɛhye mɔ anwo zo konim, ɔluakɛ sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la le kpole tɛla sunsum ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛtane ewiade ye amra anu la.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma alane ɛhye mɔ le ɛtane ewiade ye ɛdeɛ, yemɔti bɛka ewiade ye edwɛkɛ, yɛɛ ɛtane ewiade ye tie bɛ.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Na yɛmɛ yɛle Nyamenle menli. Awie biala mɔɔ ze Nyamenle la tie yɛ, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛnle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ la ɛndie yɛ. Ɛhye yɛɛ maa yɛnwu nɔhalɛ sunsum ne nee adalɛ sunsum ne a. Nyamenle le ɛhulolɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, bɛmaa yɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko, ɔluakɛ ɛhulolɛ vi Nyamenle. Awie biala mɔɔ lɛ ɛhulolɛ la le Nyamenle ara na ɔze Nyamenle.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɛhulolɛ la ɛnze Nyamenle, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle le ɛhulolɛ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Kɛ Nyamenle zile hilele kɛ ɔkulo yɛ la ɛne: ɔzoanle ɔ Ra kokye ne wɔ ewiade ye anu, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo yɛanyia ngoane.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ kɛ de la ɛne: tɛ yɛmɛ a yɛhulole Nyamenle a, yemɔ a ɔhulole yɛ na ɔzoanle ɔ Ra ne kɛ ɔrayɛ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo mgbɔdalɛdeɛ, amaa ɔlua ɔ nwo zo bɛava yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bɛahyɛ yɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, saa Nyamenle ɛhulo yɛ ɛhulolɛ zɛhae a, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛkulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Awie biala ɛtɛnwunle Nyamenle ɛlɛ, na saa yɛkulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko a, ɛnee Nyamenle de yɛ nu, na ye ɛhulolɛ ne ɛli munli wɔ yɛ nu.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Saa yɛyɛ ye zɔhane a yɛkɛnwu kɛ yɛde Nyamenle anu na ɔdaye noko ɔde yɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ yeva ɔdaye mumua ne ye Sunsum ne yemaa yɛ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Yɛnwu ye yɛɛ yɛdi daselɛ kɛ Selɛ ne ɛzoa ɔ Ra ne kɛ yemɔ a ɔle ɛtane ewiade ye amra ngoanedievolɛ a.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ka to gua kɛ Gyisɛse a le Nyamenle ara ne la, Nyamenle nee ye de, yɛɛ ɔdaye noko ɔ nee Nyamenle de.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Yɛdayɛ mumua ne yɛze, yɛɛ yɛdie yɛdi kɛ Nyamenle kulo yɛ. Nyamenle le ɛhulolɛ, yemɔti awie biala mɔɔ lɛ ɛhulolɛ la nee Nyamenle de, yɛɛ Nyamenle nee ye de.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Nyamenle maa ɛhulolɛ di munli wɔ yɛ nu, amaa yɛahola gyinla wɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle ne, ɔboalekɛ kɛ Kelaese si de la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛle wɔ ewiade ye anu a.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Ɛzulolɛ ɛnle ɛhulolɛ nu; ɛhulolɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ di munli la tu ɛzulolɛ kpokpoti. Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ lɛ ɛzulolɛ la ɛhulolɛ ɛnli munli, ɔboalekɛ ɛzulolɛ nee ndeanlɛ a lua a.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Yɛkulo Nyamenle, ɔboalekɛ ɔlumuale ɔhulole yɛ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Saa awie ka kɛ, “Mekulo Nyamenle”, na ɔkpɔ ɔ diema a, ɛnee ɔle adalɛ, ɔluakɛ awie mɔɔ ɛngulo ɔ diema mɔɔ ɔ nye dua ye la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛhulo Nyamenle mɔɔ ɔtɛnwunle ye ɛlɛ la.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Mɛla ne mɔɔ Kelaese manle yɛ la kɛ se la ɛne: ɔwɔ kɛ sonla mɔɔ kulo Nyamenle la kulo ɔ diema noko.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ die di kɛ Gyisɛse a le Mɛzaya ne la le Nyamenle ara, yɛɛ mɔɔ kulo wovolɛ ne la kulo ɔ ra ne noko.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Saa yɛkulo Nyamenle na yɛdi ye mɛla zo a ɛnee yɛhile kɛ yɛkulo Nyamenle amra ne mɔ noko.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ saa yɛdi Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo a ɛnee yɛkulo Nyamenle, yɛɛ ye mɛla ne mɔ noko ɛnyɛ ɛnlomboɛ mɔɔ bu sonla kɔme a,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ara biala di ewiade anwo zo konim. Yɛ diedi mɔɔ yɛlɛ ye wɔ Nyamenle anu la azo yɛɛ yɛdua yɛdi ewiade anwo zo konim a.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Nwane a di ewiade ye anwo zo konim a? Yemɔ a le sonla ne mɔɔ die di kɛ Gyisɛse le Nyamenle Ara la. Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo daselɛlilɛ

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse Kelaese a le mɔɔ luale ye ɛzɔnenlɛ nzule nee ye ewule mogya zo rale la. Tɛ nzule ngome a ɔluale zo a, ɔluale nzule nee mogya zo. Nyamenle Sunsum ne di daselɛ kɛ ɔle zɔhane, ɔboalekɛ Sunsum ne a le nɔhalɛ ne.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Alasevolɛ nsa a wɔ ɛkɛ a:

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: bɛmɛ a le Nyamenle Sunsum ne, nzule ne, nee mogya ne. Bɛmɛ nsa bɛdi daselɛ na bɛkile debie ko ne ala.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Saa yɛdie sonla daselɛ yɛto nu a, ɛnee Nyamenle daselɛlilɛ ɛdeɛ ne anu yɛ se kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle daselɛlilɛ ne fane ɔ Ra ne anwo.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati awie biala mɔɔ die Nyamenle Ara ne di la lɛ daselɛlilɛ ne wɔ ye nu. Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnlie Nyamenle ɛnli la ɛmaa Nyamenle ɛbɔ adalɛ, ɔluakɛ yeanlie daselɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛli ye wɔ ɔ Ra ne anwo la yeanli.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Daselɛlilɛ ne a le ɛhye: Nyamenle ɛlua ɔ Ra ne anwo zo ɛmaa yɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie Ralɛ ne la lɛ ngoane, na awie biala mɔɔ anlie Nyamenle Ara ne la ɛnlɛ ngoane. Ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Melɛkɛlɛ ɛhye mearɛlɛ bɛ amaa bɛanwu kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie Nyamenle Ara ne bɛdi la bɛlɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Yɛsi pi wɔ Nyamenle anu, yɛɛ yɛdie yɛdi kɛ saa yɛdua ye ɛhulolɛ zo yɛbiza ye debie biala a ɔtie yɛ.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ yɛze kɛ yɛbiza ye debie a ɔtie yɛ la ati, eza yɛze kɛ yɛ sa ka mɔɔ yɛbiza yɛfi ye ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Saa awie nwu adiema bie kɛ ɔlɛyɛ ɛtane mɔɔ ɛndwe ye ɛngɔ ewule nu la a, ɔzɛlɛ ɔmaa ye na Nyamenle kɛmaa adiema ne ngoane. Noko ɛtane ne bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ wie ewule a. Menga ye kɛ awie ɛzɛlɛ ɛhye anwo.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ tɔ sinli la le ɛtane, na tɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala a wie ewule a.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ awie biala mɔɔ le Nyamenle ara la ɛnyɛ ɛtane, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle Ara ne fa ye sie gyɛlɛɛnye mɔɔ Abɔnsam ɛngola ɛnva ɔ sa ɛnga ye a.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Saa bɔbɔ Abɔnsam di ɛtane ewiade ye azo belemgbunli a, yɛze kɛ yɛmɛ yɛle Nyamenle menli.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Yɛze kɛ Nyamenle Ara ne ɛra na yeramaa yɛ ndelebɛbo mɔɔ yɛfa yɛnwu nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne a. Yɛ nee nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne nee ɔ Ra Gyisɛse Kelaese a lua a. Ɛhye a le nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ne a. Ɛhye a le ngoane ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Me mra ngakula, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nwo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame Nrenya Kpanyinli ne ɛkɛ. Melɛ mekamaa Raalɛkpa ne nee ɔ mra ne mɔ. Mekulo bɛ nɔhalɛ nu kpole kpalɛ. Tɛ me ngome a mekulo bɛ a, awie biala mɔɔ ze nɔhalɛ ne la kulo bɛ,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: ɔluakɛ nɔhalɛ ne de yɛ nu na ɔ nee yɛ badɛnla dahuu.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Nyamenle Selɛ ne nee Gyisɛse Kelaese, Selɛ ne Ara ne, ɛlo yɛ, ɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne, na ɔmaa yɛ nzo nu ɛdwo yɛ dahuu wɔ nɔhalɛ nee ɛhulolɛ nu. Nɔhalɛ nee ɛhulolɛ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle me fɛ kpole kɛ menwunle kɛ ɛ mra ne mɔ bie mɔ li nɔhalɛ ne anzi, kɛmɔ Nyamenle Selɛ ne zele yɛ la.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Yemɔti, Raalɛkpa, mesɛlɛ wɔ, mɔɔ meka meahile wɔ la a le kɛ bɛmaa yɛ muala yɛhulo yɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. Mengɛlɛ mɛla fofolɛ membɛlɛ bɛ, kɛ mɛla dɛba ne mɔɔ mɔlebɛbo ne yɛ sa hanle ye la ala.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Ɛhulolɛ ɛhye a le kɛ yɛkɛli Nyamenle mɛla ne mɔ azo. Mɛla ne, kɛmɔ mɔlebɛbo ne bɛ muala bɛdele la, yemɔ a le kɛ bɛkɛdɛnla ɛhulolɛ nu.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Adalɛma dɔɔnwo ɛdwazo ewiade ɛleka muala. Bɛmɛ a le menli ne mɔɔ ɛnlie ɛndo nu kɛ Gyisɛse Kelaese rale kɛ sonla ala la. Sonla zɛhae le mɛlɛbɛla na ɔle Kelaese Kpɔvolɛ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea bɛ nwo boɛ na bɛamminli mɔɔ bɛvɛ nwolɛ bɛnyia ye la, amaa bɛanyia bɛ ahatualɛ ne amuala.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ ɛnli Kelaese ngilehilelɛ ne azo, na ɔbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔkulo la ɛnze Nyamenle. Awie biala mɔɔ di Kelaese ngilehilelɛ zo la ɛnwu Selɛ ne nee Ralɛ ne.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Saa awie ba bɛ ɛkɛ ne na ɔngilehile mɔɔ Kelaese hilehilele la a, bɛmmadie ye bɛkɔ bɛ azua nu; bɛmmayɛ ye akoaba bɔbɔ.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛlie ye la nee ye yɛ adwenle wɔ ye ninyɛndane ne mɔ ɛyɛlɛ nu. Edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka mekile bɛ, noko akee menrɛhulo kɛ menwɔva kɛlata nee ɛnke menwɔhɛlɛ; me nye la kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ na meara bɛ nwo lɔ na yɛava edwɛkɛ ne mɔ yɛali adwelie, na yɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ne ali munli.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Bɛ kulovolɛ adiema raalɛ ne amra ne mɔ biza bɛ ahye.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Kɛlata ɛhye vi medame “Nrenya Kpanyinli ne” ɛkɛ. Melɛkɛlɛ meahɔmaa me gɔnwo Gayɛse mɔɔ mekulo ye nɔhalɛ nu la.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Ayi, mesɛlɛ kɛ debie biala ɛhɔ zolɛ kpalɛ ɛmaa wɔ na ɛde kpɔkɛ kpalɛ; meze kɛ ɛte kpɔkɛ wɔ sunsum nu.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Me nye liele kpole wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mediema ne bie mɔ rale ralile wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne anwo daselɛ kɛ amgba ɛli nɔhalɛ ne anzi la. Kɛkala, ɛtɛdi nɔhalɛ ne anzi.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Debie biala ɛnyɛ me anyelielɛ ɛndɛla kɛ menwɔde kɛ me mra ne mɔ lua nɔhalɛ adenle ne anu a. Gayɛse ɛhanvolɛ

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Ayi, nɔhalɛ gyima ne ala a ɛlɛdi wɔamaa mediema ne mɔ la, bɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle nyɛvolɛ la.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Bɛhanvo ɛhulolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye la bɛhile asɔnema mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la. Mebodo wɔ, bɔ mɔdenle nea na gua bɛ adenle gyɛlɛɛnye, kɛmɔ ɛnea a ɔkɛzɔ Nyamenle anye la.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ sumunli kɛ bɛbɔle bɛ adendulɛ ne abo kɛ bɛbɔ Kelaese edwɛkɛ ne nolo la, bɛtɛdiele moalɛ biala bɛtɛfile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛle Kelaese ɛdoavolɛma la yɛboa menli ɛhye mɔ, amaa yɛ nee bɛ ali nɔhalɛ ne anwo gyima ne mɔɔ bɛlɛdi la. Dayɛtelɛfizi nee Dimiteleɛse

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Mehɛlɛ asɔnema kɛlata ezinraa bie, na Dayɛtelɛfizi mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ ɔdi bɛ kpanyinli la ɛmbu me bie.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, saa meba a menwɔye ye gyima mɔɔ yeli, yɛ nwo nzekue mɔɔ ɔbɔ nee adalɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔ ye yɛ nwo la menwɔdo gua. Yeanga ye zɔhane, saa mediema ne mɔ ba a, yemɔ a, ɔnrɛlie bɛ yɛɛ akee noko ɔndie bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛkɛlie bɛ la, na ɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔye zɛhae menli ne mɔ ali yeavi asɔne ne anu.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Ayi, mmasukoa ɛyɛ mɔɔ le ɛtane la, sukoa yɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Awie biala mɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ, yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ di ɛtane la ɛtɛnwunle Nyamenle.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Awie biala ka Dimiteleɛse anwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ; nɔhalɛ ne ɔdaye ɔka ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kpalɛ, na medame noko medi ɔ nwo daselɛ, yɛɛ ɛze noko kɛ mɔɔ meka la le nɔhalɛ. Edwɛkɛ ne awieleɛ
