english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Melɛ edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo meka mekile wɔ, noko akee menrɛhulo kɛ menwɔva kɛlata nee ɛnke menwɔhɛlɛ.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Me nye la kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara ɛ nwo lɔ na yɛava edwɛkɛ ne mɔ yɛali adwelie.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Anzonudwolɛ ɛha wɔ. Agɔnwolɛma amuala biza wɔ ahye; yɛbiza yɛ gɔnwo mɔ amuala noko ahye.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Medame Dwuudu, mɔɔ mele Gyisɛse Kelaese sonvolɛ nee Gyemise adiema la yɛɛ melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye a. Melɛ mekamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛvɛlɛ bɛ, na bɛde Egya Nyamenle ne ɛhulolɛ nu na Gyisɛse Kelaese wowa bɛ la amuala.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Nyamenle ɛnwu bɛ anwunvɔne, ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ, na ɔva ɛhulolɛ ɔyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ. Kilehilevolɛma alane

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, menzuzule kɛ mekɛlɛ bɛ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne mɔɔ yɛnyia ye la anwo, na menwu kɛ ɔhyia kɛ mekɛlɛ bɛ na mesi bɛ ahonle kɛ bɛho bɛmaa diedi ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa ye menli ne bɔkɔɔ la.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ menli bie mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle na bɛyɛ bɛ nzonlɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ dɛba kɛ bɛbazɛkye bɛ la ɛpe adenle bie azo ɛravea yɛ avinli. Menli ɛhye mɔ kakyi yɛ ɛlolɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛlo yɛ mgbane la adwɔmanebɔlɛ, yɛɛ eza bɛkpo Gyisɛse Kelaese mɔɔ le yɛ Menle nee yɛ Awulae kokye la.

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Bɛze ɛhye bɔkɔɔ, noko eza mekulo kɛ mekakye bɛ kɛ Awulae mɔɔ liele Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo la eza nzinlii zɛkyele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanlie bɛanli la.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛangola bɛanzie bɛ ti ɛleka ko, na bɛkpole bɛ gyinlabelɛ kpalɛ ne la, Nyamenle ɛgua bɛ nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ mɔɔ bɛnzianyi bɛ ɛlɛ la wɔ awozinli kabikabi ne anu lɔ kɛ bɛhendɛ Ndɛnebualɛ Kenle kpole ne.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Bɛhakye Sodɔm nee Gomɔla, nee azua mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la, menli mɔɔ wɔ azua ɛhye mɔ azo la bɔle adwɔmane nee munzule ɛbɛla, na ɔlua zolɛ kɛkala bɛdea bɛ wɔ senle ne mɔɔ ɛnnu ɛlɛ la anu, amaa yeayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ yeamaa menli kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ala yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ de a. Bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ bɛnwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ na bɛdua zo bɛsɛkye bɛ nwonane ne, bɛkpo Nyamenle tumi ne na bɛtendɛ bɛtia anyunlunyiama mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ kpanyinli Maekeɛle bɔbɔ anyɛ ɛhye. Mekɛ mɔɔ kpolera dɔle ye nee Abɔnsam avinli wɔ Mosisi funli nwo la, Maekeɛle anga ɛtane angile Abɔnsam. Mɔɔ ɔzele ye la a le kɛ, “Awulae badua wɔ kakɛ.”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ ka debie biala mɔɔ bɛnde ɔ bo la anwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ nane adwenle ne maa bɛte ɔ bo la bɛmɛ a le ninyɛne mɔɔ sɛkye bɛ la.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Abule ɛbu bɛ! Bɛva Keen agyakɛ. Bɛdoa ezukoa fɛlɛko bɛvo kɛ Beelam la. Bɛde atua kɛ Kɔla dele la, na bɛminli bɛ bo zo.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ andɔma anzɛɛ atasonlɛ wɔ mediema ɛhulolɛ ɛkponledolɛ bo; bɛno nza bɛbo, bɛbɔ bɛ nwo anyiemgba. Bɛdwenle bɛ ngome bɛ nwo ala. Bɛle kɛ amungu mɔɔ nzule ɛnle nu la ati, anwoma maa ɔdi akɔneaba. Bɛle kɛ bokile mgbenleɛ mbaka mɔɔ anzo ma la. Bɛtudu bɛ bɛ bo nee bɛ ndinli ne mɔ amuala na bɛwu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: Bɛle kɛ nyevile mɔɔ ɛzɛkye la azɛlɛkye, bɛ awubue da bɛ anyiemgba nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ali. Bɛle kɛ nwɔlɔra mɔɔ nwɔnla la. Nyamenle ɛva awozinli kabikabi ne mɔɔ ɛnde ɛlɛ la ɛzie ɛkɛ ɛmaa bɛ.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Yinɔko mɔɔ le Adam angabɛnzo mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la hanle bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ dɛba kɛ, “Awulae nee ye soanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza apenle apenle bara

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: arabua awie biala ndɛne, na yeadea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnze Nyamenle la wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye atisesebɛ nu nee amumuyɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la ɛha ɛtia ye la anwo.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ tendɛ bɛ nzo abo dahuu, bɛ kunlu ɛndwo bɛ nwo ɛlɛ; bɛdi bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ɛtane ne mɔ anzi, bɛtu bɛ nloa anu na bɛbɛlɛbɛla menli wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ boɛyɛlɛ ti. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nee ngilehilelɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Na me mediema, bɛhakye mɔɔ yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese ɛzoanvolɛma ne hanle hilele bɛ la.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Saa awieleɛ mekɛ ne ba a, menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle na bɛdi bɛ ngome bɛ atiakunluwɔzo nzi la bara, na bɛarazi bɛ amgbu.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Menli ɛhye mɔ le ewiade ye anu amra mɔɔ fa mgbakyemgbakye ba a, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ Nyamenle Sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Ayi mɔ, bɛhɔ zolɛ bɛnyi na bɛgyinla kpundii wɔ bɛ diedi nwuanzanwuanza ne anu. Bɛzɛlɛ wɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne tumi ne anu,

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: bɛzie bɛ nwo wɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ ne anu bɛhendɛ ngoane ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, mɔɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ nu ala Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese bava amaa bɛ la.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Menli bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛ adwenle ɛnzi pi a; bɛboa bɛ.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Bɛhwe bie mɔ bɛvi sendɔlɔra ne anu, bɛlie bɛ ngoane. Bɛva ɛzulolɛ bɛze bie mɔ anwunvɔne, na bɛhyi bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛ ɛtane atiakunluwɔzo ɛheha nu la. Ayɛlɛyelɛ nzɛlɛlɛ

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kokye ne mɔɔ le yɛ Ngoanedievolɛ ne, yemɔ yɛɛ anyunlunyia, belemgbunlililɛ, kpoleyɛlɛ, nee tumi ɛlua yɛ Awulae Gyisɛse Kelaese anwo zo ɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ wɔ ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ la a! Amen.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Buluku ɛhye ka ninyɛne mɔɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese yele hilele la anwo edwɛkɛ. Nyamenle manle ɔyele ɔhilele amaa yeaye mɔɔ ɛnrɛhyɛ biala na yeazi la yeahile ye sonvolɛma. Kelaese manle ye soanvolɛ rayele ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ hilele ye sonvolɛ Dwɔn.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Dwɔn ɛha mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye la amuala. Ɔhanle nɔhalɛ ne, kɛmɔ Gyisɛse Kelaese yele hilele ye la nee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔdele ɔvile Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne la amuala.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛkpogya ɔ ne zo kɛgenga Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kɛhile awie mɔ la, yɛɛ nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛkɛdie na bɛkɛva mɔɔ wɔ nu la bɛkɛzie na bɛkɛli zolɛ la! Ɔluakɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ basisi la ɛbikye. Asɔne nsuu ne mɔ ahyebizalɛ

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Medame Dwɔn a melɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ɛhye meahɔmaa asɔne nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Ehyea maanzinli nu la a: Tete Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛkala, na ɔbara la ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Sunsum nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle Belemgbunli Ebia Kpole ne anyunlu la ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Akee Gyisɛse Kelaese, nɔhalɛ dasevolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Ralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlumua bɛdwazo ye bɛvi ewule nu na ɔsie azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti la ɛlo bɛ na ɔmaa bɛ anzonudwolɛ. Gyisɛse Kelaese kulo yɛ, yeva ye mogya yelie yɛ yevi yɛ ɛtane nu,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: na yeyɛ yɛ arelemgbunli nee sɛlɛvolɛma kɛ yɛzonle ye Nyamenle Selɛ ne. Anyunlunyia nee tumi ɛyɛ ye ɛdeɛ dahuu! Amen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛnlea, ɔlua amungu ne mɔ anu ɔlɛba! Awie biala banwu ye, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔle ɔ nvenle foa atwɛ la banwu ye. Ɔdaye ɔ ti, menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la bazu aye awolɛ. Nɔhalɛ, ɔle zɔhane. Amen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Kɛ tete Awulae Nyamenle Bedevinli ne mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛkala, na ɔbara la se la ɛne, “Medame a mele ‘Alefa’ ne nee ‘Omiga’ ne a.” Kelaese ɛnwunlɛ

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Mame a mele bɛ diema Dwɔn. Kelaese ati yɛ muala yɛle ko na yɛlɛ abotane yɛlɛnwu amaneɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ yɛ nwo fɛta ye Belemgbunlililɛ ne a. Bɛvale me bɛradole bɔra ye mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Patemɔso la azo, ɔluakɛ membɔle Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nee nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse yele hilele la nolo.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Awulae kenle ne, Sunsum ne rale me nwo zo, na mendele ɛnelɛ kpole bie mɔɔ le kɛ aweɛne tendenle la kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ me nzi nehane.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Ɔse, “Kɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛnwu ye la wɔ buluku nu na fa buluku ne kɔmaa asɔne nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ azuamgbole ɛhye mɔ azo la: Ɛfɛsɛse, Semɛna, Pɛgamɛm, Tayataela, Saadese, Feladɛlefea, yɛɛ Lawɔdesia.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Mengakyile me nwo kɛ menea ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛtendɛ ahile me la, na menwunle ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nsuu.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Debie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la gyi bɛ avinli, ɔwula tɛladeɛ tendenle mɔɔ dwu ye aze na yeva ezukoa nvutuke akyeso yehye ye avinli.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Ɔ ti enrinli le fufule nwohyee kɛ boane ndɛkɛ, nwohyee kɛ ezukɔtweaba, yɛɛ ɔ nye ma sɔ kɛ senle;

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: ɔ gyakɛ anwo ta kɛ ayera mɔɔ bɛdu nu na bɛhwi nwolɛ la, na ɔ ne dielie kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ zo la.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛ nwɔlɔra nsuu ɔ sa fema ne anu, yɛɛ dadeɛ anye nwiɔ mɔɔ yɛ nla kɛ wowole la zia ɔ nloa anu. Ɔ nyunlu maanle ne ta kɛ ewia henlema sɛnzɛne.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Menwunle ye la, mempɛle menfinle ɔ gyakɛ anu kɛ asɛɛ mewu la. Na ɔvale ɔ sa fema ne ɔdole me nwo zo na ɔzele me kɛ, “Mmasulo! Mame a mele alumua ne nee awieleɛ ne a.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Mame a mele teasenli ne a. Menwule, na kɛkala mede aze dahuu. Melɛ Ewule nee Ɛbolɔ sanvɛ ne.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔnwu bɛ la, ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne kɛkala nee mɔɔ li ɛhye mɔ anzi bara la amuala.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Nwɔlɔra nsuu ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnwu bɛ me sa fema ye anu, nee ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nsuu ne abo a le ɛhye: nwɔlɔra nsuu ne a le asɔne nsuu ne Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔ yɛɛ kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nsuu ne mɔ a le asɔne nsuu ne.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Ɛfɛsɛse asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi mɔɔ lɛ nwɔlɔra nsuu ne mɔ ɔ sa fema ne anu na ɔluolua ezukoa nvutuke kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nsuu ne mɔ avinli la ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Menwu wɔ gyima ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔli la; meze wɔ ɛvɛlɛ nee wɔ abotane ne amuala. Meze kɛ ɛmkpondɛ amumuyɛma anyunlu ɛnnea yɛɛ wɔzɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse bɛle ɛzoanvolɛma la wɔnlea na wɔnwu kɛ bɛnle ɛzoanvolɛma, na bɛle alane.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ ɛlɛ abotane ɛlɛkomo ɛ nwo zo, ɛlɛsɔ amaneɛ sa wɔ me duma ne ati, yɛɛ ɔtɛyɛle wɔ ɛvɛlɛ.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Noko akee metia wɔ wɔ ɛhye anwo: ɛnɛ ɛnlɛ me nwo ɛhulolɛ kɛ alumua ne la.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ nea na nwu wɔ aze mɔɔ wɔdɔ la. Nu ɛ nwo na twe ɛ nwo fi wɔ ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la anwo, na yɛ mɔɔ alumua ne ɛyɛle la. Saa wɔannu ɛ nwo, wɔangyakyi ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ a mebara mearaye wɔ kɛnlaneɛ baka ne meavi ɔ bo zo ne.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Noko ɛlɛ ɛhye gyi ɛ nzi: ɛngulo mɔɔ Nekɔlɔsoma yɛ la. Medame noko mengulo mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la. Mɔɔ kɛli konim la mebamaa ye adenle meamaa yeali ngoane baka ne mɔɔ gyi Nyamenle tola ne anu la ma ne bie. Semɛna nrɛlaleɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Semɛna asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi alumua ne nee awieleɛ ne, mɔɔ wule na ɔziale ɔrale ngoane nu bieko la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Meze wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ kpokpoti. Meze wɔ ɛhyianlɛ, noko ɛlɛ anwonyia! Meze munzule edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse bɛle Dwuuma noko bɛnle Dwuuma la ɛlɛkeha atia wɔ la. Menli zɔhane mɔ le Seetan eku nu menli.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Mmasulo debie biala mɔɔ bɛbayɛ wɔ la. Tie, Abɔnsam ne bamaa bɛagua bɛ bie mɔ efiade, bɛazɔ bɛ bɛanlea, na bɛanwu amaneɛ dedee kenle bulu. Noko di nɔhalɛ maa me, bɔbɔ kɔdwu ewule nu, na mebabɔ wɔ ngoane abɔtile.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la. Mɔɔ kɛli konim la, ewule ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la bakpa ɔ ti. Pɛgamɛm nrɛlaleɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Pɛgamɛm asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi mɔɔ lɛ dadeɛ anye nwiɔ ne mɔɔ yɛ nla la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Meze kɛ ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la, ɛkɛ ne a Seetan ebia ne gyi a. Noko ɛlɛ me duma ne anu ɛsesebɛ na ɛdi nɔhalɛ ɛmaa me, yɛɛ wɔ diedi amkpo aze, bɔbɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhunle me nɔhalɛ dasevolɛ Antɛpase wɔ Seetan ebia ne abo la.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Noko melɛ edwɛkɛ ekyi bie metia wɔ. Ɛlɛ menli bie mɔɔ li Beelam ngilehilelɛ ne anzi a. Beelam hilehilele belemgbunli Beelake manle ɔdole Yizilayɛma agyiba, ɔmanle bɛlile aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la na bɛbɔle adwɔmane ɛbɛla.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Eza ɛlɛ menli bie mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛli Nekɔlɔsoma ngilehilelɛ ne anzi a.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Yemɔti nu ɛ nwo! Saa wɔannu ɛ nwo a ɔnrɛhyɛ biala, mebara ɛ nwo lɔ, na meava dadeɛ ne mɔɔ zia me nloa anu la me nee menli zɔhane mɔ araho.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la. “Mɔɔ kɛli konim la mebamaa ye mana ne mɔɔ vea la bie. Mebamaa ko biala noko bolɛ fufule mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ duma fofolɛ zolɛ la. Awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛnwu duma ne kyesɛ ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa ye la angomekye. Tayataela nrɛlaleɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Tayataela asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnyelɛ mɔɔ sɔ kɛ senle, na ɔ gyakɛ anwo ta kɛ ayera mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ la ɛkɛ ne.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Meze wɔ gyima. Meze wɔ ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye, wɔ nɔhalɛ mɔɔ ɛdi, wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ mɔɔ ɛsonle, nee wɔ abotane mɔɔ ɛlɛ la amuala. Meze kɛ kɛkala ɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle wɔadɛla alumua ne.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Noko melɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye metia wɔ: ɛdie raalɛ Gyɛzɛbɛle mɔɔ ɛyɛ ɔ nwo Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ la ɛto nu. Yeva ye ngilehilelɛ ne yezi me menli ne mɔ anye yemaa bɛlɛbɔ adwɔmane ɛbɛla na bɛdi aleɛ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɔ amonle la.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Memanle ye mekɛ kɛ ɔva ɔnlu ɔ nwo, noko ɔngulo kɛ ɔkɛgyakyi ye adwɔmane ɛbɛla ne.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati mebamaa anwonyane abɔ ye na meamaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye donle awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne la anwu amaneɛ, kyesɛ bɛnu bɛ nwo wɔ amumuyɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ nee ye yɛle la anwo.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Eza menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la, mebahu bɛ muala na asɔnema ne amuala anwu kɛ medame a menwu sonla biala ati anu nee ye ahonle nu a. Me nee bɛ nuhua ko biala bali wɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: “Bɛdabɛ noko mɔɔ bɛha, mɔɔ bɛwɔ Tayataela, mɔɔ bɛanli ngilehilelɛ ɛtane zɛhae anzi, bɛanzukoa mɔɔ ɔyɛ a bie mɔ fɛlɛ ye ‘Seetan ngonyia’ la, bɛmɛ yɛɛ meka meahile bɛ kɛ, menrɛva ɛzonle kpole biala menrɛzoa bɛ.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ meka meahile bɛ ala la a le kɛ bɛzɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye la anu kpalɛ kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔra la.

english_verse: I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛli konim, na ɔkɛyɛ mɔɔ mekpondɛ la nɔhalɛ nu kɛhɔ awieleɛ la, mebava tumi ne mɔɔ Egya vale manle me la meamaa ye. Mebamaa yeali maanle maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo konim, yeava tumi yeazie bɛ, na yeabubu bɛ kɛ abua. Eza mebava nwonlomɔ ɛwɔlɔra ne meamaa ye.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ, ɛhye kɔmaa Saadese asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi mɔɔ lɛ Nyamenle Sunsum nsuu ne nee nwɔlɔra nsuu ne la ɛkɛ ne. Meze mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la amuala; meze kɛ wɔlie duma kɛ ɛ nye gyi zo, noko wɔwu.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Tunwue, na miemia mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye la anu kolaa na ɔkɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ a yeazɛkye. Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ wɔyɛ la amuala, menwu kɛ ɔnli munli nretee zɛhae wɔ me Nyamenle ne anye zo.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, kakye mɔɔ bɛhilehile wɔ nee mɔɔ ɛdele la, di zolɛ, na nu ɛ nwo. Saa wɔanyɛ ɛ nye gyɛlɛmgbɛɛnye a, mebara ɛ nwo zo kɛ awule, na ɛnrɛnwu mekɛ ko ne mɔɔ mebava meara la.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Noko menli ekyi bie wɔ Saadese ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛli bɛ nwo eni a. Bɛtɛyɛle bɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ evinli. Bɛbayɛ fufule, na bɛ nee me alua, ɔluakɛ bɛfɛta.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ kɛli konim la bɛbayɛ ye fufule nwohyee, na menrɛye ye duma menrɛvi teasema buluku ne anu. Mebaha ye wienyi wɔ Egya nee Nyamenle soanvolɛma anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ bɛle me ɛdeɛ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la. Feladɛlefea nrɛlaleɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Feladɛlefea asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi Nwuanzanwuanzanli ne mɔɔ le nɔhalɛnli ne ɛkɛ. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔlɛ Belemgbunli Devidi sanvɛ ne a. Ɔto nu a, awie ɛmbuke, yɛɛ ɔbuke a, awie ɛndo nu.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Meze mɔɔ ɛyɛ la; meze kɛ wɔ tumi le ekyi bie, noko wɔli me ngilehilelɛ zo na wɔli nɔhalɛ wɔmaa me.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Tie, menli ekpunli ekyi ne mɔɔ le Seetan ɛdeɛ, alanema ne mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛle Dwuuma noko bɛnle Dwuuma la, mebamaa bɛarabu ndwɛlɛ wɔ ɛ nyunlu, na bɛ muala bɛanwu kɛ mekulo wɔ.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Kɛmɔ wɔli me edwɛkɛ zo, wɔnyia abotane la, ngyegyelɛ kpole ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba ewiade arazɔ menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo anlea la, mebaye wɔ meavi nu.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Ɔnrɛhyɛ na meara. Mɔɔ ɛlɛ la sɔ nu boɛ, amaa awie amkpodi wɔ konim ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne anvi ɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Sonla mɔɔ kɛli konim la, mebayɛ ye me Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nu sika, na yeadɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu. Mebahɛlɛ me Nyamenle ne duma nee me Nyamenle ne suakpole ne, mɔɔ le Gyɛlusalɛm fofolɛ ne, mɔɔ vi me Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ ne wɔ anwuma bara la duma wɔ ɔ nwo. Eza mebahɛlɛ me duma fofolɛ ne ɔ nwo.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la. Lawɔdesia nrɛlaleɛ ɛdeɛ ne

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kɛlɛ ɛhye kɔmaa Lawɔdesia asɔne ne Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne. “Nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye vi Amen, nɔhalɛnli ne mɔɔ yɛkola yɛfa yɛ rɛle yɛto ɔ nwo zo, nɔhalɛ dasevolɛ ne, mɔɔ le ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛbɔ la amuala abobɔlɛ la ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: Meze mɔɔ wɔyɛ la; meze kɛ wɔmɔ, ɛnle yɔlɔkɔkɔ yɛɛ ɛnle wuluwulu. Me kunlu a anrɛɛ ɛnee ɛle wuluwulu anzɛɛ yɔlɔkɔkɔ.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Na kɛmɔ ɛle adodɔlera, na ɛnle wuluwulu anzɛɛ yɔlɔkɔkɔ la, mebakpulu wɔ meagua.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Wɔmɔ ɛse, ‘Mede boɛ, menyia me nwo. Mengyia ɛhwee.’ Ɛnze kɛ ɛyɛ anwunvɔne na ɛ nwo yɛ alɔbɔlɛ. Ɛnlɛ bie, ɛlɛ ɛ nwo zɔ, yɛɛ ɛ nye ɛzi.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati metu wɔ folɛ kɛ badɔ ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛva senle bɛdu nuhua la fi me ɛkɛ, amaa wɔanyia ɛ nwo. Badɔ adɛladeɛ fufule wula keda wɔ amumuyɛ nee wɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ ɛla ali la azo. Badɔ ayile gua ɛ nye zo, amaa wɔanwu debie.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mekulo bɛ la, metwi bɛ nyunlu na metea bɛ. Zɔhane ati bɔ mɔdenle nu ɛ nwo na yɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Tie, megyi anlenkɛ ne anzi melɛbɔ nu; mɔɔ kɛde me ne na ɔkɛdukue me la, mebara ye ɛkɛ na me nee ye arado ɛsalɛ, na ɔdaye noko ɔ nee me ado ɛsalɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛli konim la, mebamaa ye adenle meamaa yearadɛnla me nwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ me belemgbunli ebia ne azo, kɛmɔ meli konim na mede Egya anwo ɛkɛ ne wɔ ye belemgbunli ebia ne azo la.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: “Sonla ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnzonlɛ la ɛdie mɔɔ Sunsum ne ka kile asɔnema amuala la.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi, mendole me nye, na menwunle kɛ bɛbuke anlenkɛ bie wɔ anwuma lɔ. Na ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ dielie kɛ aweɛne tendenle, mɔɔ lumuale dendɛle hilele me la zele me kɛ, “Fo bɛla anwuma ɛke maa mengile wɔ mɔɔ bazi ɛhye anzi la.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Ɛkɛ ne ala Sunsum ne wolole me na menwunle kɛ awie de belemgbunli ebia kpole zo wɔ anwuma lɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Ahenle ne mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la anyunlu ta kɛ ezukoa awolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ “gyasepa” nee “kanɛlea” la, na nyangondonle kɛnlɛma mɔɔ zɔho ezukoa bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “ɛmelade” la ɛdo ɛbɛnra ɛyia belemgbunli ebia kpole ne.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Mgbanyima abulanwiɔ nee nna noko mɔɔ ɛyɛ fufule na bɛbobɔ ezukoa abɔtile la dede arelemgbunli mbia abulanwiɔ nee nna zo ɛbɔ belemgbunli ebia kpole ɛhye ɛyia.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ɛsɛlɛmanye kpakye fi belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anwo finde, yɛɛ ɛnelɛ mgbole mɔɔ kulu kɛ bokile ezule la vi ebia kpole ne anwo finde. Tɛkɛ nsuu sɔ belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anwo, na bɛmɛ a le Nyamenle Sunsum nsuu ne.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Belemgbunli ebia kpole ɛhye anyunlu ɛkɛ ne, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ nyevile anye kɔngyekɔngye kɛ neanleɛ la la ɛkɛ ne faanwo. Tease abɔdeɛ nna mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ duodua bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ nzi la gyigyi belemgbunli ebia ne anwo wɔ ye tɛbanu nee ye tɛbanu ne amuala.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la le kɛ awenade. Mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la le kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli; mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la anyunlu zɔho sonla nyunlu, yɛɛ mɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le kɛ kɔleɛ mɔɔ ɛdu faa la.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ nna ɛhye mɔ ko biala lɛ ndɛbalɛ nsia mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ duodua bɛ kunlu nee bɛ nzi amuala a. Na alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ muala bɛ ne la nu bɛto edwɛne bɛse kɛ, “Nwuanzaanwu, nwuanzaanwu, Awulae Nyamenle Tumivolɛ ne le nwuanzanwuanza. Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔvi tete, ɔwɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ kɛkala, na ɔbara a.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Saa tease abɔdeɛ nna ɛhye mɔ to bɛ anyunlunyia, enililɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne ne maa mɔɔ de aze dahuu na ɔde belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la a,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Yɛ Awulae nee yɛ Nyamenle! Ɛfɛta anyunlunyia, enililɛ, nee tumi. Ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti a. Wɔ ɛhulolɛ zo yɛɛ ɛbɔle bɛ a. Wɔ ɛhulolɛ zo yɛɛ bɛwɔ ɛkɛ a.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ ahenle mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la lɛ nwoma ɔ sa fema ne anu; nwoma ne, bɛhɛlɛ ɔ kunlu nee ɔ nzi amuala na bɛva ɛyɛlɛ bɛzɔ ɔ nloa fane nsuu.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Na menwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ la ko, na ɔhanle ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Nwane a fɛta na ɔkɛhola ɔkɛwaye ɛyɛlɛ ne na ɔkɛbuke nwoma ne anu a?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Na awie ɛnle anwuma lɔ anzɛɛ azɛlɛ ye azo anzɛɛ ɛbolɔ mɔɔ holale bukele nwoma ne na ɔnleanle nu a.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Na menzunle kpalɛ kɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ fɛta na ɔkola ɔbuke nwoma ne na ɔnea nu a.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Na mgbanyima ne mɔ ko zele me kɛ, “Mmasu. Nea! Dwuda abusua nu awenade ne, mɔɔ le Belemgbunli Devidi ati anwo anlɔnra kpole ne, ɛli konim, na ɔkola ɔwaye ɛyɛlɛ nsuu ne mɔ na ɔbuke nwoma ne anu.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ Boaneralɛ ne gyi belemgbunli ebia ne mɔɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la anyunlu. Ɔzɔho Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhu ye la. Ɔlɛ mɛne nsuu yɛɛ ɛnyelɛ nsuu, mɔɔ le Nyamenle Sunsum nsuu ne, mɔɔ bɛzoanle bɛ wɔ ewiade ye amuala anu la.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Boaneralɛ ne hɔliele nwoma ne vile ahenle mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la asa fema ne anu.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Na bɛdole edwɛne fofolɛ bie kɛ, “Ɛfɛta kɛ ɛkɛlie nwoma ne, ɛkɛwaye ɛyɛlɛ ne, na ɛkɛbuke nwoma ne anu, ɔluakɛ bɛhunle wɔ na ɛvale wɔ mogya ne mɔɔ bɛhwinle bɛguale la ɛkpɔnenle menli. Ɛkpɔnenle bɛ ɛvile abusua ekpunli, aneɛ nee maanle ngakyile kɔsɔɔti anu ɛmanle Nyamenle.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Wɔmaa bɛyɛ arelemgbunli nee Nyamenle sɛlɛvolɛma na bɛbali arelemgbunli wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Mendole me nye bieko, na mendele Nyamenle soanvolɛma apenle apenle nee mgbe mgbe ane. Bɛbɔle bɛyiale belemgbunli ebia kpole ne, tease abɔdeɛ nna ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ,

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: na bɛhanle ye kpole kɛ, “Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhunle ye la, fɛta tumi, anwonyia, nrɛlɛbɛ nee anwosesebɛ, enililɛ, anyunlunyia nee ayɛlɛyelɛ!”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Na mendele kɛ abɔdeɛ biala mɔɔ wɔ anwuma nee aze, ɛbolɔ nee nyevile nu nee debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala se, “Ayɛlɛyelɛ, enililɛ, anyunlunyia nee tumi ɛyɛ mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la nee Boaneralɛ ne ɛdeɛ wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ!”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Na tease abɔdeɛ nna ne liele zo, “Amen.” Na mgbanyima ne mɔ dule guale na bɛzonlenle.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ Boaneralɛ ne ɛwaye ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛsosɔ nwoma ne anloa fane nsuu la anu ko, na mendele kɛ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne anu ko lɛ ɛnelɛ mɔɔ ye kpole le kɛ ezule mɔɔ ɛlɛkulu la hanle kɛ, “Bɛla!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Memanle me nye zo, na menwunle kɛ sonla de ɛkpɔnwɔ fufule zo na ɔlɛ ɛda ɔ sa nu ɔlɛba. Bɛbɔle ye abɔtile, na ɔvindele ɔhɔle kɛ katakyie mɔɔ ɛli konim dɔɔnwo na eza ɔlɛkɔ yeahɔho yeali konim bieko la.

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Na sonla ko mɔɔ bɛmaa ye konle dadeɛ kpole ko la de ɛkpɔnwɔ kɔkɔlɛ mɔɔ bolo kpalɛ la azo rale. Na bɛmanle ye adenle kɛ ɔye anzonudwolɛ ɔvi azɛlɛ ye azo, amaa menli ahu bɛ nwo.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Boaneralɛ ne akee wayele ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, na mendele kɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la se, “Bɛla!” Na menwunle kɛ sonla lɛ tone ɔ sa nu na ɔde ɛkpɔnwɔ bile bie azo ɔlɛba.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Akee mendele debie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛnelɛ la wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ anwo lɔ, ɔse, “Bɛbadɔ hwiiti ‘litili’ ko etaku nna, yɛɛ bɛbadɔ baale ‘litili’ nsa etaku nna. Na anrɛɛ bɛmmasɛkye nwole nee nwanye!”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Boaneralɛ ne wayele ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la; na mendele kɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la se, “Bɛla!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Meneanle, na menwunle sonla bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Ewule, kɛ ɔde ɛkpɔnwɔ nzonle bie azo ɔlɛba. Ɛbolɔ li ɔ nzi ɛkɛ ne ala. Bɛhyɛle azɛlɛ ye anu nna na bɛmanle bɛ tumi kɛ bɛva dadeɛ, ɛhɔne, anwonyane nee nanemgbole bɛhu menli mɔɔ wɔ ko azo la amuala.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Boaneralɛ ne eza wayele ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la. Na menwunle kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne ati, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile daselɛ nɔhalɛ nu la ati bɛhu bɛ la ɛkɛla ne mɔ dede azukponle ne abo.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Bɛdeanle nu kɛ, “O Tumivolɛ Awulae! Ɛle nwuanzanwuanza nee nɔhalɛnli. Na kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛbua azɛlɛ ye azo amra ndɛne na wɔadea bɛ kɛ bɛhunle yɛ a?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Na bɛmanle ko biala tɛladeɛ fufule, na bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ kɛ bɛlie bɛ ɛnwomenle ekyii, kɔkpula kɛ bɛ gɔnwo mɔ sonvolɛma nee mediema mɔɔ bɛdabɛ noko bɛbahu bɛ kɛ bɛdabɛ la, bɛ muala bɛ nloa kɛdɔ nu la.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Eza menwunle kɛ Boaneralɛ ne ɛwaye ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la. Na nea, azɛlɛ kpusule kpole bie, na sɛnzɛne ne yɛle bile kɛ ɛdanlɛ dokyi anzɛɛ bilizi, na siane ne yɛle kɔkɔlɛ yɔɔnwo kɛ mogya.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nwɔlɔra dudule vi anwomanyunlu raguale aze kɛ feege baka ma mɔɔ ahumu kpole bie ɛdu ɛkpolo bɛ ɛgua la.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Bɛnyenyanle anwomanyunlu kɛ ɛkpa la na ɔminliminlinle, na boka nee bɔra biala dudule vile bɛ bo zo ne mɔ.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli, mgbanyima, sogya mgbanyinli, sukoavolɛma nee tumivolɛma amuala nee menli kɔsɔɔti, ahanra nee alehelɛ, nriandile veɛveale awolɛ mbɔne nu nee awolɛ mɔɔ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo la abo.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Na bɛdeanle bɛvɛlɛle awoka nee awolɛ ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛragua yɛ nwo zo na bɛva yɛ bɛvea bɛmaa yɛvi mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la anye zo, na bɛye yɛ bɛvi Boaneralɛ ne ɛya ne anu!

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ bɛ ɛya kenle kpole ne ɛra na nwane bɔbɔ a kɛhola kɛgyinla ɔ nloa a?”

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: na ɔzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka azɛlɛ ye, nyevile, anzɛɛ mbaka biala bɛsɛkye bɛ, kɔkpula kɛ yɛkɛwie yɛ Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma ne mɔ amuala nzonlɛ yɛ wɔ bɛ nwoma zo la.”

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Na mendele menli mɔɔ bɛvale Nyamenle sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne bɛyɛle bɛ nzonlɛ wɔ bɛ nwoma zo la dodo. Menli apenle ngoko ɛya ko, abulanla nee nna (

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: bɛzele kɛ, “Amen! Ayɛlɛyelɛ, anyunlunyia, nrɛlɛbɛ, moyɛlɛ, enililɛ, tumi nee anwosesebɛ kɔsɔɔti le yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdeɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ! Amen.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi memanle me nye zo, na menwunle menli pemgbenleamgbe bie mɔɔ awie ɛngola bɛ tia la! Bɛvi mbusua, maanle, aneɛ nee menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti anu. Bɛgyigyi belemgbunli ebia kpole ne nee Boaneralɛ ne anyunlu ɛkɛ ne, bɛwula adɛladeɛ fufule na bɛdedɛ mrɛlakɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Bɛdeanle nu bɛzele kɛ, “Ngoanelielɛ vi yɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la nee Boaneralɛ ne.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma ne mɔ amuala rabɔle yiale belemgbunli ebia kpole ne, mgbanyima ne mɔ nee tease abɔdeɛ nna ne. Bɛbutubutule bɛ nyunlu aze wɔ belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anyunlu na bɛzonlenle Nyamenle,

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Mgbanyima ne mɔ ko bizale me kɛ, “Na nwane mɔ a le menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule la, yɛɛ bɛvi nienwu a bɛra a?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Membuale ye kɛ, “Yɛmenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛze a.” Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Menli ɛhye mɔ a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛho bɛdɔ zolɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ kpole ne anu la. Bɛkpole bɛ adɛladeɛ ne mɔ nwohyee wɔ Boaneralɛ ne mogya ne anu.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Ɛhye ati yɛɛ bɛgyigyi Nyamenle belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anwo na bɛsonle ye alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ wɔ ɔdaye ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu a. Mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la banlea bɛ nwo zo.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ bieko, ewia ɛnrɛbɔ bɛ, anzɛɛ wuluwulu kpole biala ɛnrɛhu bɛ bieko.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Ɔluakɛ Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la bayɛ mboaneneavolɛ anlea bɛ, na ɔbayɛ bɛ tataa yeahɔ nzubula mɔɔ maa ngoane la anwo. Na Nyamenle bakyikyi bɛ nye anwo monle.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ Boaneralɛ ne wayele ɛyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu mɔɔ bɛvale bɛzɔle nwoma ne anloa la, anwuma lɔ amuala yɛle diinyi kɛyɛ dɔnehwele foa ko.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ gyigyi Nyamenle anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, na bɛvale aweɛne ndendenle nsuu bɛmanle bɛ.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko noko mɔɔ lɛ ezukoa nvutuke dwora mɔɔ bɛyela ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ nu la ragyinlanle azukponle ne anwo. Bɛmanle ye ɛyɛlɛ dɔɔnwo kɛ ɔva ɔboka Nyamenle menli ne nzɛlɛlɛ ne anwo na ɔkpu ye wɔ ezukoa nvutuke azukponle ne mɔɔ gyi belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anyunlu la azo.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛlɛ ne esike ne nee Nyamenle menli ne nzɛlɛlɛ ne vi Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne asa nu hɔle Nyamenle anyunlu wɔ anwuma.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne akee vale azu mokyea ne anu samɛnlankɛ ne bie guale ɛyɛlɛ dwora ne anu na ɔvuandinle dwora ne ɔdole azɛlɛ ye azo. Na maanle nu hulule mgbole bie, ɛsɛlɛmanye kpakyele, na azɛlɛ kpusule. Aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne boɔboale bɛ nwo kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ aweɛne ndendenle nsuu ne mɔ anu.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Na bɛwolale ezuawolɛ nee senle, mɔɔ bɛva mogya bɛfonla ye la bɛguale azɛlɛ ye azo. Azɛlɛ ye anu hyɛle nsa, na ko yelale bɔkɔɔ manle mbaka nee ndile mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la dɔle nzonle.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Na ɛwɔlɔra kpole bie, mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ kɛ tɛkɛ la dule vi anwomanyunlu radɔle azudenle, nzubula nee tandane nu.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔlɔra ne duma a le “Subo.” Na azule, nzubula nee tandane mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la anu hyɛle nsa, na ko yɛle kɛ subo, na ye ɛnwonle manle menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ nlonle bie la wule.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne. Sɛnzɛne ne anu hyɛle nsa, bɛbɔle ko, na ye ɛdalɛ ne nlunle; siane ne anu hyɛle nsa, yɛɛ nwɔlɔra ne mɔ anu hyɛle nsa na bɛ nuhua ngoko nlunle. Yemɔti alehyenlɛ nu hyɛle nsa mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ɛnvinde ko anu a, yɛɛ aledwolɛ noko anu hyɛle nsa mɔɔ siane nee nwɔlɔra ɛnda ko anu a.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Na memanle me ti zo la, mendele kɔleɛ kpole bie mɔɔ ɛdu faa la ane wɔ nyamenle ne ako abo nehane kɛ ɔlɛtea nu yeaha kɛ, “Bɛ gyakɔ! Bɛ gyakɔ! Bɛ gyakɔ! Saa Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsa ne mɔɔ ɛha la bɔ bɛ aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu a, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ye azo la, bɛ gyakɔ!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Na menwunle kɛ ɛwɔlɔra bie vi anwuma ɛdu ɛradɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na bɛva azɛlɛ kuma ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la sanvɛ ne bɛwula ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔlɔra ne bukele azɛlɛ kuma ne anlenkɛ ne, na esike mungumungu mɔɔ le kɛ sendɔlɔra esike la vi nu vindele; ɛhye hedale sɛnzɛne ne anye na maanle nu yɛle kisii.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Abɛbɛ dɔɔnwo vi esike ne anu dwule aze na bɛmanle bɛ bɔlɔ mɔɔ le kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Bɛzele bɛ kɛ bɛmmasɛkye ndile anzɛɛ mbaka nee nya amolɛ biala, na bɛkeka menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ Nyamenle nzonlɛ ne bie bɛ nwoma azo la.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Bɛzele abɛbɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛmmaku menli ɛhye mɔ, na bɛkeka bɛ toonwo siane nnu. Saa bɛka a ye nyane le kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ ɛbɔ sonla la.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Mekɛ zɔhane menli bakpondɛ ewule abo zo, na bɛnrɛnwu ye; bɛbahulo kɛ bɛkɛwu, na ewule banriandi bɛ.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Saa ɛnea abɛbɛ ne mɔ a bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ bɛziezie bɛ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ kɔ konle la. Debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ezukoa abɔtile la bobɔ bɛ ti, yɛɛ bɛ nyunlu maanle ne le kɛ sonla ɛdeɛ ne la.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Bɛ ti enrinli le kɛ raalɛ ti enrinli, yɛɛ bɛ gye le kɛ awenade gye.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo abonle ne le kɛ asɛɛ bɛwula mbulalɛ adɛladeɛ la na saa bɛtu a bɛ ndɛba anu su kɛ mgbɔnwɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛtwili ehwili ahɔho la.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ dualɛ kɛ nyamenleakɛlɛ, yɛɛ bɛbɔ. Bɛ dua ne mɔ a bɛfa bɛabɔ menli toonwo siane nnu a.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ nea bɛ nwo zo a. Yemɔ a le azɛlɛ kuma ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la soanvolɛ ne. Ye duma wɔ Hibulu nu a le “Abadɔn.” Giliki nu noko a, bɛfɛlɛ ye “Apɔleɔn”

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Alumua anwubɛnyunlu ne awieleɛ ɛne. Ɛhye anzi yeha anwubɛnyunlu ɛzulolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ bara a.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne. Na mendele kɛ ɛnelɛ bie vi ezukoa azukponle ne mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la mgbɛnezo nna ne mɔ anu vindele.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Ɛnelɛ ne zele Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ aweɛne tendenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la kɛ, “Sianyizianyi Nyamenle soanvolɛma nna ne mɔɔ bɛkyekye bɛ wɔ azule kpole ‘Yufileti’ anloa la!”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Bɛzianyinle bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛvale bɛ bɛziele ɛkɛ ne kɛ dɔnehwele ne ala anu, kenle ko ne ala, siane ne ala anu, wɔ ɛvolɛ ne ala anu, bɛhyɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la anu nsa na bɛhu nuhua ko.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Mendele kɛ sogyama mɔɔ dede mgbɔnwɔ zo la angome le mgbe ngoko ɛya nwiɔ.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Wɔ yekile ne anu, menwunle sogyama ne mɔ kɛ bɛdede mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ azo, na kɛ bɛde la ɛne: bɛwulowula mbulalɛ akɛnrazo enyinlike mɔɔ le woonwu kɛ senle, buluwu kɛ “safaya”, yɛɛ guanye kɛ sɔlefa la. Mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ ati le kɛ awenade ti, na senle, esike, yɛɛ sɔlefa vi bɛ nloa anu finde.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Bɛvale senle ne, esike ne, yɛɛ sɔlefa ne mɔɔ vi mgbɔnwɔ ne mɔ anloa anu finde la bɛhyɛle aleɛabo amra anu nsa na bɛhunle nuhua ko.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Aleɛabo amra mɔɔ hale, mɔɔ ewule ɛhye angu bɛ la, annu bɛ nwo, angyakyi bɛ ɛbɛla ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛbɔ la. Bɛangyakyi awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nee mmonle mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, ayera, bolɛ, nee baka a bɛyɛ, mɔɔ bɛnnwu debie, bɛnde edwɛkɛ na bɛadia la ɛzɔlɛ.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Eza menli ne mɔ annu bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ kɔdiawu nyɛleɛ, ngonyia, awule, nee adwɔmane ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nwo.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Akee menwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ bieko kɛ ɔvi anwuma ɔlɛba. Ɔvea amungu nu na nyangondonle ɛdo ɛbɛnra ɔ ti; ɔ nyunlu ta kɛ sɛnzɛne, na ye ɛnantuo ɛdɔlɔ woonwu kɛ sua sika kpole bie mɔɔ senle la nu la.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Ɔlɛ nwoma ekyi ko mɔɔ bɛdɛlɛ nu la ɔ sa nu. Ɔvale ɔ gyakɛ fema ne ɔziele nyevile ne azo na yeava bɛne ne yeazie azɛlɛ ye azo,

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: na ɔvale ɛnelɛ mɔɔ dielie kɛ awenade ne la ɔdeanle nu kpole bie. Ɔdeanle nu ala la, maanle nu hulule fane nsuu.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Mɔɔ maanle nu hulule fane nsuu la, menyɛle kɛ mekɛlɛ, na mendele kɛ ɛnelɛ vi anwuma, ɔse, “Mɔɔ ɛdele wɔ ɛhululɛ fane nsuu ne anu la maa ɔha ɛ ti anu, mmakɛlɛ!”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ menwunle kɛ ɔgyi nyevile nee azɛlɛ zo la manle ɔ sa fema ne zo anwuma

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: na ɔvuale ɔhilele tease Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee nuhua debie biala, azɛlɛ nee zolɛ debie biala, nee nyevile nee nuhua ninyɛne muala la kɛ, “Aze ɛzilɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ!

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Saa Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la bɔ ye aweɛne tendenle ne anu a, Nyamenle ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ vea ɛkɛ ne la bara nuhua, kɛmɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele ye sonvolɛma kpɔmanvolɛma la.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Akee ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ mendele kɛ ɔvi anwuma ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me la zele me bieko kɛ, “Kɔlie nwoma ne mɔɔ bɛdɛlɛ nu, mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ gyi nyevile ne nee azɛlɛ ye azo la lɛ ye ɔ sa nu la.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Yemɔti mengɔle Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne anwo ɛkɛ na menzele ye kɛ ɔva nwoma ekyi ne ɔmaa me. Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Die na di. Ɔbayɛ ɛ nloa anu menlemenle kɛ dɔdɔ, na ɔdwu ɛ kunlu a ɔbayɛ ɛnwonle.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Menliele nwoma ekyi ne wɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne asa anu na menlile, na ɔyɛle me nloa anu menlemenle. Na mɔɔ ɔdwule me kunlu la ɔyɛle ɛnwonle.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Na bɛzele me kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɔbɔ Nyamenle Edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ fane maanle maanle, aneɛ aneɛ, menli ngakyile, nee arelemgbunli nwo la nolo bieko.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Anrɛɛ mmasuzu alie nwo ɛkɛ ne ɛboka nwolɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛva ɛkɛ ne bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle la. Zɛhae menli barava Suakpole Nwuanzanwuanza ye siane abulanla nee nwiɔ na bɛazie menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Mebamaa me dasevolɛma nwiɔ aheda ɛrele arabɔ Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne nolo kenle apenle ko ɛya nwiɔ abulasia (

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Dasevolɛma nwiɔ ne a le “ɔlivi” mbaka nwiɔ ne nee kɛnlaneɛ mbaka nwiɔ ne mɔɔ gyigyi Awulae mɔɔ lɛ azɛlɛ ye la anyunlu ɛkɛ ne la.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Saa awie se kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ a, senle vi bɛ nloa anu finde na ɔsɛkye bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ; saa awie bɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ a bɛbahu ye.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛlɛ tumi bɛto anwuma nu mɔɔ ezule ɛndɔ mekɛ tendenle biala mɔɔ bɛlɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la. Eza bɛlɛ azɛlɛ ye azo nzule biala anwo zo tumi, bɛkola bɛkakyi ye bɛmaa ɔyɛ mogya; yɛɛ bɛlɛ tumi bɛfa ewule ngakyile biala bɛbato azɛlɛ ye azo wɔ mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkulo la.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Saa bɛwie nrɛlaleɛ ne ka a, nane ne mɔɔ vi azɛlɛ kuma ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la anu la bavinde na ɔ nee bɛ araho. Ɔbali bɛ nwo zo konim na yeahu bɛ,

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: na bɛ avunli baha suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle bɛ Awulae ne meanubaka nu wɔ zolɛ la guabile ne azo. Suakpole zɔhane duma, bɛbavɛlɛ ye kɛ, sɛbe, Sodɔm anzɛɛ Yigyibiti.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Menli vi maanle maanle zo, aneɛ aneɛ nu, mbusua ekpunli ekpunli nee menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti anu baranlea bɛ avunli ne kenle nsa nee foa, na bɛnrɛmaa adenle bɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛzie bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la bali fɛlɛko kɛ menli nwiɔ zɔhane ɛwu a. Bɛbali fɛlɛko, bɛ nye balie, na bɛava ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛamaa bɛ nwo ngoko, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nwiɔ zɔhane yɛle ngyegyelɛ kpalɛ manle aleɛabo amra amuala.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Na kenle nsa nee foa ne anzi, ngoane ɛnwomenle vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ rawolole bɛ nu, na bɛdwazole, na ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwunle bɛ la amuala.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma nwiɔ ne dele kɛ ɛnelɛ kpole bie vi anwuma, ɔse, “Bɛrɛla anwuma ɛke!” Na mɔɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ anye gyi bɛ nwo ala la, amungu ravale bɛ hɔle anwuma.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Mekɛ ne anu ala, azɛlɛ kpusule kpole bie; suakpole ne anu hyɛle bulu na ko zɛkyele bɔkɔɔ. Menli apenle nsuu wule azɛlɛkpusulɛ ne anu. Na menli mɔɔ hale la ahonle dule kpole na bɛyeyɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Anwubɛnyunlu ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la awieleɛ ɛne. Akee anwubɛnyunlu ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la a ɛlɛba la. Aweɛne tendenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsuu la

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la bɔle ye aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Na ɛnelɛ mgbole dɔɔnwo bie vi anwuma hanle kɛ, “Azɛlɛ ye azo tumi muala ɛyɛ Awulae nee yɛ Mɛzaya ne ɛdeɛ; ɔbali belemgbunli ɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ!”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: bɛhanle kɛ, “Awulae Nyamenle Bedevinli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛwɔ ɛkɛ na ɛwɔ ɛkɛ kɛkala a! Yɛyɛ wɔ mo kɛ wɔmaa wɔ tumi ne zo na wɔbɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɛdi belemgbunli a!

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Ɛya ɛwolo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnzonle Nyamenle la, noko wɔ ɛya kenle ne ɛdwu. Mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛbua mɔwuamra ndɛne na ɛmaa wɔ sonvolɛma, kpɔmanvolɛma, nee wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti, ngakula nee mgbanyinli, mɔɔ sonle wɔ la ahatualɛ mɔɔ fɛta la a. Mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ akee ɔwɔ kɛ ɛsɛkye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsɛkye azɛlɛ ye la a.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Na bɛbukele Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ la, na Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne anwo lale ɛkɛ ne wienyi. Na ɛsɛlɛmanye kpakyekpakyele, maanle nu hulule, azɛlɛ kpusule, na ezuawolɛ dɔle kpole bie.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: ɛvo awolɛ zo, na ye awolɛ nyane ne ɛmaa ɔlɛsu yeadeɛdea nu.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛzulolɛ bieko vindele anwomanyunlu. Nane kɔkɔlɛ anwo ɛzulolɛ bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la lua anwomanyunlu lɔ. Ɔ ti le nsuu, ye mɛne bulu, yɛɛ etile ko biala bɔ abɔtile.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ɔvale ɔ dua ɔhyɛle nwɔlɔra mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu la anu ekpunli nsa na ɔpianle ko ɔguale aze. Akee ɔragyinlanle raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la anyunlu ɛkɛ ne kɛ saa ɔwo a yeahye kakula ne yeali.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne wole ralɛ nrenya, mɔɔ bava tumi kpole azie maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti a. Na bɛvale kakula ne bɛhɔmanle Nyamenle wɔ ye belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo lɔ.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne nriandile hɔle ɛsɛlɛ ne azo, ɛleka bie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛsiezie ɛmaa ye la, ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbanlea ye gyɛlɛɛnye yeali ye adane kenle apenle ko, ɛya nwiɔ abulasia a (

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Akee konle zile anwuma lɔ. Nyamenle soanvolɛ kpanyinli Maekeɛle nee ɔ sa zo Nyamenle soanvolɛma nee nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne nee ɔdaye ye soanvolɛma honle.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Maekeɛle nee ɔ sa zo lile nane ne anwo zo konim. Yemɔti bɛdule nane ne nee ye soanvolɛma ne amuala bɛvile anwuma lɔ.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Bɛvuandinle nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la bɛdole azɛlɛ ye azo. Yemɔ a le mɔmoane ɛwɔlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Abɔnsam anzɛɛ Seetan, mɔɔ ɛbɛlɛbɛla ewiade amra amuala la. Bɛvuandinle ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ noko bɛguale azɛlɛ ye azo.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Akee mendele ɛnelɛ kpole bie vi anwuma, ɔse, “Bɔ zo mɔɔ Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ ne ɛra a! Akee Nyamenle ɛhile ye tumi ne kɛ ɔle Belemgbunli. Akee yehile ye Mɛzaya tumi ne! Ɔluakɛ bɛvuandi mɔɔ gyi Nyamenle anyunlu nɔɔzo nee ewiazo toɔdoa yɛ mediema ne mɔ la bɛde aze.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Yɛ mediema ne mɔ ɛlua Boaneralɛ ne mogya ne azo nee nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛlile nwolɛ daselɛ la azo ɛli ɔ nwo zo konim, ɔluakɛ bɛanzulo kɛ bɛkɛva bɛ ngoane bɛkɛdo aze.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati bɛmɛ anwumaneamra, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ zolɛ la amuala, bɛli fɛlɛko! Na bɛmɛ azɛlɛ nee nyevile, bɛ gyakɔ! Ɔluakɛ Abɔnsam ɛdwu ɛra bɛ nwo lɔ, na ɛya kpole wɔ ye nuhua, ɔboalekɛ ɔze kɛ ye mekɛ ɛha ekyi bie ala.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne nwunle kɛ bɛvuandi ye bɛde azɛlɛ ye azo la, ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ wole ralɛ nrenya ne la yeahu ye.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Na bɛmanle raalɛ ne kɔleɛ ndɛbalɛ mgbole nwiɔ, amaa yeahola tu ɔvi ɛwɔlɛ ne anwo ɛkɛ yeahɔ ɛsɛlɛ zo lɔ, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbanlea ye gyɛlɛɛnye ɛvolɛ nsa nee foa la, amaa nane ne angola ɔ nwo zo kɔ bieko.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Nane ne kpule nzule kɛ azule la kɛ ɔmaa yeava raalɛ ne.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Na azɛlɛ boale raalɛ ne. Ɔmemenle nzule ne mɔɔ nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne kpule la.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne vale raalɛ ne anwo ɛya kpole na ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkadoa ɔ mra mɔɔ ɛha, mɔɔ di Nyamenle mɛla ne azo na bɛdie nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛye ɛhile la bɛdi la ɔ nee bɛ ahɔho.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Na nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ɛhye ragyinlanle ɛnweakpane ne azo wɔ nyevile ne anloa ɛkɛ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ nane bie vi nyevile ne anu ɛlɛfo ara file zo. Ɔlɛ mɛne bulu yɛɛ ɔ ti le nsuu. Bɛbɔ ye mɛne ne mɔ ko biala abɔtile na bɛhɛlɛ duma ɛtane bie mɔɔ tia Nyamenle la bɛgua nwolɛ.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Nane ɛhye anyunlu le kɛ sobolɛ nyunlu, ɔ gyakɛ le kɛ ezizile gyakɛ, yɛɛ ɔ nloa le kɛ awenade nloa. Na nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ zɔho ɛlɛnrɛne la vale ye tumi ne, ye belemgbunli ebia ne, yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ kpole ne manle ye.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Nane ne ati ne mɔ ko zɔho debie mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye hanlɛ kpole bie na hanlɛ ne ɛhɔ la. Ɔ nwo yɛle ewiade amra amuala ɛzulolɛ na bɛdule bɛdoale ye.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Menli zonlenle nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la, ɔluakɛ yemɔ a yeva tumi yemaa nane ɛhendeɛ ne a. Bɛzonlenle nane ne ɔdaye, na bɛhanle kɛ, “Nwane a nee nane ye sɛ a? Nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla ɔ nyunlu a?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Nane ne lile ɔ ti siane abulanla nee nwiɔ, na bɛmanle ye adenle bɛmanle ɔhehanle munzule edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane ɔtietiale Nyamenle.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ɔdendɛle ɛtane ɔtiale Nyamenle, ɔbɔle ye duma ɛtane, na ɔhanle munzule edwɛkɛ ɔtiale ɛleka mɔɔ ɔde, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ anwuma lɔ la amuala.
