english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Bɛmanle ye adenle kɛ ɔ nee Nyamenle menli ne ɛho na ɔli bɛ nwo zo konim, na bɛmanle ye tumi wɔ maanle biala, aneɛ biala, abusua ekpunli biala nee menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala bazonle ye. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛangɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ Boaneralɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhunle ye la ngoane buluku ne anu kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade la a bazonle ye a.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati, ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ la, tie!

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Awie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkye ye nuokɛ la, bɛbahye ye nuokɛ; awie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ wu dadeɛ nloa la, bawu dadeɛ nloa. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle menli ne nyia abotane, gyinla bɛ nwo, si ahonle, na bɛnyia diedi.

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle kɛ nane ko noko vi azɛlɛ bo ɛlɛfinde ara. Ɔlɛ mɛne nwiɔ kɛ boane ɛdeɛ ne la, noko ɔtendɛ a ɔ ne le kɛ nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Tumi kpole ne mɔɔ alumua nane ne lɛ la yɛɛ ɔfa ɔyɛ gyima a. Na ɔmanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ye azo la amuala zonlenle alumua nane ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye hanlɛ na hanlɛ ne ɛhɔ la.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Nane ɛhye mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole; ɔmanle senle bɔbɔ vi anwuma rale azɛlɛ ye azo manle menli kɔsɔɔti nwunle ye.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Ɔluale ngonyia ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛmanle ye adenle bɛmanle ɔluale alumua nane ne anwo zo ɔyele la azo ɔbɛlɛbɛlale menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala. Nane ɛhye mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la zele menli kɔsɔɔti kɛ bɛyɛ ananze mɔɔ zɔho nane ne mɔɔ bɛbɔle ye hanlɛ kpole noko ɔtɛte ngoane nu la.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Bɛmanle adenle bɛmanle nane ɛhye mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la liele ɛnwomenle guale alumua nane ne ananze ne azo, amaa ananze ne adendɛ. Eza bɛmanle ye adenle bɛmanle ɔhunle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛanzonle alumua nane ne ananze ne la amuala.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Nane ne manle menli kɔsɔɔti, ngakula nee mgbanyinli, sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma, ahanra nee alehelɛ, nyianle nzonlɛ wɔ bɛ sa fema ne anwo anzɛɛ bɛ nwoma azo.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ nzonlɛ ne mɔɔ le nane ne duma anzɛɛ ye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne bie la, ɛngola ɛnli gua.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Ɛhye hyia maa nrɛlɛbɛ. Mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo la kola sese nwu nane ne nɔma ne abo, ɔboalekɛ nɔma ne le sonla duma. Nɔma ne a le ɛya nsia abulasia nee nsia (

translation_verse: Akee mekado me nye la ɛnee Boaneralɛ ne gyi Boka Zayɔn azo; ɔ nee menli apenle ngoko ɛya ko, abulanla nee nna (

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Na mendele ɛnelɛ bie vi anwuma mɔɔ dielie kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ zo ɛlɛsonyi agua na ɔlɛkulu kɛ bokile ezule la. Eza ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ mendele la le kɛ menli dɔɔnwo ɛlɛbɔ getaa,

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: na bɛlɛto edwɛne fofolɛ bie wɔ belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anyunlu wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne nee mgbanyima ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ. Bɛdabɛ menli apenle ngoko ɛya ko abulanla nee nna ɛhye, mɔɔ bɛlie bɛ ngoane bɛvi azɛlɛ ye azo la ala a ɛhola ɛzukoa edwɛne ne a.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛzie bɛ nwo bɔkɔbɔkɔ mɔɔ bɛanva bɛ nwo bɛanga raalɛ biala a; bɛle amunli bɔkɔɔ. Bɛmɛ yɛɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ Boaneralɛ ne ɛlɛkɔ la bɛdoa ye a. Bɛmɛ a bɛlie bɛ ngoane bɛvi aleɛabo amra avinli kɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ bɛlumua bɛva bɛ bɛrɛlɛ Nyamenle nee Boaneralɛ ne a.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Bɛtɛbɔle adalɛ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ nwo te bɔkɔɔ. Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsa ne

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Eza menwunle kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko ɛdu faa lua anwomanyunlu, na ɔlɛ damɛnlangoate nrɛlaleɛ ne, mɔɔ le Edwɛkpa ne ɔlɛba yearabɔ ye nolo yeahile menli ngakyile, mbusua ekpunli ekpunli, aneɛ ngakyile, nee maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Na ɔdeanle nu ɔhanle kɛ, “Bɛzulo Nyamenle, na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ. Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔbabua aleɛabo amra ndɛne a. Bɛzonle Nyamenle mɔɔ bɔle anwuma, azɛlɛ, nyevile, nee azule muala la.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko noko ɔdaye ɔdoa ye na ɔse, “Yebɔ! Suakpole Babelɔn mɔɔ ɛlie duma la ɛbɔ bɔkɔɔ! Ɔmanle maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anu amra zukoale ye na bɛvale adwɔmanebɔlɛ bɛhakyile nza bɛnlonle!”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la ɔdaye ɔdoa alumua ɛdeɛ nwiɔ ne, na ɔlɛka ye kpole kpalɛ kɛ, “Mɔɔ kɛzonle nane ne nee ye ananze ne, na ɔkɛva ye sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne bie ɔkɛyɛ ɔ nwoma azo anzɛɛ ɔ sa anwo la

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: kɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne mɔɔ gyi ye ɛya dwora ne anu la ɛzulolɛ si de la. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ zɔhane deɛ ne la, bɛbahile bɛ nyane wɔ senle nee sɔlefa nu wɔ soanvolɛma nwuanzanwuanza nee Boaneralɛ ne anyunlu.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Senle ne mɔɔ yelɛyela bɛ la anu esike ne kɔ anwuma anwuma dahuu mɔɔ ɔ bo ɛmpɛ ɛlɛ a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle nane ne nee ye ananze ne, na bɛlɛ ye duma ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne bɛ nwo la anwo ɛnrɛdɔ bɛ ɛlɛ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ muala.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Nyamenle menli ne mɔɔ di ye mɛla ne azo na bɛdi nɔhalɛ bɛmaa Gyisɛse la bɔ mɔdenle gyinla kpundii.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Akee mendele ɛnelɛ vi anwuma, ɔse, “Kɛlɛ ɛhye: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la Awulae ɛzonlenlɛ ti bɛkɛwu la!” Na Sunsum ne liele zolɛ kɛ, “Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛ amgba! Bɛbalie bɛ ɛnwomenle wɔ bɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo, ɔluakɛ bɛ gyima kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛdi la li bɛ nzi.” Azɛlɛ ye azo bɛyɔba ne

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Akee mendole me nye, na menwunle amungu fufule nwohyee bie, na debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la de zolɛ, ɔbɔ ezukoa abɔtile na ɔlɛ ɛdedadeɛ nlane bie ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko noko vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu vindele na ɔdeanle nu ɔzele mɔɔ de amungu ne azo la kɛ, “Fa wɔ ɛdedadeɛ ne te bɛyɔba ne; ɛbuhenle ne ɛdwu, ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ye azo bɛyɔba ne ɛwie bolo.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ de amungu ne azo la denrɛle ɔ sa na ɔdele azɛlɛ ye azo bɛyɔba ne.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Menwunle kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko noko ɔdaye ɔvi anwuma lɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu yevinde. Ɔdaye noko ɔlɛ ɛdedadeɛ nlane ko ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ko, mɔɔ yemɔ a ɔnea senle ne la vi azukponle ne abo vindele. Ɔdeanle nu ɔzele mɔɔ lɛ ɛdedadeɛ nlane ne la kɛ, “Ewiade vanye ma ne ɛbolo na fa wɔ dadeɛ ne te bɛ muala!”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Zɔhane ati Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne denrɛle ɔ sa wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, ɔdele vanye ma ne mɔ amuala, na ɔvuandinle ɔguale Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne nwanye melahyinli ne anu.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Melahyinli ne hwihwinle vanye ma ne anu nzule guale suakpole ne kandiba lɔ, na mogya mɔɔ ye kuma kɛyɛ mita nwiɔ la denrɛle zenle kɛ azule mɔɔ ye tendenle kɛyɛ kilomita ɛya nsa (

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ anwomanyunlu, mɔɔ le kpole na eza ɔyɛ nwanwane a. Menwunle Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu kɛ bɛlɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile nsuu, mɔɔ le amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ li amozi a, ɔluakɛ saa bɛmɛ bɛwie a ɛnee Nyamenle ɛya kpole ne ɛdwo.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Eza menwunle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ nyevile anye kɔngyekɔngye kɛ neanleɛ mɔɔ bɛva senle bɛkpoto nu la. Akee menwunle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlile nane ne nee ye ananze ne nee nane ne mɔɔ ye duma le nɔma la anwo zo konim la. Bɛdedɛ getaa mɔɔ Nyamenle a ɛva ɛmaa bɛ la bɛ sa nu, na bɛgyigyi nyevile anye kɔngyekɔngye kɛ neanleɛ la anwo.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Ɛnee bɛlɛto Nyamenle sonvolɛ Mosisi nee Boaneralɛ ne anwo edwɛne. Bɛse, “Awulae Nyamenle Bedevinli, wɔ nyɛleɛ yɛ ɛzulolɛ, ɔyɛ nwanwane! Damɛnlangoate Belemgbunli, wɔ ndenle le fɔɔnwo nee nɔhalɛ.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Awulae, nwane a ɛnrɛzulo wɔ a, nwane a kɛzu kpolera kɛ ɛnle kpole a? Ɛ ngomekye a ɛle nwuanzanwuanza a. Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti badu agua ɛ nyunlu azonle wɔ, ɔboalekɛ awie biala ɛnwu kɛ ɛdi pɛlepɛle.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Ɛhye anzi memanle me nye zo na menwunle kɛ bɛbuke Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma lɔ la, na Nyamenle daselɛlilɛ Ndanlɛ Sua ne wɔ nu.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ wula adɛladeɛ fufule nwohyee na bɛva ezukoa nvutuke akyeso bɛhye bɛ avinli la vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu vindele, bɛdedɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile nsuu ne bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Tease abɔdeɛ nna ne anu ko vale ezukoa nvutuke dwora nsuu ne mɔɔ Damɛnlangoate Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu la ɛya ne wɔ nu la manle bɛ.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne nee ye tumi ne manle esike ngome yile sua ne, mɔɔ awie biala ɛngola nu wolo a, kyesɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile nsuu ne mɔɔ li amozi, mɔɔ Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne lɛ la abo ɛdu.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Akee mendele ɛnelɛ kpole bie wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu kɛ ɔlɛka yeahile Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne kɛ, “Bɛhɔ, bɛhɔwola Nyamenle ɛya ne mɔɔ wɔ dwora ne mɔ anu la bɛgua azɛlɛ ne azo!”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la hɔle na ɔhɔwolale ye dwora ɛdeɛ ne anu ɛya ne ɔguale azɛlɛ ne azo. Na nganlɛ mgbole mɔɔ fofo na ɔbɔ la vindele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ nane ne sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne wɔ bɛ nwo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzonlenle ye ananze ne la anwo.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la wolale ye ɛdeɛ ne guale nyevile nu. Nyevile ne hakyile kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛwu la mogya, na debie biala mɔɔ lɛ ngoane mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu la wule.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la wolale ye dwora ɛdeɛ ne anu ɛya ne guale azule nee nzubula nu, na bɛhakyile mogya.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Mendele kɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ nea nzule zo la se, “O Nwuanzanwuanzanli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛwɔ ɛkɛ na ɛwɔ ɛkɛ dahuu a, wɔli pɛlepɛle bɔkɔɔ wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ nu.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Bɛhanle Nyamenle menli ne nee kpɔmanvolɛma mogya bɛguale, na ɛdawɔ noko wɔmaa bɛ mogya kɛ bɛnlo. Mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la fɛta bɛ!”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Na mendele ɛnelɛ bie vi azukponle ne anwo ɛkɛ, ɔse, “Awulae Nyamenle Bedevinli, wɔ ndɛnebualɛ le nɔhalɛ, ɔle fɔɔnwo amgba!”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la noko wolale ye ɛdeɛ ne guale sɛnzɛne ne azo manle ɔnyianle adenle ɔvale ye wuluwulu ne ɔyelɛyelale menli.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Menli nwo dwele bɛ kpalɛ, na bɛdendɛle ɛtane bɛtiale Nyamenle, mɔɔ lɛ tumi wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile ɛhye mɔ azo la duma ne. Na bɛangyakyi ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ, bɛanye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ kɛ ɔle bedevinli.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la wolale ye dwora ne anu ɛya ne guale nane ne belemgbunli ebia ne azo. Awozinli rahedale nane ne belemgbunlililɛ zo, na menli vale abodelɛ kposale bɛ tafinlima.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle anwuma Nyamenle ne sasa wɔ bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ abodelɛ ne ati, noko bɛannu bɛ nwo bɛangyakyi ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la ɔdaye ɔwolale mɔɔ wɔ ye dwora ɛdeɛ ne anu la ɔguale azukpole “Yufileti” anu. Ɛkɛ ne ala azule ne sesanle, ɔwele resee, amaa arelemgbunli mɔɔ vi aduduleɛ la anyia adenle araze.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Na menwunle sunsum nsa bie mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na bɛle kɛ ahɛlɛne la kɛ bɛvi nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la anloa anu, nane ko ne noko anloa anu, yɛɛ kpɔmanvolɛ alane ne anloa anu bɛlɛfinde bɛara.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Bɛle sunsum ɛtane mɔɔ kola yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne a. Na bɛluolua nu bɛkpɔsa arelemgbunli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala anwo zo na bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa kɛ bɛbaho Nyamenle Bedevinli ne Kenle kpole ne anu.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Bɛdie! Mebara bɛ nwo zo kɛ awule la! Na nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɔ nye gyi zolɛ na ɔnea ye ninyɛne boɛ la, amaa yeanlɛ ɔ nwo zɔ wɔ menli nu na ɔ nyunlu angua aze!”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Na sunsum nsa ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la boɔboale arelemgbunli ne mɔ anloa wɔ ɛleka bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Hibulu nu “Amagɛdɔn” la.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Akee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsuu la wolale ye ɛdeɛ ne guale anwoma ne anu. Na ɛnelɛ kpole bie vi belemgbunli ebia kpole ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la anwo zele kɛ, “Bɛyɛ bɛwie!”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne anu hyɛle nsa, yɛɛ maanle maanle azuamgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɔle tɔɔ. Nyamenle hakyele mɔɔ suakpole Babelɔn ɛyɛ la, na ɔkpokpole ye ɛya ne kɔsɔɔti ɔguale ɔ ti zo.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Mbɔra muala minlinle, na awoka kɔsɔɔti hanle aze fɛɛnye, bɛ bo zo minlinle.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ dedɛ dwora ne mɔ la anu ko rale me nwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele me kɛ, “Bɛla maa mengile wɔ kɛ bɛsi bɛadea tuutuunli ne mɔɔ ɛlie duma la, meka suakpole ne mɔɔ ɛlie duma mɔɔ bɛhye ye wɔ azudenle ne mɔ anloa la.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Ewiade arelemgbunli zukoale ye, nee ye bɔle adwɔmane ɛbɛla, na menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala ɛyɛ mgbane kɛ bɛ nee ye ɛbɔ ye adwɔmane ɛbɛla ne a.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Sunsum ne rawolole me, na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne vale me hɔle ɛsɛlɛ bie azo. Ɛkɛ ne, menwunle raalɛ bie kɛ ɔde nane kɔkɔlɛ bie azo. Nane ne bɛhɛlɛhɛlɛ aluma ɛtane ɛtane mɔɔ tia Nyamenle la wɔ ɔ nwo. Nane ne ati le nsuu yɛɛ ye mɛne le bulu.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Raalɛ ne mɔɔ de zolɛ la heda arelemgbunli ɛdanlɛ kɔkɔlɛ, buluwu nee akɔlɛ ɛnlome afonla na yeva ezukoa nvutuke anwoneɛ, mgbɔba, yɛɛ avikpa yeziezie ɔ nwo. Ɔlɛ ezukoa nvutuke dwora ɔ sa nu. Munzule ninyɛne mgbane mgbane mɔɔ le bɛkyi nee ye adwɔmanebɔlɛ nwo ninyɛndane ngome a wɔ nu a.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Bɛhɛlɛ duma bie mɔɔ ye ndelebɛbo vea la bɛgua ɔ nwoma azo. Yemɔ a le, “Babelɔn mɔɔ ɛlie duma, tuutuuma bɛ nli nee ewiade bɛkyi ninyɛndane.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Na menwunle kɛ raalɛ ne ɛbo. Nyamenle menli ne nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nɔhalɛlilɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gyisɛse anu la ati bɛhunle bɛ la mogya mɔɔ ɔnlonle la a ɛmaa yebo zɔhane a. Menwunle ye la, ɔzinle me nwo.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne bizale me kɛ, “Duzu ati a ɛhye ɛzi ɛ nwo ɛ? Mebahile wɔ raalɛ ne, nee nane ati nsuu ne mɔɔ lɛ mɛne bulu ne mɔɔ ɔde zolɛ la abo.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Nane ne mɔɔ ɔde zolɛ la anrɛɛ de aze, na kɛkala yewu. Na ɔvi azɛlɛ kuma ne mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ bo la anu ɔbavinde yeahɔ yeamaa bɛazɛkye ye. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewiade ye anu na bɛangɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ teasema buluku ne anu, kolaa na bɛabɔ ewiade la nwu nane ne a ɔbayɛ bɛ azibɛnwo kɛ mekɛ bie ɛnee nane ne de aze, na kɛkala yewu, na eza ɔbavinde yeara bieko a.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Ɛhye hyia maa nrɛlɛbɛ nee ndelebɛbo. Adile nsuu ne le awoka nsuu mɔɔ raalɛ ne de zolɛ a. Eza bɛle arelemgbunli nsuu:

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: nuhua nnu ɛbɔ aze, ko tɛdi ye belemgbunli ne, yɛɛ ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la bɔ zo mɔɔ bara a. Saa ɔba a, ɔnrɛli agyinla biala.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na nane ne mɔɔ mekɛ bie ɛnee de aze, na kɛkala yewu la a le belemgbunli ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ mɔtwɛ la; na ɔdaye noko ɔbara yeamaa bɛazɛkye ye kɛ arelemgbunli nsuu ne mɔ la.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Mɛne bulu ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle bɛ la le arelemgbunli bulu mɔɔ ɛtɛbɔle bɛ belemgbunlililɛ bo a; bɛbamaa bɛ adenle bɛamaa bɛ nee nane ne ali belemgbunli dɔnehwele ko ala.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Bɛdabɛ bulu ne bɛ muala bɛlɛ adwenle ko, yɛɛ bɛfa bɛ tumi ne nee bɛ belemgbunlililɛ ne bɛmaa nane ne.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Bɛ nee Boaneralɛ ne baho; na Boaneralɛ ne bali bɛ nwo zo konim, ɔboalekɛ ɔle awulae mɔ Awulae yɛɛ ɔle arelemgbunli Belemgbunli. Menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la bɛkpa nu bɛye bɛ, yɛɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ a.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne eza zele me kɛ, “Azule ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛnwunle kɛ tuutuunli ne de ɔ nloa la le maanle maanle, menli, aneɛ ngakyile, yɛɛ mbusua kɔsɔɔti.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Mɛne bulu ne mɔɔ ɛnwunle bɛ la, nee nane ne bakpɔ tuutuunli ne; bɛbalie debie biala mɔɔ ɔlɛ la bɛamaa yealɛ ɔ nwo zɔ; bɛbali ye nwonane ne na bɛado ye senle nu bɛayela ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: na ɔbahɔ yeahɔbɛlɛbɛla maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ aleɛabo la amuala, meka Gɔgo nee Magɔgo, na ɔ nee bɛ ahɔ konle. Bɛ somaa bayɛ kɛ ɛnweazo anwea.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Bɛzile nu bɛhɔle azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala na bɛbɔle bɛyiale ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle menli ne de nee suakpole ne mɔɔ Nyamenle anye die nwolɛ la. Na senle vi anwuma razɛkyele bɛ.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Na bɛvuandinle Abɔnsam ne mɔɔ rabɛlɛbɛlale bɛ la bɛdole sendɔlɔra nee sɔlefa tandane ne mɔɔ bɛguale nane ne nee ye kpɔmanvolɛ alane ne nu la anu; na bɛbahile bɛ nyane alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Ndɛnebualɛ mɔɔ li amozi

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle Belemgbunli ne nee ye belemgbunli ebia fufule ne mɔɔ ɔde zolɛ la. Anwuma nee azɛlɛ minliminlinle ɔ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne na bɛannwu bɛ bieko.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Na menwunle mɔwuamra, mgbole nee ngyikyi kɔsɔɔti, kɛ bɛgyigyi belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anyunlu, na bɛbukebuke mbuluku nu wɔ ɛkɛ. Eza bɛbukele teasema buluku ne noko anu, na bɛbuale mɔwuamra ndɛne wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle na bɛhɛlɛ bɛ wɔ mbuluku ne mɔ anu la anwo.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Nyevile kpule menli mɔɔ yeva bɛ la. Ewule nee Ɛbolɔ yele bɛ ɛdeɛ mɔɔ bɛvale bɛziele la vindele, na bɛbuale bɛ muala ndɛne wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la anwo.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Akee bɛvuandinle Ewule nee Ɛbolɔ bɛguale senle tandane ne anu. Senle ɛhye a le ewule ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Awie biala mɔɔ bɛangɛlɛ ye duma wɔ teasema buluku ne anu la, bɛvuandinle ye bɛdole senle tandane ne anu.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Akee menwunle anwuma fofolɛ nee azɛlɛ fofolɛ. Ɔluakɛ alumua anwuma ne nee alumua azɛlɛ ne ɛze ɛhɔ, na nyevile ne ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Mendele ɛnelɛ kpole bie wɔ belemgbunli ebia kpole ne anwo, ɔse, “Kɛkala, akee Nyamenle sua nu a le ye menli avinli. Ɔ nee bɛ badɛnla na bɛayɛ ye menli. Nyamenle mumua ne nee bɛ badɛnla na yeayɛ bɛ Nyamenle.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Ɔbakyikyi bɛ nye anwo monle. Ewule ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko, monle ɛnle ɛkɛ, nyane ɛnle ɛkɛ, ɛzunlɛ ɛnle ɛkɛ ne bieko. Ɔluakɛ alumua ninyɛne ne mɔ ɛze ɛhɔ.”

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na mɔɔ de belemgbunli ebia kpole ne azo la hanle kɛ, “Kɛkala, meyɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti fofolɛ!” Eza ɔzele me kɛ, “Kɛlɛ ɛhye, ɔluakɛ edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ le nɔhalɛ yɛɛ bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛto zolɛ a ɔyɛ boɛ.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Bɛwie debie biala yɛ! Mame a mele ‘Alefa’ nee ‘Omiga’ ne a, mɔlebɛbo ne nee awieleɛ ne. Awie mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la mebamaa ye nzubula ne mɔɔ maa ngoane la anu nzule ne bie yeanlo mɔɔ ɔndua ɛhwee a.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ kɛli konim la banyia agyadeɛ ɛhye avi me ɛkɛ: mebayɛ ye Nyamenle na yeayɛ me ra.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na avoanvoanle, menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ diedi, ngunzima, ahɔdiawu, adwɔmanema, nindavoma, awozonle ɛzonlenlɛma, nee adalɛma amuala, bɛ ɛleka a le tandane ne mɔɔ senle nee sɔlefa ɛlɛsɔ nu la anu. Senle tandane ɛhye a le ewule ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la.” Gyɛlusalɛm fofolɛ ne

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛma nsuu ne mɔɔ lɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ dwora nsuu ne la anu ko rale me nwo ɛkɛ na ɔzele me kɛ, “Bɛla maa mengile wɔ Atɔfolɛ ne, mɔɔ le Boaneralɛ ne aye ne.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Sunsum ne wolole me, na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne vale me hɔle boka tendenle bie azo. Ɔhilele me Suakpole Nwuanzanwuanza Gyɛlusalɛm, kɛ ɔvi Nyamenle anwo lɔ anwuma na bɛlɛdwula ye aze,

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: na ɔlɛta wɔ Nyamenle anyunlunyia nu. Sua bɔdenle ne ta memeamemea kɛ ezukoa bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye “gyasepa” la, na ɔ nye le kɔngyekɔngye zɛhae.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛlie nwolɛ bane mɔɔ ye anwumahɔlɛ le tendenle kpalɛ a, ɔlɛ anuhɔlɛ bulu nee nwiɔ, yɛɛ Nyamenle soanvolɛ gyi ko biala anloa. Wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ azo, bɛhɛlɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli bulu nee nwiɔ ne aluma bɛgua zolɛ.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Anuhɔlɛ nsa a wɔ bɛ tɛbanu ko biala a: nsa wɔ adɔleɛ, nsa wɔ aduduleɛ, nsa wɔ nyevile nu, yɛɛ nsa wɔ ɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne bane ne, bɛhyele ye wɔ adiabo awolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ Boaneralɛ ne ɛzoanvolɛma bulu nee nwiɔ ne aluma wɔ nwolɛ la azo.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ dendɛle hilele me la lɛ ezukoa nvutuke baka ɛzuzudeɛ kɛ ɔfa yeazuzu suakpole ne, anuhɔlɛ ne mɔ, yɛɛ ye bane ne mɔ.

translation_verse: Suakpole ne le anianna, ye tɛbanu tɛbanu ne mɔ sɛ, ye tendenle nee ye tɛtɛlɛ sɛ. Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne vale ye baka ɛzuzudeɛ ne zuzule suakpole ne: ɔnyianle ye tendenle nu kilomita apenle nwiɔ, ɛya nna (

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Bɛvale “gyasepa” a bɛdole suakpole ne bane ne a, yɛɛ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ anye le kɛ neanleɛ la a bɛkyekyele sua bɔdenle mumua ne a.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Bɛvale ezukoa awolɛ ngakyile bulu nee nwiɔ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la a bɛyɛle suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ ɛbonle ne mɔ a; asolo ko biala ɛdeɛ. Suakpole ne awɔdenle ne mɔ noko bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ anye le kɔngyekɔngye kɛ neanleɛ la a bɛyɛle a.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Meannwu ɛzonlenlɛ sua wɔ suakpole ne azo, ɔboalekɛ ye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua a le Awulae Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ɔdaye mumua ne nee Boaneralɛ ne.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne azo amra ɛngyia sɛnzɛne anzɛɛ siane nwo, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne a le zolɛ wienyi ne a, yɛɛ Boaneralɛ ne a le ye kɛnlaneɛ a.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti balua ye wienyi ne anu yɛɛ ewiade arelemgbunli bava bɛ anyunlunyia ne ara ɛkɛ.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Suakpole ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ badeda nwolɛ dahuu, bɛnrɛtoto nuhua ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ aleɛ ɛndwo ɛkɛ ne ɛlɛ.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti lɛ bɛ kpoleyɛlɛ nee bɛ anyunlunyia bara suakpole ne azo.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Na debie biala mɔɔ anwo ɛnde la ɛnrɛhɔ suakpole ne azo. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ bɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla na ɔbɔ adalɛ la ɛnrɛhɔ ɛkɛ a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ Boaneralɛ ne teasema buluku ne anu la angome a bahɔ suakpole ne azo a.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne eza hilele me nzule ne mɔɔ maa ngoane la azudenle ne. Ɔ nye le kɔngyekɔngye kɛ neanleɛ, na ɔse ɔvi Nyamenle nee Boaneralɛ ne belemgbunli ebia kpole ne abo,

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: ɔdua suakpole ne awɔdenle ne mɔɔ la sua ne avinli la azo. Ngoane baka ne ɛfifi azudenle ne anloa nwiɔ ne, na bɛso ma ngakyile fane bulu nee nwiɔ ɛvolɛ ko biala; siane ko biala ɔso ko, na bɛ nya ne mɔ maa maanle maanle ne mɔ ngoane.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Debie biala mɔɔ Nyamenle anye ɛnlie nwolɛ la ɛnle suakpole ne azo. Nyamenle nee Boaneralɛ ne belemgbunli ebia kpole ne wɔ suakpole ne azo, na ye sonvolɛma sonle ye.

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: Bɛnwu ɔ nyunlu, yɛɛ ye duma wɔ bɛ nwoma azo.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Aleɛ ɛndwo ko wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛngyia kɛnlaneɛ anzɛɛ ewia nwo wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne a le bɛ kɛnlaneɛ a, na bɛbali belemgbunli mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. Gyisɛse ɛralɛ ne

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Na Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne zele me kɛ, “Edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ le nɔhalɛ na bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula nu a ɔyɛ boɛ. Awulae Nyamenle ne mɔɔ fa ye Sunsum ne wula ye kpɔmanvolɛma la yɛɛ ɛzoa ye soanvolɛma ne mɔ anu ko kɛ ɔraye mɔɔ ɛnrɛhyɛ biala na yeazi la ɔhile ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ a.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Na Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Bɛdie, ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara!” Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛli Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la azo la.

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Medame Dwɔn a mendele na menwunle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala a. Na mendiele na menwunle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ menwiele la, mendule mendɔle Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhilehile me ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ la agyakɛ anu kɛ mesonle ye.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Mmayɛ! Medame mele sonvolɛ kɛ ɛdawɔ nee ɛ mediema Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la azo la. Sonle Nyamenle na mmasonle me!”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Eza ɔzele me kɛ, “Mmafa Nyamenle edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la ɛfea, ɔluakɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛha na ɛhye azi la le ekyi.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Mɔɔ le musuɔfoɔ la ɛhɔ zo ɛyɛ ye munzule ninyɛne ne, mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane la ɛhɔ zo ɛyɛ. Mɔɔ le kpalɛ noko la ɛhɔ zo ɛyɛ ye ahunlunyele gyima ne, yɛɛ mɔɔ anwo te nwuanzaanwu la ɛhɔ zo ɛyɛ nwuanzanwuanza.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: Gyisɛse zele kɛ, “Bɛdie! Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara! Melɛ me sa nu ahatualɛ mebara na mearadua awie biala kakɛ wɔ gyima mɔɔ yeli la anwo.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Mame a mele ‘Alefa’ nee ‘Omiga’ ne a, mɔlebɛbo ne nee awieleɛ ne.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo bɛ ndanlɛ ne mɔ bɔkɔbɔkɔ na ɔlua zolɛ bɛnyia adenle bɛli ngoane baka ne ma ne bie, na bɛwolo bɛhɔ suakpole ne azo la.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Wɔ suakpole ne kandiba lɔ, amumuyɛma, ahɔdiawu, ngonyiayelɛma, adwɔmanema, awozonle ɛzonlenlɛma, yɛɛ adalɛma wɔ nyɛleɛ nee ɛdendɛlɛ nu la a wɔ ɛkɛ ne a.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Medame Gyisɛse, yɛɛ mezoa me soanvolɛ kɛ ɔrabɔ ɛhye mɔ nolo ɔhile bɛ wɔ asɔne ne mɔ ati a. Mele Devidi anlɔnra; mame a mele nwonlomɔ ɛwɔlɔra ne mɔɔ ta kpole la a.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Na Sunsum ne nee Atɔfolɛ ne se, “Bɛla!” Awie mɔɔ kɛde la ɔdaye ɔha kɛ, “Bɛla!” Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku bɛ la, bɛrɛla bɛralie nzule mɔɔ maa ngoane la bɛnlo. Ɔle ahyɛlɛdeɛ, bɛndɔ. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la, bɛranlo bie. Adwulaleɛ

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Medame Dwɔn, mekakye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛde Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la ɛsesebɛ kɛ: saa awie fa bie boka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye anwo a, Nyamenle bava amaneɛnwunlɛ ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la bie aboka ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nwo.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Saa awie noko ye bie fi Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la anu a, Nyamenle baye ye afoa nu ngoane baka ne nee ye ɛleka ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne azo, mɔɔ bɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la avi ɛkɛ.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Sonla ne mɔɔ di ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anwo daselɛ la se, “Nɔhalɛ, ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meara!” Amen! Awulae Gyisɛse, bɛla!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Awulae Gyisɛse ɛlo Nyamenle menli ne amuala na ɔ nee bɛ ɛdɛnla. Amen.
